instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथस्तदा। इदं धर्मार्थसहितं श्लक्ष्णंवचनमब्रवीत्।।1.8.7।।
output: Virtuous king Dasaratha paid homage to them (the ministers) and uttered these gracious, righteous and meaningful words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 8:
मम लालप्यमानस्य पुत्रार्थन्नास्ति वै सुखम्। तदर्थं हयमेधेन यक्ष्यामीति मतिर्मम।।1.8.8।।
output: There is no happiness for one who has no son. This is the cause of my intense suffering. Therefore, I have made up my mind to perform a horsesacrifice.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदहं यष्टुमिच्छामि शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा। कथं प्राप्स्याम्यहं कामं बुद्धिरत्रविचार्यताम्।।1.8.9।।
output: Therefore, I intend to perform a horsesacrifice in accordance with the scriptures. How  can I fulfil my desire in this regard? You may deliberate and find a solution".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्साध्विति तद्वाक्यं ब्राह्मणा: प्रत्यपूजयन्। वसिष्ठप्रमुखास्सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखाच्च्युतम्।।1.8.10।।
output: तत: then, वसिष्ठप्रमुखा: vasishta etc, ब्राह्मणा: brahmins, सर्वे all, पार्थिवस्य king's, मुखात् from the mouth, च्युतम् delivered, तत् वाक्यम् those words, साधु इति well said, प्रत्यपूजयन् extolled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऊचुश्च परमप्रीतास्सर्वे दशरथं वच:। सम्भारास्सम्भ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्।।1.8.11।।
output: सर्वे all of them, परमप्रीता: highly pleased, दशरथम् addressing king Dasaratha, वच: words, ऊचुश्च also spoke, सम्भारा: requisite articles, सम्भ्रियन्ताम् be collected, ते your, तुरगश्च  horse also, विमुच्यताम् be released.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रानभिप्रेतांश्च पार्थिव। यस्य ते धार्मिकी बुद्धिरियं पुत्रार्थमागता।।1.8.12।।
output: पार्थिव O King, यस्य ते since to you, पुत्रार्थम् for sons, इयम् this, धार्मिकी just and right, बुद्धि:  mind, आगता arose, अभिप्रेतान् desired ones, सर्वथा by all means, प्राप्स्यसे you will obtain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत: प्रीतोऽभवद्राजा श्रुत्वा तद्विजभाषितम्। अमात्यांश्चाब्रवीद्राजा हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षण:।।1.8.13।।
output: तत: thereafter, राजा king, तत् द्विजभाषितम् those brahmin's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रीत: अभवत् was pleased, राजा king, हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षण: with eyes excited with delight, अमात्यान् ministers, अब्रवीत् informed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 8:
सम्भारास्सम्भ्रियन्तां मे गुरूणां वचनादिह। समर्थाधिष्ठितश्चाश्वस्सोपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम्।।1.8.14।।
output: "Let the  articles required (for performing the sacrifice) be procured in accordance with the words of my spiritual preceptors and the horse be released under the protection of able men.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्। शान्तयश्चाभिवर्धन्तां यथाकल्पं यथाविधि।।1.8.15।।
output: On the northern bank of  Sarayu, a sacrificial pavillion be prepared according to the  methods ordained in the 'Kalpa'. Auspicious rites be performed in accordance with the ordinance for its uninterrupted completion.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शक्य: प्राप्तुमयं यज्ञस्सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता। नापराधो भवेत्कष्टो यद्यस्मिन्क्रतुसत्तमे।।1.8.16।।
output: अस्मिन् in this, क्रतुसत्तमे best of sacifices, कष्ट: difficulties, अपराध: omissions, न भवेत् यदि  does not happen, अयं यज्ञ: this sacrifice, सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता indeed by every king, प्राप्तुम् to obtain, शक्य: possible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 8:
छिद्रं हि मृगयन्तेऽत्र विद्वांसो ब्रह्मराक्षसा: । निहतस्य च यज्ञस्य सद्य: कर्ता विनश्यति ।।1.8.17।।
output: The learned brahmarakshasas always look out for flaws in the sacrifice so that they can spoil it. If a flaw finds place, the doer of the sacrifice is immediately destroyed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्यथा विधिपूर्वं मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते । तथा विधानं क्रियतां समर्था: करणेष्विह।।1.8.18।।
output: Therefore let the arrangements be made in a manner this sacifice is completed in accordance with the scriptures. And in this, you are experts".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथेति चाब्रुवन्सर्वे मन्त्रिण:प्रत्यपूजयन्। पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तद्वाक्यं यथाज्ञप्तं निशम्य ते।।1.8.19।।
output: Having heard these words of this Indra on earth (king Dasaratha) all the ministers with due respect replied: "May it be as ordered".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथा द्विजास्ते धर्मज्ञा वर्धयन्तो नृपोत्तमम्। अनुज्ञातास्ततस्सर्वे पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्।।1.8.20।।
output: Bowing to this best of kings (Dasaratha), all the brahmins who were experts in austerities left all the knowledgeable brahmins as they camewith his permission.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 8:
विसर्जयित्वा तान्विप्रान्सचिवानिदमब्रवीत्। ऋत्विग्भिरुपदिष्टोऽयं यथावत्क्रतुराप्यताम्।।1.8.21।।
output: After sending away the brahmins, the king said to his ministers: "Let this sacrifice be performed as enjoined by scriptures and as directed by the officiating priests".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 8:
इत्युक्त्वा नृपशार्दूलस्सचिवान्समुपस्थितान्। विसर्जयित्वा स्वं वेश्म प्रविवेश महाद्युति:।।1.8.22।।
output: Having thus ordered his ministers sitting nearby, sent this highly brilliant, this preeminent among kings them away and entered the inner apartment.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 8:
ततस्स गत्वा ता:पत्नीर्नरेन्द्रो हृदयप्रिया:। उवाच दीक्षां विशत यक्ष्येऽहं सुतकारणात्।।1.8.23।।
output: Thereafter the king said to his dearest wives: "I intend to perform a sacrifice in order to obtain sons. Therefore, you, too, commence religious discipline."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तासां तेनातिकान्तेन वचनेन सुवर्चसाम्। मुखपद्मान्यशोभन्त पद्मानीव हिमात्यये।।1.8.24।।
output: On listening to these exceedingly charming words, their bright countenances shone resplendent like lotuses after the departure of winter. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा रहस्सूतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्। ऋत्विग्भिरुपदिष्टोऽयं पुरावृत्तो मया श्रुत:।।1.9.1।।
output: एतत् this matter, श्रुत्वा having heard, सूत: king's charioteer, राजानम् addressing king, रह:  in privacy, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, ऋत्विग्भिः by officiating priests, उपदिष्ट: advised, अयम् this solution, पुरा ancient, वृत्त: happened, मया श्रुत: heard by me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्पूर्वं कथितवान्कथाम्। ऋषीणां सन्निधौ राजन् तव पुत्रागमं प्रति।।1.9.2।।
output: "O king, the divine Sanatkumara had narrated a story about your posterity in the presence of sages.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
काश्यपस्यतु पुत्रोऽस्ति विभण्डक इति श्रुत:। ऋष्यशृङ्ग इति ख्यातस्तस्य पुत्रो भविष्यति।।1.9.3।।
output: Kasyapa has a famous son named Vibhandaka. It was prophesied that he would have a son named Rsyasringa.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
स वने नित्यसंवृद्धो मुनिर्वनचरस्सदा । नान्यं जानाति विप्रेन्द्रो नित्यं पित्रनुवर्तनात् ।।1.9.4।।
output: Grown up in the forest and always moving with his father, that sage knows none other than his father.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्वैविध्यं ब्रह्मचर्यस्य भविष्यति महात्मन:। लोकेषु प्रथितं राजन्विप्रैश्च कथितं सदा।।1.9.5।।
output: राजन् O King, महात्मन: eminet one, लोकेषु in the worlds, प्रथितम् celebrated, सदा always, विप्रै: by brahmins, कथितम् described, ब्रह्मचर्यस्य of Brahmacharya (life of celebacy), द्वैविध्यम्  twofold, भविष्यति will happen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य कालस्समभिवर्तत । अग्निं शुश्रूषमाणस्य पितरं च यशस्विनम्।।1.9.6।।
output: अग्निम् firegod, यशस्विनम् enowned, पितरम् च his father also, शुश्रूषमाणस्य while attending, एवम् in this manner, वर्तमानस्य living, तस्य for him, काल: time, समभिवर्तत will be spent.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु रोमपाद: प्रतापवान्। अङ्गेषु प्रथितो राजा भविष्यति महाबल:।। 1.9.7।।
output: At this time a powerful king Romapada, mighty and celebrated would be living in the country of Anga.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
तस्य व्यतिक्रमाद्राज्ञो भविष्यति सुदारुणा । अनावृष्टिस्सुघोरा वै सर्वभूतभयावहा ।।1.9.8।।
output: Because of violation of code of conduct by the king, a terrible, dreadful drought frightening all living beings will set in the kingdom.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनावृष्ट्यां तु वृत्तायां राजा दु:खसमन्वित:। ब्राह्मणान्श्रुतवृद्धांश्च समानीय प्रवक्ष्यति।। 1.9.9।।
output: अनावृष्ट्याम् when drought, वृत्तायाम् will be prevailing, राजा king, दु:खसमन्वित: filled with grief, श्रुतवृद्धान् men who grow old by learning, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, समानीय summoning,  प्रवक्ष्यति will say.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
भवन्तश्श्रुतधर्माणो लोकचारित्रवेदिन: । समादिशन्तु नियमं प्रायश्चित्तं यथा भवेत् ।।1.9.10।।
output: भवन्त: all of you, श्रुतधर्माण: are conversant in duties (enjoined by scriptures), लोकचारित्रवेदिन: wellversed in the ways of the world, यथा in whichever manner, प्रायश्चित्तम् expiation, भवेत् happens, नियमम् religious observance, समादिशन्तु instruct.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
वक्ष्यन्ति ते महीपालं ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगा:। विभण्डकसुतं राजन्सर्वोपायैरिहानय।।1.9.11।।
output: Those brahmins versed in the Vedas, said, to 'O king bring here Rsyasringa, son of the sage Vibhandaka by all means'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
आनाय्य च महीपाल ऋश्यशृङ्गं सुसत्कृतम्। प्रयच्छ कन्यां शान्तां वै विधिना सुसमाहित: ।।1.9.12।।
output: "O monarch, on having brought Rsyasringa here, honour him, and offer him your daughter Santa with due reverence.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा चिन्तां प्रपत्स्यते । केनोपायेन वै शक्य इहानेतुं स वीर्यवान् ।।1.9.13।।
output: On hearing their words, the king in a thoughtful mood said, 'How can the mighty sage be brought here'?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो राजा विनिश्चित्य सह मन्त्रिभिरात्मवान्। पुरोहितममात्यांश्च तत: प्रेष्यति सत्कृतान्।।1.9.14।।
output: Thereafter the confident king, having decided, in consultation with his ministers to bring him (Rsyasringa), sent the priest with the counsellors on this mission.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
ते तु राज्ञो वचश्श्रुशृत्वा व्यथिता विनतानना:। न गच्छेम ऋषेर्भीता अनुनेष्यन्ति तं नृपम् ।। 1.9.15।।
output: On hearing the king's words, distressed and frightened by rishi's power, they   appealed to the king, faces bent down, 'We will not go'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वक्ष्यन्ति चिन्तयित्वा ते तस्योपायांश्च तत्क्षमान्। आनेष्यामो वयं विप्रं न च दोषो भविष्यति।। 1.9.16।।
output: After thinking  about the means to be employed to bring the rishi to the court, they told him they would bring the sage if they are not to blame (in case anything untoward happens).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमङ्गाधिपेनैव गणिकाभि: ऋषेस्सुत:। आनीतोऽवर्षयद्देवश्शान्ता चास्मै प्रदीयते।।1.9.17।।
output: एवम् in this way, अङ्गाधिपेन by the king of Anga region, Romapada, गणिकाभि: with the help of courtesans, ऋषे: सुत: son of sage Vibhandaka, आनीत: was brought, देव: god (Indra), अवर्षयत् poured rains, अस्मै for Rsyasringa, शान्ता Shanta, प्रदीयते च will be offered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
ऋश्यशृङ्गस्तु जामाता पुत्रांस्तव विधास्यति। सनत्कुमारकथितमेतावद्व्याहृतं मया।।1.9.18।।
output: 'Risyasringa, your soninlaw, would help you to obtain sons'. Thus said Sanathkumara which I have related to you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 9:
अथ हृष्टो दशरथस्सुमन्त्रं प्रत्यभाषत। यथर्श्यशृङ्गस्त्वानीतो विस्तरेण त्वयोच्यताम्।।1.9.19।।
output: Thereupon Dasaratha, pleased, (with him), said to Sumantra, "Describe in detail the  means by which Rsyasringa was brought (to the court of Romapada)". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे नवमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana of the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
सुमन्त्रश्चोदितो राज्ञा प्रोवाचेदं वचस्तदा। यथर्श्यशृङ्गस्त्वानीत श्श्रुणु मे मन्त्रिभिस्सह।।1.10.1।।
output: Thus prompted by king Dasaratha, Sumantra said,  "I shall relate to you the manner in which Rsyasringa was brought to the court. Listen to me along with your ministers".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रोमपादमुवाचेदं सहामात्य: पुरोहित:। उपायो निरपायोऽयमस्माभिरभिचिन्तित:।। 1.10.2।।
output: सहामात्य: along with ministers, पुरोहित: the priest, रोमपादम् to Romapada, इदम् these words, उवाच addressed, अस्माभि: by us, निरपाय: without danger, अयम् this, उपाय: plan, अभिचिन्तित: is thought over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
ऋश्यशृङ्गो वनचरस्तपस्स्वाध्ययने रत:। अनभिज्ञस्स नारीणां विषयाणां सुखस्य च।1.10.3।।
output: "Rsyasringa, residing in the forest, is engrossed in the study of the Vedas. He is not acquainted with women and sensual pleasures.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इन्द्रियार्थैरभिमतैर्नरचित्तप्रमाथिभि: । पुरमानाययिष्याम: क्षिप्रं चाध्यवसीयताम्।। 1.10.4।।
output: नरचित्तप्रमाथिभि: overpowering the minds of men, अभिमतै: dear, इन्द्रियार्थै: with sensual  pleasures, पुरम् town, आनाययिष्याम: we will prompt him to come over, क्षिप्रम् quickly, अध्यवसीयताम् may it be determined.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
गणिकास्तत्र गच्छन्तु रूपवत्यस्स्वलङ्कृता:। प्रलोभ्य विविधोपायैरानेष्यन्तीह सत्कृता:।।1.10.5।।
output: Beautiful and welladorned courtesans, may be sent there. They will allure him by various means and honourably bring him here.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्रुत्वा तथेति राजा च प्रत्युवाच पुरोहितम्। पुरोहितो मन्त्रिणश्च तथा चक्रुश्च ते तदा।।1.10.6।।
output: The king, having listened to these words, conveyed his approval saying, 'Let it be done that way'. The priests and ministers acted accordingly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
वारमुख्याश्च तच्छ्रुत्वा वनं प्रविविशुर्महत्। आश्रमस्याविदूरेऽस्मिन् यत्नं कुर्वन्ति दर्शने।।1.10.7।। ऋषिपुत्रस्य धीरस्य नित्यमाश्रमवासिन:।
output: Having heard this, beautiful courtesans entered the great forest and remaining at a  place not far from the hermitage made efforts to steal a sight of this son of a sage (Rsyasringa), this forest dweller, this controller of the senses.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
पितुस्सनित्यसन्तुष्टो नातिचक्राम चाश्रमात्।।1.10.8।। न तेन जन्मप्रभृति दृष्टपूर्वं तपस्विना। स्त्री वा पुमान्वा यच्चान्यत्सर्वं नगरराष्ट्रजम्।। 1.10.9।।
output: He (Rsyasringa) was always content and never stirred out of his father's hermitage. Absorbed in penance he had never seen  a woman or a man nor any of the creatures born in towns or cities right from his birth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पितुस्सनित्यसन्तुष्टो नातिचक्राम चाश्रमात्।।1.10.8।। न तेन जन्मप्रभृति दृष्टपूर्वं तपस्विना। स्त्री वा पुमान्वा यच्चान्यत्सर्वं नगरराष्ट्रजम्।। 1.10.9।।
output: He (Rsyasringa) was always content and never stirred out of his father's hermitage. Absorbed in penance he had never seen  a woman or a man nor any of the creatures born in towns or cities right from his birth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत: कदाचित्तं देशमाजगाम यदृच्छया। विभण्डकसुतस्तत्र ताश्चापश्यद्वराङ्गना:।।1.10.10।।
output: One day this son of Vibhandaka (Rsyasringa) accidentally came to the place where he saw the beautiful women.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
ताश्चित्रवेषा: प्रमदा गायन्त्यो मधुरस्वरा:। ऋषिपुत्रमुपागम्य सर्वा वचनमब्रुवन्।। 1.10.11।।
output: Those wonderfully attired women singing with sweet voices approached the son of the sage (Rsyasringa) and said:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कस्त्वं किं वर्तसे ब्रह्मन् ज्ञातुमिच्छामहे वयम्। एकस्त्वं विजने घोरे वने चरसि शंस न:।। 1.10.12।।
output: 'O brahman Who are you? How are you subsisting? We wish to know why you are roaming alone in this dreadful forest? Could you tell us.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अदृष्टरूपास्तास्तेन काम्यरूपा वने स्त्रिय:। हार्दात्तस्य मतिर्जाता व्याख्यातुं पितरं स्वकम्।।1.10.13।।
output: काम्यरूपा: women of charming appearance, ता: स्त्रिय: those women, तेन by him, वने in the forest, अदृष्टरूपा: whose forms were never seen before, हार्दात् due to affection, तस्य for him, स्वकं पितरम्  about his father, व्याख्यातुम् narrating, मति: intention, जाता arose.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पिता विभण्डकोऽस्माकं तस्याहं सुत औरस:। ऋश्यशृङ्ग इति ख्यातं नाम कर्म च मे भुवि।।1.10.14।।
output: विभण्डक: Vibhandaka, अस्माकम् our, पिता father, अहम् I, तस्य his, औरस: सुत: his own son, मे my, ऋश्यशृङ्ग Rsyasringa, इति thus, नाम name, कर्म च through result of an action (having one horn on his head), भुवि world over, ख्यातम् is known.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इहाश्रमपदोऽस्माकं समीपे शुभदर्शना:। करिष्ये वोऽत्र पूजां वै सर्वेषां विधिपूर्वकम्।।1.10.15।।
output: शुभदर्शना: O auspicious looking women, अस्माकम् our, आश्रमपद: hermitage, इह here, समीपे nearby, अत्र here, व: सर्वेषाम् to all of you, पूजाम् hospitable reception, विधिपूर्वकम् according to scriptural injunctions, करिष्ये I will extend.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
ऋषिपुत्रवचश्श्रुत्वा सर्वासां मतिरास वै। तदाश्रमपदं द्रष्टुं जग्मुस्सर्वाश्च तेन ता:।। 1.10.16।।
output: After listening to the words of the sage's son (Rsyasringa), all the beautiful women with a desire to see the hermitage  accompanied him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आगतानां तत: पूजामृषिपुत्रश्चकार ह। इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यमिदं मूलमिदं फलं च न:।।1.10.17।।
output: तत: thereafter, ऋषिपुत्र: son of ascetic, इदम् this one, न: our, अर्घ्यम् respectable offerings, इदम् this, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, इदम् this, मूलम् roots, फलं च fruits also, आगतानाम् for all those who have come, पूजाम् homage, चकार ह performed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रतिगृह्य च तां पूजां सर्वा एव समुत्सुका:। ऋषेर्भीताश्च शीघ्रं ता गमनाय मतिं दधु:।।1.10.18।।
output: The anxious courtesans received the offerings and afraid of the ascetic's return, made up their minds to withdraw immediately.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
अस्माकमपि मुख्यानि फलानीमानि वै द्विज । गृहाण प्रति भद्रं ते भक्षयस्व च मा चिरम्।।1.10.19।।
output: 'O brahmin, these are excellent fruits. May prosperity be to you. Accept them and eat them without delay.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
ततस्तास्तं समालिङ्ग्य सर्वा हर्षसमन्विता:। मोदकान्प्रददुस्तस्मै भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् बहून्।।1.10.20।।
output: Then, all the courtesans embracing him with joy, offered plentiful sweetmeats and various items of food.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तानि चास्वाद्य तेजस्वी फलानीति स्म मन्यते। अनास्वादितपूर्वाणि वने नित्यनिवासिनाम्।।1.10.21।।
output: तेजस्वी Rsyasringa, possessing the lustre of Brahma, वने in the forest, नित्यनिवासिनाम् of  those who are always residing in the forest, अनास्वादितपूर्वाणि which were not tasted earlier, तानि them, आस्वाद्य having tasted, फलानि इति as fruits, मन्यते स्म thought about them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
आपृच्छ्य च तदा विप्रं व्रतचर्यां निवेद्य च। गच्छन्ति स्मापदेशात्ता भीतास्तस्य पितुस्स्त्रिय:।।1.10.22।।
output: The ladies apprehensive of (the arrival of) his father took leave of him on the pretext of  observance of (evening) rites.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गतासु तासु सर्वासु काश्यपस्यात्मजो द्विज:। अस्वस्थहृदयश्चासीद्दु:खं स्म परिवर्तते।।1.10.23।।
output: तासु सर्वासु when all of them, गतासु (सतीषु ) having departed, काश्यपस्य Kasyapa's, आत्मज: son, द्विज: brahmin, अस्वस्थहृदय: restless in mind, आसीत् remained, दु:खम्  sorrow, परिवर्तते स्म moved him around.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽपरेद्युस्तं देशमाजगाम स वीर्यवान्। मनोज्ञा यत्र ता दृष्टा वारमुख्यास्स्वलङ्कृताः।।1.10.24।।
output: On the following day, the sage armed with the power of penance, came to the place where he had seen those enticing, welladorned courtesans.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्ट्वैव च तास्तदा विप्रमायान्तं हृष्टमानसा:। उपसृत्य ततस्सर्वास्तास्तमूचुरिदं वच:।।1.10.25।।
output: All of them were rejoiced on seeing the brahmin approaching them, came nearer to him and said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
एह्याश्रमपदं सौम्य ह्यस्माकमिति चाब्रुवन्। तत्राप्येष विधिश्श्रीमान् विशेषेण भविष्यति।।1.10.26।।
output: 'O handsome one, come to our hermitage. A special, sumptuous hospitality will be extended to you', they said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तासां सर्वासां हृदयङ्गमम्। गमनाय मतिं चक्रे तं च निन्युस्तदा स्त्रिय:।।1.10.27।।
output: Having heard their words pleasing to the mind, he agreed to go with them. And the women took him away.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
तत्र चानीयमाने तु विप्रे तस्मिन्महात्मनि। ववर्ष सहसा देवो जगत्प्रह्लादयंस्तदा।।1.10.28।।
output: As the illustrious sage was being brought (to Anga) the god of rain (Parjanya) suddenly inundated the earth which looked cherful (with rain).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
वर्षेणैवागतं विप्रं विषयं स्वं नराधिप:। प्रत्युद्गम्य मुनिं प्रह्वश्शिरसा च महीं गत:।।1.10.29।।
output: The king (Romapada) went out to welcome the ascetic, the brahmin who brought along with him rains to his country. He humbly bowed down his head and prostrated before him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्घ्यं च प्रददौ तस्मै न्यायतस्सुसमाहित:। वव्रे प्रसादं विप्रेन्द्रान्मा विप्रं मन्युराविशेत्।।1.10.30।।
output: सुसमाहित: concentrating his mind, तस्मै to him, अर्घ्यम् च offerings, न्यायत: righteously, प्रददौ gave, विप्रेन्द्रात् from the brahmin (Rsyasringa), प्रसादम् favour, वव्रे sought, विप्रम् sage Vibhandaka, मन्यु: anger, आविशेत् did not pervade.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 10:
अन्त:पुरं प्रविश्यास्मै कन्यां दत्त्वा यथाविधि। शान्तां शान्तेन मनसा राजा हर्षमवाप स:।।1.10.31।। एवं स न्यवसत्तत्र सर्वकामैस्सुपूजित:।
output: The king entered the inner apartment, duly offered him his daughter Shanta in marriage and experienced peace and satisfaction. Thus he (Rsyasringa) lived there, with all his desires fulfilled" (said Sumantra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे दशमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 11:
भूय एव हि राजेन्द्र शृणु मे वचनं हितम्। यथा स देवप्रवर: कथायामेवमब्रवीत्।।1.11.1।।
output: "Great king, I shall tell you the way Sanatkumara, great among the celestials further narrated the story. Listen to my words which may prove useful to you (said Sumantra)".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गराजेन सख्यं च तस्य राज्ञो भविष्यति। कन्या चास्य महाभागा शान्ता नाम भविष्यति।।1.11.3।।
output: That king (Dasaratha) will develop friendship with the king of Anga. A highly virtuous daughter named Santa will be born to  king of Anga.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुत्रस्तु सोऽङ्गराजस्य रोमपाद इति श्रुत:। तं स राजा दशरथो गमिष्यति महायशा:।।1.11.4।।
output: स:अङ्गराज्यस्य पुत्रस्तु that Anga king's son, रोमपाद इति Romapada by name, श्रुत:will be wellknown, महायशा: very famous, स: that, राजा king (Dasaratha), तम् him, गमिष्यति will approach.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनपत्योऽस्मि धर्मात्मन् शान्ताभर्ता मम क्रतुम्। आहरेत त्वयाज्ञप्तस्सन्तानार्थं कुलस्य च।।1.11.5।।
output: धर्मात्मन् O Follower of righteousness, अनपत्य: अस्मि I am without children, शान्ताभर्ता husband of Shanta, त्वया by you, आज्ञप्त: ordered, मम my, कुलस्य of race, सन्तानार्थम् for the sake of children (for perpetuation of my race), क्रतुम् sacrifice, आहरेत he may perform.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रुत्वा राज्ञोऽथ तद्वाक्यं मनसा स विचिन्त्य च। प्रदास्यते पुत्रवन्तं शान्ताभर्तारमात्मवान्।।1.11.6।।
output: आत्मवान् prudent and wise, राज्ञ: king's, तद्वाक्यम् that statement, श्रुत्वा having heard, अथ thereafter, स: he, मनसा विचिन्त्य च after thinking over deeply in the mind, पुत्रवन्तम् him who has sons, शान्ताभर्तारम् husband of Shanta, प्रदास्यते will offer.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रतिगृह्य च तं विप्रं स राजा विगतज्वर:। आहरिष्यति तं यज्ञं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना।।1.11.7।।
output: स: राजा that king, तं विप्रम् that brahmin, प्रतिगृह्य च having received (along with him), विगतज्वर: relieved of his mental suffering, प्रहृष्टेन with highly delighted, अन्तरात्मना heart, तं यज्ञम् that sacrifice, आहरिष्यति will perform.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 11:
तं च राजा दशरथो यष्टुकाम: कृताञ्जलि:। ऋश्यशृङ्गं द्विजश्रेष्ठं वरयिष्यति धर्मवित्।। 1.11.8।। यज्ञार्थं प्रसवार्थं च स्वर्गार्थं च नरेश्वर:। लभते च स तं कामं द्विजमुख्याद्विशांपति:।।1.11.9।।
output: King Dasaratha, lord of the people, and knower of dharma and truth, desirous of performing the sacrifice would ask Rsyasringa, with folded palms for granting a boon to perform a sacrifice in order to obtain children and to attain heaven. The king will get those desires fulfilled through that chief brahmin.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं च राजा दशरथो यष्टुकाम: कृताञ्जलि:। ऋश्यशृङ्गं द्विजश्रेष्ठं वरयिष्यति धर्मवित्।। 1.11.8।। यज्ञार्थं प्रसवार्थं च स्वर्गार्थं च नरेश्वर:। लभते च स तं कामं द्विजमुख्याद्विशांपति:।।1.11.9।।
output: King Dasaratha, lord of the people, and knower of dharma and truth, desirous of performing the sacrifice would ask Rsyasringa, with folded palms for granting a boon to perform a sacrifice in order to obtain children and to attain heaven. The king will get those desires fulfilled through that chief brahmin.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुत्राश्चास्य भविष्यन्ति चत्वारोऽमितविक्रमा:। वंशप्रतिष्ठानकरास्सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुता:।।1.11.10।।
output: अस्य to him, अमितविक्रमा: men of immense prowess, वंशप्रतिष्ठानकरा: bringing glory and fame to their dynasty, सर्वलोकेषु in all the worlds, विश्रुता: renowned, चत्वार: four, पुत्रा: sons, भविष्यन्ति will be born.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं स देवप्रवर: पूर्वं कथितवान्कथाम्। सनत्कुमारो भगवान्पुरा देवयुगे प्रभु:।।1.11.11।।
output: देवप्रवर: great among devatas, भगवान् holy, प्रभु: competent, स: that, सनत्कुमार: Sanat kumara, पुरा in the early period of, देवयुगे in Krita yuga, कथाम् this story, एवम् in this way, कथितवान् narrated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल तमानय सुसत्कृतम्। स्वयमेव महाराज गत्वा सबलवाहन:।।1.11.12।।
output: पुरुषशार्दूल greatest among men, महाराज O King, स: त्वम्  such a man you are, सबलवाहन: along with his foreces and vehicles, स्वयमेव personally, गत्वा having gone, सुसत्कृतम् wellhonoured, तम् him, आनय bring.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनुमान्य वसिष्ठं च सूतवाक्यं निशम्य च। सान्त:पुरस्सहामात्य: प्रययौ यत्र स द्विज:।।1.11.13।।
output: Having heard the charioteer's words and having obtained the consent of Vasishta, he    along with his queens and courtiers departed to the place where the brahmin (Rsyasringa) resided.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वनानि सरितश्चैव व्यतिक्रम्य शनैश्शनै:। अभिचक्राम तं देशं यत्र वै मुनिपुङ्गव:।।1.11.14।।
output: शनै: शनै: slowly and slowly, वनानि forests, सरितश्चैव rivers, व्यतिक्रम्य crossing, मुनिपुङ्गव: foremost of ascetics, यत्र where he was, तं देशम् that place, अभिचक्राम reached.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आसाद्य तं द्विजश्रेष्ठं रोमपादसमीपगम्। ऋषिपुत्रं ददर्शादौ दीप्यमानमिवानलम्।।1.11.15।।
output: He reached the spot and saw the son of the ascetic, the best of brahmins glowing like fire seated next to Romapada.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो राजा यथान्यायं पूजां चक्रे विशेषत:। सखित्वात्तस्य वै राज्ञ: प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना।।1.11.16।।
output: तत: then, राजा king Romapada, प्रहृष्टेन with delight, अन्तरात्मना in the heart, यथान्यायम् as per tradition, सखित्वात् due to friendship, विशेषत: specially, तस्य of that, राज्ञ: king Dasaratha, पूजाम् respectful salutations, चक्रे offered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रोमपादेन चाख्यातमृषिपुत्राय धीमते। सख्यं सम्बन्धकं चैव तदा तं प्रत्यपूजयत्।।1.11.17।।
output: Romapada explained his friendship and relationship with him (Dasaratha). Rsyasringa of great intellect in return felicitated Dasaratha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 11:
एवं सुसत्कृतस्तेन सहोषित्वा नरर्षभ:। सप्ताष्टदिवसान्राजा राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.11.18।।
output: In this manner, the great among men, the king wellhonoured by Romapada, spent seven or eight days there.And then spoke this to Romapada:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 11:
शान्ता तव सुता राजन् सह भर्त्रा विशांपते। मदीयनगरं यातु कार्यं हि महदुद्यतम्।।1.11.19।।
output: O lord of people, O king, It has been decided to commence an important sacrificial rite. You may send your daughter Santa along with her husband to my city.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथेति राजा संश्रुत्य गमनं तस्य धीमत:। उवाच वचनं विप्रं गच्छ त्वं सह भार्यया।।1.11.20।।
output: राजा king, तथा इति be it so, धीमत: of the wise man, तस्य गमनम्  for his departure, संश्रुत्य having agreed, त्वम् you, भार्यया सह along with your wife, गच्छ please go, विप्रम् brahmin, वचनम् words, उवाच spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋषिपुत्र: प्रतिश्रुत्य तथेत्याह नृपं तदा। स नृपेणाभ्यनुज्ञात: प्रययौ सह भार्यया।।1.11.21।।
output: तदा then, ऋषिपुत्र: son of sage, प्रतिश्रुत्य having assented, नृपम् the king, तथा इति so it shall be done, आह said, नृपेण by king, अभ्यनुज्ञात: having been permitted, भार्यया सह along with his wife, प्रययौ departed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 11:
तावन्योन्याञ्जलिं कृत्वा स्नेहात्संश्लिष्य चोरसा। ननन्दतुर्दशरथो रोमपादश्च वीर्यवान्।।1.11.22।।
output: Dasaratha and Romapada, pleased with this, wished each other with folded palms and hugged each other with love.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 11:
ततस्सुहृदमापृच्छ्य प्रस्थितो रघुनन्दन:। पौरेभ्य: प्रेषयामास दूतान्वै शीघ्रगामिन:।।1.11.23।।
output: Then king Dasaratha, took leave of  his friend and set out. He despatched swiftfooted messengers to the citizens with the command.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रियतां नगरं सर्वं क्षिप्रमेव स्वलङ्कृतम्। धूपितं सिक्तसम्मृष्टं पताकाभिरलङ्कृतम्।।1.11.24।।
output: "Let the entire city be welldecorated, perfumed, sprinkled with water and cleaned with flags hoisted."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत: प्रहृष्टा: पौरास्ते श्रुत्वा राजानमागतम्। तथा प्रचक्रुस्तत्सर्वं राज्ञा यत्प्रेषितं तदा ।।1.11.25।।
output: तत: then, ते पौरा: the people of Ayodhya, राजानम् the king, आगतम् arrival, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रहृष्टा: overjoyed, राज्ञा by king, यत् यथा as per, प्रेषितम् sent, तत् सर्वम् all that, तथा in the same manner, प्रचक्रु: fulfilled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्स्वलङ्कृतं राजा नगरं प्रविवेश ह। शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषै: पुरस्कृत्य द्विजर्षभम्।।1.11.26।।
output: तत: then, राजा king, द्विजर्षभम् foremost of brahmins, पुरस्कृत्य keeping in the forefront, स्वलङ्कृतम् welldecorated, तत् that, नगरम् city, शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषै: with conches blowing and drums beating, प्रविवेश ह entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत: प्रमुदितास्सर्वे दृष्ट्वा तं नागरा द्विजम्। प्रवेश्यमानं सत्कृत्य नरेन्द्रेणेन्द्रकर्मणा।।1.11.27।।
output: तत: then, सर्वे नागरा: all citizens, इन्द्रकर्मणां equivalent to Indra in valiant, नरेन्द्रेण by that king, सत्कृत्य having been honoured, प्रवेश्यमानम् entering, तम् that, द्विजम् brahmin, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, प्रमुदिता: were delighted.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 11:
अन्त:पुरं प्रवेश्यैनं पूजां कृत्वा च शास्त्रत:। कृतकृत्यं तदात्मानं मेने तस्योपवाहनात्।।1.11.28।।
output: He (king Dasaratha) took him in to the inner apartment and extended welcome. He thought that he has as enjoined by the sastras accomplished his objective by bringing him (Rsyasringa).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्त:पुरस्त्रियस्सर्वाश्शान्तां दृष्ट्वा तथागताम्। सह भर्त्रा विशालाक्षीं प्रीत्यानन्दमुपागमन्।।1.11.29।।
output: अन्त:पुर स्त्रिय: royal ladies, सर्वा: all, तथा in that manner, भर्त्रा सह along with her husband, आगताम् arrived, विशालाक्षीम् wideeyed lady, शान्ताम् Shanta, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रीत्या affectionately, आनन्दम् delight, उपागमन् experienced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 11:
पूज्यमाना च ताभिस्सा राज्ञा चैव विशेषत:। उवास तत्र सुखिता कञ्चित्कालं सहर्त्विजा।।1.11.30।।
output: Honoured and worshipped by royal ladies, especially by king Dasaratha, Santa dwelt there for some time comfortably with the sage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत: काले बहुतिथे कस्मिंश्चित्सुमनोहरे। वसन्ते समनुप्राप्ते राज्ञो यष्टुं मनोऽभवत्।।1.12.1।।
output: तत: afterwards, बहुतिथे काले after a lapse of long time, सुमनोहरे charming, कस्मिंश्चित्   some time, वसन्ते spring season, समनुप्राप्ते having arrived, राज्ञ: for the king, यष्टुम् to perform sacrifice, मन: अभवत् desire arose.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत: प्रसाद्य शिरसा तं विप्रं देववर्णिनम्। यज्ञाय वरयामास सन्तानार्थं कुलस्य वै।।1.12.2।।
output: Then bowing his head in respect to that brahmin who was effulgent like a celestial  and having won his grace he chose him to conduct a sacrifice for a son for (the continuity of) his dynasty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथेति च स राजानमुवाच च सुसत्कृत:। सम्भारा सम्भ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्।।1.12.3।।
output: सुसत्कृत: wellhonoured, स: that brahmin, तथेति be it so, राजानम् king, उवाच said, सम्भारा: requisite materials, सम्भ्रियन्ताम् be procured, ते your, तुरग: sacrificial horse, विमुच्यताम् च let it be released.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 12:
ततो राजाऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रिसत्तमम्। सुमन्त्रावाहय क्षिप्रं ऋत्विजो ब्रह्मवादिन:।।1.12.4।। सुयज्ञं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ काश्यपम्। पुरोहितं वसिष्ठं च ये चान्ये द्विजसत्तमा:।।1.12.5।।
output: Thereafter the king said to Sumantra, "Summon immediately, Suyajna, Vamadeva, Jabali and Kasyapa, family priest Vasishta and other foremost and learned brahmins who are the official priests wellversed in the Vedas".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 12:
ततो राजाऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रिसत्तमम्। सुमन्त्रावाहय क्षिप्रं ऋत्विजो ब्रह्मवादिन:।।1.12.4।। सुयज्ञं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ काश्यपम्। पुरोहितं वसिष्ठं च ये चान्ये द्विजसत्तमा:।।1.12.5।।
output: Thereafter the king said to Sumantra, "Summon immediately, Suyajna, Vamadeva, Jabali and Kasyapa, family priest Vasishta and other foremost and learned brahmins who are the official priests wellversed in the Vedas".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 12:
ततस्सुमन्त्रस्त्वरितं गत्वा त्वरितविक्रम:। समानयत्स तान्विप्रान् समस्तान्वेदपारगान्।।1.12.6।।
output: Then Sumantra, a man of smart movement went immediately and brought all those brahmins who were wellversed in the Vedas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तान्पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथस्तदा। धर्मार्थसहितं युक्तं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.12.7।।
output: धर्मात्मा virtuous, दशरथ: राजा king Dasaratha, तदा then, तान् them, पूजयित्वा after paying respects, धर्मार्थसहितम् full of truth and duty, श्लक्ष्णम् gracious, (इदं) युक्तं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् uttered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मम लालप्यमानस्य पुत्रार्थं नास्ति वै सुखम्। तदर्थं हयमेधेन यक्ष्यामीति मतिर्मम।।1.12.8।।
output: "There is no happiness for me. I am overwhelmed with grief as I have no son. Therefore, I intend to perform a horsesacrifice.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 12:
तदहं यष्टुमिच्छामि शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा। ऋषिपुत्रप्रभावेन कामान्प्राप्स्यामि चाप्यहम्।।1.12.9।।
output: I wish to perform the yaga acording to scriptural procedures. And I will have my desire fulfilled by the grace of the sage (Rsyasringa)".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्साध्विति तद्वाक्यं ब्राह्मणा: प्रत्यपूजयन्। वसिष्ठप्रमुखास्सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखाच्च्युतम्।।1.12.10।।
output: तत: then, वसिष्ठप्रमुखा: Vasishta and others, ब्राह्मणा: brahmins, सर्वे all, पार्थिवस्य king's, मुखात् from the mouth, च्युतम् delivered, तत् वाक्यम those words, साधु इति well said, प्रत्यपूजयन् extolled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋष्यशृङ्गपुरोगाश्च प्रत्यूचुर्नृपतिं तदा। सम्भारास्सम्भ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्।।1.12.11।।
output: The priests led by Rsyasringa replied to the king, saying, "Let the sacrificial articles be procured and your sacrificial horse released."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 12:
सर्वथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रांश्चत्वारोऽमितविक्रमान्। यस्य ते धार्मिकी बुद्धिरियं पुत्रार्थमागता ।।1.12.12।।
output: "Since this righteous thought for begetting children has entered your mind, you shall surely get four sons of immense prowess".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 12:
तत: प्रीतोऽभवद्राजा श्रुत्वा तद्विजभाषितम्। अमात्यांश्चाब्रवीद्राजा हर्षेणेदं शुभाक्षरम्।।1.12.13।।
output: Pleased to hear the brahmins' words, the king happily addressed his ministers with auspicious words:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 12:
गुरूणां वचनाच्छीघ्रं सम्भारास्सम्भ्रियन्तु मे। समर्थाधिष्ठितश्चाश्वस्सोपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम्।।1.12.14।।
output: "In accordance with the instructions by my spiritual preceptors let the articles (required for performing the sacrifice) be procured and the horse  released under the protection of warriors accompanied by the chief priest".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्। शान्तयश्चाभिवर्धन्तां यथाकल्पं यथाविधि।।1.12.15।।
output: सरय्वा: of river Sarayu, उत्तरे तीरे on the northern bank, यज्ञभूमि: sacrificial pavillion, विधीयताम् be constructed, यथाकल्पम् according to prescribed ritual code, यथाविधि according to the scriptural stipulation, शान्तयश्च expiatory rites, अभिवर्धन्ताम् may be wished.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शक्य: प्राप्तुमयं यज्ञस्सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता। नापराधो भवेत्कष्टो यद्यस्मिन्क्रतुसत्तमे।।1.12.16।।
output: If in this best of sacrifices aswamedha, obstructions and omissions do not occur it will be possible for the king to get the results.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
छिद्रं हि मृगयन्तेऽत्र विद्वांसो ब्रह्मराक्षसा:। निहतस्य च यज्ञस्य सद्य: कर्ता विनश्यति।।1.12.17।।
output: अत्र in this sacrifice, विद्वांस: learned men, ब्रह्मराक्षसा: brahma rakshasas(celestial beings turned into demons), छिद्रम् flaw, मृगयन्ते हि will be looking out for, निहतस्य struck down, यज्ञस्य of sacrifice, कर्ता च the doer, सद्य: immediately, विनश्यति will be destroyed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्यथा विधिपूर्वं मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते। तथा विधानं क्रियतां समर्था: करणेष्विह।।1.12.18।।
output: Therefore let the arrangements be made in a manner by which this sacifice is completed in accordance with the prescriptions in scriptures and you are experts in doing so".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथेति च ततस्सर्वे मन्त्रिण: प्रत्यपूजयन्। पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तद्वाक्यं यथाज्ञप्तमकुर्वत।।1.12.19।।
output: Honouring the words of the king, all the ministers did as ordered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो द्विजास्ते धर्मज्ञमस्तुवन्पार्थिवर्षभम्। अनुज्ञातास्ततस्सर्वे पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्।।1.12.20।।
output: Admiring the great king, the knower of righteousness, the brahmins permitted by him  returned to their places as they had some.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 12:
गतेष्वथ द्विजाग्य्रेषु मन्त्रिणस्तान्नराधिप:। विसर्जयित्वा स्वं वेश्म प्रविवेश महाद्युति:।।1.12.21।।
output: When the great brahmins  departed, the glorious king (Dasaratha) sent away his ministers and entered his palace. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्वादशस्सर्ग:।।2 Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुन: प्राप्ते वसन्ते तु पूर्णस्संवत्सरोऽभवत्। प्रसवार्थं गतो यष्टुं हयमेधेन वीर्यवान्।।1.13.1।।
output: Dasaratha requests Vasishta to commence the sacrifice-- orders various people skilled in their profession to attend to the preparations--Vasishta asks Sumantra to invite kings from various countries--extends hospitality-- Dasaratha commences the sacrificial ceremony with his wives

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
अभिवाद्य वसिष्ठं च न्यायत: परिपूज्य च। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं प्रसवार्थं द्विजोत्तमम्।।1.13.2।।
output: After offering humble salutations and worshipping sage Vasishta in accordance with prescribed ordinance for begetting children, he obediently said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
यज्ञो मे क्रियतां ब्रह्मन्यथोक्तं मुनिपुङ्गव। यथा न विघ्न: क्रियते यज्ञाङ्गेषु विधीयताम्।।1.13.3।।
output: "O foremost among ascetics O brahman, may the sacrifice be performed according to  tradition in such a manner that the sacrifice is performed unhindered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भवान् स्निग्धस्सुहृन्मह्यं गुरुश्च परमो महान्। ओढव्यो भवता चैव भारो यज्ञस्य चोद्यत:।।1.13.4।।
output: भवान् you, मह्यम् to me, स्निग्ध: affectionate one, सुहृत् friend, परम: great, महान् reverential, गुरु: spiritual guide, यज्ञस्य sacrifice, उद्यत: has commenced, भार: burden of performing the sacrifice, भवता चैव by you alone, ओढव्य: shall be borne.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथेति च स राजानमब्रवीद्द्विजसत्तमः। करिष्ये सर्वमेवैतद्भवता यत्समर्थितम्।।1.13.5।।
output: The great among brahmins answered him saying "I shall do everything as proposed by you".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
ततोऽब्रवीद्विजान्वृद्धान्यज्ञकर्मसु निष्ठितान्। स्थापत्ये निष्ठितांश्चैव वृद्धान्परमधार्मिकान्।।1.13.6।। कर्मान्तिकान् शिल्पकरान्वर्धकीन् खनकानपि। गणकान्शिल्पिनश्चैव तथैव नटनर्तकान्।।1.13.7।। तथा शुचीन्शास्त्रविद: पुरुषान् सुबहुश्रुतान्। यज्ञकर्म समीहन्तां भवन्तो राजशासनात्।।1.13.8।। इष्टका बहु साहस्राश्शीघ्रमानीयतामिति। 0 उपकार्या: क्रियन्तां च राज्ञां बहुगुणान्विता:।।1.13.9।।
output: Thereafter Vasishta summoned those brahmins who are experienced in the sacrificerelated activities venerable and righteous architects skilled workers brick makers, carpenters, diggers, artisans, account keepers, dancers and actors, men versed in scriptures and honest, wellinformed people and addressed them saying, "In accordance with the king's command let the work of the sacrificial ceremony be inauguarated. Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

output: तत: after that, यज्ञकर्मसु in the sacrificerelated activities, निष्ठितान् experienced, वृद्धान् venerable, द्विजान् brahmins, वृद्धान् venerable, परमधार्मिकान् most righteous people, स्थापत्ये in the science of architecture, निष्ठितांश्चैव skilled, कर्मान्तिकान् workers, शिल्पकरान् makers of bricks, वर्धकीन् carpenters, खनकानपि diggers, गणकान् men adept in calculations, शिल्पिनश्चैव artisans, तथैव and, नटनर्तकान् dancers and actors, तथा and, शुचीन् men having clean back ground, शास्त्रविद: wellversed in the scriptures, सुबहुश्रुतान् wellinformed and knowledgeable, पुरुषान् people, भवन्त: all of you, राजशासनात् by king's command, यज्ञकर्म sacrificial work, समीहन्ताम् be planned, बहुसाहस्रा in thousands, इष्टका: bricks, शीघ्रम् immediately, आनीयताम् let them be brought, राज्ञाम् kings', बहुगुणान्विता: commanding all comforts, उपकार्या: temporary residential buildings, क्रियन्ताम् be erected.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:

Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

ततोऽब्रवीद्विजान्वृद्धान्यज्ञकर्मसु निष्ठितान्। स्थापत्ये निष्ठितांश्चैव वृद्धान्परमधार्मिकान्।।1.13.6।। कर्मान्तिकान् शिल्पकरान्वर्धकीन् खनकानपि। गणकान्शिल्पिनश्चैव तथैव नटनर्तकान्।।1.13.7।। तथा शुचीन्शास्त्रविद: पुरुषान् सुबहुश्रुतान्। यज्ञकर्म समीहन्तां भवन्तो राजशासनात्।।1.13.8।। इष्टका बहु साहस्राश्शीघ्रमानीयतामिति। 0 उपकार्या: क्रियन्तां च राज्ञां बहुगुणान्विता:।।1.13.9।।

Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
ब्राह्मणावसथाश्चैव कर्तव्याश्शतशश्शुभा:। भक्ष्यान्नपानैर्बहुभिस्समुपेतास्सुनिष्ठिता:।।1.13.10।।
output: शुभा: auspicious, बहुभि: by many, भक्ष्यान्नपानै: with eatables and drinks, समुपेता: furnished with, सुनिष्ठिता: well arranged, ब्राह्मणावसथा: चैव residences for brahmins, शतश: in hundreds, कर्तव्या: be prepared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
तथा पौरजनस्यापि कर्तव्या बहुविस्तरा:। आवासा बहुभक्ष्या वै सर्वकामैरुपस्थिता:।।1.13.11।।
output: In the same manner let widely spread residential accommodation be furnished with many items of food and all kinds of entertainment be provided for people from other lands.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा जानपदस्यापि जनस्य बहुशोभनम्। दातव्यमन्नं विधिवत्सत्कृत्य न तु लीलया।।1.13.12।।
output: तथा in the sameway, जानपदस्य for the rural, जनस्यापि people also, बहुशोभनम् extremely good, अन्नम् food, विधिवत् according to tradition, सत्कृत्य treated with good respect, दातव्यम् given, लीलयातु न not casually in a careless way.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
सर्वे वर्णा यथा पूजां प्राप्नुवन्ति सुसत्कृता:। न चावज्ञा प्रयोक्तव्या कामक्रोधवशादपि।।1.13.13।।
output: People from all castes should be welltreated with respect. There should be no insult to any one through lust on greed on anger.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
यज्ञकर्मसु ये व्यग्रा: पुरुषाश्शिल्पिनस्तथा। तेषामपि विशेषेण पूजा कार्या यथाक्रमम्।।1.13.14।। ते च स्युस्सम्भृतास्सर्वे वसुभिर्भोजनेन च।
output: The people deeply immersed in performing sacrificerelated activities and sculptors be specially honoured according to their nature of work. All of them should be satisfied with money and food.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथा सर्वं सुविहितं न किञ्चित्परिहीयते।।1.13.15।। तथा भवन्त: कुर्वन्तु प्रीतिस्निग्धेन चेतसा।
output: सर्वम् all, यथा in whatever manner, सुविहितम् well managed, किञ्चित् even little, न परिहीयते not left out, तथा in that manner, भवन्त: you, प्रीतिस्निग्धेन with love and affection, चेतसा with mind, कुर्वन्तु let it be done.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सर्वे समागम्य वसिष्ठमिदमब्रुवन्।।1.13.16।। यथोक्तं तत्सुविहितं न किञ्चित्परिहीयते। यथोक्तं तत्करिष्यामो न किञ्चित्परिहास्यते।।1.13.17।।
output: Then all of them approached Vasishta and said, "everything has been wellarranged in accordance with your instruction. There is no deficiency. Everything will be done as instructed by you without leaving out anything."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्सर्वे समागम्य वसिष्ठमिदमब्रुवन्।।1.13.16।। यथोक्तं तत्सुविहितं न किञ्चित्परिहीयते। यथोक्तं तत्करिष्यामो न किञ्चित्परिहास्यते।।1.13.17।।
output: तत: then, सर्वे all, समागम्य approached, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, इदम् this statement, अब्रुवन् said, यथा in the manner, उक्तम् has been told, तत् that, सुविहितम् well arranged, किञ्चित् even little, न परिहीयते will not be left out, यथोक्तम् in the manner it has been told, तत् that, करिष्याम: we will do, किञ्चित् even a little, न परिहास्यते will not be left out.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सुमन्त्रमानीय वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। निमन्त्रयस्व नृपतीन्पृथिव्यां ये च धार्मिका:।।1.13.18।।
output: Then Vasishta, having summoned Sumantra said to him "Invite all the righteous kings on earth".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
ब्राह्मणान्क्षत्रियान्वैश्याञ्छूद्रांश्चैव सहस्रश:। समानयस्व सत्कृत्य सर्वदेशेषु मानवान्।।1.13.19।।
output: "Extend an honourable invitation to brahmins, kshatriyas, merchants and sudras in their thousands residing in all countries.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
मिथिलाधिपतिं शूरं जनकं सत्यविक्रमम्। निष्ठितं सर्वशास्त्रेषु तथा वेदेषु निष्ठितम्।।1.13.20।। तमानय महाभागं स्वयमेव सुसत्कृतम्। पूर्वसम्बन्धिनं ज्ञात्वा तत: पूर्वं ब्रवीमि ते।।1.13.21।।
output: You may personally go and bring with due honour king Janaka who is the distinguished king of Mithila, a warrior whose truth is his strength proficient in all scriptures and the Vedas. Since he is an old ally, I am telling you in advance.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मिथिलाधिपतिं शूरं जनकं सत्यविक्रमम्। निष्ठितं सर्वशास्त्रेषु तथा वेदेषु निष्ठितम्।।1.13.20।। तमानय महाभागं स्वयमेव सुसत्कृतम्। पूर्वसम्बन्धिनं ज्ञात्वा तत: पूर्वं ब्रवीमि ते।।1.13.21।।
output: मिथिलाधिपतिम् king of Mithila, शूरम् greatest of warriors, सत्यविक्रमम् a man with real heroic valour, सर्वशास्त्रेषु in all scriptures, निष्ठितम् proficient, तथा and, वेदेषु in vedas, निष्ठितम् proficient, महाभागम् distinguished, तं जनकम् that Janaka, पूर्वसम्बन्धिनम् an ancient allay, ज्ञात्वा knowing, सुसत्कृतम् with due honours, स्वयमेव personally, आनय bring him, तत: for that reason, पूर्वम् well before, ते to you, ब्रवीमि telling.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
तथा काशीपतिं स्निग्धं सततं प्रियवादिनम्। वयस्यं राजसिंहस्य स्वयमेवानयस्व ह।।1.13.22।।
output: Similarly, you may personally escort king of Kasi who is always affectionate and sweettongued. He is a friend to our king who is a lion among rulers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
तथा केकयराजानं वृद्धं परमधार्मिकम्। श्वशुरं राजसिंहस्य सपुत्रं त्वमिहानय।।1.13.23।।
output: Likewise bring here the aged and very righteous king of Kekaya along with his sons. He is fatherinlaw to this lion among kings (Dasaratha).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अङ्गेश्वरम् महाभागं रोमपादं सुसत्कृतम्। वयस्यं राजसिंहस्य समानय यशस्विनम्।।1.13.24।।
output: अङ्गेश्वरम् king of Anga, महाभागम् prosperous, राजसिंहस्य lion among kings, Dasaratha's, वयस्यम् friend, यशस्विनम् famous, रोमपादम् Romapada, सुसत्कृतम् well honoured, समानय bring.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
प्राचीनान्सिन्धु सौवीरान्सौराष्ट्रेयांश्च पार्थिवान्। दाक्षिणात्यान्नरेन्द्रांश्च समस्तानानयस्व ह।।1.13.25।।
output: Bring kings from the countries of the eastern and southern regions, from Sindhu, Sauvera and Saurashtra৷৷

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्ति स्निग्धाश्च ये चान्ये राजान: पृथिवीतले। तानानय यथाक्षिप्रं सानुगान्सह बान्धवान्।।1.13.26।।
output: Bring all other kings of this earth, who are friendly with us. Along with their retinues, families and relatives".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वसिष्ठवाक्यं तच्छ्रुत्वा सुमन्त्रस्त्वरितस्तदा। व्यादिशत्पुरुषांस्तत्र राज्ञामानयने शुभान्।।1.13.27।।
output: Having heard the words of Vasishta, Sumantra speedily despatched virtuous and auspicious emissaries to bring the kings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वयमेव हि धर्मात्मा  प्रययौ मुनिशासनात्। सुमन्त्रस्त्वरितो भूत्वा समानेतुं महीक्षित:।।1.13.28।।
output: In accordance with the ascetic's order, righteous Sumantra himself quickly set out to escort Janaka and other kings.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते च कर्मान्तिकास्सर्वे वसिष्ठाय च धीमते। सर्वं निवेदयन्ति स्म यज्ञे यदुपकल्पितम्।।1.13.29।।
output: ते those, कर्मान्तिका: workers, सर्वे all, यज्ञे in the sacrifice, यत् which, उपकल्पितम् was well arranged, सर्वम् all that, धीमते to the wise, वसिष्ठाय Vasishta, निवेदयन्ति स्म informed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत:प्रीतो द्विजश्रेष्ठस्तान् सर्वानिदमब्रवीत् । अवज्ञया न दातव्यं कस्यचिल्लीलयाऽपि वा।।1.13.30।। अवज्ञया कृतं हन्याद्दातारं नात्र संशय:। 28
output: Then, well pleased, the best among brahmins (Vasishta) said to them all "Nobody should be offered any thing with disregard. Anything given with contempt undoubtedly  results in the destruction of the donor."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
तत: कैश्चिदहोरात्रैरुपयाता महीक्षित:।।1.13.31।। बहूनि रत्नान्यादाय राज्ञो दशरथस्य वै।
output: Meanwhile kings from several countries to travelling nights and days arrived bringing with them various kinds of (precious) gifts.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
ततो वसिष्ठस्सुप्रीतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.13.32।। उपयाता नरव्याघ्र राजानस्तव शासनात्। मयापि सत्कृता: सर्वे यथार्हं राजसत्तमा:।।1.13.33।।
output: Thereupon, wellpleased, Vasishta addressing Dasaratha said "O best among men, beacuse of your command, kings from various countries have arrived. I have extended due hospitality to those noble kings according to their station."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो वसिष्ठस्सुप्रीतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.13.32।। उपयाता नरव्याघ्र राजानस्तव शासनात्। मयापि सत्कृता: सर्वे यथार्हं राजसत्तमा:।।1.13.33।।
output: तत: there upon, सुप्रीत: wellpleased, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, राजानम् addressing Dasaratha, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, नरव्याघ्र O Best among men, तव your, शासनात् by the  command, राजान: kings from various countries, उपयाता: have arrived, राजसत्तमा: noble kings, सर्वे all, यथार्हम् according to their merit, मया by me, सत्कृता: अपि were honoured also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यज्ञीयं च कृतं राजन् पुरुषैस्सुसमाहितै:। निर्यातु च भवान्यष्टुं यज्ञायतनमन्तिकात्।।1.13.34।।
output: "O king, persons with composed minds have made preparations for the yaga. Now be pleased to leave for sacrificial altar nearby to perform yaga.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
सर्वकामैरुपहृतैरुपेतं च समन्तत:। द्रष्टुमर्हसि राजेन्द्र मनसेव विनिर्मितम्।।1.13.35।।
output: O foremost of kings, you ought to see the sacrificial ground full of sources of entertainment arranged everywhere, as though improvised by imagination".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
तथा वसिष्ठवचनादृश्यशृङ्गस्य चोभयो:। शुभे दिवसनक्षत्रे निर्यातो जगतीपति:।।1.13.36।।
output: In response to the words of Vasishta and Rsyasringa, the Lord of the earth (Dasaratha) entered the sacrificial pavilion on a favourable day presided over by an auspicious star.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 13:
ततो वसिष्ठप्रमुखास्सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमा:। ऋश्यशृङ्गं पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञकर्मारभन् तदा।।1.13.37।। यज्ञवाटगतास्सर्वे यथाशास्त्रं यथाविधि। 3
output: At that moment the best of brahmins led by Vasishta and headed by Rsyasringa, entered the sacrificial enclosure and began the sacrifice in accordance with traditions and scriptural stipulations. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे तस्मिन्प्राप्ते तुरङ्गमे। सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे राज्ञो यज्ञोऽभ्यवर्तत।।1.14.1।।
output: After completion of one year when the sacrificial horse had returned, the sacrifice by the king (Dasaratha) commenced on the northern bank of river Sarayu.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋश्यशृङ्गं पुरस्कृत्य कर्म चक्रुर्द्विजर्षभा:। अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मन:।।1.14.2।।
output: The best of brahmins led by Rsyasringa performed the rituals of aswamedha organised by the exceedingly magnanimous king.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
कर्म कुर्वन्ति विधिवद्याजका वेदपारगा:। यथाविधि यथान्यायं परिक्रामन्ति शास्त्रत:।।1.14.3।।
output: The chief priests, masters of the Vedas, conducted the rituals in consonance with traditions and scriptures. They officiated in conformity with duties laid down in the Vedas and according to law.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रवर्ग्यं शास्त्रत: कृत्वा तथैवोपसदं द्विजा: चक्रुश्च विधिवत्सर्वमधिकं कर्म शास्त्रत:।।1.14.4।।
output: द्विजा: brahmins, प्रवर्ग्यम् Pravargya (a particular part of the sacrifice), शास्त्रत: according to scriptures, कृत्वा having done, तथैव and, उपसदम् Upasada (another part of the sacrifice), विधिवत् as per tradition, अधिकम् still other, सर्वं कर्म ceremonies, शास्त्रत: according to ordinance, चक्रु: performed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
अभिपूज्य ततो हृष्टास्सर्वे चक्रुर्यथाविधि। प्रातस्सवनपूर्वाणि कर्माणि मुनिपुङ्गवा:।।1.14.5।।
output: Thereafter the eminent ascetics, rejoicing in their hearts performed the worship (of celestial beings) and conducted the prescribed rituals starting with morning ablutions etc.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
ऐन्द्रश्च विधिवद्दत्तो राजा चाभिषुतोऽनघ:। माध्यन्दिनं च सवनं प्रावर्तत यथाक्रमम्।।1.14.6।।
output: Havis was duly offered to Indra daily. The juice was extracted in the morning by pressing the soma plant. Midday ablutions were performed. All in proper sequence.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
तृतीयसवनं चैव राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मन:। चक्रुस्तेशास्त्रतो दृष्ट्वा तथा ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवा:।।1.14.7।।
output: Those exceedingly noble and eminent brahmins performed third pressing of the soma, in conformity with the sastras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न चाहुतमभूत्तत्र स्खलितं वापि किञ्चन । दृश्यते ब्रह्मवत्सर्वं क्षेमयुक्तं हि चक्रिरे।।1.14.8।।
output: तत्र in that sacrifice, आहुतम् omissions in the offerings, नाभूत् did not take place, किञ्चन any thing, स्खलितम् defects or mistakes, नाभूत् did not take place, सर्वम् everything, ब्रह्मवत् with mantras (prayers), दृश्यते appeared, क्षेमयुक्तम् in a safe manner, चक्रिरे हि performed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न तेष्वहस्सु श्रान्तो वा क्षुधितो वापि दृश्यते। नाविद्वान्ब्राह्मणस्तत्र नाशतानुचरस्तथा।।1.14.9।।
output: तेषु in those, अहस्सु days, श्रान्त: a tired man, क्षुधितो वापि or hungry one, न दृश्यते was not to be seen, तत्र there, अविद्वान् not learned, ब्राह्मण: brahmin, न दृश्यते not to be seen, तथा similarly, अशतानुचर: a man followed by less than hundred people, न दृश्यते was not seen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ब्राह्मणा भुञ्जते नित्यं नाथवन्तश्च भुञ्जते। तापसा भुञ्जते चापि श्रमणा भुञ्जतेतथा।।1.14.10।।
output: नित्यम् continually, ब्राह्मणा: brahmanas, भुञ्जते are eating, नाथवन्तश्च those who have  masters, भुञ्जते are eating, तापसाश्चापि ascetics, भुञ्जते are eating, तथा and, श्रमणा: monks, भुञ्जते are eating.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
वृद्धाश्च व्याधिताश्चैव स्त्रियो बालास्तथैव च । अनिशं भुञ्जमानानां न तृप्तिरुपलभ्यते।।1.14.11।।
output: The aged, the sick, women and also children ate there and knew no limit to their enjoyment.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
दीयतां दीयतामन्नं वासांसि विविधानि च। इति सञ्चोदितास्तत्र तथा चक्रुरनेकश:।।1.14.12।।
output: "Give food, give, various kinds of clothes" echoed the organisers. And they (in charge of distribution) did.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्नकूटाश्च बहवो दृश्यन्ते पर्वतोपमा:। दिवसे दिवसे तत्र सिद्धस्य विधिवत्तदा।।1.14.13।।
output: There, could be seen day after day heaps of nicely cooked food, looking like mountains.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नानादेशादनुप्राप्ता: पुरुषास्स्त्रीगणास्तथा। अन्नपानैस्सुविहितास्तस्मिन्यज्ञे महात्मन:।।1.14.14।।
output: Men and women who had come from various countries to that sacrifice were entertained with food and drink by the magnanimous (king).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
अन्नं हि विधिवत्साधु प्रशंसन्ति द्विजर्षभा:। अहो तृप्ता: स्म भद्रं ते इति शुश्राव राघव:।।1.14.15।।
output: Brahmins having tasted the delicious food cooked in prescribed manner, praised saying "Ah We are fully satisfied. Prosperity to you". Such were the words heard by king Dasaratha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 14:
स्वलङ्कृताश्च पुरुषा ब्राह्मणान्पर्यवेषयन्। उपासते च तानन्ये सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डला:।।1.14.16।।
