देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्षा:पतगपन्नगा:। न शक्ता रावणं सोढुं किं पुनर्मानवा युधि।।1.20.22।।
output: देवदानवगन्धर्वा: gods, danavas and gandharvas, यक्षा: yakshas, पतगपन्नगा: birds and great serpents, युधि in the battle, रावणम् Ravana, सोढुम् to endure him, न शक्ता: are not capable, मानवा: men, किं पुन: again to say.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स हि वीर्यवतां वीर्यमादत्ते युधि राक्षस:। तेन चाहं न शक्तोऽस्मि संयोद्धुं तस्य वा बलै:।।1.20.23।। सबलो वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ सहितो वा ममात्मजै:।
output: स: राक्षस: that rakshasa, युधि in the battle, वीर्यवताम् of the warriors, वीर्यम् prowess, आदत्ते हि takes, मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Foremost of ascetics, सबलो वा either with forces, मम आत्मजै:सहितो वा or together with my sons, अहम् I, तेन with him, तस्य बलै:वा  or with his forces, संयोद्धुम् to engage in battle, न शक्तोऽस्मि I am not competant.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कथमप्यमरप्रख्यं सङ्ग्रामाणामकोविदम्। बालं मे तनयं ब्रह्मन् नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम्।।1.20.24।।
output: ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, अमरप्रख्यम् resembling celestial deities, सङ्ग्रामाणाम् in the warfare, अकोविदम् not experienced, बालं पुत्रकम् dear young child, मे my, तनयम् son, कथमपि how so ever, नैव दास्यामि I never, never give him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 20:
अथ कालोपमौ युध्दे सुतौ सुन्दोपसुन्दयो:।।1.20.25।। यज्ञविघ्नकरौ तौ ते नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम्।
output: Further the sons of Sunda and Upasunda by name Maricha and Subahu are causing obstacles to your sacrifice. They resemble the god of death, Yama. I shall never part with my son.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 20:
मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ। तयोरन्यतरेणाहं योध्दा स्यां ससुहृद्गण:।।1.20.26।।
output: Maricha and Subahu not only possess prowess but also are experienced in warfare. Together with my group of friends I can combat with one of the two".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति नरपतिजल्पनाद्द्विजेन्द्रं कुशिकसुतं सुमहान्विवेश मन्यु:। सुहुत इव मखेऽग्निराज्यसिक्त स्समभवदुज्ज्वलितो महर्षिवह्नि:।।1.20.27।।
output: इति in this manner, नरपतिजल्पनात् with the statements of king Dasaratha, द्विजेन्द्रम् Indra among ascetics, कुशिकसुतम् son of Kusika, सुमहान् great, मन्यु: rage, विवेश entered, महर्षिवह्नि: fire in the form of maharshi, मखे in the sacrifice, सुहुत: with good offerings of  oblation, आज्यसिक्त: sprinkled with clarified butter, अग्नि:इव like  sacrificial fire, उज्वलित: समभवत् blazed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य स्नेहपर्याकुलाक्षरम्। समन्यु: कौशिको वाक्यं प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम्।।1.21.1।।
output: On king Dasaratha's refusal to accede to his request, Viswamitra gets enraged.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पूर्वमर्थं प्रतिश्रुत्य प्रतिज्ञां हातुमिच्छसि। राघवाणामयुक्तोऽयं कुलस्यास्य विपर्यय:।।1.21.2।।
output: पूर्वम् formerly, अर्थम् object or thing, प्रतिश्रुत्य having promised, प्रतिज्ञाम् that promise, हातुम् to break, इच्छसि your are desirous, अयं विपर्यय: in contrariety (breach of vow), राघवाणाम्  Raghu's, अस्य कुलस्य in the race of, अयुक्त: improper.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 21:
यदीदं ते क्षमं राजन् गमिष्यामि यथाऽगतम्। मिथ्याप्रतिज्ञ: काकुत्स्थ सुखीभव सबान्धव:।।1.21.3।।
output: O king, if this act of yours is appropriate to you, I will go back (to the places) where from I came. O scion of the race of kakutstha, you have proved false to your promise. Live happily with your relatives".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य रोषपरीतस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमत:। चचाल वसुधा कृत्स्ना विवेश च भयं सुरान्।।1.21.4।।
output: धीमत: of the wise, तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य that Visvamitra's, रोषपरीतस्य seized of wrath, कृत्स्ना entire, वसुधा earth, चचाल had shaken, सुरान् devatas, भयम् fear,  विवेश gripped.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्रस्तरूपं तु विज्ञाय जगत्सर्वं महानृषि:। नृपतिं सुव्रतो धीरो वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।1.21.5।।
output: Great Vasishta, an adherent of ascetic practices and steadfast (to duty), seeing that the entire world frightened addressed the king, saying:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले जातस्साक्षाद्धर्म इवापर:। धृतिमान् सुव्रत: श्रीमान्नधर्मं हातुमर्हसि।।1.21.6।।
output: "Born in the line of Ikshvaku, you are a veritable the second god of righteousness, firm adherent of vows auspicious and virtuous. It is not right on your part to abandon your promise.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातो धर्मात्मा इति राघव। स्वधर्मं प्रतिपद्यस्व नाधर्मं वोढुमर्हसि।।1.21.7।।
output: राघव O Dasaratha, धर्मात्मा इति as righteousminded, त्रिषु लोकेषु in three worlds, विख्यात:, reputed, स्वधर्मम् your own duty, प्रतिपद्यस्व observe, अधर्मम् unjust act, वोढुम् to endure, न अर्हसि not worthy of you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
संश्रुत्यैवं करिष्यामीत्यकुर्वाणस्य राघव। इष्टापूर्तवधो भूयात्तस्माद्रामं विसर्जय।।1.21.8।।
output: राघव O Dasaratha, एवं करिष्यामि इति I shall do so, संश्रुत्य having promised, अकुर्वाणस्य for one who does not fulfill, इष्टापूर्तवध: भूयात् destruction of merits earned through pious acts of sacrifice and other charitable acts, तस्मात् for that reason, रामम् Rama, विसर्जय send him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृतास्त्रमकृतास्त्रं वा नैनं शक्ष्यन्ति राक्षसा:। गुप्तं कुशिकपुत्रेण ज्वलनेनामृतं यथा।।1.21.9।।
output: कृतास्त्रम् trained in the use of arms, अकृतास्त्रं वा or untrained,  कुशिकपुत्रेण by Viswamitra, गुप्तम् protected, एनम् this Rama, ज्वलनेन by flaming fire, अमृतं यथा like divine nectar, राक्षसा: rakshasas, न शक्ष्यन्ति will not be able to compete.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष विग्रहवान् धर्म एष वीर्यवतां वर:। एष बुध्याऽधिको लोके तपसश्च परायणम्।।1.21.10।।
output: एष: Visvamitra, विग्रहवान् embodiment, धर्म: righteousness, एष: Visvamitra, वीर्यवताम् of those possessing prowess, वर: excellent, एष: Visvamitra, बुध्या in intellect, लोके in this world, अधिक: surpasses, तपस: in asceticism, परायणम् last resort (supreme refuge).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषोऽस्त्रान् विविधान्वेत्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे। नैनमन्य: पुमान्वेत्ति न च वेत्स्यन्ति केचन।।1.21.11।।
output: एष: this one, विविधान् various kinds of, अस्त्रान् weapons, वेत्ति knows, सचराचरे among all animate and inanimate beings, त्रैलोक्ये in three words, अन्य: पुमान् no other man, एनं न वेत्ति does not know him, केचन none, न वेत्स्यन्ति are not going to know about him in future.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न देवा नर्षय: केचिन्नासुरा न च राक्षसा:। गन्धर्वयक्षप्रवरास्सकिन्नरमहोरगा:।।1.21.12।।
output: देवा: devatas, न(वेत्स्यन्ति) will not be able to know how to use weapons, ऋषय: rishis, केचित् न none knows, असुरा: nor asuras, राक्षसा: न nor rakshasas, सकिन्नरमहोरगा: along with kinnaras or mighty serpants, गन्धर्वयक्षप्रवरा: nor gandharvas nor best of yakshas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वास्त्राणि भृशाश्वस्य पुत्रा: परमधार्मिका:। कौशिकाय पुरा दत्ता यदा राज्यं प्रशासति।।1.21.13।।
output: All these weapons were given to Viswamitra by Bhrisasva's highly virtuous sons while he was ruling the kingdom.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेऽपि पुत्रा भृशाश्वस्य प्रजापतिसुतासुता:। नैकरूपा महावीर्या दीप्तिमन्तो जयावहा:।।1.21.14।।
output: प्रजापतिसुतासुता: grand sons of Prajapati, भृशाश्वस्य Bhrisasva's, पुत्रा: sons, तेऽपि as the weapons, नैकरूपा: of diverse forms, महावीर्या: highly energetic, दीप्तिमन्त: full of glory, जयावहा: bring victory.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जया च सुप्रभा चैव दक्षकन्ये सुमध्यमे। ते सुवातेऽस्त्रशस्त्राणि शतं परमभास्वरम्।।1.21.15।।
output: Jaya and Suprabha of slender waists are the two daughters of Daksha. They gave  birth to one hundred effulgent sons known as astras and shastras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पञ्चाशतं सुतान् लेभे जया नाम परान् पुरा। वधायासुरसैन्यानाममेयान् कामरूपिण:।।1.21.16।।
output: Formerly Jaya, for the destruction of the army of asuras gave birth to fifty sons by virtue of a boon. They  possess immeasurable power of changing forms at will.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 21:
सुप्रभाऽजनयच्चापि पुत्रान्पञ्चाशतं पुन:। संहारान्नामदुर्धर्षान् दुराक्रामान् बलीयस:।।1.21.17।।
output: Suprabha gave birth to another fifty sons named Samharas who are unassailable,  invincible and more powerful.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 21:
तानि चास्त्राणि वेत्त्येष यथावत्कुशिकात्मज:। अपूर्वाणां च जनने शक्तो भूयस्स धर्मवित्।।1.21.18।।
output: Viswamitra is well conversant with these weapons. Being virtuous, he is capable of creating new weapons also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं वीर्यो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महायशाः। न रामगमने राजन् संशयं कर्तुमर्हसि।।1.21.19।।
output: Such is the prowess of Viswamitra who is a highly effulgent and highly renowned  sage. O King in sending Rama, you need not entertain any doubt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषां निग्रहणे शक्तस्स्वयं च कुशिकात्मज:। तव पुत्रहितार्थाय त्वामुपेत्याभियाचते।।1.21.20।।
output: कुशिकात्मज: son of Kusika, स्वयं च by himself, तेषाम् of those rakhsasas, निग्रहणे in  repressing, शक्त: capable, तव your, पुत्रहितार्थाय welfare of your son, त्वाम् you, उपेत्य having reached, अभि याचते begs.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 21:
इति मुनिवचनात्प्रसन्नचित्तो रघुवृषभस्तु मुमोद भास्वराङ्ग:। गमनमभिरुरोच राघवस्य प्रथितयशा: कुशिकात्मजाय बुध्या।।1.21.21।।
output: Satisfied in his mind at the words of the sage (Vasishta), the full one among the Raghus' (Dasaratha) one with wide reputation, his frame shining gave his cheerful consent to the son of Kusika for Rama's departure. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentyfirst sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 22:
तथा वसिष्ठे ब्रुवति राजा दशरथस्सुतम प्रहृष्टवदनो राममाजुहाव सलक्ष्मणम्।।1.22.1।।
output: Vasishta having said thus, king Dasaratha, with cheerful countenance summoned Rama and Lakshmana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृतस्वस्त्ययनं मात्रा पित्रा दशरथेन च। पुरोधसा वसिष्ठेन मङ्गलैरभिमन्त्रितम्।।1.22.2।। स पुत्रं मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय राजा दशरथ: प्रियम्। ददौ कुशिकपुत्राय सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना।।1.22.3।।
output: स: दशरथ: राजा that king Dasaratha, मात्रा by mother, पित्रा दशरथेन च by father Dasaratha (by himself), कृतस्वस्त्ययनम् giving farewell by recitation of mantras for securing prosperity and averting evils, पुरोधसा वसिष्ठेन by priest Vasishta, मङ्गलै: by auspicious, अभिमन्त्रितम् making sacred by recitation of special mantras, प्रियम् पुत्रम् affectionate son, मूर्ध्नि on the forehead, उपाघ्राय having kissed, सुप्रीतेन with a pleased, अन्तरात्मना heart, कुशिकपुत्राय for kusika's son, ददौ delivered Rama (to the care of Viswamitra).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृतस्वस्त्ययनं मात्रा पित्रा दशरथेन च। पुरोधसा वसिष्ठेन मङ्गलैरभिमन्त्रितम्।।1.22.2।। स पुत्रं मूर्ध्न्युपाघ्राय राजा दशरथ: प्रियम्। ददौ कुशिकपुत्राय सुप्रीतेनान्तरात्मना।।1.22.3।।
output: Rama was given farewell by his parents with recitation of mantras (for securing prosperity and averting evils). Priest Vasishta sanctified him with mantras Dasaratha kissed his son on the forehead and delivered him to the care of Viswamitra, with a heart full of cheer.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 22:
ततो वायुस्सुखस्पर्शो नीरजस्को ववौ तदा। विश्वामित्रगतं दृष्ट्वा रामं राजीवलोचनम्।।1.22.4।।
output: At the sight of the lotuseyed Rama accompanying Viswamitra, the wind blew pollenfree with a gentle touch.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 22:
पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीद्देवदुन्दुभिनिस्वनै:। शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोष: प्रयाते तु महात्मनि।।1.22.5।।
output: The departure of glorious Viswamitra was greeted with incessant showers of flowers, the beating of celestial drums and the blowing of conches.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विश्वामित्रो ययावग्रे ततो रामो धनुर्धर:। काकपक्षधरो धन्वी तं च सौमित्रिरन्वगात्।।1.22.6।।
output: विश्वामित्र: Viswamitra, अग्रे in the forefront, ययौ walked, तत: behind him, धनुर्धर: with bow in his hand, राम: Rama (followed), काकपक्षधर: having side locks of hair, धन्वी an archer, सौमित्रि: Sumitra's son Lakshmana, तम् अन्वगात् followed him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कलापिनौ धनुष्पाणी शोभमानौ दिशो दश । विश्वामित्रं महात्मानं त्रिशीर्षाविव पन्नगौ।।1.22.7।। अनुजग्मतुरक्षुद्रौ पितामहमिवाश्विनौ।
output: कलापिनौ equipped with quivers, धनुष्पाणी the twain with bows in their hands, दश दिश: in ten cardinal points, शोभमानौ illuminating, अक्षुद्रौ warriors of not a little prowess and splendour, त्रिशीर्षौ three hooded, पन्नगौ इव resembling two serpents, महात्मानम् magnanimous, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, अश्विनौ twin Aswini devatas, पितामहमिव like Brahma, अनुजग्मतु: followed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 22:
तदा कुशिकपुत्रं तु धनुष्पाणी स्वलङ्कृतौ।।1.22.8।। बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणौ खड्गवन्तौ महाद्युती । कुमारौ चारुवपुषौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ   ।।1.22.9।। अनुयातौ श्रिया दीप्तौ शोभयेतामनिन्दितौ। स्थाणुं देवमिवाचिन्त्यं कुमाराविव पावकी ।।1.22.10।।
output: Then bows in hand, wellattired, their fingers encased in mongrel skin, for protection (against the bowstring) armed with scimitars, resplendent, young, handsome the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana shone unblemished. As they followed sage Viswamitra spreading radiance, they looked like sons of the god of fire, (Skanda and Visakhu) following the  incomprehensible Siva.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदा कुशिकपुत्रं तु धनुष्पाणी स्वलङ्कृतौ।।1.22.8।। बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणौ खड्गवन्तौ महाद्युती । कुमारौ चारुवपुषौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ   ।।1.22.9।। अनुयातौ श्रिया दीप्तौ शोभयेतामनिन्दितौ। स्थाणुं देवमिवाचिन्त्यं कुमाराविव पावकी ।।1.22.10।।
output: तदा then, धनुष्पाणी bows in their hands, स्वलङ्कृतौ wellattired, बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणौ their left arms covered by leather to protect from bowstring and fingers encased in Gauna skin, खड्गवन्तौ armed with scimitars, महाद्युती resplendent, कुमारौ youthful beings, चारुवपुषौ having elegent physique, श्रिया with lustre, दीप्तौ radiating, अनिन्दितौ faultless, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, अनुयातौ following the sage, पावकी born to firegod, कुमारौ sons Skanda and Visakhu, अचिन्त्यम् incomprehensible, देवम् god, स्थाणुम् इव like Iswara, कुशिकपुत्रम् son of Kausika, शोभयेताम् cast their radiance.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदा कुशिकपुत्रं तु धनुष्पाणी स्वलङ्कृतौ।।1.22.8।। बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणौ खड्गवन्तौ महाद्युती । कुमारौ चारुवपुषौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ   ।।1.22.9।। अनुयातौ श्रिया दीप्तौ शोभयेतामनिन्दितौ। स्थाणुं देवमिवाचिन्त्यं कुमाराविव पावकी ।।1.22.10।।
output: Then bows in hand, wellattired, their fingers encased in mongrel skin, for protection (against the bowstring) armed with scimitars, resplendent, young, handsome the two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana shone unblemished. As they followed sage Viswamitra spreading radiance, they looked like sons of the god of fire, (Skanda and Visakhu) following the  incomprehensible Siva.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अध्यर्धयोजनं गत्वा सरय्वा दक्षिणे तटे। रामेति मधुरां वाणीं विश्वामित्रोऽभ्यभाषत।।1.22.11।।
output: After crossing a distance of over half a yojana on the southern bank of Sarayu, Viswamitra addressed Rama sweet in a gentle voice.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गृहाण वत्स सलिलं मा भूत्कालस्य पर्यय:। मन्त्रग्रामं गृहाण त्वं बलामतिबलां तथा।।1.22.12।।
output: वत्स O Child, सलिलम् water, गृहाण take into your hands, कालस्य पर्यय:माभूत् let  no delay occur, त्वम् you, मन्त्रग्रामम् collection of mantras, तथा and, बलाम् Bala, अतिबलां Atibala, गृहाण receive.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न श्रमो न ज्वरो वा ते न रूपस्य विपर्यय:। न च सुप्तं प्रमत्तं वा धर्षयिष्यन्ति नैऱृता:।।1.22.13।।
output: "(If you receive these mantras), you will experience neither fatigue, nor fever nor will there be a change in your appearance. Whether you are asleep or agitated, rakshasas cannot harm you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 22:
न बाह्वोस्सदृशो वीर्ये पृथिव्यामस्ति कश्चन। त्रिषु लोकेषु वै राम न भवेत्सदृशस्तव ।।1.22.14।।
output: O Rama, there is none in this world equal to the might of your hands nor does such a person exist in the three worlds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न सौभाग्ये न दाक्षिण्ये न ज्ञाने बुद्धिनिश्चये। नोत्तरे प्रतिवक्तव्ये समो लोके तवाऽनघ।।1.22.15।।
output: अनघ O Sinless one, सौभाग्ये in auspiciouness, तव सम: equal to  you, लोके in this world, न none, दाक्षिण्ये in kindness, न none, ज्ञाने in wisdom, बुद्धिनिश्चये in decisionmaking, न  none, उत्तरे when a reply, प्रतिवक्तव्ये has to be given, न none.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतद्विद्याद्वये लब्धे भविता नास्ति ते सम:। बलात्वतिबला चैव सर्वज्ञानस्य मातरौ।।1.22.16।।
output: With these two kinds of knowledge secured, there will be none equal to you, at present or in fututre. Bala and atibala are  mother to all kinds of knowledge .

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षुत्पिपासे न ते राम भविष्येते नरोत्तम । बलामतिबलां चैव पठत: पथि राघव।।1.22.17।।
output: नरोत्तम O Best among men, राघव Oborn in the line of Raghu, राम ORama,पथि on the way, बलाम् Bala, अतिबलां चैव Atibala, पठत: if recited, ते to you, क्षुत्पिपासे hunger or thirst, न भविष्येते will not get.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विद्याद्वयमधीयाने यशश्चाप्यतुलं त्वयि। पितामहसुते ह्येते विद्ये तेजस्समन्विते।।1.22.18।। प्रदातुं तव काकुत्स्थ सदृशस्त्वं हि धार्मिक।
output: विद्याद्वयम् these two sciences, अधीयाने when pursued, त्वयि by you, अतुलम् unequalled, यशश्च fame, ककुत्स्थ ORama, born in the line Kakutstha, धार्मिक one who conforms to justice, तेजस्समन्विते both possessed of virtues, पितामहसुते two daughters of grand sire, Brahma, एते विद्ये these sciences, तव to you, प्रदातुम् conferring, त्वम् you, सदृश: fit person.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 22:
कामं बहुगुणास्सर्वे त्वय्येते नात्र संशय:। तपसा सम्भृते चैते बहुरूपे भविष्यत:।।1.22.19।।
output: You possess all these qualities in great measure. There is no doubt that If these two sciences (mantras) are nourished with austerities they will assume multiple forms (and benefit you)".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो रामो जलं स्पृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्टवदनश्शुचि:। प्रतिजग्राह ते विद्ये महर्षेर्भावितात्मन:।।1.22.20।।
output: Thereafter Rama, touched the water and was sanctified. With a cheerful face he received those two sciences from the maharshi who had perceived the supreme soul.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विद्यासमुदितो रामश्शुशुभे भूरिविक्रम:। सहस्ररश्मिर्भगवान् शरदीव दिवाकर:।।1.22.21।। गुरुकार्याणि सर्वाणि नियुज्य कुशिकात्मजे। ऊषुस्तां रजनीं तत्र सरय्वां सुसुखं त्रय:।।1.22.22।।
output: भूरिविक्रम: a highly valiant hero, राम: Rama, विद्यासमुदित: possessed of the knowledge of the two sciences, कुशिकात्मजे in the matter of Visvamitra, सर्वाणि all, गुरुकार्याणि services  to be rendered in relation to a preceptor, नियुज्य having performed, शरदि like in autumnal season, सहस्ररश्मि: (Sun) emitting thousand rays, भगवान् दिवाकर:इव  resembling Sungod, शुशुभे appeared resplendent, त्रय: the three men, तत्र there, सरय्वाम् on the bank of river Sarayu, ससुखम् with great comfort, तां रजनीम् that night, ऊषु: dwelt.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 22:
विद्यासमुदितो रामश्शुशुभे भूरिविक्रम:। सहस्ररश्मिर्भगवान् शरदीव दिवाकर:।।1.22.21।। गुरुकार्याणि सर्वाणि नियुज्य कुशिकात्मजे। ऊषुस्तां रजनीं तत्र सरय्वां सुसुखं त्रय:।।1.22.22।।
output: . Rama, the highly heroic  after acquiring knowledge (of the two sciences) and having rendered all services to preceptor Viswamitra, appeared resplendent like the Sungod in autumn. There the three of them spent the night comfortably on the bank of Sarayu.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 22:
दशरथनृपसूनुसत्तमाभ्यां तृणशयनेऽनुचिते सहोषिताभ्याम्। कुशिकसुतवचोऽनुलालिताभ्यां सुखमिव सा विबभौ विभावरी च।।1.22.23।।
output: The night was spent as though with comfort by the two eminent sons of Dasaratha, who shared the unaccustomed bed of grass. They were kept in good humour by the words of Kusika's son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्वाविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twenty second sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। अभ्यभाषत काकुत्स्थौ शयानौ पर्णसंस्तरे।।1.23.1।।
output: Accompanied by Rama and Lakshmana, Viswamitra reaches the hermitage of Kama at the confluence of Sarayu and Ganga.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम पूर्वा सन्ध्या प्रवर्तते। उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल कर्तव्यं दैवमाह्निकम्।।1.23.2।।
output: कैसल्या सुप्रजा: OBeloved son of Kausalya, (a son by whom Kausalya became a blessed mother), राम ORama, पूर्वा सन्ध्या the daybreak, प्रवर्तते is commencing ,नरशार्दूल OBest among men, उत्तिष्ठ awake (fromsleep), दैवम् oblations to gods, आह्निकम् religious rite  to be performed every day at a fixed hour, कर्तव्यम् are required to be done.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यर्षे: परमोदारं वचश्श्रुत्वा नृपात्मजौ । स्नात्वा कृतोदकौ वीरौ जेपतु: परमं जपम्।।1.23.3।।
output: On hearing the very affectionate call of Viswamitra both the brave princes had their bath and offered oblations to Sungod (standing in the water) and recited the holy name of the Lord.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृताह्निकौ महावीर्यौ विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम्। अभिवाद्याभिसंहृष्टौ गमनायाभितस्थतु:।।1.23.4।।
output: On performing the morning rites, the two highly powerful and and energetic princes stood before Viswamitra who was richly endowed with asceticism. They prostrated before him. And stood ready for their onward journey.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तौ प्रयातौ महावीर्यौ दिव्यां त्रिपथगां नदीम्। ददृशाते ततस्तत्र सरय्वास्सङ्गमे शुभे।।1.23.5।।
output: Thereafter, having gone a little further both the heroic brothers looked at the confluence of holy  Sarayu with  divine Ganga divided into three branches.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्राश्रमपदं पुण्यमृषीणामग्य्रतेजसाम् । बहुवर्षसहस्राणि तप्यतां परमं तप:।।1.23.6।।
output: तत्र there, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, परमम् utmost, तप: austerities, तप्यताम् while performing austerities, अग्य्रतेजसाम् sages of topmost vital power, ऋषीणाम् of the  anchorites, पुण्यम् sacred, आश्रमपदम् hermitage.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 23:
तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतौ राघवौ पुण्यमाश्रमम्। ऊचतुस्तं महात्मानं विश्वामित्रमिदं वच:।।1.23.7।।
output: Exceedingly delighted to see the sacred hermitage, the two princes enquired from the illustrious sage Viswamitra:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 23:
कस्यायमाश्रम: पुण्य: कोन्वस्मिन्वसते पुमान्। भगवन् श्रोतुमिच्छाव: परं कौतूहलं हि नौ।।1.23.8।।
output: "O worshipful one, whose sacred hermitage is this? Who lives here? Indeed, we are curious to know".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तयोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिपुङ्गव:। अब्रवीच्छ्रूयतां राम यस्यायं पूर्व आश्रम:।।1.23.9 ।।
output: On having heard their words, the foremost of sages gently smiled and said, "O Rama listen, who this hermitage belonged to in the past".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कन्दर्पो मूर्तिमानासीत्काम इत्युच्यते बुधै:। तपस्यन्तमिह स्थाणुं नियमेन समाहितम्।।1.23.10।। कृतोद्वाहं तु देवेशं गच्छन्तं समरुद्गगणम्। धर्षयामास दुर्मेधा हुङ्कृतश्च महात्मना।।1.23.11।।
output: कन्दर्प: Kandarpa also known as Manmatha, मूर्तिमान् incarnated in human form, आसीत् lived, बुधै: by the learned, काम: इति उच्यते is called Kama, दुर्मेधा: foolish minded, इह here, तपस्यन्तम् while doing penance, नियमेन in accordance with rules, समाहितम् absorbed in meditation, कृतोद्वाहम् with his newly wedded wife, समरुद्गगणम् accompanied by maruts, गच्छन्तम् wending his way, देवेशम् lord of deities, स्थाणुम् Siva, धर्षयामास opposed him, महात्मना by Lord Siva, हुङ्कृतश्च roared in menacing sound.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 23:
कन्दर्पो मूर्तिमानासीत्काम इत्युच्यते बुधै:। तपस्यन्तमिह स्थाणुं नियमेन समाहितम्।।1.23.10।। कृतोद्वाहं तु देवेशं गच्छन्तं समरुद्गगणम्। धर्षयामास दुर्मेधा हुङ्कृतश्च महात्मना।।1.23.11।।
output: "Kandarpa (the god of love) once lived here in human form. He is called Kama by the learned. The wicked Kama on his way with the maruts (god of wind) insulted Siva, the god of gods, while he was absorbed in austere meditation along with his newly wedded consort. On seeing Kama Lord Siva roared at him (menacingly).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवदग्धस्य रौद्रेण चक्षुषा रघुनन्दन। व्यशीर्यन्त शरीरात्स्वात्सर्वगात्राणि दुर्मते:।।1.23.12।।
output: "O descendant of Raghu, burnt down by his fierce (third) eye, all the limbs of the body of that evilminded Kama were consumed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य गात्रं हतं तत्र निर्दग्थस्य महात्मना। अशरीर: कृत: काम: क्रोधाद्देवेश्वरेण हि।।1.23.13।।
output: Having been completely burnt down by Lord Siva, Kama's body was destroyed. Mighty angry, Siva, reduced Kama to a 'disembodied being.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनङ्ग इति विख्यातस्तदाप्रभृति राघव। स चाङ्गविषयश्श्रीमान्यत्राङ्गं प्रमुमोच ह।।1.23.14।।
output: राघव O Rama, तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, अनङ्ग इति as Ananga, विख्यात: had become wellknown, यत्र where, अङ्गम् body, प्रमुमोच ह he gave up, स:च that place, श्रीमान् beautiful, अङ्गविषय: Ananga desa, विख्यात: famed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यायमाश्रम: पुण्यस्तस्येमे मुनय: पुरा। शिष्या धर्मपरा नित्यं तेषां पापं न विद्यते।।1.23.15।।
output: अयम् this, तस्य his, पुण्य: holy, आश्रम: hermitage, पुरा formerly, तस्य his, शिष्या: disciples, इमे मुनय: these ascetics, नित्यम् always, धर्मपरा: righteous, तेषाम् for them, पापम् sin, न विद्यते does not accrue.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इहाद्य रजनीं राम वसेम शुभदर्शन। पुण्ययोस्सरितोर्मध्ये श्वस्तरिष्यामहे वयम्।।1.23.16।।
output: O auspiciouslooking Rama, we will stay here tonight at the confluence of both these sacred rivers (Sarayu and Ganga) and cross over Ganga tomorrow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभिगच्छामहे सर्वे शुचय: पुण्यमाश्रमम्। स्नाताश्च कृतजप्याश्च हुतहव्या नरोत्तम।।1.23.17।।
output: O best of men, after morning ablutions offering oblations to the sacred fire, all of us sanctified will enter this pious hermitage".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषां संवदतां तत्र तपोदीर्घेण चक्षुषा। विज्ञाय परमप्रीता मुनयो हर्षमागमन्।।1.23.18।।
output: As they were conversing thus, the ascetics, with their far reaching spiritual vision (beyond the veil of time) recognised them and were immensely pleased.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्घ्यं पाद्यं तथाऽतिथ्यं निवेद्य कुशिकात्मजे। रामलक्ष्मणयो: पश्चादकुर्वन्नतिथिक्रियाम्।।1.23.19।।
output: अर्घ्यम् respectable offerings, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, तथा and, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कुशिकात्मजे to Visvamitra, निवेद्य having offered, पश्चात् thereafter, रामलक्ष्मणयो: for Rama and Lakshmana, अतिथिक्रियाम् acts of hospitality, अकुर्वन् performed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 23:
सत्कारं समनुप्राप्य कथाभिरभिरञ्जयन्। यथार्हमजपन् सन्ध्यामृषयस्ते समाहिता:।।1.23.20।।
output: Having received due hospitality, they delighted them (ascetics) with their talk. The rishis with composed minds recited their evening prayer as usual.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्र वासिभिरानीता मुनिभिस्सुव्रतै: सह। न्यवसन् सुसुखं तत्र कामाश्रमपदे तदा।।1.23.21।।
output: The ascetics who resided there, faithful to their vows, took them in. There they staed happily  in Kama's hermitage.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कथाभिरभिरामाभिरभिरामौ नृपात्मजौ। रमयामास धर्मात्मा कौशिको मुनिपुङ्गव:।।1.23.22।।
output: धर्मात्मा the magnanimous, मुनिपुङ्गव: foremost of ascetics, कौशिक: son of Kusika, अभिरामौ charming, नृपात्मजौ princes, अभिरामाभि: by enchanting, कथाभि: tales, रमयामास delighted them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत: प्रभाते विमले कृताह्निकमरिन्दमौ। विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य नद्यास्तीरमुपागतौ।।1.24.1।।
output: While crossing the river Rama asks "What is this tumultuous sound gushing from the Ganga?"--Viswamitra gives the reply--The trio enter the forest -- Viswamitra narrates the story of Tataka.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
ते च सर्वे महात्मानो मुनयस्संश्रितव्रता:। उपस्थाप्य शुभां नावं विश्वामित्रमथाब्रुवन्।।1.24.2।।
output: All the highminded ascetics and strict followers of vows secured an auspicious boat for them and addressed Viswamitra, saying:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आरोहतु भवान्नावं राजपुत्रपुरस्कृत:। अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानं मा भूत्कालविपर्यय:।।1.24.3।।
output: भवान् O Great rishi, राजपुत्रपुरस्कृत: with the princes ahead of you, नावम् boat, आरोहतु you may board it, अरिष्टम् devoid of evils, पन्थानम् path, गच्छ go, कालविपर्यय: loss of time,  माभूत् let not take place.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विश्वामित्रस्तथेत्युक्तवा तानृषीनभिपूज्य च। ततार सहितस्ताभ्यां सरितं सागरङ्गमाम्।।1.24.4।।
output: विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, तथेति 'so be it', उक्त्वा having said, तान् ऋषीन् all those sages, अभिपूज्य having worshipped, ताभ्याम् by Rama and Lakshmana, सहित: accompanied by, सागरङ्गमाम् flowing towards the sea, सरितम् river Ganga, ततार crossed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शुश्राव वै शब्दमतिसंरम्भवर्धितम्। मध्यमागम्य तोयस्य सह राम:कनीयसा।।1.24.5।।
output: तत: then, राम: Rama, तोयस्य of  the water, मध्यम् midst, आगम्य having come,      अतिसंरम्भवर्धितम् greatly augmented by the speed, शब्दम् thunderous noise, कनीयसा सह with his younger brother, शुश्राव heard.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
अथ रामस्सरिन्मध्ये पप्रच्छ मुनिपुङ्गवम्। वारिणो भिद्यमानस्य किमयं तुमुलो ध्वनि:।।1.24.6।।
output: Rama enquired of Viswamitra, the best of sages, "What is this tumultuous sound  bursting out of the waters?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
राघवस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वित:। कथयामास धर्मात्मा तस्य शब्दस्य निश्चयम्।।1.24.7।।
output: At the words of Rama filled with curiosity, the righteous (Viswamitra) narrated the true nature of that sound.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कैलासपर्वते राम मनसा निर्मितं सर:। ब्रह्मणा नरशार्दूल तेनेदं मानसं सर:।।1.24.8।।
output: "O tiger among men, Rama. Brahma created out of his mind a lake on mount Kailas and so that lake is called Manasa (Sarovara).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मात्सुस्राव सरसस्सायोध्यामुपगूहते । सर प्रवृत्ता सरयू: पुण्या ब्रह्मसरश्च्युता।।1.24.9।।
output: तस्मात् सरस: from that Manasa lake, सुस्राव flowed, सा that river, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, उपगूहते surrounds, सर प्रवृत्ता because it flows from that lake, सरयू: is known as Sarayu, ब्रह्मसरश्च्युता released from the lake of Brahma, पुण्या sacred.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
तस्यायमतुलश्शब्दो जाह्नवीमभिवर्तते। वारिसङ्क्षोभजो राम प्रणामं नियत:कुरु।।1.24.10।।
output: When Ganga approaches this river (Sarayu), there is a clash of waters and this great noise is produced. Rama, offer respectful salutations here, with a calm mind".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताभ्यां तु तावुभौ कृत्वा प्रणाममतिधार्मिकौ। तीरं दक्षिणमासाद्य जग्मतुर्लघुविक्रमौ।।1.24.11।।
output: अतिधार्मिकौ both who were exceedingly righteous, तौ उभौ both of them, ताभ्याम् to the two rivers, प्रणामम् obeisance, कृत्वा having made, दक्षिणं तीरम् southern bank, आसाद्य having reached, लघुविक्रमौ with quick steps, जग्मतु: proceeded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स वनं घोरसङ्काशं दृष्ट्वा नृपवरात्मज:। अविप्रहतमैक्ष्वाक: पप्रच्छ मुनिपुङ्गवम्।।1.24.12।।
output: ऐक्ष्वाक: descendent of Ikshvaku, नृपवरात्मज: son of best of kings, स: he, घोरसङ्काशम् dreadful, अविप्रहतम् untrodden, वनम् forest, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मुनिपुङ्गवम् foremost of ascetics, पप्रच्छ asked.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहो वनमिदं दुर्गं झिल्लिकागणनादितम्। भैरवैश्शपदै: पूर्णं शकुन्तैर्दारुणारुतै:।।1.24.13।।
output: "What a wonder This inaccessible forest echoes with the (shrill) chirpings of crickets It is filled with ferocious beasts and birds producing fearful sounds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नानाप्रकारैश्शकुनै र्वाश्यद्भिर्भैरवस्वनै:। सिंहव्याघ्रवराहैश्च वारणैश्चोपशोभितम्।।1.24.14।।
output: वाश्यद्भि: shrieking, भैरवस्वनै: frightful sounds, नानाप्रकारै: by  various kinds of, शकुनै: birds, सिंहव्याघ्रवराहै: च lions, tigers, boars, वारणै: च by elephants, उपशोभितम् shining.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धवाश्वकर्णककुभैर्बिल्वतिन्दुकपाटलै:। सङ्कीर्णं बदरीभिश्च किन्न्वेतद्दारुणं वनम्।।1.24.15।।
output: This forest jampacked with dhava, ashvakarna, kakubha, bilva, tinduka, patala and badari trees, how frightening this forest could be"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमुवाच महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। श्रूयतां वत्स काकुत्स्थ यस्यैतद्दारुणं वनम्।।1.24.16।।
output: महातेजा: highly powerful, महामुनि: great sage, विश्वामित्र: Viswamitra, तम् addressing him, उवाच spoke, वत्स O Child, काकुत्स्थ Kakusthsa, एतत् दारुणं वनम् this dreadful forest, यस्य whose, श्रूयताम् let it be heard.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ पूर्वमास्तां नरोत्तम। मलदाश्च करूशाश्च देवनिर्माणनिर्मितौ।।1.24.17।।
output: O best among men, formerly these two large and prosperous cities called Malada and Karusha built by celestial architects existed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुरा वृत्रवधे राम मलेन समभिप्लुतम्। क्षुधा चैव सहस्राक्षं ब्रह्महत्या समाविशत्।।1.24.18।।
output: O Rama, in ancient times after killing Vritrasura, Indra was overpowered by the sin of slaying a brahmin and was affected by impurity and hunger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमिन्द्रं स्नापयन् देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधना:। कलशैस्स्नापयामासुर्मलं चास्य प्रमोचयन्।।1.24.19।।
output: तम् इन्द्रम् Indra, देवा: devatas, स्नापयन् while bathing him, तपोधना: sages possessing asceticism as wealth, ऋषयश्च rishis, कलशै: with waterpitchers, स्नापयामासु: bathed him, अस्य मलम् his impurities, प्रमोचयन् liberated.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इह भूम्यां मलं दत्वा दत्वा कारूशमेव च। शरीरजं महेन्द्रस्य ततो हर्षं प्रपेदिरे।।1.24.20।।
output: With the hunger and the taint and impurity from the body of Mahendra removed at this place, the devas rejoiced.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निर्मलो निष्करूशश्च शुचिरिंन्द्रो यदाभवत्। ददौ देशस्य सुप्रीतो वरं प्रभुरनुत्तमम्।।1.24.21।।
output: Cleansed of his impurities and his hunger gone, Indra once again became pure. Allpowerful Indra highly pleased gave an excellent boon to that region.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ ख्यातिं लोके गमिष्यत:। मलदाश्च करूशाश्च ममाङ्गमलधारिणौ।।1.24.22।।
output: Indra blessed the place saying, 'Having absorbed impurities of my body, let these places be extremely fertile and prosperous and let this be renowned throughout this world as Malada and Karusha'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
साधु साध्विति तं देवा: पाकशासनमब्रुवन्। देशस्य पूजां तां दृष्ट्वा कृतां शक्रेण धीमता।।1.24.23।।
output: Having seen the honour bestowed on that land by the wise Indra, the gods said to him, 'Well done, Well done'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतौ जनपदौ स्फीतौ दीर्घकालमरिन्दम। मलदाश्च करूशाश्च मुदितौ धनधान्यत:।।1.24.24।।
output: अरिन्दम O Destroyer of enemies, मलदाश्च Malada, करूशाश्च and Karusha, स्फीतौ prosperous, एतौ these, जनपदौ townships, दीर्घकालम् for a long time, धनधान्यत: with the harvest of corn and wealth, मुदितौ rejoiced.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य यक्षी वै कामरूपिणी। बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयन्ती तदा ह्यभूत्।।1.24.25।। ताटका नाम भद्रं ते भार्या सुन्दस्य धीमत:। 2 मारीचो राक्षस: पुत्रो यस्याश्शक्रपराक्रम:।।1.24.26।।
output: Then, after a lapse of several years, O gentle one a terrible yakshini by name Tataka, wife of intelligent Sunda, capable of assuming different forms at will, possessed of the strength of a thousand elephants and mother of a rakshasa known as Maricha armed with the power of Indra took possession of this place.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य यक्षी वै कामरूपिणी। बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयन्ती तदा ह्यभूत्।।1.24.25।। ताटका नाम भद्रं ते भार्या सुन्दस्य धीमत:। 2 मारीचो राक्षस: पुत्रो यस्याश्शक्रपराक्रम:।।1.24.26।।
output: Then, after a lapse of several years, O gentle one a terrible yakshini by name Tataka, wife of intelligent Sunda, capable of assuming different forms at will, possessed of the strength of a thousand elephants and mother of a rakshasa known as Maricha armed with the power of Indra took possession of this place.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
वृत्तबाहुर्महावीर्यो विपुलास्य तनुर्महान्। राक्षसो भैरवाकारो नित्यं त्रासयते प्रजा:।।1.24.27।।
output: The arms (of Maricha) are round and strong. He is highly energetic. He has a large face and a huge body. In appearance, he is gigantic and possesses a dreadful form. That rakshasa always threatened the inhabitants.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमौ जनपदौ नित्यं विनाशयति राघव। मलदांश्च करूशांश्च ताटका दुष्टचारिणी।।1.24.28।।
output: "O Rama that wicked than Tataka carried on her depredations at regular intervals in these locations, Malada and Karusha.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सेयं पन्थानमावृत्य वसत्यध्यर्धयोजने। अत एव न गन्तव्यं ताटकाया वनं यत:।।1.24.29।।
output: सा such, इयम् thisTataka, पन्थानम् the path, आवृत्य obstructing, अध्यर्धयोजने at one and half yojanas distance, वसति living, यत: for which reason, ताटकाया: Tataka, वनम् forest, अत एव for that reason, न गन्तव्यम् one should not traverse.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
स्वबाहुबलमाश्रित्य जहीमां दुष्टचारिणीम्। मन्नियोगादिमं देशं कुरु निष्कण्टकं पुन:।।1.24.30।।
output: "By  the strength of your arms slay this one of wicked deeds. Comply with my orders and make this country safe (and habitable).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
न हि कश्चिदिमं देशं शक्नोत्यागन्तुमीदृशम्। यक्षिण्या घोरया राम उत्सादितमसह्यया।।1.24.31।।
output: O Rama none dare approach this country ravaged by such dreadful, intolerable yakshini.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 24:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यथैतद्दारुणं वनम्। यक्ष्या चोत्सादितं सर्वमद्यापि न निवर्तते।।1.24.32।।
output: You have been told the manner in which this fierce forest is entirely ruined by that cruel yakshini. Tell now she has not left this place". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुर्विंशतिस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentyfourth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 25:
अथ तस्याप्रमेयस्य मुनेर्वचनमुत्तमम्। श्रुत्वा पुरुषशार्दूल: प्रत्युवाच शुभां गिरम्।।1.25.1।।
output: On hearing the excellent words of Viswamitra, a sage with unimaginable faculty. Rama, the tiger among men (Rama) replied in a, gentle voice:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अल्पवीर्या यदा यक्षा श्श्रूयन्ते मुनिपुङ्गव। कथन्नागसहस्रस्य धारयत्यबला बलम्।।1.25.2।।
output: "O best of ascetics, I have heard the yakshas possess little prowess. How can a woman who is by gender weak possess the strength of a thousand elephants?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं शृण येन बलोत्तरा। वरदानकृतं वीर्यं धारयत्यबला बलम्।।1.25.3।।
output: विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, अबला a woman, येन for which ever  reason, बलोत्तरा acquired great strength, शृणु you may listen, वरदानकृतम् by virtue of a boon, वीर्यम् prowess, बलम् strength, धारयति possesses.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पूर्वमासीन्महायक्षस्सुकेतुर्नाम वीर्यवान्। अनपत्यश्शुभाचारस्स च तेपे महत्तप:।।1.25.4।।
output: "In the past there was a powerful and great yaksha by name Suketu. He had no  children. So he performed an intense penance following virtuous practices.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 25:
पितामहस्तु सुप्रीतस्तस्य यक्षपते स्तदा। कन्यारत्नं ददौ राम ताटकां नाम नामत:।।1.25.5।।
output: Rama the grandsire Brahma was highly gratified and granted to the king of yakshas, the gem of a daughter by name known asTataka.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ददौ नागसहस्रस्य बलं चास्या: पितामह:। नत्वेव पुत्रं यक्षाय ददौ ब्रह्मा महायशा:।।1.25.6।।
output: पितामह: lord Brahma, अस्या: for her, नागसहस्रस्य thousand elephants, बलम् strength, ददौ  granted, महायशा: that illustrious, ब्रह्मा lord Brahma, यक्षाय for that yaksha, पुत्रं तु son, न ददौ did not bestow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 25:
तां तु जातां विवर्धन्तीं रूपयौवनशालिनीम्। झर्झपुत्राय सुन्दाय ददौ भार्यां यशस्विनीम्।।1.25.7।।
output: As she grew up, glowing with youth and beauty she was given in marriage to Sunda, son of Jharjha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 25:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य यक्षी पुत्रमजायत। मारीचं नाम दुर्धर्षं यश्शापाद्राक्षसोऽभवत्।।1.25.8।।
output: After some time that yakshini gave birth to an unassailable son by name Maricha. Because of a curse, he became a rakshasa (though born of yaksha parentage).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 25:
सुन्दे तु निहते राम सागस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम्। ताटका सह पुत्रेण प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति।।1.25.9।।
output: O Rama when Sunda died Tataka along with her son wanted to attack Agastya, the best of sages.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भक्षार्थं जातसंरम्भा गर्जन्ती साभ्यधावत।0 आपतन्तीं तु तां दृष्ट्वा अगस्त्यो भगवानृषि:।।1.25.10।। राक्षसत्वं भजस्वेति मारीचं व्याजहार स:। 1
output: Roaring, she rushed with excitement to devour him. The venerable  rishi Agastya saw her approaching him and cursed Maricha to assume form of a demoness.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अगस्त्य: परमक्रुद्धस्ताटकामपि शप्तवान्।।1.25.11।। पुरुषादी महायक्षी विरूपा विकृतानना। इदं रूपं विहायाथ दारुणं रूपमस्तु ते।।1.25.12।।
output: Mighty angry, Agastya cursed Tataka saying, 'Abandon this form of a great yakshini and assume the terrible figure of a rakshasi, a cannibal with distorted appearance and a hideous countenance'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अगस्त्य: परमक्रुद्धस्ताटकामपि शप्तवान्।।1.25.11।। पुरुषादी महायक्षी विरूपा विकृतानना। इदं रूपं विहायाथ दारुणं रूपमस्तु ते।।1.25.12।।
output: परमक्रुद्ध: exceedingly wrathful, अगस्त्य: Agastya, ताटकामपि Tataka also, शप्तवान् cursed, इदं रूपम् this form, विहाय abandoning, अथ thereafter, विरूपा disfigured shape, विकृतानना hideous countenance, पुरुषादी becoming a cannibal, महायक्षी great yakshi, ते to you, दारुणं रूपम् अस्तु let it be a terrible form.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सैषा शापकृतामर्षा ताटका क्रोधमूर्छिता। देशमुत्सादयत्येनमगस्त्यचरितं शुभम्।।1.25.13।।
output: शापकृतामर्षा enraged at the curse, सा एषा ताटका this same Tataka, क्रोधमूर्छिता has become senseless with anger, अगस्त्यचरितम् place tread over by Agstya, शुभम् sacred, एनं देशम् this land, उत्सादयति is destroying.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एनां राघव दुर्वृत्तां यक्षीं परमदारुणाम्। गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय जहि दुष्टपराक्रमाम्।।1.25.14।।
output: राघव (राम) O Rama, दुर्वृत्ताम् wicked, परमदारुणाम् highly cruel, दुष्टपराक्रमाम् having vile prowess, एनां यक्षीम् this yakshi, गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय for the welfare of brahmins and the cows, जहि you may slay her.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न ह्येनां शापसम्स्पृष्टां कश्चिदुत्सहते पुमान्। निहन्तुं त्रिषु लोकेषु त्वामृते रघुनन्दन।।1.25.15।।
output: O son of Raghu's dynasty she is maligned by the curse, and so not a single man in the three worlds except you, is  competent to slay this yakshini.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न हि ते स्त्रीवधकृते घृणा कार्या नरोत्तम। चातुर्वण्यहितार्थाय कर्तव्यं राजसूनुना।।1.25.16।।
output: O best among men you need not hate killing a woman. You are a prince. You should serve the interest of the four orders of the society.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नृशंसमनृशंसं वा प्रजारक्षणकारणात्। पातकं वा सदोषं वा कर्तव्यं रक्षता सता।।1.25.17।।
output: रक्षता while protecting, सता by a virtuous man, प्रजारक्षणकारणात् for the welfare of the subjects, नृशंसं वा either cruel, अनृशंसं वा or not cruel ,पातकं वा or a sin, सदोषं वा or involving a mistake, कर्तव्यम् should be done.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राज्यभारनियुक्तानामेष धर्मस्सनातन:। अधर्म्यां जहि काकुत्स्थ धर्मोह्यस्या न विद्यते।।1.25.18।।
output: राज्यभारनियुक्तानाम् for those who enjoined by the burden of royalty, एष: this one, सनातन: eternal, धर्म: law, काकुत्स्थ O Kakusthsa, अधर्म्याम् unjust (Tataka ), जहि kill her, अस्या: for this Tataka, धर्म: righteousness, न विद्यते हि knows not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रूयते हि पुरा शक्रो विरोचनसुतां नृप। पृथिवीं हन्तुमिच्छन्तीं मन्थरामभ्यसूदयत्।।1.25.19।।
output: नृप O Prince, पुरा in the days of the past, पृथिवीम् this earth, हन्तुम् to destroy, इच्छन्तीम् intending, विरोचनसुताम् daughter of Virochana, मन्थराम् Manthara, शक्र: Indra, अभ्यसूदयत् slew, श्रूयते हि it is heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विष्णुनापि पुरा राम भृगुपत्नी दृढव्रता। अनिन्द्रं लोकमिच्छन्ती काव्यमाता निषूदिता।।1.25.20।।
output: राम O Rama, पुरा in the olden days, लोकम् this world, अनिन्द्रम् devoid of Indra, इच्छन्ती desirous, दृढव्रता determined to vow, काव्यमाता mother of Sukracharya, भृगुपत्नी अपि wife of sage Bhrigu, विष्णुनाऽपि by Visnu also, निषूदिता destroyed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 25:
एतैश्चान्यैश्च बहुभी राजपुत्र महात्मभि:। अधर्मसहिता नार्यो हता: पुरुषसत्तमै:।।1.25.21।।
output: O Prince by these magnanimous persons and by great men several unrighteous women were killed for the common good". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentyfifth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मुनेर्वचनमक्लीबं श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मज:। राघव: प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच दृढव्रत:।।1.26.1।।
output: दृढव्रत: a man firm in his vows, नरवरात्मज: the son of the foremost of men, राघव: Rama, अक्लीबम् determined, manly and bold, मुने: ascetic's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having listened, प्राञ्जलि:भूत्वा with folded palms, प्रत्युवाच replied.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पितुर्वचननिर्देशात्पितुर्वचनगौरवात्। वचनं कौशिकस्येति कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया।।1.26.2।।
output: पितु: of my father, वचननिर्देशात् to fulfil the words of command, पितु: of my sire's, वचनगौरवात् to honour his words, कौशिकस्य Kausika's, वचनम् इति the words as such, अविशङ्कया without hesitation, कर्तव्यम् fit to be done.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनुशिष्टोऽस्म्ययोध्यायां गुरुमध्ये महात्मना। पित्रा दशरथेनाहं नावज्ञेयं हि तद्वच:।।1.26.3।।
output: अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, गुरुमध्ये in the presence of elders, महात्मना by the magnanimous, पित्रा father, दशरथेन by Dasaratha, अहम् I, अनुशिष्ट: अस्मि have been ordered, तद्वच: his words, नावज्ञेयं हि cannot be disobeyed(turned down).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽहं पितुर्वचश्श्रुत्वा शासनाद्ब्रह्मवादिन:। करिष्यामि न सन्देहस्ताटकावधमुत्तमम्।।1.26.4।।
output: स: अहम्  such as I am, पितु: father's, वच: words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ब्रह्मवादिन: of the man  endowed with the knowledge of vedas, शासनात् in accordance with the command, उत्तमम् the welcoming act, ताटकावधम् slaying of Tataka, करिष्यामि I shall perform, सन्देह: न no doubt.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय देशस्यास्य सुखाय च। तव चैवाप्रमेयस्य वचनं कर्तुमुद्यत:।।1.26.5।।
output: For the welfare of cows and brahmins and also for the good of this country, I am ready to perform such acts as commanded by you of  boundless energy".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा धनुर्मध्ये बध्वा मुष्टिमरिन्दम:। ज्याशब्दमकरोत्तीव्रं दिशश्शब्देन नादयन्।।1.26.6।।
output: Rama, the destroyer of enemies having said so clinched the middle of the bow with his fist and filled the ten quarters with the resounding twanging of the bowstring.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तास्ताटकावनवासिन:। ताटका च सुसंक्रुद्धा तेन शब्देन मोहिता।।1.26.7।।
output: The dwellers of the Tataka forest were terrified by the sound (of the bow). Tataka, was might angry and amazed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं शब्दमभिनिध्याय राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्छिता। श्रुत्वा चाभ्यद्रवद्वेगाद्यतश्शब्दो विनिस्सृत:।।1.26.8।।
output: राक्षसी rakshasi, तं शब्दम् that sound, श्रत्वा having heard, क्रोधमूर्छिता infatuated with anger, अभिनिध्याय thought for a while, यत: from which direction, शब्द: sound, विनिस्सृत: originated(in that direction), वेगात् speedily, अभ्यद्रवत् rushed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
तां दृष्ट्वा राघव: क्रुद्धां विकृतां विकृताननाम्। प्रमाणेनातिवृद्धां च लक्ष्मणं सोऽभ्यभाषत।।1.26.9।।
output: Filled with wrath Rama saw Tataka, disfigured with a distorted face and gigantic in size. Turning to Lakshmana he said :

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पश्य लक्ष्मण यक्षिण्या भैरवं दारुणं वपु:। भिद्येरन् दर्शनादस्या भीरूणां हृदयानि च।।1.26.10।।
output: "O Lakshmana, behold, the sight of the dreadful hideous body of this yakshini will break timid hearts.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एनां पश्य दुराधर्षां मायाबलसमन्विताम्। विनिवृत्तां करोम्यद्य हृतकर्णाग्रनासिकाम्।।1.26.11।।
output: दुराधर्षाम् unassailable, मायाबलसमन्विताम endowed with strength gained through black magic, एनाम् her, हृतकर्णाग्रनासिकाम् deprive her of ears and tip of nose, विनिवृत्ताम् turned away, अद्य now, करोमि I shall do, पश्य see.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न ह्येनामुत्सहे हन्तुं स्त्रीस्वभावेन रक्षिताम्। वीर्यं चास्यां गतिं चापि हनिष्यामीति मे मति:।।1.26.12।।
output: स्त्रीस्वभावेन by virtue of being a woman, रक्षिताम् is protected, एनां हन्तुम् to slay her, न उत्सहे I am not inclined, अस्याम् in her, वीर्यम् prowess, गतिं चापि power of motion, हनिष्यामीति I will destroy, thus, मे मति: this is my opinion.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं ब्रुवाणे रामे तु ताटका क्रोधमूर्छिता। उद्यम्य बाहू गर्जन्ती राममेवाभ्यधावत।।1.26.13।।
output: While Rama was still speaking, Tataka, incensed with fury rushed with her uplifted arms towards him roaring.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
विश्वामित्रस्तु ब्रह्मर्षिर्हुङ्कारेणाभिभर्त्स्यताम्। स्वस्ति राघवयोरस्तु जयं चैवाभ्यभाषत।।1.26.14।।
output: Brahmarshi Viswamitra threatened her with hunkara (menacing sound), uttering, "Auspices to the Raghavas (Rama and Lakshmana) be aupicousness and success" victorious.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
उद्धून्वाना रजो घोरं ताटका राघवावुभौ। रजोमोहेन महता मुहूर्तं सा व्यमोहयत्।।1.26.15।।
output: Tataka raising a cloud of frightening dust left the descendants of Raghu bewildered quite for a moment.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
ततो मायां समास्थाय शिलावर्षेण राघवौ। अवाकिरत्सुमहता ततश्चुक्रोध राघव:।।1.26.16।।
output: Then invoking the power of magic, she showered extensive rain of boulders on both the descendants of Raghu. Rama was enraged at this.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शिलावर्षं महत्तस्याश्शरवर्षेण राघव:। प्रतिहत्योपधावन्त्या: करौ चिच्छेद पत्रिभि: ।।1.26.17।।
output: Rama retaliated that mighty rain of rocks with a volley of arrows. While she was advancing towards him, he cut off her hands.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्छिन्नभुजां श्रान्तामभ्याशे परिगर्जतीम्। सौमित्रिरकरोत्क्रोधाद्धृतकर्णाग्रनासिकाम्।।1.26.18।।
output: तत: then, छिन्नभुजाम् with her hands chopped, श्रान्ताम् tired, अभ्याशे in the nearby place, परिगर्जतीम् roaring, सौमित्रि: Lakshmana, क्रोधात् with indignation, हृतकर्णाग्रनासिकाम् अकरोत् cut off her ears and nose.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कामरूपधरा सद्य: कृत्वा रूपाण्यनेकश: । अन्तर्धानं गता यक्षी मोहयन्तीव मायया ।।1.26.19।। अश्मवर्षं विमुञ्चन्ती भैरवं विचचार ह ।
output: Capable of assuming forms at will, that yakshini intending to delude the princes through her power of magic, vanished from the sight. She then assumed various forms and released a rain of rocks. And started moving about frightfully.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तावश्मवर्षेण कीर्यमाणौ समन्तत:।।1.26.20।। दृष्ट्वा गाधिसुतश्श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: तत: then, समन्तत:on all sides, अश्मवर्षेण with rain of stones, कीर्यमाणौ being thrown out, तौ Rama and Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रीमान् auspicious, गाधिसुत: son of Gadhi, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अलं ते घृणया राम पापैषा दुष्टचारिणी।।1.26.21।। यज्ञविघ्नकरी यक्षी पुरावर्धति मायया।
output: राम Rama, ते to you, घृणया out of compassion, अलम् enough, पापा sinful, दुष्टचारिणी wicked woman, यज्ञविघ्नकरी obstructor of sacrifice, एषा यक्षी this yakshi, मायया by magic power, पुरावर्धति will regain with strength.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वध्यतां तावदेवैषा पुरा सन्ध्या प्रवर्तते।।1.26.22।। रक्षांसि सन्ध्याकालेषु दुर्धर्षाणि भवन्ति वै।
output: Kill her, for dusk is fast approaching. During evening the strength of rakshasas tends to increase and they become unassailable".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्तस्तु तदा यक्षी अश्मवृष्ट्याभिवर्षतीम्।।1.26.23।। दर्शयन् शब्दवेधित्वं तां रुरोध स सायकै:।
output: Addressed thus (by Viswamitra), Rama attacked her exhibiting his skill in targetting her by the sound and prevented with arrows the yakshini from showering  stones.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा रुद्धा शरजालेन मायाबलसमन्विता।।1.26.24।। अभिदुद्राव काकुत्स्थं लक्ष्मणं च विनेदुषी।
output: . Prevented by a multitude of arrows, she with her magical powers, advanced towards Rama and Lakshmanaroaring.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तामापतन्तीं वेगेन विक्रान्तामशनीमिव।।1.26.25।। शरेणोरसि विव्याथ सा पपात ममार च।
output: Her chest pierced with an arrow, she rushing menacingly towards them like a thunderbolt fell down dead.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां हतां भीमसङ्काशां दृष्ट्वा सुरपतिस्तदा।।1.26.26।। साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थं सुराश्च समपूजयन्।
output: तदा then, सुरपति: Indra, सुराश्च other celestial beings, हताम् slain, भीमसङ्काशाम् of terrible appearance, तां दृष्ट्वा having seen her, साधु साधु इति" well done, well done" saying so, काकुत्स्थम् Rama, समपूजयन् worshipped.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
उवाच परमप्रीत स्सहस्राक्ष: पुरन्दर:।।1.26.27।। सुराश्च सर्वे संहृष्टा विश्वामित्रमथाब्रुवन्।
output: Then exceedingly pleased the thousandeyed Indra and all other delighted celestials  said to Viswamitra:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुने कौशिक भद्रं ते सेन्द्रास्सर्वे मरुद्गणा:।।1.26.28।। तोषिता: कर्मणाऽनेन स्नेहं दर्शय राघवे।
output: "O ascetic Kausika, may prosperity be to you All devatas have been gratified by this act (of Rama) and have expressed their love for Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रजापतेर्भृशाश्वस्य पुत्रान् सत्यपराक्रमान्।।1.26.29।। तपोबलभृतो ब्रह्मन् राघवाय निवेदय।
output: ब्रह्मन् O Brahmarshi, प्रजापते: Prajapati's, भृशाश्वस्य Brishaswas', पुत्रान् sons, सत्यपराक्रमान् men of truthful prowess, तपोबलभृत़ः men endowed with ascetic energy, राघवाय for Rama, निवेदय offer.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पात्रभूतश्च ते ब्रह्मंस्तवानुगमने धृत:।।1.26.30।। कर्तव्यं च महत्कर्म सुराणां राजसूनुना।
output: "O Brahmarshi following you with firmness of mind, Rama is worthy to receive the weapons. He who is a prince has to accomplish many such great tasks for the benefit of the celestials".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा सुरास्सर्वे हृष्टा जग्मुर्यथागतम्।।1.26.31।। विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य ततस्सन्ध्या प्रवर्तते।
output: Having said these words, the celestials were pleased. They honoured Viswamitra and returned to their abodes from where they had come. And then dusk set in.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो मुनिवर: प्रीतस्ताटकावधतोषित:।।1.26.32।। मूर्ध्नि राममुपाघ्राय इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: Then, the best of ascetics Viswamitra rejoiced over the death of Tataka, kissed the forehead of Rama (fondly) and spoke these words:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
इहाद्य रजनीं राम वसेम शुभदर्शन।।1.26.33।। श्व: प्रभाते गमिष्यामस्तदाश्रमपदं मम।
output: "O auspiciouslooking Rama tonight we shall stay here. Tomorrow morning we proceed to my hermitage".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विश्वामित्रवच: श्रुत्वा हृष्टो दशरथात्मज:।।1.26.34।। उवास रजनीं तत्र ताटकाया वने सुखम्।
output: Having heard the words of Viswamitra, Rama rejoiced and rested happily that night in the Tataka forest .

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुक्तशापं वनं तच्च तस्मिन्नेव तदाहनि।।1.26.35।। रमणीयं विबभ्राज यथा चैत्ररथं वनम्।
output: Freed from the curse from that day that forest looked charming and shone like Chitraratha Kubera's (garden).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 26:
निहत्य तां यक्षसुतां स राम: प्रशस्यमानस्सुरसिद्धसङ्घै:। उवास तस्मिन्मुनिना सहैव प्रभातवेलां प्रतिबोध्यमान:।।1.26.36।।
output: Rama having killed the daughter of yaksha was praised by multitudes of devatas and siddhas. He stayed in the same forest with the sage. At the first glimpse of dawn, he was awakened by the sage (Viswamitra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षड्विंशस्सर्ग:।।7 Thus ends the twentysixth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ तां रजनीमुष्य विश्वामित्रो महायशाः। प्रहस्य राघवं वाक्यमुवाच मधुराक्षरम्।।1.27.1।।
output: Viswamitra confers celestial weapons on Rama

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
परितुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते राजपुत्र महायशः। प्रीत्या परमया युक्तो ददाम्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः।।1.27.2।।
output: महायशः of great renown, राजपुत्र O Prince, परितुष्टः अस्मि  I am extremely pleased, ते भद्रम् May you prosper, परमया प्रीत्या with great love and affection, युक्तः filled with, अस्त्राणि weapons, सर्वशः from all over, ददामि I shall give.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
देवासुरगणान्वापि सगन्धर्वोरगानपि। यैरमित्रान् प्रसह्याजौ वशीकृत्य जयिष्यसि।।1.27.3।। तानि दिव्यानि भद्रं ते ददाम्यस्त्राणि सर्वशः ।
output: यैः by means of which, देवासुरगणान्वापि even multitude of devatas, asuras, सगन्धर्वोरगानपि nagas together with gandharvas, अमित्रान् enemies, आजौ in the battle, प्रसह्य forcibly, वशीकृत्य taking them captives, जयिष्यसि you will vanquish, तानि दिव्यानि such celestial,   अस्त्राणि weapons, सर्वशः completely, ददामि I shall give, ते भद्रम् May you prosper.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दण्डचक्रं महद्दिव्यं तव दास्यामि राघव।।1.27.4।। धर्मचक्रं ततो वीर कालचक्रं तथैव च। विष्णुचक्रं तथात्युग्रमैन्द्रमस्त्रं तथैव च।।1.27.5।। वज्रमस्त्रं नरश्रेष्ठ शैवं शूलवरं तथा। अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरश्चैव ऐषीकमपि राघव।।1.27.6।। ददामि ते महाबाहो ब्राह्ममस्त्रमनुत्तमम्।
output: राघव Rama, महत् great, दिव्यम् celestial, दण्डचक्रम् Danda chakra, तव to you, दास्यामि I shall grant, नरश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, महाबाहो mighty armed one, वीर heroic, राघव Rama, ततः thereafter, धर्मचक्रम् Dharma chakra तथैव च also, कालचक्रम् Kala chakra, तथा  also, विष्णुचक्रम् Visnu chakra, तथैव च also,  ऐन्द्रम् अस्त्रम्  IndraAstra, वज्रम् अस्त्रम् Vajra astra, तथा thereafter, शैवम् relating to Shiva, शूलवरम् superior spear, ब्रह्मशिर known as Brahma Shira, अस्त्रम् astra, ऐषीकमपि Ishika astra, अनुत्तमम् highly superior, ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् Brahma astra, ते to you, ददामि I shall give.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 27:
दण्डचक्रं महद्दिव्यं तव दास्यामि राघव।।1.27.4।। धर्मचक्रं ततो वीर कालचक्रं तथैव च। विष्णुचक्रं तथात्युग्रमैन्द्रमस्त्रं तथैव च।।1.27.5।। वज्रमस्त्रं नरश्रेष्ठ शैवं शूलवरं तथा। अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरश्चैव ऐषीकमपि राघव।।1.27.6।। ददामि ते महाबाहो ब्राह्ममस्त्रमनुत्तमम्।
output: Mighty armed, heroic Rama I shall grant you the great celestial dandachakra. O best among men I shall grant you dharmachakra, kalachakra, visnuchakra, indraastra, vajraastra and the great, trident of Siva, brahmashirastra, ishika astra and highly superior brahmaastra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दण्डचक्रं महद्दिव्यं तव दास्यामि राघव।।1.27.4।। धर्मचक्रं ततो वीर कालचक्रं तथैव च। विष्णुचक्रं तथात्युग्रमैन्द्रमस्त्रं तथैव च।।1.27.5।। वज्रमस्त्रं नरश्रेष्ठ शैवं शूलवरं तथा। अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरश्चैव ऐषीकमपि राघव।।1.27.6।। ददामि ते महाबाहो ब्राह्ममस्त्रमनुत्तमम्।
output: राघव Rama, महत् great, दिव्यम् celestial, दण्डचक्रम् Danda chakra, तव to you, दास्यामि I shall grant, नरश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, महाबाहो mighty armed one, वीर heroic, राघव Rama, ततः thereafter, धर्मचक्रम् Dharma chakra तथैव च also, कालचक्रम् Kala chakra, तथा  also, विष्णुचक्रम् Visnu chakra, तथैव च also,  ऐन्द्रम् अस्त्रम्  IndraAstra, वज्रम् अस्त्रम् Vajra astra, तथा thereafter, शैवम् relating to Shiva, शूलवरम् superior spear, ब्रह्मशिर known as Brahma Shira, अस्त्रम् astra, ऐषीकमपि Ishika astra, अनुत्तमम् highly superior, ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् Brahma astra, ते to you, ददामि I shall give.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गदे द्वे चैव काकुत्स्थ मोदकी शिखरी उभे।।1.27.7।। प्रदीप्ते नरशार्दूल प्रयच्छामि नृपात्मज।
output: काकुत्स्थ born in the race of Kakutstha, नरशार्दूल best among men, नृपात्मज O Prince, Rama, प्रदीप्ते shining, द्वे two, मोदकी शिखरी Modaki and Shikhari, गदे two Maces, उभे both of them, प्रयच्छामि I shall give.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धर्मपाशमहं राम कालपाशं तथैव च।।1.27.8।। पाशं वारुणमस्त्रं च ददाम्यहमनुत्तमम्।
output: Rama, I shall grant dharmapasa, kalapasa, varuna pasa, too unique weapons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 27:
अशनी द्वे प्रयच्छामि शुष्कार्द्रे रघुनन्दन।।1.27.9।। ददामि चास्त्रं पैनाकमस्त्रं नारायणं तथा।
output: O descendant of Raghu I shall grant you two thunderbolts named shuska and ardra (dry and wet), painaka astra and narayanaastra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आग्नेयमस्त्रं दयितं शिखरं नाम नामतः।।1.27.10।। वायव्यं प्रथनं नाम ददामि च तवानघ ।
output: अनघ O Blemishless one, नामतः by name, शिखरं नाम wellknown as Sikhara, दयितम् a dear one,  आग्नेयम् अस्त्रम् Agneya astra, प्रथनं नाम by name Prathana, वायव्यम् Vayavya astra, तव to you, ददामि shall grant.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्त्रं हयशिरो नाम क्रौञ्चमस्त्रं तथैव च। शक्तिद्वयं च काकुत्स्थ ददामि तव राघव।।1.27.11।।
output: काकुत्स्थ born in the Kakutstha race, राघव Rama, हयशिरो नाम named Hayasira, अस्त्रम् astra, तथैव च also, क्रौञ्चमस्त्रम् Krauncha astra, शक्तिद्वयं च two powers, तव to you, ददामि I shall grant.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कङ्कालं मुसलं घोरं कापालमथ कङ्कणम्। धारयन्त्यसुरा यानि ददाम्येतानि सर्वशः।।1.27.12।।
output: I shall grant all these weapons, the dreadful kankala, pestle kapala and kankana used by asuras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वैद्याधरं महास्त्रं च नन्दनं नाम नामतः। असिरत्नं महाबाहो ददामि च नृपात्मज।।1.27.13।।
output: O mightyarmed prince, I shall grant mahaastra, vaidyadhara and an excellent scimitar known as nandana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गान्धर्वमस्त्रं दयितं मानवं नाम नामतः। प्रस्वापनप्रशमने दद्मि सौरं च राघव।।1.27.14।।
output: Rama, I shall grant two much favoured weapons namely gandharvaastras, manava  astra, which induce and suppress sleep and sauraastra as well.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दर्पणं शोषणं चैव सन्तापनविलापने। मदनं चैव दुर्धर्षं कन्दर्पदयितं तथा।।1.27.15।। पैशाचमस्त्रं दयितं मोहनं नाम नामतः। प्रतीच्छ नरशार्दूल राजपुत्र महायशः।।1.27.16।।
output: O renowned prince, best among men, receive these astras known as darpana, soshana, santhapana, vilapana, madana astra, the unassailable one favoured by kamadeva  and the paisacha astra known as mohana favoured by demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 27:
दर्पणं शोषणं चैव सन्तापनविलापने। मदनं चैव दुर्धर्षं कन्दर्पदयितं तथा।।1.27.15।। पैशाचमस्त्रं दयितं मोहनं नाम नामतः। प्रतीच्छ नरशार्दूल राजपुत्र महायशः।।1.27.16।।
output: O renowned prince, best among men, receive these astras known as darpana, soshana, santhapana, vilapana, madana astra, the unassailable one favoured by kamadeva  and the paisacha astra known as mohana favoured by demons.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तामसं नरशार्दूल सौमनं च महाबल। संवर्धं चैव दुर्धर्षं मौसलं च नृपात्मज।।1.27.17।। सत्यमस्त्रं महाबाहो तथा मायाधरं परम्। घोरं तेजः प्रभं नाम परतेजोऽपकर्षणम्।।1.27.18।। सौम्यास्त्रं शिशिरं नाम त्वष्टुरस्त्रं सुदामनम्। दारुणं च भगस्यापि शितेषु मथ मानवम्।।1.27.19।।
output: O tiger among men mighty prince, accept tamasa and saumanaastras, the unassailable, samavardha weapon, mausala, satyaastra, the supreme mayadhara astra, the terrible tejaprabhaastra capable of removing the energy of the opponent, a soft weapon called sisira, supremely formidable twashtus astra, Bhaga's terrible shiteshuastra (sharp arrowed one) and manava astra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 27:
तामसं नरशार्दूल सौमनं च महाबल। संवर्धं चैव दुर्धर्षं मौसलं च नृपात्मज।।1.27.17।। सत्यमस्त्रं महाबाहो तथा मायाधरं परम्। घोरं तेजः प्रभं नाम परतेजोऽपकर्षणम्।।1.27.18।। सौम्यास्त्रं शिशिरं नाम त्वष्टुरस्त्रं सुदामनम्। दारुणं च भगस्यापि शितेषु मथ मानवम्।।1.27.19।।
output: O tiger among men mighty prince, accept tamasa and saumanaastras, the unassailable, samavardha weapon, mausala, satyaastra, the supreme mayadhara astra, the terrible tejaprabhaastra capable of removing the energy of the opponent, a soft weapon called sisira, supremely formidable twashtus astra, Bhaga's terrible shiteshuastra (sharp arrowed one) and manava astra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

output: नरशार्दूल O Best among men, महाबल highly strong, नृपात्मज O Prince, तामसम् Tamasa, सौमनं चैव Saumana, दुर्धर्षम् चैव also unassilable, संवर्धं Samavardha, मौसलम् Mausala, सत्यम् अस्त्रम् Satya astra, परम् supreme, मायाधरम् Maya dhara astra, परतेजोपकर्षणम् removing the energy of the opponent, घोरम् fearful, तेजः प्रभम् नाम named Teja Prabha, शिशिरं नाम named Sisira, सौम्यास्त्रम् Saumya astra(a soft weapon), सुदामनम् supremely formidable, त्वष्टुः Twashtu's, अस्त्रम् astra, भगस्य Bhaga's, दारुणम् terrible, शितेषुम् sharparrowed astra, अथ and, मानवम् Manava, प्रतीच्छस्व accept.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतान् राम महाबाहो कामरूपान् महाबलान् । गृहाण परमोदारान् क्षिप्रमेव नृपात्मज।।1.27.20।।
output: महाबाहो O Mighty armed one, नृपात्मज O Prince, राम O Rama, कामरूपान् capable of  assuming any form at will, महाबलान् mighty, परमोदारान् highly exalted, एतान् these astras, क्षिप्रमेव immediately, गृहाण you may receive.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्थितस्तु प्राङ्मुखो भूत्वा शुचिर्मुनिवरस्तदा। ददौ रामाय सुप्रीतो मन्त्रग्राममनुत्तमम्।।1.27.21।।
output: तदा thereafter, मुनिवर he exalted one among ascetics, शुचि having purified himself, प्रङ्मुखः turning his face towards east, स्थितः भूत्वा standing, सुप्रीतः wellpleased, रामाय for Rama, अनुत्तमम् preeminently best, मन्त्रग्रामम् collection of mantras, ददौ gave.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वसङ्ग्रहणं येषां दैवतैरपि दुर्लभम्। तान्यस्त्राणि तदा विप्रो राघवाय न्यवेदयत्।।1.27.22।।
output: येषाम् of those weapons', सर्वसङ्ग्रहणम् complete acquisition, दैवतैरपि even by  the celestials, दुर्लभम् difficult to be attained, तानि such, अस्त्राणि astras, तदा then, विप्रः Visvamitra, राघवाय for Rama, न्यवेदयत् made known.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जपतस्तु मुनेस्तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः। उपतस्थुर्महार्हाणि सर्वाण्यस्त्राणि राघवम्।।1.27.23।।
output: धीमतः of the sagacious, तस्य मुनेः ascetic Viswamitra, जपतः while muttering in a subdued tone, महार्हाणि venerable, अस्त्राणि astras, सर्वाणि all, राघवम् for Rama, उपतस्थुः (reached) served.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 27:
ऊचुश्च मुदितास्सर्वे रामं प्राञ्जलयस्तदा। इमे स्म परमोदाराः किङ्करास्तव राघव।।1.27.24।।
output: The munificient presiding deities of the weapons with folded palms addressed these words to Rama saying, "Here we are, at you disposal ".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रतिगृह्य च काकुत्स्थः समालभ्य च पाणिना। मानसा मे भविष्यध्वमिति तानभ्यचोदयत्।।1.27.25।।
output: Rama received the astras he felt with his hands and commanded them saying, "Live in my mind" (serve me whenever I remember you).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः प्रीतमना रामो विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्। अभिवाद्य महातेजा गमनायोपचक्रमे।।1.27.26।।
output: Thereafter, the cheerful Rama, bowed to the mighty ascetic Viswamitra and commenced his journey. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रतिगृह्य ततोऽस्त्राणि प्रहृष्टवदनश्शुचि:। गच्छन्नेव च काकुत्स्थो विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्।।1.28.1।।
output: काकुत्स्थ: Rama, शुचि: having purified himself, अस्त्राणि astras, प्रतिगृह्य having received, तत: then, प्रहृष्टवदन: with pleasant countenance,गच्छन्नेव while proceeding onwards, अथ thereafter, विश्वामित्रम् addressing Visvamitra, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गृहीतास्त्रोऽस्मि भगवन् दुराधर्षस्सुरैरपि। अस्त्राणां त्वहमिच्छामि संहारं मुनिपुङ्गव।।1.28.2।।
output: भगवन् O Venerable one, गृहीतास्त्र: having received these weapons, सुरैरपि even by celestials, दुराधर्ष: अस्मि I have become unassailable, मुनिपुङ्गव O Best of ascetics, अहम् I, अस्त्राणाम् of astras, संहारम् withdrawal, इच्छामि desirous of knowing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। संहारं व्याजहाराथ धृतिमान् सुव्रतश्शुचि:।।1.28.3।।
output: काकुत्स्थे when Rama, एवम् in this manner, ब्रुवति had spoken, अथ thereafter, धृतिमान् one possessed of fortitude, सुव्रत: a man of excellent vows, शुचि: pure, विश्वामित्र: महामुनि: Viswamitra maharshi, संहारम् withdrawl, व्याजहार told.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सत्यवन्तं सत्यकीर्तिं धृष्टं रभसमेव च। प्रतिहारतरं नाम पराङ्मुखमवाङ्मुखम्।।1.28.4।। लक्षाक्षविषमौ चैव दृढनाभसुनाभकौ। दशाक्षशतवक्त्रौ च दशशीर्षशतोदरौ।।1.28.5।। पद्मनाभमहानाभौ दुन्दुनाभसुनाभकौ। ज्योतिषं कृशनं चैव नैराश्यविमलावुभौ।।1.28.6।। योगन्धरहरिद्रौ च दैत्यप्रशमनौतथा। सार्चिर्माली धृतिर्माली वृत्तिमान् रुचिरस्तथा।।1.28.7।। पितृसौमनसं चैव विधूतमकरावुभौ। करवीरकरं चैव धनधान्यौ च राघव।।1.28.8।। कामरूपं कामरुचिं मोहमावरणं तथा। जृम्भकं सर्वनाभं च सन्तानवरणौ तथा।।1.28.9।। भृशाश्वतनयान् राम भास्वरान्कामरूपिण:। प्रतीच्छ मम भद्रं ते पात्रभूतोऽसि राघव।।1.28.10।।
output: राघव O Descendent of Raghu, राम Rama, सत्यवन्तम् Satyavanta, सत्यकीर्तिम् Satya Kirti, धृष्टम् dhrishta, रभसम् Rabhasa, प्रतिहारतरम् Pratiharatara, पराङ्मुखम् Paranmukha, आवाङ्मुखम् Avanmukha, लक्षाक्षविषमौ Lakshaksha, Vishama, दृढनाभसुनाभकौ Drudhanabha and Sunabha, दशाक्षशतवक्त्रौ च Dasaksha and Satavaktra, दशशीर्षशतोदरौ Dasasheersha and Satodara, पद्मनाभमहानाभौ Padama Nabha and Mahanabha, दुन्दुनाभसुनाभकौ Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, ज्योतिषम् Jyotisha, कृशनं चैव Krusana also, उभौ both, नैराश्यविमलौ Nairasya and Vimala, योगन्धरहरिद्रौ च Yogandhara and Haridra, दैत्यप्रशमनौ Daitya, Prasamana, सार्चिर्माली Sarchirmali, धृति: Dhriti, माली Mali, वृत्तिमान् Vrttiman, तथा also, रुचिर: Ruchira, पितृसौमनसं चैव Pitrusaumanasa also, उभौ both, विधूतमकरौ Vidhuta and Makara, करवीरकरं चैव Karaveerakara also, धनधान्यौ Dhana and Dhanya, कामरूपम् Kama Roopa, कामरुचिम् Kama Ruchi, मोहम् Moha, तथा also, आवरणम् Avarana, जृम्भकम् Jrumbhaka, सर्वनाभं च Sarvanabha, तथा also, सन्तानवरणौ Santhana and Varana, भास्वरान्  effulgent, कामरूपिण: assuming shapes at will, भृशाश्वतनयान् Bhrusaswa's sons, मम from me, प्रतीच्छ you may receive, ते to you, भद्रम् May you prosper, पात्रभूत: असि you become worthy of them.

output: "O Rama the descendant of Raghu, receive from me the effulgent weapons who are the sons of Bhrusasva and who are capable of changing forms at will. They are  Satyavanta, Satyakirti, Dhrishta, Rabhasa, Pratiharatara, Paranmukha (turned back wards), Avanmukha (turned downwards), Lakshaksha, Vishama, Drudhanabha and Sunabha, Dasaksha, Satavaktra, Dasasheersha and Satodara, Padamanabha and Mahanabha, Dundunabha and Sunabhaka, Jyotisha, Krusanam, both Nairasya and  Vimala, Yogandhara, Haridradaitya, Prasamana, Sarchirmali, Dhri, Mali, Vrtiimanta, also Ruchira, Pitrusaumanasa, bothVidhuta Makara, Karaveera Kara, Dhana, Dhanya, Kama Roopa, Kamaruchi, Moha, also Avarana, Jrumbhaka, Sarvanabha, also Santhana and Varuna. You are worthy of receiving these weapons. May you prosper.

Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाढमित्येव काकुत्स्थ: प्रहृष्टेनान्तारात्मना। दिव्यभास्वरदेहाश्च मूर्तिमन्तस्सुखप्रदा:।।1.28.11 केचिदङ्गारसदृशा: केचिद्धूमोपमास्तथा। चन्द्रार्कसदृशा: केचित्प्रह्वाञ्जलिपुटास्तथा।।1.28.12।। रामं प्राञ्जलयो भूत्वाऽब्रुवन् मधुरभाषिण:। इमे स्म नरशार्दूल शाधि किं करवाम ते।।1.28.13।।
output: "Certainly" said Rama, and with a delighted heart received the astras. Some of the astra devatas were coal-black, some like smoke, some resembled rays of Sun or Moon. Assuming corporal forms, with shining, divine bodies, those weapons the their bodies bent down and palms folder they spoke to Rama in a gentle voice: "O tiger among men, here we are, What can we do for you"?

मानसा: कार्यकालेषु साहाय्यं मे करिष्यथ। गम्यतामिति तानाह यथेष्टं रघुनन्दन:।।1.28.14।।
output: Rama spoke to them (astra devatas) saying, "Reside in my mind and render assistance  in times of need. Now you can go according to your will".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 28:
अथ ते राममामन्त्ऱ्य कृत्वा चापि प्रदक्षिणम्। एवमस्त्विति काकुत्स्थमुक्त्वाजग्मुर्यथाऽगतम्।।1.28.15।।
output: Thereafter those devatas having said, "Be it so", circumambulated Rama, took leave of him and returned to their respective abodes from where they had come.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स च तान् राघवो ज्ञात्वा विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्। गच्छन्नेवाथ मधुरं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.28.16।।
output: After having acquired the knowledge of the weapons Rama addressed maharshi Viswamitra in gentle and soft words while walking along with him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 28:
किन्न्वेतन्मेघसङ्काशं पर्वतस्याविदूरत:। वृक्षषण्डमितो भाति परं कौतूहलं हि मे।।1.28.17।। दर्शनीयं मृगाकीर्णं मनोरममतीव च। नानाप्रकारैश्शकुनैर्वल्गुनादैरलङ्कृतम्।।1.28.18।।
output: "From this side of the mountain, not  faroff from here stand shining and goodlooking trees resembling clouds. It is replete scattered with animals, pleasing to the mind and extremely beautiful. It is adorned with various kinds of birds singing sweetly. What could be this? I am very curious to know.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 28:
किन्न्वेतन्मेघसङ्काशं पर्वतस्याविदूरत:। वृक्षषण्डमितो भाति परं कौतूहलं हि मे।।1.28.17।। दर्शनीयं मृगाकीर्णं मनोरममतीव च। नानाप्रकारैश्शकुनैर्वल्गुनादैरलङ्कृतम्।।1.28.18।।
output: "From this side of the mountain, not  faroff from here stand shining and goodlooking trees resembling clouds. It is replete scattered with animals, pleasing to the mind and extremely beautiful. It is adorned with various kinds of birds singing sweetly. What could be this? I am very curious to know.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 28:
निस्सृता: स्म मुनिश्रेष्ठ कान्ताराद्रोमहर्षणात्। अनया त्ववगच्छामि देशस्य सुखवत्तया।।1.28.19।। सर्वं मे शंस भगवन् कस्याश्रमपदं त्विदम्।
output: O best of acetics, I think we have come out of that  awesome (horripilating) forest because of the pleasant feeling experienced in this region. Whose hermitage is this? O Revered one tell me".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्प्राप्ता यत्र ते पापा ब्रह्मघ्ना दुष्टचारिण:।।1.28.20।। तव यज्ञस्य विघ्नाय दुरात्मानो महामुने। भगवन् तस्य को देशस्सा यत्र तव याज्ञिकी।।1.28.21।। रक्षितव्या क्रिया ब्रह्मन्मया वध्याश्च राक्षसा:। एतत्सर्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठ श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं प्रभो।।1.28.22।।
output: महामुने O Great acetic, भगवन् O Venerable one, ब्रह्मन् Brahmana, ब्रह्मघ्ना: slayers of Brahmins, दुष्टचारिण: doers of cruel acts, दुरात्मान: wicked minded one, ते पापा: those sinful persons, यत्र where, तव your, यज्ञस्य of the  sacrifice, विघ्नाय for creating obstacles, सम्प्राप्ता: having arrived, याज्ञिकी relating to sacrifice, क्रिया act, मया by me, रक्षितव्या is required to be protected, राक्षसा: च rakshasas also, वध्या: are required to be slain, तस्य देश: that place relating to sacrifice, क: where, मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Best among ascetics, प्रभो O Lord, अहम् I, एतत्सर्वम् all this, श्रोतुम् to listen, इच्छामि desirous of.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ तस्याप्रमेयस्य तद्वनं परिपृच्छत:। विश्वामित्रो महातेजा व्याख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।।1.29.1।।
output: अथ thereafter, तत् वनम् about that forest, परिपृच्छत: while he was enquiring, अप्रमेयस्य of the man of immeasurable prowess, तस्य of Rama, महातेजा highly lustrous, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, व्याख्यातुम् to explain, उपचक्रमे commenced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 29:
इह राम महाबाहो विष्णुर्देववर: प्रभु:। वर्षाणि सुबहूनीह तथा युगशतानि च।।1.29.2।। तपश्चरणयोगार्थमुवास सुमहातपा:।
output: "O mightyarmed Rama Lord Visnu, the foremost among the gods, and master the great ascetic lived here carrying out yogic practices and penance for innumerable years  constituting hundreds of yugas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एष पूर्वाश्रमो राम वामनस्य महात्मन:।।1.29.3।। सिद्धाश्रम इति ख्यातस्सिद्धो ह्यत्र महातपा:।
output: "O Rama this was the hermitage of glorious Vamana. The great sage her performed his ascetic pratices here, hence it is known as siddhashrama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजा वैरोचनिर्बलि:।।1.29.4।। निर्जित्य दैवतगणान् सेन्द्रांश्च समरुद्गणान्। कारयामास तद्राज्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुत:।।1.29.5।।
output: "During the period Visnu (in the incarnation of Vamana) was observing austerities at this hermitage, king Bali, son of Virochana, having vanquished Indra and maruts and devatas ruled this kingdom and became famous in all the three worlds (for his prowess and generosity.)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु राजा वैरोचनिर्बलि:।।1.29.4।। निर्जित्य दैवतगणान् सेन्द्रांश्च समरुद्गणान्। कारयामास तद्राज्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुत:।।1.29.5।।
