Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पर्वताग्रे तु लोकात्मा हस्तेनाक्रम्य केशव:। देवानां मध्यत: स्थित्वा ममन्थ पुरुषोत्तम:।।1.45.30।।
output: लोकात्मा omnipresent, पुरुषोत्तम: supreme Purusha, केशव: Visnu, देवानाम् devatas, मध्यत: amidst, स्थित्वा standing, पर्वताग्रे on the peak of mountain, हस्तेन with his hand, आक्रम्य occupying, ममन्थ churned.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 45:
अथ वर्षसहस्रेण सदण्डस्सकमण्डलु:। पूर्वं धन्वन्तरिर्नाम अप्सराश्च सुवर्चस:।।1.45.31।।
output: In this way thousand years rolled by. In the beginining came out Dhanvantari holding a staff and a water pot (carried by ascetics) and apsaras of high lustre.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 45:
अप्सु निर्मथनादेव रसास्तस्माद्वरस्त्रिय:। उत्पेतुर्मनुजश्रेष्ठ तस्मादप्सरसोऽभवन्।।1.45.32।।
output: O Best among men excellent women emerged out of the essence produced by churning of waters. Therefore they are known as apsarasas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
षष्टि: कोट्योऽभवंस्तासाम् अप्सराणां सुवर्चसाम्। असङ्ख्येयास्तु काकुत्स्थ यास्तासां परिचारिका:।।1.45.33।।
output: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सुवर्चसाम् highly lustrous, तासाम् अप्सराणाम् those apsarasas, षष्टि: कोट्य: sixty crores, अभवन् produced, तासाम् their, या: परिचारिका: those attendants, असङ्ख्येया: countless in number.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न तास्स्म परिगृह्णन्ति सर्वे ते देवदानवा:। अप्रतिग्रहणात्ताश्च सर्वास्साधारणास्स्मृता:।।1.45.34।।
output: सर्वे all, ते देवदानवा: devas or danavas, ता: them, न परिगृह्णन्ति स्म did not accept in marriage, अप्रतिग्रहणात् unmarried as they were, ता: सर्वा: all of them, साधारणा: belonging to all, स्मृता: have been called.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वरुणस्य तत: कन्या वारुणी रघुनन्दन । उत्पपात महाभागा मार्गमाणा परिग्रहम्।।1.45.35।।
output: O Joy of the Raghus (Rama) thereafter Varuna's daughter Varuni (goddess of wine) came out searching for a consort.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिते: पुत्रा न तां राम जगृहुर्वरुणात्मजाम्। अदितेस्तु सुता वीर जगृहुस्तामनिन्दिताम्।।1.45.36।।
output: O Rama while Diti's sons did not accept the unblemished Varuni, O heroic one, the sons of Aditi did.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 45:
असुरास्तेन दैतेयास्सुरास्तेनादितेस्सुता:। हृष्टा: प्रमुदिताश्चासन् वारुणीग्रहणात्सुरा:।।1.45.37।।
output: For that reason, sons of Diti were called asuras. Aditi's sons were known as suras. Devatas grew exceedingly glad for having Varuni.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उच्चैश्श्रवा हयश्रेष्ठो मणिरत्नं च कौस्तुभम्। उदतिष्ठन्नरश्रेष्ठ तथैवामृतमुत्तमम्।।1.45.38।।
output: O Foremost among men (Rama) ucchaishravas, the best of horses (the celestial horse), kausthubham, the best jewel and also nectar came (from churning).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 45:
अथ तस्य कृते राम महानासीत्कुलक्षय:। अदितेस्तु तत: पुत्रा दिते: पुत्रानसूदयन्।।1.45.39।।
output: O Rama the race of devatas and daityas suffered great destruction because of (their fight for) that nectar. Thereafter Aditi's sons, the devatas killed Diti's sons, the daityas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 45:
एकतोऽभ्यागमन् सर्वे ह्यसुरा राक्षसैस्सह। युद्धमासीन्महाघोरं वीर त्रैलोक्यमोहनम्।।1.45.40।।
output: O Heroic Rama all the asuras along with the rakshasas joined on one side. A violent and a dreadful battle which threw the three worlds in to a great confusion, ensued.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 45:
यदा क्षयं गतं सर्वं तदा विष्णुर्महाबल:। अमृतं सोऽहरत्त्तूर्णं मायामास्थाय मोहिनीम्।।1.45.41।।
output: When everything was destroyed completely, the exceedingly powerful Visnu assuming the form of Mohini a charming woman (elusive form) with the power of illusion quickly stole away the nectar.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ये गताऽभिमुखं विष्णुमक्षयं पुरुषोत्तमम्। सम्पिष्टास्ते तदा युद्धे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना।।1.45.42।।
output: अक्षयम् imperishable, पुरुषोत्तमम् supreme purusha, विष्णुम् Vishnu, ये those, युद्धे in the battle, अभिमुखम् in front of him, गता: had gone, ते they, प्रभविष्णुना by the capable, विष्णुना by Vishnu, सम्पिष्टा: were grounded.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अदितेरात्मजा वीरा दिते: पुत्रान्निजघ्निरे। तस्मिन् घोरे महायुद्धे दैतेयादित्ययोर्भृशम्।।1.45.43।।
output: In that great and terrible battle between daityas and devatas, Aditi's sons killed Diti's.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निहत्य दितिपुत्रांश्च राज्यं प्राप्य पुरन्दर:। शशास मुदितो लोकान् सर्षिसङ्घान् सचारणान्।।1.45.44।।
output: Indra, having killed the sons of Diti was happy with the kingdom gained. He ruled the worlds in the company of rishis and celestial singers". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyfifth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु दिति: परमदु:खिता। मारीचं काश्यपं राम भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.46.1।।
output: राम O Rama, तेषु पुत्रेषु when those sons, हतेषु were killed, दिति: Diti, परमदु:खिता afflicted with great grief, भर्तारम् husband, मारीचम् Maricha, काश्यपम् Kasyapas's son, इदम् अब्रवीत् spoke these words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 46:
हतपुत्राऽस्मि भगवंस्तव पुत्रैर्महाबलै:। शक्रहन्तारमिच्छामि पुत्रं दीर्घतपोऽर्जितम्।।1.46.2।।
output: "O adorable one, your highly powerful sons, (devatas) have killed mine through extensive austerities. I am desirous of obtaining a (mighty) son capable of killing Indra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
साऽहं तपश्चरिष्यामि गर्भं मे दातुमर्हसि। ईश्वरं शक्रहन्तारं त्वमनुज्ञातुमर्हसि।।1.46.3।।
output: सा अहम् I, तप: austerities, चरिष्यामि I shall practise, त्वम् you, ईश्वरम् a supreme ruler of the world, शुक्रहंतारम् capable of slaying Indra, गर्भम् embryo (son), मे to me, दातुम् to give, अर्हसि behoves of you, अनुज्ञातुम् to give consent, अर्हसि behoves.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मारीच: काश्यपस्तदा। प्रत्युवाच महातेजा दितिं परमदु:खिताम्।।1.46.4।।
output: Then, Maricha's son, exceedingly bright Kasyapa on hearing the words of Diti who was deeply grieved replied:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं भवतु, भद्रं ते शुचिर्भव तपोधने। जनयिष्यसि पुत्रं त्वं शक्रहन्तारमाहवे।।1.46.5।।
output: "O one vested with the wealth of austerities be it so. Prosperity to you Remain chaste, you will deliver a son who will kill Indra in the battle.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 46:
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु शुचिर्यदि भविष्यसि। पुत्रं त्रैलोक्यभर्तारं मत्तस्त्वं जनयिष्यसि।।1.46.6।।
output: "If you remain pure and clean, on completion of a thousand years you will give birth to a son through me who will be the lord of the three worlds".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा: पाणिना स ममार्ज ताम्। समालभ्य ततस्स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा स तपसे ययौ।।1.46.7।।
output: महातेजा: highly energetic, स: Kasyapa, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, ताम् her, पाणिना with his palm, ममार्ज touched her body gently stroking, समालभ्य having touched her, तत: then, स्वस्ति इति "May good be with thee", उक्त्वा having spoken, स: Kashyapa, तपसे to perform austerities, ययौ had gone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गते तस्मिन्नरश्श्रेष्ठ दिति: परमहर्षिता। कुशप्लवनमासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्।।1.46.8।।
output: नरश्श्रेष्ठ O Foremost of men, तस्मिन् when that Kasyapa, गते (सति) had gone, दिति: Diti, परमहर्षिता was exceedingly delighted, कुशप्लवनम् sacred spot named Kushaplavana, आसाद्य having reached, सुदारुणम् intense, तप: mortifications, तेपे practised.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 46:
तपस्तस्यां हि कुर्वन्त्यां परिचर्यां चकार  ह। सहस्राक्षो नरश्श्रेष्ठ परया गुणसम्पदा।।1.46.9।।
output: O foremost of men great treasure of virtues while she was practising austerities, the thousandeyed Indra  began to serve her.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्निं कुशान् काष्ठमप: फलं मूलं तथैव च। न्यवेदयत्सहस्राक्षो यच्चान्यदपि काङ्क्षितम्।।1.46.10।।
output: सहस्राक्ष: Devendra, अग्निम् fire, कुशान् Kusha grass, काष्ठम् sticks for burning, अप: water, फलम् fruits, तथैव च and, मूलम् roots, काङ्क्षितम् desired, अन्यत् all other things, यच्च whichever, न्यवेदयत् provided her.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गात्रसंवहनश्चैव श्रमापनयनैस्तथा। शक्रस्सर्वेषु कालेषु दितिं परिचचार ह ।।1.46.11।।
output: Indra attended on Diti, stroking her limbs gently from time to time to help her regain their  suppleness and alleviate her fatigue.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ वर्षसहस्रे तु दशोने रघुनन्दन । दिति: परमसम्प्रीता सहस्राक्षमथाब्रवीत्।।1.46.12।।
output: O son of the Raghus ten years before completion of a thousand years. Diti, highly pleased with the services rendered by Indra, addressed him", saying:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
याचितेन सुरश्रेष्ठ तव पित्रा महात्मना। वरो वर्षसहस्रान्ते दत्तो मम सुतं प्रति।।1.46.13।।
output: सुरश्रेष्ठ O Excellent among devatas, Indra, याचितेन having been sought, महात्मना by the illustrious, तव your, पित्रा father, वर्षसहस्रान्ते after completion of thousand years, सुतं प्रति about a son, मम to me, वर: boon, दत्त: granted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तपश्चरन्त्या वर्षाणि दश वीर्यवतां वर। अवशिष्टानि भद्रं ते भ्रातरं द्रक्ष्यसे तत:।।1.46.14।।
output: वीर्यवताम् among those having prowess, वर excellent, तप: austerities, चरन्त्या: performing, दश ten, वर्षाणि years, अवशिष्टानि remaining, तत: afterwards, भ्रातरम् brother, द्रक्ष्यसे you will see, ते भद्रम् may prosperity to you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमहं त्वत्कृते पुत्र समाधास्ये जयोत्सुकम्। त्रैलोक्यविजयं पुत्र सह भोक्ष्यसि विज्वर:।।1.46.15।।
output: पुत्र O Son, तम् him, त्वत्कृते for you, जयोत्सुकम् having fortitude for victory, (अहं) समाधास्ये I shall unite him, पुत्र O Son, विज्वर: relieved of grief, त्रैलोक्यविजयम् victory over three worlds, सह भोक्ष्यसि you will enjoy together with him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा दितिश्शक्रं प्राप्ते मध्यं दिवाकरे। निद्रयाऽपहृता देवी पादौ कृत्वाऽथ शीर्षत:।।1.46.16।।
output: After speaking thus to Indra, goddess Diti overpowered with sleep around midsday dropped off, her feet towards her head.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्ट्वा तामशुचिं शक्र: पादत: कृतमूर्धजाम्। शिरस्स्थाने कृतौ पादौ जहास च मुमोद च।।1.46.17।।
output: Indra laughed. He rejoiced at the sight of her ominous posture of sleeping with her feet towards her head and her hair falling on her feet.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्याश्शरीरविवरं विवेश च पुरन्दर:। गर्भं च सप्तधा राम बिभेद परमात्मवान्।।1.46.18।।
output: राम O Rama, पुरन्दर: Indra, तस्या: her, शरीरविवरं womb, विवेश च entered, परम् great, आत्मवान् courageous one, गर्भम् embryo, सप्तधा seven pieces, बिभेद severed it.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 46:
भिद्यमानस्ततो गर्भो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा। रुरोद सुस्वरं राम ततो दितिरबुध्यत।।1.46.19।।
output: O Rama that embryo, being severed by Vajra having a hundred edges, cried at high pitch which awakened Diti".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मा रुदो मा रुदश्चेति गर्भं शक्रोऽभ्यभाषत। बिभेद च महातेजा रुदन्तमपि वासव:।।1.46.20।।
output: मा रुद: "Do not weep", मा रुद: "Do not weep", इति शक्र: Indra, गर्भम् addressing embryo, अभ्यभाषत spoke, महातेजा: highly powerful, वासव: Indra, रुदन्तमपि even though crying, बिभेद severed it.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न हन्तव्यो न हन्तव्य इत्येवं दितिरब्रवीत्। निष्पपात ततश्शक्रो मातुर्वचनगौरवात्।।1.46.21।।
output: "Do not kill", "Do not kill", said Diti. Subsequently Indra, in deference to the words of his mother, emerged out of the womb.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्राञ्जलिर्वज्रसहितो दितिं शक्रोऽभ्यभाषत। अशुचिर्देवि सुप्ताऽसि पादयो: कृतमूर्धजा।।1.46.22।।
output: Armed with Vajra, Indra addressed Diti with folded palms, saying, "O Devi you have slept,  with your head towards your feet and your hair falling on your feet".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदन्तरमहं लब्ध्वा शक्रहन्तारमाहवे। अभिदं सप्तधा देवि तन्मे त्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि।।1.46.23।।
output: अहम् I, तत् that, अन्तरम् opportunity, लब्ध्वा having seized, आहवे in war, शक्रहन्तारम् that one who was to be slayer of Indra, सप्तधा into seven parts, अभिदम् severed, देवि O Devi, त्वम् you, क्षंतुम् to forgive, अर्हसि it is proper.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सप्तधातु कृते गर्भे दिति: परमदु:खिता। सहस्राक्षं दुराधर्षं वाक्यं सानुनयाऽब्रवीत्।।1.47.1।।
output: Origin of marutsVishala constructs the city Diti practises her austerities--Sumati  honours Viswamitra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 47:
ममापराधाद्गर्भोऽयं सप्तधा विफलीकृत:। नापराधोऽस्ति देवेश तवात्र बलसूदन।।1.47.2।।
output: "O Indra, Slayer of Balasura, because of my fault this embryo has been made into seven pieces and rendered useless. In this matter you have not committed any fault.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 47:
प्रियं तु कर्तुमिच्छामि मम गर्भविपर्यये। मरुतां सप्तसप्तानां स्थानपाला भवन्त्विमे।।1.47.3।।
output: This disaster to the embryo has happened contrary to expectations. Hence, I seek a favour from you. Let these seven pieces become seven guardians of marut regions (regions of the wind).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वातस्कन्धा: इमे सप्त चरन्तु दिवि पुत्रक । मारुता इति विख्याता दिव्यरूपा ममात्मजा:।।1.47.4।।
output: O Son, all these seven are my sons of celestial beauty.They will become pesiding deities for Vata Skandha (divisions of wind) and let them be wellknown as maruts wandering in the universe.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्रह्मलोकं चरत्वेक इन्द्रलोकं तथाऽपर:। दिवि वायुरिति ख्यातस्तृतीयोऽपि महायशा:।।1.47.5।।
output: Among them, one will move about in Brahmaloka, another in Indraloka, and the third, well known as vayu will move around in the sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चत्वारस्तु सुरश्रेष्ठ दिशो वै तव शासनात्। सञ्चरिष्यन्तु भद्रं ते देवभूता ममात्मजा:।।1.47.6।।
output: O best of devatas by your command the other four sons will remain celestial, and will range about in four directions.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सहस्राक्ष: पुरन्दर:। उवाच प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं दितिं बलनिषूदन:।।1.47.7।।
output: The thousandeyed Indra, slayer of Bala, on hearing Diti's words, addressed her with folded palms, saying:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वमेतद्यथोक्तं ते भविष्यति न संशय:। विचरिष्यन्ति भद्रं ते देवभूतास्तवात्मजा:।।1.47.8।।
output: "Everything will, no doubt, happen the way you said. Your sons will wander about as celestial beings. Prosperity to you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 47:
एवं तौ निश्चयं कृत्वा मातापुत्रौ तपोवने। जग्मतुस्त्रिदिवं राम कृतार्थाविति नश्श्रुतम्।।1.47.9।।
output: "O Rama mother and sons having arrived at this conclusion in the tapovana  ascended to heaven with their desire fulfilled. This is what we have heard."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष देशस्स काकुत्स्थ महेन्द्राध्युषित: पुरा। दितिं यत्र तपस्सिद्धामेवं परिचचार स:।।1.47.10।।
output: काकुत्स्थ O Rama, एष: this one, पुरा formerly, महेन्द्राध्युषित: inhabited by Indra, स: that, देश: country, यत्र where, स: he, तप: in austerities, सिद्धाम् succeded, दितिम् Diti, एवम् this way, परिचचार attended on.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 47:
इक्ष्वाकोऽस्तु नरव्याघ्र पुत्र: परमधार्मिक:।।1.47.11।। अलम्बुषायामुत्पन्नो विशाल इति विश्रुत:। तेन चासीदिह स्थाने विशालेति पुरी कृता।।1.47.12।।
output: "O Tiger among men (Rama) this highly virtuous and wellknown son named Vishala was born to Ikshvakus in Alambusa. Where, a city named Vishala was built.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इक्ष्वाकोऽस्तु नरव्याघ्र पुत्र: परमधार्मिक:।।1.47.11।। अलम्बुषायामुत्पन्नो विशाल इति विश्रुत:। तेन चासीदिह स्थाने विशालेति पुरी कृता।।1.47.12।।
output: "O Tiger among men (Rama) this highly virtuous and wellknown son named Vishala was born to Ikshvakus in Alambusa. Where, a city named Vishala was built.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विशालस्य सुतो राम हेमचन्द्रो महाबल:। सुचन्द्र इति विख्यात: हेमचन्द्रादनन्तर:।।1.47.13।।
output: O Rama mighty Hemachandra was Vishala's son. Hemachandra's successor was the celebrated Suchandra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुचन्द्रतनयो राम धूम्राश्व इति विश्रुत:। धूम्राश्वतनयश्चापि सञ्जयस्समपद्यत।।1.47.14।।
output: O Rama son of Suchandra was Dhumraswa, wellknown Sanjaya was the son of Dhumraswa.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सञ्जयस्य सुतश्श्रीमान् सहदेव: प्रतापवान्। कुशाश्वस्सहदेवस्य पुत्र: परमधार्मिक:।।1.47.15।।
output: Prosperous and powerful Sahadeva was Sanjaya's son. Highly virtuous Kusaswa was Sahadeva's son.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कुशाश्वस्य महातेजा सोमदत्त: प्रतापवान्। सोमदत्तस्य पुत्रस्तु काकुत्स्थ इति विश्रुत:।।1.47.16।।
output: Brilliant and powerful Somadatta was Kusaswa's son. That Somadatta's son was Kakutstha is wellknown.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य पुत्रो महातेजा: सम्प्रत्येष पुरीमिमाम्। आवसत्यमरप्रख्यस्सुमतिर्नाम दुर्जय:।।1.47.17।।
output: Son of Ikshvakus, Sumati comparable to devatas, invincible and exceedingly energetic is still ruling this city.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इक्ष्वाकोस्तु प्रसादेन सर्वे वैशालिका नृपा:। दीर्घायुषो महात्मानो वीर्यवन्तस्सुधार्मिका:।।1.47.18।।
output: इक्ष्वाको: Ikshwaku's, प्रसादेन by his graciousness, वैशालिका: relating to Vishala, नृपा: kings, सर्वे all, दीर्घायुष: possessing longlife, महात्मान: exalted, वीर्यवन्त: valourous, सुधार्मिका: are virtuous.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इहाद्य रजनीं राम सुखं वत्स्यामहे वयम्। श्व: प्रभाते नरश्रेष्ठ जनकं द्रष्टुमर्हसि।।1.47.19।।
output: O Rama we shall spend the right happily here. O Best among men On the tomorrow we see Janaka".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 47:
सुमतिस्तु महातेजा विश्वामित्रमुपागतम्। श्रुत्वा नरवरश्रेष्ठ: प्रत्युद्गच्छन्महायशा:।।1.47.20।।
output: Having heard of the arrival of Viswamitra the celebrated Sumati, most brilliant chief of kings proceeded (to receive him).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पूजां च परमां कृत्वा सोपाध्यायस्सबान्धव:। प्राञ्जलि: कुशलं पृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्।।1.47.21।।
output: सोपाध्याय: with spiritual preceptors, सबान्धव: together with  his relatives, परमाम् supreme, पूजाम् honours, कृत्वा having performed, प्राञ्जलि: with folded palms, कुशलम् welfare, पृष्ट्वा having enquired, अथ thereafter, विश्वामित्रम् addressing Visvamitra, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे विषयं मुनि:। सम्प्राप्तो दर्शनं चैव नास्ति धन्यतरो मम।।1.47.22।।
output: "O Sage no one is more blessed than me since you have favoured me with your arrival in my country." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पृष्ट्वा तु कुशलं तत्र परस्परसमागमे। कथान्ते सुमतिर्वाक्यं व्याजहार महामुनिम्।।1.48.1।।
output: तत्र there, परस्परसमागमे by mutual gettogether (each of them), सुमति: Sumati, कुशलम् welfare, पृष्ट्वा having enquired, कथान्ते at the end of conversation, महामुनिम् addressing  great ascetic Visvamitra, वाक्यम् these words, व्याजहार spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
इमौ कुमारौ भद्रं ते देवतुल्यपराक्रमौ। गजसिंहगती वीरौ शार्दूलवृषभोपमौ।।1.48.2।। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षौ खड्गतूणी धनुर्धरौ। अश्विनाविव रूपेण समुपस्थितयौवनौ।।1.48.3।। यदृच्छयैव गां प्राप्तौ देवलोकादिवामरौ। कथं पद्भ्यामिह प्राप्तौ किमर्थं कस्य वा मुने।।1.48.4।।
output: "O Sage, wish you well Who are these two youths who seem to possess the  prowess of celestial beings. They walk with the gait of an elephant or a lion. They are courageous like tiger or a bull. Their large eyes are like lotuspetals. They are armed with scimitars, bows and quivers. They are young and handsome like Aswinikumaras dropped from heaven casually. Whose sons are they? How did they  come here on foot? With what purpose?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:

They are young and handsome like Aswinikumaras dropped from heaven casually. Whose sons are they? How did they  come here on foot? With what purpose?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भूषयन्ताविमं देशं चन्द्रसूर्याविवाम्बरम्। परस्परस्य सदृशौ प्रमाणेङ्गितचेष्टितै:।।1.48.5।। किमर्थं च मुनिश्रेष्ठ सम्प्राप्तौ दुर्गमे पथि। वरायुधधरौ वीरौ श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वत:।।1.48.6।।
output: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Great ascetic, प्रमाणेङ्गितचेष्टितै: in personality, in expressions and gestures,  परस्परस्य each other, सदृशौ resemble, चन्द्रसूर्यौ Moon and Sun, अम्बरमिव in the sky, इमम् this, देशम् country, भूषयन्तौ adorning, वरायुधधरौ holding excellent weapons, वीरौ heroes, दुर्गमे difficult to traverse, पथि paths, किमर्थम् for what purpose, सम्प्राप्तौ have come, तत्त्वत: truly, श्रोतुम् to listen, इच्छामि I am desirous.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भूषयन्ताविमं देशं चन्द्रसूर्याविवाम्बरम्। परस्परस्य सदृशौ प्रमाणेङ्गितचेष्टितै:।।1.48.5।। किमर्थं च मुनिश्रेष्ठ सम्प्राप्तौ दुर्गमे पथि। वरायुधधरौ वीरौ श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वत:।।1.48.6।।
output: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Great ascetic, प्रमाणेङ्गितचेष्टितै: in personality, in expressions and gestures,  परस्परस्य each other, सदृशौ resemble, चन्द्रसूर्यौ Moon and Sun, अम्बरमिव in the sky, इमम् this, देशम् country, भूषयन्तौ adorning, वरायुधधरौ holding excellent weapons, वीरौ heroes, दुर्गमे difficult to traverse, पथि paths, किमर्थम् for what purpose, सम्प्राप्तौ have come, तत्त्वत: truly, श्रोतुम् to listen, इच्छामि I am desirous.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा यथावृत्तं न्यवेदयत्। सिद्धाश्रमनिवासं च राक्षसानां वधं तथा।।1.48.7।।
output: On hearing his words, he (Viswamitra) related all about their stay at Siddhashrama and the slaying of rakshasas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विश्वामित्रवचश्श्रुत्वा राजा परमहर्षित:। अतिथी परमौ प्राप्तौ पुत्रौ दशरथस्य तौ।।1.48.8।। पूजयामास विधिवत्सत्कारार्हौ महाबलौ।
output: राजा king Sumati, विश्वामित्रवच: words of Visvamitra, श्रुत्वा having listened, परमहर्षित: exceedingly delighted, परमौ distinguished, अतिथी two guests, प्राप्तौ having arrived, सत्कारार्हौ worthy of honours, महाबलौ highly valiant, तौ दशरथस्य पुत्रौ those two sons of Dasaratha, विथिवत् in accordance with tradition, पूजयामास extended hospitality.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
तत: परमसत्कारं सुमते: प्राप्य राघवौ।।1.48.9।। उष्य तत्र निशामेकां जग्मतुर्मिथिलां तत: ।
output: The descendants of Raghu (Rama and Lakshmana) having received great honour from Sumati, stayed there one night and thereafter set out for Mithila.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
तान् दृष्ट्वा मुनयस्सर्वे जनकस्य पुरीं शुभाम्।।1.48.10।। साधु साध्विति शंसन्तो मिथिलां समपूजयन्।
output: All the ascetics, having seen that auspicious city of Janaka worshipfully admired Mithila saying, 'Excellent, Excellent'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
मिथिलोपवने शून्यमाश्रमं दृश्य राघव:।।1.48.11।। पुराणं निर्जनं रम्यं पप्रच्छ मुनिपुङ्गवम्।
output: At the sight of an old uninhabited, beautiful and desolate hermitage in a grove near Mithila, the descendant of the Raghus enquired of the foremost among the ascetics (Viswamitra):

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्रीमदाश्रमसङ्काशं किन्न्विदं मुनिवर्जितम्।।1.48.12।। ज्ञातुमिच्छामि भगवन् कस्यायं पूर्वमाश्रम:।
output: "O Venerable one I wish to know why this auspicios looking hermitage was deserted by ascetics? To whom did this belong in the past."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारद:।।1.48.13।। प्रत्युवाच महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:।
output: Eloquent and brilliant Viswamitra, replied to the descendant of the Raghus saying:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि श्रुणु तत्त्वेन राघव।।1.48.14।। यस्येदमाश्रमपदं शप्तं कोपान्महात्मना।
output: "O Descendant of the Raghus I shall tell all you about this hermitage cursed by the wrath of a great man.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गौतमस्य नरश्रेष्ठ पूर्वमासीन्महात्मन:।।1.48.15।। आश्रमो दिव्यसङ्काशस्सुरैरपि सुपूजित:।
output: O Best among men this hermitage resembling a celestial retreat and wellhonoured even by devatas  once belonged to illustrious Gautama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
स चेह तप आतिष्ठदहल्यासहित: पुरा।।1.48.16।। वर्षपूगाननेकांश्च राजपुत्र महायश:।
output: O Highly renowned prince it was here in ancient times that Gautama in the company of Ahalya practised austerities for several years.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
तस्यान्तरं विदित्वा तु सहस्राक्षश्शचीपति:।।1.48.17।। मुनिवेषधरोऽहल्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: The thousandeyed Indra, consort of Sachi, having found an opportunity (during the absence of the ascetic), assumed the guise of the ascetic (Gautama) and said to Ahalya:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
ऋतुकालं प्रतीक्षन्ते नार्थिनस्सुसमाहिते।1.48.18 सङ्गमं त्वहमिच्छामि त्वया सह सुमध्यमे।।
output: 'O most beautiful one those overtaken by passion would not await the completion of the menstrual period (favourable for copulation). O woman of fine waist I desire union with you.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
मुनिवेषं सहस्राक्षं विज्ञाय रघुनन्दन।1.48.19 मतिं चकार दुर्मेधा देवराजकुतूहलात्।।
output: O Delight of the Raghus the evilintentioned Ahalya, inclined towards the king of the celestials and  knowing him to be the thousandeyed Indra in the guise of the ascetic, consented for the union.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथाब्रवीत् नरश्रेष्ठ कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना।1.48.20।। कृतार्थाऽस्मि सुरश्रेष्ठ गच्छ शीघ्रमित: प्रभो। आत्मानं मां च देवेश सर्वदा रक्ष गौतमात्।1.48.21।।
output: नरश्रेष्ठ O Foremost of men, अथ afterwards, कृतार्थेन having achieved the purpose, अन्तरात्मना whole heartedly, अब्रवीत् spoke, सुरश्रेष्ठ O Chief of celestials, कृतार्था अस्मि I have  succeeded in my desire, प्रभो O Lord, इत: from here, शीघ्रम् quickly, गच्छ go, देवेश O Lord of celestials, आत्मानं च yourself, मां च also me, सर्वदा in all respects, गौतमात् from Gautama, रक्ष protect.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथाब्रवीत् नरश्रेष्ठ कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना।1.48.20।। कृतार्थाऽस्मि सुरश्रेष्ठ गच्छ शीघ्रमित: प्रभो। आत्मानं मां च देवेश सर्वदा रक्ष गौतमात्।1.48.21।।
output: O Foremost of men with her heart's desire fulfilled, Ahalya said: "O Chief of the celestials I'm satisfied. O Lord, quit this place: O Lord of cthe gods, protect yourself and also me from Gautama in all respects."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
इन्द्रस्तु प्रहसन् वाक्यमहल्यामिदमब्रवीत्। सुश्रोणि परितुष्टोऽस्मि गमिष्यामि यथाऽगतम्।1.48.22।।
output: Indra smilingly said to Ahalya, 'O One with lovely hips, I am  gratified. I shall go away the way I have come'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं सङ्गम्य तु तया निश्चक्रामोटजात्तत:।। स सम्भ्रमात्त्वरन् राम शङ्कितो गौतमं प्रति।1.48.23।।
output: राम O Rama, एवम् in this way, तया with her, सङ्गम्य having united, स: he, सम्भ्रमात् out of fear, त्वरन् quickly, गौतमं प्रति about Gautama, शङ्कित: having apprehension, उटजात्    (ततः) from leafy hut, निश्चक्राम came out.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गौतमं तं ददर्शाथ प्रविशन्तं महामुनिम्। देवदानवदुर्धर्षं तपोबलसमन्वितम्।।1.48.24।। तीर्थेंदकपरिक्लिन्नं दीप्यमानमिवानलम्। गृहीतसमिधं तत्र सकुशं मुनिपुङ्गवम्।।1.48.25।।
output: अथ subsequently, देवदानवदुर्धर्षम् unassilable by devatas and danavas, तपोबलसमन्वितम् endowed with power of ascetism, तीर्थेंदकपरिक्लिन्नम् drenched with by sacrifical waters, अनलमिव like flaming fire, दीप्यमानम् shining, गृहीतसमिधम् carrying sacrificial fuel sticks,  सकुशम् along with Kusha grass, मुनिपुङ्गवम् preeminent among sages, गौतमं महामुनिम् great ascetic Gautama, तत्र there, प्रविशन्तम् entering, ददर्श beheld.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
गौतमं तं ददर्शाथ प्रविशन्तं महामुनिम्। देवदानवदुर्धर्षं तपोबलसमन्वितम्।।1.48.24।। तीर्थेंदकपरिक्लिन्नं दीप्यमानमिवानलम्। गृहीतसमिधं तत्र सकुशं मुनिपुङ्गवम्।।1.48.25।।
output: Subsequently, Indra beheld the great ascetic Gautama, unassailable by devatas and danavas, endowed with the power of ascetism, drenched with sacrifical waters,  shining like flaming fire, carrying sacrificial firewood and Kusha grass and preeminent  among sages, entering that leaf hut.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दृष्ट्वा सुरपतिस्त्रस्तो विवर्णवदनोऽभवत्। अथ दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षं मुनिवेषधरं मुनि:।।1.48.26।। दुर्वृत्तं वृत्तसम्पन्नो रोषाद्वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: सुरपति: Devendra, दृष्ट्वा having seen, त्रस्त: afraid of, विवर्णवदन: pale faced, अभवत् became, अथ thereafter, वृत्तसम्पन्न: wellbehaved, मुनि: sage, मुनिवेषधरम् in the guise of an ascetic, दुर्वुत्तम् illbehaved, सहस्राक्षम् Indra, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रोषात् with  enrangement, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मम रूपं समास्थाय कृतवानसि दुर्मते।।1.48.27।। अकर्तव्यमिदं तस्माद्विफलस्त्वं भविष्यसि।
output: "O Wicked natured one assuming my form you have done a forbidden act. For that reason you shall be devoid of  scrotum.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गौतमेनैवमुक्तस्य सरोषेण महात्मना।।1.48.28।। पेततुर्वृषणै भूमौ सहस्राक्षस्य तत्क्षणात्।
output: Cursed thus out of anger by eminent Gautama the  testicles of Indra immediately dropped down on the earth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा शप्त्वा स वै शक्रमहल्यामपि शप्तवान्।।1.48.29।। इह वर्षसहस्राणि बहूनि त्वं निवत्स्यसि। वायुभक्षा निराहारा तप्यन्ती भस्मशायिनी।।1.48.30।। अदृश्या सर्वभूतानां आश्रमेऽस्मिन्निवत्स्यसि।
output: स: he (the sage), शक्रम् that Indra, तथा in that manner, शप्त्वा having cursed, अहल्यामपि Ahalya also, शप्तवान् had cursed, त्वम् you, इह here, बहूनि many, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, निवत्स्यसि you will live here, वायुभक्षा subsisting on air, निराहारा without food, भस्मशायिनी lying on ashes, तप्यन्ती doing penance, सर्वभूतानाम् to all being, अदृश्या invisible,  अस्मिन् in this, आश्रमे Ashrama, निवत्स्यति you will stay on.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा शप्त्वा स वै शक्रमहल्यामपि शप्तवान्।।1.48.29।। इह वर्षसहस्राणि बहूनि त्वं निवत्स्यसि। वायुभक्षा निराहारा तप्यन्ती भस्मशायिनी।।1.48.30।। अदृश्या सर्वभूतानां आश्रमेऽस्मिन्निवत्स्यसि।
output: स: he (the sage), शक्रम् that Indra, तथा in that manner, शप्त्वा having cursed, अहल्यामपि Ahalya also, शप्तवान् had cursed, त्वम् you, इह here, बहूनि many, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, निवत्स्यसि you will live here, वायुभक्षा subsisting on air, निराहारा without food, भस्मशायिनी lying on ashes, तप्यन्ती doing penance, सर्वभूतानाम् to all being, अदृश्या invisible,  अस्मिन् in this, आश्रमे Ashrama, निवत्स्यति you will stay on.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदा चैतद्वनं घोरं रामो दशरथात्मज:।।1.48.31।। आगमिष्यति दुर्धर्षस्तदा पूता भविष्यसि।
output: दशरथात्मज: son of Dasaratha, दुर्धर्ष: unassailable, राम: Rama, यदा when, घोरम् dreadful,  एतत् वनम् this forest, आगमिष्यति will come, तदा then, पूता भविष्यसि you will be purified.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यातिथ्येन दुर्वुत्ते लोभमोहविवर्जिता।।1.48.32।। मत्सकाशे मुदा युक्ता स्वं वपुर्धारयिष्यसि।
output: 'O Wickednatured one by offering hospitality to Rama, without covetousness and passion, you will happily live with me by regaining your present form'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 48:
एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा गौतमो दुष्टचारिणीम्।।1.48.33।। इममाश्रममुत्सृज्य सिद्धचारणसेविते। हिमवच्छिखरे पुण्ये तपस्तेपे महातपा:।।1.48.34।।
output: "Highly powerful Gautama who had performed rigid austerities thus cursed the wicked Ahalya and left this hermitage, for the peaks of Himavat mountain served by siddhas and charanas. Here he performed austerities"(said Viswamitra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fortyeighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अफलस्तु ततश्शक्रो देवानग्निपुरोगमान्। अब्रवीत्त्रस्तवदनस्सर्षिस्सङ्घान् सचारणान्।।1.49.1।।
output: तत: thereafter, अफल: having been deprived of his testacles, शक्र: Indra, त्रस्तवदन: with freightened face, सर्षिस्सङ्घान् with groups of rishis, सचारणान् with charanas, अग्निपुरोगमान् with Agni in the forefront, देवान् addressing devatas, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 49:
कुर्वता तपसो विघ्नं गौतमस्य महात्मन:। क्रोधमुत्पाद्य हि मया सुरकार्यमिदं कृतम्।।1.49.2।।
output: 'I have accomplished the objective of the devatas by creating obstacles to Gautama's  austerities, evoking in consequence the wrath of the magnanimous sage'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 49:
अफलोऽस्मि कृतस्तेन क्रोधात्सा च निराकृता। शापमोक्षेण महता तपोऽस्यापहृतं मया।।1.49.3।।
output: 'By his (Gautama's) wrath I have been deprived of my testicles. She (Ahalya) has  been deserted by him. He has lost his ascetic energy through the pronouncement of this great curse'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मात्सुरवरास्सर्वे सर्षिस्सङ्घास्सचारणा: । सुरसाह्यकरं सर्वे सफलं कर्तुमर्हथ।।1.49.4।।
output: तस्मात् for that reason, सर्षिसङ्घा: with hosts of rishis, सचारणा: with charanas, सर्वे all, सुरवरा: excellent devatas, सुरसाह्यकरम् for the benefit of devatas, सफलम् restoration of my testicles, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ it is your duty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शतक्रतोर्वचश्श्रुत्वा देवास्साग्निपुरोगमा:। पितृदेवानुपेत्याहु स्सह सर्वैर्मरुद्गणै:।।1.49.5।।
output: साग्निपुरोगमा: with Agni in the forefront, देवा: devtas, शतक्रतो: Indra's (performer of one hundred sacrifices), वच: words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सर्वे all, मरुद्गणै: सह accompanied by hosts of maruts, पितृदेवान् pitrudevatas, उपेत्य having approached, आहु: said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 49:
अयं मेषस्सवृषणश्शक्रो ह्यवृषण: कृत:। मेषस्य वृषणौ गृह्य शक्रायाऽशु प्रयच्छथ।।1.49.6।।
output: 'This ram (which has received the share of your sacrificial offerings) has testicles. As Indra has been deprived of his own take these testicles immediately and graft them on to Indra'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्नेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा पितृदेवास्समागता:। उत्पाट्य मेषवृषणौ सहस्राक्षे न्यवेशयन्।।1.49.8।।
output: समागता: assembled, पितृदेवा: pitrudevatas, अग्ने: Agni's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, मेषवृषणौ testicles of ram, उत्पाट्य extracting, सहस्राक्षे for Indra, न्यवेशयन् grafted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदा प्रभृति काकुत्स्थ पितृदेवास्समागता:। अफलान् भुञ्जते मेषान् फलैस्तेषामयोजयन्।।1.49.9।।
output: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, समागता: assembled, पितृदेवा: pitrudevatas, तदा प्रभृति then onwards, अफलान् without genitals, मेषान् rams, भुञ्जते accepted as offerings, तेषाम् their, फलै: their testicles, अयोजयन् having fitted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इन्द्रस्तु मेषवृषणस्तदाप्रभृति राघव। गौतमस्य प्रभावेन तपसश्च महात्मन:।।1.49.10।।
output: O Son of the Raghus illustrious Gautama's power of ascetism was such that thenceforth Indra possessed the testicles of a ram.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 49:
तदागच्छ महातेज आश्रमं पुण्यकर्मण:। तारयैनां महाभागामहल्यां देवरूपिणीम्।।1.49.11।।
output: "Most brilliant Rama therefore enter the hermitage of the pious (Gautama) and liberate  this fortunate Ahalya of divine appearance (from the curse)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विश्वामित्रवचश्श्रुत्वा राघवस्सहलक्ष्मण:। विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य तमाश्रममथाविशत्।।1.49.12।।
output: In response to the words of Viswamitra Rama and Lakshmana entered the  hermitage, Viswamitra in front.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 49:
ददर्श च महाभागां तपसा द्योतितप्रभाम्। लोकैरपि समागम्य दुर्निरीक्ष्यां सुरासुरै:।।1.49.13।। प्रयत्नान्निर्मितां धात्रा दिव्यां मायामयीमिव। स तुषारावृतां साभ्रां पूर्णचन्द्रप्रभामिव।।1.49.14।। मध्येंऽभसो दुराधर्षां दीप्तां सूर्यप्रभामिव।
output: Rama beheld the highly fortunate Ahalya, shining brilliantly with the power of her asceticism. She could not be seen even by men, suras or asuras joined together. She looked  divine and illusory as if created with special efforts by Brahma. Though not clearly visible, she was shining bright like the light of the full Moon muffled by mists in the sky and like the inviolable light of the Sun reflected in the water.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ददर्श च महाभागां तपसा द्योतितप्रभाम्। लोकैरपि समागम्य दुर्निरीक्ष्यां सुरासुरै:।।1.49.13।। प्रयत्नान्निर्मितां धात्रा दिव्यां मायामयीमिव। स तुषारावृतां साभ्रां पूर्णचन्द्रप्रभामिव।।1.49.14।। मध्येंऽभसो दुराधर्षां दीप्तां सूर्यप्रभामिव।
output: महाभागाम् highly fortunate, तपसा with the power of ascetism, द्योतितप्रभाम् shining brilliantly, लोकैरपि by men, सुरासुरै: by suras or asuras, समागम्य joined together, दुर्निरीक्ष्याम् incapable of being seen, धात्रा by lord Brahma, प्रयत्नात् with special efforts, निर्मिताम् created, दिव्याम् divine, मायामयीमिव looking like illusory image, तुषारावृताम् covered by mist, साभ्राम् with clouds, पूर्णचन्द्रप्रभामिव looking like brightness of full moon, अम्भस: in the sky, मध्ये in the midst, दुराधर्षाम् inviolable, दीप्ताम् shining, सूर्यप्रभामिव like brightness of sun, स: Rama, ददर्श beheld.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा हि गौतमवाक्येन दुर्निरीक्ष्या बभूव ह।।1.49.15।। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां यावद्रामस्य दर्शनम्।
output: By the words of Gautama, she became invisible to the three worlds till the appearance of Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 49:
शापस्यान्तमुपागम्य तेषां दर्शनमागता।।1.49.16।। राघवौ तु ततस्तस्या: पादौ जगृहतुस्तदा।
output: With the expiry of the period of the curse, the Raghavas (Rama and Lakshmana) speared and she became perceptible when Rama touched her feet.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 49:
स्मरन्ती गौतमवच: प्रतिजग्राह सा च तौ।।1.49.17।। पाद्यमर्घ्यं तथाऽऽतिथ्यं चकार सुसमाहिता। प्रतिजग्राह काकुत्स्थो विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा।।1.49.18।।
output: Recalling the words of Gautama, she received them with water to wash their feet and offerings made with due devotion Rama accepted her hospitality extended in accordance tradition.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्मरन्ती गौतमवच: प्रतिजग्राह सा च तौ।।1.49.17।। पाद्यमर्घ्यं तथाऽऽतिथ्यं चकार सुसमाहिता। प्रतिजग्राह काकुत्स्थो विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा।।1.49.18।।
output: सा च she also, गौतमवच: words of Gautama, स्मरन्ती recalling, तौ them, प्रतिजग्राह received with due honours, सुसमाहिता with concentration of mind and attention, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, अर्घ्यम् offerings of reverence, तथा and, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, विधिदृष्टेन according to tradition, कर्मणा by acts, चकार performed, काकुत्स्थः Kakusthsa, प्रतिजग्राह received.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 49:
पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीद्देवदुन्दुभिनिस्वनै:। गन्धर्वाप्सरसां चैव महानासीत्समागम:।।1.49.19।।
output: Amidst sounds of celestial kettledrums, devatas showered flowers, gandharvas sang and apsarasa danced. There was a great assemblage (of divinities).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
साधु साध्विति देवास्तामहल्यां समपूजयन्। तपोबलविशुद्धाङ्गी गौतमस्य वशानुगाम्।।1.49.20।।
output: गौतमस्य Gautama's, वशानुगाम् in the possession of, तपोबलविशुद्धाङ्गीम् her body purified by the power of penance, ताम् that, अहल्याम् Ahalya, देवा: devatas, साधु साधु इति 'Excellent', 'Excellent', समपूजयन् exclaimed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गौतमोऽपि महातेजा अहल्यासहितस्सुखी। रामं सम्पूज्य विधिवत्तपस्तेपे महातपा:।।1.49.21।।
output: महातपा: possessed of great ascetism, महातेजा: highly glorious, गौतमोऽपि Gautama also, अहल्यासहित: accompanied by Ahalya, सुखी full of joy, रामम् Rama, विधिवत् according to tradition, सम्पूज्य having worshipped, तप: austerities, तेपे performed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामोऽपि परमां पूजां गौतमस्य महामुने:। सकाशाद्विधिवत्प्राप्य जगाम मिथिलां तत:।।1.49.22।।
output: रामोऽपि Rama also, गौतमस्य महामुने: of the great ascetic Gautama, सकाशात् from him, परमाम् great, पूजाम् hospitality, विधिवत् according to tradition, प्राप्य having received, मिथिलाम् towards Mithila, जगाम had gone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत: प्रागुत्तरां गत्वा रामस्सौमित्रिणा सह। विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञवाटमुपागमत्।।1.50.1।।
output: तत: afterwards, राम: Rama, सौमित्रिणा सह accompanied by Lakshmana, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, पुरस्कृत्य keeping him ahead, प्रागुत्तरां northeasterly direction, गत्वा having gone, यज्ञवाटम् sacrificial ground, उपागमत् reached.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्तु मुनिशार्दूलमुवाच सहलक्ष्मण:। साध्वी यज्ञसमृद्धिर्हि जनकस्य महात्मन:।।1.50.2।।
output: Rama with Lakshmana told the tiger among ascetics Viswamitra that the preparations or the sacrifice by the illustrious king Janaka were excellent.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 50:
बहूनीह सहस्राणि नानादेशनिवासिनाम्। ब्राह्मणानां महाभाग वेदाध्ययनशालिनाम्।।1.50.3।। ऋषिवाटाश्च दृश्यन्ते शकटीशतसङ्कुला:। देशो विधीयतां ब्रह्मन् यत्र वत्स्यामहे वयम्।।1.50.4।।
output: O Illustrious sage thousands of brahmins living in different countries and versed in  the study of the vedas have assembled here. The shelters for ascetics are thronged with hundreds of carts. O Great ascetic let us choose a place where we can stay.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बहूनीह सहस्राणि नानादेशनिवासिनाम्। ब्राह्मणानां महाभाग वेदाध्ययनशालिनाम्।।1.50.3।। ऋषिवाटाश्च दृश्यन्ते शकटीशतसङ्कुला:। देशो विधीयतां ब्रह्मन् यत्र वत्स्यामहे वयम्।।1.50.4।।
output: महाभाग O Illustrious one, इह here, नानादेशनिवासिनाम् living in different countries,  वेदाध्ययन शालिनाम् of those who studied the vedas, ब्राह्मणानां of Brahmins, बहूनि सहस्राणि in many thousands, शकटीशतसङ्कुला: thronged with hundreds of carts, ऋषिवाटाश्च shelters for ascetics, दृश्यन्ते are seen, ब्रह्मन् O Great ascetic, वयम् we, यत्र where, वत्स्यामहे can rest, देश: place, विधीयताम् be determined.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। निवेशमकरोद्देशे विविक्ते सलिलायुते।।1.50.5।।
output: महामुनि: great ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, रामस्य Rama's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having listened, सलिलायुते provided with water, विविक्ते in a peaceful, देशे place, निवेशम् encampment, अकरोत् chosen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विश्वामित्रमनुप्राप्तं श्रुत्वा स नृपतिस्तदा। शतानन्दं पुरस्कृत्य पुरोहितमनिन्दितम्।।1.50.6।। प्रत्युज्जगाम सहसा विनयेन समन्वित:।
output: When the king heard of the arrival of Viswamitra he went forward with Satananda, the blemishless family priest walking ahead in order to welcome him with humility.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋत्विजोऽपि महात्मानस्त्वर्घ्यमादाय सत्वरम्।।1.50.7।। विश्वामित्राय धर्मेण ददुर्मंन्त्रपुरस्कृतम्।
output: Eminent officiating priests speedily brought the offerings of worship and paid obeisance to Viswamitra with prayers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 50:
प्रतिगृह्य च तां पूजां जनकस्य महात्मन:।।1.50.8।। पप्रच्छ कुशलं राज्ञो यज्ञस्य च निरामयम्।
output: Viswamitra received illustrious king Janaka's worship and enquired about the welfare of the king and the conduct of the sacrifice.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 50:
स तांश्चापि मुनीन् पृष्ट्वा सोपाध्यायपुरोधस:।।1.50.9।। यथान्यायं ततस्सर्वैस्समागच्छत्प्रहृष्टवत्।
output: Viswamitra duly enquired the wellbeing of the sages and the spiritual teachers, priests in right order. And thereafter the rest joined them in great delight.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 50:
अथ राजा मुनिश्रेष्ठं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत।।1.50.10।। आसने भगवानास्तां सहैभिर्मुनिपुङ्गवै:।
output: The king then folded his hands in supplication to the foremost of ascetics, Viswamitra, saying "O Venerable one please be seated along with the eminent ascetics."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जनकस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा निषसाद महामुनि:।।1.50.11।। पुरोधा ऋत्विजश्चैव राजा च सह मन्त्रिभि:।
output: In response to Janaka's words, great sage Viswamitra occupied his seat. Thereafter the family priests, officiationg priests of the sacrifice, counsellors and also the king occupied their seats according to their rank.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 50:
आसनेषु यथान्यायमुपविष्टान् समन्तत:।।1.50.12।। दृष्ट्वा स नृपतिस्तत्र विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्।
output: Thereafter the king looked on all sides and  saw all of them seated  according to their rank and addressed Viswamitra saying:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्य यज्ञसमृध्दिर्मे सफला दैवतै: कृता।।1.50.13।। अद्य यज्ञफलं प्राप्तं भगवद्दर्शनान्मया।
output: "Today my sacrifice has been rendered fruitful by the devatas. I have reaped the fruit of my sacrifice today by your venerable presence.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि यस्य मे मुनिपुङ्गव।।1.50.14।। यज्ञोपसदनं ब्रह्मन् प्राप्तोऽसि मुनिभि: सह।
output: O Preeminent among ascetics O brahmana you have come to my sacrificial mandap along with these ascetics Blessed am I Obliged am I.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
द्वादशाहं तु ब्रह्मर्षे शेषमाहुर्मनीषिण:।।1.50.15।। ततो भागार्थिनो देवान् द्रष्टुमर्हसि कौशिक।
output: O Brahmarshi learned men say, only twelve days remain for completion of this acrifice. Thereafter O Viswamitra you should see devatas claiming their shares".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्त्वा मुनिशार्दूलं प्रहृष्टवदनस्तदा।।1.50.16।। पुनस्तं परिपप्रच्छ प्राञ्जलि: प्रणतो नृप:।
output: Having said this, the king (Janaka) with a cheerful countenance and saluting with folded palms again asked that tiger among ascetics (Viswamitra):

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमौ कुमारौ भद्रं ते देवतुल्यपराक्रमौ।।1.50.17।। गजसिंहगती वीरौ शार्दूलवृषभोपमौ। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षौ खड्गतूणीधनुर्धरौ।।1.50.18।। अश्विनाविव रूपेण समुपस्थितयौवनौ। यदृच्छयैव गां प्राप्तौ देवलोकादिवामरौ।।1.50.19।। कथं पद्भ्यामिह प्राप्तौ किमर्थं कस्य वा मुने।
output: मुने O Visvamitra, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you, देवतुल्यपराक्रमौ like celestials in prowess, गजसिंहगती having the gait of elephant or lion, वीरौ heros, शार्दूलवृषभोपमौ resembling tiger or bull in strength, पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षौ having expansive eyes like lotuspetals,            खड्गतूणीधनुर्धरौ holding scimitars, quivers and bows, रूपेण in beauty, अश्विनाविव like  Aswins, समुपस्थितयौवनौ approaching the youth, देवलोकात् from celestial world, यदृच्छया on their own free will, गाम् earth, प्राप्तौ reached, अमरौ इव like devatas, इमौ these two, कुमारौ youths, इह here, कथम् how, किमर्थम् for what purpose, पद्भ्याम् by foot, प्राप्तौ have come, कस्य वा to whom do they belong?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमौ कुमारौ भद्रं ते देवतुल्यपराक्रमौ।।1.50.17।। गजसिंहगती वीरौ शार्दूलवृषभोपमौ। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षौ खड्गतूणीधनुर्धरौ।।1.50.18।। अश्विनाविव रूपेण समुपस्थितयौवनौ। यदृच्छयैव गां प्राप्तौ देवलोकादिवामरौ।।1.50.19।। कथं पद्भ्यामिह प्राप्तौ किमर्थं कस्य वा मुने।
output: "O Sage (Viswamitra), be blessed. Who are these two young men with the prowess of the celestials the gait of an elephant or a lion? They resemble a tiger or a bull in courage. They have large eyes like lotuspetals. They are armed with scimitars bows and quivers. With their approaching youth, they resemble the Aswinikumaras in beauty. They look like gods who have descended on earth from heaven out of their free will. Whose sons are they? How did they come here on foot? And for what purpose?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमौ कुमारौ भद्रं ते देवतुल्यपराक्रमौ।।1.50.17।। गजसिंहगती वीरौ शार्दूलवृषभोपमौ। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षौ खड्गतूणीधनुर्धरौ।।1.50.18।। अश्विनाविव रूपेण समुपस्थितयौवनौ। यदृच्छयैव गां प्राप्तौ देवलोकादिवामरौ।।1.50.19।। कथं पद्भ्यामिह प्राप्तौ किमर्थं कस्य वा मुने।
output: "O Sage (Viswamitra), be blessed. Who are these two young men with the prowess of the celestials the gait of an elephant or a lion? They resemble a tiger or a bull in courage. They have large eyes like lotuspetals. They are armed with scimitars bows and quivers. With their approaching youth, they resemble the Aswinikumaras in beauty. They look like gods who have descended on earth from heaven out of their free will. Whose sons are they? How did they come here on foot? And for what purpose?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वरायुधधरौ वीरौ कस्य पुत्रौ महामुने।।1.50.20।। भूषयन्ताविमं देशं चन्द्रसूर्याविवाम्बरम्। परस्परस्य सदृशौ प्रमाणेङ्गितचेष्टितै:।।1.50.21।। काकपक्षधरौ वीरौ श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वत:।
output: Great ascetic, these two young men with hair falling on their temples like the wings of a crow, each of them resemble the other in personality, expressions and gestures. Wielding excellent weapons they adorn this land like the Moon and the Sun deck the sky. Whose sons are they? I wish truly to hear about these heroes".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वरायुधधरौ वीरौ कस्य पुत्रौ महामुने।।1.50.20।। भूषयन्ताविमं देशं चन्द्रसूर्याविवाम्बरम्। परस्परस्य सदृशौ प्रमाणेङ्गितचेष्टितै:।।1.50.21।। काकपक्षधरौ वीरौ श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वत:।
output: महामुने O Great ascetic, वरायुधधरौ holding excellent weapons, वीरौ these heros, कस्य whose, पुत्रौ sons, चन्द्रसूर्यौ Moon and Sun, अम्बरमिव like the sky, इमम् this, देशम् land, भूषयन्तौ adorning, प्रमाणेङ्गितचेष्टितै: in personality, expressions and gestures, परस्परस्य each other, सदृशौ resemble, काकपक्षधरौ mesh of hair falling on their temples, वीरौ about these heroes, तत्त्वत: truely, श्रोतुम् to listen, इच्छामि desiring.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा जनकस्य महात्मन:।।1.50.22।। न्यवेदयन्महात्मानौ पुत्रौ दशरथस्य तौ।
output: Hearing the words of the magnanimous Janaka, Viswamitra presented them to him saying that they were the illustrious sons of Dasaratha.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सिद्धाश्रमनिवासं च राक्षसानां वधं तथा।।1.50.23।। तच्चागमनमव्यग्रं विशालायाश्च दर्शनम्। अहल्यादर्शनं चैव गौतमेन समागमम्।।1.50.24।। महाधनुषि जिज्ञासां कर्तुमागमनं तथा। एतत्सर्वं महातेजा जनकाय महात्मने ।।1.50.25।। निवेद्य विररामाथ विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:।
output: महातेजा: highly lustrous, महामुनि: great ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, सिद्धाश्रमनिवासं च their stay at siddha ashrama, तथा and, राक्षसानाम् rakshasas', वधम् slaying, अव्यग्रम् undaunted, तत् आगमनम् that journey, विशालाया: Vishala's, दर्शनम् sight of, अहल्या दर्शनं चैव appearance of Ahalya, गौतमेन by Gautama, समागमम् meeting, तथा and, महाधनुषि in Siva's great bow, जिज्ञासाम् inquisitiveness, कर्तुम् to know, आगमनम् purpose of their arrival, एतत्सर्वम् all this, महात्मने to the distinguished, जनकाय for king Janaka, निवेद्य having related, अथ then, विरराम stopped.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्य धीमत:। हृष्टरोमा महातेजाश्शतानन्दो महातपा:।।1.51.1।। गौतमस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठस्तपसा द्योतितप्रभ:। रामसन्दर्शनादेव परं विस्मयमागत:।।1.51.2।।
output: Satananda the eldest son of Gautama, a great sage who looked brilliant with the power of austerities was thrilled to hear the words of Viswamitra the intellectual and experienced great astonishment on beholding Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रस्य धीमत:। हृष्टरोमा महातेजाश्शतानन्दो महातपा:।।1.51.1।। गौतमस्य सुतो ज्येष्ठस्तपसा द्योतितप्रभ:। रामसन्दर्शनादेव परं विस्मयमागत:।।1.51.2।।
output: Satananda describes the efforts and achievements of Viswamitra to Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तौ निषण्णौ सम्प्रेक्ष्य सुखासीनौ नृपात्मजौ। शतानन्दो मुनिश्रेष्ठं विश्वामित्रमथामब्रवीत्।।1.51.3।।
output: अथ afterwards, स: शतानन्द: Satananda, निषण्णौ sitting nearby, सुखासीनौ comfortably seated, तौ नृपात्मजौ the two princes, सम्प्रेक्ष्य having seen, मुनिश्रेष्ठम् foremost of ascetics, विश्वामित्रम् addressing Visvamitra, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
अपि ते मुनिशार्दूल मम माता यशस्विनी। दर्शिता राजपुत्राय तपो दीर्घमुपागता।।1.51.4।।
output: "O Tiger among ascetics, was my renowned mother who had been practising intense austerities for long shown to the prince (Rama)?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
अपि रामे महातेजा मम माता यशस्विनी। वन्यैरुपाहरत्पूजां पूजार्हे सर्वदेहिनाम्।।1.51.5।।
output: Did my highly lustrous and celebrated mother offer homage to Rama, worthy of reverence by all living beings, with things available in the forest?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अपि रामाय कथितं यथावृत्तं पुरातनम्। मम मातुर्महातेजो दैवेन दुरनुष्ठितम्।।1.51.6।।
output: O highly powerful sage, was Rama told the old story about the misdeed of god (Indra) to my mother?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अपि कौशिक भद्रं ते गुरुणा मम सङ्गता। मम माता मुनिश्रेष्ठ रामसन्दर्शनादित:।।1.51.7।।
output: कौशिक O Visvamitra, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you, मुनिश्रेष्ठ O best among ascetics, मम माता my mother, रामसन्दर्शनात् इत: in consequence of beholding Rama here, मम my, गुरुणा   with father, अपि सङ्गता has been united?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
अपि मे गुरुणा राम: पूजित: कुशिकात्मज। इहागतो महातेजा: पूजां प्राप्तो महात्मन:।।1.51.8।।
output: O Son of Kushika was Rama honoured by my father? Was my most brilliant father  honoured by illustrious Rama when he arrived?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अपि शान्तेन मनसा गुरुर्मे कुशिकात्मज । इहाऽगतेन रामेण प्रयतेनाभिवादित:।।1.51.9।।
output: O Kushika's son did pious Rama welcome my father with a tranquil mind when he arrived?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। प्रत्युवाच शतानन्दं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम्।।1.51.10।।
output: Great sage Viswamitra equipped with the knowledge of words heard Satananda who was proficient in speech. And replied:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
नातिक्रान्तं मुनिश्रेष्ठ यत्कर्तव्यं कृतं मया। सङ्गता मुनिना पत्नी भार्गवेणेव रेणुका।।1.51.11।।
output: O Best of ascetics (Satananda) All that is required to be done has been done and nothing was omitted. Ahalya was united with sage Gautama like Renuka with Jamadagni.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य भाषितम् । शतानन्दो महातेजा रामं वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.51.12।।
output: तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य Visvamitra's, भाषितम् having been spoken, तत् वचनम् that word, श्रुत्वा having listened, महातेजा: highly splendrous, शतानन्द: Satananda, रामम् addressing Rama, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि राघव। विश्वामित्रं पुरस्कृत्य महर्षिमपराजितम्।।1.51.13।।
output: नरश्रेष्ठ O Chief of men, राघव Rama, अपराजितम् invincible, महर्षिम् maharshi, विश्वामित्रम् Viswamitra, पुरस्कृत्य keeping him in front, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्राप्त: असि you have come, ते स्वागतम् welcome to you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
अचिन्त्यकर्मा तपसा ब्रह्मर्षिरतुलप्रभ:। विश्वामित्रो महातेजा वेत्स्येनं परमां गतिम्।।1.51.14।।
output: Highly lustrous Viswamitra has performed deeds which defy all imagination. By his austerities, he became Brahmarshi and possesses unparalleled radiance. Know him to be the supreme resort.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नास्ति धन्यतरो राम त्वत्तोऽन्यो भुवि कश्चन। गोप्ता कुशिकपुत्रस्ते येन तप्तं महत्तप:।।1.51.15।।
output: राम Rama, भुवि on this earth, त्वत्त: more than you, धन्यतर: more fortunate, अन्य: other, कश्चन none, नास्ति does not exist, येन by whom, महत् great, तप: austerities, तप्तम् having been performed, कुशिक पुत्र: son of Kusika, ते to you, गोप्ता protector.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामि कौशिकस्य महात्मन:। यथा बलं यथा वृत्तं तन्मे निगदत: श्रुणु।।1.51.16।।
output: I shall tell you about the power and achievement of the magnanimous son of Kushika Viswamitra. Listen

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
राजाऽभूदेष धर्मात्मा दीर्घकालमरिन्दम:। धर्मज्ञ: कृतविद्यश्च प्रजानां च हिते रत:।।1.51.17।।
output: This righteousminded sage, subduer of enemies, knower of dharma knowledgeable in all branches of learning, devoted to the welfare of his subjects ruled as a king for long.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
प्रजापतिसुतश्चासीत्कुशो नाम महीपति:। कुशस्य पुत्रो बलवान् कुशनाभस्सुधार्मिक:।।1.51.18।।
output: There was a king named Kusa who was the son of Brahma. His son was Kusanabha who was supremely righteous and strong.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुशनाभसुतस्त्वासीद्गाधिरित्येव विश्रृत:। गाधे: पुत्रो महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:।।1.51.19।।
output: गाधि: इत्येव known as Gadhi, विश्रृत: wellknown, कुशनाभसुत: आसीत् was the son of Kusnabha, महातेजा: highly lustrous, महामुनि: mighty ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, गाधे: Gadhi's, पुत्र: son.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विश्वामित्रो महातेजा: पालयामास मेदिनीम्। बहुवर्षसहस्राणि राजा राज्यमकारयत्।।1.51.20।।
output: महातेजा: highly lustrous, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, मेदिनीम् the earth, पालयामास ruled, राजा  this king, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, राज्यम् kingdom, अकारयत् ruled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Bala Kanda, Sarga 51:
कदाचित्तु महातेजा योजयित्वा वरूथिनीम्। अक्षौहीणीपरिवृत: परिचक्राम मेदिनीम्।।1.51.21।।
output: Once that highly lustrous Viswamitra having assembled his army of the magnitude of akshauhini went round the earth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

output: राम Rama, सराष्ट्राणि together with kingdoms, नगराणि cities, सरित: rivers, तथा and, गिरीन्  mountains, आश्रमान् hermitages, क्रमश: regularly,  विचरन् while wandering, नानावृक्षसमाकुलम्  crowded with various kinds of trees, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् filled with various species of animals, सिद्धचारणसेवितम् attended by siddhas and charanas, देवदानवगन्धर्वै: devatas, danavas, gandharvas, किन्नरै: kinnaras, उपशोभितम् shining, प्रशान्तहरिणाकीर्णम् scattered with serene deers, द्विजसङ्घनिषेवितम् inhabited by multitude of birds,  ब्रह्मर्षिगणसङ्कीर्णम्  intermingled with hosts of brahmarshis, देवर्षिगणसेवितम् attended by hosts of devarishis, तपश्चरणसंसिद्धै: by those who attained perfection through their austerities, अग्निकल्पै: by those resembling fire in brightness, महात्मभि: by the magananimous, अब्भक्षै: by those  subsisting on water only, वायुभक्षैश्च by those subsisting on air, तथा and, शीर्णपर्णाशनै: by those living on fallen leaves as their food, फलमूलाशनै: by those living on fruits and roots as their food, दान्तै: by the selfrestrained, जितरोषै: by those who have conquered anger, जितेन्द्रियै: by those who controlled senses, ऋषिभि: by sages, जपहोमपरायणै: by those who were devoted to prayers and offerings of libations, वालखिल्यै: with Valakhilyas (sages born from Brahma and have the size of thumb), अन्यै: by others, वैखानसैश्चैव by Vaikhanasa (born from the nails of Brahma), समन्तात् every where, उपशोभितम् shining with brightness, वसिष्ठस्य Vasishta's, आश्रमपदम् hermitage,  अजगाम reached.

output: Rama while Viswamitra was wandering about kingdoms, cities, rivers, mountains and  hermitages, he gradually reached the ashram of Vasishta. That hermitage afounded in a variety of trees, species of animals, siddhas, charanas, devatas, danavas, gandharvas and kinnaras, multitudes of birds and resting deer. It was inhabited by brahmarshis and devarishis, by sages who had attained perfection through austerities, by those resembling fire in brightness, by the magnanimous and the selfrestrained, by those who had conquered anger and controlled their senses, who was devoted to prayers and offerings of libations. Some of them subsisted on water, some on air. Some lived on fallen leaves, some on fruits and roots. The hermitage looked bedecked with valakhilyas (born from Vala of Brahma ) and vaikhanasas (born from the nails of Brahma).
