instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 14:
त्वरयस्व महाराजं यथा समुदितेऽहनि।।2.14.42।। पुष्ये नक्षत्रयोगे च रामो राज्यमवाप्नुयात्।
output: Hasten the maharaja as Rama has to be installed in the kingdom as soon as the day breaks under the conjunction of the sacred Pushya star.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति तस्य वच श्श्रुत्वा सूतपुत्रो महात्मनः।।2.14.43।। स्तुवन्नृपतिशार्दूलं प्रविवेश निवेशनम्।
output: Having heard the words of the great Vasistha, charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment, singing the praise of this tiger among kings (Dasaratha).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं तु पूर्वोदितं वृध्दं द्वारस्था राज सम्मतम्।।2.14.44।। न शेकुरभिसंरोध्दुं राज्ञः प्रियचिकीर्षवः।
output: द्वारस्था: doorkeepers, राज्ञः of the king, प्रियचिकीर्षवः beloved wellwishers, पूर्वोदितम् who had come earlier, वृद्धम् aged, राजसम्मतम् liked by the king, तं तु him, अभिसंरोद्धुम् to detain, न शेकुः were not able.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स समीपस्थितो राज्ञस्तामवस्थामजज्ञिवान्।।2.14.45।। वाग्भिः परमतुष्टाभिरभिष्टोतुं प्रचक्रमे।
output: Sumantra approached the king unaware of the state of his mind and commenced praising him in highly pleasing words (as usual).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत स्सूतो यथाकालं पार्थिवस्य निवेशने।।2.14.46।। सुमन्त्रः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तुष्टाव जगतीपतिम्।
output: Thereafter the charioteer Sumantra entered the inner apartment of the king, and with folded hands began singing the praise of the lord of the earth appropriate to the hour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 14:
यथा नन्दति तेजस्वी सागरो भास्करोदये।।2.14.47।। प्रीतः प्रीतेन मनसा तथाऽनन्दघन स्स्वतः।
output: Just as the mighty ocean rejoices at sunrise, the inherently cheerful Sumantra became delighted to see the king.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इन्द्रमस्यां तु वेलायामभितुष्टाव मातलिः।।2.14.48।। सोऽजयद्दानवान्सर्वांस्तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्।
output: मातलिः charioteer, अस्यां वेलायाम् at this point of  time, इन्द्रम् Indra, अभितुष्टाव extoled, सः that Indra, सर्वान् all, दानवान् demons, अजयत् conquered, तथा in that way, अहम् I, त्वाम् you, बोधयामि awakening.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वेदास्सहाङ्गविद्याश्च यथाह्यात्मभुवं विभुम्।।2.14.49। ब्रह्माणं बोधयन्त्यद्य तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्।
output: सहाङ्गविद्याः together with the knowledge of Vedangas, वेदाः Vedas, आत्मभुवम् selfborn, विभुम् lord, ब्रह्माणम् Brahma, यथा as, बोधयन्ति awakening, तथा so, अहम् I, अद्य now, त्वाम् you, बोधयामि rousing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आदित्यस्सह चन्द्रेण यथा भूतधरां शुभाम्।।2.14.50।। बोधयत्यद्य पृथिवीं तथा त्वां बोधयाम्यहम्।
output: सह चन्द्रेण along with the Moon, आदित्यः the Sun, भूतधराम् supporter of all beings, शुभाम् auspicious, पृथिवीम् earth, यथा how, बोधयति awakens, तथा in that manner, अहम् I, त्वाम् you, अद्यबोधयामि am awakening you today.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उत्तिष्ठाशु महाराज कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः।।2.14.51।। विराजमानो वपुषा मेरोरिव दिवाकरः।
output: महाराज O maharaja, कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः clad in auspicious robes befitting the festivity, वपुषा in body, विराजमानः shining, मेरोः mount Meru, दिवाकरः इव like the Sun, आशु immediately, उत्तिष्ठ get up.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्स्थ शिववैश्रवणावपि।।2.14.52।। वरुणश्चाग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयं प्रदिशन्तु ते।
output: O descendent of Kakutstha, may Moon and Sun, Siva and Kubera, Varuna, Agni and Indra bestow victory on you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 14:
गता भगवती रात्रिः कृतं कृत्यमिदं तव।।2.14.53।। बुद्ध्यस्व नृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्। उदतिष्ठत रामस्य समग्रमभिषेचनम्।।2.14.54।।
output: O best among kings the holy night has passed. Having been acquainted with the acts accomplished so far, perform whatever is further necessary for the installation    ceremony. All preparations for Rama's coronation ceremony have since been complete.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गता भगवती रात्रिः कृतं कृत्यमिदं तव।।2.14.53।। बुद्ध्यस्व नृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्। उदतिष्ठत रामस्य समग्रमभिषेचनम्।।2.14.54।।
output: नृपशार्दूल a tiger among kings, भगवती holy, रात्रिः night, गता passed, तव your, इदम् this, कृतकृत्यम् tasks accomplished, बुद्ध्यस्व get enlightened, अनन्तरम् thereafter, कार्यम् installation ceremony, कुरु perform, रामस्य Rama's, समग्रम् cimplete, अभिषेचनम्  preparations for coronation, उदतिष्ठत are ready.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 14:
पौरजानापदैश्चापि नैगमैश्च कृताञ्जलिः। स्वयं वशिष्ठो भगवान्ब्राह्मणै स्सह तिष्ठति।।2.14.55।।
output: Venerable Vasistha along with inhabitants of the city and countryside including merchants and brahmins with folded hands awaits you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षिप्रमाज्ञाप्यतां राजन्राघवस्याभिषेचनम्। यथा ह्यपालाः पशवो यथा सेना ह्यनायका।।2.14.56।। यथा चन्द्रं विना रात्रिर्यथा गावो विना वृषम्। एवं हि भविता राष्ट्रं यत्र राजा न दृश्यते।।2.14.57।।
output: O king Rama's installation may be promptly ordered. As herds without herdsman, army without commander, night without the Moon, and cows without a bull, so is a kingdom without a king.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षिप्रमाज्ञाप्यतां राजन्राघवस्याभिषेचनम्। यथा ह्यपालाः पशवो यथा सेना ह्यनायका।।2.14.56।। यथा चन्द्रं विना रात्रिर्यथा गावो विना वृषम्। एवं हि भविता राष्ट्रं यत्र राजा न दृश्यते।।2.14.57।।
output: O king Rama's installation may be promptly ordered. As herds without herdsman, army without commander, night without the Moon, and cows without a bull, so is a kingdom without a king.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति तस्य वच श्शृत्वा सान्त्वपूर्वमिवार्थवत्। अभ्यकीर्यत शोकेन भूय एव महीपतिः।।2.14.58।।
output: Hearing these  meaningful words of Sumantra uttered in an appealing tone, the lord of the earth relapsed into grief.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत स्सराजा तं सूतं सन्नहर्ष स्सुतं प्रति। शोकरक्तेक्षण श्श्रीमानुद्वीक्ष्योवाच धार्मिकः।।2.14.59।। वाक्यैस्तु खलु मर्माणि मम भूयो निकृन्तसि।
output: धार्मिकः virtuous, श्रीमान् glorious, सः राजा that king, सुतं प्रति about his son, सन्नहर्षः  cheerless, शोकरक्तेक्षणः eyes red with tears, उद्वीक्ष्य looking upwards, तं सूतम् to that charioteer, उवाच said, वाक्यैः with words, मम my, मर्माणि vital parts of body, भूयः (एव) still more, निकृन्तसि are piercing (causing excessive pain).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुमन्त्रः करुणं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा दीनं च पार्थिवम्। प्रगृहीताञ्जलिः किञ्चित्तस्माद्देशादपाक्रमत्।।2.14.60।।
output: सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, करुणम् sorrowful words, श्रुत्वा having heard, दीनम् wretched, पार्थिवम् king, दृष्ट्वा च having seen, प्रगृहीताञ्जलिः with palms folded, तस्मात् देशात् from that place, किञ्चित् a little distance, अपाक्रमत् moved away.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदा वक्तुं स्वयं दैन्यान्न शशाक महीपतिः।।2.14.61।। तदा सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी प्रत्युवाच ह।
output: महीपतिः lord of the earth (the king), दैन्यात् due to the wretched conditon, स्वयम् personally, वक्तुम् to speak out, यदा when, न शशाक was not able, तदा then, मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी Kaikeyi, सुमन्त्रम् to Sumantra, प्रत्युवाच ह said in reply.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुमन्त्र राजा रजनीं रामहर्षसमुत्सुकः।।2.14.62।। प्रजागरपरिश्रान्तो निद्राया वशमुपेयिवान्।
output: सुमन्त्र O Sumantra, राजा king, रामहर्षसमुत्सुकः excited with joy in connection with Rama's coronation, रजनीम् entire night, प्रजागरपरिश्रान्तः weary with keeping awake all night, निद्रावशम् overpowered with sleep, उपेयिवान् is affected.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्गच्छ त्वरितं सूत राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम्।।2.14.63।। राममानय भद्रं ते नात्र कार्या विचारणा।
output: So, O Sumantra quickly fetch the gentle, illustrious prince Rama. Let there be no hesitation in this matter.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 14:
स मन्यमानः कल्याणं हृदयेन ननन्द च।।2.14.64।। निर्जगाम च सम्प्रीत्या त्वरितो राजशासनात्।
output: Thinking that an auspicious event will take place, he rejoiced at heart and in obedience to royal order, left at once.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुमन्त्रश्चिन्तयामास त्वरितं चोदितस्तया।।2.14.65।। व्यक्तं रामोऽभिषेकार्थमिहायास्यति धर्मवित्।
output: Urged by Kaikeyi, Sumantra thought 'Righteous Rama will definitely come here for the purpose of  installation'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 14:
इति सूतो मतिं कृत्वा हर्षेण महताऽऽवृतः।।2.14.66।। निर्जगाम महाबाहो राघवस्य दिदृक्षया।
output: So thought the charioteer and filled with great delight left (the inner apartment), eager to see the mightyarmed Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 14:
सागरह्रदसङ्काशात्सुमन्त्रोऽन्तःपुराच्छुभात्।।2.14.67।। निष्क्रम्य जनसम्बाधं ददर्श द्वारमग्रतः।
output: Sumantra, departed from the auspcious inner apartment which looked like the deep waters of the sea and saw people thronging the gate.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः पुरस्तात्सहसा विनिर्गतो महीपतीन्द्वारगतो विलोकयन्। ददर्श पौरान्विविधान्महाधना नुपस्थितान्द्वारमुपेत्य विष्ठितान्।।2.14.68।।
output: ततः then, सहसा immediately, पुरस्तात् forward, विनिर्गतः moving, द्वारगतः having reached  the gate, विलोकयन् seeing, द्वारम् gate, उपेत्य having approached, विष्ठितान् waiting, महीपतीन् kings, उपस्थितान् having arrived, महाधनान् wealthy people, (विविधान्) पौरान् citizens, ददर्श beheld.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते तु तां रजनीमुष्य ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। उपतस्थुरुपस्थानं सह राजपुरोहिताः।।2.15.1।।
output: Dasaratha commands Sumantra to bring Rama

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अमात्या बलमुख्याश्च मुख्या ये निगमस्य च। राघवस्याभिषेकार्थे प्रियमाणास्तु संगताः।।2.15.2।।
output: अमात्या: ministers, बलमुख्याश्च army chiefs, ये निगमस्य मुख्याः chiefs of the merchants' associations, राघवस्य of Rama, अभिषेकार्थे for the consecration, प्रियमाणा: brimming with joy, संगता: assembled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उदिते विमले सूर्ये पुष्ये चाभ्यागतेऽहनि। लग्ने कर्कटके प्राप्ते जन्म रामस्य च स्थिते।।2.15.3।। अभिषेकाय रामस्य द्विजेन्द्रैरुपकल्पितम्।
output: विमले bright, सूर्ये Sun, उदिते having arisen, अहनि during day , पुष्ये च when Pushya star, अभ्यागते was ascendent, रामस्य Rama's, जन्म स्थिते constellation at the time of birth, कर्कटकलग्ने ascension of karkataka lagna, प्राप्ते had come, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकाय for the consecration, द्विजेन्द्रै: by the best of brahmins, उपकल्पितम् was decided.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
काञ्चना जलकुम्भाश्च भद्रपीठं स्वलंकृतम्।।2.15,4।। रथः च सम्यगास्तीर्णो भास्वता व्याघ्रचर्मणा।
output: काञ्चना: golden, जलकुम्भाश्च jars filled with water, स्वलंकृतम् welldecorated, भद्रपीठम् throne, भास्वता by a bright, व्याघ्रचर्मणा by the tiger skin, सम्यक् properly, आस्तीर्ण:  spread, रथः च chariot also, (भान्ति are shining.)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गङ्गायमुनयोःपुण्यात्सङ्गमादाहृतं जलम्।।2.15.5।। याश्चान्या स्सरितः पुण्या ह्रदाः कूपा स्सरांसि च। प्राग्वाहाश्चोर्ध्ववाहाश्च तिर्यग्वाहा स्समाहिताः।।2.15.6।। ताभ्यश्चैवाहृतं तोयं समुद्रेभ्यश्च सर्वशः।
output: Water had been fetched from the sacred confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, from other  holy streams, wells, ponds and lakes, from rivers flowing eastward, westward, and  zigzag, from rivers from all directions joined together. And from all the seas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गङ्गायमुनयोःपुण्यात्सङ्गमादाहृतं जलम्।।2.15.5।। याश्चान्या स्सरितः पुण्या ह्रदाः कूपा स्सरांसि च। प्राग्वाहाश्चोर्ध्ववाहाश्च तिर्यग्वाहा स्समाहिताः।।2.15.6।। ताभ्यश्चैवाहृतं तोयं समुद्रेभ्यश्च सर्वशः।
output: पुण्यात् from sacred, गङ्गायमुनयो: सङ्गमात् from the confluence of Ganga and Yamuna, पुण्या: holy, अन्या: other, या:सरित: streams, ह्रदा: ponds, कूपा: wells, सरांसि च lakes as well, आहृतम्  brought, जलम् water, प्राग्वाहा: flowing eastwards, ऊर्ध्ववाहा: flowing upwards, तिर्यग्वाहा: flowing zigzag, समाहिता: joined together, ताभ्य: च from them also, सर्वश: from all directions, समुद्रेभ्य: from all seas, आहृतम् has been collected, तोयम् water.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सलाजाः क्षीरिभिश्छन्ना घटाः काञ्चनराजताः।।2.15.7।। पद्मोत्पलयुता भान्ति पूर्णाः परमवारिणा।
output: Gold and silver vessels filled with holy water and puffed corn, adorned with lotuses, water lilies and leaves from trees rich in sap shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
क्षौद्रं दधि घृतं लाजा दर्भा स्सुमनसः पयः।।2.15.8।। वेश्याश्चैव शुभाचारा स्सर्वाभरणभूषिताः।
output: Honey, curd, ghee, puffed grain, darbha grass, flowers and milk were arranged. Wellmannered courtesans adorned with all kinds of ornaments (stood in position).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चन्द्रांशुविकचप्रख्यं काञ्चनं रत्नभूषितम्।।2.15.9।। सज्जं तिष्ठति रामस्य वालव्यजनमुत्तमम्।
output: An excellent fan of yak's tail with a staff of gold  studded with gems looking like diffused moonbeams was kept ready.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चन्द्रमण्डलसङ्काशमातपत्रं च पाण्डुरम्।।2.15.10।। सज्जं द्युतिकरं श्रीमदभिषेकपुरस्कृतम्।
output: चन्द्रमण्डलसंकाशम् resembling the Moon's orb, पाण्डुरम् pale white, द्युतिकरम् lustrous like the pole star अभिषेकपुरस्कृतम् to be placed in front of the coronation pavilion, श्रीमत् majestic, आतपत्रं umbrella, सज्जम् is arranged.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पाण्डुरश्च वृषस्सज्जः पाण्डुरोऽश्वश्च सुस्थितः।।2.15.11।। प्रसृतश्च गजःश्रीमानौपवाह्यः प्रतीक्षते।
output: पाण्डुर: pale white, वृष: bull, सज्ज: is kept ready, अश्व:च horse also, सुस्थित: in state, प्रसृत: flowing ichor (from its temples), श्रीमान् majestic, औपवाह्य: worthy of ride by a king, गज: च elephant also, प्रतीक्षते is awaiting.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अष्टौ च कन्या माङ्गल्या स्सर्वाभरणभूषिताः।।2.15.12।। वादित्राणि च सर्वाणि वन्दिनश्च तथाऽपरे।
output: Eight auspicious maidens adorned with all types of ornaments, all sorts of musical instruments, panegyrists and others (were in waiting).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इक्ष्वाकूणां यथा राज्ये संभ्रियेताभिषेचनम्।।2.15.13।। तथाजातीयमादाय राजपुत्राभिषेचनम्। ते राजवचनात्तत्र समवेतामहीपतिम्।।2.15.14।। अपश्यन्तोऽब्रुवन् को नु राज्ञो नः प्रतिवेदयेत्। न पश्यामश्च राजानमुदितश्च दिवाकरः।।2.15.15।। यौवराज्याभिषेकश्च सज्जो रामस्य धीमतः।
output: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इक्ष्वाकूणां यथा राज्ये संभ्रियेताभिषेचनम्।।2.15.13।। तथाजातीयमादाय राजपुत्राभिषेचनम्। ते राजवचनात्तत्र समवेतामहीपतिम्।।2.15.14।। अपश्यन्तोऽब्रुवन् को नु राज्ञो नः प्रतिवेदयेत्। न पश्यामश्च राजानमुदितश्च दिवाकरः।।2.15.15।। यौवराज्याभिषेकश्च सज्जो रामस्य धीमतः।
output: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेचनम् consecration, यथा as, संभ्रियेत् might have been arranged, तथा जातीयम् pertaining to that race, राजपुत्राभिषेचनम् for the consecration of the prince, आदाय having brought, राजवचनात् in accordance with the order of the king, तत्र there, समवेता: having assembled, ते they, महीपतिम् to the king, अपश्यन्त: not beholding, न: about us, क: नु who indeed, राज्ञ: to the king, प्रतिवेदयेत् inform, अब्रुवन् said, राजानम् to the king, न च पश्याम: (we) do not see, दिवाकर: च sun also, उदित: has risen, धीमत: sagacious, रामस्य Rama's, यौवराज्याभिषेक: च consecration as prince regent, सज्ज: is ready.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इक्ष्वाकूणां यथा राज्ये संभ्रियेताभिषेचनम्।।2.15.13।। तथाजातीयमादाय राजपुत्राभिषेचनम्। ते राजवचनात्तत्र समवेतामहीपतिम्।।2.15.14।। अपश्यन्तोऽब्रुवन् को नु राज्ञो नः प्रतिवेदयेत्। न पश्यामश्च राजानमुदितश्च दिवाकरः।।2.15.15।। यौवराज्याभिषेकश्च सज्जो रामस्य धीमतः।
output: Just as articles necessary for the consecration of the descendants of the Ikshvakus, are customarily arranged in the kingdom, in the same way things were arranged for the coronation of the prince belonging to that race. All those who had assembled there in response to the order of the king could not see him and so they said to themselves 'Who will inform the king of our arrival. Everything is kept ready for consecration of the sagacious Rama as prince regent. The Sun has risen. But we do not find the king'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति तेषु ब्रुवाणेषु सार्वभौमान् महीपतीन्।।2.15.16।। अब्रवीत्तानिदं सर्वान्सुमन्त्रो राजसत्कृतः।
output: While the sovereign monarchs who hailed from different parts of the earth were thus talking Sumantra the king's confidant said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
रामं राज्ञो नियोगेन त्वरया प्रस्थितोऽस्म्यहम्।।2.15.17।। पूज्या राज्ञो भवन्तस्तु रामस्य च विशेषतः।
output: In obedience to the king's command I am hurrying for Rama. All of you are honourable to king Dasaratha, especially to Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अयं पृच्छामि वचनात्सुखमायुष्मतामहम्।।2.15.18।। राज्ञः संप्रति बुद्धस्य यच्चागमनकारणम्।
output: अयम् अहम् such I am, आयुष्मताम् longlived, वचनात् by your words, संप्रति बुद्धस्य to him now awake, राज्ञ: king's, सुखम् welfare, आगमनकारणं the reason for his coming, पृच्छामि I shall ask.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्त्वाऽन्तः पुरद्वारमाजगाम पुराणवित्।।2.15.19।। सदाऽसक्तं च तद्वेश्म सुमन्त्रः प्रविवेश ह।
output: Having said so, Sumantra who was versed in history and tradition  approached the inner apartment which always remains closed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तुष्टावास्य तदा वंशं प्रविश्य स विशांपतेः।।2.15.20।। शयनीयं नरेन्द्रस्य तदाऽऽसाद्य व्यतिष्ठत।
output: Entering the king's inner apartment, he began extoling the virtues of the royal dynasty, and stood there as he approached the king's bedchamber.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
सोऽत्यासाद्य तु तद्वेश्म तिरस्करणिमन्तरा।।2.15.21।। आशीर्भिर्गुणयुक्ताभि रभितुष्टाव राघवम्।
output: Having approached the king's bedchamber Sumatra stood behind the screen, singing his glory and seeking the blessings (of God) on this son of Raghus dynasty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोमसूर्यौ च काकुत्स्थ शिववैश्रवणावपि।।2.15.22।। वरुणश्चाग्निरिन्द्रश्च विजयं प्रदिशन्तु ते।
output: काकुत्स्थ O scion of the Kakutsthas (Dasaratha), सोमसूर्यौ Moon and Sun, शिववैश्रवणौ अपि Siva and Kubera also, वरुण: Varuna, अग्नि: Agni, इन्द्र: Indra, ते to you, विजयम् victory, प्रदिशन्तु let them grant.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गता भगवती रात्रिरहः शिवमुपस्थितम्।।2.15.23।। बुद्ध्यस्व नृपशार्दूल कुरु कार्यमनन्तरम्।
output: The holy night has passed and the auspicious day has arrived. O tiger among kings,  awaken and attend to your duties.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्राह्मणा बलमुख्याश्च नैगमाश्चागता नृप।।2.15.24।। दर्शनं तेऽभिकांक्षन्ते प्रतिबुध्यस्व राघव।
output: O scion of the Raghu dynasty brahmins, army commanders and merchants have arrived and they beseech your audience. Please awake.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
स्तुवन्तं तं तदा सूतं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रकोविदम्।।2.15.25।। प्रतिबुध्य ततो राजा इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: Dasaratha waking up saw the charioteer and expert counsellor Sumantra extoling him, and said:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राममानय सूतेति यदस्यभिहितोऽनया।।2.15.26।। किमिदं कारणं येन ममाज्ञा प्रतिहन्यते।
output: You had been asked by her (Kaikeyi) to bring Rama here. What is the reason the command is disregarded?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न चैव संप्रसुप्तोऽहमानयेहाशु राघवम्।।2.15.27।। इति राजा दशरथ स्सूतं तत्रान्वशात्पुनः।
output: अहम् I, न च एव संप्रसुप्त: I have not slept, आशु instantly, राघवम् to son of the Raghus (Rama), इह here, आनय bring, इति thus, राजा दशरथ: king Dasaratha, तत्र there, सूतम् to the charioteer, पुन: again, अन्वशात् ordered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
स राजवचनं श्रुत्वा शिरसा प्रतिपूज्य तम्।।2.15.28।। निर्जगाम नृपावासान्मन्यमानः प्रियं महत्।
output: At these words of the king, he offered his salutations by bowing his head and left the king's apartment, reflecting on the great happy event.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
प्रसन्नो राजमार्गं च पताकाध्वजशोभितम्।।2.15.29।। हृष्टः प्रमुदित स्सूतो जगामाशु विलोकयन्।
output: The charioteer left cheerfully, happily looking at the highway bedecked with pennants and banners.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स सूतस्तत्र शुश्राव रामाधिकरणाः कथाः।।2.15.30।। अभिषेचनसंयुक्तास्सर्वलोकस्य हृष्टवत्।
output: स: सूत: that charioteer, तत्र there, हृष्टवत् happy, सर्वलोकस्य of all the citizens, अभिषेचनसंयुक्ता: relating to installation, रामाधिकरणा: in connection with Rama, कथा: conversation, श्रुश्राव heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो ददर्श रुचिरं कैलासशिखरप्रभम्।।2.15.31।। रामवेश्म सुमन्त्रस्तु शक्रवेश्मसमप्रभम्।
output: तत: thereafter, सुमन्त्र: तु Sumantra on his part, कैलासशिखरप्रभम् in lustre comparable to the peak of Kailasa, शक्रवेश्मसमप्रभम् resembling in splendour the abode of Indra, रुचिरम् lovely, रामवेश्म palace of Rama, ददर्श beheld.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महाकवाटविहितं वितर्दिशतशोभितम्।।2.15.32।। काञ्चनप्रतिमैकाग्रं मणिविद्रुमतोरणम्। शारदाभ्रघनप्रख्यं दीप्तं मेरुगुहोपमम्।।2.15.33।। मणिभिर्वरमाल्यानां समुहद्भिरलंकृतम्। मुक्तामणिभिराकीर्णं चन्दनागरूधूपितम्।।2.15.34।। गन्धान्मनोज्ञान् विसृजद्दार्दुरं शिखरं यथा। सारसैश्च मयूरैश्च विनदद्भिर्विराजितम्।।2.15.35।। सुकृतेहामृगाकीर्णं सुकीर्णं भक्तिभिस्तथा। मनश्चक्षुश्च भूतानामाददत्तिग्मतेजसा।।2.15.36।। चन्द्रभास्करसङ्काशं कुबेरभवनोपमम्। महेन्द्रधामप्रतिमं नानापक्षिसमाकुलम्।।2.15.37।। मेरुशृङ्गसमं सूतो रामवेश्म ददर्श ह। उपस्थितैःसमाकीर्णं जनैरञ्जलिकारिभिः।।2.15.38।। उपादाय समाक्रान्तैस्तथा जानपदैर्जनैः। रामाभिषेकसुमुखैरुन्मुखैस्समलंकृतम्।।2.15.39।। महामेघसमप्रख्यमुदग्रं सुविभूषितम्। नानारत्नसमाकीर्णं कुब्जकैरातकावृतम्।।2.15.40।।
output: The charioteer (Sumantra) beheld Rama's palace closed with two heavypanelled doors. Adorned with hundreds of galleries, it had a peak mounted with golden idols. The arches were studded with different gems and corals. Bright like dense autumnal cloud, it shone like the cave of mount Meru. It was ornamented with excellent garlands and precious diamonds. Pearls were strewn around. Decorated with sandal and aloe wood, it emitted, like the peak of mount Dardura, captivating fragrance৷৷ Sarasas and peacocks were singing sweetly. The palace was full of skilfully carved images of deer and other embellishments. It attracted the minds and the eyes of all living beings with brilliant splendour. Resplendent like the Sun and the Moon, it looked like the abode of Kubera and a reflected image of the abode of Mahendra. It was crowded with birds of various kinds. In height it was equal to the peak of mount Meru. Villagers thronged the palace with gifts, eagerly waiting with folded hands to see the spectacle of Rama's coronation. Lofty, it looked like a vast cloud. Welldecked and filled with various gems, it was crowded with hunchbacks and kiratas (hunters) too.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महाकवाटविहितं वितर्दिशतशोभितम्।।2.15.32।। काञ्चनप्रतिमैकाग्रं मणिविद्रुमतोरणम्। शारदाभ्रघनप्रख्यं दीप्तं मेरुगुहोपमम्।।2.15.33।। मणिभिर्वरमाल्यानां समुहद्भिरलंकृतम्। मुक्तामणिभिराकीर्णं चन्दनागरूधूपितम्।।2.15.34।। गन्धान्मनोज्ञान् विसृजद्दार्दुरं शिखरं यथा। सारसैश्च मयूरैश्च विनदद्भिर्विराजितम्।।2.15.35।। सुकृतेहामृगाकीर्णं सुकीर्णं भक्तिभिस्तथा। मनश्चक्षुश्च भूतानामाददत्तिग्मतेजसा।।2.15.36।। चन्द्रभास्करसङ्काशं कुबेरभवनोपमम्। महेन्द्रधामप्रतिमं नानापक्षिसमाकुलम्।।2.15.37।। मेरुशृङ्गसमं सूतो रामवेश्म ददर्श ह। उपस्थितैःसमाकीर्णं जनैरञ्जलिकारिभिः।।2.15.38।। उपादाय समाक्रान्तैस्तथा जानपदैर्जनैः। रामाभिषेकसुमुखैरुन्मुखैस्समलंकृतम्।।2.15.39।। महामेघसमप्रख्यमुदग्रं सुविभूषितम्। नानारत्नसमाकीर्णं कुब्जकैरातकावृतम्।।2.15.40।।
output: सूत: the charioteer, महाकवाटविहितम् closed with two heavy panels of doors, वितर्दिशतशोभितम् adorned with hundreds of galleries, काञ्चनप्रतिमैकाग्रम् having a peak on which were mounted golden idols, मणिविद्रुमतोरणम् arches studded with diamonds and pearls, शारदाभ्रघनप्रख्यम् as bright as dense autumnal clouds, दीप्तम् shining, मेरुगुहोपमम् like a cave of mount Meru, सुमहद्भि: extremely, वरमाल्यानाम् excellent garlands, मणिभ: with diamonds, अलंकृतम् ornamented, मुक्तामणिभि: with pearls and gems, आकीर्णम् strewn with, चन्दनागरुधूपितम् decorated with sandal and aloe wood, दार्दुरम् from mount Dardura, शिखरं यथा like its peak, मनोज्ञान् captivating the mind, गन्धान् fragrance, विसृजत् emitting, विनदद्भिः singing sweetly, सारसै: Sarasas, मयूरैश्च peacocks, विराजितम् shone, सुकृतेहामृगाकीर्णम् full of skilfully carved images of deer, तथा and, भक्तिभि: embellishments, सुकीर्णम् wellspread, तिग्मतेजसा with brilliant splendour, भूतानाम् living beings, मन: mind, चक्षुश्च the eye, आददत् captivated, चन्द्रभास्करसङ्काशम् as Sun and Moon, कुबेरभवनोपम् similar to the abode of Kubera, महेन्द्रधामप्रतिमम् reflected image of the abode of Mahendra, नानापक्षिसमाकुलम् crowded with birds of various kinds, मेरुशृङ्गसमम् (tall) like the peak of Mount Meru, उपस्थितै: having arrived, अञ्जलिकारिभि: with joined palms, जनै: by people, समाकीर्णम् filled with, तथा and, उपादाय with gifts, समाक्रान्तै: thronged (that palace) रामाभिषेकसुमुखै: eager to see Rama's coronation, उन्मुखै: eager, जानपदै: जनै: by villagers, अलंकृतम् decorated, महामेघसमप्रख्यम् looking like the vast cloud,  उदग्रम् lofty, सुविभूषितम् welldecked, नानारत्नसमाकीर्णम् filled with various gems, कुब्जकैरातकावृतम् crowded with hunchbacks and hunters, रामवेश्म palace of Rama, ददर्श ह beheld.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
महाकवाटविहितं वितर्दिशतशोभितम्।।2.15.32।। काञ्चनप्रतिमैकाग्रं मणिविद्रुमतोरणम्। शारदाभ्रघनप्रख्यं दीप्तं मेरुगुहोपमम्।।2.15.33।। मणिभिर्वरमाल्यानां समुहद्भिरलंकृतम्। मुक्तामणिभिराकीर्णं चन्दनागरूधूपितम्।।2.15.34।। गन्धान्मनोज्ञान् विसृजद्दार्दुरं शिखरं यथा। सारसैश्च मयूरैश्च विनदद्भिर्विराजितम्।।2.15.35।। सुकृतेहामृगाकीर्णं सुकीर्णं भक्तिभिस्तथा। मनश्चक्षुश्च भूतानामाददत्तिग्मतेजसा।।2.15.36।। चन्द्रभास्करसङ्काशं कुबेरभवनोपमम्। महेन्द्रधामप्रतिमं नानापक्षिसमाकुलम्।।2.15.37।। मेरुशृङ्गसमं सूतो रामवेश्म ददर्श ह। उपस्थितैःसमाकीर्णं जनैरञ्जलिकारिभिः।।2.15.38।। उपादाय समाक्रान्तैस्तथा जानपदैर्जनैः। रामाभिषेकसुमुखैरुन्मुखैस्समलंकृतम्।।2.15.39।। महामेघसमप्रख्यमुदग्रं सुविभूषितम्। नानारत्नसमाकीर्णं कुब्जकैरातकावृतम्।।2.15.40।।
output: The charioteer (Sumantra) beheld Rama's palace closed with two heavypanelled doors. Adorned with hundreds of galleries, it had a peak mounted with golden idols. The arches were studded with different gems and corals. Bright like dense autumnal cloud, it shone like the cave of mount Meru. It was ornamented with excellent garlands and precious diamonds. Pearls were strewn around. Decorated with sandal and aloe wood, it emitted, like the peak of mount Dardura, captivating fragrance৷৷ Sarasas and peacocks were singing sweetly. The palace was full of skilfully carved images of deer and other embellishments. It attracted the minds and the eyes of all living beings with brilliant splendour. Resplendent like the Sun and the Moon, it looked like the abode of Kubera and a reflected image of the abode of Mahendra. It was crowded with birds of various kinds. In height it was equal to the peak of mount Meru. Villagers thronged the palace with gifts, eagerly waiting with folded hands to see the spectacle of Rama's coronation. Lofty, it looked like a vast cloud. Welldecked and filled with various gems, it was crowded with hunchbacks and kiratas (hunters) too.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
स वाजियुक्तेन रथेन सारथिः नराकुलं राजकुलं विराजयन्। वरूथिना रामगृहाभिपातिना पुरस्य सर्वस्य मनांसि हर्षयन्।।2.15.41।।
output: Mounted on a chariot, attached with a fender and driven by horses, the charioteer advanced towards the royal palace of Rama delighting the minds of the people of the city.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्समासाद्य महाधनं महत् प्रहृष्टरोमा स बभूब सारथिः। मृर्गैर्मयूरैश्च समाकुलोल्बणं गृहं वरार्हस्य शचीपतेरिव।।2.15.42।।
output: तत: thereafter, स: सारथि: that charioteer, महाधनम् opulent, महत् magnificent, मृगै: with deer, मयूरैश्च with peacocks, समाकुलोल्बणम् with pervading beauty, शचीपते: इव like that of the consort of Sachi, Indra, वरार्हस्य of a befitting man, गृहं palace, समासाद्य having reached, प्रहृष्टरोमा बभूव was thrilled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
स तत्र कैलासनिभास्स्वलंकृताः प्रविश्य कक्ष्यास्त्रिदशालयोपमाः। प्रियान्वरान् राममते स्थितान् बहून् व्यपोह्य शुद्धान्तमुपस्थितो रथी।।2.15.43।।
output: Having entered the welldecorated palace which was (lofty) like Kailasa, he crossed the courtyards comparable to the abode of the celestials, passed through the many bosom friends of Rama and entered the private apartment.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
स तत्र शुश्राव च हर्षयुक्ताः रामाभिषेकार्थकृता जनानाम्। नरेन्द्रसूनोरभिमङ्गलार्थाः सर्वस्य लोकस्य गिरः प्रहृष्टः।।2.15.44।।
output: There he heard the happy words spoken by people about the enthronement of prince Rama and his future wellbeing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 15:
महेन्द्रसद्मप्रतिमं तु वेश्म रामस्य रम्यं मृगपक्षि जुष्टम्। ददर्श मेरोरिव श्रुङ्गमुच्चं विभ्राजमानं प्रभया सुमन्त्रः।।2.15.45।।
output: Sumantra beheld Rama's palace which resembled the high summit of mount Meru shining with splendour. Filled with animals and birds, if looked like the abode of Indra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपस्थितैरञ्जलिकारकैश्च सोपायनैर्जानपदैर्जनैश्च। कोट्या परार्धैश्च विमुक्तयानैः समाकुलं द्वारपथं ददर्श।।2.15.46।।
output: उपस्थितै: by men present, अञ्जलि कारकैश्च (अञ्जलि कारिभिश्च) paying obeisance with folded palms, सोपायनै: (with their hands ) full of gifts, विमुक्तयानै: having left their chariots, कोट्या in crores of, परार्धैश्च billions, जानपदै: villagers, जनैश्च citizens from towns, समाकुलं thronged, द्वारपथं gateway, ददर्श beheld.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो महामेघमहीधराभं प्रभिन्नमत्यङ्कुशमत्यसह्यम्। रामौपवाह्यं रुचिरं ददर्श शत्रुञ्जयं नागमुदग्रकायम्।।2.15.47।।
output: तत: thereafter, महामेघमहीधराभम् resembling a great cloud or a vast mountain, प्रभिन्नम् ichor flowing from its temples, अत्यङ्कुशम् without caring for the goad, असह्यम् intolerant, उदग्रकायम् having a huge body, रामौपवाह्यम् fit to be mounted by Rama, रुचिरम्  beautiful, शत्रृञ्जयम् by name Satrunjaya, नागम् elephant, ददर्श beheld.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वलङ्कृतान् साश्वरथान् सकुञ्जरा नमात्य मुख्यांश्च ददर्श वल्लभान्। व्यपोह्य सूतस्सहितान् समन्ततः समृद्धमन्तःपुरमाविवेश ह।।2.15.48।।
output: स्वलंङ्कृतान् welladorned, साश्वरथान् with horses and chariots, सकुञ्जरान् with elephants, वल्लभान् dear to the king, अमात्यमुख्यांश्च important ministers also, ददर्श saw, सूत: charioteer, समन्तत: on all sides, सहितान् assembled, व्यपोह्य getting out of the way, समृद्धम् glorious, अन्त:पुरम् private apartment, आविवेश entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदन्द्रिकूटाचलमेघसन्निभं महाविमानोपमवेश्मसंयुतम्। अवार्यमाणः प्रविवेश सारथिः प्रभूतरत्नं मकरो यथार्णवम्।।2.15.49।।
output: तत: afterwards, सारथि: charioteer, अद्रिकूटाचलमेघसन्निभम् similar to motionless cloud over a  mountain peak, महाविमानोपमवेश्मसंयुतम् surrounded by splendid rooms, मकर: crocodile,  prevented, प्रविवेश entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदन्तःपुरद्वारं समतीत्य जनाकुलम्। प्रविविक्तां ततः कक्ष्यामाससाद पुराणवित्।।2.16.1।। प्रासकार्मुकबिभ्रद्भिर्युवभिर्मृष्टकुण्डलैः। अप्रमादिभिरेकाग्रै स्स्वनुरक्तैरधिष्ठिताम्।।2.16.2।।
output: पुराणवित् conversant with ancient traditions, सः he (Sumantra), जनाकुलं तद् crowded with people, अन्तःपुरद्वारम् the door of the inner apartment, समतीत्य having passed through, ततः after that, प्रासकार्मुकबिभ्रद्भिः carrying spears and bows, मृष्टकुंडलैः wearing shining ear rings, अप्रमादिभिः alert, एकाग्रैः attentive, स्वनुरक्तै: with utmost devotion (to the king), युवभिः by young men, अधिष्ठिताम् guarding, प्रविविक्ताम् sparsely crowded, कक्ष्याम् courtyard, आससाद reached.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
तदन्तःपुरद्वारं समतीत्य जनाकुलम्। प्रविविक्तां ततः कक्ष्यामाससाद पुराणवित्।।2.16.1।। प्रासकार्मुकबिभ्रद्भिर्युवभिर्मृष्टकुण्डलैः। अप्रमादिभिरेकाग्रै स्स्वनुरक्तैरधिष्ठिताम्।।2.16.2।।
output: Sumantra, who was conversant with ancient traditions, passed through the entrance of the inner apartment full of people and reached the sparsely crowded courtyard. There alert, loyal young men were attentively guarding the frontyard, armed with spears and bows and wearing shining earrings.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र काषायिणो वृद्धान् वेत्रपाणीन् स्वलङ्कृतान्। ददर्श विष्ठितान् द्वारि स्त्र्यध्यक्षान्सुसमाहितान्।।2.16.3।।
output: तत्र there, काषायिणः wearing orange robes, वृद्धान् the aged, वेत्रपाणीन् canes in hands, स्वलङ्कृतान् wellornamented, सुसमाहितान् with utmost concentation, द्वारि at the entrance, विष्ठितान् appointed, स्त्र्यध्यक्षान् security staff for women's apartments, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते समीक्ष्य समायान्तं रामप्रियचिकीर्षवः। सहसोत्पतितास्सर्वे स्वासनेभ्यस्ससम्भ्रमाः।।2.16.4।।
output: On seeing (Sumantra) arriving, all of them, wellwishers to Rama, quickly rose from their seats.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तानुवाच विनीतात्मा सूतपुत्रः प्रदक्षिणः। क्षिप्रमाख्यात रामाय सुमंन्त्रो द्वारि तिष्ठति।।2.16.5।।
output: विनीतात्मा humble, सूतपुत्रः to charioteer, प्रदक्षिणः extremely courteous, तान् to them, उवाच said, सुमन्त्र: Sumantra, द्वारि at the entrance, तिष्ठति is waiting, क्षिप्रं at once, रामाय to Rama, आख्यात inform

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
ते राममुपसङ्गम्य भर्तुः प्रियचिकीर्षवः। सहभार्याय रामाय क्षिप्रमेवाभिचक्षिरे।।2.16.6।।
output: Always dedicated to the wellbeing of their master, they approached Rama who was in the company of Sita. And informed him:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रतिवेदितमाज्ञाय सूतमभ्यन्तरं पितुः। तत्रैवानाययामास राघवप्रियकाम्यया।।2.16.7।।
output: राघवः scion of the Raghus (Rama), पितुः of his father, अभ्यन्तरम् intimate, प्रतिवेदितम् informed by them, सूतम् to the charioteer, आज्ञाय having come to know, प्रियकाम्यया  desirous of pleasing, तत्रैव to that place only, आनाययामास was brought in.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं वैश्रवणसङ्काशमुपविष्टं स्वलङ्कृतम्। ददर्श सूतः पर्य्यङ्के सौवर्णे सोत्तरच्छदे।।2.16.8।। वराहरुधिराभेण शुचिना च सुगन्धिना। अनुलिप्तं परार्ध्येन चन्दनेन परन्तपम्।।2.16.9।। स्थितया पार्श्वतश्चापि वालव्यजनहस्तया। उपेतं सीतयाभूयश्चित्रया शशिनं यथा।।2.16.10।।
output: Sumantra beheld Rama, who resembled Kubera. Rama was sitting on a richlycovered golden couch, welladorned and anointed with precious, pure, fragrant red sandalpaste the colour of which appeared like the blood of a hog. With Sita standing by his side with a fan of yak's tail in her hand Rama, the tormentor of foes, looked like the Moon united with (the star) Chitra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं वैश्रवणसङ्काशमुपविष्टं स्वलङ्कृतम्। ददर्श सूतः पर्य्यङ्के सौवर्णे सोत्तरच्छदे।।2.16.8।। वराहरुधिराभेण शुचिना च सुगन्धिना। अनुलिप्तं परार्ध्येन चन्दनेन परन्तपम्।।2.16.9।। स्थितया पार्श्वतश्चापि वालव्यजनहस्तया। उपेतं सीतयाभूयश्चित्रया शशिनं यथा।।2.16.10।।
output: Sumantra beheld Rama, who resembled Kubera. Rama was sitting on a richlycovered golden couch, welladorned and anointed with precious, pure, fragrant red sandalpaste the colour of which appeared like the blood of a hog. With Sita standing by his side with a fan of yak's tail in her hand Rama, the tormentor of foes, looked like the Moon united with (the star) Chitra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं वैश्रवणसङ्काशमुपविष्टं स्वलङ्कृतम्। ददर्श सूतः पर्य्यङ्के सौवर्णे सोत्तरच्छदे।।2.16.8।। वराहरुधिराभेण शुचिना च सुगन्धिना। अनुलिप्तं परार्ध्येन चन्दनेन परन्तपम्।।2.16.9।। स्थितया पार्श्वतश्चापि वालव्यजनहस्तया। उपेतं सीतयाभूयश्चित्रया शशिनं यथा।।2.16.10।।
output: Sumantra beheld Rama, who resembled Kubera. Rama was sitting on a richlycovered golden couch, welladorned and anointed with precious, pure, fragrant red sandalpaste the colour of which appeared like the blood of a hog. With Sita standing by his side with a fan of yak's tail in her hand Rama, the tormentor of foes, looked like the Moon united with (the star) Chitra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं तपन्तमिवादित्यमुपपन्नं स्वतेजसा। ववन्दे वरदं वन्दी विनयज्ञो विनीतवत्।।2.16.11।।
output: Sumantra who knew the art of modesty, made humble, reverential salutation to Rama  the granter of boons, shining like the Sun with his own effulgence.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्राञ्जलिस्सुमुखं दृष्ट्वा विहारशयनासने। राजपुत्रमुवाचेदं सुमन्त्रो राजसत्कृतः।।2.16.12।।
output: On seeing Rama of charming countenance relaxing on a couch, Sumantra, honourable to the king (Dasaratha) said these words with folded palms.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
कौशल्यासुप्रजा राम पिता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति। महिष्या सह कैकेय्या गम्यतां तत्र मा चिरम्।।2.16.13।।
output: O Rama, worthy son of Kausalya, your father along with queen Kaikeyi desires to see you.You may go there. Please do not delay.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
एवमुक्तस्तु संहृष्टो नरसिंहो महाद्युतिः। ततस्सम्मानयामास सीतामिदमुवाच ह।।2.16.14।।
output: Highly lustrous Rama ,the lion among men, when thus spoken to, was immensely pleased and extending due honour to him said to Sita:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
देवि देवश्च देवी च समागम्य मदन्तरे। मन्त्रयेते धृवं किञ्चिदभिषेचनसंहितम्।।2.16.15।।
output: O Sita, I am sure the king and queen are discussing something relating to my consecration.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लक्षयित्वा ह्यभिप्रायं प्रियकामा सुदक्षिणा। सञ्चोदयति राजानं मदर्थमसितेक्षणा।।2.16.16।।
output: असितेक्षणा darkeyed, सुदक्षिणा highly favoured, प्रियकामा desiring the welfare (of the king), अभिप्रायम् intention, लक्षयित्वा having perceived, राजानम् to the king, मदर्थम् for my purpose, सञ्चोदयति is urging.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा प्रहृष्टा महाराजं हितकामानुवर्तिनी। जननी चार्थकामा मे केकयाधिपतेस्सुता।।2.16.17।।
output: केकयाधिपतेः सुता daughter of  the king of Kekaya (Kaikeyi), जननी च my mother also, सा she, प्रहृष्टा being extremely happy, हितकामा desirous of (my) benefit, महाराजम् to the king, अनुवर्तिनी following, मे my, अर्थकामा seeks my wellbeing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
दिष्ट्या खलु महाराजो महिष्या प्रियया सह। सुमन्त्रं प्राहिणोद्दूतमर्थकामकरं मम।।2.16.18।।
output: It is our fortune that the king and his dear queen have sent Sumantra as messenger who is interested in my prosperity and pleasure.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यादृशी परिषत्तत्र तादृशो दूत आगतः। ध्रुवमद्यैव मां राजा यौवराज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति।।2.16.19।।
output: तत्र there, यादृशी of which sort, परिषत्  council, तादृशः like that, दूतः messenger, आगतः has  arrived, ध्रुवम् assuredly, अद्यैव this very day, राजा king, माम् me, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ष्यति will consecrate.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हन्त शीघ्रमितो गत्वा द्रक्ष्यामि च महीपतिम्। सह त्वं परिवारेण सुखमास्व रमस्व च।।2.16.20।।
output: I shall go from here immediately and see the king. Remain here happily and rejoice with your maids.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
पतिसम्मानिता सीता भर्तारमसितेक्षणा। आद्वारमनुवव्राज मङ्गलान्यभिदध्युषी।।2.16.21।।
output: Reflecting over the auspicious event, the darkeyed Sita who is highly esteemed by her husband, followed him up to the entrance, (saying):

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राज्यं द्विजातिभिर्जुष्टं राजसूयाभिषेचनम्। कर्तुमर्हति ते राजा वासवस्येव लोककृत्।।2.16.22।।
output: The king will bestow upon you, like the creator of the world (Brahma) bestowing on Indra, the kingdom served by brahmins who are fit to perform 'Rajasuya' sacrifice at the time of consecration.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दीक्षितं व्रतसम्पन्नं वराजिनधरं शुचिम्। कुरङ्गशृङ्गपाणिं च पश्यन्ती त्वां भजाम्यहम्।।2.16.23।।
output: दीक्षितम् having been initiated, व्रतसम्पन्नम् engaged in the observance of the vows, वराजिनधरम् wearing excellent deerskin, शुचिम् pure, कुरङ्गशृङ्गपाणिं च carrying the horns of an antelope in your hand, त्वाम् you, पश्यन्ती looking, अहम् I, भजामि adore.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पूर्वां दिशं वज्रधरो दक्षिणां पातु ते यमः। वरुणः पश्चिमामाशां धनेशस्तूत्तरां दिशम्।।2.16.24।।
output: May Indra protect you on the east, Yama in the south, Varuna in the west and Kubera in the north.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
अथ सीतामनुज्ञाप्य कृतकौतुकमङ्गलः। निश्चक्राम सुमन्त्रेण सह रामो निवेशनात्।।2.16.25।।
output: Adorned in auspicious ornaments, Rama took leave of Sita and departed from his palace accompanied by Sumantra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
पर्वतादिव निष्क्रम्य सिंहो गिरिगुहाशयः। लक्ष्मणं द्वारिसोऽपश्यत्प्रह्वाञ्जलिपुटं स्थितम्।।2.16.26।।
output: Like a lion living in a mountain cave and coming out of it, Rama while exiting, saw Lakshmana at the entrance bowing with folded hands.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ मध्यमकक्ष्यायां समागच्छत्सुहृज्जनैः। स सर्वानर्थिनो दृष्ट्वा समेत्य प्रतिनन्द्य च।।2.16.27।। ततः पावकसङ्काशमारुरोह रथोत्तमम्। वैयाघ्रं पुरुषव्याघ्रो राजतं राजनन्दनः।।2.16.28।।
output: अथ after that, पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men, सः he, राजनन्दनः son of the king (Rama), मध्यमकक्ष्यायां in the middle courtyard, सुहृज्जनैः with friends, समागच्छत् met, सर्वान् अर्थिनः all of them eager to see him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, समेत्य having met, प्रतिनन्द्य च having greeted them, पावकसङ्काशम् resembling fire, वैयाघ्रम् covered with tigerskin, राजतम् made of silver, रथोत्तमम् best of chariots, आरुरोह mounted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ मध्यमकक्ष्यायां समागच्छत्सुहृज्जनैः। स सर्वानर्थिनो दृष्ट्वा समेत्य प्रतिनन्द्य च।।2.16.27।। ततः पावकसङ्काशमारुरोह रथोत्तमम्। वैयाघ्रं पुरुषव्याघ्रो राजतं राजनन्दनः।।2.16.28।।
output: Rama, the best among men, met all his friends in the middle courtyard. Having seen them all eager to see him, he approached and greeted them. Thereafter, he mounted the best silver chariot covered with tigerskin and glowing like fire.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मेघनादमसम्बाधं मणिहेमविभूषितम्। मुष्णन्तमिव चक्षूंषि प्रभया सूर्यवर्चसम्।।2.16.29।। करेणुशिशुकल्पैश्च युक्तं परमवाजिभिः। हरियुक्तं सहस्राक्षो रथमिन्द्र इवाशुगम्।।2.16.30।। प्रययौ तूर्णमास्थाय राघवो ज्वलितश्श्रिया।
output: श्रिया with splendour, ज्वलितः dazzling, राघवः descendant of the Raghu race (Rama), मेघनादम् sound of cloud (thunder), असम्बाधम् spacious, मणिहेमविभूषितं decorated with gold and gems, प्रभया with brilliance, चक्षूंषि eyes, मुष्णन्तमिव dazzling, सूर्यवर्चसं lusture of the Sun,  करेणुशिशुकल्पै: looking like young elephants, परमवाजिभिः with excellent horses, युक्तम् harnessed, आशुगम् swiftmoving, रथम् chariot, सहस्राक्षः thousandeyed, इन्द्रः Indra, हरियुक्तम् इव harnessed by horses (of Indra), आस्थाय mounted, तूर्णम् swiftly, प्रययौ went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मेघनादमसम्बाधं मणिहेमविभूषितम्। मुष्णन्तमिव चक्षूंषि प्रभया सूर्यवर्चसम्।।2.16.29।। करेणुशिशुकल्पैश्च युक्तं परमवाजिभिः। हरियुक्तं सहस्राक्षो रथमिन्द्र इवाशुगम्।।2.16.30।। प्रययौ तूर्णमास्थाय राघवो ज्वलितश्श्रिया।
output: The sound emanating from the chariot resembled the thunder. The spacious chariot was decorated with gold and gems which dazzled the eyes as though they shed the lustre of the Sun. The swiftmoving chariot was harnessed by excellent horses as if they were young elephants. Like the thousandeyed Indra, Rama, ablaze with royal splendour, mounted this chariot and sped away.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
स पर्जन्य इवाकाशे स्वनवानभिनादयन्।।2.16.31।। निकेतान्निर्ययौ श्रीमान्महाभ्रादिव चन्द्रमाः।
output: The magnificent chariot, rumbling like a stormcloud in the sky, emerged from (Rama's) residence like the Moon peeping through a huge cloud.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
छत्रचामरपाणिस्तु लक्ष्मणो राघवानुजः।।2.16.32।। जुगोप भ्रातरं भ्राता रथमास्थाय पृष्ठतः।
output: Holding an umbrella and a fan made of yak's tail in his hand Lakshmana boarded the chariot at the rear, guarding his brother.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो हलहलाशब्दस्तुमुलस्समजायत।।2.16.33।। तस्य निष्क्रममाणस्य जनौघस्य समन्ततः।
output: ततः then, समन्ततः  all around, निष्क्रममाणस्य departing, तस्य that (chariot's), जनौघस्य of the multitude of people, तुमुलः tumultuous, हलहलाशब्दः roaring sound, समजायत emanated.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
ततो हयवरा मुख्या नागाश्च गिरिसन्निभाः।।2.16.34।। अनुजग्मुस्तदा रामं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
output: Then the chief commanders riding the best of the horses and elephants, resembling hills in size, followed Rama in their hundreds and thousands.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अग्रतश्चास्य सन्नद्धाश्चन्दनागरुभूषिताः।।2.16.35।। खड्गचापधराश्शूरा जग्मुराशंसवो जनाः।
output: Soldiers, anointing their bodies with pastes of sandal and aloe wood, equipped with armour and holding swords and bows, went ahead heralding his (Rama's) arrival.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
ततो वादित्रशब्दाश्च स्तुतिशब्दाश्च वन्दिनाम्।।2.16.36।। सिंहनादाश्च शूराणां तदा शुश्रुविरे पथि।
output: At that time, sounds of musical instruments and songs of eulogy by panegyrists, roarings of warriors were heard on the way.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हर्म्यवातायनस्थाभिर्भूषिताभिस्समन्ततः।।2.16.37।। कीर्यमाण स्सुपुष्पौघैर्ययौ स्त्रीभिररिन्दमः।
output: Rama, the subduer of enemies, proceeded while the wellattired women standing at the windows of their mansions showered heaps of flowers on him from every side.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
रामं सर्वानवद्याङ्ग्यो रामपिप्रीषया ततः।।2.16.38।। वचोभिरग्य्रैर्हर्म्यस्था क्षितिस्थाश्च ववन्दिरे।
output: Women with faultless limbs standing on their housetops as well as on the ground paid their homage with charming words in order to propitiate Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
नूनं नन्दति ते माता कौशल्यामातृनन्दन।।2.16.39।। पश्यन्ती सिद्धयात्रं त्वां पित्र्यं राज्यमवस्थितम्।
output: O Joy of your mother (Rama) on seeing you having successfully acomplished the purpose of your journey (life) by securing your father's kingdom, your mother Kausalya will surely be delighted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वसीमन्तिनीभ्यश्च सीतां सीमन्तिनी वराम्।।2.16.40।। अमन्यन्त हि ता नार्यो रामस्य हृदयप्रियाम्।
output: Those women considered Sita who was dear to the heart of Rama the best among all women.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
तया सुचरितं देव्या पुरा नूनं महत्तपः।।2.16.41।। रोहिणीव शशाङ्केन रामसंयोगमाप या।
output: Sita was united with Rama like Rohini with the Moon surely because of her great austerities performed in the past. (They observed).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति प्रासादशृङ्गेषु प्रमदाभिर्नरोत्तमः।।2.16.42।। शुश्राव राजमार्गस्थः प्रिया वाच उदाहृताः। आत्मसंपूजनै शृण्वन् ययौ रामौ महापथम्।।2.16.43।।
output: राजमार्गस्थः along the highway, नरोत्तमः best among men, (Rama), इति thus, प्रासादशृङ्गेषु standing on the top of their buildings, प्रमदाभिः by women, उदाहृता: uttered, प्रियाः वाचः pleasing words, शुश्राव heard, आत्मसंपूजनै their admiration of himself श्रुण्वन् having heard ययौ proceeded रामः Rama महापथम् the highway

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति प्रासादशृङ्गेषु प्रमदाभिर्नरोत्तमः।।2.16.42।। शुश्राव राजमार्गस्थः प्रिया वाच उदाहृताः। आत्मसंपूजनै शृण्वन् ययौ रामौ महापथम्।।2.16.43।।
output: Rama, the best among men, while riding along the highway overheard the pleasing words uttered by women standing on the elevation of their buildings. Thus hearing his own praise Rama proceeded along the highway.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
स राघवस्तत्र कथाप्रपञ्चान् शुश्राव लोकस्य समागतस्य। आत्माधिकारा विविधाश्च वाचः प्रहृष्टरूपस्य पुरो जनस्य।।2.16.44।।
output: Rama heard these various words of admiration by people who had assembled there, and (witnessed) the rejoicings of the citizens.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
एष श्रियं गच्छति राघवोऽद्य राजप्रसादाद्विपुलां गमिष्यन्। एते वयं सर्व समृद्धकामा येषामयं नो भविता प्रशास्ता।।2.16.45।।
output: This scion of the Raghus (Rama) is going to acquire the earth and the wealth today by the king's grace. He will be our protector and fulfil all our desires.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 16:
लाभो जनस्यास्य यदेष सर्वं प्रपत्स्यते राष्ट्रमिदं चिराय। न ह्यप्रियं किञ्चन जातु कश्चि त्पश्येन्न दुःखं मनुजाधिपेऽस्मिन्।।2.16.46।।
output: If this Rama obtains the entire kingdom for a long time, it will be in the interest of the people. If he becomes king none will ever witness anything unpleasant or sad. (They observed).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स घोषवद्भिश्च मतङ्गाजैर्ययैः पुरस्सरै स्स्वस्तिकसूतमागधैः। महीयमानः प्रवरैश्च वादकै रभिष्टुतो वैश्रवणो यथा ययौ।।2.16.47।।
output: सः he (Rama), घोषवद्भिः with sounds, मतङ्गजै: with intoxicated elephants, हयैः with horses, पुरस्सरैः preceding, स्वस्तिकसूतमागधैः invocation of blessings by bards, महीयमानः greatly honoured, प्रवरैः वादकैः by best musical performers, अभिष्टुतः being praised, वैश्रवणो यथा like Kubera, ययौ went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स रामो रथमास्थाय सम्प्रहृष्टसुहृज्जनः। पताकाध्वजसम्पन्नं महार्हागरुधूपितम्।।2.17.1।। अपश्यन्नगरं श्रीमान्नानाजनसमाकुलम्।
output: Rama watches the splendour of the highway, listens to the words of his friends -- and enters his father's  palace.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स गृहैरभ्रसङ्काशैः पाण्डुरैरुपशोभितम्।।2.17.2।। राजमार्गं ययौ रामो मध्येनागरुधूपितम्।
output: सः रामः that Rama, अभ्रसङ्कशै: resembling clouds, पाण्डुरैः pale white, गृहैः houses, उपशोभितम् decorated, अगरुधूपितम् made fragrant with agaru, राजमार्गं मध्येन in the middle of the highway, ययौ proceeded.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
चन्दनानां च मुख्यानामगरूणां च सञ्चयैः।।2.17.3।। उत्तमानां च गन्धानां क्षौमकोशाम्बरस्य च। अविद्धाभिश्च मुक्ताभिरुत्तमैस्स्फाटिकैरपि।।2.17.4।। शोभमानमसंबाधैस्तं राजपथमुत्तमम्। संवृतं विविधैःपुष्पैर्भक्ष्यैरुच्चावचैरपि।।2.17.5।।
output: The highway (Rama entered) was splendid and spacious with heaps of sandal and agaru of the highest quality, excellent fragrant substances and bundles of white silken cloth. It gleamed with unholed (pristine) pearls, articles made of crystals, flowers of every kind and articles of food of every variety.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
चन्दनानां च मुख्यानामगरूणां च सञ्चयैः।।2.17.3।। उत्तमानां च गन्धानां क्षौमकोशाम्बरस्य च। अविद्धाभिश्च मुक्ताभिरुत्तमैस्स्फाटिकैरपि।।2.17.4।। शोभमानमसंबाधैस्तं राजपथमुत्तमम्। संवृतं विविधैःपुष्पैर्भक्ष्यैरुच्चावचैरपि।।2.17.5।।
output: The highway (Rama entered) was splendid and spacious with heaps of sandal and agaru of the highest quality, excellent fragrant substances and bundles of white silken cloth. It gleamed with unholed (pristine) pearls, articles made of crystals, flowers of every kind and articles of food of every variety.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
चन्दनानां च मुख्यानामगरूणां च सञ्चयैः।।2.17.3।। उत्तमानां च गन्धानां क्षौमकोशाम्बरस्य च। अविद्धाभिश्च मुक्ताभिरुत्तमैस्स्फाटिकैरपि।।2.17.4।। शोभमानमसंबाधैस्तं राजपथमुत्तमम्। संवृतं विविधैःपुष्पैर्भक्ष्यैरुच्चावचैरपि।।2.17.5।।
output: The highway (Rama entered) was splendid and spacious with heaps of sandal and agaru of the highest quality, excellent fragrant substances and bundles of white silken cloth. It gleamed with unholed (pristine) pearls, articles made of crystals, flowers of every kind and articles of food of every variety.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
ददर्श तं राजपथं दिवि देवपथं यथा। दध्यक्षतहविर्लाजैर्धूपैरगरुचन्दनैः।।2.17.6।। नानामाल्योपगंधैश्च सदाऽभ्यर्चितचत्वरम्।
output: Rama beheld the highway resembling the pathway of gods in heaven. Here the crossroads were always worshipped with curd, grains of rice, sacrificial libations, laja or puffed rice, fragrant substances like sandal wood, agaru and garlands of every kind.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
अशीर्वादान्बहून् शृण्वन्सुहृद्भिस्समुदीरितान्।।2.17.7।। यथार्हं चापि सम्पूज्य सर्वानेव नरान्ययौ।
output: Hearing many words of blessings uttered by his friends and honouring each person   according to his rank, he passed on.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पितामहैराचरितं तथैव प्रपितामहैः।।2.17.8।। अद्योपादाय तं मार्गमभिषिक्तोऽनुपालय।
output: अद्य today, अभिषिक्तः consecrated, पितामहैः by your grandfather, तथैव also, प्रपितामहैः by     greatgrandfathers, आचरितम् followed by them, तं मार्गम् that path, उपादाय after adopting (acquiring), अनुपालय you may rule the kingdom.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथास्म पोषिताः पित्रा यथा सर्वैः पितामहैः।।2.17.9।। ततस्सुखतरं रामे वत्स्यामस्सति राजनि।
output: Once Rama assumes kingship, we shall all live in happiness greater than when we were ruled by his father and grandfather.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अलमद्य हि भुक्तेन परमार्थैरलं च नः।।2.17.10।। यदि पश्याम निर्यान्तं रामं राज्ये प्रतिष्ठितम्।
output: If only we can see Rama enthroned today and going in a procession, there will be no need for food and no greater object of life to be accomplished.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अतो हि नः प्रियतरं नान्यत्किञ्चिद्भविष्यति।।2.17.11।। यथाऽभिषेको रामस्य राज्येनामिततेजसः।
output: For us, there is nothing dearer in the kingdom than the consecration of Rama of undimmed brilliance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
एताश्चान्याश्च सुहृदामुदासीनः कथाश्शुभाः।।2.17.12।। आत्मसम्पूजनीश्शृण्वन्ययौ रामो महापथम्।
output: Indifferent to such warm words by his friends in his favour Rama passed along the highway.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
न हि तस्मान्मनः कश्चिच्चक्षुषी वा नरोत्तमात्।।2.17.13।। नर श्शक्नोत्यपाक्रष्टुमतिक्रान्तेऽपि राघवे।
output: Even though Rama, the best among men had driven past them none was able to withdraw his mind or eyes from him. (They continued).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यश्च रामं न पश्येत्तु यं च रामो न पश्यति।।2.17.14।। निन्दित स्सर्वल्लोकेषु स्वात्माऽप्येनं विगर्हते।
output: 'Whoever does not see Rama or Rama does not see him, will be blamed by all men in the (three) worlds. Even his self will blame him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
सर्वेषु हि स धर्मात्मा वर्णानां कुरुते दयाम्।।2.17.15।। चतुर्णां हि वयः स्थानां तेन ते तमनुव्रताः।
output: That righteous Rama shows compassion to all, to the four castes, to the young and the old. So they were devoted to him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चतुष्पथान्देवपथांश्चैत्यान्यायतनानि च।।2.17.16।। प्रदक्षिणं परिहरन् जगाम नृपते स्सुतः।
output: The son of the king proceeded, leaving on his right, squares (intersections of four roads), and roads leading to temples, monuments and shrines too.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
स राजकुलमासाद्य मेघसङ्घोपमै श्शुभैः।।2.17.17।। प्रासादशृङ्गैर्विविधैःकैलास शिखरोपमैः। आवारयद्भिर्गगनं विमानैरिव पाण्डुरैः।।2.17.18।। वर्धमानगृहैश्चापि रत्नजालपरिष्कृतैः। तत्पृथिव्यां गृहवरं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।2.17.19।। राजपुत्रः पितुर्वेश्म प्रविवेश श्रिया ज्वलन्।
output: That prince (Rama) arrived at the excellent palace of the king, which looked like the abode of Indra on earth, blazing with splendour. The various towers of the palace touching the sky resembled clusters of white clouds, like auspicious peaks of Kailasa, and like white aerial chariots decorated with gems.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स राजकुलमासाद्य मेघसङ्घोपमै श्शुभैः।।2.17.17।। प्रासादशृङ्गैर्विविधैःकैलास शिखरोपमैः। आवारयद्भिर्गगनं विमानैरिव पाण्डुरैः।।2.17.18।। वर्धमानगृहैश्चापि रत्नजालपरिष्कृतैः। तत्पृथिव्यां गृहवरं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।2.17.19।। राजपुत्रः पितुर्वेश्म प्रविवेश श्रिया ज्वलन्।
output: That prince (Rama) arrived at the excellent palace of the king, which looked like the abode of Indra on earth, blazing with splendour. The various towers of the palace touching the sky resembled clusters of white clouds, like auspicious peaks of Kailasa, and like white aerial chariots decorated with gems.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
स राजकुलमासाद्य मेघसङ्घोपमै श्शुभैः।।2.17.17।। प्रासादशृङ्गैर्विविधैःकैलास शिखरोपमैः। आवारयद्भिर्गगनं विमानैरिव पाण्डुरैः।।2.17.18।। वर्धमानगृहैश्चापि रत्नजालपरिष्कृतैः। तत्पृथिव्यां गृहवरं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।2.17.19।। राजपुत्रः पितुर्वेश्म प्रविवेश श्रिया ज्वलन्।
output: That prince (Rama) arrived at the excellent palace of the king, which looked like the abode of Indra on earth, blazing with splendour. The various towers of the palace touching the sky resembled clusters of white clouds, like auspicious peaks of Kailasa, and like white aerial chariots decorated with gems.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स कक्ष्या धन्विभिर्गुप्तास्तिस्रोऽतिक्रम्य वाजिभिः।।2.17.20।। पदातिरपरे कक्ष्ये द्वे जगाम नरोत्तमः।
output: नरोत्तमः best among men(Rama), सः he, धन्विभिः bowmen, गुप्ताः protected, तिस्रः कक्ष्याः three courtyards, वाजिभिः on horses, अतिक्रम्य having crossed over, अपरे the remaining, द्वे कक्ष्ये two courtyards, पदातिः on foot, जगाम proceeded.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
स सर्वा स्समतिक्रम्य कक्ष्या दशरथात्मजः। सन्निवर्त्य जनं सर्वं शुद्धान्तः पुरमभ्यगात्।।2.17.21।।
output: Crossing the courtyards on his way Rama sent back his followers and entered the private apartment of the king.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 17:
तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे पितुरन्तिकं तदा जन स्स सर्वो मुदितो नृपात्मजे। प्रतीक्षते तस्य पुनः स्म निर्गमं यथोदयं चन्द्रमसस्सरित्पतिः।।2.17.22।।
output: When the prince approached his father all the people were delighted and  awaited his return like the ocean waiting for the rise of the Moon. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
स ददर्शासने रामो निषण्णं पितरं शुभे। कैकेयीसहितं दीनं मुखेन परिशुष्यता।।2.18.1।।
output: Rama beheld his father reclined on an auspicious couch and by his side was seated Kaikeyi. He looked wretched with a pale face.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स पितुश्चरणौ पूर्वमभिवाद्य विनीतवत्। ततो ववन्दे चरणौ कैकेय्या स्सुसमाहितः।।2.18.2।।
output: With all humility and wellcomposed mind, he made reverential salutation first at his father's feet and thereafter at Kaikeyi's.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
रामेत्युक्त्वा तु वचनं बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः। शशाक नृपतिर्दीनो नेक्षितुं नाभिभाषितुम्।।2.18.3।।
output: Dasaratha uttered the word 'Rama', but thereafter could neither say any more in  distress nor look at him becuase his eyes were brimming with tears.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदपूर्वं नरपतेर्दृष्ट्वा रूपं भयावहम्। रामोऽपि भयमापन्नः पदा स्पृष्ट्वेव पन्नगम्।।2.18.4।।
output: Never before did Rama see such frightful appearance of his father. He was seized with fear as if  he trampled a serpent.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
इन्द्रियैरप्रहृष्टैस्तं शोकसन्तापकर्शितम्। निश्श्वसन्तं महाराजं व्यथिताकुलचेतसम्।।2.18.5।। ऊर्मिमालिनमक्षोभ्यं क्षुभ्यन्तमिव सागरम्। उपप्लुतमिवादित्यमुक्तानृतमृषिं यथा।।2.18.6।।
output: Maharaja (Dasaratha) with his senses dulled had become emaciated due to sorrow and suffering. With an agitated and troubled mind, he was breathing heavily. Although unshakable, he looked agitated like an ocean with successive rows of waves, like  the  Sun in eclipse, like an ascetic who has uttered falsehood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इन्द्रियैरप्रहृष्टैस्तं शोकसन्तापकर्शितम्। निश्श्वसन्तं महाराजं व्यथिताकुलचेतसम्।।2.18.5।। ऊर्मिमालिनमक्षोभ्यं क्षुभ्यन्तमिव सागरम्। उपप्लुतमिवादित्यमुक्तानृतमृषिं यथा।।2.18.6।।
output: अप्रहृष्टैः without delight, इन्द्रियैः with senses, शोकसन्तापकर्शितम् emaciated with sorrow and suffering, व्यथिताकुलचेतसम् with an agitated and troubled mind, निश्श्वसन्तम् breathing heavily, ऊर्मिमालिनम् crowned with a row of waves, अक्षोभ्यम् unshakable, क्षुभ्यन्तम् shaking, सागरम् इव like a sea, उपप्लुतम् covered (eclipsed), आदित्यम् इव like the Sun, उक्तानृतम् uttering falsehood, ऋषिं यथा like an ascetic, तं महाराजम्  to that maharaja (Dasaratha).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
अचिन्त्यकल्पं हि पितुस्तं शोकमुपधारयन्। बभूव संरब्धतर स्समुद्र इव पर्वणि।।2.18.7।।
output: The more Rama reflected on the incomprehensible sorrow of the king, the more he became perturbed like an ocean on the new Moon day.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चिन्तयामास च तदा रामः पितृहिते रतः। किं स्विदद्यैव नृपतिर्न मां प्रत्यभिनन्दति।।2.18.8।।
output: पितृहिते रतः devoted to the wellbeing of his father, रामः Rama, चिन्तयामास reflected, अद्यैव today only, नृपतिः the king, किं स्वित् why is it, माम् me, न प्रत्यभिनन्दति not reciprocating my greeting.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्यदा मां पिता दृष्ट्वा कुपितोऽपि प्रसीदति। तस्य मामद्य संप्रेक्ष्य किमायासः प्रवर्तते।।2.18.9।।
output: अन्यदा in other times, पिता father, कुपितोऽपि even though angry (displeased), माम् me, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, प्रसीदति feels pleased, तस्य for him, अद्य today, माम् me, संप्रेक्ष्य having seen, किं why आयासः sorrow, प्रवर्तते caused.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स दीन इव शोकार्तो विषण्णवदनद्युतिः। कैकेयीमभिवाद्यैव रामो वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.18.10।।
output: सः रामः that Rama, दीन इव like a wretch, शोकार्तः tormented with grief, विषण्णवदनद्युतिः with a sorrowful countenance, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, अभिवाद्यैव having made salutations, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
कच्चिन्मया नापराद्धमज्ञानाद्येन मे पिता। कुपितस्तन्ममाचक्ष्व त्वं चैवैनं प्रसादय।।2.18.11।।
output: Have I committed any offence unknowingly? Please tell me why my father is angry with me. You alone can pacify him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अप्रसन्नमनाः किन्नु सदा मां प्रति वत्सलः। विवर्णवदनो दीनो न हि मामभिभाषते।।2.18.12।।
output: सदा always, मां प्रति to me, वत्सलः affectionate, अप्रसन्नमनाः किं नु why does he look displeased?, विवर्णवदनः of pale countenance, दीनः wretched, माम् to me, नाभिभाषते हि  does not speak?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
शरीरो मानसो वापि कच्चिदेनं न बाधते। सन्तापोवाऽभितापो वा दुर्लभं हि सदा सुखम्।।2.18.13।।
output: Is he suffering from any physical ailment or mental agony? It is affliction of either the body or the mind. (For) perpetual happiness is indeed rare.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कच्चिन्न किञ्चिद्भरते कुमारे प्रियदर्शने। शत्रुघ्ने वा महासत्त्वे मात्रूणां वा ममाशुभम्।।2.18.14।।
output: Has any misfortune befallen the handsome Bharata or the mighty Satrughna or any of my mothers?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अतोषयन्महाराजमकुर्वन्वा पितुर्वचः। मुहूर्तमपि नेच्छेयं जीवितुं कुपिते नृपे।।2.18.15।।
output: If I have (ever) displeased the maharaja, my father or disobeyed his command which has angered him, I do not wish to live for a moment৷৷

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यतोमूलं नरः पश्येत्प्रादुर्भावमिहात्मनः। कथं तस्मिन्नवर्तेत प्रत्यक्षे सति दैवते।।2.18.16।।
output: How can a man who owes his origin (birth) in this world to him (father) who still exists as a visible god not conduct himself (as per his wish)?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कच्चित्ते परुषं किञ्चिदभिमानात्पतिता मम। उक्तो भवत्या कोपेन यत्रास्य लुलितं मनः।।2.18.17।।
output: मम पिता my father, ते your, अभिमानात् because of selfrespect, भवत्या by you, कोपेन out of anger, परुषम् harsh, किञ्चित् anything, कच्चित् उक्तः has said?, यत्र (येन) due to which, अस्य his, मनः mind, लुलितम् has been shaken.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतदाचक्ष्व मे देवि तत्त्वेन परिपृच्छतः। किं निमित्तमपूर्वोयं विकारो मनुजाधिपे।।2.18.18।।
output: O Devi I am repeatedly asking you the cause of this unprecedented change in the king please tell me the truth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
एवमुक्ता तु कैकेयी राघवेण महात्मना। उवाचेदं सुनिर्लज्जा धृष्टमात्महितं वचः।।2.18.19।।
output: When Kaikeyi was thus asked by the magnanimous scion of the Raghus (Rama) she uttered unashamed these impudent words in her own interest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
न राजा कुपितो राम व्यसनं नास्य किञ्चन। किञ्चिन्मनोगतंत्वस्य त्वद्भयान्नाभिभाषते।।2.18.20।।
output: O Rama, the king is neither angry, nor has any misforturne befallen him. But out of fear for you he is not able to speak out what he has in mind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रियं त्वामप्रियं वक्तुं वाणी नास्योपवर्तते। तदवश्यं त्वया कार्यं यदनेनाश्रुतं मम।।2.18.21।।
output: The goddess of speech does not permit him to say an unpleasant thing to you for you are his beloved son. So you must fulfil the promise he has made to me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एष मह्यं वरं दत्त्वा पुरा मामभिपूज्य च। स पश्चात्तप्यते राजा यथाऽन्यः प्राकृतस्तथा।।2.18.22।।
output: In the past the king had honoured me with (two) boons. Now like any other common man he is repenting (for the same).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अतिसृज्य ददानीति वरं मम विशांपतिः। स निरर्थं गतजले सेतुं बन्धितुमिच्छति।।2.18.23।।
output: स: विशांपति that king, ददानि इति saying 'I shall give you', मम to me, वरम् two boons, अतिसृज्य having bestowed, गतजले at a place where the water has drained, सेतुम् dam, निरर्थम् in vain, बन्धितुम् to construct, इच्छति wishes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
धर्ममूलमिदं राम विदितं च सतामपि। तत्सत्यं न त्यजेद्राजा कुपितस्त्वत्कृते यथा।।2.18.24।।
output: O Rama, this (truth) is the basis of righteousness. The virtuous also know this. The king being angry (with me), should not abandon the truth for your sake.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदि तद्वक्ष्यते राजा शुभं वा यदि वाऽशुभम्। करिष्यसि ततस्सर्वमाख्यास्यामि पुनस्त्वहम्।।2.18.25।।
output: शुभं वा be it auspicious, अशुभं यदि वा or inauspicious, तत् that truth, राजा king, वक्ष्यते यदि if shall tell (you), करिष्यसि (यदा) you will fulfil, अहं पुनस्तु I again, तत: after that, सर्वम् all, आख्यास्यामि shall relate.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
यदि त्वभिहितं राज्ञा त्वयि तन्न विपत्स्यते। ततोऽहमभिधास्यामि न ह्येष त्वयि वक्ष्यति।।2.18.26।।
output: If you do not transgress the word given by the king I shall tell you everything. The king on his own will not tell you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा कैकेय्या समुदाहृतम्। उवाच व्यथितो रामस्तां देवीं नृपसन्निधौ।।2.18.27।।
output: कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, समुदाहृतम् uttered, एतत् this, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, राम:   Rama, व्यथित: depressed, नृपसन्निधौ in the presence of the king, तां देवीं to that lady, उवाच said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहो धिङ्नार्हसे देवि वक्तुं मामीदृशं वचः। अहं हि वचनाद्राज्ञः पतेयमपि पावके।।2.18.28।। भक्षयेयं विषं तीक्ष्णं मज्जेयमपि चार्णवे। नियुक्तो गुरुणा पित्रा नृपेण च हितेन च।।2.18.29।।
output: देवी O devi, अहो alas, धिक् what a pity, माम् to me, ईदृशम् such, वच: words, वक्तुम् to speak, नार्हसे it does not behove you, हि because, अहम् I, राज्ञ: king's, वचनात् on the word, पावकेऽपि even in fire, पतेयम् will jump, नृपेण by the king, हितेन च who desires my  welfare, गुरुणा by the gurus, पित्रा by father, नियुक्त: ordered, तीक्ष्णं विषम् deadly poison, भक्षयेयम् will drink, अपि च and also, अर्णवे in the ocean, मज्जेयम् shall get drowned.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहो धिङ्नार्हसे देवि वक्तुं मामीदृशं वचः। अहं हि वचनाद्राज्ञः पतेयमपि पावके।।2.18.28।। भक्षयेयं विषं तीक्ष्णं मज्जेयमपि चार्णवे। नियुक्तो गुरुणा पित्रा नृपेण च हितेन च।।2.18.29।।
output: देवी O devi, अहो alas, धिक् what a pity, माम् to me, ईदृशम् such, वच: words, वक्तुम् to speak, नार्हसे it does not behove you, हि because, अहम् I, राज्ञ: king's, वचनात् on the word, पावकेऽपि even in fire, पतेयम् will jump, नृपेण by the king, हितेन च who desires my  welfare, गुरुणा by the gurus, पित्रा by father, नियुक्त: ordered, तीक्ष्णं विषम् deadly poison, भक्षयेयम् will drink, अपि च and also, अर्णवे in the ocean, मज्जेयम् shall get drowned.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
तद्ब्रूहि वचनं देवि राज्ञो यदभिकाङ्क्षितम्। करिष्ये प्रतिजाने च रामो द्विर्नाभिभाषते।।2.18.30।।
output: Hence tell me, O Devi Whatever be the desire of the king: I promise I shall carry out, Rama does not say two things (does not go back on his word).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमार्जवसमायुक्तमनार्या सत्यवादिनम्। उवाच रामं कैकेयी वचनं भृशदारुणम्।।2.18.31।।
output: अनार्या ignoble, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, आर्जवसमायुक्तं devoted to rectitude of conduct, सत्यवादिनम्  truthful, तं रामम् addressing that Rama, भृशदारुणम् extremely cruel, वचनम् words, उवाच said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
पुरा दैवासुरे युद्धे पित्रा ते मम राघव। रक्षितेन वरौ दत्तौ सशल्येन महारणे।।2.18.32।।
output: O descendant of Raghu in the great war between gods and demons in the past your father had granted me two boons for protecting him when he was wounded by a shaft.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र मे याचितो राजा भरतस्याभिषेचनम्। गमनं दण्डकारण्ये तव चाद्यैव राघव।।2.18.33।।
output: राघव (Rama) scion of the Raghus, तत्र there (so), राजा the king, भरतस्य Bharata's, अभिषेचनम् consecration, अद्यैव today itself,  दण्डकारण्ये to Dandaka forest, तव your, गमनम् departure, याचितः has been asked.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदि सत्यप्रतिज्ञं त्वं पितरं कर्तुमिच्छसि। आत्मानं च नरश्रेष्ठ मम वाक्यमिदं शृणु।।2.18.34।।
output: O the best of men if you want to be true to the word given by you and your father, listen to what I say.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
सन्निदेशे पितुस्तिष्ठ यथा तेन प्रतिश्रुतम्। त्वयाऽरण्यं प्रवेष्टव्यं नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च।।2.18.35।।
output: Abide by your father's command. As promised by him go to the forest for fourteen years.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भरतस्त्वभिषिच्येत यदेतदभिषेचनम्। त्वदर्थे विहितं राज्ञा तेन सर्वेण राघव।।2.18.36।।
output: Bharata shall be consecrated, O descendant of the Raghu dynasty with all these preparations made by the king to install you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सप्त सप्त च वर्षाणि दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः। अभिषेकमिमं त्यक्त्वा जटाजिनधरो वस।।2.18.37।।
output: Forsake this consecration, wear matted locks and deerskin and take refuge in Dandaka forest for fourteen years.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भरतः कोसलपुरे प्रशास्तु वसुधामिमाम्। नानारत्न समाकीर्णां सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्।।2.18.38।।
output: भरतः Bharata, कोशलपुरे in Ayodhya, the capital of Kosala country, नानारत्न समाकीर्णाम् abounding in different kinds of gems, सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् with horses, chariots and elephants, इमां वसुधाम् this earth, प्रशास्तु let (him) rule.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
एतेन त्वां नरेन्द्रोऽयं कारुण्येन समाप्लुतः। शोकसंक्लिष्ट वदनो न शक्नोति निरीक्षितुम्।।2.18.39।।
output: This is why the king with his face tortured by tears and (his heart) overwhelmed with compassion for you, is unable to look at you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 18:
एतत्कुरु नरेन्द्रस्य वचनं रघुनन्दन। सत्येन महता राम तारयस्व नरेश्वरम्।।2.18.40।।
output: O Joy of the Raghus, O son of the Raghu race, carry out the word of promise given by the king and save him by helping him keep the truth which is great.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इतीव तस्यां परुषं वदन्त्यां न चैव रामः प्रविवेश शोकम्। प्रविव्यथे चापि महानुभावो राजा तु पुत्रव्यसनाभितप्तः।।2.18.41।।
output: इतीव in this way, तस्याम् she (Kaikeyi), परुषम् harsh words, वदन्त्याम् was speaking, रामः Rama, शोकम् sorrow, नचैव प्रविदेश did not enter, महानुभावः dignified, राजा तु king, पुत्रव्यसनाभितप्तः afflicted with the son's calamity, प्रविव्यथे was greatly pained.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 19:
तदप्रियममित्रघ्नो वचनं मरणोपमम्। श्रुत्वा न विव्यथे रामः कैकेयीं चेदमब्रवीत्।।2.19.1।।
output: The destroyer of enemies (Rama) did not feel distressed to hear these words painful like death. To Kaikeyi he said:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमस्तु गमिष्यामि वनं वस्तुमहं त्वितः। जटाजिनधरो राज्ञः प्रतिज्ञामनुपालयन्।।2.19.2।।
output: एवम् अस्तु be it so अहम् I, राज्ञः king's, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, अनुपालयन् while obeying, जटाजिनधरः wearing matted locks and deer skin , इतः from here, वनम् to the forest, वस्तुम् to live, गमिष्यामि shall go.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इदं तु ज्ञातुमिच्छामि किमर्थं मां महीपतिः। नाभिनन्दति दुर्धर्षो यथापूर्वमरिन्दमः।।2.19.3।।
output: Nevertheless I would like to know why king Dasaratha, an unassailable subduer of enemies does not greet me as usual.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 19:
मन्युर्न च त्वया कार्यो देवि ब्रूमि तवाग्रतः। यास्यामि भव सुप्रीता वनं चीरजटाधरः।।2.19.4।।
output: O Devi you should not grieve. I declare in your presence that I shall go to the forest wearing tattered clothes (bark) and matted locks. Rejoice (to hear this).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 19:
हितेन गुरुणा पित्रा कृतज्ञेन नृपेण च। नियुज्यमानो विस्रब्धः किं न कुर्यामहं प्रियम्।।2.19.5।।
output: Ordered by my father who is my wellwisher, my guru, one with a sense of gratidude and, above all a king, shall I not, without hesitation do what pleases him?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अलीकं मानसं त्वेकं हृदयं दहतीव मे। स्वयं यन्नाह मां राजा भरतस्याभिषेचनम्।।2.19.6।।
output: भरतस्य Bharata's, अभिषेचनम् consecration, राजा king, स्वयम् himself, माम् to me, यत् नाह which he did not tell, एकम् that one, मानसम् in my mind, अलीकम् one which hurts, मे my , हृदयम् heart, दहतीव as if burning.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 19:
अहं हि सीतां राज्यं च प्राणानिष्टान्धनानि च। हृष्टो भ्रात्रे स्वयं दद्यां भरतायाप्रचोदितः।।2.19.7।।
output: Unurged, I would have gladly given to Bharata the kingdom, wealth, my most coveted life, and even Sita.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किं पुनर्मनुजेन्द्रेण स्वयं पित्रा प्रचोदितः। तव च प्रियकामार्थं प्रतिज्ञामनुपालयन्।।2.19.8।।
output: In order to keep the promise I shall do everything to fulfil your desire. Needless to say that my father has ordered this.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 19:
तदाश्वासय हीमं त्वं किन्विदं यन्महीपतिः। वसुधासक्तनयनो मन्दमश्रूणि मुञ्चति।।2.19.9।।
output: Please console him. Why is it that the king with his eyes fixed upon the ground is shedding tears drop by drop?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गच्छन्तु चैवानयितुं दूताश्श्रीघ्रजवैर्हयैः। भरतं मातुलकुलादद्यैव नृपशासनात्।।2.19.10।।
output: नृपशासनात् by the king's order, मातुलकुलात् from his maternal uncle's house, भरतम् Bharata, आनयितुम् to bring back, दूताः messengers, शीघ्रजवैः speedy, हयैः horses, अद्यैव (today itself) right now, गच्छन्तु let go.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दण्डकारण्यमेषोऽहमितो गच्छामि सत्वरः। अविचार्य पितुर्वाक्यं समा वस्तुं चतुर्दश।।2.19.11।।
output: As for me, without deliberating on the propriety of my father's orders, I shall go from here at once to Dandaka forest to live (there) for fourteen years.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 19:
सा हृष्टा तस्य तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा रामस्य कैकयी। प्रस्थानं श्रद्धधाना हि त्वरयामास राघवम्।।2.19.12।।
output: Kaikeyi, happy to hear the words of the son of the Raghus as she was convinced that his departure (to the forest) was certain, hastened him (to set out).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं भवतु यास्यन्ति दूता श्शीघ्रजवैर्हयैः। भरतं मातुलकुलादुपावर्तयितुं नराः।।2.19.13।।
output: Let it be so. Messengers shall go at once on swift horses to bring Bharata from his maternal uncle's house.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तव त्वहं क्षमं मन्ये नोत्सुकस्य विलम्बनम्। राम तस्मादित श्शीघ्रं वनं त्वं गन्तुमर्हसि।।2.19.14।।
output: तु but, उत्सुकस्य eager (to go to the forest), तव your, विलंबनम् delay, क्षमम् appropriate,  अहम् I, न मन्ये do not think, राम Rama, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, इतः from here, शीघ्रम् immediately, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to go, अर्हसि behoves you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्रीडान्वित स्स्वयं यच्च नृपस्त्वां नाभिभाषते। नैतत्किञ्चिन्नरश्रेष्ठ मन्युरेषोऽपनीयताम्।।2.19.15।।
output: Out of shame the king is unable to speak to you. There is nothing other than this. O Rama, the best of men, dispel this distress (of mind).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यावत्त्वं न वनं यातः पुरादस्मादभित्वरन्। पिता तावन्न ते राम स्नास्यते भोक्ष्यतेऽपि वा।।2.19.16।।
output: राम Rama, त्वम् you, अभित्वरन् hastening up, अस्मात् this, पुरात् from this city, यावत् as long as, वनम् to the forest, न यातः do not go, तावत् till then, ते your, पिता father, स्नास्यते will neither bathe, न भोक्ष्यतेपि वा nor will eat.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धिक्कष्टमिति निःश्वस्य राजा शोकपरिप्लुतः। मूर्छितो न्यपतत्तस्मिन्पर्यङ्के हेमभूषिते।।2.19.17।।
output: राजा king, धिक् fie, कष्टम् what a calamity, इति thus, निःश्वस्य sighing, शोकपरिप्लुतः overwhelmed with sorrow, मूर्छितः having fainted, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, तस्मिन् पर्यङ्के on that couch, न्यपतत् fell down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामोऽप्युत्थाप्य राजानं कैकेय्याभिप्रचोदितः। कशयेवाहतो वाजी वनं गन्तुं कृतत्वरः।।2.19.18।।
output: कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, अभिप्रचोदितः urged, रामोऽपि Rama also, राजानम् the king, उत्थाप्य having lifted, कशया by a whip आहतः flogged, वाजीव like a horse, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to depart, कृतत्वरः hastened

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 19:
तदप्रियमनार्याया वचनं दारुणोदयम्। श्रुत्वा गतव्यथो रामः कैकेयीं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.19.19।।
