output: The king was deceived by Kaikeyi. If you also desert him after I have gone to the forest, surely he will not live.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भर्तुः किल परित्यागो नृशंसः केवलं स्त्रियाः। स भवत्या न कर्तव्यो मनसाऽपि विगर्हितः।।2.24.12।।
output: For a woman, to desert her husband is a cruel act. You must not do that which is  contemptible even to think.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यावज्जीवति काकुत्स्थः पिता मे जगतीपतिः। शुश्रूषा क्रियतां तावत्सहि धर्मस्सनातनः।।2.24.13।।
output: मे पिता my father, जगतीपतिः lord of the earth, काकुत्स्थः  the descendant of Kakutstha, यावत् as long as, जीवति lives, तावत् till then, शुश्रूषा service, क्रियताम् be done, सः that one, धर्मः हि सनातनः it is eternal virtue.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्ता तु रामेण कौशल्या शुभदर्शना। तथेत्युवाच सुप्रीता राममक्लिष्टकारिणम्।।2.24.14।।
output: At these words of Rama, unshakable in action, auspiciouslooking Kausalya, exceedingly pleased said 'Be it so'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तस्तु वचनं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः। भूयस्तामब्रवीद्वाक्यं मातरं भृशदुःखिताम्।।2.24.15।।
output: Thus addressed, Rama, the foremost among upholders of righteousness, said to his mother who was in deep grief:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मया चैव भवत्या च कर्तव्यं वचनं पितुः। राजा भर्ता गुरु श्श्रेष्ठस्सर्वेषामीश्वरः प्रभुः।।2.24.16।।
output: You and I should obey father's words. He is the king, supporter, preceptor, the best (among men) and  lord and master of all of us.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमानि तु महारण्ये विहृत्य नव पञ्च च। वर्षाणि परमप्रीतः स्थास्यामि वचने तव।।2.24.17।।
output: इमानि these, नव पञ्च च nine plus five (fourteen), वर्षाणि years, महारण्ये in the wild forest, विहृत्य having roamed, परमप्रीतः with supreme pleasure, तव your, वचने words (obeying your word), स्थास्यामि shall abide by.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
एवमुक्ता प्रियं पुत्रं बाष्पपूर्णानना तदा। उवाच परमार्ता तु कौशल्या पुत्रवत्सला।।2.24.18।।
output: Thus addressed by Rama, the affectionate Kausalya, deeply distressed, her eyes filled with tears, said to her beloved son:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आसां राम सपत्नीनां वस्तुं मध्ये न मे क्षमम्। नय मामपि काकुत्स्थ वनं वन्यां मृगीं यथा।।2.24.19।। यदि ते गमने बुद्धिः कृता पितुरपेक्षया।
output: राम O Rama, मे for me, आसाम् of these, सपत्नीनाम् of cowives, मध्ये in the midst of, वस्तुम्  to live, न क्षमम् not able, काकुत्स्थ scion of the Kakutstha race (Rama), पितुः with regard to your father, अपेक्षया with wish, गमने in going away, ते to you, बुद्धि: decision, कृता यदि if it is made, मामपि also me, वन्याम् relating to the forest (wild), मृगीं यथा like a female deer, वनम् to the forest, नय take me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
तां तथा रुदतीं रामो रुदन्वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.24.20।। जीवन्त्या हि स्त्रिया भर्ता दैवतं प्रभुरेव च
output: Adding his tears to his mother's who was wailing Rama said As long as a woman lives, her husband is her god and also her lord (master).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवत्या मम चैवाद्य राजा प्रभवति प्रभुः। न ह्यनाथा वयं राज्ञा लोकनाथेन धीमता।।2.24.21।।
output: The powerful king has authority over you as well as over me. As long as he is the sagacious lord of the entire world, how can we be without a master?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भरतश्चापि धर्मात्मा सर्वभूतप्रियंवदः। भवतीमनुवर्तेत स हि धर्मरतस्सदा।।2.24.22।।
output: Bharata, who is virtuous and speaks pleasantly to all beings and who is always attached to righteousness will surely remain obedient to you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
यथा मयि तु निष्क्रान्ते पुत्रशोकेन पार्थिवः। श्रमं नावाप्नुयात्किञ्चिदप्रमत्ता तथा कुरु।।2.24.23।।
output: After my departure, you must see that the king is not  overpowered by grief for his son and struggles as little as possible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दारुणश्चाप्ययं शोको यथैनं न विनाशयेत्। राज्ञो वृद्धस्य सततं हितं चर समाहिता।।2.24.24।।
output: दारुणः terrible, अयं शोकः this  grief, एनम् him, यथा in a manner, न विनाशयेत् will not ruin (his health), समाहिता with composed mind, वृद्धस्य of the old, राज्ञः of the king, सततम् always, हितम् good, चर act.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्रतोपवासनिरता या नारी परमोत्तमा। भर्तारं नानुवर्तेत सा तु पापगतिर्भवेत्।।2.24.25।।
output: A woman may be highly pious engaged in vows and fastings, but if she does not follow her husband, she will be condemned to hell.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
भर्तु श्शुश्रूषया नारी लभते स्वर्गमुत्तमम्। अपि या निर्नमस्कारा निवृत्ता देवपूजनात्।।2.24.26।।
output: A woman who serves her husband will attain the highest heaven even if she pays no homage to gods and abstains from worshipping them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
शुश्रूषामेव कुर्वीत भर्तुः प्रियहिते रता। एष धर्मः पुरा दृष्टो लोके वेदे श्रुतः स्मृतः।।2.24.27।।
output: A wife who serves her husband and who is engaged in doing good to him is righteous. This dharma exists in this world since ancient times, declared in the Vedas and the smritis.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
अग्निकार्येषु च सदा सुमनोभिश्च देवताः। पूज्यास्ते मत्कृते देवि बाह्मणाश्चैव सुव्रताः।।2.24.28।।
output: For my sake, O devi worship the firegod with offerings of oblations and flowers, and brahmins who are true to religious vows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
एवं कालं प्रतीक्षस्व ममागमनकाङ्क्षिणी। नियता नियताहारा भर्तृशुश्रूषणे रता।।2.24.29।।
output: Looking forward to my return, spend your time this way with moderate intake, a mind under control and a life devoted to the service of your husband.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
प्राप्स्यसे परमं कामं मयि प्रत्यागते सति। यदि धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो धारयिष्यति जीवितम्।।2.24.30।।
output: If my father, who is the best among the upholders of righteousness, survives till I come back, you will have your highest desires fulfilled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्ता तु रामेण बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा। कौशल्या पुत्रशोकार्ता रामं वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.24.31।।
output: To these words of Rama, Kausalya, distressed with grief for her son, replied with her eyes filled with tears:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गमने सुकृतां बुद्धिं न ते शक्नोमि पुत्रक। विनिवर्तयितुं वीर नूनं कालो दुरत्ययः।।2.24.32।।
output: I am unable to dissuade you, O my brave son, from your firm resolve to go to the forest. It is surely difficult (for me) to bide time.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गच्छ पुत्र त्वमेकाग्रो भद्रं तेऽस्तु सदा विभुः। पुनस्त्वयि निवृत्ते तु भविष्यामि गतव्यथा।।2.24.33।।
output: Go with a steadfast mind, O my son May god be gracious. Only with your return, I shall be relieved of my suffering.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रत्यागते महाभागे कृतार्थे चरितव्रते। पितुरानृण्यतां प्राप्ते त्वयि लप्स्ये परं सुखम्।।2.24.34।।
output: महाभागे when the reverend one, त्वयि you, कृतार्थे with your purpose accomplished, चरितव्रते when your vow is fulfilled, पितुः father's, आनृण्यताम् acquittal of debt, प्राप्ते obtained, प्रत्यागते on coming back, परम् supreme, सुखम् happiness, लप्स्ये I will attain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृतान्तस्य गतिः पुत्र दुर्विभाव्या सदा भुवि। यस्त्वां सञ्चोदयति मे वच आच्छिद्य राघव।।2.24.35।।
output: O Rama inconceivable is the course of destiny which is inciting you to go to the forest disregarding my words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
गच्छेदानीं महाबाहो क्षेमेण पुनरागतः। नन्दयिष्यसि मां पुत्र साम्ना वाक्येन चारुणा।।2.24.36।।
output: Go now, O my mightyarmed son and come back safe. And on your return, delight me with your sweet, gentle utterances.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 24:
अपीदानीं स कालस्स्याद्वनात्प्रत्यागतं पुनः। यत्त्वां पुत्रक पश्येयं जटावल्कलधारिणम्।।2.24.37।।
output: O my dear child, how pleasing would it be, if today were to be the day of your return from the forest when I can see you wearing matted hair and robes of bark

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा हि रामं वनवासनिश्चितं समीक्ष्य देवी परमेण चेतसा। उवाच रामं शुभलक्षणं वचो बभूव च स्वस्त्ययनाभिकाङ्क्षिणी।।2.24.38।।
output: देवी Devi (Kausalya), रामम् Rama, तथा like that, वनवासनिश्चितम् determined to go to the forest, समीक्ष्य (ददर्श) seeing, परमेण चेतसा with supreme consciousness, शुभलक्षणम् with auspicious qualities (virtues), रामम् to Rama, वचः words, उवाच said, स्वस्त्ययनाभिकाङ्क्षिणी wishing to perform ceremonies for (his) wellbeing, बभूव became.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
साऽवनीय तमायासमुपस्पृश्य जलं शुचिः। चकार माता रामस्य मङ्गलानि मनस्विनी।।2.25.1।।
output: Kausalya performs benedictory rites for Rama and offers prayers to all gods to protect him Rama departs for the palace of Sita.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न शक्यसे वारयितुं गच्छेदानीं रघूत्तम। शीघ्रं च विनिवर्तस्व वर्तस्व च सतां क्रमे।।2.25.2।।
output: I am unable to dissuade you, O the best among the descendants of Raghus, from going into the forest. Go now and return soon. Follow in the footsteps of the virtuous.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यं पालयसि धर्मं त्वं धृत्या च नियमेन च। स वै राघवशार्दूल धर्मस्त्वामभिरक्षतु।।2.25.3।।
output: राघवशार्दूल O tiger among the descendants of Raghu त्वम् you, धृत्या with courage, नियमेन च with selfdiscipline, यं धर्मम् which duty, पालयसि you are carrying out, सः धर्मः वै that duty alone, त्वाम् you, अभिरक्षतु let it protect.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
येभ्यः प्रणमसे पुत्र चैत्येष्वायतनेषु च। ते च त्वामभिरक्षन्तु वने सह महर्षिभिः।।2.25.4।।
output: पुत्र son, चैत्येषु in sacred places, आयतनेषु च in temples, येभ्यः to whom, प्रणमसे you are saluting, ते they, महर्षिभिः सह together with maharshis, त्वाम् you, वने in the forest,  अभिरक्षन्तु protect you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यानि दत्तानि तेऽस्त्राणि विश्वामित्रेण धीमता। तानि त्वामभिरक्षन्तु गुणैस्समुदितं सदा।।2.25.5।।
output: धीमता by the sagacious, विश्वामित्रेण by Viswamitra, ते to you, यानि अस्त्राणि those weapons, दत्तानि were bestowed, तानि they, गुणैः with (mantric) qualities, समुदितम् endowed, त्वाम् you, सदा always, अभिरक्षन्तु may protect.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पितृशुश्रूषया पुत्र मातृशुश्रूषया तथा। सत्येन च महाबाहो चिरं जीवाभिरक्षितः।।2.25.6।।
output: महाबाहो O mighty armed, पुत्र son, पितृशुश्रूषया in the service of your father, तथा also,  मातृशुश्रूषया in the service of your mother, सत्येन with truth, अभिरक्षितः you have been  protected, चिरं जीव live long.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
समित्कुश पवित्राणि वेद्यश्चायतनानि च। स्थण्डिलानि विचित्राणि शैला वृक्षाः क्षुपा ह्रदाः।।2.25.7।। पतङ्गाः पन्नगास्सिंहास्त्वां रक्षन्तु नरोत्तम।
output: O best of men may sacrificial fuel, kusa grass and sacred rings made of kusha grass, sacrificial altars, temples, various levelled sacrificial grounds, mountains, trees, plants, lakes, birds, serpents and lions protect you

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वस्तिसाध्याश्च विश्वे च मरुतश्च महर्षयः। स्वस्ति धाता विधाता च स्वस्ति पूषा भगोऽर्यमा।।2.25.8।। लोकपालाश्च ते सर्वे वासवप्रमुखास्तथा।
output: साध्याश्च devatas known as 'Sadhyas', विश्वे च viswe devatas, मरुतश्च maruts (windgod), महर्षयः the great ascetics, स्वस्ति expiatory mantras, धाता sustainer (Virat Purusha), विधाता च the preserver of creation (lord Brahma), स्वस्ति bestow blessings to you, पूषा Sun, भगः the Sun known as Bhaga, अर्यमा the Sun known as Aryama, तथा also, वासवप्रमुखाः others headed by Indra, सर्वे all, ते लोकपालाश्च guardians of the world.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋतवश्चैव पक्षाश्च मासा स्संवत्सराः क्षपाः।।2.25.9।। दिनानि च मुहूर्ताश्च स्वस्ति कुर्वन्तु ते सदा।
output: May the six seasons, years, months, fortnights, nights, days and moments bring good to you

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्मृतिर्धृतिश्च धर्मश्च पातु त्वां पुत्र सर्वतः।।2.25.10।। स्कन्दश्च भगवान्देव स्सोमश्च स बृहस्पतिः। सप्तर्षयो नारदश्च ते त्वां रक्षन्तु सर्वतः।।2.25.11।।
output: पुत्र O my son, स्मृतिः memory, धृतिश्च resolution(Dhriti), धर्मश्च Dharma, त्वाम् you, सर्वतः always, पातु may guard, भगवान् of divine personages, देवः god, स्कन्दश्च Skanda, सोमश्च Soma, सः that, बृहस्पतिः Brihaspati (preceptor of gods), ते to you, सप्तर्षयः seven rishis,  नारदश्च Narada, त्वाम् you, सर्वतः everywhere, रक्षन्तु protect you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्मृतिर्धृतिश्च धर्मश्च पातु त्वां पुत्र सर्वतः।।2.25.10।। स्कन्दश्च भगवान्देव स्सोमश्च स बृहस्पतिः। सप्तर्षयो नारदश्च ते त्वां रक्षन्तु सर्वतः।।2.25.11।।
output: पुत्र O my son, स्मृतिः memory, धृतिश्च resolution(Dhriti), धर्मश्च Dharma, त्वाम् you, सर्वतः always, पातु may guard, भगवान् of divine personages, देवः god, स्कन्दश्च Skanda, सोमश्च Soma, सः that, बृहस्पतिः Brihaspati (preceptor of gods), ते to you, सप्तर्षयः seven rishis,  नारदश्च Narada, त्वाम् you, सर्वतः everywhere, रक्षन्तु protect you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
याश्चापि सर्वतस्सिध्दा दिशश्च सदिगीश्वराः। स्तुता मया वने तस्मिन्पान्तु त्वां पुत्र नित्यशः।।2.25.12।।
output: May Siddhas, guardians of the quarters invoked by me protect you from all  directions in that forest at all times, O my son

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शैलास्सर्वे समुद्राश्च राजा वरुण एव च। द्यौरन्तरिक्षं पृथिवी नद्यस्सर्वास्तथैव च।।2.25.13।। नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि ग्रहाश्च सहदेवताः। अहोरात्रे तथा सन्ध्ये पान्तु त्वां वनमाश्रितम्।।2.25.14।।
output: When you dwell in the forest may all the mountains, seas, lord Varuna, heaven, space, and earth and also all rivers, all stars and planets with their presiding deities, day, night, dawn and dusk protect you

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
शैलास्सर्वे समुद्राश्च राजा वरुण एव च। द्यौरन्तरिक्षं पृथिवी नद्यस्सर्वास्तथैव च।।2.25.13।। नक्षत्राणि च सर्वाणि ग्रहाश्च सहदेवताः। अहोरात्रे तथा सन्ध्ये पान्तु त्वां वनमाश्रितम्।।2.25.14।।
output: When you dwell in the forest may all the mountains, seas, lord Varuna, heaven, space, and earth and also all rivers, all stars and planets with their presiding deities, day, night, dawn and dusk protect you

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋतवश्चैव षट्पुण्या मासास्संवत्सरास्तथा। कलाश्च काष्ठाश्च तथा तव शर्म दिशन्तु ते।।2.25.15।।
output: May all the six pious seasons, months, years, kala and kashta contribute to your wellbeing

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महावने विचरतो मुनिवेषस्य धीमतः। तवादित्याश्च दैत्याश्च भवन्तु सुखदास्सदा।।2.25.16।।
output: May gods and demons always give you happiness when you wander in that great forest clad in ascetic garb

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसानां पिशाचानां रौद्राणां क्रूरकर्मणाम्। क्रव्यादानां च सर्वेषां मा भूत्पुत्रक ते भयम्।।2.25.17।।
output: पुत्रक O my child, ते to you, रौद्राणाम् of the fearful, क्रूरकर्मणाम् of those committing cruel acts, राक्षसानाम् of rakshasas, पिशाचानाम् of pisachas, 'सर्वेषाम् of all, क्रव्यादानां च of flesheating animals, भयम् fear, माभूत may not be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
प्लवगा वृश्चिका दंशामशकाश्चैव कानने। सरीसृपाश्च कीटाश्च मा भूवन्गहने तव।।2.25.18।।
output: May monkeys, scorpions, wild gnats, mosquitoes, reptiles and insects in that inaccessible forest not trouble you

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महाद्विपाश्च सिंहाश्च व्याघ्रा ऋक्षाश्च दंष्ट्रिणः। महिषा श्शृङ्गिणो रौद्रा न ते द्रुह्यन्तु पुत्रक।।2.25.19।।
output: May the mighty elephants, lions with pointed incisors, tigers, bears and fierce, wild, horned buffaloes, do you no harm, O my dear son

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
नृमांसभोजना रौद्रा ये चान्ये सत्वजातयः। मा च त्वां हिंसिषुः पुत्र मया संपूजितास्त्विह।।2.25.20।।
output: May the ferocious breed of cernivores I worship not harm you, O my child

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आगमास्ते शिवास्सन्तु सिध्यन्तु च पराक्रमाः। सर्वसम्पत्तये राम स्वस्तिमान्गच्छ पुत्रक।।2.25.21।।
output: O Rama may your path be auspecious May your valour be fruitful Go safel and achieve success in everything

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वस्ति ते ऽस्त्वन्तरिक्षेभ्यः पार्थिवेभ्यः पुनः पुनः। सर्वेभ्यश्चैव देवेभ्यो ये च वै परिपन्थिनः।।2.25.22।।
output: May gods from the sky, the earth and all other gods protect you and let there be no harm to you from your foes.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गुरुस्सोमश्च सूर्यश्च धनदोऽथ यमस्तथा। पान्तु त्वामर्चिता राम दण्डकारण्यवासिनम्।।2.25.23।।
output: Propitiated by my worship, O Rama may Brihaspati, Moon, Sun, Kubera and Yama protect you when you are in Dandaka forest

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
अग्निर्वायुस्तथा धूमो मन्त्राश्चर्षिमुखाच्च्युताः। उपस्पर्शनकाले तु पान्तु त्वां रघुनन्दन।।2.25.24।।
output: May Fire, Wind, Smoke and Mantras emanated from the mouths of rishis protect you when you take your ablutions, O Son of the Raghu race O Joy of the Raghus

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
सर्वलोकप्रभुर्ब्रह्मा भूतभर्ता तथर्षयः। ये च शेषास्सुरास्ते त्वां रक्षन्तु वनवासिनम्।।2.25.25।।
output: May Siva, lord of all the worlds, Visnu, supporter of living beings, Brahma, rishis and all the rest of the gods protect you while you dwell in the forest

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति माल्यैस्सुरगणान्गन्धैश्चापि यशस्विनी। स्तुतिभिश्चानुरूपाभिरानर्चाऽयतलोचना।।2.25.26।।
output: यशस्विनी illustrious lady, आयतलोचना largeeyed (Kausalya), इति thus, माल्यैः with garlands, गन्धैश्चापि with fragrant susbtances, अनुरूपाभिः by appropriate articles, स्तुतिभिश्च with prayers, सुरगणान् hosts of gods, आनर्च worshipped.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ज्वलनं समुपादाय ब्राह्मणेन महात्मना। हावयामास विधिना राममङ्गलकारणात्।।2.25.27।।
output: After collecting the sacred fire through great brahmins she duly offered oblations to the gods for the welfare of Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
घृतं श्वेतानि माल्यानि समिधश्श्वेतसर्षपान्। उपसम्पादयामास कौशल्या परमाङ्गना।।2.25.28।।
output: परमाङ्गना noble lady, कौशल्या Kausalya, घृतम् clarified butter, श्वेतानि white,  माल्यानि garlands of flowers, समिधः sacred fuel, श्वेत सर्षपान् white grains of mustard seed,  उपसंपादयामास obtained.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपाध्याय स्सविधिना हुत्वा शान्तिमनामयम्। हुतहव्यावशेषेण बाह्यं बलिमकल्पयत्।।2.25.29।।
output: सः उपाध्यायः that officiating priest, विधिना duly, अनामयम् sound health, शान्तिं हुत्वा having performed sacrificial offerings for peace, हुतहव्यावशेषेण with the remainder of the offerings, बाह्यम् external, बलिम् ceremonies, अकल्पयत् performed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
मधु दध्यक्षतघृतैः स्वस्तिवाच्यद्विजांस्ततः। वाचयामास रामस्य वनेस्वस्त्ययनक्रियाः।।2.25.30।।
output: Thereafter she made the brahmins pronounce benedictory prayers, offering honey, curd, rice and clarified butter.Then she got mantras (expiatory rites) recited for averting evil to Rama while in the forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तस्मै द्विजेन्द्राय राममाता यशस्विनी। दक्षिणां प्रददौ काम्यां राघवं चेदमब्रवीत्।।2.25.31।।
output: The illustrious Kausalya, mother of Rama gave abundant gifts to the best of the brahmins and thereafter said to him:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
यन्मङ्गलं सहस्राक्षे सर्वदेवनमस्कृते। वृत्रनाशे समभवत्तत्ते भवतु मङ्गलम्।।2.25.32।।
output: May the same blessings bestowed by all the gods on the thousandeyed Indra at the time of killing Vritra be with you

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
यन्मङ्गलं सुपर्णस्य विनताऽकल्पयत्पुरा। अमृतं प्रार्थयानस्य तत्ते भवतु मङ्गलम्।।2.25.33।।
output: May you be conferred with the same blessings which Vinata bestowed on Garuda at the time of bringing nectar

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
अमृतोत्पादने दैत्यान् घ्नतो वज्रधरस्य यत्। अदितिर्मङ्गलं प्रादात्तत्ते भवतु मङ्गलम्।।2.25.34।।
output: May you be bestowed with the same blessings conferred by Aditi on Indra, the wielder of thunder for the killing of daityas at the time nectar was generated

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
त्रीन्विक्रमान्प्रक्रमतो विष्णोरमिततेजसः। यदासीन्मङ्गलं राम तत्ते भवतु मङ्गलम्।।2.25.35।।
output: O Rama by occupying three footsteps of space, highly lustrous Visnu owned the three worlds and obtained glory. May you obtain similar auspiciousness

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋतवस्सागरा द्वीपा वेदा लोका दिशश्च ते। मङ्गलानि महाबाहो दिशन्तु शुभमङ्गलाः।।2.25.36।।
output: महाबाहो O mightyarmed one, शुभमङ्गलाः auspicious happenings, ऋतवः seasons, सागराः seas, द्वीपाः islands, वेदाः the Vedas, लोकाः worlds, दिशश्च the quarters, ते to you,  मङ्गलानि blessings, दिशन्तु let them bestow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
इति पुत्रस्य शेषांश्च कृत्वा शिरसि भामिनी। गन्धैश्चापि समालभ्य राममायतलोचना।।2.25.37।। ओषधीं चापि सिद्धार्थां विशल्यकरणीं शुभाम्। चकार रक्षां कौशल्या मन्त्रैरभिजजाप च।।2.25.38।।
output: The largeeyed Kausalya placed the remains of the offerings on his (Rama's) head and  applied sandal cream to his body. She tied an auspicious medicinal herb known as Vishalyakarani to his arm for attainment of his objectives, repeatedly muttering prayers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति पुत्रस्य शेषांश्च कृत्वा शिरसि भामिनी। गन्धैश्चापि समालभ्य राममायतलोचना।।2.25.37।। ओषधीं चापि सिद्धार्थां विशल्यकरणीं शुभाम्। चकार रक्षां कौशल्या मन्त्रैरभिजजाप च।।2.25.38।।
output: The largeeyed Kausalya placed the remains of the offerings on his (Rama's) head and  applied sandal cream to his body. She tied an auspicious medicinal herb known as Vishalyakarani to his arm for attainment of his objectives, repeatedly muttering prayers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
उवाचातिप्रहृष्टेव सा दुःखवशवर्तिनी। वाङ्ग्मात्रेण न भावेन वाचाऽसंसज्जमानया।।2.25.39।।
output: Even though Kausalya was filled with distress, she appeared as if she was very much happy. She uttered  mere words in a confusing tone without applying her mind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आनम्य मूर्ध्नि चाघ्राय परिष्वज्य यशस्विनी। अवदत्पुत्र सिद्धार्थो गच्छ राम यथासुखम्।।2.25.40।।
output: Illustrious Kausalya embraced Rama, bending his head down and smelt his forehead. And then said O Rama go in peace and come back after accomplishing the objective.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अरोगं सर्वसिद्धार्थमयोध्यां पुनरागतम्। पश्यामि त्वां सुखं वत्स सुस्थितं राजवर्त्मनि।।2.25.41।।
output: O my son I shall be happy to behold you back in Ayodhya in sound health successful in your objectives and firmly established in the kingdom.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
प्रणष्टदुःखसङ्कल्पा हर्षविद्योतितानना। द्रक्ष्यामि त्वां वनात्प्राप्तं पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्।।2.25.42।।
output: When you return from the forest like the full Moon rising, I shall behold you with my anxieties gone and my face sparkling with joy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
भद्रासनगतं राम वनवासादिहागतम्। द्रक्ष्यामि च पुनस्त्वां तु तीर्णवन्तं पितुर्वचः।।2.25.43।।
output: After you have fulfilled your father's words and returned from your exile I shall behold you seated on the throne, O Rama

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मङ्गलैरुपसपन्नो वनवासादिहागतः। वध्वा मम च नित्यं त्वं कामान्संवर्ध याहि भोः।।2.25.44।।
output: भोः O Rama, वनवासात् from the forest, इह here, आगतः having returned, मङ्गलै: with auspicious events, उपसम्पन्नः endowed with, त्वम् you, वध्वाः of my daughterinlaw (Sita's), मम च for me also, कामान् desires, नित्यम् always, संवर्ध enhance, याहि go.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मयाऽर्चिता देवगणाश्शिवादयो महर्षयो भूतमहासुरोरगाः। अभिप्रयातस्य वनं चिराय ते हितानि काङ्क्षन्तु दिशश्च राघव।।2.25.45।।
output: O son of the Raghu race Lord Siva and other gods, the great rishis, bhutas, great asuras and serpents and four quarters worshipped by me will always promote your welfare when you dwell in the forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 25:
इतीव साऽश्रुप्रतिपूर्णलोचना समाप्य च स्वस्त्ययनं यथाविधि। प्रदक्षिणं चैव चकार राघवं पुनः पुनश्चापि निपीड्य सस्वजे।।2.25.46।।
output: Thus with her eyes brimming with tears, she duly completed the benedictory rites and  circumambulated the scion of the Raghus and embraced him again and again holding him tight.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा तु देव्या स कृतप्रदक्षिणो निपीड्य मातुश्चरणौ पुनः पुनः। जगाम सीतानिलयं महायशा स्स राघवः प्रज्वलित स्स्वया श्रिया।।2.25.47।।
output: देव्या by Devi Kausalya, तथा that way, कृतप्रदक्षिणः having circumambulated, सः Rama,  मातुः his mothers, चरणौ feet, पुनः पुनः again and again, निपीड्य holding fast, महायशाः illustrious, सः राघवः that son of the Raghu race, स्वया by his own, श्रिया with glory, प्रज्वलितः glowing, सीतानिलयम् to the palace of Sita, जगाम went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभिवाद्य च कौसल्यां राम स्संप्रस्थितो वनम्। कृतस्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा धर्मिष्ठे वर्त्मनि स्थितः।।2.26.1।। विराजयन्राजसुतो राजमार्गं नरैर्वृतम्। हृदयान्याममन्थेव जनस्य गुणवत्तया।।2.26.2।।
output: Sita enquires why Rama is distressedRama informs her about his impending banishment and instructs her to stay back in Ayodhya.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभिवाद्य च कौसल्यां राम स्संप्रस्थितो वनम्। कृतस्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा धर्मिष्ठे वर्त्मनि स्थितः।।2.26.1।। विराजयन्राजसुतो राजमार्गं नरैर्वृतम्। हृदयान्याममन्थेव जनस्य गुणवत्तया।।2.26.2।।
output: After the benedictory rites were performed by his mother Kausalya, Rama paid obeisance to her and staying on the righteous path decided to depart to the forest. He entered the highway thronged with people and illumining it with his lustre and stirred their hearts with (remembrances of) his excellent virtues.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
वैदेही चापि तत्सर्वं न शुश्राव तपस्विनी। तदेव हृदि तस्याश्च यौवराज्याभिषेचनम्।।2.26.3।।
output: Sita, her mind preoccupied with thoughts about consecration, was engaged in religious austerities and hence could not hear of all this (development).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
देवकार्यं स्वयं कृत्वा कृतज्ञा हृष्टचेतना। अभिज्ञा राजधर्माणां राजपुत्रं प्रतीक्षते।।2.26.4।।
output: कृतज्ञा grateful (to god), राजधर्माणाम् duties of a king (palace rituals), अभिज्ञा experienced in, हृष्टचेतना with pleased mind, स्वयम् herself, देवकार्यम् worship of gods, कृत्वा having made,  राजपुत्रम् prince, प्रतीक्षते was awaiting.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रविवेशाथ रामस्तु स्वं वेश्म सुविभूषितम्। प्रहृष्टजनसम्पूर्णं ह्रिया किञ्चिदवाङ्मुखः।।2.26.5।।
output: अथ thereafter, रामस्तु Rama, ह्रिया with embarrassment, किञ्चित् a little, अवाङ्मुखः with his head bent down, प्रहृष्टजनसम्पूर्णम् thronged with excited people, सुविभूषितम् welldecorated, स्वं वेश्म his own residence, प्रविवेश entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ सीता समुत्पत्य वेपमाना च तं पतिम्। अपश्यच्छोकसन्तप्तं चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियम्।।2.26.6।।
output: अथ thereafter, सीता Sita, समुत्पत्य entering suddenly, वेपमाना च a trembling, शोकसन्तप्तम् distressed with grief, चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियम् senses agitated due to anxiety, तं पतिम् her husband, अपश्यत् beheld.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां दृष्ट्वा स हि धर्मात्मा न शशाक मनोगतम्। तं शोकं राघवः सोढुं ततो विवृततां गतः।।2.26.7।।
output: धर्मात्मा virtuous, सः that, राघवः son of the Raghus (Rama), ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मनोगतम् in mind, तं शोकम् that sorrow, सोढुम् to endure (control), न शशाक was not able, ततः for that reason, विवृतताम् गतः manifested.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विवर्णवदनं दृष्ट्वा तं प्रस्विन्नममर्षणम्। आह दुःखाभिसन्तप्ता किमिदानीमिदं प्रभो।।2.26.8।।
output: विवर्णवदनम् pale face, प्रस्विन्नम् heavily perspiring, अमर्षणम् indignant, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दुःखाभिसन्तप्ता  consumed with grief, आह uttered, प्रभो O Lord, इदानीम् now, इदम् this, किम् what?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्य बार्हस्पत श्श्रीमान्युक्तः पुष्योऽनु राघव। प्रोच्यते ब्राह्मणैः प्राज्ञैः केन त्वमसि दुर्मनाः।।2.26.9।।
output: O scion of the Raghu race, today has been declared by learned brahmins a suitable and auspicious day for consecration under Pushya star with Brihaspati as presiding deity. Then why are you dejected?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न ते शतशलाकेन जलफेननिभेन च। आवृतं वदनं वल्गु छत्रेणापि विराजते।।2.26.10।।
output: How is it that your charming face shines not today under a hundredribbed umbrella (white) like foam in water?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्यजनाभ्यां च मुख्याभ्यां शतपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। चन्द्रहंसप्रकाशाभ्यां वीज्यते न तवाननम्।।2.26.11।।
output: (How is it that) your face, with its lotuslike eyes is not being fanned by excellent fans of the colour of the Moon or the swan.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वाग्मिनो वन्दिनश्चापि प्रहृष्टास्त्वां नरर्षभ। स्तुवन्तो नात्र दृश्यन्ते मङ्गलैः स्सूतमागधाः।।2.26.12।।
output: (How is it that) O best among men eloquent panegyrists, charioteers, bards are not seen singing your praise with auspicious words?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न ते क्षौद्रं च दधि च ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। मूर्ध्नि मूर्धाभिषिक्तस्य ददति स्म विधानतः।।2.26.13।।
output: वेदपारगाः versed in the Vedas, ब्राह्मणाः brahmins, मूर्धाभिषिक्तस्य having been consecrated,   ते your, मूर्ध्नि on head, विधानतः conforming to rites, क्षौद्रं च honey also, दधि च curds, न ददति स्म did not sprinkle.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
न त्वां प्रकृतय स्सर्वा श्श्रेणीमुख्याश्च भूषिताः। अनुव्रजितुमिच्छन्ति पौरजानपदास्तथा।।2.26.14।।
output: How is it that welladorned ministers, citizens from towns and villages, heads of guilds and others do not follow you?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चतुर्भिर्वेगसम्पन्नैर्हयैः काञ्चनभूषितैः। मुख्यः पुष्यरथो युक्तः किं न गच्छति तेऽग्रतः।।2.26.15।।
output: वेगसम्पन्नैः running swiftly, काञ्चनभूषितैः decorated with gold, चतुर्भिः four, हयैः horses, युक्तः harnessed, मुख्यः important, पुष्यरथः ceremonial chariot, किम् why, ते अग्रतः preceding you, न गच्छति is not going.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हस्ती चाग्रत श्श्रीमां स्तव लक्षणपूजितः। प्रयाणे लक्ष्यते वीर कृष्णमेघगिरि प्रभः।।2.26.16।।
output: How is it that the elephant, whose lustre resembles that of a mountain or a dark cloud and endowed with auspicious features is not seen leading your procession, O valiant one

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न च काञ्चनचित्रं ते पश्यामि प्रियदर्शन। भद्रासनं पुरस्कृत्य यान्तं वीर पुरस्कृतम्।।2.26.17।।
output: O heroic one O handsome one how is it that I do not see your attendants proceeding in front with the throne carved in gold?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
अभिषेको यथा सज्जः किमिदानीमिदं तव। अपूर्वो मुखवर्णश्च न प्रहर्षश्च लक्ष्यते।।2.26.18।।
output: How is it that when arrangements are under way now for your consecration, the complexion of your countenance does not look like what it was before? There is no joy on your face.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इतीव विलपन्तीं तां प्रोवाच रघुनन्दनः। सीते तत्र भवांस्तातः प्रव्राजयति मां वनम्।।2.26.19।।
output: O Sita my venerable father is banishing me to the forest, said Rama, the scion of the Raghus, the joy of the Raghu race, seeing her thus lamenting.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुले महति सम्भूते धर्मज्ञे धर्मचारिणि। शृणु जानकि येनेदं क्रमेणाभ्यागतं मम।।2.26.20।।
output: महति in a noble, कुले family, सम्भूते born in, धर्मज्ञे knower of righteousness, धर्मचारिणि for an observer of righteousness, जानकि Sita, येन क्रमेण in such course, इदम् this, अभ्यागतम् has befallen, शृण listen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
राज्ञा सत्यप्रतिज्ञेन पित्रा दशरथेन च। कैकेय्यै मम मात्रे तु पुरा दत्तौ महावरौ।।2.26.21।।
output: My father, king Dasaratha, true to his promise, had earlier granted two great boons to my mother Kaikeyi.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तयाऽद्य मम सज्जेऽस्मिन्नभिषेके नृपोद्यते। प्रचोदित स्स समयो धर्मेण प्रतिनिर्जितः।।2.26.22।।
output: When the king was preparing for my consecration, she reminded him of the promise and in the name of righteousness he has been cornered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यं दण्डके मया। पित्रा मे भरतश्चापि यौवराज्ये नियोजितः।।2.26.23।।
output: I am to dwell in the Dandaka forest for fourteen years while father has appointed  Bharata princeregent.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽहं त्वामागतो द्रष्टुं प्रस्थितो विजनं वनम्। भरतस्य समीपे तु नाहं कथ्यः कदाचन।।2.26.24।। बुद्धियुक्ता हि पुरुषा न सहन्ते परस्तवम्। तस्मान्नते गुणाः कथ्या भरतस्याग्रतो मम।।2.26.25।।
output: I have come to see you before departing for the desolate Dandaka forest. You should never praise me in the presence of Bharata because intellectuals cannot tolerate others being praised before them. You should never extol my virtues before him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽहं त्वामागतो द्रष्टुं प्रस्थितो विजनं वनम्। भरतस्य समीपे तु नाहं कथ्यः कदाचन।।2.26.24।। बुद्धियुक्ता हि पुरुषा न सहन्ते परस्तवम्। तस्मान्नते गुणाः कथ्या भरतस्याग्रतो मम।।2.26.25।।
output: I have come to see you before departing for the desolate Dandaka forest. You should never praise me in the presence of Bharata because intellectuals cannot tolerate others being praised before them. You should never extol my virtues before him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नापि त्वं तेन भर्तव्या विशेषेण कदाचन। अनुकूलतया शक्यं समीपे त्वस्य वर्तितुम्।।2.26.26।।
output: त्वम् you, तेन by him, कदाचन at any time, विशेषेण with a special treatment, न भर्तव्या  should not be supported, अनुकूलतया तु by being favourable only, अस्य his, समीपे in his vicinity, वर्तितुम् to remain, शक्यम् is possible.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्मै दत्तं नृपतिना यौवराज्यं सनातनम्। स प्रसाद्यस्त्वया सीते नृपतिश्च विशेषतः।।2.26.27।।
output: O Sita the king has conferred the hereditary regency on him. Therefore, O Sita, you must make efforts to win his favour, especially a king's.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं चापि प्रतिज्ञां तां गुरोस्समनुपालयन्। वनमद्यैव यास्यामि स्थिरा भव मनस्विनी।।2.26.28।।
output: I am leaving for the forest right away for fulfilling my father's pledge. O highminded Sita be steady.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
याते च मयि कल्याणि वनं मुनिनिषेवितम्। व्रतोपवासपरया भवितव्यं त्वयाऽनघे।।2.26.29।।
output: अनघे O sinless one, कल्याणि O auspicious one, मयि me, मुनिनिषेवितम् inhabited by ascetics, वनम् to the forest, याते when I am gone, त्वया by you, व्रतोपवास परया engaged in vratas and fasting, भवितव्यम् should be done.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
काल्यमुत्थाय देवानां कृत्वा पूजां यथाविधि। वन्दितव्यो दशरथः पिता मम नरेश्वरः।।2.26.30।।
output: You must rise in time and with the (household) gods duly worshipped, pay obeisance to my father, king Dasaratha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
माता च मम कौशल्या वृद्धा सन्तापकर्शिता। धर्ममेवाग्रतः कृत्वा त्वत्त स्सम्मानमर्हति।।2.27.31।।
output: You should give importance to duty(dharma) and show respect to my aged mother who is emaciated due to grief.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
वन्दितव्याश्च ते नित्यं या श्शेषा मम मातरः। स्नेह प्रणयसम्भोगै स्समा हि मम मातरः।।2.26.32।।
output: In terms of love, affection and service, the rest of my mothers are all equal. Therefore, you must pay them due respect regularly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भ्रातृपुत्रसमौ चापि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः। त्वया भरतशत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम।।2.26.33।।
output: What is more important is that you should look on Bharata as your brother and Satrughna as your son. They are dearer to me than my life.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
विप्रियं न च कर्तव्यं भरतस्य कदाचन। स हि राजा प्रभुश्चैव देशस्य च कुलस्य च।।2.26.34।।
output: Now Bharata is the king of the country and head of the family. Therefore, you should never do anything disagreeable to him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
आराधिता हि शीलेन प्रयत्नैश्चोपसेविताः। राजान स्सम्प्रसीदन्ति कुप्यन्तिच विपर्यये।।2.26.35।।
output: Kings are gratified if they are served with zeal and good conduct. If the contrary happens, they get provoked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 26:
औरसानपि पुत्रान्हि त्यजन्त्यहितकारिणः। समर्थान्सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति जनानपि नराधिपाः।।2.26.36।।
output: Kings abandon (even) their own sons if they are harmful and receive capable people even if they are strangers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा त्वं वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञस्समनुवर्तिनी। भरतस्य रता धर्मे सत्यव्रतपरायणा।।2.26.37।।
output: कल्याणि O auspicious one, सा त्वम् so you, राज्ञः of the king, भरतस्य of  Bharata, समनुवर्तिनी an obedient lady, धर्मे in righteousness, रता absorbed one, सत्यव्रत परायणा following the truth and the vows, इह वस live here.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं गमिष्यामि महावनं प्रिये त्वया हि वस्तव्यमिहैव भामिनि। यथा व्यलीकं कुरुषे न कस्य चि त्तथा त्वया कार्यमिदं वचो मम।।2.26.38।।
output: O my beloved Sita I am going to the wild forest. Stay here and never cause displeasure to any one in any way. Could you carry out these words of mine? इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षड्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysixth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही प्रियार्हा प्रियवादिनी। प्रणयादेव संक्रुद्धा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.27.1।।
output: प्रियवादिनी speaking pleasant words, प्रियार्हा deserving affection, वैदेही Sita, एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, प्रणयादेव out of love, संक्रुद्धा mighty angry, भर्तारम् to her husband, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किमिदं भाषसे राम वाक्यं लघुतया ध्रुवम्। त्वया यदपहास्यं मे श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मज।।2.27.2।।
output: नरवरात्मज O Prince, राम Rama, यत् since, लघुतया lightly, त्वया by you, ध्रुवम् certainly, अपहास्यम् fit to be ridiculed, श्रुत्वा having heard, मे to me (by me also), इदम् these, किं वाक्यम् what words, भाषसे are speaking.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
आर्यपुत्र पिता माता भ्राता पुत्रस्तथा स्नुषा। स्वानि पुण्यानि भुञ्जानाः स्वं स्वं भाग्यमुपासते।।2.27.3।।
output: O son of a noble monarch father, mother, brother, son or daughterinlaw   (everybody) experiences the merit (of their past deeds) and receives what is due from destiny.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भर्तुर्भाग्यं तु भार्यैका प्राप्नोति पुरुषर्षभ। अतश्चैवाहमादिष्टा वने वस्तव्यमित्यपि।।2.27.4।।
output: A wife alone, O best of men shares the destiny of her husband. I am also therefore, ordered to dwell in the forest. ( a command to you is a command to me).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न पिता नात्मजो नात्मा न माता न सखीजनः। इह प्रेत्य च नारीणां पतिरेको गतिस्सदा।।2.27.5।।
output: It is not her father or mother, nor her son or herself, nor her friends but her husband alone gives a woman the permanent refuge in this or in the next world.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
यदि त्वं प्रस्थितो दुर्गं वनमद्यैव राघव। अग्रतस्ते गमिष्यामि मृद्नन्ती कुशकण्टकान्।।2.27.6।।
output: O son of the Raghus if you set out for the impenetrable forest now itself, I shall also go, walking ahead of you and crushing the thorns and (spiky) kusa grass (rendering the path  comfortable for you to walk).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
ईर्ष्यारोषौ बहिष्कृत्य भुक्तशेषमिवोदकम्। नय मां वीर विस्रब्धः पापं मयि न विद्यते।।2.27.7।।
output: Do take me with you, O valiant one without hesitation. Dismiss all anger and envy (from your mind) like the leftover water after drinking (anger because she disobeys and envy because she, too, like Rama, is willing to brave the hazards of forest life). There is no fault on my part.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रासादाग्रैर्विमानैर्वा वैहायसगतेन वा। सर्वावस्थागता भर्तुः पादच्छाया विशिष्यते।।2.27.8।।
output: प्रासादाग्रैः on top of mansions, विमानैर्वा or in lovely palaces, वैहायसगतेन वा moving in air, सर्वावस्थागता in all stages of  life, भर्तुः husband's, पादच्छाया shelter at his feet, विशिष्यते is preferable.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनुशिष्टाऽस्मि मात्रा च पित्रा च विविधाश्रयम्। नाऽस्मि सम्प्रति वक्तव्या वर्तितव्यं यथा मया।।2.27.9।।
output: I have been so instructed by my parents about diverse duties in all stages of life that I need not be told anything (about my duties) now.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
अहं दुर्गं गमिष्यामि वनं पुरुषवर्जितम्। नानामृगगणाकीर्णं शार्दूलवृकसेवितम्।।2.27.10।।
output: I will also go to the forest, which is impassable, uninhabited, teeming with various kinds of animals and infested with tigers and wolves.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुखं वने निवत्स्यामि यथैव भवने पितुः। अचिन्तयन्ती त्रीन्लोकांश्च्चिन्तयन्ती पतिव्रतम्।।2.27.11।।
output: त्रीन् लोकान् the three worlds, अचिन्तयन्ती without thinking, पतिव्रतम् duties to the husband, चिन्तयन्ती while thinking, वने in the forest, पितुः father's, भवने in the palace, यथैव the same way, सुखम् happily, निवत्स्यामि I shall dwell.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शुश्रूषमाणा ते नित्यं नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी। सह रंस्ये त्वया वीर वनेषु मधुगन्धिषु।।2.27.12।।
output: वीर O hero , नित्यम् always, ते to you, शुश्रूषमाणा doing service, नियता self possessed, ब्रह्मचारिणी observing vow of celibacy, मधुगन्धिषु honeyscented, वनेषु in forests, त्वया सह with you, रंस्ये I shall sport.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वं हि शक्तो वने कर्तुं राम सम्परिपालनम्। अन्यस्यापि जनस्येह किं पुनर्मम मानद।।2.27.13।।
output: O respector of individuals when you are capable of protecting other people in the forest, what of me?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
सह त्वया गमिष्यामि वनमद्य न संशयः। नाहं शक्या महाभाग निवर्तयितुमुद्यता।।2.27.14।।
output: There is no doudt that I shall go with you to the forest today. O distinguished one I cannot be restrained from this resolve.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
फलमूलाशना नित्यं भविष्यामि न संशयः। न ते दुःखं करिष्यामि निवसन्ती सह त्वया।।2.27.15।।
output: Do not doubt that I shall not be able to live on fruits and roots or that I will create difficulty for you while living with you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इच्छामि सरितश्शैलान्पल्वलानि वनानि च। द्रष्टुं सर्वत्र निर्भीता त्वया नाथेन धीमता।।2.27.16।।
output: Living with you sans fear, O my sagacious husband, I wish to see the rivers, mountains, lakes and forests here and there.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाः पद्मिनीस्साधुपुष्पिताः। इच्छेयं सुखिनी द्रष्टुं त्वया वीरेण सङ्गता।।2.27.17।।
output: I wish to enjoy the lotus lakes in full bloom, abounding in swans and ducks in the company of a brave husband like you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अभिषेकं करिष्यामि तासु नित्यं यतव्रता। सह त्वया विशालाक्ष रंस्ये परमनन्दिनी ।।2.27.18।।
output: विशालाक्ष O largeeyed one, यतव्रता observing such vows, नित्यम् daily, तासु in those lotus ponds, अभिषेकम् bathing, करिष्यामि will take, परमनन्दिनी attaining great happiness, त्वया सह along with you, रंस्ये I will sport.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं वर्षसहस्राणां शतं वाऽहं त्वया सह। व्यतिक्रमं न वेत्स्यामि स्वर्गोऽपि न हि मे मतः।।2.27.19।।
output: Thus living in your company for a thousand years or even  a hundred thousand years, I shall not feel the passing of time. I shall not desire even heaven.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
स्वर्गेऽपि च विना वासो भविता यदि राघव। त्वया मम नरव्याघ्र नाहं तमपि रोचये।।2.27.20।।
output: O Raghava, tiger among men, if I were given heaven to live in without you, even that I shall not covet.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
अहं गमिष्यामि वनं सुदुर्गमं मृगायुतं वानरवारणैर्युतम्। वने निवत्स्यामि यथा पितुर्गृहे तवैव पादावुपगृह्य संयता।।2.27.21।।
output: I shall go (along with you) to the highly impenetrable forest infested with animals like monkeys and elephants. I shall live in the forest in (full) discipline as in my father's abode, taking shelter at your feet.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनन्यभावामनुरक्तचेतसं त्वया वियुक्तां मरणायनिश्चिताम्। नयस्व मां साधु कुरुष्व याचनाम् न ते मयाऽतो गुरुता भविष्यति।।2.27.22।।
output: अनन्यभावाम् without any other thought, अनुरक्तचेतसम् with heart deeply attached, त्वया by you, वियुक्ताम् separated (from you), मरणाय for death, निश्चिताम् resolved, माम् me, नयस्व take, याचनाम् my prayer, साधु be welldisposed, कुरुष्व do, अतः for that, ते for you, मया by me, गुरुता burden, न भविष्यति will not be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 27:
तथा ब्रुवाणामपि धर्मवत्सलो न च स्म सीतां नृवरो निनीषति। उवाच चैनां बहु सन्निवर्तने वने निवासस्य च दुःखितां प्रति।।2.27.23।।
output: Although Sita was thus appealing, Rama, devoted to righteousness, was (still) unwilling to take her. In order to dissuade her, he began to describe to the mournful Sita the many hardships of forest life. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स एवं ब्रुवतीं सीतां धर्मज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः। न नेतुं कुरुते बुद्धिं वने दुःखानि चिन्तयन्।।2.28.1।।
output: Rama relates to Sita the hardships of forest life-- dissuades her from accompanying him to the forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सान्त्वयित्वा पुनस्तां तु बाष्पदूषितलोचनाम्। निवर्तनार्थे धर्मात्मा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।।2.28.2।।
output: Righteous Rama consoled Sita whose eyes were blurred with tears, and in order to dissuade her (from going to the forest) said again:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सीते महाकुलीनाऽसि धर्मे च निरता सदा। इहाऽचर स्वधर्मं त्वं मे यथा मनसस्सुखम्।।2.28.3।।
output: Born in a noble race, O Sita, you are always devoted to duty. Follow your duty, here. It will make me happy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सीते यथा त्वां वक्ष्यामि तथा कार्यं त्वयाऽबले। वने हि बहवो दोषा वदतस्तान्निबोध मे।।2.28.4।।
output: अबले O frail one, सीते O Sita, त्वाम् you, यथा as, वक्ष्यामि I shall tell you, तथा like that, त्वया by you, कार्यम् should be done, वने in the forest, बहवः many, दोषाः हि hardships are there indeed, वदतः being told, मे by me, तान् about them, निबोध pray attention.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सीते विमुच्यतामेषा वनवासकृता मतिः। बहुदोषं हि कान्तारं वनमित्यभिधीयते।।2.28.5।।
output: सीते O Sita, वनवासकृता to live in the forest, एषा this, मति: mind, विमुच्यताम् give up, कान्तारम् a dreary forest, वनम् forest, बहुदोषं (बहुदोषयुतं) has many hardships, अभिधीयते हि is being said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 28:
हितबुद्ध्या खलु वचो मयैतदभिधीयते। सदा सुखं न जानामि दुःखमेव सदा वनम्।।2.28.6।।
output: I am saying all this in your interest. The forest is a haven of hardships. I know of no happiness in the forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गिरिनिर्झरसम्भूता गिरिकन्दर वासिनाम्। सिंहानां निनदा दुःखा श्श्रोतुं दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.7।।
output: It is frightening to hear the sounds of  waterfalls and the roar of lions living in the mountain caves. Therefore forest life is painful (fearful).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रीडमानाश्च विस्रब्धा मत्ता श्शून्ये महामृगाः। दृष्ट्वा समभिवर्तन्ते सीते दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.8।।
output: Big, wild animals, moving about freely and sporting in the deserted forest, attack on seeing a human. Thus forest is full of danger.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सग्राहा स्सरितश्चैव पङ्कवत्यस्सु दुस्तराः। मत्तैरपि गजैर्नित्यमतो दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.9।।
output: The rivers, infested with crocodiles and filled with mud are difficult to cross even for elephants in rut. Hence forest life is always extremely dangerous.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 28:
लताकण्टकसङ्कीर्णाः कृकवाकूपनादिताः। निरपाश्च सुदुर्गाश्च मार्गा दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.10।।
output: . The paths full of thorny creepers, echoing with the noise of wild fowls, and with no water (to drink) are difficult to tread. So forest is a source of suffering.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुप्यते पर्णशय्यासु स्वयं भग्नासु भूतले। रात्रिषु श्रमखिन्नेन तस्माद्दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.11।।
output: स्वयम् on their own, भग्नासु broken (fallen), पर्णशय्यासु bed of leaves, भूतले on the ground, श्रमखिन्नेन exhausted with struggles, रात्रिषु at night, सुप्यते will have to sleep, तस्मात्  therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is extremely painful.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहोरात्रं च सन्तोषः कर्तव्यो नियतात्मना। फलैर्वृक्षावपतितै स्सीते दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.12।।
output: सीते O Sita, अहोरात्रम् night and day, नियतात्मना with senses under control, वृक्षावपतितैः fallen down the trees, फलैः with fruits, सन्तोषः satisfaction, कर्तव्यः to be derived, अतः therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखम् is full of suffering.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपवासश्च कर्तव्यो यथा प्राणेन मैथिलि। जटाभारश्च कर्तव्यो वल्कलाम्बरधारिणा।।2.28.13।।
output: मैथिलि O Daughter of Mithila, यथाप्राणेन according to one's ability, उपवासश्च fasting also, कर्तव्यः has to be undertaken, वल्कलाम्बरधारिणा wearing robes of bark, जटाभारश्च also burden of matted hair, कर्तव्यः has to be borne.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 28:
देवतानां पित्रूणां कर्तव्यं विधिपूर्वकम्। प्राप्तानामतिथीनां च नित्यशः प्रतिपूजनम्।।2.28.14।।
output: One has to worship gods and ancestors according to tradition and extend hospitality to guests, (who arrive unexpectedly).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कार्यस्त्रिरभिषेकश्च काले काले च नित्यशः। चरता नियमेनैव तस्माद्धुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.15।।
output: One has to wander about all the while (like an ascetic) as per the customs and take ablutions three times a day at prescribed hours. Hence life in the forest is extremely hard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपहारश्च कर्तव्यः कुसुमै स्स्वयमाहृतैः। आर्षेण विधिना वेद्यां बाले दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.16।।
output: बाले O innocent one, स्वयम् on your own, आहृतैः has been brought, कुसुमैः with flowers, आर्षेण विधिना as per the injunction of the Vedas, वेद्याम् on the altar, उपहारश्च offering, कर्तव्यः needs to be made, अतः therefore, वनम् living in the forest, दुःखम् is difficult.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथालब्धेन कर्तव्यः सन्तोषस्तेन मैथिलि। यताहारैर्वनचरै र्नित्यं दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.17।।
output: The wanderers in the jungle, O daughter of Mithila, have to be satisfied daily with whatever little food is available. So forest (life) is a hard life.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अतीव वातास्तिमिरं बुभुक्षा चात्र नित्यशः। भयानि च महान्त्यत्र ततो दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.18।।
output: अत्र there (in the forest), वाताः wind, तिमिरम् darkness, अतीव is extreme, नित्यशः always, बुभुक्षा hunger, महान्ति great, भयानि च fears also, ततः therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is extremely difficult.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सरीसृपाश्च बहवो बहुरूपाश्च भामिनि। चरन्ति पृथिवीं दर्पात्ततो दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.19।।
output: भामिनि O Beautiful lady, बहुरूपाः च of various forms too, बहवः many, सरीसृपाः च reptiles also, दर्पात् fiercely, पृथिवीम् on the ground, चरन्ति move about, ततः therefore, वनम् to live in the forest, दुःखतरं is extremely dangerous.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नदी निलयना स्सर्पा नदीकुटिलगामिनः। तिषठ्न्त्यावृत्य पन्थानं ततो दुःखतरं वनम्।।.2.28.20।।
output: नदी निलयनाः live in rivers, नदीकुटिलगामिनः meandering like rivers, सर्पाः serpents, पन्थानम् the path, आवृत्य having obstructed, तिष्ठन्ति stay, ततः therefore, वनम् life in the forest, दुःखतरम् is full of sufferings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पतङ्गा वृश्चिकाः कीटा दंशाश्च मशकै स्सह। बाधन्ते नित्यमबले सर्वं दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.21।।
output: Birds, scorpions, insects, gnats and mosquitoes always create trouble. Therefore, life in the forest is all suffering.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्रुमाः कण्टकिनश्चैव कुशा: काशाश्च भामिनि। वने व्याकुलशाखाग्रास्तेन दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.22।।
output: भामिनि O lovely Sita, वने in the forest, द्रुमाः trees, कुशा काशाः च kusa grass and reeds,  कण्टकिनश्चैव thorny ones, व्याकुलशाखाग्राः with tops of branches interlaced with each other, तेन therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is full of difficulties.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कायक्लेशाश्च बहवो भयानि विविधानि च। अरण्यवासे वसतो दुःखमेव ततो वनम्।।2.28.23।।
output: अरण्यवासे living in the forest, वसतः while living, बहवः many, कायक्लेशाः physical afflictions, विविधानि various, भयानि च fears, ततः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखमेव is full of difficulties only.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 28:
क्रोधलोभौ विमोक्तव्यौ कर्तव्या तपसे मतिः। न भेतव्यं च भेतव्ये नित्यं दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.24।।
output: Anger and greed have to be given up, with the mind preoccupied with ascetic practices. One should not be afraid of fearful situations. Hence forest (life) always very hard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदलं ते वनं गत्वा क्षमं न हि वनं तव। विमृशन्निह पश्यामि बहुदोषतरं वनम्।।2.28.25।।
output: तत् for that reason, ते to you, वनम् to the forest, गत्वा going, अलम् is not desirable, तव for you, वनम् forest life, क्षमम् न हि is not fit, इह now, विमृशन् while reconsidering, वनम् forest life, बहुदोषतरम् is full of great dangers, पश्यामि I see.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वनन्तु नेतुं न कृता मतिस्तदा बभूव रामेण यदा महात्मना। न तस्य सीता वचनं चकार त त्ततोऽब्रवीद्राममिदं सुदुःखिता।।2.28.26।।
output: महात्मना by the great, रामेण by Rama, यदा when, वनम् to the forest, नेतुम् to take, मतिः mind (decision), कृता has been made, न बभूव did not happen, तदा then, सीता Sita, तस्य his, तत्  that, वचनं words, न चकार did not follow, ततः threafter, सुदुःखिता deeply grieved, रामम् to Rama, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 29:
एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य दुःखिता। प्रसक्ताश्रुमुखी मन्दमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.29.1।।
output: Having heard the words of Rama, thus spoke Sita in a faint voice in sadness, with tears flowing incessantly from her eyes:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ये त्वया कीर्तिता दोषा वने वस्तव्यतां प्रति। गुणानित्येव तान्विद्धि तव स्नेहपुरस्कृतान्।।2.29.2।।
output: वने in the forest, वस्तव्यतां प्रति about dwelling in the forest, त्वया by you, ये those, दोषाः difficulties, कीर्तिताः described, तव your, स्नेहपुरस्कृतान् accompanied by your affection, तान् them, गुणानित्येव as virtues only, विद्धि understand.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मृगा स्सिंहा गजाश्चैव शार्दूला श्शरभास्तथा। पक्षिण स्सृमराश्चैव ये चान्ये वनचारिणः।।2.29.3।। अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे ते तव राघव। रूपं दृष्ट्वाऽपसर्पेयुर्भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति।।2.29.4।।
output: राघव Rama, मृगाः antelopes, सिंहाः lions, गजाश्चैव elephants also, शार्दूला: tigers, तथा also, शरभाः sarabhas (a fabulous deer said to have eight legs), पक्षिणः birds, सृमराश्चैव srimaras (a kind of deer), अन्ये other, ये all, वनचारिणः wild beasts wandering in the forest, ते सर्वे all those, तव your, अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात् which had not been seen by you before, रूपम् your appearance, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing alone, अपसर्पेयुः will flee away, भये when fear arises, सर्वे all, बिभ्यति हि are afraid of.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मृगा स्सिंहा गजाश्चैव शार्दूला श्शरभास्तथा। पक्षिण स्सृमराश्चैव ये चान्ये वनचारिणः।।2.29.3।। अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे ते तव राघव। रूपं दृष्ट्वाऽपसर्पेयुर्भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति।।2.29.4।।
output: O scion of the Raghu race antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, birds, srimaras and other wild beasts wandering in the forest have not seen your beauty before. Now on seeing you, they will flee away. In fact, who will not be afraid of seeing an object of fear?.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 29:
त्वया च सह गन्तव्यं मया गुरुजनाज्ञया। त्वद्वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यमिह जीवितम्।।2.29.5।।
output: In accordance with the command of the elders, I must accompany you to the forest. If I am separated from you, I will give up my life here itself.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न हि मां त्वत्समीपस्थामपि शक्नोतिराघव। सुराणामीश्वर श्शक्रः प्रधर्षयितुमोजसा।।2.29.6।।
output: If I am  in your company, O Rama even the lord of the gods, Indra with all his might will not be able to hurt me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पतिहीना तु या नारी न सा शक्ष्यति जीवितुम्। काममेवं विधं राम त्वया मम निदर्शितम्।।2.29.7।।
output: या नारी a woman, पतिहीना without her husband, सा she, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यति cannot live, राम Rama, त्वया by you, कामम् greatly, एवं विधम् in this manner, मम to me, निदर्शितम्  has been illustrated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ चापि महाप्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानां मया श्रुतम्। पुरा पितृगृहे सत्यं वस्तव्यं किल मे वने।।2.29.8।।
output: महाप्राज्ञ O Sagacious one, अथ चापि moreover, पुरा formerly, पितृगृहे at my father's  house, मया by me, ब्राह्माणानाम् brahmins' (word), श्रुतम् has been heard, मे about me, सत्यम् in sooth, वने in the forest, वस्तव्यं किल to dwell certainly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्य श्शृत्वाऽहं वचनं पुरा। वनवासकृतोत्साहा नित्यमेव महाबल।।2.29.9।।
output: O mighty hero ever since I heard the prophesies from the brahmin palmists I am yearning to dwell in the forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 29:
आदेशो वनवासस्य प्राप्तव्य स्स मया किल। सा त्वया सह तत्राहं यास्यामि प्रिय नान्यथा।।2.29.10।।
output: Therefore, O my beloved I must certainly obtain such a command to dwell in the forest. I must accompany you to the forest and it cannot be otherwise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 29:
कृतादेशा भविष्यामि गमिष्यामि सह त्वया। कालश्चायं समुत्पन्न स्सत्यवाग्भवतु द्विजः।।2.29.11।।
output: I will go with you, true to the prediction of the brahmin. That time has come and let his prediction come to pass.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वनवासेऽभिजानामि दुःखानि बहुथा किल। प्राप्यन्ते नियतं वीर पुरुषैरकृतात्मभिः।।2.29.12।।
output: वीर O valiant one, वनवासे while residing in the forest, दुःखानि hardships, बहुथा किल  certainly of every kind, अभिजानामि I am aware, अकृतात्मभिः by those whose senses are not under their control, पुरुषैः by men, नियतम् definitely, प्राप्यन्ते will be experienced.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कन्यया च पितुर्गेहे वनवास श्शृतो मया। भिक्षिण्या स्साधुवृत्ताया मम मातुरिहाग्रतः।।2.29.13।।
output: पितुः father's, गेहे in the house, कन्यया when I was young, मया by me, मम मातुः my mother's, अग्रतः in the presence, साधुवृत्तायाः a saint, भिक्षिण्या a female mendicant, इह  in this world, वनवासः forest life, श्रुतः heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रसादितश्च वै पूर्वं त्वं मे बहुतिथं प्रभो। गमनं वनवासस्य काङ्क्षितं हि सह त्वया।।2.29.14।।
output: प्रभो O Lord, पूर्वम् in the past, त्वम् you, बहुतिथम् for a long time, मे for me, प्रसादितश्च वै  favoured, त्वया सह along with you, वनवासस्य गमनम् to go to the forest, काङ्क्षितं हि is wished for.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृतक्षणाऽहं भद्रं ते गमनं प्रति राघव। वनवासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते।।2.29.15।।
output: राघव Rama, ते to you, वनवासस्य of forest life, गमनं प्रति about departure, अहम् I, कृतक्षणा counting time, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you, शूरस्य of a valiant one,  चर्या movement, मम to me, रोचते हि is pleasing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शुद्धात्मन्प्रेमभावाध्दि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा। भर्तारमनुगच्छन्ती भर्ता हि मम दैवतम्।।2.29.16।।
output: शुद्धात्मन् O purehearted one, प्रेमभावात् with feeling of love, भर्तारम् husband, अनुगच्छन्ती following, विकल्मषा sinless, भविष्यामि I shall become, भर्ता husband, मम to me, दैवतं हि is a god.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रेत्यभावे हि कल्याण स्सङ्गमो मे सह त्वया। श्रुतिर्हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानां यशस्विनाम्।।2.29.17।। इहलोके च पितृभिर्या स्त्री यस्य महामते। अद्भिर्दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्यभावेऽपि तस्य सा।।2.29.18।।
output: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 29:
प्रेत्यभावे हि कल्याण स्सङ्गमो मे सह त्वया। श्रुतिर्हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानां यशस्विनाम्।।2.29.17।। इहलोके च पितृभिर्या स्त्री यस्य महामते। अद्भिर्दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्यभावेऽपि तस्य सा।।2.29.18।।
output: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमस्मात्स्वकां नारीं सुवृत्तां हि पतिव्रताम्। नाभिरोचयसे नेतुं त्वं मां केनेह हेतुना।।2.29.19।।
output: त्वम् you, केन हेतुना for what reason, इह now, एवम् this way, सुवृत्ताम् a woman of good conduct, पतिव्रताम् faithful and loyal wife, स्वकां नारीम् your own woman, माम् me, अस्मात्  from this place, नेतुम् to take, नाभिरोचयसे you are not willing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भक्तां पतिव्रतां दीनां मां समां सुखदुःखयोः। नेतुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समान सुखदुःखिनीम्।।2.29.20।।
output: काकुत्थ्स O descendant of Kakutstha, भक्ताम् devotee, पतिव्रताम् faithful to the husband, दीनां distressed, सुखदुःखयोः in happines and sorrow, समाम् having equal disposition, समान सुख दुःखिनीम् equally share your prosperity and adversity, माम् me, नेतुम् अर्हसि should take.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ययदि मां दुःखितामेवं वनं नेतुं न चेच्छसि। विषमग्निं जलं वाऽहमास्थास्ये मृत्युकारणात्।।2.29.21।।
output: एवम् in this, दुःखिताम् distressed, माम् me, वनम् to the forest, नेतुम् to take, न च इच्छसि यदि if you do not wish, मृत्युकारणात् to seek death, विषम् poison, अग्निम् fire, जलं वा or water, आस्थास्ये I shall take refuge.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं बहुविधं तं सा याचते गमनं प्रति। नानुमेने महाबाहुस्तां नेतुं विजनं वनम्।।2.29.22।।
output: Despite Sita's  pleadings with him in various ways the mightyarmed Rama would not consent to take her to the desolate forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 29:
एवमुक्ता तु सा चिन्तां मैथिली समुपागता। स्नापयन्तीव गामुष्णैरश्रुभिर्नयनच्युतैः।।2.29.23।।
output: Thus spoken to (prevented), Sita was filled with grief and cried, drenching the ground with warm tears that fell from her eyes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 29:
चिन्तयन्तीं तथा तां तु निवर्तयितुमात्मवान्। ताम्रोष्ठीं स तदा सीतां काकुत्स्थो बह्वसान्त्वयत्।।2.29.24।।
output: That selfpossessed scion of the Kakutstha dynasty consoled the copperredlipped Sita in several ways to dissuade her (from going to the forest). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyninth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
सान्त्व्यमाना तु रामेण मैथिली जनकात्मजा। वनवासनिमित्ताय भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.30.1।।
output: In response to Rama's consolation with regard to her stay in the forest, the daughter of Janaka, Maithili (Sita) said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
सा तमुत्तमसंविग्ना सीता विपुलवक्षसम्। प्रणयाच्चाभिमानाच्च परिचिक्षेप राघवम्।।2.30.2।।
output: Sita agitated over a supreme cause upbraided the broadchested scion of the Raghu race out of love and injured selfrespect.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किं त्वाऽमन्यत वैदेहः पिता मे मिथिलाधिपः। राम जामातरं प्राप्य स्त्रियं पुरुषविग्रहम्।।2.30.3।।
output: राम O Rama, पुरुषविग्रहम् in the form of a man, स्त्रियम् a woman, त्वा you, जामातरम् as  soninlaw, प्राप्य having obtained, मिथिलाधिपः king of Mithila, वैदेहः lord of Videha, मे पिता my father, किम् what, अमन्यत thought of.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनृतं बत लोकोऽयमज्ञानाद्यदि वक्ष्यति। तेजो नास्ति परं रामे तपतीव दिवाकरे।।2.30.4।।
output: तपति in a blazing, दिवाकरे इव like in the Sun, रामे in Rama, परम् great, तेजः splendour, नास्ति is not  to be found, अयं लोकः this world, अज्ञानात् out of ignorance, वक्ष्यति यदि if they say so, then that one, अनृतम् is a falsehood, बत alas

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किं हि कृत्वा विषण्णस्त्वं कुतो वा भयमस्ति ते। यत्परित्यक्तुकामस्त्वं मामनन्यपरायणाम्।।2.30.5।।
output: त्वम् you, अनन्यपरायणाम् with none else as her refuge, माम् me, परित्यक्तुकामः (इति) यत् that you want to desert, त्वम् you, किं हि कृत्वा for what reason, विषण्णः depressed,  ते to you, कुतः वा from where, भयम् fear, अस्ति exists.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
द्युमत्सेनसुतं वीर सत्यवन्तमनुव्रताम्। सावित्रीमिव मां विद्धि त्वमात्मवशवर्तिनीम्।।2.30.6।।
output: Know, O valiant one, that by remaining subordinate to you, I am as faithful to you as Savitri was to her husband, Satyavanta, son of Dyumatsena.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
न त्वहं मनसाऽप्यन्यं द्रष्टाऽस्मि त्वदृतेऽनघ। त्वया राघव गच्छेयं यथाऽन्या कुलपांसिनी।।2.30.7।।
output: O sinless son of the Raghus I am not like other women who bring disgreace to the family. I have not looked at any one except you, even with my mind's eye. I will go (to the forest) along with you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
स्वयं तु भार्यां कौमारीं चिरमध्युषितां सतीम्। शैलूष इव मां राम परेभ्यो दातुमिच्छसि।।2.30.8।।
output: I have been living with you for a long time, O Rama I am young and chaste. Why do you, like an actor, wish to hand me over to others.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्य पथ्यं च रामाऽत्थ यस्य चार्थेऽवरुध्यसे। त्वं तस्य भव वश्यश्च विधेयश्च सदाऽनघ।।2.30.9।।
output: You, O sinless Rama, may become subservient and obedient to them about whose wellfare you are speaking of and on account of whom you are preventing me to go (along with you).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
स मामनादाय वनं न त्वं प्रस्थातुमर्हसि। तपो वा यदि वाऽरण्यं स्वर्गो वा स्यात्सह मे त्वया।।2.30.10।।
output: You should not depart for the forest without taking me. Be it for penance or for the forest or for heaven, I wish to be with you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न च मे भविता तत्र कश्चित्पथि परिश्रमः। पृष्ठतस्तव गच्छन्त्या विहारशयनेष्विव।।2.30.11।।
output: तव your, पृष्ठतः behind, गच्छन्त्याः going, मे to me, तत्र there, पथि on the way, विहारशयनेष्विव on a pleasure stroll or in a (luxurious) couch, कश्चित् even a little, परिश्रमः strain, न भविता will not be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
कुशकाशशरेषीका ये च कण्टकिनो द्रुमाः। तूलाजिनसमस्पर्शा मार्गे मम सह त्वया।।2.30.12।।
output: The white reeds, the kusha, the sara and the ishika grasses and thorny trees on the way will feel as soft as cotton or as the skin of a black antelope.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महावातसमुद्धूतं यन्मामपकरिष्यति। रजो रमण तन्मन्ये परार्थ्यमिव चन्दनम्।।2.30.13।।
output: I shall regard, O charming Rama, the harmful dust raised by the stormy wind and settled on me as the most excellent sandal powder.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शाद्वलेषु यथा शिश्ये वनान्ते वनगोचर। कुथास्तरणतल्पेषु किं स्यात्सुखतरं ततः।।2.30.14।।
output: वनगोचर Rover of the forest, वनान्ते on the outskirts of the forest,  शाद्वलेषु on the meadows (of tender green grass), यथा as, शिश्ये I will lie down, ततः more than that, कुथास्तरणतल्पेषु in the couch spread with carpets, सुखतरम् more comfortable, स्यात्किम् what shall be?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पत्रं मूलं फलं यत्त्वमल्पं वा यदि वा बहु। दास्यसि स्वयमाहृत्य तन्मेऽमृतरसोपमम्।।2.30.15।।
output: Whatever leaves or roots or fruits you collect with your own hands for me little or much, they will be nectar to me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न मातुर्न पितुस्तत्र स्मरिष्यामि न वेश्मनः। आर्तवान्युपभुञ्जाना पुष्पाणि च फलानि च।।2.30.16।।
output: तत्र there, आर्तवानि seasonal, पुष्पाणि flowers, फलानि च also fruits, उपभुञ्जाना while enjoying, मातुः mother, न स्मरिष्यामि will not remember, पितुः न not about father, वेश्मनः  about home, न will not.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
न च तत्र ततः किञ्चिद्द्रष्टुमर्हसि विप्रियम्। मत्कृते न च ते शोको न भविष्यामि दुर्भरा।।2.30.17।।
output: Therefore, you should not anticipate any problem from me in the forest. Neither shall I be burdensome to you nor shall I make you experience any sorrow on my account.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
य स्त्वया सह स स्वर्गो निरयो यस्त्वया विना। इति जानन्परां प्रीतिं गच्छ राम मया सह।।2.30.18।।
output: Wherever I be with you is heaven and without, hell. O Rama, recognise this truth, and derive great pleasure in my company.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ मामेवमव्यग्रां वनं नैव नयिष्यति। विषमद्यैव पास्यामि मा विशं द्विषतां गमम्।।2.30.19।।
output: If you do not take me to the forest without the least hesitation I shall consume poison right now, but not live under the control of enemies (at Ayodhya).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
पश्चादपि हि दुःखेन मम नैवास्ति जीवितम्। उज्झितायास्त्वया नाथ तदैव मरणं वरम्।।2.30.20।।
output: If forsaken, O Lord I shall not live a life of sorrow. Instant death is better (than abandoned existence).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमं हि सहितुं शोकं मुहूर्तमपि नोत्सहे। किं पुनर्दशवर्षाणि त्रीणि चैकं च दुःखिता।।2.30.21।।
output: I cannot bear this grief even for a moment, what to speak of fourteen (ten and three and one) years of grieving.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति सा शोकसन्तप्ता विलप्य करुणं बहु। चुक्रोश पतिमायस्ता भृशमालिङ्ग्य सस्वरम्।।2.30.22।।
output: सा that Sita, शोकसन्तप्ता tormented with grief, आयस्ता exhausted, इति thus, करुणम्  piteously, बहु profusely, विलप्य lamenting, पतिम् husband, आलिङ्ग्य embracing, सस्वरम् with loud voice, भृशम् tightly, चुक्रोश cried.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
सा विद्धा बहुभिर्वाक्यैर्दिग्धैरिव गजाङ्गना। चिरसन्नियतं बाष्पं मुमोचाग्निमिवारणिः।।2.30.23।।
output: Pierced by so many words (of objection from  Rama), Sita felt like a cowelephant penetrated by poisonsmeared arrrows. And shed her longsuppressed tears like arani (a firekindling stick) kindling fire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
तस्या स्फटिकसङ्काशं वारि सन्तापसम्भवम्। नेत्राभ्यां परिसुस्राव पङ्कजाभ्यामिवोदकम्।।2.30.24।।
output: Crystallike tears arising out of distress flowed from her eyes like water trickling from two lotuses.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्चैवामलचन्द्राभं मुखमायतलोचनम्। पर्यशुष्यत बाष्पेण जलोद्धृतमिवाम्बुजम्।।2.30.25।।
output: अमलचन्द्राभम् possessing the brightness of the stainless Moon, आयतलोचनम् having large eyes, तत् that, मुखंचैव from the face, जलोद्धृतम् plucked from water, अम्बुजमिव like a lotus, बाष्पेण with tears, पर्यशुष्यत withered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तां परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां विसंज्ञामिव दुःखिताम्। उवाच वचनं रामः परिविश्वासयंस्तदा।।2.30.26।।
output: With his arms Rama embraced Sita who had almost fainted in grief. And in order to create confidence in her he said these words:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न देवि तव दुःखेन स्वर्गमप्यभिरोचये। न हि मेऽस्ति भयं किञ्चित्स्वयम्भोरिव सर्वतः।।2.30.27।।
output: देवि O Devi, तव your, दुःखेन with grief, स्वर्गमपि even heaven, न अभिरोचये I do not desire, मे to me, स्वयम्भोरिव like selfcreated Brahma, सर्वतः from everything, किञ्चित् even a little, भयम् fear, नास्ति हि is not there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तव सर्वमभिप्रायमविज्ञाय शुभानने। वासं न रोचयेऽरण्ये शक्तिमानपि रक्षणे।।2.30.28।।
output: O Sita of auspicious countenance even though I am capable of protecting you I did not like your stay in the forest as I did not know your intentions.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
यत्सृष्टाऽसि मया सार्धं वनवासाय मैथिलि। न विहातुं मया शक्या कीर्तिरात्मवता यथा।।2.30.29।।
output: Since you, O daughter of Mithila, were born to go along with me to the forest, I cannot abandon you just as a selfrespecting man cannot forsake his reputation.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
धर्मस्तु गजनासोरु सद्भिराचरितः पुरा। तं चाहमनुवर्तेऽद्य यथा सूर्यं सुवर्चला।।2.30.30।।
output: O one  with (shapely) thighs like the trunk of an elephant follow only the path of righteousness practised earlier by the virtuous as Suvarchala follows the Sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
न खल्वहं न गच्छेयं वनं जनकनन्दिनि। वचनं तन्नयति मां पितु स्सत्योपबृंहितम्।।2.30.31।।
output: Not that I shall not go to the forest (go I must). My father's word nourished by truth is leading me there, O daughter of Janaka

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एष धर्मस्तु सुश्रोणि पितुर्मातुश्च वश्यता। अतश्च तं व्यतिक्रम्य नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे।।2.30.32।।
output: Obedience to parents is a righteous act. Therefore, O one with fair hips I cannot live and disobey the word of truth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
अस्वाधीनं कथं दैवं प्रकारैरभिराध्यते। स्वाधीनं समतिक्रम्य मातरं पितरं गुरुम्।।2.30.33।।
output: Mother, father and preceptor are present before us. By overstepping them, how can we, in various ways, worship God who is beyond reach (not visible)?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यत्त्रयं तत्त्रयो लोकाः पवित्रं तत्समं भुवि। नान्यदस्ति शुभापाङ्गे तेनेदमभिराध्यते।।2.30.34।।
output: शुभापाङ्गे O one having lovely side glances, यत्र which, त्रयम् all the three (father, mother and preceptor), तत्र that, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, तत्समम् equal to those three, पवित्रम् अन्यत् any other holy thing, लोके in the world, नास्ति none, तेन therefore, इदम् this, अभिराध्यते is worshipped.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न सत्यं दानमानौ वा न यज्ञाश्चाप्तदक्षिणाः। तथा बलकरा स्सीते यथा सेवा पितुर्हिता।।2.30.35।।
output: सीते O Sita, पितुः of father, सेवा service, यथा as, हिता salutary, तथा so,  सत्यम् truth, न not, दानमानौ charity, honour, न not, आप्तदक्षिणाः gifts for the revered ones, यज्ञाःच sacrifices, बलकराः न not strengthening.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
स्वर्गो धनं वा धान्यं वा विद्याः पुत्रास्सुखानि च। गुरुवृत्त्यनुरोधेन न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम्।।2.30.36।।
output: By fulfilling father's wish, nothing is difficult to achieve, whether it is heaven, or wealth, or foodgrains, or learning, or sons or other comforts.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
देवगन्धर्वगोलोकान्ब्रह्मलोकां स्तथाऽपरान्। प्राप्नुवन्ति महात्मानो मातापितृपरायणाः।।2.30.37।।
output: मातापितृपरायणाः people devoted to the service of parents, महात्मानः great men, देवगन्धर्वगोलोकान् the world of the gods, gandharvas, and the cows or Visnu, ब्रह्मलोकम्  the world of Brahma, तथा and, अपरान् other worlds, प्राप्नुवन्ति will attain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स मां पिता यथा शास्ति सत्यधर्मपथे स्थितः। तथा वर्तितुमिच्छामि स हि धर्मस्सनातनः।।2.30.38।।
output: सत्यधर्मपथे On the path of truth and dharma, स्थितः firmly fixed, सः पिता such father, माम्   me, यथा as, शास्ति commands, तथा accordingly, वर्तितुम् to abide by, इच्छामि wish सः that one, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः हि is truth indeed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
मम सन्ना मतिस्सीते त्वां नेतुं दण्डकावनम्। वसिष्यामीति सा त्वं मामनुयातुं सुनिश्चिता।।2.30.39।।
output: O Sita, my discretion fails me in deciding whether to take you to Dandaka forest or not. You are, however, firmly determined to follow me, saying, you can live in the forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा हि सृष्टाऽनवद्याङ्गि वनाय मदिरेक्षणे। अनुगच्छस्व मां भीरु सहधर्मचरी भव।।2.30.40।।
output: O one with fascinating eyes and exquisite beauty you were born to live in the forest. O gentle lady, assist me in carrying out my duties.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वथा सदृशं सीते मम स्वस्य कुलस्य च। व्यवसायमनुक्रान्ता कान्ते त्वमतिशोभनम्।।2.30.41।।
output: कान्ते O my lovely beloved, सीते Sita, त्वम् you, मम for me, स्वस्य your own, कुलस्य च of the family, सर्वथा in all ways, सदृशम् befitting, अतिशोभनम् highly dignified, व्यवसायम् resolution,  अनुक्रान्ता done in due order.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आरभस्व शुभश्रोणि वनवासक्षमाः क्रियाः। नेदानीं त्वदृते सीते स्वर्गोऽपि मम रोचते।।2.30.42।।
output: O Sita, begin right now all preparations necessary for residing in the forest. O one, with beautiful buttocks, without you even the very heaven does not please me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च रत्नानि भिक्षुकेभ्यश्च भोजनम्। देहि चाशंसमानेभ्य स्सन्त्वरस्व च मा चिरम्।।2.30.43।।
output: आशंसमानेभ्यः for the needy, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, रत्नानि च jewels, भिक्षुकेभ्यः to mendicants, भोजनं च food also, देहि you may bestow, सन्त्वरस्व च hasten, मा चिरम् do not delay.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भूषणानि महार्हाणि वरवस्त्राणि यानि च। रमणीयाश्च ये केचित्क्रीडार्थाश्चाप्युपस्कराः।।2.30.44।। शयनीयानि यानानि मम चान्यानि यानि च। देहि स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य ब्राह्मणानामनन्तरम्।।2.30.45।।
output: महार्हाणि highly valuable, यानि all, भूषणानि ornaments, वरवस्त्राणि excellent clothing, रमणीयाः charming, ये केचित् whichever, क्रीडार्थाः meant for sport, उपस्कराः articles, मम my, शयनीयानि couches, यानानि chariots, अन्यानि other, यानि च all things, स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य to your attendants, देहि give, अनन्तरम् after that, ब्राह्मणानाम् to brahmins.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 30:
