output: पापनिश्चये O woman of sinful convictions, निरयगामिनि O one who would attain hell, धर्मसंयुक्ताम् endowed with righteous conduct, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, वियुक्ताम् separated from her son, कृत्वा having committed, अद्य now, कं लोसकम् what afterworld, प्राप्स्यसे will attain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
किं नावबुध्यसे क्रूरे नियतं बन्धुसंश्रयम्। ज्येष्ठं पितृसमं रामं कौसल्यायाऽत्मसम्भवम्।।2.74.13।।
output: O cruel one why do you not realise that Rama, born of Kausalya, is the eldest son and equal to my father? He is selfrestrained and a refuge to his kith and kin.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
अङगप्रत्यङगजः पुत्रो हृदयाच्चापि जायते। तस्मात्प्रियतमो मातुः प्रिया एव तु बान्धवाः।।2.74.14।।
output: A son born from every limb, big or small, and from the heart is the most beloved of all for his mother while the other relatives are only loving ones.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्यदा किल धर्मज्ञा सुरभि स्सुरसम्मता। वहमानौ ददर्शोर्व्यां पुत्रौ विगतचेतसौ।।2.74.15।।
output: It is said that once upon a time Surabhi, the divine cow, highly respected by the gods and conversant with righteous ways, beheld her two sons who fainted due to fatigue while carrying the burden of the ploughs.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तावर्धदिवसे श्रान्तौ दृष्ट्वा पुत्रौ महीतले। रुरोद पुत्रशोकेन बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा।।2.74.16।।
output: On seeing her two sons lying on earth exhausted, she wailed in distress for them with her eyes filled with tears.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
अधस्ताद्व्रजतस्तस्याः सुरराज्ञो महात्मनः। बिन्दवः पतिता गात्रे सूक्ष्मा स्सुरभिगन्धिनः।।2.74.17।।
output: The fine drops of her fragnant tears trickled down the body of the great king of the gods (Indra).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
﻿इन्द्रोऽप्यश्रुनिपातं तं स्वगात्रे पुण्यगन्धिनम्। सुरभिं मन्यते दृष्ट्वा भूयसीं तां सुरेश्वरः।।2.74.18।।
output: ﻿ सुरेश्वरः lord of the gods, इन्द्रोऽपि Indra, स्वगात्रे on his body, पुण्यगन्धिनम् of holy fragrance, तम् that, अश्रुपातम् flow of tears, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, ताम् her, भूयसीम् venerated, सुरभिम् as Kamadhenu, मन्यते thought

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
निरीक्षमाण श्शक्रस्तां ददर्श सुरभिं स्थिताम्। आकाशे विष्ठितां दीनां रुदन्तीं भृशदुःखिताम्।।2.74.19।।
output: While looking around Indra beheld Kamadhenu in intense pain stationed in the sky,   looking distressed and miserable, and wailing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
तां दृष्ट्वा शोकसन्तप्तां वज्रपाणिर्यशस्विनीम्। इन्द्रः प्राञ्जलिरुद्विग्न स्सुरराजोऽब्रवीद्वचः।।2.74.20।।
output: The king of the gods, Indra, wielder of thunderbolt, saw the renowned Kamadhenu consumed with grief. Alarmed, he said to her with palms joined in reverence:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भयं कच्छिन्न चास्मासु कुतश्चिद्विद्यते महत्। कुतोनिमत्तश्शोकस्ते ब्रूहि सर्वहितैषिणि।।2.74.21।।
output: सर्वहितैषिणि O wellwisher of all, अस्मासु for us, कुतश्चित् from any quarter, महत् great, भयम् fear, न विद्यते कच्छित् does not exist, ते your, शोकः sorrow, कुतोनिमित्तः for what  reason, ब्रूहि  speak.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
﻿एवमुक्ता तु सुरभि स्सुरराजेन धीमता। प्रत्युवाच ततो धीरा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदा।।2.74.22।।
output: ﻿ धीमता by the sagacious, सुरराजेन by Indra, king of the gods, एवम् this way, उक्ता having been uttered, धीरा calm, सुरभिः Surabhi, ततः then, वाक्य विशारदा proficient in speech, वाक्यम् these words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शान्तं पापं न वः किञ्चित्कुतश्चिदमराधिपः। अहं मग्नौ तु शोचामि स्वपुत्रौ विषमे स्थितौ।।2.74.23।। एतौ दृष्ट्वा कृशौ दीनौ सूर्यरश्मिप्रतापितौ। बाध्यमानौ बलीवर्धौ कर्षकेण सुराधिप।।2.74.24।।
output: 'God forbid, O Indra, lord of the Immortals no calamity has befallen you from any quarter. Only I am in trouble. I am weeping for these pair of bulls, my own sons who are in difficulty. When I see them scorched by the rays of the Sun, miserable, emaciated and weeping, beaten by a ploughman, I am immersed in grief'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शान्तं पापं न वः किञ्चित्कुतश्चिदमराधिपः। अहं मग्नौ तु शोचामि स्वपुत्रौ विषमे स्थितौ।।2.74.23।। एतौ दृष्ट्वा कृशौ दीनौ सूर्यरश्मिप्रतापितौ। बाध्यमानौ बलीवर्धौ कर्षकेण सुराधिप।।2.74.24।।
output: 'God forbid, O Indra, lord of the Immortals no calamity has befallen you from any quarter. Only I am in trouble. I am weeping for these pair of bulls, my own sons who are in difficulty. When I see them scorched by the rays of the Sun, miserable, emaciated and weeping, beaten by a ploughman, I am immersed in grief'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ममकायात्प्रसूतौ हि दुःखितौ भारपीडितौ। यौ दृष्ट्वा परितप्येऽहं नास्ति पुत्रसमः प्रियः।।2.74.25।।
output: अहम् I, भारपीडितौ oppressed by the burden, दुःखितौ anguished, यौ them both, दृष्ट्वा  having seen, परितप्ये excessively grieving, मम my, कायात् from the body, प्रसूतौ हि were born, पुत्रसमः equal to a son, प्रियः a beloved, नास्ति no one is there.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्याः पुत्रसहस्रैस्तु कृत्स्नं व्याप्तमिदं जगत्। तां दृष्ट्वा रुदतीं शक्रो न सुतान्मन्यते परम्।।2.74.26।।
output: यस्याः whose, पुत्रसहस्रैः by a thousand sons, इदं जगत् this world, व्याप्तम् are spread over, ताम् to her (Kamadhenu), रुदतीम् weeping, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शक्रः Indra, सुतात् more than a son, परम् great one, न not, मन्यते considers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
﻿सदाऽप्रतिमवृत्तायाः लोकधारणकाम्यया। श्रीमत्या गुणनित्याया स्स्वभावपरिचेष्टया।।2.74.27।। यस्याः पुत्रसहस्राणि साऽपि शोचति कामधुक्। किं पुनर्या विना रामं कौसल्या वर्तयिष्यति।।2.74.28।।
output: ﻿ Wishing always to nourish the worlds Kamadhenu conducts herself with an unequalled character. In accordance with her nature, she has imbibed in herself eminent virtues. She is endowed with all prosperity. In spite of her thousand sons, she is weeping thus for her two bulls, what can one say of Kausalya separated from her only son Will she be her normal self again?'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
﻿सदाऽप्रतिमवृत्तायाः लोकधारणकाम्यया। श्रीमत्या गुणनित्याया स्स्वभावपरिचेष्टया।।2.74.27।। यस्याः पुत्रसहस्राणि साऽपि शोचति कामधुक्। किं पुनर्या विना रामं कौसल्या वर्तयिष्यति।।2.74.28।।
output: ﻿ Wishing always to nourish the worlds Kamadhenu conducts herself with an unequalled character. In accordance with her nature, she has imbibed in herself eminent virtues. She is endowed with all prosperity. In spite of her thousand sons, she is weeping thus for her two bulls, what can one say of Kausalya separated from her only son Will she be her normal self again?'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
एकपुत्रा च साध्वी च विवत्सेयं त्वया कृता। तस्मात्त्वं सततं दुःखं प्रेत्य चेह च लप्स्यसे।।2.74.29।।
output: This pious lady is blessed with only one son and (now) has been rendered childless by you. Therefore, you shall experience grief in this world and hereafter.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहं ह्यपचितिं भ्रातुः पितुश्च सकलामिमाम्। वर्धनं यशसश्चापि करिष्यामि न संशयः।।2.74.30।।
output: अहम् I, भ्रातुः for my brother, पितुश्च for father, इमाम् this, सकलाम् complete, अपचितिम्   atonement for improper conduct, यशसः of fame, वर्धनम् enhancement, करिष्यामि will do, संशयः doubt, न not.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
﻿अनाययित्वा तनयं कौसल्याया महाबलम्। स्वयमेव प्रवेक्ष्यामि वनं मुनिनिषेवितम्।।2.74.31।।
output: ﻿ If I fail to bring back the mighty son of Kausalya, I shall enter the forest frequented by ascetics.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न ह्यहं पापसङ्कल्पे पापे पापं त्वया कृतम्। शक्तो धारयितुं पौरैरश्रुकण्ठै र्निरीक्षितः।।2.74.32।।
output: O vicious one, O evilintentioned one being watched by the citizens with their throats choked with tears of grief, I cannot endure the burden of the sin committed by you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा त्वमग्निं प्रविश वा स्वयं वा दण्डकान्विश। रज्जुं बधान वा कण्ठे न हि तेऽन्यत्परायणम्।।2.74.33।।
output: Jump into the fire or go to Dandaka forest or hang yourself. There is no other recourse for you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहमप्यवनीं प्राप्ते रामे सत्यपराक्रमे। कृतकृत्यो भविष्यामि विप्रवासितकल्मषः।।2.74.34।।
output: सत्यपराक्रमे having truth as his prowess, रामे Rama, अवनीम् this earth (kingdom), प्राप्ते will obtain, अहमपि I also, विप्रवासितकल्मषः free from all blemishes, कृतकृत्यः shall have my desire  accomplished, भविष्यामि shall become.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति नाग इवारण्ये तोमराङ्कुशचोदितः। पपात भुवि सङ्कृद्धो निश्श्वसन्निव पन्नगः।।2.74.35।।
output: In this way like an elephant driven by prods and goads in the forest, highly enraged Bharata hissing like a serpent dropped down on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 74:
संरक्तनेत्र श्शिथिलाम्भरस्तदा विधूतसर्वाभरणः परन्तपः। बभूव भूमौ पतितो नृपात्मजश्शचीपतेः केतुरिवोत्सवक्षये।।2.74.36।।
output: Prince Bharata, the scorcher of enemies, with bloodshot eyes, raiment in disarray, ornaments tossed about lay fallen on the ground like the banner of Indra (husband of Sachi) at the close of the festival of flaghoisting. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुस्सप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दीर्घकालात्समुत्थाय संज्ञां लब्ध्वा च वीर्यवान्। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां दीनामुद्वीक्ष्य मातरम्।।2.75.1।। सोऽमात्यमध्ये भरतो जननीमभ्यकुत्सयत्।
output: Bharata and Satrughna meet griefstricken Kausalya -- Kausalya reproaches Bharata harshly -- Bharata appeases Kausalya and curses himself -- Kausalya gets convinced of Bharata's conviction.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राज्यं न कामये जातु मन्त्रये नापि मातरम्।।2.75.2।। अभिषेकं न जानामि योऽभूद्राज्ञा समीक्षितः। विप्रकृष्टेह्यहं देशे शत्रुघ्नसहितोऽवसम्।।2.75.3।।
output: जातु at any time, राज्यम् kingdom, न कामये I do not wish, मातरम् अपि even (with) mother, न मन्त्रये consulted, यः the consecration, राज्ञा by king, समीक्षितः अभूत् has been supervised, अभिषेकम् consecration, न जानामि am not aware, अहम् I, शत्रुघ्नसहितः with Satrughna, विप्रकृष्टे in a distant, देशे country, अवसम् हि stayed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
राज्यं न कामये जातु मन्त्रये नापि मातरम्।।2.75.2।। अभिषेकं न जानामि योऽभूद्राज्ञा समीक्षितः। विप्रकृष्टेह्यहं देशे शत्रुघ्नसहितोऽवसम्।।2.75.3।।
output: Neither did I ever desire the kingdom nor did I ever consult my mother in this regard and I am not even aware of the consecration that was planned by the king for I was away in a distant country with Satrughna.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वनवासं न जानामि रामस्याहं महात्मनः। विवासनं वा सौमित्रे स्सीतायाश्च यथाऽभवत्।।2.75.4।।
output: I knew nothing of the banishment of great Rama nor did I know how Lakshmana or Sita had gone on exile.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथैव क्रोशतस्तस्य भरतस्य महात्मनः। कौसल्या शब्दमाज्ञाय सुमित्रामिदमब्रवीत्।।2.75.5।।
output: As magnanimous Bharata was wailing, Kausalya recognised his voice and said to Sumitra:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आगतः क्रूरकार्यायाः कैकेय्या भरतस्सुतः। तमहं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भरतं दीर्घदर्शिनम्।।2.75.6।।
output: क्रूरकार्यायाः of a woman of cruel deeds, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, सुतः son, भरतः Bharata, आगतः has come, दीर्घदर्शिनम् farsighted, तं भरतम् that Bharata, अहम् I, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I am wishing

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा सुमित्रां सा विवर्णा मलिना कृशा। प्रतस्थे भरतो यत्र वेपमाना विचेतना।।2.75.7।।
output: Having said so to Sumitra, Kausalya trembling and almost lifeless, emaciated, sullied and turned pallid set out for the place where Bharat was.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तु रामानुजश्चापि शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा। प्रतस्थे भरतो यत्र कौसल्याया निवेशनम्।।2.75.8।।
output: But at the same time Bharata, the younger brother of Rama accompanied by Satrughna  proceeded to the place where Kausalya resided.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत श्शत्रुघ्नभरतौ कौसल्यां प्रेक्ष्य दुःखितौ। पर्यष्वजेतां दुःखार्तां पतितां नष्टचेतसाम्।।2.75.9।। रुदन्तौ रुदतीं दुःखात्समेत्यार्यां मनस्स्विनीम्।
output: Then agonised Bharata and Satrughna, beholding that venerable, noblehearted, griefstricken, weeping Kausalya who was  almost semiconscious overcome with grief, approached her with great sorrow and hugged her.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भरतं प्रत्युवाचेदं कौसल्या भृशदुःखिता।।2.75.10।। इदं ते राज्यकामस्य राज्यं प्राप्तमकण्टकम्। संप्राप्तं बत कैकेय्या शशीघ्रं क्रूरेण कर्मणा।।2.75.11।।
output: भृशदुःखिता deeply afflicted, कौशल्या Kausalya, भरतं प्रति looking at Bharata, इदम् these words, उवाच said, राज्यकामस्य of one desirous of the kingdom, ते to you, इदम् this, अकण्टकम् without obstacles, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्तम् has been acquired, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, क्रूरेण by crooked, कर्मणा with act, शीघ्रम् quickly, सम्प्राप्तम् secured, बत alas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भरतं प्रत्युवाचेदं कौसल्या भृशदुःखिता।।2.75.10।। इदं ते राज्यकामस्य राज्यं प्राप्तमकण्टकम्। संप्राप्तं बत कैकेय्या शशीघ्रं क्रूरेण कर्मणा।।2.75.11।।
output: Looking at Bharata, the deeply afflicted Kausalya said, The kingdom which you had desired has been acquired without any obstacle. Alas Kaikeyi had quickly secured it for you  through her crooked act.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रस्थाप्य चीरवसनं पुत्रं मे वनवासिनम्। कैकेयी कं गुणं तत्र पश्यति क्रूरदर्शिनी।।2.75.12।।
output: What advantage did cruel Kaikeyi visualize in sending away my son to dwell in the forest  wearing robes of bark?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षिप्रं मामपि कैकेयी प्रस्थापयितुमर्हति। हिरण्यनाभो यत्रास्ते सुतो मे सुमहायशाः।।2.75.13।।
output: Kaikeyi should send me also without any delay to that place where my illustrious Rama with golden navel dwells.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथवा स्वयमेवाहं सुमित्रानुचरा सुखम्। अग्निहोत्रं पुरस्कृत्य प्रस्थास्ये यत्र राघवः।।2.75.14।।
output: Or else I, accompanied by Sumitra, shall go happily on my own holding the sacred fire in front to that place where Rama dwells.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कामं वा स्वयमेवाद्य तत्र मां नेतुमर्हसि। यत्रासौ पुरुषव्याघ्रः पुत्रो मे तप्यते तपः।।2.75.15।।
output: Or, you should now take me personally to that place where, my son Rama, the best among men, is performing austerities.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
इदं हि तव विस्तीर्णं धनधान्यसमाचितम्। हस्त्वश्वरथसम्पूर्णं राज्यं निर्यातितं तया।।2.75.16।।
output: This vast kingdom, with all its abundance of wealth and grain, elephants, horses and chariots has been delivered to you by her.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्यादिबहुभिर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैः सम्भर्त्सितोऽनघः। विव्यथे भरतस्तीव्रं व्रणे तुद्येव सूचिना।।2.75.17।।
output: इत्यादि like this, बहुभिः by many, क्रूरैः harsh, वाक्यैः with words, सूचिना with needle, व्रणे in the wound, तुद्येव as if by piercing, सम्भर्त्सितः reproached, अनघः sinless, भरतः Bharata, तीव्रम् intensely, विव्यथे was afflicted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पपात चरणौ तस्यास्तदा सम्भ्रान्तचेतनः। विलप्य बहुधाऽसंज्ञो लब्धसंज्ञस्ततः स्थितः।।2.75.18।।
output: तदा then, सम्भ्रान्तचेतनः with senses reeling, तस्याः her, चरणौ feet, पपात fell, बहुधा repeatedly, विलप्य lamenting, असंज्ञः unconscious, ततः then, लब्धसंज्ञः on regaining the senses, स्थितः stood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं विलपमानां तां भरतः प्राञ्जलिस्तदा। कौसल्यां प्रत्युवाचेदं शोकैर्बहुभिरावृताम्।।2.75.19।।
output: As Kausalya was lamenting in this manner, overwhelmed with deep grief, Bharata, his palms joined in reverence, replied her in these words:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
आर्ये कस्मादजानन्तं गर्हसे मामकिल्बिषम्। विपुलां च मम प्रीतिं स्थिरां जानासि राघवे।।2.75.20।।
output: O noble lady unaware (of what had happened), I am guiltless. Why do you upbraid me? You know well my profound, steadfast affection for Raghava (Rama).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
कृता शास्त्रानुगा बुद्धिर्माभूत्तस्य कदाचन। सत्यसन्ध स्सतां श्रेष्ठो यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.21।।
output: Did not the one who counselled the banishment of my noble brother who is steadfast and bound by truth and virtue, ever adhered to scriptures? (or) My noble brother (Rama), the best among the virtuous, bound to truth, is banished. Let not such thought occur at any time to one who steadfastly adheres to scriptures

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रेष्यं पापीयसां यातु सूर्यञ्च प्रतिमेहतु। हन्तु पादेन गां सुप्तां यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.22।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, Rama be cursed with the sin of undergoing servitude in the hands of most sinful of men, the sin of passing urine facing the Sun and of kicking a sleeping cow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
कारयित्वा महत्कर्म भर्ता भृत्यमनर्थकम्। अधर्मो योऽस्य सोऽस्यास्तु यस्याऽर्योऽनुमतेगतः।।2.75.23।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the demerit of unrighteousness in the same way as a master who gets a difficult work done by a servant without remuneration.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परिपालयमानस्य राज्ञो भूतानि पुयत्रवत्। ततस्नु दुह्यतां पापं यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.24।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a man  acting treacherously against a king who rules like a father and protects his subjects like his own children, acquires.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बलिषड्भागमुद्धृत्य नृपस्यारक्षतः प्रजाः। अधर्मो योऽस्य सोऽस्यास्तु यस्यार्थोऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.25।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire unrighteousness in the same way as a king who, having received one sixth of the income as tax from people does not protect them

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
संश्रुत्य च तपस्विभ्यस्सत्रे वै यज्ञदक्षिणाम्। तां विप्रलपतां पापं यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.26।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person acquires for having promised the ascetics the required offering at a sacrifice and later denies them

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधे युद्धे शस्त्रसमाकुले। मा स्म कार्षीत्सतां धर्मं यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.27।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the demerit in the same way as a person, who having gone to the battleground abundantly provided with elephants, horses, chariots and weapons fails to discharge the duty (of a fighter)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उपदिष्टं सुसूक्ष्मार्थं शास्त्रं यत्नेन धीमता। स नाशयतु दुष्टात्मा यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.28।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire demerit in the same way as an evilhearted person who forever destroys the subtle meaning of the scriptures imparted carefully by a sagacious preceptor

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
मा च तं व्यूढबाह्वंसं चन्द्रार्कसमतेजसम्। द्राक्षीद्राज्यस्थमासीनं यस्यार्योऽनुमतेगतः।।2.75.29।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be highly unfortunate like me in not being able to behold that longarmed and broadshoulderd one seated on the throne and resembling both the Sun and the Moon in radiance

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पायसं कृसरं छागं वृथा सोऽश्नातु निर्घृणः। गुरूंश्चाप्यवजानातु यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.30।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the demerit in the same way as a person, who partakes the sweet milkrice, sesamerice and goat's flesh without purpose (without invoking and offering it to the gods) and disrespects the teachers

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गाश्च स्पृशतु पादेन गुरून्परिवदेत्स्वयम्। मित्रे द्रुह्येत सोऽत्यन्तं यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.31।।
output: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः was exiled, सः that  person, पादेन with foot, गाः cows, स्पृशतु may touch (kick), स्वयम् himself, गुरून् elders, परिवदेत्  may be abused, मित्रे friend, अत्यन्तम् greately, द्रुह्येत causes offence.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विश्वासात्कथितं किञ्चित्परिवादं मिथः क्वचित्। विवृणोतु स दुष्टात्मा यस्याऽर्योऽमते गतः।।2.75.32।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, acquire the sin in the same way as a wickedminded person, who divulges the words of abuse secretly confided in him by his friends.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अकर्ता ह्यकृतज्ञश्च त्यक्ताचाऽत्मा निरपत्रपः। लोके भवतु विद्विष्टो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.33।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be hated universally as one who never helps any one, who is ungrateful, shameless and as one who has committed the sin of suicide

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुत्रैर्दारैश्च भृत्यैश्च स्वगृहे परिवारितः। स एको मृष्टमश्नातु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.34।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother  acquire the sin in the same way as one who, although surrounded by wife, children and servants, eats the delicacies all alone without sharing acquires.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अप्राप्य सदृशान् दाराननपत्यः प्रमीयताम्। अनवाप्य क्रियां धर्म्यां यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.35।।
output: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that man, सदृशान् worthy, दारान् wife, अप्राप्य without getting, अनपत्यः without begetting offspring, धर्म्याम् religious, क्रियाम् deeds, अनवाप्य without performing, प्रमीयताम् let him die.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
माऽत्मनस्सन्ततिं द्राक्षीत्स्वेषु दारेषु दुःखितः। आयुस्समग्रमप्राप्य यऽस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.36।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother live an entire life of anguish without begetting children through his wife or without seeing his own children

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राजस्त्रीबालवृद्धानां वधे यत्पापमुच्यते। भृत्यत्यागे च यत्पापं तत्पापं प्रतिपद्यताम्।।2.75.37।।
output: राजस्त्रीबालवृद्धानाम् of the king, woman, children and the aged, वधे kills, यत् पापम् whatever sin, उच्यते is mentioned in scriptures, भृत्यत्यागे च desertion of the dependents as well, यत् पापम् whatever sin, तत् (पापं) such (sin), प्रतिपद्यताम् be obtained.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लाक्षया मधुमांसेन लोहेन च विषेण च। सदैव बिभृयाद्भृत्यान्यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.38।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the same sin as one who supports his wife and children by trafficking in lac, wine, meat and metal and poison acquires

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सङ्ग्रमे समुपोढे स्म शत्रुपक्षभयङ्करे। पलायामानो वध्येत यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.39।।
output: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that man, शत्रुपक्षभयङ्करे सङ्ग्रमे in war, समुपोढे when at its peak, पलायमानः feeling, वध्येत be slain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
कपालपाणिः पृथिवीमटतां चीरसंवृतः। भिक्षमाणो यथोन्मत्तो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.40।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, wander this earth, begging alms, holding a human skull like an insane man dressed in rags

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मद्ये प्रसक्तो भवतु स्त्रीष्वक्षेषु च नित्यशः। कामक्रोधाभिभूतस्तु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.41।।
output: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that man, नित्यशः always, मद्ये in wine, स्त्रीषु in women, अक्षेषु च in dice for gambling, प्रसक्तः addicted, कामक्रोधाभिभूतः भवतु shall be prevailed over by passion and anger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मास्म धर्मे मनो भूयादधर्मं स निषेवताम्। अपात्रवर्षी भवतु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.42।।
output: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, अस्य his, मनः mind, धर्मे in virtue, मा भूयात् shall not stay, सः he, अधर्मे in unrighteousness, निषेवताम् will practise, अपात्रवर्षी भवतु shall confer charity on the unworthy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
सञ्चितान्यस्य वित्तनि विविधानि सहस्रशः। दस्युभिर्विप्रलुप्यन्तां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.43।।
output: May that man's accumulated extensive posssessions of various kinds of wealth be  snatched away by thieves in thousands of ways if he had counselled the exile of my esteemed brother

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उभे सन्ध्ये शयानस्य यत्पापं परिकल्प्यते। तच्चपापं भवेत्तस्य यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.44।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the extent of demerit fixed for a person, who sleeps at the hour of twilight of dawn and dusk

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
यदग्निदायके पापं यत्पापं गुरतल्पगे। मित्रद्रोहे च यत्पापं तत्पापं प्रतिपद्यताम्।।2.75.45।।
output: May that one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person who sets fire to human settlements, violates the preceptors's bed and betrays his friend

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
देवतानां पित्रूणां च मातापित्रोस्तथैव च। मा स्म कार्षीत्स शुश्रूषां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.46।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, acquire the sin in the same way as a person who fails to show obedience to the gods and the ancestors and to serve his parents

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतां लोकात्सतां कीर्त्या स्सञ्जुष्टात्कर्मणस्तथा। भ्रश्यतु क्षिप्रमद्यैव यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.47।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be expelled  this very moment from the world approved by virtuous men, from their renown and from their (noble) actions

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अपास्य मातृशुश्रूषामनर्थे सोऽवतिष्ठताम्। दीर्घबाहुर्महावक्षा: यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.48।।
output: दीर्घबाहुः longarmed, महावक्षाः broadchested, आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that person, मातृशुश्रूषाम् ministration to mother, अपास्य abdicating, अनर्थे without purpose, अवतिष्ठताम् shall remain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
बहुपुत्रो दरिद्रश्च ज्वररोगसमन्वितः। स भूयात्सतत क्लेशी यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.49।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be always miserable with many sons, poverty and fever and disease

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
आशामाशंसमानानां दीनानामूर्ध्वचक्षुषाम्। अर्थिनां वितथां कुर्याद्यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.50।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person disappoints who miserable mendicants seeking alms and looking up to him for help

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
मायया रमतां नित्यं परुषः पिशुनोऽशुचिः। राज्ञो भीतस्त्वधर्मात्मा यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.51।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person, who is abusive, niggardly, impure, unrighteous and always afraid of being caught by the king, and lives by cheating others, acquires

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋतुस्नातां सतीं भार्यामृतुकालानुरोधिनीम्। अतिवर्तेत दुष्टात्मा यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.52।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a wickedminded person who neglects his chaste wife observing the menstrual period unfavourable for conception and had bathed after menstruation  acquires

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सधर्मदारान्परित्यज्य परदारान्निषेवताम्। त्यक्तधर्मरतिर्मूढो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.53।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a foolish person who abandons righteous conduct and  forsakes his rightfully married wife and resorts to other man's wife acquires

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विप्रलुप्तप्रजातस्य दुष्कृतं ब्राह्मणस्य यत्। तदेव प्रतिपद्येत यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.54।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the same sin like that of a lowbred brahmin who commits an irreversible sin acquires

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पानीयदूषके पापं तथैव विषदायके। यत्तदेकस्स लभतां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.55।।
output: May the sin of polluting drinking water and administering poison to others be put together and be incurred by the man who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्राह्मणायोद्यतां पूजां विहन्तु कलुषेन्द्रियः। बालवत्सां च गां दोग्धु यस्यार्यो ऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.56।।
output: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person with befouled senses disturbs the offerings of worship kept ready for a brahmin and milks the cow having a young calf acquires.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तुर्ष्णार्तं सति पानीये विप्रलम्भेन योजयेत्। लभेत तस्य यत्पापं यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.57।।
output: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, (सः that person), पानीये water, सति existing, तृष्णार्तम् thirsty one, विप्रलम्भेन by deceipt, योजयेत् arranges, तस्य to him, यत् पापम् whatever sin, लभेत will result.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
भक्त्या विवदमानेषु मार्गमाश्रित्य पश्यतः। तस्य पापेन युज्येत यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.58।।
output: May that one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person acquires while giving onesided judgement between divided religious disputants

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
विहीनां पतिपुत्राभ्यां कौसल्यां पार्थिवात्मजः। एवमाश्वासयन्नेव दुःखार्तो निपपात ह।।2.75.59।।
output: While thus appeasing Kausalya deprived of her husband and son, Bharata, filled with grief, fell down at her feet.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 75:
तथा तु शपथैः कष्टै श्शपमानमचेतनम्। भरतं शोकसन्तप्तं कौसल्या वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.75.60।।
output: Kausalya said these words to Bharata who fell unconscious, consumed with grief, while swearing on painful oaths.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मम दुःखमिदं पुत्र भूयस्समुपजायते। शपथै श्शपमानो हि प्राणानुपरुणत्सि मे।।2.75.61।।
output: पुत्र son, मम to me, इदं दुःखम् this suffering, भूयः still more, समुपजायते is growing, शपथैः by oaths, शपमानः swearing, मे my, प्राणान् life, उपरुणत्सि हि you are obstructing (choking).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिष्ट्या न चलितो धर्मादात्मा ते सहलक्ष्मणः। वत्स सत्यप्रतिज्ञो ते सतां लोकमवाप्स्यसि।।2.75.62।।
output: O dear child, fortunately your mind is unswerved from righteousness. You being truthful to your promise shall attain the world of virtuous men along with Lakshmana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्युक्त्वा चाङ्कमानीय भरतं भ्रातृवत्सलम्। परिष्वज्य महाबाहुं रुरोद भृशदुःखिता।।2.75.63।।
output: भ्रातृवत्सलम् a man affectionate towards his brothr, भरतम् addressing Bharata, इति thus , उक्त्वा having said, अङ्कम् on her lap, आनीय drawing into, महाबाहुम् mightyarmed one, परिष्वज्य  hugged, भृशदुःखिता with extreme grief, रुरोद cried out.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं विलपमानस्य दुःखार्तस्य महात्मनः। मोहाच्च शोकसम्रोधाद्बभूव लुलितं मनः।।2.75.64।।
output: Afflicted by sorrow and lamenting thus, great Bharata's mind became unsteady owing to swooning and  besieged by grief.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमेवं शोकसन्तप्तं भरतं कैकयी सुतम्। उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठो वसिष्ठ श्श्रेष्ठवागृषिः।।2.76.1।।
output: Bharata performs funeral rites of king Dasaratha on the bank of Sarayu.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अलं शोकेन भद्रं ते राजपुत्र महायशः। प्राप्तकालं नरपतेः कुरु संयानमुत्तमम्।।2.76.2।।
output: O prince of great renown, may God bless you It is not proper on your part to grieve. It is time to perform the funeral rites of the king in the best way possible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वसिष्ठस्य वच श्शृत्वा भरतो धारणां गतः। प्रेतकार्याणि सर्वाणि कारयामास धर्मवित्।।2.76.3।।
output: धर्मवित् knower of his duty, भरतः Bharata, वसिष्ठस्य Vasistha's, वचः words, श्रूत्वा on hearing, धारणाम् steadiness, गतः regained, सर्वाणि all, प्रेतकार्यणि funeral rites, कारयामास began the performance.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उद्धृतं तैलसंरोधात्सतु भूमौ निवेशितम्। आपीतवर्णवदनं प्रसुप्तमिव भूमिपम्।।2.76.4।। संवेश्य शयने चाग्य्रे नानारत्नपरिष्कृते। ततो दशरथं पुत्रो विललाप सुदुःखितः।।2.76.5।।
output: The mortal remains of king Dasaratha, protector of the earth, was taken out of the oil container and placed on the floor. His pale, yellow face appeared as if he was asleep. Thereafter it was laid upon a magnificent couch adorned with every kind of gem. On seeing Dasaratha in that state  Bharata lamented in extreme distress.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उद्धृतं तैलसंरोधात्सतु भूमौ निवेशितम्। आपीतवर्णवदनं प्रसुप्तमिव भूमिपम्।।2.76.4।। संवेश्य शयने चाग्य्रे नानारत्नपरिष्कृते। ततो दशरथं पुत्रो विललाप सुदुःखितः।।2.76.5।।
output: सः पुत्रः that son Bharata, तैलसंरोधात् from the oil container, उद्धृतम् raised, भूमौ on the floor, निवेशितम् placed, आपीतवर्णवदनम् with a pale yellowcoloured face, प्रसुप्तमिव as if sleeping, भूमिपम् protector of the earth, दशरथम् Dasaratha, नानारत्न परिष्कृते adorned with every kind of gem, अग्य्रे on a magnificient, शयने on the couch, संवेश्य ततः having placed then, सुदुःखितः  in extreme distress, विललाप lamented.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किं ते व्यवसितं राजन् प्रोषिते मय्यनागते। विवास्य रामं धर्मज्ञं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्।।2.76.6।।
output: राजन् O king, प्रोषिते when I was away from home, मयि अनागते before I could return, धर्मज्ञम्   righteous one, रामम् Rama, महाबलम् valiant, लक्ष्मणं च Lakshmana, विवास्य banished, ते  you, किम् what, व्यवसितम् was resolved?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्व यास्यसि महाराज हित्वेमं दुःखितं जनम्। हीनं पुरुषसिंहेन रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।।2.76.7।।
output: O great king Where will you go leaving me who is bewailing for having been left by Rama, the lion among men and a man of pious deeds?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 76:
योगक्षेमं तु ते राजन् कोऽस्मिन्कल्पयिता पुरे त्वयि प्रयाते स्वस्तात रामे च वनमाश्रिते।।2.76.8।।
output: O king O father you have gone to heaven and Rama has taken shelter in the forest now. Who will take care of the welfare and security of your city?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विधवा पृथिवी राजन् स्त्वया हीना न राजते। हीनचन्द्रेव रजनी नगरी प्रतिभाति मा।।2.76.9।।
output: O king bereft of you, the earth (kingdom) is widowed and has lost its radiance. The city appears to me like a moonless night.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 76:
एवं विलपमानं तं भरतं दीनमानसम्। अब्रवीद्वचनं भूयो वसिष्ठस्तु महामुनिः।।2.76.10।।
output: To Bharata who was thus lamenting with a dejected mind, the great ascetic Vasistha once again said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 76:
प्रेतकार्याणि यान्यस्य कर्तव्यानि विशां पतेः। तान्यव्यग्रं महाबाहो क्रियान्तामविचारितम्।।2.76.11।।
output: O mightyarmed prince, the funeral rites that are required to be performed for the departed king ought to be done carefully without any shortcomings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथेति भरतो वाक्यं वसिष्ठस्याभिपूज्य तत्। ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यान् स्त्वरयामास सर्वशः।।2.76.12।।
output: Bharata said, 'Be it so' in obedience to Vasistha, who hastened up the learned Vedic scholars, family priests and preceptors to perform various rites.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ये त्वग्नयो नरेन्द्रेस्य चाग्न्यगाराद्बहिष्कृताः। ऋत्विग्भिर्याजकैश्चैव ते आह्रियन्त यथाविधि।।2.76.13।।
output: नरेन्द्रस्य king's, ये अग्नयः the fire, अग्न्यगारात् from firesanctuary, बहिष्कृताः have been put outside, ते they, यथाविधि in accordance with the ritual precepts, ऋत्विग्भि: by Vedic priests, याजकैश्चैव by sacrificial attendants, आह्रियन्त were withdrawn.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शिबिकायामथा़ऽरोप्य राजानं गतचेतसम्। बाष्पकण्ठा विमनसस्तमूहुः परिचारकाः।।2.76.14।।
output: Thereafter the attendants raised the mortal remains of the deceased king onto a litter, with dejected minds, throats choked with tears and carried him away.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हिरण्यं च सुवर्णं च वासांसि विविधानि च। प्रकिरन्तो जना मार्गं नृपतेरग्रतो ययुः।।2.76.15।।
output: The people went ahead of the king's body strewing on the way gold of brilliant colour and different kinds of garments.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चन्दनागरुनिर्यासान् सरलं पद्मकं तथा। देवदारूणि चाहृत्य क्षेपयन्ति तथापरे।।2.76.16।। गन्धानुच्चावचांश्चान्यां स्तत्र गत्वाथ भूमिपम्। तत्र संवेशयामासुश्चितामध्ये तमृत्विजः।।2.76.17।।
output: In this way others brought sandal, agaru and fragrant gum gugul, the resin of balsa tree and woods of sarala, padmaka and devadaru and built a pyre and strew many kinds of fragrant substances on it. Thereafter the priests laid the mortal remains of the king in the centre of the pyre.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चन्दनागरुनिर्यासान् सरलं पद्मकं तथा। देवदारूणि चाहृत्य क्षेपयन्ति तथापरे।।2.76.16।। गन्धानुच्चावचांश्चान्यां स्तत्र गत्वाथ भूमिपम्। तत्र संवेशयामासुश्चितामध्ये तमृत्विजः।।2.76.17।।
output: In this way others brought sandal, agaru and fragrant gum gugul, the resin of balsa tree and woods of sarala, padmaka and devadaru and built a pyre and strew many kinds of fragrant substances on it. Thereafter the priests laid the mortal remains of the king in the centre of the pyre.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 76:
तदा हुताशनं हुत्वा जेपुस्तस्य तदृत्विजः। जगुश्च ते यथाशास्त्र तत्र सामानि सामगाः।।2.76.18।।
output: Then the priests offering oblations to the king's fire, intoned prayers. The reciters of Sama Veda sang the hymns in accordance with the sacred scriptures.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शिबिकाभिश्च यानैश्च यथार्हं तस्य योषितः। नगरा न्निर्ययुस्तत्र वृद्धैः परिवृता स्तदा।।2.76.19।।
output: तदा then, तस्य his (the king's), योषितः wives, वृद्धैः with aged guards, परिवृताः surrounded by, यथार्हम्  according to their rank, शिबिकाभिश्च in palanquins, यानैश्च in other carriages, नगरात् from the city, तत्र to that place, निर्ययुः departed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 76:
प्रसव्यं चापि तं चकुः ऋत्विजोऽग्निचितं नृपम्। स्त्रियश्च शोकसन्तप्ताः कौसल्याप्रमुखास्तदा।।2.76.20।।
output: Then the priests and other women led by Kausalya who was consumed with grief circumambulated the pyre in the reverse direction as the king's body was engulfed by flames.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्रौञ्चीनामिव नारीणां निनादस्तत्र शुश्रुवे। आर्तानां करुणं काले क्रोशन्तीनां सहस्रशः।।2.76.21।।
output: तत्र काले at that time, आर्तानाम् of the distressed persons, करुणम् piteously, क्रोशन्तीनाम् of those women crying, सहस्रशः in thousands, नारीणाम् women's, निनादः sound, क्रौञ्चीनामिव like the sound of the kraunchas (birds), शुश्रुवे was heard.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 76:
ततो रुदन्त्यो विवशाविलप्य च पुनः पुनः। यानेभ्यस्सरयूतीरमवतेरुर्वराङ्गनाः।।2.76.22।।
output: Thereafter, the courtesans weeping uncontrollably and, lamenting again and again, alighted from carriages on the bank of the river Sarayu.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृत्वोदकं ते भरतेन सार्धं नृपाङ्गना मन्त्रिपुरोहिता श्च। पुरंप्रविश्याश्रुपरीतनेत्राः भूमौ दशाहं व्यनयन्त दुःखम्।।2.76.23।।
output: नृपाङ्गनाः wives of the king, ते they, मन्त्रिपुरोहिताश्च counsellors and priests, भरतेन सार्धम् along with Bharata, उदकम् waterlibations, कृत्वा having offered, अश्रुपरीतनेत्राः with their eyes filled with tears, पुरम् the city, प्रविश्य having reentered, दशाहम् ten days, भूमौ on the floor, दु:खम् their mourning period, व्यनयन्त spent.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
ततो दशाहेऽतिगते कृतशौचो नृपात्मजः। द्वादशेऽहनि सम्प्राप्ते श्राद्धकर्माण्यकारयत्।।2.77.1।।
output: Having observed the tenday mourning period, Bharata purified himself on the twelfth day and got the shraddha rites (obsequies) performed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ रत्नं धनमन्नं च पुष्कलम्। वासांसि च महार्हाणि रत्नानि विविधानि च।।2.77.2।।
output: During the shraddha ceremony (obsequies) Bharata bestowed on brahmins precious stones, wealth, large quantities of rice, highly valuable garments and various gems.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बास्तिकं बहु शुक्लं च गाश्चापि शतशस्तथा। दासीदासं च यानं च वेश्मानि सुमहान्ति च।।2.77.3।। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ पुत्रो राज्ञस्तस्यौर्ध्वदैहिकम्।
output: पुत्रः son of Dasaratha, तस्य that, राज्ञः king's, और्ध्वदैहिकम् rites pertaining to the other world, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, बहु many, शुक्लम् white in colour, बास्तिकम् of goats, तथा also, शतशः in hundreds, गाश्चापि even cows, दासी दासं च male and female servants, यानं च carriages, सुमहान्ति spacious, वेश्मानि च houses, ददौ gave.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
ततः प्रभातसमये दिवसेऽथ त्रयोदशे।।2.77.4।। विललाप महाबाहुर्भरत श्शोकमूर्छितः। शब्दापिहितकण्ठस्तु शोधनार्थमुपागतः।।2.77.5।। चितामूले पितुर्वाक्यमिदमाह सुदुःखितः।
output: Thereafter at the hour of dawn on the thirteenth day mightyarmed Bharata visited the cemetery to perform the purificatory ceremony. Approaching the place of the funeral pyre of his father, he lamented in the intensity of grief:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
ततः प्रभातसमये दिवसेऽथ त्रयोदशे।।2.77.4।। विललाप महाबाहुर्भरत श्शोकमूर्छितः। शब्दापिहितकण्ठस्तु शोधनार्थमुपागतः।।2.77.5।। चितामूले पितुर्वाक्यमिदमाह सुदुःखितः।
output: Thereafter at the hour of dawn on the thirteenth day mightyarmed Bharata visited the cemetery to perform the purificatory ceremony. Approaching the place of the funeral pyre of his father, he lamented in the intensity of grief:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
तात यस्मिन्निसृष्टोऽहं त्वया भ्रातरि राघवे।।2.77.6।। तस्मिन्वनं प्रव्रजिते शून्ये त्यक्तोऽस्म्यहं त्वया।
output: O dear father, my brother Rama to whom you have entrusted me has been sent to the forest now and I am  left in a vacuum.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
यस्या गतिरनाथायाः पुत्रः प्रवाजितो वनम्। तामम्बां तात कौसल्यां त्यक्त्वा त्वं क्व गतो नृप।।2.77.7।।
output: Where have you gone, my king my father, forsaking mother Kausalya who is without a protector and whose only support Rama, her son has been sent away to the forest?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्ट्वा भस्मारुणं तच्च दग्धास्थि स्थानमण्डलम्।।2.77.8।। पितु श्शरीरनिर्वाणं निष्टनन्विषसाद सः।
output: Having seen the circular place, looking reddishbrown with burnt bones and ashes, where his father's body was consumed by fire, Bharata started crying aloud in deep despondency.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तु दृष्ट्वा रुदन् दीनः पपात धरणीतले।।2.77.9।। उत्थाप्यमानश्शक्रस्य यन्त्रध्वज इव च्युतः।
output: On seeing the cremation ground desolate Bharata collapsed sobbing on the ground like a fastened flag staff of Indra, which fell as it was being raised.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अभिपेतुस्ततस्सर्वे तस्यामात्याश्शुचिव्रतम्।।2.77.10।। अन्तकाले निपतितं ययातिमृषयो यथा।
output: ततः thereafter, सर्वे all, तस्य अमात्याः his counsellors, शुचिव्रतम् a man of pious vows, अन्तकाले at the final hour, निपतितम् fallen down, ययातिम् Yayati, ऋषयो यथा like the ascetics, अभिपेतुः ran towards him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शत्रुघ्न श्चापि भरतं दृष्ट्वा शोकम् परिप्लुतः।।2.77.11।। विसंज्ञो न्यपतद्भूमौ भूमिपालमनुस्मरन्।
output: Beholding Bharata, Satrughna also plunged in grief remembering the king, and fell unconscious on the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उन्मत्त इव निश्चेता विललाप सुदुःखितः।।2.77.12।। स्मृत्वा पितुर्गुणाङ्गानि तानि तानि तथा तथा।
output: Recollecting the many virtues of his father again and again, like a madman, Satrughna, mentally unsteady, lamented in profound sorrow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
मन्थराप्रभवस्तीव्रः कैकेयीग्राहसङ्कुलः।।2.77.13।। वरदानमयोऽक्षोभ्योऽमञ्जयच्छोकसागरः।
output: With Manthara as the source, Kaikeyi as a crocodile, this terrible sea of sorrow which has submerged all of us lies unruffled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुकुमारं च बालं च सततं लालितं त्वया।।2.77.14।। क्व तात भरतं हित्वा विलपन्तं गतो भवान्।
output: Where have you gone dear father, leaving the lamenting Bharata, so young and tender, who was always your darling?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ननु भोज्येषु पानेषु वस्त्रेष्वाभरणेषु च।।2.77.15।। प्रवारयसि नस्सर्वान् तन्नः कोऽन्यः करिष्यति।
output: भोज्येषु in delicious food, पानेषु in drinks, वस्त्रेषु in garments, आभरणेषु च in ornaments, सः सर्वान् all of us, प्रवारयसि ननु used to make us choose, तत् that, नः for us, अन्यः some other, कः who, करिष्यति will do?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
अवदारणकाले तु पृथिवी नावदीर्यते।।2.77.16।। या विहीना त्वया राज्ञा धर्मज्ञेन महात्मना।
output: You are a righteous and mighty king and without you, this earth would have been broken into pieces. But it does not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पितरि स्वर्गमापन्ने रामे चारण्यमाश्रिते।।2.77.17।। किं मे जीवितसामर्थ्यं प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्।
output: पितरि when father, स्वर्गम् heaven, आपन्ने had ascended, रामे च when Rama, अरण्यम् the forest, आश्रिते had taken refuge, मे to me, जीवितसामर्थ्यम् strength to live, किम् what is there, हुताशनम् blazing fire, प्रवेक्ष्यामि I will enter.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
हीनो भ्रात्रा च पित्रा च शून्यामिक्ष्वाकुपालिताम्।।2.77.18।। अयोध्यां न प्रवेक्ष्यामि प्रवेक्ष्यामि तपोवनम्।
output: Devoid of my father and brother, I will not return to empty Ayodhya that was once ruled by the Ikshvakus. I will enter the grove of asceticism .

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तयोर्विलपितं श्रुत्वा व्यसनं चान्ववेक्ष्य तत्।।2.77.19।। भृशमार्ततरा भूयस्सर्वएवानुगामिनः।
output: तयोः of both of them, विलपितम् lamentations, श्रुत्वा having heard, तत् that, व्यसनम् of calamity, अन्ववेक्ष्य reflecting, सर्वे all, अनुगामिनः attendants, भूयः again, भृशम् extremely, आर्ततराः become more afflicted.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 77:
ततो विषण्णौ श्रान्तौ च शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ।।2.77.20।। धरण्यां संव्यवेष्टेतां भग्नशृङ्गाविवर्षभौ।
output: Thereafter, both Satrughna and Bharata, dejected and exhausted, lay writhing on the  floor like two bulls with their horns broken.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः प्रकृतिमान्वैद्यः पितुरेषां पुरोहितः।।2.77.21।। वसिष्ठो भरतं वाक्यमुत्थाप्य तमुवाच ह।
output: ततः then, प्रकृतिमान् of composed character, वैद्यः learned, एषाम् their, पितुः father's, पुरोहितः priest, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, तम् भरतम् that Bharata, उत्थाप्य having raised, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्रयोदशोऽयं दिवसः पितुर्वृत्तस्य ते विभो।।2.77.22।। सावशेषास्थिनिचये किमिह त्वं विलम्भसे।
output: O lord, this is the thirteenth day since the death of your father. The heap of bones and ashes still remain on the pyre. Why this delay on your part?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्रीणि द्वन्द्वानि भूतेषु प्रवृत्तान्यविशेषतः।।2.77.23।। तेषु चापरिहार्येषु नैवं भवितुमर्हसि।
output: त्रीणि three, द्वन्द्वानि dualities, भूतेषु in living beings, अविशेषतः without exception, प्रवृत्तानि  are applicable, तेषु they, अपरिहार्येषु cannot be eschewed, एवम् भवितुम् to become sorrowful, नार्हसि it does not behove you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुमन्त्रश्चापि शत्रुघ्नमुत्थाप्याभिप्रसाद्य च।।2.77.24।। श्रावयामास तत्त्वज्ञ स्सर्वभूतभवाभवम्।
output: The knower of reality Sumantra helped Satrughna to rise, after having consoled him, imparted him the truth about the inevitability of birth and death.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्थितौ च नरव्याघ्रौ प्रकाशेते यशस्विनौ।।2.77.25।। वर्षातपपरिक्लिनौ पृथगिन्द्रध्वजाविव।
output: Having risen from the earth both the illustrious tigers among men, Bharata and Satrughna looked  faded and weather beaten like the banners of Indra that had faded under the Sun and rain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अश्रूणि परिमृद्नन्तौ रक्ताक्षौ दीनभाषिणौ। अमात्यास्त्वरयन्ति स्म तनयौ चापराः क्रियाः।।2.77.26।।
output: The counsellors hastened up both the sons, who were wiping away the tears and speaking with blodshot eyes, to complete the remaining part of  the funeral rites. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyseventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ यात्रां समीहन्तं शत्रुघ्नो लक्ष्मणानुजः। भरतं शोकसन्तप्तमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.78.1।।
output: While Bharata looks at Manthara furiously, Satrughna drags her and throws her down -- Kaikeyi pleads for mercy and pacifies Manthara.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गतिर्य स्सर्वभूतानां दुःखे किं पुनरात्मनः। स राम स्सत्त्वसम्पन्नः स्त्रिया प्रव्राजितो वनम्।।2.78.2।।
output: Couldn't the mighty Rama who is the ultimate refuge of all beings protect himself in his own distress? That Rama has been exiled to the forest by a woman.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
बलवान्वीर्यसम्पन्नो लक्ष्मणो नाम योऽप्यसौ। किं न मोचयते रामं कृत्वा स्म पितृनिग्रहम्।।2.78.3।।
output: And why did not Lakshmana who is strong and powerful release Rama from exile by restraining our father?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
पूर्वमेव तु निग्राह्य स्समवेक्ष्य नयानयौ। उत्पथं यस्समारूढो राजा नार्या वशं गतः।।2.78.4।।
output: In the first place, the king could have restrained himself by reflecting on whether the course of action adopted by him under the influence of a woman was just or unjust.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
इति सम्भाषमाणे तु शत्रुघ्ने लक्ष्मणानुजे। प्राग्द्वारेऽभूत्तदा कुब्जा सर्वाभरणभूषिता।।2.78.5।।
output: While Satrughna, brother of Lakshmana was conversing thus, the hunchback Manthara decorated with all kinds of ornaments arrived at the entrance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
लिप्ता चन्दनसारेण राजवस्त्राणि बिभ्रती। विविधं विविधै स्तैस्तैर्भूषणैश्च विभूषिता।।2.78.6।।
output: She had besmeared herself with the essence of sandal, had put on royal garments and adorned herself in many ways with every kind of ornament.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मेखलादामभिश्चित्रैरन्यैश्च शुभभूषणैः। बभासे बहुभिर्बद्धा रज्जुबद्धेव वानरी।।2.78.7।।
output: Tied with colourful girdle strings and wearing many other auspicious ornaments, she looked like a female monkey tied with a rope.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
तां समीक्ष्य तदा द्वास्स्थास्सुभृशं पापकारिणीम्। गृहीत्वाऽकरुणां कुब्जां शत्रुघ्नाय न्यवेदयन्।।2.78.8।।
output: Seeing the hunchback, doer of many sinful deeds, the gatekeepers caught hold of her and informed Satrughna.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
यस्याः कृते वने रामो न्यस्तदेहश्च वः पिता। सेयं पापा नृशंसा च तस्याः कुरु यथामति।।2.78.9।।
output: Here is that sinful, cruel woman on whose account Rama is in the forest and your father has forsaken his body. Do with her as it pleases you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
शत्रुघ्नश्च तदाज्ञाय वचनं भृशदुःखितः। अन्तःपुरचरान्सर्वानित्युवाच धृत व्रतः।।2.78.10।।
output: Intensely grieved to hear those words, Satrughna who was steadfast in his vows said to the inmates of the inner apartment:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तीव्रमुत्पादितं दुःखं भ्रात्रूणां मे तथा पितुः। यया सेयं नृशंसस्य कर्मणः फलमश्नुताम्।।2.78.11।।
output: यया by whom, भ्रात्रूणाम् of our brothers, मे my, पितुः of father, तीव्रम् intense, दुःखम् sorrow, उत्पादितम् has been caused, सा इयम् that she, नृशंसस्य of a malicious, कर्मणः actions, फलम्  fruits, अश्नुताम् let her reap.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वा तु तेनाशु सखीजनसमावृता। गृहीता बलवत्कुब्जा सा तद्गृहमनादयत्।।2.78.12।।
output: एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having said, आशु quickly, तेन by him, बलवत् forcibly, गृहीता  caught hold of, सखीजन समावृता surrounded by her companions, सा कुब्जा that hunchback, तत् गृहम् that house, अनादयत् reverberated with her cries.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत स्सुभृशसन्तप्तस्तस्या स्सर्व स्सखीजनः। क्रुद्धमाज्ञाय शत्रुघ्नं विपलायत सर्वशः।।2.78.13।।
output: Perceiving the enraged Satrughna all her companions shook in terror and fled in different directions.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
आमन्त्रयत कृत्स्न श्च तस्या स्सर्व स्सखीजनः। यथाऽयं समुपक्रान्तो निश्शेषां नः करिष्यति।।2.78.14।।
output: All her companions conversed among themselves. The way he began, it looks he will finish all of us.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सानुक्रोशां वदान्यां च धर्मज्ञां च यशस्विनीम्। कौसल्यां शरणं याम सा हि नोऽस्तु ध्रुवा गतिः।।2.78.15।।
output: Let us seek refuge under the illustrious Kausalya, who is compassionate, generous,  and knower of righteousness. She is our sure saviour.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स च रोषेण ताम्राक्ष श्शत्रुघ्न श्शत्रुतापनः। विचकर्ष तदा कुब्जां क्रोशन्तीं धरणीतले।।2.78.16।।
output: रोषेण in fury, ताम्राक्षः a man with blodshot eyes, शत्रुतापनः scorcher of enemies, सः शत्रुघ्नः that Satrughna, तदा then, क्रोशन्तीम् shrieking, कुब्जाम् hunchback, धरणीतले on the ground, विचकर्ष dragged.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्या ह्याकृष्यमाणाया मन्थराया स्ततस्ततः। चित्रं बहुविधं भाण्डं पृथिव्यां तद्व्यशीर्यत।।2.78.17।।
output: While Manthara was being dragged by Satrughna, the collection of ornaments of many colours and of various kinds worn by her were broken and  scattered here and there all over the ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेन भाण्डेन संस्तीर्णं श्रीमद्राजनिवेशनम्। अशोभत तदा भूयः शारदं गगनं यथा।।2.78.18।।
output: तेन by that, भाण्डेन with the collection of ornaments, संस्तीर्णम् strewn on the ground, श्रीमद्राजनिवेशनम् the resplendent royal palace, तदा then, शारदम् autumnal, गगनं यथा like the sky, भूयः greatly, अशोभत shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
स बली बलवत्क्रोधाद्गृहीत्वा पुरुषर्षभः। कैकेयीमभिनिर्भर्त्स्य बभाषे परुषं वचः।।2.78.19।।
output: The mighty and the best of men Satrughna seized with fury, forcibly caught hold of that hunchback and censured Kaikeyi with harsh words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
तैर्वाक्यैः परुषैर्दुःखैः कैकेयी भृशदुःखिता। शत्रुघ्नभयसन्त्रस्ता पुत्रं शरणमागता।।2.78.20।।
output: Kaikeyi, deeply distressed at those harsh and grievous words was afraid of Satrughna and sought the protection of her son Bharata.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं प्रेक्ष्य भरतः क्रुद्धं शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रवीत्। अवध्या स्सर्वभूतानां प्रमदाः क्षम्यतामिति।।2.78.21।।
output: Bharata, addressing the enraged Satrughna said Of all beings a lady is not to be killed.  Pardon her.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हन्यामहमिमां पापां कैकेयीं दुष्टचारिणीम्। यदि मां धार्मिको रामो नासूयेन्मातृघातकम्।।2.78.22।।
output: धार्मिकः righteous, रामः Rama, मातृघातकम् slayer of mother, माम् me, न असूयेद्यदि if he were not to accuse me, दुष्टचारिणीम् a woman of wicked deeds, पापाम् sinful, इमां कैकेयीम् this Kaikeyi, अहम् I, हन्याम् would have killed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमामपि हतां कुब्जां यदि जानाति राघवः। त्वां च मां च हि धर्मात्मा नाभिभाषिष्यते ध्रुवम्।।2.78.23।।
output: धर्मात्मा righteous, राघवः Rama, इमाम् this, कुब्जाम् अपि hunchback also, हताम् as slain, जानाति यदि if he comes to know, ध्रुवम् surely, त्वां च you, मां च हि me also, नाभिभाषिष्यते will never talk (to us).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
भरतस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नो लक्ष्मणानुजः। न्यवर्तत ततो रोषात्तां मुमोच च मन्थराम्।।2.78.24।।
output: Hearing the words of Bharata, Satrughna, the younger brother of Lakshmana restrained his fury and also released Manthara.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
सा पादमूले कैकेय्या मन्थरा निपपात ह। निश्श्वसन्ती सुदुःखार्ता कृपणं विललाप च।।2.78.25।।
output: Manthara, tormented with grief, fell at the feet of Kaikeyi and began heaving deep sighs.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 78:
शत्रुघ्नविक्षेपविमूढसंज्ञां समीक्ष्य कुब्जां भरतस्य माता। शनैस्समाश्वासयदार्तरूपां क्रौञ्चीं विलग्नामिव वीक्षमाणाम्।।2.78.26।।
output: . Seeing the hunchback thrown down by Satrughna and lying senseless and anguished like a female krauncha bird caught in a net looking in different directions, Kaikeyi gently soothed her. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyeighth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः प्रभातसमये दिवसेऽथ चतुर्दशे। समेत्य राजकर्तारो भरतं वाक्यमब्रुवन्।।2.79.1।।
output: Bharata is asked to accept the throne -- orders construction of road into the forest -- gets ready to bring back Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 79:
गतो दशरथस्स्वर्गं यो नो गुरुतरो गुरुः। रामं प्रव्राज्य वै ज्येष्ठं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्।।2.79.2।।
output: Dasaratha, who was our most revered master and preceptor, having exiled his eldest son Rama and mighty Lakshmana, ascended heaven.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वमद्य भव नो राजा राजपुत्र महायशः। सङ्गत्या नापराध्नोति राज्यमेतदनायकम्।।2.79.3।।
output: महायशः O  illustrious one, राजपुत्र O king's son (prince), अद्य now, त्वम् you, नः for us, राजा  भव be king, अनायकम् without a leader, एतत् राज्यम् this kingdom, सङ्गत्या by association, नापराध्नोति has not comitted any offence.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 79:
अभिषेचनिकं सर्वमिदमादाय राघव। प्रतीक्षते त्वां स्वजनश्श्रेणयश्च नृपात्मज।।2.79.4।।
output: O prince of the Raghu race (Bharata), your subjects and guilds of traders, artisans, etc, have procured necessary materials for your consecration, and  await you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 79:
राज्यं गृहाण भरत पितृपैतामहं ध्रुवम्। अभिषेचय चात्मानं पाहि चास्मान्नरर्षभ।।2.79.5।।
output: O best among men, inherit this stable kingdom of your ancestors, get yourself consecrated and save us.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 79:
अभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं कृत्वा सर्वं प्रदक्षिणम्। भरतस्तं जनं सर्वं प्रत्युवाच धृतव्रतः।।2.79.6।।
output: Bharata, firm in vows, circumambulated all the articles procured in connection with consecration, and replied them as follows:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ज्येष्ठस्य राजता नित्यमुचिता हि कुलस्य नः। नैवं भवन्तो मां वक्तुमर्हन्ति कुशला जनाः।।2.79.7।।
output: नित्यम् always, नः our, कुलस्य race, ज्येष्ठस्य the eldest one, राजता kingship, उचिता हि is befitting (tradition) indeed, कुशलाः intelligent, जनाः people, भवन्तः all of you, माम् me, एवम् in this way, वक्तुम् to tell, न अर्हन्ति does not behove.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामः पूर्वो हि नो भ्राता भविष्यति महीपतिः। अहं त्वरण्ये वत्स्यामि वर्षाणि नव पञ्च च।।2.79.8।।
output: Our eldest brother, Rama shall become king. As for me, I shall dwell in the forest for fourteen years.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
युज्यतां महती सेना चतुरङ्गमहाबला। आनयिष्याम्यहं ज्येष्ठं भ्रातरं राघवं वनात्।।2.79.9।।
output: चतुरङ्गमहाबला powerful army of four divisions, महती great, सेना army, युज्यताम् be  marshalled, अहम् I, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, भ्रातरम् brother, राघवम् Rama, वनात् from the forest, आनयिष्यामि I will bring back.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अभिषेचनिकं चैव सर्वमेतदुपस्कृतम्। पुरस्कृत्य गमिष्यामि रामहेतोर्वनं प्रति।।2.79.10।।
output: एतत् उपस्कृतम् these collected, सर्वम् all, आभिषेचनिकम् all these articles for coronation, पुरस्कृत्य kept in front, रामहेतोः for Rama, वनं प्रति to the forest, गमिष्यामि I shall go.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्रैवं तं नरव्याघ्रमभिषिच्य पुरस्कृतम्। आनेष्यामि तु वै रामं हव्यवाहमिवाध्वरात्।।2.79.11।
output: नरव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, तम् him, तत्रैव there itself, अभिषिच्य having crowned, पुरस्कृतम् going ahead of me, रामम् to Rama, अध्वरात् from the place of sacrifice, हव्यवाहमिव like the fire, आनेष्यामि तु वै will definitely bring back.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न सकामां करिष्यामि स्वामिमां मातृगन्धिनीम्। वने वत्स्याम्यहं दुर्गे रामो राजा भविष्यति।।2.79.12।।
output: I shall never fulfil the wishes of that woman called my mother. I shall dwell in the inaccessible forest and Rama shall become king.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्रियतां शिल्पिभिः पन्था स्समानि विषमाणि च। रक्षिणश्चानुसम्यान्तु पथि दुर्गविचारकाः।।2.79.13।।
output: शिल्पिभि: by the artisans, पन्थाः road, क्रियताम् let it be laid, विषमाणि uneven ground, समानि  be levelled, दुर्गविचारकाः judging the inaccessible terrains, रक्षिणश्च guards, पथि on the way, अनुसम्यान्तु be followed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं सम्भाषमाणं तं रामहेतोर्नृपात्मजम्। प्रत्युवाच जनस्सर्व श्श्रीमद्वाक्यमनुत्तमम्।।2.79.14।।
output: रामहेतोः on behalf of Rama, एवम् in this way, सम्भाषमाणम् speaking, तं नृपात्मजम् to the son of the king, Bharata, सर्वः all, जनः the people, श्रीमत् with auspiciousness, अनुत्तमम् excellent, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं ते भाषमाणस्य पद्मा श्रीरुपतिष्ठतात्। यस्त्वं ज्येष्ठे नृपसुते पृथिवीं दातुमिच्छसि।।2.79.15।।
output: May Lakshmi, goddess of prosperity, abide in you for having expressed your desire to bestow the kingdom upon the king's eldest son.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 79:
अनुत्तमं तद्वचनं नृपात्मजप्रभाषितं संश्रवणे निशम्य च। प्रहर्षजास्तं प्रति बाष्पबिन्दवो निपेतुरार्यानननेत्रसम्भवाः।।2.79.16।।
output: With such graceful words spoken by the prince within their hearing, tears of joy filled the eyes of the noble people and fell drop by drop down their faces.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऊचुस्ते वचनमिदं निशम्य हृष्टा स्सामात्या स्सपरिषदो वियातशोकाः। पन्थानं नरवर भक्तिमान् जनश्च व्यादिष्टस्तव वचनाच्च शिल्पिवर्गः।।2.79.17।
output: इदम् this, वचनम् word, निशम्य having heard, हृष्टाः delighted, सामात्याः with ministers, सपरिषदः with council of members, ते they, वियातशोकाः relieved of their distress, इदं वचनम् these words, ऊचुः uttered, नरवर O best among men, भक्तिमान् devoted man, जनश्च people, शिल्पि वर्गः groups of artisans, तव your, वचनात् from orders, पन्थानम् to prepare the way, व्यादिष्टः have been instructed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 80:
अथ भूमिप्रदेशज्ञास्सूत्रकर्मविशारदाः। स्वकर्माभिरताश्शूराः खनका यन्त्रकास्तथा।।2.80.1।। कर्मान्तिकाः स्थपतयः पुरुष यन्त्रकोविदाः। तथा वार्धकयश्चैव मार्गिणो वृक्षतक्षकाः।।2.80.2।। कूपकारास्सुधाकारार्वंशकर्मकृतस्तथा। समर्था ये च द्रष्टारः पुरतस्ते प्रतस्थिरे।।2.80.3।।
output: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ भूमिप्रदेशज्ञास्सूत्रकर्मविशारदाः। स्वकर्माभिरताश्शूराः खनका यन्त्रकास्तथा।।2.80.1।। कर्मान्तिकाः स्थपतयः पुरुष यन्त्रकोविदाः। तथा वार्धकयश्चैव मार्गिणो वृक्षतक्षकाः।।2.80.2।। कूपकारास्सुधाकारार्वंशकर्मकृतस्तथा। समर्था ये च द्रष्टारः पुरतस्ते प्रतस्थिरे।।2.80.3।।
output: अथ thereafter, भूमिप्रदेशज्ञाः land surveyors, सूत्रकर्मविशारदा: experts in measurement, स्वकर्माभिरताः zealous workers, शूराः energetic, खनकाः excavators, तथा also, यन्त्रकाः engineers, कर्मान्तिकाः skilled workers, स्थपतयः architects, यन्त्रकोविदाः expert mechanics, पुरुषाः men, तथा similarly, वार्धकयः carpenters, मार्गिण road workers, वृक्षतक्षकाः woodcutters, कूपकाराः welldrillers, सुधाकाराः whitewashers, तथा also, वंशकर्मकृतः bambooworkers (basketmakers), समर्थाः competent, ये those, द्रष्टारः supervisors, ते they, पुरतः in advance, प्रतस्थिरे set out.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ भूमिप्रदेशज्ञास्सूत्रकर्मविशारदाः। स्वकर्माभिरताश्शूराः खनका यन्त्रकास्तथा।।2.80.1।। कर्मान्तिकाः स्थपतयः पुरुष यन्त्रकोविदाः। तथा वार्धकयश्चैव मार्गिणो वृक्षतक्षकाः।।2.80.2।। कूपकारास्सुधाकारार्वंशकर्मकृतस्तथा। समर्था ये च द्रष्टारः पुरतस्ते प्रतस्थिरे।।2.80.3।।
output: Then surveyors, experts in measurment, energetic and zealous labourers, excavators, engineers, skilled workers, architects, craftsmen, carpenters, roadlevellers, woodcutters, welldiggers, whitewashers, basketmakers, competent supervisors were sent in advance.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तु हर्षात्तमुद्देशं जनौघो विपुलः प्रयान्। अशोभत महावेगस्समुद्र इव पर्वणि।।2.80.4।।
output: हर्षात् with joy, तम् उद्देशम् to the appointed region, प्रयान् proceeding, सः that, विपुलः  multitude, जनौघः people, पर्वणि on fullmoon day, महावेगः with great speed, समुद्रः इव  like an ocean, अशोभत shone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते स्ववारं समास्थाय वर्त्मकर्मणि कोविदाः। करणैर्विविधोपेतैः पुरस्तात्सम्प्रतस्थिरे।।2.80.5।।
output: वर्त्मकर्मणि in the construction of roads, कोविदाः skilled, ते those, विविधोपेतैः with different kinds of, करणैः tools, स्ववारम् their own group, समास्थाय taking up the place, पुरस्तात् ahead, सम्प्रतस्थिरे departed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 80:
लतावल्ली श्च गुल्मांश्च स्थाणूनश्मन एव च। जनायांचक्रिरे मार्गं छिन्दन्तो विविधान्द्रुमान्।।2.80.6।।
output: Clearing and cutting branches of various trees and creepers, shrubs, plants branchless trees and hewing boulders, the road was paved by the king's men.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवृक्षेषु च देशेषु केचिद्वृक्षानरोपयन्। केचित्कुठारैष्टङ्कैश्च दात्रैश्चिन्दन्क्वचित्क्वचित्।।2.80.7।।
output: केचित् some of them, अवृक्षेषु where there were no trees, देशेषु in places, वृक्षान् saplings, अरोपयन् planted, केचित् some, क्वचित् क्वचित् here and there, कुठारैः with axes, टङ्कैश्च with hatchets, दात्रैः च with sickles, छिन्दन् severing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 80:
अपरे वीरणस्तम्भान्बलिनो बलवत्तराः। विधमन्ति स्म दुर्गाणि स्थलानि च ततस्ततः।।2.80.8।।
output: Some other stronger men, plucked the strongrooted tufts of fragrant grass. Here and there they made impassable terrains even.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अपरेऽपूरयन्कूपान्पांसुभि श्श्वभ्रमायतम्। निम्नभागान्स्ततः केचित्समान्श्चक्रु स्समन्ततः।।2.80.9।।
output: Some filled wells and chasms with loose soil, while others made low level grounds plain and wide on all sides.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 80:
बबन्धुर्बन्धनीयांश्च क्षोद्यान्सञ्चुक्षुदुस्तदा। बिभिदुर्भेदनीयांश्च तांस्तान्देशान्नरा स्तदा।।2.80.10।।
output: People threw bridges at places that needed to be bridged. They pulverised stones that obstructed the path and split open big stones to drain out water.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अचिरेणैव कालेन परिवाहान्बहूदकान्। चक्रुर्बहुविधाकारान् सागरप्रतिमान्बहून्।।2.80.11।।
output: अचिरेणकालेनैव in a short time, बहूदकान् having large volumes of water, बहुविधाकारान् of different shapes, सागरप्रतिमान् like the sea, बहून् many, परिवाहान् water courses, चक्रुः constructed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निर्जलेषु च देशेषु खानयामासुरुत्तमान्। उदपानान्बहुविधान्वेदिकापरिमण्डितान्।।2.80.12।।
output: In arid places, various good drinkingwaterwells surrounded by dykes were dug.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ससुधाकुट्टिमतलः प्रपुष्पितमहीरुहः। मत्तोद्घुष्ट द्विजगणः पताकाभिरलङ्कृतः।।2.80.13।। चन्दनोदकसंसिक्तो नानाकुसुमभूषितः। बह्वशोभत सेनायाः पन्था स्सुरपथोपमः।।2.80.14।।
output: ससुधाकुट्टिमतलः surface decorated with mosaic, प्रपुष्पितमहीरुहः avenue lined with blossoming trees, मत्तोद्घुष्ट द्विजगणः with flocks of birds intoxicated with singing, पताकाभिः with banners, अलङ्कृतः decorated, चन्दनोदकसंसिक्तः sprinkled with sandal water, नानाकुसुमभूषितः embellished with various kinds of flowers, सेनायाः army's सुरपथोपमः like the path of the gods, (सः) पन्थाः that highway, बहु brilliantly, अशोभत shone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ससुधाकुट्टिमतलः प्रपुष्पितमहीरुहः। मत्तोद्घुष्ट द्विजगणः पताकाभिरलङ्कृतः।।2.80.13।। चन्दनोदकसंसिक्तो नानाकुसुमभूषितः। बह्वशोभत सेनायाः पन्था स्सुरपथोपमः।।2.80.14।।
output: The highway for the army was paved smooth, with its surface decorated with mosaic.  It was lined with blossoming trees with flocks of birds intoxicated with singing. It was decked with banners and sprinkled with sandal water and a strewn with flowers of every kind. Like the path of gods, the highway shone with brilliance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 80:
आज्ञाप्याथ यथाऽज्ञप्ति युक्तास्तेऽधिकृता नराः। रमणीयेषु देशेषु बहुस्वादुफलेषु च।।2.80.15।। यो निवेशस्त्वभिप्रेतो भरतस्य महात्मनः। भूयस्तं शोभयामासुर्भूषाभिर्भूषणोपमम्।।2.80.16।।
output: Those authorised ordered the artisans to perform their respective tasks. Thereafter, they selected lovely tracts of land filled with trees bearing varieties of sweet fruits as restingplace for great Bharata and decorated them so splendidly, that they looked like ornaments themseleves.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आज्ञाप्याथ यथाऽज्ञप्ति युक्तास्तेऽधिकृता नराः। रमणीयेषु देशेषु बहुस्वादुफलेषु च।।2.80.15।। यो निवेशस्त्वभिप्रेतो भरतस्य महात्मनः। भूयस्तं शोभयामासुर्भूषाभिर्भूषणोपमम्।।2.80.16।।
output: अधिकृता authorised, ते नराः those persons, यथाज्ञप्ति in accordance with the orders (of Bharata), युक्ताः performing their work, आज्ञप्य issued orders (to the artisans), अथ thereafter, बहुस्वादुफलेषु with varieties of sweet fruits, रमणीयेषु lovely, देशेषु places, महात्मनः  of great, भरतस्य Bharata, यः निवेशः restingplace, अभिप्रेतः selected, तम् that place, भूषाभिः with ornaments, भूषणोपमम् like ornaments , भूयः well, शोभयामासुः shone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नक्षत्रेषु प्रशस्तेषु मुहूर्तेषु च तद्विदः। निवेशान् स्थापयामासुर्भरतस्य महात्मनः।।2.80.17।।
output: तद्विदः men well versed in the study of planetary positions relating to auspicious constellations and auspicious time (astrologers), प्रशस्तेषु at auspicious, नक्षत्रेषु in the constellation, मुहूर्तेषु at auspicious time, महात्मनः highsouled, भरतस्य for Bharata, निवेशान् restplace, स्थापयामासुः  established.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बहुपांसुचयाश्चापि परिखापरिवारिताः। तत्रेन्द्रकीलप्रतिमाः प्रतोलीवरशोभिताः।।2.80.18।। प्रासादमालावितता स्सौधप्राकारसंवृताः। पताकाशोभिता स्सर्वे सुनिर्मितमहापथाः।।2.80.19।। विसर्पद्भिरिवाऽकाशे विटङ्काग्रविमानकैः। समुच्छ्रितैर्निवेशास्ते बभुश्शक्रपुरोपमाः।।2.80.20।।
output: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बहुपांसुचयाश्चापि परिखापरिवारिताः। तत्रेन्द्रकीलप्रतिमाः प्रतोलीवरशोभिताः।।2.80.18।। प्रासादमालावितता स्सौधप्राकारसंवृताः। पताकाशोभिता स्सर्वे सुनिर्मितमहापथाः।।2.80.19।। विसर्पद्भिरिवाऽकाशे विटङ्काग्रविमानकैः। समुच्छ्रितैर्निवेशास्ते बभुश्शक्रपुरोपमाः।।2.80.20।।
output: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बहुपांसुचयाश्चापि परिखापरिवारिताः। तत्रेन्द्रकीलप्रतिमाः प्रतोलीवरशोभिताः।।2.80.18।। प्रासादमालावितता स्सौधप्राकारसंवृताः। पताकाशोभिता स्सर्वे सुनिर्मितमहापथाः।।2.80.19।। विसर्पद्भिरिवाऽकाशे विटङ्काग्रविमानकैः। समुच्छ्रितैर्निवेशास्ते बभुश्शक्रपुरोपमाः।।2.80.20।।
output: They heaped sand and dug moats around the restingplace. It was adorned with wellbuilt highways and broad thoroughfares, lined with mansions surrounded by walls as high as mount Indrakeela. The peaks of those tall residences decorated with flags which looked as if spreading into the sky. (Thus the restingplace) shone like the abode of Indra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जाह्नवीं तु समासाद्य विविधद्रुमकाननाम्। शीतलामलपानीयां महामीनसमाकुलाम्।।2.80.21।।
output: विविधद्रुमकाननाम् with groves of various trees, शीतलामलपानीयाम् with cool and limpid  waters, महामीनसमाकुलाम् abounding in large fishes, जाह्नवीम् the river Ganga, समासाद्य having reached.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 80:
सचन्द्रतारागणमण्डितं यथा नभः क्षपायाममलं विराजते। नरेन्द्रमार्गस्स तथा व्यराजत क्रमेण रम्यः शुभशिल्पिनिर्मितः।।2.80.22।।
output: The lovely royal road constructed in an orderly fashion by eminent craftsmen looked splendid like the clear sky decorated with by the Moon and clusters of stars. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightieth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 81:
ततो नान्दीमुखीं रात्रिं भरतं सूतमागधाः। तुष्टुवुर्वाग्विशेषज्ञास्स्तवैर्मङ्गलसंहितैः।।2.81.1।।
output: Thereafter bards and panegyrists adept in conversation with an auspicious start pleased Bharata with eulogy in the last part of the night.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 81:
सुवर्णकोणाभिहतः प्राणदद्यामदुन्दुभिः। दध्मुश्शङ्खांश्च शतशो नादांश्चोच्चावचस्वरान्।।2.81.2।।
output: The drums of the night watch were beaten by golden sticks. Conches in hundreds were blown and sounds of various modulations were created.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तूर्यघोष स्सुमहान्दिवमापूरयन्निव। भरतं शोकसन्तप्तं भूयश्शोकैररन्ध्रयत्।।2.81.3।।
output: सुमहान् shrill, सः that, तूर्यघोषः sound of trumpets, दिवम् the heaven, आपूरयन्निव as if filling, शोकसंतप्तम् griefstricken, भरतम् Bharata, भूयः still more, शोकैः with sorrows, अरन्ध्रयत् filled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 81:
ततः प्रबुद्धो भरतस्तं घोषं सन्निवर्त्य च। नाहं राजेति चाप्युक्त्वा शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.81.4।।
output: Then Bharata waking up, exclaimed, I am not the king, ordered the pipers to stop and said to Satrughna:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 81:
पश्य शत्रुघ्न कैकेय्या लोकस्यापकृतं महत्। विसृज्य मयि दुःखानि राजा दशरथो गतः।।2.81.5।।
output: O Satrughna see what great harm has been done to these people at the instance of Kaikeyi. King Dasaratha has gone, leaving me to suffer.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यैषा धर्मराजस्य धर्ममूला महात्मनः। परिभ्रमति राज्य श्रीर्नौरिवाकर्णिका जले।।2.81.6।।
output: धर्मराजस्य of righteous king, तस्य his, महात्मनः noble one's, धर्ममूला rooted in  righteousness, एषा such, राज्यश्रीः the goddess of kingdom, जले in water, आकर्णिका without helmsman, नौः इव like a boat, परिभ्रमति is revolving.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 81:
यो हि न स्सुमहान्नाथस्सोऽपि प्रव्राजितो वनम्। अनया धर्ममुत्सृज्य मात्रा मे राघवस्स्वयम्।।2.81.7।।
output: Even Rama, a great protector for all of us, has been banished to the forest by my mother bereft of virtuous conduct.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्येवं भरतं प्रेक्ष्य विलपन्तं विचेतनम्। कृपणं रुरुदुस्सर्वास्सस्वरं योषित स्तदा।। 2.81.8।।
output: तदा then, इत्येवम् in this way, विलपन्तम् lamenting, विचेतनम् lying unconscious, भरतम् Bharata, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, सर्वाः all, योषितः women, सस्वरम् in one voice, कृपणम् piteously, रुरुदुः cried loudly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा तस्मिन्विलपति वसिष्ठो राजधर्मवित्। सभामिक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य प्रविवेश महायशाः।।2.81.9।।
output: तस्मिन् that Bharata, तथा in that way, विलपति lamenting, राजधर्मवित् conversant with royal traditions, महायशाः illustrious man, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, इक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य of the lord of Iksvakus (king Dasaratha's), सभाम् assembly hall, प्रविवेश entered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शातकुम्भमयीं रम्यां मणिरत्नसमाकुलाम्। सुधर्मामिव धर्मात्मा सगणः प्रत्यपद्यत।।2.81.10।।
output: Righteous Vasistha along with his disciples reached the lovely golden assembly hall  inlaid with gems and precious stones, which resembled Sudharma, (the assembly hall of Indra).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स काञ्चनमयं पीठं सुखास्तरणसंवृतम्। अध्यास्त सर्ववेदज्ञो दूताननुशशास च।।2.81.11।।
output: सर्ववेदज्ञः wellversed in all the Vedas, सः Vasistha, सुखास्तरणसंवृतम् covered with comfortable spread, काञ्चनमयम् made of gold, पीठम् seat, अध्यास्त sat, दूतान् messengers, अनुशशास च ordered too.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान्वैश्यनमात्यान्गणवल्लभान्। क्षिप्रमानयताऽव्यग्राः कृत्यमात्ययिकं हि नः।।2.81.12।।
output: Fetch quietly brahmins, kshatriyas, vaisyas, ministers and army commanders at once. A matter of great urgency awaits us.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सराजभृत्यं शत्रुघ्नं भरतं च यशस्विनम्। युधाजितं सुमन्त्रं च ये च तत्र हिता जनाः।।2.81.13।।
output: Bring all the royal attendants, Satrughna, the illustrious Bharata, Yudhajit, Sumantra and all those wellwishers of the king.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो हलहलाशब्दस्सुमहान्समपद्यत। रथैरश्वैर्गजैश्चापि जनानामुपगच्छताम्।।2.81.14।।
output: ततः then, रथैः with chariots, अश्वैः on horses, गजैश्चापि on elephants, उपगच्छताम् of those arriving, जनानाम् people's, सुमहान् great, हलहला शब्दः tumultuous sound, समपद्यत arose.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो भरतमायान्तं शतक्रतुमिवामराः। प्रत्यनन्दन्प्रकृतयो यथा दशरथं तथा।।2.81.15।।
output: Then as Bharata apprroached,  ministers and subjects greeted him as they used to greet Dasaratha, just as gods greet Indra, the performer of a hundred sacrifices.
