instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ह्रद इव तिमिनागसंवृतः स्तिमितजलो मणिशङ्खशर्करः। दशरथसुतशोभिता सभा सदशरथेव बभौ यथा पुरा।।2.81.16।।
output: The assembly hall looked splendid like a lake of tranquil waters with gems, shells  pebbles, grains of sand and teeming with whales and serpents in the presence of the son of king Dasaratha. It appeared as though Dasaratha himself was present. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकाशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightyfirst sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
तामार्यगणसम्पूर्णां भरतः प्रग्रहां सभाम्। ददर्श बुद्धिसम्पन्नः पूर्णचन्द्रो निशामिव।।2.82.1।।
output: Sagacious Bharata beheld that assembly hall filled with honourable members, like the fullmoon beholds the night stretching forth (with stars).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आसनानि यथान्यायमार्याणां विशतां तदा। वस्त्राङ्गरागप्रभया द्योतिता सा सभोत्तमा।।2.82.2।।
output: When the seats were occupied by the honourable members according to their rank, that august assembly looked splendid with the brilliance of their apparels and fragrance of unguents.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा विद्वज्जनसम्पूर्णा सभा सुरुचिरा तदा। अदृश्यत घनापाये पूर्णचन्द्रेव शर्वरी।।2.82.3।।
output: तदा then, विद्वज्जनसम्पूर्णा filled with learned people, सुरुचिरा  most splendid, सा सभा that assembly, घनापाये after the departure of rains, पूर्णचन्द्रा with fullmoon, शर्वरीव like the night, अदृश्यत looked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
राज्ञस्तु प्रकृती स्सर्वा स्समग्राः प्रेक्ष्य धर्मवित्। इदं पुरोहितो वाक्यं भरतं मृदु चाब्रवीत्।।2.82.4।।
output: The chief priest Vasistha, knower of righteousness, looked at all the ministers present and addressed Bharata in a gentle voice.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तात राजा दशरथ स्स्वर्गतो धर्ममाचरन्। धनधान्यवतीं स्फीतां प्रदाय पृथिवीं तव।।2.82.5।।
output: तात dear child, राजा king, दशरथः Dasaratha, धर्मम् righteousness, आचरन् while following, धनधान्यवतीम् abounding in wealth and grains, स्फीताम् vast, पृथिवीम् kingdom, तव to you, प्रदाय having given, स्वर्गतः attained heaven.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
रामस्तथा सत्यधृतिस्सतां धर्ममनुस्मरन्। नाजहात्पितुरादेशं शशी ज्योत्स्नामिवोदितः।।2.82.6।।
output: Abiding in truth, remembering the righteous ways of virtuous men just as the rising Moon does not leave its beams, Rama too did not move away from his father's command.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पित्रा भ्रात्रा च ते दत्तं राज्यं निहतकण्टकम्। तद्भुङ्क्ष्व मुदितामात्यः क्षिप्रमेवाभिषेचय।।2.82.7।।
output: The kingdom free from obstacles has been passed on to you by your father and brother. Get yourself coronated quickly and enjoy it along with your cheerful ministers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
उदीच्या श्च प्रतीच्या श्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च केवलाः। कोट्यापरान्तास्सामुद्रारत्नान्यभिहरन्तुते।।2.82.8।।
output: Let kings from the north, the west, the south, the bordering kingdoms, and the seatraders offer you crores of gems as gifts.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतो वाक्यं शोकेनाभिपरिप्लुतः। जगाम मनसा रामं धर्मज्ञो धर्मकाङ्क्षया।।2.82.9।।
output: धर्मज्ञः knower of duty, भरतः Bharata, तत् that, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, शोकेन with distress, अभिपरिप्लुतः overwhelmed, धर्मकाङ्क्षया wishing to abide by  righteousness, रामम् Rama, मनसा with mind, जगाम reached.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सबाष्पकलया वाचा कलहंसस्वरो युवा। विललाप सभामध्ये जगर्हे च पुरोहितम्।।2.82.10।।
output: कलहंसस्वरः voice resembling the melodious cackle of a swan, युवा the young man, सबाष्पकलया voice choked with sobs, वाचा words, सभामध्ये in the midst of the assembly, विललाप lamented, पुरोहितम् to the family priest Vasistha, जगर्हे च reproached.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चरितब्रह्मचर्यस्य विद्यास्नातस्य धीमतः। धर्मे प्रयतमानस्य को राज्यं मद्विधो हरेत्।।2.82.11।।
output: चरितब्रह्मचर्यस्य one who practised brahmacharaya, विद्यास्नातस्य who is wellversed in all branches of learning, धीमतः of the sagacious, धर्मे in righteousness, प्रयतमानस्य endeavouring, राज्यम् kingdom, मद्विधः a man like me, कः who, हरेत् will seize?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कथं दशरथाज्जातो भवेद्राज्यापहारकः। राज्यं चाहं च रामस्य धर्मं वक्तुमिहार्हसि।।2.82.12।।
output: दशरथात् from Dasaratha, जातः born, राज्यापहारकः usurper of the kingdom, कथम् भवेत् how will he become?, राज्यं च kingdom, अहं च I also, रामस्य belong to Rama, इह in this matter, धर्मम् truth, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हसि it behoves you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
ज्येष्ठ श्श्रेष्ठश्च धर्मात्मा दिलीपनहुषोपमः। लब्धुमर्हति काकुत्स्थो राज्यं दशरथो यथा।।2.82.13।।
output: The eldest, eminent and righteous Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, who is comparable to Dilipa and Nahusha deserves to inherit this kingdom just as Dasaratha did.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यं कुर्यां पापमहं यदि। इक्ष्वाकूणामहं लोके भवेयं कुलपांसनः।।2.82.14।।
output: अहम् I, अनार्यजुष्टम् followed by wretched ones, अस्वर्ग्यम् not leading to heaven, पापम् sin, कुर्यां यदि if I do, लोके in this world, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् to the Ikshvaku kings, कुलपांसनः one who is a disgrace to the family, भवेयम् I shall become.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
यद्धि मात्रा कृतं पापं नाहं तदपि रोचये। इहस्थो वनदुर्गस्थं नमस्यामि कृताञ्जलिः।।2.82.15।।
output: I will never accept the evil deed committed by my mother. From here itself I shall pay obeisance with folded palms to my brother who dwells in the impenetrable forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
राममेवानुगच्छामि राजा स द्विपदां वरः। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां राज्यमर्हति राघवः।।2.82.16।।
output: I shall follow Rama the best among men. He alone and no one else deserves to rule over the kingdom of the three worlds.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्वाक्यं धर्मसंयुक्तं श्रुत्वा सर्वे सभासदः। हर्षान्मुमुचुरश्रूणि रामे निहितचेतसः।।2.82.17।।
output: Hearing the words of Bharata full of righteousness, all the men assembled there   shed tears of joy, thinking of Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदि त्वार्यं न शक्ष्यामि विनिवर्तयितुं वनात्। वने तत्रैव वत्स्यामि यथाऽर्यो लक्ष्मणस्तथा।।2.82.18।।
output: If I am not able to bring back my noble brother (Rama) from the forest, I shall also dwell there like my noble brother Lakshmana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
सर्वोपायं तु वर्तिष्ये विनिवर्तयितुं बलात्। समक्षमार्यमिश्राणां साधूनां गुणवर्तिनाम्।।2.82.19।।
output: I shall employ all possible means to bring him back and join you who are respectable, virtuous and pious.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विष्टिकर्मान्तिका स्सर्वे मार्गशोधकरक्षकाः। प्रस्थापिता मया पूर्वं यत्रापि मम रोचते।।2.82.20।।
output: मार्गशोधकरक्षकाः explorers and protectors of the paths, सर्वे all, विष्टिकर्मान्तिकाः who work for wages and no wages, मया by me, पूर्वम् previously, प्रस्थापिताः have been despatched, मम for me, यात्रापि this journey, रोचते pleases.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा तु धर्मात्मा भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः। समीपस्थमुवाचेदं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रकोविदम्।।2.82.21।।
output: Righteous Bharata who was full of devotion towards his brother having uttered thus, addressed  the skilful counsellor Sumantra standing nearby:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
तूर्णमुत्थाय गच्छ त्वं सुमन्त्र मम शासनात्। यात्रामाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं बलं चैव समानय।।2.82.22।।
output: O Sumantra quickly rise and go. On my authority, order the expedition and let the army be marshalled at once.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
एवमुक्त स्सुमन्त्रस्तु भरतेन महात्मना। हृष्टस्तदाऽदिशत्सर्वं यथासन्दिष्टमिष्टवत्।।2.82.23।।
output: On hearing the words of the magnanimous Bharata, Sumantra was delighted and as  instructed, ordered everything as if he was anxious to do it himself.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताः प्रहृष्टाः प्रकृतयो बलाध्यक्षा बलस्य च। श्रुत्वा यात्रां समाज्ञप्तां राघवस्य निवर्तने।।2.82.24।।
output: राघवस्य Rama's, निवर्तने return, समाज्ञप्ताम् ordered, बलस्य च army's, यात्राम् the expedition, श्रुत्वा having heard, ताः those, प्रकृतयः subjects, बलाध्यक्षाः chiefs of army, प्रहृष्टाः were delighted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो योधाङ्गना स्सर्वा भर्त्रून्सर्वान्गृहेगृहे। यात्रागमनमाज्ञाय त्वरयन्ति स्म हर्षिताः।।2.82.25।।
output: Then, the wives of the soldiers having come to know of the expedition were all delighted and in every household hastened up their husbands.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
ते हयैर्गोरथैश्शीघ्रैस्स्यन्दनैश्च महाजवैः सह योधैर्बलाध्यक्षा बलं सर्वमचोदयन्।।2.82.26।।
output: Those chiefs of the army urged the soldiers, horses, fastmoving bullockcarts and swift chariots (to move on).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
सज्जं तु तद्बलं दृष्ट्वा भरतो गुरुसन्निधौ। रथं मे त्वरयस्वेति सुमन्त्रं पार्श्वतोऽब्रवीत्।।2.82.27।।
output: When Bharata saw that the army was ready, he instructed Sumantra who was standing by the side of the preceptor to quickly prepare his chariot.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भरतस्य तु तस्याज्ञां प्रतिगृह्य च हर्षितः। रथं गृहीत्वा प्रययौ युक्तं परमवाजिभिः।।2.82.28।।
output: तस्य भरतस्य that Bharata's, आज्ञाम् command, प्रतिगृह्य having received, हर्षितः delighted, परमवाजिभिः with excellent horses, युक्तम् harnessed, रथम् chariot, गृहीत्वा grasping, प्रययौ went.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स राघव स्सत्यधृतिः प्रतापवान् ब्रुवन् सुयुक्तं दृढसत्यविक्रमः। गुरुं महारण्यगतं यशस्विनं प्रसादयिष्यन्भरतोऽब्रवीत्तदा।।2.82.29।।
output: तदा then, राघवः Bharata, सत्यधृतिः firm in truth, प्रतापवान् valiant, दृढसत्यविक्रमः whose valour comes out of unshakable truth, सुयुक्तम् judiciously, ब्रुवन् speaking, भरतः Bharata, महारण्यगतम् gone to the great forest, यशस्विनम् illustrious, गुरुम् esteemed brother, प्रसादयिष्यन् to propitiate, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तूर्णं समुत्थाय सुमन्त्र गच्छ बलस्य योगाय बलप्रधानान्। आनेतुमिच्छामि हि तं वनस्थं प्रसाद्य रामं जगतो हिताय।।2.82.30।।
output: O Sumantra, arise, go at once to the leaders of the army and ask them to assemble the troops. I shall propifiate Rama who is in the deep forest and bring him back for the welfare of the world.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 82:
ससूतपुत्रो भरतेन सम्यगाज्ञापितस्सम्परिपूर्णकामः। शशास सर्वान्प्रकृतिप्रधानान्बलस्य मुख्यांश्च सुहृज्जनं च।।2.82.31।।
output: The charioteer categorically commanded by Bharata, his desire fulfilled, communicated the royal mandate to all important subjects, chiefs of army and friends.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत स्समुत्थाय कुले कुले ते राजन्यवैश्या वृषलाश्च विप्राः। अयूयुजन्नुष्ट्रखरान्रथांश्च नागान्हयांश्चैव कुलप्रसूतान्।।2.82.32।।
output: ततः there after, कुले कुले in every household, ते those, राजन्यवैश्याः kshatriyas, vaisyas वृषलाश्च sudras, विप्राः brahmins, समुत्थाय after rising up, उष्ट्रखरान् camels and asses, रथांश्च chariots, कुलप्रसूतान् born in a good race, नागान् elephants, हयांश्चैव horses as well, अयूयुजन् harnessed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत स्समुत्थितः काल्यमास्थाय स्यन्दनोत्तमम्। प्रययौ भरतश्शीघ्रं रामदर्शनकाङ्क्षया।।2.83.1।।
output: Bharata's journey with queens, ministers and all others.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्रतः प्रययुस्तस्य सर्वे मन्त्रिपुरोधसः। अधिरुह्य हयैर्युक्तान्रथान्सूर्यरथोपमान्।।2.83.2।।
output: सर्वे all, मन्त्रिपुरोधस: ministers and priests, हयैः horses, युक्तान् harnessed, सूर्यरथोपमान्  resembling the chariot of the Sun, रथान् chariots, अधिरुह्य having mounted, तस्य his, अग्रतः in front of, प्रययुः went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
नवनागसहस्राणि कल्पितानि यथाविधि। अन्वयुर्भरतं यान्तमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम्।।2.83.3।।
output: As per tradition, nine thousand elephants were arranged to follow Bharata, delight of the race of the Ikshvakus as he set out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
षष्टी रथसहस्राणि धन्विनो विविधायुधाः। अन्वयुर्भरतं यान्तं राजपुत्रं यशस्विनम्।।2.83.4।।
output: Sixty thousands chariots and many archers holding weapons of every kind followed the illustrious prince Bharata as he went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
शतं सहस्राण्यश्वानां समारूढानि राघवम्। अन्वयुर्भरतं यान्तं सत्यसन्धं जितेन्द्रियम्।।2.83.5।।
output: One hundred thousand horses each mounted by a rider followed Bharata, one who had conquered  his passion and adhered to truth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
कैकेयी च सुमित्रा च कौसल्या च यशस्विनी। रामानयनसंहृष्टा ययुर्यानेन भास्वता।।2.83.6।।
output: Kaikeyi, Sumitra as well as the illustrious Kausalya travelled by a resplendent chariot, delighted with the thought of bringing Rama back.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रयाताश्चार्यसङ्घाता रामं द्रष्टुं सलक्ष्मणम्। तस्यैव च कथाश्चित्राः कुर्वाणा हृष्टमानसाः।।2.83.7।।
output: आर्यसङ्घाताश्च venerable groups of people, हृष्टमानसाः delighted in their hearts, चित्राः  various, तस्यैव Rama's only, कथाः accomplishments, कुर्वाणाः doing, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, द्रष्टुम् to see, प्रयाताः went forth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
मेघश्यामं महाबाहुं स्थिरसत्त्वं दृढव्रतम्। कदा द्रक्ष्यामहे रामं जगत श्शोकनाशनम्।।2.83.8।।
output: When shall we see that mightyarmed Rama of darkblue complexion like the raincloud, firm in strength and steadfast in vows and the destroyer of the sorrows of  this world?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्ट एव हि न श्शोकमपनेष्यति राघवः। तम स्सर्वस्य लोकस्य समुद्यन्निव भास्करः।।2.83.9।।
output: At his sight alone our sorrows will be dispelled, the way the darkness of the entire world is dispelled by the rising Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्येवं कथयन्तस्ते सम्प्रहृष्टाः कथा श्शुभाः। परिष्वजानाश्चान्योन्यं ययुर्नागरिका जनाः।।2.83.10।।
output: The inhabitants of the town proceeded joyfully, narrating Rama's delightful achievements on their way by embracing one another.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ये च तत्रापरे सर्वे सम्मता ये च नैगमाः। रामं प्रति ययुर्हृष्टा स्सर्वाः प्रकृतयस्तथा।।2.83.11।।
output: तत्र there, ये च अपरे all the others, सम्मताः respectable, ये च नैगमाः those merchants, तथा similarly, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः subjects, हृष्टाः delighted, रामम् प्रति to Rama, ययुः went along.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मणिकाराश्च ये केचित्कुम्भकाराश्च शोभनाः। सूत्रकर्मकृतश्चैव ये च शस्त्रोपजीविनः।2.83.12।। मयूरकाः क्राकचिका रोचका वेधकास्तथा। दन्तकारा स्सुधाकारा स्तथा गन्धोपजीविनः।।2.83.13।। सुवर्णकाराः प्रख्यातास्तथा कम्बलधावकाः। स्नापकोष्णोदका वैद्याधूपकाश्शौण्डिकास्तथा।।2.83.14।। रजकास्तुन्नवायाश्च ग्रामघोषमहत्तराः। शैलूषाश्च सह स्त्रीभिर्ययुः कैवर्तकास्तथा।।2.83.15।।
output: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मणिकाराश्च ये केचित्कुम्भकाराश्च शोभनाः। सूत्रकर्मकृतश्चैव ये च शस्त्रोपजीविनः।2.83.12।। मयूरकाः क्राकचिका रोचका वेधकास्तथा। दन्तकारा स्सुधाकारा स्तथा गन्धोपजीविनः।।2.83.13।। सुवर्णकाराः प्रख्यातास्तथा कम्बलधावकाः। स्नापकोष्णोदका वैद्याधूपकाश्शौण्डिकास्तथा।।2.83.14।। रजकास्तुन्नवायाश्च ग्रामघोषमहत्तराः। शैलूषाश्च सह स्त्रीभिर्ययुः कैवर्तकास्तथा।।2.83.15।।
output: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
मणिकाराश्च ये केचित्कुम्भकाराश्च शोभनाः। सूत्रकर्मकृतश्चैव ये च शस्त्रोपजीविनः।2.83.12।। मयूरकाः क्राकचिका रोचका वेधकास्तथा। दन्तकारा स्सुधाकारा स्तथा गन्धोपजीविनः।।2.83.13।। सुवर्णकाराः प्रख्यातास्तथा कम्बलधावकाः। स्नापकोष्णोदका वैद्याधूपकाश्शौण्डिकास्तथा।।2.83.14।। रजकास्तुन्नवायाश्च ग्रामघोषमहत्तराः। शैलूषाश्च सह स्त्रीभिर्ययुः कैवर्तकास्तथा।।2.83.15।।
output: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मणिकाराश्च ये केचित्कुम्भकाराश्च शोभनाः। सूत्रकर्मकृतश्चैव ये च शस्त्रोपजीविनः।2.83.12।। मयूरकाः क्राकचिका रोचका वेधकास्तथा। दन्तकारा स्सुधाकारा स्तथा गन्धोपजीविनः।।2.83.13।। सुवर्णकाराः प्रख्यातास्तथा कम्बलधावकाः। स्नापकोष्णोदका वैद्याधूपकाश्शौण्डिकास्तथा।।2.83.14।। रजकास्तुन्नवायाश्च ग्रामघोषमहत्तराः। शैलूषाश्च सह स्त्रीभिर्ययुः कैवर्तकास्तथा।।2.83.15।।
output: Gempolishers, potters, weaponsmiths, weavers, makers of adornments with peacock feathers, sawyers, makers of artificial ornaments, perforators of shells and ornaments, ivoryworkers, whitewashers, purveyors of fragrant essences, renowned goldsmiths, blanketcleaners, hotbath attendants, physicians, vintners, incense merchants, washermen, tailors, headmen of villages and hamlets, actors along with their wives, fishermen -- all followed Bharata.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समाहिता वेदविदो ब्राह्मणा वृत्तसम्मताः। गोरथैर्भरतं यान्तमनुजग्मु स्सहस्रशः।।2.83.16।।
output: समाहिताः with composed mind, वृत्तसम्मताः renowned for their virtuous conduct, वेदविदः learned in the Vedas, सहस्रशः in thousands, ब्राह्मणाः brahmins, यान्तम् departing, भरतम् Bharata, गोरथैः on bullock carts, अनुजग्मुः followed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुवेषा श्शुद्धवसनास्ताम्रमृष्टानुलेपनाः। सर्वे ते विविधैर्यानै श्शनैर्भरतमन्वयुः।।2.83.17।।
output: सुवेषाः welldressed, शुद्धवसनाः in clean clothing, ताम्रमृष्टानुलेपनाः anointed with pure red sandalpaste, ते सर्वे all those, विविधैः various, यानैः on vehicles, शनैः slowly, भरतम् Bharata, अन्वयुः followed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रहृष्टमुदिता सेना साऽन्वयात्कैकयीसुतम्। भ्रातुरानयने यान्तं भरतं भ्रातृवत्सलम्।।2.83.18।।
output: The army, overwhelmed with joy and cheer followed the devoted brother Bharata who had set out to bring back Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं रथयानाश्वकुञ्जरैः। समासेदुस्ततो गङ्गां शृङ्गीबेरपुरं प्रति।।2.83.19।। यत्र रामसखो वीरो गुहो ज्ञातिगणैर्वृतः। निवसत्यप्रमादेन देशं तं परिपालयन्।।2.83.20।।
output: After travelling a long distance on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, they reached the river Ganga close to Srngiberapura, a country ruled vigilantly by Rama's friend, the valiant Guha who lived there along with his relatives.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं रथयानाश्वकुञ्जरैः। समासेदुस्ततो गङ्गां शृङ्गीबेरपुरं प्रति।।2.83.19।। यत्र रामसखो वीरो गुहो ज्ञातिगणैर्वृतः। निवसत्यप्रमादेन देशं तं परिपालयन्।।2.83.20।।
output: ते they, रथयानाश्वकुञ्जरैः on chariots, carriages, horses and elephants, दूरम् a great distance, अध्वानम् the path, गत्वा having travelled, ततः thereafter, रामसखः Rama's friend, वीरः valiant, गुहः Guha, ज्ञातिगणैः with relatives, वृतः surrounded by, तम् that, देशम् country, अप्रमादेन vigilantly, परिपालयन् ruling, यत्र where, निवसति living, शृङ्गीबेरपुरं प्रति near Srngiberapura, गङ्गाम् Ganges, समासेदुः reached.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपेत्य तीरं गङ्गायाश्चक्रवाकैरलङ्कृतम्। व्यवातिष्ठत सा सेना भरतस्यानुयायिनी।।2.83.21।।
output: भरतस्य अनुयायिनी following Bharata, सा सेना that army, चक्रवाकैः with chakravakas (the ruddy geese), अलङ्कृतम् graced, गङ्गायाः river Ganga's, तीरम् bank, उपेत्य having reached, व्यवातिष्ठत halted there.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निरीक्ष्यानुगतां सेनां तां च गङ्गां शिवोदकाम्। भरतस्सचिवान्सर्वानब्रवीद्वाक्यकोविदः।।2.83.22।।
output: अनुगताम् following, सेनाम् army, शिवोदकाम् having sacred waters, तां गङ्गां च that river Ganga, निरीक्षय having gazed at, वाक्यकोविदः proficient in speech, भरतः Bharata, सर्वान् all, सचिवान् to ministers, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निवेशयत मे सैन्यमभिप्रायेण सर्वतः। विश्रान्ताः प्रतरिष्यामश्श्व इदानीमिमां नदीम्।।2.83.23।।
output: मे सैन्यम् my army, अभिप्रायेण according to their desires, सर्वतः all over, निवेशयत you may halt, इदानीम् now, विश्रान्ताः having taken rest, नदीम् river, श्वः tomorrow, प्रतरिष्यामः will cross.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
दातुं च तावदिच्छामि स्वर्गतस्य महीपतेः। और्ध्वदेहनिमित्तार्थमवतीर्योदकं नदीम्।।2.83.24।।
output: Meanwhile, I shall get into this river and offer libations with water to the departed king for the good of his life in the other world.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
तस्यैवं ब्रुवतोऽमात्यास्तथेत्युक्त्वा समाहिताः। न्यवेशयंस्तां छन्देन स्वेन स्वेन पृथक्पृथक्।।2.83.25।।
output: While he (Bharata's) was speaking this way, all the ministers assented by saying 'Be it so' and made arrangement for their troops to rest separately according to their pleasure.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 83:
निवेश्य गङ्गामनु तां महानदीं चमूं विधानैः परिबर्हशोभिनीम्। उवास रामस्य तदा महात्मनो विचिन्तयानो भरतो निवर्तनम्।।2.83.26।।
output: The army encamped by Bharata looked splendid with royal insigaia. After making necessary arrangements for the army on the bank of the mighty river Ganga and pondering over the means of bringing back the magnanimous Rama, Bharata stayed. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो निविष्टां ध्वजिनीं गङ्गामन्वाश्रितां नदीम्। निषादराजो दृष्ट्वैव ज्ञातीन्सन्त्वरितोऽऽब्रवीत्।।2.84.1।।
output: ततः then, निषादराजः king of the nishadas (Guha), गङ्गां नदीम् river Ganga, अन्वाश्रिताम् all along the bank, निविष्टाम् encamped, ध्वजिनीम् the bannered army, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, सन्त्वरितः hurriedly, ज्ञातीन् to relatives, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महतीयमितस्सेना सागराभा प्रदृश्यते। नास्यान्तमधिगच्छामि मनसापि विचिन्तयन्।।2.84.2।।
output: Here is an army as vast as the ocean, and I am unable to comprehend its magnitude even mentally.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथा तु खलु दुर्बुद्धिर्भरत स्स्वयमागतः। स एष हि महाकायः कोविदारध्वजो रथे।।2.84.3।।
output: दुर्बुद्धि: evilminded, भरतः Bharata, स्वयम् himself, यथा तु आगतः खलु has come it appears,  सः that, महाकायः of huge size, कोविदारध्वजः having the emblem of kovidara                          (promegranate) tree, एषः this one, रथे हि on the chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 84:
बन्धयिष्यति वा दाशानथवाऽस्मान्वधिष्यति। अथ दाशरथिं रामं पित्रा राज्याद्विवासितम्।।2.84.4।। सम्पन्नां श्रियमन्विच्छन्स्तस्य राज्ञ स्सुदुर्लभाम्। भरतः कैकयीपुत्रो हन्तुं समधिगच्छति।।2.84.5।।
output: Could it be that Bharata, son of Kaikeyi, has come here to bind us with the cords or to slay us? Or is he marching forward with the intention of taking possession of a prosperous, rare kingdom by slaying Rama who has been banished by his father:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 84:
बन्धयिष्यति वा दाशानथवाऽस्मान्वधिष्यति। अथ दाशरथिं रामं पित्रा राज्याद्विवासितम्।।2.84.4।। सम्पन्नां श्रियमन्विच्छन्स्तस्य राज्ञ स्सुदुर्लभाम्। भरतः कैकयीपुत्रो हन्तुं समधिगच्छति।।2.84.5।।
output: Could it be that Bharata, son of Kaikeyi, has come here to bind us with the cords or to slay us? Or is he marching forward with the intention of taking possession of a prosperous, rare kingdom by slaying Rama who has been banished by his father:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भर्ताचैव सखाचैव रामो दाशरथिर्मम। तस्यार्थकामास्सन्नद्धा गङ्गाऽनूपे प्रतिष्ठत।।2.84.6।।
output: दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, मम to me, भर्ता चैव is my master, सखाचैव friend too, तस्य his, अर्थकामाः wealth and desires, गङ्गाऽनूपे on the bank of river Ganga, प्रतिष्ठत   remain stationed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 84:
तिष्ठन्तु सर्वे दाशाश्च गङ्गामन्वाश्रिता नदीम्। बलयुक्ता नदीरक्षा मांसमूलफलाशनाः।।2.84.7।।
output: Let all the fishermen, who live on meat, roots and fruits and protect the river, stay here with the troops by taking up positions along the banks of the river Ganga.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नावां शतानां पञ्चानां कैवर्तानां शतं शतम्। सन्नद्धानां तथा यूनां तिष्ठन्त्वित्यभ्यचोदयत्।।2.84.8।।
output: Let five hundred boats, each manned by a hundred young fishermen fully equipped, be in readiness he exhorted them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदाऽऽदुष्टस्तु भरतो रामस्येह भविष्यति। सेयं स्वस्तिमती सेना गङ्गामद्य तरिष्यति।।2.84.9।।
output: Should it happen that Bharata is not illdisposed toward Rama, the army will safe cross the river Ganga today itself.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 84:
इत्युक्त्वोपायनं गृह्य मत्स्यमांसमधूनि च। अभिचक्राम भरतं निषादाधिपतिर्गुहः।।2.84.10।।
output: Having spoken thus, Guha, lord of the nishadas, approached Bharata, taking with him fish, meat and wine as offerings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमायान्तं तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य सूतपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। भरतायाऽचचक्षेऽथ विनयज्ञो विनीतवत्।।2.84.11।।
output: The valiant Sumantra, conversant with ways of modesty, observed Guha approaching them and humbly informed Bharata.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष ज्ञातिसहस्रेण स्थपतिः परिवारितः। कुशलो दण्डकारण्ये वृद्धो भ्रातुश्च ते सखा।।2.84.12।।
output: ज्ञातिसहस्रेण with thousands of relations, परिवारितः surrounded by, एषः स्थपतिः this lord,  दण्डकारण्ये in the Dandaka forest, कुशलः skilled, वृद्धः aged one, ते your, भ्रातुः brother's, सखा च friend also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्मात्पश्यतु काकुत्स्थ त्वां निषादाधिपो गुहः। असंशयं विजानीते यत्र तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।2.84.13।।
output: O scion of the Kakusthas (Bharata) therefore, give audience to the overlord of the nishadas, Guha, who undoubtedly knows the whereabouts of Rama and Lakshmana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा सुमन्त्राद्भरत श्शुभम्। उवाच वचनं शीघ्रं गुहः पश्यतु मामिति।।2.84.14।।
output: भरतः Bharata, सुमन्त्रात् from Sumantra, एतत् शुभम् these auspicious, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, गुहः Guha, शीघ्रम् at once, माम् me, पश्यतु let him see, इति these, वचनम् word, उवाच said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 84:
लब्ध्वाऽभ्यनुज्ञां संहृष्टो ज्ञातिभिः परिवारितः। आगम्य भरतं प्रह्वो गुहो वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.84.15।।
output: Having obtaind the permission, a delighted Guha, escorted by his relatives,  approached Bharata and humbly said:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निष्कुटश्चैव देशोऽयं वञ्चिताश्चापि ते वयम्। निवेदयामस्ते सर्वे स्वके दासकुले वस।।2.84.16।।
output: This country is like a pleasuregarden at the backyard of your palace. All of us are  subordinate to you and we solicit you to stay in the house of  this servant of yours.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्ति मूलं फलञ्चैव निषादैस्समुपाहृतम्। आर्द्रं च मांसं शुष्कं च वन्यं चोच्चावचं महत्।।2.84.17।।
output: निषादैः by nishadas, समुपाहृतम् have been brought, मूलम् root, फलं चैव fruits also, वन्यम्  the forest produce, आर्द्रम् fresh, शुष्कं च dried, उच्चावचम् of great variety, महत् best, मांसं च  अस्ति meat are here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 84:
आशंसे स्वाशिता सेना वत्स्यतीमां विभावरीम्। अर्चितो विविधैः कामै श्श्व स्ससैन्यो गमिष्यसि।।2.84.18।।
output: We hope your army having  refreshed themselves will spend the night here. With our hospitality extended, you can proceed tomorrow. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुरशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightyfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तस्तु भरतो निषादाधिपतिं गुहम्। प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो वाक्यं हेत्वर्थसंहितम्।।2.85.1।।
output: Bharata expresses his desire to bring back Rama -- enquires the way to Bharadwaja's hermitage.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
ऊर्जितः खलु ते कामः कृतो मम गुरोस्सखे। यो मे त्वमीदृशीं सेनामेकोऽभ्यर्चितुमिच्छसि।।2.85.2।।
output: O dear friend of my elder brother, your desire to extend hospitality to this large army all alone is indeed noble.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्त्वा तु महातेजा गुहं वचनमुत्तमम्। अब्रवीद्भरत श्श्रीमाननिषादाधिपतिं पुनः।।2.85.3।।
output: Having spoken to Guha courteously, the majestic, radiant Bharata continued:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
कतरेण गमिष्यामि भरद्वाजाश्रमं गुह। गहनोऽयं भृशं देशो गङ्गाऽनूपो दुरत्ययः।।2.85.4।।
output: O Guha this region of Ganga with its dense forest is very difficult to cross. How can I reach the hermitage of Bharadwaja?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजपुत्रस्य धीमतः। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं गुहो गहनगोचरः।।2.85.5।।
output: When he heard those words of the sagacious Bharata, Guha the forest ranger answered him reverentially with folded palms.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
दाशास्त्वाऽनुऽगमिष्यन्ति धन्विनस्सुसमाहिताः। अहं त्वानुगमिष्यामि राजपुत्र महायशः।।2.85.6।।
output: O prince of great renown I shall follow you, wellprepared with these fishermen, armed with bows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
कच्छिन्नदुष्टो व्रजसि रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। इयं ते महती सेना शङ्कां जनयतीव मे।।2.85.7।।
output: Are you not going to that place with the evil intention of causing harm to Rama of unwearied actions? This large army of yours arouses doubts in me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमेवमभिभाषन्तमाकाश इव निर्मलः। भरतश्श्लक्ष्णया वाचा गुहं वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.85.8।।
output: आकाशः इव like the sky, निर्मलः tranquil, भरतः Bharata, एवम् thus, अभिभाषन्तम् talking, तं गुहम् addressing Guha, श्लक्ष्णया in gentle, वाचा voice, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
माभूत्स कालो यत्कष्टं न मां शङ्कितुमर्हसि। राघव स्सहि मे भ्राता ज्येष्ठः पितुसमो मतः।।2.85.9।।
output: यत् which, कष्टम् calamity, सः कालः that time, मा भूत् shall not come, माम् to me, शङ्कितुम् to suspect, नार्हसि you should not, मे my, ज्येष्ठः eldest, भ्राता brother, सः राघवः that Rama, पितृसमः is equal to my father, मतः हि he has been held in high esteem.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं निवर्तयितुं यामि काकुत्स्थं वनवासिनम्। बुद्धिरन्या न ते कार्या गुह सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते।।2.85.10।।
output: I am going to bring back that scion of the kakutsthas (Rama) who resides in the forest. O Guha, do not entertain any other thought. I am tellng you the truth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तु संहृष्टवदन श्श्रुत्वा भरतभाषितम्। पुनरेवाब्रवीद्वाक्यं भरतं प्रति हर्षितः।।2.85.11।।
output: When he heard those words of Bharata, Guha was delighted and his face beamed with joy as he said to Bharata:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धन्यस्त्वं न त्वया तुल्यं पश्यामि जगतीतले। अयत्नादागतं राज्यं यस्त्वं त्यक्तुमिहेच्छसि।।2.85.12।।
output: यः त्वम् such a man as you are, इह now, अयत्नात् effortlessly, आगतम् arrived, राज्यम् kingdom, त्यक्तुम् to renounce, इच्छसि wish, त्वम् you, धन्यः are blessed, त्वया your, तुल्यम् equal, जगतीतले on this earth, न पश्यामि I do not see.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शाश्वती खलु ते कीर्तिर्लोकाननुचरिष्यति। यस्त्वं कृच्छ्रगतं रामं प्रत्यानयितुमिच्छसि।।2.85.13।।
output: यः त्वम् you, कृच्छ्रगतम् who is in great difficulty, रामम् Rama, प्रत्यानयितुम् to bring back, इच्छसि desire, ते your, शाश्वती everlasting, कीर्तिः fame, लोकान् in this world, अनुचरिष्यति will spread.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं सम्भाषमाणस्य गुहस्य भरतं तदा। बभौ नष्टप्रभस्सूर्यो रजनी चाभ्यवर्तत।।2.85.14।।
output: तदा then, गुहस्य Guha's, एवं thus, भरतं to Bharata, सम्भाषमाणस्य while conversing, सूर्यः sun, नष्टप्रभः diminished light, बभौ shone, रजनी च night, अभ्यवर्तत set in.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
सन्निवेश्य स तां सेनां गुहेन परितोषितः। शत्रुघ्नेन सह श्रीमाञ्छयनं समुपागमत्।।2.85.15।।
output: Fortunate Bharata gratified by Guha encamped his army and retired to bed along with Satrughna.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामचिन्तामय श्शोको भरतस्य महात्मनः। उपस्थितो ह्यनर्हस्य धर्मप्रेक्षस्य तादृशः।।2.85.16।।
output: But the thought of Rama caused grief to the magnanimous Bharata, a man of righteous outlook who did not deserve such grief.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
अन्तर्दाहेन दहनस्सन्तापयति राघवम्। वनदाहाभिसन्तप्तं गूढोऽग्निरिव पादपम्।।2.85.17।।
output: Just like a concealed forestfire scorching the dried up forest, the fire of sorrow kindled in his mind scorched Bharata.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
प्रसृतस्सर्वगात्रेभ्यस्स्वेदं शोकाग्निसम्भवम्। यथा सूर्यांशुसन्तप्तो हिमवान् प्रसृतोहिमम्।।2.85.18।।
output: Like the ice melted by the heat of the Sun's rays flows down the Himalayas, sweat poured from all parts of his body caused by the fire of grief.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
ध्याननिर्धरशैलेन विनिश्श्वसितधातुना। दैन्यपादपसंघेन शोकायासाधिशृङ्गिणा।।2.85.19।। प्रमोहानन्तसत्त्वेन सन्तापौषधिवेणुना। आक्रान्तो दुःखशैलेन महता कैकयीसुतः।।2.85.20।।
output: Bharata, son of Kaikeyi was stricken by a lofty mountain of grief. The cavityless rocks of that mountain were his contemplation, the minerals were his sighs, the multitude of trees were his desolation, peaks were his fatigue and mental distress, the unlimited number of animals were his stupor, the bamboo tree was his sorrow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
ध्याननिर्धरशैलेन विनिश्श्वसितधातुना। दैन्यपादपसंघेन शोकायासाधिशृङ्गिणा।।2.85.19।। प्रमोहानन्तसत्त्वेन सन्तापौषधिवेणुना। आक्रान्तो दुःखशैलेन महता कैकयीसुतः।।2.85.20।।
output: Bharata, son of Kaikeyi was stricken by a lofty mountain of grief. The cavityless rocks of that mountain were his contemplation, the minerals were his sighs, the multitude of trees were his desolation, peaks were his fatigue and mental distress, the unlimited number of animals were his stupor, the bamboo tree was his sorrow.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनिश्श्वसन्वै भृशदुर्मनास्ततः प्रमूढसंज्ञः परमापदं गतः। शमं न लेभे हृदयज्वरार्दितो नरर्षभो यूथहतो यथर्षभः।।2.85.21।।
output: ततः then, नरर्षभः best among men (Bharata), विनिश्श्वसन् heaving sighs, भृशदुर्मनाः with greatly distraught mind, प्रमूढसंज्ञः with bewildered senses, परमापदं a great calamity, गतः caught, हृदयज्वरार्दितः oppressed by the fever raging his heart, यूथहतः separated from the herd, ऋषभः यथा like a bull, शमं peace of mind, न लेभे  did not get.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 85:
गुहेन सार्धं भरतस्समागतो महानुभावस्सजनस्समाहितः। सुदुर्मनास्तं भरतं तदा पुनर्गुह स्समाश्वासयदग्रजं प्रति।।2.85.22।।
output: Bharata, a man of great magnanimity, joined Guha together with his people with composed mind. Then Guha, greatly distraught, again consoled  Bharata  regarding his elder brother Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चाशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightyfifth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आचचक्षेऽथ सद्भावं लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः। भरतायाप्रमेयाय गुहो गहनगोचरः।।2.86.1।।
output: Guha's reminiseesces.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं जाग्रतं गुणैर्युक्तं शरचापासिधारिणम्। भ्रातृगुप्त्यर्थमत्यन्तमहं लक्ष्मणमबृवम्।।2.86.2।।
output: I spoke to the virtuous Lakshmana, who was holding arrows, bow and sword in his hand and keeping awake completely for the protection of his brother.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इयं तात सुखा शय्या त्वदर्थमुपकल्पिता। प्रत्याश्वसिहि शेष्वास्यां सुखं राघवनन्दन।।2.86.3।।
output: राघवनन्दन delight of the race of Raghu, तात my friend, (लक्ष्मण Lakshmana), सुखा comfortable, इयम् this, शय्या couch, त्वदर्थम् for your sake, उपकल्पिता has been arranged, प्रत्याश्वसिहि be assured, अस्याम् upon it, सुखम् peacefully, शेष्व lie down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उचितोऽयं जनस्सर्वो दुःखानां त्वं सुखोचितः। धर्मात्मंस्तस्य गुप्त्यर्थं जागरिष्यामहे वयम्।।2.86.4।।
output: धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, अयम् this, सर्वः all, जनः people, दुःखानाम् for hardships, उचितः  are accustomed, त्वम् you, सुखोचितः are used to comfort, तस्य for Rama's, गुप्त्यर्थम् for the sake of protection, वयम् we, जागरिष्यामहे will stay awake.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 86:
नहि रामात्प्रियतरो ममास्ति भुवि कश्चन। मोत्सुकोऽभूर्ब्रवीम्येतदप्यसत्यं तवाग्रतः।।2.86.5।।
output: To me, there is none on earth dearer than Rama. Do not have any anxiety. I am telling you the truth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 86:
अस्य प्रसादादाशंसे लोकेऽस्मिन् सुमहद्यशः। धर्मावाप्तिं च विपुलामर्थकामौ च केवलम्।।2.86.6।।
output: By the grace of Rama, I want to acquire in this world great renown, abundance of righteousness, absolute artha (prosperity) and kama (pleasure).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽहं प्रियसखं रामं शयानं सह सीतया। रक्षिष्यामि धनुष्पाणि स्सर्वै स्स्वैर्ज्ञातिभिस्सह।।2.86.7।।
output: As for me, bow in hand and all my kinsmen with me, I shall protect my dear friend Rama who is resting with Sita.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न हि मेऽविदितं किञ्चिद्वनेऽस्मिंश्चरत स्सदा। चतुरङ्गं ह्यपि बलं प्रसहेम वयं युधि।।2.86.8।।
output: Nothing is unknown to me in this forest in which I range about continually. We can withstand an army of four divisions in a battle.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमस्माभिरुक्तेन लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना। अनुनीता वयं सर्वे धर्ममेवानुपश्यता।। 2.86.9।।
output: एवं thus, अस्माभिः by us, उक्तेन having been uttered, महात्मना by the  magnanimous, धर्ममेव virtuousness alone, अनुपश्यता seeing, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, वयम् we, सर्वे all, अनुनीताः  have been entreated.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 86:
कथं दाशरथौ भूमौ शयाने सह सीतया। शक्या निद्रा मया लब्धुं जीवितं वा सुखानि वा।।2.86.10।।
output: While Rama sleep on the ground with Sita, how can I find sleep or joy or comfort?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यो न देवासुरैस्सर्वैश्शक्यः प्रसहितुं युधि। तं पश्य गुह संविष्टं तृणेषु सह सीतया।।2.86.11।।
output: O Guha behold Rama, whom gods and demons combined cannot withstand in a battle now lying on a bed of grass with Sita.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 86:
महता तपसा लब्धो विविधैश्च परिश्रमैः। एको दशरथस्यैष पुत्रस्सदृशलक्षणः।।2.86.12।।
output: Rama is the only one among the sons who resembles his father in various virtues. Dasaratha obtained him after a great deal of austerities and efforts as well.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अस्मिन्प्रव्राजिते राजा न चिरं वर्तयिष्यति। विधवा मेदिनी नूनं क्षिप्रमेव भविष्यति।।2.86.13।।
output: After Rama is exiled, king Dasaratha will not survive for long and surely the earth will soon be widowed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनद्य सुमहानादं श्रमेणोपरताः स्त्रियः। निर्घोषो विरतो नूनमध्य राजनिवेशने।।2.86.14।।
output: स्त्रियः women, सुमहानादम् loud sounds, विनद्य having cried, श्रमेण with exhaustion, उपरताः  have ceased, अद्य now, राजनिवेशने in the king's palace, निर्घोषः clamour, नूनम् surely, विरतः   has subsided.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 86:
कौसल्या चैव राजा च तथैव जननी मम। नाशंसे यदि जीवेयुस्सर्वे ते शर्वरीमिमाम्।।2.86.15।।
output: I doubt whether the king, Kausalya and my mother Sumitra and the rest of them will outlive this night.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जीवेदपि च मे माता शत्रुघ्नस्यान्ववेक्षया। दुःखिता या तु कौसल्या वीरसूर्विनशिष्यति।।2.86.16।।
output: मे माता my mother, शत्रुघ्नस्य Satrughna's, अन्ववेक्षया looking at, जीवेदपि च might be alive, वीरसूः mother of a warrior, या कौसल्या that Kausalya, सा तु as for her, दुःखिता with extreme grief, विनशिष्यति will die.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अतिक्रान्तमतिक्रान्तमनवाप्य मनोरथम्। राज्ये राममनिक्षिप्य पिता मे विनशिष्यति।।2.86.17।।
output: My father, king Dasaratha, failing to fulfil his cherished desires one after another and unable to place Rama on the throne, will pass away.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सिद्धार्थाः पितरं वृत्तं तस्मिन्काले ह्युपस्थिते। प्रेतकार्येषु सर्वेषु संस्करिष्यन्ति भूमिपम्।।2.86.18।।
output: तस्मिन्काले when that moment, उपस्थिते had arrived, वृत्तम् being in that state, पितरम् my father, भूमिपम् for the lord of the earth, सर्वेषु all, प्रेतकार्येषु in funeral rites, संस्करिष्यन्ति will perform, सिद्धार्थाः men who attained their purpose.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रम्यचत्वरसंस्थानां सुविभक्तमहापथाम्। हर्म्यप्रासादम्पन्नां सर्वरत्नविभूषिताम्।।2.86.19।। गजाश्वरथसंबाधां तूर्यनादविनादिताम्। सर्वकल्याणसंपूर्णां हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलाम्।।2.86.20।। आरामोद्यानसंपूर्णां समाजोत्सवशालिनीम्। सुखिता विचरिष्यन्ति राजधानीं पितुर्मम।।2.86.21।।
output: There in the capital of my father with its lovely crossroads and squares, welllaid  highways, full of mansions and palaces encrusted with all kinds of precious stones, teeming with elephants, horses and chariots, resounding with trumpets, and with wellbeing everywhere, and plenty of pleasuregardens, and parks and community festivals, people sound in health would be moving about in great comfort.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रम्यचत्वरसंस्थानां सुविभक्तमहापथाम्। हर्म्यप्रासादम्पन्नां सर्वरत्नविभूषिताम्।।2.86.19।। गजाश्वरथसंबाधां तूर्यनादविनादिताम्। सर्वकल्याणसंपूर्णां हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलाम्।।2.86.20।। आरामोद्यानसंपूर्णां समाजोत्सवशालिनीम्। सुखिता विचरिष्यन्ति राजधानीं पितुर्मम।।2.86.21।।
output: There in the capital of my father with its lovely crossroads and squares, welllaid  highways, full of mansions and palaces encrusted with all kinds of precious stones, teeming with elephants, horses and chariots, resounding with trumpets, and with wellbeing everywhere, and plenty of pleasuregardens, and parks and community festivals, people sound in health would be moving about in great comfort.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 86:
रम्यचत्वरसंस्थानां सुविभक्तमहापथाम्। हर्म्यप्रासादम्पन्नां सर्वरत्नविभूषिताम्।।2.86.19।। गजाश्वरथसंबाधां तूर्यनादविनादिताम्। सर्वकल्याणसंपूर्णां हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलाम्।।2.86.20।। आरामोद्यानसंपूर्णां समाजोत्सवशालिनीम्। सुखिता विचरिष्यन्ति राजधानीं पितुर्मम।।2.86.21।।
output: There in the capital of my father with its lovely crossroads and squares, welllaid  highways, full of mansions and palaces encrusted with all kinds of precious stones, teeming with elephants, horses and chariots, resounding with trumpets, and with wellbeing everywhere, and plenty of pleasuregardens, and parks and community festivals, people sound in health would be moving about in great comfort.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अपिसत्यप्रतिज्ञेन सार्धं कुशलिना वयं। निवृत्ते समये ह्यस्मिन् सुखिताः प्रविशेमहि।।2.86.22।।
output: Can we ever reenter Ayodhya happily after safely fulfilling the vow and completing the term of exile?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
परिदेवयमानस्य तस्यैवं सुमहात्मनः। तिष्ठतो राजपुत्रस्य शर्वरी साऽत्यवर्तत।।2.86.23।।
output: सुमहात्मनः of the highminded, एवं in this way, परिदेवयमानस्य lamenting so, तस्य राजपुत्रस्य that prince, तिष्ठतः while waiting, सा शर्वरी that night, अत्यवर्तत elapsed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 86:
प्रभाते विमले सूर्ये कारयित्वा जटा उभौ। अस्मिन् भागीरथीतीरे सुखं सन्तारितौ मया।।2.86.24।।
output: The next morning when the Sun shone bright, both of them matted their hair on the bank of the river Bhagirathi (Ganga) and I ferried them across comfortably.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 86:
जटाधरौ तौ द्रुमचीरवाससौ महाबलौ कुञ्जरयूथपोपमौ। वरेषुचापासिधरौ परन्तपौ व्यपेक्षमाणौ सह सीतया गतौ।।2.86.25।।
output: Rama and Lakshmana, slayers of enemies, who are as strong as bull elephants, with their hair matted, wearing robes made of bark, armed with excellent bows, arrows and swords went along with Sita looking around (vigilantly). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षडशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightysixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गुहस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भरतो भृशमप्रियम्। ध्यानं जगाम तत्रैव यत्र तच्छ्रुतमप्रियम्।।2.87.1।।
output: Bharata enquires about Rama, Sita and Lakshmana -- Guha narrates to Kausalya how Rama, Sita and Lakshmana spent their time, matted their hair and slept on grass.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 87:
सुकुमारो महासत्त्वस्सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्ष स्तरुणः प्रियदर्शनः।।2.87.2।। प्रत्याश्वस्य मुहूर्तं तु कालं परमदुर्मनाः। पपात सहसा तोत्रैर्ह्यतिविद्ध इव द्विपः।।2.87.3।।
output: The delicate, youthful, highly energetic and mightyarmed Bharata of graceful appearance, with shoulders like that of a lion and wideeyed like lotus petals, recovered for a moment and with a mind deeply distressed fell down at once like an elephant smitten by a goad.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुकुमारो महासत्त्वस्सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्ष स्तरुणः प्रियदर्शनः।।2.87.2।। प्रत्याश्वस्य मुहूर्तं तु कालं परमदुर्मनाः। पपात सहसा तोत्रैर्ह्यतिविद्ध इव द्विपः।।2.87.3।।
output: The delicate, youthful, highly energetic and mightyarmed Bharata of graceful appearance, with shoulders like that of a lion and wideeyed like lotus petals, recovered for a moment and with a mind deeply distressed fell down at once like an elephant smitten by a goad.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदवस्थं तु भरतं शत्रुघ्नोऽनन्तरस्थितः। परिष्वज्य रुरोदोच्चैर्विसंज्ञश्शोककर्शितः।।2.87.4।।
output: अनन्तरस्थितः standing close by, शत्रुघ्नः Satrughna, तदवस्थम् in this state, भरतम् Bharata, परिष्यज्य having embraced, शोककर्शितः smitten with grief, विसंज्ञः having lost his senses,  उच्चैः loudly, रुरोद cried.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सर्वास्समापेतुर्मातरो भरतस्य ताः। उपवासकृशा दीना भर्तृव्यसनकर्शिताः।।2.87.5।।
output: Then Bharata's mothers, who were emaciated due to fasting and afflicted by the calamity of the death of their husband were desolate, rushed towards him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ताश्च तं पतितं भूमौ रुदन्त्यः पर्यवारयन्। कौसल्या त्वनुसृत्यैनं दुर्मनाः परिषस्वजे।।2.87.6।।
output: Sobbing, they gathered around Bharata who had fallen on the ground, while Kausalya approached him in a depressed state and took him into her arms.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वत्सला स्वं यथा वत्समुपगूह्य तपस्विनी। परिपप्रच्छ भरतं रुदन्ती शोकलालसा।।2.87.7।।
output: शोकलालसा distressed in grief, तपस्विनी desolate, वत्सला with filial love, रुदन्ती weeping, स्वम् her own, वत्सं यथा like child, उपगूह्य clasping, भरतम् Bharata, परिपप्रच्छ enquired.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुत्र व्याधिर्न ते कच्चिच्छरीरं परिबाधते। अद्य राजकुलस्यास्य त्वदधीनं हि जीवितम्।।2.87.8।।
output: पुत्र O son, व्याधिः illness, ते शरीरम् your body, कच्चित् न परिबाधते is not troubling, I hope, अद्य now, अस्य राजकुलस्य of this royal house, जीवितम् life, त्वदधीनं हि is dependent on you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 87:
त्वां दृष्ट्वा पुत्र जीवामि रामे सभ्रातृकेगते। वृत्ते दशरथे राज्ञि नाथ एकस्त्वमद्य नः।।2.87.9।।
output: O my son, with Rama gone to the forest along with your brother Lakshmana and with king Dasaratha departed from this world, I continue to live seeing you. From now on you alone are our sole protector.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कच्चिन्न लक्ष्मणे पुत्र श्रुतं ते किंचदप्रियम्। पुत्रे वाऽप्येकपुत्राया स्सहभार्ये वनं गते।।2.87.10।।
output: O my son, I hope you have not heard any unpleasant news about Lakshmana or about my only son Rama who has gone to the forest along with his wife.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स मुहूर्तं समाश्वस्य रुदन्नेव महायशाः। कौसल्यां परिसान्त्वेद्यं गुहं वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.87.11।।
output: महायशाः of great renown, सः that Bharata, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, समाश्वस्य composing himself, कौसल्याम् Kausalya, परिसान्त्वेद्यं reassuring, रुदन्नेव still weeping, गुहम् to Guha, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भ्राता मे क्वावसद्रात्रौ क्व सीता क्व च लक्ष्मणः। अस्वपच्छयने कस्मिन् किं भुक्त्वा गुह शंस मे।।2.87.12।।
output: O Guha where did my brother Rama, Sita and Lakshmana spend that night? What did they eat? On what couch did they sleep? Tell me all that.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽब्रवीद्भरतं हृष्टो निषादाधिपतिर्गुहः। यद्विधं प्रतिपेदे च रामे प्रियहितेऽतिथौ।।2.87.13।।
output: Thereupon delighted Guha, overlord of the nishadas, told Bharata all that he had provided to Rama, his beloved friend and guest:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 87:
अन्नमुच्चावचं भक्षाः फलानि विविधानि च। रामायाभ्यवहारार्थं बहुचोपहृतं मया।।2.87.14।।
output: I offered Rama rice including a variety of eatables like fruits in great quantity for his food.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्सर्वं प्रत्यनुज्ञासीद्राम स्सत्यपराक्रमः। न तु तत्प्रत्यगृह्णात्स क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन्।।2.87.15।।
output: Rama whose prowess is his truth, acknowledged all that but remembering the duty enjoined on a kshatriya did not accept them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न ह्यस्माभिः प्रतिग्राह्यं सखे देयं तु सर्वदा। इति तेन वयं राजन्ननुनीता महात्मना।।2.87.16।।
output: O king that great Rama entreated us in a friendly manner by saying 'O friend we should always give to others but should never accept anything from others'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लक्ष्मणेन समानीतं पीत्वा वारि महायशाः। औपवास्यं तदाऽकार्षीद्राघवस्सह सीतया।।2.87.17।।
output: महायशाः the illustrious one, राघवः Rama, तदा then, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, समानीतम् brought by, वारि water, सीतया सह with Sita, पीत्वा after drinking, औपवास्यम् fasting, अकार्षीत्  undertook.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तु जलशेषेण लक्ष्मणोऽप्यकरोत्तदा। वाग्यतास्ते त्रय स्सन्ध्यां समुपासत संहिताः।।2.87.18।।
output: Thereafter Lakshmana also drank the remainder of water. Then all the three observing silence intently performed the evening worship.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सौमित्रिस्तु ततः पश्चादकरोत्स्वास्तरं शुभम्। स्वयमानीय बर्हींषि क्षिप्रं राघवकारणात्।।2.87.19।।
output: Therafter, the son of Sumitra (Lakshmana) himself fetched darbha grass and quickly prepared an auspicious and comfortable bed for Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 87:
तस्मिन्समाविशद्राम स्स्वास्तरे सह सीतया। प्रक्षाल्य च तयोः पादावपचक्राम लक्ष्मणः।।2.87.20।।
output: Rama lay down upon the bed along with Sita. Thereafter Lakshmana, having washed their feet, moved to a distant place.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतत्तदिङ्गुदीमूलमिदमेव च तत्तृणम्। यस्मिन्रामश्च सीता च रात्रिं तां शयितावुभौ।।2.87.21।।
output: Here at the foot of the ingudi tree and upon that bed of grass both Rama and Sita rested that night.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नियम्य पृष्ठे तु तलाङ्गुलित्रवान् शरैस्सुपूर्णाविषुधी परन्तपः। महाद्धनु स्सज्यमुपोह्य लक्ष्मणो निशामतिष्ठत्परितोऽस्य केवलम्।।2.87.22।।
output: Lakshmana, the scorcher of enemies, wearing protective covering for his palms and fingers (made of gohaskin), strapping on his back two quivers filled with arrows, holding a great bow, strung ready, stood sentinel throughout the night guarding the surrounding.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत स्त्वहंचोत्तमबाणचापधृत् स्थितोऽभवं तत्र स यत्र लक्ष्मणः। अतन्द्रितैर्ज्ञातिभिरात्तकार्मुकैर्महेन्द्रकल्पं परिपालयंस्तदा।।2.87.23।।
output: Then, holding the best of arrows and bow along with my indefatigable kinsmen similarly armed with bows, I stood by the side of Lakshmana guarding Rama who is comparable to Indra. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्ताशीतितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eightyseventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्छ्रुत्वा निपुणं सर्वं भरत स्सह मन्त्रिभिः। इङ्गुदीमूलमागम्य रामशय्यामवेक्ष्य ताम्।।2.88.1।। अब्रवीज्जननी स्सर्वा इह तेन महात्मना। शर्वरी शयिता भूमाविदमस्य विमर्दितम्।।2.88.2।।
output: भरतः Bharata, तत् सर्वम् all that, निपुणम् attentively, श्रुत्वा having listened, मन्त्रिभिस्सह along with ministers, इङ्गुदीमूलम् to the foot of the ingudi tree, आगम्य having reached, ताम्  रामशय्याम् that Rama's bed, अवेक्ष gazing, सर्वाः all, जननीः mothers, अब्रवीत् said, तेन महात्मना by that magnanimous, Rama, इह here, भूमौ on the ground, शर्वरी night, शयिता has been slept, अस्य his, विमर्दितम् crushed bed, इदम् this one.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महाभागकुलीनेन महाभागेन धीमता। जातो दशरथेनोर्व्यां न रामस्स्वप्तु मर्हति।।2.88.3।।
output: Rama, son of highly fortunate and sagacious Dasaratha, born of a noble lineage does not deserve to rest on this naked earth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Ayodhya Kanda, Sarga 88:
अजिनोत्तरसंस्तीर्णे वरास्तरणसंचये। शयित्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रः कथं शेते महीतले।।2.88.4।।
output: How could Rama, the best among men used to a bed made of a pile of excellent spreads and overspread with deer skin, sleep on the bare ground?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रासादाग्रविमानेषु वलभीषु च सर्वदा। हैमराजतभौमेषु वरास्तरणशालिषु।।2.88.5।। पुष्पसञ्चयचित्रेषु चन्दनागरुगन्धिषु। पाण्डुराभ्रप्रकाशेषु शुकसङ्घरूतेषुच।।2.88.6।। प्रासादवरवर्येषु शीतवत्सु सुगन्धिषु। उषित्वामेरुकल्पेषु कृतकाञ्चन भित्तिषु।।2.88.7।। गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषैर्वराभरणनिस्स्वनैः। मृदङ्गवरशब्दैश्च सततं प्रतिबोधितः।।2.88.8।। वन्दिभिर्वन्दितः काले बहुभि स्सूतमागधैः। गाथाभिरनुरूपाभि स्स्तुतिभिश्च परन्तपः।।2.88.9।।
output: Rama, scorcher of enemies, one who was accostomed to dwell in the attic of sevenstoreyed mansions with floors paved with gold, and silver, spread with excellent carpets, decked with bouquets of flowers and perfumed with sandal and agaru. The peaks of those palaces were bright like towering white clouds and echoed with cries of  parrots. They were cool and fragrant with perfumes. The marvellous palaces made of golden walls are comparable to mount Meru. He used to wake up to the sounds of songs and musical instruments, the tinkling of finest ornaments and the splendid sounds of the drums. Many bards, genealogists and panegyrists singing befitting ballads and extolling his virtues at appropriate time used to salute him in reverence (Bharata lamented).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

output: परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, (सः that Rama), सर्वदा always, प्रासादाग्रविमानेषु वलभीषु च in the attic of the sevenstoreyed mansion, हैमराजतभौमेषु the floors paved with gold and silver, वरास्तरणशालिषु spread with excellent carpets, पुष्पसंचयचित्रेषु decked with bouquets of flowers, चन्दनागरुगन्धिषु perfumed with sandal and agaru, पाण्डुराभ्रप्रकाशेषु brightness like white clouds, शुकसङ्घरुतेषु च echoed with cries of flocks of parrots, शीतवत्सु cool, सुगन्धिषु in places fragrant with perfumes, कृतकाञ्चनभित्तिषु surrounded by goldplated walls, मेरुकल्पेषु like mount Meru, प्रासादवरवर्येषु in the best of mansions, उषित्वा having dwelt, गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषैः with the sounds of songs and musical instruments, वराभरणनिस्वनैः with the tinkling of ornaments, मृदङ्गवरशब्दैश्च and with excellent sounds of drums, (तत्र there), प्रतिबोधितः awakened, बहुभिः by many, सूतमागधैः bards and genealogists, वन्दिभिः by the panegyrists  गाथाभिः with ballads, अनुरूपाभिः by worthy, स्तुतिभिश्च by songs of praise, काले at appointed time, वन्दितः saluted in reverence.
