output: All the foresters looked at the wonderful figures of Rama, Sita and Lakshmana with unblinking eyes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 1:
अत्रैनं हि महाभागा स्सर्वभूतहिते रताः। अतिथिं पर्णशालायां राघवं संन्यवेशयन्।।3.1.15।।
output: Ever engaged in the welfare of all beings, the sages made Rama, their guest, sit in their leafy hut.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 1:
ततो रामस्य सत्कृत्य विधिना पावकोपमाः। आजह्रुस्ते महाभागाः सलिलं धर्मचारिणः।।3.1.16।।
output: The great sages comparable to the firegod and followers of righteousness honoured Rama  according to tradition by offering water.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 1:
पुष्पं मूलं फलं सर्वमाश्रमं च महात्मनः। निवेदयित्वा धर्मज्ञास्ते ततः प्राञ्जलयोऽब्रुवन्।।3.1.17।।
output: The sages who were knowers of dharma saluted the noble Rama, offered fruits, roots and flowers available  at the hermitage and with folded palms said thus:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 1:
धर्मपालो जनस्यास्य शरण्यस्त्वं महायशाः। पूजनीयश्च मान्यश्च राजा दण्डधरो गुरुः।।3.1.18।।
output: O king of great reputation, you are the refuge of the people, a protector of dharma, a chastiser of wrongdoers, a worshipful and respectable preceptor.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 1:
इन्द्रस्येह चतुर्भागः प्रजा रक्षति राघव। राजा तस्माद्वरान्भोगान्रम्यान् भुङक्तेलोकनमस्कृतः।।3.1.19।।
output: O Rama, in this world a king is considered the fourth part of Indra as he protects the people. Therefore, he is respected and he enjoys the choicest pleasures of life.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते वयं भवता रक्ष्या भवद्विषयवासिनः। नगरस्थो वनस्थो वा त्वं नो राजा जनेश्वरः।।3.1.20।।
output: Since we are the residents of your territory we deserve to be protected by you. Whether you live in the city or in the forest, you are the lord of the people and our king.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न्यस्तदण्डा वयं राजञ्जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः। रक्षणीयास्त्वया शश्वदगर्भभूतास्तपोधनाः।।3.1.21।।
output: राजन् O king, जितक्रोधाः men who have conquered anger, जितेन्द्रियाः selfcontrolled, तपोधनाः  asceties, वयम् we, न्यस्तदण्डाः cast aside the symbol of authority, गर्भभूताः like your children, त्वया by you, शश्वत् forever, रक्षणीयाः to be protected.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा फलैर्मूलैः पुष्पैर्वन्यैश्च राघवम्। अन्यैश्च विविधाहारैः सलक्ष्मणमपूजयन्।।3.1.22।।
output: Having said so, the ascetics offered with reverence fruits, roots, flowers and other forest  products to Rama and Lakshmana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृतातिथ्योऽथ रामस्तु सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति। आम्नत्ऱ्य स मुनीन्सर्वान्वनमेवान्वगाहत।।3.2.1।।
output: अथ then, कृतातिथ्यः on receiving hospitality, सः रामस्तु that Rama also, सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति at the time of sunrise, सर्वान् all, मुनीन् sages, आम्नत्ऱ्य  took leave, वनमेव into the forest, अन्वगाहत entered deep.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नानामृगगणाकीर्णमृक्षशार्दूल सेवितम्। ध्वस्तवृक्षलतागुल्मं दुर्दर्शसलिलाशयम्।।3.2.2।। निष्कूजनानाशकुनिझिल्लिकागणनादितम्। लक्ष्मणानुगतो रामो वनमध्यं ददर्श ह।।3.2.3।।
output: With Lakshmana following, Rama went through the forest, filled with herds of animals and inhabited by bears and tigers. It was a place where trees, creepers and bushes were crushed (by frequent visits of demons). It was difficult to locate a water source.  And it resounded with the chirping of various birds and insects (crickets).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नानामृगगणाकीर्णमृक्षशार्दूल सेवितम्। ध्वस्तवृक्षलतागुल्मं दुर्दर्शसलिलाशयम्।।3.2.2।। निष्कूजनानाशकुनिझिल्लिकागणनादितम्। लक्ष्मणानुगतो रामो वनमध्यं ददर्श ह।।3.2.3।।
output: लक्ष्मणानुगतः followed by Lakshmana, रामः Rama, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् filled with different kinds of animals, ऋक्षशार्दूलसेवितम् inhabited by bears and tigers, ध्वस्तवृक्षलतागुल्मम् a place where trees, creepers and bushes were crushed (due to frequent visit by demons), दुर्दश difficult to see, सलिलाशयम् waterreservoirs like wells, निष्कूजनानाशकुनि with the twitter of various birds, झिल्लिकागणनादितम् resounding with the chirping of crickets. वनमध्यम् midst of the forest, ददर्श ह witnessed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सीतया सह काकुत्स्थस्तस्मिनघोरमृगायुते। ददर्श गिरिशृङ्गाभं पुरुषादं महास्वनम्।।3.2.4।।
output: सीतया सह along with Sita, काकुत्स्थः Rama of the Kakutstha family, घोरमृगायुते infested with dreadful animals, तस्मिन् in that place, गिरिशृङ्गाभम् comparable to the peak of a mountain, महास्वनम्  heavy sound, पुरुषादम् a cannibal, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गम्भीराक्षं महावक्त्रं विकटं विषमोदरम्। बीभत्सं विषमं दीर्घं विकृतं घोरदर्शनम्।।3.2.5।।
output: He was of dreadful appearance with deep eyes, a huge face and a big belly. He looked tall, ugly and frightening.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं वसार्द्रं रुधिरोक्षितम्। त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्।।3.2.6।।
output: Wearing a tigerskin, he resembled the god of death. With a wide, open mouth, wet with marrow and drenched with blood, he struck terror into  all beings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्रीन्सिम्हान्श्चतुरो व्याघ्रान्द्वौ वृकौ पृषतान्दश। सविषाणं वसादिग्धं गजस्य च शिरो महत्। अवसज्यायसे शूले विनदन्तं महास्वनम्।।3.2.7।।
output: Roaring loudly, he carried an iron spit in which were pierced three lions, four tigers, two wolves, ten deer  and the huge head of an elephant with its tusks smeared with the fat of flesh.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स रामं लक्ष्मणं चैव सीतां दृष्ट्वा च मैथिलीम्। अभ्यधावत्सुसङ्कृद्धः प्रजाः काल इवान्तकः।।3.2.8।।
output: Looking extremely furious, he ran towards Rama, Lakshmana and Sita like the god of death rushes towards the (dying) people.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स कृत्वा भैरवं नादं चालयन्निव मेदिनीम्। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीमपक्रम्य ततोऽब्रवीत्।।3.2.9।।
output: Making a dreadful sound, as if shaking the earth, he took Sita on his lap, stepped aside and said:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
युवां जटाचीरधरौ सभार्यौ क्षीणजीवितौ। प्रविष्टौ दण्डकारण्यं शरचापासिधारिणौ।।3.2.10।।
output: You both clad in bark and wearing matted hair, holding bows, arrows and swords have entered into the Dandaka forest with your wife. Your life has been cut short indeed৷৷

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कथं तापसयोर्वां च वासः प्रमदया सह। अधर्मचारिणौ पापौ कौ युवां मुनिदूषकौ।।3.2.11।।
output: तापसयोः you wear attire of ascetics, वाम् you both, वासः stay, कथम् how is it possible, अधर्मचरिणौ both unrighteous people, मुनिदूषकौ both distorting ascetic discipline, पापौ sinners, युवाम् both , कौ who are you?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 2:
अहं वनमिदं दुर्गं विराधो नाम राक्षसः। चरामि सायुधो नित्यमृषिमांसानि भक्षयन्।।3.2.12।।
output: I am a demon named Viradha. I move in this dense forest with my weapons eating the flesh of the sages.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इयं नारी वरारोहा मम भार्या भविष्यति। युवयोः पापयोश्चाहं पास्यामि रुधिरं मृधे।।3.2.13।।
output: वरारोहा a beautiful woman (with fine hips), इयं नारी this woman, मम my, भार्या wife, भविष्यति will be, अहम् I, मृधे in the fight, पापयोः of both of you sinners, युवयोः of you both, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यामि I shall drink.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 2:
तस्यैवं ब्रुवतो दुष्टं विराधस्य दुरात्मनः। श्रुत्वा सगर्वितं वाक्यं सम्भ्रान्ता जनकात्मजा।।3.2.14।।
output: Sita, daughter of Janaka was bewildered out of fear when she heard the cruel  and boastful words of that wicked Viradha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 2:
सीता प्रवेपतोद्वेगात् प्रावाते कदली यथा।।3.2.15।। तां दृष्ट्वा राघवः सीतां विराधाङ्कगतां शुभाम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं मुखेन परिशुष्यता।।3.2.16।।
output: Seeing the auspicious Sita in the lap of Viradha shaken out of anxiety, like a plantain tree in a strong wind, Rama with his throat parched said to Lakshmana:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सीता प्रवेपतोद्वेगात् प्रावाते कदली यथा।।3.2.15।। तां दृष्ट्वा राघवः सीतां विराधाङ्कगतां शुभाम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं मुखेन परिशुष्यता।।3.2.16।।
output: Seeing the auspicious Sita in the lap of Viradha shaken out of anxiety, like a plantain tree in a strong wind, Rama with his throat parched said to Lakshmana:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पश्य सौम्य नरेन्द्रस्य जनकस्यात्मसम्भवाम्। मम भार्यां शुभाचारां विराधाङ्के प्रवेशिताम्।।3.2.17।। अत्यन्तसुखसंमव़ृद्धां राजपुत्रीं यशस्विनीम्।
output: Gentle Lakshmana, see the illustrious daughter ofJanaka, a lady of good conduct,  brought up in utmost comfort caught in the lap of Viradha

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदभिप्रेतमस्मासु प्रियं वरवृतं च यत्।।3.2.18।। कैकेय्यास्तु सुसंवृत्तं क्षिप्रमद्यैव लक्ष्मण।
output: O Lakshmana whatever Kaikeyi desired through her boons has now come true so soon.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
या न तुष्यति राज्येन पुत्रार्थे दीर्घदर्शिनी।।3.2.19।। ययाहं सर्वभूतानां प्रियः प्रस्थापितो वनम्। अद्येदानीं सकामा सा या माता मध्यमा मम।।3.2.20।।
output: Kaikeyi, my middle mother is farsighted indeed  Not content with the kingdom alone see sent me, beloved of all  beings, away to the forest. Let her cherished desire be fulfilled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 2:
या न तुष्यति राज्येन पुत्रार्थे दीर्घदर्शिनी।।3.2.19।। ययाहं सर्वभूतानां प्रियः प्रस्थापितो वनम्। अद्येदानीं सकामा सा या माता मध्यमा मम।।3.2.20।।
output: Kaikeyi, my middle mother is farsighted indeed  Not content with the kingdom alone see sent me, beloved of all  beings, away to the forest. Let her cherished desire be fulfilled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परस्पर्शात्तु वैदेह्याः न दुःखतरमस्तिमे। पितुर्विनाशात्सौमित्रे  स्वराज्यहरणात्तथा।।3.2.21।।
output: O Lakshmana nothing is more sorrowful to me than the touch of Vaidehi by another. It is more painful to me than the death of my father or loss of my kingdom.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे बाष्पशोकपरिप्लुते। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धो रुद्धो नाग इव श्वसन्।।3.2.22।।
output: काकुत्स्थे when Rama of the Kakutstha family, इति this way, ब्रुवति while he spoke, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, बाष्पशोकपरिप्लुते full of tears of sorrow, क्रुद्धः angry, रुद्धः tied up, नागः इव like a serpent, श्वसन् hissing, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 2:
अनाथ इव भूतानां नाथस्त्वं वासवोपमः। मया प्रेष्येण काकुत्स्थ किमर्थं परितप्यसे।।3.2.23।।
output: O Rama, you are, like Indra, lord of all beings. What makes you feel sad like an orphan when I am at your service like a servant?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 2:
शरेण निहतस्याद्य मया क्रुद्धेन रक्षसः। विराधस्य गतासोर्हि मही पास्यति शोणितम्।।3.2.24।।
output: The earth will drink the blood of Viradha with his life gone, slain by my angry arrow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राज्यकामे मम क्रोधो भरते यो बभूव ह। तं विराधे प्रमोक्ष्यामि वज्री वज्रमिवाचले।।3.2.25।।
output: Like Indra who hits the mountain with his thunderbolt, I shall release on Viradha the anger I felt against Bharata for his passion for the kingdom.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मम भुजबलवेगवेगितः पततु शरोऽस्य महान्महोरसि। व्यपनयतु तनोश्च जीवितं पततु ततस्समहीं विघूर्णितः।।3.2.26।।
output: मम my, भुजबलवेगवेगितः by the strength of my arms, महान् great, शरः arrow, अस्य his, महोरसि in high speed, पततु may fall, तनोः from the body, जीवितम् life, व्यपनयतु separate, ततः then, विघूर्णितः  reeling round and round, महीम् earth, पततु may fall down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणश्श्रीमान्विराधे प्रहसन्निव। कोभवान्वनमभ्येत्य चरिष्यसि यथासुखम्।।3.3.1।।
output: इति उकत्वा having said so, लक्ष्मण श्रीमान्  graceful Lakshmana, प्रहसन्निव  with a smile, विराधे at Viradha, कः भवान् who are you? वनमभ्येत्य having come to the forest, यथासुखम् at will, चरिष्यसि you are roaming about.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथोवाच पुनर्वाक्यं विराधः पूरयन्वनम्। पृच्छतो मम हि ब्रूतं कौ युवां क्व गमिष्यथः।।3.3.2.।।
output: अथ then, विराथः Viradha, वनम् forest, पूरयन् filling with echoes, पुनः again, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said, पृच्छतः asked, मम me, ब्रूतम् whereabouts, युवाम् you both, कौ who are you, क्व where, गमिष्यथः going.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमुवाच ततो रामो राक्षसं ज्वलिताननम्। पृच्छन्तं सुमहातेजा इक्ष्वाकुकुलमात्मनः।।3.3.3।।
output: Questioned by the demon, who bore a burning countenance, the highly effulgent Rama introduced his Ikshvaku family:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
क्षत्रियौ वृत्तसम्पन्नौ विद्धि नौ वनगोचरौ। त्वां तु वेदितुमिच्छावः कस्त्वं चरसि दण्डकान्।।3.3.4।।
output: Know us to be both kshatriyas, endowed with a good lineage and yet moving in the forest. We both wish to know, who you are and why you are going about in Dandaka forest?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमुवाच विराधस्तु रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। हन्त वक्ष्यामि ते राजन्निबोध मम राघव।।3.3.5।।
output: विराधस्तु Viradha also, सत्यपराक्रमम् one with truth as his prowess, तं रामम् to that Rama, उवाच said, हन्त O, राजन् to king, राघव Rama, ते to you, वक्ष्यामि I will tell, मम myself, निबोध  know.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुत्रः किल जयस्याहं माता मम शतह्रदा। विराध इति मामाहुः पृथिव्यां सर्वराक्षसाः।।3.3.6।।
output: I am indeed son to Jaya. My mother is Satahrada. Verily all the demons on this earth call me Viradha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तपसा चाभिसम्प्राप्ता ब्रह्मणो हि प्रसादजा। शस्त्रेणावध्यता लोकेऽच्छेद्याभेद्यत्वमेव च।।3.3.7।।
output: By the grace of Lord Brahma I was bestowed with this prowess through my penance. In this world none can kill me with a weapon nor split nor cut me to pieces.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्सृज्य प्रमदामेनामनपेक्षौ यथागतम्। त्वरमाणौ पलायेथां न वां जीवितमाददे।। 3.3.8।।
output: Therefore, leave this lady and run away to the place you came from. I will not take away your life .

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं रामः प्रत्युवाचेदं कोपसंरक्तलोचनः। राक्षसं विकृताकारं विराधं पापचेतसम्।।3.3.9।।
output: रामः Rama, कोपसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes reddened due to anger, विकृताकारम् with deformed appearance, पापचेतसम् with sinful intentions, तम् him, विराधं राक्षसम् to demon Viradha, प्रत्युवाच replied.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षुद्र धिक्त्वां तु हीनार्थं मृत्युमन्वेषसे ध्रुवम्। रणे प्राप्स्यसे सन्तिष्ठ न मे जीवन् गमिष्यासि।।3.3.10।।
output: O vile, mean creature  surely you are seeking death. Wait, you will meet it in the fight.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः सज्यं धनुः कृत्वा रामस्सुनिशिताञ्छरान्। सुशीघ्रमभिसन्धाय राक्षसं निजघान ह।।3.3.11।।
output: Then Rama strung his bow immediately, shot the sharp arrows at Viradha and hit him verily.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धनुषा ज्यागुणवता सप्त बाणान्मुमोच ह। रुक्मपुङ्खान्महावेगान्सुपर्णानिलतुल्यगान्।।3.3.12।।
output: From his bow  strung tight,  Rama shot seven swift, goldenfeathered arrows comparable to Garuda  and the Windgod in speed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते शरीरं विराधस्य भित्त्वाबर्हिणवाससः। निपेतुश्शोणितादिग्धा धरण्यां पावकोपमाः।।3.3.13।।
output: The arrows tied with peacockfeathers, looking like fire, pierced the body of Viradha which, drenched in blood, fell on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
स विद्धो न्यस्य वैदेहीं शूलमुद्यम्य राक्षसः। अभ्यद्रवत्सुसङ्कृद्धस्तदा रामं सलक्ष्मणम्।।3.3.14।।
output: Hit  by Rama and Lakshmana, the enraged  demon left Vaidehi, lifted a sharp spear   and ran towards them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स विनद्य महानादं शूलं शक्रध्वजोपमम्। प्रगृह्याशोभत तदा व्यात्तानन इवान्तकः।।3.3.15।।
output: The demon who produced a great noise with his wide open mouth resembled the god of death. He lifted a sharp spike that looked like Indra's banner.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ तौ भ्रातरौ दीप्तं शरवर्षं ववर्षतुः। विराधे राक्षसे तस्मिन् कालान्तकयमोपमे।।3.3.16।।
output: And then both the brothers showered bright arrows on the demon Viradha who looked like Yama, the god of death.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
स प्रहस्य महारौद्रः स्थित्वाजृम्भत राक्षसः। जृम्भमाणस्य ते बाणाः कायान्निष्पेतुराशुगाः।।3.3.17।।
output: The demon who was extremely frightening stood there, laughing and yawning.  As he yawned, all the swiftlyflying arrows fell out of his body.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्पर्शात्तु वरदानेन प्राणान्सम्रोध्य राक्षसः। विराधः शूलमुद्यम्य राघवावभ्यधावत।।3.3.18।।
output: By virtue of a boon Viradha, the demon, controlled the vital breath of his body by a mere touch and, raising the spike, ran towards the two Raghava princes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
तच्छूलं वज्रसङ्काशं गगने ज्वलनोपमम्। द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां चिच्छेद रामः शस्त्रभृतांवरः।।3.3.19।।
output: With two arrows, Rama, the best among wielders of weapons, broke down the spike in the sky burning like fire, and resembling the  thunderbolt of Indra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
तद्रामविशिखच्छिन्नं शूलं तस्यकराद्भुवि। पपाताशनिना छिन्नं मेरोरिव शिलातलम्।।3.3.20।।
output: The spike, broken down by Rama's arrow, fell like a slab of mount Meru splintered by Indra's thunder.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
तौ खड्गौ क्षिप्रमुद्यम्य कृष्णसर्पोपमौशुभौ। तूर्णमापेततुस्तस्य तदा प्रहरतां बलात्।।3.3.21।।
output: Then both Rama and Lakshmana quickly raised their swords which looked like black serpents and at once fell upon the demon who was going to strike with great force.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
स वध्यमानः सुभृशं भुजाभ्यां परिरभ्यतौ। अप्रकम्प्यौ नरव्याघ्रौ रौद्रः प्रस्थातुमैच्छत।।3.3.22।।
output: Struck down, the angry demon tightly caught hold of both of them under his arms and wanted to set out, carrying Rama and Lakshmana, the two unshakeable tigers among men.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
तस्याभिप्रायमाज्ञाय रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। वहत्वयमलं तावत्पथाऽनेन तु राक्षसः।।3.3.23।।
output: Rama understood the intention of the demon and said to Lakshmana, Let him go his way, no need to stop him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 3:
यथा चेच्छति सौमित्रे तथा वहतु राक्षसः। अयमेव हि नः पन्था येन याति निशाचरः।।3.3.24।।
output: O Lakshmana, let the nightstalker go the way he wishes. That is, in fact, our path.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तु स्वबलवीर्येण समुत्क्षिप्य निशाचरः। बालाविव स्कन्धगतौ चकारातिबलोद्धतः।।3.3.25।।
output: अतिबलोद्धतः one puffed with great strength, सः that Viradha, निशाचरः तु rakshasa on his part, स्वबलवीर्येण by his own strength, समुत्क्षिप्य after lifting, बालाविव like two children, स्कन्धगतौ on both his shoulders, चकार made.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तावारोप्य ततः स्कन्धं राघवौ रजनीचरः। विराधो विनदन्घोरं जगामाभिमुखो वनम्।।3.3.26।।
output: ततः then, रजनीचरः the nightstalker, विराधः Viradha, तौ both राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, स्कन्धम् on the shoulders, आरोप्य keeping, घोरम् dreadfuly, विनदन् while screaming, वनम् अभिमुखः towards the forest, जगाम proceeded.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
ह्रियमाणौ तु तौ दृष्ट्वा वैदेही रामलक्ष्मणौ। उच्चैस्स्वरेण चुक्रोश प्रगृह्य सुमहाजाभुजौ।।3.4.1।।
output: Seeing those two mightyarmed Rama and Lakshmana being carried away by Viradha, Sita started crying loudly:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मामृका भक्षयिष्यन्ति शार्दूलाद्वीपिनस्तथा। मां हरोत्सृज काकुत्स्थौ नमस्ते राक्षसोत्तम।।3.4.3।।
output: माम् me, ऋका wild bears, तथा in the same way, शार्दूलाद्वीपिनः tigers and panthers, भक्षयिष्यन्ति will eat me, राक्षसोत्तम O best of demons, माम् me, हर take away, काकुत्स्थौ Rama and Lakshmana, उत्सृज spare them, ते to you, नमः I salute.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वैदेह्या रामलक्ष्मणौ। वेगं प्रचक्रतुर्वीरौ वधे तस्य दुरात्मनः।।3.4.4।।
output: On hearing those words of  Sita, both the heroes, Rama and Lakshmana hastened to kill the wicked Viradha.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य रौद्रस्य सौमित्रिः सव्यं बाहुं बभञ्ज ह। रामस्तु दक्षिणं बाहुं तरसा तस्य रक्षसः।।3.4.5।।
output: सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, रौद्रस्य of that dreadful demon तस्य his, सव्यं बाहुम् left shoulder, बभञ्ज ह broke down, रामः Rama, तु too, तस्य रक्षसः that demon's, दक्षिणम् right, बाहुम् shoulder, तरसा quickly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स भग्नबाहुस्सविग्नो निपपाताशु राक्षसः। धरण्यां मेघसङ्काशो वज्रभिन्न इवाचलः।।3.4.6।।
output: With both shoulders broken, the demon, looking like a cloud (huge and dark) fell at once on the ground like a mountain split by a thunderbolt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिः पद्भिः सूदयन्तौ तु राक्षसम्। उद्यम्योद्यम्य चाप्येनं स्थण्डिले निष्पिपेषतुः।।3.4.7।।
output: राक्षसम् to the demon, मुष्टिभिः with fists, जानुभिः with knees, पद्भि: with feet, सूदयन्तौ striking, एनम् him, उद्यम्योद्यम्य by lifting him again and again, स्थण्डिले on the bare ground, निष्पिपेषतुः pulverized .

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स विद्धो बहुभिर्बाणैः खङ्गाभ्यां च परिक्षतः। निष्पिष्टो बहुधा भूमौ न ममार स राक्षसः।।3.4.8।।
output: Although pierced by arrows, and wounded by the two swords, and pulverized on the ground, the demon did not die.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
तं प्रेक्ष्य रामः सुभृशमवध्यमचलोपमम्। भयेष्वभयदश्श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.4.9।।
output: Seeing the mountainlike Viradha not dying though seriously wounded, illustrious Rama, guaranter of safety from fear said to Lakshmana:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तपसा पुरुषव्याघ्र राक्षसोऽयं न शक्यते। शस्त्रेण युधि निर्जेतुं राक्षसं निखनावहे।।3.4.10।।
output: O Lakshmana, best among men, this demon by virtue of his penance cannot be killed with any weapon in war. Therefore, let us bury him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण। वनेऽस्मिन् सुमहच्छ्वभ्रं खन्यतां रौद्रवर्चसः।।3.4.11।।
output: Dig a deep pit to bury this demon, dreadful like an elephant and emitting a fearful glow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामः प्रदरः खन्यतामिति। तस्थौ विराधमाक्रम्य कण्ठे पादेन वीर्यवान्।।3.4.12।।
output: Courageous Rama standing there put his foot firmly on the neck of Viradha and said to Lakshmana,' Dig up a crevice'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं राक्षसः प्रश्रितं वचः। इदं प्रोवाच काकुत्थ्सं विराधः पुरुषर्षभम्।।3.4.13।।
output: When the demon Viradha heard Rama saying so, he said these humble words to the scion of the Kakutsthas and the best of men :

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
हतोऽस्मि पुरुषव्याघ्र शक्रतुल्यबलेन वै। मया तु पूर्वं त्वं मोहान्न ज्ञातः पुरुषर्षभ।।3.4.14।।
output: You have killed me, O Rama, a tiger among men. You are equal to Indra in prowess. O best of men, out of delusion I could not recognise you earlier.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कौसल्यासुप्रजा राम तातस्त्वं विदितो मया। वैदेही च महाभागा लक्ष्मणश्च महायशाः।।3.4.15।।
output: तात O dear one, त्वम् you, कौसल्यासुप्रजाः the good son of Kausalya, रामः Rama, विदितः are known now, महाभागा a great lady, वैदेही च Sita too, महायशाः a man of great fame, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana too.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अभिशापादहं घोरां प्रविष्टो राक्षसीं तनुम्। तुम्बुरुर्नाम गन्धर्वः शप्तो वैश्रवणेन ह।।3.4.16।।
output: अहम् I, अभिशापात् by a curse, घोराम् this terrible, राक्षसीम् demoniac, तनुम् body, प्रविष्टः I  have entered, वैश्रवणेन by Kubera, शप्तः I am cursed, तुम्बुरुः नाम by name Tumburu, गन्धर्वः celestial musician.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रसाद्यमानश्च मया सोऽब्रवीन्मां महायशाः। यदा दाशरथी रामस्त्वां वधिष्यति संयुगे। तदा प्रकृतिमापन्नो भवान्स्वर्गं गमिष्यति।।3.4.17।।
output: When I appealed to him, that lord of great fame (Kubera) said that I would get back my original form and ascend to heaven when Rama, son of Dasaratha, would kill me in a duel.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनुपस्थीयमानो मां स क्रुद्धो व्याजहार ह। इति वैश्रवणो राजा रम्भासक्तमुवाच ह।।3.4.18।।
output: When king Kubera saw me absent (from duty) as I was infatuated with Rambha, he got angry and cursed me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तव प्रसादान्मुक्तोऽहमिहशापात्सुदारुणात्। भुवनं स्वं गमिष्यामि स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु परन्तप।।3.4.19।।
output: O scorcher of enemies by your grace I am rid of the curse. Delivered from my dreadful form, I will now go to my world. May both of you fare well.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
इतो वसति धर्मात्मा शरभङ्गः प्रतापवान्।।3.4.20।। अध्यर्धयोजने तात महर्षिस्सूर्यसन्निभः। तं क्षिप्रमधिगच्छ त्वं स ते श्रेयोऽभिधास्यति।।3.4.21।।
output: O dear, there lives Sarabhanga, a righteous sage, comparable to the Sun, at a distance of one and a half yojanas from here. Go to him at once. He will bless you with your wellbeing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
इतो वसति धर्मात्मा शरभङ्गः प्रतापवान्।।3.4.20।। अध्यर्धयोजने तात महर्षिस्सूर्यसन्निभः। तं क्षिप्रमधिगच्छ त्वं स ते श्रेयोऽभिधास्यति।।3.4.21।।
output: O dear, there lives Sarabhanga, a righteous sage, comparable to the Sun, at a distance of one and a half yojanas from here. Go to him at once. He will bless you with your wellbeing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवटे चापि मां राम प्रक्षिप्य कुशली व्रज। रक्षसां गतसत्त्वानामेष धर्मस्ससनातनः। अवटे ये निधीयन्ते तेषां लोकास्सनातनाः।।3.4.22।।
output: राम Rama, माम् me, अवटे in the pit, प्रक्षिप्य on burying, कुशली proper, व्रज you may go, गतसत्त्वाम्  who are dead, रक्षसाम् of the demons, एषः this one, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः justice, ये those, अवटे विनिक्षिप्यन्ते buried in a pit, तेषाम् to them, सनातनाः eternal, लोकाः in other worlds (heaven)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्थ्सं विराधश्शरपीडितः। बभूव स्वर्गसम्प्राप्तो न्यस्तदेहो महाबलः।।3.4.23।।
output: Having said so to Rama, the mighty  Viradha, hit by the arrows left his body and attained heaven.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं व्यादिदेश ह। कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण।।3.4.24।। वनेऽस्मिन् सुमहच्छ्वभ्रं खन्यतां रौदकर्मणः। इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामः प्रदरः खन्यतामिति। तस्थौ विराधमाक्रम्य कण्ठे पादेन वीर्यवान्।।3.4.25।।
output: When Rama heard those words, he said, O Lakshmana dig for this elephantlike demon of dreadful acts, a big pit. Having said so the mighty Rama stood firmly stamping the neck of Viradha with his foot.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं व्यादिदेश ह। कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण।।3.4.24।। वनेऽस्मिन् सुमहच्छ्वभ्रं खन्यतां रौदकर्मणः। इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामः प्रदरः खन्यतामिति। तस्थौ विराधमाक्रम्य कण्ठे पादेन वीर्यवान्।।3.4.25।।
output: राघवः Rama, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा heard, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, व्यादिदेश ordered, अस्यराक्षसस्य for this demon, रौद्रस्य of the dreadful, कुञ्जरस्येव like an elephant वनेऽस्मिन् in this forest, रौद्रकर्मणः of dreadful acts, सुमहत् wide, श्वभ्रः pit, खन्यताम् dig, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, प्रदरः a pit, खन्यताम् dig, इति in this way, वीर्यवान् valiant, पादेन by his foot, कण्ठे on the neck, विराधम् to Viradha, आक्रम्य occupying, तस्थौ stood firmly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
ततः खनित्रमादाय लक्ष्मणश्श्वभ्रमुत्तमम्। अखनत्पार्श्वतस्तस्य विराधस्य महात्मनः।।3.4.26।।
output: Then Lakshmana fetched a spade and dug a sufficiently big pit by the side of the great soul Viradha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
तं मुक्तकण्ठंनिक्षिप्य शङ्कुकर्णं महास्वनम्। विराधं प्राक्षिपच्छ्वभ्रे नदन्तं भैरवस्वनम्।।3.4.27।।
output: Rama took his foot off Viradha's neck and dropped his body with pointed ears into the pit while Viradha was groaning fearfully৷৷

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
तमाहवे दारुणमाशुविक्रमौ स्थिरावुभौ संयति रामलक्ष्मणौ। मुदान्वितौ चिक्षिपतुर्भयावहं नदन्तमुत्क्षिप्य बिले तु राक्षसम्।।3.4.28।।
output: Rama and Lakshmana, stable and firm, brave and quick, together lifted the body of Viradha who was fierce in battle and roaring and forcibly threw it into the pit with joy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
अवध्यतां प्रेक्ष्य महासुरस्य तौ शितेन शस्त्रेण तदा नरर्षभौ। समर्थ्य चात्यर्थविशारदावुभौ बिले विराधस्य वधं प्रचक्रतुः।।3.4.29।।
output: The two princes, bulls among men, who were adept in archery saw that the great demon could not be killed by any other means. They reflected over the issue  and undertook the task of killing him with sharp weapons and buried him in a pit.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
स्वयं विराधेन हि मृत्युरात्मनः प्रसह्य रामेण यथार्थमीप्सितः। निवेदितः काननचारिणा स्वयं न मे वधः शस्त्रकृतो भवेदिति।।3.4.30।।
output: Rama deliberately wanted to kill Viradha with weapons. Viradha the forestranger himself revealed that it was not possible to kill him with weapons and asked Rama to bury him in a pit.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदेव रामेण निशम्य भाषितं कृता मतिस्तस्य बिलप्रवेशने। बिलं च रामेणातिबलेन रक्षसा प्रवेश्यमानेन वनं विनादितम्।।3.4.31।।
output: तत् then, भाषितमेव words spoken, निशम्य hearing, रामेण by Rama, तस्य his, बिलप्रवेशने putting him in the pit, मतिः mind, कृता determined, बिलम् pit, प्रवेश्यमानेन while placing, अतिबलेन  mighty, रामेण by Rama, रक्षसा  by the demons, वनम् forest, विनादितम् echoed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 4:
प्रहृष्टरूपाविव रामलक्ष्मणौ विराधमुर्व्या प्रदरे निहत्य तौ। ननन्दतुर्वीतभयौ महावने शिलाभिरन्तर्दधतुश्च राक्षसम्।।3.4.32।।
output: Rama and Lakshmana were happy to consign Viradha's body to the pit after killing him. They filled the pit with rocks in the great forest without fear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हत्वा तु तं भीमबलं विराधं राक्षसं वने। ततस्सीतां परिष्वज्य समाश्वास्य च वीर्यवान्।।3.5.1।। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं रामो भ्रातरं दीप्ततेजसम्।
output: वीर्यवान् heroic, रामः Rama, भीमबलम् of terrific strength, राक्षसम् demon, तं विराधम् that Viradha, वने in the forest, हत्वा on killing, ततः thereafter, सीताम् Sita, परिष्वज्य embraced, समाश्वास्य च connsoled, दीप्ततेजसम् glowing like fire, भ्रातरम्  brother,  अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कष्टं वनमिदं दुर्गं न च स्म वनगोचराः।।3.5.2।। अभिगच्छामहे शीघ्रं शरभङ्गं तपोधनम्।
output: This wild forest with which we have not been acquainted earlier is difficult  to pass. (Hence) let us proceed quickly to sage Sarabhanga.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आश्रमं शरभङ्गस्य राघवोऽभिजगाम ह।।3.5.3।। तस्य देवप्रभावस्य तपसा भावितात्मनः। समीपे शरभङ्गस्य ददर्श महदद्भुतम्।।3.5.4।।
output: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आश्रमं शरभङ्गस्य राघवोऽभिजगाम ह।।3.5.3।। तस्य देवप्रभावस्य तपसा भावितात्मनः। समीपे शरभङ्गस्य ददर्श महदद्भुतम्।।3.5.4।।
output: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम्। अवरुह्यरथोत्सङ्गादाकाशे विबुधानुगम।।3.5.5।। असंस्पृशन्तं वसुधां ददर्श विबुधेश्वरम्। सुप्रभाभरणं देवं विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्।।3.5.6।। तद्विधैरेव बहुभिः पूज्यमानं महात्मभिः।
output: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम्। अवरुह्यरथोत्सङ्गादाकाशे विबुधानुगम।।3.5.5।। असंस्पृशन्तं वसुधां ददर्श विबुधेश्वरम्। सुप्रभाभरणं देवं विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्।।3.5.6।। तद्विधैरेव बहुभिः पूज्यमानं महात्मभिः।
output: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हरिभिर्वाजिभिर्युक्तमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.7।। ददर्शादूरतस्तस्य तरुणादित्यसन्निभम्। पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यं चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम्।।3.5.8।।
output: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning  Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
हरिभिर्वाजिभिर्युक्तमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.7।। ददर्शादूरतस्तस्य तरुणादित्यसन्निभम्। पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यं चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम्।।3.5.8।।
output: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning  Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
अपश्यद्विमलं छत्रं चित्रमाल्योपशोभितम्। चामरव्यजने चाग्र्ये रुक्मदण्डे महाधने।।3.5.9।। गृहीते वरनारीभ्यां धूयमाने च मूर्धनि।
output: Rama saw a pure white umbrella with a highly expensive golden staff, decorated with variegated flower garlands.While near his (Indra's) head stood a pair of exquisite ladies with fans made of yak's tail.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
गन्धर्वामरसिद्धाश्च बहवः परमर्षयः।।3.5.10।। अन्तरिक्षगतं देवं वाग्भिरग्य्राभिरीडिरे।
output: Many celestial singers of heaven, gods, great sages and siddhas sang with the choicest words the glory of this god stationed in the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
सह सम्भाषमाणे तु शरभङ्गेन वासवे।।3.5.11।। दृष्ट्वा शतक्रतुं तत्र रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।
output: While Indra was conversing with Sarabhanga, Rama saw him and said to Lakshmana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
रामोऽथ रथमुद्दिश्य लक्ष्मणायप्रदर्शयन्।।3.5.12।। अर्चिष्मन्तं श्रिया जुष्टमद्भुतं पश्य लक्ष्मण। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.13।।
output: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
रामोऽथ रथमुद्दिश्य लक्ष्मणायप्रदर्शयन्।।3.5.12।। अर्चिष्मन्तं श्रिया जुष्टमद्भुतं पश्य लक्ष्मण। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.13।।
output: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ये हयाः पुरुहूतस्य पुरा शक्रस्य नश्श्रुताः। अन्तरिक्षगता दिव्यास्त इमे हरयो ध्रुवम्।।3.5.14।।
output: पुरुहूतस्य of Indra who is often invoked, शक्रस्य of Indra, ये those, हयाः horses, नः for us, पुरा earlier, श्रुताः heard, ते those, हरयः horses, अन्तरिक्षगताः stationed in the sky, दिव्याः wonderful, इमे we, ध्रुवम् surely.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्रा ये तिष्ठ्न्त्यभितो रथम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः।।3.5.15।। विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतबाहवः। शोणांशुवसनास्सर्वे व्याध्रा इव दुरासदाः।।3.5.16।। उरोदेशेषु सर्वेषां हारा ज्वलनसन्निभाः। रूपं बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम्।।3.5.17।।
output: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, पुरुषव्याघ्राः finest among men, दिशम् अभितः in each direction, ये those, शतं शतम् in hundreds , कुण्डलिनः wearing earrings, खङ्गपाणयः holding swords in their hands, विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः broadchested, परिघायतबाहवः with iron beamlike strong arms, शोणांशुवसनाः clad in red clothes, युवानः youth, इमे सर्वे all of them, व्याघ्रा इव like tigers, दुरासदाः difficult to overpower, सर्वेषाम् all of them, उरोदेशेषु in their chest, ज्वलनसन्निभाः flaming like fire, हाराः necklaces, पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम् of twentyfive years of age, रूपम् appearance, बिभ्रति appear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्रा ये तिष्ठ्न्त्यभितो रथम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः।।3.5.15।। विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतबाहवः। शोणांशुवसनास्सर्वे व्याध्रा इव दुरासदाः।।3.5.16।। उरोदेशेषु सर्वेषां हारा ज्वलनसन्निभाः। रूपं बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम्।।3.5.17।।
output: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, पुरुषव्याघ्राः finest among men, दिशम् अभितः in each direction, ये those, शतं शतम् in hundreds , कुण्डलिनः wearing earrings, खङ्गपाणयः holding swords in their hands, विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः broadchested, परिघायतबाहवः with iron beamlike strong arms, शोणांशुवसनाः clad in red clothes, युवानः youth, इमे सर्वे all of them, व्याघ्रा इव like tigers, दुरासदाः difficult to overpower, सर्वेषाम् all of them, उरोदेशेषु in their chest, ज्वलनसन्निभाः flaming like fire, हाराः necklaces, पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम् of twentyfive years of age, रूपम् appearance, बिभ्रति appear.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्रा ये तिष्ठ्न्त्यभितो रथम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः।।3.5.15।। विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतबाहवः। शोणांशुवसनास्सर्वे व्याध्रा इव दुरासदाः।।3.5.16।। उरोदेशेषु सर्वेषां हारा ज्वलनसन्निभाः। रूपं बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम्।।3.5.17।।
output: O Lakshmana  around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
एतद्दि किल देवानां वयो भवति नित्यदा। यथेमे पुरुषव्याघ्रा दृश्यन्ते प्रियदर्शनाः।।3.5.18।।
output: These tigers among men have cheerful countenacess from which it can be deduced that the age of the gods always remains constant.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इहैव सह वैदेह्या मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ लक्ष्मण। यावज्जानाम्यहं व्यक्तं क एष द्युतिमान्रथे।।3.5.19।।
output: Lakshmana, stay here with Sita awhile, until I ascertain who this dazzling being on the chariot is.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमेवमुक्त्वा सौमित्रिमिहैव स्थीयतामिति। अभिचक्राम काकुत्स्थ श्शरभङ्गाश्रमं प्रति।।3.5.20।।
output: इहैव here only, स्थीयताम् stay, इति thus, तं सौमित्रिम् to that Lakshmana, उक्त्वा having said, काकुत्स्थ: (Rama) of Kakutstha family, शरभङ्गाश्रमं प्रति to Sarabhanga's hermitage, अभिचक्राम  went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
ततस्समभिगच्छन्तं प्रेक्ष्य रामं शचीपतिः। शरभङ्गमनुप्राप्य विविक्त इदमब्रवीत्।।3.5.21।।
output: Then Indra (husband of Sachi) having seen Rama coming towards him, approached Sarabhanga and said this to him privately:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इहोपयात्यसौ रामो यावन्मां नाभिभाषते। निष्ठां नयतु तावत्तु ततो मा द्रष्टुमर्हति।।3.5.22।। जितवन्तं कृतार्थं हि तदाहमचिरादिमम्। कर्म ह्यनेन कर्तव्यं महदन्यैस्सुदुष्करम्।।3.5.23।।
output: असौ oh, इह here, उपयाति coming near, यावत् until, माम् with me, नाभिभाषते he does not talk, तावत् in the mean while, निष्ठाम् to some other place, नयतु take me, ततः wherefrom, मा not, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हति is fit, जितवन्तम् victorious one, कृतार्थम् one who acomplished his task, इमम् him, अहम् I, अचिरात् in a short time, तदा then, अनेन not possible, अन्यैः for others, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, महत् great, कर्म task, कर्तव्यं हि remains to be accomplished.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इहोपयात्यसौ रामो यावन्मां नाभिभाषते। निष्ठां नयतु तावत्तु ततो मा द्रष्टुमर्हति।।3.5.22।। जितवन्तं कृतार्थं हि तदाहमचिरादिमम्। कर्म ह्यनेन कर्तव्यं महदन्यैस्सुदुष्करम्।।3.5.23।।
output: Here comes Rama. Before he talks to me, take me to some other place from where he may not be able to see me. He has to do a great task which is difficult for others. I can see him when he accomplishes the taste and emerges victorious.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
इति वज्री तमामन्त्र्य मानयित्वा च तापसम्। रथेन हययुक्तेन ययौ दिवमरिन्दमः।।3.5.24।।
output: This way honouring the sage Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, took leave of him and went to heaven in his chariot harressed with horses.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रयाते तु सहस्राक्षे राघवस्सपरिच्छदः। अग्निहोत्रमुपासीनं शरभङ्गमुपागमत्।।3.5.25।।
output: When Indra departed like that, Rama with his retinue (Sita and Lakshmana) went to Sarabhanga who was sitting by the side of the firealtar (for Agnihotra).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य पादौ च सङ्गृह्य रामस्सीता च लक्ष्मणः। निषेदुस्समनुज्ञाता लब्धवासा निमन्त्रिताः।।3.5.26।।
output: रामः Rama, सीता च and Sita, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, तस्य Sarabhanga's, पादौ feet, सङ्गृह्य prostrated, लब्धवासाः on getting seats to sit on, निमन्त्रिताः invited, समनुज्ञाताः responding to the instruction, निषेदुः sat down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शक्रोपयानं तु पर्यपृच्छत्स राघवः। शरभङ्गश्च तत्सर्यं राघवाय न्यवेदयत्।।3.5.27।।
output: ततः then, राघवः Rama, शक्रोपयानम् reason for Indra's arrival, पर्यपृच्छत् enquired, शरभङ्गश्च Sarabhanga also, तत् सर्वम् all that, राघवाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत् narrated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मामेष वरदो राम ब्रह्मलोकं निनीषति। जितमुग्रेण तपसा दुष्प्रापमकृतात्मभिः।।3.5.28।।
output: राम O Rama, एषः this god, उग्रेण severe, तपसा austerity, जितम् attained, अकृतात्मभिः  by those who have not realised their self, दुष्प्रापम् most difficult, ब्रह्मलोकम the world of Brahman, माम् myself, निनीषति wishes to take me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहं ज्ञात्वा नरव्याघ्र वर्तमानमदूरतः। ब्रह्मलोकं न गच्छामि त्वामदृष्ट्वा प्रियातिथिम्।।3.5.29।।
output: नरव्याघ्र O best of men Rama, अहम् I, प्रियातिथिम् a very dear guest, त्वाम् you, अदूरतः nearby, वर्तमानम् present, ज्ञात्वा after knowing, अदृष्ट्वा without seeing, ब्रह्मलोकम् world of Brahma, न गच्छामि I will not go.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
त्वयाऽहं पुरुषव्याघ्र धार्मिकेण महात्मना। समागम्य गमिष्यामि त्रिदिवं देवसेवितम्।।3.5.30।।
output: O Rama, the best of men  (only) after seeing a great, virtuous soul like you shall I go to heaven, the abode of the gods.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अक्षया नरशार्दूल मया लोका जिताश्शुभा। ब्राह्म्याश्च नाकपृष्ठ्याश्च प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मामकान्।।3.5.31।।
output: O tiger among men, I have conquered heavenly abodes as well as the imperishable, auspicious worlds of Brahma. Accept them all that are mine (obtained through my penance)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तो नरव्याघ्रस्सर्वशास्त्र विशारदः। ऋषिणा शरभङ्गेण राघवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.5.32।।
output: To these words of sage Sarabhanga Rama, the best of men, the knower of all sastras, the scion of the Raghus replied:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहमेवाहरिष्यामि सर्वांल्लोकान्महामुने। आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने।।3.5.33।।
output: O great sage, I will earn all the worlds myself if you direct me. But I need a proper dwellingplace in this forest.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु शक्रतुल्यबलेन वै। शरभङ्गो महाप्राज्ञः पुनरेवाब्रवीद्वचः।।3.5.34।।
output: शक्रतुल्यबलेन equal to Indra in strength, राघवेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तः said, महाप्राज्ञः sagacious, शरभङ्गः Sarabhangha, पुनरेव once again, वचः these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इह राम महातेजास्सुतीक्ष्णो नाम धार्मिकः। वसत्यरण्ये धर्मात्मा स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति।।3.5.35।।
output: Here dwells in this forest a brilliant saint, righteous and selfcontrolled, Sutikshna by name who will look to your welfare, O Rama

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुतीक्ष्णमभिगच्छ त्वं शुचौ देशे तपस्विनम्। रमणीये वनोद्देशे स ते वासं विधास्यति।।3.5.36।।
output: त्वम् you, शुचौ in a sacred, देशे place, तपस्विनम् an ascetic, सुतीक्ष्णम् Sutikshnam, अभिगच्छ you may approach, सः he, रमणीये in a delightful, वनोद्देशे in the forest, ते to you, वासम् dwelling, विधास्यति will provide.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमां मन्दाकिनीं राम प्रतिस्रोतामनुव्रज। नदीं पुष्पोडुपवहां ततस्तत्र गमिष्यसि।।3.5.37।।
output: राम O Rama, स पुष्पोडुपवहाम् carrying flowers and floats, इमाम् this, मन्दाकिनीम् river Mandakini, प्रतिस्रोताम् against the current, अनुव्रज follow, ततः then, तत्र there, गमिष्यसि you will reach.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एष पन्था नरव्याघ्र मुहूर्तं पश्य तात माम्। यावज्जहामि गात्राणि जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः।।3.5.38।।
output: O Rama, the best among men, this is the way. Look at me for a while, my dear, until I shed my limbs just as a snake sheds its withered slough.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽग्निं स समाधाय हुत्वा चाज्येन मन्त्रवित्। शरभङ्गो महातेजाः प्रविवेश हुताशनम्।।3.5.39।।
output: Then the effulgent Sarabhanga, knower of mantras (magical spells) kindled the fire with faggots and after offering oblations of ghee plunged in.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य रोमाणि केशांश्च तदा वह्निर्महात्मनः। जीर्णां त्वचं तथाऽस्थीनि यच्च मांसं सशोणितम्।।3.5.40।।
output: Then were consumed that highsouled Sarabhanga's hair on the body and on the head, the wornout skin, the bones and flesh along with blood.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 5:
स च पावकसङ्काशः कुमारस्समपद्यत। उत्थायाग्निचयात्तस्माच्छरभङ्गो व्यरोचत।।3.5.41।।
output: Sarabhanga then emerged youthful from that heap of fire, shining like a flame and looking very elegant৷৷

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स लोकानाहिताग्नीनामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। देवानां च व्यतिक्रम्य ब्रह्मलोकं व्यरोहत।।3.5.42।।
output: सः that Sarabhanga, आहिताग्नीनाम् of those who offer oblations to fire, महात्मनाम् of the great souls, ऋषीणां च of the sages, देवानां च of gods, लोकान् worlds, व्यतिक्रम्य after going beyond, ब्रह्मलोकम् world of Brahma, व्यरोहत ascended.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स पुण्यकर्मा भुवने द्विजर्षभः पितामहं सानुचरं ददर्श ह। पितामहश्चापि समीक्ष्य तं द्विजं ननन्द सुस्वागतमित्युवाच ह।।3.5.43।।
output: Sarabhanga, performer of sacred deeds, saw Brahma with his followers৷৷ Brahma also seeing Sarabhanga, the best among the brahmins,  welcomed him gladly. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शरभङ्गे दिवं प्राप्ते मुनिसङ्घास्समागताः। अभ्यगच्छन्त काकुत्स्थं रामं ज्वलिततेजसम्।।3.6.1।।
output: Sages seek Rama's protection from demons -- Rama's assurance to sages

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 6:
वैखानसा वालखिल्यास्सम्प्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः। अश्मकुट्टाश्च बहवः पत्राहाराश्च तापसाः।।3.6.2।। दन्तोलूखलिनश्चैव तथैवोन्मज्जकाः परे। गात्रशय्या अशय्याश्च तथैवाभ्रावकाशकाः।।3.6.3।। मुनयस्सलिलाहारावायुभक्षा स्तथापरे। आकाशनिलयाश्चैव तथा स्थण्डिलशायिनः।।3.6.4।। व्रतोपवासिनो दान्तास्तथाऽर्द्रपटवाससः। सजपाश्च तपोनित्यास्तथा पञ्चतपोऽन्विताः।।3.6.5।। सर्वे ब्राह्म्या श्रिया जुष्टा दृढयोगास्समाहिताः। शरभङ्गाश्रमे राममभिजग्मुश्च तापसाः।।3.6.6।।
output: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

output: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 6:

output: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वैखानसा वालखिल्यास्सम्प्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः। अश्मकुट्टाश्च बहवः पत्राहाराश्च तापसाः।।3.6.2।। दन्तोलूखलिनश्चैव तथैवोन्मज्जकाः परे। गात्रशय्या अशय्याश्च तथैवाभ्रावकाशकाः।।3.6.3।। मुनयस्सलिलाहारावायुभक्षा स्तथापरे। आकाशनिलयाश्चैव तथा स्थण्डिलशायिनः।।3.6.4।। व्रतोपवासिनो दान्तास्तथाऽर्द्रपटवाससः। सजपाश्च तपोनित्यास्तथा पञ्चतपोऽन्विताः।।3.6.5।। सर्वे ब्राह्म्या श्रिया जुष्टा दृढयोगास्समाहिताः। शरभङ्गाश्रमे राममभिजग्मुश्च तापसाः।।3.6.6।।
output: वैखानसाः Vaikhanasas (those born of the nails of Prajapati), वालखिल्याः Valakhilyas (the sixty thousand sages born out of the hair of  Brahma, they are the size of the thumb, they surround the chariot of the Sungod), सम्प्रक्षालाः those who keep on washing their body frequently, मरीचिपाः those who drink the rays of Sun and Moon, अश्मकुट्टाश्च Asmakuttas, (those who bruise their bodies with stones or those who pound the grain and make their own food), पत्राहाराः those who live on leaves, बहवः many, तापसाश्च sages, दन्तोलूखलिनश्चैव those who have teeth like mortar, वायुभक्षा  those who live on air, तथैव in a similar way, उन्मज्जकाः those who perform penance standing in neckdeep water, परे great men, गात्रशय्याः those who sleep on the skin of the tiger, अशय्याः those who do penance without bending any part of the body, तथैव similarly, अभ्रवकाशकाः those who live in the open in Sun and rain, सलिलाहाराः those who live on water only, मुनयः sages, तथा like that, वायुभक्षाः those who live on air, अपरे others, आकाशनिलयाश्चैव those  who carry on their penance under the open sky, तथा similarly, स्थण्डिलशायिनः those who sit and sleep on bare ground, तथा similarly, व्रतोपवासिनः those who observe vows and fastings, दान्ताः those who are selfrestrained, आर्द्रपटवाससः those who wear only wet clothes all the time, सजपाश्च those who repeat the names of gods always, तपोनिष्ठाः those who are steadfast in penance, तथा similarly, पञ्चतपोन्विताः those who do penance amidst five blazing fires, तापसाः ascetics, शरभङ्गाश्रमे in the hermitage of Sarabhanga, रामम् Rama, अभिजग्मुः approached, सर्वे all, ब्राह्म्या श्रिया shining with radiance born of Brahmavidya, जुष्टाः endowed, दृढयोगसमाहिताः those who are steadfast and singleminded in the practice of yoga.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 6:
अभिगम्य च धर्मज्ञा रामं धर्मभृतां वरम्। ऊचुः परमधर्मज्ञमृषिसङ्घास्समाहिताः।।3.6.7।।
output: All groups of sages, who knew dharma, and were upholders of righteousness reached Rama, the supreme knower of dharma, and said:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वमिक्ष्वाकुकुलस्यास्य पृथिव्याश्च महारथ। प्रधानश्चासि नाथश्च देवानां मघवानिव।।3.6.8।।
output: O great charioteer you are the lord of the Ikshvaku race and of the world just like Indra, chief among the gods.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विश्रुतस्त्रिषु लोकेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च। पितृभक्तिश्च सत्यं च त्वयि धर्मश्च पुष्कलः।।3.6.9।।
output: त्रिषु among the three, लोकेषु in worlds, यशसा by renown, विक्रमेण च विश्रुतः famous in valour, त्वयि in you, पितृभक्तिः च devotion to father, सत्यं च the truth also, पुष्कलः धर्मश्च as well as righteousness.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वामासाद्य महात्मानं धर्मज्ञं धर्मवत्सलम्। अर्थित्वान्नाथ वक्ष्यामस्तच्च नः क्षन्तुमर्हसि।।3.6.10।।
output: O lord, do excuse us. We sought your help to fulfil our needs since you are at hand. You are a great soul, knower and lover of dharma.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अधर्मस्सुमहांस्तात भवेत्तस्य महीपतेः। यो हरेद्बलिषड्भागां न च रक्षति पुत्रवत्।।3.6.11।।
output: O Lord, a king who collect one sixth of the produce as tax and yet does not protect his subjects like his children commits an act of grave injustice.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
युञ्जानस्स्वानिव प्राणान्प्राणैरिष्टान्सुतानिव। नित्ययुक्तस्सदा रक्षन्सर्वान्विषयवासिनः।।3.6.12।। प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीं राम कीर्तिं स बहुवार्षिकीम्। ब्रह्मणस्स्थानमासाद्य तत्र चापि महीयते।।3.6.13।।
output: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity thereafter.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
युञ्जानस्स्वानिव प्राणान्प्राणैरिष्टान्सुतानिव। नित्ययुक्तस्सदा रक्षन्सर्वान्विषयवासिनः।।3.6.12।। प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीं राम कीर्तिं स बहुवार्षिकीम्। ब्रह्मणस्स्थानमासाद्य तत्र चापि महीयते।।3.6.13।।
output: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity thereafter.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 6:
यत्करोति परं धर्म मुनिर्मूलफलाशनः। तत्र राज्ञश्चतुर्भाग प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षितः।।3.6.14।।
output: One fourth of the supreme merit a sage earns by living on fruits and roots, accrues to the king through which the people are protected righteously.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽयं ब्राह्मणभूयिष्ठो वानप्रस्थगणो महान्। त्वन्नाथोऽनाथवद्राम राक्षसैर्वध्यते भृशम्।।3.6.15।।
output: O Rama  we are a group of great sages, mostly brahmins, leading a vanaprastha  life. Yet with a protector like you, we are slaughtered in large numbers like orphans.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एहि पश्य शरीराणि मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्। हतानां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्बहूनां बहुधा वने।।3.6.16।।
output: एहि come on, वने in the forest, घोरै fierce, राक्षसैः by demons, बहुधा in many, हतानाम् killed, भावितात्मनाम् those who have perceived the Supreme spirit, बहूनाम् of many, मुनीनाम् of   sages, शरीराणि the bodies, पश्य see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 6:
पम्पानदीनिवासानामनुमन्दाकिनीमपि। चित्रकूटालयानां च क्रियते कदनं महत्।।3.6.17।।
output: A great slaughter is taking place amongst those residing on the bank of the Pampa lake, near the river Mandakini, and on mount Chitrakuta.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं वयं न मृष्यामो विप्रकारं तपस्विनाम्। क्रियमाणं वने घोरं रक्षोभिर्भीमकर्मभिः।।3.6.18।।
output: We ascetics are not able to tolerate the fearful deeds perpetrated by the dreadful demons in the forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 6:
ततस्त्वां शरणार्थं च शरण्यं समुपस्थिताः। परिपालय नो राम वध्यमानान्निशाचरैः।।3.6.19।।
output: O Rama, you are worthy of refuge. Hence we have come to you seeking your protection. We are being killed by the nightstalkers. Save us.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
परा त्वत्तो गतिर्वीर पृथिव्यां नोपपद्यते। परिपालय न स्सर्वान्राक्षसेभ्यो नृपात्मज।।3.6.20।।
output: वीर great warrior, त्वत्तः other than you, परा greatest, गतिः refuge, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, नोपपद्यते cannot be found, नृपात्मज O son of a king, नः us, सर्वान् all, राक्षसेभ्यः from the demons, परिपालय rescue.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु काकुत्स्थस्तापसानां तपस्विनाम्। इदं प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा सर्वानेव तपस्विनः।।3.6.21।।
output: Having heard this, righteous Rama of the Kakutstha dynasty said to all the ascetics engaged in penance:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 6:
नैवमर्हथ मां वक्तुमाज्ञाप्योऽहं तपस्विनाम्। केवलेनात्मकार्येण प्रवेष्टव्यं मया वनं।।3.6.22।।
output: You should not speak to me this way. I deserve to be commanded by the ascetics. I have not entered this forest only on a personal mission.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विप्रकारमपाक्रष्टुं राक्षसैर्भवतामिमम्। पितुस्तु निर्देशकरः प्रविष्टोऽहमिदं वनम्।।3.6.23।।
output: I came into this forest in obedience to my father's orders to repel the aggression of demons against you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवतामर्थसिद्ध्यर्थमागतोऽहं यदृच्छया। तस्य मेऽयं वने वासो भविष्यति महाफलः।।3.6.24।।
output: I came here to acomplish your task incidentally, Therefore, my stay in the forest will yield great results.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 6:
तपस्विनां रणे शत्रून्हन्तुमिच्छामि राक्षसान्। पश्यन्तु वीर्यमृषयस्सभ्रातुर्मे तपोधनाः।।3.6.25।।
output: I wish to kill in the fight the demons who are your enemies. O great ascetics, you may  witness my prowess supported by my brother.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दत्त्वाऽभयं चापि तपोधनानां धर्मे धृतात्मा सह लक्ष्मणेन। तपोधनैश्चापि सभाज्यवृत्तः सुतीक्ष्णमेवाभिजगाम वीरः।।3.6.26।।
output: Brave Rama, steadfast in righteousness, worthy of honour, gave assurance to protect the ascetics endowed with the wealth of penance, and proceeded towards sage Sutikshna. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्तु सहितो भ्रात्रा सीतया च परन्तपः। सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमपदं जगाम सह तैर्द्विजैः।।3.7.1।।
output: Rama, Sita and Lakshmana reach the hermitage of Sutikshna.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स गत्वा दीर्घमध्वानं नदीस्तीर्त्वा बहूदकाः। ददर्श विमलं शैलं महामेघमिवोन्नतम्।।3.7.2।।
output: सः he (Rama), दीर्घम् long, अध्वानम् distance, गत्वा went, बहूदकाः with plenty of water, नदी river, तीर्त्वा after crossing, महामेघमिव like a huge cloud, उन्नतम् lobty, विमलम् pure, शैलम् mountain, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत स्तदिक्ष्वाकुवरौ सन्ततं विविधैर्द्रुमैः। काननं तौ विविशतुस्सीतया सह राघवौ।।3.7.3।।
output: Rama and Lakshmana, the best of the Ikshvaku family, accompanied by Sita entered the dense forest  filled with trees all over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 7:
प्रविष्टस्तु वनं घोरं बहुपुष्पफलद्रुमम्। ददर्शाश्रममेकान्ते चीरमालापरिष्कृतम्।।3.7.4।।
output: Entering that dreadful forest, they saw trees full of flowers and fruits, and a hermitage in a lonely place with lines of bark robes hanging.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र तापसमासीनं मलपङ्कजटाधरम्। रामस्सुतीक्ष्णं विधिवत्तपोवृद्धमभाषत।।3.7.5।।
output: तत्र  there (at the hermitage), रामः Rama, मलपङ्कजठाधरम् with soiled, matted hair, आसीनम् seated, तपोवृद्धम्  grown old with penance, तापसम् ascetic, सुतीक्ष्णम् Sutikshna, विधिवत् as per tradition, अभाषत spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामोऽहमस्मि भगवन्भवन्तं द्रष्टुमागतः। त्वं माभिवद धर्मज्ञ महर्षे सत्यविक्रम।।3.7.6।।
output: भगवन् O revered one, अहम् am, रामः अस्मि I am Rama, भवन्तम् you, द्रष्टुम् to  see, आगतः I came, त्वं you, धर्मज्ञ knower of dharma, सत्यविक्रम having truth as your prowess, महर्षे great sage, मा me, अभिवद speak.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स निरीक्ष्य ततो धीरो रामं धर्मभृतां वरम्। समाश्लिष्य च बाहुभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.7.7।।
output: Thereafter the composed Sutikshna, looked at Rama, the best among righteous men, and embracing him with both his arms said:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वागतं ते रघुश्रेष्ठ राम सत्यभृतां वर। आश्रमोऽयं त्वयाक्रान्तस्सनाथ इव साम्प्रतम्।।3.7.8।।
output: रघुश्रेष्ठ scions of the Raghu family, सत्यभृताम् among upholders of truth, वर the best, राम Rama, ते to you, स्वागतम् welcome, साम्प्रतम् presently, त्वया your, आक्रान्तः occupied, अयम् this, आश्रमः hermitage, सनाथः इव one that has a protector.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रतीक्षमाणस्त्वामेव नारोहेऽहं महायशः। देवलोकमितो वीर देहं त्यक्त्वा महीतले। चित्रकूटमुपादाय राज्यभ्रष्टोऽसि मे श्रुतः।।3.7.9।।
output: महायशः O illustrious one, वीर heroic one, अहम् I, त्वामेव you only, प्रतीक्ष्माणः waiting for you, महीतले on earth, देहम् body, त्यक्त्वा giving up, इतः from here, देवलोकम् world of the gods, नारोहे I do not ascend, राज्यभ्रष्टः renouncing the kingdom, चित्रकूटम् Chitrakuta, उपादाय after taking, असि you are, मे I, श्रुतः heard.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इहोपयातः काकुत्थ्स देवराजश्शतक्रतुः।।3.7.10।। उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवस्सुरेश्वरः। सर्वान् लोकाञ्जितानाह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा।।3.7.11।।
output: O scion of the Kakutstha family, Indra, king of the gods came to me and said that by my meritorious deeds I have won all the worlds.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इहोपयातः काकुत्थ्स देवराजश्शतक्रतुः।।3.7.10।। उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवस्सुरेश्वरः। सर्वान् लोकाञ्जितानाह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा।।3.7.11।।
output: O scion of the Kakutstha family, Indra, king of the gods came to me and said that by my meritorious deeds I have won all the worlds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषु देवर्षिजुष्टेषु जितेषु तपसा मया। मत्प्रसादात्सभार्यस्त्वं विहरस्व सलक्ष्मणः।।3.7.12।।
output: मया by me, जितेषु which have been won, देवर्षिजुष्टेषु worlds served by divine sages like Narada, तेषु those, सभार्यः with your wife, सलक्ष्मणः and with Lakshmana, त्वम् you, मत्प्रसादात् by my grace, विहरस्व move about.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमुग्रतपसायुक्तं महर्षिं सत्यवादिनम्। प्रत्युवाचात्मवान्रामो ब्रह्माणमिव काश्यपः।।3.7.13।।
output: Selfpossessed Rama replied to the truthful ascetic who had performed intense penance. Just as Kasyapa would address Lord Brahma:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहमेवाहरिष्यामि सर्वान् लोकान्महामुने। आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने।।3.7.14।।
output: महामुने O great sage, अहमेव I alone, सर्वान् all, लोकान् worlds, आहरिष्यामि I will win, तु but, अहम् I, इह here, कानने in the forest, प्रदिष्टम् directed, आवासम् residence, इच्छामि intend to.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवान्सर्वत्र कुशलस्सर्वभूतहिते रतः। आख्यातश्शरभङ्गेण गौतमेन महात्मना।।3.7.15।।
output: You are ever engaged in the welfare of all beings. I have heard this from the great sage Sarabhanga of Gautama's clan.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण महर्षिर्लोकविश्रुतः। अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं हर्षेण महताऽप्लुतः।।3.7.16।।
output: Thus addressed by  Rama, Sutikshna, the great sage, wellknown to the world was highly delighted. He (then) said these sweet words:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अयमेवाश्रमो राम गुणवान्रम्यतामिह। ऋषिसङ्घानुचरितस्सदा मूलफलैर्युतः।।3.7.17।।
output: राम O Rama, ऋषिसङ्घानुचरितः where hosts of sages live, मूलफलैः with roots and fruits, युतः endowed, अयम् this, आश्रमः एव hermitage only, गुणवान् is good, रम्यताम् enjoy, इह here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 7:
इममाश्रममागम्य मृगसङ्घा महायशः। अहत्वा प्रतिगच्छन्ति लोभयित्वाऽकुतोभयाः।।3.7.18।।
output: O illustrious Rama, herds of animals visit this place fearlessly, enticing the inmates and (then) go back without harming any one.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 7:
नान्यद्धोषं भवेदत्र मृगेभ्योऽन्यत्र विद्धि वै। तच्छृत्वा वचनं तस्य महर्षेर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः।।3.7.19।। उवाच वचनं धीरो विकृष्य  सशरं धनुः।
output: When heroic Rama heard that there was no other problem from the wild animals except their frequent incursions, he lifted his bow with an arrow and said these words:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तानहं सुमहाभाग मृगसङ्घान्समागतान्।।3.7.20।। हन्यां निशितधारेण शरेणाशनिवर्चसा।
output: O reverend one, I will kill with a sharpedged arrow, glowing like a thunderbolt, all those herds of animals who keep coming here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 7:
भवांस्तत्राभिषज्येत किंस्यात्कृच्छ्रतरं ततः।।3.7.21।। एतस्मिन्नाश्रमे वासं चिरं तु न समर्थये।
output: What can be more agonizing for you (than my killing animals). I (therefore) do not foresee our long stay in this hermitage.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 7:
तमेवमुक्त्वोपरमं रामस्सन्ध्यामुपागमत्।।3.7.22।। अन्वास्य पश्चिमां स्नध्यां तत्र वासमकल्पयत्। सुतीक्ष्णस्याऽश्रमे रम्ये सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च।।3.7.23।।
output: Rama stopped with this. And then the evening drew to a close. Offering his evening oblation, he arranged for his stay along with Sita and Lakshmana in the delightful hermitage of Sutikshna.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमेवमुक्त्वोपरमं रामस्सन्ध्यामुपागमत्।।3.7.22।। अन्वास्य पश्चिमां संंध्यां तत्र वासमकल्पयत्। सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमे रम्ये सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च।।3.7.23।।
output: रामः Rama, तम् him, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, उपरमम् stopped there, सन्ध्याम् to the evening twilight, उपागमत् drew to a close, पश्चिमां सन्ध्याम् at Sunset in the west, अन्वास्य to offer (oblation), सीतया with Sita, लक्ष्मणेन च and Lakshmana, सुतीक्षणस्य at Sutikshna's, तत्र then, रम्ये in a delightful, आश्रमे hermitage, वासम् stay, अकल्पयत् arranged.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शुभं तापसभोज्यमन्नं स्वयं सुतीक्ष्णः पुरुषर्षभाभ्याम्। ताभ्यां सुसत्कृत्य ददौ महात्मा सन्ध्यानिवृत्तौ  रजनीं मवेक्ष्य।।3.7.24।।
output: ततः then, महात्मा the great sage, सुतीक्ष्णः Sutikshna, सन्ध्यानिवृत्तौ  evening twilight had passed, रजनीम् night, ताभ्याम् to both of them, पुरुषर्षभाभ्याम् to both best of men, तापस भोज्यम् (योग्यम्) that which is fit for ascetics, अन्नम् food, सुसत्कृत्य with all hospitality, स्वयम् himself, ददौ presented.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 8:
रामस्तु सहसौमित्रिस्सुतीक्ष्णेनाभिपूजितः। परिणाम्य निशां तत्र प्रभाते प्रत्यबुध्यत।।3.8.1।।
output: Rama, worshipped by Sutikshna and accompanied by Lakshmana, spent the night at the hermitage, and got up early in the morning.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्थाय तु यथाकालं राघवस्सहसीतया। उपस्पृश्यसुशितेन जलेनोत्पलगन्धिना।।3.8.2।।
output: In the morning Rama and Sita got up in time and took bath in cool, lilyfragrant water.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ तेऽग्निं सुरांश्चैव वैदेही रामलक्ष्मणौ। काल्यं विधिवदभ्यर्च्य तपस्विशरणे वने।।3.8.3।। उदयन्तं दिनकरं दृष्ट्वा विगतकल्मषाः। सुतीक्ष्णभिगम्येदं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रुवन्।।3.8.4।।
output: And as per routine, sinless Sita, Rama and Lakshmana offered prayers to the fire and other gods of the forest which was the refuge of the ascetics. Seeing the rising Sun, they worshipped him, and approaching Sutikshna,  said these soothing words:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 8:
अथ तेऽग्निं सुरांश्चैव वैदेही रामलक्ष्मणौ। काल्यं विधिवदभ्यर्च्य तपस्विशरणे वने।।3.8.3।। उदयन्तं दिनकरं दृष्ट्वा विगतकल्मषाः। सुतीक्ष्णभिगम्येदं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रुवन्।।3.8.4।।
output: And as per routine, sinless Sita, Rama and Lakshmana offered prayers to the fire and other gods of the forest which was the refuge of the ascetics. Seeing the rising Sun, they worshipped him, and approaching Sutikshna,  said these soothing words:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुखोषितास्स्मभगवंस्त्वया पूज्येन पूजिताः। आपृच्छामः प्रयास्यामो मुनयस्त्वरयन्ति नः।।3.8.5।।
output: भगवन् O revered Sutikshna, पूज्येन worshipworthy by you, त्वया by you, पूजिताः received, सुखोषिताः stayed comfortably, स्मः were, आपृच्छामः we bid you farewell, प्रयास्यामः we will go, मुनयः sages, नः us, त्वरयन्ति are hastening.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वरामहे वयं द्रष्टुं कृत्स्नमाश्रममण्डलम्। ऋषीणां पुण्यशीलानां दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्।।3.8.6।।
output: We wish to see the entire circle of hermitages of the sages, residing in Dandaka forest. So we are in a hurry.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 8:
अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामस्सहैभिर्मुनिपुङ्गवैः। धर्मनित्यैस्तपोदान्तैर्विशिखैरिव पावकैः।।3.8.7।।
output: We seek your permission to go with the great sages, who are ever engaged in righteousness, selfcontrolled by virtue of their penance, and are like flameless fire.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अविषह्यातपो यावत्सूर्यो नातिविराजते। अमार्गेणागतां लक्ष्मीं प्राप्येवान्वयवर्जितः।।3.8.8।। तावदिच्छामहे गन्तुमित्युक्त्वा चरणौ मुनेः। ववन्दे सहसौमित्रिस्सीतया सह राघवः।। 3.8.9।।
output: We wish to depart before the Sun grows unbearably hot like the man devoid of good lineage who acquires wealth through unlawful means (becomes arrogant). Thereafter Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana offered worship at the feet of the venerable sage.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अविषह्यातपो यावत्सूर्यो नातिविराजते। अमार्गेणागतां लक्ष्मीं प्राप्येवान्वयवर्जितः।।3.8.8।। तावदिच्छामहे गन्तुमित्युक्त्वा चरणौ मुनेः। ववन्दे सहसौमित्रिस्सीतया सह राघवः।। 3.8.9।।
output: अन्वयवर्जितः without good lineage अमार्गेण by unlawful ways, आगताम् earned, लक्ष्मीम् prosperity, प्राप्येव after getting, सूर्यः Sun, यावत् before, अविषह्यातप:  with unbearable heat (of the Sun), नातिविराजते before he comes out with blazing heat, तावत् before that, गन्तुम् to go,  इच्छामहे we desire, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, सीतया सह along with Sita, सहसौमित्रिः with Lakshmana, रामः Rama, मुनेः sage's, चरणौ feet, ववन्दे worshipped.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तौ संस्पृशन्तौ चरणावुत्थाप्य मुनिपुङ्गवः। गाढमालिङ्ग्य सस्नेहमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.8.10।।
output: When both Rama and Lakshmana touched the feet of Sutikshna, the best of the sages, he lifted them up, hugged them tightly, and said affectionately:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानं राम सौमित्रिणा सह। सीतया चानया सार्धं छाययेवानुवृत्तया।।3.8.11।।
output: You may safely tread, O Rama, this path along with Lakshmana and Sita who is following you like a shadow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पश्याश्रमपदं रम्यं दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्। एषां तपस्विनां वीर तपसा भावितात्मनाम्।।3.8.12।।
output: O valient Rama the sages, living in  the Dandaka forest, are self realised souls. See how delightful is the location of their hermitages.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सप्राज्यफलमूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च। प्रशस्तमृगयूथानि शान्तपक्षिगणानि च।। 3.8.13।। फुल्लपङ्कजषण्डानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च। कारण्डवविकीर्णानि तटाकानि सरांसि च।।3.8.14।। द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टिरम्याणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च। रमणीयान्यरण्यानि मयूराभिरुतानि च।।3.8.15।।
output: सुप्राज्यफलमूलानि places with abundant fruits and roots, पुष्पितानि with flowers in full bloom, प्रशस्तमृगयूथानि full of herds of animals, शान्तपक्षिगणानि च with flocks of quiet birds, वनानि च forest areas, फुल्लपङ्कजषण्डानि with fully blossomed lotuses, प्रसन्नसलिलानि च having clear waters, कारण्डवविकीर्णानि filled with waterducks, तटाकानि tanks, सरांसि च and lakes, दृष्टिरम्याणि delightful to look at, गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च waterfalls coming down the hills, मयूराभिरुतानि filled with sounds of peacocks, रमणीयानि beautiful, अरण्यानि forests , द्रक्ष्यसे you will see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 8:
सप्राज्यफलमूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च। प्रशस्तमृगयूथानि शान्तपक्षिगणानि च।। 3.8.13।। फुल्लपङ्कजषण्डानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च। कारण्डवविकीर्णानि तटाकानि सरांसि च।।3.8.14।। द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टिरम्याणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च। रमणीयान्यरण्यानि मयूराभिरुतानि च।।3.8.15।।
output: You will see the beautiful forestareas with abundant fruits and roots, flowers in full bloom, herds of animals, flocks of quiet birds tanks and lakes filled  with clean waters and shining with fully blossomed lotuses, resounding with waterducks and peacocks  and waterfalls coming down the hills. Thus you will enjoy a delightful sylvan sight.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सप्राज्यफलमूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च। प्रशस्तमृगयूथानि शान्तपक्षिगणानि च।। 3.8.13।। फुल्लपङ्कजषण्डानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च। कारण्डवविकीर्णानि तटाकानि सरांसि च।।3.8.14।। द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टिरम्याणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च। रमणीयान्यरण्यानि मयूराभिरुतानि च।।3.8.15।।
output: You will see the beautiful forestareas with abundant fruits and roots, flowers in full bloom, herds of animals, flocks of quiet birds tanks and lakes filled  with clean waters and shining with fully blossomed lotuses, resounding with waterducks and peacocks  and waterfalls coming down the hills. Thus you will enjoy a delightful sylvan sight.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गम्यतां वत्स सौमित्रे भवानपि च गच्छतु। आगन्तव्यं च ते दृष्ट्वा पुनरेवाश्रमं मम।।3.8.16।।
output: वत्स O dear child, गम्यताम् you may go, सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, भवानपि च you also, गच्छतु may go, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, पुनरेव again, आश्रमं to hermitage, मम my, ते for you, आगन्तव्यम् you have to come here.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा काकुत्स्थस्सहलक्ष्मणः। प्रदक्षिणं मुनिं कृत्वा प्रस्थातुमुपचक्रमे।।3.8.17।।
output: एवम् that way, उक्तः having been told, काकुत्स्थ: Rama, सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, तथेति let it be, उक्त्वा having said this, मुनिम् to the sage, प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा circumambulated( the sage as a mark of reverence), प्रस्थातुम् to set out, उपचक्रमे started.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 8:
ततश्शुभतरे तूणी धनुषी चायतेक्षणा। ददौ सीता तयोर्भ्रात्रोः खङ्गौ च विमलौ ततः।।3.8.18।।
output: Thereafter largeeyed Sita handed the brothers two quivers, two bows as well as two excellent swords.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 8:
आबध्य च शुभे तूणी चापे चादाय सुस्वनौ। निष्क्रान्तावाश्रमाद्गन्तुमुभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।3.8.19।।
output: Both Rama and Lakshmana  tied their auspicious quivers, took the two twanging bows and departed from the hermitage.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्रीमन्तौ रूपसम्पन्नौ दीप्यमानौ स्वतेजसा। प्रस्थितौ धृतचापौ तौ सीतया सह राघवौ।।3.8.20।।
output: Handsome Rama and Lakshmana, glowing in their radiance held the bows and exited  with Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुतीक्ष्णेनाभ्यनुज्ञातं प्रस्थितं रघुनन्दनम्। हृद्यया स्निग्धया वाचा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्।।3.9.1।।
output: Sita's admonition to Rama on the evil of attachment to weapons, after he had given up the kingdom.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अयं धर्मस्सुसूक्ष्मेण विधिना प्राप्यते महान्। निवृत्तेन तु शक्योऽयं व्यसनात्कामजादिह।।3.9.2।।
output: महान् great, अयं धर्मः this righteous path, सुसूक्ष्मेण in a subtle, विधिना means, प्राप्यते  is obtained, अयम् this, कामजात् born of desire, व्यसनात् by addiction, निवृत्तेन by that which is averted, इह here, शक्यः not possible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 9:
त्रीण्येव व्यसनान्यत्र कामजानि भवन्त्युत। मिथ्यावाक्यं परमकं तस्माद्गुरुतरावुभौ।।3.9.3।। परदाराभिगमनं विना वैरं च रौद्रता।
output: There are three kinds of vices born out of lust. First, speaking untruth, second, having sexual relation with others' wives and third, resorting to violence with no enmity. The later two vices are of serious nature.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 9:
मिथ्यावाक्यं न ते भूतं न भविष्यति राघव।।3.9.4।। कुतोऽभिलाषणं स्त्रीणां परेषां धर्मनाशनम्।
output: O Rama you never spoke untruth in the past nor will you speak in future. How can there be any desire in you to destroy the virtue of others' wives ?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 9:
तव नास्ति मनुष्येन्द्र न चाभूत्ते कदाचन।।3.9.5।। मनस्यपि तथा राम न चैतद्विद्यते क्वचित्।
output: O Rama, lord among men, you hadn't it (lust for other women) in the past. You havn't it now. Never does it exist even in your mind.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 9:
स्वदारनिरतस्त्वं च नित्यमेव नृपात्मज।।3.9.6।। धर्मिष्ठस्सत्यसन्धश्च पितुर्निर्देशकारकः।
output: O prince, you are always faithful to your wife. You are righteous, truthful and obedient to your father's orders.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सत्यसन्ध महाभाग श्रीमल्लक्ष्मणपूर्वज।।3.9.7।। त्वयि धर्मश्च सत्यं च त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्।
output: सत्यसन्ध truthful, महाभाग reverend, श्रीमन् powerful one, लक्ष्मणपूर्वज one born before Lakshmana (Rama), त्वयि in you, धर्मश्च righteousness, सत्यं च truth, त्वयि in you, सर्वम् all, प्रतिष्ठितम् are wellestablished.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्च सर्वं महाबाहो शक्यं धर्तुं जितेन्द्रियैः।।3.9.8।। तव वश्येन्द्रियत्वं च जानामि शुभदर्शन।
output: महाबाहो longarmed, तत् that, सर्वम् all, जितेन्द्रियैः having conquered the senses, धर्तुम् to hold, शक्यम् possible, शुभदर्शन pleasing to look at, तव वश्येन्द्रियत्वम् your ability to control the senses, जानामि I know.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 9:
तृतीयं यदिदं रौद्रं परप्राणाभिहिंसनम्।।3.9.9।। निर्वैरं क्रियते मोहात्तच्च ते समुपस्थितम्।
output: (But) you are a victim to the third (vice born of lust) i.e. showing violence without cause for enmity

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 9:
प्रतिज्ञातस्त्वया वीर दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्।।3.9.10।। ऋषीणां रक्षणार्थाय वधस्संयति रक्षसाम्।
output: O valiant one, you have promised to kill the demons in the battle, in order to protect the sages residing in the Dandaka forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 9:
एतन्निमित्तं च वनं दण्डका इति विश्रुतम्।।3.9.11।। प्रस्थितस्त्वं सह भ्रात्रा धृतबाणशरासनः।
output: It is only on account of this that you entered the wellknown Dandaka forest with your brother wielding bow and arrows.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्त्वां प्रस्थितं दृष्ट्वा मम चिन्ताकुलं मनः।।3.9.12।। त्वद्वृत्तं चिन्तयन्त्या वै भवेन्निश्श्रेयसं हितम्।
