Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 14:
मनुर्मनुष्यान् जनयद्राम पुत्रान् यशस्विनः। ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियान् वैश्यान् शूद्रांश्च मनुजर्षभ।।3.14.29।।
output: O Rama, bull among men Manu procreated brahmins, kshatriyas, vaisyas and sudras all famed human beings.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वान् पुण्यफलान्वृक्षाननलापि व्यजायत। विनता च शुकीपौत्री कद्रूश्च सुरसास्वसा।।3.14.30।।
output: अनलापि Anala too, पुण्यफलान् sacred fruits, सर्वान् of several kinds, वृक्षान् trees, व्यजायत procreated, विनता च and Vinata, शुकीपौत्री granddaughter of Suki, कद्रूश्च from Kadhruva सुरसास्वसा sibling of Surasa.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कद्रूर्नागं सहस्रास्यं विजज्ञे धरणीधरम्। द्वौ पुत्रौ विनतायास्तु गरुडोऽरुण एव च।।3.14.31।।
output: Kadhru produced a thousandhooded serpent(Adisesha) who held the whole earth on his head and Vinata, two sons, Garuda and Aruna.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्माज्जातोऽहमरुणात्सम्पातिस्तु ममाग्रजः। जटायुरिति मां विद्धि श्येनीपुत्रमरिन्दम।।3.14.32।।
output: I am born to Aruna and my elder brother is Sampati. O subduer of enemies, know me as Jatayu, son of Syeni.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 14:
सोऽहं वाससहायस्ते भविष्यामि यदीच्छसि। इदं दुर्गं हि कान्तारं मृगराक्षस सेवितम्।।3.14.33।। सीतां च तात रक्षिष्ये त्वयि याते सलक्ष्मणे।
output: If you so desire I will be helpful to you in guarding your hut. O dear, it is a difficult forest full of wild animals and demons. When you and Lakshmana are away I will protect Sita.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 14:
जटायुषं तं प्रतिपूज्य राघवो मुदा परिष्वज्य च सन्नतोऽभवत्। पितुर्हि शुश्राव सखित्वमात्मवान् जटायुषा सङ्कथितं पुनः पुनः।।3.14.34।।
output: Rama worshipped  Jatayu and bending down, embraced him. He heard from him again and again several events relating to Jatayu's  friendship with his father.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तत्र सीतां परिदाय मैथिलीं सहैव तेनातिबलेन पक्षिणा। जगाम तां पञ्चवटीं सलक्ष्मणो रिपून्दिधक्षञ्छलभानि वानलः।।3.14.35।।
output: सः Rama, मैथिलीम् princess of Mithila, सीताम् Sita, परिदाय leaving the responsibility, सलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, अतिबलेन by very strong bird, तेन by that, पक्षिणासहैव with Jatayu, अनलः fire, शलभानिव like moths, रिपून् enemies, दिधक्षन् desirous of burning, तां पञ्चवटीम् that Panchavati, जगाम went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः पञ्चवटीं गत्वा नानाव्यालमृगायुताम्। उवाच भ्रातरं रामस्सौमित्रिं दीप्ततेजसम्।।3.15.1।।
output: Rama, Lakshmana and Sita enter Panchavati --Lakshmana makes a thatched cottage at Panchavati -- performance of traditional sacrifices before entering the cottage --description of the beautiful nature around Panchavati and river Godavari.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
आगताः स्म यथोद्दिष्टममुं देशं महर्षिणा। अयं पञ्चवटीदेशस्सौम्य पुष्पितपादपः।।3.15.2।।
output: O handsome one, following the directions of the great sage, we have arrived at Panchavati, a place full of blossoming trees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वतश्चार्यतां दृष्टिः कानने निपुणोह्यसि। आश्रमः कतरस्मिन्नो देशे भवति सम्मतः।।3.15.3।।
output: कतरस्मिन् in which, देशे place, नः for us, आश्रमः hermitage, सम्मतः suitable, भवति will be, कानने in this forest, सर्वतः all over, दृष्टिः vision, चार्यताम् cast (your sight) , निपुणः good at deciding, असि you are, हि indeed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
रमते यत्र वैदेही त्वमहं चैव लक्ष्मण। तादृशो दृश्यतां देशस्सन्निकृष्टजलाशयः।।3.15.4।। वनरामण्यकं यत्र स्थलरामण्यकं तथा। सन्निकृष्टं च यत्र स्यात्समित्पुष्पकुशोदकम्।।3.15.5।।
output: Look, O Lakshmana  for a place to the liking of Sita, a place where there is water source nearby  where both of us can enjoy. Find a beautiful location where the surrounding forest is beautiful and where faggots, flowers, water and kusa grass are available at hand.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
रमते यत्र वैदेही त्वमहं चैव लक्ष्मण। तादृशो दृश्यतां देशस्सन्निकृष्टजलाशयः।।3.15.4।। वनरामण्यकं यत्र स्थलरामण्यकं तथा। सन्निकृष्टं च यत्र स्यात्समित्पुष्पकुशोदकम्।।3.15.5।।
output: Look, O Lakshmana  for a place to the liking of Sita, a place where there is water source nearby  where both of us can enjoy. Find a beautiful location where the surrounding forest is beautiful and where faggots, flowers, water and kusa grass are available at hand.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मण संयताञ्जलिः। सीतासमक्षं काकुत्स्थमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.15.6।।
output: Having been thus instructed by Rama, Lakshmana said with folded palms in the presence of Sita:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
परवानस्मि काकुत्स्थ त्वयि वर्षशतं स्थिते। स्वयं तु रुचिरे देशे क्रियतामिति मां वद।।3.15.7।।
output: काकुत्स्थ Rama, त्वयि you, वर्षशतम् for hundred years, स्थिते while living, परवान् dependant man, अस्मि I am, रुचिरे in a beautiful, देशे place, क्रियताम् it may be built, इति thus, माम् to me, वद order.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुप्रीतस्तेन वाक्येन लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः। विमृशन्रोचयामास देशं सर्वगुणान्वितम्।।3.15.8।।
output: Rama was pleased with the words of great Lakshmana. Deliberating over it, he agreed upon a site suitable in all respects.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
स तं रुचिरमाक्रम्य देशमाश्रमकर्मणि। हस्तौ गृहीत्वा हस्तेन रामस्सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्।।3.15.9।।
output: Having come to a beautiful spot suitable for the asram, Rama took both the hands of  Lakshmana in his own and said:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयं देशस्समश्रीमान् पुष्पितैस्तरुभिर्वृतः। इहाऽश्रमपदं सौम्य यथावत्कर्तुमर्हसि।।3.15.10।।
output: This place is level, surrounded by beautiful trees in full bloom. O handsome one, you may build the hermitage here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
इयमादित्यसङ्काशैः पद्मैस्सुरभिगन्धिभिः। अदूरे दृश्यते रम्या पद्मिनी पद्मशोभिता।।3.15.11।।
output: There, not very far, is a beautiful lotustank shining like the Sun, fragrant with lotuses.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
यथातख्यातमगस्त्येन मुनिना भावितात्मना। इयं गोदावरी रम्या पुष्पितैस्तरुभिर्वृता।।3.15.12।। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णा चक्रवाकोपशोभिता।
output: As said by the selfrealised soul, sage Agastya, this Godavari is beautiful, surrounded by trees with flowers in bloom, filled with flocks of swans, ducks and ruddy geese.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नातिदूरे न चासन्ने मृगयूथपिपीडिताः।।3.15.13।। मयूरनादिता रम्याः प्रांशवो बहुकन्दराः। दृश्यन्ते गिरयः सौम्य फुल्लैस्तरुभिरावृताः।।3.15.14।।
output: सौम्य O pleasing, मृगयूथपिपीडिताः herds of deer all, मयूरनादिताः sounds of peacocks, रम्याः beautiful, प्रांशवः tall, बहुकन्दराः with numerous caves, फुल्लैः flowering तरुभिः trees, आवृताः covered, गिरयः mountains, नातिदूरे not far from here, आसन्ने near, दृश्यन्ते you may see.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नातिदूरे न चासन्ने मृगयूथपिपीडिताः।।3.15.13।। मयूरनादिता रम्याः प्रांशवो बहुकन्दराः। दृश्यन्ते गिरयः सौम्य फुल्लैस्तरुभिरावृताः।।3.15.14।।
output: O handsome one, neither far nor near are seen tall mountains and flowering trees and herds of deer. Their numerous caves echo with sounds of peacocks.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सौवर्णैराजतैस्ताम्रैर्देशे देशे च धातुभिः। गवाक्षिता इवाभान्ति गजाः परमभक्तिभिः।।3.15.15।।
output: These mountains, with streaks of minerals like gold, silver and copper forming decorative designs, look beautiful like colourful windows, and appear like huge elephants.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च खर्जूरपनसाम्रकैः। नीवारैस्तिमिशैश्चैव पुन्नागैश्चोपशोभिताः।।3.15.16।। चूतैरशोकैस्तिलकैश्चम्पकैः केतकैरपि। पुष्पगुल्मलतोपेतैस्तैस्तैस्तरुभिरावृताः।।3.15.17।। चन्दनैस्पन्दनैर्नीपैः पर्णासैर्लिकुचैरपि। धवाश्वकर्णखदिरैः शमीकिंशुकपाटलैः।।3.15.18।।
output: सालैः with sal trees, तालैः with palmyrah trees, तमालैश्च with tamala trees (terminata  alata), खर्जूरपनसाम्रकैः with date, jackfruit and mango trees, नीवारैः wild paddy crops, तिमिशैश्चैव  timisha trees that will not let light pass through, पुन्नागैः with punnaga, उपशोभिताः adorning the whole place, चूतैः with mango trees, अशोकैः with asoka trees, तिलकैः with tree, चम्पकैः with champak trees, केतकैः with ketaka (pandams fascicularis), पुष्पगुल्मलतोपेतैः with flowering creepers and bushes, तैस्तैः others, तरुभिः with trees, चन्दनैः sandalwood, स्पन्दनैः spandan trees, नीपैः kadamba trees, पर्णासैः  parnasha trees, विकुचैरपि  creepers on the ground, धवाश्वकर्णखदिरैः  with dhava, ashvakarna and khadira plants, शमीकिंशुकपाटलैः with sami,  kimsukas and patala trees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च खर्जूरपनसाम्रकैः। नीवारैस्तिमिशैश्चैव पुन्नागैश्चोपशोभिताः।।3.15.16।। चूतैरशोकैस्तिलकैश्चम्पकैः केतकैरपि। पुष्पगुल्मलतोपेतैस्तैस्तैस्तरुभिरावृताः।।3.15.17।। चन्दनैस्पन्दनैर्नीपैः पर्णासैर्लिकुचैरपि। धवाश्वकर्णखदिरैः शमीकिंशुकपाटलैः।।3.15.18।।
output: सालैः with sal trees, तालैः with palmyrah trees, तमालैश्च with tamala trees (terminata  alata), खर्जूरपनसाम्रकैः with date, jackfruit and mango trees, नीवारैः wild paddy crops, तिमिशैश्चैव  timisha trees that will not let light pass through, पुन्नागैः with punnaga, उपशोभिताः adorning the whole place, चूतैः with mango trees, अशोकैः with asoka trees, तिलकैः with tree, चम्पकैः with champak trees, केतकैः with ketaka (pandams fascicularis), पुष्पगुल्मलतोपेतैः with flowering creepers and bushes, तैस्तैः others, तरुभिः with trees, चन्दनैः sandalwood, स्पन्दनैः spandan trees, नीपैः kadamba trees, पर्णासैः  parnasha trees, विकुचैरपि  creepers on the ground, धवाश्वकर्णखदिरैः  with dhava, ashvakarna and khadira plants, शमीकिंशुकपाटलैः with sami,  kimsukas and patala trees.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च खर्जूरपनसाम्रकैः। नीवारैस्तिमिशैश्चैव पुन्नागैश्चोपशोभिताः।।3.15.16।। चूतैरशोकैस्तिलकैश्चम्पकैः केतकैरपि। पुष्पगुल्मलतोपेतैस्तैस्तैस्तरुभिरावृताः।।3.15.17।। चन्दनैस्पन्दनैर्नीपैः पर्णासैर्लिकुचैरपि। धवाश्वकर्णखदिरैः शमीकिंशुकपाटलैः।।3.15.18।।
output: The place is covered with  sal and palmyrah trees including mango, jackfruit, dates, kadamba, punnaga, ashoka, champak, tilaka, ketaka, sandalwood, spandan, dhava, asvakarna parnasha, khadira, sami, kimsuka and patala trees. It is full of wild paddy, flowering bushes and creepers that run on the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इदं पुण्यमिदं मेध्यमिदं बहुमृगद्विजम्। इह वत्स्याम सौमित्रे सार्धमेतेन पक्षिणा।।3.15.19।।
output: This is a holy place fit for sacrifice. There are many animals and birds here.Hence we will reside here with Jatayu.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। अचिरेणाऽश्रमं भ्रातुश्चकार सुमहाबलः।।3.15.20।।
output: Thus directed by Rama, the mighty Lakshmana, destroyer  of enemy warriors, soon built a hermitage for his brother.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पर्णशालां सुविपुलां तत्र सङ्खातमृत्तिकाम्। सुस्तम्भां मस्करैर्दीर्घैः कृतवंशां सुशोभनाम्।।3.15. 21।। शमीशाखाभिरास्तीर्य दृढपाशावपाशिताम्। कुशकाशशरैः पर्णैस्सुपरिच्छादितां तथा।।3.15.22।। समीकृततलां रम्यां चकार लघुविक्रमः। निवासं राघवस्यार्थे प्रेक्षणीयमनुत्तमम्।।3.15.23।।
output: Lakshmana who was quick to act dug the clay with nippers, planted long bamboo poles, put branches of sami trees across and tied them with strong ropes. He spread kusa and kasa grass and leaves on the levelled ground. He built a beautiful, spacious and nice residence for Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पर्णशालां सुविपुलां तत्र सङ्खातमृत्तिकाम्। सुस्तम्भां मस्करैर्दीर्घैः कृतवंशां सुशोभनाम्।।3.15. 21।। शमीशाखाभिरास्तीर्य दृढपाशावपाशिताम्। कुशकाशशरैः पर्णैस्सुपरिच्छादितां तथा।।3.15.22।। समीकृततलां रम्यां चकार लघुविक्रमः। निवासं राघवस्यार्थे प्रेक्षणीयमनुत्तमम्।।3.15.23।।
output: लघुविक्रम: quick to act, तत्र there, सङ्खातमृत्तिकाम् nippers digging the clay, सुस्तम्भाम् having strong poles, दीर्घैः  long, मस्करैः  bamboos, कृतवंशाम् succesfully did, सुशोभनाम् very splendid, शमीशाखाभिः with branches of sami trees (Prospis cineraria), आस्तीर्य after spreading, दृढपाशावपाशिताम् tied with strong ropes, तथा then, कुशकाशशरैः kasa and kusa grass, पर्णैः leaves, समीकृततलाम् the ground was made plain, रम्याम् beautiful, सुविपुलाम् spacious, पर्णशालाम् leafy cottage, राघवस्यार्थे for Rama, अनुत्तमम् best, प्रेक्षणीयम् worthy of looking, निवासम् residence, चकार built.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पर्णशालां सुविपुलां तत्र सङ्खातमृत्तिकाम्। सुस्तम्भां मस्करैर्दीर्घैः कृतवंशां सुशोभनाम्।।3.15. 21।। शमीशाखाभिरास्तीर्य दृढपाशावपाशिताम्। कुशकाशशरैः पर्णैस्सुपरिच्छादितां तथा।।3.15.22।। समीकृततलां रम्यां चकार लघुविक्रमः। निवासं राघवस्यार्थे प्रेक्षणीयमनुत्तमम्।।3.15.23।।
output: Lakshmana who was quick to act dug the clay with nippers, planted long bamboo poles, put branches of sami trees across and tied them with strong ropes. He spread kusa and kasa grass and leaves on the levelled ground. He built a beautiful, spacious and nice residence for Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
सहसा लक्ष्मणः श्रीमान् नदीं गोदावरीं तदा। स्नात्वा पद्मानि चादाय सफलः पुनरागतः।।3.15.24।।
output: Lakshmana then went to river Godavari, had his bath, and returned with some lotuses.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
ततः पुष्पबलिं कृत्वा शान्तिं च स यथाविधि। दर्शयामास रामाय तदाश्रमपदं कृतम्।।3.15.25।।
output: Lakshmana offered oblation of flowers, invoked peace as per tradition (before occupying a newly made home) and showed Rama the cottage he had built.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तं दृष्ट्वा कृतं सौम्यमाश्रमं सीतया सह। राघवः पर्णशालायां हर्षमाहारयत्परम्।।3.15.26।।
output: सः he, राघवः Rama, तम् him, कृतम् made, सौम्यम् beautiful, आश्रमम् hermitage, सीतया सह with Sita, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, पर्णशालायाम् in the leafy cottage, परं much, हर्षम् happiness, आहारयत् expressed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुसंहृष्टः परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां लक्ष्मणं तदा। अतिस्निग्धं च गाढं च वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्।।3.15.27।।
output: Deeply pleased with Lakshmana, he hugged him tightly and said those loving words :

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रीतोऽस्मि ते महत्कर्म त्वया कृतमिदं प्रभो। प्रदेयो यन्निमित्तं ते परिष्वङ्गो मया कृतः।।3.15.28।।
output: प्रभो O master, त्वया by  you, महत् great, कर्म task, कृतम् is accomplished, ते with you, प्रीतः pleased, अस्मि I am, यन्निमित्तम् for what you have done, ते to you, प्रदेयः that which has to be given, परिष्वङ्गः embrace, मया myself, कृतः gave.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भावज्ञेन कृतज्ञेन धर्मज्ञेन च लक्ष्मण। त्वया पुत्रेण धर्मात्मा न संवृत्तः पिता मम।।3.15.29।।
output: भावज्ञेन knower of the feelings, कृतज्ञेन  grateful , धर्मज्ञेन knower of duty,  पुत्रेण by a son, त्वया by you, मम my, धर्मात्मा righteous soul, पिता father, न संवृत्तः not dead.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 15:
एवं लक्ष्मणमुक्त्वा तु राघवो लक्ष्मिवर्धनः। तस्मिन् देशे बहुफले न्यवसत्सुसुखं वशी।।3.15.30।।
output: Rama who was an enhancer of fortunes and who had his senses under control said thus to Lakshmana and lived happily there in that place filled with fruits.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कञ्चित्कालं स धर्मात्मा सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च। अन्वास्यमानो न्यवसत्स्वर्गलोके यथामरः।।3.15.31।।
output: Righteous Rama, served by Lakshmana, and Sita lived there for some time like a god in heaven. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चदशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifteenth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
वसतस्तस्य तु सुखं राघवस्य महात्मनः। शरद्व्यपाये हेमन्तऋतुरिष्टः प्रवर्तत।।3.16.1।।
output: While the great self Rama  lived happily there, autumn passed and dear winter set in.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
स कदाचित्प्रभातायां शर्वर्यां रघुनन्दनः। प्रययावभिषेकार्थं रम्यां गोदावरीं नदीम्।।3.16.2।।
output: Once Rama, delight of the Raghu race, went to the beautiful river Godavari for ablution in the early hours of the morning.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रह्वः कलशहस्तस्तं सीतया सह वीर्यवान्। पृष्ठतोऽनुव्रजन्भ्राता सौमित्रिरिदमब्रवीत्।।3.16.3।।
output: While valiant Lakshmana, walking behind Sita who was carrying a pitcher in her hand bent down a little and told Rama thus:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयं स कालः सम्प्राप्तः प्रियो यस्ते प्रियंवद। अलङ्कृत इवाभाति येन संवत्सरः शुभः।।3.16.4।।
output: O sweetspeaking brother, the season which is dear to you has arrived. It appears the auspicious year is going to be embellished with this season.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नीहारपरुषो लोकः पृथिवी सस्यशालिनी। जलान्यनुपभोग्यानि सुभगो हव्यवाहनः।।3.16.5।।
output: People feel frozen with fog, and water is no more enjoyable. The earth is full of crops and fire is so agreeable.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नवाग्रयणपूजाभिरभ्यर्च्य पितृदेवताः। कृताग्रयणकाः काले सन्तो विगतकल्मषाः।।3.16.6।।
output: Pious men offer their libations of the first crop at Agnistoma sacrifice and thereby please their manes and get rid of their sins.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
प्राज्यकामा जनपदास्सम्पन्नतरगोरसाः। विचरन्ति महीपाला यात्रास्था विजिगीषवः।।3.16.7।।
output: People in the countryside with their desires satisfied obtain abundant cow's milk at this time. Rulers of the earth are out on their expedition with a desire for victory.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सेवमाने दृढं सूर्ये दिशमन्तक सेविताम्। विहीनतिलकेव स्त्री नोत्तरा दिक्प्रकाशते।।3.16.8।।
output: सूर्ये Sun, अन्तकसेविताम् serving the god of death, दिशम् direction, दृढम् stand still, सेवमाने attending, उत्तरा दिक् northern side, विहीनतिलका without the vermilion mark, स्त्रीव like a woman, प्रकाशते is shining.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रकृत्या हिमकोशाढ्यो दूरसूर्यश्च साम्प्रतम्। यथार्थनामा सुव्यक्तं हिमवान्हिमवान्गिरिः।।3.16.9।।
output: प्रकृत्या by nature, हिमकोशाढ्यः with snow settled heavily, साम्प्रतम् presently दूरसूर्यश्च distant Sun, हिमवान् Himalaya, गिरिः mountain, हिमवान् snowy mountain, सुव्यक्तम् clearly, यथार्थनामा has a befitting name.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
अत्यन्तसुखसञ्चारा मध्याह्ने स्पर्शतस्सुखाः। दिवसास्सुभगादित्याश्चायासलिलदुर्भगाः।।3.16.10।।
output: The days are enjoyable at noon as it is pleasant to move about during this time since the sun is not scorching. But the shade and water seem to be unfortunate (as they are not liked by any one.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मृदुसूर्यास्सनीहाराः पटुशीतास्समारुताः। शून्यारण्या हिमध्वस्ता दिवसा भान्तिसाम्प्रतम्।।3.16.11।।
output: साम्प्रतम् at this time, हिमध्वस्ताः destroyed by frost, दिवसाः days, मृदुसूर्याः mild Sun, सनीहाराः heavy dews, पटुशीताः severe cold, समारुताः with breeze blowing, शून्यारण्याः with none moving in the forest, भान्ति shine.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निवृत्ताकाशशयनाः पुष्यनीता हिमारुणाः। शीता वृद्धतरायामास्त्रियामा यान्ति साम्प्रतम्।।3.16.12।।
output: At this time people do not sleep under the open sky. With the month of Pushya approaching, nights feel cool and look red due to frost. They prolong into three yamas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रविसङ्क्रान्तसौभाग्य स्तुषारारुणमण्डलः। निश्श्वासान्ध इवादर्शन्छन्द्रमा न प्रकाशते।।3.16.13।।
output: With the radiance of the Sun dimmed, with its orb reddened by frost, the moon does not shine clear like a mirror blurred with breath.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ज्योत्स्न तुषारमलिना पौर्णमास्यां न राजते। सीतेव चातपश्यामा लक्ष्यते न तु शोभते।।3.16.14।।
output: On a fullmoon night the beams of the moon faded by forest look pale, dull like Sita scorched by the heat of the Sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
प्रकृत्या शीतलस्पर्शो हिमविद्धश्च साम्प्रतम्। प्रवाति पश्चिमो वायुः काले द्विगुणशीतलः।।3.16.15।।
output: The west wind which by nature feels cold at this time blows doubly cold, hit by snow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाष्पच्छन्नान्यरण्यानि यवगोधूमवन्ति च। शोभन्तेऽभ्युदिते सूर्ये नद्भि क्रौञ्चसारसैः।।3.16.16।।
output: The snowcold forest terrains are fertile with barley and wheat crops. As the Sun rises the swans and kraunchas produce pleasing notes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
खर्जूरपुष्पाकृतिभिश्शिरोभिः पूर्णतण्डुलैः। शोभन्ते किञ्चिदानम्राश्शालयः कनकप्रभाः।।3.16.17।।
output: The tops of rice crops shining like gold resemble the flowers of datepalm.The fields full of ripe paddy bending a little (under the weight of grains) look delightful.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मयूखैरुपसर्पद्भिर्हिमनीहारसंवृतैः। दूरमभ्युदितस्सूर्यश्शशाङ्क इव लक्ष्यते।।3.16.18।।
output: हिमनीहारसंवृतैः covered with snow and dew, उपसर्पद्भि: lengthening,  मयूखैः by rays, सूर्यः Sun, दूरम् yonder, अभ्युदितः risen up, शशाङ्कः Moon, इव like, लक्ष्यते appears.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
अग्राह्यवीर्यः पूर्वाह्णे मध्याह्ने स्पर्शतस्सुखः। संरक्तः किञ्चिदापाण्डुरातपश्शोभते क्षितौ।।3.16.19।।
output: The heat of the Sun which we do not feel in the forenoon is comfortable during midday when the Sun shines slightly reddish white on earth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवश्यायनिपातेन किञ्चित्प्रक्लिन्नशाद्वला। वनानां शोभते भूमिर्निविष्टतरुणातपा।।3.16.20।।
output: As the miadows are wet with dewdrops, the land looks delightful with mild Sunlight  shining on the surface.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्पृशंस्तु विमलं शीतमुदकं द्विरदस्सुखम्। अत्यन्ततृषितो वन्यः प्रतिसंहरते करम्।।3.16.21।।
output: The wild tusker, extremely thirsty, touches the clean, cold water joyfully, but immediately withdraws its trunk unable to bear the cold.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एते हि समुपासीना विहगा जलचारिणः। नावगाहन्ति सलिलमप्रगल्भा इवाहवम्।।3.16.22।।
output: Just as inefficient warriors do not enter the warfield, aquatic birds sitting near water do not venture to take a plunge into it.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवश्यायतमोनद्धा नीहारतमसाऽवृताः। प्रसुप्ता इव लक्ष्यन्ते विपुष्पा वनराजयः।।3.16.23।।
output: The flowerless forest ranges appear as if they are asleep, enveloped in the darkness of frost and  snow .

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बाष्पसञ्छन्नसलिला रुतविज्ञेयसारसाः। हिमार्द्रवालुकैस्तीरैस्सरितो भान्ति साम्प्रतम्।।3.16.24।।
output: साम्प्रतम्  now, बाष्पसञ्छन्नसलिलाः waters covered with vapour, रुतविज्ञेयसारसाः inferred from the cackling of swans, सरितः river, हिमार्द्रवालुकैः with sands drenched with snow, तीरैः river banks,भान्ति appear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तुषारपतनाच्चैव मृदुत्वाद्भास्करस्य च। शैत्यादगाग्रस्थमपि प्रायेण रसवज्जलम्।।3.16.25।।
output: तुषारपतनाच्चैव  due to snowfall, भास्करस्य Sun's, मृदुत्वात् owing to mildness, शैत्यात् caused by coldness, रसवत् tasty, जलम् water, अगाग्रस्थमपि  although flowing from top of the mountain, प्रायेण generally.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जराजर्जरितैः पद्मैशशीर्णकेसरकर्णिकैः। नालषेर्हिमध्वस्सैर्न भन्ति कमलाकराः।।3.16.26।।
output: The lotuses in the tank  no more shine (bright) as they are decayed by age, their filaments and pericarps withered with only stalks remaining.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अस्मिंस्तु पुरुषव्याघ्रः काले दुःखसमन्वितः। तपश्चरति धर्मात्मा त्वद्भक्त्या भरतः पुरे।।3.16.27।।
output: At this time, righteous Bharata, the best among men, with his devotion to you must be sadly performing penance at his residence.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्यक्त्वा राज्यं च मानं च भोगांश्च विविधान्बहून्। तपस्स्वी नियताहारश्शेते शीते महीतले।।3.16.28।।
output: Giving up his kingdom, honour and pleasures of many kinds, Bharata will be living like an ascetic, sleeping on the ground in cold weather, his food under restriction.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽपि वेलामिमां नूनमभिषेकार्थमुद्यतः। वृतः प्रकृतिभिर्नित्यं प्रयाति सरयूं नदीम्।।3.16.29।।
output: At this time, Bharata,  accompanied by his subjects, must be daily going to river Sarayu for ablution.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धस्सुकुमारस्सुखोचितः। कथं न्वपररात्रेषु सरयूमवगाहते।।3.16.30।।
output: How can Bharata who was brought up in luxury, who is delicate, and deserves all comfort, take a dip in river Sarayu (in cold morning) ?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पद्मपत्रेक्षणो वीरश्श्यामो निरुदरो महान्। धर्मज्ञ स्सत्यवादी च ह्रीनिषेधो जितेन्द्रियः।।3.16.31।। प्रियाभिभाषी मधुरो दीर्घबाहुररिन्दमः। सन्त्यज्य विविधान्भोगानार्यं सर्वात्मना श्रितः।।3.16.32।।
output: He has a blue complexion, a pair of eyes like lotus petals, a thin waist and long arms. He is selfrestrained, softspoken, sweettempered and truthful. He knows his duty and maintains a low profile. A subduer  of enemies, he is heroic and great. Such Bharata has given up the diverse pleasures of life and has surrendered himself to you with all his soul.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
पद्मपत्रेक्षणो वीरश्श्यामो निरुदरो महान्। धर्मज्ञ स्सत्यवादी च ह्रीनिषेधो जितेन्द्रियः।।3.16.31।। प्रियाभिभाषी मधुरो दीर्घबाहुररिन्दमः। सन्त्यज्य विविधान्भोगानार्यं सर्वात्मना श्रितः।।3.16.32।।
output: He has a blue complexion, a pair of eyes like lotus petals, a thin waist and long arms. He is selfrestrained, softspoken, sweettempered and truthful. He knows his duty and maintains a low profile. A subduer  of enemies, he is heroic and great. Such Bharata has given up the diverse pleasures of life and has surrendered himself to you with all his soul.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जितस्स्वर्गस्तव भ्रात्रा भरतेन महात्मना। वनस्थमपि तापस्ये यस्त्वामनुविधीयते।।3.16.33।।
output: यः who, वनस्थमपि dwelling in the forest, त्वाम् yourself, तापस्ये in adopting asceticism, अनुविधीयते faithfully follows, तव भ्रात्रा your brother, महात्मना great self, भरतेन by Bharata, स्वर्गः heaven, जितः won.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न पित्र्यमनुवर्तन्ते मातृकं द्विपदा इति। ख्यातो लोकप्रवादोऽयं भरतेनान्यथा कृतः।।3.16.34।।
output: द्विपदाः humans, पित्र्यम् father's, न अनुवर्तन्ते do not follow, मातृकम् mother's, इति this way, ख्यातः wellknown, अयम् this, लोकप्रवादः saying in the world, भरतेन by Bharata, अन्यथा otherwise, कृतः is rendered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
भर्ता दशरथो यस्यास्साधुश्च भरतस्सुतः। कथं नु साऽम्बा कैकेयी तादृशी क्रूरशीलिनी।।3.16.35।।
output: How could mother Kaikeyi, who has a husband like Dasaratha and a noble son like Bharata, be so wicked by nature ?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्येवं लक्ष्मणे वाक्यं स्नेहाद्ब्रुवति धार्मिके। परिवादं जनन्यास्तमसहन्राघवोऽब्रवीत्।।3.16.36।।
output: धार्मिके generous, लक्ष्मणे Lakshmana, स्नेहात् out of love, इत्येवम् in this way, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवते as he was uttering, राघवः Rama, जनन्याः mother's, तम् him, परिवादम् censure, असहन् unable to tolerate, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तेऽम्बा मध्यमा तात गर्हितव्या कथञ्चन। तामेवेक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य भरतस्य कथां कुरु।।3.16.37।।
output: तात dear, मध्यमा middle, अम्बा mother, कथञ्चन never, ते by you, न गर्हितव्या not to be criticised, इक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य of the lord of the Ikshvakus, भरतस्य Bharata's, तां कथामेव about him, कुरु you may.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
निश्चिताऽपि हि मे बुद्धिर्वनवासे दृढव्रता। भरतस्नेहसन्तप्ता बालिशीक्रियते पुनः।।3.16.38।।
output: Even though I have made up my mind to dwell in the forest and keep my vow, my love for Bharata makes me waver like a child (Rama does not want Bharata to suffer on his account).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
संस्मराम्यस्य वाक्यानि प्रियाणि मधुराणि च। हृद्यान्यमृतकल्पानि मनःप्रह्लादनानि च।।3.16.39।।
output: I remember his dear, sweet, ambrosial  words, soothing to the heart and pleasing to the mind.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 16:
कदान्वहं समेष्यामि भरतेन महात्मना। शत्रुघ्नेन च वीरेण त्वया च रघुनन्दन।।3.16.40।।
output: O enhancer of joy of the Raghus  when shall I meet great Bharata, brave Satrughna and you all together?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्येवं विलपंस्तत्र प्राप्य गोदावरीं नदीम्। चक्रेऽभिषेकं काकुत्स्थस्सानुजस्सह सीतया।।3.16.41।।
output: Expressing his grief in such manner, Rama reached Godavari where he took his bath with his brother and Sita.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तर्पयित्वाऽथ सलिलैस्ते पितृ़न्दैवतानि च। स्तुवन्ति स्मोदितं सूर्यं देवताश्च समाहिताः।।3.16.42।।
output: अथ and then, ते they, सलिलैः with water, पितृ़न् forefathers, दैवतानि च and gods, तर्पयित्वा offered oblations, उदितम् risen, सूर्यम् Sun, देवताश्च deities also, समाहिताः poised together, स्तुवन्ति स्म sang in praise.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृताभिषेकस्सरराज रामः सीताद्वितीयस्सह लक्ष्मणेन। कृताभिषेको गिरिराजपुत्र्या रुद्रस्सनन्दी भगवानिवेशः।।3.16.43।।
output: सीताद्वितीयः accompanied by Sita, सः रामः that Rama, कृताभिषेकः completing his bath, सहलक्ष्मणेन along with Lakshmana, गिरिराजपुत्र्या with the daughter of the king of the mountains, कृताभिषेकः ablution over, सनन्दी along with Nandi, ईशः Isvara, रुद्रः इव like  Rudra, रराज shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
कृताभिषेको रामस्तु सीता सौमित्रिरेव च। तस्माद्गोदावरीतीरात्ततो जग्मुस्वमाश्रमम्।।3.17.1।।
output: Ablution over, Rama, accompanied by Sita and Lakshmana, went back from the bank of the river Godabari to their hermitage.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आश्रमं तमुपागम्य राघवस्सह लक्ष्मणः। कृत्वा पौर्वाह्णिकं कर्म पर्णशालामुपागमत्।।3.17.2।।
output: सहलक्ष्मणः accompanied by Lakshmana, राघवः Rama, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपागम्य on reaching, पौर्वाह्णिकम् rituals to be performed in the forenoon, कर्म rituals, कृत्वा after doing, पर्णशालाम् cottage thatched with leaves, उपागमत् went in.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उवास सुखितस्तत्र पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चकार विविधाः कथाः।।3.17.3।।
output: महर्षिभिः by ascetics, पूज्यमानः worshipped by, तत्र there, सुखितः peacefully, उवास stayed, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह with Lakshmana, विविधाः diverse, कथाः talks, चकार making.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स रामः पर्णशालायामासीनस्सह सीतया। विरराज महाबाहुश्चित्रया चन्द्रमाः इव।।3.17.4।।
output: सीतया सह along with Sita, पर्णशालायाम् in the cottage, आसीनः seated, महाबाहुः longarmed, सः रामः that Rama, चित्रया with the constellation Chitra, चन्द्रमाः इव like the Moon, विरराज appeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदाऽऽसीनस्य रामस्य कथासंसक्तचेतसः। तं देशं राक्षसी काचिदाजगाम यदृच्छया।।3.17.5।।
output: रामस्य Rama's, कथासंसक्तचेतसः  engrossed in conversation, तथा like that, आसीनस्य while he was sitting, काचित् one, राक्षसी demoness, यदृच्छया by chance, तं देशम् to that place, आजगाम came.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
सा तु शूर्पणखा नाम दशग्रीवस्य राक्षसः। भगिनी राममासाद्य ददर्श त्रिदशोपमम्।।3.17.6।।
output: Surpanakha, sister of the tenheaded demon (Ravana) approached Rama shining like a god.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
सिंहोरस्कं महाबाहुं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। आजानुबाहुं दीप्तास्यमतीव प्रियदर्शनम्।।3.17.7।। गजविक्रान्तगमनं जटामण्डलधारिणम्। सुकुमारं महासत्त्वं पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितम्।।3.17.8।। राममिन्दीवरश्यामं कन्दर्पसदृशप्रभम्। बभूवेन्द्रोपमं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी काममोहिता।।3.17.9।।
output: The demoness was infatuated with Rama,  whose chest was like that of a lion, who was strongarmed, who had a glowing face, pleasing to the eyes, who walked with the gait of an elephant, whose hair was matted,  who was gentle and strong who was, endowed with royal traits, who had a blue lotuslike complexion, who was handsome as the god of love, and who resembled Indra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सिंहोरस्कं महाबाहुं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। आजानुबाहुं दीप्तास्यमतीव प्रियदर्शनम्।।3.17.7।। गजविक्रान्तगमनं जटामण्डलधारिणम्। सुकुमारं महासत्त्वं पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितम्।।3.17.8।। राममिन्दीवरश्यामं कन्दर्पसदृशप्रभम्। बभूवेन्द्रोपमं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी काममोहिता।।3.17.9।।
output: सिंहोरस्कम् whose chest was like that of a lion, महाबाहुम् longarmed, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम् whose eyes resembled lotus petals, आजानुबाहुम् kneelong arms, दीप्तास्यम् with a glowing face, अतीव vey much, प्रियदर्शनम् pleasing to look at, गजविक्रान्तगमनम्  who walked with the gait of an elephant, जटामण्डलधारिणम् having matted hair, सुकुमारम् delicate,  महासत्वम् very strong , पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितम्  endowed with royal traits, इन्दीवरश्यामम् bluelotuslike complexion, कन्दर्पसदृशप्रभम् glowing like the god of love, इन्द्रोपमम्  as Indra, रामम् Rama, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, राक्षसी demoness, काममोहिता infatuated, बभूव became.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
सिंहोरस्कं महाबाहुं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम्। आजानुबाहुं दीप्तास्यमतीव प्रियदर्शनम्।।3.17.7।। गजविक्रान्तगमनं जटामण्डलधारिणम्। सुकुमारं महासत्त्वं पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितम्।।3.17.8।। राममिन्दीवरश्यामं कन्दर्पसदृशप्रभम्। बभूवेन्द्रोपमं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसी काममोहिता।।3.17.9।।
output: The demoness was infatuated with Rama,  whose chest was like that of a lion, who was strongarmed, who had a glowing face, pleasing to the eyes, who walked with the gait of an elephant, whose hair was matted,  who was gentle and strong who was, endowed with royal traits, who had a blue lotuslike complexion, who was handsome as the god of love, and who resembled Indra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
सुमुखं दुर्मुखी रामं वृत्तमध्यं महोदरी। विशालाक्षं विरूपाक्षी सुकेशं ताम्रमूर्धजा।।3.17.10।। प्रीतिरूपं विरूपा सा सुस्वरं भैरवस्वरा। तरुणं दारुणा वृद्धा दक्षिणं वामभाषिणी।।3.17.11।। न्यायवृत्तं सुदुर्वृत्ता प्रियमप्रियदर्शना। शरीरजसमाविष्टा राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.17.12।।
output: Rama's face was lovely, Surpanakha's was hideous. Rama had a slender waist, she had a huge belly. His eyes were large,  hers were deformed. His hair was black and beautiful, hers was coppercoloured. He was lovely in appearance, she was ugly. His voice was sweet, hers was shrill. He was young, she was dreadfully old. He was positive, she was perverted. Rama was wellbehaved, she was wicked. Rama was just and loving while she was overcome by lust.  (This) demoness said to Rama :

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुमुखं दुर्मुखी रामं वृत्तमध्यं महोदरी। विशालाक्षं विरूपाक्षी सुकेशं ताम्रमूर्धजा।।3.17.10।। प्रीतिरूपं विरूपा सा सुस्वरं भैरवस्वरा। तरुणं दारुणा वृद्धा दक्षिणं वामभाषिणी।।3.17.11।। न्यायवृत्तं सुदुर्वृत्ता प्रियमप्रियदर्शना। शरीरजसमाविष्टा राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.17.12।।
output: दुर्मुखी looking, महोदरी hugebellied, विरूपाक्षी woman with deformed eyes, ताम्रमूर्धजा copperred hair, विरूपा  ugly, भैरवस्वरा of shrill voice, दारुणा वृद्धा dreadfully old, वामभाषिणी with a perverted tongue, सुदुर्वृता very wicked, अप्रियदर्शना ugly to look at, राक्षसी the demoness, सुमुखम् of beautiful face, वृत्तमध्यम् slender waist, विशालाक्षम् largeeyed, सुकेशम् with beautiful hair, प्रीतिरूपम्  with lovely appearance, सुस्वरम् sweet voice, तरुणम्  young , दक्षिणम् favourable, न्यायवृत्तम् who was just, प्रियम् lovely, रामम् to Rama, शरीरजसमाविष्टा overcome by lust, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुमुखं दुर्मुखी रामं वृत्तमध्यं महोदरी। विशालाक्षं विरूपाक्षी सुकेशं ताम्रमूर्धजा।।3.17.10।। प्रीतिरूपं विरूपा सा सुस्वरं भैरवस्वरा। तरुणं दारुणा वृद्धा दक्षिणं वामभाषिणी।।3.17.11।। न्यायवृत्तं सुदुर्वृत्ता प्रियमप्रियदर्शना। शरीरजसमाविष्टा राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.17.12।।
output: Rama's face was lovely, Surpanakha's was hideous. Rama had a slender waist, she had a huge belly. His eyes were large,  hers were deformed. His hair was black and beautiful, hers was coppercoloured. He was lovely in appearance, she was ugly. His voice was sweet, hers was shrill. He was young, she was dreadfully old. He was positive, she was perverted. Rama was wellbehaved, she was wicked. Rama was just and loving while she was overcome by lust.  (This) demoness said to Rama :

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जटी तापसरूपेण सभार्यश्शरचापधृत्। आगतस्त्वमिमं देशं कथं राक्षससेवितम्।।3.17.13।। किमागमनकृत्यं ते तत्त्वमाख्यातुमर्हसि।
output: O Rama you are wearing matted hair like an ascetic, but living with your wife and holding bow and arrows. What brings you to this place haunted by demons ? You should tell me the truth ?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तस्तु राक्षस्या शूर्पणख्या परन्तपः।।3.17.14।। ऋजुबुद्धितया सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।
output: Thus asked by the demoness Surpanakha,  Rama, scorcher of foes began telling her everything due to his simplemindedness.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
अनृतं न हि रामस्य कदाचिदपि सम्मतम्।।3.17.15।। विशेषेणाऽश्रमस्थस्य समीपे स्त्रीजनस्य च।
output: To Rama untruth is never acceptable at the hermitage and especially in the presence of a woman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आसीद्धशरथो नाम राजा त्रिदशविक्रमः।।3.17.16।। तस्याहमग्रजः पुत्रो रामो नाम जनैश्श्रुतः।
output: (Rama replied) There was a king named Dasaratha who was mighty like the gods. I am his eldest son known among the people as Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
भ्राताऽयं लक्ष्मणो नाम यवीयान्मामनुव्रतः।।3.17.17।। इयं भार्या च वैदेही मम सीतेति विश्रुता।
output: Here is Lakshmana , my younger brother, who always follows me . And this  is the daughter of the king of Videha and my wife, wellknown as Sita.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नियोगात् तु नरेन्द्रस्य पितुर्मातुश्च यन्त्रितः।।3.17.18।। धर्मार्थं धर्मकाङ्क्षी च वनं वस्तुमिहागतः।
output: नरेन्द्रस्य king's, पितुः father's, मातुश्च and mother's, नियोगात् by the order, यन्त्रितः impelled, धर्मकाङ्क्षी च one desirous of establishing righteousness, धर्मार्थम् for the sake of duty, इह here, वस्तुम् to reside, वनम् to the forest, आगतः I have come.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वां तु वेदितुमिच्छामि कस्य त्वं कासि कस्य वा।।3.17.19।। त्वं हि तावन्मनोज्ञाङ्गी राक्षसी प्रतिभासि मे।
output: I wish to know who you are. Tell me who your kins are. With lovely limbs you do not appear to be a demoness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इह वा किंनिमित्तं त्वमागता ब्रूहि तत्त्वत:।।3.17.20।। साब्रवीद् वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसी मदनार्दिता।
output: इह here, किंनिमित्तम् for what purpose, त्वम् you, आगता वा you have come, तत्त्वत: truly, ब्रूहि  tell, वचनम् these words, श्रुत्वा hearing, मदनार्दिता overtaken by passion, सा राक्षसी that demoness, अब्रवीत् said,

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रूयतां राम वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वार्थं वचनं मम। 3.17.21।। अहं शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी कामरूपिणी। अरण्यं विचरामीदमेका सर्वभयङ्करा।।3.17.22।।
output: अहम् myself, शूर्पणखा नाम is Surpanakha by name, कामरूपिणी assume the form I desire, राक्षसी a demoness, एका alone, सर्वभयङ्करा can terrorise all creatures, इदम् this, अरण्यम् forest, विचरामि I move about.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रूयतां राम वक्ष्यामि तत्त्वार्थं वचनं मम। 3.17.21।। अहं शूर्पणखा नाम राक्षसी कामरूपिणी। अरण्यं विचरामीदमेका सर्वभयङ्करा।।3.17.22।।
output: अहम् myself, शूर्पणखा नाम is Surpanakha by name, कामरूपिणी assume the form I desire, राक्षसी a demoness, एका alone, सर्वभयङ्करा can terrorise all creatures, इदम् this, अरण्यम् forest, विचरामि I move about.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
रावणो नाम मे भ्राता बलीयान्राक्षसेश्वरः। वीरो विश्रवसः पुत्रो यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः।।3.17.23।।
output: My brother is Ravana, son of Visrava, and lord of all demons. You have heard his name I suppose.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रवृद्धनिद्रश्च सदा कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः। विभीषणस्तु धर्मात्मा न तु राक्षसचेष्टितः।।3.17.24।। प्रख्यातवीर्यौ च रणे भ्रातरौ खरदूषणौ।
output: Kumbhakarna is another brother of mine. He is very strong. He is always in deep sleep. Vibhisna another brother. He is righteous free from  any demoniac trait. My other two brothers are Khara and Dusana who are wellknown heroes of war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 17:
तानहं समतिक्रान्ता राम त्वा पूर्वदर्शनात्।।3.17.25।। समुपेतास्मि भावेन भर्तारं पुरुषोत्तमम्।
output: Setting them aside, I came here, as soon as I saw you. You are the finest among men and I am here wishing you to be my husband.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं प्रभावसम्पन्ना स्वच्छन्दबलगामिनी।।3.17.26।। चिराय भव मे भर्ता सीतया किं करिष्यसि।
output: I have influence over others, I have capacity to move wherever I want. Be my husband forever. What will you do with Sita?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विकृता च विरूपा च न चेयं सदृशी तव।।3.17.27।। अहमेवानुरूपा ते भार्या रूपेण पश्य माम्।
output: विकृता च an ugly form, विरूपा च deformed too, इयम् this woman, तव your, न सदृशी is not suitable to you, ते you, अहमेव I alone, अनुरूपा suitable, माम् me, भार्यारूपेण as wife, पश्य look upon.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमां विरूपामसतीं करालां निर्णतोदरीम्।।3.17.28।। अनेन ते सह भ्रात्रा भक्षयिष्यामि मानुषीम्।
output: विरूपाम् deformed, असतीम् unchaste, करालाम् frightful, निर्णतोदरीम् flat bellied woman, इमां मानुषीम् to this lady, ते भ्रात्रासह along with your brother, भक्षयिष्यामि I will eat up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः पर्वतशृङ्गाणि वनानि विविधानि च।।3.17.29।। पश्यन्सह मया कान्त दण्डकान्विचरिष्यसि।
output: कान्त O darling, ततः thereafter, पर्वतशृङ्गाणि tops of mountains, विविधानि many kinds, वनानि च forests also, पश्यन् while seeing, मया सह with me, दण्डकान् Dandaka forest, विचरिष्यसि will wander.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्येवमुक्तः काकुत्स्थः प्रहस्य मदिरेक्षणाम्।।3.17.30।। इदं वचनमारेभे वक्तुं वाक्यविशारदः।
output: Thus addressed, Rama, skilled in speech, laughed and started speaking to that woman of bewitching eyes. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततश्शूर्पणखां रामः कामपाशावपाशिताम्। स्वच्छया श्लक्ष्णया वाचा स्मितपूर्वमथाब्रवीत्।।3.18.1।।
output: Rama directs Surpanakha to Lakshmana-- Surpanakha approaches Lakshmana to marry her -- Lakshmana cuts her nose and ears-- Surpanakha narrates the event to Khara.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृतदारोऽस्मि भवति भार्येयं दयिता मम। त्वद्विधानां तु नारीणां सुदुःखा ससपत्नता।।3.18.2।।
output: O lady I am married and here is my wife who is dear to me. To be a cowife to some one is indeed painful for people like you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनुजस्त्वेष मे भ्राता शीलवान्प्रियदर्शनः। श्रीमानकृतदारश्च लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्।।3.18.3।।
output: Here is my younger brother Lakshmana. He is a man of good conduct, good look, valiant and virtuous. (Besides) he is not with his wife.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अपूर्वी भार्यया चार्थी तरुणः प्रियदर्शनः। अनुरूपश्च ते भर्ता रूपस्यास्य भविष्यति।।3.18.4।।
output: अपूर्वी not accompanied by his, भार्यया wife, अर्थी a man in need, तरुणः young, प्रियदर्शनः handsome, ते to your, रूपस्य beauty, अनुरूपः worthy of, भर्ता husband, भविष्यति will be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 18:
एनं भज विशालाक्षि भर्तारं भ्रातरं मम। असपत्ना वरारोहे मेरुमर्कप्रभा यथा।।3.18.5।।
output: O  woman of large eyes and fine hips, my brother is fit for you. You will (with him) shine like the radiant Sun on mount Meru. You will enjoy yourself without a cowife. You may approach him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति रामेण सा प्रोक्ता राक्षसी काममोहिता। विसृज्य रामं सहसा ततो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.18.6।।
output: रामेण by Rama, इति this way, प्रोक्ता having been told, राक्षसी the demoness, काममोहिता deluded with lust, सहसा suddenly, रामम् Rama, विसृज्य leaving, ततः thereafter, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अस्य रूपस्य ते युक्ता भार्याहं वरवर्णिनी। मया सह सुखं सर्वान्दण्डकान्विचरिष्यसि।।3.18.7।।
output: With my fine complexion, I will be a suitable wife for you. You can happily wander about in Dandaka forest with me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 18:
एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्री राक्षस्या वाक्यकोविदः। ततश्शूर्पणखीं स्मित्वा लक्ष्मणो युक्तमब्रवीत्।।3.18.8।।
output: Thus addressed by the demoness Lakshmana, son of Sumitra, wellversed in the use of words gave her a befitting reply :

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कथं दासस्य मे दासी भार्या भवितुमिच्छसि। सोऽहमार्येण परवान्भ्रात्रा कमलवर्णिनि।।3.18.9।।
output: कमलवणिनि O woman of lotus complexion, दासस्य of a servant, मे myself, भार्या wife, दासी female servant, भवितुम् will become, कथम् how, इच्छसि do you intend to be, सः such Rama, अहम् I am, आर्येण्य to that revered, परवान् dependent upon, भ्रात्रा brother.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समृद्धार्थस्य सिद्धार्था मुदितामलवर्णिनी। आर्यस्य त्वं विशालाक्षि भार्या भव यवीयसी।।3.18.10।।
output: विशालाक्षि  largeeyed, अमलवर्णिनी  of clear complexion, त्वम् you, समृद्धार्थस्य lord of great wealth, आर्यस्य to Rama, यवीयसी younger, भार्या wife, सिद्धार्था fulfilled, मुदिता happy, भव you may be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 18:
एनां विरूपामसतीं करालां निर्णतोदरीम्। भार्यां वृद्धां परित्यज्य त्वामेवैष भजिष्यति।।3.18.11।।
output: He will abandon this uglylooking, unchaste, frightening old woman of drooping belly and accept you alone as his wife.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 18:
को हि रूपमिदं श्रेष्ठं संत्यज्य वरवर्णिनि। मानुषीषु वरारोहे कुर्याद्भावं विचक्षणः।।3.18.12।।
output: O lady of fair complexion and beautiful hips, which wise man will fall in love with any other female giving up a fine figure like you ?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 18:
इति सा लक्ष्मणेनोक्ता कराला निर्णतोदरी। मन्यते तद्वचस्तथ्यं परिहासाविचक्षणा।।3.18.13।।
output: While Lakshmana was thus making fun of the dreadful, droopingbellied Surpanakha, she presumed his words to be true.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा रामं पर्णशालायामुपविष्टं परन्तपम्। सीतया सह दुर्दर्षमब्रवीत्काममोहिता।।3.18.14।।
output: Deluded with passion, Surpanakha said to formidable Rama, the scorcher of foes,  seated in the leafthatched hut along with Sita:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एनां विरूपामसतीं करालां निर्णतोदरीम्। वृद्धां भार्यामवष्टभ्य मां न त्वं बहुमन्यसे।।3.18.15।।
output: विरूपाम् ugly, असतीम् unchaste, करालाम् fiercelooking woman, निर्णतोदरीम् a flatbellied woman, वृद्धाम् aged, एनाम् her, भार्याम् wife, अवष्टभ्य  taking hold , त्वम् you, माम् me, न बहुमन्यसे not honouring me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अद्येमां भक्षयिष्यामि पश्यतस्तव मानुषीम्। त्वया सह चरिष्यामि निस्सपत्ना यथासुखम्।।3.18.16।।
output: तव while you, पश्यतः are seeing, अद्य now, इमाम् this, मानुषीम् to this woman, भक्षयिष्यामि I will eat up, निस्सपत्ना without a cowife, त्वया सह with you, यथासुखम् happily, चरिष्यामि I shall move about.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्त्वा मृगशाबाक्षीमलातसदृशेक्षणा। अभ्यधावत्सुसङ्कृद्धा महोल्कां रोहिणीमिव।।3.18.17।।
output: While speaking this, Surpanakha, with eyes like flaming amber ran to the fawneyed Sita in great anger like a giant meteor hurtling towards the constellation of Rohini :

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 18:
तां मृत्युपाशप्रतिमामापतन्तीं महाबलः। निगृह्य रामः कुपित स्ततो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.18.18।।
output: Mighty Rama in a rage restrained her who was falling upon Sita like the noose of death, and said to Lakshmana:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रूरैरनार्यै स्सौमित्रे परिहासः कथञ्चन। न कार्यः पश्यवैदेहीं कथञ्चित्सौम्य जीवतीम्।।3.18.19।।
output: O handsome Lakshmana it is not proper to cut jokes with wicked, uncivilized persons. Now see Sita who has somehow survived.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमां विरूपामसतीमतिमत्तां महोदरीम्। राक्षसीं पुरुषव्याघ्र विरूपयितुमर्हसि।।3.18.20।।
output: पुरुषव्याघ्र tiger among men, विरूपाम् uncouth, असतीम् unchaste , अतिमत्ताम् passionate, महोदरीम्  big bellied इमां राक्षसीम् this demoness,  विरूपयितुम् to deform, अर्हसि you should.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्युक्तो लक्ष्मणस्तस्याः क्रुद्धो रामस्य पार्श्वतः। उद्धृत्य खङ्गं चिच्छेद कर्णनासं महाबलः।।3.18.21।।
output: इति this, उक्तः instructed, महाबलः powerful, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, क्रुद्धः being angry, रामस्य Rama's, पार्श्वतः by the side, खङ्गम् sword, उद्धृत्य having lifted, तस्याः her, कर्णनासम् ears and nose, चिच्छेद cut off.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निकृत्तकर्णनासा तु विस्वरं सा विनद्य च। यथागतं प्रदुद्राव घोरा शूर्पणखा वनम्।।3.18.22।।
output: Dreadful Surpanakha with her ears and nose cut off, roared in a hoarse voice and ran away into the forest in the same direction as she came.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा विरूपा महाघोरा राक्षसी शोणितोक्षिता। ननाद विविधान्नादान्यथा प्रावृषि तोयदः।।3.18.23।।
output: विरूपा disfigured, महाघोरा very dreadful, शोणितोक्षिता drenched in blood, सा राक्षसी that demoness, प्रावृषि in rainy season, तोयदः यथा like a cloud, विविधान्  different, नादान् sounds, ननाद released.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा विक्षरन्ती रुधिरं बहुधा घोरदर्शना। प्रगृह्य बाहू गर्जन्ती प्रविवेश महावनम्।।3.18.24।।
output: Dripping blood profusely, the frightful demoness lifted her arms and entered the great forestroaring.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तु सा राक्षससङ्घसंवृतं खरं जनस्थानगतं विरूपिता। उपेत्य तं भ्रातरमुग्रदर्शनं पपात भूमौ गगनाद्यथाऽशनिः।।3.18.25।।
output: ततः after that, विरूपिता a disfigured woman, सा she, राक्षससङ्घसंवृतम् surrounded by demons, जनस्थानगतम्  living in Janasthana, उग्रदर्शनम्  fiercelooking, भ्रातरम् brother, तं खरम् to Khara, उपेत्य approaching, गगनात् from the sky, अशनिः thunderbolt, यथा like that, भूमौ on the ground, पपात fell down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सभार्यं भयमोहमूर्छिता सलक्ष्मणं राघवमागतं वनम्। विरूपणं चात्मनि शोणितोक्षिता शशंस सर्वं भगिनी खरस्य सा।।3.18.26।।
output: Thereafter the sister of Khara, wild with fear and delusion and drenched in blood, narrated all about the arrival of Rama, Sita and Lakshmana in the forest and her disfigurement. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्ग।। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां तथा पतितां दृष्ट्वा विरूपां शोणितोक्षिताम्। भगिनीं क्रोधसन्तप्तः खरः पप्रच्छ राक्षसः।।3.19.1।।
output: तथा in that way, पतिताम्  fallen down, विरूपाम् disfigured, शोणितोक्षिताम् drenched in blood, तां भगिनीम् that sister, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, राक्षसः demons, खरः Khara, क्रोधसन्तप्तः burning with anger, पप्रच्छ enquired.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
उत्तिष्ठ तावदाख्याहि प्रमोहं जहि सम्भ्रमम्। व्यक्तमाख्याहि केन त्वमेवं रूपा विरूपिता।।3.19.2।।
output: Get up, give up your confusion and stupefaction. Tell me clearly by whom you have been disfigured like this ?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कः कृष्णसर्पमासीनमाशीविषमनागसम्। तुदत्यभिसमापन्नमङ्गुल्यग्रेण लीलया।।3.19.3।।
output: अभिसमापन्नम् staying away , आशीविषम् a snake, अनागसम् innocent, आसीनम् settled, कृष्णसर्पम् black snake, कः who, लीलया playfully, अङ्गुल्यग्रेण with a finger tip, तुदति hurts.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
कः कालपाशं समासज्य कण्ठे मोहान्न बुध्यते। यस्त्वामद्य समासाद्य पीतवान्विषमुत्तमम्।।3.19.4।।
output: Who is he who has tied has tied his throat with the noose of death out of ignorance and yet does not know the implications ? Who is he who has caused this injury to you, but does not understand that he has drunk deadly poison.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बलविक्रमसम्पन्ना कामगा कामरूपिणी। इमामवस्थां नीता त्वं केनान्तकसमागता।।3.19.5।।
output: You have sufficient strength and courage. You are capable of  moving as you like and taking any form at your will. By whom have you been brought to this state and drawn close to death?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
देवगन्धर्वभूतानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। कोऽयमेवं विरूपां त्वां महावीर्यश्चकार ह।।3.19.6।।
output: Which valiant person among gods, gandharvas, sages and other great people, has disfigured you like this ?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
न हि पश्याम्यहं लोके यः कुर्यान्मम विप्रियम्। अमरेषु सहस्राक्षं महेन्द्रं पाकशासनम्।।3.19.7।।
output: I can see none in this world who can offend me, nor even the thousandeyed Indra among the gods.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अद्याहं मार्गणैः प्राणानादास्ये जीवितान्तकैः। सलिले क्षीरमासक्तं निष्पिबन्निव सारसः।।3.19.8।।
output: अद्य right now, अहम् I, सलिले in waters, आसक्तम् mixed, क्षीरम् milk, निष्पिबन् drinking,  सारसः इव like the swan, जीवितान्तकैः  that can put an end to life, मार्गणैः by arrows, प्राणान् life, आदास्ये I will put out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
निहतस्य मया सङ्ख्ये शरसंकृत्तमर्मणः। सफेनं रुधिरं रक्तं मेदिनी कस्य पास्यति।।3.19.9।।
output: Whose foamy, red blood will the earth drink while I strike his vital organs with my arrows in the fight ?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
कस्य पत्ररथाः कायान्मांसमुत्कृत्य सङ्गताः। प्रहृष्टा भक्षयिष्यन्ति निहतस्य मया रणे।।3.19.10।।
output: Whose flesh will be eaten by cheerful flocks of (vultures), biting and tearing his body when he is killed by me in the battle ?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं न देवा न गन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः। मयापकृष्टं कृपणं शक्तास्त्रातुं महाहवे।।3.19.11।।
output: इह here, आहवे in the battle, मया by  me, अपकृष्टम् dragged, तं कृपणम् to that helpless man, त्रातुम् to rescue, देवाः gods, न शक्ताः will not be able, पिशाचाः devils, न not, गन्धर्वाः gandharvas, न राक्षसाः not demons, न not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपलभ्य शनैस्संज्ञां तं मे शंसितुमर्हसि। येन त्वं दुर्विनीतेन वने विक्रम्य निर्जिता।।3.19.12।।
output: दुर्विनीतेन which arrogant, येन by whom, त्वम् you, विक्रम्य  showing prowess, वने in the forest, निर्जिता defeated, तम् him, शनैः slowly, संज्ञाम् consciousness, उपलभ्य  recovered, मे to me, शंसितुम्  till, अर्हसि you should.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
इति भ्रातुर्वचश्श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धस्य च विशेषतः। ततश्शूर्पणखा वाक्यं सबाष्पमिदमब्रवीत्।।3.19.13।।
output: On hearing her angry brother, Surpanakha replied with words choked with tears:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तरुणौ रूपसम्पन्नौ सुकुमारौ महाबलौ। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षौ चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरौ।।3.19.14।। फलमूलाशनौ दान्तौ तापसौ धर्मचारिणौ। पुत्रौ दशरथस्यास्तां भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।3.19.15।।
output: Here are two young sons of Dasaratha, Rama and Lakshmana, who are gentle, handsome,  strong, with eyes like white lotus, wearing deerskin and bark robes, living on fruits and roots, selfrestrained like ascetics and following the righteous path.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तरुणौ रूपसम्पन्नौ सुकुमारौ महाबलौ। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षौ चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरौ।।3.19.14।। फलमूलाशनौ दान्तौ तापसौ धर्मचारिणौ। पुत्रौ दशरथस्यास्तां भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।3.19.15।।
output: तरुणौ two young men, रूपसम्पन्नौ both very handsome, सुकुमारौ delicate, महाबलौ very strong, पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षौ with eyes like white lotus, चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरौ attired in bark robes and black deer skin, फलमूलाशनौ living on fruits and roots, दान्तौ selfrestrained, तापसौ ascetics, धर्मचारिणौ both following righteous path, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्रौ sons, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama  and Lakshmana, भ्रातरौ both brothers, आस्ताम् are here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
गन्धर्वराजप्रतिमौ पार्थिवव्यञ्जनान्वितौ। देवौ वा मानुषौ वा तौ न तर्कयितुमुत्सहे।।3.19.16।।
output: They are kings of the gandharvas with all royal insignia. I was not able to discern whether they are gods or humans.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
तरुणी रूपसम्पन्ना सर्वाभरणभूषिता। दृष्टा तत्र मया नारी तयोर्मध्ये सुमध्यमा।।3.19.17।।
output: I saw between them a young, beautiful woman of slender waist, adorned with all kinds of jewels.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताभ्यामुभाभ्यां सम्भूय प्रमदामधिकृत्य ताम्। इमामवस्थां नीताहं यथानाथासती तथा।।3.19.18।।
output: ताम् her, प्रमदाम् lady, अधिकृत्य pertaining to her, ताभ्याम् by them, उभाभ्याम् both, अहम् I, अनाथा असती यथा like an orphan, unchaste woman, तथा likewise, इमाम् this, अवस्थाम् state, नीता reduced I am.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
तस्याश्चानृजुवृत्तायास्तयोश्च हतयोरहम्। सफेनं पातुमिच्छामि रुधिरं रणमूर्धनि।।3.19.19।।
output: I wish to drink the foamy blood of that crooked woman and of both the brothers slain on the battle front.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
एष मे प्रथमः कामः कृतस्तात त्वया भवेत्। तस्यास्तयोश्च रुधिरं पिबेयमहमाहवे।।3.19.20।।
output: O dear  this is my first wish and you must fulfil it. I will drink her blood and  of the two brothers, in the battle.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति तस्यां ब्रुवाणायां चतुर्दश महाबलान्। व्यादिदेश खरः क्रुद्धो राक्षसानन्तकोपमान्।।3.19.21।।
output: तस्याम् as she, इति in that way, ब्रुवाणायाम् while speaking, खरः Khara, क्रुद्धः  angry, महाबलान् very strong ones, अन्तकोपमान्  comparable to Yama (god of death), चतुर्दश राक्षसान् fourteen demons, व्यादिदेश ordered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
मानुषौ शस्त्रसम्पन्नौ चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरौ। प्रविष्टौ दण्डकारण्यं घोरं प्रमदया सह।।3.19.22।।
output: Two human beings equipped with weapons, clad in bark robes and deerskin have entered the dreadful Dandaka forest along with a woman of bewitching beauty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तौ हत्वा तां च दुर्वृत्तामपावर्तितुमर्हथ। इयं च रुधिरं तेषां भगिनी मम पास्यति।।3.19.23।।
output: तौ both of them, दुर्वृत्ताम् woman of bad behaviour, तां च her also, हत्वा after slaying, अपावर्तितुम् get from there, अर्हथ you should, मम my, इयं भगिनी this sister, तेषाम् their, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यति will drink.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मनोरथोऽयमिष्टोऽस्या भगिन्या मम राक्षसाः। शीघ्रं सम्पाद्यतां तौ च प्रमथ्य स्वेन तेजसा।।3.19.24।।
output: राक्षसाः O demons, स्वेन by your, तेजसा power, तौ both of them, शीघ्रम् quickly, प्रमथ्य after impounding, अस्याः her, मम भगिन्याः my sister's, इष्टः very dear, मनोरथः desire, शीघ्रम् swiftly, सम्पाद्यताम् be fulfiled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 19:
इति प्रतिसमादिष्टा राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। तत्र जग्मुस्तया सार्धं घना वातेरिता यथा।।3.19.25।।
output: Thus commanded, the fourteen demons along with Surpanakha rushed there like windblown clouds.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तु ते तं समुदग्रतेजसं तथापिऽतीक्ष्णप्रदरा निशाचराः। न शेकुरेनं सहसा प्रमर्दितुं वनद्विपा दीप्तमिवाग्निमुत्थितम्।।3.19.26।।
output: The nightrangers were unable to crush him(Rama) despite their sharp, glowing weapons  just as wild elephants cannot face all at once the rising flame of the forest fire. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
ततश्शूर्पणखा घोरा राघवाश्रममागता। राक्षसानाचचक्षे तौ भ्रातरौ सह सीतया।।3.20.1।।
output: The frightful Surpanakha came to the hermitage of Rama and showed both the brothers and Sita to the demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
ते रामं पर्णशालायामुपविष्टं महाबलम्। ददृशुस्सीतया सार्धं वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च।3.20.2।।
output: They saw mighty Rama together with Vaidehi and Lakshmana sitting in the leafthatched cottage.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
तान्दृष्ट्वा राघवश्श्रीमानागतांस्तां च राक्षसीम्। अब्रवीद्भ्रातरं रामो लक्ष्मणं दीप्ततेजसम्।।3.20.3।।
output: Seeing the demons along with Surpanakha arrive, said the handsome Rama, scion of the Raghu dynasty to his brother Lakshmana, who was blazing like fire :

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
मुहूर्तं भव सौमित्रे सीतायाः प्रत्यनन्तरः। इमानस्या वधिष्यामि पदवीमागतानिह।।3.20.4।।
output: O Lakshmana  stand by Sita for a while. I shall kill these demons who have come here.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वाक्यमेतत्ततश्श्रुत्वा रामस्य विदितात्मनः। तथेति लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं रामस्य प्रत्यपूजयत्।।3.20.5।।
output: ततः then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, विदितात्मनः knower of the self, रामस्य Rama's, एतत् this, वाक्यम् statement, श्रुत्वा after hearing, तथेति agreeing to, रामस्य  Rama's, वाक्यम् statement, प्रत्यपूजयत् in turn honoured.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवोऽपि महच्चापं चामीकरविभूषितम्। चकार सज्यं धर्मात्मा तानि रक्षांसि चाब्रवीत्।।3.20.6।।
output: धर्मात्मा righteous man, राघवोऽपि Rama too, चामीकरविभूषितम् decked with gold, महत् great, चापम् bow, सज्यम् stringed, चकार made, तानि those, रक्षांसि to the demons, अब्रवीत् च said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुत्रौ दशरथस्यावां भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। प्रविष्टौ सीतया सार्धं दुश्चरं दण्डकावनम्।।3.20.7।।
output: We, Rama and Lakshmana, sons of Dasaratha, are brothers, who have entered the inaccessible Dandaka forest along with Sita.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
फलमूलाशनौ दान्तौ तापसौ धर्मचारिणौ। वसन्तौ दण्डकारण्ये किमर्थमुपहिंसथ।।3.20.8।।
output: Feeding on fruits and roots and following the righteous path, we are living in Dandaka forest like ascetics. Why are you torturing us?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
युष्मान्पापात्मकान्हन्तुं विप्रकारान्महाहवे। ऋषीणां तु नियोगेन प्राप्तोऽहं सशरायुधः।।3.20.9।।
output: अहम् I, पापात्मकान् sinners, विप्रकारान् offenders, युष्मान् you, आहवे in war, हन्तुम् to kill, सशरायुधः equipped with bows, arrows and weapons, ऋषीणाम् of ascetics, नियोगेन by their order, प्राप्तः came.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तिष्ठतैवात्र सन्तुष्टा नोपावर्तितुमर्हथ। यदि प्राणैरिहार्थो वा निवर्तध्वं निशाचराः।।3.20.10।।
output: If you care for your life, you may return, or else, if you please you may remain (die) here, O demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। ऊचुर्वाचं  सुसंक्रुद्धा ब्रह्मघ्नाश्शूलपाणयः।।3.20.11।।
output: At these words, the destroyers of brahmins, the fourteen demons were inflamed. They lifted their spears and spoke:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
क्रोधमुत्पाद्य नो भर्तुः खरस्य सुमहात्मनः। त्वमेव हास्यसे प्राणानद्यास्माभिर्हतो युधि।।3.20.12।।
output: You have incited the wrath of Khara, our great master for which you will now pay with your life in the fight.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
का हि ते शक्तिरेकस्य बहूनां रणमूर्धनी। अस्माकमग्रतः स्थातुं किं पुनर्योद्दुमाहवे।।3.20.13।।
output: बहूनाम् by many, अस्माकम् of us, अग्रतः in front of, रणमूर्धनि at the head of the battle, स्थातुम् to stand, एकस्य of  one, ते to you, का शक्तिः where is the power, आहवे in war, योद्धुम् to fight, किं पुनः why again.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एहि बाहुप्रयुक्तैर्नः परिघैश्शूलपट्टिसैः। प्राणांस्त्यक्षसि वीर्यं च धनुश्च करपीडितम्।।3.20.14।।
output: एहि come on, नः us, बाहुप्रयुक्तैः by those dicharged by our arms, परिघैः by daggers, शूलपट्टिशै spears with sharp, प्राणान् your life, वीर्यं च prowess, करपीडितम् held by hand, धनुश्च the bow aslo, त्यक्षसि will shun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सङ्कृद्धा राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। चिक्षिपुस्तानि शूलानि राघवं प्रति दुर्जयम्।।3.20.15।।
output: Saying these words, the fourteen infuriated demons hurled their spears at invincible Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तानि शूलानि काकुत्स्थस्समस्तानि चतुर्दश। तावद्भिरेव चिच्छेद शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः।।3.20.16।।
output: All the fourteen spears hurled turned into splinters by the same number of golden arrows released by Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
ततः पश्चान्महातेजा नाराचान्सूर्यसन्निभान्। जग्राह परमक्रुद्धश्चतुर्दश शिलाशितान्।।3.20.17।।
output: Then the effulgent Rama, mighty angry, took fourteen arrows sharpened by stones and glowing like the  Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गृहीत्वा धनुरायम्य लक्ष्यानुद्दिश्य राक्षसान्। मुमोच राघवो बाणान्वज्रानिव शतक्रतुः।।3.20.18।।
output: Rama took the bow, stretched it and aimed at his target, the demons  and sent the arrows as Indra would release the thunderbolt.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुक्मपुङ्खाश्च विशिखा दीप्ता हेमविभूषिताः। ते भित्त्वा रक्षसां वेगाद्वक्षांसि रुधिराप्लुताः।3.20.19।। विनिष्पेतुस्तदा भूमौ न्यमज्जन्ताशनिस्वनाः।
output: Goldfeathered blazing arrows decorated with gold, released by Rama flew fast and pierced the chests of the demons. Drenched in blood they (the arrows) thundered (out of their chests) and  plunged into the earth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते भिन्नहृदया भूमौ छिन्नमूला इव द्रुमाः।।3.20.20।। निपेतुश्शोणितार्द्राङ्गा विकृता विगतासवः।
output: ते they, भिन्नहृदयाः  with pierced hearts, शोणितार्द्राङ्गाः bodies drenched in blood, विकृताः disfigured, विगतासवः with their life gone, छिन्नमूलाः  cut at the roots, द्रुमाः इव like trees, भूमौ on earth, निपेतुः fell down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान् दृष्ट्वा पतितान्भूमौ राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्छिता।।3.20.21।। परित्रस्ता पुनस्तत्र व्यसृजद्भैरवस्वनान्।
output: Seeing the demons fallen on the ground, the demoness wild with anger and fear roared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
उपगम्य खरं सा तु किञ्चित्संशुष्कशोणिता।।3.20.22।। पपात पुनरेवार्ता सनिर्यासेव सल्लकी।
output: Her blood slightly dried up, she came back afflicted to Khara and fell down like a sallaki tree, its sap oozing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पपात पुनरेवार्ता सनिर्यासेव सल्लकी ।।3.20.23 ।।
output: Missing

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भ्रातुस्समीपे शोकार्ता ससर्ज निनदं मुहुः।।3.20.24।। सस्वरं मुमुचे बाष्पं विषण्णवदना तदा।
output: Then desperately screaming and shedding tears with a sad face beside her brother, she roared again and again.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 20:
निपातितान् दृश्य रणे तु राक्षसान् प्रधाविता शूर्पणखा पुनस्ततः। वधं च तेषां निखिलेन रक्षसां शशंस सर्वं भगिनी खरस्य सा।।3.20.25।।
output: When Surpanakha saw the demons fall dead on the battleground, she ran to Khara,her brother and told in detail about the death of the demons. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स पुनः पतितां दृष्ट्वा क्रोधाच्छूर्पणखां खरः। उवाच व्यक्तया वाचा तामनर्थार्थमागताम्।।3.21.1।।
output: Khara pacifies Surpanakha -- Surpanakha provokes Khara against Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मया त्विदानीं शूरास्ते राक्षसा रुधिराशनाः। त्वत्प्रियार्थं विनिर्दिष्टाः किमर्थं रुद्यते पुनः।।3.21.2।।
output: मया myself, त्वत्प्रियार्थम् for your pleasure, इदानीम् just now, रुधिराशनाः  who feed on blood, शूराः heroes, ते राक्षसाः those demons, विनिर्दिष्टाः commissioned, पुनः again, किमर्थम् for what reason, रुद्यते  crying.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भक्ताश्चैवानुरक्ताश्च हिताश्च मम नित्यशः। हन्यमाना न हन्यन्ते न न कुर्युर्वचो मम।।3.21.3।।
output: भक्ताश्चैव  devoted, अनुरक्ताश्च  fond of me, नित्यशः always, मम to me, हिताश्च wellwishers, हन्यमानाः while they are being attacked, न हन्यन्ते are not killed , मम my, वचः words, न न कुर्युः never fail to carry out my orders.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 21:
किमेतच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि कारणं यत्कृते पुनः। हा नाथेति विनर्दन्ती सर्पवल्लुठसि क्षितौ।।3.21.4।।
output: I wish to know what makes you lament and roll on the ground like a serpent and hissing?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 21:
अनाथवद्विलपसि नाथे तु मयि संस्थिते। उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ माभैषीर्वैक्लव्यं त्यज्यतामिह।।3.21.5।।
output: When I am here like a lord to protect you, why do you weep like an orphan? Get up. Give up your anxiety. Be not afraid.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्येवमुक्ता दुर्धर्षा खरेण परिसान्त्विता। विमृज्य नयने सास्रे खरं भ्रातरमब्रवीत्।।3.21.6।।
output: इत्येवम् thus, उक्ता addressed, खरेण by Khara, परिसान्त्विता pacified, दुर्दर्षा in invincible woman, सास्रे tearful, नयने eyes, विमृज्य wiping, भ्रातरम् to brother, खरम् to Khara, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अस्मीदानीमहं प्राप्ता हृतश्रवणनासिका। शोणितौघपरिक्लिन्ना त्वया च परिसान्त्विता।।3.21.7।।
output: My ears and nose sliced off, drenched with blood, I came to you and you pacified me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रेषिताश्च त्वया वीर राक्षसास्ते चतुर्दश। निहन्तुं राघवं क्रोधान्मत्प्रियार्थं सलक्षणम्।।3.21.8।।
output: वीर O hero, त्वया by you, क्रोधात् out of anger, मत्प्रियार्थम् to please me, सलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, राघवम् Rama, निहन्तुम् to kill, ते those, चतुर्दश fourteen, राक्षसाः demons, प्रेषिताः were sent.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते तु रामेण सामर्षाः शूलपट्टसपाणयः। समरे निहतास्सर्वे सायकैर्मर्मभेदिभिः।।3.21.9।।
output: सामर्षाः those spirited ones, शूलपट्टसपाणयः with spears in hands, ते those, सर्वे all, रामेण by Rama, मर्मभेदिभिः hearts pierced, सायकैः by arrows, निहताः killed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तान्दृष्ट्वा पतितान्भूमौ क्षणेनैव महाबलान्। रामस्य च महत्कर्म महांस्त्रासोऽभवन्मम।।3.21.10।।
output: क्षणेनैव in moments, भूमौ on earth, पतितान् fallen down, महाबलान् mighty ones, तान् them, रामस्य Rama's, महत् great, कर्म च action, दृष्ट्वा seeing, मम to me, महान् powerful, त्रासः fear, अभवत् befell.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहमस्मि समुद्विग्ना विषण्णा च निशाचर। शरणं त्वां पुनः प्राप्ता सर्वतोभयदर्शिनी।।3.21.11।।
output: O demon  I am scared and sad. To me everything looks frightening. I, therefore, seek refuge in you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 21:
विषादनक्राध्युषिते परित्रासोर्मिमालिनि। किं मां न त्रायसे मग्नां विपुले शोकसागरे।।3.21.12।।
output: I am drowned in a vast sea of sorrow where crocodiles in the form of distress reside. It is full of rows of waves of fright. Why do you not save me?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एते च निहता भूमौ रामेण निशितैः शरैः। येऽपि मे पदवीं प्राप्ता राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः।।3.21.13।।
output: The demons who live on flesh, who came following me fell down on earth and lay dead,  shot by the sharp arrows of Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 21:
मयि ते यद्यनुक्रोशो यदि रक्षस्सु तेषु च। रामेण यदि ते शक्तिस्तेजो वास्ति निशाचर।3.21.14।। दण्डकारण्यनिलयं जहि राक्षसकण्टकम्।
output: O demon  if you have compassion for me or for the demons, if you have the power and energy to face Rama, kill the enemy of the demons living in Dandaka forest.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदि रामं ममामित्रं न त्वमद्यवधिष्यसि।।3.21.15।। तवैव चाग्रतः प्राणांस्त्यक्षामि निरपत्रप।
output: मम my, अमित्रम् enemy, रामम् that Rama, त्वम् you, अद्य now, न वधिष्यसि यदि if you do not kill, निरपत्रप O shameless one, तव your, अग्रतः presence, प्राणान् life, त्यक्ष्यामि will give up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बुद्ध्याहमनुपश्यामि न त्वं रामस्य संयुगे।।3.21.16।। स्थातुं प्रतिमुखे शक्तस्सबलश्च महात्मनः।
output: त्वम् you, सबलश्च with your army too, संयुगे in an encounter, महात्मनः of the great man, रामस्य Rama's, प्रतिमुखे face to face, स्थातुम् to stand, न शक्तः you are not capable, अहम् I, बुद्ध्या through my intellect, अनुपश्यामि I can foresee.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शूरमानी न शूरस्त्वं मिथ्यारोपितविक्रमः।।3.21.17।। मानुषौ यो न शक्नोषि हन्तुं तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।
output: You call yourself a hero, yet are not able to kill two humans like Rama and Lakshmana. Your claim to heroism is false. You are not a hero at all.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामेण यदि ते शक्तिस्तेजो वास्ति निशाचर।।3.21.18।। दण्डकारण्यनिलयं जहि तं कुलपांसन।
output: O demon  you are a disgrace to the family. If you have power or energy, kill that Rama dwelling in Dandaka forest.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निस्सत्वस्याल्प वीर्यस्य वासस्ते कीदृशस्त्विह।।3.21.19।। अपयाहि जनस्थानातत्वरितस्सहबान्धवः।
output: निस्सत्वस्य of a man who has no strength, अल्पवीर्यस्य of less valiant one, ते your, इह here, वास: stay, कीदृशः what kind of, सहबान्धव: with your relations, त्वरितः quickly, जनस्थानात् from this Janasthana, अपयाहि go away.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामतेजोभिभूतो हि त्वं क्षिप्रं विनशिष्यसि।3.21.20।। स हि तेजस्समायुक्तो रामो दशरथात्मजः। भ्राता चास्य महावीर्यो येन चास्मि विरूपिता।।3.21.21।।
output: Let down by the brilliance of Rama, son of Dasaratha, you will be soon destroyed. He is mighty and his brother who has disfigured me is very valiant.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 21:
रामतेजोभिभूतो हि त्वं क्षिप्रं विनशिष्यसि।3.21.20।। स हि तेजस्समायुक्तो रामो दशरथात्मजः। भ्राता चास्य महावीर्यो येन चास्मि विरूपिता।।3.21.21।।
output: Let down by the brilliance of Rama, son of Dasaratha, you will be soon destroyed. He is mighty and his brother who has disfigured me is very valiant.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं विलप्य बहुशो राक्षसी विततोदरी। कराभ्यामुदरं हत्वा रुरोद भृशदुःखिता।।3.21.22।।
output: विततोदरी  big bellied woman, राक्षसी demoness i, बहुशः in several ways, एवम् in that manner, विलप्य  weeping, भृशदुःखिता very sad, कराभ्याम् with both her hands, उदरम् belly (here, chest), हत्वा beating, रुरोद cried.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 22:
एवमाधर्षितश्शूरश्शूर्पणख्या खरस्ततः। उवाच रक्षसां मध्ये खरः खरतरं वचः।।3.22.1।।
output: Ashamed and accused thus in the presence of the demons, the valiant Khara spoke to Surpanakha in harsh words:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 22:
तवावमानप्रभवः क्रोधोऽयमतुलो मम। न शक्यते धारयितुं लवणाम्भ इवोल्बणम्।।3.22.2।।
output: Like the overslowing salt sea water, I am unable to contain this my excessive anger arising out of your insult.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न रामं गणये वीर्यान्मानुषं क्षीणजीवितम्। आत्मदुश्चरितैः प्राणान्हतोयोऽद्य विमोक्ष्यते।।3.22.3।।
output: मानुषम् human being, क्षीणजीवितम् shortlived, रामम् Rama, वीर्यात् due to valour, न गणये I do not count, यः he who has, आत्मदुश्चरितैः by his own bad conduct, हतः be killed, अद्य now, प्राणान् life, विमोक्ष्यते will leave.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बाष्पस्संह्रियतामेष सम्भ्रमश्च विमुच्यताम्। अहं रामं सह भ्रात्रा नयामि यमसादनम्।।3.22.4।।
output: एषः this, बाष्पः tears, संह्रियाताम् may be controlled, सम्भ्रमश्च anxiety also, विमुच्यताम् give up, अहम् I, रामम् Rama, भ्रात्रा सह along with his brother, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama, नयामि l will send.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 22:
परश्वथहतस्याद्य मन्दप्राणस्य संयुगे। रामस्य रुधिरं रक्तमुष्णं पास्यसि राक्षसि।।3.22.5।।
output: With his life ebbing out, killed by my axe in the fight, you will drink today, O demoness, Rama's red, hot blood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा प्रहृष्टा वचश्श्रुत्वा खरस्य वदनाच्च्युतम्। प्रशशंस पुनर्मौर्ख्याद्भ्रातरं रक्षसां वरम्।।3.22.6।।
output: On hearing the words that came out of Khara's mouth, she was pleased. And in stupidity began praising her brother once again as the best of demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 22:
तया परुषितः पूर्वं पुनरेव प्रशंसितः। अब्रवीद्दूषणं नाम खरस्सेनापतिं तदा।।3.22.7।।
output: Khara, accused by her earlier and admired again, said to Dusana, chief of army:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि मम चित्तानुवर्तिनाम्। रक्षसां भीमवेगानां समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम्।।3.22.8।।
output: मम my, चित्तानुवर्तिनाम् acting according to will, भीमवेगानाम् of terrific speed, समरेषु in war, अनिवर्तिनाम् never turn back, रक्षसाम् of demons, चतुर्दश fourteen, सहस्राणि thousand.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नीलजीमूतवर्णानां घोराणां क्रूरकर्मणाम्। लोकहिंसाविहाराणां बलिनामुग्रतेजसाम्।।3.22.9।।
output: नीलजीमूतवर्णानाम् of the colour of the dark blue cloud, घोराणां of dreadful, कृ़रकर्मणाम् those who commit cruel acts लोकहिंसाविहाराणां those who roam about torturing people, बलिनाम् of the strong, उग्रतेजसाम् very powerful people.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषां शार्दूलदर्पाणां महास्यानां महौजसाम्। सर्वोद्योग मुदीर्णानां रक्षसां सौम्य कारय।।3.22.10।।
output: O handsome one, get them all, powerful like tigers, demons with large countenances, mighty and arragant, ready (for the fight).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 22:
उपस्थापय मे क्षिप्रं रथं सौम्य धनूंषि च। शरांश्चित्रांश्च खङ्गांश्च शक्तीश्च विविधाश्शिताः।।3.22.11।।
output: O goodnatured one, get my chariot, bows and arrows, wonderful swords of different kinds and sharp missiles ready quickly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्रे निर्यातुमिच्छामि पौलस्त्यानां महात्मनाम्। वधार्थं दुर्विनीतस्य रामस्य रणकोविदः।।3.22.12।।
output: रणकोविदः expert in warfare, दुर्विनीतस्य of the immodest, रामस्य Rama's, वधार्थम् to kill, महात्मनाम् great self, पौलस्त्यानाम् those of Paulasthya family, अग्रे in front, निर्यातुम् to go, इच्छामि I desire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Aranya Kanda, Sarga 22:
इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सूर्यवर्णं महारथम्। सदश्वैश्शबलैर्युक्तमाचचक्षेऽथ दूषणः।।3.22.13।।
output: While Khara was speaking thus, Dusana reported that a huge chariot of the colour of the Sun yoked with good horses of variegated hues stood ready.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं मेरुशिखराकारं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम्। हेमचक्रमसम्बाधं वैदूर्यमयकूबरम्।।3.22.14।। मत्स्यैः पुष्पैर्द्रुमैश्शैलैश्चन्द्रसूर्यैश्च काञ्चनैः। मङ्गलैः पक्षिसङ्घैश्च ताराभिरभिसंवृतम्।।3.22.15।। ध्वजनिस्त्रिंशसम्पन्नं किङ्किणीकविराजितम्। सदश्वयुक्तं सोऽमर्षादारुरोह खरो रथम्।।3.22.16।।
