output: ततः then, सचिवैः with his counsellers, वानरैः सह with monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, विशेषतः specially, प्रतिज्ञातम् his own promise, प्रहृष्टः felt glad

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमेकान्तसम्पृक्तौ ततस्तौ नरवानरौ। उभावन्योन्यसदृशं सुखं दुःखमभाषताम्4.7.24।।
output: Man and monkey then met privately and shared the weal and woe of one another.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महानुभावस्य वचो निशम्य हरिर्नृपाणामृषभस्य तस्य। कृतं स मेने हरिवीरमुख्य स्तदा स्वकार्यं हृदयेन विद्वान्4.7.25।।
output: Wise Sugriva, chief of monkeys, heard the words of the magnanimous Rama, a bull among men. He felt glad at heart thinking that his task has been achieved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by the sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
परितुष्टस्तु सुग्रीवस्तेन वाक्येन वानरः। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमब्रवीत्4.8.1।।
output: Sugriva, the monkey was very pleased with Rama's words and said to him in front of Lakshmana:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वथाऽहमनुग्राह्यो देवतानां न संशयः। उपपन्न गुणोपेतस्सखा यस्य भवान्मम4.8.2।।
output: 'Since one like you endowed with all virtues has become my friend I am (now) worthy of grace of the gods in all respects. There is no doubt.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शक्यं खलु भवेद्राम सहायेन त्वयाऽनघ। सुरराज्यमपि प्राप्तुं स्वराज्यं किं पनः प्रभो 4.8.3।।
output: 'O Rama, my sinless Lord, it is possible to attain even the kingdom of the gods with your help, what  to speak of my own kingdom?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽहं सभाज्यो बन्धूनां सुहृदां चैव राघव। यस्याग्निसाक्षिकं मित्रं लब्धं राघववंशजम्4.8.4।।
output: राघव Rama, यस्य whose, राघववंशजम् born in Raghava dynasty, मित्रम् friend, अग्निसाक्षिकम्  fire as witness, लब्धम् got, सः अहम् that I, बन्धूनाम्  among relatives, सुहृदां चैव also among friends, सभाज्यः became equally honourable.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
अहमप्यनुरूपस्ते वयस्यो ज्ञास्यसे शनैः। न तु वक्तुं समर्थोऽहं स्वयमात्मगतान्गुणान्4.8.5।।
output: 'You will come to know slowly that I am also a friend worthy of you.It is not proper for me to speak of my qualities( flatter myself).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
महात्मनां तु भूयिष्ठं त्वद्विधानां कृतात्मनाम्। निश्चला भवति प्रीतिर्धैर्यमात्मवतामिव4.8.6।।
output: 'The affection of exalted souls is exceedingly stable like the patience of  selfcontrolled and wellcomposed men like you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
रजतं वा सुवर्णं वा वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च। अविभक्तानि साधूनामवगच्छन्ति साधवः4.8.7।।
output: 'Good friends consider(valuables such as) silver or gold, clothes or ornaments of worldly wealth indivisible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आढ्यो वापि दरिद्रो वा दुःखितस्सुखितोऽपि वा। निर्दोषो वा सदोषो वा वयस्यः परमा गतिः4.8.8।।
output: आढ्यो वापि whether a rich man, दरिद्रो वा or poor, दुःखितः or sad one, सुखितोऽपि वा or a happy man, निर्दोषो flawless one, सदोषः guilty, वयस्यः a friend, परमा ultimate, गतिः refuge.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धनत्यागस्सुखत्यागो देहत्यागोऽपि वा पुनः। वयस्यार्थे प्रवर्तन्ते स्नेहं दृष्टवा तथाविधम्4.8.9।।
output: 'One will not hesitate to sacrifice wealth or happiness or even life for the sake of a friend like you.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
तत्तथेत्यब्रवीद्रामस्सुग्रीवं प्रियवादिनम्। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो लक्ष्म्या वासवस्येव धीमतः4.8.10।।
output: As wise Lakshmana, brilliant like Indra stood witness, Rama said, 'it is true as you say' to Sugriva who spoke pleasing words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
ततो रामं स्थितं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। सुग्रीवस्सर्वतश्चक्षुर्वने लोलमपातयत्4.8.11।।
output: With mighty Rama and Lakshmana standing by, Sugriva cast his eyes eagerly all round the forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
स ददर्श ततस्सालमविदूरे हरीश्वरः। सुपुष्पमीषत्पत्राढ्यं भ्रमरैरुपशोभितम्4.8.12।।
output: Then the chief of monkeys saw a sala tree looking lovely with tender leaves and flowers graced by bees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यैकां पर्णबहुलां भङ्क्त्वा शाखां सुपुष्पिताम्। सालस्यास्तीर्य सुग्रीवो निषसाद सराघवः4.8.13।।
output: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तस्य its, पर्णबहुलाम्  with plenty of leaves, सुशोभिताम् beautifully  blossomed, एकां शाखाम् one branch, भङ्क्त्वा broke, रामस्य for Rama, आस्तीर्य spread, स राघवः with Rama, निषसाद sat.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तावासीनौ ततो दृष्ट्वा हनूमानपि लक्ष्मणम्। सालशाखां समुत्पाट्य विनीतमुपवेशयत्4.8.14।।
output: ततः thereafter, हनूमानपि Hanuman also, आसीनौ seated, तौ both Rama and Sugriva, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, सालशाखाम् a branch of sala tree, समुत्पाट्य  broke, विनीतम् obedient, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, उपवेशयत् made him sit.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
सुखोपविष्टं रामं तु प्रसन्नमुदधिं यथा। फलपुष्पसमाकीर्णे तस्मिन् गिरिवरोत्तमे4.8.15।। ततः प्रहृष्टस्सुग्रीवश्लक्ष्णं मधुरया गिरा। उवाच प्रणयाद्रामं हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम्4.8.16।।
output: Now Rama, seated comfortably on the best of mountains overgrown with trees full of flowers and fruits, appeared tranguil like an ocean. Extremely delighted and excited, Sugriva spoke to Rama words that got mixed up with softness and sweetness out of love:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुखोपविष्टं रामं तु प्रसन्नमुदधिं यथा। फलपुष्पसमाकीर्णे तस्मिन् गिरिवरोत्तमे4.8.15।। ततः प्रहृष्टस्सुग्रीवश्लक्ष्णं मधुरया गिरा। उवाच प्रणयाद्रामं हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम्4.8.16।।
output: ततः then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, फलपुष्पमाकीर्णे in a place filled with flowers and fruits, तस्मिन् in that, गिरिवरोत्तमे on the best of mountains, सुखोपविष्टम् seated comfortably, प्रसन्नम् peaceful, उदधिं यथा like an ocean, रामम् Rama, श्लक्ष्णम् softly, मधुरया sweetly, गिरा words, हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम् mixing up words due to extreme joy and excitement, प्रणयात् out of love, उवाच said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहं विनिकृतो भ्रात्रा चराम्येष भयार्दितः। ऋष्यमूकं गिरिवरं हृतभार्यस्सुदुःखितः4.8.17।।
output: भ्रात्रा  brother, विनिकृतः offended, एषः here I am, अहम् I, भयार्दितः frightened, हृतभार्यः wife stolen, सुदुःखितः very sad, गिरिवरम् great mountain, ऋश्यमूकम् Rishyamuka, चरामि I am roaming .

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽहं त्रस्तो भये मग्नो वसाम्युद्भ्रान्तचेतनः। वालिना निकृतो भ्रात्रा कृतवैरश्च राघव4.8.18।।
output: 'O Rama my brother is my enemy. Deceived and threatened by him, I live in the forest stricken with fear and utterly confused.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वालिनो मे भयार्तस्य सर्वलोकाभयङ्कर। ममापि त्वमनाथस्य प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि4.8.19।।
output: 'O great warrior who can frighten all the worlds scared of Vali, I feel  helpless like an orphan to whom you ought to extend your grace.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तस्तु तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः। प्रत्युवाच स काकुत्स्थस्सुग्रीवं प्रहसन्निव4.8.20।।
output: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, तेजस्वी glorious, धर्मज्ञः knower of duty , धर्मवत्सलः a lover of dharma, सः काकुत्स्थः that Kakustha, प्रहसन्निव gentle smile on his face, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, प्रत्युवाच replied

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपकारफलं मित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम्। अद्यैव तं हनिष्यामि तव भार्यापहारिणम्4.8.21।।
output: मित्रम्ज्ञ a friend, उपकारफलम् carries the fruit of help, अपकारः harm, अरिलक्षणम् an enemy's characteristic feature, तव your, भार्यापहारिणम् wrested your wife, तम् him, अद्यैव this very day, वधिष्यामि I will kill.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमे हि मे महावेगा पत्रिणस्तिग्मतेजसः। कार्तिकेयवनोद्भूताश्शरा हेमविभूषिताः4.8.22।। कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्ना महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः। सुपर्वाणस्सुतीक्ष्णाग्रास्सरोषा भुजगा इव4.8.23।।
output: महावेगाः of high speed, मे my, पत्रिणः winged ones, इमे these , शराःarrows, तिग्मतेजसः glowing like fierce fire, कार्तिकेयवनोद्भताः born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds, हेमविभूषिताः decked with gold, कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्नाः covered with kanka feathers, महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः  comparable to great Indra's thunderbolt, सुपर्वाणः those with smooth joints, सुतीक्ष्णाग्राः  with very sharp and pointed tips, सरोषाः angry, भुजगाः serpents, इव like.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
इमे हि मे महावेगा पत्रिणस्तिग्मतेजसः। कार्तिकेयवनोद्भूताश्शरा हेमविभूषिताः4.8.22।। कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्ना महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः। सुपर्वाणस्सुतीक्ष्णाग्रास्सरोषा भुजगा इव4.8.23।।
output: 'Here are my highspeed, winged arrows glowing like fierce fire, born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds.They are smooth and welljointed, decked with gold, comparable in strength to great Indra's thunderbolt, very sharp with pointed tips looking like angry serpents.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भ्रातृसंज्ञममित्रं ते वालिनं कृतकिल्बिषम्। शरैर्विनिहतं पश्य विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम्4.8.24।।
output: ते your, वालिनम् at Vali, कृतकिल्बिषम् doer of wrong deeds, वालिसंज्ञम् calls Vali's brother, अमित्रम् enemy, शरैः by arrows, विनिहतम् being killed, विकीर्णम् shattered, पर्वतम् इव crushed like a mountain, पश्य you may see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
राघवस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो वाहिनीपतिः। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत्4.8.25।।
output: On hearing Rama's words, Sugriva, chief of the army of monkeys experienced immeasurable happiness and exclaimed, 'you're great, you're great.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
राम शोकाभिभूतोऽहं शोकार्तानां भवान्गतिः। वयस्य इति कृत्वा हि त्वय्यहं परिदेवये4.8.26।।
output: 'Rama I am overwhelmed with sorrow. You are the refuge of the distressed. As you are a friend I ventilate all my grief to you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वं हि पाणिप्रदानेन वयस्यो मेऽग्निसाक्षिकम्। कृतः प्राणैर्बहुमतस्सत्येनापि शपामि ते4.8.27।।
output: 'I value your hand of friendship extended to me, with fire as witness more than my very life. I, on my own, offer my pledge of friendship.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं बाष्पदूषितलोचनः। बाष्पोपहतया वाचा नोच्चैश्शक्नोति भाषितुम्4.8.29।।
output: His vision blurred, words choked with tears he was unable to speak further.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाष्पवेगं तु सहसा नदीवेगमिवागतम्। धारयामास धैर्येण सुग्रीवो रामसन्निधौ4.8.30।।
output: Quickly Sugriva controlled his tears streaming fast like the rushing river, with patience, Rama seated in front.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
सन्निगृह्य तु तं बाष्पं प्रमृज्य नयने शुभे। विनिश्श्वस्य च तेजस्वी राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.8.31।।
output: Effulgent Sugriva controlled his tears, wiped his bright eyes, took deep breath and said to Rama:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुराऽहं वालिना राम राज्यात्स्वादवरोपितः। परुषाणि च संश्राव्य निर्धूतोऽस्मि बलीयसा4.8.32।।
output: राम O Rama, पुरा in the past, अहम् I, बलीयसा powerful, वालिना by Vali, स्वात् from my  own, राज्यात् from the kingdom, अवरोपितः was uprooted, परुषाणि harsh (words), संश्राव्य making me listen, निर्धूतः thrown out, अस्मि I am.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
हृता भार्या च मे तेन प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी। सुहृदश्च मदीया ये संयता बन्धनेषु ते4.8.33।।
output: 'I was robbed of my wife who is dearer than my own life. All my friends were rounded up and imprisoned.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
यत्नवांश्च सुदुष्टात्मा मद्विनाशाय राघव। बहुशस्तत्प्रयुक्ताश्च वानरा निहता मया4.8.34।।
output: 'O Rama this evilminded one made several attempts to kill me. The monkeys he sent to kill me were themselves killed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
शङ्कया त्वेतया चेह दृष्ट्वा त्वामपि राघव। नोपसर्पाम्यहं भीतो भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति4.8.35।।
output: 'It is because of suspicion that I did not approach you. Every one is scared when there is ample reason to fear.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
केवलं हि सहाया मे हनुमत्प्रमुखास्त्विमे। अतोऽहं धारयाम्यद्य प्राणान् कृच्छ्रगतोऽपि सन्4.8.36।।
output: 'Only Hanuman and other chiefs are helping me. Therefore, I am surviving in spite of all difficulties.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एते हि कपयस्स्निग्धा मां रक्षन्ति समन्ततः। सह गच्छन्ति गन्तव्ये नित्यं तिष्ठन्ति च स्थिते4.8.37।।
output: 'These monkeys out of love for me keep me protected from all sides. They go out with me when it is necessary and stay back whenever I stop (in order to guard me).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सङ्क्षेपस्त्वेष मे राम किमुक्त्वा विस्तरं हि ते। स मे ज्येष्ठो रिपुर्भ्राता वाली विश्रुतपौरुषः4.8.38।।
output: राम O Rama, एषः this, मे my, सङ्क्षेपः in brief, ते to you, विस्तरम् in detail, उक्त्वा telling, किम् why, मे my, भ्राता brother, विश्रुतपौरुषः a man of wellknown prowess, सः वाली that Vali, रिपुः enemy.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्विनाशाद्धि मे दुःखं प्रणष्टं स्यादनन्तरम्। सुखं मे जीवितं चैव तद्विनाशनिबन्धनम्4.8.39।।
output: 'My sorrow will go only with his death. My happiness and my life are also subject to his destruction.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष मे राम शोकान्तश्शोकार्तेन निवेदितः। दुःखितस्सुखितो वापि सख्युर्नित्यं सखा गतिः4.8.40।।
output: राम Rama, शोकार्तेन out of sorrow, मे my, एषः this, शोकान्तः end the sorrow, निवेदितः  explained to you, सख्युः for a friend, दुःखितः unhappy, सुखितो वापि or happy, सखा a friend, गतिः is the only refuge.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
श्रुत्वैतद्वचनं रामस्सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्। किं निमित्तमभूद्वैरं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः4.8.41।।
output: After hearing  Sugriva, Rama said 'I wish to know the actual cause of this enmity.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
सुखं हि कारणं श्रुत्वा वैरस्य तव वानर। अनन्तरं विधास्यामि सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलम्4.8.42।।
output: 'On hearing the cause of your enmity and considering your strength and weakness, I will take steps to make you happy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 8:
बलवान् हि ममामर्षश्श्रुत्वा त्वामवमानितम्। वर्तते हृदयोत्कम्पी प्रावृड्वेग इवाम्भसः4.8.43।।
output: 'On hearing about your humiliation I feel highly agitated at heart. I feel very much angry and restless like the water in rainy season.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हृष्टः कथय विस्रब्धो यावदारोप्यते धनुः। सृष्टश्च हि मया बाणो निरस्तश्च रिपुस्तव4.8.44।।
output: मया by me, धनुः bow, यावत् until, आरोप्यते is strung, बाणः arrow, सृष्टश्च on the release, तव your, रिपुः enemy, निरस्तश्च will be destroyed, हृष्टः happily, विस्रब्धः freely, कथय speak.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवः काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे चतुर्भिस्सह वानरैः4.8.45।।
output: When the great Rama said this, Sugriva with all the four monkeys felt immeasurably glad.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः प्रहृष्टवदनस्सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणाग्रजे। वैरस्य कारणं तत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे4.8.46।।
output: With a smile on his face, Sugriva started narrating to Lakshmana's elder brother the facts about the cause of his enmity (with Vali). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः Thus ends the eighth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वाली नाम मम भ्राता ज्येष्ठश्शत्रुनिषूदनः। पितुर्बहुमतो नित्यं ममापि च तथा पुरा4.9.1।।
output: Episode of Vali's fight with Mayavi -- installation of Sugriva as king of Kishkinda -- return of Vali to Kishkinda.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पितर्युपरतेऽस्माकं ज्येष्ठोऽयमिति मन्त्रिभिः। कपीनामीश्वरो राज्ये कृतः परमसम्मतः4.9.2।।
output: तस्मिन् he, पितरि my father, उपरते demise, अयम् this, ज्येष्ठः इति being  elder, राज्ये in the kingdom, परमसम्मतः with the acceptance of all, कपीनाम् ईश्वरः king of monkeys, मन्त्रिभिः including ministers, कृतः made.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राज्यं प्रशासतस्तस्य पितृपैतामहं महत्। अहं सर्वेषु कालेषु प्रणतः प्रेष्यवत् स्थितः4.9.3।।
output: 'I served him obediently like a servant while he ruled over the great  ancestral kingdom inherited by him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मायावी नाम तेजस्वी पूर्वजो दुन्दुभेः सुतः। तेन तस्य महद्वैरं स्त्रीकृतं विश्श्रुतं पुरा4.9.4।।
output: 'Dundubhi's eldest son Mayabi was a mighty demon. He developed bitter enmity with Vali for the sake of a woman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तु सुप्तजने रात्रौ किष्किन्धाद्वारमागतः। नर्दति स्म सुसंरब्धो वालिनं चाह्वयद्रणे4.9.5।।
output: 'One midnight when all were asleep, he (Mayabi) came to the entrance of Kishkinda screaming angrily and bellowing at Vali, challenging him to a duel.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 9:
प्रसुप्तस्तु मम भ्राता नर्दितं भैरवस्वनम्। श्रुत्वा न ममृषे वाली निष्पपात जवात्तदा4.9.6।।
output: ' My brother Vali, who was asleep could not tolerate the frightful sound and jumped out of bed hastily.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तु वै निस्सृतः क्रोधात्तं हन्तुमसुरोत्तमम्। वार्यमाणस्तत स्त्रीभिर्मया च प्रणतात्मना4.9.7।।
output: ततः then, सः he, स्त्रीभिः by women, प्रणतात्मना by an obedient one, मया च and by me too, निवार्यमाणः  was prevented, तम् him, असुरोत्तमम् powerful demon, हन्तुम् to kill, क्रोधात् angrily, निःसृतः came out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 9:
स तु निर्धूय ताः सर्वा निर्जगाम महाबलः। ततोऽहमपि सौहार्दान्निस्सृतो वालिना सह4.9.8।।
output: 'That mighty warrior(Vali) came out, pushing aside all the womenfolk. I too followed  him due to my affection towards him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तु मे भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा मां च दूरादवस्थितम्। असुरो जातसन्त्रासः प्रदुद्राव ततो भृशम्4.9.9।।
output: 'On seeing my brother and me from a distance, the demon took to his heels scared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मिन् द्रवति सन्त्रस्ते ह्यावां द्रुततरं गतौ। प्रकाशश्च कृतो मार्गश्चन्द्रेणोद्गच्छता तदा4.9.10।।
output: सन्त्रस्ते when frightened, तस्मिन् him, द्रवति while running, आवाम् we also, द्रुततरम् faster, गतौ both went, तदा then, उद्गच्छता while rising, चन्द्रेण by the Moon, मार्गः the path, प्रकाशश्च was welllit, कृतः made.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तृणैरावृतं दुर्गं धरण्या विवरं महत्। प्रविवेशासुरो वेगादावामासाद्य विष्ठितौ4.9.11।।
output: 'The demon entered into a hole (cave) covered with a heap of grass, difficult, therefore, of access. Both of us reached there and took position.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं प्रविष्टं रिपुं दृष्ट्वा बिलं रोषवशं गतः। मामुवाच तदा वाली वचनं क्षुभितेन्द्रियः4.9.12।।
output: 'Seeing the enemy entering the cave, Vali became wrathful and his senses were terribly disturbed.He said to me:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इह त्वं तिष्ठ सुग्रीव बिलद्वारि समाहितः। यावत्तत्र प्रविश्याहं निहन्मि सहसा रिपुम्4.9.13।।
output: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, अहम् I, तत्र there, प्रविश्य after entering, सहसा at once, रिपुम् the enemy, यावत् निहन्मि till I kill, समाहितः being alert, अद्य now, इह here, बिलद्वारि at the hole, तिष्ठ you wait, त्वम् yourself.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मया त्वेतद्वचश्श्रुत्वा याचितस्स परन्तपः। शापयित्वा तु मां पद्भ्यां प्रविवेश बिलं महत्4.9.14।।
output: एतत् this, वचः words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, मया me, याचितः begged, परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, सः he, माम् me, पद्भ्याम् on his feet, शापयित्वा made me swear, महत् great, बिलम् cave, प्रविवेश entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहं तु नष्टं ज्ञात्वा तं स्नेहादागतसम्भ्रमः। भ्रातरं न च पश्यामि पापाशङ्कि च मे मनः4.9.16।।
output: अहं तु I also, तम् him, नष्टम् dead, ज्ञात्वा after knowing, स्नेहात् due to love, आगत संभ्रमः became agitated, भ्रातरम् brother, न पश्यामि I have not seen, मे my, मनः mind, पापाशङ्कि च suspected.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य बिलात्तस्माद्विनिस्सृतम्। सफेनं रुधिरं रक्तमहं दृष्ट्वा सुदुःखितः।।4.9.17।।
output: अथ then, दीर्घस्य कालस्य after a long time, तस्मात् from that, बिलात् from the cave, विनिःसृतम् flowing down, सफेनम् along with foam, रुधिरम् blood, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, ततः then, अहम् I, भृशदुःखितः became very sad.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नर्दतामसुराणां च ध्वनिर्मे श्रोत्रमागतः। निरस्तस्य च सङ्ग्रामे क्रोशतोनिस्स्वनो गुरोः4.9.18।।
output: 'I heard the roaring voices of the demons and not the yelling of my brother engaged in the duel.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहं त्ववगतो बुद्ध्या चिह्नैस्तैर्भ्रातरं हतम्। पिधाय च बिलद्वारं शिलया गिरिमात्रया4.9.19।। शोकार्तश्चोदकं कृत्वा किष्किन्धामागतस्सखे। गूहमानस्य मे तत्त्वं यत्नतो मन्त्रिभिश्श्रुतम्4.9.20।।
output: सखे O friend, अहं तु I also, तैः by those, चिह्नैः by the signs, भ्रातरम् my brother, हतम्  killed, बुद्ध्या with my understanding, अवगतः  came to know, गिरिमात्रया of the size of a mountain, शिलया with a rock, बिलद्वारम् the entrance of the mountain, पिधाय blocking, च and, शोकार्तः immersed in sorrow, उदकं कृत्वा offering oblations, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkindha, आगतः came, मे  me, गूहमानस्य intending to hide the fact, मन्त्रिभिः by the ministers, तत्त्वम् truth, यत्नतः  efforts, श्रुतम् heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहं त्ववगतो बुद्ध्या चिह्नैस्तैर्भ्रातरं हतम्। पिधाय च बिलद्वारं शिलया गिरिमात्रया4.9.19।। शोकार्तश्चोदकं कृत्वा किष्किन्धामागतस्सखे। गूहमानस्य मे तत्त्वं यत्नतो मन्त्रिभिश्श्रुतम्4.9.20।।
output: सखे O friend, अहं तु I also, तैः by those, चिह्नैः by the signs, भ्रातरम् my brother, हतम्  killed, बुद्ध्या with my understanding, अवगतः  came to know, गिरिमात्रया of the size of a mountain, शिलया with a rock, बिलद्वारम् the entrance of the mountain, पिधाय blocking, च and, शोकार्तः immersed in sorrow, उदकं कृत्वा offering oblations, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkindha, आगतः came, मे  me, गूहमानस्य intending to hide the fact, मन्त्रिभिः by the ministers, तत्त्वम् truth, यत्नतः  efforts, श्रुतम् heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोऽहं तैस्समागम्य सम्मतैरभिषेचितः। राज्यं प्रशासतस्तस्य न्यायतो मम राघव4.9.21।। आजगाम रिपुं हत्वा वाली तमसुरोत्तमम्।।
output: ततः then, समेतैः by those coming together, तैः by them, समागम्य having assembled, अहम् I, अभिषेचितः I was consecrated, राघव O Rama, तस्य मम to me (in such a condition), राज्यम् kingdom, न्यायतः lawfully, प्रशासतः while I was ruling, सः वानरः that monkey, रिपुम् enemy, दानवम् demon, हत्वा after killing, आजगाम came back.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभिषिक्तं तु मां दृष्ट्वा वाली संरक्तलोचनः। मदीयान्मन्त्रिणो बद्ध्वा परुषं वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.9.22।।
output: 'Seeing me on the throne, Vali became angry and his eyes turned red. He imprisoned my ministers and spoke to me harshly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निग्रहेऽपि समर्थस्य तं पापं प्रति राघव। न प्रावर्तत मे बुद्धिर्भ्रातुर्गौरवयन्त्रिता4.9.23।।
output: राघव Rama, निग्रहे in resistance, अपि also, समर्थस्य of a capable one, मे my, बुद्धि: intellect, भ्रातृगौरवयन्त्रिता controlled by my respect for my brother, तं पापं प्रति towards that sinner, न प्रावर्तत did not advance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 9:
हत्वा शत्रुं स मे भ्राता प्रविवेश पुरं तदा4.9.24।। मानयंस्तं महात्मानं यथावच्चाभ्यवादयम्। उक्ताश्च नाशिषस्तेन सन्तुष्टेनान्तरात्मना4.9.25।।
output: 'When my brother came back to the town after killing the enemy, I offered as usual my salutations to him. But he did not bless me wholeheartedly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हत्वा शत्रुं स मे भ्राता प्रविवेश पुरं तदा4.9.24।। मानयंस्तं महात्मानं यथावच्चाभ्यवादयम्। उक्ताश्च नाशिषस्तेन सन्तुष्टेनान्तरात्मना4.9.25।।
output: मे भ्राता my brother, सः he, शत्रुम् enemy, हत्वा after killing, तदा then, पुरम् town, प्रविवेश he entered, महात्मानम् great man, तम् him, मानयन् while I respected, यथावत् as usual, अभ्यवादयम् I offered salutations, तेन by him, सन्तुष्टेन  gladly, अन्तरात्मना wholeheartedly, आशिषः blessings, नोक्ताः were not pronounced.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नत्वा पादावहं तस्य मकुटेनास्पृशं प्रभो अपि वाली मम क्रोधान्न प्रसादं चकार सः4.9.26।।
output: 'O lord I bowed at his feet with my crown in total submission. Even then Vali was not pleased a bit. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे नवमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टं सम्रब्धं तमुपागतम्। अहं प्रसादयाञ्चक्रे भ्रातरं प्रियकाम्यया4.10.1
output: 'I sought to appease my brother who arrived in an agitated state overpowered with anger.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
दिष्ट्यासि कुशली प्राप्तो निहतश्च त्वया रिपुः। अनाथस्य हि मे नाथस्त्वमेकोऽनाथनन्दनः4.10.2।।
output: 'By providence you have come back safe and the enemy has been killed. You are the only protector to an orphan which I am.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदं बहुशलाकं ते पूर्णचन्द्रमिवोदितम्। छत्रं सवालव्यजनं प्रतीच्छस्व मया धृतम्4.10.3।।
output: ते to you, मया by me, धृतम् held, बहुशलाकम् having many ribs, उदितम् risen above, पूर्णचन्द्रमिव like the full Moon, सवालव्यजनम् Yak tailfans, इदम् this, छत्रम् parasol, प्रतीच्छस्व pray accept.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आर्तश्चाथ बिलद्वारि स्थितस्संवत्सरं नृप। दृष्ट्वाऽहं शोणितं द्वारि बिलाच्चापि समुत्थितम्4.10.4।। शोकसंविग्नहृदयो भृशं व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः। अपिधाय बिलद्वारं शैलशृङ्गेण तत्तथा4.10.5।। तस्माद्देशादपाक्रम्य किष्किन्धां प्राविशं पुनः।
output: नृप O king, आर्तः distressed, संवत्सरम् one year, बिलद्वारि at the entrance of the cave, स्थितः waited, अथ and then, बिलात् from the cave, समुत्थितम् flowing out, शोणितम् blood, द्वारि at the entrance, दृष्ट्वा च and seeing, शोकसंविग्नह्रुदयः with a sunken heart, भृशम् greatly, व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः senses fused, तदा then, तत् that, बिलद्वारम् entrance of the cave, शैलशृङ्गेण with a rock, अपिधाय closed, तस्मात् from  that place, देशात् kingdom, अपक्रम्य retreated, पुनः again, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, प्राविशम् entered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
आर्तश्चाथ बिलद्वारि स्थितस्संवत्सरं नृप। दृष्ट्वाऽहं शोणितं द्वारि बिलाच्चापि समुत्थितम्4.10.4।। शोकसंविग्नहृदयो भृशं व्याकुलितेन्द्रियः। अपिधाय बिलद्वारं शैलशृङ्गेण तत्तथा4.10.5।। तस्माद्देशादपाक्रम्य किष्किन्धां प्राविशं पुनः।
output: 'O king I waited at the entrance of the cave for a year. As you did not come out, I felt distressed and my heart sank in great sorrow seeing blood flowing out of the cave. With my senses fused I returned to Kishkinda, closing the entrance with a rock(lest the demon should come out).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विषादात्विह मां दृष्ट्वा पौरैर्मन्त्रिभिरेव च4.10.6।। अभिषिक्तो न कामेन तन्मेत्वं क्षन्तुमर्हसि।
output: 'Here I was consecrated by the people and ministers who saw me immersed in grief. It was not my desire to be coronated. Therefore, I may be forgiven.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वमेव राजा मानार्हस्सदा चाहं यथा पुरम्4.10.7।। राजभावनियोगोऽयं मम त्वद्विरहात्कृतः। सामात्यपौरनगरं स्थितं निहतकण्टकम्4.10.8।।
output: मानार्हः worthy of reverence, राजा the king, त्वमेव you alone are, अहं च I also, पुरा यथा like  in earlier times, मम to me, अयम् this, राजभावे held the state, नियोगः an assignment, त्वद्विरहात् due to your absence, कृतः held, सामात्यपौरनगरम् with ministers, citizens and towns, निहतकण्टकम् with the enemies destroyed, स्थितम् is stable.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वमेव राजा मानार्हस्सदा चाहं यथा पुरम्4.10.7।। राजभावनियोगोऽयं मम त्वद्विरहात्कृतः। सामात्यपौरनगरं स्थितं निहतकण्टकम्4.10.8।।
output: मानार्हः worthy of reverence, राजा the king, त्वमेव you alone are, अहं च I also, पुरा यथा like  in earlier times, मम to me, अयम् this, राजभावे held the state, नियोगः an assignment, त्वद्विरहात् due to your absence, कृतः held, सामात्यपौरनगरम् with ministers, citizens and towns, निहतकण्टकम् with the enemies destroyed, स्थितम् is stable.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
न्यासभूतमिदं राज्यं तव निर्यातयाम्यहम्। मा च रोषं कृथास्सौम्य मयि शत्रुनिबर्हण4.10.9।।
output: 'I am handing over this kingdom which was in trust. O slayer of enemies, O good natured one, give up your anger against me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
याचे त्वां शिरसा राजन्मया बद्धोऽयमञ्जलिः। बलादस्मिन् समागम्य मन्त्रिभिः पुरवासिभिः4.10.10।। राजभावे नियुक्तोऽहं शून्यदेशजिगीषया।
output: 'O king I bow my head and beg you with folded hands. The ministers and citizens assembled and forced me to take charge, as the kingdom without a ruler was vulnerable to attack.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्निग्धमेवं ब्रुवाणं मां स तु निर्भर्त्स्य वानरः4.10.11।। धिक्त्वामिति च मा मुक्त्वा बहु तत्तदुवाच ह।
output: सः वानरः that monkey, एवम् thus, स्निग्धम् affectionately, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, माम् me, निर्भर्त्स्य having abused, त्वाम् you are, धिक् reproached, इति च this way, उक्त्वा after saying, तत्तत् in various ways, बहु many (words), उवाच ह spoke

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
प्रकृतीश्च समानीय मुन्त्रिणश्चैव सम्मतान्4.10.12।। मामाह सुहृदां मध्ये वाक्यं परमगर्हितम्।
output: 'Having invited ordinary people and favourite ministers he condemned me in the presence of friends.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विदितं वो यथा रात्रौ मायावी स महासुरः4.10.13।। मां समाह्वयत क्रूरो युद्धाकाङ्क्षी सुदुर्मतिः।
output: सुदुर्मतिः wickedminded one, महासुरः great demon, मायावी Mayavi, क्रुद्धः angry one, युद्धाकाङ्क्षी wishing to tight, यथा as, रात्रौ In that night, माम् me, समाह्वयत challenged, वः to you, विदितं is known.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा निस्सृतोऽहं नृपालयात्4.10.14।। अनुयातश्च मां तूर्णमयं भ्राता सुदारुणः।
output: 'On hearing his words I came out of the royal abode quickly, followed by this wicked brother.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
स तु दृष्ट्वैव मां रात्रौ सद्वितीयं महाबलः4.10.15।। प्राद्रवद्भयसन्त्रस्तो वीक्ष्यावां समुपागतौ। अनुद्रुतश्च वेगेन प्रविवेश महाबिलम्4.10.16।।
output: 'The powerful demon that night saw me followed by another advancing towards him and fled out of fear. When we chased him, he entered this huge cave in great speed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तु दृष्ट्वैव मां रात्रौ सद्वितीयं महाबलः4.10.15।। प्राद्रवद्भयसन्त्रस्तो वीक्ष्यावां समुपागतौ। अनुद्रुतश्च वेगेन प्रविवेश महाबिलम्4.10.16।।
output: महाबलः powerful, सः he, रात्रौ that night, सद्वितीयम् followed by a second person, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा एव soon after seeing that, प्राद्रवत् he ran, समुपागतौ both advancing towards him, आवाम् both of us, वीक्ष्य after seeing, भयसन्त्रस्तः shaken with fear, वेगेन speedily, प्रविवेश entered, सः he, महाबिलम् huge cave, अनुद्रुत was chased.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
तं प्रविष्टं विदित्वा सुघोरं सुमहद्बिलम्। अयमुक्तोऽथ मे भ्राता मया तु क्रूरदर्शनः4.10.17।।
output: 'When I saw the dreadful demon entering the great cave, I instructed this cruel brother of mine:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहत्वा नास्ति मे शक्तिः प्रतिगन्तुमितः पुरीम्। बिलद्वारि प्रतीक्ष त्वं यावदेनं निहन्म्यहम्4.10.18।।
output: अहत्वा without killing him, इतः from this place, पुरीम् town, प्रतिगन्तुम् to return, मे to me, शक्तिः energy, नास्ति is not, अहम् I, एनम् him, यावत् till that time, हन्मि I kill and return, त्वम् you, बिलद्वारि at the entrance, प्रतीक्ष you may wait.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्थितोऽयमिति मत्वा तु प्रविष्टोऽहं दुरासदम्। तं च मे मार्गमाणस्य गतस्संवत्सरस्तदा4.10.19।।
output: 'Presuming that Sugriva was waiting there, I entered the formidable cave. While I was searching for the demon there, one year passed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
स तु दृष्टो मया शत्रुरनिर्वेदाद्भयावहः। निहतश्च मया तत्र सोऽसुरो बन्धुभिस्सह।।4.10.20।।
output: 'I could find that fearful enemy there and killed him along with his relatives without any difficulty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यास्यात्तु प्रवृत्तेन रुधिरौघेण तद्बिलम्। पूर्णमासीद्दुराक्रामं स्तनतस्तस्य भूतले4.10.21।।
output: भूतले on the ground, स्तनतः was roaring, तस्य his, आस्यात् from his mouth, प्रवृत्तेन due to emergence, रुधिरौघेण by the flow of blood, तत् बिलम् that cavern, पूर्णम् full, दुराक्रामम् आसीत् difficult to stay.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
सूदयित्वा तु तं शत्रुं विक्रान्तं दुन्दुभेस्सुतम्। निष्क्रामन्नेव पश्यामि बिलस्य पिहितं मुखम्4.10.22।।
output: दुन्दुभेः Dundubhi's, सुतम् son, विक्रान्तम् valiant, तं शत्रुम् that enemy, सूदयित्वा after vanquishing, इह here, निष्क्रामम् as I returned, पश्यामि I could find, बिलस्य cavern, मुखम् entrance, पिहितम् was closed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विक्रोशमानस्य तु मे सुग्रीवेति पुनः पुनः। यदा प्रतिवचो नास्ति ततोऽहं भृशदुःखितः4.10.23।।
output: सुग्रीवेति saying O Sugriva , पुनः पुनः again and again, विक्रोशमानस्य  shouting in distress, मे for me, यदा when, प्रतिवचः response, नास्ति was not heard, ततः then, अहम् I, भृशदुःखितः  very sad.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
पादप्रहारैस्तु मया बहुभिस्तद्विदारितम्। ततोऽहं तेन निष्क्रम्य यथा पुरमुपागतः4.10.24।।
output: 'I kicked the boulder again and again till it yielded. I came out that way and arrived at the city.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अत्रानेनास्मि संरुद्धो राज्यं प्रार्थयताऽत्मनः। सुग्रीवेण नृशंसेन विस्मृत्य भ्रातृसौहृदम्।।4.10.25।।
output: आत्मनः my own, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रार्थयता by desiring, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, नृशंसेन by the wicked one, अनेन by him, भ्रातृसौहृदम् brotherly love, विस्मृत्य forgetting, अहम् I, तत्र there, अस्मि I am, संरुध्दः I was obstructed

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वा तु मां तत्र वस्त्रेणैकेन वानरः। निर्वासयामास तदा वाली विगतसाध्वसः4.10.26।।
output: वानरः monkey, वाली Vali, तत्र there, माम् me, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, विगतसाध्वसः unperturbed, तदा then, एकेन with a single, वस्त्रेण cloth, निर्वासयामास   banished me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेनाहमपविद्धश्च हृतदारश्च राघव। तद्भयाच्छ महीकृत्स्ना क्रान्तेयं सवनार्णवा4.10.27।।
output: राघव O Rama, तेन on account of that, अपविद्धः attacked, हृतदारश्च stolen of my wife, अहम् I am, तद्भयात् by that fear, सवनार्णवा the entire forest and oceans, कृत्स्ना completely, इयं मही this earth, क्रान्ता is covered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
ऋष्यमूकं गिरिवरं भार्याहरणदुःखितः। प्रविष्टोऽस्मि दुराधर्षं वालिनः कारणान्तरे4.10.28।।
output: 'Tormented by the abduction of my wife by Vali, I came to the great Rishyamuka mountain  inaccessible to Vali for some other reason.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं वैरानुकथनं महत्। अनागसा मया प्राप्तं व्यसनं पश्य राघव4.10.29।।
output: 'O Rama I have given you this long, full account of the cause of our enmity. For no fault of mine I am suffering.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
वालिनस्तु भयार्तस्य सर्वलोकभयङ्कर। कर्तुमर्हसि मे वीर प्रसादं तस्य निग्रहात्4.10.30।।
output: 'O great warrior you are one who can frighten the entire world Due to the fear of Vali I seek your grace.You may resist Vali and provide me security.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तस्स तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्मसंहितम्। वचनं वक्तुमारेभे सुग्रीवं प्रहसन्निव4.10.31।।
output: एवम् that way, उक्तः spoken, धर्मज्ञः one who knows dharms, तेजस्वी glorious one, सः he, प्रहसन्निव as if joking with him, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, धर्मसंहितम् consistent with righteousness, वचनम् words, वक्तुम् to speak, आरेभे he started.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
अमोघास्सूर्यसङ्काशा ममैते निशिता श्शराः। तस्मिन्वालिनि दुर्वृत्ते निपतिष्यन्ति वेगिताः4.10.32।।
output: 'These my sharp, unfailing arrows, bright as the Sun, released by me out of anger will descend on the evildoer, Vali.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यावत्तं नाभिपश्यामि तव भार्यापहारिणम्। तावत्स जीवेत्पापात्मा वाली चारित्रदूषकः4.10.33।।
output: तव your, भार्यापहारिणम् abducter of your wife, तम् him, यावत् until, न not, अभिपश्यामि I do not see, तावत् till that time, पापात्मा sinner, चारित्रदूषकः violater of the moral code, सः वाली that Vali, जीवेत्  live.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आत्मानुमानात्पश्यामि मग्नं त्वां शोकसागरे। त्वामहं तारयिष्यामि कामं प्राप्स्यसि पुष्कलम्4.10.34।।
output: त्वाम् you, शोकसागरे in an ocean of sorrow, मग्नः immersed, आत्मानुमानात् due to my own sorrow, पश्यामि I see, त्वाम् you, अहम् I, तारयिष्यामि I will help you cross over, पुष्कलम् completely, कामम् desire, प्राप्स्यसि you will fulfil.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 10:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षपौरुषवर्धनम्। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतस्सुमहद्वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.10.35।।
output: On hearing his words that boosted his joy and vigour, Sugriva was immensely pleased and said these warm words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः Thus ends the tenth sarga of Kishkindhakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षपौरुषवर्धनम्। सुग्रीवः पूजयाञ्चक्रे राघवं प्रशशंस च4.11.1।।
output: The words of Rama boosted Sugriva's joy and manliness. He offered him prayers and praise:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
असंशयं प्रज्वलितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मर्मातिगैश्शरैः। त्वं दहेः कुपितो लोकान्युगान्त इव भास्करः4.11.2।।
output: 'There is no doubt that your sharp, blazing arrows will pierce through the vital parts of the body once you are angry, just as the Sungod burns all worlds at the end of the Yuga.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
वालिनः पौरुषं यत्तद्यच्च वीर्यं धृतिश्च या। तन्ममैकमनाश्श्रुत्वा विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम्4.11.3।।
output: वालिनः Vali's, यत् such, पौरुषम् manliness, तत् that, यत् वीर्यम् such valour, तत् that, या धृतिश्च courage, मम my, एकमनाः concentrate, श्रुत्वा on hearing, यत् which, अनन्तरम् after that, विधत्स्व  do what is to be done.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
समुद्रात्पश्चिमात्पूर्वं दक्षिणादपि चोत्तरम्। क्रामत्यनुदिते सूर्ये वाली व्यपगतक्लमः4.11.4।।
output: 'In the early hours before Sunrise Vali crosses over the oceans from the west to the east and moving from south to north (performing sandhya) without getting fatigued.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्राण्यारुह्य शैलानां शिखराणि महान्त्यपि। ऊर्ध्वमुत्क्षिप्य तरसा प्रतिगृह्णाति वीर्यवान्4.11.5।।
output: वीर्यवान् valiant , शैलानाम् of the mountains, आग्राणि tops, आरुह्य ascending, महान्ति huge, शिखराणि peaks, तरसा speedily, ऊर्ध्वम् upward, उत्क्षिप्य climbing, प्रतिगृह्णाति catches.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बहवस्सारवन्तश्च वनेषु विविधा द्रुमाः। वालिना तरसा भग्ना बलं प्रथयताऽत्मनः4.11.6।।
output: आत्मनः his, बलम् strength, प्रथयता exihibiting, वालिना by Vali, वनेषु in the forests, सारवन्तः sturdy, विविधाः several, बहवः many, द्रुमाः trees, तरसा with vigour, भग्नाः break

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महिषो दुन्दुभिर्नाम कैलासशिखरप्रभः। बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयामास वीर्यवान्4.11.7।।
output: कैलासशिखरप्रभः shining like the peak of mount Kailas, वीर्यवान् valiant one, महिषः mighty buffalo, दुन्दुभिः नाम by name Dundubhi, नागसहस्रस्य of a thousand elephants, बलम् strength, धारयामास possessed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वीर्योत्सेकेन दुष्टात्मा वरदानाच्च मोहितः। जगाम सुमहाकाय स्समुद्रं सरितां पतिम्।।4.11.8।।
output: 'Wicked Dundubhi of huge body was proud of his valour and deluded by virtue of the boons, went to the ocean, the lord of rivers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऊर्मिमन्तमभिक्रम्य सागरं रत्नसञ्चयम्। मह्यं युद्धं प्रयच्छेति तमुवाच महार्णवम्4.11.9।।
output: 'Reaching the mighty ocean, he implored the sea with (high) waves and hoards of gems for a fight.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्समुद्रो धर्मात्मा समुत्थाय महाबलः। अब्रवीद्वचनं राजन्नसुरं कालचोदितम्4.11.10।।
output: राजन् O king, ततः then, धर्मात्मा righteous self, महाबलः  powerful समुद्रः ocean, समुत्थाय  rising, कालचोदितम् driven to death by fate, असुरम् demon, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
समर्थो नास्मि ते दातुं युद्धं युद्धविशारद। श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामि यस्ते युद्धं प्रदास्यति4.11.11।।
output: 'You are proficient in warfare. I am not competent enough to challenge you to a duel. But  I will name the one who can.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शैलराजो महारण्ये तपस्विशरणं परम्। शङ्करश्वशुरो नाम्ना हिमवानिति विश्रुतः4.11.12।। गुहाप्रस्रवणोपेतो बहुकन्दरनिर्दरः। स समर्थस्तव प्रीतिमतुलां कर्तुमाहवे4.11.13।।
output: 'Himavan, the supreme abode of ascetics is the fatherinlaw of Lord Siva. He is wellknown as king of mountains, who has, waterfalls, caves, caverns and great forests.He is competent to match your incomparable love for war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शैलराजो महारण्ये तपस्विशरणं परम्। शङ्करश्वशुरो नाम्ना हिमवानिति विश्रुतः4.11.12।। गुहाप्रस्रवणोपेतो बहुकन्दरनिर्दरः। स समर्थस्तव प्रीतिमतुलां कर्तुमाहवे4.11.13।।
output: परम् supreme, तपस्विशरणम् abode of ascetics, शङ्करश्वशुरः fatherinlaw of lord Siva, हिमवानिति Himavan, नाम्ना by name, विश्रुतः wellknown, महाप्रस्रवणोपेतः great waterfalls, बहुकन्दरनिर्दरः many caves and caverns, शैलराजः king of mountains, महारण्ये in the great forest, सः he, समर्थः is competent, तव to you, अतुलाम् incomparable, प्रीतिम् love, कर्तुम् to do, आहवे in the war.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं भीत इति विज्ञाय समुद्रमसुरोत्तमः। हिमवद्वनमागच्छच्छरश्चापादिव च्युतः4.11.14।। ततस्तस्य गिरेश्श्वेता गजेन्द्रविप्रलाश्शिलाः। चिक्षेप बहुधा भूमौ दुन्दुभिर्विननाद च4.11.15।।
output: 'Dundubhi, the most powerful of demons, aware that the ocean is frightened of him went swiftly to Himavan like an arrow released from a bow. He raised many huge white cliffs of the size of great elephants to the ground and roared.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं भीत इति विज्ञाय समुद्रमसुरोत्तमः। हिमवद्वनमागच्छच्छरश्चापादिव च्युतः4.11.14।। ततस्तस्य गिरेश्श्वेता गजेन्द्रविप्रलाश्शिलाः। चिक्षेप बहुधा भूमौ दुन्दुभिर्विननाद च4.11.15।।
output: 'Dundubhi, the most powerful of demons, aware that the ocean is frightened of him went swiftly to Himavan like an arrow released from a bow. He raised many huge white cliffs of the size of great elephants to the ground and roared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
ततश्श्वेताम्बुदाकारः सौम्यः प्रीतिकराकृतिः। हिमवानब्रवीद्वाक्यं स्वे एव शिखरे स्थितः4.11.16।।
output: 'Then the gentle Himavan of pleasing appearance stood in the form of a white cloud on the peak and spoke:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
क्लेष्टुमर्हसि मां न त्वं दुन्दुभे धर्मवत्सल। रणकर्मस्वकुशलस्तपस्विशरणं ह्यहम्4.11.17।।
output: 'Dundubhi, it is not proper for you to trouble me, for I am devoted to righteousness. I am the resort of ascetics and not adept in warfare'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा गिरिराजस्य धीमतः। उवाच दुन्दुभिर्वाक्यं क्रोधात्संरक्तलोचनः4.11.18।।
output: "At these words of Himavan, the wise king of mountains, Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger replied:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदि युद्धेऽसमर्थस्त्वं मद्भयाद्वा निरुद्यमः। समाचक्ष्व प्रदद्यान्मे योऽद्य युद्धं युयुत्सतः4.11.19।।
output: त्वम् you, युद्धे in a duel, असमर्थः यदि if in capable, वा or else, मद्भयात् due to fear of me, निरुद्यमः unwilling, यः whosoever, युयुत्सतः wants to fight, मे with me, युद्धम् duel, प्रदद्यात् give me a challenge, समाचक्ष्व tell me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हिमवानब्रवीद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा वाक्यविशारदः। अनुक्तपूर्वं धर्मात्मा क्रोधात्तमसुरोत्तमम्4.11.20।।
output: 'On hearing such words, which no one had spoken earlier, righteous Himavan, skilful in conversation, flew into a rage and said to Dundubhi,the best of demons:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वाली नाम महाप्राज्ञश्शक्रतुल्य पराक्रमः। अध्यास्ते वानरश्श्रीमान् किष्किन्धामतुलप्रभाम्4.11.21।।
output: 'Vali, son of Indra, is a wise, powerful and prosperous monkey. He resides at Kishkinda, a city of incomparable glory.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स समर्थो महाप्राज्ञस्तव युद्धविशारदः। द्वन्द्वयुद्धं महद्दातुं नमुचेरिव वासवः4.11.22।।
output: 'Vali is profoundly wise, an expert in warfare. He is capable of challenging you to a duel like Indra to Namuchi.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं शीघ्रमभिगच्छ त्वं यदि युद्धमिहेच्छसि। स हि दुर्धर्षणो नित्यं शूरस्समरकर्मणि4.11.23।।
output: इह now, युद्धम् fight, इच्छसि यदि if you want to fight, त्वम् you, शीघ्रम् quickly, तम् him, अभिगच्छ  go now, शूरः heroic, सः he, नित्यम् ever, समरकर्मणि in warfare, दुर्धर्षणः हि difficult to combat.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्रुत्वा हिमवतो वाक्यं कोधाविष्टस्स दुन्दुभिः। जगाम तां पुरीं तस्य किष्किन्धां वालिनस्तदा4.11.24।।
output: 'Having heard Himavan, Dundubhi, seized with anger, went to Kishkindha,  the city of Vali.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धारयन्माहिषं रूपं तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो भयावहः। प्रावृषीव महामेघस्तोयपूर्णो नभस्स्थले4.11.25।। ततस्तु द्वारमागम्य किष्किन्धाया महाबलः। ननर्द कम्पयन्भूमिं दुन्दुभिर्दुन्दुभिर्यथा4.11.26।।
output: 'Mighty Dundubhi assuming the form of a frightening buffalo with pointed horns looking like a huge, dark raincloud in the sky in monsoon marched to the entrance of Kishkinda and roared like a wardrum as if shaking the earth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धारयन्माहिषं रूपं तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो भयावहः। प्रावृषीव महामेघस्तोयपूर्णो नभस्स्थले4.11.25।। ततस्तु द्वारमागम्य किष्किन्धाया महाबलः। ननर्द कम्पयन्भूमिं दुन्दुभिर्दुन्दुभिर्यथा4.11.26।।
output: महाबलः mighty, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, माहिषम् buffalo, रूपम् form, धारयन् assuming, तीक्ष्णशृङ्गः  pointed horns, भयावहः frightening, प्रावृषि in rainy season, नभस्तले in the sky, तोयपूर्णः laden with water, महामेघ इव like a huge cloud, किष्किन्धायाः Kishkinda's, द्वारम् entrance, आगम्य reached, भूमिम् earth, कम्पयन् shaking, दुन्दुभिर्यथा like Dundubhi a wardrum, ननर्द roared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
समीपस्थान्द्रुमान्भञ्जन्वसुधां दारयन्खुरैः। विषाणेनोल्लिखन् दर्पात्तद्द्वारं द्विरदो यथा4.11.27।।
output: 'Dundubhi felled the trees nearby, rent the earth with its hoofs, scratched the entrance gate of the city as an elephant would do with its horns in arrogance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
अन्तःपुरगतो वाली श्रुत्वा शब्दममर्षणः। निष्पपात सह स्त्रीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रमाः4.11.28।।
output: 'Unable to tolerate the sound, Vali jumped out of the harem along with the women like the Moon with stars.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
मितं व्यक्ताक्षरपदं तमुवाचाथ दुन्दुभिम्। हरीणामीश्वरो वाली सर्वेषां वनचारिणाम्4.11.29।।
output: 'Vali, king of the monkeys who roam the forest, saw Dundubhi and addressed, but briefly:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किमर्थं नगरद्वारमिदं रुध्द्वा विनर्दसि। दुन्दुभे विदितो मेऽसि रक्षप्राणान्महाबल4.11.30।।
output: दुन्दुभे O Dundubhi, इदम् this, नगरद्वारम् entrance of the city, रुध्द्वा  blocking, किमर्थम् for what reason, विनर्दसि are you roaring, मे to me, विदितः known, असि you are,महाबल O powerful one, प्राणान् life, रक्ष you may protect.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वानरेन्द्रस्य धीमतः। उवाच दुन्दुभिर्वाक्यं रोषात्संरक्तलोचनः4.11.31।।
output: 'Dundubhi whose eyes turned red in anger when he heard the words of Vali ,the wise king of the monkeys, said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
न त्वं स्त्रीसन्निधौ वीर वचनं वक्तुमर्हसि। मम युद्धं प्रयच्छाद्य ततो ज्ञास्यामि ते बलम्4.11.32।।
output: 'O hero speaking such words in the presence of women is not proper. Come to me for a combat and I will let you know your strength.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथवा धारयिष्यामि क्रोधमद्य निशामिमाम्। गृह्यतामुदयस्स्वैरं कामभोगेषु वानर4.11.33।।
output: वानर O monkey, अथवा or else, अद्य now, इमाम् this, निशाम् night, क्रोधम् anger, धारयिष्यामि I will control,  स्वैरम् freedom, कामभोगेषु for your sensual pleasures, उदयः morning, गृह्यताम् I will give you time.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
दीयतां सम्प्रदानं च परिष्वज्य च वानरान्। सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्र स्त्वं संसादय सुहृज्जनान्4.11.34।।
output: 'O king of monkeys, hug them and give them any gift you want. Spend the night with your dear ones.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुदृष्टां कुरु किष्किन्धां कुरुष्वात्मसमं पुरे। क्रीडस्व च सह स्त्रीभिरहं ते दर्पनाशनः4.11.35।।
output: किष्किन्धाम् Kishkindha, सुदृष्टाम् give a good look, पुरे the city, आत्मसमम् some one equal to you, कुरुष्व assign kingship, स्त्रीभिः with women, सह along with, क्रीडस्व च and sport, अहम्  am, ते to you, दर्पनाशनः a destroyer of arrogance.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यो हि मत्तं प्रमत्तं वा सुप्तं वा रहितं भृशम्। हन्यात्स भ्रूणहा लोके त्वद्विधं मदमोहितम्4.11.36।।
output: यः whoever, मत्तम् drunk, प्रमत्तं वा or heedless, सुप्तं वा or sleeping, रहितम् or without weapons, भृशम् greatly, मदमोहितम् stupified by lust, हन्यात् if killed, सः he, लोके in the world, भ्रूणहा हि is a killer of foetus in the womb.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स प्रहस्याब्रवीन्मन्दं क्रोधात्तमसुरोत्तमम्। विसृज्य ताः स्त्रियस्सर्वास्ताराप्रभृतिकास्तदा4.11.37।।
output: तदा then, सः he, प्रहस्य laughing, ताराप्रभृतिकाः Tara and others, ताः those, सर्वाः all, स्त्रियः women, विसृज्य having sent away, मन्दम् slowly, तम् him, असुरोत्तमम् best of demons, क्रोधात् angrily, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मत्तोऽयमिति मा मंस्था यद्यभीतोऽसि संयुगे। मदोऽयं सम्प्रहारेऽस्मिन्वीरपानं समर्थ्यताम्4.11.38।।
output: 'Do not consider me drunken. This drink will serve as a warrior's drink in the combat. Be ready, if you are not afraid of a combat.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमेवमुक्त्वा सङ्कृद्धो मालामुत्क्षिप्य काञ्चनीम्। पित्रा दत्तां महेन्द्रेण युद्धाय व्यवतिष्ठत4.11.39।।
output: तम् him, एवम् that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सङ्कृद्धः angry, पित्रा by his father, महेन्द्रेण by Indra, दत्ताम् gifted, काञ्चनीम् golden, मालाम् garland, उत्क्षिप्य removed, युद्धाय for the combat, व्यवतिष्ठत stood ready

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विषाणयोर्गृहीत्वा तं दुन्दुभिं गिरिसन्निभम्। आविध्यत तदा वाली विनदन्कपिकुञ्जरः4.11.40।।
output: तदा then, कपिकुञ्जरः elephantlike monkey, वाली Vali, गिरिसन्निभम् resembling a mountain, तम् him, दुन्दुभिम् Dundubhi, विषाणयोः by horns, गृहीत्वा  held, विनदन् roaring loudly, आविध्यत struck down.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
वाली व्यापातयाञ्चक्रे ननर्द च महास्वनम्। श्रोत्राभ्यामथ रक्तं तु तस्य सुस्राव पात्यतः4.11.41।।
output: 'Vali whirled him round and round and threw him downroaring. Blood flowed from Dundubhi's ears.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तयोस्तु क्रोधसंरम्भात्परस्परजयैषिणोः। युद्धं समभवद्घोरं दुन्दुभेर्वानरस्यच4.11.42।।
output: क्रोधसंरम्भात् highly agitated in anger, परस्परजयैषिणोः of both trying to win over the other, तयोः of both, दुन्दुभेः for Dundubhi, वानरस्य च and of the monkey, घोरम् terrific, युद्धम् combat, समभवत् took place.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयुद्ध्यत तदा वाली शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः। मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिश्चैव शिलाभिः पादपैस्तथा4.11.43।।
output: 'Then Vali who was equal to Indra in prowess fought, hitting him with fists, knees, rocks and trees.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
परस्परं घ्नतो स्तत्र वानरासुरयोस्तदा। आसीदसुरो युद्धे शक्रसूनुर्व्यवर्धत4.11.44।।
output: 'Then as the monkey and demon fought pouncing on each other, the prowess of Dundubhi got diminished and that of Vali, the son of Indra, increased.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यैश्च परिक्षीणं पराक्रमैः। तं तु दुन्दुभिमुद्यम्य धरण्यामभ्यपातयत्।।4.11.45।। युद्धे प्राणहरे तस्मिन्निष्पिष्टो दुन्दुभिस्तदा। पपात च महाकायः क्षितौ पञ्चत्वमागतः4.11.46।।
output: In the fight, Dundubhi fell down, with his strength, courage and prowess dwindled. Vali lifted his huge body and dashed it down on the ground. The body of Dundubhi dissolved into the five elements.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यैश्च परिक्षीणं पराक्रमैः। तं तु दुन्दुभिमुद्यम्य धरण्यामभ्यपातयत्।।4.11.45।। युद्धे प्राणहरे तस्मिन्निष्पिष्टो दुन्दुभिस्तदा। पपात च महाकायः क्षितौ पञ्चत्वमागतः4.11.46।।
output: व्यापारवीर्यधैर्यै in effort, strength and courage, पराक्रमैः in prowess as well, परिक्षीणं deterioration, तम् Vali, दुन्दुभिम् Dundubhi, उद्यम्य having lifted, धरण्याम् on the ground, अभ्यपातयत् hit down, तदा then, प्राणहरे in the deadly, तस्मिन् in that, युद्धे fight, दुन्दुभिः Dundubhi, निष्पिष्ट: crushed, पातयतः thrown down, तस्य his, महाकायः of huge body, पञ्चत्वम् resolved into the five elements (dead), आगतः go, क्षितौ on the ground, पपात fell down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं तोलयित्वा बाहुभ्यां गतसत्त्वमचेतनम्। चिक्षेप बलवान्वाली वेगेनैकेन योजनम्4.11.47।।
output: 'Mighty Vali lifted on both shoulders the insensate body drained of life and hurled it speedily to a distance of a yojana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य वेगप्रविद्धस्य वक्त्रात्क्षतजबिन्दवः। प्रपेतुर्मारुतोत्क्षिप्ता मतङ्गप्याश्रमं प्रति4.11.48।।
output: 'Scattered by the wind, drops of blood fell at the hermitage of Matanga from the mouth of the deadbody flung.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तान्दृष्ट्वा पतितांस्तस्य मुनिश्शोणितविप्रुषः। क्रुद्धस्तत्र महाभागश्चिन्तयामास कोन्वयम्4.11.49।।
output: महाभागः venerable one, मुनिः sage, तत्र there, पतितान् fallen, शोणितविप्रुषः drops of blood, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, तस्य his, क्रुद्धः became angry, अयम् this, को नु who can  he be, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
येनाहं सहसा स्पृष्टश्शोणितेन दुरात्मना। कोऽयं दुरात्मा दुर्भुदि्घरकृतात्मा च बालिशः4.11.50।।
output: 'Who is that petty, wicked, evil minded one who caused the drops of blood to touch (fall on) me suddenly?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्त्वाऽथ विनिष्क्रम्य ददर्श मुनिसत्तमः। महिषं पर्वताकारं गतासुं पतितं भुवि4.11.51।।
output: 'The venerable sage came out of the hermitage and saw a mountaneous buffalo fallen dead on the floor.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तु विज्ञाय तपसा वानरेण कृतं हि तत्। उत्ससर्ज महाशापं क्षेप्तारं वालिनं प्रति4.11.52।।
output: 'Having known through his ascetic vision that it was the act of a monkey, he pronounced a curse on Vali who had hurled (the body):

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इह तेनाप्रवेष्टव्यं प्रविष्टस्य वधो भवेत्। वनं मत्संश्रयं येन दूषितं रुधिरस्रवैः4.11.53।।
output: 'Whoever has desecrated this forest, protected by me, with drops of blood is forbidden to enter this place. Once he does it, he will die.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्भग्नाः पादपाश्चैमेक्षिपतेहासुरीं तनुम्। समन्तादाद्योजनं पूर्णमाश्रमं मामकं यदि4.11.54।। आगमिष्यति दुर्बुद्धिर्व्यक्तं स न भविष्यति।
output: आसुरीम् demon's, तनुम् body, क्षिपता  hurled, इमे those, पादपाश्च trees also, सम्भग्नाः are broken, समन्तात् all over, पूर्णम् entire, योजनम् yojana, मामकम् mine, आश्रमम् hermitage, आगमिष्यति if he comes, दुर्बुद्धिः wicked  one, सः he, न भविष्यति will not survive.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ये चापि सचिवाः स्तस्य संश्रिता मामकं वनम्4.11.55।। न च तैरिह वस्तव्यं श्रुत्वा यान्तु यथासुखम्।
output: मामकम् my, वनम् forest, संश्रिताः taking refuge, ये (केचित्) indeed, अस्य सचिवाः his counsellors, तैः च by them also, इह here, न वस्तव्यम् should not stay, श्रुत्वा on hearing, यथासुखम् safely, यान्तु depart.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
यदि तेऽपी ह तिष्ठन्ति शपिष्ये तानपि ध्रुवम्4.11.56।। वनेऽस्मिन्मामके नित्यं पुत्रवत्परिरक्षिते। पत्राङ्कुरविनाशाय फलमूलाभवाय च4.11.57।।
output: 'If the monkeys stay back to destroy the leaves and shoots and plunder the fruits and roots of this forest which I have protected just like my son will also certainly invite my curse.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
यदि तेऽपी ह तिष्ठन्ति शपिष्ये तानपि ध्रुवम्4.11.56।। वनेऽस्मिन्मामके नित्यं पुत्रवत्परिरक्षिते। पत्राङ्कुरविनाशाय फलमूलाभवाय च4.11.57।।
output: 'If the monkeys stay back to destroy the leaves and shoots and plunder the fruits and roots of this forest which I have protected just like my son will also certainly invite my curse.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दिवसश्चास्य मर्यादा यं द्रष्टा श्वोऽस्मि वानरम्। बहुवर्षसहस्राणि स वै शैलो भविष्यति4.11.58।।
output: अस्य for him, दिवसः one day, मर्यादा time limit, श्वः tomorrow, यम् whosoever, वानरम् monkey, द्रष्टास्मि I will see, सः he, बहुवर्षसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, शैलः mountain, भविष्यति will become.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
ततस्ते वानराश्श्रुत्वा गिरं मुनिसमीरिताम्। निश्चक्रमुर्वनात्तस्मात्तान्दृष्ट्वा वालिरब्रवीत्4.11.59।।
output: 'The monkeys fled on hearing the words spoken by the sage. Said Vali:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
किं भवन्तस्समस्ताश्च मतङ्गवनवासिनः। मत्समीपमनुप्राप्ता अपि स्वस्ति वनौकसाम्4.11.60।।
output: 'Why have you, residents of the groves of Matanga, come to me? Hope all are safe'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्ते कारणं सर्वं तदा शापं च वालिनः। शशंसुर्वानरास्सर्वे वालिने हेममालिने4.11.61।।
output: 'Then all the monkeys collected together and narrated everything about the curse given to Vali , adorned with a golden chain(on his neck).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा तदा वाली वचनं वानरेरितम्। स महर्षिंतदाऽसाद्य याचते स्म कृताञ्जलिः4.11.62।।
output: तदा then, सः वाली that Vali, वानरेरितम् spoken by monkeys, एतत् all that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, महर्षिम् to the sage, (सम्) आसाद्य having approached, याचते स्म begged.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महर्षिस्तमनादृत्य प्रविवेशाश्रमं तदा। शापधारणभीतस्तु वाली विह्वलतां गतः4.11.63।।
output: महर्षिः great sage, तम् him, अनादृत्य without obliging, आश्रमं to the hermitage, तदा then, प्रविवेश entered, वाली Vali, शापधारणभीतः with the fear of hearing the curse, विह्वलताम् agrieved, गतः became.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शापभयाद्भीत ऋश्यमूकं महागिरिम्। प्रवेष्टुं नेच्छति हरिर्द्रष्टुं वापि नरेश्वर4.11.64।।
output: नरेश्वर O Lord Rama, ततः then onwards, हरिः monkeys, शापभयात् for fear of the curse, भीतः frightened, महागिरिम् great mountain, ऋष्यमूकम् Rishyamuka, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, द्रष्टुं वापि even to see, नेच्छति does not like.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्याप्रवेशं ज्ञात्वाऽहमिदं राम महावनम्। विचरामि सहामात्यो विषादेन विवर्जितः4.11.65।।
output: 'O Rama aware of the prohibition of Vali from entering the place, I roam about this great forest  accompanied by my ministers without any apprehension.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषोऽस्थिनिचयस्तस्य दुन्दुभेस्सम्प्रकाशते। वीर्योत्सेकान्निरस्तस्य गिरिकूटोपमो महान्4.11.66।।
output: वीर्योत्सेकात् with pride of prowess, निरस्तस्य thrown away, तस्य दुन्दुभेः Dundubhi's, गिरिकूटोपमो as the mountain peak, महान् huge, एषः this, अस्थिनिचयः heap of bones, सम्प्रकाशते is shining

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमे च विपुलास्सालास्सप्त शाखावलम्बिनः। यत्रैकं घटते वाली निष्पत्रयितुमोजसा4.11.67।।
output: 'Look at these seven sturdy Sala trees with branches  of one overlapping the other.  Vali was able to remove all the leaves of one Sala tree with just one arrow.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतदस्यासमं वीर्यं मया राम प्रकीर्तितम्। कथं तं वालिनं हन्तुं समरे शक्ष्यसे नृप4.11.68।।
output: राम O Rama, अस्य his, असमम् unequalled, एतत् this, वीर्यम् strength, प्रकीर्तितम् is narrated, नृप king, समरे in a combat, तं वालिनम् that Vali's, हन्तुम् to kill, कथम् how is it, शक्ष्यसे it is possible for you?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
तथा ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं प्रहसन् लक्ष्मणोऽब्रवीत्। कस्मिन्कर्मणि निर्वृत्ते श्रद्दध्या वालिनो वधम्4.11.69।।
output: Smiling, Lakshmana asked Sugriva, 'By what action will you trust?. By the fulfilment of which task (by Rama) will you have faith?'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमुवाचाथ सुग्रीवस्सप्त सालानिमान्पुरा। एवमेकैकशो वाली विव्याथाथ स चासकृत्। 4.11.70।।
output: अथ then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तम् him, उवाच said, पुरा earlier, सः वाली that Vali, इमान् these, सप्तसालान् seven sala trees, एवम् in this way, एकैकशः one after the other, अथ then, असकृत् several times, विव्याध struck.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामोऽपिदारयेदेषां बाणेनैकेन च द्रुमम्। वालिनं निहतं मन्ये दृष्ट्वा रामस्य विक्रमम्4.11.71।।
output: 'If I see Rama splitting these trees with one arrow, I will believe he can kill Vali with his prowess.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हतस्य महिषस्यास्थि पादेनैकेन लक्ष्मण। उद्यम्याथ प्रक्षिपेच्चेत्तरसा द्वे धनुश्शते4.11.72।।
output: 'O Lakshmana and if Rama can also lift the dead buffalo's (Dundubhi's) skeleton and hurl it to a distance  of two hundred bows with one of his feet.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवो रामं रक्तान्तलोचनम्। ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं काकुत्स्थं पुनरेव वचोऽब्रवीत्4.11.73।।
output: Having said this and thinking for a moment, Sugriva again said to the heroic Rama whose eyes had turned red.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शूरश्च शूरघाती च प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः। बलवान्वानरो वाली संयुगेष्वपराजितः4.11.74।।
output: शूरश्च hero, शूरघाती च killer of heroes, प्रख्यातबलपौरुषः wellknown for prowess and valour, बलवान् powerful, वानरः वाली monkey Vali, संयुगेषु in combat, अपराजितः unconquered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
दृश्यन्ते चास्य कर्माणि दुष्कराणि सुरैरपि। यानि सञ्चिन्त्य भीतोऽहमृश्यमूकं समाश्रितः4.11.75।।
output: 'Even gods cannot do what he has done. Thinking of all this and being afraid of him, I have taken refuge at Rishyamuka.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमजय्यमधृष्यं च वानरेन्द्रममर्षणम्। विचिन्तयन्न मुञ्चामि ऋश्यमूकमहन्विमम्4.11.76।।
output: तम् him, वानरेन्द्रम् lord of monkeys, अजय्यम् invincible, अधृष्यम् one who can not be overpowered, अमर्षणम् indignant, विचिन्तयन् while thinking over, अहम् I, ऋष्यमूकम् Rishyamuka, न मुञ्चामि I have not left, इयम this.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उपलब्धं च मे श्लाघ्यं सन्मित्रं मित्रवत्सल। त्वामहं पुरुषव्याघ्र हिमवन्तमिवाश्रितः4.11.78।।
output: 'I have discovered in you a faithful friend. O tiger among men, O venerable one, you are to me like the Himalayas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
किं तु तस्य बलज्ञोऽहं दुर्भ्रातुर्बलशालिनः। अप्रत्यक्षं तु मे वीर्यं समरे तव राघव4.11.79।।
output: 'What to do? I know the strength of my mighty bad brother. But so far I have not seen your power in a battle.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
न खल्वहं त्वां तुलये नावमन्ये न भीषये। कर्मभिस्तस्य भीमैस्तु कातर्यं जनितं मम4.11.80।।
output: 'The dreadful acts of Vali have made me feel timid. This is not to compare you with him or your strength with his or insult you and scare you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
कामं राघव ते वाणी प्रमाणं धैर्यमाकृतिः। सूचयन्ति परं तेजो भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम्4.11.81।।
output: 'Rama  your word and your courage indicate your supreme strength which is like fire covered with ashes.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। स्मितपूर्वमथो रामः प्रत्युवाच हरिं प्रभुः4.11.82।।
output: Having heard the great Sugriva, Rama replied with a gentle smile:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
यदि न प्रत्ययोऽस्मासु विक्रमे तव वानर। प्रत्ययं समरे श्लाघ्यमहमुत्पादयामि ते4.11.83।।
output: 'If you have no confidence in my strength in fight, O monkey, I will create it in you so much so that you will admire it.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सान्त्वं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। राघवो दुन्दुभेः कायं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया4.11.84।। तोलयित्वा महाबाहुश्चिक्षेप दशयोजनम्। असुरस्य तनुं शुष्कं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन वीर्यवान्4.11.85।।
output: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सान्त्वं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। राघवो दुन्दुभेः कायं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन लीलया4.11.84।। तोलयित्वा महाबाहुश्चिक्षेप दशयोजनम्। असुरस्य तनुं शुष्कं पादाङ्गुष्ठेन वीर्यवान्4.11.85।।
output: Rama,the mighty elder brother of Lakshmana, having said so to Sugriva in a pleasing manner, lifted the dried body of Dundubhi easily with his toe, shook it and flung it with ease to a distance of ten yojanas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षिप्तं दृष्ट्वा ततः कायं सुग्रीवः पुनरब्रवीत्। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमर्थवत्4.11.86।।
output: Having seen Rama flinging the body, Sugriva said to him again in the presence of Lakshmanameaningfully:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आर्द्रस्समांसः प्रत्यग्रः क्षिप्तः कायः पुरा सखे4.11.87।। लघुस्सम्प्रति निर्मांस स्तृणभूतश्च राघव। परिश्रान्तेन मत्तेन भ्रात्रा मे वालिना तदा4.11.88।। क्षिप्तमेवं प्रहर्षेण भवता रघुनन्दन।
output: सखे friend, तदा that time, परिश्रान्तेन by the tired, मत्तेन by the intoxicated, मे भ्रात्रा  by my brother, वालिना by Vali, पुरा earlier, आर्द्रः wet, समांसः with flesh, प्रत्यग्रः fresh, कायः body, क्षिप्तः flung, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu race, राघव Raghava, सम्प्रति now, लघुः light, निर्मांसः without flesh, तृणभूतश्च like a bunch of grass, प्रहर्षेण playfully, भवता by you, एवम् this, क्षिप्तम् flung.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
आर्द्रस्समांसः प्रत्यग्रः क्षिप्तः कायः पुरा सखे4.11.87।। लघुस्सम्प्रति निर्मांस स्तृणभूतश्च राघव। परिश्रान्तेन मत्तेन भ्रात्रा मे वालिना तदा4.11.88।। क्षिप्तमेवं प्रहर्षेण भवता रघुनन्दन।
output: 'O friend, when Vali my brother flung the body, he was tired and intoxicated and the body was fresh with flesh (meaning heavy), but now, O Delight of the Raghu race, it is fleshless and light like a bunch of (dry) grass (for) which you could throw it playfully.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नात्र शक्यं बलं ज्ञातुं तव वा तस्य वाऽधिकम्। आर्द्रं शुष्कमिति ह्येतत्सुमहद्राघवान्तरम्4.11.89।।
output: अत्र here (in this case), तव your, बलम् strength, अधिकं वा is more  or, तस्य वा or his, ज्ञातुम् to know, न शक्यम् not able, राघव Rama, आर्द्रम् wet, शुष्कमिति dried, एतत् this, सुमहत् great, अन्तरं हि difference.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स एव संशयस्तात तव तस्य च यद्बले4.11.90।। सालमेकं तु निर्भिद्या भवेद्व्यक्तिर्बलाबले।
output: तात O dear, तव your, तस्य च and his, यत् such, बले strength, स एव that alone, संशयः  doubt, एकम् one, सालम् Sala tree, निर्भिद्य after splitling through, व्यक्तिः demonstrated, भवेत् will be known, बलाबले strength or otherwise.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृत्वेदं कार्मुकं सज्यं हस्तिहस्त मिवाततम्4.11.91।। आकर्णपूर्णमायम्य विसृजस्व महाशरम्।
output: आततम् stretched, हस्तिहस्तमिव like the elephant's trunk, एतत् that, कार्मुकम् bow, सज्यम् strung(tie it with string), कृत्वा after doing, आकर्णपूर्णम् drawing it (the string) to the ear, आयम्य after stretching, महाशरम् great arrow, विसृजस्व release.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
इमं हि सालं सहित स्त्वया शरो न संशयोऽत्रास्ति विदारयिष्यति। अलं विमर्शेन मम प्रियं ध्रुवं कुरुष्व राजात्मज शापितो मया4.11.92।।
output: 'It will be enough and my doubt will be cleared. If you can pierce the sala tree with your arrow it will be my pleasure and not a test of your strength.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 11:
यथा हि तेजस्सु वरस्सदा रवि र्यथा हि शैलो हिमवान्महाद्रिषु। यथा चतुष्पात्सु च केसरी वर स्तथा नरणामसि विक्रमे वरः4.11.93।।
output: 'Just as the Sun is the best among the brilliant, the Himalayas among the great mountains, the lion among the quadrupeds, so also you are the best among men of valour.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends  the eleventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतच्च वचनं श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवेण सुभाषितम्। प्रत्ययार्थं महातेजा रामो जग्राह कार्मुकम्4.12.1।।
output: Rama demonstrates his prowess in shooting -- Sugriva fails in the first combat with Vali -- Rama explains the difficulty in identifying Vali -- advises Sugriva to wear Gajapushpi creeper to help him identify -- once again Sugriva proceeds to encounter Vali

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
स गृहीत्वा धनुर्घोरं शरमेकं च मानदः। सालमुद्दिश्य चिक्षेप ज्यास्वनैः पूरयन्दिशः। 4.12.2।।
output: Rama, subduer of the enemy's pride, strung his terrific bow, produced the twang that filled all directions, and discharged a single arrow aimed at the sala tree.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स विसृष्टो बलवता बाणस्स्वर्णपरिष्कृतः। भित्त्वा सालान् गिरिप्रस्थं सप्त भूमिं विवेश ह4.12.3।।
output: बलवता forcefully, विसृष्टः released, स्वर्णपरिष्कृतः decorated with gold, सः बाणः that arrow, सप्त seven, सालान् sala trees, गिरिप्रस्थम् pierced through the mountain terrain, भित्त्वा on splitting, भूमिम् into the earth, विवेश ह entered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रविष्टश्च मुहूर्तेन धरां भित्त्वा महाजवः। निष्पत्य च पुनस्तूर्णं स्वतूणीं प्रविवेश ह4.12.4।।
output: In a moment the arrow emerged from the earth which it pierced and reentered the quiver with great speed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्दृष्ट्वा सप्त निर्भिन्नान्सालान्वानरपुङ्गवः। रामस्य शरवेगेन विस्मयं परमं गतः4.12.5।।
output: The chief of the monkeys was struck with wonder seeing Rama's arrow piercing through  the seven sala trees so swiftly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
स मूर्ध्ना न्यपतदभ्मौ प्रलम्बीकृतभूषणः। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतो राघवाय कृताञ्जलिः4.12.6।।
output: Sugriva was immensely happy and offered obeisance to Rama with folded hands and bowed down and prostrated while his ornaments touched the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इदं चोवाच धर्मज्ञं कर्मणा तेन हर्षितः। रामं सर्वास्त्रविदुषां श्रेष्ठं शूरमवस्थितम्4.12.7।।
output: Sugriva who stood by, elated to watch the deed of Rama, best among the valiant, proficient in the use of arms of all kinds and knower of dharma, said:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सेन्द्रानपि सुरान्सर्वांस्त्वं बाणैः पुरुषर्षभ। समर्थस्समरे हन्तुं किं पुन र्वालिनं प्रभो 4.12.8।।
output: 'O bull among men, O lord, you are capable of killing with your arrows even the gods including Indra in the battle, what to speak of Vali.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
येन सप्तमहासाला गिरिर्भूमिश्च दारिताः। बाणेनैकेन काकुत्स्थ स्थाता ते को रणाग्रतः4.12.9।।
output: काकुत्स्थ O Rama, येन by such a person, एकेन बाणेन with a single arrow, सप्त seven, महासालाः great sala trees, गिरिः mountain, भूमिश्च even earth, दारिताः pierced, ते to  you, रणाग्रतः in the forefront of the battle, कः who, स्थाता can stand.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्य मे विगतश्शोकः प्रीतिरद्य परा मम। सुहृदं त्वां समासाद्य महेन्द्रवरुणोपमम्4.12.10।।
output: 'Having found a friend in you comparable to Indra and Varuna, my grief is gone and I am so happy now.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमद्यैव प्रियार्थं मे वैरिणं भ्रातृरूपिणम्। वालिनं जहि काकुत्स्थ मया बद्धोऽयमञ्जलिः4.12.11।।
output: 'O Rama, for my pleasure kill Vali who is, to me, an enemy in the guise of a brother. I fold my hands to you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो रामः परिष्वज्य सुग्रीवं प्रियदर्शनम्। प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो लक्ष्मणानुगतं वचः4.12.12।।
output: ततः then, महाप्राज्ञः very wise, रामः Rama, प्रियदर्शनम् handsome, लक्ष्मणानुगतम् following Lakshmana, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, परिष्वज्य having embraced, वचः these words, प्रत्युवाच said in reply.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्माद्गच्छेम किष्किन्धां क्षिप्रं गच्छ त्वमग्रतः। गत्वा चाह्वय सुग्रीव वालिनं भ्रातृगन्धिनम्4.12.13।।
output: सुग्रीव Sugriva, क्षिप्रम् at once, अस्मात् from here, किष्किन्थाम् to Kishkinda, गच्छेम will go, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् at once, अग्रतः forward, गच्छ go, गत्वा on going, भ्रातृगन्धिनम् a brother for name's sake, वालिनम् Vali, आह्वय invite.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वे ते त्वरितं गत्वा किष्किन्धां वालिनः पुरीम्। वृक्षैरात्मानमावृत्य व्यतिष्ठन्गहने वने4.12.14।।
output: ते सर्वे they all, वालिनः Vali's, पुरीम् capital, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkinda, त्वरितम् quickly, गत्वा went, गहने dense, वने forest, वृक्षैः with trees, आत्मानम् themselves, अवृ़त्य after covering, अतिष्ठन् stayed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुग्रीवो व्यनदद्घोरं वालिनोऽऽह्वानकारणात्। गाढं परिहितो वेगान्नादैर्भिन्दन्निवाम्बरम्4.12.15।।
output: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, गाढं tightly, परिहितः tightened the cloth around waist, वेगात् with speed, नादैः by roaring, अम्बरम् sky, भिन्दन्निव as if piercing the sky, वालिनः Vali's, ह्वानकारणात् to call out, घोरम् terrific, व्यनदत् screamed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
तं श्रुत्वा निनदं भ्रातुः क्रुद्धो वाली महाबलः। निश्चक्राम सुसंरब्धो भास्करोऽस्ततटादिव4.12.16।।
output: On hearing his brother roaring, powerful Vali was enraged and rushed like the Sun from behind the western shore of the ocean (this simile suggests the downfall of Vali).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सुतुमुलं युद्धं वालिसुग्रीवयोरभूत्। गगने ग्रहयोर्घोरं बुधाङ्गारकयोरिव4.12.17।।
output: Then a tumultuous combat took place between Vali and Sugriva who looked like the planets Mercury and Mars.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
तलैरशनिकल्पैश्च वज्रकल्पैश्च मुष्टिभिः। जघ्नतुस्समरेऽन्योन्यं भ्रातरौ क्रोधमूर्छितौ4.12.18।।
output: The brothers, insensate with fury, struck each other like thunder with their palms, soles  and fists in the combat.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो रामो धनुष्पाणिस्तावुभौ समुदीक्ष्यतु। अन्योन्यसदृशौ वीरावुभौ देवाविवाश्विनौ4.12.19।।
output: ततः then, धनुष्पाणिः wielder of bow, रामः Rama, देवौ two deities, अश्विनौ इव like the twin Aswini Kumaras, अन्योन्यसदृशौ both of them similar in looks, तौ they, उभौ both, वीरौ the two heroes, समुदीक्ष्यतु  watched

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
यन्नावगच्छत्सुग्रीवं वालिनं वापि राघवः। ततो न कृतवान्बुद्धिं मोक्तुमन्तकरं शरम्4.12.20।।
output: Since Rama was not able to distinguish between Vali and Sugriva, he could not decide whether he should discharge his deadly arrow .

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे भग्नस्सुग्रीवस्तेन वालिना। अपश्यन्राघवं नाथमृश्यमूकं प्रदुद्रुवे4.12.21।।
output: Discomfited  by Vali, and not seeing Rama around, Sugriva ran towards Rishyamuka mountain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्लान्तो रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गः प्रहारैर्जर्झरीकृतः। वालिनाऽभिद्रुतः क्रोधात्प्रविवेश महावनम्4.12.22।।
output: वालिना by Vali, क्रोधात् angry, अभिद्रुतः chased, क्लान्तः exhausted, रुधिरसिक्ताङ्गः body drenched in blood, प्रहारैः with strokes, जर्झरीकृतः mauled, महावनम् great grove (of Matanga), प्रविवेश entered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
तं प्रविष्टं वनं दृष्ट्वा वाली शापभयार्दितः। मुक्तो ह्यसि त्वमित्युक्त्वा स निवृत्तो महाद्युतिः4.12.23।।
output: Effulgent Vali saw Sugriva entering the (prohibited) grove and turned back due to the fear of the curse (of sage Matanga) saying, 'You have escaped'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राघवोऽसि सह भ्रात्रा सह चैव हनूमता। तदेव वनमागच्छत्सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः4.12.24।।
output: Rama together with Lakshmana and Hanuman also arrived at the same gave where  Sugriva was.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं समीक्ष्यागतं रामं सुग्रीवस्सहलक्ष्मणम्। ह्रीमान्दीनमुवाचेदं वसुधामवलोकयन्4.12.25।।
output: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, आगतम् coming in, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, तं रामम् that Rama, दृष्ट्वा seeing, ह्रीमान् ashamed, वसुधाम् ground, अवलोकयन् looking down , दीनम्  piteously, इदम् this, उवाच spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आह्वयस्वेति मामुक्त्वा दर्शयित्वा च विक्रमम्। वैरिणा घातयित्वा च किमिदानीं त्वया कृतम्4.12.26।।
output: 'You demonstrated your prowess and directed me to challenge Vali and then why did you make the enemy hit me thus?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
तामेन वेलां वक्तव्यं त्वया राघव तत्त्वतः। वालिनं न निहन्मीति ततो नाहमितो व्रजे4.12.27।।
output: 'Had you, in fact, told me that you were not going to kill Vali, I would not have budged from this place.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य चैवं ब्रुवाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। करुणं दीनया वाचा राघवः पुनरब्रवीत्4.12.28।।
output: On hearing the great Sugriva's miserable and moving words, Rama again said:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीव श्रूयातां तात क्रोधश्च व्यपनीयताम्। कारणं येन बाणोऽयं न मया स विसर्जितः4.12.29।।
output: 'O dear Sugriva dispel your anger and listen to me why I had not released the arrow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 12:
अलङ्कारेण वेषेण प्रमाणेन गतेन च। त्वं च सुग्रीव वाली च सदृशौ स्थः परस्परम्4.12.30।।
output: 'O Sugriva in form, ornaments and movements there is perfect resemblance between you and Vali.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वरेण वर्चसा चैव प्रेक्षितेन च वानर। विक्रमेण च वाक्यैश्च व्यक्तिं वां नोपलक्षये4.12.31।।
output: 'O monkey in your voice, in brightness, in looks, in valour or in words I have marked no difference between you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽहं रूपसादृश्यान्मोहितो वानरोत्तम। नोत्सृजामि महावेगं शरं शत्रुनिबर्हणम्4.12.32।।
output: 'O distinguished monkey you both are so similar in form that I was puzzled and did not release my swift arrow that could have destroyed the enemy.
