मद्दोषकृतदोषां तां यथा तारां तपस्विनीम्। सुग्रीवो नावमन्येत तथाऽवस्थातुमर्हसि4.18.56।।
output: मद्दोषकृतदोषाम् suffered due to my offence, तपस्विनीम् wretch, तां ताराम् that Tara, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, नावमन्येत not think ill of her, तथा that, अवस्थातुम् to maintain, अर्हसि hope

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 18:
त्वया ह्यनुगृहीतेन राज्यं शक्यमुपासितुम्4.18.57।। त्वद्वशे वर्तमानेन तव चित्तानुवर्तिना। शक्यं दिवं चार्जयितुं वसुधां चापि शासितुम्4.18.58।।
output: 'It is possible for a person favoured by you to rule the kingdom.It is possible for one who is under your control and acts according to your will to rule the entire world and earn heaven.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 18:
त्वया ह्यनुगृहीतेन राज्यं शक्यमुपासितुम्4.18.57।। त्वद्वशे वर्तमानेन तव चित्तानुवर्तिना। शक्यं दिवं चार्जयितुं वसुधां चापि शासितुम्4.18.58।।
output: 'It is possible for a person favoured by you to rule the kingdom.It is possible for one who is under your control and acts according to your will to rule the entire world and earn heaven.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वत्तोऽहं वधमाकाङ्क्षन्वार्यमाणोऽपि तारया। सुग्रीवेण सह भ्रात्रा द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागतः4.18.59।। इत्युक्त्वा सन्नतो रामं विरराम हरीश्वरः।
output: 'Even though I was prevented by Tara, I came for a duel with Sugriva since I wished to die in your hands.' Having spoken thus to Rama, Vali fell silent.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तमाश्वासयद्रामो वालिनं व्यक्तदर्शनम्4.18.60।। सामसम्पन्नया वाचा धर्मतत्त्वार्थयुक्तया।
output: सः रामः Rama, व्यक्तदर्शनम् him who saw clearly, तं वालिनम् that Vali, सामसम्पन्नया for peace and tranquillity, धर्मतत्त्वार्थयुक्तया reflecting truth and righteousness, वाचा with words, आश्वासयत् he consoled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्य एतदर्थं प्लवङ्गम4.18.61।। न वयं भवता चिन्त्या नाप्यात्मा हरिसत्तम। वयं भवद्विशेषेण धर्मतः कृतनिश्चयाः4.18.62।।
output: प्लवङ्गम O monkey, एतदर्थम् on this account, त्वया by you, सन्तापः worry, न कार्यः not to be entertained, हरिसत्तम best of the monkeys, भवता by you, वयम् we, न चिन्त्याः not worry, आत्मापि you too, न not, वयम् we, भवद्विशेषेण for your sin, धर्मतः principles of righteousness, कृतनिश्चयाः came to firm decision.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 18:
न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्य एतदर्थं प्लवङ्गम4.18.61।। न वयं भवता चिन्त्या नाप्यात्मा हरिसत्तम। वयं भवद्विशेषेण धर्मतः कृतनिश्चयाः4.18.62।।
output: 'O best of monkeys, abandon all your anxiety on this score. Bother not about us or about yourself. Whatever has happened, has happened in consonance with dharma.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दण्ड्ये यः पातयेद्दण्डं दण्ड्यो यश्चापि दण्ड्यते। कार्यकारणसिद्धार्था वुभौ तौ नावसीदतः4.18.63।।
output: 'The sinner and the punisher, whoever gives punishment and whoever receives it, are both regulated by the law of cause and effect. So do not despair.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्भवान्दण्डसंयोगादस्माद्विगतकल्मषः। गतस्स्वां प्रकृतिं धर्म्यं धर्मदृष्टेन वर्त्मना4.18.64।।
output: 'You have been purged of your sin through punishment from the point of view of righteousness. You have regained your spiritual nature on the path of dharma.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 18:
त्यज शोकं च मोहं च भयं च हृदये स्थितम्। त्वया विधानं हर्यग्र्य न शक्यमतिवर्तितुम्4.18.65।।
output: 'O best of monkeys remove sorrow from your heart, delusion and fear. It is not possible for you to transgress fate.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 18:
यथा त्वय्यङ्गदो नित्यं वर्तते वानरेश्वर। तथा वर्तेत सुग्रीवे मयि चापि न संशयः4.18.66।।
output: 'O lord of monkeys Angada will remain with Sugriva and with me as he used to live with you. Rest assured.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तस्य वाक्यं मधुरं महात्मन स्समाहितं धर्मपथानुवर्तिनः। निशम्य रामस्य रणावमर्दिनो वचस्सुयुक्तं निजगाद वानरः4.18.67।।
output: सः वानरः that monkey, महात्मनः of the great, धर्मपथानुवर्तिनः of a man following a righteous path, रणावमर्दिनः  a crusher of enemy in war, तस्य रामस्य that Rama's, मधुरम् sweet, समाहितम् wellcomposed, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य after hearing, सुयुक्तम् very fitting, वचः words, निजगाद replied.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शराभितप्तेन विचेतसा मया प्रदूषितस्त्वं यदजानता प्रभो। इदं महेन्द्रोपम भीमविक्रम प्रसादितस्त्वं क्षम मे नरेश्वर4.18.68।।
output: 'Pray, O mighty prince, hero of immense valour, pardon me for the words of blame I unwittingly hurled at you. I said all that in excruciating pain caused by your mighty arrow and in confusion of what is right and what is wrong.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
स वानरमहाराजश्शयानश्शरविक्षतः। प्रत्युक्तो हेतुमद्वाक्यैर्नोत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत4.19.1।।
output: The king of monkeys lying on the ground struck by the arrow did not offer to reply after listening to Rama's appropriate answers (to his objections).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
अश्मभिः प्रविभिन्नाङ्गः पादपैराहतो भृशम्। रामबाणेन चाक्रान्तो जीवितान्ते मुमोह सः4.19.2।।
output: Severely battered by stones, hit by trees and pierced by Rama's arrow, Vali lost consciousness as the end of his life was nearing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
तं भार्या बाणमोक्षेण रामदत्तेन संयुगे। हतं प्लवगशार्दूलं तारा शुश्राव वालिनम्4.19.3।।
output: Tara, wife of Vali, heard that her husband, tiger among monkeys, was killed in the battle by the arrow discharged by Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा सपुत्राप्रियं श्रुत्वा वधं भर्तुस्सुदारुणम्। निष्पपात भृशं तस्माद्विविधा गिरिगह्वरात्4.19.4।।
output: Hearing the terrible, unhappy news of her husband's death, Tara anxiously rushed along with her son out of the mountain cave.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
ये त्वङ्गदपरीवारा वानरा भीमविक्रमाः। ते सकार्मुकमालोक्य रामं त्रस्ताः प्रदुद्रुवुः4.19.5।।
output: Alarmed at the sight of Rama holding the bow, the terribly courageous monkeys who followed Angada as his bodyguards ran in different directions.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा ददर्श ततस्त्रस्तान्हरीनापततो भृशम्। यूथादिव परिभ्रष्टान्मृगान्निहतयूथपान्4.19.6।।
output: ततः then, सा she, त्रस्तान् terrorstricken, भृशम् very much, आपततः running, निहतयूथपान् the leader killed, यूथात् from the troop, परिभ्रष्टान् strayed, मृगानिव like the deer, हरीन् monkeys, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
तानुवाच समासाद्य दुःखितान्दुखिता सती। रामवित्रासितान्सर्वाननुबद्धानिवेषुभिः4.19.7।।
output: Sorrowful Tara, the wife of Vali, duly approaching the monkeys stricken with grief and running as if chased by the arrows of Rama at their back, said to them:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराः राजसिंहस्य यस्य यूयं पुरस्सराः। तं विहाय सुसन्त्रस्ताः कस्माद्द्रवथ दुर्गताः4.19.8।।
output: वानराः O monkeys, यूयम् all of you, यस्य whosoever, राजसिंहस्य of a lion among kings, पुरःसराः walked ahead, तम् him, विहाय left, सुसन्त्रस्ताः extremely frightened, दुर्गताः distressed, कस्मात् why, द्रवथ are you running?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
राज्यहेतोस्स चेद्भ्राता भ्रात्रा रौद्रेण पातितः। रामेण प्रहितैरौद्रैर्मार्गणैर्दूरपातिभिः4.19.9।।
output: 'If the (elder) brother is struck down by his (younger) brother in anger for the sake of kingship using farreaching arrows discharged by Rama, why are you running?'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कपिपत्न्या वचश्श्रुत्वा कपयः कामरूपिणः। प्राप्तकालमविक्लिष्टमूचुर्वचनमङ्गनाम्4.19.10।।
output: On hearing Tara, the wife of Vali, the monkeys who could assume any form at their will replied with clear words appropriate to the occasion:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जीवपुत्रे निवर्तस्व पुत्रं रक्षस्व चाङ्गदम्। अन्तको रामरूपेण हत्वा नयति वालिनम्4.19.11।।
output: 'O mother, your son is still alive. Go back and protect your son Angada. Lord of death in the form of Rama has come and killed Vali and is carrying him away.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षिप्तान् वृक्षान्समाविध्य विपुलाश्च शिलास्तथा। वाली वज्रसमैर्बाणै रामेण विनिपातितः4.19.12।।
output: 'Rama smashed the trees and stones Vali hurled at him and then struck him down with thunderboltlike arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अभिद्रुतमिदं सर्वं विद्रुतं प्रसृतं बलम्। अस्मिन् प्लवगशार्दूले हते शक्रसमप्रभे4.19.13।।
output: शक्रसमप्रभे equal to Indra in splendour, अस्मिन् his, प्लवगशार्दूले tiger among monkeys, हते  is killed, इदम् this, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, अभिद्रुतम् terrified, विद्रुतम् scattered , प्रसृतम् spread all over.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रक्ष्यतां नगरद्वारमङ्गदश्चाभिषिच्यताम्। पदस्थं वालिनः पुत्रं भजिष्यन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः4.19.14।।
output: नगरद्वारम् the gateway of the city, रक्ष्यताम् may be protected, अङ्गदश्च Angada also, अभिषिच्यताम् be consecrated, पदस्थम् assuming the position of a king, वालिनः पुत्रम् Vali's son, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, भजिष्यन्ति will serve him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथवाऽरुचितं स्थानमिह ते रुचिरानने। आविशन्ति हि दुर्गाणि क्षिप्रमन्यानि वानराः4.19.15।।
output: 'O lovely Tara, this very day other monkeys will soon occupy our citadels.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
अभार्याश्च सभार्याश्च सन्त्यत्र वनचारिणः। लुब्धेभ्यो विप्रयुक्तेभ्यस्तेभ्यो नस्तुमुलं भयम्4.19.16।।
output: 'There are monkeys wandering in the forest (sent away by Vali). Some of them have made others' wives their own and some have been separated from their wives. They are a great cause of fear.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
अल्पान्तरगतानां तु श्रुत्वा वचनमङ्गना। आत्मनः प्रतिरूपं सा बभाषे चारुहासिनी4.19.17।।
output: Hearing the words of the pettyminded monkeys, Tara spoke to them in her own way with a gentle smile:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
पुत्रेण मम किं कार्यं राज्येनच किमात्मना। कपिसिंहे महाभागे तस्मिन्भर्तरि नश्यति4.19.18।।
output: 'Now that the glorious Vali, a lion among monkeys, my husband is dying, of what purpose is the son, or the kingdom or my own life?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पादमूलं गमिष्यामि तस्यैवाहं महात्मनः। योऽसौ रामप्रयुक्तेन शरेण विनिपातितः4.19.19।।
output: 'I will seek the soles of the feet of the great soul who has been killed by the arrow discharged by Rama.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
एवमुक्त्वा प्रदुद्राव रुदन्ती शोककर्शिता। शिरश्चोरश्च बाहुभ्यां दुःखेन समभिध्नती4.19.20।।
output: So saying, the griefstricken, weeping Tara hastened, sadly beating with both hands her head and her chest.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आव्रजन्ती ददर्शाथ पतिं निपतितं भुवि। हन्तारं दानवेन्द्राणां समरेष्वनिवर्तिनम्4.19.21।।
output: आव्रजन्ती as she approached, अथ then, दानवेन्द्राणाम् of warriors among demons, हन्तारम्  killed, समरेषु in wars, अनिवर्तिनम् who never retreated, भुवि on the ground, निपतितम् fallen, पतिम् husband, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षेप्तारं पर्वतेन्द्राणां वज्राणामिव वासवम्। महावातसमाविष्टं महामेघौघनिस्स्वनम्4.19.22।।
output: Vali who used to hurl huge mountains like Indra discharges thunderbolts, who had the speed  of wind of high velocity, who would roar like huge thundering clouds,

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रतुल्यपराक्रान्तं वृष्टवेवोपरतं घनम्। नर्दन्तं नर्दतां भीमं शूरं शूरेण पातितम्4.19.23।। शार्दूलेनामिषस्यार्थे मृगराजं यथाहतम्।
output: (Vali) who was equal to Indra in prowess looked like a huge monsoon cloud that had calmed down after pouring all water, a roaring warrior who could frighten others,  struck down by another warrior,  appeared like a lion killed by a tiger for the sake of meat

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्चितं सर्वलोकस्य सपताकं सवेदिकम्4.19.24।। नागहेतोस्सुपर्णेन चैत्यमुन्मथितं यथा।
output: सर्वलोकस्य by all the worlds, अर्चितम् revered, सपताकम् along with the flag, सवेदिकम् along with the altar, सुपर्णेन by Garuda, नागहेतोः on account of serpent, उन्मथितम् destroyed, चैत्यं यथा like the sacred chaityaa place of worship.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
अवष्टभ्य च तिष्ठन्तं ददर्श धनुरुत्तम्4.19.25।। रामं रामानुजं चैव भर्तुश्चैवानुजं शुभा।
output: The auspicious lady Tara beheld Rama standing there firmly with his brother and Sugriva, leaning on the best of bows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तावतीत्य समासाद्य भर्तारं निहतं रणे4.19.26।। समीक्ष्य व्यथिता भूमौ सम्भ्रान्ता निपपात ह।
output: तौ both of them (Rama and Lakshmana), अतीत्य  passing, रणे in war, निहतम् killed, भर्तारम् her husband, समासाद्य having reached, समीक्ष्य after seeing, व्यथिता very much pained, सम्भ्रान्ता agitated, भूमौ on the ground, निपपात ह fell down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुप्त्वेव पुनरुत्थाय आर्यपुत्रेति शोचती4.19.27।। रुरोद सा पतिं दृष्ट्वा संवीतं मृत्युदामभिः।
output: सा that, सुप्त्वेव as if from sleep, पुनः again, उत्थाय rising up, आर्यपुत्र इति O Aryaputra (husband), शोचती weeping, मृत्युदामभिः with the garland of death, संवीतम् surrounded, पतिम् husband, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, रुरोद lamented.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 19:
तामवेक्ष्य तु सुग्रीवः क्रोशन्तीं कुररीमिव। विषादमगमत्कष्टं दृष्ट्वा चाङ्गदमागतम्4.19.28।।
output: Seeing Tara crying like a female osprey and Angada following her in despair, Sugriva felt pain (at heart). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामचापविसृष्टेन शरेणान्तकरेण तम्। दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं भूमौ तारा ताराधिपानना4.20.1।। सा समासाद्य भर्तारं पर्यष्वजत भामिनी।
output: ताराधिपानना moonfaced, भामिनी lovely woman, सा तारा that Tara, रामचापविसृष्टेन by the release of an arrow from Rama's bow, अन्तकरेण by a deathdealing one, शरेण arrow, (वि)निहतम् killed, तम् him, भूमौ on the ground, दृष्ट्वा beholding, समासाद्य went near, पर्यष्वजत embraced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
इषुणाऽभिहतं दृष्ट्वा वालिनं कुञ्जरोपमम्4.20.2।। वानरेन्द्र महेन्द्राभं शोकसन्तप्तमानसा। तारा तरुमिवोन्मूलं पर्यदेवयदातुरा4.20.3।।
output: Beholding Vali, the lord of monkeys, who was strong as an elephant, splendid as a mountain, fallen down like an uprooted tree, struck by the arrow, Tara became restless and wailed bitterly:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इषुणाऽभिहतं दृष्ट्वा वालिनं कुञ्जरोपमम्4.20.2।। वानरेन्द्र महेन्द्राभं शोकसन्तप्तमानसा। तारा तरुमिवोन्मूलं पर्यदेवयदातुरा4.20.3।।
output: Beholding Vali, the lord of monkeys, who was strong as an elephant, splendid as a mountain, fallen down like an uprooted tree, struck by the arrow, Tara became restless and wailed bitterly:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
रणे दारुण विक्रान्त प्रवीर प्लवतां वर। किं दीनामपुरोभागामद्य त्वं नाभिभाषसे।।4.20.4।।
output: 'O valiant hero, lord of monkeys you were terrifying in war. Why don't you speak now to me so forlorn and helpless?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
उत्तिष्ठ हरिशार्दूल भजस्व शयनोत्तमम्। नैवंविधाश्शेरते हि भूमौ नृपतिसत्तमाः4.20.5।।
output: 'O tiger among monkeys get up. Come and sleep on the best of beds. Best of kings, you should not lie on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
अतीव खलु ते कान्ता वसुधा वसुधाधिप। गतासुरपि यां गात्रैर्मां विहाय निषेवसे4.20.6।।
output: 'O lord of the earth I know you loved the earth more than you loved me since you have forsaken me and enjoy her company by hugging her with your limbs, even after death.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्यक्तमन्या त्वया वीर धर्मत: सम्प्रवर्तिता। किष्किन्धेव पुरी रम्या स्वर्गमार्गे विनिर्मिता4.20.7।।
output: 'O my heroic husband, you are the legitimate, righteous king of Kiskinda. You have evidently built another beautiful city Kiskinda on your way to heaven.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यान्यस्माभिस्त्वया सार्धं वनेषु मधुगन्धिषु। विहृतानि त्वया काले तेषामुपरमः कृतः4.20.8।।
output: त्वया with you, अस्माभि: by us, सार्धम् with us, मधुगन्धिषु sweetscented, वनेषु in the forests, यानि such, विहृतानि pleasure trips, काले at this time, तेषाम् their, उपरमः made to end, त्वया by you, कृतः is made.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
निरानन्दा निराशाऽहं निमग्ना शोकसागरे। त्वयि पञ्चत्वमापन्ने महायूथपयूथपे4.20.9।।
output: 'You are the leader of leaders. Now that you have attained heaven I am bereft of all joy,   plunged in a sea of grief.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हृदयं सुस्थिरं मह्यं दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं पतिम्। यन्न शोकाभिसन्तप्तं स्फुटतेऽद्य सहस्रधा4.20.10।।
output: 'I presume my heart is strong, for it has not broken into a thousand pieces, even though I am overwhelmed with grief to see my husband fallen on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
सुग्रीवस्य त्वया भार्या हृता स च विवासितः। यत्तु त्तस्य त्वया व्युष्टिः प्राप्तेयं प्लवगाधिप4.20.11।।
output: 'O king of monkeys you have banished Sugriva. You have usurped his wife. This is the fruit  of your action.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निश्श्रेयसपरा मोहात्त्वया चाहं विगर्हिता। यैषाऽब्रुवं हितं वाक्यं वानरेन्द्र हितैषिणी4.20.12।।
output: 'O lord of monkeys wishing your wellbeing I tendered salutary advice. But out of delusion you despised them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रूपयौवनदृप्तानां दक्षिणानां च मानद। नूनमप्सरसामार्य चित्तानि प्रमथिष्यसि4.20.13।।
output: मानद O venerable one, रूपयौवनदृप्तानाम् endowed with youth and beauty, दक्षिणानाम् of the kindhearted, अप्सरसाम् of apsarasas, चित्तानि hearts, प्रमथिष्यसि you will churn, नूनम् surely.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कालो निस्संशयो नूनं जीवितान्तकरस्तव। बलाद्येनावपन्नोऽसि सुग्रीवस्यावशो वशम्4.20.14।।
output: 'No doubt time is inexorable. The time of your death had surely arrived.Now you, whom nobody could control, have come under the sway of Sugriva.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
वैधव्यं शोकसन्तापं कृपणं कृपणा सती। अदुःखोपचिता पूर्वं वर्तयिष्याम्यनाथवत्।।4.20.15।।
output: 'I have not experienced poverty or suffering before. Immersed in grief, like an orphan, now I am reduced to the pitiable condition of a widow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
लालितश्चाङ्गदो वीरस्सुकुमारस्सुखोचितः। वर्त्स्यते कामवस्थां मे पितृव्ये क्रोधमूर्छिते।।4.20.16।।
output: 'To what plight will the tender Angada, who has been tended affectionately and deserves comforts, be reduced when his uncle displays anger?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
कुरुष्व पितरं पुत्र सुदृष्टं धर्मवत्सलम्। दुर्लभं दर्शनं वत्स तव तस्य भविष्यति।।4.20.17।।
output: (Turning to Angada Tara said) 'O son, look at your father, a lover of dharma. See him, as it will be difficult to see him later, dear'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समाश्वासय पुत्रं त्वं सन्देशं सन्दिशस्व मे। मूर्ध्नि चैनं समाघ्राय प्रवासं प्रस्थितो ह्यसि4.20.18।।
output: त्वम् you, पुत्रम् son, समाश्वासय console him, एनम् him, मूर्ध्नि touching his forehead, समाघ्राय enjoying the sweet smell of his body, च एनं him, सन्देशम्  instructon, सन्दिश्व  consoling him, प्रवासम् on a journey, प्रस्थितः going, असि हि you are.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
रामेण हि महत्कर्म कृतं त्वामभिनिघ्नता। आनृण्यं च गतं तस्य सुग्रीवस्य प्रतिश्रवे4.20.19।।
output: 'Indeed, Rama has achieved a great feat in fulfilling his promise to Sugriva. He is acquitted of the debt by killing you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
सकामो भव सुग्रीव रुमां त्वं प्रतिपत्स्यसे। भुङ्क्षव राज्यमनुद्विग्नश्शस्तो भ्राता रिपुस्तव4.20.20।।
output: '(Now turning to Sugriva she said) O Sugriva your enemy brother has been killed and your desire has been fulfilled.You will get back Ruma and enjoy the kingdom without any obstacles.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किं मामेवं विलपतीं प्रेम्णा त्वं नाभिभाषसे। इमाः पश्य वरा बह्वीर्भार्यास्ते वानरेश्वर4.20.21।।
output: '(To Vali she said) O lord of monkeys Why don't you speak to me loving words when I am wailing this way? Here are your excellent wives'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
तस्या विलपितं श्रुत्वा वानर्यस्सर्वतश्च ताः। परिगृह्याङ्गदं दीनं दुःखार्ता परिचुक्रुशुः4.20.22।।
output: On hearing the wailing of Tara, all the other wives of Vali held the piteous (in their arms) Angada and wailed, overwhelmed with sorrow:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किमङ्गदं साङ्गदवीरबाहो विहाय यास्यद्य चिरप्रवासम्। न युक्तमेवं गुणसन्निकृष्टं विहाय पुत्रं प्रियपुत्र गन्तुम्4.20.23।।
output: साङ्गदवीरबाहो O hero adorned with armlets, अङ्गदम् Angada, विहाय deserting, चिरप्रवासम् on a long journey, किम् why, प्रयातः असि going, गुणसन्निकृष्टम् with qualities like yours, प्रियपुत्र  your dear son, पुत्रम् son, एवम् this way, न युक्तम् not proper to go.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किमप्रियं ते प्रिय चारुवेष मया कृतं नाथ सुतेन वा ते। सहाङ्गदां मां प्रविहाय वीर यत्प्रस्थितो दीर्घ मितः प्रवासम्4.20.24।।
output: प्रियचारुवेष  robed attractively, वीर esteemed one, नाथ lord, सहाङ्गदाम् with Angada, माम् me, विहाय leaving, इतः  this place, दीर्घम् long distance, प्रवासम् journey, यत् प्रस्थितः since you have begun, मया by me, ते to you, सुतेन वा or by your son, किम् what, अप्रियम् unpleasant, कृतम् done.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 20:
यद्यप्रियं किञ्चिदसम्प्रधार्य कृतं मया स्यात्तव दीर्घबाहो। क्षमस्व मे तद्धरिवंशनाथ व्रजामि मूर्ध्ना तव वीर पादौ।।4.20.25।।
output: 'O longarmed chief of the monkey clan O warrior pardon me any wrong done unknowingly, inconsiderately. I touch your feet with my head.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो निपतितां तारां च्युतां तारामिवाम्बरात्। शनैराश्वासयामास हनुमान्हरियूथपः4.21.1।।
output: Hanuman consoles Tara -- requests her to ask Angada to perform the last rites for Vali -- Tara's reply.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 21:
गुणदोषकृतं जन्तुस्स्वकर्म फलहेतुकम्। अव्यग्रस्तदवाप्नोति सर्वं प्रेत्य शुभाशुभम्4.21.2।।
output: 'On departing from this mortal world an embodied soul reaps gradually the good and evil fruits of action performed under the notion of virtue or vice with an eye to their good or evil consequences.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शोच्या शोचसि कं शोच्यं दीनं दीनाऽनुकम्पसे। कस्य कोवाऽनुशोच्योऽस्ति देहेऽस्मिन् बुद्बुदोपमे4.21.3।।
output: शोच्या worry, शोच्यम् a matter to grieve, कम् whom, शोचसि you are grieving, दीना in a  miserable manner, अनुकम्पसे you show sympathy, अस्मिन् in this, देहे body, बुद्बुदोपमे like a bubble, कः who, कस्य for whom, अनुशोच्यः worthy of worrying, अस्ति now.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अङ्गदस्तु कुमारोऽयं द्रष्टव्यो जीवपुत्रया। अयत्यां च विधेयानि समर्थान्यस्य चिन्तय4.21.4।।
output: जीवपुत्रया  who has a son surviving, कुमारः prince, अयम् this, अङ्गदः Angada, द्रष्टव्यः should be looked after, आयत्याम् in future, अस्य his, विधेयानि duties, समर्थानि properly, चिन्तय you may think of.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 21:
जानास्यनियतामेवं भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। तस्माच्छुभं हि कर्तव्यं पण्डितेनैह लौकिकम्।।4.21.5।।
output: 'You are aware of the uncertain and transient happenings in the lives of living beings. Therefore, a wise lady should do auspicious work in this world.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्मिन्हरिसहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। वर्तयन्ति कृतांशानि सोऽयं दिष्टान्तमागतः4.21.6।।
output: 'Tens of millions of monkeys depended on this hero with their hopes on him. He has reached his ultimate destiny now to enjoy the fruits of his good deeds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 21:
यदयं न्यायदृष्टार्थस्सामदानक्षमापरः। गतो धर्मजितां भूमिं नैनं शोचितुमर्हसि4.21.7।।
output: 'This hero with a right vision, adopted the means of conciliation, charity and forgiveness (in his administration) and has finally reached a position through righteousness in his death. It is not proper to mourn for him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वे हि हरिशार्दूलाः पुत्रश्चायं तवाङ्गदः। इदं हर्यृक्षपतिराज्यं च त्वत्सनाथमनिन्दिते4.21.8।।
output: 'O blemishless lady these great monkeys including your son Angada and the entire kingdom of monkeys and bears are under your protection.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ताविमौ शोकसन्तप्तौ शनैः प्रेरय भामिनि। त्वया परिगृहीतोऽयमङ्गदश्शास्तु मेदिनीम्4.21.9।।
output: 'O fair sex Encourage these two griefstricken heroes (Angada and Sugriva) gently. Let Angada rule this earth under your protection.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सन्ततिश्च यथा दृष्टा कृत्यं यच्चापि साम्प्रतम्। राज्ञस्तत्क्रियतां सर्वमेष कालस्य निश्चयः4.21.10।।
output: सन्ततिः a son, यथा that way, दृष्टा after seeing, साम्प्रतम् presently, राज्ञः to king Vali, यत् all such thing, कृत्यं चापि and done, तत् that, सर्वम् all, क्रियताम् may be carried out, एषः this, कालस्य at this time, निश्चयः is the decision.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
संस्कार्यो हरिराजश्च अङ्गदश्चाभिषिच्यताम्। सिंहासनगतं पुत्रं पश्यन्ती शान्तिमेष्यसि4.21.11।।
output: हरिराजः king of monkeys, संस्कार्यः all rituals should be performed, अङ्गदश्च by Angada, अभिषिच्यताम् may be consecrated, सिंहासनगतम् seated on the throne, पुत्रम् son, पश्यन्ती while you are looking at him, शान्तिम् peace, एष्यसि you will attain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता। अब्रवीदुत्तरं तारा हनूमन्तमवस्थितम्4.21.12।।
output: भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता tormented by the husband's death, सा तारा that Tara, तस्य his, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, अवस्थितम् waiting, हनूमन्तम् to Hanumanta, अवस्थितम् who was waiting, उत्तरम् reply, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अङ्गदप्रतिरूपाणां पुत्राणामेकतश्शतम्। हतस्याप्यस्य वीरस्य गात्रसंश्लेषणं वरम्4.21.13।।
output: अङ्गदप्रतिरूपाणाम् of those who may be prototypes of Angada, पुत्राणाम् of sons, शतम् one hundred, एकतः on one side, हतस्यापि even if he is slayed, अस्य his, वीरस्य warrior's, गात्रसंश्लेषणम् embracing the body, वरम् is better.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 21:
न चाहं हरिराजस्य प्रभवाम्यङ्गदस्य वा। पितृव्यस्तस्य सुग्रीवस्सर्वकार्येष्वनन्तरः4.21.14।।
output: अहम् I am, हरिराजस्य of the king of monkeys, अङ्गदस्य वा or about Angada, न प्रभवामि not the right, तस्य his, पितृव्यः father's brother, सर्वकार्येषु in all tasks, अनन्तरः herafter.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न ह्येषाबुद्धिरास्थेया हनूमन्नङ्गदं प्रति। पिता हि बन्धुः पुत्रस्य न माता हरिसत्तम4.21.15।।
output: 'O Hanuman the best of monkeys, you need not think about (the future of) Angada. A father plans for a son and not (even) the mother.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न हि मम हरिराजसंश्रयात् क्षमतरमस्ति परत्र चेह वा। अभिमुखहतवीरसेवितं शयनमिदं मम सेवितुं क्षमम्4.21.16।।
output: मम my, इह वा in this world or, परत्र वा or in the next world, हरिराजसंश्रयात् other than joining king of monkeys, क्षमतरम् a safer course, न अस्ति हि is not found, अभिमुखहतवीरसेवितम् used by this slain warrior in front of me, इदं this, शयनम् resting place, सेवितुम् to rest, मम for me, क्षमम् is fitting.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
वीक्षमाणस्तु मन्दासुस्सर्वतो मन्दमुच्छ्वसन्। आदावेव तु सुग्रीवं ददर्शत्वात्मजाग्रतः4.22.1।।
output: Vali, gazing all around, breathing slowly and sighing feably beheld Sugriva at first instance, Sugriva who was standing in front of his own son.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं प्राप्तविजयं वाली सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वरः। आभाष्य व्यक्तया वाचा सस्नेहमिदमब्रवीत्4.22.2।।
output: प्लवगेश्वरः lord of monkeys, वाली Vali, प्राप्तविजयम् had won a victory, तं सुग्रीवम् to that Sugriva, आभाष्य spoke, व्यक्तया addressing, वाचा words, सस्नेहम् with love, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
सुग्रीव दोषेण न मां गन्तुमर्हसि किल्बिषात्। कृष्यमाणं भविष्येण बुद्धिमोहेन मां बलात्4.22.3।।
output: 'O Sugriva you ought not to accuse me of exiling you, and wresting your wife. My mind was deluded by the force of fate that controls one's future.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
युगपद्विहितं तात न मन्ये सुखमावयोः। सौहार्द भ्रातृयुक्तं हि तदिदं तात नान्यथा4.22.4।।
output: 'O dear I believe that both of us are not destined to enjoy the love and happiness that come together to brothers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
प्रतिपद्य त्वमद्यैव राज्यमेषां वनौकसाम्। मामप्यद्यैव गच्छन्तं विद्धि वैवस्वतक्षयम्4.22.5।।
output: त्वम् you, अद्यैव just now, एषाम् of these, वनौकसाम् forest dwellers, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रतिपद्य accept, मामपि me also, अद्यैव now, वैवस्वतक्षयम् the abode of Vivasvan, lord of the death, गच्छन्तम्  going, विद्धि know.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जीवितं च हि राज्यं च श्रियं च विपुलामिमाम्। प्रजहाम्येष वै तूर्णं महच्चागर्हितं यशः4.22.6।।
output: 'I am leaving this world soon, along with this vast kingdom, prosperity and untarnished fame.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अस्यां त्वहमवस्थायां वीर वक्ष्यामि यद्वचः। यद्यप्यसुकरं राजन्कर्तुमेव तदर्हसि4.22.7
output: 'O warrior king you should do whatever I request you at this hour even though it may not be easy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुखार्हं सुखसंवृद्धं बालमेनमबालिशम्। बाष्पपूर्णमुखं पश्य भूमौ पतितमङ्गदम्4.22.8।।
output: सुखार्हम् who deserves happiness, सुखसंवृद्धम् raised with comfort, बालम् young boy, अबालिशम् youthful, बाष्पपूर्णमुखम् tearful face, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम्  fallen down, अङ्गदम् Angada, पश्य see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
मम प्राणैः प्रियतरं पुत्रं पुत्रमिवौरसम्। मया हीनमहीनार्थं पर्वतः परिपालय4.22.9।।
output: 'He is dearer to me than my life. Take care of him like your own son. He is separated from me. Take care of him in all respects, so that he is not deprived of anything.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वमेवास्य हि दाता च परित्राता च सर्वशः। भयेष्वभयदश्चैव यथाऽहं प्लवगेश्वर।।4.22.10।।
output: 'O lord of monkeys from now on, you alone will be his father, provider of everything, saviour and protector in danger.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एष तारात्मज श्रीमांस्त्वया तुल्यपराक्रमः। रक्षसां च वधे तेषामग्रतस्ते भविष्यति4.22.11।।
output: 'This prosperous son of Tara, your equal in valour, will remain with you in the forefront to crush demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
अनुरूपाणि कर्माणि विक्रम्य बलवान्रणे। करिष्यत्येष तारेयस्तरस्वी तरुणोऽङ्गदः4.22.12।।
output: 'This mighty hero Angada, son of Tara, is young and dynamic. He will strike (the enemy) in a fitting manner in war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुषेणदुहिता चेयमर्थसूक्ष्मविमनिश्चये। औत्पातिके च विविधे सर्वतः परिनिष्ठिता4.22.13।।
output: सुषेणदुहिता daughter of Sushena, इयं च and she also , अर्थसूक्ष्मविनिश्चये in disecerning subtle matters, विविधे various, औत्पातिके च and in foreseeing events that come up suddenly, सर्वतःall over, परिनिष्ठिता very efficient( in crisis management),

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
यदेषा साध्विति ब्रूयात्कार्यं तन्मुक्तसंशयम्। न हि तारामतं किञ्चिदन्यथा परिवर्तते4.22.14।।
output: 'Tara's opinion is never wrong. It does not change. Whatever she speaks is right and should be carried out without any doubt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवस्य च ते कार्यं कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया। स्यादधर्मो ह्यकरणे त्वां च हिंस्याद्विमानितः4.22.15।।
output: राघवस्य Rama's, कार्यं च work also, ते to you, अविशङ्कया without hesitation, कर्तव्यम्   duty, अकरणे not do, अधर्मः unrighteousness, स्यात् हि will be, अमानितः disobeyed, त्वाम् you, हिंस्यात् च will hurt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमां च मालामाधत्स्व दिव्यां सुग्रीव काञ्चनीम्। उदारा श्रीस्थिता ह्यास्यां सम्प्रजह्यान्मृते मयि4.22.16।।
output: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, दिव्यां divine, काञ्चनीम् golden, इमां मालाम् this necklace, अधत्स्व wear now, अस्याम् in it, स्थिता present, उदारा great, श्रीः brightness, मयि when me, मृते (when) dead, सम्प्रजह्यात् हि it will be gone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्येवमुक्तस्सुग्रीवो वालिना भ्रातृसौहृदात्। हर्षं त्यक्त्वा पुनर्दीनो ग्रहग्रस्त इवोडुराट्4.22.17।।
output: वालिना by Vali, भ्रातृसौहृदात् due to brotherly affection, इत्येवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हर्षम् happiness, त्यक्त्वा having given up , पुनः again, दीनः dull, ग्रहग्रस्तः eclipsed by planet Rahu, उडुराट् इव like the Moon.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्वालिवचनाच्छान्तः कुर्वन्युक्तमतन्द्रितः। जग्राह सोऽभ्यनुज्ञातो मालां तां चैव काञ्चनीम्4.22.18।।
output: On hearing Vali's words, Sugriva became composed with no illfeeling. Considering it to be proper, he received with his permission the golden necklace.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तां मालां काञ्चनीम् दत्त्वा दृष्ट्वाचैवात्मजं स्थितम्। संसिद्धः प्रेत्यभावाय स्नेहादङ्गदमब्रवीत्4.22.19।।
output: Having given the golden necklace to Sugriva,Vali, feeling ready to depart, looked at his son Angada who stood by and spoke affectionately:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देशकालौ भजस्वाद्य क्षममाणः प्रियाप्रिये। सुखदुःख सह: काले सुग्रीववशगो भव4.22.20।।
output: 'Enduring pleasure or pain equally  with due regard to time and place favourable to you or otherwise, you should submit to the will of Sugriva.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथा हि त्वं महाबाहो लालितस्सततं मया। न तथा वर्तमानं त्वां सुग्रीवो बहुमंस्यते।।4.22.21।।
output: 'O longarmed one you have always been affectionately brought up by me. Sugriva may not rear you that way.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
माऽस्यामित्रैर्गतं गच्छेर्मा शत्रुभिररिन्दम। भर्तुरर्थपरो दान्तः सुग्रीववशगो भव4.22.22।।
output: अरिन्दम O conqueror of enemies, अस्य his, अमित्रैः friends his enemies, गतम् in the past , मा गच्छेः  after my exit, शत्रुभिः with his enemies too, मा do not, भर्तुः protector's, अर्थपरः devoted to his interests, दान्तः selfrestrained, सुग्रीववशगः stand by Sugriva, भव you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
न चातिप्रणयः कार्यः कर्तव्योऽप्रणयश्च ते। उभयं हि महान्दोष स्तस्मादन्तरदृग्भव4.22.23।।
output: 'You are not to be excessively friendly or otherise as both are serious mistakes. Therefore, be insightful.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
इत्युक्त्वाऽथ विवृत्ताक्षः शरसम्पीडितो भृशम्। विवृतैर्दशनै र्भीमैर्बभूवोत्क्रान्तजीवितः4.22.24।।
output: Having spoken this, tormented by the arrow, eyes popping out and his dreadful teeth ejected, Vali remained drained of life.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो विचुक्रुशुस्तत्र वानरा हरियूथपाः। परिदेवयमानास्ते सर्वे प्लवगपुङ्गवा:4.22.25।।
output: Then the best of the monkeys and their troop leaders bewailed the death of Vali, crying bitterly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 22:
किष्किन्धा ह्यद्य शून्याऽसीत्स्वर्गते वानराधिपे। उद्यानानि च शून्यानि पर्वताः काननानि च4.22.26।। हते प्लवगशार्दूले निष्प्रभा वानराः कृताः।
output: Lord of monkeys having gone to heaven, Kishkinda looked desolate including the pleasure gardens, the mountains and forests. The monkeys also became dull.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्य वेगेन महता काननानि वनानि च। पुष्पौघेणानुबध्यन्ते करिष्यति तदद्य कः4.22.27।।
output: (The vanaras wailed aloud saying) 'The forests and gardens looked connected together with the flowers that swayed by his speed .Who can do that now?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
येन दत्तं महद्युद्धं गन्धर्वस्य महात्मनः4.22.28।। गोलभस्य महाबाहोर्दशवर्षाणि पञ्च च। नैव रात्रौ न दिवसे तद्युद्धमुपशाम्यति4.22.29।।
output: येन by him, महात्मनः of the great self, महाबाहोः of strong shoulders, गोलभस्य of Golabha, गन्धर्वस्य of gandharva, दश ten, पञ्च five, च and, वर्षाणि years, महत् great, युद्धम् war, दत्तम् given, तत् युद्धम् that war, रात्रौ during night, नैव उपशाम्यति not stops, दिवसे during day, न not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
येन दत्तं महद्युद्धं गन्धर्वस्य महात्मनः4.22.28।। गोलभस्य महाबाहोर्दशवर्षाणि पञ्च च। नैव रात्रौ न दिवसे तद्युद्धमुपशाम्यति4.22.29।।
output: येन by him, महात्मनः of the great self, महाबाहोः of strong shoulders, गोलभस्य of Golabha, गन्धर्वस्य of gandharva, दश ten, पञ्च five, च and, वर्षाणि years, महत् great, युद्धम् war, दत्तम् given, तत् युद्धम् that war, रात्रौ during night, नैव उपशाम्यति not stops, दिवसे during day, न not.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तु षोडशे वर्षे गोलभो विनिपातितः। हत्वा तं दुर्विनीतं तु वाली दंष्ट्राकरालवान्4.22.30।। सर्वाऽभयङ्करोऽस्माकं कथमेष निपातितः।
output: 'In the sixteenth year Golabha, the uncontrollable enemy was killed by Vali with his dreadful fangs and rendered protection to everybody. How did he get killed?'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हते तु वीरे प्लवगाधिपे तदा प्लवङ्गमास्तत्र न शर्म लेभिरे। वनेचराः सिंहयुते महावने यथा हि गावो निहते गवां पतौ4.22.31।।
output: Just as the cattle get frightened when the leader of the herd gets killed in a huge forest full of lions, the young monkey became puzzled when the chief of monkeys got killed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्समुपजिघ्रन्ती कपिराजस्य तन्मुखम्। पतिं लोकाच्च्युतं तारा मृतं वचनमब्रवीत्4.23.1।।
output: Tara laments -- Vali regrets about Tara's fate -- Vali calls  Angada to witness Tara's plight

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
शेषे त्वं विषमे दुःखमकृत्वा वचनं मम। उपलोपचिते वीर सुदुःखे वसुधातले4.23.2।।
output: 'O hero, not caring for my words (of caution), you are now lying with great pain on hard stones on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
मत्तः प्रियतरा नूनं वानरेन्द्र मही तव। शेषे हि तां परिष्वज्य मां च न प्रतिभाषसे4.23.3।।
output: 'O lord of monkeys you lie in the end, embracing the earth and not replying to me. Surely you deem this earth dearer than me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
सुग्रीवस्य वशं प्राप्तो विधिरेषभवत्यहो। सुग्रीव एव विक्रान्तो वीर साहसिकप्रिय4.23.4।।
output: 'O lover of brave deeds, fate has brought you under the sway of Sugriva, although he had lost to you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋक्षवानरमुख्यास्त्वां बलिनः पर्युपासते। एषां विलपितं कृच्छ्रमङ्गदस्य च शोचतः4.23.5।। मम चेमा गिरः श्रुत्वा किं त्वं न प्रतिबुध्यसे।
output: 'Oh powerful Vali leaders of the bears and monkeys, the entire lot are standing near you, wailing. Angada has been  crying in grief. How is it that you are not rising up even after hearing their wailing voices and  my call? .

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इदं तच्छूरशयनं यत्र शेषे हतो युधि। शायिता निहता यत्र त्वयैव रिपवः पुरा4.23.6।।
output: 'Earlier you have killed enemies in combats and made them lie down where now you lie.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
विशुद्धसत्त्वाभिजन प्रिययुद्ध मम प्रिय। मामनाथां विहायैकां गतस्त्वमसि मानद4.23.7।।
output: 'O venerable hero, born in a pure and noble family, you are a lover of battles. Now you have left me an orphan.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शूराय न प्रदातव्या कन्या खलु विपश्चिता। शूरभार्यां हतां पश्य सद्यो मां विधवां कृताम्4.23.8।।
output: विपश्चिता by wise men, कन्या a girl, शूराय for a warrior, न प्रदातव्या should not be given in marriage, सद्यः presently, विधवां कृताम्  rendered a widow, हताम् killed, शूरभार्याम् wife of a warrior, माम् me, पश्य you may see.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवभग्नश्च मे मानो भग्ना मे शाश्वती गतिः4.23.9।। अगाधे च निमग्नाऽस्मि विपुले शोकसागरे।
output: 'My pride is crushed. My husband, the ultimate resort for me is shattered.I am plunged in a vast, bottomless ocean of grief.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अश्मसारमयं नूनमिदं मे हृदयं दृढम्4.23.10।। भर्तारं निहतं दृष्ट्वा यन्नाद्य शतधा कृतम्।
output: निहतम्  killed, भर्तारम् husband, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, यत् since, अद्य now, शतधा into a hundred, न कृतम् not broken, मे my, दृढम् hard, इदं हृदयम् this heart, अश्मसारमयम् made of stone, नूनम् surely.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुहृच्चैव हि भर्ता च प्रकृत्या मम च प्रियः। आहवे च पराक्रान्तश्शूरः पञ्चत्वमागतः4.23.11।।
output: मम my, प्रकृत्या by nature, प्रियः dear, सुहृच्छैव a friend also, भर्ता च and husband, आहवे in  battle, पराक्रान्तः a powerful, शूरः hero, पञ्चत्वम् death, आगतः reached.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पतिहीना तु या नारी कामं भवतु पुत्रिणी। धनधान्यैस्सुपूर्णाऽपि विधवेत्युच्यते बुधैः4.23.12।।
output: 'Even if a woman without husband, is blessed with sons and abundant wealth and grain, still learned people call her a widow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वगात्रप्रभवे वीर शेषे रुधिरमण्डले। क्रिमिरागपरिस्तोमे त्वमात्मशयने यथा4.23.13।।
output: 'O hero how is it that you are lying in a crimson bed of the pool of blood flowing from your body?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
रेणुशोणितसंवीतं गात्रं तव समन्ततः। परिरब्धुं न शक्नोमि भुजाभ्यां प्लवगर्षभ 4.23.14।।
output: 'O bull among monkeys how can I embrace you with my arms as your body is covered with dust particles and blood?.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृतकृत्योऽद्य सुग्रीवो वैरेऽस्मिन्नतिदारुणे। यस्य रामविमुक्तेन हृतमेकेषुणा भयम्4.23.15।।
output: 'Sugriva has achieved his goal in his dreadful enmity (with you). His fear is dispelled by a single arrow released by Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शरेण हृदि लग्नेन गात्रसंस्पर्शने तव। वार्यामि त्वां निरीक्षन्ती त्वयि पञ्चत्वमागते4.23.16।।
output: त्वयि your, पञ्चत्वम् death, आगते reached, हृदि in the chest,  शरेण by the arrow,  लग्नेन by  arrow pierced, गात्रसंस्पर्शने touching limbs, वार्यामि refrain from, त्वां your, निरीक्षन्ती only looking at you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उद्ववर्ह शरं नीलस्तस्य गात्रगतं तदा। गिरिगह्वरसंलीनं दीप्तमाशीविषं यथा4.23.17।।
output: तदा then, नीलः Nila, तस्य his, गात्रगतम् deadbody, शरम् arrow, गिरिगह्वरसंलीनम् hidden in the mountain cave(heart), दीप्तम् glowing, आशीविषं यथा like a serpent, उद्ववर्ह made effort.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य निष्कृष्यमाणस्य बाणस्य च बभौ द्युतिः। अस्तमस्तकसंरुद्धो रश्मिर्दिनकरादिव4.23.18।।
output: As the arrrow(drenched in blood) was being pulled out, its glow looked like the Sun's rays obstructed by the peak of the western mountain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
पेतुः क्षतजधारास्तु व्रणेभ्यस्तस्य सर्वशः। ताम्रगैरिकसम्पृक्ता धारा इव धराधरात्4.23.19।।
output: The streams of blood that flowed all over from the wounds of his body appeared like streams of water mixed with red and copper colour.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवकीर्णं विमार्जन्ती भर्तारं रणरेणुना। अस्रैर्नयनजैश्शूरं सिषेचास्त्रसमाहतम्4.23.20।।
output: She (Tara) wiped the body wounded with the weapon and covered with wardust,  sprinkling her tear drops from her eyes.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गं दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं पतिम्। उवाच तारा पिङ्गाक्षं पुत्रमङ्गदमङ्गना4.23.21।।
output: Turning to the body of her husband fully drenched in blood, thus spoke Tara to her tawnyeyed  son Angada:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
अवस्थां पश्चिमां पश्य पितुः पुत्र सुदारुणाम्। सम्प्रसक्तस्य वैरस्य गतोऽन्तः पापकर्मणा4.23.22।।
output: 'O son you see the most terrific end of your father on whom enmity forced sinful deeds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
बालसूर्योदयतनुं प्रयान्तं यमसदनम्। अभिवादय राजानं पितरं पुत्र मानदम्4.23.23।।
output: 'O son offer salutations to your venerable father, the king, departing for the abode of Yama (lord of death) looking (red with blood) like the rising Sun.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
एवमुक्तस्समुत्थाय जग्राह चरणौ पितुः। भुजाभ्यां पीनवृत्ताभ्यामङ्गदोऽहमिति ब्रुवन्4.23.24।।
output: Thus advised by Tara, Angada got up, clasped his father's feet with his stout arms, and saluted, saying, 'I am Angada.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
अभिवादयमानं त्वामङ्गदं त्वं यथा पुरा। दीर्घायुर्भव पुत्रेति किमर्थं नाभिभाषसे4.23.25।।
output: 'Why do you not, with the words 'May you live long'', bless, as before, your son Angada who is greeting you? (said Tara).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं पुत्रसहाया त्वामुपासे गतचेतसम्। सिंहेन निहतं सद्यो गौस्सवत्सेव गोवृषम्4.23.26।।
output: 'Just like a cow followed by its calf would attend upon a mighty bull struck by a lion I will wait with my son upon you who have lost consciousness (died).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इष्ट्वा सङ्ग्रामयज्ञेन रामप्रहरणाम्भसि। अस्मिन्नवभृथे स्नातः कथं पत्न्या मया विना4.23.27।।
output: सङ्ग्रामयज्ञेन इष्ट्वा having performed a sacrificial war, पत्न्या with wife, मया विना without me, रामप्रह्ररणाम्भसि in the water of Rama's arrow, अस्मिन् in this, अवभृथे in this bath taken at the end of a sacrifice, कथम् how, स्नातः did you bathe?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
या दत्ता देवराजेन तव तुष्टेन संयुगे। शातकुम्भमयीं मालां तां ते पश्यामि नेह किम्4.23.28।।
output: 'Why do I not see on your chest the golden necklace gifted by the king of the gods (Indra), pleased with you in the battle?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 23:
राज्यश्रीर्न जहाति त्वां गतासुमपि मानद। सूर्यस्यावर्तमानस्य शैलराजमिव प्रभा4.23.29।।
output: 'O venerable one, even though life has departed from you, kingly glory does not leave you any more than the light of the setting son leaves the king of mountains. (western mountain)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न मे वचः पथ्यमिदं त्वया कृतं न चास्मि शक्ता हि निवारणे तव। हता सपुत्राऽस्मि हतेन संयुगे सह त्वया श्रीर्विजहाति मामिह4.23.30।।
output: त्वया by you, मे mine, पथ्यम् proper, इदं वचः these words, न कृतम् not followed, तव your, निवारणे in preventing, शक्ता capable, न अस्मि च हि I was not, संयुगे in war, हतेन one who is killed, सुपुत्रा along with my son, हतास्मि I am dead, श्रीः goddess of fortune, त्वया सह along with you, मामिह from me, विजहाति has deserted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां चाश्रुवेगेन दुरासदेन त्वभिप्लुतां शोकमहार्णवेन। पश्यंस्तदा वाल्यनुजस्तरस्वी भ्रातुर्वधेनाप्रतिमेन तेपे4.24.1।।
output: दुरासदेन by the unassailable, शोकमहार्णवेन by the ocean of grief, अश्रुवेगेन with the flood of tears, अभिप्लुताम् overwhelmed, ताम् her,पश्यन् perceiving, तदा then, तरस्वी powerful, वाल्यनुजः younger brother of Vali (Sugriva), अप्रतिमेन incomparable, भ्रातुः वधेन over killing of the brother, तेपे agonized.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स बाष्पपूर्णेन मुखेन वीक्ष्य क्षणेन निर्विण्णमना मनस्वी। जगाम रामस्य शनैस्समीपं भृत्यैर्वृतसम्परिदूयमानः4.24.2।।
output: बाष्पपूर्णेन filled with tears, मुखेन face, क्षणेन for a moment, वीक्ष्य glanced, निर्विण्णमनाः  depressed soul, मनस्वी highly sensitive, सः Sugriva, सम्परिदूयमानः pained, भृत्यैः by attendants, वृतः surounded, शनैः slowly, रामस्य to Rama, समीपम् presence, जगाम reached.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तं समासाद्य गृहीतचाप मुदात्तमाशीविषतुल्यबाणम्। यशस्विनं लक्षणलक्षिताङ्ग मवस्थितं राघव मित्युवाच4.24.3।।
output: सः he (Sugriva), गृहीतचापम् stood with the bow, उदात्तम् magnanimous, आशीविषतुल्यबाणम्  with sepentlike arrow, यशस्विनम् illustrious, लक्षणलक्षिताङ्गम् endowed with auspicious features, अवस्थितम् him, who stood, तं राघवम् that Rama, समासाद्य went near, इति thus, उवाच spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथा प्रतिज्ञातमिदं नरेन्द्र कृतं त्वया दृष्टफलं च कर्म। ममाद्य भोगेषु नरेन्द्रपुत्र मनो निवृत्तं सहजीवितेन4.24.4।।
output: 'Your majesty you have struck down Vali as promised and the consequences of your action are seen now. O prince, however, my mind is not interested in the enjoyment of pleasures. I have no interest in life.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्यां महिष्यां तु भृशं रुदन्त्या पुरे च विक्रोशति दुःखतप्ते। हतेऽग्रजे संशयितेऽङ्गदे च न राम राज्ये रमते मनो मे4.24.5।।
output: राम Rama, अस्याम् when she, महिष्याम् this queen, भृशम् deeply, रुदन्त्याम्  is weeping, दुःखतप्ते agonized, पुरे in the city, विक्रोशति wailing, नृपे the king, हते killed, अग्रजे च and my elder brother, संशयिते uncertain, अङ्गदे Angada's life, मे to me, मनः mind, राज्ये in the kingdom, न रमते not interested.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रोधादमर्षादतिविप्रधर्षा द्भ्रातुर्वधो मेऽनुमतः पुरस्तात्। हते त्विदानीं हरियूथपेऽस्मिन् सुतीव्रमिक्ष्वाकुकुमार तप्स्ये।।4.24.6।।
output: 'O prince of the Ikshvaku family, the anger due to my exilement and my intolerance of his harsh words, had made the killing of my brother agreeable to me earlier. Now that the leader of the monkey clan is killed I am  intensely hurt.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्रेयोऽद्य मन्ये मम शैलमुख्ये तस्मिन्निवासश्चिरमृश्यमूके। यथा तथा वर्तयतस्स्ववृत्त्या नेमं निहत्य त्रिदिवस्य लाभः4.24.7।।
output: 'I now feel dwelling long on the great mountain Rishyamuka  as usual and somehow  eking out a livelihood is preferable to attaining heaven as a sequel to the death of my brother.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न त्वां जिघांसामि चरेति यन्मा मयं महात्मा मतिमानुवाच। तस्यैव तद्राम वचोऽनुरूप मिदं पुनः कर्म च मेऽनुरूपम्4.24.8।।
output: 'O Rama when the wise, highsouled Vali said to me, 'I do not like to kill you in this place be gone from here', his words reflected his nobility. This action of mine (killing of Vali) is, on the other hand, in consonance with my nature.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
भ्राता कथं नाम महागुणस्य भ्रातुर्वधं राघव रोचयेत। राज्यस्य दुःखस्य च वीर सारं विचिन्तयन्कामपुरस्कृतऽस्सन्4.24.9।।
output: 'O Rama prompted by passion, without thinking of the difference between obtaining the kingdom to satisfy one's desire and the consequent grief, which brother would  be willing to kill his virtuous elder brother?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
वधो हि मे मतो नासीत्स्वमाहात्म्याव्यतिक्रमात्। ममाऽसीद्बुद्धिदौरात्म्यात्प्राणहारी व्यतिक्रमः4.24.10।।
output: 'The idea of killing me was not acceptable to his noble nature, while my wicked thought caused his death.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
द्रुमशाखावभग्नोऽहं मुहुर्तं परिनिष्टनन्। सान्त्वयित्वा त्वनेनोक्तो न पुनः कर्तुमर्हसि4.24.11।।
output: 'When my brother hit me with the branch of a tree I screamed for a while. But he pacified me and said it was improper and he would not repeat it.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
भ्रातृत्वमार्यभावश्च धर्मश्चानेन रक्षितः। मया क्रोधश्च कामश्च कपित्वं च प्रदर्शितम्4.24.12।।
output: 'Thus while nobility, a feeling of respect,brotherliness and duty was shown to me by my brother, I exhibited wrath, passion and  frivolity, the nature of the monkey.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
अचिन्तनीयं परिवर्जनीय मनीप्सनीयं स्वनवेक्षणीयम्। प्राप्तोऽस्मि पाप्मानमिमं नरेन्द्र भ्रातुर्वधात्त्वाष्ट्रवधादिवेन्द्र:4.24.13।।
output: 'O king  just as Indra committed sin by killing Tvashta, I have reaped the sin by  killing my brorther which is unthinkable, avoidable, undesirable and ignoble.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पाप्मानमिन्द्रस्य मही जलं च वृक्षाश्च कामं जगृहुः स्त्रियश्च। को नाम पाप्मानमिमं क्षमेत शाखामृगस्य प्रतिपत्तुमिच्छेत्।।4.24.14।।
output: कामं surely, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, पाप्मानम् sinful action, मही earth, जलं च and water, वृक्षाश्च and trees, स्त्रियश्च women, जगृहुः received, शाखामृगस्य of an animal moving on branches of plants, a monkey, इमम् this, पाप्मानम् sin, को नाम who will, क्षमेत will pardon, प्रतिपत्तुम् to receive, इच्छेत will desire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
नार्हामि सम्मानमिमं प्रजानां न यौवराज्यं कुत एव राज्यम्। अधर्मयुक्तं कुलनाशयुक्त मेवंविधं राघव कर्म कृत्वा4.24.15।।
output: 'O Rama having acted in an unrighteous manner, which destroys the clan, I am not fit to accept the respect of people nor the status of a prince regent, what to speak of kingship?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पापस्य कर्ताऽस्मि विगर्हितस्य क्षुद्रस्य लोकापकृतस्य चैव। शोको महान्मामभिवर्ततेऽयं वृष्टेर्यथा निम्नमिवाम्बुवेगः4.24.16।।
output: 'I have committed a sin which is condemned by the world. This intense grief has engulfed me just as the flow of rain water inundates the lowlying area when it rains.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोदर्यघातापरगात्रवालः सन्तापहस्ताक्षिशिरोविषाणः। एनोमयो मामभिहन्ति हस्ती दृप्तो नदीकूलमिव प्रवृद्धः।।4.24.17।।
output: सोदर्यघातापरगात्रवालः slaying of brother forming a tail of the body, सन्तापहस्ताक्षिशिरोविषाणः  remorse forming the trunk, eyes, head and tusks, एनोमयः sinful, दृप्तः proud, प्रवृद्धः growing, हस्ती elephant, माम् me, नदीकूलमिव like the banks of a river, अभिहन्ति is striking me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अंहो बतेदं नृवराविषह्यं निवर्तते मे हृदि साधुवृत्तम्। विवर्णमग्नौ परितप्यमानं किट्टं यथा राघव जातरूपम्4.24.18।।
output: नृवर O distinguished sire, राघव O Rama, मे in my, हृदि in heart, साधुवृत्तम् good behaviour, इदम् this, अंहः this anxiety, अविषह्य unbearable, अग्नौ in fire, परितप्यमानम् being burnt, विवर्णम्  brightens in colour, जातरूपम् gold, किट्टं यथा like the dirt, निवर्तते turned, बत indeed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
महाबलानां हरियूथपाना मिदं कुलं राघव मन्निमित्तम्। अस्याङ्गदप्यापि च शोकतापा दर्धस्थितप्राणमितीव मन्ये।।4.24.19।।
output: 'O Rama this race of mighty monkey chiefs is as though reduced to a halfdead state because of my action and the grief of Angada.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
सुतस्सुलभ्यस्सुजनस्सुवश्यः कुतस्तु पुत्रस्सदृशोऽङ्गदेन। न चापि विद्येत स वीर देशो यस्मिन्भवेत्सोदरसन्निकर्षः4.24.20।।
output: 'One can find easily a son who is controllable and accessible in need but it is difficult to find a good son like Angada, who is virtuous and mighty and who is respectful to parents. O warrior (Rama), there is no place where I can get a brother like Vali. (A brother cannot be made. His relationship is natural. Rama stresses the same subhashita in Yuddhakanda when Lakshmana swooned).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यद्यङ्गदो वीरवरार्ह जीवेत् जीवेच्छ माता परिपालनार्थम्। विना तु पुत्रं परितापदीना तारा न जीवेदिति निश्चितं मे4.24.21।।
output: यदि if, वीरवरार्हः  mighty hero, अङ्गदः Angada, जीवेत् may live, माता his mother, परिपालनार्थम् to take care  जीवेत् will live, पुत्रं विना तु without her son, परितापदीना dejected and miserable, तारा Tara, न जीवेत् will not live, इति this, मे my, निश्चितम् it is my firm belief.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽहं प्रवेक्ष्याम्यतिदीप्तमग्निं भ्रात्रा च पुत्रेण च सख्यमिच्छन्। इमे विचेष्यन्ति हरिप्रवीरा स्सीतां निदेशे तव वर्तमानाः4.24.22।।
output: सः अहम् I, भ्रात्रा च and with brother, पुत्रेण च and with the son, सख्यम् friendship, इच्छन् desiring, अतिदीप्तम्  blazing, अग्निम् fire, प्रवेक्ष्यामि I will enter, इमे these, हरिप्रवीराः monkey leaders, तवनिदेशे as per your command, वर्तमानाः go around, सीताम् for Sita, विचेष्यन्ति will search.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृत्स्नं तु ते सेत्स्यति कार्यमेत न्मय्यप्रतीते मनुजेन्द्रपुत्र कुलस्य हन्तारमजीवनार्हं रामानुजानीहि कृतागसं माम्4.24.23।।
output: 'O prince Rama even if I am dead the entire task of yours, will be accomplished by the  vanara race. I have ruined the whole race. I am sinful and not fit to live. Permit me (to enter fire).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
इत्येवमार्तस्य रघुप्रवीरः श्रुत्वा वचो वाल्यनुजस्य तस्य। सञ्जातबाष्पः परवीरहन्ता रामो मुहूर्तं विमना बभूव4.24.24।।
output: Rama, the hero of the Raghu dynasty, a destroyer of the enemy heroes, was moved to tears. He lost composure for a moment when he heard Sugriva's lament.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्मिन् क्षणेऽभीक्ष्णमवेक्ष्यमाणः क्षितिक्षमावान्भुवनस्य गोप्ता। रामो रुदन्तीं व्यसने निमग्नां समुत्सुकः सोऽथ ददर्श ताराम्4.24.25।।
output: In that moment, Rama,the protector of the world, tolerant like the earth, beheld Tara plunged in grief, looking at him again and again and weeping.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां चारुनेत्रां कपिसिंहनाथां पतिं समाश्लिष्य तदा शयानाम्। उत्थापयामासुरदीनसत्त्वां मन्त्रिप्रधानाः कपिवीरपत्नीम्4.24.26।।
output: चारुनेत्राम्  beautiful eyed, कपिसिंहनाथाम् whose lord was a great lion among monkeys, तदा then, पतिम् lord, समाश्लिष्य by clinging, शयानाम् while lying down, अदीनसत्त्वाम् a noble lady, कपिवीरपत्नीम् wife of the heroic monkey, ताम् her, मन्त्रिप्रधानाः principal ministers, उत्थापयामासु: made her get up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा विस्फुरन्ती परिरभ्यमाणा भर्तुस्सकाशादपनीयमाना। ददर्श रामं शरचापपाणिं स्वतेजसा सूर्यमिव ज्वलन्तम्4.24.27।।
output: परिरभ्यमाणा while she was clinging, भर्तुः husband's, सकाशात् from his presence, अपनीयमाना while she was taken away, सा she, विस्फुरन्ती struggling, शरचापपाणिम् wielding bow and arrows, स्वतेजसा by his effulgence, सूर्यमिव like the Sun, ज्वलन्तम् glowing, रामम् Rama, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुसंवृतं पार्थिपलक्षणैश्च तं चारुनेत्रं मृगशाबनेत्रा। अदृष्टपूर्वं पुरुषप्रधान मयं स काकुत्स्थ इति प्रजज्ञे4.24.28।।
output: The fawneyed Tara saw the magnificent man of Kakutstha family endowed with all royal marks and beautiful eyes, whom she had never seen before and knew he was Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्येन्द्रकल्पस्य दुरासदस्य महानुभावस्य समीपमार्या। आर्ताऽतितूर्णं व्यसनाभिपन्ना जगाम तारा परिविह्वलन्ती4.24.29।।
output: आर्या noble, आर्ता desperate, व्यसनम् agony, प्रपन्ना  experiencing, तारा Tara, परिविह्वलन्ती lady shaken up, इन्द्रकल्पस्य equal to Indra, दुरासदस्य unapproachable, महानुभावस्य great man's, तस्य his, समीपम् proximity, अतितूर्णम् quickly, जगाम went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
सा तं समासाद्य विशुद्धसत्त्वा शोकेन सम्भ्रान्तशरीरभावा। मनस्विनी वाक्यमुवाच तारा रामं रणोत्कर्षणलब्धलक्षम्4.24.30।।
output: Wise Tara, baffled out of grief and agitated, with pure consciousness, approached Rama,  eminent in warfare who could hit the target. And spoke:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
त्वमप्रमेयश्च दुरासदश्च जितेन्द्रियश्चोत्तमधार्मिकश्च। अक्षय्यकीर्तिश्च विचक्षणश्च क्षितिक्षमावान्क्षतजोपमाक्षः4.24.31।।
output: 'You are immeasurable, unassailable, self controlled, and best among the righteous. Your fame never diminishes. You have great sense of discrimination. You are known to possess forbearance like the mother earth. Your eyes are redcornered (which is a sign of valour).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वमात्तबाणासनबाणपाणि र्महाबलस्संहननोपपन्नः। मनुष्यदेहाभ्युदयं विहाय दिव्येन देहाभ्युदयेन युक्तः।।4.24.32।।
output: 'You are wielding bow and arrows. You possess mighty human limbs that have the power to destroy the enemy .You  have assumed a divine human body.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
येनैक बाणेन हतः प्रियो मे तेनैव मां त्वं जहि सायकेन। हता गमिष्यामि समीपमस्य न मामृते राम रमेत वाली4.24.33।।
output: 'O warrior kill me by the same single arrow with which you killed my beloved lord,Vali. I will join him after death as he will not be happy without me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
स्वर्गेऽपि पद्मामलपत्रनेत्र स्समेत्य सम्प्रेक्ष्य च मामपश्यन्। न ह्येष उच्चावचताम्रचूडा विचित्रवेषाप्सरसोऽभजिष्यत्।।4.24.34।।
output: 'If Vali with eyes of clear petals of a lotus does not see me in heaven, he may not join the wonderfully dressed apsarasas adorned with different kinds of red flowers in their hair.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वर्गेऽपि शोकं च विवर्णतां च मया विना प्राप्प्यति वीर वाली। रम्ये नगेन्द्रस्य तटावकाशे विदेहकन्यारहितो यथा त्वम्4.24.35।।
output: 'O Rama Vali will experience sorrow and become pale bereft of me even in heaven just as you are filled with sorrow even on a delightful mountain slope bereft of princess of Videha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वं वेत्थ यावद्वनिताविहीनः प्राप्नोति दुःखं पुरुषः कुमारः। तत्त्वं प्रजानन् जहि मां न वाली दुःखं ममादर्शनजं भजेत4.24.36।।
output: 'You are aware of the grief of a young man separated from his wife. Kill me so that I can go to Vali. Let not Vali experience the sorrow of not seeing me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यच्चापि मन्येत भवान्महात्मा स्त्रीघातदोषो न भवेत्तु मह्यम्। आत्मेयमस्येति च मां जहि त्वं न स्त्रीवधस्स्यान्मनुजेन्द्रपुत्र।।4.24.37।।
output: 'O prince as you are great, you might think of the blemish of killing a woman. Since Tara is Vali's soul, you may kill me. It will not amount to killing a woman.(You will only be killing the soul of Vali by killing Tara).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शास्त्रप्रयोगाद्विविधाच्च वेदा दात्माह्यनन्यः पुरुषस्य दाराः। दाराप्रदानान्नहि दानमन्य त्प्रदृश्यते ज्ञानवतां हि लोके4.24.38।।
output: शास्त्रप्रयोगात् by the procedure ordained in the sastras, विविधात् in many ways, वेदात् from statements in the Vedas, दाराः a wife, पुरुषस्य husband's, आत्माह्यचन्यः an inseparable part of the soul, लोके in the world, दारप्रदानात् restoring a wife to her husband, अन्यत् other than that, दानम् an offering, ज्ञानवताम् for the learned people, न प्रदृश्यते हि is not seen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
त्वं चापि मां तस्य मम प्रियस्य प्रदास्य से धर्ममवेक्ष्य वीर अनेन दानेन न लप्स्यसे त्व मधर्मयोगं मम वीर घातात्4.24.39।।
output: 'O gallant prince  if you give me away to my dear lord, carefully considering dharma, you will not be committing any adharma by killing me since it will be an offering.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
आर्तामनाथामपनीयमाना मेवं विधामर्हसि मां निहन्तुम्। अहं हि मातङ्गविलासगामिना प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण धीमता4.24.40।। विना वरार्होत्तमहेममालिना चिरं न शक्ष्यामि नरेन्द्र जीवितुम्। इत्येवमुक्तस्तु विभुर्महात्मा तारां समाश्वास्य हितं बभाषे4.24.41।।
output: 'O king it is proper on your part to kill me as I am in great distress. I am a helpless orphan torn away from her husband.O king I will not live long without the wise leader of monkeys who walked majestically like an elephant and wore the choicest golden necklace'. Implored by Tara this way, the great soul, Rama, lord of the earth said to Tara these words of consolation:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आर्तामनाथामपनीयमाना मेवं विधामर्हसि मां निहन्तुम्। अहं हि मातङ्गविलासगामिना प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण धीमता4.24.40।। विना वरार्होत्तमहेममालिना चिरं न शक्ष्यामि नरेन्द्र जीवितुम्। इत्येवमुक्तस्तु विभुर्महात्मा तारां समाश्वास्य हितं बभाषे4.24.41।।
output: नरेन्द्र king, आर्ताम् to the helpless , अनाथाम् to an orphan, अपनीयमानाम् a woman torn away, एवं विधाम् to this state, माम् me, निहन्तुम् to kill, अर्हसि you should, अहम् I, मातङ्गविलासगामिना with the majestic gait of a proud elephant, धीमता wise, वरार्होत्तमहेममालिना adorned with the choicest golden necklace, प्लवङ्गमानां ऋषभेण विना without the bull among the monkeys, चिरम् for a long time, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यामि not be able, इत्येवम् in this manner, उक्तः having implored, विभुः lord of the earth, महात्मा a great soul, ताराम् Tara, समाश्वास्य  consoling, हितम् advice, बभाषे spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मा वीरभार्ये विमतिं कुरुष्व लोको हि सर्वो विहितो विधात्रा। तं चैव सर्वं सुखदुःखयोगं लोकोऽब्रवीत्तेन कृतं विधात्रा।।4.24.42।।
output: वीरभार्ये O wife of a valiant one, विमतिम् disconsolate thought, माकुरुष्व not entertain, सर्वः all, लोकः worlds, विधात्रा by the creator, विहितः हि is fixed, सर्वम् all, तम् such, सुखदुःखयोगं चैव state of happiness and sorrow also, तेन विधात्रा by that creator, कृतम् done, लोकः people, अब्रवीत् have maintained.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 24:
आश्वासिता तेन तु राघवेण प्रभावयुक्तेन परन्तपेन। सा वीरपत्नी ध्वनता मुखेन सुवेषरूपा विरराम तारा4.24.44।।
output: Consoled by the influential Rama, scorcher of enemies, Tara the charming wife of a warrior, stopped wailing aloud. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे चतुर्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyfourth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीवं चैव तारां च साङ्गदं सहलक्ष्मणः। समानशोकः काकुत्स्थ स्सान्त्वयन्निदमब्रवीत्।।4.25.1।।
output: Rama exhorts Tara  on fate and time -- preparation for the funeral -- grief of monkeys and Angada -- performance of funeral rites.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न शोकपरितापेन श्रेयसा युज्यते मृतः। यदत्रानन्तरं कार्यं तत्समाधातुमर्हथ4.25.2।।
output: शोकपरितापेन by lamenting, मृतः the dead, श्रेयसा with wellbeing, न युज्यते will not gain, अत्र here, यत् whatever, अनन्तरम् later, कार्यम् should be done, तत् that, समाधातुम् to take up, अर्हथ you may do.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लोकवृत्तमनुष्ठेयं कृतं वो बाष्पमोक्षणम्। न कालादुत्तरं किञ्चित्कर्म शक्यमुपासितुम्4.25.3।।
output: लोकवृत्तम् worldly way, अनुष्ठेयम् should be performed, वः by you, बाष्पमोक्षणम् shedding tears, कृतम् is done, कालात्  after lapse of time, उत्तरम् later, परम् supreme, किञ्चित् कर्म even a little task, उपासितुम् to be engaged in, न शक्यम् not possible.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नियतिः कारणं लोके नियतिः कर्मसाधनम्। नियतिस्सर्वभूतानां नियोगेष्विह कारणम्4.25.4।।
output: 'Fate is the cause of the world. Fate is the means of accomplishment. Fate assigns duties to all beings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न कर्ता कस्यचित्कश्चिन्नियोगे चापिनेश्वरः। स्वभावे वर्तते लोकस्तस्य कालः परायणम्4.25.5।।
output: 'No one can control another's action. No one including God can be the agent of action. No one has the power to entrust duty to others. This entire world is governed by one's own nature. Nature in turn is governed by Time (fate).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
न कालः कालमत्येति न कालः परिहीयते। स्वभावं च समासाद्य न कश्चिदतिवर्तते4.25.6।।
output: 'God (though independent) does not deviate from Time. Time cannot be escaped or trangressed. It cannot be condoned or avoided. No one can transgress their own nature.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
न कालस्यास्ति बन्धुत्वं न हेतुर्न पराक्रमः। न मित्रज्ञातिसम्बन्धः कारणं नात्मनो वशः4.25.7।।
output: 'Time has no consideration for relationship, friendship, or kinship or valour. Time itself is the cause. It is never under one's control.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किं तु कालपरीणामो द्रष्टव्यस्साधु पश्यता। धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च कालक्रमसमाहिताः4.25.8।।
output: किं तु however, साधु properly, पश्यता by a person who can see, कालपरीणामः effect of fate, द्रष्टव्यः should be visualised, धर्मश्च and dharma, अर्थश्च even wealth, कामश्च and pleasures, कालक्रमसमाहिताः are ordained by an order which is controlled by fate.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इतस्स्वां प्रकृतिं वाली गतःप्राप्तः क्रियाफलम्। धर्मार्थकाम संयोगैः पवित्रं प्लवगेश्वरः4.25.9।।
output: प्लवगेश्वरः king of monkeys, वाली vali, इतः dead, स्वाम् his own, प्रकृतिम् nature, गतः has reached, धर्मार्थकामसंयोगैः with the combination of dharma, wealth and pleasures, पवित्रम् sacred, क्रियाफलम् result of his action, प्राप्तः attained.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वधर्मस्य च संयोगाज्जितस्तेन महात्मना। स्वर्गः परिगृहीतश्च प्राणानपरिरक्षता4.25.10।।
output: प्राणान् life, अपरिरक्षिता by not protecting, तेन महात्मना by that great soul, स्वधर्मस्य सम्योगात् by virtue of his own dharma, स्वर्गः heaven, जितः won, परिगृहीतश्च has been accepted.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
एषा वै नियतिश्शेष्ठा यां गतो हरियूथपः। तदलं परितापेन प्राप्तकालमुपास्यताम्4.25.11।।
output: 'The state attained by the chief of monkeys is an excellent one.Therefore there is no need to regret. Attend to your duties (relating to rites)'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
वचनान्ते तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। अवदत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सुग्रीवं गतचेतसम्4.25.12।।
output: Seeing Sugriva had lost his senses, Lakshmana, the slayer of enemy warriors humbly said at the end of Rama's address:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
कुरु त्वमस्य सुग्रीव प्रेतकार्यमनन्तरम्। ताराङ्गदाभ्यां सहितो वालिनो दहनं प्रति।।4.25.13।।
output: 'O Sugriva perform with Tara and Angada the funeral obsequies relating to the cremation of Vali.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
समाज्ञापय काष्ठानि शुष्कानि च बहूनि च। चन्दनादीनि दिव्यानि वालिसंस्कारकारणात्4.25.14।।
output: 'Let the best of dry logs and sandalwood be ordered for the funeral rites of Vali.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समाश्वासय चैनं त्वमङ्गदं दीनचेतसम्। मा भूर्बालिशबुद्धिस्त्वं त्वदधीनमिदं पुरम्4.25.15।।
output: त्वम् you, दीनचेतसम् despondent, एनम् him, अङ्गदम् Angada, समाश्वासय you may pacify, त्वम् you, बालिशबुद्धिः मा भूः you may not be childish, इदं पुरम् this city, त्वदधीनम् is under you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
अङ्गदस्त्वानयेन्माल्यं वस्त्राणि विविधानि च। घृतं तैलमथो गन्धान्यच्चात्र समनन्तरम्4.25.16।।
output: 'Let Angada for his part collect garlands of many kinds, clothes, clarified butter, oil, fragrants and all that is required to be procured.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
त्वं तार शिबिकां शीघ्रमादायागच्छ सम्भ्रमात्। त्वरा गुणवती युक्ता ह्यस्मिन्काले विशेषतः4.25.17।।
output: 'O Tara quickly get a swiftmoving litter fastened with ropes specially  suitable for this occasion.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सज्जीभवन्तु प्लवगाश्शिबिकावाहनोचिताः। समर्था बलिनश्चैव निर्हरिष्यन्ति वालिनम्।।4.25.18।।
output: शिबिकावाहनोचिताः those monkeys who can carry the litter, समर्थाः capable ones, बलिनश्चैव and strong also, प्लवगाः monkeys, सज्जीभवन्तु let them get ready, वालिनम् Vali's, निर्हरिष्यन्ति they will carry him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सुग्रीवं सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः। तसौ भ्रातृसमीपस्थो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा4.25.19।।
output: सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः the delight of Sumitra, परवीरहा slayer of enemies, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, भ्रातृसमीपस्थः near his brother, स्थौ stood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लक्ष्मणस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा तारस्सम्भ्रान्तमानसः। प्रविवेश गुहां शीघ्रं शिबिकासक्तमानसः4.25.20।।
output: On hearing Lakshmana, Tara in an excited state quickly entered the cave city to get the litter.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आदाय शिबिकां तारस्स तु पर्यापतत्पुनः। वानरैरुह्यमानां तां शूरैरुद्वहनोचितैः4.25.21।।
output: Tara jumped in on to the litter carried by strong monkeys.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
दिव्यां भद्रासनयुतां शिबिकां स्यन्दनोपमाम्। पक्षिकर्मभिराचित्रां द्रुमकर्मविभूषिताम्4.25.22।। आचितां चित्रपत्तीभि स्सुनिविष्टां समन्ततः। विमानमिव सिद्धानां जालवातायनान्विताम्4.25.23।। सुनियुक्तां विशालां च सुकृतां विश्वकर्मणा। दारुपर्वतकोपेतां चारुकर्मपरिष्कृताम्4.25.24।। वराभरणहारैश्च चित्रमाल्योपशोभिताम्। गुहागहनसञ्छन्नां रक्तचन्दनभूषिताम्4.25.25।। पुष्पौघैस्समभिच्छन्नां पद्ममालाभिरेव च। तरुणादित्यवर्णाभिर्भ्राजमानाभिरावृताम्4.25.26।।
output: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिव्यां भद्रासनयुतां शिबिकां स्यन्दनोपमाम्। पक्षिकर्मभिराचित्रां द्रुमकर्मविभूषिताम्4.25.22।। आचितां चित्रपत्तीभि स्सुनिविष्टां समन्ततः। विमानमिव सिद्धानां जालवातायनान्विताम्4.25.23।। सुनियुक्तां विशालां च सुकृतां विश्वकर्मणा। दारुपर्वतकोपेतां चारुकर्मपरिष्कृताम्4.25.24।। वराभरणहारैश्च चित्रमाल्योपशोभिताम्। गुहागहनसञ्छन्नां रक्तचन्दनभूषिताम्4.25.25।। पुष्पौघैस्समभिच्छन्नां पद्ममालाभिरेव च। तरुणादित्यवर्णाभिर्भ्राजमानाभिरावृताम्4.25.26।।
