instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिव्यां भद्रासनयुतां शिबिकां स्यन्दनोपमाम्। पक्षिकर्मभिराचित्रां द्रुमकर्मविभूषिताम्4.25.22।। आचितां चित्रपत्तीभि स्सुनिविष्टां समन्ततः। विमानमिव सिद्धानां जालवातायनान्विताम्4.25.23।। सुनियुक्तां विशालां च सुकृतां विश्वकर्मणा। दारुपर्वतकोपेतां चारुकर्मपरिष्कृताम्4.25.24।। वराभरणहारैश्च चित्रमाल्योपशोभिताम्। गुहागहनसञ्छन्नां रक्तचन्दनभूषिताम्4.25.25।। पुष्पौघैस्समभिच्छन्नां पद्ममालाभिरेव च। तरुणादित्यवर्णाभिर्भ्राजमानाभिरावृताम्4.25.26।।
output: A swiftmoving, marvellous palanquin designed by Viswakarma was brought. Covered with colourful pictures of birds and trees on every side it looking like an aerial chariot fit for saints. Fitted with a splendid seat grilled windows, artificially made small caverns and grottos of wood was embellished with carvings of mountains, choice ornaments and garlands. With red sandal paste, red scented flowers and red lotus garlands, it resembled the rising Sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
ईदृशीं शिबिकां दृष्ट्वा रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। क्षिप्रं विनीयतां वाली प्रेतकार्यं विधीयताम्4.25.26।।
output: Seeing the palanquin, Rama said to Lakshmana 'Let the body of Vali be placed in the palanquin quickly and last rites duly performed'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो वालिनमुद्यम्य सुग्रीवश्शिबिकां तदा। आरोपयत विक्रोशन्नङ्गदेन सहैव तु4.25.27।।
output: Then Sugriva along with Angada, crying aloud bitterly, lifted the body (of Vali) and placed it on the palanquin.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आरोप्य शिबिकां चैव वालिनं गतजीवितम्। अलङ्कारैश्च विविधैर्माल्यैर्वस्त्रैश्च भूषितम्4.25.28।।
output: विविधैः with different, अलङ्कारैश्च with ornaments, माल्यैः with garlands, वस्त्रैश्च clothes, भूषितम्  adorned, गतजीवितम् dead, वालिनम् Vali, शिबिकाम् palanquin, आरोप्य on placing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
आज्ञापयत्तदा राजा सुग्रीव प्लवगेश्वरः। और्ध्वदैहिकमार्यस्य क्रियतामनुरूपतः।।4.25.29।।
output: King Sugriva, lord of the monkeys, said, 'Let the funeral rites of my noble sire be performed in a fitting manner'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विश्राणयन्तो रत्नानि विविधानि बहून्यपि। अग्रतः प्लवगा यान्तु शिबिका समनन्तरम्4.25.30।।
output: 'Let the monkeys march in front, showering many different gems in large quantities and let the palanquin follow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
राज्ञामृद्दिविशेषा हि दृश्यन्ते भुवि यादृशाः। तादृशैरिह कुर्वन्तु वानरा भर्तृसत्क्रियाम्4.25.31।।
output: 'Let the monkeys perform the funeral rites of our lord in an honourable way as expensively as has been done with regard to the obsequies of kings who ruled over this land.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
तादृशं वालिनः क्षिप्रं प्राकुर्वन्नौर्ध्वदैहिकम्। अङ्गदं परिगृह्याऽशु तारप्रभृतयस्तदा4.25.32।। क्रोशन्तः प्रययुस्सर्वे वानरा हतबान्धवाः।
output: Tara, Angada and the other bereaved monkeys hastened to perform the funeral ceremony of Valiweeping.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
ततः प्रणिहिताः सर्वा वानर्योस्य वशानुगाः4.25.33।। चुक्रुशु र्वीर वीरेति भूयः क्रोशन्ति ताः स्त्रीयः।
output: Then all the female monkeys who were in his (Vali's) harem walked past the deadbody of Vali, crying again and again 'Alas, Oh hero'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताराप्रभृतयस्सर्वा वानर्यो हरियूथपाः। अनुजग्मुर्हि भर्तारं क्रोशन्त्यः करुणस्वनाः4.25.34।।
output: हरियूथपाः chief of the monkey troops, ताराप्रभृतयः Tara and others, सर्वाः all, वानर्यः  female monkeys, करुणस्वनाः with pathetically, क्रोशन्त्यः crying, भर्तारम् husband, अनुजग्मुः went following, हि indeed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
तासां रुदितशब्देन वानरीणां वनान्तरे। वनानि गिरयश्चैव विक्रोशन्तीव सर्वतः4.25.35।।
output: When the female monkeys were weeping in the midst of the forest, it looked as if the forest and the hills were also mourning.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
पुलिने गिरिनद्यास्तु विविक्ते जलसंवृते4.25.36।। चितां चक्रुस्सुबहवो वानराश्शोककर्शिता:।
output: Tormented with tears, the monkeys prepared in a solitary place surrounded by waters a pyre on the sandbank of a mountain stream.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवरोप्य ततस्स्कन्धाच्छिबिकां वाहनोचिताः। तस्थुरेकान्तमाश्रित्य सर्वे शोकसमन्विता:4.25.37।।
output: Putting down the palanquin from their shoulders on the lonely spot, the bearers stood in tearswaiting.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तारा पतिं दृष्ट्वा शिबिकातलशायिनम्4.25.38।। आरोप्याङ्के शिरस्तस्य विललाप सुदुःखिता।
output: ततः then, तारा Tara, शिबिकातलशायिनम् who was lying on the sibika, पतिम् husband, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, सुदुःखिता a lady full of grief, तस्य his, शिरः head, अङ्के on her lap, आरोप्य  placed, विललाप cried.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हा वानर महाराज हा नाथ मम वत्सल4.25.39।। हा महार्ह महाबाहो हा मम प्रिय पश्य माम्। जनं न पश्यसीमं त्वं कस्माच्छोकाभिपीडितम्।4.25.40।।
output: 'Why don't you look at me, oppressed with tears, O monkey king, O my venerable lord, O longarmed one, O my dear?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हा वानर महाराज हा नाथ मम वत्सल4.25.39।। हा महार्ह महाबाहो हा मम प्रिय पश्य माम्। जनं न पश्यसीमं त्वं कस्माच्छोकाभिपीडितम्।4.25.40।।
output: हा वानरमहाराज O monkey king, हा मम नाथ O my great husband, हा महार्ह O venerable lord, हा महाबाहो O longarmed one, मम my, प्रिय dear, माम् me, पश्य see, त्वम् you, शोकाभिपीडितम् tormented with tears, इमं जनम् this person, कस्मात् why, न पश्यसि not see?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रहृष्टमिव ते वक्त्रं गतासोरपि मानद आस्तार्कसमवर्णं च लक्ष्यते जीवतो यथा4.25.41।।
output: 'O revered self even though you are bereft of life, your face looks cheerful. It carries the colour of the setting Sun, and looks the same when you were alive.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष त्वां रामरूपेण कालः कर्षति वानर। येन स्म विधवास्सर्वाः कृता एकेषुणा वने4.25.42।।
output: वानर monkey, एषः कालः this god of death, त्वाम् you, रामरूपेण in the form of Rama, कर्षति dragged away, येन by that, वने in the forest, एकेषुणा with a single arrow, सर्वाः all, विधवाः widows, कृताः are turned.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमास्तास्तव राजेन्द्र वानर्योवल्लभास्सदा। पादैर्विकृष्ट मध्वानमागताः किं न बुध्यसे4.25.43।।
output: 'O king of kings why don't you understand that these female monkeys, your wives who were dear to you have come on foot this long distance with great difficulty?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
तवेष्टा ननु नामैता भार्याश्चन्द्रनिभाननाः। इदानीं नेक्षसे कस्तात्सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वरम्4.25.44।।
output: 'O lord of monkeys these moonfaced wives were indeed once your favourites. Why don't you look  at them? Why don't you look Sugriva?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एते हि सचिवा राजं स्तारप्रभृतयस्तव। पुरवासी जनश्चायं परिवार्यासतेऽनघ4.25.45।।
output: राजन् O king, तारप्रभृतयः Tara and others, एते these, तव सचिवाः your ministers, अयम् this, पुरवासिजनः inhabitants of the capital, परिवार्य by surrounding you, आसते they are sitting, अनघ O sinless hero.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
विसर्जयैतान् प्लवगान्यथोचितमरिन्दम। ततः क्रीडामहे सर्वा वनेषु मदनोत्कटाः4.25.46।।
output: 'O conqueror of enemies give these monkeys their due in accordance with their status and send them back as you used to do when they were passionately sporting in your company here in this forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
एवं विलपतीं तारां पतिशोकपरिप्लुताम्। उत्थापयन्ति स्म तदा वानर्यश्शोककर्शिताः4.25.47।।
output: The griefstricken female monkeys helped Tara, overwhelmed with sorrow due to her husband's death, rise from the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
सुग्रीवेण ततस्सार्धंमङ्गदः पितरं रुदन्। चितामारोपयामास शोकेनाभिहतेन्द्रियः4.25.48।।
output: Then Angada, helped by Sugriva, placed his father's body on the pyre, with his senses numbed in deep sorrow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽग्निं विधिवद्दत्त्वा सोऽपसव्यं चकार ह। पितरं दीर्घमध्वानं प्रस्थितं व्याकुलेन्द्रियः4.25.49।।
output: Overwhelmed with sorrow, he offered fire to the father who had set out on a long journey (to heaven). As per tradition he went round the pyre anteclock wise.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
संस्कृत्य वालिनं ते तु विधिपूर्वं प्लवङ्गमाः। आजग्मुरुदकं कर्तुं नदीं शुभजलां शिवाम्4.25.50।।
output: The monkeys set Vali's body to be consumed by fire as per tradition and proceeded to an auspicious river of pure water in order to offer oblation (to the departed soul).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्ते सहितास्तत्र ह्यङ्गदं स्थाप्य चाग्रतः। सुग्रीवतारासहितास्सिषिचुर्वालिने जलम्4.25.51।।
output: Then the monkeys along with Sugriva and Tara positioning Angada in the forefront made waterofferings (to Vali) collectively.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 25:
सुग्रीवेणेव दीनेन दीनो भूत्वा महाबलः। समानशोकः काकुत्स्थ: प्रेतकार्याण्यकारयत्4.25.52।।
output: Mighty Rama, who was equally sorrowful and pitiable as Sugriva, directed the performance of funeral rites.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततश्शोकाभिसन्तप्तं सुग्रीवं क्लिन्नवाससम्। शाखामृगमहामात्राः परिवार्योपतस्थिरे4.26.1।।
output: Sugriva's coronation -- declaration of Angada as heir apparent -- retirement of Rama to Rshyamuka -- Rama asks Sugriva to make arrangements to find Sita after the rainy season.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभिगम्य महाबाहुं राममक्लिष्टकारिणम्। स्थिताः प्राञ्जलयस्सर्वे पितामहमिवर्षयः4.26.2।।
output: Just like sages stand before the creator Brahma, all the monkeys stood with folded hands before the longarmed Rama, the remover of sorrow.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः काञ्चनशैलाभ स्तरुणार्कनिभाननः। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं हनूमान्मारुतात्मजः4.26.3।।
output: ततः then, काञ्चनशैलाभः of the hue of the golden mountain, तरुणार्कनिभाननः whose face was like the rising Sun, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनूमान् Hanuman, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भवत्प्रसादात्सुग्रीवः पितृपैतामहं महत्। वानराणां सुदुष्प्रापं प्राप्तो राज्यमिदं प्रभो4.26.4।।
output: प्रभो O lord, सुग्रीव: Sugriva, सुदुष्प्रापम् that which is difficult to acquire, वानराणाम् of monkeys, इदम् this, पितृपैतामहम् ancestral, महत् great, राज्यम् kingdom, भवत्प्रसादात् by your grace, प्राप्तः has obtained.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भवता समनुज्ञातः प्रविश्य नगरं शुभम्4.26.5।। संविधास्यति कार्याणि सर्वाणि ससुहृज्जनः। स्नातोऽयं विविधैर्गन्धैरौषधैश्च यथाविधि4.26.6।।
output: अयम् he, ससुहृज्जनः along with friends, भवता by you, समनुज्ञातः permitted, शुभम् auspicious, नगरम् city, प्रविश्य on entering, विविधैः with different kinds of, गन्धैः with fragrants, औषधैश्च with medicinal herbs, यथाविधि as per tradition, स्नातः bathed, सर्वाणि all, कार्याणि works, संविधास्यति will do.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भवता समनुज्ञातः प्रविश्य नगरं शुभम्4.26.5।। संविधास्यति कार्याणि सर्वाणि ससुहृज्जनः। स्नातोऽयं विविधैर्गन्धैरौषधैश्च यथाविधि4.26.6।।
output: अयम् he, ससुहृज्जनः along with friends, भवता by you, समनुज्ञातः permitted, शुभम् auspicious, नगरम् city, प्रविश्य on entering, विविधैः with different kinds of, गन्धैः with fragrants, औषधैश्च with medicinal herbs, यथाविधि as per tradition, स्नातः bathed, सर्वाणि all, कार्याणि works, संविधास्यति will do.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
अर्चयिष्यति रत्नैश्च माल्यैश्च त्वां विशेषतः। इमां गिरिगुहां रम्यामभिगन्तुमितोऽर्हसि4.26.7।। कुरुष्व स्वामिसम्बन्धं वानरान्सम्प्रहर्षय।
output: 'He wants to propitiate you first specially with garlands and  gems. Pray enter this beautiful mountain cave for the pleasure of the monkeys and establish relationship with king Sugriva.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तो हनुमता राघवः परवीरहा4.26.8।। प्रत्युवाच हनूमन्तं बुद्धिमान्वाक्यकोविदः।
output: Requested by Hanuman who was skilful in conversation, wise Rama, slayer of enemies, replied:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चतुर्दश समास्सौम्य ग्रामं वा यदि वा पुरम्4.26.9।। न प्रवेक्ष्यामि हनुमन्पितुर्निर्देशपालकः।
output: सौम्य dear, हनुमन् Hanuman, पितुः father's, निर्देशपालकः obedient to  father's command, चतुर्दश fourteen, समाः years, ग्रामं वा a village or, यदि वा or if, पुरम् a city, न प्रवेक्ष्यामि I will not enter.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
सुसमृद्धां गुहां रम्यां सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः4.26.10।। प्रविष्टो विधिवद्वीरः क्षिप्रं राज्येऽभिषिच्यताम्।
output: 'Let Sugriva enter the beautiful prosperous cavern (Kishkinda) and be installed by you as king with due rituals.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वा हनूमन्तं रामस्सुग्रीवमब्रवीत्4.26.11।। वृत्तज्ञो वृत्तसम्पन्नमुदारबलविक्रमम्।
output: वृत्तज्ञः knower of etiquette, रामः Rama, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, वृत्तसम्पन्नम् endowed with wisdom, उदारबलविक्रमम् mighty strong, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इममप्यङ्गदं वीर यौवराज्येऽभिषेचय4.26.12।। ज्येष्ठस्य स सुतो ज्येष्ठस्सदृशो विक्रमेण ते। अङ्गदोऽयमदीनात्मा यौवराज्यस्य भाजनम्4.26.13।।
output: 'O hero consecrate Angada as heirapparent since he deserves it as the eldest son of your brother, a noble soul and equal to you in prowess.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इममप्यङ्गदं वीर यौवराज्येऽभिषेचय4.26.12।। ज्येष्ठस्य स सुतो ज्येष्ठस्सदृशो विक्रमेण ते। अङ्गदोऽयमदीनात्मा यौवराज्यस्य भाजनम्4.26.13।।
output: 'O hero consecrate Angada as heirapparent since he deserves it as the eldest son of your brother, a noble soul and equal to you in prowess.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पूर्वोऽयं वार्षिको मासः श्रावणस्सलिलागमः। प्रवृत्तास्सौम्य चत्वारो मासा वार्षिकसज्ञिकाः4.26.14।।
output: 'O noble Sugriva the four months from now will be rainy season. This is Sravana, the first month of the season in which rain is expected to start pouring.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
नायमुद्योगसमयः प्रविश त्वं पुरीं शुभाम्। अस्मिन्वत्स्याम्यहं सौम्य पर्वते सह लक्ष्मणः4.26.15।।
output: 'O goodnatured Sugriva this is not a suitable time for any endeavour. Go to the auspicious capital city of Kishkinda and I will reside on the mountain with Lakshmana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इयं गिरिगुहा रम्या विशाला युक्तमारुता। प्रभूतसलिला सौम्य प्रभूतकमलोत्पला4.26.16।।
output: 'Dear Sugriva this cavern of the mountain is large and airy. It has abundant water resources with lotuses and lilies.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
कार्तिके समनुप्राप्ते त्वं रावणवधे यत। एष नस्समयस्सौम्य प्रविश त्वं स्वमालयम्4.26.17।। अभिषिक्तस्व राज्ये च सुहृदस्सम्प्रहर्षय।
output: 'Enter the city and get yourself installed and cheer your friends. Make all arrangement for killing Ravana when the month of Kartika begins as it is the proper time (for the purpose).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति रामाभ्यनुज्ञातस्सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः4.26.18।। प्रविवेश पुरीं रम्यां किष्किन्धां वालिपालिताम्।
output: Thus permitted by Rama , Sugriva, lord of the monkeys entered the beautiful city of Kishkinda (once) ruled by Vali.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
तं वानरसहस्राणि प्रविष्टं वानरेश्वरम्4.26.19।। अभिवाद्य प्रविष्टानि सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्।
output: Thousands of monkeys entered the city of Kishkinda along with their king, and stood  in attendance everywhere.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः प्रकृतयस्सर्वा दृष्ट्वा हरिगणेश्वरम्4.26.20।। प्रणम्य मूर्ध्ना पतिता वसुधायां समाहिताः।
output: Then all the subjects of the city collected together, prostrated to the chief of the monkey clan with their forehead touching the ground (as a mark of respect) and sat down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीवः प्रकृतीस्सर्वास्सम्भाष्योत्थाप्य वीर्यवान्4.26.21।। भ्रातुरन्तःपुरं सौम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः।
output: Asking the monkeys to rise to their feet, the mighty and powerful Sugriva entered the inner chambers of his brother.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
प्रविश्य त्वभिनिष्क्रान्तं सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वरम्4.26.22।। अभ्यषिञ्चन्त सुहृदस्सहस्राक्षमिवामराः।
output: With Sugriva,the lord of the monkeys, returned to Kishkinda, his kith and kin  coronated him just as the gods consecrated the thousandeyed Indra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
तस्य पाण्डुरमाजह्रुश्छत्रं हेमपरिष्कृतम्4.26.23।। शुक्ले च वालव्यजने हेमदण्डे यशस्करे। तथा सर्वाणि रत्नानि सर्वबीजौषधीरपि4.26.24 सक्षीराणां च वृक्षाणां प्ररोहान्कुसुमानि च। शुक्लानि चैव वस्त्राणि श्वेतं चैवानुलेपनम्4.26.25।। सुगन्धीनि च माल्यानि स्थलजान्यम्बुजानि च। चन्दनानि च दिव्यानि गन्धांश्च विविधान्बहून्4.26.26।। अक्षतं जातरूपं च प्रियङ्गुमधुसर्पिषी। दधि चर्म च वैयाघ्रं वाराही चाप्युपानहौ4.26.27।। समालम्भनमादाय रोचनां समनश्शिलाम्। आग्मुस्तत्र मुदिता वराः कन्यास्तु षोडश4.26.28।।
output: The monkeys brought a white canopy decorated with gold and two chamaras with glorious golden staff. They also brought jewels, all kinds of medicinal herbs, sprouts, sap from trees, white flowers and white clothes, unguents, garlands of fragrant lotuses that grow on land and water, heavently sandal, fragrants of different kinds, goldcoloured paddy, honey of priyanga, curds, tiger skin and sandals made of boar skin. Then sixteen beautiful, cheerful females appeared with unguent, gorochana mixed with red arsenic (used for putting tilaka on the forehead).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्ते वानरश्रेष्ठं यथाकालं यथाविधि। रत्नैर्वस्त्रैश्च भक्ष्यैश्च तोषयित्वा द्विजर्षभान्4.26.29।।
output: Then they duly propitiated the brahmins, offering them gifts of gems, clothes and eatables.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
ततः कुशपरिस्तीर्णं समिद्धं जातवेदसम्। मन्त्रपूतेन हविषा हुत्वा मन्त्रविदो जनाः4.26.30।।
output: Then the priests (people who recite Vedic hymns) strew around kusa grass, kindled sacred fire with recitation of mantras and made offerings of havis into the fire.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो हेमप्रतिष्ठाने वरास्तरणसंवृते। प्रासादशिखरे रम्ये चित्रमाल्योपशोभिते4.26.31।। प्राङ्मुखं विविधैर्मन्त्रै: स्थापयित्वा वरासने। नदीनदेभ्यस्संहृत्य तीर्थेभ्यश्च समन्ततः4.26.32।। आहृत्य च समुद्रेभ्यस्सर्वेभ्यो वानरर्षभाः। अपः कनककुम्भेषु निधाय विमलाश्शुभाः4.26.33।। शुभैर्वृषभशृङ्गैश्च कलशैश्चापि काञ्चनैः। शास्त्रदृष्टेन विधिना महर्षिविहितेन च4.26.34।। गजो गवाक्षो गवयश्शरभो गन्धमादनः। मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चैव हनुमान्जाम्बवान्नलः4.26.35।। अभ्यषिञ्चन्त सुग्रीवं प्रसन्नेन सुगन्धिना। सलिलेन सहस्राक्षं वसवो वासवं यथा4.26.36।।
output: Then Sugriva was seated facing the east on a golden throne with fine coverings on top of the mansion decorated with multicoloured garlands. As per tradition, sacred waters  collected from rivers and rivulets and stored in golden pots was aportioned in accordance with the procedure ordained by the sages in sastras. At the appropriate time the pure and fragrant water was poured by Gaja, Gavaya, Sarabha, Mainda, Dvivida, Hanumanta, Jambavan and Nala on Sugriva, the bull among monkeys through horns of bulls and jars of gold, like the eight Vasus bathed the thousandeyed Indra. Thus they performed the consecration.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे सर्वे वानरपुङ्गवाः। प्रचुक्रुशुर्महात्मानो हृष्टा स्तत्र सहस्रशः 4.26.37।।
output: As Sugriva was ceremoniously consecrated, thousands of monkeys rejoiced and shrieked out of joy.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्य तु वचः कुर्वन्सुग्रीवो हरिपुङ्गवः। अङ्गदं सम्परिष्वज्य यौवराज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्4.26.38।।
output: In obedience to Rama's instruction, Sugriva, lord of the monkeys installed Angada as prince regent and embraced him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
अङ्गदे चाभिषिक्ते तु सानुक्रोशाः प्लवङ्गमाः। साधु साध्विति सुग्रीवं महात्मानोऽभ्यपूजयन्4.26.39।।
output: The great monkeys concerned hailed Sugriva's action  saying, 'well done, well done' on the installation of Angada.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामं चैव महात्मानं लक्ष्मणं च पुनः पुनः। प्रीताश्च तुष्टुवुस्सर्वे तादृशे तत्र वर्तिते4.26.40।।
output: तत्र there, तादृशे on such an occasion, वर्तिते when it happened, सर्वे all, प्रीताश्च pleased, महात्मानम् great soul, रामं चैव Rama also, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, पुनः पुनः again and again, तुष्टुवुः praised.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 26:
हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा पताकाध्वजशोभिता। बभूव नगरी रम्या किष्किन्धा गिरिगह्वरे4.26.41।।
output: The beautiful city of Kishkinda situated in a mountaincave, decorated with banners and flags was filled with happy, wellfed citizens.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम्। आजगाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्रवणं गिरिम्4.27.1।।
output: After the consecration, Sugriva entered the cavecity (of Kishkinda) and Rama accompanied by his brother reached mountain Prasravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
शार्दूलमृगसङ्घुष्टं सिंहैर्भीमरवैर्वृतम्। नानागुल्मलतागूढं बहुपादपसङ्कुलम्4.27.2।। ऋक्षवानरगोपुच्छैर्मार्जारैश्च निषेवितम्। मेघराशिनिभं शैलं नित्यं शुचिजलाशयम्।।4.27.3।।
output: The (Prasravana) mountain reverberated with the terrific roars of tigers and deer and lions. There were several kinds of shrubs, creepers and trees.It was inhabited by bears, apes, monkeys and wild cats in large number. The mountain was like a huge cluster of clouds. The waters in the ponds were pure.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य शैलस्य शिखरे महतीमायतां गुहाम्। प्रत्यगृह्णत वासार्थं रामस्सौमित्रिणा सह4.27.4।।
output: रामः Rama, सौमित्रिणा सह with Saumitri, तस्य शैलस्य  mountain's, शिखरे on the top, महतीम् great long, आयताम् wide, गुहाम् cave, वासार्थम्  to reside, प्रत्यगृह्णत  decided to reside.

instruction:

output: Sinless Rama, the delight of the Raghus made an agreement with Sugriva and then spoke appropriately to Lakshmana, his obedient brother and enhancer of glory:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
इयं गिरिगुहा रम्या विशाला युक्तमारुता। अस्यां वत्स्याम सौमित्रे वर्षरात्रमरिन्दम4.27.6।।
output: 'O Saumitri, subduer of enemies this beautiful mountain cave is spacious and  adequately ventilated. We will reside here in the rainy season.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गिरिशृङ्गमिदं रम्यमुन्नतं पार्थिवात्मज4.27.7।। श्वेताभिः कृष्णताम्राभिश्शिलाभिरुपशोभितम्। नानाधातुसमाकीर्णं दरीनिर्झरशोभितम्4.27.8।। विविधैर्वृक्षषण्डैश्च चारुचित्रलतायुतम्। नानाविहगसङ्घुष्टं मयूररवनादितम्4.27.9।। मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च सिन्धुवारैश्शिरीषकैः। कदम्बार्जुनसर्जैश्च पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्4.27.10।।
output: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.

output: पार्थिवात्मज O prince, श्वेताभिः with white, कृष्णताम्राभिः with black and red, शिलाभिः with stones, उपशोभितम् is very enchanting, नाना धातुसमाकीर्णम् with different kinds of minerals scattered all over, दरीनिर्झरशोभितम् having fascinating caves and waterfalls, विविधैः with different, वृक्षषण्डैश्च with clusters of trees, चारुचित्रलतायुतम् with fascinating vines, नानाविहगसङ्घुष्टम् crowded with different birds, मयूरवरनादितम् with sounds of peacocks, मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च with bushes of delicate Jasmine and kunda, सिन्धुवारैः sindhuvara flower plants, शिरीषकै: sireeshaka trees, पुष्पितैः in bloom, सर्जैश्च and with sarja trees, उपशोभितम् very delighting, उत्तमम् best, इदम् this, गिरिशृङ्गम् this peak of mountain, उन्नतम् is lofty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गिरिशृङ्गमिदं रम्यमुन्नतं पार्थिवात्मज4.27.7।। श्वेताभिः कृष्णताम्राभिश्शिलाभिरुपशोभितम्। नानाधातुसमाकीर्णं दरीनिर्झरशोभितम्4.27.8।। विविधैर्वृक्षषण्डैश्च चारुचित्रलतायुतम्। नानाविहगसङ्घुष्टं मयूररवनादितम्4.27.9।। मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च सिन्धुवारैश्शिरीषकैः। कदम्बार्जुनसर्जैश्च पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्4.27.10।।
output: पार्थिवात्मज O prince, श्वेताभिः with white, कृष्णताम्राभिः with black and red, शिलाभिः with stones, उपशोभितम् is very enchanting, नाना धातुसमाकीर्णम् with different kinds of minerals scattered all over, दरीनिर्झरशोभितम् having fascinating caves and waterfalls, विविधैः with different, वृक्षषण्डैश्च with clusters of trees, चारुचित्रलतायुतम् with fascinating vines, नानाविहगसङ्घुष्टम् crowded with different birds, मयूरवरनादितम् with sounds of peacocks, मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च with bushes of delicate Jasmine and kunda, सिन्धुवारैः sindhuvara flower plants, शिरीषकै: sireeshaka trees, पुष्पितैः in bloom, सर्जैश्च and with sarja trees, उपशोभितम् very delighting, उत्तमम् best, इदम् this, गिरिशृङ्गम् this peak of mountain, उन्नतम् is lofty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गिरिशृङ्गमिदं रम्यमुन्नतं पार्थिवात्मज4.27.7।। श्वेताभिः कृष्णताम्राभिश्शिलाभिरुपशोभितम्। नानाधातुसमाकीर्णं दरीनिर्झरशोभितम्4.27.8।। विविधैर्वृक्षषण्डैश्च चारुचित्रलतायुतम्। नानाविहगसङ्घुष्टं मयूररवनादितम्4.27.9।। मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च सिन्धुवारैश्शिरीषकैः। कदम्बार्जुनसर्जैश्च पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्4.27.10।।

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इयं च नलिनी रम्या फ़ुल्लपङ्कजमण्डिता। नातिदूरे गुहायानौ भविष्यति नृपात्मज4.27.11।।
output: नृपात्मज son of a king, फ़ुल्लपङ्कजमण्डिता adorned with lotuses in full bloom, रम्या endearing, इयं नलिनी this lotus creeper, नौ for us, गुहायाः from the cave, नातिदूरे not far from here, भविष्यति is located.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रागुदक्प्रवणे देशे गुहा साधु भविष्यति। पश्चाच्चैवोन्नता सौम्य निवातेयं भविष्यति4.27.12।।
output: सौम्य goodnatured Lakshmana, प्रागुदक्प्रवणे descending path in the northeast, देशे of this place, गुहा cave, साधु auspicious, भविष्यति it will be, पश्चात् west side, उन्नता elevated, इयम् this, निवाता free from strong wind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गुहाद्वारे च सौमित्रे शिला समतला शुभा। श्लक्ष्णा चैवायता चैव भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमा4.27.13।।
output: 'O Lakshmana at the entrance of the cave is a rock, smooth and large,  resembling a heap of shining collyrium.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
गिरिशृङ्गमिदं तात पश्य चोत्तरतः शुभम्। भिन्नाञ्जनचयाकारमम्भोधरमिवोत्थितम्4.27.14।।
output: 'O dear look at the mountain peak in the north rising like a raincloud.It is auspicious.  It resembles a heap of collyrium.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दक्षिणस्यामपि दिशि स्थितं श्वेतमिवापरम्। कैलासशिखरप्रख्यं नानाधातुविभूषितम्4.27.15।।
output: दक्षिणस्यांदिशि in the southern direction, स्थितम् is located, श्वेतम् white, इवापरम् like another, कैलासशिखर प्रख्यम् like the tip of Kailasa mountain, नानाधातुविभूषितम् rich with various minerals.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्राचीनवाहिनीं चैव नदीं भृशमकर्दमाम्। गुहायाः पूर्वतः पश्य त्रिकूटे जाह्नवीमिव4.27.16।। चन्दनैस्तिलकैस्तालैस्तमालैरतिमुक्तकैः। पद्मकैः सरलैश्चैव अशोकैश्चैव शोभिताम्4.27.17।।
output: प्राचीनवाहिनीम् flowing towards the east, भृशम् greatly, अकर्दमाम् pure, चन्दनैः with sandalwood, तिलकैः with tilaka, सालैः with sala, तमा tamala, अतिमुक्तकैः with  atimuktaka (a lustrous jasmine creeper which sheds flowers profusely), पद्मकैः with Padmaka, सरलैश्चैव with sarala, अशोकैश्चैव and with asoka, शोभिताम् fascinating, त्रिकूटे at Trikuta, जाह्नवीमिव like the river Jahnavi, नदीम् river, गुहायाः from the caves, पूर्वतः to the east, पश्य see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
प्राचीनवाहिनीं चैव नदीं भृशमकर्दमाम्। गुहायाः पूर्वतः पश्य त्रिकूटे जाह्नवीमिव4.27.16।। चन्दनैस्तिलकैस्तालैस्तमालैरतिमुक्तकैः। पद्मकैः सरलैश्चैव अशोकैश्चैव शोभिताम्4.27.17।।
output: 'Look at the river flowing towards the east. It has clean water and flows towards the east of the cave and looks like the river Jahnavi flowing on the mount Trikuta. This place looks delightful with the sandalwood, tilaka, sala, tamala, atimukta, padmaka, sarala and asoka trees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानीरैस्तिमिशैश्चैव वकुलैः केतकैर्धवैः। हिन्तालैस्तिनिशैर्नीपैर्वेत्रकैः कृतमालकैः4.27.18।। तीरजैश्शोभिता भाति नानारूपै स्ततस्ततः। वसनाभरणोपेता प्रमदेवाभ्यलङ्कृता4.27.19।।
output: तीरजैः  grown on the bank, नानारूपैः different kinds of, ततस्ततः here and there, वानीरैः with cane reeds, तिमिशै: timis, एव with,वकुलैः vakula,केतकैर्धवै: ketaka, हिन्तालैः hintala, तिनिशैः tinisa, नीपैः (नीपवृक्षैः) kadamba trees, वेत्रकैः cane creepers, धवैः dhavas, कृतमालकैः krutamalaka, वेतसैः  betasa, शोभिता beautiful, वसनाभरणोपेता with clothes and ornaments, अभ्यलङ्कृता decorated, प्रमदेव like a woman, भाति looks.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानीरैस्तिमिशैश्चैव वकुलैः केतकैर्धवैः। हिन्तालैस्तिनिशैर्नीपैर्वेत्रकैः कृतमालकैः4.27.18।। तीरजैश्शोभिता भाति नानारूपै स्ततस्ततः। वसनाभरणोपेता प्रमदेवाभ्यलङ्कृता4.27.19।।
output: तीरजैः  grown on the bank, नानारूपैः different kinds of, ततस्ततः here and there, वानीरैः with cane reeds, तिमिशै: timis, एव with,वकुलैः vakula,केतकैर्धवै: ketaka, हिन्तालैः hintala, तिनिशैः tinisa, नीपैः (नीपवृक्षैः) kadamba trees, वेत्रकैः cane creepers, धवैः dhavas, कृतमालकैः krutamalaka, वेतसैः  betasa, शोभिता beautiful, वसनाभरणोपेता with clothes and ornaments, अभ्यलङ्कृता decorated, प्रमदेव like a woman, भाति looks.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
शतशः पक्षिसङ्घैश्च नानानादैर्विनादिता। एकैकमनुरक्तैश्च चक्रवाकैरलङ्कृता।।4.27.20।। पुलिनैरतिरम्यैश्च हंससारससेवितैः। प्रहसन्तीवभात्येषा नारी सर्वविभूषिता।।4.27.21।।
output: 'The river flocked with hundreds of birds chirping melodious notes and specially the chakravaka birds which are clinging to their mates in great love are moving in pairs.The river has lovely sandy banks filled with swans and sarasa birds. The river appears as though a young woman decked all over is laughing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शतशः पक्षिसङ्घैश्च नानानादैर्विनादिता। एकैकमनुरक्तैश्च चक्रवाकैरलङ्कृता।।4.27.20।। पुलिनैरतिरम्यैश्च हंससारससेवितैः। प्रहसन्तीवभात्येषा नारी सर्वविभूषिता।।4.27.21।।
output: शतशः in hundreds, पक्षिसङ्घैश्च with flocks of birds, नानानादैर्विनादिता resounded with different melodies, एकैकम् each one, अनुरक्तैश्च by the loving ones, चक्रवाकैः by ruddy geese, अलङ्कृता beautified, अतिरम्यैः enchanting, पुलिनैः sandy banks, हंससारससेवितैः filled with swans and watercranes, एषा this, सर्वविभूषिता decorated all over, प्रहसन्ती laughing, नारीव  like a young woman, भाति shines.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्वचिन्नीलोत्पलैश्छन्ना भाति रक्तोत्पलैः क्वचित्। क्वचिदाभाति शुक्लैश्च दिव्यैः कुमुदकुट्मलैः4.27.22।।
output: क्वचित् at one place, नीलोत्पलैः with blue lotuses, क्वचित् at another place, रक्तोत्पलैः with red lotuses, छन्ना covered, भाति splendid looking, क्वचित् at some places, शुक्लैश्च with white lotuses, दिव्यैः wonderful, कुमुदकुट्मलैः lotus buds, आभाति appears.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
पारिप्लवशतैर्जुष्टा बर्हिक्रौञ्चविनादिता। रमणीया नदी सौम्य मुनिसङ्घैर्निषेविता4.27.23।।
output: 'This placid river water is haunted by waterbirds, peacocks and kraunchas, It is inhabited by groups of sages.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
पश्य चन्दनवृक्षाणां पङ्क्तीस्सुरचिता इव। ककुभानां च दृश्यन्ते मनसेवोदितास्समम्4.27.24।।
output: 'See the uniform rows of sandalwood trees, it looks as though they are arranged together imaginatively.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
अहो सुरमणीयोऽयं देशश्शत्रुनिषूदन। दृढं रंस्याव सौमित्रे साध्वत्र निवसावहै4.27.25।।
output: 'O Saumitri destroyer of enemies this place is most enchanting. Surely we will reside here sporting in joy .

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
इतश्च नातिदूरे सा किष्किन्धा चित्रकानना। सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या भविष्यति नृपात्मज4.27.26।।
output: 'O prince  Sugriva's delightful city of Kishkinda with wonderful forest around is not  far from here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषश्श्रूयते जयतां वर। नर्दतां वानराणां च मृदङ्गाडम्बरै स्सह4.27.27।।
output: 'O hero among the victorious, the sounds of vocal and instrumental music, the beating of drums and shrieking of monkeys are heard (from here).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लब्ध्वा भार्यां कपिवरः प्राप्य राज्यं सुहृद्वृतः। ध्रुवं नन्दति सुग्रीवस्सम्प्राप्य महतीं श्रियम्4.27.28।।
output: कपिवरः monkey chief, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, भार्याम् wife, लब्ध्वा having obtained, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्य having attained, महतीम् very great, श्रियम् prosperity, सम्प्राप्य having earned, सहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends and relatives, नन्दति he is enjoying, ध्रुवम् surely.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्त्वा न्यवसत्तत्र राघवस्सहलक्ष्मणः। बहुदृश्यदरीकुञ्जे तस्मिन्प्रस्रवणे गिरौ4.27.29।।
output: Having said so, Rama resided with Lakshmana on the Prasvarana mountain with many beautiful caverns and shrubs of vines.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुसुखेऽपि बहुद्रव्ये तस्मिन्हि धरणीधरे। वसतस्तस्य रामस्य रतिरल्पापिना भवेत्4.27.30।।
output: सुसुखे in comfort, बहुद्रव्ये richly endowed, तस्मिन् in that, धरणीधरे on that mountain, वसतः while residing, तस्य रामस्य for that Rama's, अल्पापि even a little, रतिः pleasure, नाभवत् was not experienced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
हृतां हि भार्यां स्मरतः प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसीम्। उदयाभ्युदितं दृष्ट्वा शशाङ्कं च विशेषतः4.27.31।।
output: Specially with the rising Moon in the east, he remembered his abuducted wife who was dearer to him than his life.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आविवेश न तं निद्रा निशासु शयनं गतम्। तत्समुत्थेन शोकेन बाष्पोपहतचेतसम्4.27.32।।
output: तत्समुत्थेन rising, शोकेन by grief, बाष्पोपहतचेतसम् mind befogged with tears, निशासु nights, शयनम् while lying in bed, गतम् gone, तम् he, निद्रा sleep, न आविवेश did not take hold him, निशासु during nights.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं शोचमानं काकुत्स्थं नित्यं शोकपरायणम्। तुल्यदुःखोऽब्रवीद्भ्राता लक्ष्मणोऽनुनयन्वचः4.27.33।।
output: Seeing Rama worried and engrossed in endless sorrow, his brother Lakshmana who was equally sad spoke these words of consolation:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अलं वीर व्यथां गत्वा न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि। शोचतो व्यवसीदन्ति सर्वार्था विदितं हि ते4.27.34।।
output: वीर O hero, व्यथाम् pain, गत्वा अलम् stop it, त्वम् you, शोचितुम् to worry, न अर्हसि you do not deserve, शोचतः by grieving, सर्वार्थाः all objects, व्यवसीदन्ति हि sink, ते to you, विदितं हि you are aware of this.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवान्क्रियापरो लोके भवान् देवपरायणः। आस्तिको धर्मशीलश्च व्यवसायी च राघव4.27.35।। न ह्यव्यवसितश्शत्रुं राक्षसं तं विशेषतः। समर्थस्त्वं रणे हन्तुं विक्रमैर्जिह्मकारिणम्4.27.36।।
output: 'O Rama you are a man of action, enterprising. You are godfearing, righteous and religious. You will not be able to kill a crooked enemy in a battle, especially a demon, with your valour if you make no endeavour.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवान्क्रियापरो लोके भवान् देवपरायणः। आस्तिको धर्मशीलश्च व्यवसायी च राघव4.27.35।। न ह्यव्यवसितश्शत्रुं राक्षसं तं विशेषतः। समर्थस्त्वं रणे हन्तुं विक्रमैर्जिह्मकारिणम्4.27.36।।
output: 'O Rama you are a man of action, enterprising. You are godfearing, righteous and religious. You will not be able to kill a crooked enemy in a battle, especially a demon, with your valour if you make no endeavour.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समुन्मूलय शोकं त्वं व्यवसायं स्थिरं कुरु। ततस्सपरिवारं तं निर्मूलं कुरु राक्षसम्।।4.27.37।।
output: त्वम् you, शोकम् sorrow, समुन्मूलय  may uproot, व्यवसायम् daring, स्थिरं कुरु be firm in resolve, ततः then, सपरिवारम् along with all relatives, तं निर्मूलं  him destroy, कुरु you do, राक्षसम् that demon.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पृथिवीमपि काकुत्स्थ ससागरवनाचलाम्। परिवर्तयितुं शक्तः किमङ्गपुन रावणम्4.27.38।।
output: 'O Kakutstha, you can turn the earth with its oceans, forests and mountains, what to speak of Ravana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शरत्कालं प्रतीक्षस्व प्रावृट्कालोऽयमागतः। ततस्सराष्ट्रं सगणं रावणं त्वं वधिष्यसि4.27.39।।
output: अयम् this, प्रावृट्कालः rainy season, आगतः has set in, शरत्कालम् autumn, प्रतीक्षस्व you may wait for, ततः then, सराष्ट्रम् along with his country, सगणम् along with his troops, त्वं you, रावणम्  Ravana, वधिष्यसि will slay.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं तु खलु ते वीर्यं प्रसुप्तं प्रतिबोधये। दीप्सैराहुतिभिः काले भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम्4.27.40।।
output: 'I am only awakening your dormant valour as one would kindle the fire covered with ashes by making offerings.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लक्ष्मणस्य तु तद्वाक्यं प्रतिपूज्य हितं शुभम्। राघवस्सुहृदं स्निग्धमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।4.27.41।।
output: राघवः Rama, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, हितम् good counsel, शुभम् auspicious, तत् वाक्यम् those words, प्रतिपूज्य respecting, सुहृदम् warm hearted, स्निग्धं loving, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
वाच्यं यदनुरक्तेन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च। सत्यविक्रमयुक्तेन तदुक्तं लक्ष्मण त्वया4.27.42।।
output: 'O Lakshmana you have spoken the words of an affectionate and friendly counsellor of proven valour.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष शोकः परित्यक्तस्सर्वकार्यावसादकः। विक्रमेष्वप्रतिहतं तेजः प्रोत्साहयाम्यहम्।।4.27.43।।
output: सर्वकार्यावसादकः which can destroy all work, एषःthis, शोकः sorrow, परित्यक्तः is given up, अहम् I, विक्रमेषु during heroic exploits, अप्रतिहतम् unaffected, तेजः vigour प्रोत्सहयामि  I will resort to

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 27:
शरत्कालं प्रतीक्षिष्ये स्थितोऽस्मि वचने तव। सुग्रीवस्य नदीनां च प्रसादमनुपालयन्4.27.44।।
output: 'I will wait for autumn. I will stick to your advice while I wait until Sugriva and the rivers are pleased (with moderate flow of water.)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपकारेण वीरस्तु प्रतीकारेण युज्यते। अकृतज्ञोऽप्रतिकृतो हन्ति सत्त्ववतां मनः4.27.45।।
output: उपकारेण with him, वीरः hero, प्रतीकारेण by helping in turn, युज्यते will not fail to do, अकृतज्ञः ungrateful, अप्रतिकृतः one who does not return a favour, सत्त्ववताम् spirited people's, मनः heart, हन्ति destroys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथैव मुक्तःप्रणिधाय लक्ष्मणः कृताञ्जलिस्तत्प्रतिपूज्य भाषितम्। उवाच रामं स्वभिरामदर्शनं प्रदर्शयन्दर्शनमात्मनश्शुभम्4.27.46।।
output: Then Lakshmana reflected upon the words of Rama thoughtfully. He honoured his brother's words by receiving his advice with folded hands and spoke to his handsome brother giving out his own views:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथोक्तमेतत्तव सर्वमीप्सितं नरेन्द्र कर्ता न चिराद्धरीश्वरः। शरत्प्रतीक्षः क्षमतामिमं भवान् जलप्रपातं रिपुनिग्रहे धृतः4.27.47।।
output: नरेन्द्र king, यथा as, अद्धरीश्वर excellant king, नचिरात् soon, तव your, ईप्सितम् desire, एतत् सर्वम् all this, कर्ता going to do, रिपुनिग्रहे to combat with the enemy, धृतः be determined, भवान् thyself, शरत्प्रतीक्षः waiting for autumn, इमम् this, जलप्रपातम् waterflow, क्षमताम्  forgive.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नियम्य कोपं प्रतिपाल्यतां शरत् क्षमस्व मासां श्चतुरो मया सह। वसाचलेऽस्मिन्मृगराजसेविते संवर्धयन् शत्रुवधे समुद्यमम्4.27.48।।
output: शत्रुवधे in slaying of enemies, समुद्यमम् effort, क्षमस्व you may pardon, कोपम् anger, नियम्य controlling, शरत् autumn, प्रतिपाल्यताम् you may wait for, चतुरः four, मासान् months, संवर्तयन्  carrying out, मृगराजसेविते inhabited by lions, अस्मिन् अचले on this mountain, मया सह along with me, वस stay.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
स तदा वालिनं हत्वा सुग्रीवमभिषिच्य च। वसन्माल्यवतः पृष्ठे रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्4.28.1।।
output: After the killing of Vali and installation of Sugriva as king, Rama arrived at mountain Malyavan to reside.He said to Lakshmana:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयं स कालस्सम्प्राप्तस्समयोऽद्य जलागमः। सम्पश्य त्वं नभो मेघैस्संवृतं गिरिसन्निभैः4.28.2।।
output: 'Now that the rainy season has started, see the sky covered with mountainlike (huge) clouds.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नवमासधृतं गर्भं भास्करस्य गभस्तिभिः। पीत्वा रसं समुद्राणां द्यौः प्रसूते रसायनम्4.28.3।।
output: 'The sky has drained the water from the oceans through the Sun's rays and has borne it for nine months (from Kartika to Asarha) in its womb. It delivers water which is the base for all juices.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
शक्यमम्बरमारुह्य मेघसोपानपङ्क्तिभिः। कुटजार्जुनमालाभिरलङ्कर्तुं दिवाकरम्4.28.4।।
output: 'It is possible to climb up to the sky on the stairs formed by the clouds and decorate the Sungod with garlands made of kutaja and arjuna flowers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्ध्यारागोत्थितैस्ताम्रैरन्तेष्वधिक पाण्डरैः। स्निग्धैरभ्रपटच्छेदैर्बद्धव्रणमिवाम्बरम्4.28.5।।
output: 'The sky looks as though its wounds are dressed with pale white moistureladen bandage cloths of clouds, red in the border, tinged as they are with the glow of twilight.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मन्दमारुत निश्वासं सन्ध्याचन्दनरञ्जितम्। आपाण्डुजलदं भाति कामातुरमिवाम्बरम्4.28.6।।
output: 'The sky with its gentle winds as its sighs, its ash coloured clouds (suggestive of a pale face) painted with red sandalpaste in the form of glow of twilight appears like a passionate lover.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषा घर्मपरिक्लिष्टा नववारिपरिप्लुता। सीतेव शोकसन्तप्ता मही बाष्पं विमुञ्चति4.28.7।।
output: घर्मपरिक्लिष्टा scorched by the heat, नववारिपरिप्लुता flooded with fresh rain water, एषा मही the earth that way, शोकसन्तप्ता burning with grief, सीतेव like Sita, बाष्पम् tears, विमुञ्चति is shedding.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मेघोदरविनिर्मुक्ताः कह्लारसुखशीतलाः। शक्यमञ्जलिभिः पातुं वाताः केतकिगन्धिनः4.28.8।।
output: 'The winds released from the wombs of clouds, cool as the delicate touch of white lotuses,charged with the fragrance of ketaka flowers can be inhaled through the hollow of one's palms.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष फुल्लार्जुनश्शैलः केतकैरधिवासितः। सुग्रीव इव शान्तारिर्धाराभिरभिषिच्यते4.28.9।।
output: फुल्लार्जुनः arjuna flowers, केतकैः ketaka flowers, अधिवासितः filled with fragrance, एषः शैलः this mountain that way, शान्तारिः tranquilled by the destruction of enemy, सुग्रीव इव like Sugriva, धाराभिः with flowing water, अभिषिच्यते is consecrated.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
मेघकृष्णाजिनधरा: धारायज्ञोपवीतिनः। मारुतापूरितगुहाः प्राधीता इव पर्वताः4.28.10।।
output: 'The mountains are covered with dark clouds which appear like the hide of the antelope. Streams of rain water flowing are like the sacred threads hanging down the shoulder and the sounds of wind filling the caves resemble the recitation of Vedas by priests. (These mountains are comparable to the brahmacharins engaged in the recitation of Vedas wearing antelopeskin and sacred threads).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कशाभिरिव हैमीभिर्विद्युद्भिरिवताडितम्। अन्तस्त्सतनिर्घोषं सवेदनमिवाम्बरम्4.28.11।।
output: हैमीभिः by the golden, कशाभिरिव whips, विद्युद्भि: by the lightnings, ताडितम् lashed, स्तनित thunder, निर्घोषम् sounds, अम्बरम् sky, अन्तः inside, सवेदनमिव as if crying in severe pain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
नीलमेघाश्रिता विद्युत्स्फुरन्ती प्रतिभाति मा। स्फुरन्ती रावणस्याङ्के वैदेहीव तपस्विनी4.28.12।।
output: 'The triggering of lightning in the dark clouds appears to me like austere Vaidehi struggling helplessly to get free from the lap of Ravana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इमास्ता मन्मथवतां हिताः प्रतिहता दिशः। अनुलिप्ता इव घनैर्नष्टग्रहनिशाकराः4.28.13।।
output: मन्मथवताम् for the lovers, हिताः favourable, प्रतिहताः blocked, नष्टग्रहनिशाकराः Moon or planets seized to appear, इमाः this, ताः दिशः directions, घनैः with dense clouds, अनुलिप्ता इव as if smeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
चिद्बाष्पाभिसंरुद्धान् वर्षागमसमुत्सुकान्। कुटजान्पश्य सौमित्रे पुष्पितान्गिरिसानुषु4.28.14।। मम शोकाभिभूतस्य कामसन्दीपनान् स्थितान्।
output: 'O Saumitri look at the kutaja flowers standing on the mountain slopes withered by the heat. They welcome the fresh showers of rain and rekindle passion in me even though my heart is overwhelmed with grief.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
रजः प्रशान्तं सहिमोऽद्य वायु र्निदाघदोषप्रसराः प्रशान्ताः। स्थिता हि यात्रा वसुधाधिपानां प्रवासिनो यान्ति नरास्स्वदेशान्4.28.15।।
output: 'Now the dust has settled and the wind carrying mist is cool. The torments of summer have ceased. The expeditions of kings have come to a stop and the travellers return to their native land.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
सम्प्रस्थिता मानसवासलुब्धाः प्रियान्विताः सम्प्रति चक्रवाकाः। अभीक्ष्णवर्षोदकविक्षतेषु यानानि मार्गेषु न सम्पतन्ति4.28.16।।
output: 'Desirous of living in Manasa lake swans have set out on their journey and the chakravaka birds are now united with their mates. The carts move not on the roads damaged by heavy rains.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्वचित्प्रकाशं क्वचिदप्रकाशं नभः प्रकीर्णाम्बुधरं विभाति। क्वचित्क्वचित्पर्वतसन्निरुद्धं रूपं यथा शान्तमहार्णवस्य4.28.17।।
output: 'The sky which is visible here is not visible there due to clouds scattered. It looks bright (blue) here and dull there. It appears like an unruffled ocean interspersed with hills here and there.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
व्यामिश्रितं सार्जकदम्बपुष्पै र्नवं जलं पर्वतधातुताम्रम्। मयूरकेकाभिरनुप्रयातं शैलापगाश्शीघ्रतरं वहन्ति4.28.18।।
output: 'The mountainstreams of rainwater mingled with sarja and kadamba flowers carry fresh water swiftly to the ocean along with the deposits of red mineral rocks of the mountain. Hark, the peacock cries.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रसाकुलं षट्पदसन्निकाशं प्रभुज्यते जम्बुफलं प्रकामम्। अनेकवर्णं पवनावधूतं भूमौ पतत्याम्रफलं विपक्वम्4.28.19।।
output: रसाकुलम् very juicy, षट्पदसन्निकाशम् like the black bee, जम्बुफलम् jambu fruit, प्रकामम् to the heart's content, प्रभुज्यते are eaten, अनेकवर्णम् of multiple colours, विपक्वम् fully ripened, आम्रफलम् mango fruit, पवनावधूतम् shaken by the wind, भूमौ on the ground, पतति fall.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विद्युत्पताकास्सबलाकमालाः शैलेन्द्रकूटाकृतिसन्निकाशाः। गर्जन्ति मेघाः समुदीर्णनादाः मत्ता गजेन्द्रा इव संयुगस्थाः4.28.20।।
output: विद्युत्पताकाः with banners of lightning, सबलाकमालाः closely connected garlands (rows) of herons, शैलेन्द्रकूटाकृतिसन्निकाशाः resembling the shapes of high mountain peaks, मेघाः clouds, संयुगस्थाः marching in wars, मत्ताः proud, गजेन्द्रा इव resembling elephants, समुदीर्णनादाः trumpetting in excitement, गर्जन्ति rumble.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
वर्षोदकाप्यायितशाद्वलानि प्रवृत्तनृत्तोत्सवबर्हिणानि। वनानि निर्वृष्टवलाहकानि पश्यापराह्णेष्वधिकं विभान्ति4.28.21।।
output: 'The tender green grass of the forest is shining with rainwater, the peacocks are having dance festival and the forests look more enchanting  in the afternoon.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समुद्वहन्त स्सलिलातिभारं बलाकिनो वारिधरा नदन्तः। महत्सु शृङ्गेषु महीधराणां विश्रम्य विश्रम्य पुनः प्रयान्ति4.28.22।।
output: 'The huge rumbling clouds on the high mountain peaks carry heavy load of water. Now they rest and now resume their journey accompanied by herons.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मेघाभिकामा परिसम्पतन्ती सम्मोदिता भाति बलाकपङ्क्तिः। वातावधूता वरपौण्डरीकी लम्बेव माला रचिताम्बरस्य4.28.23।।
output: 'The happy rows of herons flying in the sky to meet the clouds, appear like a long garland of choice white lotuses strung together hanging in the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बालेन्द्रगोपान्तरचित्रितेन विभाति भूमिर्नवशाद्वलेन। गात्रानुपृक्तेन शुकप्रभेण नारीव लाक्षोक्षितकम्बलेन4.28.24।।
output: बालेन्द्रगोपान्तरचित्रितेन dotted with small Indragopa insects, नवशाद्वलेन with fresh grass, भूमिः ground, गात्रानुपृक्तेन touching their body, शुकप्रभेण with parrot green,लाक्षोक्षितकम्बलेन with a veil dotted with redlac dye sprinkled on it, नारीव like a lady, विभाति is shining.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निद्रा शनैः केशवमभ्युपैति द्रुतं नदी सागरमभ्युपैति। हृष्टा बलाका घनमभ्युपैति कान्ता सकामा प्रियमभ्युपैति4.28.25।।
output: 'Sleep steals over Lord Visnu. The rivers run swiftly to the sea, the female herons fly to catch the clouds joyfully. The young bride eagerly approaches her dear lord. (It is believed that Lord Visnu goes to sleep during chaturmasya, ie. from Asarh to Kartik)

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
जाता वनान्ताश्शिखिसम्प्रनृत्ता जाताः कदम्बाः सकदम्बशाखाः। जाता वृषा गोषु समानकामा जाता मही सस्यवनाभिरामा4.28.26।।
output: 'Peacocks dance in the forest. The branches of the kadamba trees get filled with flowers. Bulls long for union with the cows. The earth looks beautiful with green crops and trees.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
वहन्ति वर्षन्ति नदन्ति भान्ति ध्यायन्ति नृत्यन्ति समाश्वसन्ति। नद्यो घना मत्तगजा वनान्ताः प्रियाविहीनाश्शिखिनः प्लवङ्गमाः4.28.27।।
output: 'The clouds are raining. The rivers are flowing. Proud elephants are trumpeting. Those separated from their loved ones are brooding. The monkeys are quiet and the peacocks are dancing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रहर्षिताः केतकपुष्पगन्ध माघ्राय हृष्टा वननिर्झरेषु। प्रपातशब्दाकुलिता गजेन्द्रा स्सार्धं मयूरै स्समदा नदन्ति4.28.28।।
output: 'The lordly elephants get intoxicated with the fragrance of ketaki flowers, the noise of waterfalls and the cackle of peacocks and they give out a shrill trumpet.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धारानिपातैरभिहन्यमानाः कदम्बशाखासु विलम्बमानाः। क्षणार्जितं पुष्परसावगाढं शनैर्मदं षट्चरणास्त्यजन्ति4.28.29।।
output: 'Having sucked honey from the flowercups filled with honey, the bees are shedding their drunkenness slowly and hanging on the branches of kadamba trees, smitten with showers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गारचूर्णोत्करसन्निकाशैः फलैस्सुपर्याप्तरसैस्समृद्धैः। जम्बूद्रुमाणां प्रविभान्ति शाखाः निलीयमाना इव षट्पदौघैः4.28.30।।
output: 'The branches of jambu trees profusely  filled with fruits appear like piled up balls of charcoal, while swarms of bees rest on the branches on the jambu trees.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
तटित्पताकाभिरलङ्कृताना मुदीर्णगम्भीरमहारवाणाम्। विभान्ति रूपाणि बलाहकानां रणोद्यतानामिव वानरणानाम्4.28.31।।
output: 'The rainclouds decorated with banners of lightning and giving out peals of thunder shine like elephants in rut trumpeting, eager to fight in battle.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मार्गानुगश्शैलवनानुसारी सम्प्रस्थितो मेघरवं निशम्य। युद्धाभिकामः प्रतिनादशङ्की मत्तो गजेन्द्रः प्रतिसन्निवृत्तः4.28.32।।
output: मेघरवम् thunder of clouds, निशम्य heard, प्रतिनादशङ्की suspected it to be the sound of the enemy, युद्धाभिकामः desirous of waging war, सम्प्रस्थितः started to go, मार्गानुगः following the way, शैलवनानुसारी following the trees of the forest along the mountain, मत्तः proud, गजेन्द्रः elephant, प्रतिसन्निवृत्तः turned back.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्वचित्प्रगीता इव षट्पदौघैः क्वचित्प्रनृत्ता इव नीलकण्ठैः। क्वचित्प्रमत्ता इव वारणेन्द्रै र्विभान्त्यनेकाश्रयिणो वनान्ताः4.28.33।।
output: अनेकाश्रयिणः supporting many, वनान्ताः forestland, क्वचित् in some places, षट्पदौघैः with swarms of bees, प्रगीताः इव humming, क्वचित् in some regions, नीलकण्ठै: with peacocks, प्रनृत्ता इव as if dancing, क्वचित् at some place, वारणेन्द्रैः by the elephants, प्रमत्ताः इव like the intoxicated ones, विभान्ति were shining.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कदम्बसर्जार्जुनकन्दलाढ्या वनान्तभूमिर्नववारिपूर्णा। मयूरमत्ताभिरुतप्रनृत्तै रापानभूमिप्रतिमा विभाति4.28.34।।
output: कदम्बसर्जार्जुनकन्दलाढ्याः rich with the shoots of kadamba, sarja, arjuna trees, नववारिपूर्णा filled with fresh rain water, वनान्तभूमिः the forestland, मयूरमत्ताभिरुतप्रनृत्तै: sounds and dances of intoxicated peahens, विभाति shines, आपानभूमिप्रतिमा like a tavern.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
मुक्तासकाशं सलिलं पतद्वै सुनिर्मलं पत्रपुटेषु लग्नम्। हृष्टा विवर्णच्छदना विहङ्गा स्सुरेन्द्रदत्तं तृषिताः पिबन्ति4.28.35।।
output: 'Thirsty birds rejoice drinking exceedingly pure water held in leafcups offered by Indra (in the form of rain), which looks like pearls collected in the leafcups. As the drops fall on them the hue of their wings seems to change (fade).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
षट्पादतन्त्रीमधुराभिधानं प्लवङ्गमोदीरितकण्ठतालम्। आविष्कृतं मेघमृदङ्गनादै र्वनेषु सङ्गीतमिव प्रवृत्तम्4.28.36।।
output: 'The sweet humming of bees like the music of string instruments (Vina), the croaking of frogs, the rumbling of clouds sounding like the beating of drums make it appear as if a musical concert has started in the forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
क्वचित्प्रनृत्तै: क्वचिदुन्नदद्भिः क्वचिच्च वृक्षाग्रनिषण्णकायैः। व्यालम्बबर्हाभरणैर्मयूरै र्वनेषु सङ्गीतमिव प्रवृत्तम्4.28.37।।
output: 'Here the peacocks are dancing and there they are singing. Elsewhere they are reclining on treetops with their big plumage hanging down. It appears as though the peacocks have started a musical concert in the forest.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वनैर्घनानां प्लवगाः प्रबुद्धाः विहाय निद्रां चिरसन्निरुद्धाम्। अनेकरूपाकृतिवर्णनादाः नवाम्बुधाराभिहता नदन्ति4.28.38।।
output: घनानाम् of the clouds, स्वनैः sounds, प्रबुद्धाः awakened, अनेकरूपाकृतिवर्णनादाः in different forms, colours and sounds, प्लवगाः frogs, चिरसन्निरुद्धाम्  preventing for a long time, निद्राम् sleep, विहाय giving up, नवाम्बुधाराभिहताः  by the flow of rain waters, नदन्ति croaking.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नद्यस्समुद्वाहितचक्रवाका स्तटानि शीर्णान्यपवाहयित्वा। दृप्ता नवप्राभृतपूर्णभोगाः द्रुतं स्वभर्तारमुपोपयान्ति4.28.39।।
output: 'Washing away their broken banks which obstruct their way to the sea, the bloated rivers like proud young ladies with chakravaka birds borne on their surface ,which look like protruberant breasts, rush swiftly to meet their lord, the sea, chosen for full enjoyment with the gifts of flowers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नीलेषु नीला: प्रविभान्ति सक्ताः मेघेषु मेघा नववारिपूर्णाः। दवाग्निदग्धेषु दवाग्निदग्धा श्शैलेषु शैला इव बद्धमूलाः4.28.40।।
output: 'Dark clouds filled with fresh water, leaning on dark clouds appear like boulders of rock, scorched with wild fire with their bases yet firmly rooted shining.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रहृष्टसन्नादितबर्हिणानि सशक्रगोपाकुलशाद्वलानि। चरन्ति नीपार्जुनवासितानि गजास्सुरम्याणि वनान्तराणि4.28.41।।
output: गजाः elephants, प्रहृष्टसन्नादितबर्हिणानि peacocks making noise out of joy, सशक्रगोपाकुलशाद्वलानि filled with Indragopa insects crawling on young grass beds, नीपार्जुनवासितानि giving out smell of kadamba and arjuna blossoms, सुरम्याणि delightful, वनान्तराणि forestland, चरन्ति roam about.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
नवाम्बुधाराहतकेसराणि द्रुतं परित्यज्य सरोरुहाणि। कदम्बपुष्पाणि सकेसराणि नवानि हृष्टा भ्रमराः पतन्तिः4.28.42।।
output: 'The bees have quit the lotus filaments destroyed by the rain and happily move quickly towards fresh filaments of kadamba flowers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मत्ता गजेन्द्रा मुदिता गवेन्द्रा वनेषु विश्रान्ततरा मृगेन्द्रा। रम्या नगेन्द्रा निभृता नरेन्द्राः प्रक्रीडितो वारिधरैस्सुरेन्द्रः4.28.43।।
output: गजेन्द्राः elephants, मत्ताः proud, वनेषु in the forest, गवेन्द्राः proud bulls, मुदिताः are happy, मृगेन्द्राः king of animals, विश्रान्ततराः are taking rest, नगेन्द्राः mountains, रम्याः beautiful, नरेन्द्राः kings, निभृताः not moving, सुरेन्द्र: lord of gods, वारिधरैः with clouds, प्रक्रीडितः sporting.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
मेघास्समुद्धूतसमुद्रनादाः महाजलौघैर्गगनावलम्बाः। नदीस्तटाकानि सरांसि वापी र्महीं च कृत्स्नामपवाहयन्ति4.28.44।।
output: 'With their big torrents, clouds hanging over the sky, drowning the roar of the sea, make the rivers, ponds, lakes and tanks overflow and flood the entire earth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
वर्षप्रवेगा विपुलाः पतन्ति प्रवान्ति वातास्समुदीर्णघोषाः। प्रणष्टकूलाः प्रवहन्ति शीघ्रं नद्योजलैर्विप्रतिपन्नमार्गाः4.28.45।।
output: 'Torrents of rain pour at great speed. Winds roar. Rivers flow swiftly changing their direction due to breach in the banks

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
नरैर्नरेन्द्रा इव पर्वतेन्द्रा स्सुरेन्द्रदत्तै: पवनोपनीतैः। घनाम्बुकुम्भैरभिषिच्यमाना रूपं श्रियं स्वामिव दर्शयन्ति4.28.46।।
output: 'The mountains are consecrated with waterpitchers of clouds brought by the winds, offered by Lord Indra. Just as kings, consecrated by men, display their majesty, the mountains exhibit their form and glory. (Clouds are compared with water pots)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
घनोपगूढं गगनं सतारं न भास्करो दर्शनमभ्युपैति। नवैर्जलौघैर्धरणी विसृप्ता तमो विलिप्ता न दिशः प्रकाशाः4.28.47।।
output: 'Ennveloped by clouds, the Sun and stars are not visible. The earth glides with the flow of fresh waters. The directions are not clear, covered by darkness.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
महान्ति कूटानि महीधराणां धाराभिधौतान्यधिकं विभान्ति। महाप्रमाणैर्विपुलैः प्रपातै र्मुक्ताकलापैरिव लम्बमानैः4.28.48।।
output: 'The huge mountain peaks are washed by the heavy downpour of rain which look like long strings of pearls hanging.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
शैलोपलप्रस्खलमानवेगा श्शैलोत्तमानां विपुलाः प्रपाताः। गुहासु सन्नादितबर्हिणासु हारा विकीर्यन्त इवावभान्ति4.28.49।।
output: 'The waterfalls rushing down the rocks on the huge mountains and flowing through caves, and peacocks singing create an image of broken and scattered chains of pearls.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शीघ्रप्रवेगा विपुलाः प्रपाताः निर्धौतशृङ्गोपतला गिरीणाम्। मुक्ताकलापप्रतिमाः पतन्तो महागुहोत्सङ्गतलैर्ध्रियन्ते4.28.50।।
output: 'The fast flow of waterfalls spread over vast areas completely wash the surroundings  of the mountain peaks. It appears like chains of pearls collected in the lap of huge caves.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुरतामर्दविच्छिन्नास्स्वर्गस्त्रीहारमौक्तिकाः। पतन्ति चातुला दिक्षु तोयधारास्समन्तत:4.28.51।।
output: 'The strings of incomparable waterfalls all over the mountain appear as though pearls from the chains of sexually indulgent celestial women are dropping down from heaven, broken through physical friction.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निलीयमानैर्विहगैर्निमीलद्भिश्च पङ्कजैः। विकसन्त्या च मालत्या गतोऽस्तं ज्ञायते रविः4.28.52।।
output: निलीयमानैः by the resting, विहगैः by birds, निमीलद्भि closing, पङ्कजैः च by lotuses, विकसन्त्या by blooming, मालत्या च by Jasmines also, रविः Sun, अस्तंगतः has set, ज्ञायते is understood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वृत्ता यात्रा नरेन्द्राणां सेना प्रतिनिवर्तते। वैराणि चैव मार्गाश्च सलिलेन समीकृताः4.28.53।।
output: नरेन्द्राणाम् kings, यात्रा expeditions, वृत्ता has been stopped, सेना army, प्रतिनिवर्तते is  returning, सलिलेन  with water, वैराणि enmities, चैव also, मार्गाश्च as well as roads also, समीकृताः are suspended.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
मासि प्रोष्ठपदे ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणानां विवक्षताम्। अयमध्यायसमयस्सामगानामुपस्थितः4.28.54।।
output: 'The month of Bhadrapada meant for the recitation of the Vedas by brahmins and for those desirous of singing  Sama Veda has started.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निवृत्तकर्मायतनो नूनं सञ्चितसञ्चयः। आषाढीमभ्युपगतो भरतः कोसलाधिपः4.28.55।।
output: 'Surely Bharata, king of Kosala, would have completed the collection of all his requirement before the commencement of the month of Asarh.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नूनमापूर्यमाणायास्सर्वव्या वर्धते रयः। मां समीक्ष्य समायान्तमयोध्याया इव स्वनः4.28.56।।
output: 'Just as the cheerful voices of people of Ayodhya rise as soon as they see me returning, certainly the speed of river Sarayu is rising, filled with rain water.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
इमास्फीतगुणा वर्षास्सुग्रीवस्सुखमश्नुते। विजितारिः सदारश्च राज्ये महति च स्थितः4.28.57।।
output: 'Having defeated his enemy, Sugriva with his wife during the rainy season is wellestablished in the kingdom,  abounding in merits.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
अहं तु हृतदारश्च राज्याच्य महतश्च्युतः। नदीकूलमिव क्लिन्नमवसीदामि लक्ष्मण।।4.28.58।।
output: 'O Lakshmana I have lost my wife. I have been dethroned from the mighty kingdom. I am sinking like a river bank overflowed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शोकश्च मम विस्तीर्णो वर्षाश्च भृशदुर्गमाः। रावणश्च महान् शत्रुरपारं प्रतिभाति मे4.28.59।।
output: 'My sorrow which increases, the rains which make it hard to cover distances and Ravana the great enemyall these appear difficult to conquer.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अयात्रां चैव दृष्ट्वेमां मार्गांश्च भृशदुर्गमान्। प्रणते चैव सुग्रीवे न मया किञ्चिदीरितम्4.28.60।।
output: सुग्रीवे when Sugriva, प्रणते चैव is faithful to me, इमाम् this, अयात्राम् suspending the expedition, भृशदुर्गमान् very difficult, मार्गांश्च road, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, मया myself, किञ्चित् even a little, न ईरितम् not spoken.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अपि चातिपरिक्लिष्टं चिराद्दारैस्समागतम्। आत्मकार्यगरीयस्त्वाद्वक्तुं नेच्छामि वानरम्4.28.61।।
output: 'Since Sugriva has gone through great difficulties and is reunited with his wives after a long time and since our task is great, I did not desire to speak to him now.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
स्वयमेव हि विश्रम्य ज्ञात्वा कालमुपागतम्। उपकारं च सुग्रीवो वेत्स्यते नात्र संशयः4.28.62।।
output: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, विश्रम्य after resting, कालम् time, उपागतम् has come, ज्ञात्वा after knowing, उपकारं च help also, स्वयमेव himself, वेत्स्यते will know, हि indeed, अत्र about that, संशयः doubt, न no.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
तस्मात्कालप्रतीक्षोऽहं स्थितोऽस्मि शुभलक्षण। सुग्रीवस्य नदीनां च प्रसादममनुपालयन्4.28.63।।
output: 'O Lakshmana of auspicious qualities I will wait for the proper time to appease Sugriva as well as the rivers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 28:
उपकारेण वीरस्तु प्रतीकारेण युज्यते। अकृतज्ञोऽप्रतिकृतो हन्ति सत्त्ववतां मनः4.28.64।।
output: A hero should in return help whoever has helped him. An ungrateful person hurts the heart of the virtuous by not returning the assistance.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथैवमुक्तः प्रणिधाय लक्ष्मणः कृताञ्जलिस्तत्प्रतिपूज्य भाषितम्। उवाच रामं स्वभिरामदर्शनं प्रदर्शयन्दर्शनमात्मनश्शुभम्4.28.65।।
output: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ then, एवं in this way, मुक्तम् expressed, प्रणिधाय after contemplating on it, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, भाषितम् speech, प्रतिपूज्य after honouring, आत्मनः self, शुभम् auspicious, दर्शनम् opinion, प्रदर्शयन् exhibited, स्वभिरामदर्शनम्  a delightful one, रामम् to Rama, उवाच said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथोक्तमेतत्तव सर्वमीप्सितं नरेन्द्र कर्ता नचिराद्धरीश्वरः। शरत्प्रतीक्षः क्षमतामिमं भवान् जलप्रपातं रिपुनिग्रहे धृतः4.28.66।।
output: 'O Rama come Autumn, Sugriva will soon do all that you desire. Bear with the rains. Stay steadfast (in your determination) to destroy the enemy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किंधाकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyeighth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समीक्ष्य विमलं व्योम गतविद्युद्वलाहकम्। सारसाकुलसङ्घुष्टं रम्यज्योत्स्नानुलेपनम्4.29.1।। समृद्धार्थं च सुग्रीवं मन्दधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहम्। अत्यर्थमसतां मार्गमेकान्तगतमानसम्4.29.2।। निर्वृत्तकार्यं सिद्धार्थं प्रमदाभिरतं सदा। प्राप्तवन्तमभिप्रेतान्सर्वानेव मनोरथान्4.29.3।। स्वां च पत्नीमभिप्रेतां तारां चापि समीप्सिताम्। विहरन्तमहोरात्रं कृतार्थं विगतज्वरम्4.29.4।। क्रीडन्तमिव देवेशं नन्दनेऽप्सरसां गणैः। मन्त्रिषु न्यस्तकार्यं च मन्त्रिणामनवेक्षकम्4.29.5।। उत्सन्नराज्यसन्देशं कामवृत्तमवस्थितम्। निश्चितार्थोऽर्थतत्त्वज्ञः कालधर्मविशेषवित्4.29.6।। प्रसाद्य वाक्यैर्मधुरैर्हेतुमद्भिर्मनोरमैः। वाक्यविद्वाक्य तत्त्वज्ञं हरीशं मारुतात्मजः4.29.7।। हितं तत्त्वं च पथ्यं च सामधर्मार्थनीतिमत्। प्रणयप्रीतिसंयुक्तं विश्वासकृतनिश्चयम्। हरीश्वरमुपागम्य हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.29.8।।
output: विमलं clear, गतविद्युद्वलाहकम् free from clouds and lightning, सारसाकुलसङ्घुष्टम् cackling of herons, रम्यज्योत्स्नानुलेपनम् lovely moonlight, व्योम sky, समृद्धार्थम् rich, मन्दधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहम्  slow in attaining dharma and artha, अत्यर्थम् excessively, असताम् bad persons, मार्गम् path, एकान्तगतमानसम् engaged in fulfilling desires only, निर्वृत्तकार्यम् satisfied with his work, सिद्धार्थम्  accomplished, सदा all the time, प्रमदाभिरतम् engrossed in enjoyment of women, अभिप्रेताम् coveted, स्वां पत्नीम् his own wife, सर्वान् एव all, मनोरथान् desires, समीप्सिताम्  desired, तारां चापि Tara also, प्राप्तवन्तम् having obtained, अहोरात्रम् day and night, विहरन्तम्  strolling, कृतार्थम् accomplished, विगतज्वरम् without worry, नन्दने अप्सरसाम् with Apsaras in Nandana garden, गणैः groups, क्रीडन्तम्  sporting, देवेशम् इव like god Indra, मन्त्रिषु to the ministers, न्यस्तकार्यं च entrusting duty, मन्त्रिणाम् of the ministers, अनवेक्षकम् not watchful, उत्सन्नराज्यसन्देशम् without minding the duties of the kingdom, कामवृत्तम् इव as if engrossed in sensual pleasures, (अव) स्थितम् remaining, हरीशम् monkey king, सुग्रीवं च Sugriva, समीक्ष्य seen, निश्चितार्थः knower of responsibilities, अर्थतत्त्वज्ञः knower of principles, कालधर्मविशेषवित्  aware of duties to be performed at right time, वाक्यवित् skilful in expression, मधुर: sweet, मारुतात्मजः son of the windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, वाक्यतत्त्वज्ञम्  good at speech, हरीश्वरम् Sugriva, उपागम्य went to, मधुरै: with sweet, हेतुमद्भिः reasonable, मनोरमैः pleasing, वाक्यैः words, प्रसाद्य making happy, हितम् wellmeaning, तत्त्वम् truth, पथ्यम् च helpful, सामधर्मार्थनीतिमत् conciliatory, righteous, just and truthful words, प्रणयप्रीतिसंयुक्तम्  full of affection, विश्वासकृतनिश्चयम् having decided to take him into confidence, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

समीक्ष्य विमलं व्योम गतविद्युद्वलाहकम्। सारसाकुलसङ्घुष्टं रम्यज्योत्स्नानुलेपनम्4.29.1।। समृद्धार्थं च सुग्रीवं मन्दधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहम्। अत्यर्थमसतां मार्गमेकान्तगतमानसम्4.29.2।। निर्वृत्तकार्यं सिद्धार्थं प्रमदाभिरतं सदा। प्राप्तवन्तमभिप्रेतान्सर्वानेव मनोरथान्4.29.3।। स्वां च पत्नीमभिप्रेतां तारां चापि समीप्सिताम्। विहरन्तमहोरात्रं कृतार्थं विगतज्वरम्4.29.4।। क्रीडन्तमिव देवेशं नन्दनेऽप्सरसां गणैः। मन्त्रिषु न्यस्तकार्यं च मन्त्रिणामनवेक्षकम्4.29.5।। उत्सन्नराज्यसन्देशं कामवृत्तमवस्थितम्। निश्चितार्थोऽर्थतत्त्वज्ञः कालधर्मविशेषवित्4.29.6।। प्रसाद्य वाक्यैर्मधुरैर्हेतुमद्भिर्मनोरमैः। वाक्यविद्वाक्य तत्त्वज्ञं हरीशं मारुतात्मजः4.29.7।। हितं तत्त्वं च पथ्यं च सामधर्मार्थनीतिमत्। प्रणयप्रीतिसंयुक्तं विश्वासकृतनिश्चयम्। हरीश्वरमुपागम्य हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.29.8।।
output: Hanuman awakens Sugriva from slumber -- advises to initiate the search Vaidehi.
