instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समीक्ष्य विमलं व्योम गतविद्युद्वलाहकम्। सारसाकुलसङ्घुष्टं रम्यज्योत्स्नानुलेपनम्4.29.1।। समृद्धार्थं च सुग्रीवं मन्दधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहम्। अत्यर्थमसतां मार्गमेकान्तगतमानसम्4.29.2।। निर्वृत्तकार्यं सिद्धार्थं प्रमदाभिरतं सदा। प्राप्तवन्तमभिप्रेतान्सर्वानेव मनोरथान्4.29.3।। स्वां च पत्नीमभिप्रेतां तारां चापि समीप्सिताम्। विहरन्तमहोरात्रं कृतार्थं विगतज्वरम्4.29.4।। क्रीडन्तमिव देवेशं नन्दनेऽप्सरसां गणैः। मन्त्रिषु न्यस्तकार्यं च मन्त्रिणामनवेक्षकम्4.29.5।। उत्सन्नराज्यसन्देशं कामवृत्तमवस्थितम्। निश्चितार्थोऽर्थतत्त्वज्ञः कालधर्मविशेषवित्4.29.6।। प्रसाद्य वाक्यैर्मधुरैर्हेतुमद्भिर्मनोरमैः। वाक्यविद्वाक्य तत्त्वज्ञं हरीशं मारुतात्मजः4.29.7।। हितं तत्त्वं च पथ्यं च सामधर्मार्थनीतिमत्। प्रणयप्रीतिसंयुक्तं विश्वासकृतनिश्चयम्। हरीश्वरमुपागम्य हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.29.8।।
output: विमलं clear, गतविद्युद्वलाहकम् free from clouds and lightning, सारसाकुलसङ्घुष्टम् cackling of herons, रम्यज्योत्स्नानुलेपनम् lovely moonlight, व्योम sky, समृद्धार्थम् rich, मन्दधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहम्  slow in attaining dharma and artha, अत्यर्थम् excessively, असताम् bad persons, मार्गम् path, एकान्तगतमानसम् engaged in fulfilling desires only, निर्वृत्तकार्यम् satisfied with his work, सिद्धार्थम्  accomplished, सदा all the time, प्रमदाभिरतम् engrossed in enjoyment of women, अभिप्रेताम् coveted, स्वां पत्नीम् his own wife, सर्वान् एव all, मनोरथान् desires, समीप्सिताम्  desired, तारां चापि Tara also, प्राप्तवन्तम् having obtained, अहोरात्रम् day and night, विहरन्तम्  strolling, कृतार्थम् accomplished, विगतज्वरम् without worry, नन्दने अप्सरसाम् with Apsaras in Nandana garden, गणैः groups, क्रीडन्तम्  sporting, देवेशम् इव like god Indra, मन्त्रिषु to the ministers, न्यस्तकार्यं च entrusting duty, मन्त्रिणाम् of the ministers, अनवेक्षकम् not watchful, उत्सन्नराज्यसन्देशम् without minding the duties of the kingdom, कामवृत्तम् इव as if engrossed in sensual pleasures, (अव) स्थितम् remaining, हरीशम् monkey king, सुग्रीवं च Sugriva, समीक्ष्य seen, निश्चितार्थः knower of responsibilities, अर्थतत्त्वज्ञः knower of principles, कालधर्मविशेषवित्  aware of duties to be performed at right time, वाक्यवित् skilful in expression, मधुर: sweet, मारुतात्मजः son of the windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, वाक्यतत्त्वज्ञम्  good at speech, हरीश्वरम् Sugriva, उपागम्य went to, मधुरै: with sweet, हेतुमद्भिः reasonable, मनोरमैः pleasing, वाक्यैः words, प्रसाद्य making happy, हितम् wellmeaning, तत्त्वम् truth, पथ्यम् च helpful, सामधर्मार्थनीतिमत् conciliatory, righteous, just and truthful words, प्रणयप्रीतिसंयुक्तम्  full of affection, विश्वासकृतनिश्चयम् having decided to take him into confidence, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राज्यं प्राप्तं यशश्चैव कौली श्रीरभिवर्धिता। मित्राणां सङ्ग्रहश्शेषस्तं भवान्कर्तुमर्हति4.29.9।।
output: राज्यम् kingdom, यशश्चैव and fame, प्राप्तम् attained, कौली of the family, श्रीः prosperity, अभिवर्धिता heightened, मित्राणाम् of friends, सङ्ग्रहः earning good will, शेषः remains, तम् that( duty), भवान् by you, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हति  is proper

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यो हि मित्रेषु कालज्ञस्सततं साधु वर्तते4.29.10।। तस्य राज्यं च कीर्तिश्च प्रतापश्चाभि वर्धते।
output: 'The kingdom, glory and fame of a king who knows the value of time and conducts himself well towards his allies always grows.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्य कोशश्च दण्डश्च मित्राण्यात्मा च भूमिप4.29.11।। समवेतानि सर्वाणि स राज्यं महदश्नुते।
output: 'He to whom the treasury, sceptre, allies and his own self all these are equally dear,  enjoys a large kingdom.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तद्भवान्वृत्तसम्पन्नः स्थितः पथि निरत्यये4.29.12।। मित्रार्थमभिनीतार्थं यथावत्कर्तुमर्हति।
output: तत् therefore, वृत्तसम्पन्नः endowed with right conduct, भवान् you, निरत्यये devoted, स्थितः  conforming to, अभिनीतार्थम् a proper course of action, मित्रार्थम् for the cause of ally यथावत् duly, कर्तुम् doing, अर्हति it is proper.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्त्यज्य सर्वकर्माणि मित्रार्थे योऽनुवर्तते4.29.13।। सम्भ्रमाद्धि कृतोत्साहस्सोऽनर्थैर्नावरुध्यते।
output: 'Whoever sets aside his personal interest and works for the welfare of his ally with due enthusiasm and excitement  will not be harmed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्तु कालव्यतीतेषु मित्रकार्येषु वर्तते4.29.14।। स कृत्वा महतोऽप्यर्थान्न मित्रार्थेन युज्यते।
output: यः he who, कालव्यतीतेषु exceedng the time limit, मित्रकार्येषु in his friend's task, वर्तते acts, सः he, महतः great, अर्थान् effort, कृत्वा does, मित्रार्थेन for the cause of  friend, न युज्यते not  succeed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
यदिदं मित्रकार्यं वीर नोमित्रकार्यमरिन्दम 4.29.15।। क्रियतां राघवस्यैतद्वैदेह्याः परिमार्गणम्। तदिदं वीर कार्यं ते कालातीतमरिन्दम 4.29.16।।
output: 'O subduer of enemies we should do the brave deed of finding Vaidehi for the sake of your friend. O crusher of enemies this is your duty at present and it is already delayed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
यदिदं मित्रकार्यं वीर नोमित्रकार्यमरिन्दम 4.29.15।। क्रियतां राघवस्यैतद्वैदेह्याः परिमार्गणम्। तदिदं वीर कार्यं ते कालातीतमरिन्दम 4.29.16।।
output: 'O subduer of enemies we should do the brave deed of finding Vaidehi for the sake of your friend. O crusher of enemies this is your duty at present and it is already delayed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न च कालमतीतं ते निवेदयति कालवित्। त्वरमाणोऽपि सन्प्राज्ञस्तव राजन्वशानुगः4.29.17।।
output: राजन् O king, प्राज्ञः a wise person, कालवित् one who is aware of the importance of timely action, सः he, त्वरमाणोऽपि even if he is in a hurry, तव your, वशानुगः staying( in your kingdom), अतीतम् exceeding, कालम् time, ते to you, न निवेदयति will not report.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
कुलस्य हेतुः स्फीतस्य दीर्घबन्धुश्च राघवः। अप्रमेयप्रभावश्च स्वयं चाप्रतिमो गुणैः4.29.18।।
output: 'Rama is  responsible in lending stability to you and to your wellknown family. He will continue to be your ally for a long time. Let it be known that his power is boundless and his virtues peerless.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य त्वं कुरु वै कार्यं पूर्वं तेन कृतं तव। हरीश्वर कपिश्रेष्ठानाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि4.29.19।।
output: 'O king pray accomplish his object the same way he has accomplished your own. You ought to issue orders to the foremost of the monkeys.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न हि तावद्भवेत्कालो व्यतीतश्चोदनादृते। चोदितस्य हि कार्यस्य भवेत्कालव्यतिक्रमः4.29.20।।
output: चोदनादृते before prompting, कालः time, व्यतीतः elapsed न तावत् भवेत् cannot be used, चोदितस्य if he directs, कार्यस्य the task, कालव्यतिक्रमः time limit has elapsed, भवेत् will happen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
अकर्तुरपि कार्यस्य भवान्कर्ता हरीश्वर किं पुनः प्रतिकर्तुस्ते राज्येन च धनेन च4.29.21।।
output: 'O lord of monkeys help even a person who has not helped you. As such, do you need to be told that you should help one, with whose help you have earned wealth and kingdom?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
शक्तिमानपिविक्रान्तो वानरर्क्षगणेश्वर। कर्तुं दाशरथेः प्रीतिमाज्ञायां किन्न सज्जसे4.29.22।।
output: 'O protector of the monkeys, you are powerful and you are prompt. Why don't you issue orders which will please Rama?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कामं खलु शरैश्शक्तस्सुरासुरमहोरगान्। वशे दाशरथिः कर्तुं त्वत्प्रतिज्ञां हि काङ्क्षते4.29.23।।
output: 'Indeed, Rama is fully capable of subduing gods, demons as well as nagas with his arrows. He is looking for your help in view of your promise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
प्राणत्यागाविशङ्केन कृतं तेन तवप्रियम्। तस्य मार्गाम वैदेहीं पृथिव्यामपि चाम्बरे4.29.24।।
output: 'He has done you a deed dear to you without hesitation, risking his own life.Let us help him in search of his Vaidehi whether she is on earth or in heaven.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देवदानव गन्धर्वा नसुरास्समरुद्गणाः। न च यक्षा भयं तस्य कुर्युः किमुत राक्षसाः4.29.25।।
output: 'Not gods, demons, gandharvas or even marutas, suras or yakshas can cause fright in him much less the rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
तदेवं शक्तियुक्तस्य पूर्वं प्रियकृतस्तव। रामस्यार्हसि पिङ्गेश कर्तुं सर्वात्मना प्रियम्4.29.26।।
output: 'Therefore, O king of monkeys you ought to oblige Rama wholeheartedly exerting all your strength, as he has done your work.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नाधस्तादवनौ नाप्सु गतिर्नोपरि चाम्बरे। कस्यचित्सज्जतेऽस्माकं कपीश्वर तवाज्ञया4.29.27।।
output: कपीश्वर O lord of monkeys, तव your, आज्ञया by orders, अस्माकम् for us, कस्यचित् of any place, अधस्तात् underground, सज्जते made possible, अवनौ on the earth, अप्सु in water, न or, उपरि up , अम्बरे च and in the sky, न or else.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदाज्ञापय कः किं ते कुतो वापि व्यवस्यतु। हरयोऽह्यप्रधृष्यास्ते सन्ति कोट्यग्रतोऽनघ4.29.28।।
output: अनघ sinless hero, तत् therefore, आज्ञापय you order, कः who, किं what, कुत:from where,  व्यवस्यतु determine to act, ते your, कोट्यग्रतः more than a crore, अप्रधृष्याः invincible, हरयः vanaras, सन्ति हि at your service.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा काले साधु निवेदनम्। सुग्रीवस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नश्चकार मतिमुत्तमाम्4.29.29।।
output: Sugriva who had a great sense of duty, started applying  his mind, when he heard the honest advice of Hanuman.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
स सन्दिदेशाभिमतं नीलं नित्यकृतोद्यमम्। दिक्षु सर्वासु सर्वेषां सैन्यानामुपसङ्ग्रहे4.29.30।।
output: He sent word to the ever diligent Nila, his favourite, to collect all cadres of army of the monkeys from all directions.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
यथा सेना समग्रा मे यूथपालाश्च सर्वशः। समागच्छन्त्यसङ्गेन सेनाग्राणि तथा कुरु4.29.31।।
output: 'Let the entire army with leaders of different groups assemble here seperately. O chief of army act accordingly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ये त्वन्तपालाः प्लवगाश्शीघ्रगा व्यवसायिनः। समानयन्तु ते सैन्यं त्वरिताश्शासनान्मम4.29.32।। स्वयं चानन्तरं सैन्यं भवानेवानुपश्यतु।
output: 'Let the swiftfooted monkeys, guardians of frontiers, army chiefs muster soon in obedience to my command. You (Nila) alone should personally  supervise the work to be done next.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
त्रिपञ्चरात्रादूर्ध्वं यः प्राप्नुयान्नेह वानरः। तस्य प्राणान्तिको दण्डो नात्र कार्या विचारणा4.29.33।।
output: यः वानरः such vanara, त्रिपञ्चरात्रात् after three or five nights, ऊर्ध्वम् over and above, इह here, प्राप्नुयात् may reach, तस्य his, प्राणान्तिकः  death sentence, दण्डः punishment, अत्र here, विचारणाः thought, न कार्या  no doubt

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 29:
हरींश्च वृद्धानुपयातु साङ्गदो भवान्ममाज्ञामधिकृत्य निश्चिताम्। इति व्यवस्थां हरिपुङ्गवेश्वरो विधाय वेश्म प्रविवेश वीर्यवान्4.29.34।।
output: 'In strict obedience to my orders, go with Angada to the elderly monkeys and inform them about my decision and order'. After making this arrangement valiant Sugriva entered his residence. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyninth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गुहं प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः। वर्षरात्रोषितो रामः कामशोकाभिपीडितः4.30.1।। पाण्डुरं गगनं दृष्ट्वा विमलं चन्द्रमण्डलम्। शारदीं रजनीं चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्नानुलेपनाम्4.30.2।। कामवृत्तं च सुग्रीवं नष्टां च जनकात्मजाम्। बुद्ध्वा कालमतीतं च मुमोह परमातुरः4.30.3।।
output: सुग्रीवे (when) Sugriva, गुहम् residence, प्रविष्टे entered, गगने into the sky, घनैः heavy clouds, विमुक्ते is cleared, वर्षरात्रे rainy night, कामशोकाभिपीडितः agonised out of love, रामः Rama, पाण्डुरम् pale white, गगनम् sky, विमलम् clear, चन्द्रमण्डलम्  orb of the Moon, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, ज्योत्स्नानुलेपनाम् covered with bright moonlight, शारदीम् of autumn, रजनीं चैव night like, बुद्ध्वा known, कामवृत्तम् engaged in love, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, नष्टाम् lost, जनकात्मजां च Janaka's daughter, अतीतम् exceeded, कालम् time, दृष्ट्वा seeing, परमातुरः perturbed, मुमोह च swooned.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गुहं प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः। वर्षरात्रोषितो रामः कामशोकाभिपीडितः4.30.1।। पाण्डुरं गगनं दृष्ट्वा विमलं चन्द्रमण्डलम्। शारदीं रजनीं चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्नानुलेपनाम्4.30.2।। कामवृत्तं च सुग्रीवं नष्टां च जनकात्मजाम्। बुद्ध्वा कालमतीतं च मुमोह परमातुरः4.30.3।।
output: Rama's agony accentuated by autumn -- description of the beauty of autumn -- Lakshmana leaves for Sugriva.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गुहं प्रविष्टे सुग्रीवे विमुक्ते गगने घनैः। वर्षरात्रोषितो रामः कामशोकाभिपीडितः4.30.1।। पाण्डुरं गगनं दृष्ट्वा विमलं चन्द्रमण्डलम्। शारदीं रजनीं चैव दृष्ट्वा ज्योत्स्नानुलेपनाम्4.30.2।। कामवृत्तं च सुग्रीवं नष्टां च जनकात्मजाम्। बुद्ध्वा कालमतीतं च मुमोह परमातुरः4.30.3।।
output: सुग्रीवे (when) Sugriva, गुहम् residence, प्रविष्टे entered, गगने into the sky, घनैः heavy clouds, विमुक्ते is cleared, वर्षरात्रे rainy night, कामशोकाभिपीडितः agonised out of love, रामः Rama, पाण्डुरम् pale white, गगनम् sky, विमलम् clear, चन्द्रमण्डलम्  orb of the Moon, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, ज्योत्स्नानुलेपनाम् covered with bright moonlight, शारदीम् of autumn, रजनीं चैव night like, बुद्ध्वा known, कामवृत्तम् engaged in love, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, नष्टाम् lost, जनकात्मजां च Janaka's daughter, अतीतम् exceeded, कालम् time, दृष्ट्वा seeing, परमातुरः perturbed, मुमोह च swooned.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तु संज्ञामुपागम्य मुहूर्तान्मतिमान्पुनः। मनस्स्थामपि वैदेहीं चिन्तयामास राघवः4.30.4।।
output: मतिमान् sensible man, पुन: again, सः राघवः that Rama, मुहूर्तात् in a short time, संज्ञाम् consciousness, उपागम्य having regained, मनःस्थामपि present in his mind, वैदेहीम् of Vaidehi, चिन्तयामास thinking of.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
आसीनः पर्वतस्याग्रे हेमधातुविभूषिते। शारदं गगनं दृष्ट्वा जगाम मनसा प्रियाम्4.30.5।।
output: Sitting on top of the mountain shining with gold and minerals, Rama  gazed at the pleasant autumnal sky and started thinking of his beloved.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्ट्वा च विमलं व्योम गतविद्युद्वलाहकम्। सारसारावसङ्घुष्ठं विललापार्तया गिरा4.30.6।।
output: Looking at the sky rid of clouds and lightning, filled with the sounds of flocks of sarasa birds, Rama cried in a pitiable state.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
सारसारावसन्नादैस्सारसारवनादिनी। याऽऽश्रमे रमते बाला साऽद्य मे रमते कथम्4.30.7।।
output: 'How will the young lady (Sita) whose voice is like the sarasa bird's, who was revelling, listening to its sweet cackle at the hermitage be living now?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
पुष्पितांश्चासनान् दृष्ट्वा काञ्चनानिव निर्मलान्। कथं सा रमते बाला पश्यन्ती मामपश्यती4.30.8।।
output: 'How will my beloved wife feel on seeing the asana flowers which are as pure as gold, when she does not find me anywhere?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
या पुरा कलहंसानां स्वरेण कलभाषिणी। बुध्यते चारुसर्वाङ्गी साऽद्य मे बुद्ध्यते कथम्4.30.9।।
output: 'How will my Sita with her charming limbs and sweet words, who used to get up from sleep by the cackle of swans, wake up now?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निस्वनं चक्रवाकानां निशम्य नहचारिणाम्। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षी कथमेषा भविष्यति4.30.10।।
output: पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षी lady with large, pale white eyes, एषा such, सहचारिणाम् of her companions, चक्रवाकानाम् of Chakravaka birds, निस्वनम् sweet voices, निशम्य  listening, कथम् how, भविष्यति will she be.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सरांसि सरितो वापीः काननानि वनानि च। तां विना मृगशाबाक्षीं चरन्नाद्य सुखं लभे4.30.11।।
output: 'Even though I am wandering by lakes, rivers, wells, forests and groves,I am not happy without that fawneyed lady.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अपि तां मद्वियोगाच्छ सौकुमार्याच्च भामिनीम्। सुदूरं पीडयेत्कामश्शरद्गुणनिरन्तरः4.30.12।।
output: 'I think even the charm of autumn must be always tormenting that lovely lady, as she is very far from me. She is too delicate to suffer the agony of separation.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
एवमादि नरश्रेष्ठो विललाप नृपात्मजः। विहङ्ग इव सारङ्गस्सलिलं त्रिदशेश्वरात्4.30.13।।
output: Thus the best among the princes wailed just as chakrabaka laments for water from Indra, lord of the gods.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्चञ्चूर्य रम्येषु फलार्थी गिरिसानुषु। ददर्श पर्युपावृत्तो लक्ष्मीवान्लक्ष्मणोऽग्रजम्4.30.14।।
output: ततः then, फलार्थी for getting fruits, रम्येषु from the beautiful, गिरिसानुषु the mountain slopes, चञ्चूर्य went about looking, पर्युपावृत्तः going round and round, लक्ष्मीवान् graceful man, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अग्रजम् elder brother, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
तं चिन्तया दुस्सहया परीतं विसंज्ञमेकं विजने मनस्वी। भ्रातुर्विषादात्परितापदीनः समीक्ष्य सौमित्रिरुवाच रामम्4.30.15।।
output: Observing Rama who had lost his senses, lying alone in unbearable agony, venerable Lakshmana became sad and miserable and spoke to his brother:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किमार्य कामस्य वशंगतेन किमात्मपौरुष्यपराभवेन। अयं सदा संह्रियते समाधिः किमत्र योगेन निवर्तितेन4.30.16।।
output: आर्य O revered (brother), कामस्य वशंगतेन succumbed to passion, किम् why, आत्मपौरुष्य  selfconfidence, पराभवेन defeat, किम् of what use, सदा ever, अयम् this, समाधिः composure, संहियते is withdrawn, अत्र निवर्तितेन desisting from, योगेन from yoga, किम् why?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्रियाभियोगं मनसः प्रसादं समाधियोगानुगतं च कालम्। सहायसामर्थ्यमदीनसत्त्वः स्वकर्म हेतुं च कुरुष्व हेतुम्4.30.17।।
output: अदीनसत्त्व: an undaunted warrior, क्रियाभियोगम् make efforts to work, मनसः mind's, प्रसादम् serenity, समाधियोगानुगतम् followed by contemplative mood, कालं च taking advantage of time, सहायसामर्थ्यम् strength of effort, हेतुम् cause, स्वकर्म च by your own effort, हेतुम् cause of success, कुरुष्व  achieve.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न जानकी मानव वंशनाथ त्वया सनाथा सुलभा परेण। न चाग्निचूडां ज्वलितामुपेत्य न दह्यते वीर वरार्ह कच्छित्4.30.18।।
output: 'O lord of the human race O worthy hero when you are the protector, Janaki cannot be retained by any one easily just as burning fire after it reaches its full height cannot be retained by any one.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सलक्षणं लक्ष्मणमप्रधृष्यं स्वभावजं वाक्यमुवाच रामः। हितं च पथ्यं च नयप्रसक्तं ससाम धर्मार्थसमाहितं च4.30.19।।
output: Rama said to Lakshmana, an unassailable warrior with auspicious signs, that what he had spoken was natural, beneficial, wise and useful.It is in accordance with Sama Veda and the science of statecraft, well established in dharma and artha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
निस्संशयं कार्यमवेक्षितव्यं क्रियाविशेषोऽह्यनुवर्तितव्यः। ननु प्रवृत्तस्य दुरासदस्य कुमार कार्यस्य फलं च चिन्त्यम्4.30.20।।
output: 'My dear, there is no doubt that I have to consider the work (ahead), give special attention to follow up. Surely I need to think over this herculian task and its achievement'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ पद्मपलाशाक्षीं मैथिलीमनुचिन्तयन्। उवाच लक्ष्मणं रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता4.30.21।।
output: अथ then, रामः Rama, पद्मपलाशाक्षीम् lady with eyes like lotus petals, मैथिलीम् Mythili, अनुचिन्तयन् while worrying, परिशुष्यता with dried up, मुखेन with mouth, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, उवाच said

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तर्पयित्वा सहस्राक्षस्सलिलेन वसुन्धराम्। निर्वर्तयित्वा सस्यानि कृतकर्मा व्यवस्थितः4.30.22।।
output: सहस्राक्षः thousandeyed Indra, सलिलेन  with water, वसुन्धराम् the earth, तर्पयित्वा having satisfied, सस्यानि crops, निर्वर्तयित्वा  brought  back, कृतकर्मा done his duty, व्यवस्थितः settled down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषाश्शैलद्रुमपुरोगमाः। विसृज्य सलिलं मेघाः परिश्रान्ता नृपात्मज4.30.23।।
output: 'O prince having discharged their water the clouds (after the rains) are exhausted. They are moving now over trees and mountains, making deep and pleasant sounds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
नीलोत्पलदलश्यामाश्श्यामीकृत्वा दिशो दश। विमदा इव मातङ्गाश्शान्तवेगाः पयोधराः4.30.24।।
output: 'The clouds, which were dark till now like the blue lotus petals darkening all the ten directions  are like elephants free from all intoxication as their fury is abated৷৷

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जलगर्भा महामेघा कुटजार्जुनगन्धिनः। चरित्वा विरतास्सौम्य वृष्टिवातास्समुद्यताः4.30.25।।
output: सौम्य O dear, जलगर्भाः laden with water, महामेघाः huge clouds, कुटजार्जुनगन्धिनः the fragrance of kutaja and arjuna flowers, समुद्यताः are blowing, वृष्टिवाताः winds carrying rainwater, चरित्वा having moved, विरताः stopped.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
घनानां वारणानां च मयूराणां च लक्ष्मण। नादः प्रस्रवणानां च प्रशान्तस्सहसाऽनघ4.30.26।।
output: 'O sinless Lakshmana the rumblings of heavy clouds, the trumpeting of elephants, the cry of peacocks and the sound of waterfalls have become suddenly stilled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अभिवृष्टा महामेघैर्निर्मलाश्चित्रसानवः। अनुलिप्ता इवाऽभान्ति गिरयश्चित्रदीप्तिभिः4.30.27।।
output: महामेघैः with huge clouds, अभिवृष्टाः having showered rain, निर्मलाः clean, चित्रसानवः peaks of different colours, गिरयः mountains, चित्रदीप्तिभिः glowing in variegated colours, अनुलिप्ताः इव as if smeared , आभान्ति appear.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
शाखासु सप्तच्छदपादपानां प्रभासु तारार्कनिशाकराणाम्। लीलासु चैवोत्तम वारणानां श्रियं विभज्याद्य शरत्प्रवृत्ता4.30.28।।
output: 'The autumn has set in, manifesting its grace on the branches of saptachada trees(sevenleafed banana plant) through the radiance of stars, Sun and Moon and through the sports of excellent elephants.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्प्रत्यनेकाश्रय चित्रशोभा लक्ष्मीश्शरत्कालगुणोपनीता। सूर्याग्रहस्तप्रतिबोधितेषु पद्माकरेष्वभ्यधिकं विभाति4.30.29।।
output: सम्प्रति at present, अनेकाश्रयचित्रशोभा  manifesting  beauty in varied manner, शरत्कालगुणोपपन्ना brought about by the merits of the season, लक्ष्मीः goddess of wealth, सूर्याग्रहस्तप्रतिबोधितेषु touched by the rays of the Sun, पद्माकरेषु the lotuses, अधिकम् exceedingly, विभाति shines.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
सप्तच्छदानां कुसुमोपगन्धी षट्पादबृन्दैरनुगीयमानः। मत्तद्विपानां पवनोऽनुसारी दर्पं विनेष्यन्नधिकं करोति।।4.30.30।।
output: 'The wind carries the fragrance of saptachada flowers. Attracted by the fragrance, swarms of bees come humming. The pride of the elephants in rut increases.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभ्यागतैश्चारुविशालपक्षै स्सरःप्रियैः पद्मरजोवकीर्णैः। महानदीनां पुलिनोपयातैः क्रीडन्ति हंसास्सह चक्रवाकैः4.30.31।।
output: 'The swans have come face to face with chakravaka birds. They have newly arrived.  Lovers of lakes, they are shaking the pollen of lotuses on their lovely wide wings and have settled on the sandy bankssporting.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मदप्रगल्भेषु च वारणेषु गवां समूहेषु च दर्पितेषु। प्रसन्नतोयासु च निम्नगासु विभाति लक्ष्मीर्बहुधा विभक्ता4.30.32।।
output: 'Goddess Laxmi with her scattered self shines there among the proud elephants, among herds of excited bulls and among streams with clear water.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नभस्समीक्ष्याम्बुधरैर्विमुक्तं विमुक्तबर्हाभरणा वनेषु। प्रियास्वसक्ता विनिवृत्तशोभा गतोत्सवा ध्यानपरा मयूराः4.30.33।।
output: वनेषु in the forests, मयूराः peacocks, अम्बुधरैः by the clouds, विमुक्तम् devoid, नभः sky, समीक्ष्य on seeing, विमुक्तबर्हाभरणाः those who have shed their ornamental plumage, प्रियासु loved ones, असक्ताः lost interest, विनिवृत्तशोभाः their glory withdrawn, गतोत्सवाः devoid of happiness, ध्यानपराः are absorbed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
मनोज्ञगन्धैः प्रियकैरनल्पैः पुष्पातिभारावनताग्रशाखैः। सुवर्णगौरैर्नयनाभिरामै रुद्योतितानीव वनान्तराणि4.30.34।।
output: 'The forests are delightful to the eyes, as if illuminated by a large number of goldencoloured, finesmelling priyaka branches bent under the heavy loads of flowers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रियान्वितानां नलिनीप्रियाणां वने रतानां कुसुमोद्धतानाम्। मदोत्कटानां मदलालसानां गजोत्तमानां गतयोऽद्य मन्दाः4.30.35।।
output: अद्य now, प्रियान्वितानाम् accompanied by their loved ones, नलिनीप्रियाणाम्  who love lotus ponds,  वने रतानां  who enjoy the forest, कुसुमोद्धतानाम्  who are enthused by the smell of flowers,मदलालसानाम् of the deeply passionate, मदोत्कटानाम् of the excited by intoxication, गजोत्तमानाम् lordly elephants, गतयः movements, मन्दाःare slow

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
व्यभ्रं नभश्शस्त्रविधौतवर्णं कृशप्रवाहानि नदीजलानि। कह्लारशीताः पवनाः प्रवान्ति तमोविमुक्ताश्च दिशः प्रकाशाः4.30.36।।
output: 'Cleared of the black clouds, the sky is shining like a polished weapon. The river waters flow feebly. Winds blowing over white lotuses feel cool. All quarters clear of darkness are shining.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
शरद्गुणाप्यायितरूपशोभाः प्रहर्षिताः पांशुसमुत्क्षिताङ्गाः। मदोत्कटास्सम्प्रति युद्धलुब्धा वृषा गवां मध्यगता नदन्ति4.30.38।।
output: 'The bulls surrounded by cows are bellowing with the dust settled on their limbs. Excited by passion they are happy, ready to fight. They look attractive, blessed by the attributes of Autumn.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
समन्मथं तीव्रगतानुरागाः कुलान्विता मन्दगतिं करिण्यः। मदान्वितं सम्परिवार्य यान्तं वनेषु भर्तारमनुप्रयान्ति4.30.39।।
output: 'The female elephants of good breed, deeply passionate, gather round and follow their intoxicated lord moving slowly through the forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
त्यक्त्वा वराण्यात्मविभूषणानि बर्हाणि तीरोपगता नदीनाम्। निर्भर्त्स्यमाना इव सारसौघैः प्रयान्ति दीना विमदा मयूराः4.30.40।।
output: 'The peacocks have shed their ornamental wear, their plumes. They are moving on the river banks miserably, devoid of high spirit as if they are being taunted by flocks of sarasa birds (who are highspinted and cheerful).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
वित्रास्य कारण्डवचक्रवाका न्महारवैर्भिन्नकटा गजेन्द्राः। सरस्सु बद्धाम्बुजभूषणेषु विक्षोभ्य विक्षोभ्य जलं पिबन्ति4.30.41।।
output: 'Excellent elephants in rut, with ichor exuding from their temples trumpet, frightening the ducks and chakravaka birds in the water. Strirring the water in the lakes, ornamented with lotuses, they drink it.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
व्यपेतपङ्कासु सवालुकासु प्रसन्नतोयासु सगोकुलासु। ससारसारावनिनादितासु नदीषु हृष्टा निपतन्ति हंसाः4.30.42।।
output: 'The swans are full of joy, flocking on the sand banks of rivers crowded with cows where the water is pure and devoid of mud. The rivers are full of sarasa birds and swans who are singing delightfully.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नदीघनप्रस्रवणोदकाना मतिप्रवृद्धानिलबर्हिणानाम्। प्लवङ्गमानां च गतोत्सवानां द्रुतं रवास्सम्प्रति सम्प्रणष्टाः4.30.43।।
output: सम्प्रति now, नदीघनप्रस्रवणोदकानाम् of the water of rivers, clouds and waterfalls, अतिप्रवृद्धानिलबर्हिणानाम् of peacocks excited by blowing winds, गतोत्सवानाम् having lost pleasure, प्लवङ्गमानां च and the frogs, सम्प्रणष्टाः lost, द्रुतं quickly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनेकवर्णास्सुविनष्टकाया नवोदितेष्वम्बुधरेषु नष्टाः। क्षुधार्दिता घोरविषा बिलेभ्य श्चिरोषिता विप्रसरन्ति सर्पाः4.30.44।।
output: अम्बुधरेषु as the rainclouds, नवोदितेषु when seen fresh, नष्टाः lost, सुविनष्टकायाः bodies emaciated, अनेकवर्णाः of different colours, क्षुधार्दिताः troubled by hunger, घोरविषाः highly poisonous, चिरोषिताः staying for a long time, सर्पाः serpents, बिलेभ्यः from anthills, विप्रसरन्ति are coming out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
चञ्चच्चन्द्रकरस्पर्शहर्षोन्मीलिततारका। अहो रागवती सन्ध्या जहाति स्वयमम्बरम्4.30.45।।
output: 'While the stars appear with the soothing touch of the Moon's beams, this ruddy twilight is quitting the sky on her own.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
रात्रिश्शशाङ्कोदितसौम्यवक्त्रा तारागणोन्मीलितचारुनेत्रा। ज्योत्स्नांशुकप्रावरणा विभाति नारीव शुक्लांशुकसंवृताङ्गी4.30.46।।
output: 'The night appears like a lady with a sweet face lit up by the rising Moon, her beautiful eyes opened up by stars, her body draped in the robe of white Moon light.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विपक्वशालिप्रसवानि भुक्त्वा प्रहर्षिता सारसचारुपङ्क्तिः। नभस्समाक्रामति शीघ्रवेगाः वातावधूता ग्रथितेव माला4.30.47।।
output: 'Driven by the wind, the lovely sarasa birds, after eating ripened grains from paddy fields happily fly the sky in rows like a garland at great speed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
सुप्तैकहंसं कुमुदैरुपेतं महाह्रदस्थं सलिलं विभाति। घनैर्विमुक्तं निशि पूर्णचन्द्रं तारागणाकीर्णमिवान्तरिक्षम्4.30.48।।
output: 'With a single swan in sleep night lotuses blooming around it, the water in the big tank appear like the sky free from clouds with the full Moon and clusters of stars scattered. (The swan is the moon, the lotuses the stars and the clean pond the sky).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रकीर्णहंसाकुलमेखलानां प्रबुद्धपद्मोत्पलमालिनीनाम्। वाप्युत्तमानामधिकाऽद्य लक्ष्मी र्वराङ्गनानामिव भूषितानाम्4.30.49।।
output: 'Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth (also of autumn) appears decorated with deep wells like an excellent lady with swans as girdles and blooming lotuses and lilies as  garlands.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वेणुस्वनव्यञ्जिततूर्यमिश्रः प्रत्यूषकालानिलसम्प्रवृद्धः। सम्मूर्छितो गर्गरगोवृषाणा मन्योन्यमापूरयतीव शब्दः4.30.50।।
output: 'The whistling of bamboos enhanced by the wind in the early morning, and the bellowing of bulls echoing in the caves supplement each other as it were.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नवैर्नदीनां कुसुमप्रभासै र्व्याधूयमानैर्मृदुमारुतेन। धौतामलक्षौमपटप्रकाशैः कूलानि काशैरुपशोभितानि4.30.51।।
output: नदीनाम् of rivers, कूलानि banks, कुसुमप्रभासैः full of fresh bloomimg flowers, मृदुमारुतेन by the gentle wind, व्याधूयमानैः made to move, धौतामलक्षौमपटप्रकाशैः shining like a clean white silken cloth, नवैः  fresh, काशैः  kasa reeds, उपशोभितानि shine.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
वनप्रचण्डा मधुपानशौण्डाः प्रियान्विताष्षट्चरणाः प्रह्रृष्टाः। वनेषु मत्ताः पवनानुयात्रां कुर्वन्ति पद्मासनरेणुगौराः4.30.52।।
output: 'The butterflies glitter around in the forest fearlessly showing their skill in drinking honey, with their backs turned white with the dust of pollen grains from the lotus cups. They follow the wind along with their loved ones in the forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जलं प्रसन्नं कुमुदं प्रभासं क्रौञ्चस्वनश्शालिवनं विपक्वम्। मृदुश्च वायुर्विमलश्च चन्द्र श्शंसन्ति वर्षव्यपनीतकालम्4.30.53।।
output: 'The fresh blooms of night lotuses, the cackle of krauncha birds, fully ripened fields of paddy, the gentle breeze and the bright Moon indicate the coming to an end of the rainy season and setting in of autum.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मीनोपसन्दर्शितमेखलानां नदीवधूनां गतयोऽद्य मन्दाः। कान्तोपभुक्तालसगामिनीनां प्रभातकालेष्विव कामिनीनाम्4.30.54।।
output: 'Now the riverbrides, displaying their girdles of fish, have  slowed down like the gait of sensuous ladies in the early morning, exhausted by sexual pleasures.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
सचक्रवाकानि सशैवलानि काशैर्दुकूलैरिव संवृतानि। सपत्रलेखानि सरोचनानि वधूमुखानीव नदीमुखानि4.30.55।।
output: 'Crowded with chakravaka birds and green moss, and covered with kasa reeds like silken veils, the river banks appear like the face of the bride decorated with designs of green leaves and gorochana tilaka.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रफुल्लबाणासनचित्रितेषु प्रहृष्टषट्पादनिकूजितेषु। गृहीतचापोद्यतचण्डदण्डः प्रचण्डचारोऽद्य वनेषु कामः4.30.56।।
output: अद्य now, प्रफुल्लबाणासनचित्रितेषु cheerful as though painted with bana and asana flowers, प्रहृष्टषट्पादनिकूजितेषु bees are humming happily, वनेषु in the forest, गृहीतचापोद्यतचण्डदण्डः holding the bow and awarding strict punishment, कामः Cupid, प्रचण्डचारः moving with great speed and power.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लोकं सुवृष्ट्या परितोषयित्वा नदीस्तटाकानि च पूरयित्वा। निष्पन्नसस्यां वसुधां च कृत्वा त्यक्त्वा नभस्तोयधराः प्रणष्टाः4.30.57।।
output: 'Having showered heavy rains, and filling tanks and rivers, and producing bumper crops on the earth the clouds have disapeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
दर्शयन्ति शरन्नद्यः पुलिनानि शनैः शनैः। नवसङ्गमसव्रीडा जघनानीव योषितः4.30.58।।
output: 'Just as bashful young brides show their loins slowly during their first sexual meet the rivers start showing their sandy banks slowly in autumn.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
प्रसन्नसलिलास्सौम्य कुररीभिर्विनादिताः। चक्रवाकगणाकीर्णा विभान्ति सलिलाशयाः4.30.59।।
output: 'O gentle Lakshmana the pure water in the tanks and sweet sounds of flocks of female kurari birds and chakravakas there are splendid.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
असनास्सप्तपर्णाश्च कोविदाराश्च पुष्पिताः। दृश्यन्ते बन्धुजीवाश्च श्यामाश्च गिरिसानुषु4.30.60।।
output: 'The asanas, saptaparna, kovida and bandhujeeva trees and shyama creepers are seen in full bloom on the mountain slopes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
हंससारसचक्राह्वैः कुररैश्च समन्ततः। पुलिनान्यवकीर्णानि नदीनां पश्य लक्ष्मण4.30.61।।
output: 'Lakshmana look at the swans, sarasas, chakravakas and kurara birds scattered all over the river banks.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्योन्यबद्धवैराणां जिगीषूणां नृपात्मज। उद्योगसमयस्सौम्य पार्थिवानामुपस्थितः4.30.62।।
output: नृपात्मज O prince, सौम्य O handsome one, अन्योन्यबद्धवैराणाम् having enmity against others, जिगीषूणाम् waiting to be victorious, पार्थिवानाम् of kings, उद्योगसमयः time for expeditions, उपस्थितः has come.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इयं सा प्रथमा यात्रा पार्थिवानां नृपात्मज न च पश्यामि सुग्रीवमुद्योगं वा तथाविधम्4.30.63।।
output: 'O prince this is time for the first expedition (of the year) by kings. I do not find Sugriva making effort in that direction.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चत्वारो वार्षिका मासा गता वर्षशतोपमाः। मम शोकाभिभूतस्य सौम्य सीतामपश्यतः4.30.64।।
output: सीताम् Sita, अपश्यतः not seeing, सौम्य O gentle one, शोकाभिभूतस्य caught in grief, मम to me, वर्षशतोपमाः equal to a hundred years, वार्षिकाः rainy, चत्वारः four, मासाः months, गताः are gone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
चक्रवाकीव भर्तारं पृष्ठतोऽनुगता वनम्। विषमं दण्डकारण्यमुद्यानमिव याऽगता4.30.65।।
output: 'Just as a female chakravaka follows the male, Sita followed her husband into this dense Dandaka forest as though it is a pleasuregarden.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रियाविहीने दुःखार्ते हृतराज्ये विवासिते। कृपां न कुरुते राजा सुग्रीवो मयि लक्ष्मण4.30.66।।
output: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, प्रियाविहीने separated from wife, दुःखार्ते a griefstricken man, हृतराज्ये  lost kingdom, विवासिते banished, मयि at me, राजा सुग्रीवः king Sugriva, कृपाम् mercy, न कुरुते not showing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनाथो हृतराज्योऽयं रावणेन च धर्षितः। दीनो दूरगृहः कामी मां चैव शरणं गतः4.30.67।। इत्येतैः कारणैस्सौम्य सुग्रीवस्य दुरात्मनः। अहं वानरराजस्य परिभूतः परन्तप4.30.68।।
output: 'O gentle one although I am a vanquisher of foes, this evilminded king of monkeys is slighting me because I am away from home, I have lost my kingdom, I am outraged by Ravana, I am miserable and lovesick and I have sought his help.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनाथो हृतराज्योऽयं रावणेन च धर्षितः। दीनो दूरगृहः कामी मां चैव शरणं गतः4.30.67।। इत्येतैः कारणैस्सौम्य सुग्रीवस्य दुरात्मनः। अहं वानरराजस्य परिभूतः परन्तप4.30.68।।
output: 'O gentle one although I am a vanquisher of foes, this evilminded king of monkeys is slighting me because I am away from home, I have lost my kingdom, I am outraged by Ravana, I am miserable and lovesick and I have sought his help.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स कालं परिसङ्ख्याय सीतायाः परिमार्गणे। कृतार्थस्समयं कृत्वा दुर्मतिर्नावबुध्यते4.30.69।।
output: 'The evilminded Sugriva, having fulfilled his objective, does not realise that he has made a promise to me and has reached the time set for the search of Sita.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वं च किष्किन्धां प्रविश्य ब्रूहि वानरपुङ्गवम्। मूर्खं ग्राम्यसुखे सक्तं सुग्रीवं वचनान्मम4.30.70।।
output: 'Go to Kishkinda and speak (on my behalf ) to that  fool, Sugriva, the chief of monkeys who is revelling in habitual sensual pleasures

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अर्थिनामुपपन्नानां पूर्वं चाप्युपकारिणाम्। आशां संश्रुत्य यो हन्ति स लोके पुरुषाधमः4.30.71।।
output: 'He who, having promised to his friend to grant his desire and who, having been obliged, fails to implement the promise, is the lowest on earth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
शुभं वा यदि वा पापं यो हि वाक्यमुदीरितम्। सत्येन प्रतिगृह्णाति स वीरः पुरुषोत्तमः4.30.72।।
output: '(On the other hand) he who honours his promise, whether good or bad, is truly heroic, the best of men.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृतार्था ह्यकृतार्थानां मित्राणां न भवन्ति ये। तान्मृतानपि क्रव्यादाः कृतघ्नान्नोपभुञ्जते4.30.73।।
output: कृतार्थाः one who has achieved his objective, ये whoever, अकृतार्थानाम् of the needy man, मित्राणाम् to the friends, न भवन्ति not help, मृतान् after death, कृतघ्नान् ungrateful people, तान् them, क्रव्यादाः अपि even by carnivorous animals, न उपभुञ्जते not like to eat.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नूनं काञ्चनपृष्ठस्य विकृष्टस्य मया रणे। द्रष्टुमिच्छति चापस्य रूपं विद्युद्गणोपमम्4.30.74।।
output: 'Surely he wishes to see the form of my bow inlaid with gold bent by me to its full length, looking like a streak of lightning.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
घोरं ज्यातलनिर्घोषं क्रुद्धस्य मम संयुगे। निर्घोषमिव वज्रस्य पुनस्संश्रोतुमिच्छसि4.30.75।।
output: संयुगे in the combat, क्रुद्धस्य of the enraged, मम my, वज्रस्य thunderbolt's, निर्घोषमिव like the terrific sound, घोरम् dreadful, ज्यातलनिर्घोषम् twang of the bow string, पुनः again, संश्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छसि  wants.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
काममेवंगतेऽप्यस्य परिज्ञाते पराक्रमे। त्वत्सहायस्य मे वीर न चिन्ता स्यान्नृपात्मज4.30.76।।
output: 'O prince knowing my valour fully welI, and knowing that you are here to help me he is unhesitatingly revelling in sensual pleasures.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 30:
यदर्थमयमारम्भः कृतः परपुरञ्जयः। समयं नाभिजानाति कृतार्थः प्लवगेश्वरः4.30.77।।
output: 'O conqueror of the enemy capital the monkey lord who has achieved his goal does not realise the importance of my mission.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वर्षासमयकालं तु प्रतिज्ञाय हरीश्वरः। व्यतीतांश्चतुरो मासान्विहरन्नावबुध्यते4.30.78।।
output: 'Having promised (to search for Sita) after the rainy season,Sugriva is not aware that he has (already) spent the four monthsrevelling.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सामात्यपरिषत्क्रीडन्पानमेवोपसेवते। शोकदीनेषु नास्मासु सुग्रीवः कुरुते दयाम्4.30.79।।
output: 'Sporting with the council of ministers surrounding him, resorting to drinking, he shows no compassion to us feeling wretched with grief.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उच्यतां गच्छ सुग्रीवस्त्वया वत्स महाबल। मम रोषस्य यद्रूपं ब्रूयाश्चैवमिदं वचः4.30.80।।
output: 'O mighty warrior O dear, go to Sugriva and make him aware of the virulence of my anger and tell him:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न च सङ्कुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः। समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालिपथमन्वगाः4.30.81।।
output: 'The route by which Vali departed, killed by me has not been closed. O Sugriva you ought to abide by the pledge given. Do not  follow the path of Vali.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एक एव रणे वाली शरेण निहतो मया। त्वां तु सत्यादतिक्रान्तं हनिष्यामि सबान्धवम्4.30.82।।
output: 'Vali was killed by me in the battle with a single arrow while I shall kill you now along with your near and dear ones since you have deviated from the truth.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदेवं विहिते कार्ये यद्धितं पुरुषर्षभ। तत्तद्भ्रूहि नरश्रेष्ठत्वर कालव्यतिक्रमः4.30.83।।
output: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, नरश्रेष्ट O king among monkeys, तत् therefore, कार्ये in the task, एवम् in this way, विहिते when carried out, यत् all that, हितम् is good, तत् all that, ब्रूहि tell, त्वर be quick, कालव्यतिक्रमः time is passing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कुरुष्व सत्यं मयि वानरेश्वर प्रतिश्रुतं धर्ममवेक्ष्य शाश्वतम्। मा वालिनं प्रेत्य गतो यमक्षयं त्वमद्य पश्येर्मम चोदितैश्शरैः4.30.84।।
output: 'O lord of monkeys Carry out the promise you made to me, consider it to be eternal dharma. Slain by my arrows, you will see  Vali in the abode of the lord of death.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स पूर्वजं तीव्रविवृद्धकोपं लालप्यमानं प्रसमीक्ष्य दीनम्। चकार तीव्रां मतिमुग्रतेजा हरीश्वरे मानववंशनाथः4.30.85।।
output: मानववंशनाथः protector of the human race, उग्रतेजाः terrific lustre, सः he (Lakshmana), तीव्रविवृद्धकोपम् very angry, दीनम् piteous, लालप्यमानम् wailing, पूर्वजम् elder brother, प्रसमीक्ष्य on seeing, हरीश्वरे at Sugriva, तीव्रम् intense, मतिम् in mind, चकार went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स कामिनं दीनमदीनसत्त्वं शोकाभिपन्नं समुदीर्णकोपम्। नरेन्द्रसूनुर्नरदेवपुत्रं रामानुजः पूर्वजमित्युवाच4.31.1।।
output: Lakshmana arrives at Sugriva's cavepalace -- Lakshmana's anger over Sugriva's slackness -- monkeys fear Lakshamana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न वानरः स्थास्यति साधुवृत्ते न मंस्यते कर्मफलानुषङ्गान्। न भोज्यते वानरराज्यलक्ष्मीं तथाहि नाभिक्रमतेऽस्य बुद्धिः4.31.2।।
output: वानरः monkey (Sugriva), साधुवृत्ते well conducted, स्थास्यति abide, कर्मफलानुषङ्गान् sharing fruits of action equally, मंस्यते not recognised, वानरराज्यलक्ष्मीम् prosperous kingship of the monkeys, न भोज्यते not enjoy, तथाहि hence, अस्य his, बुद्धिः intellect, नाभिक्रमते not conducted in our favour (search of Sita)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मतिक्षयाद्ग्राम्यसुखेषु सक्त स्तव प्रसादाप्रतिकारबुद्धिः। हतोऽग्रजं पश्यतु वीर तस्य न राज्यमेवं विगुणस्य देयम्4.31.3।।
output: वीर hero, तव your, प्रसादाप्रतिकारबुद्धिः ingratitude to the benefactor, मतिक्षयात् mind grown smaller, ग्राम्यसुखेषु in rustic, vulgar pleasures, सक्तः engaged, हतः killed, अग्रजम् elder brother, तस्य his, पश्यतु let him see, एवम् that way, विगुणस्य desttitute of virtues, राज्यम् kingdom, न देयम् not to be given.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न धारये कोपमुदीर्णवेगं निहन्मि सुग्रीवमसत्यमद्य। हरिप्रवीरैस्सह वालिपुत्रो नरेन्द्रपत्न्या विचयं करोतु4.31.4।।
output: 'I cannot hold my overflowing anger. I shall kill this untruthful Sugriva. Let Vali's son along with the foremost of monkeys search for the queen (Sita).'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
तमात्तबाणासनमुत्पतन्तं निवेदितार्थं रणचण्डकोपम्। उवाच रामः परवीरहन्ता स्ववेक्षितं सानुनयं च वाक्यम्4.31.5।।
output: Rama, a slayer of enemy heroes but not of those who seek his refuge, spoke in a conciliatory tone to Lakshmana who jumped, wielding bow and arrows, inspired with his fierce fighting spirit.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
नेदमत्र त्वया ग्राह्यं साधुवृत्तेन लक्ष्मण। तां प्रीतिमनुवर्तस्व पूर्ववृत्तं च सङ्गतम्4.31.7।।
output: 'O Lakshmana with your good conduct you should not do so.  Keeping in view the affectionate friendship extended (by Sugriva) earlier, be friendly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सामोपहितया वाचा रूक्षाणि परिवर्जयन्। वक्तुमर्हसि सुग्रीवं व्यतीतं कालपर्यये4.31.8।।
output: कालपर्यये not attempting timely action, व्यतीतम् who exceeded, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, रूक्षाणि harsh, परिवर्जयन् avoiding, सामोपहितया adopting conciliating, वाचा with word, वक्तुम् to speak, अर्हसि proper for you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
सोऽग्रजेनानुशिष्टार्थो यथावत्पुरुषर्षभः। प्रविवेश पुरीं वीरो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा4.31.9।।
output: Having been duly briefed by his elder brother, the heroic Lakshmana, destroyer of enemies, a bull among men entered the city.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
ततश्शुभमतिः प्राज्ञो भ्रातुः प्रियहिते रतः। लक्ष्मणः प्रतिसंरब्धो जगाम भवनं कपेः4.31.10।। शक्रबाणासनप्रख्यं धनुः कालान्तकोपमः। प्रगृह्य गिरिशृङ्गाभं मन्दरः सानुमानिव।।4.31.11।।
output: The noblehearted, benevolent and wise Lakshmana, eager to please Rama, picked up his bow looking like a mountain peak, comparable to the bow of Indra and agitated with the anger of the god of Death entered the mansion of Sugriva which stood like the mountain peak of Mandara.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शुभमतिः प्राज्ञो भ्रातुः प्रियहिते रतः। लक्ष्मणः प्रतिसंरब्धो जगाम भवनं कपेः4.31.10।। शक्रबाणासनप्रख्यं धनुः कालान्तकोपमः। प्रगृह्य गिरिशृङ्गाभं मन्दरः सानुमानिव।।4.31.11।।
output: ततः then, शुभमतिः good hearted man, प्राज्ञ: wise man, प्रियहिते benevolent person, रतः involved, प्रतिसम्रब्धः eager to please, कालान्तकोपमः resembling the anger of the god of death, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शक्रबाणासनप्रख्यम् comparable to the bow of Indra, गिरिशृङ्गाभम् like a mountain peak, धनुः bow, प्रगृह्य holding, मन्दरः Mandara, सानुमानिव like mountain peak, कपेः monkey's, भवनम् to the mansion, जगाम went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
यथोक्तकारी वचनमुत्तरं चैव सोत्तरम्। बृहस्पतिसमो बुद्ध्या मत्वा रामानुजस्तदा4.31.12।। कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन भ्रातुः कोपाग्निना वृतः। प्रभञ्जन इवाप्रीतः प्रययौ लक्ष्मणस्तदा4.31.13।।
output: Then Lakshmana, obedient, intelligent like Brihaspati, like a tempest, encompassed by the fire of anger and deliberating in his mind as to the possible questions from Sugriva and the reply from him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
यथोक्तकारी वचनमुत्तरं चैव सोत्तरम्। बृहस्पतिसमो बुद्ध्या मत्वा रामानुजस्तदा4.31.12।। कामक्रोधसमुत्थेन भ्रातुः कोपाग्निना वृतः। प्रभञ्जन इवाप्रीतः प्रययौ लक्ष्मणस्तदा4.31.13।।
output: Then Lakshmana, obedient, intelligent like Brihaspati, like a tempest, encompassed by the fire of anger and deliberating in his mind as to the possible questions from Sugriva and the reply from him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सालतालाश्वकर्णांश्च तरसा पातयन्बहून्। पर्यस्यन्गिरिकूटानि द्रुमानन्यांश्च वेगतः4.31.14।। शिलाश्च शकलीकुर्वन्पद्भ्यां गज इवाशुगः। दूरामेकपदं त्यक्त्वा ययौ कार्यवशाद्द्रुतम्4.31.15।।
output: आशुगः swift, गज इव like an elephant, वेगतः speedily, तरसा vigorously, सालतालाश्वकर्णांश्च sala, tala, and asvakarna, पातयन् felling trees, अन्यान् and others, द्रुमांश्च trees, गिरिकूटानि mountain rocks, बलात् forcibly, पर्यस्यन् turning them, पद्भ्याम् with his feet, शिलाः rocks, शकलीकुर्वन् breaking to pieces, दूरम् a distance, एकपदे with one foot, त्यक्त्वा pushing, कार्यवशात् to carry out the task, द्रुतम् quickly, ययौ went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
सालतालाश्वकर्णांश्च तरसा पातयन्बहून्। पर्यस्यन्गिरिकूटानि द्रुमानन्यांश्च वेगतः4.31.14।। शिलाश्च शकलीकुर्वन्पद्भ्यां गज इवाशुगः। दूरामेकपदं त्यक्त्वा ययौ कार्यवशाद्द्रुतम्4.31.15।।
output: 'Lakshmana rushed on foot speedily, cutting the branches of sala, tala and asvakarna and other trees on the way  and forcibly turning and crushing the mountain rocks into pieces with a single foot, like a swiftmoving elephant taking long strides, to carry out the task.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तामपश्यद्बलाकीर्णां हरिराजमहापुरीम्। दुर्गामिक्ष्वाकुशार्दूलः किष्किन्धां गिरिसङ्गटे4.31.16।।
output: इक्ष्वाकुशार्दूलः tiger of the Ikshvaku race, गिरिसङ्कटे in between the mountains, बलाकीर्णाम् filled by the army, दुर्गाम् inaccessible, हरिराजमहापुरीम् vanara king's capital city, ताम् that, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkinda, अपश्यत् saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रोषात्प्रस्फुरमाणोष्ठ स्सुग्रीवं प्रति लक्ष्मणः। ददर्श वानरान्भीमाकनिष्किन्धाया बहिश्चरान्4.31.17।।
output: His lips trembling in anger, Lakshmana saw fierceful monkey guards of Sugriva at the entrance of Kishkinda city.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं दृष्ट्वा वानरास्सर्वे लक्ष्मणं पुरुषर्षभम्। शैलशृङ्गाणि शतशः प्रवृद्धांश्च महीरुहान्4.31.18।। जगृहुः कुञ्जरप्रख्या वानराः पर्वतान्तरे।
output: पर्वतान्तरे in between the mountains, कुञ्जरप्रख्याः comparable to elephants in size, सर्वे all, वानराः monkeys, पुरुषर्षभम् bull among men, तं लक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, शतशः in hundreds, शैलशृङ्गाणि boulders of rocks, प्रवृद्धान् fully grown, महीरुहान् च huge trees, जगृहुः seized.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
तान्गृहीतप्रहरणान्सर्वान्दृष्ट्वा तु लक्ष्मणः4.31.19।। बभूव द्विगुणं क्रुद्धो बह्विन्धन इवानलः।
output: On seeing the monkeys wielding weapons, Lakshmana's anger doubled like logs of firewood put to burning.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
तं ते भयपरीताङ्गाः क्रुद्धं दृष्ट्वा प्लवङ्गमाः4.31.20।। कालमृत्युयुगान्ताभं शतशो विद्रुता दिशः।
output: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, who looked like a veritable god of Death at the time of dissolution of the universe, hundreds of monkeys, their limbs trembling in fear ran in different directions.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्सुग्रीवभवनं प्रविश्य हरिपुङ्गवाः4.31.21।। क्रोधमागमनं चैव लक्ष्मणस्य न्यवेदयन्।
output: ततः then, हरिपुङ्गवा: monkeychiefs, सुग्रीवभवनम् to Sugriva's mansion, प्रविश्य having entered, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, आगमनम् about the arrival, क्रोधं चैव and his anger, न्यवेदयन् reported.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तारया सहितः कामी सक्तः कपिवृषो रहः4.31.22।। न तेषां कपिवीराणां शुश्राव वचनं तदा।
output: तदा then, कामी passionate, तारया with Tara, सहितः along with, रहः in privy, सक्तः engrossed in love, कपिवृषः bull among monkeys, तेषाम् their, कपिवीराणाम् of the monkeychiefs, वचनम् words, न शुश्राव not heed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सचिवसन्दिष्टा हरयो रोमहर्षणाः। गिरिकुञ्जर मेघाभा नगर्या निर्ययुस्तदा।।4.31.23।।
output: Commanded by the ministers, the monkeys who looked like fierce mountains, elephants and clouds that caused horripilation, left the place at once.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नखदंष्ट्रायुधा घोरास्सर्वे विकृतदर्शनाः4.31.24।। सर्वे शार्दूलदर्पाश्च सर्वे च विकृताननाः।
output: The monkeys, their faces, deformed, their nails and teeth like weapons were dreadful and horrifying in appearance, proud as tigers

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दशनागबलाः केचित्केचिद्दशगुणोत्तराः4.31.25।। केचिन्नागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः।
output: Of them some possessed the strength of ten, some a hundred and some a thousand elephants. All of them were of equal valour.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृत्स्नांहि कपिभिर्व्याप्तां द्रुमहस्सैर्महाबलैः4.31.26।। अपश्यल्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धः किष्किन्धां तां दुरासदाम्।
output: कृत्स्नां entire palace, क्रुद्धः angry, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, द्रुमहस्तै: holding trees in hands, महाबलैः mighty strong, कपिभिः monkeys, व्याप्ताम् huge, दुरासदाम् inaccessible, तां किष्किन्धाम् that Kishkinda, अपश्यत् saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
ततस्ते हरयस्सर्वे प्राकारपरिघान्तरात्4.31.27।। निष्क्रम्योदग्रसत्त्वास्तु तस्थुराविष्कृतं तदा।
output: The mighty monkeys came out of the entrance of the ironboundary wall from beneath and made their appearance and stood in full attention.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुग्रीवस्य प्रमादं च पूर्वजं चार्तमात्मवान्4.31.28।। बुद्ध्वा कोपवशं वीरः पुनरेव जगाम सः।
output: आत्मवान् sensible, सः वीरः that warrior, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, प्रमादम् dereliction, पूर्वजं च and his elder brother, आर्तम् helpless, बुद्ध्वा  recognising, पुनरेव once again, क्रोधवशम् under the grip of anger, जगाम was drawn.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स दीर्घोष्णमहोच्छवासः कोपसंरक्तलोचनः4.31.29।। बभूव नरशार्दूल स्सधूम इव पावकः।
output: Sighing hot, deep breath, eyes turned red in anger, this tiger among men appeared like fire with smoke (The sigh was smoke and red eyes, fire).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाणशल्यस्फुरज्जिह्वस्सायकासनभोगवान्4.31.30।। स्वतेजोविषसङ्घातः पञ्चास्य इव पन्नगः।
output: His bow was like the hood of a snake,with the iron nails fixed on the tip of his arrows like moving fangs and his own brightness like the venom of the fivehooded snake.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं नागेन्द्रमिव कोपितम्4.31.31।। समासाद्याङ्गदस्त्रासाद्विषादमगमद्भृशम्।
output: Dismayed, Angada approached Lakshmana, who was glowing like fire at the time of dissolution of the world and enraged like the lord of serpents.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
सोऽङ्गदं रोषताम्राक्षस्सन्दिदेश महायशाः4.31.32।। सुग्रीवः कथ्यतां वत्स ममागमनमित्युत।
output: Renowned Lakshmana, with his eyes turned red in anger said to Angada 'O dear, inform Sugriva, about my arrival'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एष रामानुजः प्राप्तस्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम4.31.33।। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तो द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः। तस्य वाक्यं यदि रुचिः क्रियतां साधु वानर4.31.34।। इत्युक्त्वा शीघ्रमागच्छ वत्स वाक्यमरिन्दम।
output: 'O subduer of enemies speak in this way: 'Lakshmana, the dear younger brother of Rama has come to you and waits for your presence at the entrance, burning in grief of his elder brother. Well, if you like to hear his words, do as you please.' 'Return swiftly after saying so.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष रामानुजः प्राप्तस्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम4.31.33।। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तो द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः। तस्य वाक्यं यदि रुचिः क्रियतां साधु वानर4.31.34।। इत्युक्त्वा शीघ्रमागच्छ वत्स वाक्यमरिन्दम।
output: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, वत्स dear, भ्रातुः brother's, व्यसनसन्तप्तः burning in grief, रामानुजः Rama's younger brother, एषः लक्ष्मणः this Lakshmana, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, प्राप्तः arrived, द्वारि at the entrance, तिष्ठति stands, वानर Vanara, रुचिः यदि if you like, तस्य his, वाक्ये words, साधु well, क्रियताम् do accordingly, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, शीघ्रम् swiftly, आगच्छ come.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शोकाविष्टोऽङ्गदोऽब्रवीत्। पितुस्समीपमागम्य सौमित्रिरयमागतः4.31.35।।
output: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, शोकाविष्ट: griefstricken, अङ्गदः Angada, पितुः father's, समीपम् near, आगम्य reached, अयम् this, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, आगतः has come, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथाङ्गदस्तस्य वचो निशम्य सम्भ्रान्तभावः परिदीनवक्त्रः। निपत्य तूर्णं नृपतेस्तरस्वी ततः रुमायाश्चरणौ ववन्दे4.31.36।।
output: On hearing Lakshmana's words powerful Angada felt agitated. His face turned pale. He went and prostrated at once to the king and then to the queen, Ruma.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
संङ्गृह्य पादौ पितुरग्र्यतेजाः जग्राह मातुः पुनरेव पादौ। पादौ रुमायाश्च निपीडयित्वा निवेदयामास ततस्तमर्थम्4.31.37।।
output: Highly brilliant Angada holding his father's feet first, then mother's and thereafter Ruma's, reported the matter to  Sugriva.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स निद्रामदसंवीतो वानरो न विबुद्धवान्। बभूव मदमत्तश्च मदनेन च मोहितः4.31.38।।
output: निद्रामदसंवीतः overcome by drinks and sleep, वानरः monkey, न विबुद्धवान् he did not come to his senses, मदमत्तश्च intoxicated, मदनेन च overwhelmed by love, मोहितः deluded, बभूव appeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
ततः किलकिलां चक्रुर्लक्ष्मणं प्रेक्ष्य वानराः। प्रसादयन्तस्तं क्रुद्धं भयमोहितचेतसः4.31.39।।
output: Looking at angry Lakshmana, and scared at heart, the monkeys started making a noise in order to please him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते महौघनिभं दृष्ट्वा वज्राशनिसमस्वनम्। सिंहनादं समं चक्रुर्लक्ष्मणस्य समीपतः4.31.40।।
output: ते they, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, महौघनिभम् looked like a mighty flood, वज्राशनिसमस्वनम् noise like a thunderbolt, सिंहनादम् lion's roar, समम् like, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, समीपतः near, चक्रुः made.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
तेन शब्देन महता प्रत्यबुध्यत वानरः। मदविह्वलताम्राक्षो व्याकुलस्रग्विभूषणः4.31.41।।
output: By the great sound (of the monkeys) the drunken redeyed vanara king awakened, his garlands and ornaments in disarray.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथाङ्गदवचः श्रुत्वा तेनैव च समागतौ। मन्त्रिणौ वानरेन्द्रस्य सम्मतौ दारदर्शिनौ4.31.42।। प्लक्षश्चैव प्रभावश्च मन्त्रिणावर्थधर्मयोः। वक्तुमुच्चावचं प्राप्तं लक्ष्मणं तौ शशंसतुः4.31.43।।
output: On hearing Angada's words the two ministers named Plaksha and Prabhava who were perrmitted to have audience with the queens went to the harem on invitation from Angada. They reported to Sugriva about the arrival of Lakshmana who had come to speak to him about matters regading wealth and righteousness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथाङ्गदवचः श्रुत्वा तेनैव च समागतौ। मन्त्रिणौ वानरेन्द्रस्य सम्मतौ दारदर्शिनौ4.31.42।। प्लक्षश्चैव प्रभावश्च मन्त्रिणावर्थधर्मयोः। वक्तुमुच्चावचं प्राप्तं लक्ष्मणं तौ शशंसतुः4.31.43।।
output: अथ then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तेनैव along with him, समागतौ both of them assembled, सम्मतौ दारदर्शिनौ both of them permitted to have audience with womenfolk, अर्थधर्मयोः in matters of wealth and righteousness, मन्त्रिणौ ministers, प्लक्षश्चैव Plaksha and, प्रभावश्च Prabhava also, तौ both, वानरेन्द्रस्य the king's, मन्त्रिणौ both ministers, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana's, प्राप्तम् arrived, वक्तुम् to tell, उच्चावचम् to talk , शंसतुः both of them spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रसादयित्वा सुग्रीवं वचनैस्सामनिश्चितैः। आसीनं पर्युपासीनौ यथा शक्रं मरुत्पतिम्4.31.44।।
output: Both of them sat close by Sugriva who was like Indra and said these pleasing words:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सत्यसन्धौ महाभागौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। वयस्यभावं सम्प्राप्तौ राज्यार्हौ राज्यदायिनौ4.31.45।।
output: 'Rama and Lakshmana, both the brothers venerable and true to their promise, have conferred on you sovereignty and have extended friendship.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तयोरेको धनुष्पाणिर्द्वारि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः। यस्य भीताः प्रवेपन्तो नादान्मुञ्चन्ति वानराः4.31.46।।
output: तयोः between the two, एकः only, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, धनुष्पाणिः wielding a bow in his hand, द्वारि at the entrance, तिष्ठति is standing, यस्य his, भीताः frightened ones, प्रवेपन्तः are trembling, वानराः monkeys, नादान् sounds, मुञ्चन्ति are producing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स एष राघवभ्राता लक्ष्मणो वाक्यसारथिः। व्यवसायरथः प्राप्तस्तस्य रामस्य शासनात्4.31.47।।
output: 'By the command of Rama, his brother has come to you, Rama's words as charioteer and his work as chariot'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयं च दयितो राजंस्ताराया स्तनयोऽङ्गदः। लक्ष्मणेन सकाशं ते प्रेषितस्त्वरयाऽनघ4.31.48।।
output: 'O blameless king Tara's son, Angada, has sent us into your presence. Lakshmana has come.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 31:
सोऽयं रोषपरीताक्षो द्वारि तिष्ठति वीर्यवान्। वानरान्वानरपते चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव4.31.49।।
output: 'O lord of monkeys Valiant Lakshmana is standing at the entrance,eyes filled with anger as if he would burn the vanaras'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य त्वं सपुत्रस्सहबन्धुभिः। गच्छ शीघ्रं महाराज रोषो ह्यस्य निवर्त्यताम्4.31.50।।
output: महाराज O great king, त्वम् you, सपुत्रः with your son, सहबान्धवः with your relations, शीघ्रम् quickly, गच्छ go, मूर्ध्ना face, तस्य his, प्रणम्य after saluting, अद्य now, रोषः anger, निवर्त्यताम् may be averted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदाह रामो धर्मात्मा तत्कुरुष्व समाहितः। राजं स्तिष्ठस्व समये भव सत्यप्रतिश्रवाः4.31.51।।
output: राजन् O king, धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, यत् whatever, आह says तत् that, समाहितः with a steady mind, कुरुष्व  you may do, सत्यप्रतिश्रवाः be true to your promise, स्वसमये your agreement, भव you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गदस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्सचिवैस्सह। लक्ष्मणं कुपितं श्रुत्वा मुमोचासनमात्मवान्4.32.1।।
output: Sugriva's anxiety to know the reason for Lakshmana's anger -- Hanuman persuades Sugriva to act.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सचिवानब्रवीद्वाक्यं निश्चित्य गुरुलाघवम्। मन्त्रज्ञान्मन्त्रकुशलो मन्त्रेषु परिनिष्ठितान्4.32.2।।
output: Sugriva, being skilled in secret assessment of matters, considering the merits and demerits, spoke to his council of ministers capable of intelligent counselling:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न मे दुर्व्याहृतं किञ्चिन्नापि मे दुरनुष्ठितम्। लक्ष्मणो राघवभ्राता क्रुद्धः किमिति चिन्तये4.32.3।।
output: मे of me, किञ्चित् a little, न दुर्व्याहृतम् not uttered any harsh or arrogant word, मे of me, अपि दुरनुष्ठितम् indeed no wrong deed is done, राघव भ्राता Rama's brother, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, किम् why, क्रुद्धः angry, इति this, चिन्तये I am thinking.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
असुहृद्भिर्ममामित्रैर्नित्यमन्तरदर्शिभिः। मम दोषानसम्भूतान् श्रावितो राघवानुजः4.32.4।।
output: राघवानुजः Rama's younger brother, असुहृद्भि: heartless people, नित्यम् always, अन्तरदर्शिभिः picking holes at me, अमित्रैः by enmies, मम my, असम्भूतान् imaginary, दोषान् faults, श्रावितः have told.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 32:
अत्र तावद्यथाबुद्धि सर्वैरेव यथाविधि। भावस्य निश्चयस्तावद्विज्ञेयो निपुणं शनैः4.32.5।।
output: 'In the meanwhile, (right now) all of you should think quietly and try to know the reason (for Lakshmana's anger), using your intellect and expertise logically and decide( the course of action).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न खल्वस्ति मम त्रासो लक्ष्मणान्नापि राघवात्। मित्रं त्वस्थानकुपितं जनयत्येव सम्भ्रमम्4.32.6।।
output: 'I have no fear either from Lakshmana or from Rama. However, when a friend is enraged without reason, it creates misgivings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वथा सुकरं मित्रं दुष्करं परिपालनम्। अनित्यत्वाच्छ चित्तानां प्रीतिरल्पेपि भिद्यते4.32.7।।
output: 'It is easy to earn a friend but keeping the friendship sustained is difficult. Due to fickleness of mind friendship gets broken even on flimsy grounds.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अतो निमित्तं त्रस्तोहं रामेण तु महात्मना। यन्मयोपकृतं शक्यं प्रतिकर्तुं न तन्मया4.32.8।।
output: 'Therefore, I am apprehensive of Rama. I am not able to repay the help he has rendered to me'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान्हरिपुङ्गवः। उवाच स्वेन तर्केण मध्ये वानरमन्त्रिणाम्4.32.9।।
output: सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, एवम् in that way, उक्तस्तु been said, हरिपुङ्गवः best of monkeys, हनुमान् Hanuman, वानरमन्त्रिणाम् among monkeys ministers, मध्य in the midst, स्वेन by his own, तर्केण logic, उवाच said these words.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वथा नैतदाश्चर्यं यस्त्वं हरिगणेश्वर। न विस्मरसि सुस्निग्धमुपकार कृतं शुभम्4.32.10।।
output: हरिगणेश्वर chief of the vanara clan, त्वम् to you, सुस्निग्धम्  with utmost sense of friendship, कृतम् done, शुभम् good, न विस्मरसि इति यत् forgetting like this, एतत् this way, सर्वथा always, आश्चर्यम् surprise, न no.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राघवेण तु वीरेण भयमुत्सृज्य दूरतः। त्वत्प्रियार्थं हतो वाली शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः4.32.11।।
output: 'To remove your fear and to please you, the great hero Rama has killed Vali, an equal to Indra in valour.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वथा प्रणयात्कृद्धो राघवो नात्र संशयः। भ्रातरं सम्प्रहितवान्लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्4.32.12।।
output: 'Rama's anger is purely out of love for you. He has sent Lakshmana, a bestower of prosperity to you. There is no doubt about it.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 32:
त्वं प्रमत्तो न जानीषे कालं कालविदां वर। फुल्लसप्तच्छदश्यामा प्रवृत्ता तु शरच्छिवा4.32.13।।
output: 'You knows best the passage of time (changing seasons). But you are not aware out of inattention that the auspicious autumn has set in, making the garden lush green with blossoms of Saptachada flowers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निर्मलग्रहनक्षत्रा द्यौः प्रनष्टवलाहका। प्रसन्नाश्च दिशस्सर्वास्सरितश्च सरांसि च4.32.14।।
output: प्रनष्टवलाहका with disappearance of clouds, द्यौः sky, निर्मलग्रहनक्षत्रा with clear appearance of planets and constellations, सर्वाः all, दिशः directions, सरितश्च rivers, सरांसि च and tanks, प्रसन्नाः pleasant.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्राप्तमुद्योगकालं तु नावैषि हरिपुङ्गव। त्वं प्रमत्त इति व्यक्तं लक्ष्मणोऽयमिहागतः4.32.15।।
output: हरिपुङ्गव chief of monkeys, प्राप्तम् having set in, उद्योगकालम् time for making millitary endeavour, नावैषि not aware, त्वम् you, प्रमत्तः इति inattentive, अयं लक्ष्मणः this Lakshmana, इह here, आगतः has come, व्यक्तम् it is evident.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आर्तस्य हृतदारस्य पुरुषं पुरुषान्तरात्। वचनं मर्षणीयं ते राघवस्य महात्मनः4.32.16।।
output: आर्तस्य of a man in distress, हृतदारस्य of a man who is deprived of his wife, महात्मनः of a great self, राघवस्य Rama's, पुरुषान्तरात् from another man, परुषम् harsh, वचनम् words, ते for you, मर्षणीयम् should be tolerated.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृतापराधस्य हि ते नान्यत्पश्याम्यहं क्षमम्। अन्तरेणाञ्जलिं बद्ध्वा लक्ष्मणस्य प्रसादनात्4.32.17।।
output: 'In these circumstances the best way is seeking apology from Lakshmana with folded hands. I do not see any way other than this.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नियुक्तैर्मन्त्रिभिर्वाच्यो ह्यवश्यं पार्थिवो हितम्। अत एव भयं त्यक्त्वा ब्रवीम्यवधृतं वचः4.32.18।।
output: 'The counsellors and ministers appointed by a king should certainly give good advice, without fear. This I tell you since I have faith in my words.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न स क्षमः कोपयितुं यः प्रसाद्यः पुनर्भवेत्। पूर्वोपकारं स्मरता कृतज्ञेन विशेषतः4.32.20।।
output: 'He who deserves propitiation, should not be offended, more so by a  grateful man, remembering the  help received by him earlier.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 32:
तस्य मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य त्वं सपुत्रस्ससुहृज्जनः। राजंस्तिष्ठस्व समये भर्तुर्भार्येव तद्वशः4.32.21।।
output: 'O king bow down your head along with your son, friends and relations and honour the oath just as a wife subordinates to the will of the husband. Stand by obediently.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न रामरामानुजशासनं त्वया कपीन्द्र युक्तं मनसाऽप्यपोहितुम्। मनो हि ते ज्ञास्यति मानुषं बलं स राघवस्यास्य सुरेन्द्रवर्चसः4.32.22।।
output: कपीन्द्र O king of monkeys, रामरामानुजशासनम् Rama's word or Lakshmana's command, त्वया by you, मनसापि even in heart, अपोहितुम् to overlook, न युक्तम् not proper, अस्य his, सराघवस्य along with Rama, सुरेन्द्रवर्चसः countenace having the lustre of Indra, मानुषम् human, बलम् strength, ते मनः your mind, ज्ञास्यति हि  knows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ प्रतिसमादिष्टो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। प्रविवेश गुहां घोरां किष्किन्धां रामशासनात्।।4.33.1।।
output: अथ and then, प्रतिसमादिष्टः having been called in, परवीरहा slayer of enemies, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रामशासनात् as per Rama's command, घोराम् frightful in appearance, गुहाम् cave, किष्किन्धाम् Kishkinda, प्रविवेश entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्वारस्था हरयस्तत्र महाकाया महाबलाः। बभूवुर्लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे प्राञ्जलय स्थिताः।।4.33.2।।
output: तत्र there, द्वारस्थाः  gatekeepers, महाकायाः of huge body, महाबलाः mighty, हरयः monkeys, सर्वे all, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा seeing, प्राञ्जलयः greeted with folded palms, स्थिताः stood, बभूवुः became.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निश्वसन्तं तु तं दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्धं दशरथात्मजम्। बभूवुर्हरयस्त्रस्ता न चैनं पर्यवारयन्।।4.33.3।।
output: The monkeys kept away out of fear to see the son of Dasaratha, who was angry and sighing deeply.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तां रत्नमयीं श्रीमान्दिव्यां पुष्पितकाननाम्। रम्यां रत्नसमाकीर्णां ददर्श महतीं गुहाम्।।4.33.4।।
output: Lakshmana, the bestower of fortune, saw the mammoth cave inlaid with gems and precious stones and forests full of delightful flowers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधां नानापण्योपशोभिताम्। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभिताम्।।4.33.5।।
output: हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधाम् thronged with elevated mansions and palaces, नानापण्योपशोभिताम् illumined with jewels, सर्वकामफलैः which satisfied every one's wish, पुष्पितैः flowers in bloom, वृक्षैः by trees, उपशोभिताम् splendid.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
देवगन्धर्वपुत्रैश्च वानरैः कामरूपिभिः। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरै श्शोभितां प्रियदर्शनैः।।4.33.6।।
output: देवगन्धर्वपुत्रैः sons born of gods and gandharvas, कामरूपिभिः by those who could change their form as they wished, दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरैः wearing beautiful garlands, प्रियदर्शनैः  pleasing in appearance, वानरैः by monkeys, उपशोभिताम् very delightful.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चन्दनागरुपद्मानां गन्धैस्सुरभिगन्धिनाम्। मैरेयाणां मधूनां च सम्मोदितमहापथाम्।।4.33.7।।
output: The royal roads were filled with fragrant unguents, like sandal, agaru and lotus incenses, finesmelling honey of several kinds and happy inhabitants.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विन्ध्यमेरुगिरिप्रख्यै: प्रासादैर्नैकभूमिभिः। ददर्श गिरिनद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र राघवः।।4.33.8।।
output: Lakshmana saw tall buildings comparable to Vindhya and Meru mountains and pure water flowing from the mountain streams.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
अङ्गदस्य गृहं रम्यं मैन्दस्य द्विविधस्य च। गवयस्य गवाक्षस्य गजस्य शरभस्य च।।4.33.9।। विद्युन्मालेश्च सम्पाते स्सूर्याक्षस्य हनूमतः। वीरबाहो स्सुबाहोश्च नलस्य च महात्मनः।।4.33.10।। कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तारजाम्बवतोस्तथा। दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः।।4.33.11।। एतेषां कपिमुख्यानां राजमार्गे महात्मनाम्। ददर्श गृहमुख्यानि महासाराणि लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.12।।
output: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अङ्गदस्य गृहं रम्यं मैन्दस्य द्विविधस्य च। गवयस्य गवाक्षस्य गजस्य शरभस्य च।।4.33.9।। विद्युन्मालेश्च सम्पाते स्सूर्याक्षस्य हनूमतः। वीरबाहो स्सुबाहोश्च नलस्य च महात्मनः।।4.33.10।। कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तारजाम्बवतोस्तथा। दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः।।4.33.11।। एतेषां कपिमुख्यानां राजमार्गे महात्मनाम्। ददर्श गृहमुख्यानि महासाराणि लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.12।।
output: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अङ्गदस्य Angada's, रम्यम् beautiful, गृहम् home, मैन्दस्य Mainda's,  च  and, गवयस्य Gavaya's, गवाक्षस्य Gavaksha's, गजस्य Gaja's, शरभस्य च and Sarabha's, विद्युन्मालेश्च Vidyunmala's, सम्पातेः Sampati's, सूर्याक्षस्य Suryaksha's, हनूमतः Hanuman's, वीरबाहोः Veerabahu's, सुबाहोश्च Subhahu's, महात्मनः of the great, नलस्य च Nala's, कुमुदस्य Kumuda's, सुषेणस्य Sushena's, तथा similarly, तारजाम्बवतोः Tara's and Jambavan's, दधिवक्त्रस्य् of Dadhivaktra's, नीलस्य Nila's, सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः of Supaatala and Sunetra, एतेषाम् of all of them, महात्मनाम् great ones, कपिमुख्यानाम् monkey chiefs, महासाराणि prosperous, द्विविदस्य Dwivida's, गृहमुख्यानि important homes, राजमार्गे on the royal road, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
अङ्गदस्य गृहं रम्यं मैन्दस्य द्विविधस्य च। गवयस्य गवाक्षस्य गजस्य शरभस्य च।।4.33.9।। विद्युन्मालेश्च सम्पाते स्सूर्याक्षस्य हनूमतः। वीरबाहो स्सुबाहोश्च नलस्य च महात्मनः।।4.33.10।। कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तारजाम्बवतोस्तथा। दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः।।4.33.11।। एतेषां कपिमुख्यानां राजमार्गे महात्मनाम्। ददर्श गृहमुख्यानि महासाराणि लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.12।।
output: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
अङ्गदस्य गृहं रम्यं मैन्दस्य द्विविधस्य च। गवयस्य गवाक्षस्य गजस्य शरभस्य च।।4.33.9।। विद्युन्मालेश्च सम्पाते स्सूर्याक्षस्य हनूमतः। वीरबाहो स्सुबाहोश्च नलस्य च महात्मनः।।4.33.10।। कुमुदस्य सुषेणस्य तारजाम्बवतोस्तथा। दधिवक्त्रस्य नीलस्य सुपाटलसुनेत्रयोः।।4.33.11।। एतेषां कपिमुख्यानां राजमार्गे महात्मनाम्। ददर्श गृहमुख्यानि महासाराणि लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.12।।
output: On the royal road, Lakshmna saw beautiful homes of monkeychiefs Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, Gavaya, Gavaksha, Gaja, Sarabha, Vidyunmalin, Sampati, Suryaksha, Hanuman, Veerabahu, Subahu, the great Nala, Kumuda and Sushena. Similarly he saw the homes of Tara and Jambavan, Dadhivaktra, Nila, Supatala and Sunetra. (Tara mentioned here is a male monkey.)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पाण्डुराभ्रप्रकाशानि दिव्यमाल्ययुतानि च। प्रभूतधनधान्यानि स्त्रीरत्नै श्शोभितानि च।।4.33.13।।
output: पाण्डुराभ्रप्रकाशानि shining like white clouds, दिव्यमाल्ययुतानि च with wonderful garlands hanging, प्रभूतधनधान्यानि filled with abundant wealth and grain, स्त्रीरत्नैः with best of women, शोभितानि च shining bright.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पाण्डुरेण तु सालेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।4.33.14।। शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्।।4.33.15।। महेन्द्रदत्तैश्श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसन्निभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैशीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः।।4.33.16।। हरिभिस्संवृतद्वारं बलिभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्।।4.33.17।। सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणस्सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः।।4.33.18।।
output: The abode of Sugriva was encircled by a white rampart and unapproachable.It was enchanting like the abode of Indra. The mansion tops were like the white peaks of Kailas mountain filled with blossoming trees which could yield all kinds of fruits to suit one's taste. The trees were huge like dark clouds, cool and shady with wonderful flowers in full bloom, the riches gifted by Indra, were delightful. The entrance was guarded by mighty monkeys holding weapons in hand. It had a golden archway at the entrance decorated with wonderful garlands and strings of golden flowers. Saumitri of great prowess entered the rich abode of Sugriva just as the Sun enters huge clouds unobstructed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
पाण्डुरेण तु सालेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।4.33.14।। शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्।।4.33.15।। महेन्द्रदत्तैश्श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसन्निभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैशीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः।।4.33.16।। हरिभिस्संवृतद्वारं बलिभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्।।4.33.17।। सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणस्सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः।।4.33.18।।
output: The abode of Sugriva was encircled by a white rampart and unapproachable.It was enchanting like the abode of Indra. The mansion tops were like the white peaks of Kailas mountain filled with blossoming trees which could yield all kinds of fruits to suit one's taste. The trees were huge like dark clouds, cool and shady with wonderful flowers in full bloom, the riches gifted by Indra, were delightful. The entrance was guarded by mighty monkeys holding weapons in hand. It had a golden archway at the entrance decorated with wonderful garlands and strings of golden flowers. Saumitri of great prowess entered the rich abode of Sugriva just as the Sun enters huge clouds unobstructed.

Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
पाण्डुरेण तु सालेन परिक्षिप्तं दुरासदम्। वानरेन्द्रगृहं रम्यं महेन्द्रसदनोपमम्।।4.33.14।। शुक्लैः प्रासादशिखरैः कैलासशिखरोपमैः। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पितैरुपशोभितम्।।4.33.15।। महेन्द्रदत्तैश्श्रीमद्भिर्नीलजीमूतसन्निभैः। दिव्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैशीतच्छायैर्मनोरमैः।।4.33.16।। हरिभिस्संवृतद्वारं बलिभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः। दिव्यमाल्यावृतं शुभ्रं तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणम्।।4.33.17।। सुग्रीवस्य गृहं रम्यं प्रविवेश महाबलः। अवार्यमाणस्सौमित्रिर्महाभ्रमिव भास्करः।।4.33.18।।
output: The abode of Sugriva was encircled by a white rampart and unapproachable.It was enchanting like the abode of Indra. The mansion tops were like the white peaks of Kailas mountain filled with blossoming trees which could yield all kinds of fruits to suit one's taste. The trees were huge like dark clouds, cool and shady with wonderful flowers in full bloom, the riches gifted by Indra, were delightful. The entrance was guarded by mighty monkeys holding weapons in hand. It had a golden archway at the entrance decorated with wonderful garlands and strings of golden flowers. Saumitri of great prowess entered the rich abode of Sugriva just as the Sun enters huge clouds unobstructed.
