instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स सप्त कक्ष्या धर्मात्मा नानाजनसमाकुलाः। प्रविश्य सुमहद्गगुप्तं ददर्शान्तःपुरं महत्।।4.33.19।। हैमराजतपर्यङ्कैर्बहुभिश्च वरासनैः। महार्हास्तरणोपेतैस्तत्र तत्रोपशोभितम्।।4.33.20।।
output: Righteous Lakshmana crossed the seven enclosures filled with different kinds of people and saw a great harem full of several bright gold and silver cots, excellent  seats here and there with best of cushions spread.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
स सप्त कक्ष्या धर्मात्मा नानाजनसमाकुलाः। प्रविश्य सुमहद्गगुप्तं ददर्शान्तःपुरं महत्।।4.33.19।। हैमराजतपर्यङ्कैर्बहुभिश्च वरासनैः। महार्हास्तरणोपेतैस्तत्र तत्रोपशोभितम्।।4.33.20।।
output: Righteous Lakshmana crossed the seven enclosures filled with different kinds of people and saw a great harem full of several bright gold and silver cots, excellent  seats here and there with best of cushions spread.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
प्रविशन्नेव सततं शुश्राव मधुरस्वरम्। तन्त्रीगीतसमाकीर्णं समगीतपदाक्षरम्।।4.33.21।।
output: As he entered, he heard melodious sounds of string instruments and music worded to metre with different kinds of tunes.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बह्वीश्च विविधाकारा रूपयौवनगर्विताः। स्त्रियस्सुग्रीवभवने ददर्श सुमहाबलः।।4.33.22।।
output: महाबलः powerful man, सः he, सुग्रीवभवने in Sugriva's palace, विविधाकाराः of different forms, रूपयौवनगर्विताः proud of their youth and beauty, बह्वीः many, स्त्रियः women, ददर्श saw, च and.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्ट्वाऽभिजनसम्पन्नाश्चित्रमाल्यकृतस्रजः। फलमाल्यकृतव्यग्रा भूषणोत्तमभूषिताः।।4.33.23।। नातृप्तान्नापि चाव्यग्रान्नानुदात्तपरिच्छदान्। सुग्रीवानुचरांश्चापि लक्षयामास लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.24।।
output: Lakshmana saw women with a good lineage adorned with colourful flower garlands and choicest ornaments engaged in making garlands and arranging fruits. He also saw at Sugriva's palace attendants, gentle, welldressed, contented and not too busy.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्ट्वाऽभिजनसम्पन्नाश्चित्रमाल्यकृतस्रजः। फलमाल्यकृतव्यग्रा भूषणोत्तमभूषिताः।।4.33.23।। नातृप्तान्नापि चाव्यग्रान्नानुदात्तपरिच्छदान्। सुग्रीवानुचरांश्चापि लक्षयामास लक्ष्मणः।।4.33.24।।
output: Lakshmana saw women with a good lineage adorned with colourful flower garlands and choicest ornaments engaged in making garlands and arranging fruits. He also saw at Sugriva's palace attendants, gentle, welldressed, contented and not too busy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कूजितं नूपुराणां च काञ्चीनां निनदं तथा। सन्निशम्य तत श्रीमान्सौमित्रिर्लज्जितोऽभवत्।।4.33.25।।
output: ततः then, श्रीमान् illustrious, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, नूपुराणाम् of anklets, कूजितम् tinkling, तथा likewise, काञ्चीनाम् of bells on the girdles of women, निनदम् jingling sound, निशम्य on hearing, लज्जितः abashed, अभवत् felt.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
रोषवेगप्रकुपितशश्रुत्वा चाभरणस्वनम्। चकार ज्यास्वनं वीरो दिशश्शब्देन पूरयन्।।4.33.26।।
output: On hearing the sounds of ornaments (of females), heroic Lakshmana lost his temper quickly. He pulled his bowstring forcefully in wrath producing frightening sound filling all quarters.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चारित्रेण महाबाहुरपकृष्ट स्सलक्ष्मणः। तस्थावेकान्तमाश्रित्य रामकोपसमन्वितः।।4.33.27।।
output: Aware of the anger of Rama (who likes it not), the longarmed Lakshmana moved away from the spot (abstained from entering private apartments) as per tradition, receded to a lonely place and stood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेन चापस्वनेनाथ सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः। विज्ञायाऽगमनं त्रस्त स्सञ्चचाल वरासनात्।।4.33.28।।
output: Then, sensing the arrival of Lakshmana, by the sound of his bow string, Sugriva the lord of vanaras, alighted at once from the throne.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अङ्गदेन यथा मह्यं पुरस्तात्प्रतिवेदितम्। सुव्यक्तमेष सम्प्राप्त स्सौमित्रिर्भ्रातृवत्सलः।।4.33.29।।
output: पुरस्तात् earlier, अङ्गदेन by Angada, मह्यम् to me, यथा as, प्रतिवेदितम् announced, भ्रातृवत्सलः  loving brother, एषः this, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, सम्प्राप्तः has come, सुव्यक्तम् it is true.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गदेन समाख्यातं ज्यास्वनेन च वानरः। बुबुधे लक्ष्मणं प्राप्तं मुखं चास्यव्यशुष्यत।।4.33.30।।
output: As proclaimed by Angada and also from the sound of the twang, Sugriva knew about the arrival of Lakshmana. His mouth parched (with fear).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
ततस्तारां हरिश्रेष्ठस्सुग्रीवः प्रियदर्शनाम्। उवाच हितमव्यग्रस्त्रास सम्भ्रान्तमानसः।।4.33.31।।
output: Then Sugriva, the best of monkeys got agitated at heart out of fear. He saw the pleasing Tara and said to her these good words clearly:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
किन्नु तत्कारणं सुभ्रु प्रकृत्या मृदुमानसः। सरोष इव सम्प्राप्तो येनायं राघवानुजः।।4.33.32।।
output: 'O Tara with beautiful eyebrows this younger brother of Rama is normally softhearted. But today he arrived here angry. What could be the reason?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किं पश्यसि कुमारस्य रोषस्थानमनिन्दिते। न खल्वकारणे कोपमाहरेन्नरसत्तमः।।4.33.33।।
output: अनिन्दिते O blemshless lady, कुमारस्य of the prince, रोषस्थानम् cause for being angry, किम् what? पश्यसि do you see, नरसत्तमः great man, अकारणे without reason, कोपम् anger, न आहरेत् खलु will not display anger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदस्य कृतमस्माभिर्बुध्यसे किञ्चिदप्रियम्। तदबुद्ध्या सम्प्रधार्याशु क्षिप्रमर्हसि भाषितुम्।।4.33.34।।
output: अस्माभिः by us, अस्य at him, किञ्चित् if any, अप्रियम् displeasing, कृतम् done, बुध्यसे यत् if you that way, तत् that, आशु quickly, बुद्ध्या with your intellect, सम्प्रधार्य considering, क्षिप्रम immediately, अर्हसि you ought to, अभिभाषितुम् to speak.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथवा स्वयमेवैनं द्रष्टुमर्हसि भामिनि। वचनै स्सान्त्वयुक्तैश्च प्रसादयितुमर्हसि।।4.33.35।।
output: 'O lovely lady or else, you should see him personally and propitiate him with your soothing words.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वद्दर्शन विशुद्धात्मा न स कोपं करिष्यति। न हि स्त्रीषु महात्मानः क्वचित्कुर्वन्ति दारुणम्।।4.33.36।।
output: विशुद्धात्मा he is cleansed by you, सः he, त्वद्दर्शन by seeing you, कोपम् anger, न करिष्यति will not be, महात्मानः great men, क्वचित् at any time, स्त्रीषु at women, दारुणम् terrific acts, न कुर्वन्ति हि will not be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
त्वया सान्त्वैरुपक्रान्तं प्रसन्नेन्द्रियमानसम्। ततः कमलपत्राक्षं द्रक्ष्याम्यहमरिन्दमम्।।4.33.37।।
output: 'Start talking to him with pleasing words and make him happy. Then I shall see Lakshmana with eyes like lotuspetals, a subduer of enemies'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा प्रस्खलन्ती मदविह्वलाक्षी प्रलम्बकाञ्चीगुण हेमसूत्रा। सलक्षणा लक्ष्मणसन्निधानं जगाम तारा नमिताङ्गयष्टिः।।4.33.38।।
output: Tara, whose eyes were drowsy with drink, whose long gold string of the girdle was hanging loose appeared before Lakshmana with faltering steps and bent low, bashful of her appearance. (It suggests a state of exhaustion after sexual pleasures).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तां समीक्ष्यैव हरीशपन्तीं तस्थावुदासीनतया महात्मा। अवाङ्मुखोऽभून्मनुजेन्द्रपुत्रः स्त्रीसन्निकर्षाद्विनिवृत्तकोपः।।4.33.39।।
output: Since prince Lakshmana is a great man, he stood with his face down and showing no reaction, controlled his anger due to the presence of a female standing close by.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
सा पानयोगाद्विनिवृत्तलज्जा दृष्टिप्रसादाच्च नरेन्द्रसूनोः। उवाच तारा प्रणयप्रगल्भं वाक्यं महार्थं परिसान्त्वपूर्वम्।।4.33.40।।
output: Setting aside her shyness for being in a drunken state, and observing Lakshmana's favourable disposition, she spoke meaningful words in a pleasing manner with friendly eloquence:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किं कोपमूलं मनुजेन्द्रपुत्र कस्ते न सन्तिष्ठति वाङ्निदेशे। क श्शुष्कवृक्षं वनमापतन्तं दवाग्निमासीदति निर्विशङ्कः।।4.33.41।।
output: मनुजेन्द्रपुत्र O son of lord among men, कोपमूलम् cause of anger, किम् what, ते to you, वाङ्निदेशे your word of command, कः who, न सन्तिष्ठति has stood by, शुष्कवृक्षम् dried  pieces of wood, वनम् forest, आपतन्तम् advancing, दवाग्निम् forest fire, निर्विशङ्कः without fear, आसीदति rests.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
स तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा सान्त्वपूर्वमशङ्कितम्। भूयः प्रणयदृष्टार्थं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।4.33.42।।
output: Having heard Tara's unhesitant submission spoken in a pleasant and friendly manner, Lakshmana replied:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
किमयं कामवृत्तस्ते लुप्तधर्मार्थसङ्ग्रहः। भर्ता भर्तृहिते युक्ते न चैनमवबुद्ध्यसे।।4.33.43।।
output: 'O lady, your husband engrossed in sensual pleasures, has lost sight of dharma and artha. Why don't you understand it in the interest of your husband whose wellwisher you are?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
न चिन्तयति राज्यार्थं नास्मान् शोकपरायणान्। सामात्यपरिषत्तारे पानमेवोपसेवते।।4.33.44।।
output: 'O Tara that we are in grief Sugriva does not realize. He is not attending to state affairs. He is only enjoying drinking in the company of ministers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स मासांश्चतुरः कृत्वा प्रमाणं प्लवगेश्वरः। व्यतीतां स्तान्मदव्यग्रो विहरन्नावबुध्यते।।4.33.45।।
output: सः प्लवगेश्वरः king of monkeys, चतुरः four, मासान् months, प्रमाणम् promised, कृत्वा having made, मदव्यग्रः addicted to drinks, विहरन् enjoying, तान् those, व्यतीतान् exceeded time, नावबुध्यते he is not realising.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न हि धर्मार्थसिद्ध्यर्थं पानमेवं प्रशस्यते। पानादर्थश्च धर्मश्च कामश्च परिहीयते।।4.33.46।।
output: धर्मार्थसिद्ध्यर्थम् for accomplishment of dharma and artha, एवम् that way, पानम् drinking, न प्रशस्यते हि not admirable, पानात् by drinking, अर्थश्च material wealth, कामश्च by desire, धर्मश्च morals, परिहीयते will be destroyed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धर्मलोपो महांस्तावत्कृते ह्यप्रतिकुर्वतः। अर्थलोपश्च मित्रस्य नाशे गुणवतो महान्।।4.33.47।।
output: 'Dharma is violated when we help not one who has helped. Loss of a virtuous friend leads to great loss of wealth. It results in destruction.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मित्रं ह्यर्थगुणश्रेष्ठं सत्यधर्मपरायणम्। तद्द्वयं तु परित्यक्तं न तु धर्मे व्यवस्थितम्।।4.33.48।।
output: सत्यधर्मपरायणम् abide in truth and righteousness, मित्रम् friend, अर्थगुणश्रेष्ठम् who excelled in acquiring  artha, तत् द्वयम् both these, परित्यक्तम् is given up, धर्मे in righteous, न तु व्यवस्थितम् not abiding.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदेवं प्रस्तुते कार्ये कार्यमस्माभिरुत्तरम्। यत्कार्यं कार्यतत्त्वज्ञे तदुदाहर्तुमर्हसि।।4.33.49।।
output: कार्यतत्त्वज्ञे well aware of duty, तत् that, प्रस्तुते कार्ये in this task, एवम् this way, अस्माभिः by us, यत् such, उत्तरं in turn, कार्यम् duty, कार्यम् task, त्वम् you, उदाहर्तुम् to explain, अर्हसि should.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा तस्य धर्मार्थसमाधियुक्तं निशम्य वाक्यं मधुरस्वभावम्। तारा गतार्थे मनुजेन्द्रकार्ये विश्वासयुक्तं तमुवाच भूयः।।4.33.50।।
output: Tara heard the sweet words of Lakshmana which showed his good understanding of dharma and artha. What she said to him in reply reflects her faith in Sugriva's effort to help Rama's cause:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न कोपकालः क्षितिपालपुत्र न चाति कोप स्स्वजने विधेयः। त्वदर्थकामस्य जनस्य तस्य प्रमादमप्यर्हसि वीर सोढुम्।।4.33.51।।
output: क्षितिपालपुत्र O prince, कोपकालः to be angry at this time, न not, स्वजने in your own people, कोपः anger, न चाति विधेयः not to indulge, वीर warrior, त्वदर्थकामस्य of a person desiring to attend to your task, तस्य जनस्य of such people, प्रमादमपि even a mistake, सोढुम् to hear, अर्हसि it is proper.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कोपं कथं नाम गुणप्रकृष्टः कुमार कुर्यादपकृष्टसत्त्वे। कस्त्वद्विधः कोपवशं हि गच्छे त्सत्त्वावरुद्धस्तपसः प्रसूतिः।।4.33.52।।
output: 'O prince how can you, richly endowed with virtues be angry with an inferior person? How can a person like you, preeminent in virtues,and a source of great penance fall a victim to anger?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जानामि रोषं हरिवीरबन्धो र्जानामि कार्यस्य च कालसङ्गम्। जानामि कार्यं त्वयि यत्कृतं न स्तच्चापि जानामि यदत्र कार्यम्।।4.33.53।।
output: 'I know about the anger of (Rama), the friend of Sugriva. I am aware of the time limit set for his work. I am aware of our omissions in this regard. I also know about the mission.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
तच्चापि जानामि यथविषह्यं बलं नरश्रेष्ठ शरीरजस्य। जानामि यस्मिंश्च जनेऽवबद्धं कामेन सुग्रीवमसक्तमद्य।।4.33.54।।
output: 'O Lakshmana I am aware of the irresistible strength of lust born out of the body. I am aware of Sugriva's indifference to his duty due to his  passion with whomsoever it be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
न कामतन्त्रे तव बुद्धिरस्ति त्वं वै यथा मन्युवशं प्रपन्नः। न देशकालौ हि न चार्थधर्मा ववेक्षते कामरतिर्मनुष्यः।।4.33.55।।
output: 'You are under the grip of anger and your mind is not involved in carnal desire. One who is engaged in sensual pleasures does not reckon time and place, nor does he consider artha and dharma.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
तं कामवृत्तं मम सन्निकृष्टं कामाभियोगाच्च निवृत्तलज्जम्। क्षमस्व तावत्परवीरहन्त स्त्वद्भ्रातरं वानरवंशनाथम्।।4.33.56।।
output: 'O slayer of enemy heroes pardon Sugriva, the lord of vanara clan, who is to you a brother. He is here indulging in sports of love with me. He has no sense of shame about his passion.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महर्षयो धर्मतपोऽभिकामाः कामानुकामाः प्रतिबद्धमोहाः। अयं प्रकृत्या चपलः कपिस्तु कथं न सज्जेत सुखेषु राजा।।4.33.57।।
output: 'Even sages committed to piety and austerity are sometimes deluded by sensual gratification. He is a king and a monkey who is fickle by nature. How can he be not tempted by sensual pleasures'?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महार्थं सा वानरी लक्ष्मणमप्रमेयम्। पुन स्सखेदं मदविह्वलञ्च भर्तुर्हितं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे।।4.33.58।।
output: Overcome by drunkenness, Tara once again spoke to Lakshmana of unfathomable prowess, in a meaningful way keeping in view the welfare of her playful and drunken lord:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
उद्योगस्तु चिराज्ञप्त स्सुग्रीवेण नरोत्तम। कामस्यापि विधेयेन तवार्थप्रतिसाधने।।4.33.59।।
output: 'O best of men although overpowered by sense pleasures, Sugriva has already initiated efforts for the accomplishment of your work.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आगता हि महावीर्या हरयः कामरूपिणः। कोटीशतसहस्राणि नानानगनिवासिनः।।4.33.60।।
output: 'O great warrior monkeys residing at different mountains who can assume any form they like have arrived in hundreds and thousands of crores.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
तदागच्छ महाबाहो चारित्रं रक्षितं त्वया। अच्छलं मित्रभावेन सतां दारावलोकनम्।।4.33.61।।
output: 'O longarmed one  come in. You have been standing out guarding your character. It is not a mistake to see the wife of a pious person with a friendly feeling.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तारया चाभ्यनुज्ञातस्त्वरया चापि चोदितः। प्रविवेश महाबाहुरभ्यन्तरमरिन्दमः।।4.33.62।।
output: Strongarmed Lakshmana, a subduer of enemies, permitted by Tara entered the harem immediately (thinking of the urgency of the task).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत स्सुग्रीवमासीनं काञ्चने परमासने। महार्हास्तरणोपेते ददर्शादित्यसन्निभम्।।4.33.63।। दिव्याभणचित्राङ्गं दिव्यरूपं यशस्विनम्। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं महेन्द्रमिव दुर्जयम्।।4.33.64।। दिव्याभरणमालाभिः प्रमदाभि स्समावृतम्। संरब्धतररक्ताक्षो बभूवान्तकसन्निभः।।4.33.65।।
output: ततः then, महार्हास्तरणोपेते strewn with fine cushions, काञ्चने on a golden, परमासने on a grand throne, आसीनम् seated, आदित्यसन्निभम् like the Sun god, दिव्याभरणचित्राङ्गम् decorated with excellent ornaments, दिव्यरूपम् heavenly in appearance, यशस्विनम् famous, दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरम् adorned with beautiful garlands, महेन्द्रमिव like the lord of gods, दुर्जयम् like one who is difficult to be conquered, दिव्याभरणमाल्याभिः adorned with excellent ornaments, garlands and clothes, प्रमदाभिः by women decked with, समावृतम् surrounded, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, ददर्श saw, संरब्धतररक्ताक्षः bewildered with eyes turned red, निभः resembling, बभूव appeared, अन्तकसन्निभः like Yama the god of death.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत स्सुग्रीवमासीनं काञ्चने परमासने। महार्हास्तरणोपेते ददर्शादित्यसन्निभम्।।4.33.63।। दिव्याभणचित्राङ्गं दिव्यरूपं यशस्विनम्। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं महेन्द्रमिव दुर्जयम्।।4.33.64।। दिव्याभरणमालाभिः प्रमदाभि स्समावृतम्। संरब्धतररक्ताक्षो बभूवान्तकसन्निभः।।4.33.65।।
output: Lakshmana saw famous Sugriva, difficult to be conquered, seated on a golden throne strewn around with cushions, decorated with ornaments of different colours, endearing in appearance, decked with beautiful garlands and clothes. He was surrounded by women adorned with most fascinating ornaments and garlands. Bewildered at the sight, Lakshmana's eyes turned red in anger. He appeared like Yama, lord of death.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 33:
तत स्सुग्रीवमासीनं काञ्चने परमासने। महार्हास्तरणोपेते ददर्शादित्यसन्निभम्।।4.33.63।। दिव्याभणचित्राङ्गं दिव्यरूपं यशस्विनम्। दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं महेन्द्रमिव दुर्जयम्।।4.33.64।। दिव्याभरणमालाभिः प्रमदाभि स्समावृतम्। संरब्धतररक्ताक्षो बभूवान्तकसन्निभः।।4.33.65।।
output: Lakshmana saw famous Sugriva, difficult to be conquered, seated on a golden throne strewn around with cushions, decorated with ornaments of different colours, endearing in appearance, decked with beautiful garlands and clothes. He was surrounded by women adorned with most fascinating ornaments and garlands. Bewildered at the sight, Lakshmana's eyes turned red in anger. He appeared like Yama, lord of death.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमप्रतिहतं क्रुद्धं प्रविष्टं पुरुषर्षभम्। सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः।।4.34.1।।
output: Lakshmana meets Sugriva -- reminds him of his promise to Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रुद्धं निश्श्वसमानं तं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तं दृष्ट्वा दशरथात्मजम्।।4.34.2।। उत्पपात हरिश्रेष्ठो हित्वा सौवर्णमासनम्। महान्महेन्द्रस्य यथा स्वलङ्कृत इव ध्वजः।।4.34.3।।
output: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, son of Dasaratha, sighing heavily, glowing like bright fire burning with the sorrow of Rama, Sugriva jumped out of his seat quitting the decorated golden throne just as Indra's decorated banner is raised up suddenly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रुद्धं निश्श्वसमानं तं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तं दृष्ट्वा दशरथात्मजम्।।4.34.2।। उत्पपात हरिश्रेष्ठो हित्वा सौवर्णमासनम्। महान्महेन्द्रस्य यथा स्वलङ्कृत इव ध्वजः।।4.34.3।।
output: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, son of Dasaratha, sighing heavily, glowing like bright fire burning with the sorrow of Rama, Sugriva jumped out of his seat quitting the decorated golden throne just as Indra's decorated banner is raised up suddenly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उत्पतन्तमनूत्पेतू रुमाप्रभृतयः स्त्रियः। सुग्रीवं गगने पूर्णचन्द्रं तारागणा इव।।4.34.4।।
output: रुमाप्रभृतयः Ruma and others, स्त्रियः women, उत्पतन्तम्  jumped up, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, गगने in the sky, पूर्णम् full, चन्द्रम् Moon, तारागणा cluster of stars, इव like, अनूत्पेतु: jumped up.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 34:
संरक्तनयनः श्रीमान्विचचाल कृताञ्जलिः। बभूवावस्थितस्तत्र कल्पवृक्षो महानिव।।4.34.5।।
output: With eyes red as blood through drunkenness,prosperous Sugriva was shaken like the Kalpa tree.He stood there and offered salutations(to Lakshmana) with folded hands.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रुमाद्वितीयं सुग्रीवं नारीमध्यगतं स्थितम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धस्सतारं शशिनं यथा।।4.34.6।।
output: सतारम् surrounded by stars, शशिनं यथा like the Moon, रुमाद्वितीयम् along with Ruma, नारीमध्यगतम् surrounded by women, स्थितम् who stood, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, क्रुद्धः infuriated, लक्ष्मणः to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सत्त्वाभिजनसम्पन्नस्सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः। कृतज्ञस्सत्यवादी च राजा लोके महीयते।।4.34.7।।
output: 'Only a king who is an heir to a noble family, compassionate, and selfcontrolled, grateful and truthful excels in the world.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्तु राजा स्थितोऽधर्मे मित्राणामुपकारिणाम्। मिथ्या प्रतिज्ञां कुरुते को नृशंसतरस्ततः।।4.34.8।।
output: यः whoever, राजा a king, अधर्मे in unrighteous path, स्थितः adopts, उपकारिणाम् to his benefactors, मिथ्या false, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, कुरुते makes, ततः then, नृशंसतरः more malicious, कः what

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शतमश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं तु गवानृते। आत्मानं स्वजनं हन्ति पुरुषः पुरुषानृते।।4.34.9।।
output: पुरुषः  man, अश्वानृते tells a lie about a horse, शतम् hundred, हन्ति kills, गवानृते tells a lie about a cow, सहस्रम् thousand, पुरुषानृते a lie about a man, आत्मानम् himself, स्वजनम् his own people, हन्ति kills.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पूर्वं कृतार्थो मित्राणां न तत्प्रतिकरोति यः। कृतघ्नस्सर्वभूतानां स वध्यः प्लवगेश्वर।।4.34.10।।
output: प्लगेश्वर O lord of monkeys, पूर्वम् first, कृतार्थः is fulfilled, यः whoever, मित्राणाम् to the friends, तत् that, प्रतिकरोति does not help in turn, कृतघ्नः an ungrateful one, सः he, सर्वभूतानाम् to all beings, वध्यः deserves to be killed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 34:
गीतोऽयं ब्रह्मणा श्लोक स्सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः। दृष्ट्वा कृतघ्नं क्रुद्धेन तन्निबोध प्लवङ्गम।।4.34.11।।
output: 'O lord of the monkeys here is a verse worthy of appreciation by all the worlds, sung by a brahmin, when he saw an ungrateful person. Listen:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 34:
ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चोरे भग्नव्रते तथा। निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भि: कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः।।4.34.12।।
output: 'There is expiation for one who kills a brahmin, a drunkard, a thief and a violator of sacred vows. But there is no atonement for an ungrateful man.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनार्यस्त्वं कृतघ्नश्च मिथ्यावादी च वानर। पूर्वं कृतार्थो रामस्य न तत्प्रतिकरोषि यत्।।4.34.13।।
output: 'O monkey you have already achieved your objective (with the help of Rama) but have not helped Rama in return. You are surely an ignoble and ungrateful liar.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ननु नाम कृतार्थेन त्वया रामस्य वानर। सीताया मार्गणे यत्नः कर्तव्यः कृतमिच्छता।।4.34.14।।
output: वानर monkey, कृतार्थेन by a grateful one, रामस्य Rama's, कृतम् task, इच्छता intending, त्वया by you, सीतायाः Sita's, मार्ग in search, यत्नः attempt, ननु नाम कर्तव्यः it should be taken up indeed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स त्वं ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु सक्तो मिथ्याप्रतिश्रवः। न त्वां रामो विजानीते सर्पं मण्डूकराविणम्।।4.34.15।।
output: 'You have failed to keep your word. You are engaged in worldly pleasures. Rama did not know that you are a serpent croaking like a frog.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महाभागेन रामेण पापः करुणवेदिना। हरीणां प्रापितो राज्यं त्वं दुरात्मा महात्मना।।4.34.16।।
output: महाभागेन by the illustrious, महात्मना by the great self, करुणवेदिना by the compassionate, रामेण by Rama, पापः sinner, दुरात्मा evilminded, त्वम् you, हरीणाम् monkeys', राज्यम् kingdom, प्रापितः granted.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 34:
कृतं चेन्नाभिजानीषे रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। सद्यस्त्वं निशितैर्भावार्हतो द्रक्ष्यसि वालिनम्।।4.34.17।।
output: 'If you do not recognise  the help of Rama who can accomplish any deed with ease, you will be killed with my sharp arrows and meet Vali (in heaven).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न च सङ्कुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः। समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालिपथमन्वगाः।।4.34.18।।
output: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, समये by agreement, तिष्ठ stand by, हतः killed, वाली Vali, येन by whichever path, गतः gone, पन्थाः path, न च सङ्कुचितः is not a narrow one, वालिपथम् the path of Vali, मा अन्वगाः do not follow him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न नूनमिक्ष्वाकुवरस्य कार्मुक च्युतान् शरान्पश्यसि वज्र सन्निभान्। तत स्सुखं नाम निषेवसे सुखी। न रामकार्यं मनसाऽप्यवेक्षसे।।4.34.19।।
output: 'You have not seen the thunderboltlike arrows released from the bow of Rama, the renowned prince of the Ikshvaku race. Therefore you are resorting to enjoyment without any fear and have not given thought to Rama's work.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfourth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 35:
तथा ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं तारा ताराधिपनिभानना।।4.35.1।।
output: While Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra, was glowing like fire with his brilliance, thus spoke the moonfaced Tara:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 35:
नैवं लक्ष्मण वक्तव्यो नायं परुषमर्हति। हरीणामीश्वरश्श्रोतुं तव वक्त्राद्विशेषतः।।4.35.2।।
output: 'O Lakshmana you, in particular, should not speak to the king of vanaras in that manner. He does not deserve to hear from your mouth words which are harsh.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 35:
नैवाकृतज्ञस्सुग्रीवो न शठो नापि दारुणः। नैवानृतकथो वीर न जिह्मश्च कपीश्वरः।।4.35.3।।
output: 'O hero Sugriva, king of monkeys, is not ungrateful or deceitful, He is neither crooked nor false.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 35:
उपकारं कृतं वीरो नाप्ययं विस्मृतः कपिः। रामेण वीर सुग्रीवो यदन्यैर्दुष्करं रणे।।4.35.4।।
output: 'O hero this warrior Sugriva has not forgotten the help rendered by Rama in combat which was difficult (to win).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 35:
रामप्रसादात्कीर्तिञ्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। प्राप्तवानिह सुग्रीवो रुमां मां च परन्तप ।।4.35.5।।
output: 'O scorcher of enemies it is by Rama's grace that Sugriva has attained fame, the kingdom of monkeys and Ruma and me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुदुःखं शयितः पूर्वं प्राप्येदं सुखमुत्तमम्। प्राप्तकालं न जानीते विश्वामित्रो यथा मुनिः।।4.35.6।।
output: 'Sleep did not come to him in deep distress in the past, and now that great happiness has come, he does not realize that it is time to act (search for Sita). He behaves like sage Viswamitra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
घृताच्यां किल संसक्तो दशवर्षाणि लक्ष्मण। अहोऽमन्यत धर्मात्मा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः।।4.35.7।।
output: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, धर्मात्मा great self, महामुनिः great sage, विश्वामित्रः Visvamitra, दश ten, वर्षाणि years, घृताच्याम् with an apsara Gritachi, संसक्तः in union, अह one day, अमन्यत thought, किल indeed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स हि प्राप्तं न जानीते कालं कालविदां वरः। विश्वामित्रो महातेजाः किं पुनर्यः पृथग्जनः।।4.35.8।।
output: कालविदाम् वरः a distinguished person among those who know the value of time, महातेजाः brilliant, सः that, विश्वामित्रः Visvamitra, प्राप्त कालम् right time, न जानीते did not know, यः he who, पृथग्जनः ordinary man, किं पुनः what else.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
देहधर्मं गतस्यास्य परिश्रान्तस्य लक्ष्मण। अवितृप्तस्य कामेषु कामं क्षन्तुमिहार्हसि।।4.35.9।।
output: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, देहधर्मं गतस्य  attending to physical needs, परिश्रान्तस्य tired person, कामेषु in lust, अवितृप्तस्य finding no satisfaction, अस्य his, कामम् love, इह now, क्षन्तुम् to pardon, अर्हसि should.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न च रोषवशं तात गन्तुमर्हसि लक्ष्मण। निश्चयार्थमविज्ञाय सहसा प्राकृतो यथा।।4.35.10।।
output: 'O dear Lakshmana not knowing the true intention of Sugriva, it is not proper for you to be rashly angry like an ordinary man.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सत्त्वयुक्ता हि पुरुषास्त्वद्विधाः पुरुषर्षभ। अविमृश्य न रोषस्य सहसा यान्ति वश्यताम्।।4.35.11।।
output: 'O bull among men men with right vision like you do not become angry instantly without right thinking.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रसादये त्वां धर्मज्ञ सुग्रीवार्थे समाहिता। महान्रोषसमुत्पन्न स्संरम्भस्त्यज्यतामयम्।।4.35.12।।
output: 'O Lakshmana, knower of dharma, give up your agitation arising out of great anger. Be composed for the sake of Sugriva.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुमां मां कपि राज्यं च धनधान्यवसूनि च। रामप्रियार्थं सुग्रीवस्त्यजेदिति मतिर्मम।।4.35.13।।
output: 'I feel Sugriva should (is prepared to) renounce the monkeykingdom, wealth, grains and other treasures and even Ruma and me for the pleasure of Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समानेष्यति सुग्रीव स्सीतया सह राघवम्। शशाङ्कमिव रोहिण्या निहत्वा रावणं रणे।।4.35.14।।
output: 'Killing Ravana in war, Sugriva will restore Sita soon to Rama.Rama will join Sita like Moon joins Rohini.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शतकोटिसहस्राणि लङ्कायां किल राक्षसाः। आयुतानि च षट्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि शतानि च।।4.35.15।।
output: 'The number of demons in Lanka is reported to be a hundred thousand crore, three lakh, ninetynine thousand and six hundred. (Note: Indian tradition has numbers up to eighteen digits. One hundred thousand crores is equal to a 'mahapadma' which has thirteen digits. The number described here is 1000000399600.)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहत्वा तांश्च दुर्धर्षान्राक्षसान्कामरूपिणः। न शक्यो रावणो हन्तुं येन सा मैथिली हृता।।4.35.16।।
output: दुर्धर्षान् unassailable, कामरूपिणः who can assume any form at will, तान् them, राक्षसान् demons, अहत्वा without killing, येन by whomsoever, सा she, मैथिली Maithili, हृता stolen, रावण: Ravana, हन्तुम् to kill, न शक्यः not possible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 35:
ते न शक्या रणे हन्तुमसहायेन लक्ष्मण। रावणः क्रूरकर्मा च सुग्रीवेण विशेषतः।।4.35.17।।
output: 'O Lakshmana moreover it is not possible for Sugriva alone to kill the wicked Ravana without the help of the monkeys.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमाख्यातवान्वाली स ह्यभिज्ञो हरीश्वरः। आगमस्तु न मे व्यक्तश्श्रवात्तस्माद्ब्रवीम्यहम्।।4.35.18।।
output: वाली Vali, एवम् in that way, आख्यातवान् gave an account, सः that, हरीश्वरः lord of monkeys, अभिज्ञः हि a well informed person, आगमः source, मे to myself, न व्यक्तः not known, तस्मात् therefore, श्रवात् from what is heard, अहम् I, ब्रवीमि I am speaking.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वत्सहायनिमित्तं वै प्रेषिता हरिपुङ्गवाः। आनेतुं वानरान्युद्धे सुबहून्हरियूधपान्।।4.35.19।।
output: 'Monkey chiefs have been sent to bring multitudes of monkey leaders to help you in the battle.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांश्च प्रतीक्षमाणोऽयं विक्रान्तात्सुमहाबलान्। राघवस्यार्थसिध्यर्थं न निर्याति हरीश्वरः।।4.35.20।।
output: 'Sugriva is awaiting the arrival of the powerful and strong vanaras without whose help he cannot accomplish Rama's task.Therefore he has not yet started (the search).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 35:
कृता तु संस्था सौमित्रे सुग्रीवेण पुरा यथा। अद्य तैर्वानरैस्सर्वैरागन्तव्यं महाबलैः।।4.35.21।।
output: 'O Lakshmana since Sugriva has already promulgated an ordinance to all the mighty vanaras, they should be all arriving by now.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 35:
ऋक्षकोटिसहस्राणि गोलाङ्गूलशतानि च। अद्य त्वामुपयास्यन्ति जहि कोपमरिन्दम। कोट्योऽनेकास्तु काकुत्स्थ कपीनां दीप्ततेजसाम्।।4.35.22।।
output: अरिन्दम subduer of enemies, काकुत्स्थ Lakshmana, अद्य now, ऋक्षकोटिसहस्राणि thousands of crores of bears, गोलाङ्गूलशतानि hundreds of golangulas (monkeys with long tails like those of cows), दीप्ततेजसाम्  of fiery spirit, कपीनाम् of monkeys, अनेकाः many, कोट्यः crores, त्वाम् your, उपयास्यन्ति will attend on you, कोपम् anger, जहि give up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तव हि मुखमिदं निरीक्ष्य कोपात् क्षतजनिभे नयने निरीक्षमाणाः। हरिवरवनिता न यान्ति शान्तिं प्रथमभयस्य हि शङ्कितास्तु सर्वाः।।4.35.23।।
output: हरिवरवनिताः wives of foremost of monkeys, तव your, इदम् this, मुखम् face, निरीक्ष्य on seeing, कोपात् from anger, क्षतजनिभे resembling blood, नयने eyes, निरीक्षमाणाः looking at the eyes, शान्तिम् peace, न यान्ति not able to, सर्वाः all, प्रथमभयस्य of the earlier fear, शङ्कितास्तु suspecting.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्तस्तारया वाक्यं प्रश्रितं धर्मसंहितम्। मृदुस्वभावस्सौमित्रिः प्रतिजग्राह तद्वचः।।4.36.1।।
output: Lakshmana gets pacified -- Sugriva praises Rama's valour -- Lakshmana tenders apology for his harsh words

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
तस्मिन्प्रतिगृहीते तु वाक्ये हरिगणेश्वरः। लक्ष्मणात्सुमहत्त्रासं वस्त्रं क्लिन्नमिवात्यजत्।।4.36.2।।
output: Sugriva, king of the vanara clan, cast aside his great fear when Lakshmana accepted the words of Tara just as one discards a wet garment from the body.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
ततः कण्ठगतं माल्यं चित्रं बहुगुणं महत्। चिच्छेद विमदश्चासीत्सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः।।4.36.3।।
output: Thereupon Sugriva, relieved from his drunken state tore off the great, colourful valuable garland worn on his neck.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
स लक्ष्मणं भीमबलं सर्ववानरसत्तमः। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सुग्रीव स्सम्प्रहर्षयन्।।4.36.4।।
output: Sugriva, the noblest of all monkeys, spoke these polite words in a pleasing manner to Lakshmana of terrific strength:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रणष्टा श्रीश्च कीर्तिश्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। रामप्रसादात्सौमित्रे पुन: प्राप्तमिदं मया।।4.36.5।।
output: 'O Saumitri my prosperity, fame and the permanent sovereignty of vanaras had been lost. It was  regained by the grace of Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
कश्शक्तस्तस्य देवस्य ख्यातस्य स्वेन कर्मणा। तादृशं विक्रमं वीर प्रतिकर्तुमरिन्दम।।4.36.6।।
output: 'O crusher of enemies  how is it possible to repay the famous lord Rama's valour (in killing Vali)?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
सीतां प्राप्स्यति धर्मात्मा वधिष्यति च रावणम्। सहायमात्रेण मया राघव स्स्वेन तेजसा।।4.36.7।।
output: 'Righteous Rama can merely restore Sita with my assistance. By his own fiery energy he will kill Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
सहायकृत्यं किं तस्य येन सप्त महाद्रुमाः। शैलश्च वसुधा चैव बाणेनैकेन दारिताः।।4.36.8।।
output: 'Rama shattered seven huge trees, a mountain and earth with a single arrow. What assistance does he need?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धनुर्विष्फारयानस्य यस्य शब्देन लक्ष्मण। सशैला कम्पिता भूमिस्सहायै: किन्नु तस्य वै।।4.36.9।।
output: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, धनुः bow, विष्फारयानस्य  with the twang of his bow, यस्य its, शब्देन by the sound, सशैला: even the mountains, भूमिः earth, कम्पिता was shaken तस्य his, सहायैः assistance, किं why?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनुयात्रां नरेन्द्रस्य करिष्येऽहं नरर्षभ। गच्छतो रावणं हन्तुं वैरिणं सपुरस्सरम्।।4.36.10।।
output: 'O Lakshmana, bull among men I shall only join him along with others when he leads the army to kill Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
यदि किञ्चिदतिक्रान्तं विश्वासात्प्रणयेन वा। प्रेष्यस्य क्षमितव्यं मे न कश्चिन्नापराध्यति।।4.36.11।।
output: 'If I have committed even a little transgression in my faith in Rama or affection for him and exceeded the time limit, my mistakes are to be excused as one would pardons a servant. No one is flawless in the world.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। अभवल्लक्ष्मणः प्रीतः प्रेम्णा चैवमुवाच ह।।4.36.12।।
output: Lakshmana who was happy to hear great Sugriva replied affectionately:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वथा हि मम भ्राता सनाथो वानरेश्वर। त्वया नाथेन सुग्रीव प्रश्रितेन विशेषतः।।4.36.13।।
output: वानरेश्वर O king of monkeys, सुग्रीव Sugriva, नाथेन by a king, विशेषतः specially, प्रश्रितेन by a courteous one, त्वया you, मम my, भ्राता brother, सर्वथा in all ways, सनाथः हि has a guardian.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
यस्ते प्रभाव स्सुग्रीव यच्च ते शौचमार्जवम्। अर्हस्त्वं कपिराज्यस्य श्रियं भोक्तुमनुत्तमाम्।।4.36.14।।
output: 'You are powerful and straightforward by nature.You are humble and noble. Therefore, you deserve the high prosperity of the kingdom of the monkeys.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सहायेन तु सुग्रीव त्वया रामः प्रतापवान्। वधिष्यति रणे शत्रूनचिरान्नात्र संशयः।।4.36.15।।
output: सुग्रीव Sugriva, सहायेन with you as associate, त्वया by your, प्रतापवान् valiant hero, रामः Rama, शत्रून्  enemies, रणे in war, अचिरात् shortly, वधिष्यति he will kill, संशयः is doubt, न not, अत्र in this case

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
धर्मज्ञस्य कृतज्ञस्य सङ्ग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनः। उपपन्नं च युक्तं च सुग्रीव तव भाषितम्।।4.36.16।।
output: 'O Sugriva you know dharma.You are grateful and will not turn back from the battle. So your words are true and befitting.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
दोषज्ञस्सति सामर्थ्ये कोऽन्यो भाषितुमर्हति। वर्जयित्वा मम ज्येष्ठं त्वां च वानरसत्तम।।4.36.17।।
output: 'O best of monkeys barring you and my elder brother, who else would be capable of speaking this way about themselves even when you are aware of other's faults?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
सदृशश्चासि रामस्य विक्रमेण बलेन च। सहायो दैवतैर्दत्तश्चिराय हरिपुङ्गव।।4.36.18।।
output: 'You who are equal to Rama in valour and strength, will continue to be the gift of gods to us for long.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 36:
किं तु शीघ्रमितो वीर निष्क्रम त्वं मया सह। सान्त्वयस्व वयस्यं च त्वं भार्याहरणकर्शितम्।।4.36.19।।
output: 'Nevertheless I want you to proceed from here with me at once and reassure your friend who is agrieved due to the abduction of his wife.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यच्च शोकाभिभूतस्य श्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम्। मया त्वं परुषाण्युक्तस्तच्चत्वं क्षन्तु मर्हसि।।4.36.20।।
output: त्वम् You, शोकाभिभूतस्य of a griefstricken man, रामस्य भाषितम् Rama's words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, मया by me, त्वम् you, परुषाणि harshly, उक्तः इति यत् thus spoken, अर्हसि you will, तच्च that, क्षन्तुम् to forgive.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना। हनूमन्तं स्थितं पार्श्वे सचिवन्त्विदमब्रवीत्।।4.37.1।।
output: Having heard the great Lakshmana Sugriva said to Hanuman, the minister who stood by his side:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महेन्द्रहिमवद्विन्ध्यकैलासशिखरेषु च। मन्दरे पाण्डुशिखरे पञ्चशैलेषु ये स्थिताः।।4.37.2।। तरुणादित्यवर्णेषु भ्राजमानेषु सर्वतः। पर्वतेषु समुद्रान्ते पश्चिमायां च ये दिशि।।4.37.3।। आदित्यभवने चैव गिरौ सन्ध्याभ्रसन्निभे। पद्मातालवनं भीमं संश्रिता हरिपुङ्गवाः।।4.37.4।। अञ्जनाम्बुदसङ्काशाः कुञ्जरप्रतिमौजसः। अञ्जने पर्वते चैव ये वसन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.5।। मनश्शिला गुहावासा वानराः कनकप्रभाः। मेरुपार्श्वगताश्चैव ये धूम्रगिरिं संश्रिताः।।4.37.6।। तरुणादित्यवर्णाश्च पर्वते ये महारुणे। पिबन्तो मधुमैरेयं भीमवेगाः प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.7।। वनेषु च सुरम्येषु सुगन्धिषु महत्सु च। तापसानां च रम्येषु वनान्तेषु समन्ततः।।4.37.8।। तांस्तां स्त्वमानय क्षिप्रं पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्। सामदानादिभि: स्सर्वैराशु प्रेषय वानरान्।।4.37.9।।
output: महेन्द्रहिमवद्विन्ध्यकैलासशिखरेषु च on the peaks of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya and Kailasa mountains, पाण्डुशिखरे on the white peak, मन्दरे of Mandara, पञ्चशैलेषु on the five mountains, ये who, स्थिताः ever residing, समुद्रान्ते on the shores of the sea, सर्वत: all over, भ्राजमानेषु on the lustrous, तरुणादित्यवर्णेषु colour of the rising Sun, पर्वतेषु on mountains, पश्चिमायाम् western, दिशि direction, ये those, सन्ध्याभ्रसन्निभे like the clouds of the setting Sun, आदित्यभवने the mountain where the Sun rises, गिरौ चैव even mountains, भीमं fierce, हरिपुङ्गवाः best of monkeys, पद्म तालवनम् in the garden of Padmatala, संश्रिताः staying, अञ्जने पर्वते on the Anjani mountain, अञ्जनाम्बुदसङ्काशाः resembling black clouds, कुञ्जरेन्द्रप्रतिमौजसः strong as best elephants, ये प्लवङ्गमाः the monkeys, वसन्ति dwelling, मनश्शिलागुहावासाः  residing at Manassilva (a red pigment of arsenic) mountain caves, कनकप्रभाः shining like gold in complexion, वानराः monkeys, मेरुपार्श्वगताश्चैव and those who have gone to Mount Meru, ये those, धूम्रगिरिम् at  Dhumra mountain, श्रिताः staying, महारुणे on Maharuna, पर्वते on the mountain, मैरेयं मधु liquor of Maireya, पिबन्तः drinking, भीमवेगाः of terrific speed, ये those, तरुणादित्यवर्णाः of the colour of the rising Sun, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, सुरम्येषु on beautiful spots, सुगन्धिषु of the fragrant, महत्सु on the great, वनेषु च and in the forests, तापसानां च रम्येषु at the delightful hermitages of ascetics, समन्ततः all over, वनान्तेषु allover the forest, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, तां स्तान् respective ones, सर्ववानरान् all the monkeys, सामदानादिभिः using all means (sama and dana), सवै: by all, आशुप्रेषय send for, वानरान् the monkeys, क्षिप्रम् at once, त्वम् you, आनय bring.

output: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who  resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

output: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who  resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

instruction:

output: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who  resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

output: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who  resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
प्रेषिताः प्रथमं ये च मयादूता महाजवाः। त्वरणार्थं तु भूयस्त्वं हरीन् सम्प्रेषयापरान्।।4.37.10।।
output: 'This is in addition to the monkeys for whom swiftfooted messengers have already been sent.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ये प्रसक्ताश्च कामेषु दीर्घसूत्राश्च वानराः। इहाऽनयस्व तान् सर्वान् शीघ्रं तु मम शासनात्।।4.37.11।।
output: 'Get all the monkeys including those engaged in carnal pleasures and those slow in movement all at once on my command.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
अहोभिर्दशभिर्ये च नागच्छन्ति ममाज्ञया। हन्तव्यास्ते दुरात्मानो राजशासनदूषकाः।।4.37.12।।
output: 'Kill those evilminded ones within ten days for disobeying the royal orders.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
शतान्यथ सहस्राणां कोट्यश्च मम शासनात्। प्रयान्तु कपिसिंहानां दिशो मम मते स्थिताः।।4.37.13।।
output: 'The hundreds of thousands of crores of obedient lionlike monkeys should proceed in all directions at my command.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
मेघपर्वतसङ्काशाश्छादयन्त इवाम्बरम्। घोररूपाः कपिश्रेष्ठा यान्तु मच्छासनादितः।।4.37.14।।
output: 'Fierce monkeys, comparable to clouds and mountains in appearance shall go as though covering the sky from here at my command.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते गतिज्ञा गतिं ज्ञात्वा पृथिव्यां सर्ववानराः। आनयन्तु हरीन् सर्वांस्त्वरिता शसनान्मम।।4.37.15।।
output: गतिज्ञाः those who know the locations, ते they, सर्ववानराः all vanaras, त्वरिताः quickly, गतिं ज्ञात्वा knowing their movements, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, सर्वान् all, हरीन् monkeys, मम my, शासनात् command, आनयन्तु bring.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य वानर राजस्य श्रुत्वा वायुसुतो वचः। दिक्षु सर्वासु विक्रान्तान्प्रेषयामास वानरान्।।4.37.16।।
output: Having heard Sugriva's command, Hanuman, son of the Windgod, sent powerful monkeys in all directions.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते पदं विष्णुविक्रान्तं पतत्रिज्योतिरध्वगाः। प्रयाताः प्रहिता राज्ञा हरयस्तत्क्षणेन वै।।4.37.17।।
output: The monkeys ordered by the king, traversed the pathway of birds and heavenly bodies, the path Lord Visnu had trod. [Note: the sky is called Vishnupada since Lord Visnu set his foot on the sky in his incarnation as Vamana.]

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते समुद्रेषु गिरिषु वनेषु च सरस्सु च। वानरा वानरान्सर्वान्रामहेतोरचोदयन्।।4.37.18।।
output: ते वानराः set his foot those monkeys, समुद्रेषु on the sea shore, गिरिषु on the mountains, वनेषु च in the forests, सरस्सु च  on the banks of lakes, सर्वान् all over, वानरान् monkeys, रामहेतोः  to serve Rama's cause, अचोदयन् driven.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
मृत्युकालोपमस्याऽज्ञां राजराजस्य वानराः। सुग्रीवस्याययु श्श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवभयदर्शिनः।।4.37.19।।
output: In response to the command of the king, who was like death to them, the monkeys came at once, driven by fear from Sugriva.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
ततस्तेऽञ्जनसङ्काशा गिरेस्तस्मान्महाजवाः। तिस्रः कोट्यः प्लवङ्गानां निर्ययुर्यत्र राघवः।।4.37.20।।
output: Then three crores of swiftfooted monkeys, dark like collyrium, rushed forth to the mountain to meet Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
अस्तं गच्छति यत्रार्कस्तस्मिन्गिरिवरे स्थिताः। सन्तप्त हेममहाभासस्तस्मात्कोट्यो दश च्युताः।।4.37.21।।
output: Ten crores of monkeys shining like pure molten gold, staying on the best of mountains where the Sun sets moved towards Kishkinda.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
कैलासशिखरेभ्यश्च सिंहकेसरवर्चसाम्। ततः कोटिसहस्राणि वानराणामुपागमन्।।4.37.22।।
output: From the peaks of Kailasa mountain moved out one thousand crores of monkeys who were of bright colour like the lion's mane.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
फलमूलेन जीवन्तो हिमवन्तमुपाश्रिताः। तेषां कोटिसहस्राणां सहस्रं समवर्तत।।4.37.23।।
output: Then monkeys residing at mount Himavan feeding on fruits and roots came in thousands of crores. (This number is called Shankha 1000,000,000,000,0, it is one digit higher than Mahapadma.)

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
अङ्गारकसमानानां भीमानां भीमकर्मणाम्। विन्ध्याद्वानरकोटीनां सहस्राण्यपतन्द्रुतम्।।4.37.24।।
output: From the Vindhya mountain came down thousands of crores of swiftfooted monkeys of terrific deeds. They were fierce like fire (Angaraka).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षीरोदवेलानिलयास्तमालवनवासिनः। नारिकेलाशनाश्चैव तेषां सङ्ख्या न विद्यते।।4.37.25।।
output: The monkeys residents of Tamala forest on the shores of the ocean of milk feeding on coconuts arrived from the groves in countless number.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वनेभ्यो गह्वरेभ्यश्च सरिद्भ्यश्च महाजवा। आगच्छद्वानरी सेना पिबन्तीव दिवाकरम्।।4.37.26।।
output: महाजवा: swift movers, वानरी सेना army of monkeys, दिवाकरम् Sun, पिबन्तीव as if it was swallowing, वनेभ्यः from the forests, गह्वरेभ्यश्च from the caves, सरिद्भ्यश्च from the river banks, आगच्छत् came.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ये तु त्वरयितुं याता वानरास्सर्ववानरान्। ते वीरा हिमवच्छैलं ददृशुस्तं महाद्रुमम्।।4.37.27।।
output: ये those, वानराः monkeys, सर्ववानरान् all the rest of monkeys, त्वरयितुम् to hasten, याताः they had gone, ते वीराः those heroes, हिमवच्छैलं the mountain Himavat, तम् that, महाद्रुमम्  great tree, ददृशुः saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मिन्गिरिवरे रम्ये यज्ञो माहेश्वरः पुरा। सर्वदेवमनस्तोषो बभौ दिव्यो मनोहरः।।4.37.28।।
output: रम्ये on the enchanting, तस्मिन् on that, गिरिवरे on the best of mountains, पुरा earlier, सर्वदेवमनस्तोषः made the minds of all deities happy, दिव्य: मनोहर: divine and wonderful, माहेश्वरः Lord Mahesvara, यज्ञः Yajna, बभौ was performed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्ननिष्यन्दजातानि मूलानि च फलानि च। अमृतास्वादकल्पानि ददृशुस्तत्र वानराः।।4.37.29।।
output: तत्र there, वानराः monkeys, अन्ननिष्यन्दजातानि produced out of the havis of the Yajna, अमृतास्वादकल्पानि sweet like nectar, मूलानि and roots, च and, फलानि च fruits also, ददृशुः they saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदन्नसम्भवं दिव्यं फलमूलं मनोहरम्। यः कश्चित्सकृदश्नाति मासं भवति तर्पितः।।4.37.30।।
output: Any one who shares even a little of the divine, delicious fruits and roots grown out of that havis will have no hunger or thirst for a month.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तानि मूलानि दिव्यानि फलानि च फलाशनाः। औषधानि च दिव्यानि जगृहुर्हरियूथपाः।।4.37.31।।
output: The monkey leaders who lived on fruits collected the divine fruits, roots as well as  medicinal herbs.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्माच्च यज्ञायतनात्पुष्पाणि सुरभीणि च। आनिन्युर्वानरा गत्वा सुग्रीवप्रियकारणात्।।4.37.32।।
output: The monkeys also collected finesmelling flowers from the sacrificial altar to please Sugriva with.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते तु सर्वे हरिवराः पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्। सञ्चोदयित्वा त्वरिता यूथानां जग्मुरग्रतः।।4.37.33।।
output: सर्वे all, ते हरिवराः those great monkeys, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, सर्ववानरान् all the monkeys, सञ्चोदयित्वा after guiding, यूथानाम् of the hordes, अग्रतः in the forefront, त्वरिता: quickly, जग्मुः proceeded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते तु तेन मुहूर्तेन यूथपाश्शीघ्रगामिनः। किष्किन्धां त्वरया प्राप्ता स्सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः।।4.37.34।।
output: शीघ्रगामिनः swiftwalkers, ते यूथपाः leaders of the groups, तेन मुहूर्तेन in that short time, वानरः monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, यत्र there, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, त्वरया quickly, प्राप्ताः reached.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते गृहीत्वौषधीस्सर्वाः फलमूलं च वानराः। तं प्रतिग्राहयामासुर्वचनं चेदमब्रुवन्।।4.37.35।।
output: Offering all kinds of medicinal herbs, fruits and roots collected, to Sugriva the monkeys said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 37:
सर्वे परिगताश्शैलास्समुद्राश्च वनानि च। पृथिव्यां वानरास्सर्वे शासनादुपयान्ति ते।।4.37.36।।
output: सर्वे all, शैलाः mountains, समुद्रा: oceans, वनानि च and forests, परिगताः have been covered, ते your, शासनात् with command, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, वानराः vanaras, उपयान्ति they are coming.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं श्रुत्वा ततो हृष्ट स्सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः। प्रतिजग्राह तत्प्रतीतस्तेषां सर्वमुपायनम्।।4.37.37।।
output: ततः then, प्लवगाधिपः king of monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, एवम् in that way, श्रुत्वा on hearing, हृष्टः happy, तेषाम् their, सर्वम् entire, उपायनम् gift, तत् प्रीतः he was pleased with it, प्रतिजग्राह च and accepted them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रतिगृह्य च तत्सर्वमुपायनमुपाहृतम्। वानरान्सान्त्वयित्वा च सर्वानेव व्यसर्जयत्।।4.38.1।।
output: Sugriva expresses his indebtedness to Rama -- armies of monkeys of varied forms and strength from different parts of the earth arrive.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विसर्जयित्वा स हरीन् शूरांस्तान्कृतकर्मणः। मेने कृतार्थमात्मानं राघवं च महाबलम्।।4.38.2।।
output: सः he, कृतकर्मणः those who have done the task asigned, शूरान् तान् those heroes, हरीन् the monkeys, विसर्जयित्वा after sending away, आत्मानम् himself, महाबलम् powerful, राघवं च and Rama, कृतार्थम् achieved, मेने felt.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स लक्ष्मणो भीमबलं सर्ववानरसत्तमम्। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सुग्रीवं सम्प्रहर्षयन्।।4.38.3।। किष्किन्धाया विनिष्क्राम यदि ते सौम्य रोचते।
output: Cheering Sugriva, the foremost among the monkeys, the mighty Lakshmana said in a humble way: 'O goodnatured Sugriva if you would like to come to Rama let us depart  from Kishkinda.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य सुभाषितम्।।4.38.4।। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह। एवं भवतु गच्छाव: स्थेयं त्वच्छासने मया।।4.38.5।।
output: Hearing the gentle words of Lakshmana, spoken lovingly in that manner and asking him to come along with him, Sugriva was highly pleased.He agreed to go with him and said, 'As you please. I abide by your command'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य सुभाषितम्।।4.38.4।। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह। एवं भवतु गच्छाव: स्थेयं त्वच्छासने मया।।4.38.5।।
output: Hearing the gentle words of Lakshmana, spoken lovingly in that manner and asking him to come along with him, Sugriva was highly pleased.He agreed to go with him and said, 'As you please. I abide by your command'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमेवमुक्त्वा सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम्। विसर्जयामास तदा तारामन्याश्च योषितः।।4.38.6।।
output: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, शुभलक्षणम् auspicious signs, तं लक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, एवम् in such a way, उक्त्वा having spoken, तदा then, ताराम् to Tara, अन्याः योषितश्चैव other  women also, विसर्जयामास despatched.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतेत्युच्चैर्हरिवरान्सुग्रीवस्समुदाहरत्। तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा हरयश्शीघ्रमाययुः।।4.38.7।। बद्धाञ्जलिपुटास्सर्वे ये स्युः स्त्रीदर्शनक्षमाः।
output: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, एते you come, इति thus, उच्चैः loudly, हरिवरान् foremost of the monkeys, समुदाहरत् as he collected them, तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं श्रुत्वा on hearing the word, ये who, स्त्रीदर्शनक्षमाः female monkeys fit to see, स्युः they be, सर्वे all, हरयः monkeys, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः those with folded hands, शीघ्रम् quickly, आययुः came.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
तानुवाच ततः प्राप्तान्राजाऽर्कसदृशप्रभः।।4.38.8।। उपस्थापयत क्षिप्रं शिबिकां मम वानराः।
output: Then seeing the monkeys who had come there, king Sugriva who was shining like the Sungod asked them to get a palanquin ready at once.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य हरयश्शीघ्रविक्रमाः।।4.38.9।। समुपस्थापयामासुश्शिबिकां प्रियदर्शनाम्।
output: शीघ्रविक्रमाः those who were quick to act, हरयः monkeys, तस्य his, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, प्रियदर्शनाम् pleasing to see, शिबिकाम् palanquin, समुपस्थापयामासुः placed in front of him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तामुपस्थापितां दृष्ट्वा शिबिकां वानराधिपः।।4.38.10।। लक्ष्मणाऽरुह्यतां शीघ्रमिति सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्।
output: वानराधिपः chief of monkeys, उपस्थापिताम् was brought in, तां शिबिकाम् palanquin, दृष्ट्वा seeing, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, शीघ्रम् quickly, आरुह्यताम् get on, इति thus, सौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, अब्रवत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
इत्युक्त्वा काञ्चनं यानं सुग्रीवस्सूर्यसन्निभम्।।4.38.11।। बृहद्भिर्हरिभिर्युक्तमारुरोह सलक्ष्मणः।
output: With this Sugriva, shining like the Sungod, entered along with Lakshmana the golden palanquin carried by ablebodied monkeys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण म्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि।।4.38.12।। शुक्लैश्च वालव्यजनैर्धूयमानैस्समन्ततः। शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च हरिभिश्चाभिवन्दितः।।4.38.13।। निर्ययौ प्राप्य सुग्रीवो राज्यश्रियमनुत्तमाम्।
output: With a pale white umbrella over his head, white yaktail fans and sounds of conches and drums, Sugriva set out receiving greetings from monkeys, rejoicing in his royal glory.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण म्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि।।4.38.12।। शुक्लैश्च वालव्यजनैर्धूयमानैस्समन्ततः। शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च हरिभिश्चाभिवन्दितः।।4.38.13।। निर्ययौ प्राप्य सुग्रीवो राज्यश्रियमनुत्तमाम्।
output: With a pale white umbrella over his head, white yaktail fans and sounds of conches and drums, Sugriva set out receiving greetings from monkeys, rejoicing in his royal glory.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
स वानरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बहुभि श्शस्त्रपाणिभिः।।4.38.14।। परिकीर्णो ययौ तत्र यत्र रामो व्यवस्थितः।
output: Surrounded by hundreds of monkeys wielding various sharp weapons, Sugriva went forth to the region where Rama resided৷৷

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तं देशमनुप्राप्य श्रेष्ठं रामनिषेवितम्।।4.38.15।। अवातरन्महातेजा श्शिबिकायास्सलक्ष्मणः।
output: महातेजाः brilliant, सलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, सः he, रामनिषेवितम् where Rama was resided, श्रेष्ठम् best, तं देशम् that location, अनुप्राप्य having reached, शिबिकायाः from the palanquin, अवातरत् descended.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आसाद्य च ततो रामं कृताञ्जलिपुटोऽभवत्।।4.38.16।। कृताञ्जलौ स्थिते तस्मिन्वानराश्चाभवंस्तथा।
output: ततः then, रामम् to Rama, आसाद्य approached, कृताञ्जलिपुटः with folded hands, अभवत् remained, तस्मिन् when he, कृताञ्जलौ with folded hands, स्थिते stood, वानराश्च  monkeys also, तथा similarly, अभवन् did so.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
तटाकमिव तं दृष्ट्वा रामः कुड्मलपङ्कजम्।।4.38.17।। वानराणां महत्सैन्यं सुग्रीवे प्रीतिमानभूत्।
output: Rama was pleased on beholding the great army of monkeys standing, resembling a pond full of lotus buds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
पादयोः पतितं मूर्ध्ना तमुत्थाप्य हरीश्वरम्।।4.38.18।। प्रेम्णा च बहुमानाच्च राघवः परिषस्वजे।
output: Sugriva touched Rama's feet, bending his head down, and Rama lifted him up and embraced him with love and great regard.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परिष्वज्य च धर्मात्मा निषीदेति ततोऽब्रवीत्।।4.38.19।। निषण्णं तं ततो दृष्ट्वा क्षितौ रामोऽब्रवीद्वचः।
output: Embracing him, Rama offered him a seat on the ground and said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
धर्ममर्थं च कामं च यस्तु काले निषेवते।।4.38.20।। विभज्य सततं वीर स्स राजा हरिसत्तम।
output: 'O best among the heroic monkeys, a king who apportions his time properly towards pursuit of dharma, artha and kama is a hero and deserves to be a king.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हित्वा धर्मं तथाऽर्थं च कामं यस्तु निषेवते।।4.38.21।। स वृक्षाग्रे यथा सुप्तः पतितः प्रतिबुध्यते।
output: 'One who neglects dharma and artha and pursues only kama (sensuous enjoyment) is like a man asleep on top of the tree, waking up only to realize that he has fallen down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अमित्राणां वधे युक्तो मित्राणां सङ्ग्रहे रतः।।4.38.22।। त्रिवर्गफलभोक्ता तु राजा धर्मेण युज्यते।
output: अमित्राणाम् of enemies, वधे in slaying, युक्तः  right, मित्राणाम् of friends, सङ्ग्रहे in the acqusition of, रतः is engaged, राजा that king, धर्मेण with righteousness, युज्यते is associated, त्रिवर्गफलभोक्ता च enjoys the fruits of all the three (dharma, artha and kama) goals of life.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उद्योगसमयस्त्वेषप्राप्तश्शत्रुविनाशन।।4.38.23।। सञ्चिन्त्यतां हि पिङ्गेश हरिभिस्सह मन्त्रिभिः।
output: 'O king of monkeys, slayer of enemies the time to act has arrived. Think of the strategies with your ministers and other monkeys.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामं वचनमब्रवीत्।।4.38.24।। प्रणष्टा श्रीश्च कीर्तिश्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। त्वत्प्रसादान्महाबाहो पुनःप्राप्तमिदं मया।।4.38.25।।
output: On hearing this, Sugriva said to Rama,'O longarmed one the fortune, fame and soverignty of vanaras which was lost has been regained only by your grace.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामं वचनमब्रवीत्।।4.38.24।। प्रणष्टा श्रीश्च कीर्तिश्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। त्वत्प्रसादान्महाबाहो पुनःप्राप्तमिदं मया।।4.38.25।।
output: On hearing this, Sugriva said to Rama,'O longarmed one the fortune, fame and soverignty of vanaras which was lost has been regained only by your grace.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तव देव प्रसादाच्च भ्रातुश्च जयतां वर। कृतं न प्रतिकुर्याद्यः पुरुषाणां स दूषकः।।4.38.26।।
output: देव O lord, जयतां वर best of the victorious men, तव your, भ्रातुश्च your brother's, प्रसादात् by the grace, च also, कृतम् accomplished, यः whoever, न प्रतिकुर्यात् not help in return, पुरुषाणाम् among men, स दूषकः the lowest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
एते वानरमूख्याश्च शतशश्शत्रुसूदन। प्राप्ताश्चादाय बलिनः पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्।।4.38.27।।
output: 'O destroyer of enemies hundreds of strong vanara chiefs gathered from all over the earth have reached here.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋक्षाश्चावहिताश्शूरा गोलाङ्गूलाश्च राघव। कान्तारवनदुर्गाणामभिज्ञा घोरदर्शनाः।।4.38.28।। देवगन्धर्वपुत्राश्च वानराः कामरूपिणः। स्वैस्स्वै: परिवृतास्सैन्यैर्वर्तन्ते पथि राघव।।4.38.29।।
output: राघव O Rama, कान्तार वनदुर्गाणाम् inaccessible fortresses of forests, घोरदर्शनाः of fierce  appearance, ऋक्षाश्च bears, अवाहिताः familiar with every place, शूराः valiant, गोलाङ्गूलाश्च golangulas also, देवगन्धर्वपुत्राश्च loins of divine beings, and gandharvas, कामरूपिणः  who can assume any form at their will, वानराश्च vanaras, स्वैः स्वैः with their, सैन्यैः armies, परिवृताः gathered, पथि on the way, वर्तन्ते are coming.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
ऋक्षाश्चावहिताश्शूरा गोलाङ्गूलाश्च राघव। कान्तारवनदुर्गाणामभिज्ञा घोरदर्शनाः।।4.38.28।। देवगन्धर्वपुत्राश्च वानराः कामरूपिणः। स्वैस्स्वै: परिवृतास्सैन्यैर्वर्तन्ते पथि राघव।।4.38.29।।
output: 'O Rama valiant bears of fierce appearance, also golangulas (a variety of monkeys with tails like cows') familiar with the inaccessible fortresses of forest have come. These monkeys are sons of divine beings and gandharvas who can assume any form at will. They are on their way along with their armies.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शतैश्शतसहस्रैश्च वर्तन्ते कोटिभिश्च प्लवङ्गमाः। अयुतैश्चावृता वीराश्शङ्कुभिश्च परन्तप ।।4.38.30।। अर्बुदैरर्बुदशतैर्मध्यैश्चान्त्यैश्च वानराः। समुद्रैश्च परार्धैश्च हरयो हरियूथपाः।।4.38.31।। आगमिष्यन्ति ते राजन्महेन्द्रसमविक्रमाः। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा विन्ध्य मेरुकृतालयाः।।4.38.32।।
output: O scorcher of enemies the vanara troops in hundred thousand crores, ayutas, sanku, arbuda, hundreds of arbudas, madhyas, antyas, samudras and parardhas (100000000000000000), are expected. O king  they are residents of Vindhya and Meru mountains, comparable to lord Indra in courage and appear like mountains Meru and Mandara.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शतैश्शतसहस्रैश्च वर्तन्ते कोटिभिश्च प्लवङ्गमाः। अयुतैश्चावृता वीराश्शङ्कुभिश्च परन्तप ।।4.38.30।। अर्बुदैरर्बुदशतैर्मध्यैश्चान्त्यैश्च वानराः। समुद्रैश्च परार्धैश्च हरयो हरियूथपाः।।4.38.31।। आगमिष्यन्ति ते राजन्महेन्द्रसमविक्रमाः। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा विन्ध्य मेरुकृतालयाः।।4.38.32।।
output: राजन् O king, वीर heroic, शतैः in hundreds, शतसहस्रैश्च in lakhs, कोटिभिश्च even in crores, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, अयुतैश्च in ayutas, शङ्कुभिश्च in sankus(multitudes), अर्बुदैः one hundred millions, अर्बुदशतैः hundreds of arbudas, मध्यैश्च in madhyas, अन्त्येश्च in antyas, आवृताः come together, वानराः monkeys, वर्तन्ते are reaching, समुद्रैश्च in samudras, परार्धैश्च in parardhas, हरयः monkeys, महेन्द्रसमविक्रमाः comparable to Indra in courage, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशाः mount Meru, and Mandara, विन्ध्यमेरुकृतालयाः mount Vindhya and Meru, हरियूथपाः monkey troops, आगमिष्यन्ति have started coming.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शतैश्शतसहस्रैश्च वर्तन्ते कोटिभिश्च प्लवङ्गमाः। अयुतैश्चावृता वीराश्शङ्कुभिश्च परन्तप ।।4.38.30।। अर्बुदैरर्बुदशतैर्मध्यैश्चान्त्यैश्च वानराः। समुद्रैश्च परार्धैश्च हरयो हरियूथपाः।।4.38.31।। आगमिष्यन्ति ते राजन्महेन्द्रसमविक्रमाः। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा विन्ध्य मेरुकृतालयाः।।4.38.32।।
output: राजन् O king, वीर heroic, शतैः in hundreds, शतसहस्रैश्च in lakhs, कोटिभिश्च even in crores, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, अयुतैश्च in ayutas, शङ्कुभिश्च in sankus(multitudes), अर्बुदैः one hundred millions, अर्बुदशतैः hundreds of arbudas, मध्यैश्च in madhyas, अन्त्येश्च in antyas, आवृताः come together, वानराः monkeys, वर्तन्ते are reaching, समुद्रैश्च in samudras, परार्धैश्च in parardhas, हरयः monkeys, महेन्द्रसमविक्रमाः comparable to Indra in courage, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशाः mount Meru, and Mandara, विन्ध्यमेरुकृतालयाः mount Vindhya and Meru, हरियूथपाः monkey troops, आगमिष्यन्ति have started coming.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते त्वामभिगमिष्यन्ति राक्षसं ये सबान्धवम्। निहत्य रावणं सख्ये ह्यानयिष्यन्ति मैथिलीम्।।4.38.33।।
output: ये those, संख्ये in war, सबान्धवम् with relatives, राक्षसम् ogre, रावणम् Ravana, निहत्य after killing, मैथिलीम् Maithili, आनयिष्यन्ति will bring her, ते they, त्वाम् you, अभिगमिष्यन्ति they will reach you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 38:
ततस्तमुद्योगमवेक्ष्य बुद्धिमा न्हरिप्रवीरस्य निदेशवर्तिनः। बभूव हर्षाद्वसुधाधिपात्मजः प्रबुद्धनीलोत्पलतुल्यदर्शनः।।4.38.34।।
output: The wise statesman, Rama observing the efforts of Sugriva and his attendants looked like a blooming blue lotus through delight. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends of thirtyeighth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana, composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः। बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य प्रत्युवाच कृताञ्जलिम्।।4.39.1।।
output: धर्मभृताम् among the upholders of righteousness, वरः foremost, रामः Rama, इति thus, ब्रुवाणम् spoke, कृताञ्जलिम् with folded hands, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, सम्परिष्वज्य having hugged, प्रत्युवाच replied.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
यदिन्द्रो वर्षते वर्षं न तच्चित्रं भवेत्क्वचित्। आदित्यो वा सहस्रांशुः कुर्याद्वितिमिरं नभः।।4.39.2।। चन्द्रमा रश्मिभिः कुर्यात्पृथिवीं सौम्य निर्मलाम्। त्वद्विधो वाऽपि मित्राणां प्रतिकुर्यात्परन्तप ।।4.39.3।।
output: 'O scorcher of enemies, gentle Sugriva it will not be strange if Indra showers rain, if the Sun in the sky dispels darkness with his thousand rays, and if the  Moon cools down the earth with his light, and a person like you helps his friend.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदिन्द्रो वर्षते वर्षं न तच्चित्रं भवेत्क्वचित्। आदित्यो वा सहस्रांशुः कुर्याद्वितिमिरं नभः।।4.39.2।। चन्द्रमा रश्मिभिः कुर्यात्पृथिवीं सौम्य निर्मलाम्। त्वद्विधो वाऽपि मित्राणां प्रतिकुर्यात्परन्तप ।।4.39.3।।
output: परन्तप O scorcher of enemies, सौम्य O gentle one, इन्द्रः Indra, वर्षम् यत् वर्षते when he rains, सहस्रांशुः god with a thousand rays, वा or else, आदित्यः Sun, नभः sky, वितिमिरम् bright, कुर्यात् make, चन्द्रमाः Moon, पृथिवीं on the earth, रश्मिभिः with his rays, निर्मलाम् cool, कुर्यात् does, त्वद्विधः a person like you, मित्राणाम् for friends, प्रतिकुर्यात् help in turn, तत् that, चित्रम् strange, न भविष्यति will not be.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं त्वयि न तच्चित्रं भवेद्यत्सौम्य शोभनम्। जानाम्यहं त्वां सुग्रीव सततं प्रियवादिनम्।।4.39.4।।
output: 'O gentle Sugriva this your help to me is not surprising. You always help your friends and speak in a pleasing manner.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वत्सनाथ: सखे सङ्ख्ये जेताऽस्मि सकलानरीन्। त्वमेव मे सुहृतन्मित्रं साहाय्यं कर्तुमर्हसि।।4.39.5।।
output: सखे O friend, त्वत्सनाथः one supported by you, सङ्ख्ये in war, सकलान् all, अरीन् enemies, जेताऽस्मि I will win over, सुहृत् goodhearted, मित्रम् friend, त्वमेव you alone, मे to me, साहाय्यम् help, कर्तुम् to render, अर्हसि it is proper on your part.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
जहारात्मविनाशाय वैदेहीं राक्षसाधमः। वञ्चयित्वा तु पौलोमीमनुह्लादो यथा शचीम्।।4.39.6।।
output: Just as Anuhlada (son of Hiranyakasipu and brother of Prahlada) took away, Poulomi  (Sachi, daughter of Puloma) deceiving Indra, this lowly demon took away Sita, daughter of the king of Videha.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न चिरात्तं हनिष्यामि रावणं निशितैश्शरैः। पौलोम्याः पितरं दृप्तं शतक्रतुरिवाऽहवे।।4.39.7।।
output: तं रावणम् that Ravana, न चिरात् very soon, अहवे in a battle, शतक्रतुः one who has done a hundred sacrifices, Indra, पौलोम्याः Pouloma's, दृप्तम् proud, पितरम् father, निशितैः with sharp ones, शरैः arrows, हनिष्यामि will kill.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैव रजस्समभिवर्तत। उष्णां तीव्रां सहस्रांशोश्छादयद्गगने प्रभाम्।।4.39.8।।
output: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the mean while, गगने in the sky, सहस्रांशोः thousandrayed Sun's, उष्णां तीव्राम् intense heat, प्रभाम् radiance, छादयत् covering, रजः dust, समभिवर्तत was raised.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिशः पर्याकुलाश्चासन्रजसा तेन मूर्छता। चचाल च मही सर्वा सशैलवनकानना।।4.39.9।।
output: By the spreading of dust, the quarters were not visible.The earth including the mountains gardens and forests was shaken up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैर्महाबलैः। कृत्स्ना सञ्छादिता भूमिरसङ्ख्येयैः प्लवङ्गमैः।।4.39.10।। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण ततस्तैर्हरियूथपैः। कोटीशतपरीवारैः कामरूपिभिरावृता।।4.39.11।। नादेयैः पार्वतीयैश्च सामुद्रैश्च महाबलैः। हरिभिर्मेघनिर्ह्रादैरन्यैश्च वनचारिभिः।।4.39.12।। तरुणादित्यवर्णैश्च शशिगौरैश्च वानरैः। पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च श्वेतैर्मेरुकृतालयैः।।4.39.13।।
output: ततः then, नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैः resembling mountains, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैः having sharp fangs, महाबलैः  powerful, असङ्ख्येयैः innumerable, प्लवङ्गमैः by the monkeys, कृत्स्ना the entire, भूमिः land, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a minute's time, सच्छादिता was covered, ततः then, हरियूथपैः with monkey troops, कोटीशतपरीवारैः by a hundred crore monkeys, कामरूपिभिः  who can assume form at will, वानरैः by monkeys, नादेयैः coming from the rivers, पार्वतेयैश्च from the mountains, सामुद्रैश्च from the seas, महाबलैः very strong ones, हरिभिः monkeys, मेघनिर्ह्रादैः  thundering like clouds, अन्यैः others, वनचारिभिः wanderers of the forest, तरुणादित्यवर्णैः of red complexion resembling the rising Sun, शशिगौरैश्च tawny coloured ones like the Moon, पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च of the colour of filaments of white lotus, श्वेतैः by white, र्मेरुकृतालयैः residents of the mountain Meru, वानरैः with monkeys.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
