output: ततः then, नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैः resembling mountains, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैः having sharp fangs, महाबलैः  powerful, असङ्ख्येयैः innumerable, प्लवङ्गमैः by the monkeys, कृत्स्ना the entire, भूमिः land, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a minute's time, सच्छादिता was covered, ततः then, हरियूथपैः with monkey troops, कोटीशतपरीवारैः by a hundred crore monkeys, कामरूपिभिः  who can assume form at will, वानरैः by monkeys, नादेयैः coming from the rivers, पार्वतेयैश्च from the mountains, सामुद्रैश्च from the seas, महाबलैः very strong ones, हरिभिः monkeys, मेघनिर्ह्रादैः  thundering like clouds, अन्यैः others, वनचारिभिः wanderers of the forest, तरुणादित्यवर्णैः of red complexion resembling the rising Sun, शशिगौरैश्च tawny coloured ones like the Moon, पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च of the colour of filaments of white lotus, श्वेतैः by white, र्मेरुकृतालयैः residents of the mountain Meru, वानरैः with monkeys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैर्महाबलैः। कृत्स्ना सञ्छादिता भूमिरसङ्ख्येयैः प्लवङ्गमैः।।4.39.10।। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण ततस्तैर्हरियूथपैः। कोटीशतपरीवारैः कामरूपिभिरावृता।।4.39.11।। नादेयैः पार्वतीयैश्च सामुद्रैश्च महाबलैः। हरिभिर्मेघनिर्ह्रादैरन्यैश्च वनचारिभिः।।4.39.12।। तरुणादित्यवर्णैश्च शशिगौरैश्च वानरैः। पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च श्वेतैर्मेरुकृतालयैः।।4.39.13।।
output: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
ततो नगेन्द्रसङ्काशैस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रैर्महाबलैः। कृत्स्ना सञ्छादिता भूमिरसङ्ख्येयैः प्लवङ्गमैः।।4.39.10।। निमेषान्तरमात्रेण ततस्तैर्हरियूथपैः। कोटीशतपरीवारैः कामरूपिभिरावृता।।4.39.11।। नादेयैः पार्वतीयैश्च सामुद्रैश्च महाबलैः। हरिभिर्मेघनिर्ह्रादैरन्यैश्च वनचारिभिः।।4.39.12।। तरुणादित्यवर्णैश्च शशिगौरैश्च वानरैः। पद्मकेसरवर्णैश्च श्वेतैर्मेरुकृतालयैः।।4.39.13।।
output: In a minute, the entire land was crowded with innumerable powerful monkeys of the size of mountains having sharp fangs.The monkey leaders with a hundred crore monkey followers, who could assume any form at their will mighty monkeys from the mountains, rivers and seas vanaras thundering like clouds and other free vanaras who were wanderers vanaras red in colour like the rising Sun, tawny coloured ones like the Moon some who were of the hue of white lotus filaments and some vanaras residing in mount Meru came there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कोटीसहस्रैर्दशभिः श्रीमान्परिवृतस्तदा। वीरश्शतवलिर्नाम वानरः प्रत्यदृश्यत।।4.39.14।।
output: Then appeared the glorious warrior named Satavali, followed by ten thousand crore of monkeys.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः काञ्चनशैलाभस्ताराया वीर्यवान्पिता। अनेकैर्दशसाहस्रैः कोटिभिः प्रत्यदृश्यत।।4.39.15।।
output: ततः then, काञ्चनशैलाभः appearing like the golden mountain (Meru), वीर्यवान् valiant, पिता father, दशसाहस्रैः by ten thousand, कोटिभिः by crores, अनेकैः and many, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared with, ताराया Tara's.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथाऽपरेण कोटीनां सहस्रेण समन्वितः। पिता रुमाया सम्प्राप्तस्सुग्रीवश्वशुरो विभुः।।4.39.16।।
output: तथा likewise, विभुः mighty one, रुमायाः पिता father of Ruma, सुग्रीवश्वशुरः king Sugriva's fatherinlaw, अपरेण by another, कोटीनाम् by a crore, सहस्रेण thousand, समन्वितः accompanied with, सम्प्राप्तः reached.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पद्मकेसरसङ्काशस्तरुणार्कनिभाननः। बुद्धिमान्वानरश्रेष्ठस्सर्ववानरसत्तमः।।4.39.17।। अनेकैर्बहुसाहस्रैर्वानराणां समन्वितः। पिता हनुमतश्रशीमान्केसरी प्रत्यदृश्यत।।4.39.18।।
output: पद्मकेसरसङ्काशः like lotus filaments in colour, तरुणार्कनिभाननः with the countenance red like the early morning Sun, बुद्धिमान् wise, वानरश्रेष्ठः foremost of vanaras, सर्ववानरसत्तमः the best among vanaras, हनुमतः Hanuman's, पिता father, श्रीमान् prosperous, केसरी Kesari, वानराणाम् of vanaras, अनेकैः many, बहुसाहस्रैः by many thousands, समन्वितः accompanied by, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
पद्मकेसरसङ्काशस्तरुणार्कनिभाननः। बुद्धिमान्वानरश्रेष्ठस्सर्ववानरसत्तमः।।4.39.17।। अनेकैर्बहुसाहस्रैर्वानराणां समन्वितः। पिता हनुमतश्रशीमान्केसरी प्रत्यदृश्यत।।4.39.18।।
output: Then arrived Kesari, the wise and illustrious monkey, foremost and the best among vanaras, father of Hanuman. He was of the colour of lotus filaments and his countenance was red like the early morning Sun. He was accompanied by many thousands of monkeys.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गोलाङ्गूलमहाराजो गवाक्षो भीमविक्रमः। वृतः कोटिसहस्रेण वानराणामदृश्यत।।4.39.19।।
output: वानराणाम् of vanaras, कोटिसहस्रेण by a thousand crores, वृतः surrounded, गोलाङ्गूलमहाराजः king of Langur, भीमविक्रमः a warrior of fierce valour, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, अदृश्यत was seen

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋक्षाणां भीमवेगानां धूम्रश्शत्रुनिबर्हणः। वृतः कोटिसहस्राभ्यां द्वाभ्यां समभिवर्तत।।4.39.20।।
output: Dhumra, destroyer of enemies, came next followed by two thousand crore of bears of terrible speed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महाचलनिभैर्घोरै: पनसो नाम यूथपः। आजगाम महावीर्यस्तिसृभिः कोटिभिर्वृतः।।4.39.21।।
output: Similarly, the great warrior named Panasa, leader of the troop, reported with three crore dreadful vanaras of the size of huge mountains.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
नीलाञ्जनचयाकारो नीलो नामाऽथ यूथपः। अदृश्यत महाकायः कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः।।4.39.22।।
output: Then appeared Nila of huge body, dark like a mountain of collyrium accompanied by ten crore vanaras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः काञ्चनशैलाभो गवयो नाम यूथपः। आजगाम महावीर्यः पञ्चभि: कोटिभिर्वृतः।।4.39.23।।
output: ततः then, काञ्चनशैलाभः appearing like golden mountain, महावीर्यः a great warrior, गवयो नाम Gavaya by name, यूथपः leader of a group, पञ्चभिः कोटिभिः by five crores, वृतः surrounded, आजगाम arrived.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दरीमुखश्च बलवान्यूथपोऽभ्याययौ तदा। वृतः कोटिसहस्रेण सुग्रीवं समुपस्थितः।।4.39.24।।
output: तदा then, बलवान् strong, दरीमुखः Darimukha, यूथपः leader, कोटिसहस्रेण with one thousand crores, वृतः surrounded, अभ्याययौ came near, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, समुपस्थितः approached.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चोभावश्विपुत्रौ महाबलौ। कोटिकोटिसहस्रेण वानराणामदृश्यताम्।।4.39.25।।
output: Two very powerful sons of Asvini, Mainda and Dvivida, appeared with a thousand crore vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
गजश्च बलवान् वीर: कोटिभिस्तिसृभिर्वृतः। आजगाम महातेजा सुग्रीवस्य समीपतः।।4.39.26।।
output: Strong and powerful Gaja also reached Sugriva with three crore vanaras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋक्षराजो महातेजा जाम्बवान्नाम नामतः। कोटिभिर्दशभिः प्राप्तः सुग्रीवस्य वशे स्थितः।।4.39.27।।
output: महातेजाः glorious, नामतः by name, जाम्बवान् नाम called Jambavan, ऋक्षराजः king of bears, दशभिः ten, कोटिभि with crores, प्राप्तः got, सुग्रीवस्य to Sugriva, वशे under control, स्थितः stood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुमण्वान्नाम विक्रान्तो वानरो वानरेश्वरम्। आययौ बलवांस्तूर्णं कोटीशतसमावृतः।।4.39.28।।
output: Sturdy and victorious vanara called Rumanvan came swiftly followed by a hundred crore vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
ततः कोटिसहस्राणां सहस्रेण शतेन च। पृष्ठतोऽनुगतः प्राप्तो हरिभिर्गन्धमादनः।।4.39.29।।
output: Then came Gandhamadana with a hundred thousand crore of vanaras following him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः पद्मसहस्रेण वृतश्शङ्कुशतेन च। युवराजोऽङ्गदः प्राप्तः पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः।।4.39.30।।
output: ततः then, पितुः तुल्यपराक्रमः comparable in prowess to his father, युवराजः heir apparent, अङ्गदः Angada, पद्मसहस्रेण with a thousand Padmas (trillion), शङ्कुशतेन च one hundred times Sanku (ten trillion), वृतः surrounded, प्राप्तः arrived.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्ताराद्युतिस्तारो हरिर्भीमपराक्रमः। पञ्चभिर्हरिकोटीभिर्दूरतः प्रत्यदृश्यत।।4.39.31।।
output: And Tara (brother of Ruma's father) of terrific valour shining like a star showed up at a distance with five crore vanaras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इन्द्रजानुः कपिर्वीरो यूथपः प्रत्यदृश्यत। एकादशानां कोटीनामीश्वरस्तैस्समावृतः।।4.39.32।।
output: एकादशानां कोटीनाम् of eleven crores of vanaras, ईश्वरः chief, वीरःhero, यूथपः leader of troop, इन्द्रजानुः Indrajanu, कपिः vanara, तैः with them, समावृतः surrounded, प्रत्यदृश्यत appeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
ततो रम्भस्त्वनुप्राप्तस्तरुणादित्यसन्निभः। अयुतेनावृतश्चैव सहस्रेण शतेन च।।4.39.33।।
output: Thereafter Rambha of the colour of the rising Sun brought together an army of one thousand and one hundred ayuta troops.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
ततो यूथपतिर्वीरो दुर्मुखो नाम वानरः। प्रत्यदृश्यत कोटीभ्यां द्वाभ्यां परिवृतो बली।।4.39.34।।
output: Thereafter the mighty hero, leader of the troop, by name Durmukha appeared with  two crore vanaras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कैलासशिखराकारैर्वानरैर्भीमविक्रमैः। वृतः कोटिसहस्रेण हनुमान्प्रत्यदृश्यत।।4.39.35।।
output: हनुमान् Hanuman, कैलासशिखराकारैः with those like the peaks of Kailasa mountain, भीमविक्रमैः with warriors of frightful valour, कोटिसहस्रेण by one thousand crores, वानरैः with vanaras, वृतः surrounded by, प्रत्यदृश्यत showed up.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नलश्चापि महावीर्यस्संवृतो द्रुमवासिभिः। कोटीशतेन सम्प्राप्तस्सहस्रेण शतेन च।।4.39.36।।
output: Valiant Nala also arrived surrounded by a hundred crore and a hundred thousand treedwellers (monkeys).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो दधिमुखश्रीमान्कोटिभिर्दशभिर्वृतः। सम्प्राप्तोऽभिमतस्तस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः।।4.39.37।।
output: Then the illustrious Dadhimukha, great Sugriva's favourite leader reached with ten crore vanaras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शरभः कुमुदो वह्निर्वानरो रंह एव च। एते चान्ये च बहवो वानराः कामरूपिणः।।4.39.38।। आवृत्य पृथिवीं सर्वां पर्वतांश्च वनानि च। यूथपा स्समनुप्राप्ता स्तेषां संख्या न विद्यते।।4.39.39।। आगताश्च विशिष्टाश्च पृथिव्यां सर्ववानराः।
output: Sarabha, Kumuda, Vahni and Ramhi and many other vanara troops who can assume any form at their will and others from all over the land, mountains and forest advanced towards Sugriva. All the outstanding vanaras of the earth came and covered the land.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शरभः कुमुदो वह्निर्वानरो रंह एव च। एते चान्ये च बहवो वानराः कामरूपिणः।।4.39.38।। आवृत्य पृथिवीं सर्वां पर्वतांश्च वनानि च। यूथपा स्समनुप्राप्ता स्तेषां संख्या न विद्यते।।4.39.39।। आगताश्च विशिष्टाश्च पृथिव्यां सर्ववानराः।
output: शरभः Sarabha, कुमुदः Kumuda, वानरः vanara, वह्निः Vahni, रंहः एव च and so also Ramha, एते all of them, कामरूपिणः who can assume any form at will, अन्ये च and others, बहवः many, तेषाम् of them, संख्या number, वानराः vanaras, यूथपाः troops, सर्वाम् entire, पृथिवीम् land, पर्वतांश्च and mountains, वनानि च and forests also, आवृत्य having occupied, समनुप्राप्ताः advancing towards, आगताः came, सर्ववानराः all the vanaras, पृथिव्याम् of the earth, विशिष्टाश्च outstanding.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आप्लवन्तः प्लवन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवङ्गमाः। अभ्यवर्तन्त सुग्रीवं सूर्यमभ्रगणा इव।।4.39.40।।
output: The monkeys came leaping, jumping and roaring in enthusiasm and surrounded Sugriva just as clouds surround the Sun.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुर्वाणा बहुशब्दांश्च प्रहृष्टा बाहुशालिनः। शिरोभिर्वानरेन्द्राय सुग्रीवाय न्यवेदयन्।।4.39.41।।
output: प्रहृष्टाः happy ones, बाहुशालिनः of sturdy shoulders, बहुशब्दान् many kinds of noises, कुर्वाणाः while they made, शिरोभिः with their heads, वानरेन्द्राय to the lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, न्यवेदयन् reported.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
अपरे वानरश्रेष्ठास्सङ्गम्य च यथोचितम्। सुग्रीवेण समागम्य स्थिताः प्राञ्जलय स्तदा।।4.39.42।।
output: Thereafter the vanaras came close to Sugriva freely and on reaching him stood, offering salutations with folded hands.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीवस्त्वरितो रामे सर्वांस्तां वानररर्षभान्। निवेदयित्वा धर्मज्ञः स्थितः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्।।4.39.43।।
output: Sugriva, knower of dharma, at once presented all the prominent vanaras to Rama, and standing with folded hands said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 39:
यथासुखं पर्वतनिझरेषु वनेषु सर्वेषु च वानरेन्द्राः। निवेशयित्वा विधिवद्बलानि बलं बलज्ञः प्रतिपत्तुमीष्टे।।4.39.44।।
output: Sugriva told the chiefs to station the forces by the side  of swift mountain streams, in forests, and hills and ascertain their exact number. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
अथ राजा समृद्धार्थस्सुग्रीवः प्लवगेश्वरः। उवाच नरशार्दूलं रामं परबलार्दनम्।।4.40.1।।
output: Sugriva, lord of monkeys, who was supported by a massive army informed Rama, the tiger among men and a crusher of the enemy army

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आगता विनिविष्टाश्च बलिनः कामरूपिणः। वानरा वारणेन्द्रभा: ये मद्विषयवासिनः।।4.40.2।।
output: 'The vanaras living in my kingdom have come and have settled down. They are strong and huge like elephants and they can assume any form at will.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त इमे बहुविक्रान्तैर्हरिभिर्भीमविक्रमैः। आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्यदानवसन्निभाः।।4.40.3।।
output: 'Dreadful monkeys, powerful monkeys of fierce valour who resemble demons in form, have arrived.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ख्यातकर्मापदानाश्च बलवन्तो जितक्लमाः। पराक्रमेषु विख्याता व्यवसायेषु चोत्तमाः।।4.40.4।। पृथिव्यम्बुचरा राम नानानगनिवासिनः। कोट्यग्रश इमे प्राप्ता वानरास्तव किङ्कराः।।4.40.5।।
output: राम O Rama, ख्यातकर्मापदानाश्च earned fame for their valiant deeds in the past, बलवन्तः powerful ones, जितक्लमाः indefatigable, पराक्रमेषु in might, विख्याताः famous, व्यवसायेषु in making efforts, उत्तमाः best, पृथिव्यम्बुचराः who can move on earth as well as water, नानानगनिवासिनः living on several mountains, इमे they, वानराः vanaras, कोट्यग्रश: crores of them, तव your, किङ्कराः vanaras, प्राप्ताः have come.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ख्यातकर्मापदानाश्च बलवन्तो जितक्लमाः। पराक्रमेषु विख्याता व्यवसायेषु चोत्तमाः।।4.40.4।। पृथिव्यम्बुचरा राम नानानगनिवासिनः। कोट्यग्रश इमे प्राप्ता वानरास्तव किङ्कराः।।4.40.5।।
output: राम O Rama, ख्यातकर्मापदानाश्च earned fame for their valiant deeds in the past, बलवन्तः powerful ones, जितक्लमाः indefatigable, पराक्रमेषु in might, विख्याताः famous, व्यवसायेषु in making efforts, उत्तमाः best, पृथिव्यम्बुचराः who can move on earth as well as water, नानानगनिवासिनः living on several mountains, इमे they, वानराः vanaras, कोट्यग्रश: crores of them, तव your, किङ्कराः vanaras, प्राप्ताः have come.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निदेशवर्तिनस्सर्वे सर्वे गुरुहिते रताः। अभिप्रेतमनुष्ठातुं तव शक्ष्यन्त्यरिन्दम।।4.40.6।।
output: 'O Rama,the subduer of foes all of them will follow your command.They are engaged in seeking the wellbeing of elders and can fulfil your wish.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त इमे बहुसाहस्रैरनीकै भीमविक्रमैः। आगता वानरा घोरा दैत्यदानवसन्निभा:।।4.40.7।।
output: 'Dreadful monkeys who resemble demons have arrived along with thousands of fierce fighters.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
यन्मन्यसे नरव्याघ्र प्राप्तकालं तदुच्यताम्। तत्सैन्यं त्वद्वशे युक्तमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि।।4.40.8।।
output: 'O tiger among men announce the proper time for action. This army is at your command. Command them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
काममेषामिदं कार्यं विदितं मम तत्त्वतः। तथापि तु यथातत्त्वमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि।।4.40.9।।
output: इदम् this, कार्यम् task, मम to me, तत्त्वतः  in principle, एवम् that way, विदितं कामम् is known to me, तथापि even then, यथातत्त्वम् properly, आज्ञापयितुम् to order, अर्हसि you may.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति ब्रुवाणं सुग्रीवं रामो दशरथात्मजः। बाहुभ्यां सम्परिष्वज्य इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।4.40.10।।
output: On hearing him, Rama, Dasaratha's son, hugged Sugriva with his arms and said:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ज्ञायतां मम वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा। स च देशो महाप्राज्ञ यस्मिन्वसति रावणः।।4.40.11।।
output: महाप्राज्ञ O very wise one, मम my, वैदेही Vaidehi, जीवति वा alive or, न वा not or, रावणः Ravana, यस्मिन् in whichever, वसति resides, सः he, देशः in a place, च and, ज्ञायताम् it may be found out.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अधिगम्य तु वैदेहीं निलयं रावणस्य च। प्राप्तकालं विधास्यामि तस्मिन्काले सह त्वया।।4.40.12।।
output: 'On locating Vaidehi in the kingdom of Ravana I shall take up proper course of action  in conjunction with you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नाहमस्मिन् प्रभुः कार्ये वानरेश न लक्ष्मणः। त्वमस्य हेतुः कार्यस्य प्रभुश्च प्लवगेश्वर।।4.40.13।।
output: प्लवगेश्वर O lord of monkeys, वानरेश king of vanaras, अहम् I, अस्मिन् in this, कार्ये in the task, प्रभुः  commanders, न not, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, न  not, त्वम् you, अस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the task, हेतुः means, प्रभुश्च lord.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वमेवाऽज्ञापय विभो मम कार्यविनिश्चयम्। त्वं हि जानासि यत्कार्यं मम वीर न संशयः।।4.40.14।।
output: 'O king you have understood the task to be performed and, therefore, issue orders without the least hesitation.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
सुहृद्वितीयो विक्रान्तः प्राज्ञः कालविशेषवित्। भवानस्मध्दिते युक्त स्सुकृतार्थोऽर्थवित्तमः।।4.40.15।।
output: 'You are my second friend (Lakshmana being the first). You are valiant as well as wise. You are aware of timely action. You are interested in my wellbeing. You are capable. You know my purpose. You are a startegic planner'. (The present purpose is to plan the course of action. That is artha. Sugriva knows this artha very well).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो विनतं नाम यूथपम्। अब्रवीद्रामसान्निध्ये लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः।।4.40.16।। शैलाभं मेघनिर्घोषमूर्जितं प्लवगेश्वरः।
output: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been asked, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामसान्निध्ये in the presence of Rama, धीमतः  learned, लक्ष्मणस्य च Lakshmana's, यूथपम् a troop leader, शैलाभम् lofty like a mountain, मेघनिर्घोषम्  who roared like a thunderous cloud, ऊर्जितम् wellbuilt body, विनतं नाम called Vinata, प्लवगेश्वरम् lord of monkeys, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
सोमसूर्यात्मजै स्सार्धं वानरैर्वानरोत्तम।।4.40.17।। देशकालनयैर्युक्तः कार्या कार्यविनिश्चये। वृतश्शतसहश्रेण वानराणां तरस्विनाम्।।4.40.18।। अधिगच्छ दिशं पूर्वां सशैलवनकाननाम्।
output: 'O foremost of the vanaras march forward with the sons of Moon and Sun, followed by one lakh swift monkeys towards the eastern direction full of mountains, gardens, and forests. Endowed with political wisdom, you are capable of taking right decision in accordance with time and place.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्र सीतां च वैदेहीं निलयं रावणस्य च।।4.40.19।। मार्गध्वं गिरिशृङ्गेषु वनेषु च नदीषु च।
output: 'Search for Sita in the abode of Ravana, on mountain peaks and river banks and in forests.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नदीं भागीरथीं रम्यां सरयूं कौशिकीं तथा।।4.40.20।। कालिन्दीं यमुनां रम्यां यामुनं च महागिरिम्। सरस्वतीं च सिन्धुं च शोणं मणिनिभोदकम्।।4.40.21।। महीं कालमहीं चैव शैलकाननशोभिताम्। ब्रह्ममालान्विदेहांश्च मालवान्कालिकोसलान्।।4.40.22।। मागधांश्च महाग्रामान्पुण्ड्रांन्वङ्गां स्तथैव च। पत्तनं कोशकाराणां भूमिं च रजताकराम्।।4.40.23।।
output: 'Look for Sita in the beautiful places on rivers Bhagirathi, Sarayu, Kausiki and Kalindi, on the great mountains adjacent to river Yamuna, banks of rivers Saraswati, Sindhu, Sona with crystalclear waters, the country of Mahim and Kalamahi adorned with mountains and forests. Proceed to Brahmamala, Videha, Malava, Kasi, Kosala and Maghada with great villages, the country of Pundram, Vanga, the country famous for silk worms and the land with silver caves. (It is the eastern direction of river Saravati between Himavat and Vindhya and not east of Kiskinda)

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
सर्वमेतद्विचेतव्यं मृगयद्भिस्ततस्ततः। रामस्य दयितां भार्यां सीतां दशरथस्नुषाम्।।4.40.24।।
output: 'Search all over the place looking carefully here and there for Sita the beloved consort of Rama, daughterinlaw of Dasaratha.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समुद्रमवगाढांश्च पर्वतान्पत्तनानि च। मन्दरस्य च ये कोटिं संश्रिताः केचिदायताम्।।4.40.25।। कर्णप्रावरणाश्चैव तथा चाप्योष्ठकर्णकाः। घोरलोहमुखाश्चैव जवनाश्चैकपादकाः।।4.40.26।। अक्षया बलवन्तश्च पुरुषाः पुरुषादकाः। किराताः कर्ण चूडाश्च हेमाङ्गा: प्रियदर्शनाः।।4.40.27।। आममीनाशनास्तत्र किराता द्वीपवासिनः। अन्तर्जलचरा घोरा नरव्याघ्रा इति शृताः।।4.40.28।। एतेषामाश्रयास्सर्वे विचेयाः कावनौकसः। गिरिभिर्ये च गम्यन्ते प्लवनेन प्लवेन च।।4.40.29।।
output: काननौकसः inhabitants of the forests, समुद्रम् the oceans, अवगाढान् deep pits, पर्वतानि on the mountains,पत्तनानि च and towns, मन्दरस्य on Mandara mountain, आयताम् living, कोटिम्  broad peaks, संश्रिताः taken shelter, केचित् some, कर्णप्रावरणाश्चैव who cover their ears,  ओष्ठकर्णकाः who have ears on lips, घोरलोहमुखाश्चैव who have iron faces, जवनाः of great speed, एकपादकाः with one foot, अक्षयाः  who cannot be destroyed, बलवन्तश्च powerful people, पुरुषाः men, पुरुषादकाः cannibals, किराताः Kiratas, आकर्ण चूडाः with hair reaching their ears, प्रियदर्शनाः of pleasing appearance, हेमाङ्गाः of goldencolour limbs, आममीनाशनाः eating uncooked fish, द्वीपवासिनः residents of island, किराताः Kiratas, इति thus, शृताः it is heard, अन्तर्जलचराः moving under water, घोराः fierce ones, नरव्याघ्राः tiger among men, एतेषाम् of them, सर्वे all, आश्रयाः shelters, विचेयाः should be searched, ये those, गिरिभिः by moutains, प्लवनेन  leaping animals, प्लवनेन च and jumping, गम्यन्ते should go and search.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समुद्रमवगाढांश्च पर्वतान्पत्तनानि च। मन्दरस्य च ये कोटिं संश्रिताः केचिदायताम्।।4.40.25।। कर्णप्रावरणाश्चैव तथा चाप्योष्ठकर्णकाः। घोरलोहमुखाश्चैव जवनाश्चैकपादकाः।।4.40.26।। अक्षया बलवन्तश्च पुरुषाः पुरुषादकाः। किराताः कर्ण चूडाश्च हेमाङ्गा: प्रियदर्शनाः।।4.40.27।। आममीनाशनास्तत्र किराता द्वीपवासिनः। अन्तर्जलचरा घोरा नरव्याघ्रा इति शृताः।।4.40.28।। एतेषामाश्रयास्सर्वे विचेयाः कावनौकसः। गिरिभिर्ये च गम्यन्ते प्लवनेन प्लवेन च।।4.40.29।।
output: 'There are people who have taken shelter in the deep pits in the midst of the sea, in deep valleys, mountains, cities and broad peaks of Mandara mountain and forests.All those regions should be thoroughly searched. There are innumerable inhabitants,such as strong cannibals, some who cover their ears, some who have ears extended up to the lips, some with dreadful metallic faces, some swiftmoving, onefooted indestructible beings. There are Kirata tribes of golden complexion and handsome looks whose tuft of hair is set to the sides so that it touches their ears. These Kiratas are Islanddwellers and they eat uncooked fish.They move in waters and are fierce, known as tigerlike men (Naravyagras because half of their body is human and other half is tiger in form). All the shelters of these forestdwellers should be searched well.Those who can be sent by crossing mountains, those who can leap (in air) and those who can swim through waters may be also dispatched.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रत्नवन्तं यवद्वीपं सप्तराज्योपशोभितम्। सुवर्णरूप्यकं चैव सुवर्णाकरमण्डितम्।।4.40.30।। यवद्वीपमतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पर्वतः। दिवं स्पृशति शृङ्गेण देवदानवसेवितः।।4.40.31।। एतेषां गिरिदुर्गेषु प्रपातेषु वनेषु च। मार्गध्वं सहितास्सर्वे रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम्।।4.40.32।।
output: 'Go beyond Java island filled with precious gems. It has seven kingdoms. It is adorned with gold and silver mines in abundance. There is a mountain Sisira (abode of Garuda) beyond Java Island. It touches the sky with its lofty cliffs. Gods and demons visit this mountain. You may look for illustrious Rama's consort in these inaccessible mountains, waterfalls and forests.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रत्नवन्तं यवद्वीपं सप्तराज्योपशोभितम्। सुवर्णरूप्यकं चैव सुवर्णाकरमण्डितम्।।4.40.30।। यवद्वीपमतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पर्वतः। दिवं स्पृशति शृङ्गेण देवदानवसेवितः।।4.40.31।। एतेषां गिरिदुर्गेषु प्रपातेषु वनेषु च। मार्गध्वं सहितास्सर्वे रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम्।।4.40.32।।
output: सप्तराज्योपशोभितम् prosperous and divided into seven kingdoms, यवद्वीपम् island of Java, सुवर्णाकरमण्डितम् glittering with gold mines, सुवर्णरूप्यकं चैव island of gold and silver, रत्नवन्तम् rich in gems, यवद्वीपम् island of Java, अतिक्रम्य going beyond, शिशिरोनाम Sisira by name, देवदानवसेवितः frequented by gods and demons, पर्वतः mountains, शृङ्गेण with a peak, दिवम् sky, स्पृशति touching, सर्वे all, सहिताः together, एतेषाम् of those, गिरिदुर्गेषु inaccesible mountains, प्रपातेषु at water falls, वनेषु च and in forests, यशस्विनीम् famed, रामपन्तीम् Rama's wife, मार्गध्वम् search for.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
रत्नवन्तं यवद्वीपं सप्तराज्योपशोभितम्। सुवर्णरूप्यकं चैव सुवर्णाकरमण्डितम्।।4.40.30।। यवद्वीपमतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पर्वतः। दिवं स्पृशति शृङ्गेण देवदानवसेवितः।।4.40.31।। एतेषां गिरिदुर्गेषु प्रपातेषु वनेषु च। मार्गध्वं सहितास्सर्वे रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम्।।4.40.32।।
output: 'Go beyond Java island filled with precious gems. It has seven kingdoms. It is adorned with gold and silver mines in abundance. There is a mountain Sisira (abode of Garuda) beyond Java Island. It touches the sky with its lofty cliffs. Gods and demons visit this mountain. You may look for illustrious Rama's consort in these inaccessible mountains, waterfalls and forests.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
ततो रक्तजलं शोणमगाधं शीघ्रगामिनम्। गत्वा पारं समुद्रस्य सिद्धचारणसेवितम्।।4.40.33।। तस्य तीर्थेषु रम्येषु विचित्रेषु वनेषु च। रावण स्सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः।।4.40.34।।
output: 'Therefrom reach out to the swiftflowing river Sona which has redcoloured waters. Then crossing the sea which is the abode of Siddhas and Charanas search the different rivers reaching the sea, and the picturesque and wonderful forests to trace the abode of Ravana who has stolen Sita.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो रक्तजलं शोणमगाधं शीघ्रगामिनम्। गत्वा पारं समुद्रस्य सिद्धचारणसेवितम्।।4.40.33।। तस्य तीर्थेषु रम्येषु विचित्रेषु वनेषु च। रावण स्सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः।।4.40.34।।
output: ततः then, रक्तजलम् having red coloured water, शीघ्रगामिनम् fastflowing, शोणमगाधम् deep river Sona, (प्राप्य after reaching there), समुद्रस्य ocean's, सिद्धचारणसेवितम् inhabited by Siddhas and Charanas, पारम् to the opposite side, गत्वा on going, तस्य its, रम्येषु in delightful, तीर्थेषु in rivers, वचित्रेषु wonderful, वनेषु च and forests, ततस्ततः here and there, वैदेह्या along with Vaidehi, रावणः Ravana, मार्गितव्यः should be sought for.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत स्समुद्रद्वीपांश्च सुभीमान्द्रष्टुमर्हथ। ऊर्मिमन्तं समुद्रं च क्रोशन्तमनिलोद्धतम्।।4.40.35।।
output: ततः then, सुभीमान् fierce, समुद्रद्वीपांश्च islands of the ocean, समुद्रं च and the ocean, अनिलोद्धतम् swept by wind, क्रोशन्तम् roaring, ऊर्मिमन्तम् stirred up by waves, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हथ it is proper for you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्रासुरा महाकायाश्छायां गृह्णन्ति नित्यशः। ब्रह्मणा समनुज्ञाता दीर्घकालं बुभुक्षिताः।।4.40.36।।
output: 'Demons of huge bodies catch the shadows of passersby in that place as they have been hungry for long and have the permission of Brahma to do so.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं कालमेघप्रतिमं महोरगनिषेवितम्। अभिगम्य महानादं तीर्थेनैव महोदधिम्।।4.40.37।। ततो रक्तजलं भीमं लोहितं नाम सागरम्। गत्वा प्रेक्ष्यथ तां चैव बृहतीं कूटशाल्मलीम्।।4.40.38।।
output: कालमेघप्रतिमम् looking like black clouds at the time of dissolution, महोरगनिषेवितम् inhabited by great serpents, महानादम् roaring, महोदधिम् great ocean, रक्तजलं with red colured water, तीर्थेनैव through the river bank, अभिगम्य after reaching there, लोहितं नाम called Lohita, सागरम् sea, गत्वा going there, बृहतीम् a huge one, ताम् that one, कूटशाल्मलीम् Salmali tree (silkcotton tree), प्रेक्ष्यथ seeing, चैव also.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
तं कालमेघप्रतिमं महोरगनिषेवितम्। अभिगम्य महानादं तीर्थेनैव महोदधिम्।।4.40.37।। ततो रक्तजलं भीमं लोहितं नाम सागरम्। गत्वा प्रेक्ष्यथ तां चैव बृहतीं कूटशाल्मलीम्।।4.40.38।।
output: 'Reach out to the great roaring ocean which looks like a black cloud at the time of dissolution, inhabited by great serpents.Go through the bank of the river, and touch the frightening sea named Lohita of red coloured water.You will see a huge silkcotton tree in that place.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गृहं च वैनतेयस्य नानारत्नविभूषितम्। तत्र कैलाससङ्काशं विहितं विश्वकर्मणा।।4.40.39।।
output: तत्र there, नानारत्नविभूषितम् adorned with diffrent kinds of gems, कैलाससङ्काशम् looking like the Kailasa mountain, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, विहितम् constructed, वैनतेयस्य Garuda's, गृहम् house, च also.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
तत्र शैलनिभा भीमा मन्देहा नाम राक्षसाः। शैलशृङ्गेषु लम्बन्ते नानारूपा भयावहाः।।4.40.40।।
output: 'There are frightening demons called Mandehas of different forms, fearsome as huge mountains hanging down the mountain peaks.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
ते पतन्ति जले नित्यं सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति। निहता ब्रह्मतेजोभिरहन्यहनि राक्षसाः।।4.40.41।। अभितप्ताश्च सूर्येण लम्बन्ते स्म पुनः पुनः।
output: 'Those demons  keep dropping down in water at the time of Sunrise every day, by the power of Gayatri mantras recited by brahmins scorched by the heat of the Sun. Again and again they keep hanging  on to the cliffs.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
ततः पाण्डुरमेघाभं क्षीरोदं नाम सागरम्।।4.40.42।। गत्वा द्रक्ष्यथ दुर्धर्षा मुक्ताहारमिवोर्मिभिः।
output: 'You who are unassailable by the enemies, will see the milky ocean appearing like clouds, resembling a pearl necklace with its rows of waves.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य मध्ये महान् श्वेतो ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः।।4.40.43।। दिव्यगन्धैः कुसुमितै राजितैश्च नगैर्वृतः। सरश्च राजतैः पद्मैर्ज्वलितैर्हेमकेसरैः।।4.40.44।। नाम्ना सुदर्शनं नाम राजहंसैस्समाकुलम्।
output: तस्य मध्ये in the middle, दिव्यगन्धैः with wonderful fragrances, कुसुमितैः flowering, राजितैः  glowing, नगैः with mountains, वृतः surrounded, ऋषभो नाम called Rishaba, श्वेतः white, पर्वतः mountain, ज्वलितैः with glittering, हेमकेसरैः with golden filaments, राजतैः with silver, पद्मैः with lotuses, राजहंसैः with royal swans, समाकुलम् surrounded, नाम्ना known as, सुदर्शनं नाम called Sudarsana, सरश्च lake.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य मध्ये महान् श्वेतो ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः।।4.40.43।। दिव्यगन्धैः कुसुमितै राजितैश्च नगैर्वृतः। सरश्च राजतैः पद्मैर्ज्वलितैर्हेमकेसरैः।।4.40.44।। नाम्ना सुदर्शनं नाम राजहंसैस्समाकुलम्।
output: 'In the midst of that ocean stands a majestic white mountain named Rishaba surrounded by trees filled with silver flowers emitting wonderful fragrance.There is also a lake named Sudarsana with glittering silver lotuses having gleaming golden filaments. Royal swans inhabit these surroundings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विबुधाश्चारणा यक्षाः किन्नराश्चाप्सरोगणाः।।4.40.45।। हृष्टास्समभिगच्छन्ति नलिनीं तां रिरंसवः।
output: 'The deities, called charanas, yakshas and kinneras, also apsarasas keep coming there to stoll by that lotus pond.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षीरोदं समतिक्रम्य तदा द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः।।4.40.46।। जलोदं सागरं शीघ्रं सर्वभूतभयावहम्।
output: वानराः O monkeys, क्षीरोदम् milky ocean, समतिक्रम्य going beyond, सर्वभूतभयावहम् most dreadful to all creatures, जलोदम् ocean, सागरम् sea, शीघ्रं swiftly, तदा then, द्रक्ष्यथ you will see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
तत्र तत्कोपजं तेजः कृतं हयमुखं महत्।।4.40.47।। अस्याहुस्तन्महावेगमोदनं सचराचरम्।
output: 'Here is born Hayamukha, out of the fastspreading fire of anger of the ocean. Its movable and  immovable creatures constitute his food.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र विक्रोशतां नादो भूतानां सागरौकसाम्।।4.40.48।। श्रूयते च समर्थानां दृष्ट्वा तद्बडबामुखम्।
output: तत्र there, तत् that, बडबामुखम् burning face of Vadava, दृष्ट्वा seeing, असमर्थानाम् of the weak, विक्रोशताम् crying loudly, सागरौकसाम् dwelling in the sea, भूतानाम् of creatures, नादः sound, श्रूयते is heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वादूदस्योत्तरे देशे योजनानि त्रयोदश।।4.40.49।। जातरूपशिलो नाम महान्कनकपर्वतः।
output: स्वादूदस्य of the ocean of tasty water, उत्तरे देशे  the north direction, त्रयोदश thirteen, योजनानि yojanas, महान् huge, कनकपर्वतः golden mountain, जातरूपशिलो नाम called Jatarupasila.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र चन्द्रप्रतीकाशं पन्नगं धरणीधरम्।।4.40.50।। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षं ततो द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः। आसीनं पर्वतस्याग्रे सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम्।।4.40.51।। सहस्रशिरसं देवमनन्तं नीलवाससम्।
output: वानराः O monkeys, ततः then, तत्र there, पर्वतस्य mountain's, अग्रे on the top, आसीनम् seated, चन्द्रप्रतीकाशम् resembling the Moon in brightness, पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षम् of large eyes like lotus petals, सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम् revered by all beings, सहस्रशिरसम् thousandheaded, नीलवाससम् robed in blue cloth, देवम् worshipped, धरणीधरम् bearing the load of the earth, अनन्तम् Ananta, पन्नगम् serpent, द्रक्ष्यथ you will see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
तत्र चन्द्रप्रतीकाशं पन्नगं धरणीधरम्।।4.40.50।। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षं ततो द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः। आसीनं पर्वतस्याग्रे सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम्।।4.40.51।। सहस्रशिरसं देवमनन्तं नीलवाससम्।
output: 'O monkeys on top of the mountain you will see Ananta, a thousandhooded serpent seated, as bright as the Moon, robed in blue, with large eyes like lotus petals bearing the load of the earth, and revered by all beings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्रिशिराः काञ्चनः केतुस्तालस्तस्य महात्मनः।।4.40.52।। स्थापितः पर्वतस्याग्रे विराजति सवेदिकः।
output: 'Highsouled Ananta's flag is a threeheaded golden palm tree shining on an altar on top of the mountain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि निर्माणं कृतं तत् त्रिदशेश्वरैः।।4.40.53।। ततः परं हेममय श्श्रीमानुदयपर्वतः। तस्य कोटिर्दिवं स्पृष्ट्वा शतयोजनमायता।।4.40.54।। जातरूपमयी दिव्या विराजति सवेदिका।
output: 'The flag of Ananta is fixed by the gods in the eastern direction. Beyond that stands the famous golden mountain behind which the sun rises. Its golden peak with a divine altar spread over a hundred yojanas touches heaven.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पूर्वस्यां दिशि निर्माणं कृतं तत् त्रिदशेश्वरैः।।4.40.53।। ततः परं हेममय श्श्रीमानुदयपर्वतः। तस्य कोटिर्दिवं स्पृष्ट्वा शतयोजनमायता।।4.40.54।। जातरूपमयी दिव्या विराजति सवेदिका।
output: 'The flag of Ananta is fixed by the gods in the eastern direction. Beyond that stands the famous golden mountain behind which the sun rises. Its golden peak with a divine altar spread over a hundred yojanas touches heaven.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सालैस्तालैस्तमालैश्च कर्णिकारैश्च पुष्पितैः।।4.40.55।। जातरूपमयैर्दिव्यै श्शोभते सूर्यसन्निभैः।
output: जातरूपमयैः golden form, दिव्यैः divine, सूर्यसन्निभैः resembling the Sun, पुष्पितैः flowering, सालैः with  salas, तालैः with palmyras, तमालैश्च with tamalas, कर्णिकारैश्च with karnikaras also, शोभते enchanting.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
तत्र योजनविस्तारमुच्छ्रितं दशयोजनम्।।4.40.56।। शृङ्गं सौमनसं नाम जातरूपमयं ध्रुवम्।
output: 'There is a huge golden peak called Saumanas of ten yojanas in height spread over a breadth of one yojana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
तत्रपूर्वं पदं कृत्वा पुरा विष्णुस्त्रिविक्रमे।।4.40.57।। द्वितीयं शिखरे मेरोश्चकार पुरुषोत्तमः।
output: 'When the supreme being, Visnu took his three strides as Lord Vamana, he placed his first foot on this peak and the second on the peak of mount Meru.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्तरेण परिक्रम्य जम्बूद्वीपं दिवाकरः।।4.40.58।। दृश्यो भवति भूयिष्ठं शिखरं तन्महोच्छ्रयम्।
output: 'The Sun circumabulates Jambu island  and when he arrives at this lofty cliff of the mountain, it takes the northern direction and becomes visible to the world.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
तत्र वैखानसा नाम वालखिल्या महर्षयः।।4.40.59।। प्रकाशमाना दृश्यन्ते सूर्यवर्णास्तपस्विनः।
output: 'Over there the great ascetics Vaikhanasas and Valakhilyas appear  like the radiating Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयं सुदर्शनो द्वीपः पुरो यस्य प्रकाशते।।4.40.60।। यस्मिं स्तेजश्च चक्षुश्च सर्वप्राणभृतामपि।
output: 'The region in front of this mountain is called Sudarsana Island. This island is where the Sun who gives all beings the ability to see rises.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शैलस्य तस्य शृङ्गेषु कन्दरेषु वनेषु च।।4.40.61।। रावणस्सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः।
output: तस्य शैलस्य of that mountain, शृङ्गेषु on the peak, कन्दरेषु in the caves, वनेषु च in the forests, ततस्ततः here and there, रावणः Ravana, वैदेह्यासह with Vaidehi, मार्गितव्यः may be looked for.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
काञ्चनस्य च शैलस्य सूर्यस्य च महात्मनः।।4.40.62।। आविष्टा तेजसा सन्ध्या पूर्वा रक्ता प्रकाशते।
output: 'The early morning twilight appears bright red because of the glow of the golden mountain as well as of the great Sungod.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
पूर्वमेतत्कृतं द्वारं पृथिव्या भुवनस्य च।।4.40.63।। सूर्यस्योदयनं चैव पर्वा ह्येषा दिगुच्यते।
output: 'Here is the entrance for the earth as well as for all the worlds and since the Sun also rises from this place it is called the eastern direction.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य शैलस्य पृष्ठेषु निर्झरेषु गुहासु च।।4.40.64।। रावण स्सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः।
output: 'You may look for Ravana and also for Vaidehi even behind the mountain on the plains and also near the mountain streams and caves all over.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः परमगम्या स्याद्दिक्पूर्वा त्रिदशावृता।।4.40.65।। रहिता चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यामदृश्या तिमिरावृता।
output: ततः परम् beyond that, त्रिदशावृता guarded by gods, चन्द्रसूर्याभ्याम् by Moon and Sun, रहिता not present, तिमिर darkness, आवृता pervaded by, पूर्वादिक् eastern direction, अगम्या स्यात् not possible to reach, अदृश्या invisible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
शैलेषु तेषु सर्वेषु कन्दरेषु वनेषु च।।4.40.66।। ये च नोक्ता मया देशा विचेया तेषु जानकी।
output: 'You should look for Janaki everywhere -- on the mountains, in the lakes and  in the places not indicated by me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
एतावद्वानरैश्शक्यं गन्तुं वानरपुङ्गवाः।।4.40.67।। अभास्करममर्यादं न जानीमस्ततः परम्।
output: 'O chieftains monkeys can go that far. We know not what lies beyond those boundaries where no Sun shines.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 40:
अधिगम्य तु वैदेहीं निलयं रावणस्य च।।4.40.68।। मासे पूर्णे निवर्तध्वमुदयं प्राप्य पर्वतम्।
output: 'Reaching the mountain behind which the sun rises, look for Vaidehi and the home of Ravana and return by the month's end.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न वस्तव्यं वसन्वध्यो भवेन्मम।।4.40.69।। सिद्धार्थास्सन्निवर्तध्वमधिगम्य तु मैथिलीम्।
output: 'If you do not report within one month, you will be killed. May you see Maithili and come back after reaching the goal.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महेन्द्रकान्तां वनषण्डमण्डितां दिशं चरित्वा निपुणेन वानराः। अवाप्य सीतां रघुवंशजप्रियां ततो निवृत्तास्सुखिनो भविष्यथ।।4.40.70।।
output: 'O monkeys go about the beloved quarter (east) of Indra bestowed with differnt kinds of forests and groves. Look out carefully for Rama's beloved Sita, spot her and return, you will live happily. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकांडे चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortieth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवस्तन्महद्वानरं बलम्। दक्षिणां प्रेषयामास वानरानभिलक्षितान्।।4.41.1।।
output: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, महत् great, तत् that, वानरं बलम् monkey army, प्रस्थाप्य after despatching, ततः then, अभिलक्षितान् those recognised for excellence, वानरान् monkeys, दक्षिणाम् southern direction, प्रेषयामास sent forth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नील मग्निसुतं चैव हनुमन्तं च वानरम्। पितामहसुतं चैव जाम्बवन्तं महाबलम्।।4.41.2।। सुहोत्रं च शरारिं च शरगुल्मं तथैव च। गजं गवाक्षं गवयं सुषेणमृषभं तथा।।4.41.3।। मैन्दं च द्विविदं चैव विजयं गन्धमादनम्। उल्कामुखमसङ्गं च हुताशनसुतावुभौ।।4.41.4।। अङ्गदप्रमुखान्वीरान्वीर: कपिगणेश्वरः। वेगविक्रमसम्पन्नान्सन्दिदेश विशेषवित्।।4.41.5।।
output: वीरः hero, विशेषवित् extraordinary, कपिगणेश्वरः leader of the monkey army, अग्निसुतम् son of the firegod, नीलम् Nila, वानरम् monkey, हनुमन्तं च  and Hanumantha, पितामहसुतम् son of Brahma, महाबलम् of formidable strength, जाम्बवन्तं Jambavanta चैव also, सुहोत्रं च Suhotra and also, शरारिं च Sarari and, तथैव च so also, शरगुल्मम् Saragulma, गजम् Gaja, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, गवयम् Gavaya, सुषेणम् Sushena, तथा so also, वृषभम् Vrisabha, मैन्दं च Mainda and, द्विविदं चैव Dvivida also, विजयम् Vijaya, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadana, उल्कामुखम् Ulkamukha, असङ्गं च Asanga, हुताशनसुत son of firegod, उभौ both, अङ्गदप्रमुखान् Angada, वेगविक्रमसम्पन्नान् those endowed with speed and valour, वीरान् heroes, सन्दिदेश delivered the message.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
नील मग्निसुतं चैव हनुमन्तं च वानरम्। पितामहसुतं चैव जाम्बवन्तं महाबलम्।।4.41.2।। सुहोत्रं च शरारिं च शरगुल्मं तथैव च। गजं गवाक्षं गवयं सुषेणमृषभं तथा।।4.41.3।। मैन्दं च द्विविदं चैव विजयं गन्धमादनम्। उल्कामुखमसङ्गं च हुताशनसुतावुभौ।।4.41.4।। अङ्गदप्रमुखान्वीरान्वीर: कपिगणेश्वरः। वेगविक्रमसम्पन्नान्सन्दिदेश विशेषवित्।।4.41.5।।
output: The extraordinary Sugriva commanded Nila, son of the firegod, Hanuman, the formidable, Jambavan, son of Brahma, Suhotra, Sarari, Saragulma, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sushena, Vrishabam, Mainda, Dvivida, Vijaya, Gandhamadana, the two sons of Firegod, Ulkamuka and Asanga including Angada, leader of the group, to proceed. All of them were endowed with speed and valour.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नील मग्निसुतं चैव हनुमन्तं च वानरम्। पितामहसुतं चैव जाम्बवन्तं महाबलम्।।4.41.2।। सुहोत्रं च शरारिं च शरगुल्मं तथैव च। गजं गवाक्षं गवयं सुषेणमृषभं तथा।।4.41.3।। मैन्दं च द्विविदं चैव विजयं गन्धमादनम्। उल्कामुखमसङ्गं च हुताशनसुतावुभौ।।4.41.4।। अङ्गदप्रमुखान्वीरान्वीर: कपिगणेश्वरः। वेगविक्रमसम्पन्नान्सन्दिदेश विशेषवित्।।4.41.5।।

All of them were endowed with speed and valour.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषामग्रेसरं चैव महाबलमथाङ्गदम्। विधाय हरिवीराणामादिशद्दक्षिणां दिशम्।।4.41.6।।
output: Then Sugriva ordered mighty Angada to lead the group of the heroic monkeys in the southern direction.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ये केचन समुद्देशास्तस्यां दिशि सुदुर्गमाः। कपीशः कपिमुख्यानां स तेषां तानुदाहरत्।।4.41.7।।
output: तस्यां दिशि in that quarter, दुर्गमाः inaccessible, ये केचन those, समुद्देशाः spots, सः कपीशः the monkey king, कपिमुख्यानाम् to the chieftains of monkeys, तानुदाहरत् he gave an account.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सहस्रशिरसं विन्ध्यं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम्। नर्मदां च नदीं रम्यां महोरगनिषेविताम्।।4.41.8।। ततो गोदावरीं रम्यां कृष्णवेणीं महानदीम्। वरदां च महाभागां महोरगनिषेविताम्।।4.41.9।। मेखलामुत्कलां चैव दशार्णनगराण्यपि। आश्ववन्तीमवन्तीं च सर्वामेवानुपश्यत।।4.41.10।।
output: 'Search for Sita all over Vindhya of a thousand peaks filled with several trees and creepers, and along the river Narmada. Then proceed to Godavari, lovely Krishnaveni, Mahanadi, Varada and Mahabhaga inhabited by terrific serpents.You may search Mekhala, Utkala and Dasarna cities, Asvavanti and Avanti countries also.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
सहस्रशिरसं विन्ध्यं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम्। नर्मदां च नदीं रम्यां महोरगनिषेविताम्।।4.41.8।। ततो गोदावरीं रम्यां कृष्णवेणीं महानदीम्। वरदां च महाभागां महोरगनिषेविताम्।।4.41.9।। मेखलामुत्कलां चैव दशार्णनगराण्यपि। आश्ववन्तीमवन्तीं च सर्वामेवानुपश्यत।।4.41.10।।
output: 'Search for Sita all over Vindhya of a thousand peaks filled with several trees and creepers, and along the river Narmada. Then proceed to Godavari, lovely Krishnaveni, Mahanadi, Varada and Mahabhaga inhabited by terrific serpents.You may search Mekhala, Utkala and Dasarna cities, Asvavanti and Avanti countries also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सहस्रशिरसं विन्ध्यं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम्। नर्मदां च नदीं रम्यां महोरगनिषेविताम्।।4.41.8।। ततो गोदावरीं रम्यां कृष्णवेणीं महानदीम्। वरदां च महाभागां महोरगनिषेविताम्।।4.41.9।। मेखलामुत्कलां चैव दशार्णनगराण्यपि। आश्ववन्तीमवन्तीं च सर्वामेवानुपश्यत।।4.41.10।।
output: 'Search for Sita all over Vindhya of a thousand peaks filled with several trees and creepers, and along the river Narmada. Then proceed to Godavari, lovely Krishnaveni, Mahanadi, Varada and Mahabhaga inhabited by terrific serpents.You may search Mekhala, Utkala and Dasarna cities, Asvavanti and Avanti countries also.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विदर्भानृषिकांश्चैव रम्यान्माहिषकानपि। तथा वङ्गान्कलिङ्गांश्च कौशिकांश्च समन्ततः।।4.41.11।। अन्वीक्ष्य दण्डकारण्यं सपर्वतनदीगुहाम्। नदीं गोदावरीं चैव सर्वमेवानुपश्यत।।4.41.12।। तथैवान्ध्रांश्च पुण्ड्रांश्च चोलान्पाण्ड्यांत्स केरलान्।
output: विदर्भान् in Vidarbha, ऋषिकांश्चैव and in Rishika, रम्यान् picturesque, माहिषकानपि country of  Mahishaka, तथा so also, वङ्गकलिङ्गांश्च Vanga and Kalinga, समन्ततः all over, कौशिकांश्च Kausika, सपर्वतनदीगुहाम् in the mountains, river banks and caves, दण्डकारण्यम् in Dandaka forest, अन्वीक्ष्य after searching for, गोदावरीं Godavari, नदीं river, चैव also, तथैव in the same way, आन्ध्रांश्च Andhra also, पुण्ड्रांश्च country Pundra even, चोलान् Chola, पाण्ड्यांत्स Pandya country, केरलान् Kerala, सर्वमेव all over, अनुपश्यत search.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विदर्भानृषिकांश्चैव रम्यान्माहिषकानपि। तथा वङ्गान्कलिङ्गांश्च कौशिकांश्च समन्ततः।।4.41.11।। अन्वीक्ष्य दण्डकारण्यं सपर्वतनदीगुहाम्। नदीं गोदावरीं चैव सर्वमेवानुपश्यत।।4.41.12।। तथैवान्ध्रांश्च पुण्ड्रांश्च चोलान्पाण्ड्यांत्स केरलान्।
output: 'Look for Sita in the countries of Vidarbha and Rishika, in the picturesque country of Mashaka, Vanga and Kalinga and all over Kausika. Look for her in mountains caves and on river banks, in Dandaka forest, in Godavari, in Andhra also in Pundra, Chola and Pandya countries and all over Kerala.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
अयोमुखश्च गन्तव्यः पर्वतो धातुमण्डितः।।4.41.13।। विचित्रशिखर श्श्रीमांश्चित्रपुष्पितकाननः। सचन्दनवनोद्देशो मार्गितव्यो महागिरिः।।4.41.14।।
output: 'Look for Sita all over mount Ayomukha (known as Malaya), rich in ores. It has wonderful peaks. It looks colourful with the forest in bloom. This great mountain is full of sandalwood forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयोमुखश्च गन्तव्यः पर्वतो धातुमण्डितः।।4.41.13।। विचित्रशिखर श्श्रीमांश्चित्रपुष्पितकाननः। सचन्दनवनोद्देशो मार्गितव्यो महागिरिः।।4.41.14।।
output: 'Look for Sita all over mount Ayomukha (known as Malaya), rich in ores. It has wonderful peaks. It looks colourful with the forest in bloom. This great mountain is full of sandalwood forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तामापगां दिव्यां प्रसन्नसलिलां शिवाम्। तत्र द्रक्ष्यथ कावेरीं विहितामप्सरोगणैः।।4.41.15।।
output: 'Then you will see the sacred river Cauvery with pure and auspicious water, where celestial nymphs sport.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यासीनं नगस्याग्रे मलयस्य महौजसम्। द्रक्ष्यथाऽदित्यसङ्काशमगस्त्यमृषिसत्तमम्।।4.41.16।।
output: महौजसम् a person shining brightly, तस्य its, नगस्य mountain's, अग्रे on the top, आसीनम्  seated, आदित्यसङ्काशम् like the Sun, ऋषिसत्तमम् a celebtated sage, अगस्त्यम् Agastya, द्रक्ष्यथ you find.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञाताः प्रसन्नेन महात्मना। ताम्रपर्णीं ग्राहजुष्टां तरिष्यथ महानदीम्।।4.41.17।।
output: 'You will then come cross the great river Tamraparni infested with alligators. Cross it with the permission of the sage pleased (with you).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा चन्दनवनैर्दिव्यै प्रच्छन्ना द्वीपशालिनी। कान्तेव युवति: कान्तां समुद्रमवगाहते।।4.41.18।।
output: दिव्यै: lovely, चन्दनवनैः with sandalwood forests, प्रच्छन्ना covered, द्वीपशालिनी with wonderful islands, सा that, युवति: young lady, कान्तां beloved, इव like, समुद्रम् ocean, अवगाहते reaches.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो हेममयं दिव्यं मुक्तामणिविभूषितम्। युक्तं कवाटं पाण्ड्यानां गता द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः।।4.41.19।।
output: 'O monkeys leaving that river, you will find encrusted with pearls the wonderful golden gate of the city of Pandyas (modern Madurai).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्समुद्रमासाद्य सम्प्रधार्यार्थनिश्चयम्। अगस्त्येनान्तरे तत्र सागरे विनिवेशितः।।4.41.20।। चित्रनानानगः श्रीमान्महेन्द्र: पर्वतोत्तमः। जातरूपमयः श्रीमानवगाढो महार्णवम्।।4.41.21।।
output: 'Then on reaching the sea shore, decide the course of action. Sage Agastya has set up (between the moat of the city and and the sea) a glorious golden mountain Mahendra. Filled with colourful trees, it stretches into the sea.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
ततस्समुद्रमासाद्य सम्प्रधार्यार्थनिश्चयम्। अगस्त्येनान्तरे तत्र सागरे विनिवेशितः।।4.41.20।। चित्रनानानगः श्रीमान्महेन्द्र: पर्वतोत्तमः। जातरूपमयः श्रीमानवगाढो महार्णवम्।।4.41.21।।
output: 'Then on reaching the sea shore, decide the course of action. Sage Agastya has set up (between the moat of the city and and the sea) a glorious golden mountain Mahendra. Filled with colourful trees, it stretches into the sea.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नानाविधैर्नगै स्सर्वैलताभिश्चोपशोभितम्। देवर्षियक्षप्रवरैरप्सरोभिश्च सेवितम्।।4.41.22।। सिद्धचारणसङ्घैश्च प्रकीर्णं समनोरमम्। तमुपैति सहस्राक्षः सदा पर्वसु पर्वसु।।4.41.23।।
output: 'That mountain with several kinds of colourful trees and vines is frequented by gods, sages and prominent yakshas like siddhas and charanas. It is exceedingly delightful and even the thousandeyed Indra keeps visiting this place on full and new Moon days.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
नानाविधैर्नगै स्सर्वैलताभिश्चोपशोभितम्। देवर्षियक्षप्रवरैरप्सरोभिश्च सेवितम्।।4.41.22।। सिद्धचारणसङ्घैश्च प्रकीर्णं समनोरमम्। तमुपैति सहस्राक्षः सदा पर्वसु पर्वसु।।4.41.23।।
output: 'That mountain with several kinds of colourful trees and vines is frequented by gods, sages and prominent yakshas like siddhas and charanas. It is exceedingly delightful and even the thousandeyed Indra keeps visiting this place on full and new Moon days.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
द्वीपस्तस्यापरे पारे शतयोजनमायतः। अगम्यो मानुषैर्दीप्तस्तं मार्गध्वं समन्ततः।।4.41.24।।
output: 'Beyond this, on the other side of the sea stretching over an area of a hundred yojanas is an island difficult to reach for humans. Which you may explore.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र सर्वात्मना सीता मार्गितव्या विशेषतः। स हि देशस्तु वध्यस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः।।4.41.25।। राक्षसाधिपतेर्वासस्सहस्राक्षसमद्युतेः।
output: तत्र सीता there Sita, विशेषतः specially there, सर्वात्मना by all, मार्गितव्या search for, सः that, देशः region, वध्यस्य who deserves to be killed, दुरात्मनः of the evilminded, राक्षसाधिपतेः of the lord of demons, सहस्राक्षसमद्युतेः equal to thousandeyed Indra in radiance, रावणस्य Ravana's, वासः abode.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य मध्ये तस्य तु राक्षसी।।4.41.26।। अङ्गारकेति विख्याता छायामाकृष्य भोजिनी।
output: 'In the midst of the southern sea is a famous ogress, Angaraka (also Simhika) by name who swallows humans by capturing them even by their shadows.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं निस्संशयान्कृत्वा संशयान्नष्टसंशयाः।।4.41.27।। मृगयध्वं नरेन्द्रस्य पत्नीममिततेजसः।
output: 'In this way make sure wherever you have a doubt (of Sita's presence) and proceed to look for the consort of Rama, king of limitless lustre.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
तमतिक्रम्य लक्ष्मीवान्समुद्रे शतयोजने।।4.41.28।। गिरिः पुष्पितको नाम सिद्धचारणसेवितः।
output: तम् that island, अतिक्रम्य after crossing, शतयोजने a hundred yojanas, समुद्रे in the sea, लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous island, सिद्धचरणसेवितः inhabited by siddhas and charanas, पुष्पितकोनाम named Pushpithaka, गिरिः mountain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चन्द्रसूर्यांशुसङ्काशस्सागराम्बुसमावृतः।।4.41.29।। भ्राजते विपुलैश्शृङ्गैरम्बरं विलिखन्निव।
output: चन्द्रसूर्यांशुसङ्काशः bright like the radiance of Sun and Moon, सागराम्बुसमाश्रयः surrounded by seawater, अम्बरम् sky, विपुलैः with extended, शृङ्गैः with the peaks, विलिखन्निव as if scratching, भ्राजते shines.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यैकं काञ्चनं शृङ्गं सेवतेऽयं दिवाकरः।।4.41.30।। श्वेतं राजतमेकं च सेवतेऽयं निशाकरः। न तं कृतघ्नाः पश्यन्ति न नृशंसा न नास्तिकाः।।4.41.31।।
output: तस्य its, एकम् one, शृङ्गम् peak, काञ्चनम् is golden, यम् which, दिवाकरः Sun, सेवते resorts to, एकम् one, श्वेतम् white one, राजतम् silver, अयं this, निशाकरः Moon, सेवते resorts, तम् him, कृतघ्नाः ungrateful, न पश्यन्ति cannot see, नृशंसाः the mean, न not, नास्तिकाः unbelievers, न not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यैकं काञ्चनं शृङ्गं सेवतेऽयं दिवाकरः।।4.41.30।। श्वेतं राजतमेकं च सेवतेऽयं निशाकरः। न तं कृतघ्नाः पश्यन्ति न नृशंसा न नास्तिकाः।।4.41.31।।
output: तस्य its, एकम् one, शृङ्गम् peak, काञ्चनम् is golden, यम् which, दिवाकरः Sun, सेवते resorts to, एकम् one, श्वेतम् white one, राजतम् silver, अयं this, निशाकरः Moon, सेवते resorts, तम् him, कृतघ्नाः ungrateful, न पश्यन्ति cannot see, नृशंसाः the mean, न not, नास्तिकाः unbelievers, न not.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रणम्य शिरसा शैलं तं विमार्गत वानराः। तमतिक्रम्य दुर्धर्ष स्सूर्यवान्नाम पर्वतः।।4.41.32।। अध्वना दुर्विगाहेन योजनानि चतुर्दश।
output: 'O monkeys bowing down to that mountain, proceed in search of Sita. O unassailable vanaras, beyond this mountain is another called Suryavan. It is at a distance of fourteen yojanas and it is difficult to cover that distance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
ततस्तमप्यतिक्रम्य वैद्युतो नाम पर्वतः।।4.41.33। सर्वकामफलैर्वृक्षै स्सर्वकालमनोहरैः।
output: 'Beyond that mountain lies Vaidyuta, a hill with trees yielding lovely fruits in all seasons which can satisfy all desires.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्र भुक्त्वा वरार्हाणि मूलानि च फलानि च।।4.41.34।। मधूनि पीत्वा मुख्यानि परं गच्छत वानराः।
output: 'O monkeys eat your cherlshed roots and fruits and drink the best of honey there and proceed further.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र नेत्रमनःकान्तः कुञ्जरो नाम पर्वतः।।4.41.35।। अगस्त्यभवनं यत्र निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा।
output: तत्र there, नेत्र मनःकान्तः pleasing to the eye and heart, कुञ्जरो नाम called Kunjara, पर्वतः mountain,यत्र there,विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma,अगस्त्यभवनम् home of Agastya, निर्मितम् is built.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र योजनविस्तारमुच्छ्रितं दशयोजनम्।।4.41.36।। शरणं काञ्चनं दिव्यं नानारत्नविभूषितम्।
output: तत्र there, योजनविस्तारम् a yojana in breadth, दशयोजनम् ten yojanas, उच्छ्रितम् tall, दिव्यम् wonderful, नानारत्नविभूषितम् adorned with many gems, काञ्चनम् gold, शरणम् dwelling.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्र भोगवती नाम सर्पाणामालयः पुरी।।4.41.37।। विशालकक्ष्या दुर्धर्षा सर्वतः परिरक्षिता। रक्षिता पन्नगैर्घोरैस्तीक्ष्णदष्ट्रैरैर्महाविषैः।।4.41.38।। सर्पराजो महाप्राज्ञो यस्यां वसति वासुकिः।
output: 'There on that mountain (Kunjara) stands a city called Bhogavati, which is the abode of serpents. It has wide corridors. Guarded on all sides, it is unassailable since it is protected by venomous serpents with sharp fangs. The wise serpent king Vasuki resides there. (Bhogavati is the replica of the city of the same name in Patala, the sixth subterranean region)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र भोगवती नाम सर्पाणामालयः पुरी।।4.41.37।। विशालकक्ष्या दुर्धर्षा सर्वतः परिरक्षिता। रक्षिता पन्नगैर्घोरैस्तीक्ष्णदष्ट्रैरैर्महाविषैः।।4.41.38।। सर्पराजो महाप्राज्ञो यस्यां वसति वासुकिः।
output: तत्र there, विशालकक्ष्या a place with broad corridors, दुर्धर्षा an unassailable place, सर्वतः everywhere, परिरक्षिता protected, घोरैः by dreadful ones, तीक्ष्णं दष्ट्रै with sharp fangs, महाविषैः with highly poisonous ones, पन्नगैः with serpent, रक्षिता protected, सर्पाणाम् of serpents, आलयः abode, भोगवती नाम named Bhogavati, पुरी city, यस्याम् in it, सर्पराजः serpent king, महाप्राज्ञो very wise, वासुकिः Vasuki, वसति resides.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निर्याय मार्गितव्या च सा च भोगवती पुरी।।4.41.39।। तत्र चानन्तरा देशा ये केचन सुसम्वृताः।
output: सा that, भोगवती पुरी city of Bhogavati, मार्गितव्या search, निर्याय after coming out, तत्र there, सुसम्वृताः well covered, ये केचन those as may be, अनन्तरा देशाः hidden locations

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं च देशमतिक्रम्य महानृषभसंस्थितः।।4.41.40।। सर्वरत्नमयः श्रीमान् ऋषभो नाम पर्वतः।
output: तं देशम्  that place, अतिक्रम्य after crossing, ऋषभसंस्थितः of the size of a bull, सर्वरत्नमयः filled with all gems, श्रीमान् rich, ऋषभोनाम named Rishaba, महान् huge, पर्वतःmountain

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गोशीर्षकं पद्मकं च हरिश्यामं च चन्दनम्।।4.41.41।। दिव्यमुत्पद्यते यत्र तच्चैवाग्निसमप्रभम्।
output: 'There grow sandal trees of amazing colours like that of gorochana, padmaka (like lotus), greenish black and red as fire.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न तु तच्चन्दनं दृष्टवा स्प्रष्टव्यं च कदाचन।।4.41.42।। रोहिता नाम गन्धर्वा घोरा रक्षन्ति तद्वनम्।
output: तत् then, चन्दनम् sandal, दृष्टवा seeing, कदाचन ever, न स्प्रष्टव्यं तु do not touch, घोरां dreadful, तत् वनम् that forest, रोहिता: नाम named Rohita, गन्धर्वाः gandharva, रक्षन्ति protect.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र गन्धर्वपतयः पञ्च सूर्यसमप्रभाः।।4.41.43।। शैलूषो ग्रामणी श्शिग्रु श्शुभ्रो बभ्रुस्तथैव च। रविसोमाग्निवपुषां निवासः पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।4.41.44।।
output: तत्र there, शैलूषः Sailusha, ग्रामणीः Gramani, शिग्रु Sigru, शुभ्र: Subhra, तथैव so also, बभ्रुः Babhru, सूर्यसमप्रभाः with the Sun's radiance, पञ्च five, गन्धर्वपतयः Gandharva kings, रविसोमाग्निवपुषाम् with radiance like the Sun, Moon and Fire, पुण्यकर्मणाम् of those who have done meritorious deeds, निवासः dwelling.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्र गन्धर्वपतयः पञ्च सूर्यसमप्रभाः।।4.41.43।। शैलूषो ग्रामणी श्शिग्रु श्शुभ्रो बभ्रुस्तथैव च। रविसोमाग्निवपुषां निवासः पुण्यकर्मणाम्।।4.41.44।।
output: 'Five ghandharva kings named Sailusha, Gramani, Sigru, Subhra and Babhru who have the radiance like the Sun reside there. It is the abode of those who have done meritorious deeds.They glow like Sun, Moon and Fire.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्ते पृथिव्या दुर्धर्षास्तत्र स्वर्गजितः स्थिताः। ततः परं न वस्सेव्यः पितृलोक स्सुदारुणः।।4.41.45।।
output: 'The divine people who have earned a place in heaven stay there at the end of their life on earth. Beyond, lies the dreadful world of deceased ancestors. It is not possible for you to enter that place.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
राजधानी यमस्यैषा कष्टेन तमसा वृता। एतावदेव युष्माभिर्वीरा वानरपुङ्गवाः।।4.41.46।। शक्यं विचेतुं गन्तुं वा नातो गतिमतां गतिः।
output: 'O heroic monkeys that is the capital of Yama (god of death) covered with pitch darkness. You can go till that place. Beyond, there is no access for the earthlings.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
सर्वमेतत्समालोक्य यच्चान्यदपि दृश्यते।।4.41.47।। गतिं विदित्वा वैदेह्या स्सन्निवर्तितुमर्हथ।
output: 'Ransack this and all other places you can see. You should search for the whereabouts of Vaidehi before you return.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
यस्तु मासान्निवृत्तोऽग्रे दृष्टा सीतेति वक्ष्यति।।4.41.48।। मत्तुल्यविभवो भोगै स्सुखं स विहरिष्यति।
output: 'He who returns  in a month to announce Sita has been found will spend his life in luxury with as much prosperity as I do have.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 41:
ततः प्रियतरो नास्ति मम प्राणाद्विशेषतः।।4.41.49।। कृतापराधो बहुशो मम बन्धुर्भविष्यति।
output: 'None will be dearer to me than he. Even if he has made a mistake, he will be to me dear and near.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अमितबलपराक्रमा भवन्तो विपुलगुणेषु कुलेषु च प्रसूताः। मनुजपतिसुतां यथा लभध्वं तदधिगुणं पुरुषार्थमारभध्वम्।।4.41.50।।
output: भवन्तः all of you, अमितबलपराक्रमाः immeasurably mighty and powerful, विपुलगुणेषु with many virtues, कुलेषु in families, प्रसूताः you are born, मनुजपतिसुताम् daughter of the king, यथा in whatever way, लभध्वम् you find, तदधिगुणम् possesing meritorious quality, पुरुषार्थम् righteous pursuit, आरभध्वम् you may begin.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ प्रस्थाप्य सुग्रीवस्तान्हरीन्दक्षिणां दिशम्। अब्रवीन्मेघसङ्काशं सुषेणं नाम यूथपम्।।4.42.1।।
output: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तान् them, हरीन् monkeys, दक्षिणां दिशम् in the southernquarter, प्रस्थाप्य having sent, अथ now, मेघसङ्काशम्  resembling a cloud, सुषेणं नाम known as Sushena, यूथपम् troop leader, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तारायाः पितरं राजा श्वशुरं भीमविक्रमम्। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमभिगम्य प्रणम्य च।।4.42.2।।
output: King (Sugriva) went with folded hands to Tara's father, his fatherinlaw, of terrifying valour, offered salutation and said:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मरीचिपुत्रं मारीचमर्चिष्मन्तं महाकपिम्। वृतं कपिवरै श्शूरैर्महेन्द्रसदृशद्युतिम्।।4.42.3।। बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नं वैनतेयसमद्युतिम्। मरीचिपुत्रान्मारीचानर्चिर्मालान्महाबलान्।।4.42.4।। ऋषिपुत्रांश्चतांत्सर्वान्प्रतीचीमादिशद्दिशम्।
output: मरीचिपुत्रम् son of Marichi, मारीचम् Maricha, महाकपिम् great monkey, शूरैः with brave ones, कपिवरैः with best monkeys, वृतम् surounded, महेन्द्रसदृशद्युतिम् glowing like Mahendra, बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नम् with wisdom and bravery, वैनतेयसमद्युतिम् equal to Garuda in lustre, अर्चिष्मन्तम् a person filled with lustre, मरीचिपुत्रान् sons of Maricha, अर्चिर्मालान् Archirmala's, महाबलान् valiant ones, ऋषिपुत्रांश्च sons of sages, सर्वान् all, मारीचान् Maricha's, प्रतीचीं दिशम् to western quarter, आदिशत् instructed.

instruction:

मरीचिपुत्रं मारीचमर्चिष्मन्तं महाकपिम्। वृतं कपिवरै श्शूरैर्महेन्द्रसदृशद्युतिम्।।4.42.3।। बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नं वैनतेयसमद्युतिम्। मरीचिपुत्रान्मारीचानर्चिर्मालान्महाबलान्।।4.42.4।। ऋषिपुत्रांश्चतांत्सर्वान्प्रतीचीमादिशद्दिशम्।
output: Sugriva  spoke to the great lustrous monkey Archisman, son of the eminent sage Marichi who possessed the wisdom and prowess of Indra and was comparable to Vaineteya (Garuda) in lustre. He also spoke to the other sons of Maricha, called Marichas, who were very strong and known as Archismalas (garlands of continuous glow) and asked all of them to proceed in the western direction.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्वाभ्यां शतसहस्राभ्यां कपीनां कपिसत्तमाः।।4.42.5।। सुषेणप्रमुखा यूयं वैदेहीं परिमार्गतः।
output: कपिसत्तमाः foremost of monkeys, यूयम् you, सुषेण प्रमुखाः having Sushena as leader, कपीनाम् among monkeys, द्वाभ्याम् with two, शतसहस्राभ्याम् hundred thousands, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, परिमार्गत: search.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुराष्ट्रान्सहबाह्लीकान् श्चन्द्रचित्रांस्तथैव च।।4.42.6।। स्फीताञ्जनपदान्रम्यान्विपुलानि पुराणि च। पुन्नागगहनं कुक्षिं वकुलोद्दालकाकुलम्।।4.42.7।। तथा केतकषण्डांश्च मार्गध्वं हरियूथपाः।
output: 'O leaders of monkeys search for Sita in the countries of Saurashtra, and also Bahlika, Chandrachitra, in delightful villages and vast towns, also in Kukshi covered haphazardly with punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees as well as ketaka shrubs.

instruction:

output: 'O leaders of monkeys search for Sita in the countries of Saurashtra, and also Bahlika, Chandrachitra, in delightful villages and vast towns, also in Kukshi covered haphazardly with punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees as well as ketaka shrubs.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रत्यक्स्रोतोगमाश्चैव नद्यश्शीतजलाश्शिवाः।।4.42.8।। तापसानामरण्यानि कान्तारा गिरयश्च ये। तत्रस्थलीं मरुप्रायामत्युच्चशिरसश्शिलाः।।4.42.9।। गिरिजालावृतां दुर्गां मार्गित्वा पश्चिमां दिशम्। ततः पश्चिममासाद्य समुद्रं द्रष्टुमर्हथ।।4.42.10।। तिमिनक्रायुतजलमक्षोभ्यमथ वानराः।
output: वानराः O monkeys, प्रत्यक्स्रोतोगमाः those flowing to the west, शीतजलाः cool waters, शिवाः sacred, नद्यश्चैव rivers too, तापसानां in hermits, अरण्यानि woods, ये those, कान्तारा: गिरयश्च forests and mountains, तत्र there, मरुप्रायाः dry, स्थलीं lands, अत्युच्चशिरसाः high peaks, शिलाःmountains, गिरिजालावृताम् surrounded by mountain ranges, दुर्गाम् inaccessible, दिशम् direction, मार्गित्वा after searching, पश्चिमां western side, ततः then, समुद्रम् the sea, पश्चिमम् the western, आसाद्य after reaching, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हथ it is proper for you, तिमिनक्रायुतजलम् water infested with whales and alligators, अक्षोभ्यम् which cannot be agitated, अथ then, वानराः monkeys.

instruction:

ततः केतकषण्डेषु तमालगहनेषु च।।4.42.11।। कपयो विहरिष्यन्ति नारिकेलवनेषु च।
output: ततः then, कपयः monkeys, केतकषण्डेषु in the ketaka shrubs, तमालगहनेषु च in the thickets of tamala trees, नारिकेलवनेषु च and in coconut groves, विहरिष्यन्ति roam.

instruction:

तत्र सीतां च मार्गध्वं निलयं रावणस्य च।।4.42.12।। वेलातलनिविष्टेषु पर्वतेषु वनेषु च। मुरचीपत्तनं चैव रम्यं चैव जटीपुरम्।।4.42.13।। अवन्तीमङ्गलोपां च तथा चालक्षितं वनम्। राष्ट्राणि च विशालानि पत्तनानि ततस्ततः।।4.42.14।।
output: 'Look for Sita as well as the residence of Ravana.You should find the whereabouts of Sita in the mountains and forests located on the sea shore. Search in the city of Murachi, beautiful city of Jata, Avanti, Angalopa and in the unnoticed forestland. Look for her in the vast kingdoms and cities all over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 42:
सिन्धुसागरयोश्चैव सङ्गमे तत्र पर्वतः। महान्हेमगिरिर्नाम शतशृङ्गो महाद्रुमः।।4.42.15।।
output: 'There is a lofty mountain with a hundred peaks and great trees at the confluence of river Sindhu and the sea. It is known as Hemagiri (golden mountain).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 42:
तस्य प्रस्थेषु रम्येषु सिंहाः पक्षगमाः स्थिताः। तिमिमत्स्यगजांश्चैव नीडान्यारोपयन्ति ते।।4.42.16।।
output: 'On the slopes of that mountain you will find lions called Pakshagamas, that is lions with wings. They carry  the whales, fishes and elephants from the sea to their shelters on the beautiful mountain slopes.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तानि नीडानि सिंहानां गिरिशृङ्गगताश्च ये। दृप्तास्तृप्ताश्च मातङ्गास्तोयदस्वननिस्वनाः।।4.42.17।। विचरन्ति विशालेऽस्मिंस्तोयपूर्णे समन्ततः।
output: 'The proud elephants wandering on the mountain slopes, and on the vast tract filled with water would be happy trumpeting like thundering clouds. They roam in the caves of lions.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य शृङ्गं दिवस्पर्शं काञ्चनं चित्रपादपम्।।4.42.18।। सर्वमाशु विचेतव्यं कपिभिः कामरूपिभिः।
output: तस्य दिवस्पर्शम् touching the sky, चित्रपादपम् colourful trees, काञ्चनम् golden, शृङ्गम् peak, सर्वम् all, कामरूपिभिः by those who can assume any form, कपिभिः by monkeys, आशु at once , विचेतव्यम् look for carefully

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 42:
कोटिं तत्र समुद्रे तु काञ्चनीं शतयोजनाम्।।4.42.19।। दुर्दर्शां  पारियात्रस्य गतां द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः।
output: 'O monkeys you will see the dazzling golden tip of a mountain called Pariyatra towards the end of the sea. It is extended over a hundred yojanas and  dificult to gaze because of its brilliance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 42:
कोट्यस्तत्र चतुर्विंशद्गन्धर्वाणां तपस्विनाम्।।4.42.20।। वसन्त्यग्निनिकाशानां घोराणां कामरूपिणाम्।
output: 'There dwell twentyfour crore of terrific gandharvas blazing like fire who can assume any form.They lead an ascetic life.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पावकार्चिः प्रतीकाशास्समवेतास्सहस्रशः।।4.42.21।। नात्यासादयितव्यास्ते वानरैर्भीमविक्रमैः।
output: सहस्रशः in thousands, समवेताः assembled together, प्रतीकाशाः appearing like, ते you, भीमविक्रमैः with very brave ones, वानरैः by monkeys, नात्यासादयितव्याः not to go very close to them, पावकार्चिःwith fire likeglow

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 42:
नादेयं च फलं तस्माद्देशात्किञ्चित् प्लवङ्गमैः।।4.42.22।। दुरासदा हि ते वीरा स्सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। फलमूलानि ते तत्र रक्षन्ते भीमविक्रमाः।।4.42.23।।
output: 'You should not pluck any fruits from those woods, for courageous gandharvas protect the fruits of the trees. It is difficult to go there, for those heroes have frightening bravery.

instruction:

output: तस्मात् देशात् from that country, प्लवङ्गमैः by monkeys, फलम् fruits, किञ्चित् a little, नादेयम् should not be taken, सत्त्ववन्तः courageous, महाबलाः strong, ते वीराः those heroes, दुरासदाः हि  difficult to go there, भीमविक्रमाः heroes of frightening bravery, ते they, तत्र there, फलमूलानि fruits and roots, रक्षन्ते keep protecting

instruction:

तत्र यत्नश्च कर्तव्यो मार्गितव्या च जानकी। न हि तेभ्यो भयं किञ्चित्कपित्वमनुवर्तताम्।।4.42.24।।
output: 'Exert yourself in your search for Janaki. Indeed there will be no fear from them, if you behave like normal monkeys in a natural way.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्र वैढूर्यवर्णाभो वज्रसंस्थानसंस्थितः। नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णो वज्रो नाम महागिरिः।।4.42.25।। श्रीमान्समुदितस्तत्र योजनानां शतं समम्। गुहास्तत्र विचेतव्या प्रयत्नेन प्लवङ्गमाः ।।4.42.26।।
output: '(Beyond) there  is a glorious mountain called Vajra of the colour of Vaidurya, hard as a diamond with different kinds of trees and vines.The  mountain extends evenly to a stretch of a hundred yojanas.There are caves in the mountain where you may look for her with due effort.

instruction:

चतुर्भागे समुद्रस्य चक्रवान्नाम पर्वतः। तत्र चक्रं सहस्रारं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा।।4.42.27।।
output: 'Then move to the fourth part (of the western sea) where you will see  a mountain called Chakravan occupying a quarter part of the sea.You will find there a thousandspiked wheel built by Visvakarma.

instruction:

तत्र पञ्चजनं हत्वा हयग्रीवं च दानवम्। आजहार ततश्चक्रं शङ्खं च पुरुषोत्तमः।।4.42.28।।
output: 'It was there that the Supreme Lord Visnu, having slain Hayagriva and Panchajanam,  recovered the discus and conch for himself.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य सानुषु चित्रेषु विशालासु गुहासु च। रावण स्सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्तत स्ततः।।4.42.29।।
output: 'Look for Vaidehi and Ravana in the wide caves and colourful slopes of the (Chakravan) mountain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
योजनानां चतुष्षष्टिर्वराहो नाम पर्वतः। सुवर्णशृङ्गस्सुश्रीमा नगाधे वरुणालये।।4.42.30।।
output: 'Plunge deep down into the sea and you will see a goldenpeaked mountain called Varaha, the residence of Varuna.It is extended over sixty four yojanas in the sea.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 42:
तत्र प्राग्ज्योतिषं नाम जातरूपमयं पुरम्। यस्मिन्वसति दुष्टात्मा नरको नाम दानवः।।4.42.31।।
output: 'On the (Varaha) mountain is the city called Pragjyotisha, which is full of gold.There lives the  evilminded demon Naraka.

instruction:

output: 'There all over the wonderful slopes and wide caves look for Vaidehi and Ravana.

output: 'On crossing the hill ruled by Indra you will reach the rows of sixty thousand mountains of gold shining like the brilliance of the rising Sun. The mountains glow with golden trees filled with bloom.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषां मध्ये स्थितो राजा मेरुरुत्तरपर्वतः। आदित्येन प्रसन्नेन शैलो दत्तवरः पुरा।।4.42.38।।
output: 'In the midst of the sixty thousand hills stands Meru, King of mountains. It is the northern mountain, blessed by the Sungod with a boon in the past.

instruction:

instruction:

विश्वे देवाश्च मरूतो वसवश्च दिवौकसः। आगम्य पश्चिमां सन्ध्यां मेरुमुत्तमपर्वतम्।।4.42.41।। आदित्यमुपतिष्ठन्ति तैश्च सूर्योऽभिपूजितः। अदृश्यस्सर्वभूतानामस्तं गच्छतिपर्वतम्।।4.42.42।।
output: The Visvadevas, Vasus, Maruts, and the gods reach Meru, this great king of mountains, in the evening twilight. Worshipped by them, the Sungod sets behind the mountain and becomes invisible to all beings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:

output: The Visvadevas, Vasus, Maruts, and the gods reach Meru, this great king of mountains, in the evening twilight. Worshipped by them, the Sungod sets behind the mountain and becomes invisible to all beings.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 42:
योजनानां सहस्राणि दश तानि दिवाकरः। मुहूर्तार्धेन तं शीघ्रमभियाति शिलोच्चयम्।।4.42.43।।
output: 'Crossing ten thousand yojanas swiftly in half a moment, the Sun touches the mount behind which he sets.

instruction:

output: तस्य its,शृङ्गे on the peak, प्रासादगणसम्बाधम् cluster of mansions, सूर्यसन्निभम् shining like Sun, महत्great, दिव्यम् wonderful, भवनम् building, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, विहितम् is built

instruction:

output: चित्रैः with colourful, नानापक्षिसमाकुलैः with flocks of different kinds of birds, तरुभिः with trees, शोभितम् enchanting, महात्मनः of great, पाशहस्तस्य one who holds the noose in hand, वरुणस्य Varuna's, निकेतम् residence

instruction:

output: मेरुम् Meru, अस्तं च from Asta, अन्तरा between, दशशिराः ten peaks, जातरूपमयः golden, श्रीमान् shining, चित्रवेदिकः with wonderful altars, महान् great, तालः palm tree, भ्राजते shines

instruction:

तेषु सर्वेषु दुर्गेषु सरस्सु च सरित्सु च। रावणस्सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्तत स्ततः।।4.42.47।।
output: 'Look for Vaidehi and Ravana all over those inaccessible mountains, lakes and rivers.

instruction:
