रामलक्ष्मणबाणाश्च निशिताः कङ्कपत्रिणः।।4.59.26।। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां पर्याप्तास्त्राणनिग्रहे।
output: 'The heronfeathered arrows of Rama and Lakshmana are sharp and strong enough to protect or subdue all the three worlds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 59:
कामं खलु दशग्रीव स्तेजोबलसमन्वितः।।4.59.27।। भवतां तु समर्थानां न किञ्चिदपि दुष्करम्।
output: 'The tenheaded Ravana is mighty, powerful and strong, indeed. But you are efficient and it will not be difficult for you to achieve this task.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदलं कालसङ्गेन क्रियतां बुद्धिनिश्चयः।।4.59.28।। न हि कर्मसु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः।
output: 'Do not bother about the time limit. Resolve to achieve the objective, for wise people  like you should not lag behind in accepting challenges.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 60:
ततः कृतोदकं स्नातं तं गृध्रं हरियूथपाः। उपविष्टा गिरौ रम्ये परिवार्य समन्ततः।।4.60.1।।
output: Sampati bathed and offered libations to Jatayu. Then all the monkeys sat round him on the beautiful mountain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमङ्गदमुपासीनं तैस्सर्वैर्हरिभिर्वृतम्। जनितप्रत्ययो हर्षात्सम्पातिः पुनरब्रवीत्।।4.60.2।।
output: Angada sat near Sampati surrounded by all monkeys. Sampati who had gained confidence spoke to Angada  once again joyously.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृत्वा निश्शब्दमेकाग्रा श्श्रुण्वन्तु हरयो मम। तत्वं सङ्कीर्तयिष्यामि यथा जानामि मैथिलीम्।।4.60.3।।
output: 'O monkeys I shall tell you in detail how I came to know the princess from Mithila. Listen quietly with rapt attention:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 60:
अस्य विन्ध्यस्य शिखरे पतितोऽस्मि पुरावने। सूर्यतपपरीताङ्गो निर्दग्धस्सूर्यरश्मिभिः।।4.60.4।।
output: Scorched by the rays of the Sun, I was burnt totally and fell on the peak of this mount Vindhya years ago.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लब्धसंज्ञस्तु षड्रात्राद्विवशो विह्वलन्निव। वीक्षमाणो दिशस्सर्वा नाभिजानामि किञ्चन।।4.60.5।।
output: षड्रात्रात् after six nights, लब्धसंज्ञः with consciousness restored, विवश  pale, विह्वलन्निव perturbed, सर्वाः all, दिशः quarters, वीक्षमाणः while looking at, किञ्चन even a little, नाभिजानामि I could not recognise anything.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तु सागरान् शैलान्नदीस्सर्वास्सरांसि च। वनानि च प्रदेशांश्च नीरीक्ष्य मतिरागता।।4.60.6।।
output: ततः then, सागरान् the seas, शैलान् mountain, सर्वाः नदीः all rivers, सरांसि च and lakes, वनानि च and forests, प्रदेशांश्च and all locations, नीरीक्ष्य after observing, मतिः mind, आगता realised.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हृष्टपक्षिगणाकीर्णः कन्दरान्तरकूटवान्। दक्षिणस्योदधेस्तीरे विन्ध्योऽयमिति निश्चितः।।4.60.7।।
output: हृष्टपक्षिगणाकीर्णः inhabited by flocks of  happy birds, कन्दरान्तरकूटवान् filled with caves and mountains, अयम् this, दक्षिणस्य southern side, उदधेः ocean's, तीरे on the shore, विन्ध्य Vindhya, इति this is, निश्चितः for sure.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आसीच्चात्राश्रमं पुण्यं सुरैरपि सुपूजितम्। ऋषिर्निशाकरो नाम यस्मिन्नुग्रतपाभवत्।।4.60.8।।
output: अत्र there, सुरैरपि even by Gods, सुपूजितम् worshipped with reverence, आश्रमम् hermitage, आसीत् was situated, यस्मिन् in it, निशाकरो नाम called Nisakara, उग्रतपाः performed rigorous penance, ऋषिः sage, अभवत् lived.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अष्टौ वर्षसहस्राणि तेनास्मिन्नृषिणा विना। वसतो मम धर्मज्ञा स्वर्गते तु निशाकरे।।4.60.9।।
output: 'O righteous monkeys after the death of sage Nishakara eight thousand years have passed. And I have been living here.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवतीर्य तु विन्ध्याग्रात्कृच्छ्रेण विषमाच्छनैः। तीक्ष्णदर्भां वसुमतीं दुःखेन पुनरागतः।।4.60.10।।
output: विषमात् from the craggy rugged place, विन्ध्याग्रात् from the peak of Vindhya mountain, शनैः slowly, कृच्छ्रेण with great difficulty, अवतीर्य having descended, तीक्ष्णदर्भाम् a place with sharp rough darbha grass, वसुमतीम् to the land, दुःखेन with difficulty, पुनः again, आगतः came.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 60:
तमृषिं द्रष्टुकामोऽस्मि दुःखेनाभ्यागतो भृशम्। जटायुषा मया चैव बहुशोऽभिगतो हि सः।।4.60.11।।
output: 'Eager to see the great sage I reached the place with much difficulty. I and my brother Jatayu had  approached him many a time earlier.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 60:
तस्याश्रमपदाभ्याशे ववुर्वातास्सुगन्धिनः। वृक्षो वापुष्पितः कश्चिदफलो वा न विद्यते।।4.60.12।।
output: 'In the vicinity of that hermitage there was no tree without flowers or fruits and fragrant was the breeze that blew around.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उपेत्य चाश्रमं पुण्यं वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रितः। द्रष्टुकामः प्रतीक्षेऽहं भगवन्तं निशाकरम्।।4.60.13।।
output: 'On reaching the sacred hermitage, I stood and waited under a tree for the audience of the divine sage Nishakara.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथापश्यमदूरस्थमृषिं ज्वलिततेजसम्। कृताभिषेकं दुर्धर्षमुपावृत्तमुदङ्मुखम्।।4.60.14।।
output: अथ then, कृताभिषेकम् after having ritual bath, उपावृत्तम् returned towards, दुर्धर्षम् unassailable, उदङ्मुखम् facing towards north, ज्वलिततेजसम् shining with brilliance (of ascetic power), अदूरस्थम् near by, ऋषिम् sage, अपश्यम् I saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमृक्षास्सृमरा व्याघ्रास्सिंहा नागास्सरीसृपाः। परिवार्योपगच्छन्ति धातारं प्राणिनो यथा।।4.60.15।।
output: 'He was followed by bears, deer, tigers, lions, elephants and snakes just as living beings follow their creator.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः प्राप्तमृषिं ज्ञात्वा तानि सत्त्वानि वै ययुः। प्रविष्टे राजनि यथा सर्वं सामात्यकं बलम्।।4.60.16।।
output: राजनि when the king, प्रविष्टे enters, सर्वम् all, सामात्यकम् including the feudatories, बलम्  army, यथा like, ऋषिम् that sage, प्राप्तम् when he came, ज्ञात्वा knowing, ततः then, तानि all those, सत्त्वानि creatures, ययुः went.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋषिस्तु दृष्ट्वा मां प्रीतः प्रविष्टश्चाश्रमं पुनः। मुहूर्तमात्रान्निष्क्रम्य ततः कार्यमपृच्छत।।4.60.17।।
output: ऋषिस्तु sage also, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, प्रीतः pleased, आश्रमम् to the hermitage, प्रविष्टः entered, ततः then, मुहूर्तमात्रात् for a moment, पुनः again, निष्क्रम्य after coming out, कार्यम् the task, अपृच्छत enquired.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सौम्य वैकल्यतां दृष्ट्वा रोम्णां ते नावगम्यते। अग्निदग्धाविमौ पक्षौ व्रणाश्चापि शरीरके।।4.60.18।।
output: 'O gentle one seeing your body devoid of hair I can understood that your wings have been burnt and your body bruised.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गृध्रौ द्वौ दृष्टपूर्वौ मे मातरिश्वसमौ जवे। गृध्राणां चैव राजानौ भ्रातरौ कामरूपिणौ।।4.60.19।।
output: 'You are the king among vultures equal to wind in speed.I had seen both the brothers earlier and both of you could change your form at will.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 60:
ज्येष्ठो हि त्वं तु सम्पाते जटायुरनुजस्तव। मानुषं रूपमास्थाय गृह्णीतां चरणौ मम।।4.60.20।।
output: सम्पाते O Sampati, त्वम् you, ज्येष्ठो हि  the elder, जटायु Jatayu, तव your, अनुजः younger brother, मानुषम् human, रूपम् form, आस्थाय assuming, मम my, चरणौ feet, गृह्णीताम् touch my feet.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किं ते व्याधिसमुत्थानं पक्षयोः पतनं कथम्। दण्डोऽयंच कृतः केन सर्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः।।4.60.21।।
output: ते to you, व्याधिसमुत्थानं किम् what disease affected you, पक्षयोः to both your wings, पतनम् dropping down, कथम् how come, केन by whom, अयम् this, दण्डः punishment, कृतः is given, पृच्छतः for the enquiry, सर्वम् all about, आख्याहि you may tell me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तद्दारुणं कर्म दुष्करं सहसात्कृतम्। आचचक्षे मुनेस्सर्वं सूर्यानुगमनं तथा।।4.61.1।।
output: ततः then, सहसा rashly, कृतम् done, दुष्करम् impetuous, दारुणम् arrogant, तत् कर्म that deed, तदा then, सूर्यानुगमनम् following the Sun, सर्वम् everything, मुनेः to the sage, आचचक्षे I revealed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 61:
भगवन्व्रणयुक्तत्वाल्लज्जया व्याकुलेन्द्रियः। परिश्रान्तो न शक्नोमि वचनं परिभाषितुम्।।4.61.2।।
output: 'O revered sage I am exhausted and my senses are depressed. I am ashamed of myself. My body is wounded. Therefore I am not able to reply.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 61:
अहं चैव जटायुश्च सङ्घर्षाद्धर्पमोहितौ। आकाशं पतितौ वीरौ जिज्ञासन्तौ पराक्रमम्।।4.61.3।।
output: 'Deluded by pride, I and my brother Jatayu challenging each other to test our relative strength flew  far into the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 61:
कैलासशिखरे बद्ध्वा मुनीनामग्रतः पणम्। रविस्स्यादनुयातव्यो यावदस्तं महागिरिम्।।4.61.4।।
output: 'Both of us made a bet on the peak of mount Kailasa in the presence of sages to follow the Sungod until he sets on the western mountain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथाऽवां युगपत्प्राप्तावपश्याव महीतले। रथचक्रप्रमाणानि नगराणि पृथक्पृथक्।।4.61.5।।
output: 'And from there both of us looked at all the cities on the land which seemed like the size of chariot wheels one after the other.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 61:
क्वचिद्वादित्रघोषांश्च ब्रह्मघोषांश्च शुश्रुवः। गायन्तीश्चाङ्गना बह्वीः पश्यावो रक्तवाससः।।4.61.6।।
output: 'We heard at some places sounds of musical instruments, sounds of Vedic chanting, and many lovely young women dressed in redsinging.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तूर्णमुत्पत्य चाकाशमादित्यपथमाश्रितौ। आवामालोकयावस्तद्वनं शाद्वलसन्निभम्।।4.61.7।।
output: 'We flew quickly into the sky and reached the path of the Sun and looked down at the forest which looked like a green lawn.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपलैरिव सञ्छन्ना दृश्यते भूश्शिलोच्चयैः। आपगाभिश्च संवीता सूत्रैरिव वसुन्धरा।।4.61.8।।
output: भूः land, शिलोच्चयैः with tall mountains, उपलैः with pebbles, सञ्छन्ना इव as though it is covered, दृश्यते looked, आपगाभिः by rivers, वसुन्धरा land, सूत्रैः with threads, संवीता इव as if entwined.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 61:
हिमवांश्चैव विन्ध्यश्च मेरुश्च सुमहान्नगः। भूतले सम्प्रकाशन्ते नागा इव जलाशये।।4.61.9।।
output: 'The mountains of the earth, Himavan and Vindhya and the great Meru looked like huge elephants in a huge pond.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तीव्रस्स्वेदश्च खेदश्च भयं चासीत्तदाऽऽवयोः। समाविशति मोहश्च तमो मूर्छा च दारुणा।।4.61.10।।
output: 'Much sweat, pain and fear generated in us while we went on and up. This led to terrific confusion and stupor.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न दिग्विज्ञायते याम्या नाग्नेयी न च वारुणी। युगान्ते नियतो लोको हतो दग्ध इवाग्निना।।4.61.11।।
output: 'I did not know which the southern direction was or the southeast or the west. It looked as if the world had been consumed by fire and dissolved, as if it was the end of the yuga.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मनश्च मे हतं भूयस्सन्निवर्त्यतु संश्रयम्। यत्नेन महता ह्यस्मिन्पुनस्सन्धाय चक्षुषी।।4.61.12।। यत्नेन महता भूयो भास्करः प्रतिलोकितः। तुल्यः पृथ्वीप्रमाणेन भास्करः प्रतिभाति नौ।।4.61.13।।
output: मे my, मनः mind, हतम् disturbed, चक्षुषी eyes, संश्रयम् a resort, प्राप्य became, महता with great, यत्नेन with effort, अस्मिन् in this, मनः mind, चक्षुषी both my eyes, सन्धाय by fixing, भूयः again, महता यत्नेन with great effort, भास्करः Sun, प्रतिलोकितः was seen, भास्करः Sun, पृथ्वीप्रमाणेन with the measurement of earth, तुल्यः equal, नौ to us, प्रतिभाति appeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मनश्च मे हतं भूयस्सन्निवर्त्यतु संश्रयम्। यत्नेन महता ह्यस्मिन्पुनस्सन्धाय चक्षुषी।।4.61.12।। यत्नेन महता भूयो भास्करः प्रतिलोकितः। तुल्यः पृथ्वीप्रमाणेन भास्करः प्रतिभाति नौ।।4.61.13।।
output: मे my, मनः mind, हतम् disturbed, चक्षुषी eyes, संश्रयम् a resort, प्राप्य became, महता with great, यत्नेन with effort, अस्मिन् in this, मनः mind, चक्षुषी both my eyes, सन्धाय by fixing, भूयः again, महता यत्नेन with great effort, भास्करः Sun, प्रतिलोकितः was seen, भास्करः Sun, पृथ्वीप्रमाणेन with the measurement of earth, तुल्यः equal, नौ to us, प्रतिभाति appeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 61:
जटायुर्मामनापृच्छ्य निपपात महीं ततः। तं दृष्ट्वा तूर्णमाकाशादात्मानं मुक्तवानहम्।।4.61.14।।
output: 'Without taking leave of me Jatayu descended down to the earth. Seeing that, I also followed him down quickly from the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 61:
पक्षाभ्यां च मया गुप्तो जटायुर्न प्रदह्यते। प्रमादात्तत्र निर्दग्धः पतन्वायुपथादहम्।।4.61.15।।
output: 'I protected Jatayu with my wings so that he was not burnt. I, however, got burnt miserably and fell down from the aerial region.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आशङ्के तं निपतितं जनस्थाने जटायुषम्। अहं तु पतितो विन्ध्ये दग्धपक्षो जडीकृतः।।4.61.16।।
output: तं जटायुषम् that Jatayu, जनस्थाने at Janasthana, निपतितम् fell down, आशङ्के I guess, अहं तु but I, दग्धपक्षः with burnt wings, जडीकृतः devoid of consciousness, विन्ध्ये on Vindhya, पतितः fell.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 61:
राज्येन हीनो भ्रात्रा च पक्षाभ्यां विक्रमेण च। सर्वथा मर्तुमेवेच्छन्पतिष्ये शिखराद्गीरेः।।4.61.17।।
output: 'Bereft of my kingdom, my brother and my wings, and having lost my strength I desire to fall down from the mountain top and die.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfirst sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 62:
एवमुक्ता मुनिश्रेष्ठ मरुदं दुःखितो भृशं। अथ ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु भगवानिदमब्रवीत्।।4.62.1।।
output: 'When thus I spoke to the venerable sage in that manner roaring very painfully the divine sage replied after reflecting silently for a moment:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पक्षौ तु ते प्रपक्षौ च पुनरन्यौभविष्यतः। प्राणाश्च चक्षुषी चैव विक्रमश्च बलं च ते।।4.62.2।।
output: पक्षौ तु wings, ते to you, प्रपक्षौ च and feathers, पुन: again, अन्यौ and other, प्राणाश्च life also, चक्षुषी eyes, चैव also, विक्रमश्च prowess, बलं च and strength, ते to you, भविष्यतः you will attain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुराणे सुमहत्कार्यं भविष्यति मया श्रुतं। दृष्टं मे तपसा चैव श्रुत्वा च विदितं मम4.62.3।।
output: 'I have foreseen with the power of my penance that a great task will be done by you. I have also heard about it in the Puranas and came to know of it.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राजा दशरथो नाम कश्चिदिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः। तस्य पुत्रो महातेजा रमोनाम भविष्यति।।4.62.4।।
output: इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः delight of the Ikshvaku family, दशरथो Dasaratha, नाम named, राजा king, कश्चित indeed, तस्य his, पुत्रो son, महा highly, तेजाः effulgent, रमो Rama, नाम by name, भविष्यति will beget.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अरण्यं च सह र्भात्रा लक्ष्मणेनगमिष्यति। अस्मिन्नर्थे नियुक्त स्सन्पित्रा सत्यपराक्रमः।।4.62.5।।
output: 'On account of the command of his father, Rama armed with the strength of truth will proceed to the forest with his brother Lakshmana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 62:
नैऋतो रावणो नाम तस्य भार्यां हरिष्यति। राक्षसेन्द्रो जनस्थनादवध्य स्सुरदानवैः4.62.6।।
output: 'The king of demons, Ravana who is indestructible even by gods and demons will be abducting his wife from Janastahana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 62:
सा च कामैः प्रलोभ्यन्ती भक्ष्यै:भोज्यैश्च मैथिली। नभोक्ष्यति महाभागा दुःखे मग्ना यशस्विनी।।4.62.7।।
output: 'Immersed in grief, chaste and famed Sita, will not take any food or enjoy pleasures however much she is tempted.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 62:
परमान्नंतु वैदेह्या ज्ञात्वा दास्यति वा सः। यदन्नममृतप्रख्यं सुराणामपिदुर्लभम्4.62.8।।
output: 'Knowing that Vaidehi is not eating food(given by Ravana) Indra,the ruler of gods, will offer nectarlike food rare even for gods.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदन्नं मैथिलीप्राप्य विज्ञायेन्द्रादिदंत्विति। अग्रमुदृत्य रामाय भूतले निर्वपिष्यति।।4.62.9।।
output: तदन्नं such food, मैथिली princess from Mithila, प्राप्य received, विज्ञाय having understood, अदिदंत्विति this is provided by, इन्द्रात् Indra, अग्रम् large portion, उदृत्य taken out, रामाय for Rama, भूतले on the earth, निर्वपिष्यति offers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदि जीवति मे भर्ता लक्ष्मणेन सह प्रभुः। देवत्वं गच्छ्तो र्वापि तयो रन्नमिदंत्विति4.62.10।।
output: 'If my husband and Lakshmana are living or else even if they have attained heaven let this food be enjoyed by them', Sita will say.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एष्यन्त्यन्वेषका स्तस्या रामदूताः प्लवांगमाः। आख़्येया राम महीषी त्वया तेभ्यो विहंगम4.62.11।।
output: रामदूताः Rama's messenger, एष्यन्ति and others that way, अन्वेषका to search, तस्याः for her, प्लवांगमाः monkeys, आख़्येया narrate, रामः Rama, महीषी queen, त्वया your, तेभ्यो to them, विहंगम bird (Sampati).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वथा हि नगन्तव्यमीदृशः क्व गमिष्यसि। देशकालौ प्रतीक्षस्व पक्षौ त्वं प्रतिपत्स्यसे4.62.12।।
output: सर्वथा in all respects, हि indeed, न गन्तव्यम् should not leave, इदृशः remain here, क्व गमिष्यसि where can you go, देशकालौ time and place, प्रतीक्षस्व waiting for, पक्षौ wings, त्वं yours, प्रतिपत्स्यसे will again grow.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नोत्सहेयमहंकर्तुमध्यैव त्वां सपक्षकम्। इहस्थ स्त्वं तु लोकानां हितं कार्यं करिष्यसि।।4.62.13।।
output: नोत्सह not enthusiastic, इयम् for me, अहंकर्तु if I make you get (the wings), मध्यैव remain here, त्वां your, सपक्षकम् your wings, इहस्थ: here itself, त्वं you, तु to you, लोकानां हितां good for the world, कार्यं task, करिष्यसि you will do.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वयापि खलु तत्कार्यं तयोश्चनृपपुत्रयोः। ब्राह्मणानां सुराणां च मुनीनां वासवस्य च।।4.62.14।।
output: '(Carry on) the work not only for the princes (Rama and Lakshmana) but also for the brahmins, sages, gods and others who live here.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इच्छाम्यहमपिद्रष्टुं भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। नेच्छेचिरं धारयुतुं प्राणां स्त्यक्ष्ये कलेबरं। महर्षि स्त्वब्रवीदेवं दृष्टतत्वार्थदर्शनः।।4.62.15।।
output: 'I also want to see Rama and Lakshmana. But I do not like to hold on to my life for long. Hence I will give up my body'. The knower of self, the sage (Nishakara) said this to Sampati. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे  द्विषष्टितम स्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysecond sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्वाक्यैर्वाक्यविशारदः। मां प्रशस्याभ्यनुज्ञाप्य प्रविष्टस्स स्वमालयम्।।4.63.1।।
output: वाक्यविशारदः skilful in speech, सः he (sage), एतैः by these, अन्यैश्च and others, बहुभिः by many, वाक्यैः with words, माम् me, प्रशस्य having praised, अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य permitted me to leave, स्वम् his own, आलयम् dwelling, प्रविष्टः entered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कन्दरात्तु विसर्पित्वा पर्वतस्य शनैश्शनैः। अहं विन्ध्यं समारुह्य भवतः प्रतिपालये।।4.63.2।।
output: 'Having crawled slowly and slowly from the cave and climbed the Vindhya, I have been awaiting your arrival.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्य त्वेतस्य कालस्य साग्रं वर्षशतं गतम्। देशकालप्रतीक्षोऽस्मि हृदि कृत्वा मुनेर्वचः।।4.63.3।।
output: 'More than a hundred years have passed and all this time I have borne the sage's words in my heart and have waited for the right time and place.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महाप्रस्थानमासाद्य स्वर्गते तु निशाकरे। मां निर्दहति सन्तापो वितर्कैर्बहुभिर्वृतम्।।4.63.4।।
output: 'Nishakara went on his last journey and attained heaven. Since then many sad thoughts have crisscrossed my mind and I am consumed with those thoughts.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उत्थितां मरणे बुद्धिं मुनिवाक्यैर्निवर्तये। बुद्धिर्या तेन मे दत्ता प्राणानां रक्षणाय तु।।4.63.5।। सा मेऽपनयते दुःखं दीप्तेवाग्निशिखा तमः।
output: मरणे for death, उत्थिम् intending, बुद्धिम् my mind, मुनिवाक्यैः  sage's words, निवर्तये I avert, मे my, प्राणानाम् of life, रक्षणे in protecting, तेन by him, मे my, या such, बुद्धिः thought, दत्ता is given, सा that, दीप्ता glowing, अग्निशिखा like the flames of fire, तमः इव like darkness, मे my, दु:खम् agony, अपनयते take away.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बुद्ध्यता च मया वीर्यं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः।।4.63.6।। पुत्रस्सन्तर्जितो वाग्भिर्न त्राता मैथिली कथम्।
output: दुरात्मनः of the evilminded, रावणस्य Ravana's, वीर्यं बुद्ध्यता knowing his valour, मया by me, मैथिली princess from Mithila, कथम् how, न त्राता not protected, वाग्भिः with (harsh) words, पुत्रः son, संतर्जितः goaded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्या विलपितं श्रुत्वा तौ च सीताविनाकृतौ।।4.63.7।। न मे दशरथस्नेहात्पुत्रेणोत्पादितं प्रियम्।
output: तस्याः her, विलपितम् wailing, श्रुत्वा on hearing also, तौ both (Rama and Lakshmna), सीताविनाकृतौ separated from Sita, मे for me, दशरथस्नेहात् in view of my friendship with Dasaratha, पुत्रेण by my son, प्रियम् pleased, न उत्पादितम् not created.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 63:
तस्य त्वेवं ब्रुवाणस्य सम्पातेर्वानरैस्सह।।4.63.8।। उत्पेततुस्तदा पक्षौ समक्षं वनचारिणाम्।
output: Even as he was telling this to the monkeys his wings started appearing in their presence.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स दृष्ट्वा स्वां तनुं पक्षैरुद्गतैररुणच्छदैः।।4.63.9।। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे वानरांश्चेदमब्रवीत्।
output: He experienced an unparalleled delight seeing wings with red feathers growing on his body, and said to the monkeys:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋषेर्निशाकरस्यैव प्रभावादमितात्मन:।।4.63.10।। आदित्यरश्मिनिर्दग्धौ पक्षौ मे पुनरुपस्थितौ।
output: अमितात्मनः of the most revered soul, ऋषेः sage, निशाकरस्य Nishakara's, प्रभावात् due to his grace, आदित्यरश्मिनिर्दग्धौ those that are burnt by Sun's radiant heat, मे my, पक्षौ both wings, पुनः again, उपस्थितौ have grown.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यौवने वर्तमानस्य ममासीद्यः पराक्रमः।।4.63.11।। तमेवाद्यावगच्छामि बलं पौरुषमेव च।
output: 'The valour, strength and even courage that I had in my youth,I am experiencing now.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वथा क्रियतां यत्न स्सीतामधिगमिष्यथ।।4.63.12।। पक्षलाभो ममायं वस्सिद्धिप्रत्ययकारकः।
output: सर्वथा by all means, यत्नः effort, क्रियताम् may be made, सीताम् Sita, अधिगमिष्यथ you will trace, मम me, अयम् this, पक्षलाभः growing of wings, वः to you, सिद्धिप्रत्ययकारकः is a proof of your success in future.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 63:
इत्युक्त्वा स तान्हरीन् सर्वान्सम्पातिः पतगोत्तमः।।4.63.13।। उत्पपात गिरेश्शृङ्गाज्जिज्ञासुः खगमो गतिम्।
output: Sampati, the foremost of the birds thus spoke to the monkeys and flew up from the mountain's peak keen on finding the aerial path.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रतिसंहृष्टमानसाः।।4.63.14।। बभूवुर्हरिशार्दूला विक्रमाभ्युदयोन्मुखाः।
output: हरिशार्दूलाः tigers among monkeys, तस्य his, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, प्रतिसंहृष्टमानसाः in turn felt very happy, विक्रमाभ्युदयोन्मुखाः hoping success with their valour, बभूवुः  became.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ पवनसमानविक्रमाः प्लवगवराः प्रतिलब्धपौरुषाः। अभिजिदभिमुखा दिशं ययु र्जनकसुतापरिमार्गणोन्मुखाः।।4.63.15।।
output: अथ now, पवनसमानविक्रमाः as strong as the wind, प्रतिलब्धपौरुषाः regained courage, प्लवगवराः best of the monkeys, अभिजिदभिमुखाः facing Abhijit, जनकसुतापरिमार्गणोन्मुखाः eager to find the daughter of Janaka, दिशम् direction, ययुः went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आख्याता गृध्रराजेन समुत्प्लुत्य प्लवङ्गमाः। सङ्गताः प्रीतिसंयुक्ता विनेदुर्भीमविक्रमाः।।4.64.1।।
output: Angada discusses with the monkeys the strategies to cross the ocean.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सम्पातेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा हरयो रावणक्षयम्। हृष्टास्सागरमाजग्मुस्सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।।4.64.2।।
output: On hearing the words of Sampati, the monkeys felt glad and, eager to see Sita, reached the ocean, the passage to the abode of Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
अभिक्रम्य तु तं देशं ददृशुर्भीमविक्रमाः। कृत्स्नं लोकस्य महतः प्रतिबिम्बमिव स्थितम्।।4.64.3।।
output: Having reached the ocean, the monkeys, endowed with frightening courage, stood looking at the vast ocean which appeared like an image of the whole world.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य समासाद्योत्तरां दिशम्। सन्निवेशं ततश्चक्रुर्हरिवीरा महाबलाः।।4.64.4।।
output: Powerful and heroic monkeys assembled at the northern end of the southern ocean.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
सत्त्वैर्महद्भिर्विकृतैः क्रीडद्भिर्विविधैर्जले। व्यात्तास्यैस्सुमहाकायैरूर्मिभिश्च समाकुलम्।।4.64.5।। प्रसुप्तमिव चान्यत्र क्रीडन्तमिव चान्यतः। क्वचित्पर्वतमात्रैश्च जलराशिभिरावृतम्।।4.64.6।। सङ्कुलं दानवेन्द्रैश्च पातालतलवासिभिः। रोमहर्षकरं दृष्ट्वा विषेदु: कपिकुञ्जराः।।4.64.7।।
output: The ocean was of terrifying form filled with various violent species of grotesque creatures of huge bodies playing in the water. Full of violent tides, it appeared asleep at one place and apparently sporting in another. In some places it was rising as high as a mountain with huge volumes of water. It was as if roaring with the demon chiefs residing in the underworld. The great monkeys were worried seeing the huge ocean which created horripilation in them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सत्त्वैर्महद्भिर्विकृतैः क्रीडद्भिर्विविधैर्जले। व्यात्तास्यैस्सुमहाकायैरूर्मिभिश्च समाकुलम्।।4.64.5।। प्रसुप्तमिव चान्यत्र क्रीडन्तमिव चान्यतः। क्वचित्पर्वतमात्रैश्च जलराशिभिरावृतम्।।4.64.6।। सङ्कुलं दानवेन्द्रैश्च पातालतलवासिभिः। रोमहर्षकरं दृष्ट्वा विषेदु: कपिकुञ्जराः।।4.64.7।।
output: The ocean was of terrifying form filled with various violent species of grotesque creatures of huge bodies playing in the water. Full of violent tides, it appeared asleep at one place and apparently sporting in another. In some places it was rising as high as a mountain with huge volumes of water. It was as if roaring with the demon chiefs residing in the underworld. The great monkeys were worried seeing the huge ocean which created horripilation in them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सत्त्वैर्महद्भिर्विकृतैः क्रीडद्भिर्विविधैर्जले। व्यात्तास्यैस्सुमहाकायैरूर्मिभिश्च समाकुलम्।।4.64.5।। प्रसुप्तमिव चान्यत्र क्रीडन्तमिव चान्यतः। क्वचित्पर्वतमात्रैश्च जलराशिभिरावृतम्।।4.64.6।। सङ्कुलं दानवेन्द्रैश्च पातालतलवासिभिः। रोमहर्षकरं दृष्ट्वा विषेदु: कपिकुञ्जराः।।4.64.7।।
output: जले in water, क्रीडद्भिः  sporting in water, महद्भि: great ocean, विकृतैः  of terrifying form, विविधैः several, सत्त्वै: species, व्यात्तास्यैः by grotesque creatures, सुमहाकायैः of massive body, ऊर्मिभिश्च with waves, समाकुलम् filled with, यत्र there, प्रसुप्तमिव as if sleeping, अन्यतः at other places, क्रीडन्तमिव like sporting, क्वचित् and at some places, पर्वतमात्रैः  as high as mountain, जलराशिभिः volumes of water, आवृतम् covered, पातालतलवासिभिः who dwell in the underworld, दानवेन्द्रैश्च also by lords of demons, सङ्कुलम् filled, रोमहर्षकरम् causing horripilation, दृष्ट्वा seeing, कपिकुञ्जराः elephants among monkeys, विषेदुः became worried.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
आकाशमिव दुष्पारं सागरं प्रेक्षय वानराः। विषेदु स्सहसासर्वे कथं कार्यमिति ब्रुवन्।।4.64.8।।
output: All the monkeys were worried when they suddenly saw the ocean which looked impassable like the sky. They wondered if they can at all accomplish the task (of finding Sita)

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
विषण्णां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा सागरस्य निरीक्षणात्। आश्वासयामास हरीन्भयार्तान् हरिसत्तमः।।4.64.9।।
output: Angada, the best among the monkeys saw the worried army despondent gazing at the ocean, and comforted the frightened troops.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
तान्विषादेन महता विषण्णान्वानरर्षभान्। उवाच मतिमान्काले वालिसूनुर्महाबलः।।4.64.10।।
output: Angada,the strong and wise  son of Vali, spoke thus to the tensed vanaras in the right time:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न विषादे मनः कार्यं विषादो दोषवत्तमः। विषादो हन्ति पुरुषं बालं क्रुद्ध इवोरगः।।4.64.11।।
output: 'Do not be despondent. It is the biggest flaw. It destroys a person like an angry serpent killing a young child.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यो विषादं प्रसहते विक्रमे पर्युपस्थिते। तेजसा तस्य हीनस्य पुरुषार्थो न सिध्यति।।4.64.12।।
output: विक्रमे when valiance, समुपस्थिते needs to be exhibited, यः whoever, विषादम् despondency, प्रसहते will succumb, तेजसा with brilliant, हीनस्य of a deprived one, तस्य his, पुरुषार्थः manly pursuit, न सिध्यति will not achieve.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामङ्गदो वानरैस्सह। हरिवृद्धैस्समागम्य पुनर्मन्त्रममन्त्रयत्।।4.64.13।।
output: तस्याम् when that, रात्रौ night, व्यतीतायाम् having ended, अङ्गदः Angada, हरिवृद्धैः with old monkeys, वानरैस्सह along with fellowmonkeys, समागम्य joined together, पुनः again, मन्त्रम् counsel, अमन्त्रयत् sought.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा वानराणां ध्वजिनी परिवार्याङ्गदं बभौ। वासवं परिवार्येव मरुतां वाहिनी स्थिता।।4.64.14।।
output: वानराणाम् of the monkeys, सा that, ध्वजिनी army, अङ्गदम् Angada, परिवार्य surrounding, स्थिता stood, वासवम् Indra, परिवार्य surrounding, मरुताम् of Maruts, वाहिनी इव like the army, बभौ appeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कोऽन्यस्तां वानरीं सेनां शक्त:स्तम्भयितुं भवेत्। अन्यत्र वालितनयादन्यत्र च हनूमतः।।4.64.15।।
output: वालितनयात् अन्यत्र other than Vali's son, हनूमतः Hanumat, अन्यत्र other than, अन्यः another person, कः who, ताम् that, वानरीम् monkey सेनाम् army, स्तम्भयितुम् to suspend, शक्तः can do, भवेत् will be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
ततस्तान्हरिवृद्धांश्च तच्च सैन्यमरिन्दमः। अनुमान्याङ्गदश्श्रीमान्वाक्यमर्थवदब्रवीत्।।4.64.16।।
output: Then the illustrious Angada, subduer of foes took the counsel of elderly monkeys and  the army into confidence and thus addressed them all in meaningful words:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
क इदानीं महातेजा लङ्घयिष्यति सागरम्। कः करिष्यति सुग्रीवं सत्यसन्धमरिन्दमम्।।4.64.17।।
output: 'Now which mighty monkey will cross the ocean? Who will prove Sugriva, subduer of enemies, true to his promise?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
को वीरो योजनशतं लङ्घयेत प्लवङ्गमाः। इमांश्च यूथपान् सर्वान्मोक्षयेत्को महाभयात्।।4.64.18।।
output: 'O monkeys which one can leap a hundred yojanas and liberate the monkey leaders from the great fear of Sugriva?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कस्य प्रभावाद्धारांश्च पुत्रांश्चैव गृहाणि च। इतो निवृत्ताः पश्येम सिद्धार्थास्सुखिनो वयम्।।4.64.19।।
output: 'By whose effort can we be successful and return home happily from here to meet wives and sons?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कस्य प्रसादाद्रामं च लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। अभिगच्छेम संहृष्टास्सुग्रीवं च वनौकसम्।।4.64.20।।
output: 'By whose grace shall we approach Rama and Lakshmana and even the monkey king Sugriva happily?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदि कश्चित्समर्थो वस्सागरप्लवने हरिः। स ददा त्विह न शशीघ्रं पुण्यामभयदक्षिणाम्।।4.64.21।।
output: 'If there is any one among you who is capable of leaping  across the ocean he will be giving all of us the sacred gift of life quickly?'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
अङ्गदस्य वच श्शृत्वा न कश्चित् किञ्चिदब्रवीत्। स्तिमिते वा भवत्सर्वा सा तत्र हरिवाहिनी।।4.64.22।।
output: After hearing Angada, no one spoke a word. The entire army of monkeys became still and motionless.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुनरेवाङ्गदः प्राह तान्हरीन्हरिसत्तमः। सर्वे बलवतां श्रेष्ठा भवन्तो दृढविक्रमाः।।4.64.23।। व्यपदेश्य कुले जाताः पूजिताश्चाप्यभीक्ष्णशः।
output: Angada, the best of the monkeys again addressed them saying, 'you are all mighty, eminent and courageous, born in renowned families and have been honoured again and again(for your actions).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 64:
न हि वो गमने सङ्गः कदाचित्कस्यचित्क्वचित्। ब्रुवध्वं यस्य या शक्तिः प्लवने प्लवगर्षभाः।।4.64.24।।
output: 'None of you at any time have faced any obstruction in doing your deeds. You are efficient  in leaping. O bulls among monkeys now speak out, who among you can fly and how far? इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे चतुष्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfourth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथाङ्गदवचश्श्रुत्वा ते सर्वे वानरर्षभाः। स्वं स्वं गतौ समुत्साहमूचुस्तत्र यथाक्रमम्।।4.65.1।। गजो गवाक्षो गवयश्शरभो गन्धमादनः। मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चैव सुषेणो जाम्बवां स्तथा।।4.65.2।।
output: अथ and then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्चैव even Dvivida, सुषेणः Sushena, तथा so also, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, सर्वे all, ते them, वानरर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, यथाक्रमम् following an order, तत्र there, गतौ in turn the scope for, स्वं स्वम् on their own, समुत्साहम् capability (to leap), ऊचुः expressed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथाङ्गदवचश्श्रुत्वा ते सर्वे वानरर्षभाः। स्वं स्वं गतौ समुत्साहमूचुस्तत्र यथाक्रमम्।।4.65.1।। गजो गवाक्षो गवयश्शरभो गन्धमादनः। मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चैव सुषेणो जाम्बवां स्तथा।।4.65.2।।
output: Each of the monkey leaders declares the distance they can fly -- Jambavan resolves not to send Angada but send Hanuman instead to cross.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
आबभाषे गजस्तत्र प्लवेयं दशयोजनम्। गवाक्षो योजननान्याह गमिष्यामीति विंशतिम्।।4.65.3।।
output: Gaja said he can leap ten yojanas and Gavaksha said he can go upto twenty yojanas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गवयो वानरस्तत्र वानरां स्तानुवाच ह। त्रिंशतं तु गमिष्यामि योजनानां प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.65.4।। शरभस्तानुवाचाथ वानरान् वानरर्षभः। चत्वारिंशद्गमिष्यामि योजनानां प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.65.5।। वानरस्तु महातेजा अब्रवीद्गन्धमादनः। योजनानां गमिष्यामि पञ्चाशत्तु न संशयः।।4.65.6।। मैन्दस्तु वानरस्तत्र वानरांस्तानुवाच ह। योजनानां परं षष्टिमहं प्लवितुमुत्सहे।।4.65.7।। ततस्तत्र महातेजा द्विविदः प्रत्यभाषत। गमिष्यामि न सन्देहस्सप्ततिं योजनान्यहम्।।4.65.8।। सुषेणस्तु महातेजा:प्रोक्तवान्हरिसत्तमान्। अशीतिं योजनानां तु प्लवेयं प्लवगेश्वराः।।4.65.9।।
output: तत्र there, गवयो Gava, वानरः monkeys, तान् वानरान् the monkeys, उवाच ह said like that, प्लवङ्गमाः O leaping monkeys, योजनानाम्  yojanas, त्रिंशतम् thirty, गमिष्यामि I can reach, तत्र there, शरभः Sarabha, वानरर्षभ great monkey, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, योजनानाम् yojanas, चत्वारिंशत् forty, गमिष्यामि can reach, संशयः doubt, न without, महातेजाः bright, गन्धमादनः Ghandamadana, वानरान् monkeys, अब्रवीत् said, योजनानाम् yojanas, पञ्चाशत् fifty, गमिष्यामि I can go, संशयः doubt, न no, तत्र there, मैन्दः Mainda, वानरस्तु to the monkeys, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, अहम् I, योजनानाम् of yojanas, षष्टिं परम् more than sixty, प्लवितुम् to leap, उत्सहे I am enthusiastic, ततः then, महातेजाः highly brilliant, द्विविदः Dvivida, तत्र there, प्रत्यभाषत in turn spoke, अहम् I, सप्तति: seventy, योजनानि yojanas, गमिष्यामि I can go, सन्देहः doubt, न not, महातेजाः brilliant, सत्त्ववान् strong, सुषेणः Sushena, कपिसत्तमः best among the monkeys, अहम् I, पराक्रमे capability, योजनानाम् of yojanas, अशीतिम् eighty, प्लवेयं I can leap.

Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषां कथयतां तत्र सर्वांस्ताननुमान्य च। ततो वृद्धतमस्तेषां जाम्बवान्प्रत्यभाषत।।4.65.10।।
output: ततः then, तेषाम् among them, वृद्धतमः oldest, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, तेषाम् they, तत्र there, कथयताम् (when they were) saying, तान् सर्वान् all the, अनुमान्य inferred, प्रत्यभाषत replied.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पूर्वमस्माकमप्यासीत्कश्चिद्गतिपराक्रमः। ते वयं वयसः पारमनुप्राप्तास्स्म साम्प्रतम्।।4.65.11।।
output: पूर्वम् earlier, अस्माकमपि even I also, कश्चित् some, गतिपराक्रमः very courageous, आसीत् had , ते वयम् for me, साम्प्रतम् attained, वयसः (old) age, पारम् fag end of life, अनुप्राप्ताः स्म have reached.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
किन्तु नैवं गते शक्यमिदं कार्यमुपेक्षितुम्। यदर्थं कपिराजश्च रामश्च कृतनिश्चयौ।।4.65.12।।
output: 'However  in this situation, it is not possible for us to neglect (our task) as it is the order of the monkeyking and Rama who are determined to achieve the objective.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
साम्प्रतं कालभेदेन या गतिस्तां निबोधत। नवतिं योजनानां तु गमिष्यामि न संशयः।।4.65.13।।
output: साम्प्रतम् at this age, कालभेदेन due to advancement of age, या that, गतिः movement, ताम् that, निबोधत you know, योजनानाम् of yojanas, नवतिम् ninety,गमिष्यामि I can leap, संशयः doubt, न not.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
तांश्च सर्वान्हरिश्रेष्ठाञ्जाम्बवान्पुनरब्रवीत्। न खल्वेतावदेवासीद्गमने मे पराक्रमः।।4.65.14।।
output: Jambavan, the distinguished among the monkeys again said, 'My strength to leap into the sky was not only that much (I was stronger in my youth and could cover longer distances)'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मया महाबलेश्चैव यज्ञे विष्णुस्सनातनः। प्रदक्षिणीकृतः पूर्वं क्रममाणस्त्रिविक्रमम्।।4.65.15।।
output: मया by myself, पूर्वम् earlier, महाबलेश्चैव of Mahabali, यज्ञे in yagna, क्रममाणः the advancing Lord, विष्णुः Visnu, सनातनः eternal, त्रिविक्रमः Visnu of three strides, प्रदक्षिणीकृतः circumambulated.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स इदानीमहं वृद्धः प्लवने मन्दविक्रमः। यौवने च तदाऽसीन्मे बलमप्रतिमं परैः।।4.65.16।।
output: 'Having grown old I do not have the same courage. In my youth my prowess was incomparable and none could excel me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
सम्प्रत्येतावतीं शक्तिं गमने तर्कयाम्यहम्। नैतावता हि संसिद्धिः कार्यस्यास्य भविष्यति।।4.65.17।।
output: 'I guess that at this time I do not have the capacity to fly to that extent. Achieving the objective is out of question with this much of energy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथोत्तरमुदारार्थमब्रवीदङ्गदस्तदा। अनुमान्य तथा प्राज्ञो जाम्बवन्तं महाकपिम्।।4.65.18।।
output: अथ and now, तदा then, प्राज्ञः wise, अङ्गदः Angada, महाकपिम् great monkey, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, अनुमान्य doubting, उदारार्थम् in a gentle manner, उत्तरम् reply, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहमेतद्गमिष्यामि योजनानां शतं महत्। निवर्तने तु मे शक्तिस्स्यान्न वेति न निश्चितम्।।4.65.19।।
output: 'I can  certainly go to a distance of a hundred yojanas. However, I cannot say whether I will have enough capacity to return?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठं जाम्बवान्वाक्यकोविदः। ज्ञायते गमने शक्तिस्तव हर्यृक्षसत्तम।।4.65.20।।
output: वाक्यकोविदः skilful at speech, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, तम् him, हरिश्रेष्ठम् best of monkeys, उवाच said, हर्यृक्षसत्तम best among bears and monkeys, गमने I am going to fly, तव your, शक्तिः energy, ज्ञायते is known.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कामं शतं सहस्रं वा न ह्येष विधिरुच्यते। योजनानां भवान् शक्तो गन्तुं प्रतिनिवर्तितुम्।।4.65.21।।
output: 'You can go upto even a hundred thousand yojanas and have the required energy to return also. But it is not proper to send you (because you are the heir apparent).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
न हि प्रेषयिता तात स्वामी प्रेष्यः कथञ्चन। भवताऽयं जनस्सर्वः प्रेष्यः प्लवगसत्तम।।4.65.22।।
output: तात dear , प्रेषयिता who orders, स्वामी lord, कथञ्चन in any way, प्रेष्यः a servant who is sent, न हि indeed, प्लवगसत्तम best of monkeys, सर्वः all, अयं जनः this group, भवता by you, प्रेष्यः to be sent.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भवान्कळत्रमस्माकं स्वामिभावे व्यवस्थितः। स्वामी कळत्रं सैन्यस्य गतिरेषा परन्तप।।4.65.23।।
output: परन्तप O scorcher of enemies, स्वामिभावे in a state of commander, व्यवस्थितः you are established, भवान् you, अस्माकम् for us, कलत्रम् wife, स्वामी lord, सैन्यस्य army's, कलत्रम् wife, एषा so that, गतिः proper.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अपि चैतस्य कार्यस्य भवान्मूलमरिन्दम। तस्मात्कळत्रवत्तात प्रतिपाल्यस्सदा भवान्।।4.65.24।।
output: 'O subduer of enemies in acomplishing this task you are the root. O dear therefore you should always be taken care of by us just like the wife looked after.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
मूलमर्थस्य संरक्ष्यमेष कार्यविदां नयः। मूले सति हि सिद्ध्यन्ति गुणा फलो पुष्पोदयाः।।4.65.25।।
output: 'The root of any objective should be protected well. This is the basis of an accomplisher. Only when the roots are intact, the trees have the ability to yield flowers and fruits.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्भवानस्य कार्यस्य साधने सत्यविक्रम। बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नो हेतुरत्र परन्तप।।4.65.26।।
output: 'O warrior of proven valour O subduer of enemies in achieving this objective you are the source, being endowed with valour and wisdom.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
गुरुश्च गुरुपुत्रश्च त्वं हि नः कपिसत्तम। भवन्तमाश्रित्य वयं समर्था ह्यर्थसाधने।।4.65.27।।
output: 'O best of monkeys you are the son of my guide (Vali) and respectable. We will be capable of accomplishing the goal only under your protection and guidance.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उक्तवाक्यं महाप्राज्ञं जाम्बवन्तं महाकपिः। प्रत्युवाचोत्तरं वाक्यं वालिसूनुरथाङ्गदः।।4.65.28।।
output: Jambavan, the wise monkey having said that, Angada, the great son of Vali, replied:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदि नाहं गमिष्यामि नान्यो वानरपुङ्गवः। पुनः खल्विदमस्माभिः कार्यं प्रायोपवेशनम्।।4.65.29।।
output: अहम् I am, न गमिष्यामि यदि if I will not go, अन्यः other, वानरपुङ्गवः monkey leader, न not, अस्माभिः by us, पुनः again, इदम् this, प्रायोपवेशनम् fasting to death, कार्यं खलु have to do.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न ह्यकृत्वा हरिपतेस्सन्देशं तस्य धीमतः। तत्रापि गत्वा प्राणानां पश्यामि परिरक्षणम्।।4.65.30।।
output: 'If I do not fulfil the objective of the wise king of monkeys I cannot save my life even after returning there (Kishkinda).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
स हि प्रसादे चात्यर्थं कोपे च हरिरीश्वरः। अतीत्य तस्य सन्देशं विनाशो गमने भवेत्।।4.65.31।।
output: 'The monkey king has the authority to shower grace or give vent to his anger. If we go without fulfilling the task we will face destruction.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्यथा ह्यस्य कार्यस्य न भवत्यन्यथा गतिः। तद्भवानेव दृष्टार्थस्सञ्चिन्तयितु मर्हति।।4.65.32।।
output: 'Therefore, think over well so that we do not fail ultimately. You have a vision.You should suggest means by which this mission does not misfire.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽङ्गदेन तदा वीरः प्रत्युक्तः प्लवगर्षभः। जाम्बवानुत्तरं वाक्यं प्रोवाचेदं ततोऽङ्गदम्।।4.65.33।।
output: On listening to Angada's words, Jambavan, the  bull among monkeys, replied this way:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 65:
अस्य ते वीर कार्यस्य न किञ्चित्परिहीयते। एष सञ्चोदयाम्येनं यः कार्यं साधयिष्यति।।4.65.34।।
output: 'O hero this work will not be balked. I will now inspire one who can achieve this task.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनेकशतसाहस्रीं विषण्णां हरिवाहिनीम्। जाम्बवान्समुदीक्ष्यैवं हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्।।4.66.1।।
output: जाम्बवान् Jambavan, विषण्णाम् worried, अनेकशतसाहस्रीम् several hundred thousands, हरिवाहिनीम् army of monkeys, समुदीक्ष्य observed, अथ then, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, एवम् this way, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वीर वानरलोकस्य सर्वशास्त्रविदां वर। तूष्णीमेकान्तमाश्रित्य हनूमन्किं न जल्पसि।।4.66.2।।
output: वानरलोकस्य in the world of monkeys, वीर hero, सर्वशास्त्रविदाम् among the knowledgeable in all sastras, वर choicest one, हनूमान् Hanuman, तूष्णीम् quietly, एकान्तम् solitude, आश्रित्य remaining, किम् why, न जल्पसि you are not speaking.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
हनूमन्हरिराजस्य सुग्रीवस्य समो ह्यसि। रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि तेजसा च बलेन च।।4.66.3।।
output: 'Hanuman you are equal to the king of monkeys and also Rama and Lakshmana in brilliance and strength.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अरिष्टनेमिनः पुत्रो वैनतेयो महाबलः। गरुत्मानिति विख्यात उत्तमस्सर्वपक्षिणाम्।।4.66.4।।
output: अरिष्टनेमिनः Arishtanemi's, पुत्रः son, सर्वपक्षिणाम् among all birds, उत्तमः greatest, वैनतेयः Vainateya's, महाबलः very powerful, गरुत्मान् इति Garuthman as such, विख्यातः very famous.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बहुशो हि मया दृष्टः सागरे स महाबलः। भुजङ्गानुद्धरन्पक्षी महावेगो महायशाः।।4.66.5।।
output: महाबलः very powerful, महावेगः very swift, महायशाः very famous, सः that, पक्षी bird, सागरे ocean, भुजङ्गान् serpents, उद्धरन् while snatching, मया by me, बहुशः many times, दृष्टः हि is seen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पक्षयोर्यद्बलं तस्य तावद्भुजबलं तव। विक्रमश्चापि वेगश्च न ते तेनावहीयते।।4.66.6।।
output: 'The strength of your shoulders is equal to that of his (Garuda's) wings. Your speed and valour are no less.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बलं बुद्धिश्च तेजश्च सत्त्वं च हरिपुङ्गव। विशिष्टं सर्वभूतेषु किमात्मानं न बुध्यसे।।4.66.7।।
output: हरिपुङ्गव leader of the monkeys, बलम् strength, बुद्धिश्च wisdom, तेजश्च brilliance, सत्त्वम् valour, सर्वभूतेषु of all beings, विशिष्टम् superior, आत्मानम् your self, किम् why, न बुध्यसे do you not know that.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
अप्सराप्सरसां श्रेष्ठा विख्याता पुञ्जिकस्थला। अञ्जनेति परिख्याता पत्नी केसरिणो हरेः।।4.66.8।।
output: पुञ्जिकस्थला Punjikasthala, अप्सरसाम् among apsarasas, श्रेष्ठा eminent, विख्याता famous, अञ्जनेति by name Anjana, परिख्याता wellknown as, अप्सरा: apsara, हरेः monkeys, केसरिणः Kesari, पत्नी wife.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि। अभिशापादभूत्तात वानरी कामरूपिणी।।4.66.9।।
output: तात dear, रूपेण in appearance, अप्रतिमा peerless, त्रिषु among three, लोकेषु in worlds, विख्याता famous, अभिशापात् by a curse, भुवि on the land, कामरूपिणी lovely one, who can change form at her will, वानरी monkey, अभूत् she was.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दुहिता वानरेन्द्रस्य कुञ्जरस्य महात्मनः। मानुषं विग्रहं कृत्वा रूपयौवनशालिनी।।4.66.10।। विचित्रमाल्याभरणा महार्हक्षौमवासिनी। अचरत्पर्वतस्याग्रे प्रावृडम्बुदसन्निभे।।4.66.11।।
output: वानरेन्द्रस्य of the king of monkeys, महात्मनः of the great, कुञ्जरस्य Kunjara's, दुहिता  daughter, रूपयौवनशालिनी young and beautiful, मानुषम् human, विग्रहम् form, कृत्वा took, विचित्रमाल्याभरणा decked in wonderful garlands and ornaments, महार्हक्षौमवासिनी wearing rich silk clothes, प्रावृडम्बुदसन्निभे looking like the proud raincloud, पर्वतस्य अग्रे on top of the mountain, अचरत् she was wandering.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
दुहिता वानरेन्द्रस्य कुञ्जरस्य महात्मनः। मानुषं विग्रहं कृत्वा रूपयौवनशालिनी।।4.66.10।। विचित्रमाल्याभरणा महार्हक्षौमवासिनी। अचरत्पर्वतस्याग्रे प्रावृडम्बुदसन्निभे।।4.66.11।।
output: 'She was the daughter of a great king of monkeys called Kunjara. That young and beautiful lady had assumed a lustrous human form decked with wonderful garlands, ornaments and silk clothes and was roving on top of the mountain which appeared like a proud raincloud.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
तस्या वस्त्रं विशालाक्ष्याः पीतं रक्तदशं शुभम्। स्थितायाः पर्वतस्याग्रे मारुतोऽपहरच्छनैः।।4.66.12।।
output: 'While the largeeyed lady was stationed on the mountain top, the Windgod gently let her auspicious yellow garment with red border fly away.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स ददर्श ततस्तस्या वृत्तावूरू सुसंहतौ। स्तनौ च पीनौ सहितौ सुजातं चारु चाननम्।।4.66.13।।
output: ततः then, सः he, तस्याः her, वृत्तौ curved, सुसंहतौ both wellset, ऊरू both thighs, पीनौ plump, सहितौ together, स्तनौ च two breasts, सुजातम् very beautiful, चारु pleasing, आननं च face, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां विशालायतश्रोणीं तनुमध्यां यशस्विनीम्। दृष्टवैव शुभसर्वाङ्गीं पवनः काममोहितः।।4.66.14।।
output: विशालायतश्रोणीम् a lady of broad hips, तनुमध्याम् slender waist, यशस्विनीम् famed one, शुभसर्वाङ्गीम् a lady of beautiful limbs, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, पवनः Windgod, काममोहितः was infatuated.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तां भुजाभ्यां दीर्घाभ्यां पर्यष्वजत मारुतः। मन्मथाविष्टसर्वाङ्गो गतात्मा तामनिन्दिताम्।।4.66.15।।
output: 'The Windgod lost his control over himself. His whole being was overpowered by love for her beautiful, flawless body. He embraced her with his long arms.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा तु तत्रैव सम्भ्रान्ता सुव्रता वाक्यमब्रवीत्। एकपत्नीव्रतमिदं को नाशयितुमिच्छति।।4.66.16।।
output: तत्रैव on that spot itself, सम्भ्रान्ता bewildered lady, सुव्रता a chaste woman, सा तु she was, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, इदम् this, एकपत्नीव्रतम् observing strict monoandry, कः who, नाशयितुम् to destroy, इच्छति is wishing?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अञ्जनाया वच्शुत्वा मारुतः प्रत्यभाषत। न त्वां हिंसामि सुश्रोणि मा भूत्ते सुभगे भयम्।।4.66.17।।
output: 'On hearing Anjana's words, the Windgod replied, ' O auspicious lady, I do you no harm, O lady of beautiful hips. I reached (enjoyed) you in mind, not body. You need not fear.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मनसाऽस्मि गतो यत्त्वां परिष्वज्य यशस्विनीम्। वीर्यवान्बुद्धिसम्पन्न: पुत्रस्तव भविष्यति।।4.66.18।।
output: यशस्विनि O renowned woman, यत् such as, त्वाम् you, परिष्वज्य after embracing, मनसा mentally, गतः अस्मि I united with you, तव your, वीर्यवान् courageous, बुद्धिसम्पन्नः endowed with wisdom, पुत्रः son, भविष्यति will be born.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महासत्त्वो महातेजा महाबलपराक्रमः। लङ्घने प्लवने चैव भविष्यति हि मत्समः।।4.66.19।।
output: 'He will be very powerful, illustrious and will be of great valour and strength. He will be my equal in leaping and flying'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
एवमुक्ता ततस्तुष्टा जननी ते महाकपे। गुहायां त्वां महाबाहो प्रजज्ञे प्लवगर्षभम्।।4.66.20।।
output: 'O great monkey O strongshouldered one having been assured that way, your mother was pleased and delivered you, a bull among monkeys, in a cave.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
अभ्युत्थितं ततस्सूर्यं बालो दृष्ट्वा महावने। फलं चेति जिघृक्षुस्त्वमुत्प्लुत्याभ्युद्गतो दिवम्।।4.66.21।।
output: 'On seeing the rising Sun in the deep forest, mistaking him to be a fruit, you wanted to seize it, when you were young.You suddenly flew into the sky and went flying towards the Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शतानि त्रीणि गत्वाऽथ योजनानां महाकपे। तेजसा तस्य निर्धूतो न विषादं ततोगतः।।4.66.22।।
output: 'O great monkey you went three hundred yojanas and were pushed back by the  Sun's radiance. Yet it did not leave you depressed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
तावदापपत स्तूर्णमन्तरिक्षं महाकपे। क्षिप्तमिन्द्रेण ते वज्रं कोपाविष्टेन धीमता।।4.66.23।।
output: 'O great monkey while falling fast in space, wise Indra hurled his thunderbolt quickly at you, in anger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदा शैलाग्रशिखरे वामो हनुरभज्यत। ततो हि नामधेयं ते हनुमानिति कीर्त्यते।।4.66.24।।
output: तदा then, शैलाग्रशिखरे on the edge of the mountain peak, वामः left, हनुः chin, अभज्यत was broken, ततः then, ते your, नामधेयम् named, हनुमानिति Hanuman, कीर्त्यते wellknown.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
तस्त्वावि निहतं दृष्ट्वा वायुर्गन्धवहस्स्वयम्। त्रैलोक्ये भृशसङ्कृद्धो न ववौ वै प्रभञ्जनः।।4.66.25।।
output: The Windgod who is a carrier of fragrance and breaker of trees became very angry on seeing (the injury on) you and stopped blowing in the three worlds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्भ्रान्ताश्च सूरास्सर्वे त्रैलोक्ये क्षुभिते सति। प्रसादयन्ति संक्रुद्धं मारुतं भुवनेश्वराः।।4.66.26।।
output: त्रैलोक्ये in all the three worlds, क्षुभिते सति  disturbed, भुवनेश्वराः all lords of the world, सर्वे all, सुराः Gods, संभ्रान्ताः became uneasy, संक्रुद्धम् angry, मारुतम् Maruta, प्रसादयन्ति propitiated.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रसादिते च पवने ब्रह्मा तुभ्यं वरं ददौ। अशस्त्रवध्यतां तात समरे सत्यविक्रम।।4.66.27।।
output: 'O dear when the Windgod was pleased, Brahma gave a boon to you, to appease his anger. The boon made you truly valiant so that you cannot be struck by any weapon and killed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वज्रस्य च निपातेन विरुजं त्वां समीक्ष्य च। सहस्रनेत्रः प्रीतात्मा ददौ ते वरमुत्तमम्।।4.66.28।। स्वच्छन्दतश्च मरणं तेभूयादिति वै प्रभो।
output: 'O lord observing that you are not hurt even when struck by the thunderbolt, Indra offered, one of the best boons to you, to choose to die only when you wish.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स त्वं केसरिणः पुत्रः क्षेत्रजो भीमविक्रमः।।4.66.29।। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रस्तेजसा चापि तत्समः। त्वं हि वायुसुतो वत्स प्लवने चापि तत्समः।।4.66.30।।
output: 'You are a son of Kesari endowed with terrific strength and a lawful son of Maruta also. You are, therefore, equal to the very Windgod in flying and in brilliance.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स त्वं केसरिणः पुत्रः क्षेत्रजो भीमविक्रमः।।4.66.29।। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रस्तेजसा चापि तत्समः। त्वं हि वायुसुतो वत्स प्लवने चापि तत्समः।।4.66.30।।
output: भीमविक्रमः of terrific strength, सः त्वम् that you are, केसरिणः Kesari's, क्षेत्रजः the offspring (one of twelve sons according to Hindu scriptures), पुत्रः son, मारुतस्य Marutha's, औरसः पुत्रः lawful son, तेजसा with brilliance, तत्समश्च also equal to him, वत्स dear, वायुसुतः son of the Windgod, त्वम् you, प्लवने in flying, च अपि also, तत्समः हि equal to.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वयमद्य गतप्राणा भवान्नस्त्रातु साम्प्रतम्। दाक्ष्यविक्रमसम्पन्नः कपिराज इवापरः।।4.66.31।।
output: अद्य now, वयम् we, गतप्राणाः almost lost our life, भवान् you, साम्प्रतम् at present, त्रातु you may save us, दाक्ष्यविक्रमसम्पन्नः fully endowed with valour and courage, अपरः another, कपिराजः monkey king, इव like.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्रिविक्रमे मया तात सशैलवनकानना। त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वः पृथिवी परिक्रान्ता प्रदक्षिणम्।।4.66.32।।
output: तात dear, त्रिविक्रमे when Visnu took three strides, सशैलवनकानना with its mountains, trees and forests, पृथिवी the whole earth, मया by me, त्रिस्सप्तकृत्वः twenty one times, प्रदक्षिणम् परिक्रान्ता circumambulated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा चौषधयोऽस्माभिस्सञ्चिता देवशासनात्। निष्पन्नममृतं याभिस्तदासीन्नो महद्बलम्।।4.66.33।।
output: तदा then, देवशासनात् by the command of the gods, याभिः by those, अमृतम् nectar, निष्पन्नम् produced, ओषधयः herbs, अस्माभिः by us, सञ्चिताः are collected, तदानीम्  then, नः for us, बलम् strength, महत् great.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स इदानीमहं वृद्धः परिहीनपराक्रमः। साम्प्रतं कालमस्माकं भवान्सर्वगुणान्वितः।।4.66.34।।
output: इदानीम् as such, वृद्धः old, सः अहम् I being, परिहीनपराक्रमः my valour is depleted, साम्प्रतं कालम् at this time, भवान् you have, अस्माकम् for us, सर्वगुणान्वितः endowed with all qualities.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
तद्विजृम्भस्व विक्रान्त: प्लवतामुत्तमो ह्यसि। त्वद्वीर्यं द्रष्टुकामा हि सर्वा वानरवाहिनी।।4.66.35।।
output: 'Cheer up and advance.You are the best among the creatures that can leap.The entire army of monkeys want to see your valour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 66:
उत्तिष्ठ हरिशार्दूल लङ्घयस्व महार्णवम्। परा हि सर्वभूतानां हनुमन्या गतिस्तव।।4.66.36।।
output: 'O Hanuman, tiger among monkeys, rise up and cross this great ocean.You have that supreme capacity among all beings.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विषण्णा हरयस्सर्वे हनुमन्किमुपेक्षसे। विक्रमस्व महावेगो विष्णुस्त्रीन्विक्रमानिव।।4.66.37।।
output: 'O Hanuman All the monkeys look dejected. Why do you delay? O warrior, act quick with your rapid speed like Trivikrama who took three strides that covered the entire universe'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं दृष्ट्वा जृम्भमाणं ते क्रमितुं शतयोजनम्। वीर्येणापूर्यमाणं च सहसा वानरोत्तमम्।।4.67.1।। सहसा शोकमुत्सृज्य प्रहर्षेण समन्विताः। विनेदुस्तुष्टुवुश्चापि हनूमन्तं महाबलम्।।4.67.2।।
output: शतयोजनम् hundred yojanas, क्रमितुम् to cross, जृम्भमाणम् enlarging, सहसा at once, वीर्येण in strength, आपूर्यमाणं च and being filled, वानरोत्तमम् best of monkeys, महाबलम् a warrior of great strength, तं हनूमन्तम् he, Hanuman, दृष्ट्वा seeing, ते those monkeys, सहसा all at once, शोकम् grief, उत्सृज्य gave up, प्रहर्षेण with joy, समन्विताः endowed, विनेदुः screamed aloud, तुष्टुवुश्चापि also propitiated him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
तं दृष्ट्वा जृम्भमाणं ते क्रमितुं शतयोजनम्। वीर्येणापूर्यमाणं च सहसा वानरोत्तमम्।।4.67.1।। सहसा शोकमुत्सृज्य प्रहर्षेण समन्विताः। विनेदुस्तुष्टुवुश्चापि हनूमन्तं महाबलम्।।4.67.2।।
output: 'In order to cross a hundred yojanas, Hanuman, the best of monkeys expanded his  might and strength. Seeing him, a warrior of great strength, all the monkeys, filled with enthusiasm at once gave up grief and collected together.They rejoiced and propitiated him screaming aloud.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रहृष्टा विस्मिताश्चैव वीक्षन्ते स्म समन्ततः। त्रिविक्रमकृतोत्साहं नारायणमिव प्रजाः।।4.67.3।।
output: The monkeys collected together happily, gazing at Hanuman.They were wonderstruck to see Hanuman in that huge form, just as all beings were when they saw Lord Narayana in his incarnation of Vamana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
संस्तूयमानो हनुमान्व्यवर्धत महाबलः। समाविध्य च लाङ्गूलं हर्षाद्बलमुपेयिवान्।।4.67.4।।
output: The monkeys praised the mighty Hanuman as he grew in size whirling his tail around joyfully.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
तस्य संस्तूयमानस्य सर्वैर्वानरपुङ्गवैः। तेजसापूर्यमाणस्य रूपमासीदनुत्तमम्।।4.67.5।।
output: As Hanuman was being praised by the monkey leaders, his body filled with lustre. It looked excellent.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथा विजृम्भते सिंहो विवृद्धो गिरिगह्वरे। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रस्तथा सम्प्रति जृम्भते।।4.67.6।।
output: विवृद्धः grown, गिरिगह्वरे in a mountain cave, सिंहः lion, यथा as, विजृम्भते he stretches himself, मारुतस्य Windgod's, औरसः पुत्रः lawful son, सम्प्रति at that time, तथा like that, जृम्भते grew.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
अशोभत मुखं तस्य जृम्भमाणस्य धीमतः। अम्बरीषमिवाऽदीप्तं विधूम इव पावकः।।4.67.7।।
output: On expansion, wise Hanuman's face was bright, glowing like a burning oven and  shining like smokeless fire.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हरीणामुत्थितो मध्यात्सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः। अभिवाद्य हरीन्वृद्धान्हनुमानिदमब्रवीत्।।4.67.8।।
output: हरीणाम् from the monkeys, मध्यात् from the midst, उत्थितः he rose, सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः with the hair bristling on the body, हनुमान् Hanuman, वृद्धान् elderly, हरीन् monkeys (Jambavan), अभिवाद्य saluted reverentially, इदम् this word, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अरुजत्सर्वताग्राणि हुताशनसखोऽनिलः। बलवानप्रमेयश्च वायुराकाशगोचरः।।4.67.9।।
output: 'The Windgod is a friend of fire who is a powerful consumer of oblations. His strength is immeasurable. He wanders in the sky and shatters the mountain tops.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्याहं शीघ्रवेगस्य शीघ्रगस्य महात्मनः। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रः प्लवनेनास्मि तत्समः।।4.67.10।।
output: शीघ्रवेगस्य swiftmoving god's, शीघ्रगस्य of a swift one, महात्मनः of a great one, तस्य his, मारुतस्य Windgod's, औरसः पुत्रः lawfulson, अहम् I am, प्लवनेन in leaping, तत्समः equal to him, अस्मि I am.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्सहेयं हि विस्तीर्णमालिखन्तमिवाम्बरम्। मेरुं गिरिमसङ्गेन परिगन्तुं सहस्रशः।।4.67.11।।
output: 'I can with all enthusiasm go round the vast mount Meru a thousand times without resting on it which is as though scratching the sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाहुवेगप्रणुन्नेन सागरेणाहमुत्सहे। समाप्लावयितुं लोकं सपर्वतनदीह्रदम्।।4.67.12।।
output: 'I can submerge this world including its mountains rivers and lakes. I can push back the sea waters quickly with my arms.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ममोरुजङ्घावेगेन भविष्यति समुत्थितः। सम्मूर्च्छितमहाग्राहस्समुद्रो वरुणालयः।।4.67.13।।
output: 'Thrust by my thighs,the ocean will rise up, carrying with it the shanks and  mighty crocodiles stunned by the force.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
पन्नगाशनमाकाशे पतन्तं पक्षिसेविते। वैनतेयमहं शक्तः परिगन्तुं सहस्रशः।।4.67.14।।
output: 'I am capable of circumambulating a thousand times the great Garuda who consumes snakes and flies in the sky, the abode of birds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उदयात्प्रस्थितं वापि ज्वलन्तं रश्मिमालिनम्। अनस्तमितमादित्यमभिगन्तुं समुत्सहे।।4.67.15।। ततो भूमिमसंस्पृश्य पुनरागन्तुमुत्सहे। प्रवेगेनैव महता भीमेन प्लवगर्षभाः।।4.67.16।।
output: प्लवगर्षभाः O bull among monkeys, उदयात् from the mountain behind which the sun rises, प्रस्थितम् starts, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, रश्मिमालिनम् with rays, आदित्यम् the Sun, अनस्तमितम् before he sets, अभिगन्तुम् to approach, अहम् I, उत्सहे rise, ततः then, भूमिम् earth, अस्पृष्ट्वा without touching, भीमेन with a terrific, महता with great, प्रवेगेनैव with the same high speed, पुनः again, आगन्तुम् to return, उत्सहे I desire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
उदयात्प्रस्थितं वापि ज्वलन्तं रश्मिमालिनम्। अनस्तमितमादित्यमभिगन्तुं समुत्सहे।।4.67.15।। ततो भूमिमसंस्पृश्य पुनरागन्तुमुत्सहे। प्रवेगेनैव महता भीमेन प्लवगर्षभाः।।4.67.16।।
output: 'O bull among monkeys when the Sun rises from behind the eastern mountain it is possible for me to start with him and go to the western horizon and return before the blazing Sun with its beams of light sets. It is also possible for me to descend to  the earth with the same speed and return to the Sun without touching the earth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्सहेयमतिक्रान्तुं सर्वानाकाशगोचरान्। सागरं क्षोभयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम्।।4.67.17।।
output: 'If I rise up, I can overtake all those creatures flying in the sky and from there I can stir up the ocean and tear up the earth easily.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पर्वतांश्चूर्णयिष्यामि प्लवमानः प्लवङ्गमाः। हरिष्याम्यूरुवेगेन प्लवमानो महार्णवम्।।4.67.18।।
output: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, प्लवमानः while I leap, पर्वतान् mountains, चूर्णयिष्यामि can crush them to powder, प्लवमानः when I leap, ऊरुवेगेन with the force of my thighs, महार्णवम् vast ocean, हरिष्यामि can pull with me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लतानां विविधं पुष्पं पादपानां च सर्वशः। अनुयास्यन्ति मामद्य प्लवमानं विहायसा।।4.67.19।।
output: अद्य now, विहायसा through the sky, प्लवमानम् as I leap, माम् me, लतानाम् of creepers, पादपानां च and of trees, विविधम् many, पुष्पम् flower, सर्वशः all over, अनुयास्यन्ति will follow me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
भविष्यति हि मे पन्थास्स्वातेः पन्था इवाम्बरे। चरन्तं घोरमाकाशमुत्पतिष्यन्तमेव वा।।4.67.20।। द्रक्ष्यन्ति निपतिष्यन्तं च सर्वभूतानि वानराः।
output: 'O monkey when I fly upward in the dreadful sky or descend down, all creatures will see me, for my path will be the path of the constellation of Swati (a group of stars).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महामेरुप्रतीकाशं मां द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः।।4.67.21।। दिवमावृत्य गच्छन्तं ग्रसमानमिवाम्बरम्।
output: 'O monkeys when I fly in the sky like the great mount Meru, you will see me as if I am swallowing the sky because I will be enveloping it with my strides.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वैनतेयस्य या शक्तिर्मम सा मारुतस्य वा।।4.67.23।। ऋते सुपर्णराजानं मारुतं वा महाजवम्। न तद्भूतं प्रपश्यामि यन्मां प्लुतमनुव्रजेत्।।4.67.24।।
output: 'Only Garuda and Maruta have the capacity to fly like me. No one other than the king of vultures and the Windgod have the speed to fly like me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
वैनतेयस्य या शक्तिर्मम सा मारुतस्य वा।।4.67.23।। ऋते सुपर्णराजानं मारुतं वा महाजवम्। न तद्भूतं प्रपश्यामि यन्मां प्लुतमनुव्रजेत्।।4.67.24।।
output: 'Only Garuda and Maruta have the capacity to fly like me. No one other than the king of vultures and the Windgod have the speed to fly like me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
निमेषान्तरमात्रेण निरालम्बनमम्बरम्। सहसा निपतिष्यामि घनाद्विद्युदिवोत्थिता।।4.67.25।।
output: 'Just as the lightning generated by the clouds lands at once flying in the sky without any support I can also land in less than a moment.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बुद्ध्या चाहं प्रपश्यामि मनश्चेष्टा च मे तथा। अहं द्रक्ष्यामि वैदेहीं प्रमोदध्वं प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.67.27।।
output: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, अहम् I, बुद्ध्या with my intellect, प्रपश्यामि I can visualise, मे my, मनश्चेष्टा च my feeling in mind, तथा so also, अहम् I am, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, द्रक्ष्यामि I will see, प्रमोदध्वम् be happy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मारुतस्य समो वेगे गरुडस्य समो जवे। अयुतं योजनानां तु गमिष्यामीति मे मतिः।।4.67.28।।
output: वेगे in speed, मारुतस्य Maruta's, समः equal, जवे in rapidity, गरुडस्य Garuda's, समः equal, योजनानाम् of yojanas, अयुतम् ten thousand, गमिष्यामीति I will go, मे my, मतिः feeling.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
वासवस्य सवज्रस्य ब्रह्मणो वा स्वयम्भुवः। विक्रम्य सहसा हस्तादमृतं तदिहानये।।4.67.29।। लङ्कां वापि समुत्क्षिप्य गच्छेयमिति मे मतिः।
output: 'I think I can encounter Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt and obtain nectar from his hands. I can even confront Brahma, the selfborn creator courageously. I can even uproot Lanka and carry it.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमेवं वानरश्रेष्ठं गर्जन्तममितौजसम्।।4.67.30।। प्रहृष्टा हरयस्तत्र समुदैक्षन्त विस्मिताः।
output: The monkeys looked at him and were amazed, happy to see him roaring and shining in brilliance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ज्ञातीनां शोकनाशनम्।।4.67.31।। उवाच परिसंहृष्टो जाम्बवान्हरिसत्तमः।
output: Jambavan, the finest of the monkeys, felt very glad on hearing his words which put an end to the sorrow of the kith and kin and said:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वीर केसरिणः पुत्र हनुमान्मारुतात्मज।।4.67.32।। ज्ञातीनां विपुलश्शोकस्त्वया तात प्रणाशितः।
output: वीर O hero, केसरिणः Kesari's, पुत्र son, मारुतात्मज O son of Marutha, तात O dear, त्वया by you, ज्ञातीनाम् of the kith and kin, विपुलः profound, शोकः grief, प्रणाशितः has been removed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
तव कल्याणरुचयः कपिमुख्यास्समागताः।।4.67.33।। मङ्गलं कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं करिष्यन्ति समाहिताः।
output: तव your, कल्याणरुचयः well wishers, समागताः collected, कपिमुख्याः chiefs of monkeys, समाहिताः collected together, कार्य(अर्थ)सिद्ध्यर्थम् to achieve your objective, मङ्गलां auspicious prayers, करिष्यन्ति they will offer.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋषीणां च प्रसादेन कपिवृद्धमतेन च।।4.67.34।। गुरूणां च प्रसादेन प्लवस्व त्वं महार्णवम्।
output: ऋषीणाम् of sages, प्रसादेन by the grace, कपिवृद्धमतेन च elderly monkeys', गुरूणाम् of elderlies, प्रसादेन by grace, च and, त्वम् you, महार्णवम् vast ocean, प्लवस्य cross.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्थास्यामश्चैकपादेन यावदागमनं तव।।4.67.35।। त्वद्गतानि च सर्वेषां जीवनानि वनौकसाम्।
output: तव your, आगमनं यावत् awaiting your arrival, एकपादेन on one foot, स्थास्यामः we will stand, सर्वेषाम् of all of us, वनौकसाम् of forestdwellers, जीवनानि lives, त्वद्गतानि will depend upon you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
ततस्तु हरिशार्दूलस्तानुवाच वनौकसः।।4.67.36।। नेयं मम मही वेगं लङ्घने धारयिष्यति।
output: Then the tiger among monkeys, Hanuman said to those forestdwellers (monkeys), 'The earth cannot bear the thrust of my leaping.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
एतानीह नगस्यास्य शिलासङ्कटशालिनः।।4.67.37।। शिखराणि महेन्द्रस्य स्थिराणि सुमहान्ति च।
output: 'The rocks on the peaks of the ranges of mount Mahendra cannot with stand it, although they are huge and firm.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
एषु वेगं करिष्यामि महेन्द्रशिखरेष्वहम्।।4.67.38।। नानाद्रुमविकीर्णेषु धातुनिष्यन्दशोभिषु।
output: 'I will pick up speed on the peaks of mount Mahendra filled with different kinds of trees and minerals.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतानि मम निष्पेषं पादयोः प्लवतां वराः।।4.67.39।। प्लवतो धारयिष्यन्ति योजनानामितश्शतम्।
output: 'O great monkeys these mountain peaks can withstand the crushing force of my feet as I leap over a hundred yojanas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
ततस्तं मारुतप्रख्यस्सहरिर्मारुतात्मजः।।4.67.40।। आरुरोह नगश्रेष्ठं महेन्द्रमरिमर्दनः। वृतं नानाविधैः वृक्षैर्मृगसेवितशाद्वलम्।।4.67.41।। लताकुसुमसम्बाधं नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमम्। सिंहशार्दूलचरितं मत्तमातङ्गसेवितम्।।4.67.42।। मत्तद्विजगणोद्घुष्टं सलिलोत्पीडसङ्कुलम्।
output: The son of Maruta, who was as eminent as the Windgod, the crusher of enemies ascended the great mountain Mahendra, full of grassland inhabited by deer, thickly grown with various trees and creepers full of fragrant flowers and fruits, where roam lions and tigers and proud elephants, a place that echoes with sounds of intoxicated birds and waterfalls.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तं मारुतप्रख्यस्सहरिर्मारुतात्मजः।।4.67.40।। आरुरोह नगश्रेष्ठं महेन्द्रमरिमर्दनः। वृतं नानाविधैः वृक्षैर्मृगसेवितशाद्वलम्।।4.67.41।। लताकुसुमसम्बाधं नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमम्। सिंहशार्दूलचरितं मत्तमातङ्गसेवितम्।।4.67.42।। मत्तद्विजगणोद्घुष्टं सलिलोत्पीडसङ्कुलम्।
output: ततः then, मारुतप्रख्यः as eminent as the Windgod, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, अरिमर्दनः crusher of enemies, सः हरिः that monkey, नानाविधैः with several, वृक्षैः  trees, वृतम् covered, मृगसेवितशाद्वलम् grassy land inhabited by deer, लताकुसुमसम्बाधम् filled with creepers and fragrant flowers, नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमम् ever with trees full of flowers and fruits, सिंहशार्दूलचरितं where lions and tigers move, मत्तमातङ्गसेवितम् inhabited by proud elephants, मत्तद्विजगणोद्घुष्टम् filled with flocks of intoxicated birds, सलिलोत्पीडसङ्कुलम् full of water falls, नगश्रेष्ठम् great mountain, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra, आरुरोह ascended.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तं मारुतप्रख्यस्सहरिर्मारुतात्मजः।।4.67.40।। आरुरोह नगश्रेष्ठं महेन्द्रमरिमर्दनः। वृतं नानाविधैः वृक्षैर्मृगसेवितशाद्वलम्।।4.67.41।। लताकुसुमसम्बाधं नित्यपुष्पफलद्रुमम्। सिंहशार्दूलचरितं मत्तमातङ्गसेवितम्।।4.67.42।। मत्तद्विजगणोद्घुष्टं सलिलोत्पीडसङ्कुलम्।
output: The son of Maruta, who was as eminent as the Windgod, the crusher of enemies ascended the great mountain Mahendra, full of grassland inhabited by deer, thickly grown with various trees and creepers full of fragrant flowers and fruits, where roam lions and tigers and proud elephants, a place that echoes with sounds of intoxicated birds and waterfalls.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महद्भिरुच्छ्रितं शृङ्गैर्महेन्द्रं स महाबलः।।4.67.43।। विचचार हरिश्रेष्ठो महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः।
output: The mighty, preeminent monkey who was equal to Indra in valour took a leap from the high peaks of the tall mountain, Mahendra৷৷

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पादाभ्यां पीडितस्तेन महाशैलो महात्मना।।4.67.44।। रराज सिंहाभिहतो महान्मत्त इव द्विपः।
output: महात्मना by great self, तेन by him, बाहुभ्याम् with both his shoulders, पीडितः crushed, महाशैलः mighty mountain, सिंहाभिहतः struck by a lion, मत्तः proud, महान् great, द्विपः इव like an elephant, रराज looked.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुमोच सलिलोत्पीडान्विप्रकीर्णशिलोच्चयः।।4.67.45।। वित्रस्तमृगमातङ्गः प्रकम्पितमहाद्रुमः।
output: The rocks of the mountain got scattered by the force. The deer and elephants were terrified. The trees were shaken up violently and streams of water gushed forth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नानागन्धर्वमिथुनैः पानसंसर्गकर्कशैः।।4.67.46।। उत्पतद्भिश्च विहगैर्विद्याधरगणैरपि। त्यज्यमानमहासानुस्सन्निलीनमहोरगः।।4.67.47।। चलशृङ्गशिलोद्घातस्तदाऽभूत्स महागिरिः।
output: तदा then, सः महागिरिः that great mountain, पानसंसर्गकर्कशैः by those whose behaviour was rough in a drunken state, नानागन्धर्वमिथुनैः by different groups of copulating gandharvas, उत्पतद्भि: by those flying, विहगैश्च by birds in the sky, विद्याधरगणैरपि hosts of vidyadharas, त्यज्यमानमहासानुः abandoned by the vast mountain slopes, सन्निलीनमहोरगः with serpents resting, चलशृङ्गशिलोद्घातः the rocks shaken up on mountain tops, अभूत् appeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
नानागन्धर्वमिथुनैः पानसंसर्गकर्कशैः।।4.67.46।। उत्पतद्भिश्च विहगैर्विद्याधरगणैरपि। त्यज्यमानमहासानुस्सन्निलीनमहोरगः।।4.67.47।। चलशृङ्गशिलोद्घातस्तदाऽभूत्स महागिरिः।
output: Shaken by the rude shock, couples of intoxicated gandharvas left in a huff the vast slopes of the great mountain. Flocks of birds and groups of vidyadharas flew away. The serpents went into hiding. Rocks fell off the shaken mountain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निश्श्वसद्भिस्तदाऽर्तैस्तु भुजङ्गैरर्धनि:सृतैः।।4.67.48।। सपताक इवाभाति स तदा धरणीधरः।
output: तदा then, सः that, धरणीधरः holder of the earth, mountain, निश्वसद्भि: hissing out of the rocks, अर्धनि:सृतैः protruding half of their body, भुजगैः serpents, सपताकः इव like the flags, आभाति appeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
ऋषिभिस्त्राससम्भ्रान्तैस्त्यज्यमानः शिलोच्चयः।।4.67.49।। सीदन्महति कान्तारे सार्थहीन इवाध्वगः।
output: The alarmed and agitated sages abandonned the mountain peaks.The mountain appeared like a lone traveller separated from the caravan in the great forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Kishkindha Kanda, Sarga 67:
सवेगवान् वेगसमाहितात्मा हरिप्रवीरः परवीरहन्ता। मनस्समाधाय महानुभावो जगाम लङ्कां मनसा मनस्वी।।4.67.50।।
output: Magnanimous, wise and heroic Hanuman, destroyer of enemy warriors, fixed his attention on speed, betook himself mentally to Lanka (ere he reached it physically). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामाणये वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyseventh sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
ततो रावणनीतायाः सीतायाः शत्रुकर्शनः। इयेष पदमन्वेष्टुं चारणाचरिते पथि।।5.1.1।।
output: Hanuman, crusher of enemies resolved to find the whereabouts of Sita, carried away by Ravana. He followed the path of the Charanas, celestial bards.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दुष्करं निष्प्रतिद्वन्द्वं चिकीर्षन् कर्म वानरः। समुदग्रशिरोग्रीवो गवांपतिरिवाबभौ।।5.1.2।।
output: वानरः vanara, दुष्करम् formidable, निष्प्रतिद्वन्द्वम् which could not be challenged, चिकीर्षन् intending to (cross), समुदग्रशिरोग्रीवः raised his head and neck, गवां पतिः इव like the best of bulls, बभौ appeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथ वैडूर्यवर्णेषु शाद्वलेषु महाबलः। धीरः सलिलकल्पेषु विचचार यथासुखम्।।5.1.3।।
output: अथ then, महाबलः mighty, धीरः calm, वैडूर्यवर्णेषु of the colour of vaidurya (tawny), सलिलकल्पेषु on the sheet of water (marshy land with green grass that looked like sheet of water), शाद्वलेषु on green grassy lands, यथासुखम् very easily, विचचार strdled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
द्विजान् वित्रासयन् धीमानुरसा पादपान् हरन्। मृगांश्च सुबहून्निघ्नन् प्रवृद्ध इव केसरी।।5.1.4।।
output: Wise Hanuman went about like a lion scaring away birds, uprooting trees with his chest, and trampling many animals.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नीललोहितमांजिष्ठपत्रवर्णैः सितासितैः। स्वभावविहितैश्चित्रैर्धातुभिः समलङ्कृतम्।।5.1.5।। कामरूपिभिराविष्टमभीक्ष्णं सपरिच्छदैः। यक्षकिन्नरगन्धर्वैर्देवकल्पैश्च पन्नगैः।।5.1.6।।
output: नीललोहितमांजिष्ठपत्रवर्णैः blue, red, yellow and green coloured, सितासितैः as well as with white and black colours, स्वभावविहितैः in their natural state, चित्रैः by wonderful ones, धातुभिः with minerals, समलङ्कृतम् decorated all over, कामरूपिभिः by those who take any form at free will, सपरिच्छदैः  all surrounded by their retinue, यक्षकिन्नरगन्धर्वैः by yakshas, kinneras and gandharvas,अभीक्ष्णम् very much, आविष्टम् occupied, र्देवकल्पैश्च resembling gods, पन्नगैः by nagas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नीललोहितमांजिष्ठपत्रवर्णैः सितासितैः। स्वभावविहितैश्चित्रैर्धातुभिः समलङ्कृतम्।।5.1.5।। कामरूपिभिराविष्टमभीक्ष्णं सपरिच्छदैः। यक्षकिन्नरगन्धर्वैर्देवकल्पैश्च पन्नगैः।।5.1.6।।
output: नीललोहितमांजिष्ठपत्रवर्णैः blue, red, yellow and green coloured, सितासितैः as well as with white and black colours, स्वभावविहितैः in their natural state, चित्रैः by wonderful ones, धातुभिः with minerals, समलङ्कृतम् decorated all over, कामरूपिभिः by those who take any form at free will, सपरिच्छदैः  all surrounded by their retinue, यक्षकिन्नरगन्धर्वैः by yakshas, kinneras and gandharvas,अभीक्ष्णम् very much, आविष्टम् occupied, र्देवकल्पैश्च resembling gods, पन्नगैः by nagas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तस्य गिरिवर्यस्य तले नागवरायुते। तिष्ठन् कपिवरस्तत्र ह्रदे नाग इवाबभौ।।5.1.7।।
output: सः that, कपिवरः leader of monkeys, तत्र there, नागवरायुते with lordly elephants, तस्य गिरिवर्यस्य at the great mountain, तले foot, तिष्ठन् stood, ह्रदे centre, नागः इव like elephant, अबभौ looked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
स सूर्याय महेन्द्राय पवनाय स्वयंभुवे। भूतेभ्यश्चाञ्जलिं कृत्वा चकार गमने मतिम्।।5.1.8।।
output: Offering salutations with folded palms to the Sungod, to Mahendra, lord of the gods, to the windgod, to the Creator Brahma and to all the attendants of lord Siva, made up his mind to proceed (to Lanka).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अञ्जलिं प्राङ्मुखः कुर्वन् पवनायात्मयोनये। ततो हि ववृधे गन्तुं दक्षिणो दक्षिणां दिशम्।।5.1.9।।
output: प्राङ्मुखः facing the east, आत्मयोनये his father, पवनाय windgod, अञ्जलिम् salutations with folded palms, कृत्वा having offered, ततः then, दक्षिण with equanimity, दक्षिणां दिशम् southern direction, गन्तुम् to depart, ववृधे हि grew in size.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
