प्लवङ्गप्रवरैर्दृष्टः प्लवने कृतनिश्चयः। ववृधे रामवृद्ध्यर्थं समुद्र इव पर्वसु।।5.1.10।।
output: Having made up his mind to leap for the cause of Rama, Hanuman began to grow in size just as the sea grows during the fullmoon and newmoon days, while the monkey troops were watching.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निष्प्रमाणशरीरः सन् लिलङ्घयिषुरर्णवम्। बाहुभ्यां पीडयामास चरणाभ्यां च पर्वतम्।।5.1.11।।
output: अर्णवम् ocean, लिलङ्घयिषुः one wishing to cross over, निष्प्रमाणशरीरः having an immeasurable figure, सन् while being, बाहुभ्याम् with both his arms, चरणाभ्यां च and with feet, पर्वतम् mountain, पीडयामास pressed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स चचालाचलश्चापि मुहूर्तं कपिपीडितः। तरूणां पुष्पिताग्राणां सर्वं पुष्पमशातयत्।।5.1.12।।
output: Pressed firmly by Hanuman, the mountain was shaken for a moment which caused the flowers to drop down from the tree tops.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेन पादपमुक्तेन पुष्पौघेण सुगन्धिना। सर्वतः संवृतः शैलो बभौ पुष्पमयो यथा।।5.1.13।।
output: शैलः the mountain, पादपमुक्तेन by those dropped down from the trees, सुगन्धिना full of fragrance, पुष्पौघेण heap of flowers, सर्वतः all over, संवृतः covered, यथा like, बभौ appeared, पुष्पमय: made of flowers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तेन चोत्तमवीर्येण पीड्यमानः स पर्वतः। सलिलं सम्प्रसुस्राव मदं मत्त इव द्विपः।।5.1.14।।
output: The mountain pressed hard under the feet of the valiant (Hanuman), discharged streams of water just as an elephant in rut would exude water of intoxication.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पीड्यमानस्तु बलिना महेन्द्रस्तेन पर्वतः। रीतीर्निर्वर्तयामास काञ्चनाञ्जनराजतीः।।5.1.15।।
output: Pressed by the powerful Hanuman, mount Mahendra let out streams of the hue of gold and silver (containing the ores of these minerals)৷৷

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुमोच च शिलाः शैलो विशालाः समनःशिलाः। मध्यमेनार्चिषा जुष्टा धूमराजीरिवानलः।।5.1.16।।
output: The mountain threw down big boulders along with sulphur just like fire emits columns of smoke, surrounded by flames.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गिरिणा पीड्यमानेन पीड्यमानानि सर्वतः। गुहाविष्टानि भूतानि विनेदुर्विकृतैः स्वरैः।।5.1.17।।
output: गुहाविष्टानि of the caves, भूतानि creatures, पीड्यमानेन being pressed, गिरिणा by the mountain, सर्वतः all over, पीड्यमानानि on account of pressing, विकृतैः with horrible, स्वरैः voices, विनेदुः shrieked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
स महासत्त्वसन्नादः शैलपीडानिमित्तजः। पृथिवीं पूरयामास दिशश्चोपवनानि च।।5.1.18।।
output: Due to the crushing of the mountain, a loud noise of the various creatures shot up filling the earth in all directions and groves around.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शिरोभिः पृथुभिः सर्पा व्यक्तस्वस्तिकलक्षणैः। वमन्तः पावकं घोरं ददंशुर्दशनैः शिलाः।।5.1.19।।
output: सर्पाः snakes, व्यक्तस्वस्तिकलक्षणैः with signs of swastika marks, पृथुभिः by wide ones, शिरोभिः with hoods, घोरम् terrible, पावकम् fire, वमन्तः poured out, दशनैः with fangs, शिलाः ददंशुः bit the rocks.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तास्तदा सविषैर्दष्टाः कुपितैस्तैर्महाशिलाः। जज्ज्वलुः पावकोद्दीप्ता बिभिदुश्च सहस्रधा।।5.1.20।।
output: Bitten by the venomous and angry snakes, the mountain was broken into a thousand pieces by the blazing flames.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
यानि चौषधजालानि तस्मिन् जातानि पर्वते। विषघ्नान्यपि नागानां न शेकुः शमितुं विषम्।।5.1.21।।
output: Even the medicinal herbs grown on the mountain could not neutralize the effect of the poison of snakes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
भिद्यतेऽयं गिरिर्भूतैरिति मत्त्वा तपस्विनः। त्रस्ता विद्याधरास्तस्मादुत्पेतुः स्त्री गणैः सह।।5.1.22।। पानभूमिगतं हित्वा हैममासवभाजनम्। पात्राणि च महार्हाणि करकांश्च हिरण्मयान्।।5.1.23। लेह्यानुच्चावचान् भक्ष्यान् मांसानि विविधानि च। आर्षभाणि च चर्माणि खडगांश्च कनकत्सरून्।।5.1.24।।
output: Even the ascetics left the place approaching that the mountain would be broken into pieces by creatures. The alarmed vidyadharas leaped into the sky along with groups of their women, leaving behind golden jugs of wine as well as precious utensils, big and small sizes, and golden goblets, cups in the drinking place, as well as many tasty eatables like licking food, chewing food and many types of meat. They also left bullhides and swords with golden sheaths.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भिद्यतेऽयं गिरिर्भूतैरिति मत्त्वा तपस्विनः। त्रस्ता विद्याधरास्तस्मादुत्पेतुः स्त्री गणैः सह।।5.1.22।। पानभूमिगतं हित्वा हैममासवभाजनम्। पात्राणि च महार्हाणि करकांश्च हिरण्मयान्।।5.1.23। लेह्यानुच्चावचान् भक्ष्यान् मांसानि विविधानि च। आर्षभाणि च चर्माणि खडगांश्च कनकत्सरून्।।5.1.24।।
output: अयम् this, गिरिः mountain, भूतैः by creatures, भिद्यते broken, इति thus, मत्त्वा after, तपस्विनः ascetics, उत्पेतुः jumped up, विद्याधराः Vidyadharas, त्रस्ताः terrified, पानभूमिगतम् from the drinking places, हैमम् golden, आसवभाजनम् drinking cups, महार्हाणि valuable ones, करकांश्च goblets, उच्चावचान् various big and small ones, लेह्यान् food that is licked, भक्ष्यान् eatables, विविधानि of many kinds, मांसानि meat, आर्षभाणि of oxen, चर्माणि animal hides, कनकत्सरून् covered with golden sheaths, खडगांश्च swords, हित्वा after, स्त्रीगणैः सह along with groups of women, तस्मात् from that place, उत्पेतुः flew away.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भिद्यतेऽयं गिरिर्भूतैरिति मत्त्वा तपस्विनः। त्रस्ता विद्याधरास्तस्मादुत्पेतुः स्त्री गणैः सह।।5.1.22।। पानभूमिगतं हित्वा हैममासवभाजनम्। पात्राणि च महार्हाणि करकांश्च हिरण्मयान्।।5.1.23। लेह्यानुच्चावचान् भक्ष्यान् मांसानि विविधानि च। आर्षभाणि च चर्माणि खडगांश्च कनकत्सरून्।।5.1.24।।
output: अयम् this, गिरिः mountain, भूतैः by creatures, भिद्यते broken, इति thus, मत्त्वा after, तपस्विनः ascetics, उत्पेतुः jumped up, विद्याधराः Vidyadharas, त्रस्ताः terrified, पानभूमिगतम् from the drinking places, हैमम् golden, आसवभाजनम् drinking cups, महार्हाणि valuable ones, करकांश्च goblets, उच्चावचान् various big and small ones, लेह्यान् food that is licked, भक्ष्यान् eatables, विविधानि of many kinds, मांसानि meat, आर्षभाणि of oxen, चर्माणि animal hides, कनकत्सरून् covered with golden sheaths, खडगांश्च swords, हित्वा after, स्त्रीगणैः सह along with groups of women, तस्मात् from that place, उत्पेतुः flew away.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृतकण्ठगुणाः क्षीबा रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनाः। रक्ताक्षाः पुष्कराक्षाश्च गगनं प्रतिपेदिरे।।5.1.25।।
output: कृतकण्ठगुणाः wearing chains, क्षीबाः intoxicated ones, रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनाः wearing garlands and smearing with red unguents (sandalpaste), रक्ताक्षाः with red eyes, पुष्कराक्षाश्च with lotus like eyes, गगनम् to the sky, प्रतिपेदिरे flew into the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हारनूपुरकेयूरपारिहार्यधराः स्त्रियः। विस्मिताः सस्मितास्तस्थुराकाशे रमणैः सह।।5.1.26।।
output: हारनूपुरकेयूरपारिहार्यधराः wearing necklaces, anklets and armlets, स्त्रियः women, विस्मिताः wonderstruck, सस्मिताः gently  smiling, रमणैः सह with their lovers, आकाशे in the sky, तस्थुः stayed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
दर्शयन्तो महाविद्यां विद्याधरमहर्षयः। सहितास्तस्थुराकाशे वीक्षाञ्चक्रुश्च पर्वतम्।।5.1.27।।
output: The seers among the Vidyadharas, proficient in different fields of knowledge were also watching the mountain from the sky along with others.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुश्रुवुश्च तदा शब्दमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम्। चारणानां च सिद्धानां स्थितानां विमलेऽम्बरे।।5.1.28।।
output: Then the vidyadharas heard the words of praise(of Hanuman) by the sages, seekers of the ultimate truth, the charanas and the siddhas who stood and watched in the clear sky:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एष पर्वतसङ्काशो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः। तितीर्षति महावेगस्समुद्रं मकरालयम्।।5.1.29।।
output: "Hanuman the son of the Windgod, who is like a mountain, with extraordinary might  intends to cross the ocean, the abode of crocodiles".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामार्थं वानरार्थं च चिकीर्षन् कर्म दुष्करम्। समुद्रस्य परं पारं दुष्प्रापं प्राप्तुमिच्छति।।5.1.30।।
output: "For the sake of Rama and the vanaras he wants to reach the other shore of the ocean, which is difficult, and indeed impossible".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
इति विद्याधराः श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां महात्मनाम्। तमप्रमेयं ददृशुः पर्वते वानरर्षभम्।।5.1.31।।
output: The vidyadharas heard the sages speaking in that manner on the mountain. They beheld Hanuman, the bull among vanaras, whose strength  was beyond measure.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
दुधुवे च स रोमाणि चकम्पे चाचलोपमः। ननाद सुमहानादं सुमहानिव तोयदः।।5.1.32।।
output: Hanuman, huge as a mountain moved his body and shook the hair on his body, thundering like a cloud.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आनुपूर्व्येण वृत्तं च लाङ्गूलं लोमभिश्चितम्। उत्पतिष्यन् विचिक्षेप पक्षिराज इवोरगम्।।5.1.33।।
output: उत्पतिष्यन् ready to take off, आनुपूर्व्येण in an order, वृत्तम् covered, लोमभिः with hair, चितम् full of, लाङ्गूलम् tail, पक्षिराजः king of birds, उरगं इव like a serpent, विचिक्षेप shook, cast down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य लाङ्गूलमाविद्धमात्तवेगस्य पृष्ठतः। ददृशे गरुडेनेव ह्रियमाणो महोरगः।।5.1.34।।
output: आत्तवेगस्य of great, तस्य his, पृष्ठतः at the back, अविद्धम् curled, लाङ्गूलम् tail, गरुडेन by Garuda, ह्रियमाणः carried off, महोरगः इव like a big serpent, ददृशे appeared.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाहू संस्तम्भयामास महापरिघसन्निभौ। ससाद च कपिः कट्यां चरणौ सञ्चुकोच च।।5.1.35।।
output: The monkey fixed his arms, looking like iron clubs, firmly on the mountain and crouched his waist and contracted his feet.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
संहृत्य च भुजौ श्रीमांस्तथैव च शिरोधराम्। तेजः सत्त्वं तथा वीर्यमाविवेश स वीर्यवान्।।5.1.36।।
output: The glorious and courageous Hanuman his head and shoulders contracted, summoned up all his energy and vigour.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मार्गमालोकयन्दूरादूर्ध्वं प्रणिहितेक्षणः। रुरोध हृदये प्राणानाकाशमवलोकयन्।।5.1.37।।
output: Having cast his eyes upward in order to view the distance and direction in which he had to leap, he restrained his breath in the chest while looking at the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पद्भ्यां दृढमवस्थानं कृत्वा स कपिकुञ्जरः। निकुञ्च्य कर्णौ हनुमानुत्पतिष्यन् महाबलः।। वानरान् वानरश्रेष्ठ इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।5.1.38।।
output: कपिकुञ्जरः an elephant among monkeys, महाबलः very strong one, वानरश्रेष्ठः best of vanaras, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, पद्भ्याम् feet, दृढम् firmly, अवस्थानम् standing in that position, कृत्वा did, कर्णौ ears, निकुञ्च्य contracted, उत्पतिष्यन् while preparing to leap, वानरान् vanaras, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथा राघवनिर्मुक्तः शरः श्वसनविक्रमः। गच्छेत्तद्वद्गमिष्यामि लङ्कां रावणपालिताम्।।5.1.39।।
output: राघवनिर्मुक्तः released by Raghava, शरः arrow, यथा similar manner, गच्छेत् goes, तद्वत् like that, श्वसनविक्रमः with the speed of wind, रावणपालिताम् governed by Ravana, लङ्काम् Lanka, गमिष्यामि I will reach.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
न हि द्रक्ष्यामि यदि तां लङ्कायां जनकात्मजाम्। अनेनैव हि वेगेन गमिष्यामि सुरालयम्।।5.1.40।।
output: "If I am not able to find the  daughter of Janaka at Lanka I will go to heaven, abode of the gods, with the same speed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
यदि वा त्रिदिवे सीतां न द्रक्ष्याम्यकृतश्रमः। बद्ध्वा राक्षसराजानमानयिष्यामि रावणम्।।5.1.41।।
output: "If I do not find Sita in heaven in spite of my efforts, I will bind that king of demons, Ravana and bring him here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
सर्वथा कृतकार्योऽहमेष्यामि सह सीतया। आनयिष्यामि वा लङ्कां समुत्पाट्य सरावणाम्।।5.1.42।।
output: "I will, by all means return successful with Sita or else I will uproot Lanka along with Ravana and bring him here".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा तु हनुमान्वानरान्वानरोत्तमः।।5.1.43।। उत्पपाताथ वेगेन वेगवानविचारयन्। सुपर्णमिव चात्मानं मेने स कपिकुञ्जरः।।5.1.44।।
output: Having thus addressed the monkeys the foremost of vanaras,Hanuman endowed with great speed leaped without any exertion. The elephant among monkeys felt like Garuda.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
एवमुक्त्वा तु हनुमान्वानरान्वानरोत्तमः।।5.1.43।। उत्पपाताथ वेगेन वेगवानविचारयन्। सुपर्णमिव चात्मानं मेने स कपिकुञ्जरः।।5.1.44।।
output: Having thus addressed the monkeys the foremost of vanaras,Hanuman endowed with great speed leaped without any exertion. The elephant among monkeys felt like Garuda.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
समुत्पतति तस्मिंस्तु वेगात्ते नगरोहिणः। संहृत्य विटपान् सर्वान् समुत्पेतुः समन्ततः।।5.1.45।।
output: When he took off, numerous trees on the mountain drawing together the branches all over flew along with him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स मत्तकोयष्टिमकान् पादपान् पुष्पशालिनः। उद्वहन्नूरुवेगेन जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे।।5.1.46।।
output: He swept away the lapwings in heat on the blossoms of the trees by the speed of his thighs while he coursed through the cloudless sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऊरुवेगोद्धता वृक्षा मुहूर्तं कपिमन्वयुः। प्रस्थितं दीर्घमध्वानं स्वबन्धुमिव बान्धवाः।।5.1.47।।
output: Swept away by the force of his thighs, the trees bent forward following him for a while just as relatives accompany their kith and kin on long travel.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमूरुवेगोन्मथिताः सालाश्चान्ये नगोत्तमाः। अनुजग्मुर्हनूमन्तं सैन्या इव महीपतिम्।।5.1.48।।
output: Uprooted by the force of Hanuman's thighs,great trees like  sala followed him just like the troops follow the king.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
सुपुष्पिताग्रैर्बहुभिः पादपैरन्वितः कपिः। हनुमान् पर्वताकारो बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः।।5.1.49।।
output: With numerous trees laden with flowers following him, Hanuman who looked like a mountain, presented a queer spectable.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
सारवन्तोऽथ ये वृक्षा न्यमज्जन् लवणाम्भसि। भयादिव महेन्द्रस्य पर्वता वरुणालये।।5.1.50।।
output: Then the huge trees sank into the ocean of salt water even as mountains did, afraid of Indra's (thunderbolt).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स नानाकुसुमैः कीर्णः कपिः साङ्कुरकोरकैः। शुशुभे मेघसङ्काशः खद्योतैरिव पर्वतः।।5.1.51।।
output: Covered with tender sprouts and buds of different kinds of flowers Hanuman shone brightly like a flying mountain with fireflies.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विमुक्तास्तस्य वेगेन मुक्त्वा पुष्पाणि ते द्रुमाः। अवशीर्यन्त सलिले निवृत्ताः सुहृदो यथा।।5.1.52।।
output: तस्य his, वेगेन speed, विमुक्ताः released, ते द्रुमाः those trees, पुष्पाणि flowers, मुक्त्वा  having dropped, निवृत्ताः returning, सुहृदो यथा like friends, सलिले water, अवशीर्यन्त fallen into water.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लघुत्वेनोपपन्नं तद्विचित्रं सागरेऽपतत्। द्रुमाणां विविधं पुष्पं कपिवायुसमीरितम्।।5.1.53।। ताराचितमिवाकाशं प्रबभौ स महार्णवः।
output: लघुत्वेन being light, उपपन्नम् risen up, विचित्रम् colourful, कपिवायुसमीरितम् driven by the wind caused by the speed of Hanuman, द्रुमाणाम् of the trees, तत् there, विविधम् various, पुष्पम् flowers, सागरे in the ocean, अपतत् fell, महार्णवः ocean, ताराचितम् filled with stars, आकाशमिव like the sky, प्रबभौ सः glowing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुष्पौघेणानुबद्धेन नानावर्णेन वानरः। बभौ मेघ इवाकाशे विद्युद्गण विभूषितः।।5.1.54।।
output: Covered with blossoms of different kinds and colours, Hanuman looked like a cloud brightened by lightnings in the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तस्य वेगसमाधूतैः पुष्पैस्तोयमदृश्यत।।5.1.55।। ताराभिरभिरामाभिरुदिताभिरिवाम्बरम्।
output: The seawater looked splendid with flowers dropped by dint of his speed. It  resembled the firmament spangled with enchanting stars just risen in the sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्याम्बरगतौ बाहू ददृशाते प्रसारितौ।।5.1.56।। पर्वताग्राद्विनिष्क्रान्तौ पञ्चास्याविव पन्नगौ।
output: That great Vanara appeared as if he was gulping the entire ocean with its rising waves. While he was looking upward it appeared as though he was keen to drink in the sea as well.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पिबन्निव बभौ चापि सोर्मिमालं महार्णवम्।।5.1.57।। पिपासुरिव चाकाशं ददृशे स महाकपिः।
output: सः that, महाकपिः great vanara, सोर्मिमालम् with its rising waves, महार्णवम् ocean, पिबन्निव as if gulping, बभौ looked, आकाशम् sky, च and , अपि also, पिपासुरिव as if thirsty, ददृशे looked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तस्य विद्युत्प्रभाकारे वायुमार्गानुसारिणः।।5.1.58।। नयने विप्रकाशेते पर्वतस्थाविवानलौ।
output: As he was moving in the sky following the direction of the wind, his eyes blazed like two fires burning on the mountain, flashing like lightning.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पिङ्गे पिङ्गाक्षमुख्यस्य बृहती परिमण्डले।।5.1.59।। चक्षुषी सम्प्राकाशेते चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ।
output: The large, round, reddishbrown eyes of Hanuman shed their bright light like the rising Moon and Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुखं नासिकया तस्य ताम्रया ताम्रमाबभौ।।5.1.60।। सन्ध्यया समभिस्पृष्टं यथा तत्सूर्यमण्डलम्।
output: By the reflection of his copperyred nose, his face looked red like the Sun's orb coming close at twilight.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लाङ्गूलं च समाविद्धं प्लवमानस्य शोभते।।5.1.61।। अम्बरे वायुपुत्रस्य शक्रध्वज इवोच्छ्रितम्।
output: अम्बरे in the sky, प्लवमानस्य when he was flying, वायुपुत्रस्य of the son of the Windgod, समाविद्धम् installed, लाङ्गूलम् tail, उच्छ्रितं lifted up (in the air), शक्रध्वजः इव like the flag staff of Indra, शोभते looks splendid.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लाङ्गूलचक्रेण महान् शुक्लदंष्ट्रोऽनिलात्मजः।।5.1.62।। व्यरोचत महाप्राज्ञः परिवेषीव भास्करः।
output: शुक्लदंष्ट्रः whiteteethed, महाप्राज्ञः very wise, महान् great, अनिलात्मजः son of the Windgod, लाङ्गूलचक्रेण  curled up tail, परिवेषी surrounded, भास्करः इव like the Sun, व्यरोचत halo

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
स्फिग्देशेनाभिताम्रेण रराज स महाकपिः।।5.1.63।। महता दारितेनेव गिरिर्गैरिकधातुना।
output: The great monkey with copperred buttocks (other parts being dark) looked splendid like a cleft mountain with a huge deposit of minerals shining red.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य वानरसिंहस्य प्लवमानस्य सागरम्।।5.1.64।। कक्षान्तरगतो वायुर्जीमूत इव गर्जति।
output: The wind passing through the arm pits of the lionlike vanara crossing the ocean sounded like a thundering cloud.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
खे यथा निपतत्युल्का ह्युत्तरान्ताद्विनिःसृता।।5.1.65।। दृश्यते सानुबन्धा च तथा स कपिकुञ्जरः।
output: The elephantlike monkey was seen darting across the ocean(going from north to south) like a meteor risen in the north  along with its tailend falling down the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
पतत्पतङ्गसङ्काशो व्यायतः शुशुभे कपिः।।5.1.66।। प्रवृद्ध इव मातङ्गः कक्ष्यया बध्यमानया।
output: The vanara expanded into an enormous size form appeared as though moving like the setting Sun. He looked like a huge elephant bound round the waist.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपरिष्टाच्छरीरेण छायया चावगाढया।।5.1.67।। सागरे मारुताविष्टा नौरिवासीत्तदा कपिः।
output: तदा then, कपि: vanara, उपरिष्टात् the top, शरीरेण with his body, सागरे in the ocean, अवगाढया reflected, छायया च  shadow also, मारुताविष्टा swept by the wind, नौरिव like the ship, आसीत् appeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यं यं देशं समुद्रस्य जगाम स महाकपिः। स स तस्योरुवेगेन सोन्माद इव लक्ष्यते।।5.1.68।।
output: सः that, महाकपिः great vanara, समुद्रस्य of the ocean, यं यं देशं to whichever place, जगाम went, सः सः those, तस्य his, ऊरुवेगेन by the speed of his thighs, सोन्मादः इव riotous with eddies, whirlpools and revolving foam etc.like, लक्ष्यते was seen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सागरस्योर्मिजालानामुरसा शैलवर्ष्मणाम्। अभिघ्नंस्तु महावेगः पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः।।5.1.69।।
output: महावेगः very swift, सः that, महाकपिः great vanara, शैलवर्ष्मणाम् as mountains, सागरस्य of the ocean, ऊर्मिजालानाम् the rows of waves, उरसा by his chest, अभिघ्नन् while dashing against, पुप्लुवे flew.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कपिवातश्च बलवान् मेघवातश्च निःसृतः। सागरं भीमनिर्घोषं कम्पयामासतुर्भृशम्।।5.1.70।।
output: बलवान् forceful, कपिवातश्च wind generated by the swift movement of the monkey, निःसृतः rushing towards, मेघवातश्च and the wind of the clouds, भीम निर्घोषम् creating dreadful sounds, सागरम् ocean, भृशम् violently, कम्पयामासतुः both started agitating.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विकर्षन्नूर्मिजालानि बृहन्ति लवणाम्भसि। पुप्लुवे कपिशार्दूलो विकिरन्निव रोदसी।।5.1.71।।
output: कपिशार्दूलः a tiger among vanaras, लवणाम्भसि the saltwater ocean, बृहन्ति many, ऊर्मिजालानि mighty waves of the ocean, विकर्षन् pulling across, रोदसी the intermediary space (अन्तरिक्ष), विकिरन्निव drawing and dividing the earth and sky like, पुप्लुवे leaped forward.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशानुद्धतान् स महार्णवे। अत्यक्रामन्महावेगस्तरङ्गान् गणयन्निव।।5.1.72।।
output: Hanuman moving along in high speed looked as if he was counting the mighty waves risen ike Meru and Mandara mountains.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य वेगसमुद्धूतं जलं सजलदं तदा। अम्बरस्थं विबभ्राज शारदाभ्रमिवाततम्।।5.1.73।।
output: तदा then, तस्य his, वेगसमुद्धूतम् raised by his onrush, सजलदम् along with the cloud, जलम् water, अम्बरस्थम् found in the sky, आततम् stretched, शारदाभ्रमिव like the autumnal clouds, विबभ्राज shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तिमिनक्रझषाः कूर्मा दृश्यन्ते विवृतास्तदा। वस्त्रापकर्षणेनेव शरीराणि शरीरिणाम्।।5.1.74।।
output: On account of the seawater rising up,  the whales, crocodiles, fish and tortoises laid bare like the limbs of the body disrobed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्लवमानं समीक्ष्याथ भुजङ्गाः सागरालयाः। व्योम्नि तं कपिशार्दूलं सुपर्ण इति मेनिरे।।5.1.75।।
output: अथ and then, व्योम्नि in the sky, प्लवमानम् coursing through, तं कपिशार्दूलम् that tiger among vanaras, समीक्ष्य seeing, सागरालयाः those in the abode of the sea, भुजङ्गाः serpents, सुपर्णः इति to be Garuda, मेनिरे thought.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णा त्रिंशद्योजनमायता। छाया वानरसिंहस्य जले चारुतराभवत्।।5.1.76।।
output: दशयोजनविस्तीर्णा spread over ten yojanas in breadth, त्रिंशद्योजनम् thirty yojanas, आयता long, वानरसिंहस्य of the lion among monkeys, छाया shadow, जले in water, चारुतरा more pleasing, अभवत् looked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
श्वेताभ्रघनराजीव वायुपुत्रानुगामिनी। तस्य सा शुशुभे छाया वितता लवणाम्भसि।।5.1.77।।
output: The broad shadow of the son of the Windgod in the sea following him shone like a dark row of clouds sailing in the pristine sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
शुशुभे स महातेजा महाकायो महाकपिः। वायुमार्गे निरालम्बे पक्षवानिव पर्वतः।।5.1.78।।
output: Hanuman the great vanara, splendid with a huge body coursing through the air seemed like a winged mountain flying the sky without any support.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
येनासौ याति बलवान् वेगेन कपिकुञ्जरः। तेन मार्गेण सहसा द्रोणीकृत इवार्णवः।।5.1.79।।
output: As the powerful monkey, an elephant among vanaras, was proceeding swiftly along, the ocean got instantly transformed into a trough on account of water swelling by the force of his flight.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आपाते पक्षिसङ्घानां पक्षिराज इव व्रजन्। हनुमान् मेघजालानि प्रकर्षन् मारुतो यथा।।5.1.80।।
output: हनुमान् Hanuman, मारुतो यथा like the wind, मेघजालानि strings of clouds, प्रकर्षन् while attracting, पक्षिसङ्घानाम् of the group of birds, आपाते when landed, व्रजन् while moving, पक्षिराजः इव like the king of birds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पाण्डुरारुणवर्णानि नीलमाञ्जिष्ठकानि च। कपिनाकृष्यमाणानि महाभ्राणि चकाशिरे।।5.1.81।।
output: कपिना by the vanara, आकृष्यमाणानि drawing, पाण्डुरारुणवर्णानि white and red colour, नीलमाञ्जिष्ठकानि च blue and yellow clouds, महाभ्राणि big clouds, चकाशिरे shining.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
प्रविशन्नभ्रजालानि निष्पतंश्च पुनः पुनः। प्रच्छन्नश्च प्रकाशश्च चन्द्रमा इव लक्ष्यते।।5.1.82।।
output: Entering into and emerging from the clouds, he looked like the Moon that appears and disappears (behind a bank of clouds).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
प्लवमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा प्लवङ्गं त्वरितं तदा। ववर्षुः पुष्पवर्षाणि देवगन्धर्वदानवाः।।5.1.83।।
output: Then seeing Hanuman crossing quickly, the gods, gandharvas and demons rained flowers on him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तताप न हि तं सूर्यः प्लवन्तं वानरोत्तमम्। सिषेवे च तदा वायू रामकार्यार्थसिद्धये।।5.1.84।।
output: The Sun spared Hanuman from the heat and even the Windgod served him, blowing cool while he was taking leaps in order to fulfil Rama's mission.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋषयस्तुष्टुवुश्चैनं प्लवमानं विहायसा। जगुश्च देवगन्धर्वाः प्रशंसन्तो महौजसम्।।5.1.85।।
output: The sages praised him while he was coursing through the sky, the gods and gandharvas sang in praise of him extolling his majesty and vigour.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नागाश्च तुष्टुवुर्यक्षा रक्षांसि विबुधाः खगाः। प्रेक्ष्य सर्वे कपिवरं सहसा विगतक्लमम्।।5.1.86।।
output: Observing the unwearied monkey the nagas, yakshas, the demons (protecting the southwest), the learned sages and birds praised him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्मिन् प्लवगशार्दूले प्लवमाने हनूमति। इक्ष्वाकुकुलमानार्थी चिन्तयामास सागरः।।5.1.87।।
output: While the monkeychief was leaping (across the sea) the Seagod wished the wellbeing of the Ikshvaku family and honoured him. (The Seagod belonged to the same race) :

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
साहाय्यं वानरेन्द्रस्य यदि नाहं हनूमत:। करिष्यामि भविष्यामि सर्ववाच्यो विवक्षताम्।।5.1.88।।
output: 'If I fail to help the monkeychief, the wise will blame me'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहमिक्ष्वाकुनाथेन सगरेण विवर्धितः। इक्ष्वाकुसचिवश्चायं नावसीदितुमर्हति।।5.1.89।।
output: अहम् I, इक्ष्वाकुनाथेन by the scion of the Ikshvakus, सगरेण by Sagara, विवर्धितः made to extend , इक्ष्वाकुसचिवः च and the minister of Ikshvaku race, अयम् this person, अवसीदितुम् to perish, नार्हति he shouldl not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा मया विधातव्यं विश्रमेत यथा कपिः।।5.1.90।। शेषं च मयि विश्रान्तः सुखेनातिपतिष्यति।
output: कपिः monkey, यथा likewise, विश्रमेत he may take rest, तथा in that way, मया by myself, विधातव्यम् arrangement has to be made, मयि on me, विश्रान्तः the rest, शेषम् remaining, सुखेन comfortably, अतिपतिष्यति will leap over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
इति कृत्वा मतिं साध्वींसमुद्र श्छन्नमम्भसि।।5.1.91।। हिरण्यनाभं मैनाकमुवाच गिरिसत्तमम्।
output: Having resolved in his mind, the Seagod addressed the noble, golden mount Mainaka, hidden in the sea:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वमिहासुरसंघानां पातालतलवासिनाम्।।5.1.92।। देवराज्ञा गिरिश्रेष्ठ परिघः सन्निवेशितः।
output: गिरिश्रेष्ठ O foremost mountain, त्वम् you, इह here, पातालतलवासिनाम् for those residing in the nether world, असुरसङ्घानाम् of hordes of demons, परिघः beam used as a barrier against the gateway, देवराज्ञा by the lord of the gods, सन्निवेशितः arranged.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वमेषां जातवीर्याणां पुनरेवोत्पतिष्यताम्।।5.1.93।। पातालस्याप्रमेयस्य द्वारमावृत्य तिष्ठसि।
output: जातवीर्याणाम् of the violent, एषाम् for these, पुनरेव again, उत्पतिष्यताम् prone to come up, त्वम् you, अप्रमेयस्य of the immeasurable, पातालस्य nether world's, द्वारम् entrance, आवृत्य  blocking, तिष्ठसि are staying.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्चैव शक्तिस्ते शैल वर्धितुम्।।5.1.94।। तस्मात्संचोदयामि त्वामुत्तिष्ठ गिरिसत्तम।
output: शैल O mountain, तिर्यक् across, ऊर्ध्वम् upward, अधश्चैव and at the bottom, वर्धितुम् to grow, ते to you, शक्तिः energy, गिरिसत्तम O noble mountain, तस्मात् therefore, त्वाम् you, सञ्चोदयामि I am prompting, उत्तिष्ठ you mary rise.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स एष कपिशार्दूलस्त्वामुपर्येति वीर्यवान्।।5.1.95।। हनूमान्रामकार्यार्थं भीमकर्मा खमाप्लुतः।
output: "Valiant Hanuman, a tiger among monkeys and a performer of dreadful deeds, is  flying over you to fulfil Rama's mission

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्य साह्यं मया कार्यमिक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्तिनः।।5.1.96।। मम हीक्ष्वाकवः पूज्याः परं पूज्यतमास्तव।
output: अस्य to him, इक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्तिनः for him who serves the Ikshvaku race, मया by me, साह्यम् help, कार्यम् should be given, मम to myself, इक्ष्वाकवः the kings of the Ikshvaku race, पूज्याः worthy of adoration, तव  to you, पूज्यतमाः most adorable .

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुरु साचिव्यमस्माकं न नः कार्यमतिक्रमेत्।।5.1.97।। कर्तव्यमकृतं कार्यं सतां मन्युमुदीरयेत्।
output: अस्माकम् for us, साचिव्यम् counselling (the duty of a minister), कुरु you may do, नः for us, कार्यम् task, न अतिक्रमेत् may not be lost, कर्तव्यम् our duty, कार्यम्  task, अकृतम् not carried out, सताम् for pious men, मन्युम् anger, उदीरयेत् will cause.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सलिलादूर्ध्वमुत्तिष्ठ तिष्ठत्वेष कपिस्त्वयि।।5.1.98।। अस्माकमतिथिश्चैव पूज्यश्च प्लवतां वरः।
output: "Rise up from the waters. Let him rest on you since this noble monkey is our guest and worthy of worship.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चामीकरमहानाभ देवगन्धर्वसेवित।।5.1.99।। हनुमांस्त्वयि विश्रान्तस्ततः शेषं गमिष्यति।
output: चामीकरमहानाभ O goldenpeaked one, देवगन्धर्व सेवित resorted to by gods,  gandharvas, हनुमान् Hanuman, त्वयि by you, विश्रान्तः resting, ततः then, शेषम् remaing part, गमिष्यति will cover.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
काकुत्स्थस्यानृशंस्यं च मैथिल्याश्च विवासनम्।।5.1.100।। श्रमं च प्लवगेन्द्रस्य समीक्ष्योत्थातुमर्हसि।
output: "You ought to rise up if you consider the nobility of the scion of the Kakusthas, the deportation of Mythili, and the exertion put forth by Hanuman, the lord of monkeys".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हिरण्यनाभो मैनाको निशम्य लवणाम्भसः।।5.1.101।। उत्पपात जलात्तूर्णं महाद्रुमलतायुतः।
output: हिरण्यनाभः mountain with gold at its bosom, मैनाकः Mainaka, लवणाम्भसः of the salty ocean, निशम्य after listening, महाद्रुमलतायुतः with great trees and creepers, तूर्णम् at once, जलात् from the water, उत्पपात  rose up.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स सागरजलं भित्त्वा बभूवाभ्युत्थितस्तदा।।5.1.102।। यथा जलधरं भित्त्वा दीप्तरश्मिर्दिवाकरः।
output: Just as the rising Sun comes out with glowing rays tearing the veil of dark clouds, the mountain rose up from the water of the ocean.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स महात्मा मुहूर्तेन सर्वतः सलिलावृतः।।5.1.103।। दर्शयामास शृङ्गाणि सागरेण नियोजितः। आदित्योदयसङ्काशैरालिखद्भिरिवाम्बरम्। शातकुम्भमयैः शृङ्गैः सकिन्नरमहोरगैः।।5.1.104।।
output: At the instance of Varuna, (the presiding deity of the ocean) the lofty mountain appeared, projecting its peaks, hitherto submerged in the water. The golden peaks inhabited by nagas and kinnaras resemmbled the rising Sun as though scraping the sky in a moment.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स महात्मा मुहूर्तेन सर्वतः सलिलावृतः।।5.1.103।। दर्शयामास शृङ्गाणि सागरेण नियोजितः। आदित्योदयसङ्काशैरालिखद्भिरिवाम्बरम्। शातकुम्भमयैः शृङ्गैः सकिन्नरमहोरगैः।।5.1.104।।
output: सकिन्नरमहोरगैः with nagas and kinnaras, आदित्योदयसङ्काशैः resembling the rising Sun, सर्वतः all over, सलिलावृत: submerged by water, अम्बरम् sky, आलिखद्भि: as if scraping the sky, इव like that, शातकुम्भमयैः golden, शृङ्गैः with peak, सर्वतः all over, सलिलावृतः covered with water, सः महात्मा the great mountain, सागरेण the ocean's, नियोजितः ordered, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, शृङ्गाणि mountain peak, दर्शयामास was seen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तप्तजाम्बूनदैः शृङ्गैः पर्वतस्य समुत्थितैः।।5.1.105।। आकाशं शस्त्रसङ्काशमभवत्काञ्चनप्रभम्।
output: The sky shone like barnished weapons smeared with the golden colour of the mountain peaks that rose up above the water.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जातरूपमयैः शृङ्गैर्भ्राजमानैः स्वयंप्रभैः।।5.1.106।। आदित्यशतसङ्काशः सोऽभवद्गिरिसत्तमः।
output: The noble mountain, Mainaka was glittering  like a thousand Suns with selfeffulgent golden peaks shining.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तमुत्थितमसङ्गेन हनुमानग्रतः स्थितम्।।5.1.107।। मध्ये लवणतोयस्य विघ्नोऽयमिति निश्चितः।
output: Hanuman considered the mountain rising up in the midst of the ocean and standing in front an impediment.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तमुच्छ्र्रतमत्यर्थं महावेगो महाकपिः।।5.1.108।। उरसा पातयामास जीमूतमिव मारुतः।
output: महावेगः swift in action, सः महाकपिः that great vanara, अत्यर्थम् instantly, उच्छ्रितम् risen, तम् him, मारुतः the wind, जीमूतमिव like a cloud, उरसा with the chest, पातयामास pushed it down.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
स तथा पातितस्तेन कपिना पर्वतोत्तमः।।5.1.109।। बुद्ध्वा तस्य कपेर्वेगं जहर्ष च ननन्द च।
output: Felled by the vanara's speed, the tall mountain overwhelmed with joy roared in high pitch.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तमाकाशगतं वीरमाकाशे समुपस्थितः।।5.1.110।। प्रीतो हृष्टमाना वाक्यमब्रवीत्पर्वतः कपिम्। मानुषं धारयन् रूपमात्मनः शिखरे स्थितः।।5.1.111।।
output: Now the mountain assumed a human form  and standing on its own summit, which stood very high, and glad at heart, addressed the heroic vanara gone to the aerial region.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमाकाशगतं वीरमाकाशे समुपस्थितः।।5.1.110।। प्रीतो हृष्टमाना वाक्यमब्रवीत्पर्वतः कपिम्। मानुषं धारयन् रूपमात्मनः शिखरे स्थितः।।5.1.111।।
output: Now the mountain assumed a human form  and standing on its own summit, which stood very high, and glad at heart, addressed the heroic vanara gone to the aerial region.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दुष्करं कृतवान्कर्म त्वमिदं वानरोत्तम। निपत्य मम शृङ्गेषु विश्रमस्व यथासुखम्।।5.1.112।।
output: वानरोत्तम O best of the vanaras, त्वम् you, दुष्करम् formidable, इदम् this, कर्म deed, कृतवान्  accomplished, मम my, शृङ्गेषु on this peak, निपत्य alighting, यथासुखम् comfortably, विश्रमस्व you may rest.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवस्य कुले जातैरुदधिः परिवर्धितः। स त्वां रामहिते युक्तं प्रत्यर्चयति सागरः।।5.1.113।।
output: उदधिः the ocean, राघवस्य of Raghava's, कुले in the family, जातैः by those born, परिवर्धितः is extended, सः सागरः that Sagara, रामहिते for the service of Rama, युक्तम् endowed with, त्वाम् you, प्रत्यर्चयति honour in return.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
कृते च प्रतिकर्तव्यमेष धर्मः सनातनः। सोऽयं त्वत्प्रतिकारार्थी त्वत्तः सम्मानमर्हति।।5.1.114।।
output: कृते when help is rendered, प्रतिकर्तव्यम्  it should be repaid, एषः this, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः dharma, तत्प्रतिकारार्थी for doing service in return, सः अयम् this, त्वत्तः from you, सम्मानम् honour, अर्हति he deserves.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
त्वन्निमित्तमनेनाहं बहुमानात्प्रचोदितः। तिष्ठ त्वं कपिशार्दूल मयि विश्रम्य गम्यताम्।।5.1.115।। तव सानुषु विश्रान्तः शेषं प्रक्रमतामिति। योजनानां शतं चापि कपिरेष समाप्लुतः।।5.1.116।।
output: "I was prompted by the ocean for your sake since he has great regard for you. O great monkey you may rest here for a while and continue your journey. The lord of the ocean feels that this tiger among monkeys can cover the distance of a hundred yojanas. He tells me, 'let him rest on your peak and then cover the rest of the distance'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
त्वन्निमित्तमनेनाहं बहुमानात्प्रचोदितः। तिष्ठ त्वं कपिशार्दूल मयि विश्रम्य गम्यताम्।।5.1.115।। तव सानुषु विश्रान्तः शेषं प्रक्रमतामिति। योजनानां शतं चापि कपिरेष समाप्लुतः।।5.1.116।।
output: "I was prompted by the ocean for your sake since he has great regard for you. O great monkey you may rest here for a while and continue your journey. The lord of the ocean feels that this tiger among monkeys can cover the distance of a hundred yojanas. He tells me, 'let him rest on your peak and then cover the rest of the distance'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदिदं गन्धवत्स्वादु कन्दमूलफलं बहु। तदास्वाद्य हरिश्रेष्ठ विश्रान्तोऽनु गमिष्यसि।।5.1.117।।
output: हरिश्रेष्ठ O foremost of the monkeys, तत् इदम् such as this, गन्धवत् sweet smelling, स्वादु tasty, बहु plenty, कन्दमूलफलम् roots and fruits, इदम् this, तत् that, आस्वद्य after tasting, विश्रान्तः taking rest, अनु later, गमिष्यसि you may go.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्माकमपि सम्बन्ध: कपिमुख्य त्वयास्ति वै। प्रख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु महागुणपरिग्रहः।।5.1.118।।
output: कपिमुख्य O chief of monkeys, त्रिषु in the three, लोकेषु in the worlds, प्रख्यातः wellknown, महागुणपरिग्रहः possesing great merits, सम्बन्धः kinship, त्वया with you, अस्माकमपि for us also, अस्ति वै  is there.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
वेगवन्तः प्लवन्तो ये प्लवगा मारुतात्मज। तेषां मुख्यतमं मन्ये त्वामहं कपिकुञ्जर।।5.1.119।।
output: "O son of the Windgod you are an elephant among monkeys, the foremost among them who move at a high speed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अतिथिः किल पूजार्हः प्राकृतोऽपि विजानता। धर्मं जिज्ञासमानेन किं पुनस्त्वादृशो महान्।।5.1.120।।
output: "Even a newcomer, however ordinary, deserves worship by a wise man who wishes to educate himself in the path of righteousness. Needless to say that distinguished guest like you deserves all reverence.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
त्वं हि देववरिष्ठस्य मारुतस्य महात्मनः। पुत्रस्तस्यैव वेगेन सदृशः कपिकुञ्जर।।5.1.121।।
output: "O foremost among the vanaras you are the son of the highsouled Windgod's, preeminent among the gods, you are also equal to him in speed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पूजिते त्वयि धर्मज्ञ पूजां प्राप्नोति मारुतः। तस्मात्त्वं पूजनीयो मे शृणु चाप्यत्र कारणम्।।5.1.122।।
output: "O knower of righteousness to worship you is to honour the Windgod. Therefore you are worthy of worship for me. I will tell you the reason. Listen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पूर्वं कृतयुगे तात पर्वताः पक्षिणोऽभवन्। ते हि जग्मुर्दिशः सर्वा गरुडानिलवेगिनः।।5.1.123।।
output: तात O dear son, पूर्वम् formerly, कृतयुगे in Krita yuga, पर्वताः mountains,पक्षिणः had wings, अभवन् endowed, ते  they, गरुडानिलवेगिनः swift like Garuda and wind, सर्वाः all, दिशः directions, जग्मुः went about.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु देवसङ्घा: महर्षिभिः। भूतानि च भयं जग्मुस्तेषां पतनशङ्कया।5.1.124।।
output: "When they moved about, even hosts of sages, gods and creatures panicked for fear of falling down (and destroying all worlds).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
ततः क्रुद्धः सहस्राक्षः पर्वतानां शतक्रतुः। पक्षान् चिच्छेद वज्रेण तत्र तत्र सहस्रशः।।5.1.125।।
output: "Provoked at this, the thousandeyed Indra who had performed a hundred sacrifices cut off the wings of mountains into a thousands pieces with his thunderbolt.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
स मामुपागतः क्रुद्धो वज्रमुद्यम्य देवराट्। ततोऽहं सहसा क्षिप्तः श्वसनेन महात्मना।।5.1.126।।
output: "Angry Indra held the thunderbolt and came towards me chasing. At that time the great Wind-god tossed me into the air and dropped me down at once.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्मिन्लवणतोये च प्रक्षिप्तः प्लवगोत्तम। गुप्तपक्षसमग्रश्च तव पित्राभिरक्षितः।।5.1.127।।
output: प्लवगोत्तम O distinguished among the vanaras, गुप्तपक्षसमग्रश्च kept my wings intact, अस्मिन् in this, लवणतोये in the salt waters of the sea, प्रक्षिप्तः thrown down, तव पित्रा by your father, अभिरक्षितः protected.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोऽहं मानयामि त्वां मान्यो हि मम मारुतः। त्वया मे ह्येष सम्बन्धः कपिमुख्य महागुणः।।5.1.128।।
output: कपिमुख्य O esteemed vanara, मारुतः Windgod, मम my, मान्यः हि revered one, ततः therefore, अहम् I, त्वाम् you, मानयामि I will honour you, त्वया by you, मे to me, एषः this, सम्बन्धः relationship, महागुणः is great.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये सागरस्य ममैव च। प्रीतिं प्रीतमनाः कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि महाकपे।।5.1.129।।
output: "O great monkey when I hold you so high, you ought to oblige me and the (god of the) ocean wholeheartedly (and accept our hospitalty).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रमं मोक्षय पूजां च गृहाण कपिसत्तम। प्रीतिं च बहुमन्यस्व प्रीतोऽस्मि तव दर्शनात्।।5.1.130।।
output: कपिसत्तम O noble monkey, श्रमम् fatigue, मोक्ष्य after being relieved, पूजां  च and offerings, गृहाण accept, प्रीतिम् love, बहुमन्यस्व oblige us, तव your, दर्शनात् by your presence, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तः कपिश्रेष्ठस्तं नगोत्तममब्रवीत्। प्रीतोऽस्मि कृतमातिथ्यं मन्युरेषोऽपनीयताम्।।5.1.131।।
output: The great Hanuman, pleased with the words of Mainaka, said "I am pleased at your hospitality. Remove your unhappiness.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
त्वरते कार्यकालो मे अहश्चाप्यतिवर्तते। प्रतिज्ञा च मया दत्ता न स्थातव्यमिहान्तरे।।5.1.132।।
output: "My commitment is hastening me. The day set (for the accomplishment of the task) is also drawing to a close. A vow is made and I will not halt in the middle of my work."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
इत्युक्त्वा पाणिना शैलमालभ्य हरिपुङ्गवः। जगामाकाशमाविश्य वीर्यवान् प्रहसन्निव।।5.1.133।।
output: Having said this, the mighty monkey gently touched the mountain with his hands before ascending to the sky with a smile on his face.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स पर्वतसमुद्राभ्यां बहुमानादवेक्षितः। पूजितश्चोपपन्नाभिराशीर्भिरनिलात्मजः।।5.1.134।।
output: The mountain and the sea honoured and adored the son of the Windgod and gave him appropriate  blessings.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथोर्ध्वं दूरमुत्प्लुत्य हित्वा शैलमहार्णवौ। पितुः पन्थानमास्थाय जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे।।5.1.135।।
output: अथ then, शैलमहार्णवौ the mountain and the ocean, हित्वा after leaving, ऊर्ध्वम् high, दूरम् long distance, उत्प्लुत्य leaping into, विमले in the clear, अम्बरे in sky, पितुः father's, पन्थानम् the path, आस्थाय after taking, जगाम went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
भूयश्चोर्ध्वं गतिं प्राप्य गिरिं तमवलोकयन्। वायुसूनुर्निरालम्बे जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे।।5.1.136।।
output: Rising higher and further up and looking at the mountain (which was going down into the ocean), the son of the Windgod coursed through the cloudless sky unsupported.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तद् द्वितीयं हनुमतो दृष्ट्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। प्रशशंसुः सुराः सर्वे सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः।।5.1.137।।
output: हनुमतः of Hanuman, तत् that, सुदुष्करम् most difficult, द्वितीयम् a second, कर्म task, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, सर्वे all, सुराः gods, सिद्धाश्च siddhas, परमर्षयः great sages, प्रशंशसुः praised him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देवताश्चाभवन् हृष्टास्तत्रस्थास्तस्य कर्मणा। काञ्चनस्य सुनाभस्य सहस्राक्षश्च वासवः।।5.1.138।।
output: The gods who happened to be present at that time (on the mountain) and the thousandeyed Indra were delighted by the gesture of golden Sunabha (Mainaka) mountain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
उवाच वचनं धीमान् परितोषात्सगद्गदम्। सुनाभं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं स्वयमेव शचीपतिः।।5.1.139।।
output: Indra, the lord of Sachi, was personally satisfied and spoke to Mainaka, the best of mountains, in faltering tone, his throat choked out of joy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हिरण्यनाभ शैलेन्द्र परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते भृशम्। अभयं ते प्रयच्छामि तिष्ठ सौम्य यथासुखम्।।5.1.140।।
output: हिरण्यनाभ O Hiranyanabha, शैलेन्द्र O lord of mountains, ते with you, भृशम् a lot, परितुष्टः अस्मि I am pleased, सौम्य O pious one, ते to you, अभयम् security, प्रयच्छामि I give, यथासुखम् happily as you please, तिष्ठ you may stay on.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
साह्यं कृतं ते सुमहद्विक्रान्तस्य हनूमतः। क्रमतो योजनशतं निर्भयस्य भये सति।।5.1.141।।
output: "You have rendered very valuable help to Hanuman who was attempting to leap  a distance of a hundred yojanas. He is fearless even when there is reason to fear (of falling down).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्यैष हितायैव याति दाशरथेर्हरिः। सत्क्रियां कुर्वता तस्य तोषितोऽस्मि दृढं त्वया।।5.1.142।।
output: "The vanara has gone on a mission to help the son of Dasaratha. I am highly pleased with the service rendered to him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः प्रहर्षमगमद्विपुलं पर्वतोत्तमः। देवतानां पतिं दृष्ट्वा परितुष्टं शतक्रतुम्।।5.1.143।।
output: Thereafter Mainaka, the great mountain was delighted to see Indra,  lord of the gods, performer of a hundred yajnas satisfied.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स वै दत्तवरः शैलो बभूवावस्थितस्तदा। हनुमांश्च मुहूर्तेन व्यतिचक्राम सागरम्।।5.1.144।।
output: Then mount Mainaka, assured by Indra became secure. And Hanuman also crossed over the ocean in a short while.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। अब्रुवन् सूर्यसङ्काशां सुरसां नागमातरम्।।5.1.145।।
output: Then the gods, gandharvas, siddhas and great sages approached Surasa, the mother of nagas, who was glowing like the Sungod and said:.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
अयं वातात्मजः श्रीमान्प्लवते सागरोपरि। हनुमान्नाम तस्य त्वं मुहूर्तं विघ्नमाचर।।5.1.146।। राक्षसं रूपमास्थाय सुघोरं पर्वतोपमम्। दंष्ट्राकरालं पिङ्गाक्षं वक्त्रं कृत्वा नभः समम्।।5.1.147।।
output: "The glorious son of the Windgod, called Hanuman, is crossing the ocean. Obstruct him for sometime by assuming the hideous form of a demon, gigantic as a mountain, fearful with yellowishbrown eyes, with big teeth and a wide mouth like the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
अयं वातात्मजः श्रीमान्प्लवते सागरोपरि। हनुमान्नाम तस्य त्वं मुहूर्तं विघ्नमाचर।।5.1.146।। राक्षसं रूपमास्थाय सुघोरं पर्वतोपमम्। दंष्ट्राकरालं पिङ्गाक्षं वक्त्रं कृत्वा नभः समम्।।5.1.147।।
output: "The glorious son of the Windgod, called Hanuman, is crossing the ocean. Obstruct him for sometime by assuming the hideous form of a demon, gigantic as a mountain, fearful with yellowishbrown eyes, with big teeth and a wide mouth like the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बलमिच्छामहे ज्ञातुं भूयश्चास्य पराक्रमम्। त्वां विजेष्यत्युपायेन विषादं वा गमिष्यति।।5.1.148।।
output: अस्य his, बलम् strength, भूयः once again, पराक्रमं च and valour, उपायेन intelligence त्वाम्  you, विजेष्यति he will win, वा or else, विषादम् dejected, गमिष्यति will give way, ज्ञातुम् to know, इच्छामहे we wish.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी दैवतैरभिसत्कृता। समुद्रमध्ये सुरसा बिभ्रती राक्षसं वपुः।।5.1.149।। विकृतं च विरूपं च सर्वस्य च भयावहम्। प्लवमानं हनूमन्तमावृत्येदमुवाच ह।।5.1.150।।
output: Thus honoured by the gods, Surasa assumed a terrific ugly form frightening to all and stood in the midst of the ocean. Putting up a distorted appearance and encompassing Hanuman who was crossing the ocean, she spoke to him:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
एवमुक्ता तु सा देवी दैवतैरभिसत्कृता। समुद्रमध्ये सुरसा बिभ्रती राक्षसं वपुः।।5.1.149।। विकृतं च विरूपं च सर्वस्य च भयावहम्। प्लवमानं हनूमन्तमावृत्येदमुवाच ह।।5.1.150।।
output: Thus honoured by the gods, Surasa assumed a terrific ugly form frightening to all and stood in the midst of the ocean. Putting up a distorted appearance and encompassing Hanuman who was crossing the ocean, she spoke to him:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मम भक्षः प्रदिष्टस्त्वमीश्वरैर्वानरर्षभ। अहं त्वां भक्षयिष्यामि प्रविशेदं ममाननम्।।5.1.151।।
output: "O bull among vanaras the lords of the universe have provided you as food for me. I will eat you. Enter my mouth".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
एवमुक्तः सुरसया प्राञ्जलिर्वानरर्षभः। प्रहृष्टवदनः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।5.1.152।।
output: Thus addressed by Surasa,  the glorious Hanuman said this with a blooming face and folded hands:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
रामो दाशरथिर्नाम प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या चापि भार्यया।।5.1.153।।
output: "Dasaratha's son called Rama accompanied by his brother Lakshmana and his wife Vaidehi entered Dandaka forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्यकार्यविषक्तस्य बद्धवैरस्य राक्षसैः। तस्य सीता हृता भार्या रावणेन यशस्विनी।।5.1.154।।
output: "While Rama was engaged otherwise, his glorious wife Sita was abducted by Ravana actuated by deeprooted enmity of demons with him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तस्याः सकाशं दूतोऽहं गमिष्ये रामशासनात्। कर्तुमर्हसि रामस्य साह्यं विषयवासिनि।।5.1.155।।
output: "I am going as Rama's emissary to search for his wife. It is proper for you to render help since you are a resident of his kingdom.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
एवमुक्ता हनुमता सुरसा कामरूपिणी। अब्रवीन्नातिवर्तेन्मां कश्चिदेष वरो मम।।5.1.157।।
output: Having heard Hanuman, Surasa capable of taking any form at her free will told him that no one can cross (her region) as she had been given such a boon(by the Creator)৷৷

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं प्रयान्तं समुद्वीक्ष्य सुरसा वाक्यमब्रवीत्। बलं जिज्ञासमाना वै नागमाता हनूमतः।।5.1.158।।
output: नागमाता mother of serpents, सुरसा Surasa, हनूमतः of Hanuman, बलम् strength, जिज्ञासमाना वै desirous of knowing, प्रयान्तम् who was attempting to go away, तम् her, समुद्वीक्ष्य observing, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रविश्य वदनं मेऽद्य गन्तव्यं वानरोत्तम। वर एष पुरा दत्तो मम धात्रेति सत्वरा।।5.1.159।। व्यादाय विपुलं वक्त्रं स्थिता सा मारुतेः पुरः।
output: वानरोत्तम O best of the vanaras, अद्य today, मे my, वदनम् face (mouth), प्रविश्य after entering, गन्तव्यम् you may go, एषः वरः such a boon, पुरा past, मम to me, धात्रा by Brahma, दत्तः is given, इति thus, सत्वरा quickly, विपुलम् wide, वक्त्रम् mouth, व्यादाय opened, सा she, मारुतेः vanara's, पुरः front, स्थिता stood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तः सुरसया क्रुद्धो वानरपुङ्गवः।।5.1.160।। अब्रवीत्कुरु वै वक्त्रं येन मां विषहिष्यसे।
output: सुरसया by Surasa, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been spoken to, वानरपुङ्गवः supreme vanara, क्रुद्धः got angry, अब्रवीत् he said, वक्त्रम् mouth, कुरु वै open, येन in such a way, माम् me, विषहिष्यसे you can bear me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्त्वा सुरसां क्रुद्धो धशयोजनमायता।।5.1.161।। दशयोजनविस्तारो बभूव हनुमांस्तदा।
output: Provoked by the words of Surasa, Hanuman stretched himself to ten yojanas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तं दृष्ट्वा मेघसङ्काशं दशयोजनमायतम्।।5.1.162।। चकार सुरसा चास्यं विंशद्योजनमायतम्।
output: Seeing his body stretched to ten yojanas like a cloud, Surasa also widened her mouth to twenty yojanas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हनुमांस्तु ततः क्रुद्धस्त्रिंशद्योजनमायतः।।5.1.163।। चकार सुरसा वक्त्रं चत्वारिंशत्तथोच्छ्रितम्। बभूव हनुमावनीरः पञ्चाशद्योजनोच्छ्रितः।।5.1.164।।
output: Provoked, Hanuman further stretched his body to thirty yojanas and Surasa on her own enlarged her mouth to forty yojanas. Then the great hero Hanuman stretched his body to fifty yojanas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हनुमांस्तु ततः क्रुद्धस्त्रिंशद्योजनमायतः।।5.1.163।। चकार सुरसा वक्त्रं चत्वारिंशत्तथोच्छ्रितम्। बभूव हनुमावनीरः पञ्चाशद्योजनोच्छ्रितः।।5.1.164।।
output: ततः then, हनुमांस्तु Hanuman also, क्रुद्धः in anger, त्रिंशद्योजनम् thirty yojanas, आयतः wide, सुरसा Surasa, तथा like that, वक्त्रम् mouth, चत्वारिंशम् forty yojanas, उच्छ्रितम् high, चकार did, वीरः hero, हनुमान् Hanuman, पञ्चाशद्योजनोच्छ्रितः fifty yojanas high, बभूव became.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
चकार सुरसा वक्त्रं षष्टियोजनमायतम्। तथैव हनुमावनीरः सप्ततीयोजनोच्छ्रितः।।5.1.165।।
output: Surasa widened her mouth sixty yojanas and then the heroic Hanuman enlarged himself to seventy yojanas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चकार सुरसा वक्त्रमशीतीयोजनायतम्। हनुमानचलप्रख्यो नवतीयोजनोच्छ्रितः।।5.1.166।।
output: सुरसा Surasa, वक्त्रम् mouth, अशीतीयोजनायतम् eighty yojanas wide, चकार  made, अचलप्रख्यः like a mountain, हनुमान् Hanuman, नवतीयोजनोच्छ्रितः ninety yojanas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चकार सुरसा वक्त्रं शतयोजनमायतम् तव सानुषु विश्रान्तः शेषं प्रक्रमतामिति। तद्दृष्ट्वा व्यादितं त्वास्यं वायुपुत्रः सुबुद्धिमान्। दीर्घजिह्वं सुरसया सुघोरं नरकोपमम्।।5.1.167।। सुसंक्षिप्यात्मनः कायं बभूवाङ्गुष्ठमात्रकः।
output: Intelligent Hanuman observing Surasa's enlarged mouth open and dreadful like hell with a long tongue, suddenly shrunk his body to the size of a thumb.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽभिपत्याशु तद्वक्त्रं निष्पत्य च महाबलः। अन्तरिक्षे स्थितः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।5.1.168।।
output: श्रीमान् glorious one, महाबलः mighty, सः he, आशु immediatly, तद्वक्त्रम् her mouth, अभिपत्य got in, निष्पत्य च and got out, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, स्थितः stood, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रविष्टोऽस्मि हि ते वक्त्रं दाक्षायणि नमोऽस्तु ते। गमिष्ये यत्र वैदेही सत्यं चासीद्वरस्तव।।5.1.169।।
output: "O Dakshayani I have indeed entered your mouth and your boon has come true (as nobody can go against the boon of the Creator). Allow me to proceed in quest of Vaidhehi. My salutations to you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तं दृष्ट्वा वदनान्मुक्तं चन्द्रं राहुमुखादिव। अब्रवीत्सुरसा देवी स्वेन रूपेण वानरम्।।5.1.170।।
output: Seeing Hanuman released out of her mouth like the Moon released from the mouth of Rahu, Surasa assumed her true form and said:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्थसिद्ध्यै हरिश्रेष्ठ गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम्। समानयस्व वैदेहीं राघवेण महात्मना।।5.1.171।।
output: सौम्य O noble one, हरिश्रेष्ठ O best of vanaras, अर्थसिद्ध्यै for achieving your purpose, यथासुखम् with pleasure, गच्छ proceed, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, महात्मना with the great self, राघवेण with Raghava, समानयस्व unite.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
तत्तृतीयं हनुमतो दृष्ट्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्। साधु साध्विति भूतानि प्रशशंसुस्तदा हरिम्।।5.1.172।।
output: Witnessing Hanuman achieving a very difficult feat for the third time, all the living beings applauded him saying "Well done, welldone".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स सागरमनाधृष्यमभ्येत्य वरुणालयम्। जगामाकाशमाविश्य वेगेन गरुडोपमः।।5.1.173।।
output: वेगेन speedily, गरुडोपमः like Garuda, सः he, अनाधृष्यम् invincible, वरुणालयम् abode of varuna, सागरम् ocean, अभ्येत्य piercing through, आकाशम् sky, आविश्य coursing, जगाम went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सेविते वारिधाराभिः पतगैश्च निषेविते। चरिते कैशिकाचार्यैरैरावतनिषेविते।।5.1.174।। सिंहकुञ्जरशार्दूलपतगोरगवाहनैः। विमानैः सम्पतद्भिश्च विमलैः समलङ्कृते।।5.1.175।। वज्राशनिसमाघातैः पावकैरुपशोभिते। कृतपुण्यैर्महाभागैः स्वर्गजिद्भिरलङ्कृते।।5.1.176।। वहता हव्यमत्यर्धं सेविते चित्रभानुना। ग्रहनक्षत्रचन्द्रार्कतारागण विभूषिते।।5.1.177।। महर्षिगणगन्धर्वनागयक्षसमाकुले। विविक्ते विमले विश्वे विश्वावसुनिषेविते।।5.1.178।। देवराजगजाक्रान्ते चन्द्रसूर्यपथे शिवे। विताने जीवलोकस्य वितते ब्रह्मनिर्मिते।।5.1.179।। बहुशः सेविते वीरैर्विद्याधरगणैर्वरैः। जगाम वायुमार्गे तु गरुत्मानिव मारुतिः।।5.1.180।।
output: Hanuman passed through the path of wind like Garuda. The region was refreshed with clouds that released torrents of rain and frequented by birds. The great masters of music (Tumburu, Narada and Gandharvas) trained in Kasika moved there driven by lions, elephants, tigers, birds and serpents and were moving in different aerial vehicles. It was splendid with god at fire who strikes fiercely like thunderbolt. It was inhabited by great sages who had acquired merit. The region was traversed by firegod who carried havis in large quantities earnestly. It was decorated with planets, constellations, Moon, Sun and clusters of stars. It was filled with groups of greal sages, gandharvas, nagas and yakshas. It was isolated part of the universe traversed by the king of gandharvas like Vishvavasu. It was an auspicious path for Moon and Sun, a sporting ground for Airavata, the vehicle of lord Indra. It was an extensive world of living beings created by Brahma. It was frequented by many heroes ascending to heaven and blocked by vidyadharas.

output: वारिधाराभिः with clouds that release torrents, सेविते frequented by, पतगैश्च by birds, निषेविते inhabited by, कैशिकाचार्यैः by masters (Tumburu, Narada and Gandharvas) of music and dance (Kaisikaart and science of music), चरिते traversed by, ऐरावतनिषेविते attended by elephant Airabata (of Indra), सिंहकुञ्जरशार्दूलपतगोरगवाहनैः with aerial vehicles drawn by lions, elephants, tigers, birds and serpents, सम्पतद्भि:  driven by, विमलैः by clear, विमानैः by aerial vehicles, समलङ्कृते well decorated, वज्राशनिसमाघातैः by the god of fire who strike fiercely  like a thunderbolt, पावकैः by fires, उपशोभिते looking splendid, कृतपुण्यैः by those who have performed meritorious deeds, महाभागैः by accomplished people, स्वर्गजिद्भि: by those who conquered heaven, अलङ्कृते decorated, अत्यर्थम् greatly, हव्यम् havis,वहता carrying, चित्रभानुना by fire, सेविते attended by, ग्रहनक्षत्रचन्द्रार्कतारागणविभूषिते adorned with planets, Moon, Sun and stars constellations, महर्षिगणगन्धर्व नागयक्षसमाकुले filled with groups of  eminent sages gandharvas, nagas, yakshas, विविक्ते isolated region, विमले cloudless, विश्वे  by vishva, विश्वावसुनिषेविते inhabited by Vishvavasu, देवराजगजाक्रान्ते sporting ground for the elephant of Indra, चन्द्रसूर्यपथे in the path of Moon and Sun, शिवे an auspicious place, जीवलोकस्य for the living beings, ब्रह्मनिर्मिते created by Brahma, वितते  extensive, विताने canopy, वरैः by the esteemed, वीरैः by heroes, विद्याधरगणैः by Vidyadhara groups, बहुशः frequently, सेविते attended by, वायुमार्गे the path of wind, मारुतिः Hanuman, गरुत्मानिव like Garuda, जगाम went.

सेविते वारिधाराभिः पतगैश्च निषेविते। चरिते कैशिकाचार्यैरैरावतनिषेविते।।5.1.174।। सिंहकुञ्जरशार्दूलपतगोरगवाहनैः। विमानैः सम्पतद्भिश्च विमलैः समलङ्कृते।।5.1.175।। वज्राशनिसमाघातैः पावकैरुपशोभिते। कृतपुण्यैर्महाभागैः स्वर्गजिद्भिरलङ्कृते।।5.1.176।। वहता हव्यमत्यर्धं सेविते चित्रभानुना। ग्रहनक्षत्रचन्द्रार्कतारागण विभूषिते।।5.1.177।। महर्षिगणगन्धर्वनागयक्षसमाकुले। विविक्ते विमले विश्वे विश्वावसुनिषेविते।।5.1.178।। देवराजगजाक्रान्ते चन्द्रसूर्यपथे शिवे। विताने जीवलोकस्य वितते ब्रह्मनिर्मिते।।5.1.179।। बहुशः सेविते वीरैर्विद्याधरगणैर्वरैः। जगाम वायुमार्गे तु गरुत्मानिव मारुतिः।।5.1.180।।
output: Hanuman passed through the path of wind like Garuda. The region was refreshed with clouds that released torrents of rain and frequented by birds. The great masters of music (Tumburu, Narada and Gandharvas) trained in Kasika moved there driven by lions, elephants, tigers, birds and serpents and were moving in different aerial vehicles. It was splendid with god at fire who strikes fiercely like thunderbolt. It was inhabited by great sages who had acquired merit. The region was traversed by firegod who carried havis in large quantities earnestly. It was decorated with planets, constellations, Moon, Sun and clusters of stars. It was filled with groups of greal sages, gandharvas, nagas and yakshas. It was isolated part of the universe traversed by the king of gandharvas like Vishvavasu. It was an auspicious path for Moon and Sun, a sporting ground for Airavata, the vehicle of lord Indra. It was an extensive world of living beings created by Brahma. It was frequented by many heroes ascending to heaven and blocked by vidyadharas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
प्रदृश्यमानः सर्वत्रः हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। भेजेऽम्बरं निरालम्बं लम्बपक्ष इवाद्रिराट्।।5.1.181।।
output: Hanuman, son of the Windgod was seen everywhere in the sky. He appeared like a longwinged king of mountains unsupported.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्लवमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा सिंहिका नाम राक्षसी। मनसा चिन्तयामास प्रवृद्धा कामरूपिणी।।5.1.182।।
output: कामरूपिणी who can take any form at will, सिंहिका नाम called Simhika, राक्षसी demoness, प्लवमानम् him who was speeding in the sky, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, प्रवृद्धा expanded in size, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अद्य दीर्घस्य कालस्य भविष्याम्यहमाशिता। इदं हि मे महत्सत्त्वं चिरस्य वशमागतम्।।5.1.183।।
output: चिरस्य after a long time, इदम् this, महत् great, सत्त्वम् being, मे my, वशम् fold, आगतम् has come, दीर्घस्य after a long, कालस्य time, अद्य today, अहम् I, आशिता satiated, भविष्यामि I will be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
इति सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा छायामस्य समाक्षिपत्। छायायां गृह्यमाणायां चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.1.184।।
output: Thinking thus, she dragged him by his shadow before she took hold of him, Hanuman started deliberating within.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
समाक्षिप्तोऽस्मि सहसा पङ्गूकृतपराक्रमः। प्रतिलोमेन वातेन महानौरिव सागरे।।5.1.185।।
output: "I am caught suddenly. I am handicapped.I am like a huge ship in an ocean retarded by the wind blowing from the opposite direction.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधश्चैव वीक्षमाणस्ततः कपिः। ददर्श स महत्सत्त्वमुत्थितं लवणाम्भसि।।5.1.186।।
output: Looking around, right and left, up and down, the monkey saw a huge being rise from the salty sea.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तद्धृष्ट्वा चिन्तयामास मारुतिर्विकृताननम्। कपिराजेन कथितं सत्त्वमद्भुतदर्शनम्।।5.1.187।। छायाग्राहि महावीर्यं तदिदं नात्र संशयः।
output: मारुतिः Maruti, विकृताननम् hideous countenance, तत् that creature, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, चिन्तयामास reflected, कपिराजेन by the king of monkeys, कथितम् described, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wonderful appearance, छायाग्राहि  which can hold the shadow, महावीर्यम् very powerful, तत् that, सत्त्वम् creature, इदम् this, अत्र here it is, संशयः doubt, न no.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तां बुद्ध्वार्थतत्त्वेन सिंहिकां मतिमान्कपिः।।5.1.188।। व्यवर्धत महाकायः प्रावृषीव वलाहकः।
output: Recognising the true nature of Simhika the clutcher of shadows, the wise Hanuman grew to a huge size like a cloud in rainy season.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य सा कायमुद्वीक्ष्य वर्धमानं महाकपेः।।5.1.189।। वक्त्रं प्रसारयामास पातालान्तरसन्निभम्।
output: सा she, तस्य महाकपेः Hanuman's, कायम् body, वर्धमानम् growing, उद्वीक्ष्य after observing, पातालान्तरसन्निभम् like the depth of the underworld, वक्त्रम् mouth, प्रसारयामास distended.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
घनराजीव गर्जन्ती वानरं समभिद्रवत्।।5.1.190।। स ददर्श ततस्तस्या विवृतं सुमहन्मुखम्। कायमात्रं च मेधावी मर्माणि च महाकपिः।।5.1.191।।
output: Roaring like a heavy mass of clouds, Simhika chased Hanuman. Intelligent Hanuman observed her enormous mouth and noticed her vital parts.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
घनराजीव गर्जन्ती वानरं समभिद्रवत्।।5.1.190।। स ददर्श ततस्तस्या विवृतं सुमहन्मुखम्। कायमात्रं च मेधावी मर्माणि च महाकपिः।।5.1.191।।
output: Roaring like a heavy mass of clouds, Simhika chased Hanuman. Intelligent Hanuman observed her enormous mouth and noticed her vital parts.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
स तस्या विवृते वक्त्रे वज्रसंहननः कपिः। संक्षिप्य मुहुरात्मानं निष्पपात महाबलः।।5.1.192।।
output: Hanuman, the vanara whose physique was as hard as thunderbolt suddenly contracted once again and entered her opened mouth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आस्ये तस्या निमज्जन्तं ददृशुः सिद्धचारणाः। ग्रस्यमानं यथा चन्द्रं पूर्णं पर्वणि राहुणा।।5.1.193।।
output: The siddhas and charanas who were watching his performance of drowning in her mouth were amazed as though the moon is seized by Rahu on a fullmoon night.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
ततस्तस्या नखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मर्माण्युत्कृत्य वानरः। उत्पपाताथ वेगेन मनः सम्पातविक्रमः।।5.1.194।।
output: The vanara who had the speed of mind tore her vital parts with his sharp nails and rushed out quickly before she closed her mouth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां तु दृष्ट्वा च धृत्या च दाक्षिण्येन निपात्य च। स कपिप्रवरो वेगाद्ववृधे पुनरात्मवान्।।5.1.195।।
output: आत्मवान् selfcontrolled, सः he, कपिप्रवरः great monkey, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा च after seeing, धृत्या च with firmness of mind, दाक्षिण्येन with ingenuity, निपात्य thrown down, पुनः again, वेगात् rapidly, ववृधे grew in size.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हृतहृत्सा हनुमतापपात विधुराम्भसि। तां हतां वानरेणाशु पतितां वीक्ष्य सिंहिकाम्।।5.1.196।। भूतान्याकाशचारीणि तमूचुः प्लवगोत्तमम्।
output: Heart torn asunder and killed by Hanuman, miserable Simhika instantly fell into the sea water. Observing it, the beings who ranged the sky said to the foremost of vanaras:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भीममद्य कृतं कर्म महत्सत्त्वं त्वया हतम्।।5.1.197।। साधयार्थमभिप्रेतमरिष्टं प्लवतां वर।
output: प्लवतां वर O great jumper, अद्य  to day, त्वया by you, महत्  great, सत्त्वम् creature, हतम् is destroyed, भीमम् fierce, कर्म action, कृतम् done, अभिप्रेतम् intention, अर्थम् aim, अरिष्टम् unobstructed, साधय you fulfill

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
यस्य त्वेतानि चत्वारि वानरेन्द्र यथा तव।।5.1.198।। धृतिर्दृष्टिर्मतिर्दाक्ष्यं सः कर्मसु न सीदति।
output: "O lord of vanaras he in whom these four qualities, fortitude, vision, intelligence and dexterity exist as in you will achieve his mission and not get lost".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तैः सम्भावितः पूज्यः प्रतिपन्नप्रयोजनः।।5.1.199।। जगामाकाशमाविश्य पन्नगाशनवत्कपिः।
output: पूज्यः a venerable one, सः कपिः that monkey, तैः by them, सम्भावितः honoured, प्रतिपन्नप्रयोजनः achieved the objective, आकाशम् sky, आविश्य having ascended,      पन्नगाशानवत् like Garuda, जगाम went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 1:
प्राप्तभूयिष्ठपारस्तु सर्वतः प्रतिलोकयन्।।5.1.200।। योजनानां शतस्यान्ते वनराजिं ददर्श सः।
output: On reaching the other side of the shore crossing  a hundred yojanas, he saw rows of forest trees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ददर्श च पतन्नेव विविधद्रुमभूषितम्।।5.1.201।। द्वीपं शाखामृगश्रेष्ठो मलयोपवनानि च।
output: शाखामृगश्रेष्ठः best among the animals that jump on branches, monkeys, पतन्नेन onwhile yet on air, विविधद्रुमभूषितम् adorned with several kinds of beautiful trees, द्वीपम् island, मलयोपवनानि gardens bordering Malaya mountain, ददर्श च also saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स सागरमनादृष्यमतिक्रम्य महाबलः। त्रिकूटशिखरे लङ्कां स्थितां स्वस्थो ददर्श ह।।5.2.1।।
output: Hanuman reaches the main entrance of Lanka  assuming a diminutive form.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः पादपमुक्तेन पुष्पवर्षेण वीर्यवान्। अभिवृष्टः स्थितस्तत्र बभौ पुष्पमयो यथा।।5.2.2।।
output: ततः then, तत्र there, स्थितः he stood, वीर्यवान् heroic one, पादपमुक्तेन dropped from the trees, पुष्पवर्षेण by the rain of flowers, अभिवृष्टः covered fully, पुष्पमयो यथा like a heap of flowers, बभौ looked.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
योजनानां शतं श्रीमांस्तीर्त्वाप्युत्तमविक्रमः। अनिःश्वसन् कपिस्तत्र न ग्लानिमधिगच्छति।।5.2.3।।
output: The glorious, powerful vanara (Hanuman) even after crossing a hundred yojanas, felt neither suffocated nor exasperated.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
शतान्यहं योजनानां क्रमेयं सुबहून्यपि। किं पुनः सागरस्यान्तं संख्यातं शतयोजनम्।।5.2.4।।
output: (He said to himself), "I can cross a distance of even hundreds of yojanas. What to say of a hundred yojanas which is a calculated distance."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
स तु वीर्यवतां श्रेष्ठः प्लवतामपि चोत्तमः। जगाम वेगवान् लङ्कां लङ्घयित्वा महोदधिम्।।5.2.5।।
output: Courageous and exalted Hanuman, the best among vanaras, noted for his speed reached Lanka crossing over the great ocean on his own.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शाद्वलानि च नीलानि गन्धवन्ति वनानि च। गण्डवन्ति च मध्येन जगाम नगवन्ति च।।5.2.6।।
output: Hanuman passed through forests laden with fragrant flowers, bluish grassy land, big rocks and mountains covered with trees.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शैलांश्च तरुसंछन्नान् वनाराजीश्च पुष्पिताः। अभिचक्राम तेजस्वी हनुमान् प्लवगर्षभः।।5.2.7।।
output: Brilliant Hanuman, a bull among monkeys, crossed the mountains covered with blossoming trees and forest ranges.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तस्मिन्नचले तिष्ठन्वनान्युपवनानि च। स नगाग्रे च तां लङ्कां ददर्श पवनात्मजः।।5.2.8।।
output: That son of the Windgod stood on the mountain and saw the forests and groves round Lanka situated on the mountain peak.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सरलान् कर्णिकारांश्च खर्जूरांश्च सुपुष्पितान्। प्रियालून्मुचुलिन्दांश्च कुटजान् केतकानपि।।5.2.9।। प्रियंङ्गून् गन्धपूर्णांश्च नीपान् सप्तच्छदांस्तथा। आसनान् कोविदारांश्च करवीरांश्च पुष्पितान्।।5.2.10।। पुष्पभारनिबद्धांश्च तथा मुकुलितानपि। पादपान् विहगाकीर्णान् पवनाधूतमस्तकान्।।5.2.11।। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णा वापीः पद्मोत्मलायुताः। आक्रीडान् विविधान् रम्यावन् विविधांश्च जलाशयान्।।5.2.12।। सन्ततान् विविधैर्वृक्षैः सर्वर्तुफलपुष्पितैः। उद्यानानि च रम्याणि ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः।।5.2.13।।
output: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.

output: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सरलान् कर्णिकारांश्च खर्जूरांश्च सुपुष्पितान्। प्रियालून्मुचुलिन्दांश्च कुटजान् केतकानपि।।5.2.9।। प्रियंङ्गून् गन्धपूर्णांश्च नीपान् सप्तच्छदांस्तथा। आसनान् कोविदारांश्च करवीरांश्च पुष्पितान्।।5.2.10।। पुष्पभारनिबद्धांश्च तथा मुकुलितानपि। पादपान् विहगाकीर्णान् पवनाधूतमस्तकान्।।5.2.11।। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णा वापीः पद्मोत्मलायुताः। आक्रीडान् विविधान् रम्यावन् विविधांश्च जलाशयान्।।5.2.12।। सन्ततान् विविधैर्वृक्षैः सर्वर्तुफलपुष्पितैः। उद्यानानि च रम्याणि ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः।।5.2.13।।
output: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
समासाद्य च लक्ष्मीवान् लङ्कां रावणपालिताम्। परिखाभिः सपद्माभिः सोत्पलाभिरलङ्कृताम्।।5.2.14।। सीतापहरणार्थेन रावणेन सुरक्षिताम्। समन्ताद्विचरद्भिश्च राक्षसैरुग्रधन्विभिः।।5.2.15।। काञ्चनेनावृतां रम्यां प्राकारेण महापुरीम्। गृहैश्च ग्रहसंकाशैः शारदाम्बुदसन्निभैः।।5.2.16।। पाण्डुराभिः प्रतोलीभिरुच्चाभिरभिसंवृताम्। अट्टालकशताकीर्णां पताकाध्वजमालिनीम्।।5.2.17।। तोरणैः काञ्चनैर्दिव्यैर्लतापङ्त्किविचित्रितैः। ददर्श हनुमान् लङ्कां दिवि देवपुरीं यथा।।5.2.18।।
output: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated  houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
गिरिमूर्ध्निं स्थितां लङ्कां पाण्डुरैर्भवनैः शुभैः। ददर्श स कपिश्रेष्ठः पुरमाकाशगं यथा।।5.2.19।।
output: The foremost among the vanaras, perched on top of the mountain saw the city of Lanka on the mountain with auspicious mansions as though touching the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
पालितां राक्षसेन्द्रेण निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा। प्लवमानमिवाकाशे ददर्श हनुमान् पुरीम्।।5.2.20।।
output: The city of Lanka, ruled by the lord of demons and built by Visvakarma looked as if it was a city floating in the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
वप्रप्राकारजघनां विपुलाम्बुनवाम्बराम्। शतघ्नीशूलकेशान्तामट्टालकवतंसकाम्।।5.2.21।। मनसेव कृतां लङ्कां निर्मितां विश्वकर्मणा। द्वारमुत्तरमासाद्य चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.2.22।।
output: Having reached the northern entrance of the city he started thinking that Visvakarma must have conceived Lanka as a lady with its ramparts as her hips and loins, moats filled with water as her robes, the spiked iron tridents as her locks of hair, and the tall towers as her her ear rings

instruction:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कैलासशिखरप्रख्यामालिखन्तीमिवाम्बरम्। डीयमानामिवाकाशमुच्छ्रितैर्भवनोत्तमैः।।5.2.23।। सम्पूर्णां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्नागैर्भोगवतीमिव। अचिन्त्यां सुकृतां स्पष्टां कुबेराध्युषितां पुरा।।5.2.24।। दंष्ट्रिभिर्बहुभिः शूरैः शूलपट्टसपाणिभिः। रक्षितां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्गुहामाशीविषैरिव।।5.2.25।। तस्याश्च महतीं गुप्तिं सागरं च निरीक्ष्य सः। रावणं च रिपुं घोरं चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.2.26।।
output: Observing Lanka that resembled mount Kailas, with sky scrapers appearing as if flying, filled with dreadful demons and nagas protecting the city of Bhogavati (the city of Patala), unimaginably wellbuilt. It was once occupied by Kubera (half brother of Ravana). It was guarded by horrible demons holding tridents and spears in their hands. The city appeared like a cavern protected by venomous serpents with protruding fangs. Hanuman examined the high security of Lanka and looked at the ocean. He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable  enemy:

instruction:

कैलासशिखरप्रख्यामालिखन्तीमिवाम्बरम्। डीयमानामिवाकाशमुच्छ्रितैर्भवनोत्तमैः।।5.2.23।। सम्पूर्णां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्नागैर्भोगवतीमिव। अचिन्त्यां सुकृतां स्पष्टां कुबेराध्युषितां पुरा।।5.2.24।। दंष्ट्रिभिर्बहुभिः शूरैः शूलपट्टसपाणिभिः। रक्षितां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्गुहामाशीविषैरिव।।5.2.25।। तस्याश्च महतीं गुप्तिं सागरं च निरीक्ष्य सः। रावणं च रिपुं घोरं चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.2.26।।
