He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable  enemy:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
कैलासशिखरप्रख्यामालिखन्तीमिवाम्बरम्। डीयमानामिवाकाशमुच्छ्रितैर्भवनोत्तमैः।।5.2.23।। सम्पूर्णां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्नागैर्भोगवतीमिव। अचिन्त्यां सुकृतां स्पष्टां कुबेराध्युषितां पुरा।।5.2.24।। दंष्ट्रिभिर्बहुभिः शूरैः शूलपट्टसपाणिभिः। रक्षितां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्गुहामाशीविषैरिव।।5.2.25।। तस्याश्च महतीं गुप्तिं सागरं च निरीक्ष्य सः। रावणं च रिपुं घोरं चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.2.26।।
output: Observing Lanka that resembled mount Kailas, with sky scrapers appearing as if flying, filled with dreadful demons and nagas protecting the city of Bhogavati (the city of Patala), unimaginably wellbuilt. It was once occupied by Kubera (half brother of Ravana). It was guarded by horrible demons holding tridents and spears in their hands. The city appeared like a cavern protected by venomous serpents with protruding fangs. Hanuman examined the high security of Lanka and looked at the ocean. He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable  enemy:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आगत्यापीह हरयो भविष्यन्ति निरर्थकाः। न हि युद्धेन वै लङ्का शक्या जेतुं सुरैरपि।।5.2.27।।
output: 'It is not possible for monkeys to come here and even if they do, it is no use. Lanka is invincible even to the gods in war.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमां तु विषमां दुर्गां लङ्कां रावणपालिताम्। प्राप्यापि स महाबाहुः किं करिष्यति राघवः।।5.2.28।।
output: 'What will  Rama the mighty armed hero do even after reaching this formidable city of Lanka ruled by Ravana?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवकाशो नसान्त्वस्य राक्षसेष्वभिगम्यते। न दानस्य न भेदस्य नैव युद्धस्य दृश्यते।।5.2.29।।
output: 'There is no scope for reconciliation with the demons. It is not possible to win over them with gifts. They cannot be divided by dissension. There is no scope for war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
चतुर्णामेव हि गतिर्वानराणां महात्मनाम्। वालिपुत्रस्य नीलस्य मम राज्ञश्च धीमतः।।5.2.30।।
output: 'Only four great monkeys can have access to this place. They are Angada the son of Vali, Nila, Sugriva, the wise king of monkeys and myself.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यावज्जानामि वैदेहीं यदि जीवति वा न वा। तत्रैव चिन्तयिष्यामि दृष्ट्वा तां जनकात्मजाम्।।5.2.31।।
output: 'Whether Janaka's daughter, Vaidehi is alive or not is not known. After seeing her I shall think over'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः स चिन्तयामास मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः। गिरिशृङ्गे स्थितस्तस्मिन् रामस्याभ्युदये रतः।।5.2.32।।
output: ततः then, रामस्य Rama's, अभ्युदये in his welfare, रतः lay, सः that, कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among vanaras, तस्मिन् on that, गिरिशृङ्गे on the mountain peak, स्थितः stood, मुहूर्तम् for a short while, चिन्तयामास  pondered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनेन रूपेण मया न शक्या रक्षसां पुरी। प्रवेष्टुं राक्षसैर्गुप्ता क्रूरैर्बलसमन्वितैः।।5.2.33।।
output: क्रूरैः by the fierce, बलसमन्वितैः by the powerful ones, राक्षसैः by demons, गुप्ता guarded, रक्षसाम् of demons, पुरी city, मया by me, अनेन by this present, रूपेण form, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, न शक्या not possible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
उग्रौजसो महावीर्या बलवन्तश्च राक्षसाः। वञ्चनीया मया सर्वे जानकीं परिमार्गता।।5.2.34।।
output: जानकीम् Sita, परिमार्गता while searching, मया by me, उग्रौजसः energetic, महावीर्याः very valiant, बलवन्तश्च powerful, राक्षसाः demons, सर्वे all, वञ्चनीयाः should be deceived.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लक्ष्यालक्ष्येण रूपेण रात्रौ लङ्का पुरी मया। प्रवेष्टुं प्राप्तकालं मे कृत्यं साधयितुं महत्।।5.2.35।।
output: मे for me, महत् great, कृत्यम् task, साधयितुम् to accomplish, मया by me, लक्ष्यालक्ष्येण in a non conspicious, रूपेण form, रात्रौ during night, लङ्कापुरी city of Lanka, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, प्राप्तकालम् is the appropriate time.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां पुरीं तादृशीं दृष्ट्वा दुराधर्षां सुरासुरैः। हनुमान् चिन्तयामास विनिश्चित्य मुहुर्मुहुः।।5.2.36।।
output: हनुमान् Hanuman, सुरासुरैः by gods and demons, दुराधर्षाम् unassailable, तादृशीम् such, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, दृष्ट्वा seeing, विनिश्चित्य sighing, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, चिन्तयामास reflected.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
केनोपायेन पश्येयं मैथिलीं जनकात्मजाम्। अदृष्टो राक्षसेन्द्रेण रावणेन दुरात्मना।।5.2.37।।
output: दुरात्मना evilminded, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by lord of demons, रावणेन by Ravana, अदृष्टः without being seen, केन for that, उपायेन means, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, मैथिलीम् Mythili, पश्येयम् will be possible to find.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न विनश्येत्कथं कार्यं रामस्य विदितात्मनः। एकामेकश्च वश्येयं रहिते जनकात्मजाम्।।5.2.38।।
output: विदितात्मनः one who is endowed with selfknowledge, रामस्य Rama's, कार्यम् task, कथम् how, न विनश्येत् will not be spoilt, एकश्च single person, रहिते in a private audience, एकाम् her, जनकात्मजाम् Sita, पश्येयम् possible to see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
भूताश्चार्था विपद्यन्ते देशकालविरोधिताः। विक्लबं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा।।5.2.39।।
output: 'Just as darkness disappears at Sunrise, wellplanned strategies also fail at the hands of a thoughtless messenger when they are set in opposition to proper time and place.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अर्थानर्थान्तरे बुद्धिर्निश्चितापि न शोभते। घातयन्ति हि कार्याणि दूताः पण्डितमानिनः।।5.2.40।।
output: 'Even though messengers are not intelligent, they think themselves clever and capable. They act foolishly, swerve from proper course of action and fail in their effort.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
न  विनश्येत्कथं कार्यं वैक्लब्यं न कथं भवेत्। लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य कथं नु न वृथा भवेत्।।5.2.41।।
output: 'How should the task be performed? How to avoid impetuousness? How can my purpose of crossing the ocean be not wasted?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
मयि दृष्टे तु रक्षोभी रामस्य विदितात्मनः। भवेद्व्यर्थमिदं कार्यं रावणानर्थमिच्छतः।।5.2.42।।
output: 'If I am seen by the demons, the plan of Rama, possessor of selfknowledge, to kill Ravana, will be wasted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न हि शक्यं क्वचित् स्थातुमविज्ञातेन राक्षसैः। अपि राक्षसरूपेण किमुतान्येन केनचित्।।5.2.43।।
output: राक्षसैः by demons, अविज्ञातेन without being identified, राक्षसरूपेणापि even by assuming the form of a demon, क्वचित् anywhere, स्थातुम् to stay with them, न शक्यं हि  not be possible, अन्येन in other form, केनचित् by any form, किमुत what to say.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वायुरप्यत्र नाज्ञातश्चरेदिति मतिर्मम। न ह्य स्त्यविदितं किञ्चिद्राक्षसानां बलीयसाम्।।5.2.44।।
output: 'I think even the wind who has no form cannot move here without being detected. Nothing escapes the notice of powerful demons. There is nothing unknown to them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
इहाहं यदि तिष्ठामि स्वेन रूपेण संवृतः। विनाशमुपयास्यामि भर्तुरर्थश्च हीयते।।5.2.45।।
output: 'I will surely meet with death if I hide here in my original form and my master's mission also will be spoilt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदहं स्वेन रूपेण रजन्यां ह्रस्वतां गतः। लङ्कामभिपतिष्यामि राघवस्यार्थसिद्धये।।5.2.46।।
output: तत् therefore, अहम् I, स्वेन रूपेण in my own form, ह्रस्वताम् in a tiny form, गतः assuming, राघवस्य Rama's, अर्थसिद्धये to accomplish, रजन्याम् in the night, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभिपतिष्यामि I shall jump.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणस्य पुरीं रात्रौ प्रविश्य सुदुरासदाम्। विचिन्वन् भवनं सर्वं द्रक्ष्यामि जनकात्मजाम्।।5.2.47।।
output: 'Entering by night the inaccessible city of Ravana, I shall search all over the palace and find Sita'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति सञ्चिन्त्य हनुमान् सूर्यस्यास्तमयं कपिः। आचकाङ्क्षे तदा वीरो वैदेह्या दर्शनोत्सुकः।।5.2.48।।
output: Having planned in that manner the heroic Hanuman keen to see Sita waited for the Sunset.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सूर्ये चास्तं गते रात्रौ देहं सङ्क्षिप्य मारुतिः। पृषदंशकमात्रः सन् बभूवाद्भुतदर्शनः।।5.2.49।।
output: When Sun set, Maruti, the son of the Windgod, reduced himself at night to the small size of a cat, wonderful to behold.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रदोषकाले हनुमांस्तूर्णमुत्प्लुत्य वीर्यवान्। प्रविवेश पुरीं रम्यां सुविभक्तमहापथाम्।।5.2.50।।
output: वीर्यवान् courageous, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रदोषकाले at dusk, तूर्णम् at once, उत्ल्पुत्य jumped, सुविभक्तमहापथाम् a place well laidoutgreat royal path, रम्याम् beautiful, पुरीम् city, प्रविवेश entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रासादमालाविततां स्तम्भैः काञ्चनराजतैः। शातकुम्भमयैर्जालैर्गन्थर्वनगरोपमाम्।।5.2.51।। सप्तभौमाष्टभौमैश्च स ददर्श महापुरीम्। तलैः स्फाटिकसंकीर्णैः कार्तस्वरविभूषितैः।।5.2.52।।
output: सः that, प्रासादमालावितताम् stretched with a row of mansions, काञ्चनराजतैः with gold and silver, स्तम्भैः with pillars, शातकुम्भमयैः made of gold, जालैः fretwork, गन्धर्वनगरोपमाम् resembling the city of gandharvas, सप्तभौमाष्टभौमैः च seven and eight storied mansions, स्फाटिकसंकीर्णैः inlaid with crystals, कार्तस्वरविभूषितैः decorated with gold, तलैः floors, महापुरीम्  the grand city, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रासादमालाविततां स्तम्भैः काञ्चनराजतैः। शातकुम्भमयैर्जालैर्गन्थर्वनगरोपमाम्।।5.2.51।। सप्तभौमाष्टभौमैश्च स ददर्श महापुरीम्। तलैः स्फाटिकसंकीर्णैः कार्तस्वरविभूषितैः।।5.2.52।।
output: Hanuman saw the city stretched with rows of buildings all over,with seven or eight storied  mansions, which had pillars of gold and silver, windows with fretwork of gold, inlaid with crystals, floors decorated with gold, resembling the grand city of gandharvas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वैडूर्यमणिचित्रैश्च मुक्ताजालविभूषितैः। तलैः शुशुभिरे तानि भवनान्यत्र रक्षसाम्।।5.2.53।।
output: अत्र here, रक्षसाम् of demons, भवनानि mansions, वैडूर्यमणिचित्रैः  inlaid with precious gems, मुक्ताजालविभूषितैः fretwork ornamented with pearls, तलैः with floors, शुशुभिरे looked splendid.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
काञ्चनानि च चित्राणि तोरणानि च रक्षसाम्। लङ्कामुद्योतयामासुः सर्वतः समलङ्कृताम्।।5.2.54।।
output: रक्षसाम् of demons, काञ्चनानि golden ones, चित्राणि colourful ones, तोरणानि archways, समलङ्कृताम् decorated all over, लङ्काम् Lanka, सर्वतः everywhere, उद्योतयामासुः illumined.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अचिन्त्यामद्भुताकारां दृष्टवा लङ्कां महाकपिः। आसीद्विषण्णो हृष्टश्च वैदेह्या दर्शनोत्सुकः।।5.2.55।।
output: महाकपिः great vanara, अचिन्त्याम् unimaginable, अद्भुताकाराम् wonderful, लङ्काम् Lanka, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, दर्शनोत्सुकः eager to see, विषण्णः sad, हृष्टश्च and glad, आसीत् became.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
स पाण्डुराविद्धविमानमालिनीं महार्हजाम्बूनदजालतोरणाम्। यशस्विनीं रावणबाहुपालितां क्षपाचरैर्भीमबलैः समावृताम्।।5.2.56।।
output: He found that famed place with a garland of tall, white mansions, conspicuous with archways latticed with gold strings, protected by mighty Ravana and surrounded by terrific demons.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चन्द्रोऽपि साचिव्यमिवास्य कुर्वंस्तारागणैर्मध्यगतो विराजन्। ज्योत्स्नावितानेन वितत्य लोक मुत्तिष्ठते नैकसहस्ररश्मि:।।5.2.57।।
output: नैकसहस्ररश्मि: having thousands of rays, चन्द्रोऽपि even the Moon, तारागणैः with multitude of stars, मध्यगतः came in the centre, विराजन् illumining, लोकम् the world, ज्योत्स्नावितानेन with a canopy of moonlight, वितत्य having expanded, अस्य his, साचिव्यम् ministerial assistance, कुर्वन्निव as if to render, उत्तिष्ठते rises.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 2:
शङ्खप्रभं क्षीरमृणालवर्ण मुद्गच्छमानं व्यवभासमानम्। ददर्श चन्द्रं स हरिप्रवीरः पोप्लूयमानं सरसीव हंसम्।।5.2.58।।
output: The heroic vanara saw the rising Moon flitting in and out shining like a fresh white conch, in the colour of milk and lotus stalks, bright like a swan floating in the lakelike sky. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्वितीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the second sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
स लम्बशिखरे लम्बे लम्बतोयदसन्निभे। सत्त्वमास्थाय मेधावी हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।।5.3.1।। निशि लङ्कां महासत्त्वो विवेश कपिकुञ्जरः। रम्यकाननतोयाढ्यां पुरीं रावणपालिताम्।।5.3.2।।
output: The mighty son of the Windgod, intelligent Hanuman, an elephant among vanaras, standing on the peak of the Lamba which looked like a high rainbearing cloud and relying on his energy, entered by night the city of Lanka, ruled by Ravana  rich in delightful forests, groves and water pools.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:

output: The mighty son of the Windgod, intelligent Hanuman, an elephant among vanaras, standing on the peak of the Lamba which looked like a high rainbearing cloud and relying on his energy, entered by night the city of Lanka, ruled by Ravana  rich in delightful forests, groves and water pools.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शारदाम्बुधरप्रख्यैर्भवनैरुपशोभिताम्। सागरोपमनिर्घोषां सागरानिलसेविताम्।।5.3.3।। सुपुष्टबलसम्पुष्टां यथैव विटपावतीम्। चारुतोरणनिर्यूहां पाण्डुरद्वारतोरणाम्।।5.3.4।। भुजगाचरितां गुप्तां शुभां भोगवतीमिव। तां स विद्युद्घनाकीर्णां ज्योतिर्मार्गनिषेविताम्।।5.3.5।। मन्दमारुतसञ्चारां यथेन्द्रस्यामरावतीम्। शातकुम्भेन महता प्राकारेणाभिसंवृताम्।।5.3.6।। किङ्किणीजालघोषाभिः पताकाभिरलङ्कृताम्। आसाद्य सहसा हृष्टः प्राकारमभिपेदिवान्।।5.3.7।।
output: शारदाम्भुधरप्रख्यैः like autumnal clouds, भवनैः mansions, उपशोभिताम् beautiful, सागरोपमनिर्घोषाम् sounds of the roar of the sea, सागरानिलसेविताम् served by the sea breeze, सुपुष्टबलसम्पुष्टाम् strong with wellnourished army, विटपावतीं यथैव just as Vitapavati, चारुतोरणनिर्यूहाम् stationed at the beautiful archways, पाण्डुरद्वारतोरणाम् provided with white gates and archs, भुजगाचरिताम् inhabited by snakes, गुप्ताम् protected, शुभाम् auspicious, भोगवतीमिव just as Bhogavati (Patala), the abode of serpents, सविद्युद्घनाकीर्णाम् overcast with clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, जोतिर्मार्गनिषेविताम् served by planets and stars, मन्दमारुतसञ्चाराम्  winds blowing mild (out of fear of Ravana), इन्द्रस्य Indra's, अमरावतीं यथा like the city of Amaravati, शातकुम्भेन with golden, महता great, प्राकारेण with rampart, अभिसंव़ृताम् adorned everywhere, किङ्किणीजालघोषाभिः with jingling sounds of small bells, पताकाभिः with flags, अलङ्कृताम् decorated, ताम् that, सहसा at once, आसाद्य having reached, हृष्टः  was thrilled, प्राकारम् the rampart, अभिपेदिवान् surveyed.

instruction:

output: Hanuman, happy to reach Lanka, stood on its rampart and surveyed the city of land which was splendid with beautiful mansions overcast with autumnal clouds pierced by glittering streaks of lightning, served by planets and stars with mild winds blowing (out of fear of Ravana), with the roaring sounds of the sea and with a wellfed army like Vitapavati (that is Alaka, the capital of Kubera, halfbrother of Ravana and the treasurer of celestials),  which had elephants sationed at the outer gates, provided with white archways and protected by serpents like the auspicious city of Bhogavati (capital of Patala). Surrounded by a golden rampart, the city resembled Amaravati, the capital of Indra, decorated with flags fluttering, echoing with the jingling sounds of small bells.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विस्मयाविष्टहृदयः पुरीमालोक्य सर्वतः। जाम्बूनदमयैर्द्वारैर्वैडूर्यकृतवेदिकैः।।5.3.8।। वज्रस्फटिकमुक्ताभिर्मणिकुट्टिमभूषितैः। तप्तहाटकनिर्यूहै राजतामलपाण्डुरैः।।5.3.9।। वैढूर्यकृतसोपानैः स्फाटिकान्तरपांसुभिः। चारुसंजवनोपेतैः खमिवोत्पतितैः शुभैः।।5.3.10।। क्रौञ्चबर्हिणसङ्घुष्टैः राजहंस निषेवितैः। तूर्याभरणनिर्घोषैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादिताम्।।5.3.11।। वस्वौकसाराप्रतिमां तां वीक्ष्य नगरीं ततः। खमिवोत्पतितुं कामां जहर्ष हनुमान् कपिः।।5.3.12।।
output: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.

output: पुरीम् the city, सर्वतः all over, आलोक्य surveying, विस्मयाविष्टहृदयः wonderstruck at heart, ततः then, कपिः vanara, हनुमान् Hanuman, जम्बूनदमयैः full of gold, द्वारैः shutters,  वैढूर्यकृतवेदिकैः platforms encrusted with vaidurya, वज्रस्फटिकमुक्ताभिः with diamonds, crystals and pearls, मणिकुट्टिमभूषितैः studded with gems, तप्तहाटकनिर्यूहैः made of molten gold, राजतामलपाण्डुरैः pure white silver floors, वैढूर्यकृतसोपानैः stairscases encrusted with vaidurya, स्फाटिकान्तरपांसुभिः covered with crystal grains, चारुसंजवनोपेतैः with lovely quadrangles, क्रौञ्चबर्हिणसङ्घुष्टैः echoing with sounds of Krauncha birds and Peacocks, राजहंसनिषेवितैः inhabited by royal swans, खम् sky, उत्पतितैरिव rising into the sky, शुभैः auspicious, तूर्याभरणनिर्घोषैः filled with sounds of musical instruments, सर्वतः all over, प्रतिनादिताम् resounding, वस्वौकसारप्रतिमाम् like the replica of the city of Vaswokasara, खम् sky, उत्पतिताम् इव as if risen, ताम् that, लङ्कां नगरीम् city of Lanka, वीक्ष्य gazing, जहर्ष rejoiced.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विस्मयाविष्टहृदयः पुरीमालोक्य सर्वतः। जाम्बूनदमयैर्द्वारैर्वैडूर्यकृतवेदिकैः।।5.3.8।। वज्रस्फटिकमुक्ताभिर्मणिकुट्टिमभूषितैः। तप्तहाटकनिर्यूहै राजतामलपाण्डुरैः।।5.3.9।। वैढूर्यकृतसोपानैः स्फाटिकान्तरपांसुभिः। चारुसंजवनोपेतैः खमिवोत्पतितैः शुभैः।।5.3.10।। क्रौञ्चबर्हिणसङ्घुष्टैः राजहंस निषेवितैः। तूर्याभरणनिर्घोषैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादिताम्।।5.3.11।। वस्वौकसाराप्रतिमां तां वीक्ष्य नगरीं ततः। खमिवोत्पतितुं कामां जहर्ष हनुमान् कपिः।।5.3.12।।
output: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
विस्मयाविष्टहृदयः पुरीमालोक्य सर्वतः। जाम्बूनदमयैर्द्वारैर्वैडूर्यकृतवेदिकैः।।5.3.8।। वज्रस्फटिकमुक्ताभिर्मणिकुट्टिमभूषितैः। तप्तहाटकनिर्यूहै राजतामलपाण्डुरैः।।5.3.9।। वैढूर्यकृतसोपानैः स्फाटिकान्तरपांसुभिः। चारुसंजवनोपेतैः खमिवोत्पतितैः शुभैः।।5.3.10।। क्रौञ्चबर्हिणसङ्घुष्टैः राजहंस निषेवितैः। तूर्याभरणनिर्घोषैः सर्वतः प्रतिनादिताम्।।5.3.11।। वस्वौकसाराप्रतिमां तां वीक्ष्य नगरीं ततः। खमिवोत्पतितुं कामां जहर्ष हनुमान् कपिः।।5.3.12।।
output: Surveying all over, Hanuman was wonderstruck to see as though it was leaping into the sky. The city had golden shutters, altars encrusted with vaidurya, mansions inlaid with diamonds, crystals, pearls and other gems, crowned with pure gold and silver. The staircases built with silver were studded with vaidurya. The beautiful quadrangles, coverd with grains of crystal were as though leaping into the air. It echoed with sounds of krauncha birds, peacocks and royal swans. Filled with sounds of musical instruments, it resembled the city of Vaswokasara.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तां समीक्ष्य पुरीं रम्यां राक्षसाधिपतेः शुभाम्। अनुत्तमामृद्धियुतां चिन्तयामास वीर्यवान्।।5.3.13।।
output: Gazing at the enchanting, auspicious, prosperous city of the king of demons mighty Hanuman began to reflect:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
नेयमन्येन नगरी शक्या धर्षयितुं बलात्। रक्षिता रावणबलैरुद्यतायुधधारिभिः।।5.3.14।।
output: 'It is not possible to attack this city by to outsiders as it is protected by the forces of Ravana with their weapons ready(to attack).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
कुमुदाङ्गदयोर्वापि सुषेणस्य महाकपेः। प्रसिद्धेयं भवेद्भूमिर्मैन्दद्विविदयोरपि।।5.3.15।।
output: 'This land can be reached by Kumuda and Angada or the great vanara Sushena and even by Mainda and Dvivida.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विवस्वतस्तनूजस्य हरेश्च कुशपर्वणः। ऋक्षस्य केतुमालस्य मम चैव गतिर्भवेत्।।5.3.16।।
output: विवस्वतः Sun's, तनूजस्य of the son, हरेः monkey's, कुशपर्वणः of Kushaparva, कपिमुख्यस्य of the chief of vanaras, केतुमालस्य Ketumala, ऋक्षस्य Riksha (Jambavan) also, मम चैव for me also, गतिः within reach, भवेत् will be.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समीक्ष्य तु महाबाहू राघवस्य पराक्रमम्। लक्ष्मणस्य च विक्रान्तमभवत् प्रीतिमान् कपिः।।5.3.17।।
output: कपिः vanara, महाबाहु: longarmed, राघवस्य Raghava's, पराक्रमम् valour, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, विक्रान्तं च valiant advances, समीक्ष्य after considering, प्रीतिमान् pleased, अभवत् felt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां रत्नवसनोपेतां कोष्ठागारावतंसकाम्। यन्त्रागारस्तनीमृद्धां प्रमदामिव भूषिताम्।।5.3.18।। तां नष्टतिमिरां दीप्तैर्भास्वरैश्च महागृहैः। नगरीं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य स ददर्श महाकपिः।।5.3.19।।
output: सः महाकपिः the great vanara, रत्नवसनोपेताम् clad in robes studded with gems, कोष्ठागारावतंसकाम् stable houses as her earrings, यन्त्रागाराम् armouries, ऋद्धाम् breasts, भूषिताम् ornamented, प्रमदामिव  like a young maiden, दीप्तै: by glittering ones, भास्वरैश्च by glowing, महागृहैः by great mansions, नष्टतिमिराम् dispelled darkness, ताम् hero, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, नगरीम् city, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
तां रत्नवसनोपेतां कोष्ठागारावतंसकाम्। यन्त्रागारस्तनीमृद्धां प्रमदामिव भूषिताम्।।5.3.18।। तां नष्टतिमिरां दीप्तैर्भास्वरैश्च महागृहैः। नगरीं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य स ददर्श महाकपिः।।5.3.19।।
output: Hanuman looked at the city of the demon king, whose darkness was dispelled by bright gems and mighty mansions as if it were a young maiden. The prosperous city was like a well decorated woman, adorned with ornaments having walls for her dress, the stables for her earrings, the armouries for her breasts.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
थ सा हरिशार्दूलं प्रविशन्तं महाबलम्। नगरी स्वेन रूपेण ददर्श पवनात्मजम्।।5.3.20।।
output: अथ then, सा नगरी that city, हरिशार्दूलम् tiger among vanaras, महाबलम् of great prowess, पवनात्मजम् son of the Windgod, प्रविशन्तम् while he entered, स्वेन in her real, रूपेण form, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा तं हरिवरं दृष्ट्वा लङ्का रावणपालिता। स्वयमेवोत्थिता तत्र विकृताननदर्शना।।5.3.21।।
output: Seeing the best of vanaras, the deity of the city of Lanka, ruled by Ravana rose up before him in a distorted form.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुरस्तात्कपिवर्यस्य वायुसूनोरतिष्ठत। मुञ्चमाना महानादमब्रवीत्पवनात्मजम्।।5.3.22।।
output: कपिवर्यस्य at the great vanara, वायुसूनोः of the son of the Windgod, पुरस्तात् in front of, अतिष्ठत stood, महानादम् loud sound, मुञ्चमाना while producing, पवनात्मजम् to the son of the Windgod, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कस्त्वं केन च कार्येण इह प्राप्तो वनालय। कथयस्वेह यत्तत्त्वं यावत्प्राणा धरन्ति ते।।5.3.23।।
output: "O dweller of the forest, who are you? Why did you come here? Speak the truth about your identity, so long as you hold on to your life.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न शक्यं खल्वियं लङ्का प्रवेष्टुं वानर त्वया। रक्षिता रावणबलैरभिगुप्ता समन्ततः।।5.3.24।।
output: वानर vanara, रावणबलैः by Ravana's army, रक्षिता protected, समन्ततः everywhere, अभिगुप्ता kept secret, इयं लङ्का this Lanka, त्वया by you, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, न शक्यं खलु surely not possible.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ तामब्रवीद्वीरो हनुमानग्रतः स्थिताम्। कथयिष्यामि ते तत्त्वं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि।।5.3.25।।
output: Then Hanuman who was standing in front of her said, "I will tell you the truth since you are asking me".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
का त्वं विरूपनयना पुरद्वारेऽवतिष्ठसि। किमर्थं चापि मां रुद्ध्वा निर्भर्त्सयसि दारुणा।।5.3.26।।
output: पुरद्वारे at the gate of the city, अवतिष्ठसि  stands, विरूपनयना woman of ugly distorted eyes, त्वम् you, का who are, दारुणा dreadful, माम् me, रुद्ध्वा after obstructing, किमर्थम् why, निर्भर्त्सयसि threatening.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हनुमद्वचनं श्रुत्वा लङ्का सा कामरूपिणी। उवाच वचनं क्रुद्धा परुषं पवनात्मजम्।।5.3.27।।
output: कामरूपिणी one who can assume any form at free will, सा लङ्का that Lanka, हनुमद्वचनम् Hanuman's words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, क्रुद्धा enraged, पवनात्मजम् son of Windgod, परुषम् harsh, वचनम् words, उवाच spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं राक्षसराजस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः। आज्ञाप्रतीक्षा दुर्धर्षा रक्षामि नगरीमिमाम्।।5.3.28।।
output: "In obedience to the orders of the great demon king, Ravana, I am protecting this unassailable city.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न शक्या मामवज्ञाय प्रवेष्टुं नगरी त्वया। अद्य प्राणैः परित्यक्तः स्वप्स्यसे निहतो मया।।5.3.29।।
output: "It is not possible for you to enter this city ignoring my presence. Soon you will be killed. You will give up your life and attain eternal sleep.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं हि नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम। सर्वतः परिरक्षामि ह्येतत्ते कथितं मया।।5.3.30।।
output: "O monkey I am the presiding ogress of Lanka presenting myself personally. I  am to protect this city. This is my answer to you".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लङ्काया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः। यत्नवान्स हरिश्रेष्ठः स्थितश्शैल इवापरः।।5.3.31।।
output: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हरिश्रेष्ठः best of the monkeys, सः he, हनुमान् Hanuman, लङ्कायाः Lanka's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, यत्नवान् he got ready, अपरः another, शैलः mountain, स्थितः stood, इव like.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
स तां स्त्रीरूपविकृतां दृष्टवा वानरपुङ्गवः। आबभाषेऽथ मेधावी सत्त्ववान् प्लवगर्षभः।।5.3.32।।
output: Seeing the monster of a woman, the powerful Hanuman, bull among vanaras endowed with wisdom spoke to her.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्रक्ष्यामि नगरीं लङ्कां साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम्। निर्विशङ्कमिमंलोकं पश्यन्त्यास्तवसांप्रतम्। इत्यर्थमिह संप्राप्तः परं कौतूहलं हि मे।।5.3.33।।
output: साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम् marketplaces, ramparts and gateways,  निर्विशङ्कम् freely, इमं लोकं this world, लङ्कां नगरीम् Lanka city, द्रक्ष्यामि I see, इत्यर्थम् for this reason, इह here, संप्राप्तः I came here, मे to myself, परम् great, कौतूहलं हि curiosity

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
वनान्युपवनानीह लङ्कायाः काननानि च। सर्वतो गृहमुख्यानि द्रष्टुमागमनं हि मे।।5.3.34।।
output: "I have arrived here to see Lanka's gardens, groves and forests and also all the important houses".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा लङ्का सा कामरूपिणी। भूय एव पुनर्वाक्यं बभाषे परुषाक्षरम्।।5.3.35।।
output: कामरूपिणी one who can assume any form at free will, लङ्का Lanka, तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, पुनः again, भूयः एव more, वाक्यम् words, परुषाक्षरम् in harsh words, बभाषे spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
मामनिर्जित्य दुर्बुद्धे राक्षसेश्वरपालितां। न शक्यमद्य ते द्रष्टुं पुरीयं वानराधम।।5.3.36।।
output: "O evilminded, foolish monkey It is not possible for you to enter the city ruled by Ravana, the king of demons without conquering me".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः स कपिशार्दूलस्तामुवाच निशाचरीम्। दृष्ट्वा पुरीमिमां भद्रे पुनर्यास्ये यथागतम्।।5.3.37।।
output: The tiger among monkeys said to the, the nightwalker "O noble Lanka I shall see this city and go back".

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः कृत्वा महानादं सा वै लङ्का भयावहम्। तलेन वानरश्रेष्ठं ताडयामास वेगिता।।5.3.38।।
output: ततः then, सा लङ्का that Lanka, भयावहम् frightening, महानादम् loud noise, कृत्वा after making, वेगिता with speed, वानरश्रेष्ठम् best vanara, तलेन with her palm, ताडयामास struck.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
ततः स कपिशार्दूलो लङ्कया ताडितो भृशम्। ननाद सुमहानादं वीर्यवान् पवनात्मजः।।5.3.39।।
output: At this strong slap, the heroic Hanuman, son of the Windgod roared loudly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
ततः संवर्तयामास वामहस्तस्य सोऽङ्गुलीः। मुष्टिनाऽऽभिजघानैनां हनुमान् क्रोधमूर्छितः।।5.3.40।। स्त्री चेति मन्यमानेन नातिक्रोधः स्वयं कृतः।
output: Overcome by anger, Hanuman clenched the fingers of his left hand and hit her with his fist. Considering her to be, after all, a woman he did not turn outrageous.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलाङ्गी निशाचरी।।5.3.41।। पपात सहसा भूमौ विकृताननदर्शना।
output: Struck by the blow of Hanuman the demoness fell down on the ground at once, her limbs shattered, her face distorted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तु हनुमान् प्राज्ञस्तां दृष्ट्वा विनिपातिताम्।।5.3.42।। कृपां चकार तेजस्वी मन्यमानः स्त्रियं तु ताम्।
output: Wise and brilliant Hanuman, seeing the deity fallen down, left her (without killing her) out of compassion, thinking that she is a woman, after all.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो वै भृशसंविग्ना लङ्का सा गद्गदाक्षरम्।।5.3.43।। उवाचागर्वितं वाक्यं हनूमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम्।
output: ततः then, सा that, लङ्का Lanka, भृशसंविग्ना greatly agitated, गद्गदाक्षरम् with choked voice, अगर्बितम् deflated of pride, वाक्यम् these words, प्लवङ्गमम् to the monkey, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, उवाच said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रसीद सुमहाबाहो त्रायस्व हरिसत्तम ।।5.3.44।। समये सौम्य तिष्ठन्ति सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः।
output: सुमहाबाहो O longarmed, हरिसत्तम great monkey, प्रसीद be gracious, त्रायस्व save me, सौम्य noble, सत्त्ववन्तः hero of great strength, महाबलाः strong, समये when the time comes, तिष्ठन्ति abide.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहं तु नगरी लङ्का स्वयमेव प्लवङ्गम।।5.3.45।। निर्जिताहं त्वया वीर विक्रमेण महाबल।
output: प्लवङ्गम O monkey, अहं तु I, on my part, स्वयम् self, लङ्कानगर्येव city of Lanka itself, महाबल O strong one, वीर O hero, अहम् I, त्वया by you, विक्रमेण with valour, निर्जिता won.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदं तु तथ्यं शृणु वै ब्रुवन्त्या मे हरीश्वर।।5.3.46।। स्वयंभुवा पुरा दत्तं वरदानं यथा मम।
output: हरीश्वर O lord of vanaras, पुरा in the past, मम to me, स्वयंभुवा by the creator Brahma, यथा as, वरदानम् a boon, दत्तम् given, इदम् this, तथ्यं तु it is true, ब्रुवन्त्या while I tell you, मे to my self, शृणु वै listen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदा त्वां वानरः कश्चिद्विक्रमाद्वशमानयेत्।।5.3.47।। तदा त्वया हि विज्ञेयं रक्षसां भयमागतम्।
output: यदा when, कश्चित् one, वानरः vanara, विक्रमात् by his prowess, त्वाम् you, वशम् आनयेत् vanquishes you,तदा then, राक्षसाम् for demons, भयम् danger, आगतम् will set in, त्वया by you, विज्ञेयम् know.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
स हि मे समयः सौम्य प्राप्तोऽद्य तव दर्शनात्।।5.3.48।। स्वयंभू विहितः सत्यो न तस्यास्ति व्यतिक्रमः।
output: "O gentle one the time ordained by Brahma has come today with your presence  here. The truth revealed by Brahma, the selfborn, cannot be proved otherwise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 3:
सीतानिमित्तं राज्ञस्तु रावणस्य दुरात्मनः।।5.3.49।। रक्षसां चैव सर्वेषां विनाशः समुपागतः।
output: "The ruin of all demons and evilminded king Ravana will take place due to (the abduction of) Sita.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्प्रविश्य हरिश्रेष्ठ पुरीं रावणपालिताम्।।5.3.50।। विधत्स्व सर्वकार्याणि यानि यानीह वाञ्छसि।
output: हरिश्रेष्ठ O great vanara, तत् therefore, रावण पालिताम् ruled by Ravana, पुरीम् city, प्रविश्य after entering, इह here, यानि यानि whatever, वाञ्छसि you wish to do, सर्वकार्याणि all works, विधत्स्व undertake.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रविश्य शापोपहतां हरीश्वर शुभां पुरीं राक्षसमुख्यपालिताम्। यदृच्छया त्वं जनकात्मजां सतीं विमार्ग सर्वत्र गतो यथासुखम्।।5.3.51।।
output: "O lord of vanaras you may search for the chaste lady, daughter of king Janaka all over freely entering this doomed city, ruled by the chief of demons. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायाणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे तृतीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the third sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स निर्जित्य पुरीं श्रेष्ठां लङ्कां तां कामरूपिणीम्। विक्रमेण महातेजा हनुमान् कपिसत्तमः।।5.4.1।। अद्वारेण च महाबाहुः प्राकारमभिपुप्लुवे।
output: कपिसत्तमः monkey chief, महातेजाः mighty, महाबाहुः of strong shoulders, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, कामरूपिणीम् who can assume any form at free will, श्रेष्ठाम् excellent, तां लङ्काम् that deity of Lanka, विक्रमेण by his prowess, निर्जित्य having won, अद्वारेण by the rear entrance, प्राकारम् boundary, अभिपुप्लुवे leapt over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 4:
प्रविश्य नगरीं लङ्कां कपिराजहितंकरः।।5.4.2।। चक्रेऽथ पादं सव्यं च शत्रूणां स तु मूर्धनि।
output: Hanuman, a devotee of the king of monkeys entered the city of Lanka placing his left foot first on the forehead of the city and proceeded (by tradition one enters the enemy's dwelling by placing the left foot first to cause defeat of the enemy).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 4:
प्रविष्टः सत्त्वसम्पन्नो निशायां मारुतात्मजः।।5.4.3।। स महापथमास्थाय मुक्तापुष्पविराजितम्। ततस्तु तां पुरीं लङ्कां रम्यामभिययौ कपिः।।5.4.4।।
output: The son of the Windgod, endowed with great strength, entered the enchanting Lanka and walked along the highway set with flowers of pearls.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रविष्टः सत्त्वसम्पन्नो निशायां मारुतात्मजः।।5.4.3।। स महापथमास्थाय मुक्तापुष्पविराजितम्। ततस्तु तां पुरीं लङ्कां रम्यामभिययौ कपिः।।5.4.4।।
output: The son of the Windgod, endowed with great strength, entered the enchanting Lanka and walked along the highway set with flowers of pearls.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हसितोत्कृष्टनिनदैस्तूर्यघोषपुरस्सरैः। वज्रांकुशनिकाशैश्च वज्रजालविभूषितैः।।5.4.5।। गृहमेघैः पुरी रम्या बभासे द्यौरिवाम्बुदैः।
output: हसितोत्कृष्टनिनदैः filled with sounds of laughter, तूर्यघोषपुरः सरैः reverberating with sounds of musical instruments, वज्रांकुशनिकाशैश्च by those comparable to the goads of diamonds, वज्रजालविभूषितैः adorned with diamond lattices, गृहमेघैः  the houses like clouds, रम्या beautiful, पुरी city, अम्बुदैः with clouds, द्यौरिव like the sky, बभासे was shining.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 4:
प्रजज्वाल ततो लङ्का रक्षोगणगृहैः शुभैः।।5.4.6।। सिताभ्रसदृशैश्चित्रैः पद्मस्वस्तिकसंस्थितैः। वर्धमानगृहैश्चापि सर्वतः सुविभूषिता।।5.4.7।।
output: The city of Lanka appeared radiant with its tall mansions resembling white clouds. The  mansions had auspicious marks of lotus and swastika engraved on them and were opening in the direction of the south.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 4:
प्रजज्वाल ततो लङ्का रक्षोगणगृहैः शुभैः।।5.4.6।। सिताभ्रसदृशैश्चित्रैः पद्मस्वस्तिकसंस्थितैः। वर्धमानगृहैश्चापि सर्वतः सुविभूषिता।।5.4.7।।
output: The city of Lanka appeared radiant with its tall mansions resembling white clouds. The  mansions had auspicious marks of lotus and swastika engraved on them and were opening in the direction of the south.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तां चित्रमाल्याभरणां कपिराजहितङ्करः। राघवार्थं चरन् श्रीमान् ददर्श च ननन्द च।।5.4.8।।
output: Glorious Hanuman, wellwisher of Sugriva, king of vanaras, looked around the city, decorated with colourful garlands. Surveying it for the cause of Raghava, he was greatly delighted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवनाद्भवनं गच्छन् ददर्श पवनात्मजः। विविधाकृतिरूपाणि भवनानि ततस्ततः।।5.4.9।।
output: Going from one building to another, Hanuman saw mansions of different kinds  structures.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुश्राव मधुरं गीतं त्रिस्थानस्वरभूषितम्। स्त्रीणां मदसमृद्धानां दिवि चाप्सरसामिव।।5.4.10।।
output: He heard melodious songs of intoxicated women set to tune in three places namely chest, throat and head and three pitches known as mandra (slow) madhya (medium) and tara (high). The songs resembled those of the apsarasas well set in musical notes set to music.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुश्राव काञ्चीनिनदं नूपुराणां च, निःस्वनम्। सोपाननिनदांश्चैव भवनेषु महात्मनाम्।।5.4.11।। अस्फोटितनिनादांश्च क्ष्वेलितांश्च ततस्ततः।
output: Great Hanuman heard the jingling sounds of waist bells and anklets of women and sounds of great men climbing up and down flights of steps, sounds of clapping and joking everywhere in the mansions.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुश्राव जपतां तत्र मन्त्रान् रक्षोगृहेषु वै।।5.4.12।। स्वाध्यायनिरतांश्चैव यातुधानान् ददर्श सः। रावणस्तवसंयुक्तान् गर्जतो राक्षसानपि।।5.4.13।।
output: He heard chantings of sacred verses in the houses of demons engaged in the study of the vedas. And heard demons singing loudly the eulogy of Ravana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शुश्राव जपतां तत्र मन्त्रान् रक्षोगृहेषु वै।।5.4.12।। स्वाध्यायनिरतांश्चैव यातुधानान् ददर्श सः। रावणस्तवसंयुक्तान् गर्जतो राक्षसानपि।।5.4.13।।
output: तत्र there, रक्षोगृहेषु in the demons' houses, जपताम् of those chanting, मन्त्रान् sacred (verses) words, शुश्राव heard, सः he, स्वाध्यायनिरतान् of those engaged in the study of Vedas continuously, यातुधानान् of demons, ददर्श saw, रावणस्तवसंयुक्तान् those engaged in the eulogy of Ravana, गर्जतः of those shouting, राक्षसानपि even the demons, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राजमार्गं समावृत्य स्थितं रक्षोबलं महत्। ददर्श मध्यमे गुल्मे रावणस्य चरान् बहून्।।5.4.14।।
output: मध्यमे in the midst, गुल्मे in the city, राजमार्गम् highway, समावृत्य surrounding, स्थितम् stationed, महत् great, रक्षोबलम् army of demons, रावणस्य of Ravana, बहून् many, चरान् spies, ददर्श observed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दीक्षितान् जटिलान् मुण्डान् गोजिनाम्बरवाससः। दर्भमुष्टिप्रहरणानग्निकुण्डायुघांस्तथा।।5.4.15।। कूटमुद्गरपाणींश्च दण्डायुधधरानपि। एकाक्षानेककर्णांश्च लम्बोदरपयोधरान्।।5.4.16।। करालान् भुग्नवक्त्रांश्च विकटान् वामनांस्तथा। धन्विनः खङ्गिनश्चैव शतघ्नीमुसलायुधान्।।5.4.17।। परिघोत्तमहस्तांश्च विचित्रकवचोज्ज्वलान्। नातिस्थूलान्नातिकृशान्नातिदीर्घातिह्रस्वकान्।।5.4.18।। नातिगौरान्नातिकृष्णान्नातिकुब्जान्न वामनान्। विरूपान् बहुरूपांश्च सुरूपांश्च सुवर्चसः।5.4.19।। ध्वजीन् पताकिनश्चैव ददर्श विविधायुधान्।
output: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were  holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 4:
दीक्षितान् जटिलान् मुण्डान् गोजिनाम्बरवाससः। दर्भमुष्टिप्रहरणानग्निकुण्डायुघांस्तथा।।5.4.15।। कूटमुद्गरपाणींश्च दण्डायुधधरानपि। एकाक्षानेककर्णांश्च लम्बोदरपयोधरान्।।5.4.16।। करालान् भुग्नवक्त्रांश्च विकटान् वामनांस्तथा। धन्विनः खङ्गिनश्चैव शतघ्नीमुसलायुधान्।।5.4.17।। परिघोत्तमहस्तांश्च विचित्रकवचोज्ज्वलान्। नातिस्थूलान्नातिकृशान्नातिदीर्घातिह्रस्वकान्।।5.4.18।। नातिगौरान्नातिकृष्णान्नातिकुब्जान्न वामनान्। विरूपान् बहुरूपांश्च सुरूपांश्च सुवर्चसः।5.4.19।। ध्वजीन् पताकिनश्चैव ददर्श विविधायुधान्।
output: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were  holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.

output: दीक्षितान् priests, जटिलान् ascetics (with matted hair), मुण्डान् with shaven heads, गोजिनाम्बरवासस: robed in cowhides, दर्भमुष्टिप्रहरणान् who held darbha grass, तथा so also, अग्निकुण्डायुधान् equipped with tools for fire sacrifice, कूटमुद्गरपाणीन् च holding iron mallets and hammers in hand, दण्डायुधधरानपि holding staff and spikes, एकाक्षान् singleeyed, एककर्णांश्च those with a single ear, लम्बोदरपयोधरान् with huge drooping stomachs and breasts, करालान् frightful, भुग्नवक्त्रांश्च with stooping faces, विकटान् of distorted forms, तथा similarly, वामनान् dwarfs, धन्विनः men armed with bows, खडिगनश्चैव with swords, शतघ्नीमुसलायुधान् with shataghni or pestle (club tripped with iron) like thunderbolt, परिघोत्तमहस्तांश्च ironbolt like hands, विचित्रकवचोज्ज्वलान् radiant with wonderful shields, नातिस्थूलान् not very stout, नातिकृशान् not very thin, नातिदीर्घातिह्रस्वकान् not very tall or short, नातिगौरान् not very fair, नातिकृष्णान् nor very dark, नातिकुब्जान् not so hunchbacked, न वामनान् neither very short, विरूपान् nor too hideous, बहुरूपांश्च in many forms, सुरूपांश्च goodlooking ones, सुवर्चसः of goodlooking countenance, ध्वजीन् holding banners, पताकिनश्चैव and flags, विविधायुधान् holding several kinds of weapons, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दीक्षितान् जटिलान् मुण्डान् गोजिनाम्बरवाससः। दर्भमुष्टिप्रहरणानग्निकुण्डायुघांस्तथा।।5.4.15।। कूटमुद्गरपाणींश्च दण्डायुधधरानपि। एकाक्षानेककर्णांश्च लम्बोदरपयोधरान्।।5.4.16।। करालान् भुग्नवक्त्रांश्च विकटान् वामनांस्तथा। धन्विनः खङ्गिनश्चैव शतघ्नीमुसलायुधान्।।5.4.17।। परिघोत्तमहस्तांश्च विचित्रकवचोज्ज्वलान्। नातिस्थूलान्नातिकृशान्नातिदीर्घातिह्रस्वकान्।।5.4.18।। नातिगौरान्नातिकृष्णान्नातिकुब्जान्न वामनान्। विरूपान् बहुरूपांश्च सुरूपांश्च सुवर्चसः।5.4.19।। ध्वजीन् पताकिनश्चैव ददर्श विविधायुधान्।
output: Going around Lanka, Hanuman witnessed all kinds of demons priests who were performing rituals, ascetics with matted hair, some with shaven heads, and some robed in cowhides. Some were  holding fistfuls of darbha grass (as weapons), others held sacrificial tools (as weapons), some had mallets, some hammers and others had staff and spikes. Some looked frightful with a single eye, some with a single ear, some with drooping stomachs and sagging breasts and in distorted forms. Similarly some dwarfs and some wielding iron weapons, their bodies covered with wonderful shields some not very tall or short, not stout or thin, not very dark and not with hideous forms or mutilated bodies. Some had goodlooking countenances, some were seen holding posts and flags and weapons of several kinds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 4:
शक्तिवृक्षायुधांश्चैव पट्टिसाशनिधारिणः।।5.4.20।। क्षेपणीपाशहस्तांश्च ददर्श स महाकपिः। स्रग्विणस्त्वनुलिप्तांश्च वराभरणभूषितान्।।5.4.21।। नानावेषसमायुक्तान् यथास्स्वैरगतान् बहून्। तीक्ष्णशूलधरांश्चैव वज्रिणश्च महाबलान्।।5.4.22।।
output: The great monkey saw the demons who held shaktis and trees as weapons (Shakti is a lance), some held threepointed spears, missiles and slings with which missiles are hurled. Some of them wore flower garlands, smeared unguents on their body and were bedecked with choicest ornaments. They were dressed in several ways and many of them moved freely. They were very strong and held sharp tridents and armed with thunderboltlike weapons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 4:
शतसाहस्रमव्यग्रमारक्षं मध्यमं कपिः। रक्षोधिपतिनिर्दिष्टं ददर्शान्तःपुराग्रतः।।5.4.23।।
output: Hanuman saw in front of the harem one hundred thousand strong, vigilant soldiers of a middle rank ordered by the lord of demons.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तदा तद्गृहं दृष्ट्वा महाहाटकतोरणम्। राक्षसेन्द्रस्य विख्यातमद्रिमूर्ध्नि प्रतिष्ठितम्।।5.4.24।। पुण्डरीकावतंसाभिः परिखाभिरलङ्कृतम्। प्राकारावृतमत्यन्तं ददर्श स महाकपिः।।5.4.25।।
output: The great monkey observed the huge archway of the demon king's palace made of gold situated on top of the mountain as if scraping the sky, circled by moats full of white lotuses appearing as though the moats were decorated with earornaments. The whole city was encircled by a boundary wall.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्रिविष्टपनिभं दिव्यं दिव्यनादनिनादितम्। वाजिहेषितसङ्घुष्टं नादितं भूषणैस्तथा।।5.4.26।। रथैर्यानैर्विमानैश्च तथा हयगजैः शुभैः। वारणैश्च चतुर्थन्तैः श्वेताभ्रनिचयोपमैः।।5.4.27।। भूषितं रुचिरद्वारं मत्तैश्च मृगपक्षिभिः। रक्षितं सुमहावीर्यैर्यातुधानैः सहस्रशः। राक्षसाधिपतेर्गुप्तमाविवेश महाकपिः।।5.4.28।।
output: And then the great vanara entered the wonderful mansion that resembled heaven. It was resonating with pleasing sounds of jingling ornaments made more noisy by the neighing of the horses. There were carriages, chariots, flying chariots, horses and elephants. The beautiful entrance was looking splendid with intoxicated animals and birds. That place looked splendid with fourtusked elephants resembling heaps of white clouds. The beautiful entrance was guarded by thousands of valiant demons.

output: महाकपिः great vanara, त्रिविष्टपनिभम् resembling heaven, दिव्यम् wonderful, वाजिहेषितसङ्घुष्टम् filled with neighing horses, तथा similarly, भूषणैः with ornaments, नादितम् vibrant, रथैः with chariots, यानैः with carriages, विमानैश्च with flying chariots, शुभैः with auspicious, हयगजैः horses and elephants, श्वेताभ्रनिचयोपमैः appearing like a heap of white clouds, चतुर्थर्न्तै: four tusked, वारणैश्च with elephants also, भूषितम् ornamented, मत्तै: intoxicated, मृगपक्षिभिः beasts and birds, रुचिरद्वारम् a beautiful entrance, सुमहावीर्यैः with demon's of great valour, सहस्रशः in their thousands, यातुधानैः by demons, रक्षितम् guarded, राक्षसाधिपतेः of the lord of demons, गुप्तम् secret, आविवेश entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सहेमजाम्बूनदचक्रवालं महार्हमुक्तामणिभूषितान्तम्। परार्थ्यकालागुरुचन्दनाक्तं स रावणान्तःपुरमाविवेश।।5.4.29।।
output: सः he, सहेम with gold, जाम्बूनदचक्रवालम् walls polished with gold, महार्हमुक्तामणिभूषितान्तम् decorated with precious pearl strings throughout, परार्थ्यकालागुरुचन्दनाक्तम् sprinkled with best of fragrants of sandal, रावणान्तःपुरम्  harem of Ravana, आविवेश entered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः स मध्यंगतमंशुमन्तं ज्योत्स्नावितानं महदुद्वमन्तम्। ददर्श धीमान् दिवि भानुमन्तं गोष्ठे वृषं मत्तमिव भ्रमन्तम्।।5.5.1।।
output: Hanuman finds demons all over Lanka -- feels sad, unable to find Sita.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
लोकस्य पापानि विनाशयन्तं महोदधिं चापि समेधयन्तम्। भूतानि सर्वाणि विराजयन्तं ददर्श शीतांशुमथाभियान्तम्।।5.5.2।।
output: While moving forward, Hanuman saw the Moon spreading his light, thereby warding off the agony of all creatures, causing the swelling of the ocean and illuminating the earth as well as the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
या भाति लक्ष्मीर्भुवि मन्दरस्था तथा प्रदोषेषु च सागरस्था। तथैव तोयेषु च पुष्करस्था रराज सा चारुनिशाकरस्था।।5.5.3।।
output: भुवि on earth, या that, लक्ष्मीः splendour (beauty), मन्दरस्था found on Mandara mountain, भाति glows, तथा so also, प्रदोषेषु at dusk, सागरस्था found in the ocean, तथैव the same, तोयेषु in water, पुष्करस्था in lotuses in the lakes, सा such, चारुनिशाकरस्था is found in beautiful Moon, रराज shone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हंसो यथा राजतपञ्जरस्थः सिंहो यथा मन्दरकन्दरस्थः। वीरो यथा गर्वितकुञ्जरस्थ चन्द्रोऽपि बभ्राज तथाम्बरस्थः।।5.5.4।।
output: 'Like a swan in a cage of silver, like a lion in a cave of Mandara mountain, like a hero on a proud, intoxicated elephant, the Moon shone in the sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्थितः ककुद्मानिव तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो महाचलः श्वेत इवोच्चशृङ्गः। हस्तीव जाम्बूनदबद्धशृङ्गो रराज चन्द्रः परिपूर्णशृङ्गः।।5.5.5।।
output: The fullmoon with its hornlike spot  shone like a bull with sharp horns, like the  white Himalayan mountain with its lofty peaks, and like an elephant with gold plated tusks

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनष्टशीताम्बुतुषारपङ्को महाग्रहग्राहविनष्टपङ्कः। प्रकाशलक्ष्म्याश्रयनिर्मलाङ्क: रराज चन्द्रो भगवान् शशाङ्कः।।5.5.6।।
output: विनष्टशीताम्बुतुषारपङ्कः with the dew formed with frost, महाग्रहग्राह विनष्टपङ्कः the frost destroyed by the  great planet (Sun), प्रकाशलक्ष्म्याश्रयनिर्मलाङ्कः the clean surface resting on graceful radiance, शशाङ्कः the rabbitlike figure on Moon, भगवान् god, चन्द्रः Moon, रराज shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
शिलातलं प्राप्य यथा मृगेन्द्रो महारणं प्राप्य यथा गजेन्द्रः। राज्यं समासाद्य यथा नरेन्द्र स्तथाप्रकाशो विरराज चन्द्रः।।5.5.7।।
output: The Moon shone bright like a lion mounted on a rock, like a lordly elephant in a deep forest, like a king on attaining the kingdom.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रकाशचन्द्रोदयनष्टदोषः प्रवृत्तरक्षः पिशिताशदोषः। रामाभिरामेरितचित्तदोषः स्वर्गप्रकाशो भगवान् प्रदोषः।।5.5.8।।
output: प्रकाशचन्द्रोदयनष्टदोषः the darkness dispelled with the rise of the radiant Moon, प्रवृत्तरक्षःपिशिताशदोषः dark deeds dispelled, canibals started by their movement, रामाभिरामेरितचित्तदोषः the natural instinct for love among women is incited, भगवान् resplendent Moon, प्रदोषः dusk, स्वर्गप्रकाशः spread its bliss like heaven every where.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तन्त्रीस्वनाः कर्णसुखाः प्रवृत्ताः स्वपन्ति नार्यः पतिभिः सुवृत्ताः। नक्तंचराश्चापि तथा प्रवृत्ता: विहर्तुमत्यद्भुतरौद्रवृत्ताः।।5.5.9।।
output: कर्णसुखाः pleasing to the ears, तन्त्रीस्वनाः sounds of string instruments, प्रवृत्ताः started, सुवृत्ताः chaste, नार्यः women, पतिभिः with their husbands, स्वपन्ति are sleeping, तथा likewise, अत्यद्भुतरौद्रवृत्ता: whose deeds were wonderful exhibiting their anger, नक्तंचराश्चापि night walkers also, विहर्तुम् to roam about, प्रवृत्ताः started.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मत्तप्रमत्तानि समाकुलानि रथाश्वभद्रासनसङ्कुलानि। वीरश्रिया चापि समाकुलानि ददर्श धीमान् स कपिः कुलानि।।5.5.10।।
output: Intelligent Hanuman, the great warrior, observed there in the prosperous mansions, demons proud of their wealth, highly intoxicated and dull, their houses full of horsedrawn chariots with comfortable seats.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परस्परं चाधिकमाक्षिपन्ति भुजांश्च पीनानधिकं क्षिपन्ति। मत्तप्रलापानधिकं क्षिपन्ति मत्तानि चान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्ति।।5.5.11।।
output: The intoxicated demons were quarrelling, ridiculing one another bitterly and wildly throwing their stout arms on one another, indulging in incoherent talk, uttering vulgar words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
रक्षांसि वक्षांसि च विक्षिपन्ति गात्राणि कान्तासु च विक्षिपन्ति। रूपाणि चित्राणि च विक्षिपन्ति दृढानि चापानि च विक्षिपन्ति।।5.5.12।।
output: The demons were seen expanding their chests sportively and caressing their wives by placing their limbs on them. They were assuming wonderful forms, and drawing their bows up to their ears.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ददर्श कान्ताश्च समालभन्त्य स्तथा परास्तत्र पुनः स्वपन्त्यः। सुरूपवक्त्राश्च तथा हसन्त्यः क्रुद्धाः पराश्चापि विनिःश्वसन्त्य।।5.5.13।।
output: He even saw women collected there, their limbs smeared with unguents on their bodies, like wise women with beautiful countenances laughing at others, some sleeping, and others hissing (sighing) like angry serpents.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महागजैश्चापि तथा नदद्भि: सुपूजितैश्चापि तथा सुसद्भिः। रराज वीरैश्च विनिःश्वसद्भिः ह्रदो भुजङ्गैरिव निःश्वसद्भिः।।5.5.14।।
output: There were huge elephants trumpeting, respected people, warriors sighing for the lack of enemies (to vanquish). It had a lake infested with hissing snakes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
बुद्धिप्रधानान् रुचिराभिधानान् संश्रद्धधानान् जगतः प्रधानान्। नानाविधानान् रुचिराभिधानान् ददर्श तस्यां पुरि यातुधानान्।।5.5.15।।
output: He saw there in the city of Lanka, demons, who were intellectuals, pleasing in words, with faith in religion, preeminent heroes of the world  of different kinds, followers of good practices and with lovely names.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
ननन्द दृष्ट्वा स च तान् सुरूपान्नानागुणानात्मगुणानुरूपान्। विद्योतमानान्स तदानुरूपान् ददर्श कांश्चिच्च पुनर्विरूपान्।।5.5.16।।
output: He rejoiced to see the handsome demons radiant with forms commensurate with their virtues. He also saw some ugly figures, their traits in conformity to their forms.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
ततो वरार्हाः सुविशुद्धभावा स्तेषां स्त्रियस्तत्र महानुभावाः। प्रियेषु पानेषु च सक्तभावा ददर्श तारा इव सुप्रभावाः।।5.5.17।।
output: There he saw demonesses adorned with choicest ornaments, their minds attached faithfully to their husbands and bottles of wine. Some of the wives of the demons, however, looked gentle and bright like stars.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रिया ज्वलन्तीस्त्रपयोपगूढा निशीथकाले रमणोपगूढाः। ददर्श काश्चित्प्रमदोपगूढा यथा विहङ्गाः कुसुमोपगूढाः।।5.5.18।।
output: श्रिया with grace, ज्वलन्ती shining brightly, त्रपया with shyness, उपगूढाः embraced, निशीथकाले at night, रमणोपगूढाः embraced by the beloved, प्रमदोपगूढाः filled with joy, कुसुमोपगूढाः adorned with flowers, विहङ्गाः यथा like birds, काश्चित् indeed, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
अन्याः पुनर्हर्म्यतलोपविष्टा स्तत्र प्रियाङ्केषु सुखोपविष्टाः। भर्तुः प्रिया धर्मपरा निविष्टा ददर्श धीमान् मदनाभिविष्टाः।।5.5.19।।
output: Intelligent Hanuman saw demonesses seated happily on the laps of their beloved ones on the terraces of the mansions, exhibiting their attachment to one another,  overwhelmed with sexual pleasure.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अप्रावृताः काञ्चनराजिवर्णाः काश्चित्परार्थ्यास्तपनीयवर्णाः। पुनश्च काश्चिच्छशलक्ष्मवर्णाः कान्तप्रहीणा रुचिराङ्गवर्णाः।।5.5.20।।
output: अप्रावृताः without any veil, काञ्चनराजिवर्णाः of golden hue,परार्थ्याः altruistic demonesses, तपनीयवर्णाः shining with polished gold, काश्चित् a few, पुनश्च again, शशलक्ष्मवर्णाः pale white like the colour of Moon, काश्चित् a few, रुचिराङ्गवर्णाः of attractive complexion, कान्तप्रहीणाः separated from their husbands.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
ततः प्रियान् प्राप्य मनोभिरामाः सुप्रीतियुक्ताः प्रसमीक्ष्यरामाः। गृहेषु हृष्टाः परमाभिरामाः हरिप्रवीरः स ददर्श रामाः।।5.5.21।।
output: That heroic monkey saw ogresses delighted in the happy company of their loved ones who have joined them, ecstatic wives in the houses.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चन्द्रप्रकाशाश्च हि वक्त्रमालाः वक्राक्षिपक्ष्माश्च सुनेत्रमालाः। विभूषणानां च ददर्श मालाः शतह्रदानामिव चारुमालाः।।5.5.22।।
output: He saw rows of faces of shedemons shining like moonlight with sidelong glances and graceful eyelashes wearing ornaments resembling charmimg flashes of lightning.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
न त्वेव सीतां परमाभिजातां पथि स्थिते राजकुले प्रजाताम्। लतां प्रपुल्लामिव साधु जातां ददर्श तन्वीं मनसाभिजाताम्।।5.5.23।।
output: Hanuman could not find Sita  anywhere, an excellent lady  born in a noble royal family, adopting the right path, a lady  delicate like a blossoming creeper of good breed, or so he imagined.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 5:
सनातने वर्त्मनि सन्निविष्टां रामेक्षणां तां मदनाभिविष्टाम्। भर्तुर्मनः श्रीमदनुप्रविष्टां स्त्रीभ्यो वराभ्यश्च सदा विशिष्टाम्।।5.5.24।।
output: 'Sita must have had a pair of beautiful eyes. She must have been a passionate lady with mind fixed on her glorious husband. Ever established in dharma, she is perhaps a distinguished lady compared to her counterparts (in Lanka).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उष्णार्दितां सानुसृतास्रकण्ठीम् पुरा वरार्होत्तमनिष्ककण्ठीम्। सुजातपक्ष्मामभिरक्तकण्ठीं वनेऽप्रवृत्तामिव नीलकण्ठीम्।।5.5.25।।
output: उष्णार्दिताम् shedding hot tears, सानुसृतास्रकण्ठीम् with her throat choked with incessant tears, पुरा earlier, वरार्होत्तमनिष्ककण्ठीम् wearing costly ornaments on the neck, सुजातपक्ष्माम्  who has beautiful eyelashes, अभिरक्तकण्ठीम् a woman of sweet, loving voice, वने in the forest, अप्रवृत्ताम् wandering, नीलकण्ठीमिव like a peahen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अव्यक्तरेखामिव चन्द्ररेखां पांसुप्रदिग्धामिव हेमरेखाम्। क्षतप्ररूढामिव बाणरेखां वायुप्रभिन्नामिव मेघरेखाम्।।5.5.26।।
output: She would be like a barely visible ray of the Moon, like a streak of gold covered with dust, like an unhealed scar of a wound caused by an arrow only superficially covered and like a flake of cloud swept off by the wind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सीतामपश्यन् मनुजेश्वरस्य रामस्य पत्नीं वदतां वरस्य। बभूव दुःखाभिहतश्चिरस्य प्लवङ्गमो मन्द इवाचिरस्य।।5.5.27।।
output: Hanuman stood griefstricken, having (unsuccessfully) searched for a long time for the wife of Rama, the lord of men. The highly eloquent was now despondent. For a while he looked dull and dejected. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स निकामं विमानेषु निषण्णः कामरूपधृत्। विचचार पुनर्लङ्कां लाघवेन समन्वितः।।5.6.1।।
output: कामरूपधृत् who could assume any form, सः that (Hanuman), विमानेषु in the tall mansions, निकामम् freely, निषण्णः sad, पुनः again, लाघवेन rapidly, समन्वितः endowed with strength, लङ्काम् Lanka, विचचार started ranging

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान्राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्। प्राकारेणार्कवर्णेन भास्वरेणाभिसम्वृतम्।।5.6.2।।
output: अथ then, लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, अर्कवर्णेन red in colour, भास्वरेण dazzling like the midday Sun, प्राकारेण by the boundary wall, अभिसम्वृतम् enclosed, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् the residence of the lord of demons, आससाद reached

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रक्षितं राक्षसैर्घोरैः सिंहैरिव महद्वनम्। समीक्षमाणो भवनं चकाशे कपिकुञ्जरः।।5.6.3।।
output: सिंहैः by lions, महावनमिव like a thick forest, भीमैः by fearful, राक्षसैः by demons, रक्षितम् protected, भवनम् mansion, समीक्षमाणः observing, कपिकुञ्जर: elephant among vanaras, चकाशे looked bright

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रूप्यकोपहितै श्चित्रैस्तोरणैर्हेमभूषितैः। विचित्राभिश्च कक्ष्याभिर्द्वारैश्च रुचिरैर्वृतम्।।5.6.4।।
output: He saw beautiful silver archways decorated with gold, colourful inner apartments with beauteous entrances.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गजास्थितैर्महामात्रैः शूरैश्च विगतश्रमैः। उपस्थितमसंहार्यैः र्हयैः स्यन्दनयायिभिः।।5.6.5।।
output: गजास्थितैः mounted on elephants, शूरैः by drivers, विगतश्रमैः unwearied, महामात्रैः great, असंहार्यैः irresistible, हयैः with horses, स्यन्दनयायिभिः  chariotriders, उपस्थितम् kept ready

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 6:
सिंहव्याघ्रतनुत्राणैर्दान्तकाञ्चनराजतैः। घोषवद्भिर्विचित्रैश्च सदा विचरितं रथैः।।5.6.6।।
output: There were wonderful chariots covered with skins of lions and tigers, encrusted with ivory, gold and silver with ringing bells moving about.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बहुरत्नसमाकीर्णं परार्थ्यसनभाजनम्। महारथसमावासं महारथमहास्वनम्।।5.6.7।।
output: बहुरत्नसमाकीर्णम् with many precious gems, परार्थ्यासनभाजनम् with excellent seats and vessels, महारथसमावासम् having halting places for big  chariots, महारथमहास्वनम् filled with deep sounds of great charioteers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृश्यैश्च परमोदारैस्तैस्तैश्च मृगपक्षिभिः। विविधै र्बहुसाहस्रैः परिपूर्णं समन्ततः।।5.6.8।।
output: It was pleasing with several kinds of beautiful beasts in their thousands all over.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनीतैरन्तपालैश्च रक्षोभिश्च सुरक्षितम्। मुख्याभिश्च वरस्त्रीभिः परिपूर्णं समन्ततः।।5.6.9।।
output: विनीतैः by disciplined, अन्तपालैः by guards, रक्षोभिः by demons, सुरक्षितम् well guarded, मुख्याभिः important, वरस्त्रीभिः by beautiful shedemons, समन्ततः everywhere, परिपूर्णम् filled

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुदितप्रमदारत्नं राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्। वराभरणसंह्रादैः समुद्रस्वनन्निस्वनम्।।5.6.10।।
output: Full of the jewels of joyous women, the residence of the lord of demons reverberated with the jingling of their ornaments and accessories like the sound of the sea.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तद्राजगुणसम्पन्नं मुख्यैश्चागुरुचन्दनैः। महाजनैः समाकीर्णां सिंहैरिव महद्वनम्।।5.6.11।।
output: राजगुणसम्पन्नम् endowed with royal traits, मुख्यैः with eminent demons, अगुरुचन्दनैः with the fragrance of agaru and sandal, सिंहैः by lions, महत् वनमिव like a huge forest, महाजनैः by great people, समाकीर्णम् full.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भेरीमृदङ्गाभिरुतं शङ्खघोषनिनादितम्। नित्यार्चितं पर्वहुतं पूजितं राक्षसैः सदा।।5.6.12।।
output: Reverberating with the sounds of trumpets, mridangam and conches, there the demons daily performed worships and sacrifices on new and fullmoon days.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 6:
समुद्रमिव गम्भीरं समुद्रमिव निस्स्वनम्। महात्मनो महाद्वेश्म महारत्नपरिच्छदम्।।5.6.13।। महारत्नसमाकीर्णं ददर्श स महाकपिः।
