output: The son of the Windgod saw at the palace of Ravana, the lord of demons, colourful palanquins of several kinds, bowers, picture galleries, spots for sporting, hillocks (artificial) made of wood, apartments for romance, for pleasures and day time activities.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 6:
शिबिका विविधाकाराः स कपिर्मारुतात्मजः। लतागृहाणि चित्राणि चित्रशालागृहाणि च।।5.6.36।। क्रीडागृहाणि चान्यानि दारुपर्वतकानपि। कामस्य गृहकं रम्यं दिवागृहकमेव च।।5.6.37।। ददर्श राक्षसेन्द्रस्य रावणस्य निवेशने।
output: The son of the Windgod saw at the palace of Ravana, the lord of demons, colourful palanquins of several kinds, bowers, picture galleries, spots for sporting, hillocks (artificial) made of wood, apartments for romance, for pleasures and day time activities.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स मन्दरगिरिप्रख्यं मयूरस्थानसङ्कुलम्।।5.6.38।। ध्वजयष्टिभिराकीर्णं ददर्श भवनोत्तमम्। अनेकरत्नसङ्कीर्णं निधिजालं समन्ततः।।5.6.39।। धीरनिष्ठितकर्मान्तं गृहं भूतपतेरिव।
output: Comparable to mount Mandara, it was crowded with peacocks, set with flag staffs fixed all over, magnificent mansions built by skilled craftsmen with great efforts, decked with gems of several kinds, rich with treasures comparable to Kailasa, the home of Siva, the Lord of all beings.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स मन्दरगिरिप्रख्यं मयूरस्थानसङ्कुलम्।।5.6.38।। ध्वजयष्टिभिराकीर्णं ददर्श भवनोत्तमम्। अनेकरत्नसङ्कीर्णं निधिजालं समन्ततः।।5.6.39।। धीरनिष्ठितकर्मान्तं गृहं भूतपतेरिव।
output: सः he, मन्दरगिरिप्रख्यम् comaparable to mount Mandara, मयूरस्थानसङ्कुलम् places crowded with peacocks, ध्वजयष्टिभिः with flag staffs fixed, आकीर्णम् filled with, धीरनिष्ठितकर्मान्तम् built by skilled craftsmen with great care, भूतपतेः of Siva, the lord of all creatures, गृहमिव like home, भवनोत्तमम् magnificent mansion, समन्ततः every where, अनेकरत्नसङ्कीर्णम् full of gems, निधिजालम् treasure troves, ददर्श saw

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अर्चिर्भिश्चापि रत्नानां तेजसा रावणस्य च।।5.6.40।। विरराजाथ तद्वेश्म रश्मिमानिव रश्मिभिः।
output: The palace of Ravana looked splendid with gems of different hues and with Ravana's presence, it was shining like the radiant Sungod.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जाम्बूनदमयान्येन शयनान्यासनानि च।।5.6.41।। भाजनानि च मुख्यानि ददर्श हरियूथपः।
output: The leader of the vanaras saw there beds, seats and main vessels made of gold.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मध्वासवकृतक्लेदं मणिभाजनसङ्कुलम्।।5.6.42।। मनोरममसंबाधं कुबेरभवनं यथा। नूपुराणां च घोषेण काञ्चीनां निनदेन च।।5.6.43।। मृदङ्तलघोषैश्च घोषवद्भिर्विनादितम्। प्रासादसङ्घातयुतं स्त्रीरत्नशतसङ्कुलम्।।5.6.44। सुव्यूढकक्ष्यं हनुमान् प्रविवेश महागृहाम्।
output: ध्वासवकृतक्लेदम् drenched with liqour and other drinks, मणिभाजनसङ्कुलम् with gemencrusted vessels scattered all over, मनोरमम् very delightful, असम्बाधम् spacious, कुबेरभवनं यथा like the mansion of Kubera, नूपुराणाम् of anklets, घोषेण by the sound, काञ्चीनाम् of girdles, निनदेन with the sounds, घोषवद्भि:  filled with sounds of, मृदङ्गतल घोषैश्च with the sounds of drums, विनादितम् resonating, प्रासादसङ्घातयुतम् with rows of mansions, स्त्रीरत्नशतसङ्कुलम् filled with hundreds of exquisite women, सुव्यूढकक्ष्यम् with welllaid apartments, महागृहम् lofty palace, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रविवेश entered

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स वेश्मजालं बलवान् ददर्श व्यासक्तवैडूर्यसुवर्णजालम्। यथा महत् प्रावृषि मेघजालं विद्युत्पिनद्धं सविहङ्गजालम्।।5.7.1।।
output: Description of the aerial car -- Pushpaka.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 7:
निवेशनानां विविधाश्च शालाः प्रधानशङ्खायुधचापशालाः। मनोहराश्चापि पुनर्विशालाः ददर्श वेश्माद्रिषु चन्द्रशालाः।।5.7.2।।
output: Attached to the spacious halls of the houses, were storehouses for valuable  conches, weapons, bows and arrows. On the top of the attics on these mansions, were large and delightful terraces open to the Moon.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गृहाणि नानावसुराजितानि देवासुरैश्चापि सुपूजितानि। सर्वैश्च दोषैः परिवर्जितानि कपिर्ददर्श स्वबलार्जितानि।।5.7.3।।
output: The monkey saw numerous kinds of treasures, cherished by gods and demons, which were won by Ravana's might.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 7:
तानि प्रयत्नाभिसमाहितानि मयेन साक्षादिव निर्मितानि। महीतले सर्वगुणोत्तराणि ददर्श लङ्काधिपतेर्गृहाणि।।5.7.4।।
output: The mansions of the lord of Lanka built with great care and  effort on earth were  by all means excellent  and appeared as though built personally by Maya (the divine architect wellknown for magical skills).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो ददर्शोछ्रचितमेघरूपं मनोहरं काञ्चनचारुरूपम्। रक्षोऽधिपस्यात्मबलानुरूपं गृहोत्तमं ह्यप्रतिरूपरूपम्।।5.7.5।।
output: ततः then, उछ्रचितमेघरूपम् appearing like a towering cloud, मनोहरम् soulcaptivating, काञ्चनचारुरूपम् golden palace possessing splendour of molten gold, अप्रतिरूपरूपम् matchless, आत्मबलानुरूपम् worthy of the might of Ravana, रक्षोधिपस्य of the lord of demons, गृहोत्तमम् magnificent palace, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महीतले स्वर्गमिव प्रकीर्णं श्रिया ज्वलन्तं बहुरत्नकीर्णम्। नानातरूणां कुसुमावकीर्णं गिरेरिवाग्रं रजसावकीर्णम्।।5.7.6।।
output: महीतले on earth, प्रकीर्णम् scattered, स्वर्गमिव like heaven, श्रिया with splendour, ज्वलन्तम् while glittering, बहुरत्नकीर्णम् with many gems, नानातरूणाम् of all kinds of trees, कुसुमावकीर्णम् scattered with flowers, रजसा with dust, अवकीर्णम् covered, गिरेः mountain, अग्रमिव like the peak.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नारीप्रवेकैरिव दीप्यमानं तटिद्भिरम्भोदवदर्च्यमानम्। हंसप्रवेकैरिव वाह्यमानं श्रिया युतं खे सुकृतां विमानम्।।5.7.7।।
output: नारीप्रवेकैः by resplendent women,दीप्यमानमिव as if lit up,तटिद्भिः with lightning, अम्भोदवत् like a raincloud, अर्च्यमानम् worshipped, हंसप्रवेकैः borne by swans, वाह्यमानम् इव as if being drawn by, श्रिया auspicious, युतम् endowed, खे in the sky, सुकृताम् royal, विमानम् aerial chariot.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथा नगाग्रं बहुधातुचित्रं यथा नभश्च ग्रहचन्द्रचित्रम्। ददर्शयुक्तीकृतमेघचित्रं विमानरत्नं बहुरत्नचित्रम्।।5.7.8।।
output: युक्तीकृतमेघचित्रम् mass of colourful clouds, ग्रहचन्द्रचित्रम् looking colourful with planets and Moon, नभः यथा like the sky, बहुरत्नचित्रम् colourful on account of gems encrusted, बहुधातुचित्रम् colourful on account of many minerals, नगाग्रं यथा like the peak of a mountain, विमानरत्नम् jewel of a chariot, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 7:
मही कृता पर्वतराजिपूर्णा शैलाः कृता वृक्षवितानपूर्णाः। वृक्षाः कृताः पुष्पवितानपूर्णाः पुष्पं कृतं केसरपत्रपूर्णम्।।5.7.9।।
output: The whole  earth had been picturised on it. It was filled with rows of mountains  and a canopy of trees all over. The trees were filled with lovely flowers with petals and filaments drawn on them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृतानि वेश्मानि च पाण्डुराणि तथा सुपुष्पाण्यपि पुष्कराणि। पुनश्च पद्मानि सकेसराणि धन्यानि चित्राणि तथा वनानि।।5.7.10।।
output: There were pictures of mansions white in colour and pools of crystalclear water filled with lovely flowers. There were pictures of beautiful lotuses drawn on it.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुष्पाह्वयं नामविराजमानं रत्नप्रभाभिश्च विवर्धमानम्। वेश्मोत्तमानामपि चोच्यमानं महाकपिस्तत्र महाविमानम्।।5.7.11।।
output: तत्र there, महाकपिः great vanara, पुष्पाह्वयम् Pushpaka chariot by name, नामविराजमानम् splendid indeed, रत्नप्रभाभिः glitter of gems, विवर्धमानम् glowing, वेश्मोत्तमानामपि of magnificent mansions, उच्यमानम् tall, महाविमानम् great chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 7:
कृताश्च वैडूर्यमया विहङ्गाः रूप्यप्रवालैश्च तथा विहङ्गाः। चित्राश्च नानावसुभिर्भुजङ्गाः जात्यानुरूपास्तुरगाः शुभाङ्गाः।।5.7.12।।
output: Inside were birds made of vaidurya, silver and corals. There were colourful serpents made of various gems, and highclass horses of exquisite limbs drawn.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रवालजाम्बूनदपुष्पपक्षाः सलीलमावर्जितजिह्मपक्षाः। कामस्य साक्षादिव भान्ति पक्षाः कृता विहङ्गाः सुमुखाः सुपक्षाः।।5.7.13।।
output: It had curved figures of birds with beautiful wings carved out of corals and gold The wings were shining as if they were really the wings of allies of Cupid, the god of love.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नियुज्यमानास्तु गजाः सुहस्ताः सकेसराश्चोत्पलपत्रहस्ताः। बभूवदेवी च कृता सुहस्ता लक्ष्मी स्तथा पद्मिनि पद्महस्ता।।5.7.14।।
output: He saw on it lotus ponds, artificial elephants with shapely trunks, offering to Laxmi who herself was a lotus, holding in her beautiful hands blue lotuses shining with filaments.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इतीव तद्गृहमभिगम्य शोभनम् सविस्मयो नगमिव चारुशोभनम्। पुनश्च तत्परमसुगन्धि सुन्दरम् हिमात्यये नगमिव चारुकन्दरम्।।5.7.15।।
output: इतीव in that way, शोभनम् auspicious, चारुशोभनम् beautifully fashioned, नगमिव like a mountain, तद्गृहम् that palace, अभिगम्य having reached, सविस्मयः wonderstruck, परमसुगन्धि highly fragrant, सुन्दरम् beautiful, हिमात्यये at the end of winter, चारुकन्दरम् having beautiful caves, नगमिव like mountain, तत् that, पुनश्च once again.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 7:
ततः स तां कपिरभिपत्य पूजितां चरन् पुरीं दशमुखबाहुपालिताम्। अदृश्य तां जनकसुतां सुपूजितां सुदुःखितः पतिगुणवेगवर्जिताम्।।5.7.16।।
output: Then Hanuman moved about that cherished city ruled by the strength of arms of the tenheaded king. Unable to find venerable Sita, who was deprived of the benefit of her husband's virtuous proximity, he became deeply sad.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तदा बहुविधभावितात्मनः कृतात्मनो जनकसुतां सुवर्त्मनः। अपश्यतोऽभवदतिदुःखितं मनः सुचक्षुषः प्रविचरतो महात्मनः।।5.7.17।।
output: ततः from there, तदा then, बहुविधभावितात्मनः thinking of many things in his mind, कृतात्मनः of a great soul, सुवर्त्मनः of the followers of righteous path, सुचक्षुषः foresighted, प्रविचरतः while he moved, जनकसुताम् daughter of Janaka, अपश्यत: unable to find, महात्मनः of the great self, मनः mind, अतिदुःखितम् very distressed, अभवत् became.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 8:
स तस्य मध्ये भवनस्य संस्थितं महद्विमानं मणिवज्रचित्रितम्। प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालकृत्रिमं ददर्श वीरः पवनात्मजः कपिः।।5.8.1।।
output: The courageous son of the Windgod, Hanuman, the vanara saw the aerial chariot kept in the middle of the mansion inlaid with gems and diamonds latticed with artificial windows of barnished gold.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 8:
तदप्रमेयाप्रतिकारकृत्रिमं कृतं स्वयं साध्विति विश्वकर्मणा। दिवं गतं वायुपथप्रतिष्ठितं व्यराजतादित्यपथस्य लक्ष्मवत्।।5.8.2।।
output: The immeasurable Pushpaka fashioned by Visvakarma with images of incomparable beauty was not possible to describe. An excellent  product of his achievement, it was placed in the aerial path appearing as a beaconlight (signpost) in the orbit of the Sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 8:
न तत्र किञ्चिन्न कृतं प्रयत्नतो न तत्र किञ्चिन्न महार्हरत्नवत्। न ते विशेषा नियताः सुरेष्वपि न तत्र किञ्चिन्न महाविशेषवत्।।5.8.3।।
output: There was nothing in Pushpaka which was not executed carefully with special effort, nothing which was not made of precious stones. Such privileges were not available to even gods. Indeed there was nothing which was not unique.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तपः समाधानपराक्रमार्जितं मनः समाधानविचारचारिणम्। अनेकसंस्थानविशेषनिर्मितं ततस्ततस्तुल्यविशेषदर्शनम्।।5.8.4।।
output: तपः spiritual efforts, समाधानपराक्रमार्जितम् designed through concentration and prowess, मनः समाधानविचारचारिणम् which can reach the places desired by the thought of its master, अनेकसंस्थानविशेषनिर्मितम् built with many special seats, ततस्ततः at all places, तुल्यविशेषदर्शनम्  of equally good appearance

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 8:
विशेषमालम्ब्य विशेषसंस्थितं विचित्रकूटं बहुकूटमण्डितम्। मनोऽभिरामं शरदिन्दुनिर्मलं विचित्रकूटं शिखरं गिरेर्यथा।।5.8.5।।
output: The Pushpaka was specially designed in a unique manner. It was decorated with many colourful peaks. It was delghtful and pleasing to the mind and bright like the autumnal fullmoon. It looked like a mountain with many wonderful towers around.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वहन्ति यं कुण्डलशोभिताननाः महाशना व्योमचरा निशाचराः। विवृत्तविध्वस्तविशाललोचनाः महाजवा भूतगणाः सहस्रशः।।5.8.6।।
output: यम् such (a chariot), कुण्डलशोभिताननाः faces brightened by the earrings, महाशनाः  gluttons, व्योमचराः ranging in the sky, निशाचराः nightrangers, विवृत्तविध्वस्त विशाललोचनाः with big rolling and frightening eyes, महाजवाः of tremendous speed, भूतगणाः groups of Bhutas, सहस्रशः in thousands, वहन्ति  drawing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वसन्तपुष्पोत्करचारुदर्शनं वसन्तमासादपि कान्तदर्शनम्। स पुष्पकं तत्र विमानमुत्तमं ददर्श तद्वानरवीरसत्तमः।।5.8.7।।
output: That hero among monkeys, beheld the aerial chariot looking beautiful like a colourful collection of spring blossoms. Its appearance was more pleasant than spring itself. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यालयवरिष्ठस्य मध्ये विपुलमायतं। ददर्श भवनश्रेष्ठं हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.9.1।।
output: Description of the harem of Ravana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्धयोजनविस्तीर्णमायतं योजनं हि तत्। भवनं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य बहुप्रासादसङ्कुलम्।।5.9.2।।
output: राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of Indra among demons, तत् that, बहुप्रासादसङ्कुलम् of multitude of palaces, भवनम् mansion, अर्धयोजनविस्तीर्णम्  width of half yojana, योजनम् yojana, आयतम् long.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मार्गमाणस्तु वैदेहीं सीतामायतलोचनाम्। सर्वतः परिचक्राम हनूमानरिसूदनः।।5.9.3।।
output: Hanuman, the subduer of enemies, went  around in search of  the largeeyed Vaidehi.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उत्तमं राक्षसावासं हनुमानवलोकयन्। आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान् राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्।।5.9.4।। चतुर्विषाणैर्द्विरदैस्त्रिविषाणैस्तथैव च। परिक्षिप्तमसम्बाधं रक्ष्यमाणमुदायुधैः।।5.9.5।।
output: अथ now, लक्ष्मीवान् endowed with brightness, हनुमान् Hanuman, उत्तमम् best, राक्षसावासम् residence of demons, चतुर्विषाणैः fourtusked, तथैव च and similarly, त्रिविषाणैः threetusked, द्विरदैः twotusked, परिक्षिप्तम् surrounded by, असम्बाधम् spacious, उदायुधैः holding weapons, रक्ष्यमाणम् guarded by, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् home of the lord of the ogres, अवलोकयन् seeing, आससाद reached.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
उत्तमं राक्षसावासं हनुमानवलोकयन्। आससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान् राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्।।5.9.4।। चतुर्विषाणैर्द्विरदैस्त्रिविषाणैस्तथैव च। परिक्षिप्तमसम्बाधं रक्ष्यमाणमुदायुधैः।।5.9.5।।
output: Searching the excellent residences of important demons, Hanuman finally reached  the palace of the lord of ogres guarded by armed demons with elephants with two or three or four tusks.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसीभिश्च पत्नीभी रावणस्य निवेशनम्। आहृताभिश्च विक्रम्य राजकन्याभिरावृतम्।।5.9.6।। तन्नक्रमकराकीर्णं तिमिङ्गिलझषाकुलम्। वायुवेगसमाधूतं पन्नगैरिव सागरम्।।5.9.7।।
output: Hanuman entered the palace of Ravana crowded with shedemons who were the wives of Ravana and the princesses brought by him after winning them in wars. To Hanuman, it looked like an ocean filled with crocodiles, sharks, whales, and a variety of fishes and snakes tossed by the force of the wind.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
राक्षसीभिश्च पत्नीभी रावणस्य निवेशनम्। आहृताभिश्च विक्रम्य राजकन्याभिरावृतम्।।5.9.6।। तन्नक्रमकराकीर्णं तिमिङ्गिलझषाकुलम्। वायुवेगसमाधूतं पन्नगैरिव सागरम्।।5.9.7।।
output: Hanuman entered the palace of Ravana crowded with shedemons who were the wives of Ravana and the princesses brought by him after winning them in wars. To Hanuman, it looked like an ocean filled with crocodiles, sharks, whales, and a variety of fishes and snakes tossed by the force of the wind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
या हि वैश्रवणे लक्ष्मीर्या चेन्द्रे हरिवाहने। सा रावणगृहे सर्वा नित्यमेवानपायिनी।।5.9.8।।
output: Whatever wealth was possessed by Vaisravana (Kubera, the son of sage Vishrava) and also Indra who rides the Ucchaisrava green horse, was there in the palace of Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
या च राज्ञः कुबेरस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य च। तादृशी तद्विशिष्टा वा ऋद्धी रक्षोगृहेष्विह।।5.9.9।।
output: The wealth stored in Ravana's palace was akin to what lay in the palaces of Kubera, Yama or Varuna, and ever more exquisite.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य हर्म्यस्य मध्यस्थं वेश्म चान्यत्सुनिर्मितं। बहुनिर्यूहसङ्कीर्णं ददर्श पवनात्मजः।।5.9.10।।
output: पवनात्मजः son of the Windgod, तस्य of that, हर्म्यस्य of the palace, मध्यस्थम् in the centre, सुनिर्मितम् well built, बहुनिर्यूहसङ्कीर्णम् a complex many houses, अन्यत् another, वेश्म home, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ब्रह्मणोऽर्थे कृतं दिव्यं दिवि यद्विश्वकर्मणा। विमानं पुष्पकं नाम सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्।।5.9.11।। परेण तपसा लेभे यत्कुबेरः पितामहात्। कुबेरमोजसा जित्वा लेभे तद्राक्षसेश्वरः।।5.9.12।।
output: सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, पुष्पकं नाम called Pushpaka, यत् that, दिव्यम् wonderful, विमानम् aerial chariot, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, दिवि in the sky, ब्रह्मणः अर्थे for Brahma, कृतम् built, यत् the same one, कुबेरः Kubera, पितामहात् from grandfather the creator, परेण with supreme, तपसा by penance, लेभे got, तत् that, राक्षसेश्वरः lord of demons, ओजसा by his might, कुबेरम् Kubera, जित्वा after defeating, लेभे acquired.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ब्रह्मणोऽर्थे कृतं दिव्यं दिवि यद्विश्वकर्मणा। विमानं पुष्पकं नाम सर्वरत्नविभूषितम्।।5.9.11।। परेण तपसा लेभे यत्कुबेरः पितामहात्। कुबेरमोजसा जित्वा लेभे तद्राक्षसेश्वरः।।5.9.12।।
output: सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, पुष्पकं नाम called Pushpaka, यत् that, दिव्यम् wonderful, विमानम् aerial chariot, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, दिवि in the sky, ब्रह्मणः अर्थे for Brahma, कृतम् built, यत् the same one, कुबेरः Kubera, पितामहात् from grandfather the creator, परेण with supreme, तपसा by penance, लेभे got, तत् that, राक्षसेश्वरः lord of demons, ओजसा by his might, कुबेरम् Kubera, जित्वा after defeating, लेभे acquired.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ईहामृगसमायुक्त्तै: कार्तस्वरहिरमण्मयैः। सुकृतैराचितं स्तम्भैः प्रदीप्तमिव च श्रिया।।5.9.13।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशैरुल्लिखद्भिरिवाम्बरं। कूटागारैश्शुभाकारैस्सर्वतस्समलङ्कृतम्।।5.9.14।।
output: ईहामृगसमायुक्तै: with images of wolves carved, कार्तस्वरहिरण्मयैः made of Kartaswara and Hiranmaya, two types of gold, सुकृतैः finely built, स्तम्भैः with pillars, आचितम् supported, श्रिया lustrous, प्रदीप्तमिव as though blazing, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशैः resembling mountain Meru and Mandara, अम्बरम् sky, उल्लिखद्भिरिव as though scraping, शुभाकारैः by auspicious, कूटागारैः with multitude of pleasurehouses, सर्वतः everywhere, समलङ्कृतम् decorated.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
ईहामृगसमायुक्त्तै: कार्तस्वरहिरमण्मयैः। सुकृतैराचितं स्तम्भैः प्रदीप्तमिव च श्रिया।।5.9.13।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशैरुल्लिखद्भिरिवाम्बरं। कूटागारैश्शुभाकारैस्सर्वतस्समलङ्कृतम्।।5.9.14।।
output: It was supported by finely built pillars of two types of gold (Kartaswara and Hiranmaya) with images of wolves carved on them and blazing. It was tall as if scraping the sky and resembled mountains like Meru and Mandara. It was graced with multitudes of  auspicious and decorated pleasurehouses everywhere.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
ज्वलनार्कप्रतीकाशं सुकृतं विश्वकर्मणा। हेमसोपानसंयुक्तं चारुप्रवरवेदिकम्।।5.9.15।।
output: It was well built by Visvakarma and and had golden stairways, with radiant platforms glowing like fire and Sun.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जालवातायनैर्युक्तं काञ्चनैः स्स्फाटिकैरपि। इन्द्रनीलमहानीलमणिप्रवरवेदिकम्।।5.9.16।।
output: काञ्चनैः with gold, स्फाटिकैरपि with crystal also, जालवातायनैः by latticed windows, युक्तम् endowed, इन्द्रनीलमहानीलमणिप्रवरवेदिकम् platforms encrusted with saphires called Indraneela and Mahaneela.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विद्रुमेण विचित्रेण मणिभिश्च महाघनैः। निस्तुलाभिश्च मुक्ताभिस्तलेनाभिविराजितम्।।5.9.17।।
output: It was shining bright with colourful corals, precious gems and peerless pearls fixed on its floor.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चन्दनेन च रक्तेन तपनीयनिभेन च। सुपुण्यगन्धिना युक्तमादित्यतरुणोपमम्।।5.9.18।।
output: It was bright like molten gold, fragrant with red sandal comparable to the rising Sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
कूटागारैर्वराकारैर्विविधैस्समलङ्कृतम्। विमानं पुष्पकं दिव्यमारुरोह महाकपिः।।5.9.19।।
output: Hanuman ascended the wonderful Pushpaka, welldecked with many corridors.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्रस्थस्स तदा गन्धं पानभक्ष्यान्नसम्भवम्। दिव्यं सम्मूर्छितं जिघ्रद्रूपवन्तमिवानिलम्।।5.9.20।।
output: There he smelt the stupefying, unearthly odour of food and drink. He felt as though the fragrance had taken a potentially solid form. (Note: The wind has no form. But when he carried the aroma of food and drink it appeared like the personification of wind which could be smelt. गन्धवती पृथवी fragrance comes from earth पृथवीतत्त्व the poet transmits the same to the wind who has got only स्पर्श sense of touch).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स गन्धस्तं महासत्त्वं बन्धुर्बन्धुमिवोत्तमम्। इत एहीत्युवाचेन तत्र यत्र स रावणः।।5.9.21।।
output: स: गन्धः that fragrance, महासत्त्वम् mighty, तम् him (Hanuman), उत्तमम् great, बन्धुम् relative, बन्धुरिव like a relative, सः रावणः that Ravana, यत्र wherever, तत्र there, इतः एहि come here, इति thus, उवाच इव as if told.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
ततस्तां प्रस्थितश्शालां ददर्श महतीं शुभाम्। रावणस्य मनः कान्तां कान्तामिव वरस्त्रियम्।।5.9.22।।
output: Then he proceeded to an auspicious hall, which was Ravana's favourite like his chief queen dear to his heart.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मणिसोपानविकृतां हेमजालविभूषिताम्। स्फाटिकैरावृततलां दन्तान्तरितरूपिकाम्।।5.9.23।।
output: मणिसोपानाविकृताम् staircase inlaid with special gems, हेमजालविभूषिताम् latticed with gold, स्फाटिकैः with crystals, आवृततलाम् floors covered with, दन्तान्तरितरूपिकाम् inlaid with silver set in ivory frame.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुक्ताभिश्च प्रवालैश्च रूप्यचामीकरैरपि। विभूषितां मणिस्तम्भैस्सुबहुस्तम्भभूषिताम्।।5.9.24।।
output: It was decorated with pillars of silver and gold inlaid with pearls and corals and gems.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
नम्रैरृजुभिरत्युच्चैस्समन्तात्सुविभूषितैः। स्तम्भै: पक्षैरिवात्युच्चैर्दिवं संप्रस्थितामिव।।5.9.25।।
output: It had highly ornamented pillars all over, some slightly bent and others straight. With lofty columns looking like wings it appeared as if the mansion had started on its journey to heaven.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महत्या कुथयास्तीर्णां पृथिवीलक्षणाङ्कया। पृथिवीमिव विस्तीर्णां सराष्ट्रगृहमालिनीम्।।5.9.26।।
output: The floor was covered with a wide carpet spread from wall to wall with designs of different murals of many places and houses drawn in a row (garland like). The big carpet appeared like the expanse of earth itself.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नादितां मत्तविहगैर्दिव्यगन्धाधिवासिताम्। परार्ध्यास्तरणोपेतां रक्षोधिपनिषेविताम्।।5.9.27।।
output: The mansion was resounding with the noise of birds singing in heat. It had wonderful fragrance. It was laid with exquisite tapestries and served as a dwelling place for the king of demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
धूम्रामगरुधूपेन विमलां हंसपाण्डुराम्। चित्रां पुष्पोपहारेण कल्माषीमिव सुप्रभाम्।।5.9.28।।
output: It was smoky with fumes of agaru incence though spotless like a swan. It was colourful and radiant like Kamadhenu, the wishfulfilling cow, because of the offering of flowers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मनस्संह्लादजननीं वर्णस्यापि प्रसादिनीम्। तां शोकनाशिनीं दिव्यां श्रियः सञ्जननीमिव।।5.9.29।।
output: मनः संह्लादजननीम् one which was soul ravishing, वर्णस्यापि with colour and complexion, प्रसादिनीम् pleasing, शोकनाशिनीम् banished sorrow, श्रियः of prosperity, सञ्जननीमिव like the source, दिव्याम् wonderful, ताम् it was.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थैस्तु पञ्च पञ्चभिरुत्तमैः। तर्पयामास मातेव तदा रावणपालिता।।5.9.30।।
output: रावणपालिता chamber of Ravana, तदा then, माता इव like a mother, उत्तमैः with excellent, पञ्चभिः with the five, इन्द्रियार्थैः with objects of the senses, पञ्च five, इन्द्रियाणि sense organs, तर्पयामास satisfied.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वर्गोऽयं देवलोकोऽयमिन्द्रस्येयं पुरी भवेत्। सिद्धिर्वेयं परा हि स्यादित्यमन्यत मारुतिः।।5.9.31।।
output: 'This may be heaven or world of gods. It may be Amaravati, the abode of Indra or else it may be the supreme achievment (of the Creator), thought Maruti৷৷

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
प्रध्यायत इवापश्यत्प्रदीपांस्तत्र काञ्चनान्। धूर्तानिव महाधूतैर्देवनेन पराजितान्।।5.9.32।।
output: Seeing the golden lamps that stood burning steadily, Hanuman thought they looked like  gamblers in deep thought defeated by expert  gamblers in a game of dice.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दीपानां च प्रकाशेन तेजसा रावणस्य च। अर्चिर्भिर्भूषणानां च प्रदीप्तेत्यभ्यमन्यत।।5.9.33।।
output: दीपानाम् of the lamps, प्रकाशेन by the glow, रावणस्य Ravana's, तेजसा च and by his brightness, भूषणानाम् of ornaments, अर्चिर्भिः च by the glow spread there, प्रदीप्ता इति as if glowing like fire, अमन्यत he thought in his mind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽपश्यत्कुथाऽऽसीनं नानावरायम्बरस्रजम्। सहस्रं वरनारीणां नानावेषविभूषितम्।।5.9.34।।
output: He found thousands of beautiful women seated on carpets wearing different clothes and garlands and dressed in various attires.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परिवृत्तेऽर्धरात्रे तु पाननिद्रावशं गतम्। क्रीडित्वोपरतं रात्रौ सुष्वाप बलवत्तदा।।5.9.35।।
output: Drinking and sporting until midnight, they had dropped off to sleeptired.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्प्रसुप्तं विरुरुचे निश्शब्दान्तरभूषणम्। निःशब्दहंसभ्रमरं यथा पद्मवनं महत्।।5.9.36।।
output: Fast asleep, sounds of their ornaments silenced, the young women looked like a large bed of lotuses with swans and bees sitting calm without their usual noise.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तासां संवृतदन्तानि मीलिताक्षीणि मारुतिः। अपश्यत्पद्मगन्धीनि वदनानि सुयोषिताम्।।5.9.37।।
output: Hanuman looked at the faces of the wellbred young women with closed eyes and concealed teeth, fragrant like lotuses.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रबुद्धानीव पद्मानि तासां भूत्वा क्षपाक्षये। पुनस्संवृतपत्राणि रात्राविव बभुस्तदा।।5.9.38।।
output: The faces of the women looked like blooming lotuses at daybreak, their petals closed up again at night.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
इमानि मुखपद्मानि नियतं मत्तषट्पदाः। अम्बुजानीव फुल्लानि प्रार्थयन्ति पुनः पुनः।।5.9.39।।
output: The intoxicated bees would again and again long to enjoy these beautiful faces which were like blooming lotuses.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति चामन्यत श्रीमानुपपत्त्या महाकपिः। मेने हि गुणतस्तानि समानि सलिलोद्भवैः।।5.9.40।।
output: The illustrious Hanuman felt it to be correct to compare those faces with lotuses for their fragrance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
सा तस्य शुशुभे शाला ताभिस्त्रीभिर्विराजिता। शारदीव प्रसन्ना द्यौस्ताराभिरभिशोभिता।।5.9.41।।
output: Brightened by (the beauty of) the maidens, the mansion shone like the autumnal sky endearing  and pleasing with stars.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
स च ताभिः परिवृतश्शुशुभे राक्षसाधिपः। यथा ह्युडुपतिश्शीमांस्ताराभिरभिसंवृतः।।5.9.42।।
output: The lord of demons surrounded by women shone like the beautiful Moon encircled by stars.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
याश्च्यवन्तेऽम्बरात्ताराः पुण्यशेषसमावृताः। इमास्तास्सङ्गताः कृत्स्ना इति मेने हरिस्तदा।।5.9.43।।
output: याः those, ताराः stars, पुण्यशेषसमावृताः with left over merits, अम्बरात् from the sky, च्यवन्ते fallen, ताः those, कृत्स्नाः entirely, इमाः these women, सङ्गताः collected together, इति thus, तदा then, हरिः the monkey, मेने thought.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
ताराणामिव सुव्यक्तं महतीनां शुभार्चिषाम्। प्रभावर्णप्रसादाश्च विरेजुस्तत्र योषिताम्।।5.9.44।।
output: It was clear that the grace and lustre of those women looked brilliant like the lustre and grace of brilliant stars releasing an auspicious glow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्यावृत्तगुरुपीनस्रक्प्रकीर्णवरभूषणाः। पानव्यायामकालेषु निद्रापहृतचेतसः।।5.9.45।।
output: Garlands displaced and jewels scattered, they were drowsy due to drink and sexual exercise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
व्यावृत्ततिलकाः काश्चित्काश्चिदुद्भ्रन्तनूपुराः। पार्श्वे गलितहाराश्च काश्चित्परमयोषितः।।5.9.46।।
output: A few young women had their circular vermilion mark (on the forehead) smudged, some had their anklets loosened and a few had their necklaces.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुक्ताहाराऽवृताश्चान्याः काश्चिद्विस्रस्तवाससः। व्याविद्धरशनादामाः किशोर्य इव वाहिताः।।5.9.47।।
output: Some had their strings of pearl broken, others had their clothes slipped off, and some had their waist belts snapped. They were like young mares fallen to rest after carrying heavy loads.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
सुकुण्डलधराश्चान्या विच्छिन्नमृदितस्रजः। गजेन्द्रमृदिताः फुल्ला लता इव महावने।।5.9.48।।
output: With their good eartops broken and flower garlands crushed some looked like blooming creepers in a dense forest crushed by mighty elephants.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
चन्द्रांशुकिरणाभाश्च हाराः कासांचिदुत्कटाः। हंसा इव बभुस्सुप्ताः स्तनमध्येषु योषिताम्।।5.9.49।।
output: The pearl chains, large and shining like rays of the Moon in the space between the breasts looked like sleeping swans.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
अपरासां च वैडूर्याः कादम्बा इव पक्षिणः। हेमसूत्राणि चान्यासां चक्रवाका इवाभवन्।।5.9.50।।
output: The vaidurya worn by women (on the breasts) looked like Kadamba birds while the golden chains put on by some others appeared like ruddy geese.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाश्चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः। आपगा इव ता रेजुर्जघनैः पुलिनैरिव।।5.9.51।।
output: Their hips were like river banks crowded with swans, karandava and Chakravaka birds shining like rivers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किङ्किणीजालसङ्कोशास्ता हैमविपुलाम्बुजाः। भावग्राहा यशस्तीराः सुप्ता नद्य इवाऽऽबभुः।।5.9.52।।
output: किङ्किणीजालसङ्कोशाः tiny bells tied round the waist looking like buds, हैमविपुलाम्बुजाः bold golden ornaments looking like lotuses, भावग्राहाः their amorous gestures of love play like crocodiles, यशस्तीराः radiant beauty of silver banks, सुप्ताः sleeping, नद्यः इव resembled rivers, आबभुः appeared.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मृदुष्वङ्गेषु कासाञ्चित्कुचाग्रेषु च संस्थिताः। बभुर्वर्भूषणानीव शुभा भूषणराजयः।।5.9.53।।
output: The beautiful imprints made by the (heavy) ornaments on the tender limbs, breasts and nipples of some women appeared like many ornaments.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अंशुकान्ताश्च कासाञ्चिन्मुखमारुतकम्पिताः। उपर्युपरि वक्त्राणां व्याधूयन्ते पुनः पुनः।।5.9.54।।
output: Shaken by the breath released from their mouths the fringes of the garments of some women were drawn towards their faces again and againfluttering.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताः पताका इवोद्धूताः पत्नीनां रुचिरप्रभाः। नानावर्णसुवर्णानां वक्त्रमूलेषु रेजिरे।।5.9.55।।
output: नानावर्णसुवर्णानाम् of the women of different beautiful hues, पत्नीनाम् of the wives, वक्त्रमूलेषु on the edges of their faces, ताः those, रुचिरप्रभाः with beautiful glow, उध्दूताः raised, पताकाः इव like flags, रेजिरे shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
ववल्गुश्चात्र कासांचित्कुण्डलानि शुभार्चिषाम्। मुखमारुतसंसर्गान्मन्दं मन्दं सुयोषिताम्।।5.9.56।।
output: The eartops of some women endowed with auspicious charm were swinging softly generating a gentle sound by the touch of their breath.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
शर्कराऽसवगन्धैश्च प्रकृत्या सुरभिः सुखः। तासां वदननिश्वासस्सिषेवे रावणं तदा।।5.9.57।।
output: The sweet smell of wine emitted from their mouth and the natural fragrance of their breath was refreshing to Ravana  as if it was serving him at that time.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणाननशङ्काश्च काश्चिद्रावणयोषितः। मुखानि स्म सपत्नीनामुपाजिघ्रन्पुनः पुनः।।5.9.58।।
output: Some women of Ravana (overcome by blind passion) smelt again and again the mouths of their cowives next to them  assuming it to be Ravana's.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
अत्यर्थं सक्तमनसो रावणे ता वरस्त्रियः। अस्वतन्त्राः सपत्नीनां प्रियमेवाऽचरंस्तदा।।5.9.59।।
output: Even though the beautiful wives (should have been angry with their cowives for smelling their mouths) they behaved pleasingly, having no freedom to act with Ravana

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाहूनुपनिधायान्याः पारिहार्यविभूषितान्। अंशुकानि च रम्याणि प्रमदास्तत्र शिश्यिरे।।5.9.60।।
output: Some women slept pillowed on their arms, laying aside their adornments and others had their garment under the head as pillows and lay in sleep.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
अन्या वक्षसि चान्यस्यास्तस्याः काचित्पुनर्भुजम्। अपरा त्वङ्कमन्यस्यास्तस्याश्चाप्यपरा भुजौ।।5.9.61।।
output: Some women lay placing their arms on the breasts of the other while their own arms were used as pillow by another. One woman placed her head  on the lap of the other and slept.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऊरुपार्श्वकटीपृष्ठमन्योन्यस्य समाश्रिताः। परस्परनिविष्टाङ्ग्यो मदस्नेहवशानुगाः।।5.9.62।।
output: मदस्नेहवशानुगाः given to intoxication and love, अन्योन्यस्य with one another, ऊरुपार्श्वकटीपृष्ठम् on thighs, side, hips and back on the lap of the other, समाश्रिताः had slept, परस्परनिविष्टाङ्ग्यः lay intertwined, one on the other.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
अन्योन्यभुजसूत्रेण स्त्रीमाला ग्रथिता हि सा। मालेव ग्रथिता सूत्रे शुशुभे मत्तषट्पदा।।5.9.63।।
output: Knit with the shoulders of one another like a garland of flowers intertwined with the tipsy bees resting the women shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
लतानां माधवे मासि फुल्लानां वायुसेवनात्। अन्योन्य मालाग्रथितं संसक्तकुसुमोच्चयम्।।5.9.64।। व्यतिवेष्टितसुस्कन्धमन्योन्यभ्रमराकुलम्। आसीद्वनमिवोद्धूतं स्त्रीवनं रावणस्य तत्।।5.9.65।।
output: The women of Ravana appeared like a garden in spring. They were as if a cluster of creepers blossomed in spring due to the caresses of the breeze. They were knit together as one string forming a garland, flowers of one creeper striking the other. The joints of these creepers had grown strong when tangled together. Shaken by the breeze, the bees resting on one creeper would go to the other.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
लतानां माधवे मासि फुल्लानां वायुसेवनात्। अन्योन्य मालाग्रथितं संसक्तकुसुमोच्चयम्।।5.9.64।। व्यतिवेष्टितसुस्कन्धमन्योन्यभ्रमराकुलम्। आसीद्वनमिवोद्धूतं स्त्रीवनं रावणस्य तत्।।5.9.65।।
output: The women of Ravana appeared like a garden in spring. They were as if a cluster of creepers blossomed in spring due to the caresses of the breeze. They were knit together as one string forming a garland, flowers of one creeper striking the other. The joints of these creepers had grown strong when tangled together. Shaken by the breeze, the bees resting on one creeper would go to the other.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उचितेष्वपि सुव्यक्तं न तासां योषितां तदा। विवेकः शक्य आधातुं भूषणाङ्गाम्बरस्रजाम्।।5.9.66।।
output: It was not possible to distinguish clearly between their jewels, limbs, garments and garlands and to place them in the right spots.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणे सुखसंविष्टे तास्त्रियो विविधप्रभाः। ज्वलन्तः काञ्चना दीपाः प्रैक्षन्तानिमिषा इव।।5.9.67।।
output: When Ravana was happily asleep, the gods of light burning on the gold lampposts gazed without winking as it were, at the women, whom they dare  not gaze for fear of waking Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
राजर्षिपितृदैत्यानां गन्धर्वाणां च योषितः। राक्षसानां च याः कन्यास्तस्य कामवशं गताः।।5.9.68।।
output: The women halled from the families of royal sages, ancestral deities, daityas and demons who were infatuated with him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
युद्धकामेन ताः सर्वा रावणेन हृताः स्त्रियः। समदा मदनेनैव मोहिताः काश्चिदागताः।।5.9.69।।
output: सर्वाः all, ताः स्त्रियः those women, युद्धकामेन on account of his love for war, रावणेन by Ravana, हृताः kidnapped, समदाः passionate ones, काश्चित् a few, मदनेन by lust, मोहिताः एव deluded, आगताः came.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न तत्र काचित्प्रमदा प्रसह्य वीर्योपपन्नेन गुणेन लब्धा। न चान्यकामापि न चान्यपूर्वा विना वरार्हां जनकात्मजां ताम्।।5.9.70।।
output: Except Sita no other woman among them had been taken there by force. They were won only on account of his valour and virtues. None loved any one earlier and none was married to others.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
न चाकुलीना न च हीनरूपा नादक्षिणा नानुपचारयुक्ता। भार्याभवत्तस्य न हीनसत्त्वा न चापि कान्तस्य न कामनीया।।5.9.71।।
output: None among them was born of a lowly family, nor lacked beauty, kindness, skill, strength or brightness. No one was not lovable to Ravana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बभूव बुद्धिस्तु हरीश्वरस्य यदीदृशी राघवधर्मपत्नी। इमा यथा राक्षसराजभार्याः सुजातमस्येति हि साधुबुद्धेः।।5.9.72।।
output: 'If the lawful wife of Rama born of a good family can be allowed to remain with Rama in the same way as the consorts of the lord of demons, how fortunate it would be, thought the wise lord of monkeys'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 9:
पुनश्च सोऽचिन्तयादात्तरूपो ध्रुवं विशिष्टा गुणतो हि सीता। अथायमस्यां कृतवान्महात्मा लङ्केश्वरः कष्टमनार्यकर्म।।5.9.73।।
output: Hanuman once again assuming his true form said to himself, 'Sita is surely a virtuous lady superior to and more distinguished than them all. Alas, this lord of Lanka committed an ignoble, act (by abducting her). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे नवमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
तत्र दिव्योपमं मुख्यं स्फाटिकं रत्नभूषितम्। अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् ददर्श शयनासनम्।।5.10.1।। दान्तकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गैर्वैडूर्यैश्च वरासनैः। महार्हास्तरणोपेतैरुपपन्नं महाधनैः।।5.10.2।।
output: Looking around, Hanuman noticed a bed chamber, with a heavenly dais on which he saw a couch encrusted with crystals, vaidurya, and inlaid with colourful ivory and gold. It had an exquisite rich covering.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्र दिव्योपमं मुख्यं स्फाटिकं रत्नभूषितम्। अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान् ददर्श शयनासनम्।।5.10.1।। दान्तकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गैर्वैडूर्यैश्च वरासनैः। महार्हास्तरणोपेतैरुपपन्नं महाधनैः।।5.10.2।।
output: तत्र there, आवेक्षमाणः while looking around, हनुमान् Hanuman, दिव्योपमम् fine, heavenly मुख्यम् foremost, स्फाटिकम् made with crystals, रत्नभूषितम् encrusted with gems, दान्तकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गैः inlaid with colourful ivory and gold, वैडूर्यैः with Vaidurya, महार्हास्तरणोपेतैः with exquisite coverings, महाधनैः rich, वरासनैः fine dais, उपेतम् endowed with, शयनासनम् couch, ददर्श observed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य चैकतमे देशे सोऽग्य्रमालाविभूषितम्। ददर्श पाण्डुरं छत्रं ताराधिपतिसन्निभम्।।5.10.3।।
output: Hanuman saw an umbrella in one spot decorated with the best of garlands. The white umbrella looked like the Moon, lord of stars.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तं चित्रभानुसमप्रभम्। अशोकमालाविततं ददर्श परमासनम्।।5.10.4।। वालव्यजनहस्ताभिर्वीज्यमानं समन्ततः। गन्धैश्च विविधैर्जुष्टं वरधूपेन धूपितम्।।5.10.5।। परमास्तरणास्तीर्णमाविकाजिनसंवृतम्। दामभिर्वरमाल्यानां समन्तादुपशोभितम्।।5.10.6।।
output: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तं चित्रभानुसमप्रभम्। अशोकमालाविततं ददर्श परमासनम्।।5.10.4।। वालव्यजनहस्ताभिर्वीज्यमानं समन्ततः। गन्धैश्च विविधैर्जुष्टं वरधूपेन धूपितम्।।5.10.5।। परमास्तरणास्तीर्णमाविकाजिनसंवृतम्। दामभिर्वरमाल्यानां समन्तादुपशोभितम्।।5.10.6।।
output: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
तस्मिन् जीमूतसंकाशं प्रदीप्तोत्तमकुण्डलम्। लोहिताक्षं महाबाहुं महारजतवाससम्।।5.10.7।। लोहितेनानुलिप्ताङ्गं चन्दनेन सुगन्धिना। सन्ध्यारक्तमिवाकाशे तोयदं सतटिद्गणम्।।5.10.8।। वृतमाभरणैर्दिव्यैः सुरूपं कामरूपिणम्। सवृक्षवनगुल्माढ्यं प्रसुप्तमिव मन्दरम्।।5.10.9।। क्रीडित्वोपरतं रात्रौ वराभरणभूषितम्। प्रियं राक्षसकन्यानां राक्षसानां सुखावहम्।।5.10.10।। पीत्वाऽप्युपरतं चापि ददर्श स महाकपिः। भास्वरे शयने वीरं प्रसुप्तं राक्षसाधिपम्।।5.10.11।।
output: Hanuman saw the mightyarmed, heroic lord of demons, sleeping with huge bloodshot eyes looking like a cloud, he was adorned with flashing earrings, and clad in robes of silver texture. His body was smeared with red sandal paste of sweet fragrance. Therefore, he looked like a cloud reddened by twilight and flashing with the lightning of his ornaments. He was handsome and could assume any form at will. He looked like Mandara mountain surrounded thickly with  trees and wild bushes. Decked with exquisite ornaments, he was sleeping after dalliance at night on that glittering couch. He was the beloved of the ogresses and bringer of joy to them

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागं रावणं वानरर्षभः। आसाद्य परमोद्विग्नस्सोपासर्पत्सुभीतवत्।।5.10.12।।
output: Having reached Ravana, who was breathing (hissing) like a snake, Hanuman was for a moment frightened and drew away from him as if he was put to terrible fear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथाऽऽरोहणमासाद्य वेदिकाऽन्तरमाश्रितः। सुप्तं राक्षसशार्दूलं प्रेक्षते स्म महाकपिः।।5.10.13।।
output: महाकपिः great vanara, अथ then, आरोहणम् stairway, आसाद्य on reaching, वेदिकान्तरम् another altar, आश्रितः approached, सुप्तम् sleeping, राक्षसशार्दूलम् tiger among ogres, प्रेक्षते स्म glanced once again.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शुशुभे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य स्वपतः शयनोत्तमम्। गन्धहस्तिनि संविष्टे यथा प्रस्रवणं महत्।।5.10.14।।
output: स्वपतः sleeping, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य lord of rakshasa's, शयनोत्तमम् magnificent couch, गन्धहस्तिनि elephant in rut, संविष्टे is sleeping, महत् great, प्रस्रवणं यथा like Prasravana hill, शुशुभे looked lovely.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
काञ्चनाङ्गदसन्नध्दै च ददर्श स महात्मनः। विक्षिप्तौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भुजाविन्द्रध्वजोपमौ।।5.10.15।। ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरापीडनकृतव्रणौ। वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ।।5.10.16।। पीनौ समसुजातांसौ संगतौ बलसंयुतौ। सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठा स्वङ्गुलीतललक्षितौ।।5.10.17।। संहतौ परिघाकारौ वृत्तौ करिकरोपमौ। विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ।।5.10.18।। शशक्षतजकल्पेन सुशीतेन सुगन्धिना। चन्दनेन परार्ध्येन स्वनुलिप्तौ स्वलङ्कृतौ।।5.10.19।। उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ। यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ।।5.10.20।।
output: Hanuman saw the great Ravana's arms, which were like a pair of Indra's flag staff adorned with golden straps. The arms bore the marks of wounds caused by Airavata, (Indra's elephant), torn by the thunderbolt of Indra in war, and wounded by the discus of Lord Visnu. His strong, fleshy, wellbuilt arms, having auspicious thumbnails, shapely fingers and palms, pressed together, resembled the iron crowbars or beam used for main doors. The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged  by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.

output: सः that, महात्मनः the great self, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, काञ्चनाङ्गदनसद्धौ two arms adorned with golden straps, विक्षिप्तौ ल्यिन्ग lying, इन्द्रध्वजोपमौ like the pair of flag staff of Indra, ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैः torn by Iravata, the vehicle of Indra, आपीडनकृतव्रणौ having scars caused by injury, वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ  arms with scars caused by the thunderbolt of Indra, विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ wounded by Visnu's discus, पीनौ fleshy, समसुजातांसौ wellbuilt, fleshy arms, सङ्गतौ tough, बलसंयुतौ strong, सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठौ on shapely thumb nails, स्वङ्गुलीतल लक्षितौ on shapely palms and fingers, संहतौ wellfixed, परिघाकारौ like iron crowbars, वृत्तौ rounded, करिकरोपमौ resembling elephant tusk, शुभ्रे on a clean, शयने couch, विक्षिप्तौ lying, पञ्चशीर्षौ like fivehooded, उरगौ इव like two serpents, शशक्षतजकल्पेन like the colour of the hare's blood, सुशीतेन by cool, सुगन्धिना with fragrant, परार्थ्येन fine, चन्दनेन by sandal paste, स्वनुलिप्तौ be smeared, स्वलङ्कृतौ welldecorated, उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ massaged by the best of women, गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ anointed by best of fragrants, यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ which can make yakshas, pannagas, gandharvas, gods and demons cry in terror, भुजौ arms, ददर्श saw.

instruction:

काञ्चनाङ्गदसन्नध्दै च ददर्श स महात्मनः। विक्षिप्तौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भुजाविन्द्रध्वजोपमौ।।5.10.15।। ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरापीडनकृतव्रणौ। वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ।।5.10.16।। पीनौ समसुजातांसौ संगतौ बलसंयुतौ। सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठा स्वङ्गुलीतललक्षितौ।।5.10.17।। संहतौ परिघाकारौ वृत्तौ करिकरोपमौ। विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ।।5.10.18।। शशक्षतजकल्पेन सुशीतेन सुगन्धिना। चन्दनेन परार्ध्येन स्वनुलिप्तौ स्वलङ्कृतौ।।5.10.19।। उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ। यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ।।5.10.20।।
output: सः that, महात्मनः the great self, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, काञ्चनाङ्गदनसद्धौ two arms adorned with golden straps, विक्षिप्तौ ल्यिन्ग lying, इन्द्रध्वजोपमौ like the pair of flag staff of Indra, ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैः torn by Iravata, the vehicle of Indra, आपीडनकृतव्रणौ having scars caused by injury, वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ  arms with scars caused by the thunderbolt of Indra, विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ wounded by Visnu's discus, पीनौ fleshy, समसुजातांसौ wellbuilt, fleshy arms, सङ्गतौ tough, बलसंयुतौ strong, सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठौ on shapely thumb nails, स्वङ्गुलीतल लक्षितौ on shapely palms and fingers, संहतौ wellfixed, परिघाकारौ like iron crowbars, वृत्तौ rounded, करिकरोपमौ resembling elephant tusk, शुभ्रे on a clean, शयने couch, विक्षिप्तौ lying, पञ्चशीर्षौ like fivehooded, उरगौ इव like two serpents, शशक्षतजकल्पेन like the colour of the hare's blood, सुशीतेन by cool, सुगन्धिना with fragrant, परार्थ्येन fine, चन्दनेन by sandal paste, स्वनुलिप्तौ be smeared, स्वलङ्कृतौ welldecorated, उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ massaged by the best of women, गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ anointed by best of fragrants, यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ which can make yakshas, pannagas, gandharvas, gods and demons cry in terror, भुजौ arms, ददर्श saw.

Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
काञ्चनाङ्गदसन्नध्दै च ददर्श स महात्मनः। विक्षिप्तौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भुजाविन्द्रध्वजोपमौ।।5.10.15।। ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरापीडनकृतव्रणौ। वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ।।5.10.16।। पीनौ समसुजातांसौ संगतौ बलसंयुतौ। सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठा स्वङ्गुलीतललक्षितौ।।5.10.17।। संहतौ परिघाकारौ वृत्तौ करिकरोपमौ। विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ।।5.10.18।। शशक्षतजकल्पेन सुशीतेन सुगन्धिना। चन्दनेन परार्ध्येन स्वनुलिप्तौ स्वलङ्कृतौ।।5.10.19।। उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ। यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ।।5.10.20।।
output: Hanuman saw the great Ravana's arms, which were like a pair of Indra's flag staff adorned with golden straps. The arms bore the marks of wounds caused by Airavata, (Indra's elephant), torn by the thunderbolt of Indra in war, and wounded by the discus of Lord Visnu. His strong, fleshy, wellbuilt arms, having auspicious thumbnails, shapely fingers and palms, pressed together, resembled the iron crowbars or beam used for main doors. The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged  by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ददर्श स कपिस्तत्र बाहू शयनसंस्थितौ। मन्दरस्यांतरे सुप्तौ महाही रुषिताविव।।5.10.21।।
output: The vanara, gazed at the arms of Ravana placed on the couch that appeared like two angry snakes asleep in a cave on (the lap) of mount Mandara.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
ताभ्यां स परिपूर्णाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां राक्षसेश्वरः। शुशुभेऽचलसङ्काशः शृङ्गाभ्यामिव मन्दरः।।5.10.22।।
output: The lord of demons looked splendid like a mountain with his long, fully developed arms. He appeared like Mandara mountain with two lofty peaks.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चूतपुन्नागसुरभिर्वकुलोत्तमसंयुतः। मृष्टान्नरससंयुक्तः पानगन्धपुरस्कृतः।।5.10.23।। तस्य राक्षससिंहस्य निश्चक्राम महामुखात्। शयानस्य विनिःश्वासः पूरयन्निव तद् गृहम्।।5.10.24।।
output: The breath released from the huge mouth of that lion of demons carried the fragrance of mango and punnaga as well as excellent Bakula flowers. It exuded the aroma of rich and delicious food and different drink. It was as though pervading the whole chamber.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चूतपुन्नागसुरभिर्वकुलोत्तमसंयुतः। मृष्टान्नरससंयुक्तः पानगन्धपुरस्कृतः।।5.10.23।। तस्य राक्षससिंहस्य निश्चक्राम महामुखात्। शयानस्य विनिःश्वासः पूरयन्निव तद् गृहम्।।5.10.24।।
output: शयानस्य while he was sleeping, तस्य राक्षससिंहस्य of that of lion of demons, महामुखात् from his huge mouth, चूतपुन्नागसुरभिः fragrance of Punnaga and Mango blossoms, वकुलोत्तमसंयुतः and mixed with the fragrance of the best of Bakula flowers, मृष्टान्नरससंयुक्तः mixed with aroma of rich food, पानगन्धपुरस्सरः and also of the aroma of drinks, विनिःश्वासः breath, तत् that, गृहम् home, पूरयन्निव  pervading as though, निश्चक्राम spread out.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मुक्तामणिविचित्रेण काञ्चनेन विराजितम्। मकुटेनापवृत्तेन कुण्डलोज्वलिताननम्।।5.10.25।। रक्तचन्दनदिग्धेन तथा हारेण शोभिना। पीनायतविशालेन वक्षसाऽभिविराजितम्।।5.10.26।। पाण्डरेणापविद्धेन क्षौमेण क्षतजेक्षणम्। महार्हेण सुसंवीतं पीतेनोत्तमवाससा।।5.10.27।। माषराशिप्रतीकाशं निश्श्वसन्तं भुजङ्गवत्। गाङ्गे महति तोयान्ते प्रसुप्तमिव कुञ्जरम्।।5.10.28।। चतुर्भिः काञ्चनैर्दीपैद्धीप्यमानचतुर्दिशम्। प्रकाशीकृतसर्वाङ्गं मेघं विद्युद्गणैरिव।।5.10.29।। पादमूलगताश्चापि ददर्श सुमहात्मनः। पत्नी: स प्रियभार्यस्य तस्य रक्षःपतेर्गृहे।।5.10.30।।
output: सः that, तस्य रक्षःपतेः of Ravana, the lord of demons, गृहे in the palace, मुक्तामणिविचित्रेण studded with pearls and gems, काञ्चनेन by gold, अपवृत्तेन kept aside, मकुटेन by a crown, विराजितम् glittering, कुण्डलोज्वलिताननम् face shining with earrings, रक्तचन्दनदिग्धेन smeared with bright red sandal paste, हारेण by a string of pearls, शोभिना shining, पीनायतविशालेन fleshy and broad, वक्षसा on the chest, अभिविराजितम् very splendid, पाण्डरेण white, अपविद्धेन in disarray, क्षौमेण by silken cloth, क्षतजेक्षणम् having bloodred eyes, महार्हेण with an excellent, पीतेन with yellow, उत्तमवाससा with very expensive cloth, सुसंवीतम् covered well,माषराशिप्रतीकाशम् resembling a heap of blackbeans, भुजङ्गवत् like a snake, निःश्वसन्तम् sighing heavily, महति in a large, गाङ्गे on Ganga, तोयान्ते on the edge of water, प्रसुप्तम् sleeping, कुञ्जरम् इव like the elephant, काञ्चनैः golden,चतुर्भिः with four, दीपैः with lamps, दीप्यमानचतुर्दिशम् illumined on all four sides, विद्युद्गणैः by the flashes of lightning, प्रकाशीकृतसर्वाङ्गम् all his limbs lit up, प्रियभार्यस्य and his dear wives, सुमहात्मनः that great Ravana, पादमूलगताः seated at the feet, पत्नीश्च wives, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
मुक्तामणिविचित्रेण काञ्चनेन विराजितम्। मकुटेनापवृत्तेन कुण्डलोज्वलिताननम्।।5.10.25।। रक्तचन्दनदिग्धेन तथा हारेण शोभिना। पीनायतविशालेन वक्षसाऽभिविराजितम्।।5.10.26।। पाण्डरेणापविद्धेन क्षौमेण क्षतजेक्षणम्। महार्हेण सुसंवीतं पीतेनोत्तमवाससा।।5.10.27।। माषराशिप्रतीकाशं निश्श्वसन्तं भुजङ्गवत्। गाङ्गे महति तोयान्ते प्रसुप्तमिव कुञ्जरम्।।5.10.28।। चतुर्भिः काञ्चनैर्दीपैद्धीप्यमानचतुर्दिशम्। प्रकाशीकृतसर्वाङ्गं मेघं विद्युद्गणैरिव।।5.10.29।। पादमूलगताश्चापि ददर्श सुमहात्मनः। पत्नी: स प्रियभार्यस्य तस्य रक्षःपतेर्गृहे।।5.10.30।।
output: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep)  was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely  rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.
