His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
मुक्तामणिविचित्रेण काञ्चनेन विराजितम्। मकुटेनापवृत्तेन कुण्डलोज्वलिताननम्।।5.10.25।। रक्तचन्दनदिग्धेन तथा हारेण शोभिना। पीनायतविशालेन वक्षसाऽभिविराजितम्।।5.10.26।। पाण्डरेणापविद्धेन क्षौमेण क्षतजेक्षणम्। महार्हेण सुसंवीतं पीतेनोत्तमवाससा।।5.10.27।। माषराशिप्रतीकाशं निश्श्वसन्तं भुजङ्गवत्। गाङ्गे महति तोयान्ते प्रसुप्तमिव कुञ्जरम्।।5.10.28।। चतुर्भिः काञ्चनैर्दीपैद्धीप्यमानचतुर्दिशम्। प्रकाशीकृतसर्वाङ्गं मेघं विद्युद्गणैरिव।।5.10.29।। पादमूलगताश्चापि ददर्श सुमहात्मनः। पत्नी: स प्रियभार्यस्य तस्य रक्षःपतेर्गृहे।।5.10.30।।
output: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep)  was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely  rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
मुक्तामणिविचित्रेण काञ्चनेन विराजितम्। मकुटेनापवृत्तेन कुण्डलोज्वलिताननम्।।5.10.25।। रक्तचन्दनदिग्धेन तथा हारेण शोभिना। पीनायतविशालेन वक्षसाऽभिविराजितम्।।5.10.26।। पाण्डरेणापविद्धेन क्षौमेण क्षतजेक्षणम्। महार्हेण सुसंवीतं पीतेनोत्तमवाससा।।5.10.27।। माषराशिप्रतीकाशं निश्श्वसन्तं भुजङ्गवत्। गाङ्गे महति तोयान्ते प्रसुप्तमिव कुञ्जरम्।।5.10.28।। चतुर्भिः काञ्चनैर्दीपैद्धीप्यमानचतुर्दिशम्। प्रकाशीकृतसर्वाङ्गं मेघं विद्युद्गणैरिव।।5.10.29।। पादमूलगताश्चापि ददर्श सुमहात्मनः। पत्नी: स प्रियभार्यस्य तस्य रक्षःपतेर्गृहे।।5.10.30।।
output: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep)  was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely  rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
शशिप्रकाशवदनाश्चारुकुण्डलभूषिताः। अम्लानमाल्याभरणा ददर्श हरियूथपः।।5.10.31।।
output: Hanuman, the leader of vanaras found the wives of Ravana,  whose  faces were bright as the Moon, adorned with beautiful earrings and fresh floral garlands.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नृत्तवादित्रकुशला राक्षसेन्द्रभुजाङ्कगाः। वराभरणधारिण्यो निषण्णा ददृशे हरिः।।5.10.32।।
output: Hanuman saw  the women there wearing fine jewellery, performing dances, playing musical instruments, and resting on the lap or leaning on the arms of the demon king.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वज्रवैडूर्यगर्भाणि श्रवणान्तेषु योषिताम्। ददर्श तापनीयानि कुण्डलान्यङ्गदानि च।।5.10.33।।
output: He noticed on the earlobes of the the women gold earrings decked with diamonds and vaidurya. They were wearing shining armlets of gold.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तासां चन्द्रोपमैर्वक्त्रैश्शुभैर्ललितकुण्डलैः। विरराज विमानं तन्नभस्तारागणैरिव।।5.10.34।।
output: ललितकुण्डलैः by lovely earrings, चन्द्रोपमैः Moon like, शुभैः by beautiful, तासाम् their, वक्त्रै: with countenance, तत् विमानम् that exceptional cot, तारागणैः with hosts of stars, नभः इव like the sky, विरराज resplendent.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
मदव्यायामखिन्नास्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य योषितः। तेषु तेष्ववकाशेषु प्रसुप्तास्तनुमध्यमाः।।5.10.35।।
output: Exhausted by drinking and indulging in amorous sport, the consorts of Ravana slept here and there with their visible slender waists.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
अङ्गहारैस्तथैवान्या कोमलैर्नृत्तशालिनी। विन्यस्तशुभसर्वाङ्गी प्रसुप्ता वरवर्णिनी।।5.10.36।।
output: Another woman exceedingly beautiful and a delicate danseuse of beautiful complexion and rhythmic movements held her limbs in a dancing posture (though asleep) due to her habit .

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
काचिद्वीणां परिष्वज्य प्रसुप्ता सम्प्रकाशते। महानदीप्रकीर्णेव नलिनी पोतमाश्रिता।।5.10.37।।
output: Another woman slept hugging her veena. She shone like a lotus plant flung in a large river, clinging on to a boat. (Veena is compared to a boat and the woman to a lotusplant in the ambience of flowing waters of the river. The entire hall had put up such a dynamic view showing hectic life of the inmates).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्या कक्षगतेनैव मड्डुकेनासितेक्षणा। प्रसुप्ता भामिनी भाति बालपुत्रेव वत्सला।।5.10.38।।
output: कक्षगतेनैव held on her armpit, मड्डुकेन with Madduka drum, इव like प्रसुप्ता sleeping, अन्याः other, असितेक्षणा darkeyed, वत्सला lovingly, बालपुत्रा held a baby, भामिनीव a beautiful lady, भाति  splendid.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
पटहं चारुसर्वाङ्गी पीड्य शेते शुभस्तनी। चिरस्य रमणं लब्ध्वा परिष्वज्येव भामिनी।।5.10.39।।
output: Another charming beauty endowed with beautiful breasts lay hugging a tambourine as though a passionate woman lay embracing her lover whom she secured after a long time.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
काचिद्वंशं परिष्वज्य सुप्ता कमललोचना। रहः प्रियतमं गृह्य सकामेव च कामिनी।।5.10.40।।
output: कमललोचना lotuseyed, काचित् yet another lady, वंशम् lute, परिष्वज्य embracing, रहः in privacy, प्रियतमम् lover, गृह्य holding, सकामा in love, कामिनीव like a lover, सुप्ता slept.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
विपञ्चीं परिगृह्यान्या नियता नृत्तशालिनी। निद्रावशमनुप्राप्ता सह कान्तेव भामिनी।।5.10.41।।
output: Another selfpossessed lady, graceful in dance, holding a sevenstringed lute  was as though lying asleep with her beloved.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्या कनकसङ्काशैर्मृदुपीनैर्मनोरमैः। मृदङ्गं परिपीड्याङ्गैः प्रसुप्ता मत्तलोचना।।5.10.42।।
output: Another lady with drunken eyes lay fast asleep holding a drum close to her beautiful bosom with her soft limbs. (These images show that these women were singing and dancing till late night and slept exhausted).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भुजपार्श्वान्तरस्थेन कक्षगेन कृशोदरी। पणवेव सहानिन्द्या सुप्ता मदकृतश्रमा।।5.10.43।।
output: अनिन्द्या flawless, कृशोदरी of slender stomach, मदकृतश्रमा exhausted by drunkenness, भुजपर्श्वान्तरस्थेन pressed to her bosom, कक्षगेन into her armpit, पणवेन सह with tabor, सुप्ता slept

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
डिण्डिमं परिगृह्यान्या तथैवासक्तडिण्डिमा। प्रसुप्ता तरुणं वत्समुपगूह्येव भामिनी।।5.10.44।।
output: One lovely woman and another held a drum and slept as if they were hugging their young child.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
काचिदाडम्बरं नारी भुजसंयोगपीडितम्। कृत्वा कमलपत्राक्षी प्रसुप्ता मदमोहिता।।5.10.45।।
output: Yet another with her eyes like lotus petals deluded with passion tightly held in her arms a musical instrument known as Adambaram and slept.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
कलशीमपविध्यान्या प्रसुप्ता भाति भामिनी। वसन्ते पुष्पशबला मालेव परिमार्जिता।।5.10.46।।
output: Another lovely lady was fast asleep, having turned a goblet of water  aside, yet another lay like a garland of variegated flowers in spring season.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पाणिभ्यां च कुचौ काचित्सुवर्णकलशोपमौ। उपगूह्याबला सुप्ता निद्राबलपराजिता।।5.10.47।।
output: Overcome with sleep another woman lay pressing with her own hands her golden gobletlike breasts.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्या कमलपत्राक्षी पूर्णेन्दुसदृशानना। अन्यामालिङ्ग्य सुश्रोणीं प्रसुप्ता मदविह्वला।।5.10.48।।
output: One woman with eyes like lotus petals and face like the fullmoon embraced another young woman of beautiful hips  and slept tipsy with drink.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
आतोद्यानि विचित्राणि परिष्वज्य वरस्त्रियः। निपीड्य च कुचैस्सुप्ता कामिन्यः कामुकानिव।।5.10.49।।
output: Some charming maidens held wonderful musical instruments pressing against their bosom and slept like passionate women embracing their loved ones.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तासामेकान्तविन्यस्ते शयानां शयने शुभे। ददर्श रूपसम्पन्नामपरां स कपिः स्त्रियम्।।5.10.50।।
output: सः कपिः that vanara, तासाम् among them, एकान्तविन्यस्ते lying separately, शुभे excellent, शयने bed, शयानाम् sleeping, रूपसम्पन्नाम् richly endowed with beauty, स्त्रियम् women, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 10:
मुक्तामणिसमायुक्तैर्भूषणैः सुविभूषिताम्। विभूषयन्तीमिव तत्स्वश्रिया भवनोत्तमम्।।5.10.51।। गौरीं कनकवर्णाभामिष्टामन्तः पुरेश्वरीम्। कपिर्मन्दोदरीं तत्र शयानां चारुरूपिणीम्।।5.10.52।।
output: Then the vanara saw  a very beautiful woman of golden complexion decked with pearls and gems and with ornaments as if illuminating the excellent mansion with her splendour She was the king's favourite and the chief queen, Mandodari.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मुक्तामणिसमायुक्तैर्भूषणैः सुविभूषिताम्। विभूषयन्तीमिव तत्स्वश्रिया भवनोत्तमम्।।5.10.51।। गौरीं कनकवर्णाभामिष्टामन्तः पुरेश्वरीम्। कपिर्मन्दोदरीं तत्र शयानां चारुरूपिणीम्।।5.10.52।।
output: कपिः vanara, मुक्तामणिसमायुक्तै: with pearls and gems, भूषणैः with ornaments, सुविभूषिताम् well decorated, स्वश्रिया by her radiance, तत् that, भवनोत्तमम् that excellent mansion, विभूषयन्तीमिव as if decorating, गौरीम् woman of golden complexion, कनकवर्णाभाम् of golden complexion, इष्टाम् favourite, अन्तःपुरेश्वरीम् queen of the harem, तत्र there, शयानाम् sleeping, चारुरूपिणीम् very beautiful, मन्दोदरीम् Mandodari.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तां दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्भूषितां मारुतात्मजः। तर्कयामास सीतेति रूपयौवनसम्पदा।।5.10.53। हर्षेण महता युक्तो ननन्द हरियूथपः।
output: On seeing her embellished with ornaments, beauty and charm, the long armed son of the Windgod, the chief of the vanaras thought her to be Sita and rejoiced.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आस्फोटयामास चुचुम्ब पुच्छं ननन्द चिक्रीड जगौ जगाम। स्तम्भानरोहन्निपपात भूमौ निदर्शयन् स्वां प्रकृतिं कपीनाम्।।5.10.54।।
output: आस्फोटयामास clapped his palms, पुच्छम् tail, चुचुम्ब kissed, ननन्द rejoiced, चिक्रीड played, जगौ sang songs, जगाम went about, स्वाम् himself, कपीनाम् of being monkeys, प्रकृतिम् nature, निदर्शयन् while exhibiting, स्तम्भान् pillars, अरोहन् while climbing up, भूमौ on the land, निपपात jumped down.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
अवधूय च तां बुद्धिं बभूवावस्थितस्तदा। जगाम चापरां चिन्तां सीतां प्रति महाकपिः।।5.11.1।।
output: The great vanara, having rejected his judgement, started thinking again.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न रामेण वियुक्ता सा स्वप्तुमर्हति भामिनी। न भोक्तुं वाप्यलङ्कर्तुं न पानमुपसेवितुम्।।5.11.2।। नान्यं नरमुपस्थातुं सुराणामपि चेश्वरम्। न हि रामसमः कश्चिद्विद्यते त्रिदशेष्वपि।।5.11.3।। अन्येयमिति निश्चित्य पानभूमौ चचार सः।
output: 'Lovely Sita, being away from Rama, will not sleep, will not eat or drink or adorn herself. How can she approach any other man even if he is the king of gods for there is none equal to Rama even among gods'. Having thus decided, Hanuman strolled about the banquet hall.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
न रामेण वियुक्ता सा स्वप्तुमर्हति भामिनी। न भोक्तुं वाप्यलङ्कर्तुं न पानमुपसेवितुम्।।5.11.2।। नान्यं नरमुपस्थातुं सुराणामपि चेश्वरम्। न हि रामसमः कश्चिद्विद्यते त्रिदशेष्वपि।।5.11.3।। अन्येयमिति निश्चित्य पानभूमौ चचार सः।
output: 'Lovely Sita, being away from Rama, will not sleep, will not eat or drink or adorn herself. How can she approach any other man even if he is the king of gods for there is none equal to Rama even among gods'. Having thus decided, Hanuman strolled about the banquet hall.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रीडितेनापराः क्लान्ता गीतेन च तथाऽपराः।।5.11.4।। नृत्तेन चापराः क्लान्ताः पानविप्रहतास्तथा।
output: Some women were fatigued after sporting, similarly some were exhausted after singing. Others were tired through dancing and some were worn out by continuous drinking.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मुरजेषु मृदङ्गेषु पीठिकासु च संस्थिताः।।5.11.5।। तथाऽऽस्तरणमुख्येषु संविष्टाश्चापराः स्त्रियः।
output: मुरजेषु on murajas, मृदङ्गेषु on tabors, पीठिकासु च on hassocks, संस्थिताः resting, अपराः other, स्त्रियः women, आस्तरणमुख्येषु on exquisite beds, संविष्टाः lying.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
अङ्गनानां सहस्रेण भूषितेन विभूषणैः।।5.11.6।। रूपसल्लापशीलेन युक्तगीतार्थभाषिणा। देशकालाभियुक्तेन युक्तवाक्याभिधायिना।।5.11.7।। रताभिरतसंसुप्तं ददर्श हरियूथपः।
output: The monkey leader saw thousands of  beautiful women asleep after long dalliance. Some of them were adorned with ornaments, some were good at arguments and versed in the appreciation of songs, some were aware of the appropriate time and place and some were adept in right expressions.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गनानां सहस्रेण भूषितेन विभूषणैः।।5.11.6।। रूपसल्लापशीलेन युक्तगीतार्थभाषिणा। देशकालाभियुक्तेन युक्तवाक्याभिधायिना।।5.11.7।। रताभिरतसंसुप्तं ददर्श हरियूथपः।
output: The monkey leader saw thousands of  beautiful women asleep after long dalliance. Some of them were adorned with ornaments, some were good at arguments and versed in the appreciation of songs, some were aware of the appropriate time and place and some were adept in right expressions.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तासां मध्ये महाबाहुः शुशुभे राक्षसेश्वरः।।5.11.8।। गोष्ठे महति मुख्यानां गवां मध्ये यथा वृषः।
output: In the midst of these women the longarmed lord of demons shone like a (majestic) bull in a big cowshed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स राक्षसेन्द्रः शुशुभे ताभिः परिवृतस्स्वयम्।।5.11.9।। करेणुभिर्यथाऽरण्ये परिकीर्णो महाद्विपः।
output: ताभिः by those women, परिवृतः surrounded, सः राक्षसेन्द्रः the demon king, स्वयम् himself, महारण्ये in a great forest, करेणुभिः with female elphants, परिकीर्णः scattered, महाद्विपः यथा like a proud elephant, शुशुभे shone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वकामैरुपेतां च पानभूमिं महात्मनः।।5.11.10।। ददर्श हरिशार्दूलस्तस्य रक्षःपतेर्गृहे।
output: हरिशार्दूलः tiger among vanaras, महात्मनः of the great, तस्य his, रक्षःपते: Ravana's, गृहे in the palace, सर्वकामैः with all his, उपेताम् provided, पानभूमिं च drinking place, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
मृगाणां महिषाणां च वराहाणां च भागशः।।5.11.11।। तत्र न्यस्तानि मांसानि पानभूमौ ददर्श सः।
output: There at the drinking hall the meat of deer, buffaloes and boars portioned and placed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रौक्मेषु च विशालेषु भाजनेष्वर्धभक्षितान्।।5.11.12।। ददर्श हरिशार्दूलो मयूरान् कुक्कुटांस्तथा।
output: The tiger among vanaras also saw there meat of peacocks and chicken placed in large golden vessels, some half eaten.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
वराहवार्ध्राणसकान् दधिसौवर्चलायुतान्।।5.11.13।। शल्यान् मृगमयूरांश्च हनुमानन्ववैक्षत।
output: Hanuman saw the meat of pigs and jungle fowls, deer, peacocks and bones marinated with yoghurt and special kinds of salt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्रकरान्विविधान् सिद्धांश्चकोरानर्धभक्षितान्।।5.11.14।। महिषानेकशल्यांश्च छागांश्च कृतनिष्ठितान्। लेह्यानुच्चावचान्पेयान् भोज्यानि विविधानि च।।5.11.15।।
output: विविधान् several types, सिद्धान् cooked, क्रकरान् fowls, अर्धभक्षितान् half eaten, चकोरान् ruddy geese, महिषान् buffaloes, एकशल्यांश्च fishes, छागांश्च goats, उच्चवचान् all sorts of them, लेह्यान् varieties of food that can be licked, पेयान् drinks, विविधानि of many kinds, भोज्यानि eatables.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रकरान्विविधान् सिद्धांश्चकोरानर्धभक्षितान्।।5.11.14।। महिषानेकशल्यांश्च छागांश्च कृतनिष्ठितान्। लेह्यानुच्चावचान्पेयान् भोज्यानि विविधानि च।।5.11.15।।
output: He saw several kinds of (nonvegetarian) food like cooked meat of fowls, ruddy geese, buffaloes, goats, fishes as well as food for licking. (Food is of four kinds  1) भक्ष्य which can be chewed 2) भोज्य ordinary solid, semisolid food which can be consumed  3) लेह्य food for licking  4) चोष्य liquid food (which can be sipped)).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथाऽऽम्ललवणोत्तंसैर्विविधैरागषाडबैः। हारनूपुरकेयूरैरपविद्धैर्महाधनैः।।5.11.16।। पानभाजनविक्षिप्तैः फलैश्च विविधैरपि। कृतपुष्पोपहारा भूरधिकं पुष्यति श्रियम्।।5.11.17।।
output: तथा so also, आम्ललवणोत्तंसैः seasoned with sour and salty ingredients, विविधैः with many types, रागषाडबैः with syrups, अपविद्धै: with discarded, महाधनैः with heavy, हारनूपुरकेयूरैः with chains, anklets, shoulder straps, पानभाजनविक्षिप्तै: with those drinks spilt from the glasses, विविधैः with many, फलैश्च fruits, कृतपुष्पोपहारा with the offerings flowers of, भूः the earth, अधिकम् greatly, श्रियम् rich, पुष्यति looked splendid.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथाऽऽम्ललवणोत्तंसैर्विविधैरागषाडबैः। हारनूपुरकेयूरैरपविद्धैर्महाधनैः।।5.11.16।। पानभाजनविक्षिप्तैः फलैश्च विविधैरपि। कृतपुष्पोपहारा भूरधिकं पुष्यति श्रियम्।।5.11.17।।
output: The banquet hall looked splendid with food seasoned with salt and sour ingredients. There was ragashadavas (syrup made with grapes, pomegranates, different juices like half ripe mangoes and seasoned with ginger cardomom, butter etc). Heavy chains, anklets and shouldersstraps were thrown aside. (The people relaxed while eating and drinking and discarded heavy ornaments). Many glasses were found scattered or drinks spilt on the floor after use.Many fruits and flowers were kept.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्र तत्र च विन्यस्तै: सुश्लिष्टैश्शयनासनैः। पानभूमिर्विना वह्निं प्रदीप्तेवोपलक्ष्यते।।5.11.18।।
output: Good couches and different kinds of seats were wellarranged in the banquet hall. The place appeared as if it was glowing witout fire.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बहुप्रकारैर्विविधैर्वरसंस्कारसंस्कृतैः। मांसैः कुशलसम्पृक्तैः पानभूमिगतैः पृथक्।।5.11.19।।
output: In the banquet hall there were many types of meat arranged in a number of ways. They were cooked by experts by seasoning them with choicest ingredients.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दिव्याः प्रसन्ना विविधाः सुराः कृतसुरा अपि। शर्कराऽसवमाध्वीकपुष्पासवफलासवाः।।5.11.20।। वासचूर्णैश्च विविधैर्मृष्टास्तैस्तैः पृथक् पृथक्।
output: दिव्याः wonderful, प्रसन्नाः pleasing, विविधाः many, सुराः wines, शर्करासवमाध्वीकपुष्पासवफलासवाः sugercanejuices, honey, juices made from flowers and fruits, कृतसुराः अपि even though fermented, तैस्तै: as mentioned earlier, विविधैः with many, वासचूर्णैः with spice powders, पृथक् पृथक् diferent and, मृष्टाः were made delicious.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सन्तता शुशुभे भूमिर्माल्यैश्च बहुसंस्थितैः।।5.11.21।। हिरण्मयैश्च विविधैर्भाजनैः स्फाटिकैरपि। जाम्बूनदमयैश्चान्यैः करकैरभिसंवृता।।5.11.22।।
output: बहुसंस्थितैः arranged in varied styles, माल्यैश्च with garlands, संतता strectched, हिरण्मयैः with those made of gold, स्फाटिकैरपि and crystalware, विविधैः several kinds, भाजनैः with vessels, जाम्बूनदमयैः made of pure gold, अन्यैः by others, करकैः with jars, अभिसंवृता spread all over, भूमिः floor, शुशुभे looked  beautiful.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्तता शुशुभे भूमिर्माल्यैश्च बहुसंस्थितैः।।5.11.21।। हिरण्मयैश्च विविधैर्भाजनैः स्फाटिकैरपि। जाम्बूनदमयैश्चान्यैः करकैरभिसंवृता।।5.11.22।।
output: (The banquet hall) appeared beautiful with many kinds of garlands arranged in different locations. Also there were vessels made of pure gold, crystalware and jars spread all over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
राजतेषु च कुम्भेषु जाम्बूनदमयेषु च। पानश्रेष्ठं तदा भूरि कपिस्तत्र ददर्श ह।।5.11.23।।
output: Hanuman saw the best of wines in large quantities kept in silver and pure gold pots.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
﻿सोऽपश्यच्छातकुम्भानि सीधोर्मणिमयानि च। राजतानि च पूर्णानि भाजनानि महाकपिः।।5.11.24।।
output: ﻿ स: महाकपिः that great monkey, शीधोः of wine, शातकुम्भानि made of gold, मणिमयानि च inlaid with gems also, राजतानि च and silver, पूर्णानि filled, भाजनानि vessels, अपश्यत् saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
क्वचिदल्पावशेषाणि क्वचित्पीतानि सर्वशः। क्वचिन्नैव प्रपीतानि पानानि स ददर्श ह।।5.11.25।।
output: He saw wine jars at one place, some fully drained, and at another place not touched at all.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
क्वचिद् भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् क्वचित्पानानि भागशः। क्वचिदन्नावशेषाणि पश्यन्वै विचचार ह।।5.11.26।।
output: He moved about looking at different types of eatables and drinks arranged separately along with the left over food.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्वचित्प्रभिन्नैः करकैः क्वचिदालोलितैर्घटैः। क्वचित्संपृक्तमाल्यानि जलानि च फलानि च।।5.11.27।।
output: क्वचित् in one place, प्रभिन्नैः with broken, करकैः with pots, क्वचित् at other place, आलोलितैः with rolling, घटैः with pots, क्वचित् somewhere else, संपृक्तमाल्यानि strewn and mixed up flower garlands, जलानि च and water, फलानि च and fruits.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शयनान्यत्र नारीणां शुभ्राणि बहुधा पुनः। परस्परं समाश्लिष्य काश्चित्सुप्ता वराङ्गनाः।।5.11.28।।
output: Hanuman saw many beds some unused and some occupied by lovely women sleeping, embracing one another.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
काश्चिच्च वस्त्रमन्यस्यास्स्वपन्त्याः परिधाय च। आहृत्य चाबलाः सुप्ता निद्राबलपराजिताः।।5.11.29।।
output: Overcome with sleep some women pulled clothes of other women and covered their bodies with them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तासामुच्छवासवातेन वस्त्रं माल्यं च गात्रजम्। नात्यर्थं स्पन्दते चित्रं प्राप्य मन्दमिवानिलम्।।5.11.30।।
output: तासाम् their, गात्रजम् on their bodies, वस्त्रम् clothes, माल्यं च and garlands, उच्छवासवातेन by their exhaling, मन्दम् mildly, अनिलम् wind, प्राप्य इव as though caught, नात्यर्थम् by that, चित्रम् it is lovely, स्पन्दते moving.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चन्दनस्य च शीतस्य शीधोर्मधुरसस्य च। विविधस्य च माल्यस्य धूपस्य विविधस्य च।।5.11.31।। बहुधा मारुतस्तत्र गन्धं विविधमुद्वहन्।
output: With the many scents of cool sandal, of sweetsmelling wines of diverse kinds, as well as flower garlands of several types and of incense burning in that hall, the cool wind blew spreading several fragrances all over.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्नानानां चन्दनानां च धूपानां चैव मूर्छितः।।5.11.32।। प्रववौ सुरभिर्गन्धो विमाने पुष्पके तदा।
output: The wind wafting through the Pushpaka chariot carried the fragrance of the cool sandalpaste used in bath and the sweet smell of wines and thick smoke of fragrance spread further.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
श्यामावदातास्तत्रान्याः काश्चित्कृष्णा वराङ्गनाः।।5.11.33।। काश्चित् काञ्चनवर्णाङ्ग्यः प्रमदा राक्षसालये।
output: There in the demons abode were women who were fair, some lovely with dark and others with golden complexion.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
तासां निद्रावशत्वाच्च मदनेन विमूर्छितम्।।5.11.34।। पद्मिनीनां प्रसुप्तानां रूपमासीद्यथैव हि।
output: Withered due to indulgence in sex they were overcome with sleep. The charm of the women was like the lotus creepers with closed lotuses .

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
एवं सर्वमशेषेण रावणान्तः पुरं कपिः।।5.11.35।। ददर्श सुमहातेजाः न ददर्श च जानकीम्।
output: Brilliant Hanuman ransacked the harem of Ravana but found no Janaki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निरीक्षमाणश्च तदा ताः स्त्रियः स महाकपिः।।5.11.36।। जगाम महतीं चिन्तां धर्मसाध्वसशङ्कितः।
output: तदा then, स्त्रियः women, निरीक्षमाणः while seeing, सः he, महाकपिः the great monkey, धर्मसाध्वसशङ्कितः thinking that he transgressed the moral code, महतीम् great, चिन्ताम् worry, जगाम experienced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
परदारावरोधस्य प्रसुप्तस्य निरीक्षणम्।।5.11.37।। इदं खलु ममात्यर्थं धर्मलोपं करिष्यति।
output: 'Observing the wives of others in this manner in their inner chambers very much amounts to transgression of moral code  by me'. ( thought he)

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
न हि मे परदाराणां दृष्टिर्विषयवर्तिनी।।5.11.38।। अयं चात्र मया दृष्टः परदारापरिग्रहः।
output: 'I did see these wives of another, but not with a sensual mind. I have only seen them but not with foul intention'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 11:
तस्य प्रादुरभूच्चिन्ता पुनरन्या मनस्विनः।।5.11.39।। निश्चितैकान्तचित्तस्य कार्यनिश्चयदर्शिनी।
output: Another  bright idea struck the highly sensible Hanuman, who had a clear vision of the task ahead-- 'I was firm and singleminded in my direction regarding the task ahead' (thought he).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कामं दृष्टा मया सर्वा विश्वस्ता रावणस्त्रियः।।5.11.40।। न हि मे मनसः किञ्चिद्वैकृत्यमुपजायते।
output: विश्वस्ताः loyal, सर्वाः all, रावणस्त्रियः wives of Ravana, मया by me, कामं दृष्टाः are seen indeed without any foul desire, मे my, मनसः minds, किञ्चित् even a little, वैकृत्यम् passionate feeling, न उपजायते हि indeed not arise.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मनो हि हेतुः सर्वेषामिन्द्रियाणां प्रवर्तने।।5.11.41।। शुभाशुभास्ववस्थासु तच्च मे सुव्यवस्थितम्।
output: शुभाशुभासु for good and bad, अवस्थासु in all stages, सर्वेषाम् for all, इन्द्रियाणाम् of sense organs, प्रवर्तने in reaction, मनः mind, हेतुः is instrumental, मे my, तच्च that also, सुव्यवस्थितम्  is firmly eastablished.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नान्यत्र हि मया शक्या वैदेही परिमार्गितुम्।।5.11.42।। स्त्रियो हि स्त्रीषु दृश्यन्ते सदा सम्परिमार्गणे।
output: वैदेही Vaidehi, अन्यत्र at other places, परिमार्गितुम् to search, मया by me, न शक्या हि not possible indeed, सदा always, सम्परिमार्गणे during search, स्त्रियः women, स्त्रीषु among women, दृश्यन्ते can be seen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्य सत्त्वस्य या योनिस्तस्यां तत्परिमार्ग्यते। न शक्या प्रमदा नष्टा मृगीषु परिमार्गितुम्।।5.11.43।।
output: यस्य whose, सत्त्वस्य of a being, या whichever, योनिः source, तत् that, तस्याम् in that, परिमार्ग्यते is searched, नष्टा lost, प्रमदा woman, मृगीषु among female deer, परिमार्गितुम् to search, न शक्या not possible.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदिदं मार्गितं तावच्छुद्धेन मनसा मया।।5.11.44।। रावणान्तःपुरं सर्वं दृश्यते न तु जानकी।
output: 'I searched all over Ravana's harem with a pure mind but I have not seen Janaki'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
देवगन्धर्वकन्याश्च नागकन्याश्च वीर्यवान्।।5.11.45।। अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान्नैवापश्यत जानकीम्।
output: देवगन्धर्वकन्याश्च daughters of gods, gandharvas also, नागकन्याश्च and daughters of nagas, अवेक्षमाणः looked, वीर्यवान् valiant, हनुमान् Hanuman, जानकीम् Janaki, नैवापश्यत did not find.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तामपश्यन्कपिस्तत्र पश्यञ्श्चान्या परस्त्रियः।।5.11.46।। अपक्रम्य तदा वीरः प्रध्यातुमुपचक्रमे।
output: Heroic Hanuman, unable to find Sita among the women, moved aside and started thinking.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स भूयस्तु परं श्रीमान् मारुतिर्यत्नमास्थितः।।5.11.47।। आपानभूमिमुत्सृज्य तद्विचेतुं प्रचक्रमे।
output: श्रीमान् Illustrious, सः मारुतिः Maruti, भूयः once again, परम् great, यत्नम् effort, आस्थितः made, आपानभूमिम् banquet hall, उत्सृज्य leaving, तत् that, विचेतुम् to search, प्रचक्रमे departed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तस्य मध्ये भवनस्य मारुति र्लतागृहांश्चित्रगृहान्निशागृहान्। जगाम सीतां प्रति दर्शनोत्सुको न चैव तां पश्यति चारुदर्शनाम्।।5.12.1।।
output: Hanuman makes a thorough search of Ravana's palace for Sita.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 12:
स चिन्तयामास ततो महाकपिः प्रियामपश्यन्रघुनन्दनस्य ताम्। ध्रुवं हि सीता म्रियते यथा न मे विचिन्वतो दर्शनमेति मैथिली।।5.12.2।।
output: The great monkey, unable to find the beloved of Rama thought Sita might not be surviving. So he started thinking, ' I could not see her even though I have searched all over'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा राक्षसानां प्रवरेण जानकी स्वशीलसंरक्ष्णतत्परा सती। अनेन नूनं प्रति दुष्टकर्मणा हता भवेदार्यपथे परे स्थिता।।5.12.3।।
output: परे best, आर्यपथे on a noble path, स्थिता follower, सा जानकी Janaki,              स्वशीलसंरक्षणतत्परा सती who wishes to protect her chastity, प्रति दुष्टकर्मणा by this evil mind, अनेन by him, राक्षसानां प्रवरेण by the demon king, हता slayed, भवेत् is, नूनम् surely.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विरूपरूपा विकृता विवर्चसो महानना दीर्घविरूपदर्शनाः। समीक्ष्य सा राक्षसराजयोषितो भयाद्विनष्टा जनकेश्वरात्मजा।।5.12.4।।
output: 'The daughter of Janaka might have collapsed out of fear, looking at the distorted faces of ugly, tall and monstrous demon maids of Ravana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सीतामदृष्ट्वा ह्यनवाप्य पौरुषं विहृत्य कालं सह वानरैश्चिरम्। न मेऽस्ति सुग्रीवसमीपगा गतिः सुतीक्ष्णदण्डो बलवांश्च वानरः।।5.12.5।।
output: सीताम् Sita, अदृष्ट्वा without seeing, पौरुषम् pride of achievement, अनवाप्य without achieving, वानरैः सह accompanied by vanaras, चिरं कालम् for a long time, विहृत्य having passed time, मे to myself, सुग्रीवसमीपगा to approach Sugriva, गतिः way, नास्ति not possible, वानरः vanara, सुतीक्ष्णदण्डः  will punish severely, बलवांश्च powerful.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्टमन्तःपुरं सर्वं दृष्टा रावणयोषितः। न सीता दृश्यते साध्वीवृथा जातो मम श्रमः।।5.12.6।।
output: 'I have searched all over the harem. Ravana's women have been seen. (Yet) I have not been able to see noble Sita. My efforts have been wasted'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 12:
किं नु मां वानराः सर्वे गतं वक्ष्यन्ति सङ्गताः। गत्वा तत्र त्वया वीर किं कृतं तद्वदस्व नः।।5.12.7।।
output: 'What will the vanaras say when I return? What should I speak when they ask me: O hero, what did you accomplish there?'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अदृष्ट्वा किं प्रवक्ष्यामि तामहं जनकात्मजाम्। ध्रुवं प्रायमुपैष्यन्ति कालस्य व्यतिवर्तने।।5.12.8।।
output: 'Since the time limit has exceeded and Janaki is not spotted, surely the vanaras would sit and wait unto death. What am I going to say'?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 12:
किं वा वक्ष्यति वृद्धश्च जाम्बवानाङ्गदश्च सः। गतं पारं समुद्रस्य वानराश्च समागताः।।5.12.9।।
output: 'What will the elderly Jambavan say? What will young prince Angada and other vanaras collected there say when I reach the seashore to meet them'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलमनिर्वेदः परं सुखम्। अनिर्वेदो हि सततं सर्वार्थेषु प्रवर्तकः।।5.12.10।।
output: Wise Hanuman once again declared, 'being free from despair is the root cause of prosperity. Freedom from despondency gives supreme happiness and leads to success'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
करोति सफलं जन्तोः कर्म यत्तत्करोति सः। तस्मादनिर्वेदकृतं यत्नं चेष्टेऽहमुत्तमम्।।5.12.11।। भूयस्तावद्विचेष्यामि देशान्रावणपालितान्।
output: यत् that, कर्म action, करोति that he will do, जन्तोः of a living being, तत् that, सफलम् fruitful, सः he, करोति will do, तस्मात् therefore, अहम् I, अनिर्वेदकृतम् without experiencing despair, उत्तमम् best, प्रयत्नम् effort, चेष्टे I act, अदृष्टान् not seen, रावणपालितान् ruled by Ravana, देशान् country, विचेष्यामि तावत् search everywhere.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 12:
आपानशाला विचितास्तथा पुष्पगृहाणि च।।5.12.12।। चित्रशालाश्च विचिता भूयः क्रीडागृहाणि च। निष्कुटान्तररथ्याश्च विमानानि च सर्वशः।।5.12.13।।
output: 'I have searched the banquet halls, bowers of creepers, picture galleries and gymnasiums. I have searched everywhere through the paths of gardens and mansions, harems and the Pushpaka chariot also.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आपानशाला विचितास्तथा पुष्पगृहाणि च।।5.12.12।। चित्रशालाश्च विचिता भूयः क्रीडागृहाणि च। निष्कुटान्तररथ्याश्च विमानानि च सर्वशः।।5.12.13।।
output: पानशालाः banquet halls, विचिताः searched, तथा so also, पुष्पगृहाणि च bowers of creepers, चित्रशालाश्च picture galleries, विचिताः searched, भूयः further, क्रीडागृहाणि च and sports galleries, निष्कुटान्तररथ्याश्च paths through the gardens and mansions, female apartments, विमानानि च of the chariot, सर्वशः everywhere.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति सञ्चिन्त्य भूयोऽपि विचेतुमुपचक्रमे। भूमीगृहांश्चैत्यगृहान् गृहातिगृहकानपि।।5.12.14।।
output: Thinking thus, he started searching once again the basement cells, temples, homes within homes.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्पतन्निष्पतंश्चापि तिष्ठन्गच्छन् पुनः पुनः। अपावृण्वंश्च द्वाराणि कवाटान्यवघाटयन्।।5.12.15।। प्रविशन्निष्पतंश्चापि प्रपतन्नुत्पतन्नपि। सर्वमप्यवकाशं स विचचार महाकपिः।।5.12.16।।
output: The great vanara searched all over again and again jumping up and down, stopping for a while and moving, opening and closing doors, by crossing, entering and exiting, jumping up and down. Thus he moved about and searched whereever there was scope to search

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उत्पतन्निष्पतंश्चापि तिष्ठन्गच्छन् पुनः पुनः। अपावृण्वंश्च द्वाराणि कवाटान्यवघाटयन्।।5.12.15।। प्रविशन्निष्पतंश्चापि प्रपतन्नुत्पतन्नपि। सर्वमप्यवकाशं स विचचार महाकपिः।।5.12.16।।
output: सः महाकपिः that great vanara, पुनः पुनः again and again, उत्पतन् jumping, निष्पतंश्चापि climbing down, तिष्ठन्  standing, गच्छन् going, द्वाराणि entrance, अपावृण्वन् opening, कवाटानि doors, अवघाटयन् crossing, प्रविशन् entering, निष्पतंश्चापि and coming out, प्रपतन् jumping down, उत्पतन्नपि climbing up, सर्वम् अपि and all over, अवकाशम् scope, विचचार searched.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 12:
चतुरङ्गुलमात्रोऽपि नावकाशः स विद्यते। रावणान्तःपुरे तस्मिन् यं कपिर्न जगाम सः।।5.12.17।।
output: Even a space of four fingers in the inner chambers of Ravana was not left out in his search for Sita.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 12:
प्राकारान्तररथ्याश्च वेदिकाश्चैत्यसंश्रयाः। दीर्घिकाः पुष्करिण्यश्च सर्वं तेनावलोकितम्।।5.12.18।।
output: He moved in the lanes inside the boundary walls, around the shrines, altars, wells and tanks whereever it was possible to look for.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षस्यो विविधाकारा विरूपा विकृतास्तथा। दृष्टा हनुमता तत्र न तु सा जनकात्मजा।।5.12.19।।
output: विविधाकाराः of different types, विरूपाः ugly, तथा so also, विकृताः deformed, राक्षस्यः ogresses, तत्र there, हनुमता by Hanuman, दृष्टाः were seen, सा she, जनकात्मजा तु daughter of Janaka, न not found.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रूपेणाप्रतिमा लोके वरा विद्याधरस्त्रियः। दृष्टा हनुमता तत्र न तु राघवनन्दिनी।।5.12.20।।
output: रूपेण in beauty, लोके in the world, अप्रतिमाः incomparable, वराः best, विद्याधरस्त्रियः Vidyadhara women, तत्र there, हनुमता by Hanuman, दृष्टाः were seen, राघवनन्दिनी तु beloved of Raghava, न not find.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नागकन्या वरारोहाः पूर्णचन्र्दनिभाननाः। दृष्टा हनुमता तत्र न तु सीता सुमध्यमा।।5.12.21।।
output: वरारोहाः lovely women with symmetrical limbs, पूर्णचन्र्दनिभाननाः moonfaced women, नागकन्याः daughters of nagas, तत्र there, हनुमता by Hanuman, दृष्टाः were seen, सुमध्यमा a woman of lovely waist, सीता तु Sita, न not found.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रमथ्य राक्षसेन्द्रेण नागकन्या बलाद्धृताः। दृष्टा हनुमता तत्र न सा जनकनन्दिनी।।5.12.22।।
output: राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the demon king, प्रमथ्य defeating, बलात् forcefully, हृताः abducted, नागकन्याः daughters of nagas, तत्र there, हनुमता by Hanuman, दृष्टाः seen, सा that, जनकनन्दिनी न not the delight of Janaka.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 12:
सोऽपश्यंस्तां महाबाहुः पश्यंश्चान्या वरस्त्रियः। विषसाद मुहुर्धीमान् हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।।5.12.23।।
output: The longarmed Hanuman, son of the Windgod was able to see other great women but not Sita. So he became despondent.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 12:
उद्योगं वानरेन्द्राणां प्लवनं सागरस्य च। व्यर्थं वीक्ष्यानिलसुतश्चिन्तां पुनरुपागमत्।।5.12.24।।
output: The son of the Wind god, the great monkey realised the futility of his efforts in crossing the sea. He brooded again.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवतीर्य विमानाच्च हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः। चिन्तामुपजगामाथ शोकोपहतचेतनः।।5.12.25।।
output: अथ now, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, विमानात् from the aerialchariot, अवतीर्य after descending, शोकोपहतचेतनः mind stricken with grief, चिन्ताम् worry, उपजगाम he experienced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
विमानात्तु सुसम्क्रम्य प्राकारं हरियूथपः। हनुमान्वेगवानासीद्यथा विद्युद्घनान्तरे।।5.13.1।।
output: Hanuman, the vanara leader, jumped from the aerial chariot to the boundary wall like a flash of lightning in the clouds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्परिक्रम्य हनुमान्रावणस्य निवेशनात्। अदृष्ट्वा जानकीं सीतामब्रवीद्वचनं कपिः।।5.13.2।।
output: कपिः vanara, हनुमान् Hanuman, रावणस्य Ravana's, निवेशनात् from the home, सम्परिक्रम्य going round, जानकीम् Janaka's daughter, सीताम् Sita, अदृष्ट्वा not seeing, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भूयिष्ठं लोलिता लङ्का रामस्य चरता प्रियम्। न हि पश्यामि वैदेहीं सीतां सर्वाङ्गशोभनाम्।।5.13.3।।
output: "I have thoroughly surveyed the entire city of Lanka to please Rama, but I am unable to find Sita of flawless beauty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पल्वलानि तटाकानि सरांसि सरितस्तथा। नद्योऽनूपवनान्ताश्च दुर्गाश्च धरणीधराः।।5.13.4।। लोलिता वसुधा सर्वा न तु पश्यामि जानकीम्।
output: पल्वलानि waterlogs, तटाकानि tanks, सरांसि lakes, तथा similarly, सरितः streams, नद्यः rivers, अनूपवनान्ताश्च along the woods, दुर्गाः difficult places to reach, धरणीधराः mountains, सर्वा: all, वसुधा over the land, लोलिता searched, जानकीं तु but Janaki, न पश्यामि I have not seen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
इह सम्पातिना सीता रावणस्य निवेशने।।5.13.5।। आख्याता गृध्रराजेन न च पश्यामि तामहम्।
output: "Sampati, king of vultures had said that Sita is at Ravana's palace. But I have not been able to see her.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किं नु सीताऽथ वैदेही मैथिली जनकात्मजा।।5.13.6।। उपतिष्ठेत विवशा रावणं दुष्टचारिणम्।
output: "Can it be that Mythili, daughter of Janaka, dejected and helpless succumbed to the evil intentions of Ravana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षिप्रमुत्पततो मन्ये सीतामादाय रक्षसः।।5.13.7।। बिभ्यतो रामबाणानामन्तरा पतिता भवेत्।
output: रामबाणानाम् of the arrows of Rama, बिभ्यतः out of fear, रक्षसः the demon, सीताम् Sita, आदाय having brought, क्षिप्रम् at great speed, उत्पततः while flying, अन्तरा in the middle, पतिता dropped, भवेत् may be, मन्ये I think.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
अथवा ह्रियमाणायाः पथि सिद्धनिषेविते।।5.13.8।। मन्ये पतितमार्याया हृदयं प्रेक्ष्य सागरम्।
output: "Or, perhaps while being borne away on the path frequented by siddhas, the beloved of Rama might have fallen down (dead), heart broken, on seeing the (vast) sea.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणस्योरुवेगेन भुजाभ्यां पीडितेन च।।5.13.9।। तया मन्ये विशालाक्ष्या त्यक्तं जीवितमार्यया।
output: रावणस्य Ravana's, उरुवेगेन by the high speed in the flight, भुजाभ्याम् with the arms, पीडितेन च being under pressure, विशालाक्ष्या by the largeeyed one, तया by her, आर्यया by the noble lady, जीवितम् life, त्यक्तम् given up, मन्ये I think.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपर्युपरि वा नूनं सागरं क्रमतस्तदा।।5.13.10।। विवेष्टमाना पतिता सागरे जनकात्मजा।
output: तदा then, सागरम् उपर्युपरि higher and higher over the sea, क्रमतः for him while he advanced, जनकात्मजा Janaki, विवेष्टमाना wriggling hard to extricate, सागरे in the sea, नूनम् surely, पतिता fallen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहो क्षुद्रेण वाऽनेन रक्षन्ती शीलमात्मनः।।5.13.11।। अबन्धुर्भक्षिता सीता रावणेन तपस्विनी।
output: अहो Oh, आत्मनः of her self, शीलम् chastity, रक्षन्ती while protecting, अबन्धुः distanced from relatives, तपस्विनी a helpless woman, सीता Sita, क्षुद्रेण by the cruel one, अनेन by him, रावणेन by Ravana, भक्षिता eaten.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथवा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पत्नीभिरसितेक्षणा।।5.13.12।। अदुष्टा दुष्टभावाभिर्भक्षिता सा भविष्यति।
output: "Or else, the pious, blackeyed Sita might have been eaten by the the cruelnatured wives of the lord of demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
सम्पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतिमं पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणम्।।5.13.13।। रामस्य ध्यायती वक्त्रं पञ्चत्वं कृपणा गता।
output: "Or, she might have attained death, meditating on Rama, whose face resembles the fullmoon and eyes the lotus petals.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हा राम लक्ष्मणेत्येवं हाऽयोध्ये चेति मैथिली।।5.13.14।। विलप्य बहु वैदेही न्यस्तदेहा भविष्यति।
output: वैदेही Vaidehi, मैथिली Mythili, हा राम Alas, Rama, हा लक्ष्मण alas, Lakshmana, हा अयोध्या alas, Ayodhya, इति thus, बहु very much, विलप्य weaping, न्यस्तदेहा cast off life, भविष्यति may be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
अथवा निहिता मन्ये रावणस्य निवेशने।।5.13.15।। नूनं लालप्यते सीता पञ्जरस्थेव शारिका।
output: "Or, I think Sita might have been imprisoned in a cage like a myna in Ravana's palace. She will be surely crying.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जनकस्य सुता सीता रामपत्नी सुमध्यमा।।5.13.16।। कथमुत्पलपत्राक्षी रावणस्य वशं व्रजेत्।
output: जनकस्य Janaka's, सुता daughter, रामपत्नी Rama's wife, सुमध्यमा a lady of beautiful waist, उत्पलपत्राक्षी eyes like lotus petals, सीता Sita, रावणस्य Ravana's, वशम् fold, कथम् how, व्रजेत् can come under.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनष्टा वा प्रणष्टा वा मृता वा जनकात्मजा।।5.13.17।। रामस्य प्रियभार्यस्य न निवेदयितुं क्षमम्।
output: जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, विनष्टा वा whether lost, प्रणष्टा वा or whether irretrievable, मृता वा or dead, प्रियभार्यस्य for him who is fond of his wife, रामस्य of Rama, निवेदयितुम् to report, न क्षमम् not proper.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निवेद्यमाने दोषस्स्याद्दोषस्स्यादनिवेदने।।5.13.18।। कथं नु खलु कर्तव्यं विषमं प्रतिभाति मे।
output: निवेद्यमाने by informing this, दोषः mistake, स्यात् may be, अनिवेदने by not informing, दोषः mistake, स्यात् may be, कथम् how, कर्तव्यं नु खलु what to do, मे to me, विषमम् difficult, प्रतिभाति appears.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
अस्मिन्नेवंगते कार्ये प्राप्तकालं क्षमं च किम्।।5.13.19।। भवेदिति मतं भूयो हनुमान्प्रविचारयत्।
output: "I wonder what the right course of action is when things have taken such a turn? What is proper for me to do? Hanuman once again deliberated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदि सीतामदृष्ट्वाऽहं वानरेन्द्रपुरीमितः।।5.13.20।। गमिष्यामि ततः को मे पुरुषार्थो भविष्यति।
output: अहम् I, सीताम् Sita, अदृष्ट्वा without seeing, इतः from here, वानरेन्द्रपुरीम् city of vanaras, गमिष्यामि I reach, यदि if, ततः then, कः what (has been accomplished), पुरुषार्थः accomplishment, भविष्यति will happen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ममेदं लङ्घनं व्यर्थं सागरस्य भविष्यति।।5.13.21।। प्रवेशश्चैव लङ्कायाः राक्षसानां च दर्शनम्।
output: "My crossing the ocean, my entry into Lanka and my survey of the demons are all futile.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किं मां वक्ष्यति सुग्रीवो हरयो वा समागताः।।5.13.22।। किष्किन्धां समनुप्राप्तं तौ वा दशरथात्मजौ।
output: "What will Sugriva or even the vanaras and the two sons of Dasaratha say when I reach Kishkinda?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
गत्वा तु यदि काकुत्स्थं वक्ष्यामि परमप्रियम्।।5.13.23।। न दृष्टेति मया सीता ततस्तक्ष्यति जीवितम्।
output: "If I report the most unpleasant news that Sita was not found, Rama will give up his life.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
परुषं दारुणं क्रूरं तीक्ष्णमिन्द्रियतापनम्।।5.13.24।। सीतानिमित्तं दुर्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा स न भविष्यति।
output: परुषम् harsh, दारुणम् dreadful, क्रूरम् cruel, तीक्ष्णम् sharp, इन्द्रियतापनम् that which can scorch senses, सीतानिमित्तम् about Sita, दुर्वाक्यम् unwelcome words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, सः Rama, न भविष्यति will not live.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं तु कृच्छ्रगतं दृष्ट्वा पञ्चत्वगतमानसम्।।5.13.25।। भृशानुरक्तो मेधावी न भविष्यति लक्ष्मणः।
output: कृच्छ्रगतम्  in painful state, पञ्चत्वगतमानसम् one who has almost given his life, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा seeing, भृशानुरक्तः deeply devoted, मेधावी wise, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, न भविष्यति will not survive.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनष्टौ भ्रातरौ श्रुत्वा भरतोऽपि मरिष्यति।।5.13.26।। भरतं च मृतं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुघ्नो न भविष्यति।
output: भ्रातरौ both brothers, विनष्टौ dead, श्रुत्वा after hearing, भरतोऽपि Bharata also, मरिष्यति will die, मृतम् dead, भरतम् of Bharata, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, शत्रुघ्नश्च even Satrughna, न भविष्यति will not live.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
पुत्रान्मृतान्समीक्ष्याथ न भविष्यन्ति मातरः।।5.13.27।। कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च कैकेयी च न संशयः।
output: अथ then, मातरः mothers, कौसल्या च and Kausalya, सुमित्रा च even Sumitra, कैकेयी च even Kaikeyi, पुत्रान् of sons, मृतान् of their death, समीक्ष्य on seeing, न भविष्यन्ति will not be able to live, संशयः न no doubt.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृतज्ञस्सत्यसन्धश्च सुग्रीवः प्लवगाधिपः।।5.13.28।। रामं तथा गतं दृष्ट्वा ततस्त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्।
output: "On seeing that Rama has ended his life, the grateful and truthful monkey leader, Sugriva will give up his life.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दुर्मना व्यथिता दीना निरानन्दा तपस्विनी।।5.13.29।। पीडिता भर्तृशोकेन रुमा त्यक्ष्यति जीवितम्।
output: "Distressed, disheartened, pained and grieved on account of her husband's death, the virtuous lady Ruma (wife of Sugriva) will be unhappy and die.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वालिजेन तु दुःखेन पीडिता शोककर्शिता।।5.13.30।। पञ्चत्वं च गते राज्ञि ताराऽपि न भविष्यति।
output: "Tara who is troubled by Vali's death and tortured with grief will not live when king Sugriva dies.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मातापित्रोर्विनाशेन सुग्रीवव्यसनेन च।।5.13.31।। कुमारोऽप्यङ्गदः कस्माद्धारयिष्यति जीवितम्।
output: "On account of his parents death and also because of Sugriva's calamity, Angada will give up his life.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
भर्तृजेन तु दुःखेन ह्यभिभूता वनौकसः।।5.13.32।। शिरांस्यभिहनिष्यन्ति तलैर्मुष्टिभिरेव च।
output: "The grief due to the death of their king will make the vanaras hit their heads with their palms and fists.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
सान्त्वेनानुप्रदानेन मानेन च यशस्विना।।5.13.33।। लालिताः कपिराजेन प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यन्ति वानराः।
output: "The vanaras who were reared by the king's kind words, gifts and care will give up their life.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
न वनेषु न शैलेषु न निरोधेषु वा पुनः।।5.13.34।। क्रीडामनुभविष्यन्ति समेत्य कपिकुञ्जराः।
output: "The chiefs among vanaras together will not enjoy their life in the forest or mountains or caves.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
सपुत्रदारास्सामात्या भर्तृव्यसनपीडिताः।।5.13.35।। शैलाग्रेभ्यः पतिष्यन्ति समेषु विषमेषु च।
output: "Tormented by their king's death the vanaras with their wives, sons and ministers will drop down from the mountain peaks on the rough ground and die.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
विषमुद्बन्धनं वापि प्रवेशं ज्वलनस्य वा।।5.13.36।। उपवासमथो शस्त्रं प्रचरिष्यन्ति वानराः।
output: "The vanaras will put an end to their lives by poisoning or by hanging or by selfimmolation or by killing themselves with weapons or by fasting unto death.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
घोरमारोदनं मन्ये गते मयि भविष्यति।।5.13.37।। इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाशश्च नाशश्चैव वनौकसाम्।
output: मयि गते when I go, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाशश्च destruction of the Ikshvakus, वनौकसाम् of vanaras, नाशश्चैव destruction, घोरम् dreadful, आरोदनम् weeping, भविष्यति will be, मन्ये I think.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽहं नैव गमिष्यामि किष्किन्धां नगरीमितः।।5.13.38।। न च शक्ष्याम्यहं द्रष्टुं सुग्रीवं मैथिलीं विना।
output: अहम् I, इतः from here, किष्किन्धां नगरीम् to the city of Kishkinda, नैव गमिष्यामि I will not go, अहम् I, मैथिलीं Mythili, विना without, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, द्रष्टुम् to see, न च शक्ष्यामि not possible for me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
मय्यगच्छति चेहस्थे धर्मात्मानौ महारथौ।।5.13.39।। आशया तौ धरिष्येते वानराश्च मनस्विनः।
output: Both the highsouled warrior princes treading a righteous path as well as the vanaras will survive with a hope of my return if I stay back.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हस्तादानो मुखादानो नियतो वृक्षमूलिकः।।5.13.40।। वानप्रस्थो भविष्यामि ह्यदृष्ट्वा जनकात्मजाम्। सागरानूपजे देशे बहुमूलफलोदके।।5.13.41।।
output: जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, अदृष्ट्वा by not seeing, हस्तादानः food available to hand, मुखादानः and mouth, नियतः strictly, बहुमूलफलोदके filled with fruits roots and water, सागरानूपजे on the shore of the sea, देशे here, वृक्षमूलिकः surviving on roots of trees, वानप्रस्थः like a hermit, भविष्यामि I will be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
हस्तादानो मुखादानो नियतो वृक्षमूलिकः।।5.13.40।। वानप्रस्थो भविष्यामि ह्यदृष्ट्वा जनकात्मजाम्। सागरानूपजे देशे बहुमूलफलोदके।।5.13.41।।
output: "If Janaki is not found I will stay here and live like a hermit subsisting on whatever is available on this sea shore, which has abundance of roots, fruits and water.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चितां कृत्वा प्रवेक्ष्यामि समिद्धमरणीसुतम्। उपविष्टस्य वा सम्यग्लिङ्गिनीं साधयिष्यतः।।5.13.42।। शरीरं भक्षयिष्यन्ति वायसाः श्वापदानि च।
output: "I will prepare a pyre  and enter the fire  so that sea waves wash off the ashes or crows and beasts will eat up my body while i sit fasting unto death.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदं महर्षिभिर्दृष्टं निर्याणमिति मे मतिः।।5.13.43।। सम्यगापः प्रवेक्ष्यामि न चेत्पश्यामि जानकीम्।
output: इदम् this, महर्षिभिः by ascetics, दृष्टम्  seen, निर्याणम् ending of life, इति like this, मे my, मतिः thought, जानकीम् Janaki, न चेत्पश्यामि if I am not able to see, सम्यक् right, आपः water, प्रवेक्ष्यामि will enter.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
सुजातमूला सुभगा कीर्तिमाला यशस्विनी।।5.13.44।। प्रभग्ना चिररात्रीयं मम सीतामपश्यतः।
output: My glory which had a good start (in the form of bringing Rama to Sugriva) and brought fortune to Sugriva and fame to me has been snapped as I could not find Sita.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तापसो वा भविष्यामि नियतो वृक्षमूलिकः।।5.13.45।। नेतः प्रतिगमिष्यामि तामदृष्ट्वासितेक्षणाम्।
output: नियतः strictly, वृक्षमूलिकः resting under the tree, तापसो वा or an ascetic, भविष्यामि I will remain, असितेक्षणाम् blackeyed, ताम् her, अदृष्टवा without seeing, इतः from here, न प्रतिगमिष्यामि I will not go back.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदीतः प्रतिगच्छामि सीतामनधिगम्य ताम्।।5.13.46।। अङ्गदस्सह तैस्सर्वैर्वानरैर्न भविष्यति।
output: ताम् her, सीताम् Sita, अनधिगम्य without finding, इतः from this place, प्रतिगच्छामि यदि if I go back, सर्वैः by all, तै: by those, वानरैः सह along with vanaras, अङ्गदः Angada, न भविष्यति will not live.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनाशे बहवो दोषा जीवन् भद्राणि पश्यति।।5.13.47।। तस्मात्प्राणान् धरिष्यामि ध्रुवो जीवितसङ्गमः।
output: विनाशे by comitting suicide, बहवः many, दोषाः sins, जीवन् by living, भद्राणि auspicious events, पश्यति can be experienced, तस्मात् therefore, प्राणान् life, धरिष्यामि I will sustain, जीवितसङ्गमः only a living person, ध्रुवः is certain

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं बहुविधं दुःखं मनसा धरायन्मुहुः।।5.13.48।। नाध्यगच्छत्तदा पारं शोकस्य कपिकुञ्चरः।
output: The elephant among monkeys (Hanuman) worrying over and over again, holding his head for long could not reach the end of his grief.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणं वा वधिष्यामि दशग्रीवं महाबलम्।।5.13.49।। काममस्तु हृता सीता प्रत्याचीर्णं भविष्यति।
output: वा or, दशग्रीवम् tenheaded one, महाबलम् endowed with great strength, रावणम् Ravana, वधिष्यामि I will, हृता dead, सीता Sita, कामम् अस्तु desire will be fulfilled, प्रत्याचीर्णम् fitting reply, भविष्यति will be.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथवैनं समुत्क्षिप्य उपर्युपरि सागरम्।।5.13.50।। रामायोपहरिष्यामि पशुं पशुपतेरिव।
output: "Or else, I shall carry him across the sea and put him before Rama like a bull as if he is a sacrificial prey to lord Siva."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति चिन्तां समापन्नः सीतामनधिगम्य ताम्।।5.13.51।। ध्यानशोकपरीतात्मा चिन्तयामास वानरः।
output: Distressed over his inability to find Sita, Hanuman's mind was overcome with anxiety and he started thinking further.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यावत्सीतां हि पश्यामि रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम्।।5.13.52।। तावदेतां पुरीं लङ्कां विचिनोमि पुनः पुनः।
output: "Till I find the virtuous Sita, wife of Rama in this Lanka, I shall keep searching everywhere again and again.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्पातिवचनाच्चापि रामं यद्यानयाम्यहम्।।5.13.53।। अपश्यन् राघवो भार्यां निर्धहेत्सर्ववानरान्।
output: सम्पातिवचनात् on Sampati's words, अहम् I, रामम् Rama, आनयामि यदि if I had brought, राघवः Raghava, भार्याम् wife, अपश्यन् unable to see, सर्ववानरान् all vanaras, निर्दहेत् would have burnt.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इहैव नियताहारो वत्स्यामि नियतेन्द्रियः।।5.13.54।। न मत्कृते विनश्येयुः सर्वे ते नरवानराः।
output: "I will stay here itself, restricting my food and controlling my senses. Let not men and monkeys perish for my fault.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अशोकवनिका चेयं दृश्यते या महाद्रुमा।।5.13.55।। इमामधिगमिष्यामि न हीयं विचिता मया।
output: महाद्रुमा huge trees, या such, इयम् this, अशोकवनिका Ashoka grove, दृश्यते is seen, इमाम् there, अधिगमिष्यामि I will go, इयम् here, मया by me, न विचिता हि not looked for.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
वसून्रुद्रांस्तथाऽदित्यानश्विनौ मरुतोऽपि च।।5.13.56।। नमस्कृत्वा गमिष्यामि रक्षसां शोकवर्धनः।
output: "I shall offer salutations to Vasus, Rudras Adityas and Aswinis and proceed to  increase (cause) the sorrow of the demons. (There are eight Vasus, eleven Rudras, twelve Adityas, two Ashwins and fortynine Windgods).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
जित्वा तु राक्षसान् सर्वानिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दिनीम्।।5.13.57।। सम्प्रदास्यामि रामाय यथा सिद्धिं तपस्विने।
output: "I will conquer all the ogres and pass them to Sita, the delight of the Ikshvaku family  as an offering and give Rama to her as the fruit of her austerities."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सः मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा चिन्तावग्रथितेन्द्रियः।।5.13.58।। उदतिष्ठन्महातेजा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।
output: The brilliant son of the Windgod, Hanuman, whose senses were overwhelmed with worries, regained his senses in a short while and got up.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नमोऽस्तु रामाय सलक्ष्मणाय देव्यै च तस्यै जनकात्मजायै। नमोऽस्तु रुद्रेंद्रयमानिलेभ्यो नमोऽस्तु चन्द्रार्कमरुद्गणेभ्यः।।5.13.59।।
output: "My salutations to Lakshmana, Rama and divine daughter of Janaka. Salutations to Rudra, Indra, Yama and Vayu. Salutations to Sun, Moon and Maruts"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तेभ्यस्तु नमस्कृत्य सुग्रीवाय च मारुतिः। दिशस्सर्वास्समालोक्य ह्यशोकवनिकां प्रति।।5.13.60।।
output: Having offered salutations to all gods as well as to Sugriva, he looked at all quarters and left for the Ashoka grove.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स गत्वा मनसा पूर्वमशोकवनिकां शुभाम्। उत्तरं चिन्तयामास वानरो मारुतात्मजः।।5.13.61।।
output: मारुतात्मजः Hanuman, सः वानरः the vanara, मनसा in his mind, पूर्वम् earlier, शुभाम् auspicious, अशोकवनिकाम् grove of Ashoka, गत्वा after going, उत्तरम् again, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ध्रुवं तु रक्षोबहुला भविष्यति वनाकुला। अशोकवनिका पुण्या सर्वसंस्कारसंस्कृता।।5.13.62।।
output: 'This Ashoka grove filled with many trees, guarded by many demons is carefully tended. It must be sacred.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रक्षिणश्चात्र विहिता नूनं रक्षन्ति पादपान्। भगवानपि सर्वात्मा नातिक्षोभं प्रवाति वै।।5.13.63।। संक्षिप्तोऽयं मयाऽत्मा च रामार्थे रावणस्य च।
output: अत्र there, विहिताः posted, रक्षिणश्च guards, पादपान् trees, नूनम् surely, रक्षन्ति they are protecting, सर्वात्मा all pervading, भगवानपि divinity also, नातिक्षोभम् not violent, प्रवाति वै is blowing, मया my, रामार्थे for Rama's sake, रावणस्य च and Ravana also, अयम् this, आत्मा my own self, संक्षिप्तः made small.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सिद्धिं मे संविधास्यन्ति देवाः सर्षिगणास्त्विह।।5.13.64।। ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान् देवाश्चैव दिशन्तु मे। सिद्धिमग्निश्च वायुश्च पुरुहूतश्च वज्रभृत्।।5.13.65।। वरुणः पाशहस्तश्च सोमादित्यौ तथैव च। अश्विनौ च महात्मानौ मरुतः शर्व एव च।।5.13.66।। सिद्धिं सर्वाणि भूतानि भूतानां चैव यः प्रभुः। दास्यन्ति मम ये चान्ये ह्यदृष्टाः पथि गोचराः।।5.13.67।।
output: सर्षिगणाः (स ऋषिगणा:) along with all sages, देवाः gods, इह here, मे to me, सिद्धिंम् success, संविधास्यन्ति will give, स्वयंभूः selfborn, भगवान् god, ब्रह्मा Brahma, देवाश्चैव and also gods, अग्निश्च and Fire, वायुश्च even Wind, वज्रभृत् Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt, पुरूहूतश्च Indra who is invoked several times in sacrifices, पाशहस्तः holding a rope, वरुणश्च Varuna too, तथैव च so also,सोमादित्यौ Moon and Sun, महात्मानौ all great, अश्विनौ च twin Aswinis also, मरुतः Maruts, शर्वः एव च lord Siva, मे to me, सिद्धिम् success, दिशन्तु many give, सर्वाणि all, भूतानि beings, यः whoever, भूतानाम् of creatures, प्रभु: lord, अन्ये other, ये those, अदृष्टाः not seen, पथि on the way, गोचराः creatures moving on earth, मम to me, सिद्धिम् success, दास्यन्ति will ordain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सिद्धिं मे संविधास्यन्ति देवाः सर्षिगणास्त्विह।।5.13.64।। ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान् देवाश्चैव दिशन्तु मे। सिद्धिमग्निश्च वायुश्च पुरुहूतश्च वज्रभृत्।।5.13.65।। वरुणः पाशहस्तश्च सोमादित्यौ तथैव च। अश्विनौ च महात्मानौ मरुतः शर्व एव च।।5.13.66।। सिद्धिं सर्वाणि भूतानि भूतानां चैव यः प्रभुः। दास्यन्ति मम ये चान्ये ह्यदृष्टाः पथि गोचराः।।5.13.67।।
output: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis  Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
सिद्धिं मे संविधास्यन्ति देवाः सर्षिगणास्त्विह।।5.13.64।। ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान् देवाश्चैव दिशन्तु मे। सिद्धिमग्निश्च वायुश्च पुरुहूतश्च वज्रभृत्।।5.13.65।। वरुणः पाशहस्तश्च सोमादित्यौ तथैव च। अश्विनौ च महात्मानौ मरुतः शर्व एव च।।5.13.66।। सिद्धिं सर्वाणि भूतानि भूतानां चैव यः प्रभुः। दास्यन्ति मम ये चान्ये ह्यदृष्टाः पथि गोचराः।।5.13.67।।
output: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis  Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
सिद्धिं मे संविधास्यन्ति देवाः सर्षिगणास्त्विह।।5.13.64।। ब्रह्मा स्वयंभूर्भगवान् देवाश्चैव दिशन्तु मे। सिद्धिमग्निश्च वायुश्च पुरुहूतश्च वज्रभृत्।।5.13.65।। वरुणः पाशहस्तश्च सोमादित्यौ तथैव च। अश्विनौ च महात्मानौ मरुतः शर्व एव च।।5.13.66।। सिद्धिं सर्वाणि भूतानि भूतानां चैव यः प्रभुः। दास्यन्ति मम ये चान्ये ह्यदृष्टाः पथि गोचराः।।5.13.67।।
output: May all sages, gods, the selfborn Brahma, Windgod, Indra, the wielder of thunderbolt whose name is invoked in sacrifices, Yama, who carries a rope, Varuna give success and Lord Siva help me. May the Sun, Moon, Aswinis  Marutas assist me. May the gods of the quarters and the lord of all beings help me to succeed. May those whom I could not see also bring success to me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 13:
तदुन्नसं पाण्डुरदन्तमव्रणं शुचिस्मितं पद्मपलाशलोचनम्। द्रक्ष्ये तदार्यावदनं कदान्वहं प्रसन्नताराधिपतुल्यदर्शनम्।।5.13.68।।
output: 'Oh when and how would I behold that beautiful noble lady of stainless character, with a Moonlike face, prominent nose, white teeth, pleasant smile and with eyes like lotus petals?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षुद्रेण पापेन नृशंसकर्मणा सुदारुणालङ्कृतवेषधारिणा। बलाभिभूता ह्यबला तपस्विनी कथं नु मे दृष्टिपथेऽद्य सा भवेत्।।5.13.69।।
output: "How will I set my eyes on that gentle, frail and suffering thing now, who has been abducted by that mean, cruel sinner of dreadful look?" इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स मुहूर्तमिव ध्यात्वा मनसा चाधिगम्य ताम्। अवप्लुतो महातेजाः प्राकारं तस्य वेश्मनः।।5.14.1।।
output: Hanuman ascends the simsupa tree in the Ashoka grove and watches.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तु संहृष्टसर्वाङ्गः प्राकारस्थो महाकपिः। पुष्पिताग्रान्वसन्तादौ ददर्श विविधान् द्रुमान्।।5.14.2।। सालानशोकान् भव्यांश्च चंपकांश्च सुपुष्पितान्। उद्दालकान्नागवृक्षांश्चूतान्कपिमुखानपि।।5.14.3।।
output: प्राकारस्थः from the boundary, सः महाकपिः great vanara, संह्रष्टसर्वाङ्गः contracting his body, वसन्तादौ begining of  spring, पुष्पिताग्रान् blossoms on top, विविधान् several kinds, द्रुमान् trees, ददर्श saw, सालान् Salas, भव्यान् Bhavyas, अशोकान् Ashokas, सुपुष्पितान् blossomed, चम्पकांश्च Champakas, उद्दालकान् Uddalakas, नागवृक्षान् Naga trees, चूतान् Mangoes, कपिमुखानपि as the snout of the monkeys

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
स तु संहृष्टसर्वाङ्गः प्राकारस्थो महाकपिः। पुष्पिताग्रान्वसन्तादौ ददर्श विविधान् द्रुमान्।।5.14.2।। सालानशोकान् भव्यांश्च चंपकांश्च सुपुष्पितान्। उद्दालकान्नागवृक्षांश्चूतान्कपिमुखानपि।।5.14.3।।
output: Standing on the boundary wall, the great vanara contracted his body and observed the blossoms on several tree tops---- Salas, lovely Ashoka trees and blossoms of champak, uddalaka, naga, mangoes with their fruits crimson as the snout of a monkey, it being the beginning of Spring.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथाम्रवणसञ्छन्नां लताशतसमावृताम्। ज्यामुक्त इव नाराचः पुप्लुवे वृक्षवाटिकाम्।।5.14.4।।
output: He penetrated like an arrow released from a bow the cluster of trees covering mango grove and overgrown with hundreds of creepers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
स प्रविश्य विचित्रां तां विहगैरभिनादिताम्। राजतैः कांचनैश्चैव पादपैः सर्वतो वृताम्।।5.14.5।। विहगैर्मृगसङ्घैश्च विचित्रां चित्रकाननाम्। उदितादित्यसङ्काशां ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः।।5.14.6।। वृतां नानाविधैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पोपगफलोपगैः। कोकिलैर्भृङ्गराजैश्च मत्तैर्नित्यनिषेविताम्।।5.14.7।। प्रहृष्टमनुजे काले मृगपक्षिसमाकुले। मत्तबर्हिणसङ्घुष्टां नानाद्विजगणायुताम्।।5.14.8।।
output: Entering deep into the grove, Hanuman saw clusters of trees pleasing to look at, herds of animals and flocks of colourful birds singing melodious notes.The grove was surrounded on all sides by silvery and golden trees which looked colourful with flocks of birds and herds of deer. It was full of lovely thickets looking like the rising sun. It was fringed with various trees bearing abundance of fruits and flowers. It was inhabited by intoxicated cuckoos, bees,  proud peacocks and numerous lovely birds.

instruction:

output: Entering deep into the grove, Hanuman saw clusters of trees pleasing to look at, herds of animals and flocks of colourful birds singing melodious notes.The grove was surrounded on all sides by silvery and golden trees which looked colourful with flocks of birds and herds of deer. It was full of lovely thickets looking like the rising sun. It was fringed with various trees bearing abundance of fruits and flowers. It was inhabited by intoxicated cuckoos, bees,  proud peacocks and numerous lovely birds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
स प्रविश्य विचित्रां तां विहगैरभिनादिताम्। राजतैः कांचनैश्चैव पादपैः सर्वतो वृताम्।।5.14.5।। विहगैर्मृगसङ्घैश्च विचित्रां चित्रकाननाम्। उदितादित्यसङ्काशां ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः।।5.14.6।। वृतां नानाविधैर्वृक्षैः पुष्पोपगफलोपगैः। कोकिलैर्भृङ्गराजैश्च मत्तैर्नित्यनिषेविताम्।।5.14.7।। प्रहृष्टमनुजे काले मृगपक्षिसमाकुले। मत्तबर्हिणसङ्घुष्टां नानाद्विजगणायुताम्।।5.14.8।।
output: Entering deep into the grove, Hanuman saw clusters of trees pleasing to look at, herds of animals and flocks of colourful birds singing melodious notes.The grove was surrounded on all sides by silvery and golden trees which looked colourful with flocks of birds and herds of deer. It was full of lovely thickets looking like the rising sun. It was fringed with various trees bearing abundance of fruits and flowers. It was inhabited by intoxicated cuckoos, bees,  proud peacocks and numerous lovely birds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मार्गमाणो वरारोहां राजपुत्रीमनिन्दिताम्। सुखप्रसुप्तान्विहगान् बोधयामास वानरः।।5.14.9।।
output: वानरः vanara, वरारोहाम् born of a noble family, अनिन्दिताम् blameless, राजपुत्रीम् princess, मार्गमाणः searching, सुखप्रसुप्तान् happily sleeping, विहगान् birds, बोधयामास awakened.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उत्पतद्भिर्द्विजगणैः पक्षैः सालास्समाहताः। अनेकवर्णा विविधा मुमुचुः पुष्पवृष्टयः।।5.14.10।।
output: उत्पतद्भिः by the flying ones, द्विजगणैः by flocks of birds, पक्षैः with wings, समाहताः hit, सालाः sala, अनेकवर्णाः of different colours, विविधाः many, पुष्पवृष्टयः showers of flowers, मुमुचुः let loose.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुष्पावकीर्णश्शुशुभे हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः। अशोकवनिकामध्ये यथा पुष्पमयो गिरिः।।5.14.11।।
output: पुष्पावकीर्णः covered with flowers, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, अशोकवनिकामध्ये in the middle of the Ashoka grove, पुष्पमयः full of flowers, गिरिः यथा like a mountain, शुशुभे shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
﻿दिशस्सर्वाः प्रधावन्तं वृक्षषण्डगतं कपिम्। दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि वसन्त इति मेनिरे।।5.14.12।।
output: ﻿ Beholding that sprightly monkey running in all directions, its body covered with variegated blossoms fallen from the trees, all living beings there thought that it was Spring personified

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
﻿वृक्षेभ्यः पतितैः पुष्पैरवकीर्णा पृथग्विदैः। रराज वृक्षेभ्यः तत्र प्रमदेव विभूषिता।।5.14.13।।
output: ﻿ Strewn with flowers of various colours fallen from the trees of various kinds, the goddess of earth looked charming like a young woman profusely bedecked.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तरस्विना ते तरवस्तरसाभिप्रकम्पिताः। कुसुमानि विचित्राणि ससृजुः कपिना तदा।।5.14.14।।
output: ﻿ तदा then, तरस्विना endowed with speed, कपिना by the monkey, तरसा speedily, अभिप्रकम्पिताः vigorously shaken, ते those, तरवः trees, विचित्राणि colourful, कुसुमानि flowers, ससृजुः showered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निर्धूतपत्रशिखराः शीर्णपुष्पफला द्रुमाः। निक्षिप्तवस्त्राभरणा धूर्ता इव पराजिताः।।5.14.15।।
output: The tree tops, shorn of their leaves and flowers and fruits fallen, appeared like gamblers who had lost their stakes and had to lay down their clothes and ornaments.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हनूमता वेगवता कम्पितास्ते नगोत्तमाः। पुष्पपर्णफलान्याशु मुमुचुः पुष्पशालिनः।।5.14.16।।
output: Shaken by the swift Hanuman, even the big trees dropped flowers, fruits and leaves.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विहङ्गसङ्घैर्हीनास्ते स्कन्धमात्राश्रया द्रुमाः। बभूवुरगमाः सर्वे मारुतेव निर्धुताः।5.14.17।।
output: सर्वे all, ते द्रुमाः those trees, मारुतेन by Hanuman, विनिर्धुताः laid bare, अगमाः इव trees unable to move, विहङ्गसङ्घै: by flocks of birds, हीनाः deserted, स्कन्धमात्राश्रयाः only resting on the trunks, बभूवुः became.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
निर्धूतकेशी युवतिर्यथा मृदितवर्णका। निष्पीतशुभदन्तोष्ठी नखैर्दन्तैश्च विक्षता।।5.14.18।। तथा लाङ्गूलहस्तैश्च चरणाभ्यां च मर्दिता। बभूवाशोकवनिका प्रभग्नवरपादपा।।5.14.19।।
output: The garden of Ashoka with trees shattered and crushed by Hanuman's tail,  hands and feet, appeared like a woman with dishevelled hair, with her vermilion mark effaced, her bright teeth and lips faded for being kissed and wounded with nails and bitten with teeth (by her lover).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
महालतानां दामानि व्यथमत्तरसा कपिः। यथा प्रावृषि विन्ध्यस्य मेघजालानि मारुतः।।5.14.20।।
output: Hanuman shook with tremendous speed the huge clusters of creepers hanging there just like stormy wind in rainy season scatters masses of clouds on the Vindhya mountain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
स तत्र मणिभूमीश्च राजतीश्च मनोरमाः। तथा काञ्चनभूमीश्च ददर्श विचरन्कपिः।।5.14.21।।
output: Roaming there the monkey noticed the beautiful floors paved with gems, gold and silver৷৷

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
﻿वापीश्च विविधाकाराः पूर्णाः परमवारिणा। महार्हैर्मणिसोपानैरुपपन्नास्ततस्ततः।।5.14.22।। मुक्ताप्रवालसिकताः स्फाटिकान्तरकुट्टिमाः। काञ्चनैस्तरुभिश्चित्रैस्तीरजैरुपशोभिताः।।5.14.23।। फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवनाश्चक्रवाकोपकूजिताः। नत्यूहरुतसंघुष्टा हंससारसनादिताः।।5.14.24।। दीर्घाभिर्द्रुमयुक्ताभिः सरद्भिश्च समन्ततः। अमृतोपमतोयाभिश्शिवाभिरुपसंस्कृताः।।5.14.25।। लताशतैरवततास्सन्तानकुसुमावृताः। नानागुल्मावृतघनाः करवीरकृतान्तराः।।5.14.26।।
output: ﻿ He observed ponds of different shapes filled with clear water with steps paved with rich gems, with sands of pearls and corals and bottoms of crystal, which contained beds of lotuses in bloom, adorned with chakravaka birds and resonant with cacklings of swans and sarasas and vatyuhas rubbing their beaks. There were golden platforms built on banks and platforms built of crystals. There were trees on the bank of streams, and nectarlike sacred waters flowing in them surrounded by hundreds of creepers, and Ashoka blossoms scattered everywhere, with thickly grown bushes of different kinds, with lilies in bloom in tanks.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
ततोऽम्बुधरसङ्काशं प्रवृद्धशिखरं गिरिम्। विचित्रकूटं कूटैश्च सर्वतः परिवारितम्।।5.14.27।। शिलागृहैरवततं नानावृक्षैः समावृतम्। ददर्श हरिशार्दूलो रम्यं जगति पर्वतम्।।5.14.28।।
output: The tiger among monkeys beheld a delightingful mountain, resembling the raincloud with tall, pleasing peaks, wonderful peaks spread all over the mountain. There were caves built of stone, with a variety of trees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ददर्श च नगात्तस्मान्नदीं निपतितां कपिः। अङ्कादिव समुत्पत्य प्रियस्य पतितां प्रियाम्।।5.14.29।। जले निपतिताग्रैश्च पादपैरुपशोभिताम्। वार्यमाणामिव क्रुद्धां प्रमदां प्रियबन्धुभिः।।5.14.30।। पुनरावृत्ततोयां च ददर्श स महाकपिः। प्रसन्नामिव कान्तस्य कान्तां पुनरुपस्थिताम्।।5.14.31।।
output: कपिः monkey, तस्मात् from that, नगात् hill, निपतिताम् descending down, नदीं a stream, प्रियस्य beloved's, अङ्कात् from the thighs, समुत्पत्य jumping up, पतिताम् falling down, प्रियाम् इव like a beloved, जले in water, निपतिताग्रैः with the branches bent into water, पादपैः with trees, उपशोभिताम् splendid, प्रियबन्धुभिः by dear relatives, वार्यमाणाम् prevented, क्रुद्धाम् angry one, प्रमदाम् इव like a woman, नदीम् river, ददर्श saw, आवृत्ततोयाम् with water running backwards creating circles, कान्तस्य at the lover, प्रसन्नाम् pleased, पुनः again, उपस्थिताम् approached, कान्तामिव like a woman, सः Hanuman, महाकपिः great monkey, पुनः again, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 14:
ददर्श च नगात्तस्मान्नदीं निपतितां कपिः। अङ्कादिव समुत्पत्य प्रियस्य पतितां प्रियाम्।।5.14.29।। जले निपतिताग्रैश्च पादपैरुपशोभिताम्। वार्यमाणामिव क्रुद्धां प्रमदां प्रियबन्धुभिः।।5.14.30।। पुनरावृत्ततोयां च ददर्श स महाकपिः। प्रसन्नामिव कान्तस्य कान्तां पुनरुपस्थिताम्।।5.14.31।।
output: Hanuman, the great monkey saw a stream descending from the hill which looked like a beloved jumping down from the thighs of her lover. It was adorned with trees whose boughs touched the water and thus looking like an angry woman leaving her dear lover but detained by her relatives. With the water running backward in circles it appeared as if the beloved has returned to her lover pleased.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्या दूरात्सपद्मिन्यो नानाद्विजगणायुताः। ददर्श हरिशार्दूलो हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः।।5.14.32।।
output: Not far from there, Hanuman, son of the Windgod sighted lotus ponds filled with different kinds of water birds.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृत्रिमां दीर्घिकां चापि पूर्णां शीतेन वारिणा। मणिप्रवरसोपानां मुक्तासिकतशोभिताम्।।5.14.33।। विविधैर्मृगसङ्घैश्च विचित्रां चित्रकाननाम्। प्रासादैस्सुमहद्भिश्च निर्मितैर्विश्वकर्मणा।।5.14.34।। काननैः कृत्रिमैश्चापि सर्वतः समलङ्कृताम्।
output: Hanuman saw an oblong pond, full of cool water provided with steps, embellished with gems and beautified with pearl dust as sand on its bank.  Thronged with many kinds of animals, it looked colourful with large mansions constructed by Visvakarma in the artificial woodlands decorated all over.
