instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्याधस्ताच्च तां देवीं राजपुत्रीमनिन्दिताम्।।5.17.18।। लक्षयामास लक्ष्मीवान् हनुमान् जनकात्मजाम्।
output: लक्ष्मीवान् illustrious, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य of that, अधस्तात् under that (tree), राजपुत्रीम् princess, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, अनिन्दिताम् blameless, तां देवीम् that queen, लक्षयामास watched her.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निष्प्रभां शोकसन्तप्तां मलसङ्कुलमूर्धजाम्।।5.17.19।। क्षीणपुण्यां च्युतां भूमौ तारां निपतितामिव।
output: निष्प्रभाम् lady shorn of lustre, शोकसन्तप्तान् tromented with grief, मलसङ्कुलमूर्धजाम् with dishevelled filled with dust, क्षीणपुण्याम् merits exhausted, च्युताम् slipped, भूमौ on the land, निपतिताम् fallen, तारामिव like meteor.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चारित्रव्यपदेशाढ्यां भर्तृदर्शनदुर्गताम्।।5.17.20।। भूषणैरुत्तमैर्हीनां भर्तृवात्सल्यभूषणाम्।
output: She was rich by  her reputation for chastity but poor as she yearned to see her husband. Though devoid of all excellent ornaments, she looked adorned with love for her husband.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 17:
राक्षसाधिपसंरुद्धां बन्धुभिश्च विना कृताम्।।5.17.21।। वियूथां सिंहसंरुद्धां बद्धां गजवधूमिव।
output: Besieged by the demon king, deprived of her near and dear ones, Sita was looking like a fettered female elephant separated from its herd and besieged by lions.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चन्द्ररेखां पयोदान्ते शारदाभ्रैरिवावृताम्।।5.17.22।। क्लिष्टरूपामसंस्पर्शादयुक्तामिव वल्लकीम्।
output: पयोदान्ते at the close of the rainy season, शारदाभ्रैः by the autumnal clouds, आवृताम् covered, चन्द्ररेखामिव like the crescent Moon, असंस्पर्शात् being untouched, क्लिष्टरूपाम् a lady in faint form, अयुक्ताम् not used, वल्लकीमिव like the lute.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सीतां भर्तृवशे युक्तामयुक्तां राक्षसीवशे।।5.17.23।। अशोकवनिकामथ्ये शोकसागरमाप्लुताम्। ताभिः परिवृतां तत्र सग्रहामिव रोहिणीम्।।5.17.24।। ददर्श हनुमान् देवीं लतामकुसुमामिव।
output: She deserves to be with Rama, but had fallen under the sway of shedemons. Sitting in the midst of Ashoka grove she was like a creeper without blossoms. Immersed in the ocean of sorrow the noble lady was like the star Rohini surrounded by unpropitious planets.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 17:
सीतां भर्तृवशे युक्तामयुक्तां राक्षसीवशे।।5.17.23।। अशोकवनिकामथ्ये शोकसागरमाप्लुताम्। ताभिः परिवृतां तत्र सग्रहामिव रोहिणीम्।।5.17.24।। ददर्श हनुमान् देवीं लतामकुसुमामिव।
output: She deserves to be with Rama, but had fallen under the sway of shedemons. Sitting in the midst of Ashoka grove she was like a creeper without blossoms. Immersed in the ocean of sorrow the noble lady was like the star Rohini surrounded by unpropitious planets.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सा मलेन च दिग्धाङ्गी वपुषा चाप्यलङ्कृता।।5.17.25।। मृणाली पङ्कदिग्धेव विभाति न विभाति च।
output: मलेन with dirt, दिग्धाङ्गी a lady with daubed limbs, वपुषा चापि her self, अलङ्कृता decorated with ornaments, सा she, पङ्कदिग्धा lotus smeared with mud, मृणालीव a lotus fibre, विभाति shines, न विभाति च had no brightness also.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 17:
मलिनेन तु वस्त्रेण परिक्लिष्टेन भामिनीम्।।5.17.26।। संवृतां मृगशाबाक्षीं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः। तां देवीं दीनवदनामदीनां भर्तृतेजसा।।5.17.27।। रक्षितां स्वेन शीलेन सीतामसितलोचनाम्।
output: Hanuman saw the fawneyed lady clad in crushed and soiled clothes with a pathetic face. She felt no dejection when she thought of her husband's prowess. The blackeyed beauty was protected by her own chastity.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मलिनेन तु वस्त्रेण परिक्लिष्टेन भामिनीम्।।5.17.26।। संवृतां मृगशाबाक्षीं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः। तां देवीं दीनवदनामदीनां भर्तृतेजसा।।5.17.27।। रक्षितां स्वेन शीलेन सीतामसितलोचनाम्।
output: Hanuman saw the fawneyed lady clad in crushed and soiled clothes with a pathetic face. She felt no dejection when she thought of her husband's prowess. The blackeyed beauty was protected by her own chastity.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 17:
तां दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् सीतां मृगशाबनिभेक्षणाम्। मृगकन्यामिव त्रस्तां वीक्षमाणां समन्ततः।।5.17.28।। दहन्तीमिव निःश्वासैर्वृक्षान् पल्लवधारिणः। संघातमिव शोकानां दुःखस्योर्मिमिवोत्थिताम्।।5.17.29।।
output: Seeing the fawneyed Sita, a frightened female deer  looking all around (as if for some help) sighing hot breath, was as though burning the trees having tender leaves with her hot sighs. She looked like a collective mass of all sorrows, a high tide of suffering.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् सीतां मृगशाबनिभेक्षणाम्। मृगकन्यामिव त्रस्तां वीक्षमाणां समन्ततः।।5.17.28।। दहन्तीमिव निःश्वासैर्वृक्षान् पल्लवधारिणः। संघातमिव शोकानां दुःखस्योर्मिमिवोत्थिताम्।।5.17.29।।
output: हनुमान् Hanuman, मृगशाबनिभेक्षणाम् fawneyed one (doeeyed), त्रस्ताम् frightened lady, मृगकन्यामिव like a female deer, समन्ततः in all directions, वीक्षमाणाम् was looking, पल्लवधारिणः with sprouts, वृक्षान् trees, निःश्वासैः sighing,दहन्तीमिव as if burning, शोकानाम् of sorrows, सङ्घातमिव like a mass, उत्थिताम् arisen, दुःखस्य sorrow's, ऊर्मिमिव like a wave, उत्थितां rise, तां सीताम् that Sita, दृष्ट्वा seeing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 17:
तां क्षमां सुविभक्ताङ्गी विनाभरणशोभिनीम्।।5.17.30।। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे मारुतिः प्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम्।
output: She was a tolerant lady. She had beautiful limbs which looked splendid even though she was not wearing ornaments. Hanuman experienced immeasurable joy on seeing Mythili.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 17:
हर्षजानि च सोऽश्रूणि तां दृष्ट्वा मदिरेक्षणाम्। मुमुचे हनुमांस्तत्र नमश्चक्रे च राघवम्।।5.17.31।।
output: Seeing that lady with eyes intoxicating, Hanuman shed tears of joy. At once he paid obeisance to Rama. (thinking he could trace Sita at last).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नमस्कृत्वा च रामाय लक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान्। सीतादर्शनसंहृष्टो हनुमान् संवृतोऽभवत्।।5.17.32।।
output: Heroic Hanuman felt happy when he saw Sita. He offered salutations to Rama and Lakshmana at heart and covered himself (with the leaves of the Simsupa tree) and waited. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तदशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथा विप्रेक्ष्यमाणस्य वनं पुष्पितपादपम्। विचिन्वतश्च वैदेहीं किंचिच्छेषा निशाऽभवत्।।5.18.1।।
output: पुष्पितपादपम् flowering trees, वनम् grove, तथा likewise, विप्रेक्ष्यमाणस्य of the observer, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, विचिन्वतश्च while searching, निशा night, किञ्चिच्छेषा a small part, अभवत् was left.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
षडङ्गवेदविदुषां क्रतुप्रवरयाजिनाम्। शुश्राव ब्रह्मघोषांश्च स विरात्रे ब्रह्मरक्षसाम्।।5.18.2।।
output: At dawn sounds of recitation of Vedas and the six auxillary sciences, (i.e .grammar, prosody, etymology, phonetics, astronomy and the science of rituals) by the brahmins among demons wellversed in performing exalted sacrificial ceremonies were heard.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
अथ मङ्गलवादित्रशब्दैः श्रुतिमनोहरैः। प्राबुध्यत महाबाहुर्दशग्रीवो महाबलः।।5.18.3।।
output: By that time the strongarmed, powerful, tennecked Ravana was awakened by the delightful sounds of auspicious musical instruments.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विबुध्यतु यथाकालं राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्। स्रस्तमाल्याम्बरधरो वैदेहीमन्वचिन्तयत्।।5.18.4।।
output: प्रतापवान् chivalrous person, राक्षसेन्द्रः lord of demons, यथाकालम् at the usual time, विबुध्य after waking , स्रस्तमाल्याम्बरधरः with disarrayed garland and raiment, वैदेहीम्  of Vaidehi, अन्वचिन्तयत् thought.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भृशं नियुक्तस्तस्यां च मदनेन मदोत्कटः। न स तं राक्षसः कामं शशाकात्मनि गूहितुम्।।5.18.5।।
output: The demon king who was unable to hide his great passion and control his senses was drawn towards Sita, in his state of intoxication.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स सर्वाभरणैर्युक्तो बिभ्रच्छ्रियमनुत्तमाम्। तां नगैर्बहुभिर्जुष्टां सर्वपुष्पफलोपगैः।।5.18.6।।
output: Adorned with all ornaments and glowing with excellent splendour he went through the path filled with trees flourishing with all kinds of flowers and fruits.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वृतां पुष्करिणीभिश्च नानापुष्पोपशोभिताम्। सदा मदैश्च विहगैर्विचित्रां परमाद्भुताम्।।5.18.7।।
output: पुष्करिणीभिः with ponds, वृताम् covered, नानापुष्पोपशोभिताम् beautiful with different kinds of flowers, सदा मदैः always elated, विहगैः with birds, विचित्राम् colourful, परमाद्भुताम् very wonderful.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ईहामृगैश्च विविधैर्जुष्टां दृष्टिमनोहरैः। वीधीः संप्रेक्षमाणश्च मणिकाञ्चनतोरणाः।।5.18.8।। नानामृगगणाकीर्णां फलैः प्रपतितैर्वृताम्। अशोकवनिकामेव प्राविशत्संततद्रुमाम्।।5.18.9।।
output: मणिकाञ्चनतोरणाः gateways ornamented with gold and gems, वीथीः pathways, सम्प्रेक्षमाणश्च observing, दृष्टिमनोहरैः with those pleasant to see, विविधैः with several, ईहामृगैश्च with wolves, जुष्टाम् occupies (with pleasure), नानामृगगणाकीर्णाम् filled with several kinds of animals herds, प्रपतितैः dropped from the trees, फलैः with fruits, वृताम् surrounded, सन्ततद्रुमाम् filled with a long stretch trees, अशोकवनिकामेव into the Ashoka garden, प्राविशत् entered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
ईहामृगैश्च विविधैर्जुष्टां दृष्टिमनोहरैः। वीधीः संप्रेक्षमाणश्च मणिकाञ्चनतोरणाः।।5.18.8।। नानामृगगणाकीर्णां फलैः प्रपतितैर्वृताम्। अशोकवनिकामेव प्राविशत्संततद्रुमाम्।।5.18.9।।
output: Watching the garden filled with trees, gateways ornamented with gold and gems, he entered through the pleasant pathways in the Ashoka garden. There were wonderful wolves and several herds of animals in the garden. Fruits dropped from trees were strewn all over.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गनाशतमात्रं तु तं व्रजन्तमनुव्रजत्। महेन्द्रमिव पौलस्त्यं देवगन्धर्वयोषितः।।5.18.10।।
output: Ravana, son of sage Paulasti, was followed by a hundred women, just as Indra is trailed by the females of gods and gandharvas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
दीपिकाः काञ्चनीः काश्चिज्जगृहुस्तत्र योषितः। वालव्यजनहस्ताश्च तालवृन्तानि चापराः।।5.18.11।।
output: Some women carried golden lamps, some held yalk tail fans in their hands while others bore palmleaf fans.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
काञ्चनैरपि भृङ्गारैर्जह्रुः सलिलमग्रतः। मण्डलाग्रान् बृसीश्चापि गृह्यान्याः पृष्ठतो ययुः।।5.18.12।।
output: Some moved ahead of him carrying water in golden pitchers. Others followed him carrying circular couches (to be used as seats).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
काचिद्रत्नमयीं स्थालीं पूर्णां पानस्य भामिनी। दक्षिणा दक्षिणेनैव तदा जग्राह पाणिना।।5.18.13।।
output: One glorious and compassionate lady carried in her right hand a gemstudded jar filled with wine.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राजहंसप्रतीकाशं छत्रं पूर्णशशिप्रभम्। सौवर्णदण्डमपरा गृहीत्वा पृष्ठतो ययौ।।5.18.14।।
output: अपरा another lady, राजहंसप्रतीकाशम् resembling a royal swan, पूर्णशशिप्रभम् bright like fullmoon, सौवर्णदण्डम् having a golden handle, छत्रम् umbrella, गृहीत्वा taking, पृष्ठतः behind, ययौ went.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निद्रामदपरीताक्ष्यो रावणस्योत्तमाः स्त्रियः। अनुजग्मुः पतिं वीरं घनं विद्युल्लता इव।।5.18.15।।
output: निद्रामदपरीताक्ष्यः with eyes dizzy with sleep and intoxication, रावणस्य Ravana's, उत्तमाः prime, स्त्रियः wives, विद्युल्लताः like streaks of lightning, घनमिव like the the cloud, वीरम् heroic, पतिम् husband, अनुजग्मुः followed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
व्याविद्धहारकेयूराः समामृदितवर्णकाः। समागळितकेशान्तास्सस्वेदवदनास्तथा।।5.18.16।। घूर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः। स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुमास्सुमाल्याकुलमूर्धजाः।।5.18.17।। प्रयान्तं नैऋतपतिं नार्यो मदिरलोचनाः। बहुमानाच्च कामाच्च प्रिया भार्यास्तमन्वयुः।।5.18.18।।
output: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्याविद्धहारकेयूराः समामृदितवर्णकाः। समागळितकेशान्तास्सस्वेदवदनास्तथा।।5.18.16।। घूर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः। स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुमास्सुमाल्याकुलमूर्धजाः।।5.18.17।। प्रयान्तं नैऋतपतिं नार्यो मदिरलोचनाः। बहुमानाच्च कामाच्च प्रिया भार्यास्तमन्वयुः।।5.18.18।।
output: The necklaces and armlets (of the wives) disarrayed, the sandal paste and other unguents on the body smudged, hair hanging down their faces, the sweating damsels followed Ravana. They were dizzy with leftover intoxication and sleep and were swaying from side to side. Their dishevelled hair was loose and faces filled with sweat, their flower garlands on the body had wilted due to sweat on their limbs. The drunken wives of Ravana, actuated by their high regard and passion for him followed as he advanced with drunken eyes.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
व्याविद्धहारकेयूराः समामृदितवर्णकाः। समागळितकेशान्तास्सस्वेदवदनास्तथा।।5.18.16।। घूर्णन्त्यो मदशेषेण निद्रया च शुभाननाः। स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुमास्सुमाल्याकुलमूर्धजाः।।5.18.17।। प्रयान्तं नैऋतपतिं नार्यो मदिरलोचनाः। बहुमानाच्च कामाच्च प्रिया भार्यास्तमन्वयुः।।5.18.18।।
output: व्याविद्धहारकेयूराः with necklaces and armlets disarrayed, समामृदितवर्णकाः with smudged sandal paste and other unguents on the body, समागलितकेशान्ताः with loosened hair, तथा likewise, सस्वेदवदनाः with sweat on the faces, मदशेषेण dizzy with leftover intoxication, निद्रया च and also due to sleep, घूर्णन्त्यः moving to and fro, स्वेदक्लिष्टाङ्गकुसुमाः due to wilting of flowers by the sweat on their limbs,  सुमाल्याकुलमूर्धजाः adorned with beautiful flowers in their hair, मदिरलोचनाः drunkeneyed, प्रियाः dear, भार्याः wives, नार्यः ladies, बहुमानाच्च due to high regard, कामाच्च and due to passion, प्रयान्तम् as he advanced, तम् him, नैऋतपतिम् the lord of demons, अन्वयुः followed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
स च कामपराधीन: पतिस्तासां महाबलः। सीतासक्तमना मन्दो मन्दाञ्चितगतिर्बभौ।।5.18.19।।
output: Their husband, powerful Ravana under the control of passion looking dull, absorbed in the  thoughts of Sita walked slowly as though counting his steps.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः काञ्चीनिनादं च नूपुराणां च निस्वनम्। शुश्राव परमस्त्रीणां स कपिर्मारुतात्मजः।।5.18.20।।
output: Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, heard their jingling golden girdles and anklets.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं चाप्रतिमकर्माणमचिन्त्यबलपौरुषम्। द्वारदेशमनुप्राप्तं ददर्श हनुमान् कपिः।।5.18.21।।
output: Then Hanuman, the Vanara saw Ravana of extraordinary deeds, and of unimaginable strength and valour at the entrance (of Ashoka garden)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दीपिकाभिरनेकाभिः समन्तादवभासितम्। गन्धतैलावसिक्ताभिर्ध्रियमाणाभिरग्रतः।।5.18.22।।
output: Hanuman saw him in the glow of lamps wet with fragrant oil carried by many shedemons all over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
कामदर्पमदैर्युक्तं जिह्मताम्रायतेक्षणम्। समक्षमिव कन्दर्पमपविद्धशरासनम्।।5.18.23।।
output: Hanuman saw him, who was possessed of lust, arrogance and intoxication. He appeared like Cupid setting aside his quiver and arrows with his curved, big, red eyes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
मथितामृतफेनाभमरजोवस्त्रमुत्तमम्। सलीलमनुकर्षन्तं विमुक्तं सक्तमङ्गदे।।5.18.24।।
output: He was playfully pulling up his upper garment that slipped and stuck to his armlet. This excellent unsoiled robe was looking like the foam of churned nectar.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं पत्रविटपे लीनः पत्रपुष्पघनावृतः। समीपमिव संक्रान्तं निध्यातुमुपचक्रमे।।5.18.25।।
output: Hanuman seated on a leafy branch (of the simsupa tree) thickly covered with leaves and flowers started scanning the identity of Ravana who was drawing nearer.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवेक्षमाणस्तु ततो ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः। रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना रावणस्य वरस्त्रियः।।5.18.26।।
output: The leader of the monkeys started gazing at the chief wives of Ravana endowed with youth and beauty৷৷

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
ताभिः परिवृतो राजा सुरूपाभिर्महायशाः। तन्मृगद्विजसङ्घुष्टं प्रविष्टः प्रमदावनम्।।5.18.27।।
output: Surrounded by beauties, the glorious king entered the grove meant for women, reverberating with the sounds of beasts and birds.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षीबो विचित्राभरणः शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः। तेन विश्रवसः पुत्रः स दृष्टो राक्षसाधिपः।।5.18.28।। वृतः परमनारीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रमाः। तं ददर्श महातेजास्तेजोवन्तं महाकपिः।।5.18.29।।
output: The brilliant vanara looked at the son of Visravas (Ravana), the demon king  adorned with wonderful ornaments. He had long tapering ears. He was intoxicated with drink. Encircled by damsels, he was looking like the Moon surrounded by stars.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षीबो विचित्राभरणः शङ्कुकर्णो महाबलः। तेन विश्रवसः पुत्रः स दृष्टो राक्षसाधिपः।।5.18.28।। वृतः परमनारीभिस्ताराभिरिव चन्द्रमाः। तं ददर्श महातेजास्तेजोवन्तं महाकपिः।।5.18.29।।
output: The brilliant vanara looked at the son of Visravas (Ravana), the demon king  adorned with wonderful ornaments. He had long tapering ears. He was intoxicated with drink. Encircled by damsels, he was looking like the Moon surrounded by stars.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणोऽयं महाबाहुरिति सञ्चिन्त्य वानरः। अवप्लुतो महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.18.30।।
output: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, वानरः vanara, महातेजाः brilliant one, हनुमान् Hanuman, अयम् this, महाबाहुः strongarmed, रावणः Ravana, इति this, सञ्चिन्त्य having thought, अवप्लुतः got down.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 18:
स तथाप्युग्रतेजाः सन्निर्धूतस्तस्य तेजसा। पत्रगुह्यान्तरे सक्तो हनुमान् संवृतोऽभवत्।।5.18.31।।
output: Hanuman, possessed of extraordinary energy, was taken aback at the might of Ravana. He remained hiding covered over with leaves.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तामसितकेशान्तां सुश्रोणीं संहतस्त्नीम्। दिदृक्षुरसितापाङ्गामुपावर्तत रावणः।।5.18.32।।
output: With the desire to see Sita endowed with black hair, beautiful hips, plump breasts and dark sideglances, Ravana returned (to Ashokavana). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्मिन्नेव ततः काले राजपुत्री त्वनिन्दिता। रूपयौवनसम्पन्नं भूषणोत्तमभूषितम्।।5.19.1।। ततो दृष्ट्वैव वैदेही रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्। प्रावेपत वरारोहा प्रवाते कदली यथा।।5.19.2।।
output: Description of Sita who was overcome with grief.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मिन्नेव ततः काले राजपुत्री त्वनिन्दिता। रूपयौवनसम्पन्नं भूषणोत्तमभूषितम्।।5.19.1।। ततो दृष्ट्वैव वैदेही रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्। प्रावेपत वरारोहा प्रवाते कदली यथा।।5.19.2।।
output: ततः then, तस्मिन् काले एव at that time, राजपुत्री princess, अनिन्दिता blameless, वरारोहा of beautiful waist, वैदेही Vaidehi, रूपयौवनसम्पन्नम् endowed with beauty and youth, भूषणोत्तमभूषितम् adorned with best of ornaments, राक्षसाधिपम् lord of demons, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्ट्वैव  just by seeing him, प्रवाते  strong wind, कदली यथा like the banana plant, प्रावेपत was shaken.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आच्छाद्योदरमूरुभ्यां बाहुभ्यां च पयोधरौ। उपविष्टा विशालाक्षी रुदन्ती वरवर्णिनी।।5.19.3।।
output: विशालाक्षी largeeyed one, वरवर्णिनी a woman of fair complexion, ऊरुभ्याम् with thighs, उदरम् her belly, बाहुभ्याम् with both arms, पयोधरौ her breasts, आच्छाद्य after covering, रुदन्ती while crying, उपविष्टा was seated.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दशग्रीवस्तु वैदेहीं रक्षितां राक्षसीगणैः। ददर्श सीतां दुःखार्तां नावं सन्नामिवार्णवे।।5.19.4।।
output: The tennecked Ravana, too, on his part saw Sita, tormented with grief, guarded by the shedemons like a boat sunk in the sea.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
असंवृतायामासीनां धरण्यां संशितव्रताम्। छिन्नां प्रपतितां भूमौ शाखामिव वनस्पतेः।।5.19.5।।
output: असंवृताम् on a bare, धरण्याम् on the ground, आसीनाम् seated, संशितव्रताम् one who is woeful, छिन्नाम् broken, भूमौ on the ground, प्रपतिताम्  fallen, वनस्पतेः of a tree, शाखामिव like a branch.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मलमण्डनचित्राङ्गीं मण्डनार्हाममण्डिताम्। मृणाली पङ्कदिग्धेव विभाति न विभाति च।।5.19.6।।
output: Her body looked colourful with dust. Although she deserved adornment, she had none. She was like a lotus stem in mud looking bright yet dull (with mud).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समीपं राजसिंहस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः। सङ्कल्पहयसंयुक्सैर्यान्तीमिव मनोरथैः।।5.19.7।।
output: She was as though moving towards the knower of the self, the supreme king, Rama with the horses of her resolution yoked to the chariot of her mind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुष्यन्तीं रुदतीमेकां ध्यानशोकपरायणाम्। दुःखस्यान्तमपश्यन्तीं रामां राममनुव्रताम्।।5.19.8।।
output: She was emaciated, absorbed in thought of Rama alone and crying and unable to find the end to her grief.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वेष्टमानां तथाऽविष्टां पन्नगेन्द्रवधूमिव। धूप्यमानां ग्रहेणेव रोहिणीं धूमकेतुना।।5.19.9।।
output: Sitting in that manner she resembled a coiled serpent queen, the star Rohini overshadowed by a smoking comet (that is Ravana).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 19:
वृत्तशीलकुले जातामाचारवति धार्मिके। पुनःसंस्कारमापन्नां जातामिव च दुष्कुले।।5.19.10।।
output: Though born in a traditional righteous and virtuous family, she was as though passing through a purificatory process like a lowbred woman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभूतेनापवादेन कीर्तिं निपतितामिव। आम्नायानामयोगेन विद्यां प्रशिथिलामिव।।5.19.11।।
output: She resembled reputation besmirched by scandals, like Vedic studies  slackened by lack of aplication. (Knowledge is verified with a suitable statment of the Veda which is the ultimate test of ones finding. This method is adopted in all Astika sastras which accept the authority of the Veda).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 19:
सन्नामिव महाकीर्तिं श्रद्धामिव विमानिताम्। पूजामिव परिक्षीणामाशां प्रतिहतामिव।।5.19.12।।
output: She was like great fame grown dim, faith slighted, worship meddled and hope frustrated. (Note: Sita's condition is being compared with abstract concepts such as fame, faith, reverence and hope which are hit by reverses in fate. She was the personification of all such suffering.)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आयतीमिव विध्वस्तामाज्ञां प्रतिहतामिव। दीप्तामिव दिशं काले पूजामपहृतामिव।।5.19.13।।
output: विध्वस्ताम् blasted, आयतीमिव like the prospect, प्रतिहताम् flouted, आज्ञामिव like the command, काले at the time of catastrophe, दीप्ताम् glowing, दिशमिव like the direction, अपहृताम् abducted, पूजामिव like worship

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 19:
पद्मिनीमिव विध्वस्तां हतशूरां चमूमिव। प्रभामिव तमोध्वस्तामुपक्षीणामिवापगाम्।।5.19.14।।
output: She was like a lotuscreeper blighted, an army with its gallant warriors killed, radiance of light blocked by darkness and a stream run dry.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वेदीमिव परामृष्टां शान्तामग्निशिखामिव। पौर्णमासीमिव निशां राहुग्रस्तेन्दुमण्डलाम्।।5.19.15।।
output: (She was) like the altar of worship defiled, blazing fire extinguished, and the Moon eclipsed by Rahu in the full moon night.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 19:
उत्कृष्टपर्णकमलां वित्रासितविहङ्गमाम्। हस्तिहस्तपरामृष्टामाकुलां पद्मिनीमिव।।5.19.16।।
output: (She appeared) like a lotuspond the excellent leaves of whose lotuses surrounded by frightened birds are destroyed by the trunks of elephants.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 19:
पतिशोकातुरां शुष्कां नदीं विस्रावितामिव। परया मृजया हीनां कृष्णपक्षनिशामिव।।5.19.17।।
output: Stricken with grief caused by separation from her husband, she appeared like a river gone thin and dry, not fit for ablution, like a night during dark fortnight of the month deprived of all its glow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुकुमारीं सुजाताङ्गीं रत्नगर्भगृहोचिताम्। तप्यमानामिवोष्णेन मृणालीमचिरोद्धृताम्।।5.19.18।।
output: A delicate lady with beautiful limbs who deserved to be in a gemcrusted house was (now) like a lotus stem just plucked out and  scorched by the Sun's heat.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 19:
गृहीतामालितां स्तम्भे यूथपेन विनाकृताम्। निःश्वसन्तीं सुदुःखार्तां गजराजवधूमिव।।5.19.19।।
output: She was sighing heavily in intense grief like a royal female elephant tied to a pillar and separated from her lord, the leader of the herd.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 19:
एकया दीर्घया वेण्या शोभमानामयत्नतः। नीलया नीरदापाये वनराज्या महीमिव।।5.19.20।।
output: She was lovely even with a single braid of unkempt hair like the earth with a single row of dark trees covering its surface at the end of the rainy season.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपवासेन शोकेन ध्यानेन च भयेन च। परिक्षीणां कृशां दीनामल्पाहारां तपोधनाम्।।5.19.21।।
output: उपवासेन by fasting, शोकेन due to grief, ध्यानेन due to brooding, भयेन च and  threatenings, परिक्षीणां a wasted, कृशाम् emaciated, दीनाम depressed, अल्पाहाराम् ate little, तपोधनाम् rich by austerities.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आयाचमानां दुःखार्तां प्राञ्जलिं देवतामिव। भावेन रघुमुख्यस्य दशग्रीवपराभवम्।।5.19.22।।
output: देवतामिव like a goddess, दुःखार्ताम् tormented with grief, भावेन mentally, रघुमुख्यस्य to the foremost of the Raghu family, Rama, दशग्रीवपराभवम् insult by Ravana, प्राञ्जलिं with folded hands, आयाचमानाम् seemed as though supplicating.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समीक्षमाणां रुदतीमनिन्दितां सुपक्ष्मताम्रायतशुक्ललोचनाम्। अनुव्रतां राममतीव मैथिलीं प्रलोभयामास वधाय रावणः।।5.19.23।।
output: Blameless Mythili with clear, large eyes and beautiful eyelashes with a reddish tint at the corners was looking around, crying. Ravana tried to allure Sita who was deeply faithful to Rama and threatened to kill her (when he found her unflinching). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनविंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तां परिवृतां दीनां निरानन्दां तपस्विनीम्। साकारैर्मधुरैर्वाक्यैर्न्यदर्शयत रावणः।।5.20.1।।
output: सः रावणः that Ravana, परिवृताम् surrounded, दीनाम् depressed, निरानन्दाम् sorrowful, तपस्विनीम् ascetic, ताम् her, साकारैः with animated words, मधुरै with sweet, वाक्यैः words, न्यदर्शयत expressed

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
मां दृष्ट्वा नागनासोरु गूहमाना स्तनोदरम्। अदर्शनमिवात्मानं भयान्नेतुं त्वमिच्छसि।।5.20.2।।
output: "On seeing me, Sita, you want to conceal your thighs, belly and breasts through fear of me. I think you do not want me to see you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
कामये त्वां विशालाक्षि बहुमन्यस्व मां प्रिये। सर्वाङ्गगुणसम्पन्ने सर्वलोकमनोहरे।।5.20.3।।
output: "O largeeyed one  you are endowed with beauty in all limbs. You are the delight of all worlds. I desire you, dear  Oblige me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
नेह केचिन्मनुष्या वा राक्षसाः कामरूपिणः। व्यपसर्पतु ते सीते भयं मत्तः समुत्थितम्।।5.20.4।।
output: "O Sita no human or demon. who can take any form at their will can relieve your fear born of me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वधर्मो रक्षसां भीरु सर्वथैव न संशयः। गमनं वा परस्त्रीणां हरणं सम्प्रमथ्य वा।।5.20.5।।
output: "O timid lady having an unrighteous approach to wives of others or their abduction by force is natural to demons, There is no doubt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं चैतदकामां तु न त्वां स्प्रक्ष्यामि मैथिलि। कामं कामः शरीरे मे यथाकामं प्रवर्तताम्।।5.20.6।।
output: मैथिलि Mythili, एतत् this, एवम् in this manner, कामः passion, कामम् passion, यथाकामम् as it desires, मे  my, शरीरे  body, प्रवर्तताम् may sway, तु indeed, अकामाम् not force to accept my desire, त्वाम् to you, न स्प्रक्ष्यामि I will not touch.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देवि नेह भयं कार्यं मयि विश्वसि हि प्रिये। प्रणयस्व च तत्त्वेन मैवं भूः शोकलालसा।।5.20.7।।
output: "O reverend lady, fear not me on that account. Have confidence in me. Show your love. Do not be swayed by grief .

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एकवेणी धराशय्या ध्यानं मलिनमम्बरम्। अस्थानेऽप्युपवासश्च नैतान्यौपयिकानि ते।।5.20.8।।
output: एकवेणी O lady with a single braid of hair, धराशय्या sleeping on the ground, ध्यानम् brooding, मलिनम् soiled, अम्बरम् clothes, अस्थाने without an occasion, उपवासश्च by fasting, एतानि these, ते to you, औपयिकानि not fit for you, न not.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
विचित्राणि च माल्यानि चन्दनान्यगरूणि च। विविधानि च वासांसि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च।।5.20.9।। महार्हाणि च पानानि शयनान्यासनानि च। गीतं नृत्तं च वाद्यं च लभ मां प्राप्य मैथिलि।।5.20.10।।
output: "O Mythili having secured me, you get all these comforts wonderful garlands, sandal, incense, garments and beautiful ornaments, rich drinks, beds and seats.You can enjoy songs, dances accompanied by musical instruments.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विचित्राणि च माल्यानि चन्दनान्यगरूणि च। विविधानि च वासांसि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च।।5.20.9।। महार्हाणि च पानानि शयनान्यासनानि च। गीतं नृत्तं च वाद्यं च लभ मां प्राप्य मैथिलि।।5.20.10।।
output: मैथिलि Mythili, माम् me, प्राप्य having secured, विचित्राणि wonderful, माल्यानि garlands, चन्दनानि sandal, अगरूणि incense, विविधानि several kinds, वासांसि च garments, दिव्यानि divine one, आभरणानि च ornaments, महार्हाणि rich, पानानि drinks, शयनानि bed also, आसनानि च and seats, गीतम् singing, नृत्तं च and dancing, वाद्यं च and musical instruments, लभ you may take

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्त्रीरत्नमसि मैवं भूः कुरु गात्रेषु भूषणम्। मां प्राप्य हि कथं नु स्वास्त्वमनर्हा सुविग्रहे।।5.20.11।।
output: "You are a, a jewel among women. You should not  remain like this. You  should adorn yourself properly. How can you remain deprived after having me?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदं ते चारु सञ्जातं यौवनं व्यतिवर्तते। यदतीतं पुनर्नैति स्रोतः शीघ्रमपामिव।।5.20.12।।
output: चारु beautiful, सञ्जातम् created, इदम् this, ते यौवनम् your youth, व्यतिवर्तते will pass away, यत् since, शीघ्रम् fast, अतीतम् a past, अपाम् water, स्रोतः इव like flow, पुनः again, नैति does not come.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वां कृत्वोपरतो मन्ये रूपकर्ता स विश्वसृक्। न हि रूपोपमा त्वन्या तवास्ति शुभदर्शने।।5.20.13।।
output: शुभदर्शने lady of auspicious looks, रूपकर्ता creator, सः he, विश्वसृक् one who creates the world, त्वाम् you, कृत्वा having created, उपरतः he stopped, मन्ये I think, अन्या other lady, तव रूपोपमा comparable to your beauty, नास्ति हि indeed does not exist.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
त्वां समासाद्य वैदेहि रूपयौवनशालिनीम्। कः पुमानतिवर्तेत साक्षादपि पितामहः।।5.20.14।।
output: "O Vaidehi you have (extraordinary) beauty  and (exuberant) youth. Who would not lose his balance of mind even if he were Brahma the grandsire himself after getting you?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यद्यत्पश्यामि ते गात्रं शीतांशुसदृशानने। तस्मिंस्तस्मिन् पृथुश्रोणि चक्षुर्मम निबध्यते।।5.20.15।।
output: "O one with a face like the cool fullmoon, with heavy hips. I am unable to extricate my eyes from any limb (of your body) I see.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भव मैथिलि भार्या मे मोहमेनं विसर्जय। बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणामाहृतानामितस्ततः।।5.20.16।। सर्वासामेव भद्रं ते ममाग्रमहिषी भव।
output: मैथिलि O Mythili, मे my, भार्या wife, भव be, एनम् this, मोहम् delusion, विसर्जय give up, इतस्ततः from here and there, आहृतानाम् brought, बह्वीनाम् of many women, मम my, उत्तमस्त्रीणाम् among the best women, सर्वासामेव of all of them, अग्रमहिषी the chief consort, भव be, ते भद्रम् be blessed৷৷

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
लोकेभ्यो यानि रत्नानि सम्प्रमथ्याहृतानि वै।।5.20.17।। तानि मे भीरु सर्वाणि राज्यं चैतदहं च ते।
output: "O timid lady, gems brought forcibly from all the worlds, this kingdom as well as myself are yours.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विजित्य पृथिवीं सर्वां नानानगरमालिनीम्।।5.20.18।। जनकाय प्रदास्यामि तव हेतोर्विलासिनि।
output: "O lovely lady I will win all the cities and lands and give them to Janaka for your sake.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
नेह पश्यामि लोकेऽन्यं यो मे प्रतिबलो भवेत्। पश्य मे सुमहद्वीर्यमप्रतिद्वन्द्वमाहवे।।5.20.19।।
output: "I'm unrivalled in this entire world. Behold my matchless virility which permits no rival in war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
असकृत्संयुगे भग्ना मया विमृदितध्वजाः।।5.20.20।। अशक्ताः प्रत्यनीकेषु स्थातुं मम सुरासुराः।
output: मया by me, असकृत् again and again, संयुगे in battle, भग्नाः shattered, विमृदितध्वजाः their flags crushed, सुरासुराः gods and demons, मम my, प्रत्यनीकेषु in the wars against me, स्थातुम् to stand, अशक्ताः unable.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
इच्छ मां क्रियतामद्य प्रतिकर्म तवोत्तमम्।।5.20.21।। सप्रभाण्यवसज्यन्तां तवाङ्गे भूषणानि च। साधु पश्यामि ते रूपं संयुक्तं प्रतिकर्मणा।।5.20.22।।
output: "Offer your love to me. Get yourself decorated in an excellent way. Wear glowing ornaments on your limbs. Let me see you in pleasingly decorated form.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
इच्छ मां क्रियतामद्य प्रतिकर्म तवोत्तमम्।।5.20.21।। सप्रभाण्यवसज्यन्तां तवाङ्गे भूषणानि च। साधु पश्यामि ते रूपं संयुक्तं प्रतिकर्मणा।।5.20.22।।
output: "Offer your love to me. Get yourself decorated in an excellent way. Wear glowing ornaments on your limbs. Let me see you in pleasingly decorated form.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रतिकर्माभिसंयुक्ता दाक्षिण्येन वरानने। भुंक्ष्व भोगान्यथाकामं पिब भीरु रमस्व च।।5.20.23।।
output: "O charming lady decorate yourself liberally. Enjoy these pleasures as you please. Drink and make merry.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथेष्टं च प्रयच्छ त्वं पृथिवीं वा धनानि च। ललस्व मयि विस्रब्धा धृष्टमाज्ञापयस्व च।।5.20.24।।
output: त्वम् yourself, पृथिवीम् the land, धनानि च and wealth also, यथेच्छम् as you wish, प्रयच्छ donate, विस्रब्धा being free, मयि with me, ललस्व enjoy, धृष्टम् boldly, आज्ञापयस्व च and command.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मत्प्रसादाल्ललन्त्याश्च ललन्तां बान्धवास्तव। ऋद्धिं ममानुपश्य त्वं श्रियं भद्रे यशश्च मे।।5.20.25।।
output: "O blessed lady, see my affluence and my fame. Seeing you enjoy (life) by my grace all your kinsmen will follow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किं करिष्यसि रामेण सुभगे चीरवाससा। निक्षिप्तविजयो रामो गतश्रीर्वनगोचरः।।5.20.26।। व्रती स्थण्डिलशायी च शङ्के जीवति वा न वा।
output: "O beautiful lady Rama has renounced victory, he has lost his fortune. Clad in bark, he is wandering in the forest following asceticism and sleeping on the ground. What can he do  for you? I am in doubt if he is alive or not.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न हि वैदेहि रामस्त्वां द्रष्टुं वा प्युपलप्स्यते। पुरोबलाकैरसितैर्मेघैर्ज्योत्स्नामिवावृताम्।।5.20.27।।
output: "O Vaidehi I wonder if Rama can see you at all. You are like moonlight veiled by dark clouds and  cannot  be seen even by the flying cranes.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न चापि मम हस्तात्त्वां प्राप्तुमर्हति राघवः।।5.20.28।। हिरण्यकशिपुः कीर्तिमिन्द्रहस्तगतामिव।
output: "Surely Raghava will not be able to win you back from my hands any more than the demon Hiranyakasipu was able to usurp the fame of Indra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
चारुस्मिते चारुदति चारुनेत्रे विलासिनि।।5.20.29।। मनो हरसि मे भीरु सुपर्णः पन्नगं यथा।
output: "O lovely, timid lady your smile, your teeth and your eyes are bewitching. Just as Garuda snatches away a serpent, you ravish my mind by your beauty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्लिष्टकौशेयवसनां तन्वीमप्यनलङ्कृताम्।।5.20.30।। त्वां दृष्ट्वा स्वेषु दारेषु रतिं नोपलभाम्यहम्।
output: क्लिष्टकौशेयवसनाम् wearing soiled silk clothes, तन्वीम् beautiful, त्वाम् you, अनलङ्कृतामपि even when you are not decorated, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, अहम् I, स्वेषु at my own, दारेषु wives, रतिम् love, नोपलभामि I find not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्तःपुरनिवासिन्यः स्त्रियः सर्वगुणान्विताः।।5.20.31।। यावन्त्यो मम सर्वासामैश्वर्यम् कुरु जानकि।
output: जानकि Janaki, मम my, अन्तःपुरनिवासिन्यः residing in the harem of the royal palace, सर्वगुणान्विताः endowed with all virtues, यावन्त्यः many of them, स्त्रियः women, सर्वासाम् for all of them, ऐश्वर्यम् authority, कुरु you may exercise.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मम ह्यसितकेशान्ते त्रैलोक्यप्रवराः स्त्रियः।।5.20.32।। तास्त्वां परिचरिष्यन्ति श्रियमप्सरसो यथा।
output: असितकेशान्ते lady of dark tresses, मम me, ताः those, त्रैलोक्यप्रवराः best among the women in the three worlds, स्त्रियः women, अप्सरस: apsaras, श्रियं यथा like goddess Lakshmi, त्वाम् you, परिचरिष्यन्ति will attend on you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यानि वैश्रवणे सुभ्रु रत्नानि च धनानि च।।5.20.33।। तानि लोकांश्च सुश्रोणि मां च भुङ्क्ष्व यथासुखम्।
output: सुश्रोणि heavyhipped, सुभ्रु lady of beautiful brows, वैश्रवणे with Vaisravana, यानि all such, रत्नानि gems, धनानि च and wealth, तानि those, लोकांश्च worlds also, मां च me as well, यथासुखम् be happy, भुङ्क्ष्व you may enjoy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न रामस्तपसा देवि न बलेन न विक्रमैः।।5.20.34।। न धनेन मया तुल्यस्तेजसा यशसापि वा।
output: देवि queen, रामः Rama, तपसा by penance, मया to me, न तुल्यः not equal, बलेन by prowess, न विक्रमैः nor by valour, न not, धनेन in wealth, तेजसा in brilliance, यशसापि वा or even in fame, न not.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 20:
पिब विहर रमस्व भुङ्क्ष्व भोगान् धननिचयं प्रदिशामि मेदिनीं च। मयि लल ललने यथासुखं त्वं त्वयि च समेत्य ललन्तु बान्धवास्ते।।5.20.35।।
output: "O delightful one I will bestow you with heaps of riches and land. Therefore, enjoy with me drinking, sporting, and revelling. Accept me and be happy to sport with me.Let your elatives join you and enjoy all my wealth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कुसुमिततरुजालसन्ततानि भ्रमरयुतानि समुद्रतीरजानि। कनकविमलहारभूषिताङ्गी विहर मया सह भीरु काननानि।।5.20.36।।
output: "O timid lady embellish yourself with necklaces of pure gold and enjoy with me in the enchanting seaside forest groves full of trees with blossoms and swarming bees. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे विंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सीता रौद्रस्य रक्षसः। आर्ता दीनस्वरा दीनं प्रत्युवाच शनैर्वचः।।5.21.1।।
output: Sita spurns Ravana's submission.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दुःखार्ता रुदती सीता वेपमाना तपस्विनी। चिन्तयन्ती वरारोहा पतिमेव पतिव्रता।।5.21.2।। तृणमन्तरतः कृत्वा प्रत्युवाच शुचिस्मिता।
output: Sita, austere, beautiful and chaste afflicted by grief kept sobbing. Brooding over her husband and trembling in fear, she placed a blade of grass in between her and Ravana and replied with a gentle smile on her face.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निवर्तय मनो मत्तः स्वजने क्रियतां मनः।।5.21.3।। न मां प्रार्थयितुं युक्तं सुसिद्धिमिव पापकृत्।
output: "Turn your mind away from me and fix it on your wives. You should not expect to seek me just as a sinner cannot hope to seek blessedness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अकार्यं न मया कार्यमेकपत्न्या विगर्हितम्।।5.21.4।। कुलं सम्प्राप्तया पुण्यं कुले महति जातया।
output: महति high, कुले lineage, जातया born, पुण्यम् meritorious, कुलम् family, सम्प्राप्तया joined by virtue of marriage, एकपत्न्या a woman devoted to a single husband, मया by me, विगर्हितम् contemptible, अकार्यम् forbidden act, न कार्यम्  not to be done.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 21:
एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही रावणं तं यशस्विनी।।5.21.5।। राक्षसं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भूयो वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: Glorious Vaidehi having thus spoken to the demon turned her back and continued:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नाहमौपयिकी भार्या परभार्या सती तव।।5.21.6।। साधु धर्ममवेक्षस्व साधु साधुव्रतं चर।
output: "I cannot be your lawful wife obtainable by your personal efforts. I am a chaste woman married to another man. (Being a king) examine the dharma honestly and adopt a pious way of life.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 21:
यथा तव तथान्येषां दारा रक्ष्या निशाचर।।5.21.7।। आत्मानमुपमां कृत्वा स्वेषु दारेषु रम्यताम्।
output: "O nightranger Enjoy your wives. Take care of them. Taking your example, others' wives also deserve to be protected.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 21:
अतुष्टं स्वेषु दारेषु चपलं चलितेन्द्रियम्।।5.21.8।। नयन्ति निकृतिप्रज्ञं परदाराः पराभवम्।
output: "The wives of others will insult an evilminded man who is not satisfied with his own wives, is fickleminded and has no control over his senses.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इह सन्तो न वा सन्ति सतो वा नानुवर्तसे।।5.21.9।। तथाहि विपरीता ते बुद्धिराचारवर्जिता।
output: "Are there no pious men around or are you not heeding their words? Your mind is perverted and inclined to commit a forbidden act.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वचो मिथ्याप्रणीतात्मा पथ्यमुक्तं विचक्षणैः।।5.21.10।। राक्षसानामभावाय त्वं वा न प्रतिपद्यसे।
output: "You are indulging in unrighteous act and not listening to the advice of wise men who have a sense of discrimination. You are the cause of the destruction of demons.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अकृतात्मानमासाद्य राजानमनये रतम्।।5.21.11।। समृद्धानि विनश्यन्ति राष्ट्राणि नगराणि च।
output: "Even prosperous countries and cities are destroyed on account of indiscreet rulers engaged in unfair means.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथेयं त्वां समासाद्य लङ्का रत्नौघसङ्कुला।।5.21.12।। अपराधात्तवैकस्य नचिराद्विनशिष्यति।
output: तथा in that way, त्वाम् you, समासाद्य having got, रत्नौघसङ्कुला filled with gems, इयम् this, लङ्का Lanka, एकस्य a single person, तव your, अपराधात् for your crime, न चिरात् very soon, विनशिष्यति will be destroyed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वकृतैर्हन्यमानस्य रावणादीर्घदर्शिनः।।5.21.13।। अभिनन्दन्ति भूतानि विनाशे पापकर्मणः।
output: "O Ravana living beings will welcome and enjoy the destruction of a shortsighted sinner killed by his own vile act.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवं त्वां पापकर्माणं वक्ष्यन्ति निकृता जनाः।।5.21.14।। दिष्ट्यैतद्व्यसनं प्राप्तो रौद्र इत्येव हर्षिताः।
output: एवम् in that way, पापकर्माणम् sinner, त्वाम् you, निकृताः insulted, जनाः people, हर्षिताः will feel glad, रौद्रः angry one, दिष्ट्या luckily, एतत् thus, व्यसनम् doom, प्राप्तः met, इत्येव like this, वक्ष्यन्ति they will say.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 21:
शक्या लोभयितुं नाहमैश्वर्येण धनेन वा।।5.21.15।। अनन्या राघवेणाहं भास्करेण प्रभा यथा।
output: "I cannot be lured by your power or wealth. I am inseparable from Raghava like light from the Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उपधाय भुजं तस्य लोकनाथस्य सत्कृतम्।।5.21.16।। कथं नामोपधास्यामि भुजमन्यस्य कस्य चित्।
output: "How can I pillow on somebody's arm after resting on the honourable arm of the great lord of the worlds ?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहमौपयिकी भार्या तस्यैव वसुधापतेः।।5.21.17।। व्रतस्नातस्य विप्रस्य विद्येव विदितात्मनः।
output: "I am alone the lawful wife of the lord of the earth like the knowledge of the Vedas which rightfully belongs to a wise brahmin who has realised the self after having had his ceremonial bath (as a token of celibacy) and having observed strict vows during the period of his study.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
साधु रावण रामेण मां समानय दुःखिताम्।।5.21.18।। वने वाशितया सार्धं करेण्वेव गजाधिपम्।
output: रावण Ravana, दुःखिताम् grieving, माम् to me, गजाधिपम् with the king of elephants, वने in the forest, वाशितया by the separated, करेण्वेव female elephant, रामेण with Rama, सार्धम् along with, साधु it is proper, समानय you may unite me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 21:
मित्रमौपयिकं कर्तुं रामः स्थानं परीप्सता।।5.21.19।। वधं चानिच्छता घोरं त्वयासौ पुरुषर्षभः।
output: "I wish you to build friendship with Rama, the bull among men. Surely it is the right thing for you to do, if you are desirous of avoiding a dreadful death.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विदितः स हि धर्मज्ञः शरणागतवत्सलः।।5.21.20।। तेन मैत्री भवतु ते यदि जीवितुमिच्छसि।
output: धर्मज्ञः one who knows dharma, सः he, शरणागतवत्सलः kind to those who seek his protection, विदितः हि famous, जीवितुम् to preserve your life, इच्छसि यदि if you so desire, ते to you, तेन with him, मैत्री friendship, भवतु  be built.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रसादयस्व त्वं चैनं शरणागतवत्सलम्।।5.21.21।। मां चास्मै नियतो भूत्वा निर्यातयितुमर्हसि।
output: त्वम् you, शरणागतवत्सलम् one who is compassionate to those who seek refuge, एनम् him, प्रसादयस्व च propitiate, नियतः disciplined, भूत्वा after exercising, माम् me, अस्मै for your sake I, निर्यातयितुम् to return, अर्हसि it is proper for you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवं हि ते भवेत्स्वस्ति सम्प्रदाय रघूत्तमे।।5.21.22।। अन्यथा त्वं हि कुर्वाणो वधं प्राप्स्यसि रावण।
output: "It is good for you to give me back to Rama, the foremost in the Raghu dynasty. Otherwise you will face death.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वर्जयेद्वज्रमुत्सृष्टं वर्जयेदन्तकश्चिरम्।।5.21.23।। त्वद्विधं तु न सङ्कृद्धो लोकनाथः स राघवः।
output: "A thunderbolt may spare its target, Yama, lord of death may spare for a long time the life of a person doomed. But Rama, the lord of the world, will not spare any one when enraged.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्य धनुषः शब्दं श्रोष्यसि त्वं महास्वनम्।।5.21.24।। शतक्रतुविसृष्टस्य निर्घोषमशनेरिव।
output: "You will hear the terrible twang of Rama's bow resembling the rumble of the thunderbolt released by Indra who performed a hundred yajnas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इह शीघ्रं सुपर्वाणो ज्वलितास्या इवोरगा: ।।5.21.25।। इषवो निपतिष्यन्ति रामलक्ष्मणलक्षणाः।
output: "Arrows marked with Rama and Lakshmana will soon rain on Lanka like the poisonous snakes with flaming fangs.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रक्षांसि परिनिघ्नन्तः पुर्यामस्यां समन्ततः।।5.21.26।। असंपातं करिष्यन्ति पतन्तः कङ्कवाससः।
output: "The shafts bound with feathers of Kanka birds (released by Rama and Lakshmana) will be killing the demons all over this Lanka. They will not give a chance for any other weapon to fall.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसेन्द्रमहासर्पान् स रामगरुडो महान्।।5.21.27।। उद्धरिष्यति वेगेन वैनतेय इवोरगान्।
output: "Just as Garuda swiftly extirpates the serpents, Rama will exterminate the demon leaders.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 21:
अपनेष्यति मां भर्ता त्वत्तः शीघ्रमरिन्दमः।।5.21.28।। असुरेभ्यः श्रियं दीप्तां विष्णुस्त्रिभिरिव क्रमैः।
output: "My husband, the subduer of enemies, will soon take me away just as Lord Visnu in the form of Vamana took away the glowing prosperity from the demons with three strides.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जनस्थाने हतस्थाने निहते रक्षसां बले।।5.21.29।। अशक्तेन त्वया रक्षः कृतमेतदसाधु वै।
output: रक्षसाम् demons, बले in the army, निहते when it was killed, जनस्थाने in Janasthana, हतस्थाने spot of death,  रक्षः O demon, अशक्तेन having no capacity, त्वया  by you, एतत् this, असाधु dishonest, कृतं वै act is done.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आश्रमं तु तयोः शून्यं प्रविश्य नरसिंहयोः।।5.21.30।। गोचरं गतयोर्भ्रात्रोरपनीता त्वयाधम।
output: अधम mean creature, नरसिंहयोः two lions among men, तयोः those two, भ्रात्रोः brothers, गोचरम् not found, गतयोः when they went, शून्यम् desolate, आश्रमम् hut, प्रविश्य entered, त्वया you, अपनीता abducted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न हि गन्धमुपाघ्राय रामलक्ष्मणयोस्त्वया।।5.21.31।। शक्यं संदर्शने स्थातुं शुना शार्दूलयोरिव।
output: शुना by a dog, शार्दूलयोरिव like two tigers, रामलक्ष्मणयोः of both Rama and Lakshmana, गन्धम् smell, उपाघ्राय smelling, त्वया  by you, सन्दर्शने in their sight, स्थातुम् to stand there, न शक्यं हि it will not be possible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 21:
तस्य ते विग्रहे ताभ्यां युगग्रहणमस्थिरम्।।5.21.32।। वृत्रस्येवेन्द्रबाहुभ्यां बाहोरेकस्य विग्रहे।
output: "You will not be able to withstand them in a battle. You will meet the same fate as the onearmed Vritra in a battle with the twoarmed Indra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्षिप्रं तव स नाथो मे रामः सौमित्रिणा सह।।5.21.33।। तोयमल्पमिवादित्यः प्राणानादास्यते शरैः।
output: "My lord Rama accompanied by Saumitri will draw out your life by his arrows swiftly as Aditya sucks up shallow water at once by his radiance.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गिरिं कुबेरस्य गतोऽथ वालयं सभां गतो वा वरुणस्य राज्ञः। असंशयं दाशरथेर्न मोक्ष्यसे महाद्रुमः कालहतोऽशनेरिव।।5.21.34।।
output: कालहतः doomed by time, कुबेरस्य Kubera's, गिरिम् mountain, वा or else, आलयम् residence, गतः going, राज्ञः king, वरुणस्य Varuna's, सभाम् assembly, गतो वा or will go, महाद्रुमः mighty tree, अशनेरिव by lightning, दाशरथेः by Rama son of Dasaratha, न मोक्ष्यसे you do not escape.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा परुषं राक्षसाधिपः। प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां विप्रियं प्रियदर्शनाम्।।5.22.1।।
output: राक्षसाधिपः lord of demons, परुषम् sharp, सीतायाः of Sita, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, ततः then, प्रियदर्शनम् is pleasing to see, विप्रियम् unpleasant, सीताम् to Sita, प्रत्युवाच replied.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
यथा यथा सान्त्वयिता वश्यः स्त्रीणां तथा तथा। यथा यथा प्रियं वक्ता परिभूतस्तथा तथा।।5.22.2।।
output: "The more the lover is courteous and loving and pleasing to women the more he is humiliated by them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्नियच्छति मे क्रोधं त्वयि कामः समुत्थितः। द्रवतोऽमार्गमासाद्य हयानिव सुसारथिः।।5.22.3।।
output: "My love for you has restrained my anger, just as a good charioteer controls the horses galloping on a wrong path.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
वामः कामो मनुष्याणां यस्मिन् किल निबध्यते। जने तस्मिंस्त्वनुक्रोशः स्नेहश्च किल जायते।।5.22.4।।
output: "Love is partial. It gets bound to those in whomsoever compassion and friendship is generated, even though they are punishable.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतस्मात्कारणान्न त्वां घातयामि वरानने। वधार्हामवमानार्हां मिथ्याप्रव्रजिते रताम्।।5.22.5।।
output: वरानने O beautiful lady, एतस्मात् on this, कारणात् account, वधार्हाम् deserve to be killed, अवमानार्हाम् deserves to be put to shame, मिथ्याप्रव्रजिते in a pseudoascetic life, रताम् engaged, त्वाम् you, न घातयामि will not kill.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
परुषाणीह वाक्यानि यानि यानि ब्रवीषि माम्। तेषु तेषु वधो युक्तस्तव मैथिलि दारुणः।।5.22.6।।
output: "O Mythili for each of the piercing statements made you deserve dreadful death."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेहीं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। क्रोधसंरम्भसंयुक्तः सीतामुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.22.7।।
output: राक्षसाधिपः lord of demons, रावणः Ravana, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, क्रोधसंरम्भसंयुक्तः stirred up with anger and exitement, सीताम् to Sita, उत्तरम् in reply, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्वौ मासौ रक्षितव्यौ मे योऽवधिस्ते मया कृतः। ततः शयनमारोह मम त्वं वरवर्णिनि।।5.22.8।।
output: मया by me, ते to you, यः that, अवधिः deadline, कृत: fixed, द्वौ two, मासौ months, मे to me, रक्षितव्यौ keep, वरवर्णिनि of beautiful hue, ततः thereafter, मम my, शयनम् bed, आरोह come to share.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऊर्ध्वं द्वाभ्यां तु मासाभ्यां भर्तारं मामनिच्छतीम्। मम त्वां प्रातराशार्थमालभन्ते महानसे।।5.22.9।।
output: द्वाभ्याम् those two, मासाभ्याम् two months, ऊर्ध्वम् after that, माम् me, भर्तारम् as husband, अनिच्छतीम् reluctant, त्वाम् you, मम my, प्रातराशार्थम् for breakfast, महानसे to the kitchen, आलभन्ते cook you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां तर्ज्यमानां सम्प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसेन्द्रेण जानकीम्। देवगन्धर्वकन्यास्ता विषेदुर्विकृतेक्षणाः।।5.22.10।।
output: राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the demon king, तर्ज्यमानाम् threatened, तां जानकीम् that Janaki, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing, ताः those, देवगन्धर्वकन्याः daughters of gods and gandharvas, विकृतेक्षणाः distressed eyes, विषेदुः wept sadly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ओष्ठप्रकारैरपरा वक्त्रनेत्रैस्तथापराः। सीतामाश्वासयामासुस्तर्जितां तेन रक्षसा।।5.22.11।।
output: When Sita was threatened by the demon king, the daughters of gods and gandharvas there consoled her through gestures of their lips and eyes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
ताभिराश्वासिता सीता रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्। उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं वृत्तशौण्डीर्यगर्वितम्।।5.22.12।।
output: Having thus been consoled, Sita, proud of the power of her virtues, said this to Ravana in selfdefence:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
नूनं न ते जनः कश्चिदस्ति निःश्रेयसे स्थित:। निवारयति यो न त्वां कर्मणोऽस्माद्विगर्हितात्।।5.22.13।।
output: "Obviously there is no one among your people keen on your welfare since nobody is preventing you from this reproachable act.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
मां हि धर्मात्मनः पत्नीं शचीमिव शचीपतेः। त्वदन्यस्त्रिषु लोकेषु प्रार्थयेन्मनसापि कः।।5.22.14।।
output: "Who in all the three worlds other than you would, even in mind, seek this consort of the righteous self (Sri Rama) like  Sachi to Indra? .

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्याममिततेजसः। उक्तवानसि यत्पापं क्व गतस्तस्य मोक्ष्यसे।।5.22.15।।
output: "O stupid demon where can you go to escape the consequences of your sinful words spoken against Rama's consort of undimmed brilliance?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथा दृप्तश्च मातङ्गः शशश्च सद्दृशो युधि। तथा मातङ्गवद्रामस्त्वं नीच: शशवत् स्मृतः।।5.22.16।।
output: "It is like a proud elephant fighting in war with a rabbit. Rama is like an elephant and you are like an ordinary rabbit people speak of.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स त्वमिक्ष्वाकुनाथं वै क्षिपन्निह न लज्जसे। चक्षुषोर्विषयं तस्य न तावदुपगच्छसि।।5.22.17।।
output: सः such, त्वम् you, इह here, इक्ष्वाकुनाथम् king of the Ikshvakus, क्षिपन् looking down, न लज्जसे you are not ashamed, तस्य this, चक्षुषोर्विषयं within his sight, तावत् until then, न उपगच्छसि  not yet caught

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमे ते नयने क्रूरे विरूपे कृष्णपिङ्गले। क्षितौ न पतिते कस्मान्मामनार्य निरीक्षितः।।5.22.18।।
output: "O ignoble wretch I wonder why your dark brown, distorted eyes do not fall off (the socket) when you look at me (lustfully).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य धर्मात्मनः पत्नीं स्नुषां दशरथस्य च। कथं व्याहरतो मां ते न जिह्वा व्यवशीर्यते।।5.22.19।।
output: धर्मात्मनः righteous, तस्य his, पत्नीम् wife, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, स्नुषां च daughterinlaw also, माम् me, व्याहरतः while you speak, ते you, जिह्वा tongue, कथम् how is it, न व्यवशीर्यते not snap and fall down on the ground?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
असन्देशात्तु रामस्य तपसश्चानुपालनात्। न त्वां कुर्मि दशग्रीव भस्म भर्मार्ह तेजसा।।5.22.20।।
output: "O Ravana I can reduce you to ashes through the fire of my chastity. But I do not have Rama's permission and I want to preserve my power of ascetism even though you are fit to be consigned to the flames.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नापहर्तुमहं शक्या त्वया रामस्य धीमतः। विधिस्तव वधार्थाय विहितो नात्र संशयः।।5.22.21।।
output: धीमतः of a wise one, रामस्य Rama's, अहम् I am, त्वया by you, अपहर्तुम् to abduct, न शक्या it is not possible, तव your, वधार्थाय for your ruin, विधिः providence, विहितः ordained, अत्र here, संशयः doubt, न no.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
शूरेण धनदभ्रात्रा बलैः समुदितेन च। अपोह्य रामं कस्माद्धि दारचौर्यं त्वया कृतम्।।5.22.22।।
output: "You are a (great) warrior and a brother of Kubera. You possess an army. Then why did you abduct Rama's wife bypassing him?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। विवृत्य नयने क्रूरे जानकीमन्ववैक्षत।।5.22.23।।
output: On hearing Janaki, the lord of demons, Ravana looked at her with his cruel eyes opened wide and rolling.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नीलजीमूतसङ्काशो महाभुजशिरोधरः। सिंहसत्त्वगतिः श्रीमान् दीप्त जिह्वाग्रलोचनः।।5.22.24।।
output: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशः looked like a mass of dark cloud, महाभुजशिरोधरः who had strong arms and neck, सिंहसत्त्वगतिः gait like a lion, श्रीमान् prosperous, दीप्तजिह्वाग्रलोचनः with blazing eyes and tongue.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चलाग्रमकुटप्रांशुश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः। रक्तमाल्याम्बरधर तत्सङ्गदविभूषणः।।5.22.25।।
output: He appeared taller with an unsteady crown. He was wearing wonderful red flower garlands and clothes and was smeared with unguents, shining in ornamental armlets.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
श्रोणिसूत्रेण महता मेचकेन सुसंवृतः। अमृतोत्पादनद्धेन भुजगेनेव मन्दरः।।5.22.26।।
output: Wrapped well with a big black thread around his hips, he appeared like mount Mandara encompassed by a black serpent at the time of churning the milkocean for nectar.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताभ्यां स परिपूर्णाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां राक्षसेश्वरः। शुशुभेऽचलसङ्काशः शृङ्गाभ्यामिव मन्दरः।।5.22.27।।
output: अचलसङ्काशः looked like a mountain, राक्षसेश्वरः lord of demons, परिपूर्णाभ्याम् with full, ताभ्याम् both of them, भुजाभ्याम् with two arms, शृङ्गाभ्याम् with two peaks, मन्दरः इव like the Mandara, सः he, शुशुभे shone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तरुणादित्यवर्णाभ्यां कुण्डलाभ्यां विभूषितः। रक्तपल्लवपुष्पाभ्यामशोकाभ्यामिवाचलः।।5.22.28।।
output: He stood like a mountain with two Ashoka trees clothed with red leaves and flowers in the form of earrings of the colour of the rising Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स कल्पवृक्षप्रतिमो वसन्त इव मूर्तिमान्। श्मशानचैत्यप्रतिमो भूषितोऽपि भयङ्करः।।5.22.29।।
output: He was comparable to the wishfulfilling tree grown in heaven, a personified spring season and a memorial structure raised on the cremation ground. He looked frightening even though  welladorned.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवेक्षमाणो वैदेहीं कोपसंरक्तलोचनः। उवाच रावणः सीतां भुजङ्ग इव निःश्वसन्।।5.22.30।।
output: कोपसंरक्तलोचनः eyes red with anger, रावणः Ravana, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अवेक्षमाणः looking at, भुजङ्गः इव like a serpent, निःश्वसन् breathing heavily, सीताम् to Sita, उवाच said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनयेनाभिसम्पन्नमर्थहीनमनुव्रते। नाशयाम्यहमद्य त्वां सूर्यः सन्ध्यामिवौजसा।।5.22.31।।
output: अनयेन with a wrong policy, अभिसम्पन्नम् endowed, अर्थहीनम् meaningless, अनुव्रते a lady following a vow of chastity, अद्य now, अहम् I, त्वाम् you, सूर्यः Sun, ओजसा with his bright light, सन्ध्यामिव like the morning twilight, नाशयामि dispel.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं राजा रावणः शत्रुरावणः। सन्दिदेश ततः सर्वा राक्षसीर्घोरदर्शनाः।।5.22.32।।
output: राजा king, शत्रुरावणः who torments enemies with his terrific voice, रावणः Ravana, मैथिलीम् to Mythili, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, घोरदर्शनाः women of fierceful looks, सर्वाः all, राक्षसीः shedemons, सन्दिदेश commanded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एकाक्षीमेककर्णां च कर्णप्रावरणां तथा। गोकर्णीं हस्तिकर्णीं च लम्बकर्णीमकर्णिकाम्।।5.22.33।। हस्तिपाद्यश्वपाद्यौ च गोपादीं पादचूलिकाम्। एकाक्षीमेकपादीं च पृथुपादीमपादिकाम्।।5.22.34।। अतिमात्रशिरोग्रीवामतिमात्रकुचोदरीम्। अतिमात्रास्यनेत्रां च दीर्घजिह्वामजिह्विकाम्।।5.22.35।। अनासिकां सिंहमुखीं गोमुखीं सूकरीमुखीम्।
output: एकाक्षीम् oneeyed, एककर्णां च with one year, तथा similarly, कर्णप्रावरणाम् whose ear was covered, गोकर्णीम् who had cow's ears, हस्तिकर्णीं च  who had ears like those of an elephant, लम्बकर्णीम् one who had long ears, अकर्णिकाम् who had no ears, हस्तिपाद्यश्वपाद्यौ च one with the feet of an elephant and another with the hoofs of the horse, गोपादीम् with cow's hoof, पादचूलिकाम् one with hair on feet, एकाक्षीम् oneeyed one, एकपादीं च with one foot, पृथुपादीम् one with broad feet, अपादिकाम्  who had no feet, अतिमात्राशिरोग्रीवाम् with a huge neck and head, अतिमात्राकुचोदरीम् of large breasts and belly, अतिमात्रास्यनेत्रां च  with big face and eyes, दीर्घजिह्वाम् with long tongue, अजिह्विकाम् with no tongue, अनासिकाम्  noseless, सिंहमुखीम् with a lion face, गोमुखीम् with the face of a cow, सूकरीमुखीम् a boar faced ogress.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
एकाक्षीमेककर्णां च कर्णप्रावरणां तथा। गोकर्णीं हस्तिकर्णीं च लम्बकर्णीमकर्णिकाम्।।5.22.33।। हस्तिपाद्यश्वपाद्यौ च गोपादीं पादचूलिकाम्। एकाक्षीमेकपादीं च पृथुपादीमपादिकाम्।।5.22.34।। अतिमात्रशिरोग्रीवामतिमात्रकुचोदरीम्। अतिमात्रास्यनेत्रां च दीर्घजिह्वामजिह्विकाम्।।5.22.35।। अनासिकां सिंहमुखीं गोमुखीं सूकरीमुखीम्।
output: Of them one had one eye, the other one ear, another with ears covered, one had the ear of a cow, another had ears of an elephant and yet another, long, hanging ears. One had the feet of an elephant, another, hoofs of a horse and still another of a cow. While one had a single foot, another had broad feet and yet another no feet at all. One had a long neck and a large head. One had large breasts and belly. One had a big face and eyes, another had a long tongue and yet another no tongue at all. One had no nose and still another had a lion face and yet another the face of a cow.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथा मद्वशगा सीता क्षिप्रं भवति जानकी।।5.22.36।। तथा कुरुत राक्षस्यः सर्वाः क्षिप्रं समेत्य च।
output: राक्षस्यः O rakshasa women, जानकी Janaki, सीता Sita, क्षिप्रम् quickly, यथा in a manner, मद्वशगा submits to me, भवति you do, तथा in that way, सर्वाः all of you, क्षिप्रम् at once, समेत्य च jointly, कुरुत you may try.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रतिलोमानुलोमैश्च सामदानादिभेदनैः।।5.22.37।। आवर्जयत वैदेहीं दण्डस्योद्यमनेन च।
output: "By adopting means favourable or contrary to her will or through persuasion or coercion or through reward or punishment, draw Vaidehi's mind towards me." (said Ravana).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति प्रतिसमादिश्य राक्षसेन्द्रः पुनः पुनः।।5.22.38।। काममन्युपरीतात्मा जानकीं पर्यतर्जयत्।
output: राक्षसेन्द्रः demon king, पुनः पुनः again and again, इति thus, प्रतिसमादिश्य repeated his instruction, काममन्युपरीतात्मा burning with passion and anger, जानकीम् Janaki, पर्यतर्जयत् threatened by pointing his finger at her

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
उपगम्य ततः शीघ्रं राक्षसी धान्यमालिनी।।5.22.39।। परिष्वज्य दशग्रीवमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: An ogress called Dhanyamalini at once approached the tenheaded Ravana and embracing him, said:.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
मया क्रीड महाराज सीतया किं तवानया।।5.22.40।। विवर्णया कृपणया मानुष्या राक्षसेश्वर।
output: "O king of demons, sport with me, my lord. What purpose will be served with this pale wretched Sita, a human being after all?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नूनमस्या महाराज न दिव्यान् भोगसत्तमान्।।5.22.41।। विदधात्यमरश्रेष्ठस्तव बाहुबलार्जितान्।
output: "O king surely she is not ordained by Brahma, the foremost among the immortals to enjoy the luxuries earned by the strength of your arms.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अकामां कामयानस्य शरीरमुपतप्यते।।5.22.42।। इच्छन्तीं कामयानस्य प्रीतिर्भवति शोभना।
output: अकामाम् a woman devoid of desire, कामयानस्य of a man who desires, शरीरम् body, उपतप्यते only is tormented, इच्छन्तीम् a lady who desires, कामयानस्य one who is desiring, शोभना is enjoyable, प्रीतिः pleasure भवति becomes

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तस्तु राक्षस्या समुत्क्षिप्तस्ततो बली।।5.22.43।। प्रहसन्मेघसङ्काशो राक्षसः स न्यवर्तत।
output: Having heard her words, the demon king who resembled a fierce dark cloud turned away, laughing heartily.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रस्थितः स दशग्रीवः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम्।।5.22.44।। ज्वलद्भास्करवर्णाभं प्रविवेश निवेशनम्।
output: Thereupon the tennecked demon departed, as if he was shaking the earth and entered his residence which was shining like the blazing midday Sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
देवगन्धर्वकन्याश्च नागकन्याश्च सर्वतः।।5.22.45।। परिवार्य दशग्रीवं विविशुस्तं गृहोत्तमम्।
output: Then the daughters of gods, gandharvas and nagas gathered round and followed him into his excellent palace.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 22:
स मैथिलीं धर्मपरामवस्थितां प्रपेपमानां परिभर्त्स्य रावणः। विहाय सीतां मदनेन मोहितः स्वमेव वेश्म प्रविवेश भास्वरम्।।5.22.46।।
output: Having derided Mythili trembling in fear yet steadfast in treading the righteous path, Ravana, overpowered with passion left her and entered his glittering mansion. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्वाविंशस्सर्गः। Thus ends twentysecond sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं राजा रावणः शत्रुरावणः। सन्दिश्य च ततः सर्वा राक्षसीर्निर्जगाम ह।।5.23.1।।
output: King Ravana, tormentor of enemies, having thus spoken to Mythili commanded the demonesses and departed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निष्क्रान्ते राक्षसेन्द्रे तु पुनरन्तःपुरं गते। राक्षस्यो भीमरूपास्ताः सीतां समभिदुद्रुवुः।।5.23.2।।
output: As the demon king left for his abode all the demonesses of hideous looks rushed towards Sita and crowded around her.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः। परं परुषया वाचा वैदेहीमिदमब्रुवन्।।5.23.3।।
output: The demonesses, overcome with anger, approached Sita and harshly said:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
पौलस्त्यस्य वरिष्ठस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः। दशग्रीवस्य भार्या त्वं सीते न बहुमन्यसे।।5.23.4।।
output: 'O Sita don't you think it is a privilege to be the  wife of the highsouled, tennecked Ravana, who is the distinguished king of a high family of sage Paulastya?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
ततस्त्वेकजटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्। आमन्त्य्र क्रोधाताम्राक्षी सीतां करतलोदरीम्।।5.23.5।।
output: Then Ekajata, a shedemon of hideous looks, eyes red with anger and a belly of the size of the palm said to Sita:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रजापतीनां षण्णां तु चतुर्थो यः प्रजापतिः। मानसो ब्रह्मणः पुत्रः पुलस्त्य इति विश्रुतः।।5.23.6।।
output: षण्णाम् of the six, प्रजापतीनाम् of Prajapatis, यः he who was, चतुर्थः fourth, प्रजापतिः, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, मानसः born out of mind, पुत्रः a son, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, इति thus, विश्रुतः very famous.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुलस्त्यस्य तु तेजस्वी महर्षिर्मानसः सुतः। नाम्ना स विश्रवा नाम प्रजापतिसमप्रभः।।5.23.7।।
output: नाम्ना with the name, विश्रवा नाम Vishravas by name, प्रजापतिसमप्रभः equal in splendour to Prajapati, तेजस्वी glorious, सः महर्षिः that sage, पुलस्त्यस्य Pulastya's, मानसः mindborn, सुतः son.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य पुत्रो विशालाक्षि रावणः शत्रुरावणः। तस्य त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हसि।।5.23.8।। मयोक्तं चारुसर्वाङ्गिः वाक्यं किं नानुमन्यसे।
output: 'O largeeyes lady to become the wife of the lord of demons is a stroke of good luck. You deserve to be one. O lady of beautiful limbs why don't you accept his proposal?'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो हरिजटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.23.9।। विवर्त्य नयने कोपान्मार्जारसदृशेक्षणा।
output: ततः then, मार्जारसदृशेक्षणा cateyed, हरिजटा नाम called Harijata, राक्षसी ogress, कोपात् with anger, नयने both eyes, विवर्त्य rolling, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
येन देवास्त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवराजश्च निर्जिताः।।5.23.10।। तस्य त्वं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हसि।
output: 'You ought to be the wife of the lord of ogres who has vanquished thirty three crores of gods including Indra, their king.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
ततस्तु प्रघसा नाम राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्छिता।।5.23.11।। भर्त्सयन्ती तदा घोरमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: Then an ogress named Praghasa, overwhelmed with anger, deriding Sita said these terrible words:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
वीर्योत्सिक्तस्य शूरस्य सङ्ग्रामेषु निवर्तिनः।।5.23.12।। बलिनो वीर्ययुक्तस्य भार्यात्वं किं न लप्स्यसे।
output: 'Why don't you wish to be the wife of such a mighty and powerful king, a valiant hero who has never beaten a retreat in war?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
प्रियां बहुमतां भार्यां त्यक्त्वा राजा महाबलः।।5.23.13।। सर्वासां च महाभागां त्वामुपैष्यति रावणः।
output: 'Even renouncing his highly respectable,  favourite wife among all, mighty Ravana is prepared to accept you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
समृद्धं स्त्रीसहस्रेण नानारत्नोपशोभितम्।।5.23.14।। अन्तःपुरं समुत्सृज्य त्वामुपैष्यति रावणः।
output: 'Ravana is prepared to abandon a thousand wives in his prosperous harem  decorated with all kinds of gems in order to accept you.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
अन्या तु विकटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.23.15।। असकृद्देवता युद्धे नागगन्धर्वदानवाः। निर्जिताः समरे येन स ते पार्श्वमुपागतः।।5.23.16।।
output: Another ogress called Vikata said, ' Know that he who has often defeated gods in war and has vanquished nagas, gandharvas and demons has come to you (seeking your favour)'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्या तु विकटा नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.23.15।। असकृद्देवता युद्धे नागगन्धर्वदानवाः। निर्जिताः समरे येन स ते पार्श्वमुपागतः।।5.23.16।।
output: विकटा नाम called Vikata, अन्या other, राक्षसी तु ogress also, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, येन by whom, असकृत् often, युद्धे in war, देवताः gods, समरे in war, नागगन्धर्वदानवाः nagas, gandharvas and demons, निर्जिताः vanquished, सः he, ते your, पार्श्वम् side, आगतः has come to you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य सर्वसमृद्धस्य रावणस्य महात्मनः। किमद्य राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भार्यात्वं नेच्छसेऽधमे।।5.23.17।।
output: अधमे O foolish woman, सर्वसमृद्धस्य who has abundance of wealth, महात्मनः great self, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of ogres, तस्य his, रावणस्य Ravana's, भार्यात्वम् to be wife, अद्य now, किम् why, नेच्छसे do not you desire

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 23:
ततस्तु दुर्मुखी नाम राक्षसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्। यस्य सूर्यो न तपति भीतो यस्य च मारुतः।।5.23.18।। न वाति स्मायतापाङ्गे किं त्वं तस्य न तिष्ठसि।
output: Then an ogress called Durmukhi said, 'O lady of long sideglances why don't you yield to him, afraid of whom the Sun scorches not and strong winds blow not?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुष्पवृष्टिं च तरवो मुमुचुर्यस्य वै भयात्।।5.23.19।। शैलाश्च सुभ्रु पानीयं जलदाश्च यदेच्छति। तस्य नैरृतराजस्य राजराजस्य भामिनि ।।5.23.20।। किं त्वं न कुरुषे बुद्धिं भार्यार्थे रावणस्य हि।
output: सुभ्रु lady with beautiful eyebrows, भामिनि radiant one, यस्य whose, भयात् fear, तरवः trees, पुष्पवृष्टिम् rain of flowers, मुमुचुः released, यदा whenever, इच्छति wishes, शैलाश्च even mountains, जलदाश्च clouds also, पानीयम् water, नैरृतराजस्य for the king of the southwest, Ravana, राजराजस्य king of kings, तस्य his, रावणस्य Ravana's, भार्यार्थे to become his wife, बुद्धिम् mind accepting, त्वम् you, किम् why, न कुरुषे not wishing?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 24:
ततः सीतामुपागम्य राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। परुषं परुषा नार्य ऊचुस्तां वाक्यमप्रियम्।।5.24.1।।
output: Then the hideous ogresses approached Sita and spoke these harsh words in an unbecoming manner:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किं त्वमन्तःपुरे सीते सर्वभूतमनोहरे। महार्हशयनोपेते न वासमनुमन्यसे।।5.24.2।।
output: 'O Sita why don't you agree to dwell in Ravana's inner apartment furnished with fine bedsteads, and which is delightful?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 24:
मानुषी मानुषस्यैव भार्यात्वं बहुमन्यसे। प्रत्याहर मनो रामान्न त्वं जातु भविष्यसि।।5.24.3।।
output: 'You are  a woman, wife of Rama, an ordinary mortal you are holding in high esteem. Withdraw your mind from Rama or else you will not survive.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 24:
त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारं रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम्। भर्तारमुपसङ्गम्य विहरस्व यथासुखम्।।5.24.4।।
output: "Accept Ravana as your husband and after uniting with him enjoy all the pleasures of the three worlds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 24:
मानुषी मानुषं तं तु राममिच्छसि शोभने। राज्याद्भ्र्रष्टमसिद्धार्थं विक्लबं त्वमनिन्दिते।।5.24.5।।
output: 'O charming lady you have an irreproachable beauty and grace. Why do you think of human Rama only who has been dethroned from the kingdom. He is only a human being who is unsuccessful and distressful.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 24:
राक्षसीनां वचः श्रुत्वा सीता पद्मनिभेक्षणा। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।5.24.6।।
output: Hearing the words of the ogresses, Sita with eyes like lotus petals full of tears replied this way:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदिदं लोकविद्विष्टमुदाहरथ सङ्गताः। नैतन्मनसि वाक्यं मे किल्बिषं प्रतिभाति वः।।5.24.7।।
output: सङ्गताः joined together, लोकविद्विष्टम् not acceptable to the world, यत् such, इदम् this, मे my, वाक्यम् words, उदाहरथ you spoke, एतत् this way, वः addressed by you, मनसि in mind, किल्बिषम् sinful, न प्रतिभाति not thought.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न मानुषी राक्षसस्य भार्या भवितुमर्हति। कामं खादत मां सर्वा न करिष्यामि वो वचः।।5.24.8।।
output: मानुषी a human being, राक्षसस्य ogre's, भार्या wife, भवितुम् to become, न अर्हति ought not to be, सर्वाः all of you, कामम् freely, माम् me, खादत eat, वः addressed by you, वचः words, न करिष्यामि I will not do.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दीनो वा राज्यहीनो वा यो मे भर्ता स मे गुरुः। तं नित्यमनुरक्तास्मि यथा सूर्यं सुवर्चला।।5.24.9।।
output: 'Dejected or dethroned from the kingdom, Rama is my lawful husband. I will ever remain devoted to Rama as Suvarchala, wife of the Sungod is to him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 24:
यथा शची महाभागा शक्रं समुपतिष्ठति। अरुन्धती वसिष्ठं च रोहिणी शशिनं यथा।।5.24.10।। लोपामुद्रा यथागस्त्यं सुकन्या च्यवनं यथा। सावित्री सत्यवन्तं च कपिलं श्रीमती यथा।।5.24.11।। सौदासं मदयन्तीव केशिनी सगरं यथा। नैषधं दमयन्तीव भैमी पतिमनुव्रता।।5.24.12।। तथाऽहमिक्ष्वाकुवरं रामं पतिमनुव्रता।
output: 'I am steadfast (in love) to my husband Rama, the foremost of the Ikshvaku family in the same manner as noble Sachi to Indra, Arundhati to Vasistha, Rohini to the Moon, Lopamudra to Agastya, Sukanya to sage Chyavana, Savitri to Satyavan, Srimati to Kapilamuni Madayanti to Soudasu, Kesini to king Sagara and Bhima's daughter Damayanti to her lord Nala, (the king of Nishadas)'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 24:
यथा शची महाभागा शक्रं समुपतिष्ठति। अरुन्धती वसिष्ठं च रोहिणी शशिनं यथा।।5.24.10।। लोपामुद्रा यथागस्त्यं सुकन्या च्यवनं यथा। सावित्री सत्यवन्तं च कपिलं श्रीमती यथा।।5.24.11।। सौदासं मदयन्तीव केशिनी सगरं यथा। नैषधं दमयन्तीव भैमी पतिमनुव्रता।।5.24.12।। तथाऽहमिक्ष्वाकुवरं रामं पतिमनुव्रता।
output: 'I am steadfast (in love) to my husband Rama, the foremost of the Ikshvaku family in the same manner as noble Sachi to Indra, Arundhati to Vasistha, Rohini to the Moon, Lopamudra to Agastya, Sukanya to sage Chyavana, Savitri to Satyavan, Srimati to Kapilamuni Madayanti to Soudasu, Kesini to king Sagara and Bhima's daughter Damayanti to her lord Nala, (the king of Nishadas)'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथा शची महाभागा शक्रं समुपतिष्ठति। अरुन्धती वसिष्ठं च रोहिणी शशिनं यथा।।5.24.10।। लोपामुद्रा यथागस्त्यं सुकन्या च्यवनं यथा। सावित्री सत्यवन्तं च कपिलं श्रीमती यथा।।5.24.11।। सौदासं मदयन्तीव केशिनी सगरं यथा। नैषधं दमयन्तीव भैमी पतिमनुव्रता।।5.24.12।। तथाऽहमिक्ष्वाकुवरं रामं पतिमनुव्रता।
output: महाभागा noble, शची Sachi, यथा like, शक्रम् Indra, समुपतिष्ठति is steadfadt, अरुन्धती Arundhati, वसिष्ठं च with Vasistha, रोहिणी Rohini, शशिनम् the moon, यथा likewise, लोपामुद्रा Lopamudra, अगस्त्यम् with Agastya, यथा similarly, सुकन्या Sukanya, च्यवनम् Chayavanam, यथा so also, सावित्री Savitri, सत्यवन्तम् with Satyavan, श्रीमती Srimati, कपिलम् with Kapilamuni, यथा so also, सौदासम् Soudasa, मदयन्तीव Madayanti, केशिनी Kesini, सगरं यथा with Sagara likewise, पतिम् as husband, नैषधम् Nala, king of Naishada, अनुव्रता devoted, भैमी Bhima's daughter, दमयन्तीव like Damayanti, तथा in the same way, अहम् I, इक्ष्वाकुवरम् foremost of Ikshvaku family, पतिम् a husband, रामम् Rama, अनुव्रता I am devoted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यः क्रोधमूर्छिताः।।5.24.13।। भर्त्सयन्ति स्म परुषैर्वाक्यै रावणचोदिताः।
output: रावणचोदिताः ordered by Ravana, राक्षस्यः by the ogresses, सीतायाः Sita's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, क्रोधमूर्छिताः overtaken by anger, परुषैः with harsh, वाक्यैः with statements, भर्त्सयन्ति स्म threatened.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवलीनः स निर्वाक्यो हनूमान् शिंशुपाद्रुमे।।5.24.14।। यसीतां सन्तर्जयन्तीस्ता राक्षसीरशृणोत् कपिः।
output: Hanuman who kept himself concealed on the simsupa tree speechlessly listened to the ogresses threatening Sita.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 24:
तामभिक्रम्य सङ्कृद्धा वेपमानां समन्ततः।।5.24.15।। भृशं संलिलिहुर्दीप्तान् प्रलम्बान् दशनच्छदान्।
output: Sita was trembling in fear. The  enraged ogresses went on licking their lips hanging, again and again.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
