स तस्य कृत्वार्थपतेर्महाकपिर्महद्व्यलीकं मनसो महात्मनः। युयुत्सुरेको बहुभिर्महाबलैश्शिया ज्वलंस्तोरणमास्थितः कपिः।।5.41.21।।
output: सः महाकपिः that great vanara, महात्मनः of the great self, तस्य his, अर्थपतेः of the lord of wealth, मनसः in mind, महत् great, व्यलीकम् unpleasantness, कृत्वा having caused, महाबलैः mighty, बहुभिः many, एकः singlehanded, युयुत्सुः ready to fight, श्रिया blazing, ज्वलन् glowing, तोरणम् exit doorway, आस्थितः stood.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
ततः पक्षिनिनादेन वृक्षभङ्गस्वनेन च। बभूवुस्त्राससम्भ्रान्तास्सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः।।5.42.1।।
output: The residents of Lanka panicked at the shrieking sounds of birds and cracking sounds of trees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विद्रुताश्च भयत्रस्ता विनेदुर्मृगपक्षिणः। रक्षसां च निमित्तानि क्रूराणि प्रतिपेदिरे।।5.42.2।।
output: मृगपक्षिणः beasts and birds, विद्रुता: ran and flown away, भयत्रस्ताः became scared, विनेदुः screeching in all directions, रक्षसां च for the ogres, क्रूराणि fierce, निमित्तानि portents, प्रतिपेदिरे appeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो गतायां निद्रायां राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। तद्वनं ददृशुर्भग्नं तं च वीरं महाकपिम्।।5.42.3।।
output: ततः then, विकृताननाः women of hideous faces, राक्षस्यः ogressses, निद्रायाम् in sleep, गतायाम् was awakened, भग्नम् devastated, तत् that, वनम् garden, वीरम् hero, तं महाकपिं च that great vanara, ददृशुः saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स ता दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्महासत्त्वो महाबलः। चकार सुमहद्रूपं राक्षसीनां भयावहम्।।5.42.4।।
output: महाबाहुः strong armed one, महासत्त्वः a great hero, महाबलः mighty, सः he, Hanuman, ताः the women, दृष्ट्वा seeing, राक्षसीनाम् for the ogresses, भयावहम् to create fear, सुमहत् very huge, रूपम् form, चकार assumed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
ततस्तं गिरिसङ्काशमतिकायं महाबलम्। राक्षस्यो वानरं दृष्ट्वा पप्रच्छुर्जनकात्मजाम्।।5.42.5।।
output: Then, seeing the huge body of the mighty vanara resembling a mountain the ogresses questioned Janaki about him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कोऽयं कस्य कुतो वायं किं निमित्तमिहागतः। कथं त्वया सहानेन संवादः कृत इत्युत।।5.42.6।।
output: "Who is he? By whom has he been sent? From where and why did he come here? What dialogue  did you have with him?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आचक्ष्व नो विशालाक्षि मा भूत्ते सुभगे भयम्। संवादमसितापाङ्गे त्वया किं कृतवानयम्।।5.42.7।।
output: "O lovely, largeeyed lady O auspicious one have no fear. What conversation did he have with you? Tell us".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथाब्रवीन्महासाध्वी सीता सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी। रक्षसां भीमरूपाणां विज्ञाने मम का गतिः।।5.42.8।।
output: Chaste and beautiful Sita said, "How do I know about the ogresses who assume many fierce forms?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यूयमेवाभिजानीत योऽयं यद्वा करिष्यति। अहिरेव ह्यहेः पादान्विजानाति न संशयः।।5.42.9।।
output: "You alone can know about who he is and what he is about. A serpent alone knows the movement (footprints) of another serpent. There is no doubt about it.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहमप्यस्य भीतास्मि नैनं जानामि को न्वयं। वेद्मि राक्षसमेवैनं कामरूपिणमागतम्।।5.42.10।।
output: "I am also scared of him. I do not know who he is. I think he is a demon, who came here assuming a form of his choice.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षस्यो विद्रुता दिशः। स्थिताः काश्चिद्गताः काश्चिद्रावणाय निवेदितुम्।।5.42.11।।
output: वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after listening to, राक्षस्यः ogresses, दिशः in all directions, विद्रुताः ran, काश्चित् some, स्थिताः stood there, काश्चित् some, रावणाय to Ravana, निवेदितुम् to report, गताः fled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणस्य समीपे तु राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। विरूपं वानरं भीममाख्यातुमुपचक्रमुः।।5.42.12।।
output: विकृताननाः uglyfaced, राक्षस्यः shedemons, रावणस्य to Ravana, समीपे presence, विरूपम्  disfigured, भीमम् frightening, वानरम् vanara, आख्यातुम् to report, उपचक्रमुः started.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अशोकवनिकामध्ये राजन्भीमवपुः कपिः। सीतया कृतसंवादस्तिष्ठत्यमितविक्रमः।।5.42.13।।
output: "Your majesty an extremely powerful and frightening Vanara had a dialogue with Sita. He is stationed in the midst of Ashoka garden.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
न च तं जानकी सीता हरिं हरिणलोचना। अस्माभिर्बहुधा पृष्टा निवेदयितुमिच्छति।।5.42.14।।
output: "The deereyed Sita is not willing to disclose to us his identity even when we questioned her.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वासवस्य भवेद्दूतो दूतो वैश्रवणस्य वा। प्रेषितो वापि रामेण सीतान्वेषणकाङ्क्षया।।5.42.15।।
output: वासवस्य Vasava's, दूतः envoy, वैश्रवणस्य Vaisravana's, दूतो वा is he an envoy, सीतान्वेषणकाङ्क्षया or one who has come to trace Sita, रामेण by Rama, प्रेषितो वापि or sent, भवेत् may be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
तेन त्वद्भुतरूपेण यत्तत्तव मनोहरम्। नानामृगगणाकीर्णं प्रमृष्टं प्रमदावनम्।।5.42.16।।
output: "Your beautiful pleasure garden filled with a variety of beasts has been ruined by this wonderful figure.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न तत्र कश्चिदुद्देशो यस्तेन न विनाशितः। यत्र सा जानकी सीता स तेन न विनाशितः।।5.42.17।।
output: तेन by him, यः whichever, न विनाशितः not ruined, उद्देशः place, तत्र there, कश्चित् even one, न not, सा that, जानकी Janaki, सीता Sita, यत्र wherever, सः that place, तेन by him, न विनाशितः not ruined.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जानकीरक्षणार्थं वा श्रमाद्वा नोपलभ्यते। अथवा कश्श्रमस्तस्य सैव तेनाभिरक्षिता।।5.42.18।।
output: "It is not clear whether he spared that place for protecting Janakai or he stopped due to exhaustion. What is fatigue for him? It must be to save her that she is spared by him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
चारुपल्लवपुष्पाढ्यं यं सीता स्वयमास्थिता। प्रवृद्धश्शिंशुपावृक्ष स्स च तेनाभिरक्षितः।।5.42.19।।
output: "He has spared the simsupa tree with lovely, tender leaves and flowers which is a chosen  resort by Sita.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्योग्ररूपस्योग्र त्वं दण्डमाज्ञातुमर्हसि। सीता सम्भाषिता येन तद्वनं च विनाशितम्।।5.42.20।।
output: "Your highness should take severe action on that person of fierce appearance with whom Sita dared to speak, and by whom the garden is ruined.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मनः परिगृहीतां तां तव रक्षोगणेश्वर। कस्सीतामभिभाषेत यो न स्यात्त्यक्तजीवितः।।5.42.21।।
output: रक्षोगणेश्वर O lord of the demon clan, मनः परिगृहीताम् one who is desired by you, तां सीताम् that Sita, यः whoever, त्यक्तजीवितः given up hope of life, न स्यात् if not, कः who, अभिभाषेत he will dare to talk.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
राक्षसीनां वचश्त्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। हुताग्निरिव जज्वाल कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः।।5.42.22।।
output: On listening to the report of the ogresses, Ravana, the lord of demons flared up like blazing flame of a sacrificial fire, his eyeballs rolling in rage.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
तस्य क्रुद्धस्य नेत्राभ्यां प्रापतन्नास्रबिन्दवः। दीप्ताभ्यामिव दीपाभ्यां सार्चिष स्स्नेहबिन्दवः।।5.42.23।।
output: From his angry eyes fell down drops of tears just as burning drops of oil drip from two burning lamps.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
आत्मनस्सदृशान्शूरान्किङ्करान्नाम राक्षसान्। व्यादिदेश महातेजा निग्रहार्थं हनूमतः।।5.42.24।।
output: Then powerful Ravana commanded heroic demons called kinkaras who vied in strength to catch Hanuman.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषामशीतिसाहस्रं किङ्कराणां तरस्विनाम्। निर्ययुर्भवनात्तस्मात्कूटमुद्गरपाणयः।।5.42.25।। महोदरा महादंष्ट्रा घोररूपा महाबलाः। युद्धाभिमनसस्सर्वे हनुमद्ग्रहणोद्यताः।।5.42.26।।
output: तरस्विनाम् of swiftmoving ones, तेषां किङ्कराणाम् of the kinkaras, अशीतिसाहस्रम् eighty thousand, महोदराः largebellied, महादंष्ट्राः largetoothed, घोररूपाः dreadfullooking, महाबलाः powerful, युद्धाभिमनसः ready to fight in war, सर्वे all, कूटमुद्गरपाणयः hammers and clubs, हनुमद्ग्रहणोद्यताः resolved to capture Hanuman, तस्मात् from that, भवनात् building, निर्ययुः came out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
तेषामशीतिसाहस्रं किङ्कराणां तरस्विनाम्। निर्ययुर्भवनात्तस्मात्कूटमुद्गरपाणयः।।5.42.25।। महोदरा महादंष्ट्रा घोररूपा महाबलाः। युद्धाभिमनसस्सर्वे हनुमद्ग्रहणोद्यताः।।5.42.26।।
output: Eighty thousand powerful  kinkaras (a clan of demons), largebellied, with large teeth and of dreadful appearance, swift in action, armed with hammers and clubs marched from there, resolved to capture Hanuman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते कपीन्द्रं समासाद्य तोरणस्थमवस्थितम्। अभिपेतुर्महावेगाः पतङ्गा इव पावकम्।।5.42.27।।
output: The kinkaras rushed towards the leader of vanaras who stood near the archway like the moths rushing towards the flame.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः परिघैः काञ्चनाङ्गदैः। आजघ्नुर्वानरश्रेष्ठं शरैश्चादित्यसन्निभैः।।5.42.28।।
output: They assailed Hanuman with iron maces, crowbars edged with gold and shining arrows resembling the Sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
मुद्गरैः पट्टिशैश्शूलैः प्रासतोमरशक्तिभिः। परिवार्य हनूमन्तं सहसा तस्थुरग्रतः।।5.42.29।।
output: They quickly surrounded Hanuman and stood with hammers, sharpedged spears, tridents, barbed missiles and powerful javelins.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हनुमानपि तेजस्वी श्रीमान्पर्वतसन्निभः। क्षितावाविध्य लाङ्गूलं ननाद च महास्वनम्।।5.42.30।।
output: Gigantic Hanuman, illustrious and brilliant, roared and waved his tail striking it with force on the ground causing loud sound.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स भूत्वा सुमहाकायो हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। धृष्टमास्फोटयामास लङ्कां शब्देन पूरयन्।।5.42.31।।
output: मारुतात्मजः Maruti's son, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, सुमहाकायः with a huge body, भूत्वा assuming, शब्देन by the sound, लङ्काम् entire Lanka, पूरयन् echoed, धृष्टम् wildly, अस्फोटयामास patted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यास्फोटितशब्देन महता सानुनादिना। पेतुर्विहङ्गा गगनादुच्चैश्चेदमघोषयत्।।5.42.32।।
output: सानुनादिना by the frightening echoing sound, महता with great, तस्य his, अस्फोटितशब्देन by the sound of the patting, विहङ्गाः birds, गगनात् from the sky, पेतुः fell down, उच्चैः with a loud noise, इदम् thus, अघोषयत् च proclaimed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः।।5.42.33।।
output: "Victory to Rama, the mighty and powerful, Victory to Lakshmana. Victory to king Sugriva who is ruled by Rama."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दासोऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। हनुमान्शत्रुसैन्यानां निहन्ता मारुतात्मजः।।5.42.34।।
output: शत्रुसैन्यानाम् of the enemy army, निहन्ता killer, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, अहम् I am, कोसलेन्द्रस्य of the lord of Kosala kingdom, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः a man of unwearied action, रामस्य Rama's, दासः servant.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न रावणसहस्रं मे युद्धे प्रतिबलं भवेत्। शिलाभिस्तु प्रहरतः पादपैश्च सहस्रशः।।5.42.35।।
output: सहस्रशः a thousand ways, शिलाभिः with stones, पादपैश्च with even trees, प्रहरतः while I pound, मे to me, युद्धे in war, रावणसहस्रम् a thousand Ravanas, प्रतिबलम् match in strength, न भवेत् will not.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
अर्दयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कामभिवाद्य च मैथिलीम्। समृद्धार्थो गमिष्यामि मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम्।।5.42.36।।
output: "I shall destroy the city of Lanka and pay my respects to Mythili right under the nose of all demons. I will return with my purpose accomplished.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
तस्य सन्नादशब्देन तेऽभवन्भयशङ्किताः। ददृशुश्च हनूमन्तं सन्ध्यामेघमिवोन्नतम्।।5.42.37।।
output: Terrified on hearing the roar, the kinkaras looked at the towering Hanuman who seemed like a cloud in twilight (red in colour).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वामिसन्देशनिश्शङ्कास्ततस्ते राक्षसाः कपिम्। चित्रैः प्रहरणैर्भीमैरभिपेतुस्ततस्ततः।।5.42.38।।
output: Obeying their king's commnad, putting aside their fear, the kinkaras freely attacked the vanara  from all directions with dreadful weapons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
स तैः परिवृतश्शूरैस्सर्वतस्सुमहाबलः। आससादाऽयसं भीमं परिघं तोरणाश्रितम्।।5.42.39।।
output: Extremely powerful Hanuman surrounded by heroes all over, on his part went to the archway and picked up a terrific iron beam.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तं परिघमादाय जघान रजनीचरान्। स पन्नगमिवादाय स्फुरन्तं विनतासुतः।।5.42.40।। विचचाराम्बरे वीरः परिगृह्य च मारुतिः।
output: सः he, तं परिघम् that iron beam, आदाय took hold, रजनीचरान् nightrangers, जघान struck them, वीरः hero, सः मारुतिः that Maruti, विनतासुतः just as Vinatha's son, स्फुरन्तम् shoots, पन्नगम् serpent, आदाय seized, परिगृह्य took hold, अम्बरे in the sky, विचचार started moving.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 42:
स हत्वा राक्षसान्वीरान्किङ्करान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.42.41।। युद्धाकाङ्क्षी पुनर्वीरस्तोरणं समुपाश्रितः।
output: The great Windgod's son killed the kinkaras, and returned to the archway desiring further combat.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तस्माद्भयान्मुक्ताः कतिचित्तत्र राक्षसाः।।5.42.42।। निहतान्किङ्करान्सर्वान्रावणायन्यवेदयन्।
output: Then a few surviving ogres took to their heels after getting over that shock and reported to Ravana of the destruction of the kinkaras in the combat

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स राक्षसानां निहतं महद्बलं निशम्य राजा परिवृत्तलोचनः। समादिदेशाप्रतिमं पराक्रमे प्रहस्तपुत्रं समरे सुदुर्जयम्।।5.42.43।।
output: स he, राजा king, राक्षसानाम् of ogres, महत् mighty, बलम् army, निहतम् killed, निशम्य after hearing, परिवृत्तलोचनः with his eyes rolling, पराक्रमे in valour, अप्रतिमम् matchless, समरे in war, सुदुर्जयम् difficult to conquer, प्रहस्तपुत्रम् son of Prahasta, समादिदेश commanded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्स किङ्करान्हत्वा हनुमान्ध्यानमास्थितः। वनं भग्नं मया चैत्यप्रासादो न विनाशितः।।5.43.1।। तस्मात्प्रासादमप्येवं भीमं विध्वंसयाम्यहं। इति सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा हनुमान्दर्शयन्बलम्।।5.43.2।। चैत्यप्रासादमाप्लुत्य मेरुशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम्। आरुरोह कपिश्रेष्ठो हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.43.3।।
output: ततः then, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, किङ्करान् kinkaras, हत्त्वा having slain, ध्यानम् reflected, आस्थितः resumed, मया by me, वनम् garden, भग्नम् destroyed, चैत्यप्रासादः the Chaitya palace, न विनाशितः not ruined, तस्मात् therefore, अद्य now, अहम् I, भीमम् fearsome, प्रासादम् building, एवम् in this way, विध्वंसयामि I will destroy, कपिश्रेष्ठः foremost of vanaras, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, मनसा in his mind, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking, बलम् strength, दर्शयन्  showed, मेरुशृङ्गमिव like the peak of mount Meru, उन्नतम् tall, चैत्यप्रासादम् Chaitya palace, उत्ल्पुत्य jumped, आरुरोह climbed

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्स किङ्करान्हत्वा हनुमान्ध्यानमास्थितः। वनं भग्नं मया चैत्यप्रासादो न विनाशितः।।5.43.1।। तस्मात्प्रासादमप्येवं भीमं विध्वंसयाम्यहं। इति सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा हनुमान्दर्शयन्बलम्।।5.43.2।। चैत्यप्रासादमाप्लुत्य मेरुशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम्। आरुरोह कपिश्रेष्ठो हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.43.3।।
output: Hanuman destroys the demons in the palace

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 43:
ततस्स किङ्करान्हत्वा हनुमान्ध्यानमास्थितः। वनं भग्नं मया चैत्यप्रासादो न विनाशितः।।5.43.1।। तस्मात्प्रासादमप्येवं भीमं विध्वंसयाम्यहं। इति सञ्चिन्त्य मनसा हनुमान्दर्शयन्बलम्।।5.43.2।। चैत्यप्रासादमाप्लुत्य मेरुशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम्। आरुरोह कपिश्रेष्ठो हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.43.3।।
output: Having slain the kinkaras, Hanuman stood and reflected, ' I have ruined the garden and not the palatial buildings that are like temples (Chaityas)'. Then Hanuman, son of the Windgod, decided in his mind to show his strength and jumped on to the top of the palatial building that appeared like the peak of mount Meru.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आरुह्य गिरिसङ्काशं प्रासादं हरियूथपः। बभौ स सुमहातेजाः प्रतिसूर्य इवोदितः।।5.43.4।।
output: हरियूथपः vanara leader, सुमहातेजाः brilliant, सः he, गिरिसङ्काशम् resembling a mountain, प्रासादम् palace, आरुह्य after climbing, उदितः rising, प्रतिसूर्यः इव like another Sun, बभौ looked

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 43:
संप्रधृष्य च दुर्धर्षं चैत्यप्रासादमुत्तमम्। हनुमान्प्रज्वलन्लक्ष्म्या पारियात्रोपमोऽभवत्।।5.43.5।।
output: Having destroyed the fine palace building, the indomitable Hanuman was blazing with glory like the mountain Pariyatra. (one of the seven Kula mountains viz., Mahendra, Malaya, Sahya, Shuktiman, Riksha, Vindhya and Pariyatra)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स भूत्वा सुमहाकायः प्रभावान्मारुतात्मजः। धृष्टमास्फोटयामास लङ्कां शब्देन पूरयन्।।5.43.6।।
output: Hanuman heaved his body  huge  with his prowess and patted his arms loudly filling the city of Lanka with that terrible sound.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यास्फोटितशब्देन महता श्रोत्रघातिना। पेतुर्विहङ्गमास्तत्र चैत्यपालाश्च मोहिताः।।5.43.7।।
output: By the deafening sound caused by the patting, the birds fell down and the guards of the palace lost consciousness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्त्रविज्जयतां रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः।।5.43.8।।
output: अस्त्रवित् knowledgeable about all missiles, रामः Rama, जयताम् be victorious, महाबलः matchless warrior, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, राघवेण by Rama, अभिपालितः ruled, राजा king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, जयति be victorious.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 43:
दासोऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। हनुमान्शत्रुसैन्यानां निहन्ता मारुतात्मजः।।5.43.9।।
output: 'I am the son of the Windgod, destroyer of enemy army. I am a servant of Rama, the king of Kosala who can accomplish any task with ease.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न रावणसहस्रं मे युद्धे प्रतिबलं भवेत्। शिलाभिस्तु प्रहरतः पादपैश्च सहस्रशः।।5.43.10।।
output: 'Not even a thousand Ravanas can stand my might  in combat as I start assailing them with thousands of  rocks or even trees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्दयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कामभिवाद्य च मैथिलीम्। समृद्धार्थो गमिष्यामि मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम्।।5.43.11।।
output: सर्वरक्षसाम् of all ogres, मिषताम् they keep looking, लङ्कां पुरीम् city of Lanka, अर्थयित्वा destroying, मैथिलीम् Mythili, अभिवाद्य च offering obeisance, समृद्धार्थः having accomplished the task, गमिष्यामि return to.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वा विमानस्थश्चैत्यस्थान्हरियूथपः। ननाद भीमनिर्ह्रादो रक्षसां जनयन्भयम्।।5.43.12।।
output: Having made proclamations that way from the top of the Vimana (palace) the monkey leader roared making terrific sound frightening the ogres.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 43:
तेन शब्देन महता चैत्यपालाश्शतं ययुः। गृहीत्वा विविधानस्त्रान्प्रासान्खङ्गान्परश्वथान्।।5.43.13।। विसृजन्तो महाकाया मारुतिं पर्यवारयन्।
output: Hearing the terrific sound, a hundred gigantic guards of the palace set forth, holding different kinds of weapons like darts, swords and axes and hurled at Maruti surrounding him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते गदाभिर्विचित्राभिः परिघैः काञ्चनाङ्गदैः। आजघ्नुर्वानरश्रेष्ठं बाणैश्चादित्यसन्निभैः।।5.43.14।।
output: Holding astonishing maces decorated with gold, iron crowbars and sharp arrows resembling the rays of the Sun the ogres hit Hanuman, the foremost of vanaras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आवर्त इव गङ्गायास्तोयस्य विपुलो महान्। परिक्षिप्य हरिश्रेष्ठं स बभौ रक्षसां गणः।।5.43.15।।
output: The demons surrounding the great monkey looked like a big whirlpool of the water of the river Ganga.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो वातात्मजः क्रुद्धो भीम रूपं समास्थितः।।5.43.16।। प्रासादस्य महन्तस्य स्तम्बं हेमपरिष्कृतम्। उत्पाटयित्वा वेगेन हनुमान्पवनात्मजः।।5.43.17।। ततस्तं भ्रामयामास शतधारं महाबलः।
output: Thereupon the infuriated son of the Windgod, assumed a fearsome form, uprooted a pillar of the palace decked with gold and holding that hundred edged pillar whirled it round swiftly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो वातात्मजः क्रुद्धो भीम रूपं समास्थितः।।5.43.16।। प्रासादस्य महन्तस्य स्तम्बं हेमपरिष्कृतम्। उत्पाटयित्वा वेगेन हनुमान्पवनात्मजः।।5.43.17।। ततस्तं भ्रामयामास शतधारं महाबलः।
output: ततः then, वातात्मज son of the Windgod, क्रुद्धः infuriated, भीमम् fearsome, रूपम् form, समास्थितः assumed, महान् great, पवनात्मजः son of the Windgod, महाबलः mighty, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य प्रासादस्य of that palace, हेमपरिष्कृतम् decked with gold, स्तम्भं pillar, उत्पाटयित्वा uprooted, ततः then, शतधारम् holding a hundred edged, तम् that, वेगेन swiftly, भ्रामयामास whirled round.

instruction:

तत्र चाग्निस्समभवत्प्रासादश्चाप्यदह्यत।।5.43.18।। दह्यमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा प्रासादं हरियूथपः। स राक्षसशतं हत्त्वा वज्रेणेन्द्र इवासुरान्।।5.43.19।। अन्तरिक्षे स्थितश्श्तीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
output: Thereafter fire was generated (through friction) and with if the palace blazed. Hanuman saw the palace burning. He killed a hundred demons there as Indra killed demons with his thunderbolt. instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मादृशानां सहस्राणि विसृष्टानि महात्मनाम्।।5.43.20।। बलिनां वानरेन्द्राणां सुग्रीववशवर्तिनाम्। अटन्ति वसुधां कृत्स्नां वयमन्ये च वानराः।।5.43.21।।
output: महात्मनाम् huge, बलिनाम् of mighty, सुग्रीववशवर्तिनाम् of those loyal to Sugriva, मादृशानाम् of people like me, वानरेन्द्राणाम् of the best of  vanara leaders, सहस्राणि in thousands, विसृष्टानि are despatched, वयम् we, अन्ये others, वानराश्च and vanaras, कृत्स्नाम् entire, वसुधाम् the earth, अटन्ति we are wandering.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 43:
मादृशानां सहस्राणि विसृष्टानि महात्मनाम्।।5.43.20।। बलिनां वानरेन्द्राणां सुग्रीववशवर्तिनाम्। अटन्ति वसुधां कृत्स्नां वयमन्ये च वानराः।।5.43.21।।
output: "Thousands of huge and mighty monkeys, equal to me, loyal to king Sugriva, are coming under the orders and have been recruited from the entire earth. They  are the best among monkeys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दशनागबलाः केचित्केचिद्दशगुणोत्तराः। केचिन्नागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः।।5.43.22।।
output: "Of them some have the strength equal to ten elephants, others are ten times stronger, and still others have a thousand elephants' strength.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्ति चौघबलाः केचित्केचिद्वायुबलोपमाः। अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्ये तत्रासन्हरियूथपाः।।5.43.23।।
output: "Some have the strength of flood waters, some are powerful as wind and yet others have strength beyond measure.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ईदृग्विधैस्तु हरिभिर्वृतो दन्तनखायुधैः। शतैश्शतसहस्रैश्च कोटीभिरयुतैरपि।।5.43.24।। आगमिष्यति सुग्रीवः सर्वेषां वो निषूदनः।
output: ईद्दृग्विधैः endowed with such warriors, दन्त अपितु नखायुधै: by those using teeth and nails as weapons, शतैः in hundreds, अयुतैः in ayuta (ten thousand), शतसहस्रैः a hundred thousand, कोटीभिः in crores, हरिभिः with vanaras also, वृतः surrounded, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सर्वेषाम् of all of them, वः you, निषूदनः killer, आगमिष्यति would come here.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नेयमस्ति पुरी लङ्का न यूयं न च रावणः।5.43.25।। यस्मादिक्ष्वाकुनाथेन बद्धं वैरं महात्मना।
output: यस्मात् since, महात्मना with great self, इक्ष्वाकुनाथेन with the lord of Ikshvaku dynasty, वैरम् enmity, बद्धम् is bound, इयम् this, लङ्कापुरी city of Lanka, नास्ति will not be found, यूयम् even you, न not, रावणः च and Ravana, न also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्दिष्टो राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रहस्तस्य सुतो बली। जम्बुमाली महादंष्ट्रो निर्जगाम धनुर्धरः।।5.44.1।। रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरस्स्रग्वी रुचिरकुण्डलः। महान्विवृत्तनयनश्चण्डस्समरदुर्जयः।।5.44.2।। धनुश्शक्रधनुः प्रख्यं महद्रुचिरसायकम्। विष्फारयाणो वेगेन वज्राशनिसमस्वनम्।।5.44.3।।
output: Killing of Jambumali by Hanuman

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सन्दिष्टो राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रहस्तस्य सुतो बली। जम्बुमाली महादंष्ट्रो निर्जगाम धनुर्धरः।।5.44.1।। रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरस्स्रग्वी रुचिरकुण्डलः। महान्विवृत्तनयनश्चण्डस्समरदुर्जयः।।5.44.2।। धनुश्शक्रधनुः प्रख्यं महद्रुचिरसायकम्। विष्फारयाणो वेगेन वज्राशनिसमस्वनम्।।5.44.3।।
output: महादंष्ट्रः one with big front teeth, धनुर्धरः bow in hand, रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरः adorned with a garland of red flowers and red clothes, स्रग्वी wearing a chaplet, रुचिरकुण्डलः with beautiful earrings, महान् great, विवृत्तनयनः who had big round eyes, चण्डः fierce, समरदुर्जयः  invincible in war, बली mighty, प्रहस्तस्य सुतः son of Prahasta,जम्बुमाली Jambumali,राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the demon king, सन्दिष्टः commanded, महत् huge, रुचिरसायकम् who had radiant arrows, वज्राशनिसमस्वनम् making sounds like thunderbolt, शक्रधनुःप्रख्यम् like Indra's splendid bow (a rainbow), धनुः bow, वेगेन very swiftly, विष्फारयाणः as if thundering, निर्जगाम went out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
सन्दिष्टो राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रहस्तस्य सुतो बली। जम्बुमाली महादंष्ट्रो निर्जगाम धनुर्धरः।।5.44.1।। रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरस्स्रग्वी रुचिरकुण्डलः। महान्विवृत्तनयनश्चण्डस्समरदुर्जयः।।5.44.2।। धनुश्शक्रधनुः प्रख्यं महद्रुचिरसायकम्। विष्फारयाणो वेगेन वज्राशनिसमस्वनम्।।5.44.3।।
output: Commanded  by the demon king, Jambumali the invincible son of Prahasta, who had large teeth in front, big rolling eyes, red flower garland, red robes and a chaplet with beautiful earrings. He went round twanging his producing thunderous sound. His arrows were huge, shining and beautiful.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
तस्य विष्फारघोषेण धनुषो महता दिशः। प्रदिशश्च नभश्चैव सहसा समपूर्यत।।5.44.4।।
output: All directions including the intermediate directions and the sky were filled with that loud sound produced by his twang.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रथेन खरयुक्तेन तमागतमुदीक्ष्य सः। हनुमान्वेगसम्पन्नो जहर्ष च ननाद च।।5.44.5।।
output: खरयुक्तेन drawn by donkeys, रथेन by the chariot, आगतम् reached, तम् him, उदीक्षय after seeing, सः हनुमान् that Hanuman, वेगसम्पन्नः who was endowed with speed, जहर्ष च felt glad, ननाद च and made a loud noise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
तं तोरणविटङ्कस्थं हनुमन्तं महाकपिम्। जम्बुमाली महाबाहुर्विव्याध निशितैश्शरैः।।5.44.6।।
output: Strongarmed Jambumali with his sharp arrows hit great Hanuman who stood on top of the exit archway.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्धचन्द्रेण वदने शिरस्येकेन कर्णिना। बाह्वोर्विव्याध नाराचैर्दशभिस्तं कपीश्वरम्।।5.44.7।।
output: अर्धचन्द्रेण with a crescentshaped arrow, वदने on the face, एकेन with one, कर्णिना ear shaped arrow, शिरसि on the head, दशभिः ten, नाराचैः iron arrows, बाह्वोः into the arms, तं कपीश्वरम् that lord of monkeys, विव्याध hit.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य तच्छुशुभे ताम्रं शरेणाभिहतं मुखम्। शरदीवाम्बुजं फुल्लं विद्धं भास्कररश्मिना।।5.44.8।।
output: शरेण by an arrow, अभिहतम् struck, ताम्रम् reddish, तत् his, मुखम् face, शरदि in autumn, भास्करश्मिना with Sun's radiance, विद्धम् hit, फुल्लम् blown, अम्बुजमिव like a lotus, शुशुभे appeared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
तत्तस्य रक्तं रक्तेन रञ्जितं शुशुभे मुखम्। यथाकाशे महापद्मं सिक्तं चन्दनबिन्दुभिः।।5.44.9।।
output: His red face  stained with blood was glowing bright like red lotus in the sky sprinkled with drops of red sandal.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चुकोप बाणाभिहतो राक्षसस्य महाकपिः। ततः पार्श्वेऽतिविपुलां ददर्श महतीं शिलाम्।।5.44.10।।
output: बाणाभिहतः struck by the shafts, महाकपिः great monkey, राक्षसस्य of the demon, चुकोप enraged, ततः then, पार्श्वे lying beside, अतिविपुलाम् huge, महतीम् on the ground, शिलाम् rock, ददर्श he saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
तरसा तां समुत्पाट्य चिक्षेप बलवद्भली। तां शरैर्दशभिः क्रुद्धस्ताडयामास राक्षसः।।5.44.11।।
output: Powerful Hanuman with all vehemence lifted the rock and hurled it at the giant which he angrily smashed with ten arrows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
विपन्नं कर्म तद्दृष्ट्वा हनुमांश्चण्डविक्रमः। सालं विपुलमुत्पाट्य भ्रामयामास वीर्यवान्।।5.44.12।।
output: Hanuman, a strong, powerful and fierce warrior pulled out a sala tree and whirled it. Seeing that his attempt has failed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
भ्रामयन्तं कपिं दृष्ट्वा सालवृक्षं महाबलम्। चिक्षेप सुबहून्बाणान्जम्बुमाली महाबलः।।5.44.13।।
output: Gigantic Jambumali seeing the mighty Hanuman whirling the sala tree fired many arrows at him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सालं चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेद वानरं पञ्चभिर्भुजे। उरस्येकेन बाणेन दशभिस्तु स्तनान्तरे।।5.44.14।।
output: सालम् sala tree, चतुर्भिः with four, चिच्छेद cut off, वानरम् vanara, पञ्चभिः with five, भुजे on his arm, उरसि on his chest, एकेन बाणेन with one arrow, स्तनान्तरे in the hollow of the chest, दशभिः with ten.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स शरैः पूरिततनु: क्रोधेन महता वृतः। तमेव परिघं गृह्य भ्रामयामास वेगितः।।5.44.15।।
output: शरैः arrows, पूरिततनु: the body was filled, सः that, महता intense, क्रोधेन with anger, वृतः endowed, वेगितः speedily, तं परिघमेव the same iron spear, गृह्य seized, भ्रामयामास started whirling.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
अतिवेगोऽतिवेगेन भ्रामयित्वा बलोत्कटः। परिघं पातयामास जम्बुमालेर्महोरसि।।5.44.16।।
output: Hanuman of immeasurable strength hurled the iron spear after turning it round and round at high speed on the broad chest of Jambumali.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य चैव शिरो नास्ति न बाहू न च जानुनी। न धनुर्न रथो नाश्वास्तत्रादृश्यन्त नेषवः।।5.44.17।।
output: Neither his head could be discerned nor his arms, knees, nor bow, chariot nor donkeys. Nothing was seen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स हतस्सहसा तेन जम्बुमाली महाबलः। पपात निहतो भूमौ चूर्णिताङ्गविभूषणः।।5.44.18।।
output: Mighty Jambumali killed  by that blow dropped down dead at once with his ornaments reduced to powder.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
जम्बुमालिं च निहतं किङ्करांश्च महाबलान्। चुक्रोध रावणश्शुत्वा कोपसंरक्तलोचनः।।5.44.19।।
output: Ravana's eyes became bloodshot in anger when he heard about the death of Jambumali and of the strong army of kinkaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 44:
स रोषसंवर्तितताम्रलोचनः प्रहस्तपुत्त्रे निहते महाबले। अमात्यपुत्त्रानतिवीर्यविक्रमान् समादिदेशाशु निशाचरेश्वरः।।5.44.20।।
output: When the mighty son of Prahasta was killed, infuriated Ravana, his eyes red and rolling, commanded the highly valiant sons of ministers. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfourth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणस्सुताः। निर्ययुर्भवनात्तस्मात्सप्तसप्तार्चिवर्चसः।।5.45.1।। महाबलपरीवारा धनुष्मन्तो महाबलाः। कृतास्त्रास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठाः परस्परजयैषिणः।।5.45.2।। हेमजालपरिक्षिप्तैर्ध्वजवद्भिः पताकिभिः। तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैर्वाजियुक्तैर्महारथैः।।5.45.3।। तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि चापान्यमितविक्रमाः। विस्फारयन्तस्संहृष्टास्तटित्वन्त इवाम्बुदाः।।5.45.4।।
output: ततः then, सप्तार्चिवर्चसः energetic like fire, महाबलपरीवाराः endowed with great army, धनुष्मन्तः experts in archery, महाबलाः mighty, कृतास्त्राः अस्त्रविदाम् distinguished wielders of weapons, श्रेष्ठाः foremost, परस्परजयैषिणः wished to conquer each other, अमितविक्रमाः very valiant, सप्त seven, ते they, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सुताः sons, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of ogres, चोदिताः directed, संहृष्टाः gladly, तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि decked with shining gold, चापानि bows, विष्फारयन्तः by sporting, तटित्वन्तः shining with lightning, अम्बुदाः इव like storm clouds, हेमजलपरिक्षिप्तैः decked with golden mesh, ध्वजवद्भिः bearing staffs, पताकिभिः with flags,तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैः making sounds like stormy clouds, वाजियुक्तै: yoked to horses,महारथैः with great chariots, तस्मात् from that, भवनात् from the palace, निर्ययुः departed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणस्सुताः। निर्ययुर्भवनात्तस्मात्सप्तसप्तार्चिवर्चसः।।5.45.1।। महाबलपरीवारा धनुष्मन्तो महाबलाः। कृतास्त्रास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठाः परस्परजयैषिणः।।5.45.2।। हेमजालपरिक्षिप्तैर्ध्वजवद्भिः पताकिभिः। तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैर्वाजियुक्तैर्महारथैः।।5.45.3।। तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि चापान्यमितविक्रमाः। विस्फारयन्तस्संहृष्टास्तटित्वन्त इवाम्बुदाः।।5.45.4।।
output: Hanuman kills the seven sons of Ravana's chief minister

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 45:
ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणस्सुताः। निर्ययुर्भवनात्तस्मात्सप्तसप्तार्चिवर्चसः।।5.45.1।। महाबलपरीवारा धनुष्मन्तो महाबलाः। कृतास्त्रास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठाः परस्परजयैषिणः।।5.45.2।। हेमजालपरिक्षिप्तैर्ध्वजवद्भिः पताकिभिः। तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैर्वाजियुक्तैर्महारथैः।।5.45.3।। तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि चापान्यमितविक्रमाः। विस्फारयन्तस्संहृष्टास्तटित्वन्त इवाम्बुदाः।।5.45.4।।
output: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy  clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like  stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 45:
ततस्ते राक्षसेन्द्रेण चोदिता मन्त्रिणस्सुताः। निर्ययुर्भवनात्तस्मात्सप्तसप्तार्चिवर्चसः।।5.45.1।। महाबलपरीवारा धनुष्मन्तो महाबलाः। कृतास्त्रास्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठाः परस्परजयैषिणः।।5.45.2।। हेमजालपरिक्षिप्तैर्ध्वजवद्भिः पताकिभिः। तोयदस्वननिर्घोषैर्वाजियुक्तैर्महारथैः।।5.45.3।। तप्तकाञ्चनचित्राणि चापान्यमितविक्रमाः। विस्फारयन्तस्संहृष्टास्तटित्वन्त इवाम्बुदाः।।5.45.4।।
output: Commanded by Ravana, the seven sons of minister blazing like fire followed by large army of experts in archery, possessing great valour, armed with weapons, being distinguished wielders of weapons, skilled in the use of weapons, who were equally capable of conquering each other sallied forth gladly to fight with Hanuman. They drove chariots yoked with horses which were decked with golden mesh, holding totem staffs (a figure engraved to identify a hero) and flags, neighing like clouds. The valiant heroes were sporting and making sounds like stormy  clouds wielding wonderful bows glittering like molten gold, shining like lightning. As they marched from the palace they looked like  stormy clouds accompanied by lightning.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जनन्यस्तु ततस्तेषां विदित्वा किङ्करान्हतान्। बभूवुश्शोकसम्भ्रान्तास्सबान्धवसुहृज्जनाः।।5.45.5।।
output: ततः then, तेषाम् their, सबान्धवसुहृज्जनाः with friends and relatives, जनन्यस्तु mothers, किंकरान् kinkaras, हतान् killed, विदित्वा having known, कसम्भ्रान्ताः were agitated with grief, बभूवुः became.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते परस्परसङ्घर्षात्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः। अभिपेतुर्हनूमन्तं तोरणस्थमवस्थितम्।।5.45.6।।
output: The barnished golden ornaments worn by them were shining as they brushed shoulders with one another (eager to fight first) to attack Hanuman who stood waiting at the main archway.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 45:
सृजन्तो बाणवृष्टिं ते रथगर्जितनिस्स्वनाः। वृष्टिमन्त इवांभोदा विचेरुर्नैऋताम्बुदाः।।5.45.7।।
output: They went roaring with their chariots rattling, sending forth torrents of arrows like the stormy clouds thundering.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 45:
अवकीर्णस्ततस्ताभिर्हनुमान्शरवृष्टिभिः। अभवत्संवृताकारश्शैलराडिव वृष्टिभिः।।5.45.8।।
output: Later, Hanuman covered with showers of arrows scattered all over appeared like the king of mountains shot with showers of rain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स शरान्मोघयामास तेषामाशुचरः कपिः। रथवेगं च वीराणां विचरन्विमलेऽम्बरे।।5.45.9।।
output: Then the monkey moving fast in the clear sky rendered the arrows of the giant heroes and speeding chariots futile.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तैः क्रीडन्धनुष्मद्भिर्व्योम्नि वीरः प्रकाशते। धनुष्मद्भिर्यथा मेघैर्मारुतः प्रभुरम्बरे।।5.45.10।।
output: Sporting in the sky with the giants who held bows in their hands, Hanuman shone like the powerful Windgod sporting in the sky surrrounded by rambling dark clouds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 45:
स कृत्वा निनदं घोरं त्रासयंस्तां महाचमूम्। चकार हनुमान्वेगं तेषु रक्षस्सु वीर्यवान्।।5.45.11।।
output: Valiant Hanuman making terrific sound and frightening the army of ogres marched swiftly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तलेनाभ्यहनत्कांश्चित्पादैः कांश्चित्परन्तपः। मुष्टिनाभ्यहनत्कांश्चिन्नखैः कांश्चिद्व्यदारयत्।।5.45.12।।
output: The scorcher of enemies, Hanuman hit some ogres with his palm, some with his feet and some with his fist and pierced some with his nails.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 45:
प्रममाथोरसा कांश्चिदूरुभ्यामपरान्कपिः। केचित्तस्य निनादेन तत्रैव पतिता भुवि।।5.45.13।।
output: The monkey strangled some with his chest and some between his thighs. A few fell down dead on the ground hearing his roaring noise.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तेष्ववसन्नेषु भूमौ निपतितेषु च। तत्सैन्यमगमत्सर्वं दिशोदश भयार्दितम्।।5.45.14।।
output: तेषु when they (sons of minister), अवसन्नेषु were annexed, भूमौ on the ground, निपतितेषु च when fallen dead on the ground, ततः then, सर्वम् all, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, भयार्दितम् struck with fear, दश दिशः in all ten directions, अगमत् fled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 45:
विनेदुर्विस्वरं नागा निपेतुर्भुवि वाजिनः। भग्ननीडध्वजच्छत्रैर्भूश्च कीर्णाऽभवद्रथैः।।5.45.15।।
output: The elephants trumpeted discordantly out of fear, the horses fell down on the ground and even the chariots with seats, parasols and flag staffs broken were strewn all over the ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्रवता रुधिरेणाथ स्रवन्त्यो दर्शिताः पथि। विविधैश्च स्वरैर्लङ्का ननाद विकृतं तदा।।5.45.16।।
output: अथ then, स्रवता flowing, रुधिरेण by blood, पथि way, स्रवन्त्यः flowed, दर्शिताः seen, तदा then, लङ्का Lanka, विविधैः with many, स्वरैः with sounds, विकृतम् horrifying cries, ननाद roared.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तान्प्रवृद्धान्विनिहत्य राक्षसान् महाबलश्चण्डपराक्रमः कपिः। युयुत्सुरन्यैः पुनरेव राक्षसै स्तमेव वीरोऽभिजगाम तोरणम्।।5.45.17।।
output: Having killed the ogres who were old and strong, the valiant and mighty Hanuman, wishing to slay the other ogres advanced towards the archway. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हतान्मन्त्रिसुतान् बुद्ध्वा वानरेण महात्मना। रावणस्संवृताकारश्चकार मतिमुत्तमाम्।।5.46.1।।
output: Five Generals of Ravana done to death by Hanuman in war

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
स विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दुर्धरं चैव राक्षसम्। प्रघसं भासकर्णं च पञ्चसेनाग्रनायकान्।।5.46.2।। सन्दिदेश दशग्रीवो वीरान्नयविशारदान्। हनुमद्ग्रहणव्यग्रान्वायुवेगसमान्युधि।।5.46.3।।
output: The tenheaded Ravana, eager to capture Hanuman, commanded his five army Generals called Virupaksha, Yupaksha, Durdhara, Praghasa and Bhaskarna, who were great warriorstatesmen valiant and, equal to wind in speed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दुर्धरं चैव राक्षसम्। प्रघसं भासकर्णं च पञ्चसेनाग्रनायकान्।।5.46.2।। सन्दिदेश दशग्रीवो वीरान्नयविशारदान्। हनुमद्ग्रहणव्यग्रान्वायुवेगसमान्युधि।।5.46.3।।
output: The tenheaded Ravana, eager to capture Hanuman, commanded his five army Generals called Virupaksha, Yupaksha, Durdhara, Praghasa and Bhaskarna, who were great warriorstatesmen valiant and, equal to wind in speed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
यात सेनाग्रगास्सर्वे महाबलपरिग्रहाः। सवाजिरथमातङ्गास्स कपिश्शास्यतामिति।।5.46.4।।
output: "O Army generals march with a large, strong army with horses, chariots and elephants and punish the vanara.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
यत्नैश्च खलु भाव्यं स्यात्तमासाद्य वनालयम्। कर्म चापि समाधेयं देशकालाविरोधिनम्।।5.46.5।।
output: "Go to that forestdweller and make all efforts to impose on him punishment appropriate to time and place (keeping in view the harm he has done).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न ह्यहं तं कपिं मन्ये कर्मणा प्रतितर्कयन्। सर्वथा तन्महद्भूतं महाबलपरिग्रहम्।।5.46.6।।
output: "Judging again and again from all actions, I do not think he is an ordinary monkey. He is a being endowed with great strength.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
भवेदिन्द्रेण वा सृष्टमस्मदर्थं तपोबलात्। सनागयक्षगन्धर्वा देवासुरमहर्षयः।।5.46.7।। युष्माभिस्सहितैस्सर्वैर्मया सह विनिर्जिताः। तैरवश्यं विधातव्यं व्यलीकं किञ्चिदेव नः।।5.46.8।। तदेव नात्र सन्देहः प्रसह्य परिगृह्यताम्। नावमान्यो भवद्भिश्च हरिर्धीरपराक्रमः।।5.46.9।।
output: "To me it appears he is created by Indra with his ascetic power (for punishing us). I have subdued nagas, yakshas, gandharvas and even gods, asuras and ascetics with your help. So you should certainly bring him here without doing any harm. Capture the monkey forcibly. Do not insult that mighty monkey.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भवेदिन्द्रेण वा सृष्टमस्मदर्थं तपोबलात्। सनागयक्षगन्धर्वा देवासुरमहर्षयः।।5.46.7।। युष्माभिस्सहितैस्सर्वैर्मया सह विनिर्जिताः। तैरवश्यं विधातव्यं व्यलीकं किञ्चिदेव नः।।5.46.8।। तदेव नात्र सन्देहः प्रसह्य परिगृह्यताम्। नावमान्यो भवद्भिश्च हरिर्धीरपराक्रमः।।5.46.9।।
output: अस्मदर्धम् it seems to me, तपोबलात् by ascetic power, इन्द्रेण by Indra, सृष्टं वा may be created, भवेत् may be, सहितैः along with, सर्वैः by all, युष्माभिः of you, मया by me, सनागयक्षगन्धर्वाः nagas, yakshas, gandharvas,देवासुरमहर्षयः gods, demons and ascetics, विनिर्जिताः subdued, तैः by them, नः us, किञ्चिदेव even a little, व्यलीकम् harm, अवश्यम् certainly, विधातव्यम् should be done, तदेव this is same reaction, अत्र in this case, सन्देहः doubt, न no, प्रसह्य with force, परिगृह्यताम् he may be captured, धीरपराक्रमः a warrior of heroic strength, हरिः monkey, भवद्भि by you also, नावमान्यः should not be insulted.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
भवेदिन्द्रेण वा सृष्टमस्मदर्थं तपोबलात्। सनागयक्षगन्धर्वा देवासुरमहर्षयः।।5.46.7।। युष्माभिस्सहितैस्सर्वैर्मया सह विनिर्जिताः। तैरवश्यं विधातव्यं व्यलीकं किञ्चिदेव नः।।5.46.8।। तदेव नात्र सन्देहः प्रसह्य परिगृह्यताम्। नावमान्यो भवद्भिश्च हरिर्धीरपराक्रमः।।5.46.9।।
output: "To me it appears he is created by Indra with his ascetic power (for punishing us). I have subdued nagas, yakshas, gandharvas and even gods, asuras and ascetics with your help. So you should certainly bring him here without doing any harm. Capture the monkey forcibly. Do not insult that mighty monkey.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
दृष्टा हि हरयः पूर्वं मया विपुलविक्रमाः। वाली च सहसुग्रीवो जाम्बवांश्च महाबलः।।5.46.10।। नीलस्सेनापतिश्चैव ये चान्ये द्विविदादयः। नैवं तेषां गतिर्भीमा न तेजो न पराक्रमः।।5.46.11।। न मतिर्न बलोत्साहौ न रूपपरिकल्पनम्।
output: "Earlier I have seen monkeys of immense prowess, like Vali and Sugriva as well as Jambavan, the bear. Also I have seen the army general, Nila, Dvivida and others. They do not have such tremendous splendour or movement valour, intellect and strength and energy. They did not have such ability to change form at their will.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दृष्टा हि हरयः पूर्वं मया विपुलविक्रमाः। वाली च सहसुग्रीवो जाम्बवांश्च महाबलः।।5.46.10।। नीलस्सेनापतिश्चैव ये चान्ये द्विविदादयः। नैवं तेषां गतिर्भीमा न तेजो न पराक्रमः।।5.46.11।। न मतिर्न बलोत्साहौ न रूपपरिकल्पनम्।
output: पूर्वम् earlier, मया by me, विपुलविक्रमाः of immense prowess, हरयः monkeys, सहसुग्रीवः with Sugriva, वाली च and Vali, महाबलः mighty, जाम्बवांश्च and Jambavan, सेनापतिः army chief, नीलः Nila, द्विविदादयः Dvivida and others, अन्ये च and others, ये those, दृष्टाः हि have seen, तेषाम् for them, गतिः movement, एवम् that way, भीमा tremendous, न not, तेजः splendour, पराक्रमः valour, न not, मतिः intellect, न not, बलोत्साहौ strength and energy, रूपपरिकल्पनम् ability to change form at will.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महत्सत्त्वमिदं ज्ञेयं कपिरूपं व्यवस्थितम्।।5.46.12।। प्रयत्नं महदास्थाय क्रियतामस्य निग्रहः।
output: "It should be understood that he has taken the form of a monkey. You have to put in extraordinary effort to capture him by acting in a suitable manner.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कामं लोकास्त्रयस्सेन्द्रास्ससुरासुरमानवाः।।5.46.13।। भवतामग्रतः स्थातुं न पर्याप्ता रणाजिरे।
output: "Even Indra, suras, asuras and humans and the three worlds together are incompetent to stand before you in a battlefield.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथापि तु नयज्ञेन जयमाकाङ्क्षता रणे।।5.46.14।। आत्मा रक्ष्यः प्रयत्नेन युद्धसिद्धिर्हि चञ्चला।
output: "Even then, you should safeguard yourself with great effort adopting warstrategies in an intelligent  manner to be victorious, for success in war is uncertain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ते स्वामिवचनं सर्वे प्रतिगृह्य महौजसः।।5.46.15।। समुत्पेतुर्महावेगा हुताशसमतेजसः। रथैर्मत्तैश्च मातङ्गैर्वाजिभिश्च महाजवैः।।5.46.16।। शस्त्रैश्च विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैस्सर्वैश्चोपचिता बलैः।
output: महौजसः very strong, हुताशसमतेजसः resplendant as sacrificial fire, ते सर्वे all of them, स्वामिवचनम् king's words, प्रतिगृह्य accepting, महावेगाः who were swift, रथैः with chariots, मत्तै intoxicated, मातङ्गै: with elephants, महाजवैः of great speed, वाजिभिश्च with horses, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, विविधैः many kinds, शस्त्रै: with weapons, सर्वे all, बलैः strong army, उपचिताः collecting,समुत्पेतुः sallied forth together

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ते स्वामिवचनं सर्वे प्रतिगृह्य महौजसः।।5.46.15।। समुत्पेतुर्महावेगा हुताशसमतेजसः। रथैर्मत्तैश्च मातङ्गैर्वाजिभिश्च महाजवैः।।5.46.16।। शस्त्रैश्च विविधैस्तीक्ष्णैस्सर्वैश्चोपचिता बलैः।
output: Taking King's order, the strong and swift warriors, resplendent as the flame of sacrificial fire sallied forth with their army on chariots, on the back of rutting elephants,  some on swift horses equipped with sharp weapons of many kinds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तं ददृशुर्वीरा दीप्यमानं महाकपिम्।।5.46.17।। रश्मिमन्तमिवोद्यन्तं स्वतेजोरश्मिमालिनम्। तोरणस्थं महोत्साहं महासत्त्वं महाबलम्।।5.46.18।।
output: ततः then, वीराः heroes, स्वतेजोरश्मिमालिनम् shining like the Sungod with his own effulgence, उद्यन्तम् a rising one, रश्मिमन्तमिव like the Sun, दीप्यमानम् shining, तोरणस्थम् standing at the archway, महोत्साहम् extraordinary agility, महासत्त्वम् intelligent,महाबलम् endowed with tremendous strength, तं महाकपिम् him the vanara, ददृशुः saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तं ददृशुर्वीरा दीप्यमानं महाकपिम्।।5.46.17।। रश्मिमन्तमिवोद्यन्तं स्वतेजोरश्मिमालिनम्। तोरणस्थं महोत्साहं महासत्त्वं महाबलम्।।5.46.18।।
output: ततः then, वीराः heroes, स्वतेजोरश्मिमालिनम् shining like the Sungod with his own effulgence, उद्यन्तम् a rising one, रश्मिमन्तमिव like the Sun, दीप्यमानम् shining, तोरणस्थम् standing at the archway, महोत्साहम् extraordinary agility, महासत्त्वम् intelligent,महाबलम् endowed with tremendous strength, तं महाकपिम् him the vanara, ददृशुः saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महामतिं महावेगं महाकायं महाबलम्। तं समीक्ष्यैव ते सर्वे दिक्षु सर्वास्ववस्थिताः।।5.46.19।। तै स्तै: प्रहरणैर्भीमैरभिपेतुस्ततस्ततः।
output: सर्वे all, महामतिम् highly intelligent, महावेगम् very swift, महाकायम् having a huge body, महाबलम् tremendous strength, तम् him, समीक्ष्यैव having observed, सर्वासु in all, दिक्षु directions, अवस्थिताः positioned, ततस्ततः here and there, भीमैः with dreadful, स्तैस्तै: with different, प्रहरणैः with weapons, अभिपेतुः attacked.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य पञ्चायसास्तीक्ष्णाश्शिताः पीतमुखाश्शराः।।5.46.20।। शिरस्युत्पलपत्राभा दुर्धरेण निपातिताः।
output: Durdhara pierced into the head of Hanuman with five sharp arrows and polished steel shafts with yellow tips (gold) shining like red lotus petals. They were like petals of lilies thrown on the head of Hanuman (causing no pain).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
स तैः पञ्चभिराविद्धश्शरैश्शिरसि वानरः।।5.46.21।। उत्पपात नदन् व्योम्नि दिशो दश विनादयन्।
output: With five arrows pierced in the head of the vanara, Hanuman leaped into the sky with terrible roar, which resounded in all the ten directions.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तु दुर्धरो वीरस्सरथस्सज्यकार्मुकः।।5.46.22।। किरन् शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिपेदे महाबलः।
output: Then the powerful, hero, Durdhara, mounted on his chariot, fastened his bowstring and hit Hanuman with hundreds of sharp arrows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
स कपिर्वारयामास तं व्योम्नि शरवर्षिणम्।।5.46.23।। वृष्टिमन्तं पयोदान्ते पयोदमिव मारुतः।
output: The great monkey kept away the showering arrows like the wind prevents raincloud from showering rain drops at the end of monsoon.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्ध्यमानस्ततस्तेन दुर्धरेणानिलात्मजः।।5.46.24।। चकार कदनं भूयो व्यवर्धत च वेगवान्।
output: तेन by him, दुर्धरेण by Durdhara, अर्ध्यमानः attacked, अनिलात्मजः son of the Windgod, ततः then, कदनम् battle, चकार fought, वेगवान् swift hero, भूयः again, व्यवर्धत  grew in size.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स दूरं सहसोत्पत्य दुर्धरस्य रथे हरिः।।5.46.25।। निपपात महावेगो विद्युद्राशिर्गिराविव।
output: Hanuman suddenly leaped far off into the air at high speed and fell on Durdhara's chariot just like a thunderous lightning falls on a mountain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 46:
ततस्स मथिताष्टाश्वं रथं भग्नाक्षकूबरम्।।5.46.26।। विहाय न्यपतद्भूमौ दुर्धरस्त्यक्तजीवितः।
output: Having lost his chariot, the horses yoked to it killed, its axle and pole broken to pieces, Durdhara fell down dead from the chariot.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भुवि।।5.46.27।। सञ्जातरोषौ दुर्धर्षावुत्पेतुररिन्दमौ।
output: दुर्धर्षौ  unassailable warriors, अरिन्दमौ  crushers of enemies, विरूपाक्षयूपाक्षौ Virupaksha and Yupaksha, भुवि on the ground, निपतितम् fallen, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा seeing, सञ्जातरोषौ enraged, उत्पेतुः leaped at him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स ताभ्यां सहसोत्पत्य विष्ठितो विमलेऽम्बरे।।5.46.28।। मुद्गराभ्यां महाबाहुर्वक्षस्यभिहतः कपिः।
output: As the strongarmed vanara stood stationed in the clear white sky both the generals leaped into the sky and hit him all of a sudden with two iron hammers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तयोर्वेगवतोर्वेगं विनिहत्य महाबलः।।5.46.29।। निपपात पुनर्भूमौ सुपर्णसमविक्रमः।
output: Powerful Hanuman, an equal to Garuda in valour fell down while resisting the swift generals.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स सालवृक्षमासाद्य तमुत्पाट्य च वानरः।।5.46.30।। तावुभौ राक्षसौ वीरौ जघान पवनात्मजः।
output: Then the son of the Windgod seized a sala tree uprooted it, lifted it and smashed the two giant generals with it.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तांस्त्रीन्हतान्ज्ञात्वा वानरेण तरस्विना।।5.46.31।। अभिपेदे महावेगः प्रसह्य प्रघसो हरिम्। भासकर्णश्च सङ्कृद्धश्शूलमादाय वीर्यवान्।।5.46.32।।
output: Finding all the three generals dead, swift Praghasa advanced towards the Vanara and attacked him. Valiant Bhasakarna also lifted a trident and attacked him. Both were famous for swift and violent action in war

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तांस्त्रीन्हतान्ज्ञात्वा वानरेण तरस्विना।।5.46.31।। अभिपेदे महावेगः प्रसह्य प्रघसो हरिम्। भासकर्णश्च सङ्कृद्धश्शूलमादाय वीर्यवान्।।5.46.32।।
output: Finding all the three generals dead, swift Praghasa advanced towards the Vanara and attacked him. Valiant Bhasakarna also lifted a trident and attacked him. Both were famous for swift and violent action in war

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एकतः कपिशार्दूलं यशस्विनमवस्थितम्। पट्टिसेन शिताग्रेण प्रघसः प्रत्ययोधयत्।।5.46.33।। भासकर्णश्च शूलेन राक्षसः कपिसत्तमम्।
output: यशस्विनम् renowned, कपिशार्दूलम् tiger among monkeys, एकतः on one side, अवस्थितम् तम् stationed, प्रघसः Praghasa, शिताग्रेण with sharp weapon, पट्टिसेन iron crowbar, कपिसत्तमम् foremost of the monkeys, प्रत्ययोधयत् fought back, भासकर्णः Bhaskarna, राक्षसः giant, शूलेन with spear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स ताभ्यां विक्षतैर्गात्रैरसृग्दिग्धतनूरुहः।।5.46.34।। अभवद्वानरः क्रुद्धो बालसूर्यसमप्रभः।
output: ताभ्याम् by both of them, विक्षतैः with wounded ones, गात्रैः with his limbs, असृग्दिग्धतनूरुहः his fur smeared with blood, सः वानरः that vanara, बालसूर्यसमप्रभः was shining like the rising Sun, क्रुद्धः angry, अभवत् became.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समुत्पाट्य गिरेश्शृङ्गं समृगव्यालपादपम्।।5.46.35।। जघान हनुमान् वीरो राक्षसौ कपिकुञ्जरः।
output: कपिकुञ्जरः a mighty elephant among the monkeys, वीरः courageous, हनुमान् Hanuman, समृगव्यालपादपम् along with animals serpents and trees, गिरेः शृङ्गम् mountain peak, समुत्पाट्य having uprooted, राक्षसौ both the giants,जघान  killed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तेष्ववसन्नेषु सेनापतिषु पञ्चसु।।5.46.36।। बलं तदवशेषं च नाशयामास वानरः।
output: When the five army chiefs were killed, Hanuman began to destoy the remaining army force.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अश्वैरश्वान् गजैर्नागान् योधैर्योधान् रथैरथान्।।5.46.37।। स कपिर्नाशयामास सहस्राक्ष इवासुरान्।
output: The vanara pitted horses against horses, elephants against elephants, warriors against warriors and chariots against chariots as Indra destroyed demons.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हतैर्नागैश्च तुरगैर्भग्नाक्षैश्च महारथैः।।5.46.38।। हतैश्च राक्षसैर्भूमी रुद्धमार्गा समन्ततः।
output: There was no path (one could not move forward) with elephants, and horses killed and with broken axles of great chariots and smashed chariots spread all over the way.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः कपिस्तान्ध्वजिनीपतीन् रणे निहत्य वीरान्सबलान्सवाहनान्। समीक्ष्य वीरः परिगृह्य तोरणं कृतक्षणः काल इव प्रजाक्षये।।5.46.39।।
output: Then the heroic monkey having killed the army generals and their army and destroyed their vehicles in war came back to the archway after reviewing and stood like the timespirit bent upon the destruction of humanity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सेनापतीन्पञ्च स तु प्रमापितान् हनूमता सानुचरान्सवाहनान्। समीक्ष्य राजा समरोद्धतोन्मुखं कुमारमक्षं प्रसमैक्षताग्रतः।।5.47.1।।
output: राजा the king, सानुचरान् with the followers,सवाहनान् and their vehicles, पञ्च five, सेनापतीन् generals of the army, हनुमता by Hanuman, प्रमापितान् killed, समीक्ष्य seeing, समरोद्धतोन्मुखम् inclined to fight the war, अग्रतः in front of him, कुमारम् the prince, अक्षम् Aksha, प्रसमैक्षत turned his attention to.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स तस्य दृष्ट्यर्पणसम्प्रचोदितः प्रतापवान्काञ्चनचित्रकार्मुकः। समुत्पपाताथ सदस्युदीरितो द्विजातिमुख्यैर्हविषेव पावकः।।5.47.2।।
output: Spurred by the mere glance of Ravana, the glorious Aksha with his wonderful bow inlaid with gold sprang up from the royal assembly just as flame rises from firesanctuary when oblations are poured in by reputed brahmins.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो महद्बालदिवाकरप्रभं प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालसन्ततम्। रथं समास्थाय ययौ स वीर्यवान्महाहरिं तं प्रति नैरृतर्षभः।।5.47.3।।
output: ततः then, वीर्यवान् courageous, सः नैरृतर्षभः that bull among giants, बालदिवाकरप्रभम् splendid like the rising Sun, प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालसन्ततम् glittering like the stretch of pure gold, महत् great, रथम् chariot, समास्थाय having ascended, तम् him, महाहरिं प्रति towards the great vanara, ययौ marched.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
ततस्तपस्सङ्ग्रहसञ्चयार्जितं प्रतप्तजाम्बूनदजालशोभितम्। पताकिनं रत्नविभूषितध्वजं मनोजवाष्टाश्ववरैः सुयोजितम्।।5.47.4।।
output: The chariot was (strong as it was) gained by his austerities of high order. It was overlaid with pure gold armour, fixed with flags, and staff, studded with precious gems, yoked to the best of eight horses and endowed with the speed of mind.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
सुरासुराधृष्यमसङ्गचारिणं रविप्रभं व्योमचरं समाहितम्। सतूणमष्टासिनिबद्धबन्धुरं यथाक्रमावेशितशक्तितोमरम्।।5.47.5।।
output: (The chariot) was unassailable to suras or asuras.It moved without touching the ground, it could fly in air and had the splendour of the Sun. It was equipped readily with quivers, eight swords, javelins and clubs placed in right order.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विराजमानं प्रतिपूर्णवस्तुना सहेमदाम्ना शशिसूर्यवर्चसा। दिवाकराभं रथमास्थितस्ततस्स निर्जगामामरतुल्यविक्रमः।।5.47.6।।
output: ततः then, अमरतुल्यविक्रमः equal to gods in courage, सः he, सहेमदाम्ना with a golden garland, शशिसूर्यवर्चसा bright as Moon and Sun, प्रतिपूर्णवस्तुना equipped with all weapons, bows and shields etc, विराजमानम् glowing, दिवाकराभम् shining like the Sun, रथम् chariot, आस्थितः ascended, निर्जगाम went out.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स पूरयन्खं च महीं च साचलां तुरङ्गमातङ्गमहारथस्वनैः। बलैस्समेतैस्सहि तोरणस्थितं समर्थमासीनमुपागमत्कपिम्।।5.47.7।।
output: Seated on the chariot he (Aksha) sallied forth along with the army filling the entire earth and mountains with the sounds of horses, elephants and rumblings of big chariots and reached the portal where the great vanara stood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तं समासाद्य हरिं हरीक्षणो युगान्तकालाग्निमिव प्रजाक्षये। अवस्थितं विस्मितजातसम्भ्रम स्समैक्षताक्षो बहुमानचक्षुषा।।5.47.8।।
output: The lioneyed Aksha saw the vanara who appeared like the cosmic fire at the time of dissolution of the universe. The prince was astonished and struck with awe (at the majestic form of the Vanara) and looked at him with great  respect.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स तस्य वेगं च कपेर्महात्मनः पराक्रमं चारिषु पार्थिवात्मजः। विचारयन्स्वं च बलं महाबलो हिमक्षये सूर्य इवाभिवर्धते।।5.47.9।।
output: Aksha, the mighty prince judging the speed and prowess of the monkey with his own in confronting enemies and the strength of the monkey, began to swell up in spirit like the glow of the Sun at the end of winter.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स जातमन्युः प्रसमीक्ष्य विक्रमं स्थिरं स्थिरस्सम्यति दुर्निवारणम्। समाहितात्मा हनुमन्तमाहवे प्रचोदयामास शरैस्त्रिभि श्शितैः।।5.47.10।।
output: संयति in war, दुर्निवारणम् irresistible, स्थिरम् steady, विक्रमम् valour, प्रसमीक्ष्य recognising, सः that Aksha, जातमन्युः became angry, स्थिरः stable, समाहितात्मा with full attention, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, शितैः with sharp, त्रिभिः with three शरैः  arrows, आहवे in the battle, प्रचोदयामास provoked

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः कपिं तं प्रसमीक्ष्य गर्वितं जितश्रमं शत्रुपराजयोर्जितम्। अवैक्षताक्षस्समुदीर्णमानसस्सबाणपाणिः प्रगृहीतकार्मुकः।।5.47.11।।
output: तः then, सः अक्षः that Aksha, गर्वितम् with pride, शत्रुपराजयोर्जितम् who was intent to conquer the enemy, तं कपिम् him, that Hanuman, जितश्रमम् who conquered, प्रसमीक्ष्य  considered, बाणपाणिः with bow and arrows in hand, प्रगृहीतकार्मुकः holding a bow, समुदीर्णमानसः reflected in his mind, अवैक्षत looked

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स हेमनिष्काङ्गदचारुकुण्डल स्समाससादाऽशुपराक्रमः कपिम्। तयोर्बभूवाप्रतिमस्समागम स्सुरासुराणामपि सम्भ्रमप्रदः।।5.47.12।।
output: Adorned with armlets studded with golden coins and lovely earrings Aksha advanced instantaneously to meet the monkey. Their matchless combat excuitement and enthusiasm even among gods and demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
ररास भूमिर्न तताप भानुमा न्वनौ न वायुः प्रचाचल चाचलः। कपेः कुमारस्य च वीक्ष्य संयुगं ननाद च द्यौरुदधिश्च चुक्षुभे।।5.47.13।।
output: Witnessing the fight between Hanuman and Prince Aksha, even the earth shrieked in agony, the Sun became dim, the wind stopped blowing, mountains were shaken, the sky thundered and even the ocean was agitated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्स वीरस्सुमुखान् पतत्रिणस्सुवर्णपुङ्खान्सविषानिवोरगान्। समाधिसम्योगविमोक्षतत्त्वविच्छरानथ त्रीन्कपिमूर्ध्न्यपातयत्।।5.47.14।।
output: ततः then, अथ there, वीरः hero, समाधिसम्योगविमोक्षतत्त्ववित्  good at targeting and releasing with due concentration, सः he, सुमुखान् of good looking, सुवर्णपुङ्खान् goldenshafted (touching the bowstring), पतत्रिणः  winged arrows with feathers, सविषान् smeared with poison, उरगानिव like serpents, त्रीन् three, शरान् arrows, कपिमूर्ध्नि on the head of the vanara, अपातयत् struck

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तै श्शरैर्मूर्ध्नि समं निपातितैः क्षरन्नसृग्दिग्धविवृत्तलोचनः। नवोदितादित्यनिभ श्शरांशुमान् व्यराजतादित्य इवांशुमालिकः।।5.47.15।।
output: With the three arrows shot on his forehead simultaneously his eyes were drenched with flowing blood and with arrows shining like rays he appeared like the rising Sun, garlanded by glowing rays.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्स पिङ्गाधिपमन्त्रिसत्तमः समीक्ष्य तं राजवरात्मजं रणे। उदग्रचित्रायुधचित्रकार्मुकं जहर्ष चापूर्यत चाहवोन्मुखः।।5.47.16।।
output: Hanuman, the esteemed minister of the copperyeyed Sugriva observed the prince holding manifold splendid weapons. He rejoiced, grew in size ready to fight, making the necessary prepararions (taking the required position).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स मन्दराग्रस्थ इवांशुमालिको विवृद्धकोपो बलवीर्यसंयुतः। कुमारमक्षं सबलं सवाहनं ददाह नेत्राग्निमरीचिभिस्तदा।।5.47.17।।
output: Huge Hanuman, endowed with strength and valour looked  like the rising Sun on the peak of mount Mandara. He looked at prince Aksha and his army as well as his vehicles as though he was burning them with the rays emerging from his fiery eyes.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्स बाणासनचित्रकार्मुक श्शरप्रवर्षो युधि राक्षसाम्बुदः। शरान्मुमोचाशु हरीश्वराचले वलाहको वृष्टिमिवाचलोत्तमे।।5.47.18।।
output: Aksha, with his wonderful quiver and bow, began to rain rapidly a shower of arrows in the battle, on the mountainlike monkeylord just as a cloud rains on a mountain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः कपिस्तं रणचण्डविक्रमं विवृद्धतेजोबलवीर्यसंयुतम्। कुमारमक्षं प्रसमीक्ष्य संयुगे ननाद हर्षाद् घनतुल्यविक्रमम्।।5.47.19।।
output: Then Hanuman saw prince Aksha, endowed with excessive splendour, power and energy advancing in a fierce manner like a cloud in the battle. Then Hanuman happy (to see the heroic prince) roared like a clap of thunder.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स बालभावाद्युधि वीर्यदर्पितः प्रवृद्धमन्युः क्षतजोपमेक्षणः। समाससादाप्रतिमं कपिं रणे गजो महाकूपमिवावृतं तृणैः।।5.47.20।।
output: Young Aksha, proud of his valour with eyes bloodshot in anger rushed towards the matchless Hanuman, just as an elephant would approach a huge pitfall covered with grass.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स तेन बाणैः प्रसभं निपातितैश्चकार नादं घननादनिस्स्वनः। समुत्पपाताशु नभस्स मारुतिर्भुजोरुविक्षेपणघोरदर्शनः।।5.47.21।।
output: Struck by the arrows released by prince Aksha, Hanuman roared violently like a thundering cloud and leaped into the sky  putting up a fierce appearance, stretching his arms and thighs.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समुत्पतन्तं समभिद्रवद्बली स राक्षसानां प्रवरः प्रतापवान्। रथी रथिश्रेष्ठतमः किरन्शरैः पयोधरश्शैलमिवाश्मवृष्टिभिः।।5.47.22।।
output: बली mighty, राक्षसानाम् of the ogres, प्रवरः leader, प्रतापवान् brave, रथी charioteer, रथिश्रेष्ठतमः formost among the best warriors fighting on a chariot, सः that, पयोधरः cloud, अश्मवृष्टिभिः showering of hailstorm, शैलमिव like a mountain, शरैः with arrows, किरन् hitting into the sky, उत्पतन्तम् while leaping, समभिद्रवत् chased

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स तान्शरांस्तस्य हरिर्विमोक्षयंश्चचार वीरः पथि वायुसेविते। शरान्तरे मारुतवद्विनिष्पतन्मनोजवस्संयति चण्डविक्रमः।।5.47.23।।
output: Dodging like the wind  between the arrows and also escaping the arrows Hanuman, who was swift in movement like the mind, was seen exhibiting his terrific valour in the battle while he moved in the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमात्तबाणासनमाहवोन्मुखं खमास्तृणन्तं विशिखैश्शरोत्तमैः। अवैक्षताक्षं बहुमानचक्षुषा जगाम चिन्तां च स मारुतात्मजः।।5.47.24।।
output: सः मारुतात्मजः that son of the Windgod, आत्तबाणासनम् holding a quiver, अहवोन्मुखम् facing the battle, विशिखैः with arrows, शरोत्तमैः with the best of missiles, खम् sky, आस्तृणन्तम् spreading in the sky, तम् him, अक्षम् that Aksha, बहुमानचक्षुषा admiring looks, अवैक्षत saw, चिन्तां च and thought,जगाम arose.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शरैर्भिन्नभुजान्तरः कपिः कुमारवीरेण महात्मना नदन्। महाभुजः कर्मविशेषतत्त्ववि द्विचिन्तयामास रणे पराक्रमम्।।5.47.25।।
output: ततः then, महाभुजः strongarmed one, कर्मविशेषतत्त्ववित् one who knew the propriety of special actions, कपिः monkey, महात्मना by the great self, कुमारवीरेण by the warrior prince, भिन्नभुजान्तरः with his arms wounded, नदन्  roaring, रणे in battle, पराक्रमम् regarding his heroic advances, विचिन्तयामास started rethinking

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
अबालवद्बालदिवाकरप्रभः करोत्ययं कर्म महन्महाबलः। न चास्य सर्वाहवकर्मशोभिनः प्रमापणे मे मतिरत्र जायते।।5.47.26।।
output: 'He (Aksha) is like the radiant, rising Sun with extraordinary might. He is accomplishing great deeds unlike young warriors of his age and is exhibiting a magnificent feat. He knows all means of fighting. I do not feel like cutting him to size. My mind does not allow me to kill this boy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
अयं महात्मा च महांश्च वीर्यत स्समाहितश्चातिसहश्च संयुगे। असंशयं कर्मगुणोदयादयं सनागयक्षैर्मुनिभिश्च पूजितः।।5.47.27।।
output: 'He is a great self. His valour is also admirable. He is focused in battle and highly tolerant. There is no doubt that on account of his excellence  even nagas, yakshas and sages offer salutations to him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
पराक्रमोत्साहविवृद्धमानस स्समीक्षते मां प्रमुखाग्रतःस्थितः। पराक्रमो ह्यस्य मनांसि कम्पयेत्सुरासुराणामपि शीघ्रगामिनः।।5.47.28।।
output: 'His mental horizon is enhanced by his valour and power. He is standing before me and dares to look into my eyes. Surely his swift movement and valour will shake  even the minds of suras and asuras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
न खल्वयं नाभिभवेदुपेक्षितः पराक्रमो ह्यस्य रणे विवर्धते। प्रमापणं त्वेव ममाद्य रोचते न वर्धमानोऽग्निरुपेक्षितुं क्षमः।।5.47.29।।
output: If I ignore him now, he would get the better of me (I have to consider his challenge seriously). His valour in the battle is growing. It is proper to subdue him now. A spreading fire cannot be neglected.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
इति प्रवेगं तु परस्य चिन्तयन्स्वकर्मयोगं च विधाय वीर्यवान्। चकार वेगं तु महाबलस्तदा मतिं च चक्रेऽस्य वधे महाकपिः।।5.47.30।।
output: Reflecting on the power of the enemy, the mighty and valiant vanara thought of his own course of action. Hanuman made up his mind to kill the enemy and increased his speed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तस्य तानष्टहयान्महाजवान् समाहितान्भारसहान्विवर्तने। जघान वीरः पथि वायुसेविते तलप्रहारैः पवनात्मजः कपिः।।5.47.31।।
output: Hanuman the brave son of the Windgod hit with his palm and killed the eight horses (yoked to Aksha's chariot) which had great speed were stable and had the capacity to  bear heavy loads while turning round in the sky. (The battle was fought in the air since Hanuman leaped into the air and the demon hero had to resist him there).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
ततस्तलेनाभिहतो महारथ स्स तस्य पिङ्गाधिपमन्त्रिनिर्जितः। प्रभग्ननीडः परिमुक्तकूबरः पपात भूमौ हतवाजिरम्बरात्।।5.47.32।।
output: Then hit by Hanuman with his palm, the minister of the copperyeyed Sugriva, the huge chariot seat of Aksha was broken, the wooden frame of the yoke was disjointed, horses were  slain and the great chariot fell down from the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स तं परित्यज्य महारथो रथं सकार्मुकः खङ्गधरः खमुत्पतन्। तपोऽभियोगादृषिरुग्रवीर्यवान्विहाय देहं मरुतामिवालयम्।।5.47.33।।
output: (Aksha) the great charioteer abandoned the chariot, held a sword and a bow, and flew up to the region of the sky with his fierce power just as a sage with his fearsome ascetic power ascends to heaven, leaving his body.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः कपिस्तं विचरन्तमम्बरे पतत्रिराजानिलसिद्धसेविते। समेत्य तं मारुततुल्यविक्रमः क्रमेण जग्राह स पादयोर्दृढम्।।5.47.34।।
output: ततः then, मारुततुल्यविक्रमः equal to wind in prowess, कपिः Hanuman, पतत्रिराजानिलसिद्धसेविते in the flying abode of Garuda, Wind and the Siddhas, अम्बरे in the sky, विचरन्तम् while flying, तम् him, समेत्य reached, क्रमेण gradually, तम् him, पादयोः by both his legs, दृढम् firmly, जग्राह caught

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स तं समाविध्य सहस्रशः कपिर्महोरगं गृह्य इवाण्डजेश्वरः। मुमोच वेगात्पितृतुल्यविक्रमो महीतले संयति वानरोत्तमः।।5.47.35।।
output: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras who was equal to his father in valour, seized him just as Garuda, the lord of birds, would seize a great serpent. And spinning him round speedily a thousand times and hitting him, dropped him on the earth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 47:
स भग्नबाहूरुकटीशिरोधरः क्षरन्नसृङिनर्मथितास्थिलोचनः। सम्भग्नसन्धि: प्रविकीर्णबन्धनो हतः क्षितौ वायुसुतेन राक्षसः।।5.47.36।।
output: Hit by Hanuman, the ogre's arms, thighs, hips and neck broken, bones rendered to fragments, eyes protruded, joints disjointed, tendons strewn he was thrown down on the earth dripping blood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महाकपिर्भूमितले निपीड्य तं चकार रक्षोधिपतेर्महद्भयम्। महर्षिभिश्चक्रचरैर्महाव्रतै स्समेत्य भूतैश्च सयक्षपन्नगैः।।5.47.37।। सुरैश्च सेन्द्रैर्भृशजातविस्मयै र्हते कुमारे स कपिर्निरीक्षितः।
output: महाकपिः great vanara, तम् him, भूमितले on the earth, निपीड्य after smashing down, रक्षोधिपतेः of the king of demons, महत् great, भयम् fear, चकार developed, कुमारे when the prince was हते slain, सः कपिः that vanara, भृशजातविस्मयैः who were wonderstruck, चक्रचरैः those who take rounds, महाव्रतैः by those observants of great vows, महर्षिभिः great seers, सयक्षपन्नगैः including yakshas and pannagas, भूतैश्च all beings, सेन्द्रैः including Indra, सुरैश्च and by suras, समेत्य collecting together, निरीक्षितः seen with awe

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निहत्य तं वज्रिसुतोपमप्रभं कुमारमक्षं क्षतजोपमेक्षणम्। तमेव वीरोऽभिजगाम तोरणं कृतक्षणः काल इव प्रजाक्षये।।5.47.38।।
output: Hanuman, the hero with bloodshot eyes having  slain Aksha, shone resplendent like the son of Indra (Jayanta), and reached the portal, and waited looking like the god of death determined to destroy all beings. इत्यार्षे वाल्मीकीये श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
ततस्तु रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा हनूमताक्षे निहते कुमारे। मनस्समाधाय सदेवकल्पं समादिदेशेन्द्रजितं सरोषः।।5.48.1।।
output: Thereafter the great demon king, mighty angry at the death of Aksha in the hands of Hanuman, controlled his feeling and ordered Indrajit who was like a godhead.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वमस्त्रविच्छस्त्रविदां वरिष्ठस्सुरासुराणामपि शोकदाता। सुरेषु सेन्द्रेषु च दृष्टकर्मा पितामहाराधनसञ्चितास्त्रः।।5.48.2।।
output: त्वम् you are, अस्त्रवित् an expert in astras (missiles), शस्त्रविदाम् among the experts in the use of weapons, वरिष्ठः highly efficient, सुरासुराणामपि for suras and asuras also, शोकदाता brought grief, सेन्द्रेषु including Indra, सुरेषु among gods, दृष्टकर्मा a warrior of proven ability, पितामहाराधनसञ्चितास्त्रः propitiating grand father Brahma acquired many missiles.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
तवास्त्रबलमासाद्य ससुराः समरुद्गणाः। न शेकुस्समरे स्थातुं सुरेश्वरसमाश्रिताः।।5.48.3।।
output: "None could face you in war including Indra, Maruts and gods because of your skill and the power of your astras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न कश्चित्त्रिषु लोकेषु संयुगेन गतश्रमः। भुजवीर्याभिगुप्तश्च तपसा चाभिरक्षितः।।5.48.4।। देशकालविभागज्ञस्त्वमेव मतिसत्तमः।
output: संयुगेन in war, गतश्रमः not experienced fatigue, कश्चित् some one, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds,न not, मतिसत्तमः most intelligent, त्वमेव you alone, भुजवीर्याभिगुप्तश्च protected by the strength of your arms, तपसा with the power of austerity, अभिरक्षितः  wellprotected, देशकालविभागज्ञः aware of the proper place and time of action.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न तेऽस्त्यशक्यं समरेषु कर्मणा न तेऽस्त्यकार्यं मतिपूर्वमन्त्रणे। न सोऽस्ति कश्चित्त्रिषु सङ्ग्रहेषु वै न वेद यस्तेऽस्त्रबलं बलं च ते।।5.48.5।।
output: समरेषु in war, कर्मणा by the task, ते to you, अशक्यम् not possible, नास्ति there is nothing, मतिपूर्वमन्त्रणे wise counsel, ते to you, अकार्यम् impossible act, नास्ति not, त्रिषु in the three, सङ्ग्रहेषु in making by mantra an astra return, यः such a person, ते to you, अस्त्रबलम् strength of your weapons, ते बलं च your own strength, न वेद does not know, सः he, कश्चित् none, नास्ति not.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
ममानुरूपं तपसो बलं च ते पराक्रमश्चास्त्रबलं च संयुगे। न त्वां समासाद्य रणावमर्दे मनश्श्रमं गच्छति निश्चितार्थम्।।5.48.6।।
output: "The power of your penance, your valour and your ability to discharge astras in war is equal only to mine. I am not bothered about the consequences of war you wage because your victory is certain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निहताः किङ्करास्सर्वे जम्बुमाली च राक्षसः। अमात्यपुत्रा वीराश्च पञ्च सेनाग्रयायिनः।।5.48.7।। बलानि सुसमृद्धानि साश्वनागरथानि च।
output: सर्वे all, किङ्कराः kinkaras, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, राक्षसश्च ogres also, वीराः heroes, अमात्यपुत्राः sons of ministers, पञ्च five, सेनाग्रयायिनः army generals, निहताः killed, सुसमृद्धानि well equipped, साश्वनागरथानि च including horses, elephants and chariots, बलानि च armies also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सहोदरस्ते दयितः कुमारोऽक्षश्च सूदितः।।5.48.8।। न हि तेष्वेव मे सारो यस्त्वय्यरिनिषूदन।
output: "Your dear young brother Aksha is killed. O scourage of enemies I do not have the faith in them as I have in you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
इदं हि दृष्ट्वा मतिमन्महद्बलं कपेः प्रभावं च पराक्रमं च। त्वमात्मनश्चापि समीक्ष्य सारं कुरुष्व वेगं स्वबलानुरूपम्।।5.48.9।।
output: "O intelligent warrior measure the  strength, power and valour of the monkey and  your own strength carefully. Exercise your own strength and speed accordingly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बलावमर्थस्तयि सन्निकृष्टे यथा गते शाम्यति शान्तशत्रौ। तथा समीक्ष्यात्मबलं परं च समारभस्वास्त्रविदां वरिष्ठ।।5.48.10।।
output: "O  warrior of extraordinary merit among the wielders of astras  asses your strength approach the enemy in a manner by which he is subdued without causing further destruction to our army. Carefully measure your own strength and your enemy's  before you start fighting.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
न वीरसेना गणशोच्यवन्ति न वज्रमादाय विशालसारम्। न मारुतस्यास्य गतेः प्रमाणं न चाग्निकल्पः करणेन हन्तुम्।।5.48.11।।
output: "O hero take no large army as it is futile with this monkey endowed with extraordinary vigour. Even a thunderbolt can do nothing. He is like the wind and has no match in speed. He is like the sacrificial fire who cannot be destroyed by weapons.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमेवमर्थं प्रसमीक्ष्य सम्यक् स्वकर्मसाम्याद्धि समाहितात्मा। स्मरंश्च दिव्यं धनुषोऽस्त्रवीर्यं व्रजाक्षतं कर्म समारभस्व।।5.48.12।।
output: तम् him, एवम् in that way, अर्थम् matter, सम्यक् properly, प्रसमीक्ष्य assess, स्वकर्मसाम्यात् person of good judgement, समाहितात्मा with singleminded attention, धनुषः of the bow, दिव्यम् divine, अस्त्रवीर्यम् strength of your astras, स्मरंश्च recollecting, व्रज move, कर्म the act, अक्षतम् without being destroyed in the middle, समारभस्व start.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न खल्वियं मतिश्श्रेष्ठा यत्त्वां सम्प्रेषयाम्यहम्। इयं च राजधर्माणां क्षत्रियस्य मतिर्मता।।5.48.13।।
output: अहम् I, त्वाम् you, सम्प्रेषयामि इति यत् this way sending you to war is not good, इयं मतिः this I think, श्रेष्ठा the best, न खलु not certainly, इयम् this, राजधर्माणाम् in accordance with state craft, क्षत्रियस्य for a kshatriya, मतिः thought, मता approved.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नानाशस्त्रेषु सङ्ग्रामे वैशारद्यमरिन्दम। अवश्यमेव बोद्धव्यं काम्यश्च विजयो रणे।।5.48.14।।
output: अरिंदम subduer of foes, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, नानाशस्त्रेषु with many kinds of weapons, वैशारद्यम् efficient, अवश्यमेव ultimately, बोद्धव्यम् aware, रणे in war, विजयश्च only victory, काम्यः seek.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः पितुस्तद्वचनं निशम्य प्रदक्षिणं दक्षसुतप्रभावः। चकार भर्तारमदीनसत्त्वो रणाय वीरः प्रतिपन्नबुद्धिः।।5.48.15।।
output: Hearing the father's words (of exhortation), he, who is never distressed at the prospect of war decided to seek the battle as he was powerful like the son of Daksha, and went round his father with respect.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
ततस्तै स्स्वगणैरिष्टैरिन्द्रजित् प्रतिपूजितः। युद्धोद्धतः कृतोत्साहस्सङ्ग्रामं प्रत्यपद्यत।।5.48.16।।
output: Having been honoured by his own kith and kin who loved him, Indrajit rushed forth for war with martial vigour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
श्रीमान्पद्मपलाशाक्षो राक्षसाधिपतेस्सुतः। निर्जगाम महातेजास्समुद्र इव पर्वसु।।5.48.17।।
output: When the illustrious son of Ravana, the highly Indrajit resplendent with eyes of lotus petals marched ahead he looked like the turbulent ocean on a fullmoon day.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स पक्षिराजोपमतुल्यवेगैर्व्याळैश्चतुर्भिः सिततीक्षणदंष्ट्रैः। रथं समायुक्तमसहयवेगं समारुरोहेन्द्रजिदिन्द्रकल्पः।।5.48.18।।
