output: Like Indra, Indrajit ascended the chariot (which had the standard of Indra as it was seized from him as a token of his having conquered Indra) yoked to four sharptoothed tigers. It moved in swiftness vying with Garuda, the king of birds in speed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
स रथी धन्विनां श्रेष्ठः शस्त्रज्ञोस्त्रविदां वरः। रथेनाभिययौ क्षिप्रं हनुमान्यत्र सोऽभवत्।।5.48.19।।
output: Mounted on the chariot, Indrajit, the best in archery and an expert in weaponry went quickly to the place where that great Hanuman was stationed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तस्य रथनिर्घोषं ज्यास्वनं कार्मुकस्य च। निशम्य हरिवीरोऽसौ संप्रहृष्टतरोऽभवत्।।5.48.20।।
output: The leader of the monkey also became happier on hearing the rumbling (of the chariot) and the twang of Indrajit's bowstring.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुमहच्चापमादाय शितशल्यांश्च सायकान्। हनुमन्तमभिप्रेत्य जगाम रणपण्डितः।।5.48.21।।
output: Indrajit who was an adept in warfare, picked his highly powerful bow and aimed his sharpedged arrow at Hanuman.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
तस्मिंस्ततः संयति जातहर्षे रणाय निर्गच्छति चापपाणौ। दिशश्च सर्वाः कलुषा बभूवु र्मृगाश्च रौद्रा बहुधा विनेदुः।।5.48.22।।
output: When he sallied forth happily holding a bow full of passion for war, darkness prevailed in all quarters and it became gloomy. Beasts began to howl in various frightful ways.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समागतास्तत्र तु नागयक्षा महर्षयश्चक्रचराश्च सिद्धाः। नभस्समावृत्य च पक्षिसङ्घा विनेदुरुच्चैः परमप्रहृष्टाः।।5.48.23।।
output: तत्र there, समागताः having assembled, नागयक्षाः Nagas and Yakshas, चक्रचराः those who go round the orbits, महर्षयः seers, सिद्धाश्च Siddhas, पक्षिसङ्घाः flocks of birds, नभः in the sky, समावृत्य  collected, परमप्रहृष्टाः very happy, उच्चैः loudly, विनेदुः screeched

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
आयान्तं सरथं दृष्ट्वा तूर्णमिन्द्रजितं कपिः। विननाद महानादं व्यवर्धत च वेगवान्।।5.48.24।।
output: Hanuman of very high speed enlarged his body and roared, perceiving Indrajit's chariot coming swiftly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इन्द्रजित्तु रथं दिव्यमास्थितश्चित्रकार्मुकः। धनुर्विष्फारयामास तटिदूर्जितन्निस्स्वनम्।।5.48.25।।
output: इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajit on his part, दिव्यम् divine, रथम् chariot, आस्थितः seated, चित्रकार्मुकः wonderful bow, तटिदूर्जितन्निस्स्वनम् rumbling with lightning speed, धनुः bow, विष्फारयामास twanged

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्समेतावतितीक्ष्णवेगौ महाबलौ तौ रणनिर्विशङ्कौ। कपिश्च रक्षोधिपतेस्तनूजः सुरासुरेन्द्राविव बद्धवैरौ।।5.48.26।।
output: Then the son of the demon king and Hanuman, both very fast in speed, mighty and powerful, fearless in war and like sura and asura closed in upon each other.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
स तस्य वीरस्य महारथस्य धनुष्मतः संयति सम्मतस्य। शरप्रवेगं व्यहनत्प्रवृद्ध श्चचार मार्गे पितुरप्रमेयः।।5.48.27।।
output: Hanuman of immeasurable strength heaved himself to a huge proprtion and went moving on the path of his father (windgod) rendering useless the extraordinary speed of the arrows of Indrajit, who was great in chariot warfare, and an efficient archer.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शरानायततीक्ष्णशल्यान् सुपत्रिणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खान्। मुमोच वीरः परवीरहन्ता सुसन्नतान् वज्रनिपातवेगान्।।5.48.28।।
output: ततः then, परवीरहन्ता a slayer of enemy warriors, वीरः hero, आयततीक्षणशल्यान् long and sharppointed arrows, सुपत्रिणः with fine feathers, काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्स्वा with gold tips touching the bowstring, सुसन्नतान् a little bent at the tips, वज्रनिपातवेगान् which had the speed of lightning, शरान् arrows, मुमोच discharged

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तु तत्स्यन्दननिस्स्वनं च मृदङ्गभेरीपटहस्वनं च। विकृष्यमाणस्य च कार्मुकस्य निशम्य घोषं पुनरुत्पपात।।5.48.29।।
output: Thereupon, hearing the rumbling of the chariot, the sounds of mrudangas, bheris, and patahas drawing towards him, and percieving the loud twang of the bow (of Indrajit) Hanuman sprang up again.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शराणामन्तरेष्वाशु व्यवर्तत महाकपिः। हरिस्तस्याभिलक्ष्यस्य मोघयन्लक्ष्यसंग्रहम्।।5.48.30।।
output: महाकपिः great monkey, हरिः tawny one, आशु quickly, अभिलक्ष्यस्य aiming at target, तस्य his, लक्ष्यसंग्रहम् hosts of aims, मोघयन् while rendering futile, शराणाम् arrows,अन्तरेषु between spaces, व्यवर्तत moved

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शराणामग्रतस्तस्य पुनः समभिवर्तत। प्रसार्य हस्तौ हनुमानुत्पपातानिलात्मजः।।5.48.31।।
output: Hanuman, son of the Windgod again stood facing the arrows directly stretching his hands and jumped (into the air).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तावुभौ वेगसम्पन्नौ रणकर्मविशारदौ। सर्वभूतमनोग्राहि चक्रतुर्युद्धमुत्तमम्।।5.48.32।।
output: वेगसम्पन्नौ both endowed with speed, रणकर्मविशारदौ two experts in warfare, तौ उभौ both, सर्वभूतमनोग्राहिf  captivated the minds of all creatures,उत्तमम् best, युद्धम् war, चक्रतुः fought

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हनुमतो वेद न राक्षसोऽन्तरं न मारुतिस्तस्य महात्मनोऽन्तरम्। परस्परं निर्विषहौ बभूवतुः समेत्य तौ देवसमानविक्रमौ।।5.48.33।।
output: राक्षसः giant, हनूमतः of Hanuman, अन्तरम् way to hit, न वेद did not know, मारुतिः Maruti, महात्मनः of the great self, तस्य his, न not, देवसमानविक्रमौ equal to gods in valour, तौ both, समेत्य met, परस्परम् with each other, निर्विषहौ unable to bear with each other, बभूवतुः became.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
ततस्तु लक्ष्ये स विहन्यमाने शरेष्वमोघेषु च संपतत्सु। जगाम चिन्तां महतीं महात्मा समाधिसंयोगसमाहितात्मा।।5.48.34।।
output: Indrajit's infallible arrows missed Hanuman. Then the great warrior became perplexed and started thinking seriously within himself entering into a reflective mood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो मतिं राक्षसराजसूनु श्चकार तस्मिन् हरिवीरमुख्ये। अवध्यतां तस्य कपेस्समीक्ष्य कथं निगच्छेदिति निग्रहार्थम्।।5.48.35।।
output: Then Indrajit, son of the demon king, thinking that a vanara should not be killed started considering other means of catching hm.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
ततः पैतामहं वीरः सोऽस्त्रमस्त्रविदां वरः। संदधे सुमहत्तेजा: तं हरिप्रवरं प्रति।।5.48.36।।
output: Then the heroic master of weapons, an excellent and glorious warrior directed the  Brahmastram towards the foremost of monkeys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवध्योऽयमिति ज्ञात्वा तमस्त्रेणास्त्रतत्त्ववित्। निजग्राह महाबाहुर्मारुतात्मजमिन्द्रजित्।।5.48.37।।
output: Indrajit, the strongarmed hero, who knew the secrets of all missiles, realising that the son of the Windgod cannot be killed caught him by the divine weapon of Brahma (Brahmastram).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
तेन बद्धस्ततोऽस्त्रेण राक्षसेन स वानरः। अभवन्निर्विचेष्टश्च पपात स महीतले ।।5.48.38।।
output: Then Hanuman bound by the weapon of the demon was unable to move and fell on the ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोऽथ बुद्ध्वा स तदस्त्रबन्धं प्रभोः प्रभावाद्विगतात्मवेगः। पितामहानुग्रहमात्मनश्च विचिन्तयामास हरिप्रवीरः।।5.48.39।।
output: ततः then, अथ and, सः हरिप्रवीरः that monkey leader, तदस्त्रबन्धंम् bond of that astram, बुद्ध्वा after realising, प्रभोः of the Lord, प्रभावात् by the grace, विगतात्मवेगः finding his speed arrested, आत्मनः for me, पितामहानुग्रहम् the boon of lord Brahma, विचिन्तयामास started thinking

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत स्स्वायम्बुवैर्मन्त्रैर्ब्रह्मास्त्रमभिमन्त्रितम्। हनुमांश्चिन्तयामास वरदानं पितामहात्।।5.48.40।।
output: Hanuman realised that it was by invoking creator Brahma and applying the mantra that he was caught by Brahmastram. On that occasion he started thinking of the boon given to him  by Grandsire Brahma :

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न मेऽस्त्रबन्धस्य च शक्तिरस्ति विमोक्षणे लोकगुरोः प्रभावात्। इत्येव मत्वा विहितोऽस्त्रबन्धो मयात्मयोनेरनुवर्तितव्यः।।5.48.41।।
output: 'I deem it an effect of the power of Brahma. It is not possiblle for me to free myself due to the power of the great lord presiding over the universe through the astra. It should be obeyed'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
स वीर्यमस्त्रस्य कपिर्विचार्य पितामहानुग्रहमात्मनश्च। विमोक्षशक्तिं परिचिन्तयित्वा पितामहाज्ञामनुवर्तते स्म।।5.48.42।।
output: Reflecting within himself about the power of the astra, Hanuman recalled Braham's favour to him. He recalled his own power to liberate himself from the Brahmastra and resolved to abide by the order of Brahma.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्त्रेणापि हि बद्धस्य भयं मम न जायते। पितामहमहेन्द्राभ्यां रक्षितस्यानिलेन च।।5.48.43।।
output: पितामहमहेन्द्राभ्याम् both by Brahma and Indra, अनिलेन च and by the Windgod, रक्षितस्य for me being protected, मे to me, अस्त्रेण by astra, बद्धस्यापि even though bound, भयम् fear, न जायते not having

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
ग्रहणे चापि रक्षोभिर्महन्मे गुणदर्शनम्। राक्षसेन्द्रेण संवादस्तस्माद्गृह्णन्तु मां परे।।5.48.44।।
output: 'If I am caught by the demon I will have the opportunity to see the demon lord. Therefore, let me be caught by my enemies'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स निश्चितार्थः परवीरहन्ता समीक्ष्यकारी विनिवृत्तचेष्टः। परैः प्रसह्याभिगतैर्निगृह्य ननाद तैस्त्रै: परिभर्त्स्यमानः।।5.48.45।।
output: Hanuman, a destroyer of enemies, who assesses before he acts, resolved (to submit to the ordinance of Brahma), to be silent (the power of his movement affected). When the enemy forces came to him slowly and slowly, siezed him forcibly and abused him, he roared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तं राक्षसा दृष्ट्वा निर्विचेष्टमरिंदमम्। बबन्धुश्शणवल्कैश्च द्रुमचीरैश्च संहतैः।।5.48.46।।
output: ततः then, राक्षसाः the ogres, अरिंदमम् subduer of enemies, तम् him, निर्विचेष्टम् refrained from moving, दृष्टवा seeing, शणवल्कैश्च with hemp rope, संहतैः firmly knit together, द्रुमचीरैश्च  by bark robes, बबन्धु  tied

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
स रोचयामास परैश्च बन्धनं प्रसह्य वीरैरभिनिग्रहं च। कौतूहलान्मां यदि राक्षसेन्द्रो द्रष्टुं व्यवस्येदिति निश्चितार्थः।।5.48.47।।
output: Bound by the enemy warriors, Hanuman, decided to bear all humiliations, thinking, 'May be the demon king might come to see me out of curiosity if he is so disposed'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
स बद्धस्तेन वल्केन विमुक्तोऽस्त्रेण वीर्यवान्। अस्त्रबन्धः स चान्यं हि न बन्धमनुवर्तते।।5.48.48।।
output: On being bound by bark ropes Hanuman was set free from the bond of Brahmastra, since  the bondage of Brahmastra does not tolerate another ordinary bondage.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
अथेन्द्रजित्तु द्रुमचीरबद्धं विचार्य वीरः कपिसत्तमं तम्। विमुक्तमस्त्रेण जगाम चिन्तां नान्येन बद्धो ह्यनुवर्ततेऽस्त्रम्।।5.48.49।।
output: Then the heroic Indrajit coming to know that the foremost of the monkeys bound by bark ropes was released from the bondage of Brahmastra, thought, 'indeed the divine weapon does not tolerate other bonds, so the vanara is released'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहो महत्कर्म कृतं निरर्थकम्कं न राक्षसैर्मन्त्रगतिर्विमृष्टा। पुनश्च मन्त्रे विहतेऽस्त्रमन्यत्प्रवर्तते संशयिता स्स्मसर्वे।।5.48.50।।
output: 'Alas! my achievement has been wasted. The ogres had not considered the impact of the mantra of astra . Once the Brahmastra is ineffective another astra cannot be operative again. We are all running a risk.'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
अस्त्रेण हनुमान्मुक्तो नात्मानमवबुध्यत। कृष्यमाणस्तु रक्षोभि स्तौश्च बन्धैर्निपीडितः।।5.48.51।।
output: Though binding and dragging by the ogres had hurt Hanuman, he on his part did not know that he had been released from Brahmastra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हन्यमानस्ततः क्रूरै राक्षसैः काष्ठमुष्टिभिः। समीपं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य प्राकृष्यत स वानरः।।5.48.52।।
output: ततः then, सः वानरः that vanara, क्रूरैः by the cruel ones, राक्षसैः by rakshasas, काष्ठमुष्टिभिः  with sticks and fists, हन्यमानः  beaten, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य to the lord of rakshasas, समीपम् near, प्राकृष्यत was dragged

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
अथेन्द्रजित्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य मुक्तमस्त्रेण बद्धं द्रुमचीरसूत्रैः। न्यदर्शयत्तत्र महाबलं तं हरिप्रवीरं सगणाय राज्ञे।।5.48.53।।
output: Then Indarjit, seeing the powerful Hanuman, the foremost of monkeys who was released from the Brahmastra, still bound by bark ropes, presented him to the ogres and their master in the royal assembly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं मत्तमिव मातङ्गं बद्धं कपिवरोत्तमम्। राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्राय रावणाय न्यवेदयन्।।5.48.54।।
output: मत्तम् in rut, मातङ्गमिव elephant like, बद्धम् bound, कपिवरोत्तमम् best of monkeys, तम् him, राक्षसाः ogres, राक्षसेन्द्राय to the demon king, रावणाय to Ravana, न्यवेदयन् presented

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
कोऽयं कस्य कुतोवात्र किं कार्यं को व्यपाश्रयः। इति राक्षसवीराणां तत्र सञ्जज्ञिरे कथाः।।5.48.55।।
output: "Who is he? Whose son is he? Why has he come here? Where has he come from? What business does he have here?" Thus the heroic demons talked among themselves.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हन्यतां दह्यतां वापि भक्ष्यतामिति चापरे। राक्षसास्तत्र सङ्क्रुद्धा: परस्परमथाब्रुवन्।।5.48.56।।
output: अथ and then, अपरे others, राक्षसाः rakshasas, सङ्कृद्धाः very angry, हन्यताम् kill him, दह्यतां चापि he may be burnt also, भक्ष्यताम् devoure, इति this way, परस्परम् one another, अब्रुवन् spoke

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 48:
अतीत्य मार्गं सहसा महात्मा स तत्र रक्षोधिपपादमूले। ददर्श राज्ञः परिचारवृद्धान् गृहं महारत्नविभूषितं च।।5.48.57।।
output: The great Hanuman moving quickly and crossing the path came near the feet of the king. He saw the aged and experienced ministers of the king and the palace of the king adorned with precious gems.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स ददर्श महातेजा रावणः कपिसत्तमम्। रक्षोभिर्विकृताकारैः कृष्यमाणमितस्ततः।।5.48.58।।
output: महातेजाः resplendent one, सः रावणः that Ravana, विकृताकारैः by ugly looking ones, रक्षोभिः by the rakshasas, इतस्ततः here and there, कृष्यमाणम् being dragged, कपिसत्तमम्  foremost monkey, ददर्श saw

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसाधिपतिं चापि ददर्श कपिसत्तमः। तेजोबलसमायुक्तं तपन्तमिव भास्करम्।।5.48.59।।
output: Hanuman the best of monkeys also saw the demon king who had both splendour and strength, radiating brilliance like the Sun.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सरोषसम्वर्तितताम्रदृष्टिर्दशाननस्तं कपिमन्ववेक्ष्य। अथोपविष्टान् कुलशीलवृद्धान् समादिशत्तं प्रति मन्त्रिमुख्यान्।।5.48.60।।
output: सः दशाननः that tenheaded one, रोषसम्वर्तितताम्रदृष्टिः  his red eyes rolling in  rage, तं कपिम् him the monkey, अन्ववेक्ष्य observing unwinkingly, अथ and then, उपविष्टान् seated, कुलशीलवृद्धान् noble and aged members of his clan, मन्त्रिमुख्यान् important ministers, तं प्रति with regard to him, समादिशत् ordered

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथाक्रमं तैस्स कपिर्विपृष्टः कार्यार्थमर्धस्य च मूलमादौ। निवेदयामास हरीश्वरस्य दूतः सकाशादहमागतोऽस्मि।।5.48.61।।
output: तैः by those, यथाक्रमम् in a proper order, कार्यार्थम् purpose, अर्धस्य of the purpose, मूलम् origin, विपृष्टः  questioned, सः कपिः that monkey, हरीश्वरस्य सकाशात्  a messsenger of the king of monkeys, सकाशात from his place, आगतः अस्मि I came,  निवेदयामास he reported

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 49:
ततस्स कर्मणा तस्य विस्मितो भीमविक्रमः। हनुमान्रोषताम्राक्षो रक्षोधिपमवैक्षत।।5.49.1।।
output: The highly courageous Hanuman, astonished at  the  action (of binding and dragging him to the court) by the demon king looked at him with eyes turned red in anger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भ्राजमानं महार्हेण काञ्चनेन विराजता। मुक्ताजालावृतेनाथ मकुटेन महाद्युतिम्।।5.49.2।।
output: महार्हेण of innate splendour, काञ्चनेन with a golden, विराजता shining, अथ and, मुक्ताजालावृतेन covered with strings of pearls, मकुटेन with crown, भ्राजमानम् shining, महाद्युतिम् glittering.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वज्रसंयोगसंयुक्तैर्महार्हमणिविग्रहैः। हैमैराभरणैश्चित्रैर्मनसेव प्रकल्पितैः।।5.49.3।।
output: He was decked with wonderful golden ornaments studded with diamonds and had small motifs of precious gems fixed to them. They were as though designed by imagination. (An ornament made with the hand connot be so fine and delicate.)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महार्हक्षौमसंवीतं रक्तचन्दनरूषितम्। स्वानुलिप्तं विचित्राभिर्विविधाभिश्च भक्तिभिः।।5.49.4।।
output: He was dressed in exquisite silk and smeared with red sandal paste and had many ornamental designs drawn on his body with fragrant unguents.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विचित्रैर्दर्शनीयैश्च रक्ताक्षैर्भीमदर्शनैः। दीप्ततीक्ष्णमहादंष्ट्रैः प्रलम्बदशनच्छदैः।।5.49.5।। शिरोभिर्दशभिर्वीरं भ्राजमानं महौजसम्। नानाव्यालसमाकीर्णैश्शिखरैरिव मन्दरम्।।5.49.6।।
output: दर्शनीयैः appeared, रक्ताक्षैः with bloodred eyes, भीमदर्शनैः with terrible looks, दीप्ततीक्ष्णमहादंष्ट्रैः with shining sharp big teeth, प्रलम्बदशनच्छदैः with drooping lips, दशभिः with ten, शिरोभिः with heads, विचित्रैः wonderful, नानाव्यालसमाकीर्णैः with different kinds of beasts, शिखरैः with peaks, मन्दरम् इव like Mandara mountain, भ्राजमानं splendid, महौजसम् lustrous, वीरम् hero.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विचित्रैर्दर्शनीयैश्च रक्ताक्षैर्भीमदर्शनैः। दीप्ततीक्ष्णमहादंष्ट्रैः प्रलम्बदशनच्छदैः।।5.49.5।। शिरोभिर्दशभिर्वीरं भ्राजमानं महौजसम्। नानाव्यालसमाकीर्णैश्शिखरैरिव मन्दरम्।।5.49.6।।
output: He appeared terrible with bloodred eyes, shining sharp big teeth, drooping lips and ten heads, which looked like ten peaks of mountain Mandara inhabited by various beasts. He was heroic, powerful and splendid.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नीलाञ्जनचयप्रख्यं हारेणोरसि राजता। पूर्णचन्द्राभवक्त्रेण सबलाकमिवाम्बुदम्।।5.49.7।।
output: नीलाञ्जनचयप्रख्यम् like a black mountain of collyrium, उरसि on the chest, राजता by the illumining, हारेण with a pearl necklace, पूर्णचन्द्राभवक्त्रेण with a face like the fullmoon, बलाकम् with cranes around, अम्बुदमिव like a cloud.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाहुभिर्बद्धकेयूरैश्चन्दनोत्तमरूषितैः। भ्राजमानाङ्गदैः पीनैः पञ्चशीर्षैरिवोरगैः।।5.49.8।।
output: Adorned with armlets (keyura), smeared with choicest sandal paste, his shining, stout armlets appeared like many fivehooded serpents (fingers appearing like hoods).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 49:
महतिस्फाटिके चित्रे रत्नसंयोगसंस्कृते। उत्तमास्तरणास्तीर्णे सूपविष्टं वरासने।।5.49.9।।
output: (He was) seated on a huge magnificent throne of crystal encrusted with precious stones and overspread with a wonderful carpet.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 49:
अलङ्कृताभिरत्यर्थं प्रमदाभिः समन्ततः। वालव्यजनहस्ताभिरारात्समुपसेवितम्।।5.49.10।।
output: Young and beautiful girls decorated exceedingly well holding whisks all over the vicinity attended on him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दुर्धरेण प्रहस्तेन महापार्श्वेन रक्षसा। मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रतत्त्वज्ञैर्निकुम्भेन च मन्त्रिणा।।5.49.11।। सुखोपविष्टं रक्षोभिश्चतुर्भिर्बलदर्पितैः। कृत्स्नं परिवृतं लोकं चतुर्भिरिव सागरैः।।5.49.12।।
output: He was attended by Durdhara, Prahasta, Mahaparsva and Nikumbha who were his learned ministers. Seated comfortably and attended by the four arrogant ministers, he was puffed with pride of their strength and appeared like the entire world surrounded by four oceans.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दुर्धरेण प्रहस्तेन महापार्श्वेन रक्षसा। मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रतत्त्वज्ञैर्निकुम्भेन च मन्त्रिणा।।5.49.11।। सुखोपविष्टं रक्षोभिश्चतुर्भिर्बलदर्पितैः। कृत्स्नं परिवृतं लोकं चतुर्भिरिव सागरैः।।5.49.12।।
output: He was attended by Durdhara, Prahasta, Mahaparsva and Nikumbha who were his learned ministers. Seated comfortably and attended by the four arrogant ministers, he was puffed with pride of their strength and appeared like the entire world surrounded by four oceans.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मन्त्रिभिर्मन्त्रतत्त्वज्ञैरन्यैश्च शुभबुद्धिभिः। अन्वास्यमानं रक्षोभिः सुरैरिव सुरेश्वरम्।।5.49.13।।
output: He was attended by ogres including ministers who were intellectuals and adept in counselling. He appeared like lord Indra attended by the gods.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अपश्यद्राक्षसपतिं हनुमानतितेजसम्। विष्ठितं मेरुशिखरे सतोयमिव तोयदम्।।5.49.14।।
output: हनुमान् Hanuman, अतितेजसम् highly resplendent, मेरुशिखरे on the peak of mount Meru, विष्ठितम् seated, सतोयम् laden with water, तोयदम् इव like cloud, राक्षसपतिम् demon king, अपश्यत् saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तैस्सम्पीड्यमानोऽपि रक्षोभिर्भीमविक्रमैः। विस्मयं परमं गत्वा रक्षोधिपमवैक्षत।।5.49.15।।
output: Hanuman looked at the demon king with great amazement even while he was dealt harshly by the demons of fierce valour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 49:
भ्राजमानं ततो दृष्ट्वा हनुमान्राक्षसेश्वरम्। मनसा चिन्तयामास तेजसा तस्य मोहितः।।5.49.16।।
output: Seeing the splendour of the lord of demons, Hanuman was dimayed and started thinking thus:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहो रूपमहो धैर्यमहो सत्त्वमहो द्युतिः। अहो राक्षसराजस्य सर्वलक्षणयुक्तता।।5.49.17।।
output: 'Oh what charm what courage what strength what splendour How great is this demonking, an endowment of all merits.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 49:
यद्यधर्मो न बलवान् स्यादयं राक्षसेश्वरः। स्यादयं सुरलोकस्य सशक्रस्यापि रक्षिता।।5.49.18।।
output: 'If only this lord of demons was not unrighteous, he could have become even the lord (protector) of gods including Indra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 49:
अस्य क्रूरैर्नृशंसैश्च कर्मभिर्लोककुत्सितैः। सर्वे बिभ्यति खल्वस्माल्लोकास्सामरदानवाः।।5.49.19।। अयं ह्युत्सहते क्रुद्धः कर्तुमेकार्णवं जगत्।
output: 'This Ravana has done many cruel, fierce and contemptible deeds. That is why even the demons, gods and all the people of this world get scared of him. He will render the entire world into a single ocean when he turns angry'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इति चिन्तां बहुविधामकरोन्मतिमान् हरिः।।5.49.20।। दृष्ट्वा राक्षसराजस्य प्रभावममितौजसः।
output: Many such thoughts crossed Hanuman's intelligent mind on seeing Ravana's brilliance and power. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमुद्वीक्ष्य महाबाहुः पिङ्गाक्षं पुरत स्थितम्। कोपेन महताऽविष्टो रावणो लोकरावणः।।5.50.1।। शङ्काहृतात्मा दध्यौ स कपीन्द्रं तेजसावृतम्।
output: On the command of Ravana Prahasta enquires Hanuman the purpose of his visit -- Hanuman reveals that he is a vanara and a messenger of Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किमेष भगवान्नन्दी भवेत्साक्षादिहागतः।।5.50.2।। येन शप्तोऽस्मि कैलासे मया सञ्चालिते पुरा। सोऽयं वानरमूर्तिस्स्यात्किंस्विद्बाणो महाऽसुरः।।5.50.3।।
output: 'Is he Lord Nandi who came here in person? I was earlier cursed by him when I shook the mount Kailasa in the past. Could he have assumed a monkeyform or may be he is the great demon Bana. (Nandi is the bull, the vehicle of Lord Siva).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किमेष भगवान्नन्दी भवेत्साक्षादिहागतः।।5.50.2।। येन शप्तोऽस्मि कैलासे मया सञ्चालिते पुरा। सोऽयं वानरमूर्तिस्स्यात्किंस्विद्बाणो महाऽसुरः।।5.50.3।।
output: 'Is he Lord Nandi who came here in person? I was earlier cursed by him when I shook the mount Kailasa in the past. Could he have assumed a monkeyform or may be he is the great demon Bana. (Nandi is the bull, the vehicle of Lord Siva).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 50:
स राजा रोषताम्राक्षः प्रहस्तं मन्त्रिसत्तमम्। कालयुक्तमुवाचेदं वचोऽविपुलमर्थवत्।।5.50.4।।
output: The infuriated demon king told the great minister Prahasta, these  profound words in a brief manner appropriate to the hour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 50:
दुरात्मा पृच्छ्यतामेष कुतः किं वात्र कारणम्। वनभङ्गे च कोऽस्यार्थो राक्षसीनां च तर्जने।।5.50.5।।
output: "Enquire from this wicked one, why he has come and from where, Why he destroyed the garden and for what purpose he threatened the demonesses?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 50:
मत्पुरीमप्रधृष्यां वाऽगमने किं प्रयोजनम्। आयोधने वा किं कार्यं पृच्छयतामेष दुर्मतिः।।5.50.6।।
output: "Enquire why this wicked one entered this inviolable city and for what purpose did he wage a war"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा प्रहस्तो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते न भीः कार्या त्वया कपे।।5.50.7।।
output: प्रहस्तः Prahasta, रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, कपे O monkey, समाश्वसिहि be relaxed, ते भद्रम् feel safe, त्वया you, भीः न कार्या need not entertain fear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदि तावत्त्वमिन्द्रेण प्रेषितो रावणालयम्। तत्त्वमाख्याहि मा भूत्ते भयं वानर मोक्ष्यसे।।5.50.8।।
output: वानर O vanara, त्वम् you, इन्द्रेण by Indra, रावणालयम् to the abode of Ravana, प्रेषितः यदि तावत् if you are sent, तत्त्वम् truth, आख्याहि you may tell, ते to you, भयम् माभूत् be not afraid, मोक्ष्यसे you will be released.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदि वैश्रवणस्य त्वं यमस्य वरुणस्य च। चाररूपमिदं कृत्वा प्रविष्टो नः पुरीमिमाम्।।5.50.9।। विष्णुना प्रेषितो वाऽपि दूतो विजयकाङ्क्षिणा।
output: इदम् this, चाररूपम् charming appearance, कृत्वा after assuming, नः our, इमां पुरीम् this city, प्रविष्टः entered, त्वम् you, वैश्रवणस्य Vaisravana's (Kubera's), यमस्य Yama's, वरुणस्य च Varuna's and, विजयकाङ्क्षिणा with a desire to win, विष्णुना  by Visnu, दूतः messenger, प्रेषितो वापि sent perhaps.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न हि ते वानरं तेजो रूपमात्रं तु वानरम्।।5.50.10।। तत्त्वत: कथयस्वाद्य ततो वानर मोक्ष्यसे।
output: वानर vanara, ते your, रूपमात्रं तु only your appearance, वानरम् is of a vanara, तेजः glow, वानरम् of a vanara, न हि not indeed, अद्य this day, तत्त्वतः truth, कथयस्व you may speak, ततः then, मोक्ष्यसे you will be set free.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनृतं वदतश्चापि दुर्लभं तव जीवितम्।।5.50.11।। अथवा यन्निमित्तस्ते प्रवेशो रावणालये।
output: तव your, अनृतम् false, वदतः while you speak, जीवितम् life, दुर्लभम् difficult, अथवा or else, रावणालये in the abode of Ravana, ते प्रवेशः your entry, यन्निमित्तः for waht reason.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तो हरिश्रेष्ठस्तदा रक्षोगणेश्वरम्।।5.50.12।। अब्रवीन्नास्मि शक्रस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा। धनदेन न मे सख्यं विष्णुना नास्मि चोदितः।।5.50.13।। जातिरेव मम त्वेषा वानरोऽहमिहागतः।
output: एवम् that way, उक्तः having been addressed, हरिश्रेष्ठः foremost of monkeys, तदा then, रक्षोगणेश्वरम् to the lord of the demon clan, अब्रवीत् said, शक्रस्य of Indra, यमस्य Yama's, वरुणस्य Varuna's, नास्मि I am not (a messenger), मे to me, धनदेन with Kubera, सख्यम् friendship, न not, विष्णुना by Visnu, चोदितः sent (prompted), न not, एषा this way, मम my, जातिरेव birth itself, अहम् I am, वानरः vanara, इह here, आगतः come.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तो हरिश्रेष्ठस्तदा रक्षोगणेश्वरम्।।5.50.12।। अब्रवीन्नास्मि शक्रस्य यमस्य वरुणस्य वा। धनदेन न मे सख्यं विष्णुना नास्मि चोदितः।।5.50.13।। जातिरेव मम त्वेषा वानरोऽहमिहागतः।
output: एवम् that way, उक्तः having been addressed, हरिश्रेष्ठः foremost of monkeys, तदा then, रक्षोगणेश्वरम् to the lord of the demon clan, अब्रवीत् said, शक्रस्य of Indra, यमस्य Yama's, वरुणस्य Varuna's, नास्मि I am not (a messenger), मे to me, धनदेन with Kubera, सख्यम् friendship, न not, विष्णुना by Visnu, चोदितः sent (prompted), न not, एषा this way, मम my, जातिरेव birth itself, अहम् I am, वानरः vanara, इह here, आगतः come.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 50:
दर्शने राक्षसेन्द्रस्य दुर्लभे तदिदं मया।।5.50.14।। वनं राक्षसराजस्य दर्शनार्थे विनाशितम्।
output: राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of ogres, दर्शने to see, दुर्लभे which is difficult, मया by me, तत् that, इदम् this, वनम् garden, राक्षसराजस्य demon king's, दर्शनार्थे in order to see, विनाशितम् to destroy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्ते राक्षसाः प्राप्ता बलिनो युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः। रक्षणार्थं तु देहस्य प्रतियुद्धा मया रणे।।5.50.15।।
output: ततः then, बलिनः powerful, ते राक्षसाः those ogres, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः desiring to fight, प्राप्ताः came, देहस्य of body, रक्षणार्थं तु to protect, मया by me, रणे in the combat, प्रतियुद्धाः in return I fought.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्त्रपाशैर्न शक्योऽहं बद्धुं देवासुरैरपि।।5.50.16।। पितामहादेष वरो मामाप्येषोऽभ्युपागतः।
output: अहम् I, देवसुरैरपि even by suras and asuras, अस्त्रपाशैः by bondage of astras, बद्धुम् to bind, न शक्यः not possible, एषः वरः such a boon, ममापि to me also, पितामहादेव only from grand father Brahma, अभ्युपागतः it has been granted me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राजानं द्रष्टुकामेन मयास्त्रमनुवर्तितम्।।5.50.17।। विमुक्तो ह्यहमस्त्रेण राक्षसैस्त्वभिपीडितः। केनचिद्राजकार्येण सम्प्राप्तोऽस्मि तवान्तिकम्।।5.50.18।।
output: "Wishing to see the king I honoured this astra and not otherwise. Even though I was tormented by the ogres and released by the astra I submitted to you as I have a small work assigned by the king.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 50:
राजानं द्रष्टुकामेन मयास्त्रमनुवर्तितम्।।5.50.17।। विमुक्तो ह्यहमस्त्रेण राक्षसैस्त्वभिपीडितः। केनचिद्राजकार्येण सम्प्राप्तोऽस्मि तवान्तिकम्।।5.50.18।।
output: "Wishing to see the king I honoured this astra and not otherwise. Even though I was tormented by the ogres and released by the astra I submitted to you as I have a small work assigned by the king.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दूतोऽहमिति विज्ञेयो राघवस्यामितौजसः। श्रूयतां चापि वचनं मम पथ्यमिदं प्रभो।।5.50.19।।
output: अहम् I, अमितौजसः of highly powerful, राघवस्य Rama's, दूतः इति messenger thus, विज्ञेयः it may be known, प्रभो O lord, पथ्यम् good, इदम् this, मम वचनम् my word, श्रूयतां चापि listen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं समीक्ष्य महासत्त्वं सत्त्ववान्हरिसत्तमः। वाक्यमर्थवदव्यग्रस्तमुवाच दशाननम्।।5.51.1।।
output: सत्त्ववान् courageous, हरिसत्तमः best of monkeys, महासत्त्वम् very powerful, तं दशाननम् the tenheaded, समीक्ष्य after observing, अव्यग्रम् slowly, अर्थवत् meaningful, वाक्यम् these words, तत् such, उवाच spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं सुग्रीवसंदेशादिह प्राप्तस्तवालयम्। राक्षसेन्द्र हरीशस्त्वां भ्राता कुशलमब्रवीत्।।5.51.2।।
output: "O lord of demons I reached your realm here by the orders of Sugriva, lord of monkeys who is like your brother. He conveys his good wishes to you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
भ्रातुश्शृणु समादेशं सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। धर्मार्थोपहितं वाक्यमिह चामुत्र च क्षमम्।।5.51.3।।
output: "The great Sugriva who is like your brother sends you a message pertinent to this world and the other world, that which is beneficial and consistent with righteousness and propriety (धर्म and अर्थ). Listen:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राजा दशरथो नाम रथकुञ्जरवाजिमान्। पितेव बन्धुर्लोकस्य सुरेश्वरसमद्युतिः।।5.51.4।।
output: "There was an emperor named Dasaratha richly endowed with chariots, horses and elephants. He was a friend to the world and was like a father and equal to Indra in splendour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
ज्येष्ठस्तस्य महाबाहुः पुत्रः प्रियकरः प्रभुः। पितुर्निदेशान्निष्क्रान्तः प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्।।5.51.5।। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया चापि भार्यया। रामो नाम महातेजा धर्म्यं पन्थानमास्थितः।।5.51.6।।
output: "His eldest son, a highly effulgent one, named Rama who was dear to the king, accepting his father's orders went into exile with brother Lakshmana and wife Sita also accepting a righteous path and entered Dandaka forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
ज्येष्ठस्तस्य महाबाहुः पुत्रः प्रियकरः प्रभुः। पितुर्निदेशान्निष्क्रान्तः प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्।।5.51.5।। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया चापि भार्यया। रामो नाम महातेजा धर्म्यं पन्थानमास्थितः।।5.51.6।।
output: "His eldest son, a highly effulgent one, named Rama who was dear to the king, accepting his father's orders went into exile with brother Lakshmana and wife Sita also accepting a righteous path and entered Dandaka forest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य भार्या वने नष्टा सीता पतिमनुव्रता। वैदेहस्य सुता राज्ञो जनकस्य महात्मनः।।5.51.7।।
output: "Sita, daughter of king Janaka of Videha kingdom, loyally followed her husband, Rama. She was lost in the forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
स मार्गमाणस्तां देवीं राजपुत्रः सहानुजः। ऋश्यमूकमनुप्राप्त: सुग्रीवेण समागतः।।5.51.8।।
output: "Searching for the divine lady the prince reached mount Rshyamuka along with his brother and there he met Sugriva.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
तस्य तेन प्रतिज्ञातं सीतायाः परिमार्गणम्। सुग्रीवस्यापि रामेण हरिराज्यं निवेदितम्।।5.51.9।।
output: "Sugriva promised Rama to undertake search for Sita and Rama assured Sugriva of securing him the kingdom of the monkeys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तेन मृधे हत्वा राजपुत्रेण वालिनम्। सुग्रीवः स्थापितो राज्ये हर्यृक्षाणां गणेश्वरः।।5.51.10।।
output: "Then prince Rama killed Vali in battle and made Sugriva, king of the vanaras and bears and restored the kingship of Sugriva.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वया विज्ञातपूर्वश्च वाली वानरपुङ्गवः। रामेण निहतस्सङ्ख्ये शरेणैकेन वानरः।।5.51.11।।
output: वानरपुङ्गवः chief of vanaras, वाली Vali, त्वया by you, विज्ञातपूर्वश्च is known earlier, वानरः vanara, रामेण by Rama, सङ्ख्ये in a combat, एकेन by only one, शरेण with an arrow, निहतः is killed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
स सीतामार्गणे व्यग्रस्सुग्रीवः सत्यसङ्गरः। हरीन् सम्प्रेषयामास दिशस्सर्वा हरीश्वरः।।5.51.12।।
output: "Sugriva, who is true to his word and a faithful warrior, king of monkeys anxiously sent vanaras in all directions for searching Sita.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तां हरीणां सहस्राणि शतानि नियुतानि च। दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते ह्यधश्चोपरि चाम्बरे।।5.51.13।।
output: हरीणाम् of monkeys, सहस्राणि in thousands, शतानि hundreds, नियुतानि च of unlimited numbers, ताम् her, सर्वासु in all, दिक्षु in directions, अधश्च underworld, उपरि in heavens, अम्बरे च in the sky, मार्गन्ते are searching.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वैनतेयसमाः केचित्केचित्तत्रानिलोपमाः। असङ्गगतयशशीघ्रा हरिवीरा महाबलाः।।5.51.14।।
output: "Some of the very powerful heroes equal to Garuda, equal to the Windgod (in swiftness) have gone (in quest of Sita) without touching the earth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहं तु हनुमान्नाम मारुतस्यौरसस्सुतः। सीतायास्तु कृते तूर्णं शतयोजनमायतम्।।5.51.15।। समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वैव तां दिदृक्षुरिहागतः।
output: "I, Maruta's son, Hanuman by name too came swiftly leaping across a hundred yojanas across the ocean searching for Sita.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
भ्रमता च मया दृष्टा गृहे ते जनकात्मजा।।5.51.16।। तद्भवान् दृष्टधर्मार्थस्तपःकृतपरिग्रहः। परदारान् महाप्राज्ञ नोपरोद्धुं त्वमर्हसि।।5.51.17।।
output: "While I was roaming I saw Janaka's daughter Sita at your house.You are a knower of the truth of righteousness. You are very wise and carrried out great austerities. It does not behove you to abduct another man's wife.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भ्रमता च मया दृष्टा गृहे ते जनकात्मजा।।5.51.16।। तद्भवान् दृष्टधर्मार्थस्तपःकृतपरिग्रहः। परदारान् महाप्राज्ञ नोपरोद्धुं त्वमर्हसि।।5.51.17।।
output: भ्रमता while roaming, मया by myself, ते your, गृहे in house, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, दृष्टा saw, भवान् you, दृष्टधर्मार्थः knower of the truth of righteousness, तपः कृतपरिग्रहः carried out great austerities, तत् such, महाप्राज्ञ very wise person, त्वम् you, परदारान् another man's wife, उपरोद्धुम् to abduct, न अर्हसि  it does not behove you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न हि धर्मविरुद्धेषु बह्वपायेषु कर्मसु। मूलघातिषु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः।।5.51.18।।
output: "Indeed, respectable people and wise men like you should not indulge in actions opposed to righteousness as it will strike at the very root of your existence.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कश्च लक्ष्मणमुक्तानां रामकोपानुवर्तिनाम्। शराणामग्रतः स्थातुं शक्तो देवासुरेष्वपि।।5.51.19।।
output: लक्ष्मणमुक्तानाम् released by Lakshmana, रामकोपानुवर्तिनाम् following Rama's wrath, शराणाम् of those arrows, अग्रतः in front, स्थातुम् to stand, देवासुरेष्वपि even among gods and asuras, कः who, शक्त: has power.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न चापि त्रिषु लोकेषु राजन्विद्येत कश्चन। राघवस्य व्यलीकं यः कृत्वा सुखमवाप्नुयात्।।5.51.20।।
output: "O king  there is none in these three worlds who can enjoy happiness by displeasing Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
तत् त्रिकालहितं वाक्यं धर्म्यमर्थानुबन्धि च। मन्यस्व नरदेवाय जानकी प्रतिदीयताम्।।5.51.21।।
output: "Think that my advice is beneficial to you for you present, past and future. It is righteous. It will provide you material wealth too. Hence return Sita to the lord of the people.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
दृष्टा हीयं मया देवी लब्धं यदिह दुर्लभम्। उत्तरं कर्म यच्छेषं निमित्तं तत्र राघवः।।5.51.22।।
output: "I have actually spotted the divine lady here which was most difficult. Rama will plan the remaining course of action.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
लक्षितेयं मया सीता तथा शोकपरायणा। गृह्य यां नाभिजानासि पञ्चास्यामिव पन्नगीम्।।5.51.23।।
output: "I have seen Sita immersed in deep sorrow. You do not realise that by abducting her you are keeping a fivehooded female serpent in your house.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
नेयं जरयितुं शक्या सासुरैरमरैरपि। विषसंसृष्टमत्यर्थं भुक्तमन्नमिवौजसा ।।5.51.24।।
output: "Just as food mixed with venom cannot be digested by the great fire (fire of hunger), it is not possible to keep Sita even by gods and demons. (Sita is like food mixed with poison. Ravana cannot digest her with all his power.)

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तपस्सन्तापलब्धस्ते योऽयं धर्मपरिग्रहः। न स नाशयितुं न्याय्य आत्मप्राणपरिग्रहः।।5.51.25।।
output: तपस्सन्तापलब्ध: obtained by the the virtue of austerity, ते to you, यः that, अयम् this, धर्मपरिग्रहः accumlation of righteousness, आत्मप्राणपरिग्रहः at the cost of your life, सः that, नाशयितुम् to destroy, न न्याय्यः not proper.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवध्यतां तपोभिर्यां भवान् समनुपश्यति। आत्मनः सासुरैर्देवैर्हेतुस्तत्राप्ययं महान्।।5.51.26।।
output: भवान् your self, तपोभिः with austerities, आत्मनः of yourself, सासुरैः including asuras, देवैः by devas, याम् whom, अवध्यताम् not to be killed, समनुपश्यसि you see, तत्रापि even then, अयम् this, महान् great, हेतुः cause.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीवो न हि देवोऽयं नासुरो न च राक्षसः। न दानवो न गन्धर्वो न यक्षो न च पन्नगः।।5.51.27।। तस्मात्प्राणपरित्राणं कथं राजन्करिष्यसि।
output: "Sugriva is not an demon, nor a danava nor gandharva, nor a yaksha nor even a pannaga. Therefore how can you save your life from Sugriva?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न तु धर्मोपसंहारमधर्मफलसंहितम्।।5.51.28।। तदेव फलमन्वेति धर्मश्चाधर्मनाशन:।
output: धर्मोपसंहारम् exceeding rigteousness, अधर्मफलसंहितम् yields results of unrighteousness, न तु not, तत् that, फलमेव result itself, अन्वेति follows, धर्मश्च righteousness, अधर्मनाशनः will destroy unrighteousness.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
प्राप्तं धर्मफलं तावद्भवता नात्र संशयः। फलमस्याप्यधर्मस्य क्षिप्रमेव प्रपत्स्यसे।।5.51.29।।
output: "There is no doubt you have earned merit through righteousness (dharma destroys adharma and yields sweet fruit ultimately). But now you will quickly reap the result of your unrighteousness also.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जनस्थानवधं बुद्ध्वा बुद्ध्वा वालिवधं तथा।।5.51.30।। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च बुध्यस्व हितमात्मनः।
output: जनस्थानवधम् killing of all ogres at Janasthana, बुद्ध्वा after realising, तथा that way, वालिवधम् killing of Vali, बुद्ध्वा after realising, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च alliance of Rama and Sugriva also, आत्मनः your own, हितम् benefit, बुध्यस्व know (Judge and adopt suitable course of action.)

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
कामं खल्वहमप्येकस्सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्।।5.51.31।। लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तस्तस्यैष तु न निश्चयः।
output: " Alone, I can destroy this entire Lanka teeming with horses, chariots and elephants. Indeed I have the energy but not the mandate of Sri Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
रामेण हि प्रतिज्ञातं हर्यृक्षगणसन्निधौ।।5.51.32।। उत्सादनममित्राणां सीता यैस्तु प्रधर्षिता।
output: "Rama made a vow in the presence of bears and vanaras that he would exterminate the arrogant enemy troops  by whom Sita is abducted and assaulted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अपकुर्वन् हि रामस्य साक्षादपि पुरन्दरः।।5.51.33।। न सुखं प्राप्नुयादन्यः किं पुनस्त्वद्विधो जनः।
output: रामस्य to Rama, अपकुर्वन् while offending, साक्षात् personally, पुरन्दरः अपि even the destroyer of enemy citadel, Indra, सुखम् happiness, नप्राप्नुयात् will not have, त्वद्विधः people like you, किं पुनः what to say again.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यां सीतेत्यभिजानासि येयं तिष्ठति ते वशे।।5.51.34।। कालरात्रीति तां विद्धि सर्वलङ्काविनाशिनीम्।
output: "Sita who is under your custody is no ordinary lady. She is indeed the dark night of dissolution, destroyer of entire Lanka. Know this.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदलं कालपाशेन सीताविग्रहरूपिणा।।5.51.35।। स्वयं स्कन्धावसक्तेन क्षेममात्मनि चिन्त्यताम्।
output: "Stop holding the noose of death in Sita's form whom you yourself have placed on your shoulders. Think of your own welfare.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
सीतायास्तेजसा दग्धां रामकोपप्रपीडिताम्।।5.51.36।। दह्यमानामिमां पश्य पुरीं साट्टप्रतोलिकाम्।
output: "Visualize this city of Lanka including its marketplaces and main streets as  burnt by Sita's power of chastity and  Rama's anger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वानि मित्राणि मन्त्रींश्च ज्ञातीन् भ्रात्रून् सुतान् हितान्।।5.51.37।। भोगान्दारांश्च लङ्कां च मा विनाशमुपानय।
output: स्वानि your, मित्राणि friends, मन्त्रींश्च ministers, ज्ञातीन् clan, भ्रात्रून् brothers and sisters, सुतान् sons, हितान् wellwishers, भोगान् pleasures, दारांश्च and wives, लङ्कां च and Lanka, विनाशम् destruction, मा उपानय do not lead.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
सत्यं राक्षसराजेन्द्र शृणुष्व वचनं मम।।5.51.38।। रामदासस्य दूतस्य वानरस्य विशेषतः।
output: "O king of demon listen to the words of truth of the servant of Rama, his messenger and specially a vanara.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
सर्वान् लोकान् सुसंहृत्य सभूतान् सचराचरान्।।5.51.39।। पुनरेव तथा स्रष्टुं शक्तो रामो महायशाः।
output: "Illustrious Rama can put an end  to and dissolve all creatures including both movable and immovables of all worlds. He can recreate all of them in the same way. He has such superhuman powers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
देवासुरनरेन्द्रेषु यक्षरक्षोगणेषु च।।5.51.40।। विद्याधरेषु सर्वेषु गन्धर्वेषूरगेषु च। सिद्धेषु किन्नरेन्द्रेषु पतत्रिषु च सर्वतः।।5.51.41।। सर्वभूतेषु सर्वत्र सर्वकालेषु नास्ति सः। यो रामं प्रतियुध्येत विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमम्।।5.51.42।।
output: "He is equal to Visnu in valour. There is none who can dare face his rage, be it among gods, asuras, yakshas, rakshasas, vidyadharas, gandharvas uragas, siddhas, kings of kinnaras, birds and all beings at all places and at all times.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
देवासुरनरेन्द्रेषु यक्षरक्षोगणेषु च।।5.51.40।। विद्याधरेषु सर्वेषु गन्धर्वेषूरगेषु च। सिद्धेषु किन्नरेन्द्रेषु पतत्रिषु च सर्वतः।।5.51.41।। सर्वभूतेषु सर्वत्र सर्वकालेषु नास्ति सः। यो रामं प्रतियुध्येत विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमम्।।5.51.42।।
output: "He is equal to Visnu in valour. There is none who can dare face his rage, be it among gods, asuras, yakshas, rakshasas, vidyadharas, gandharvas uragas, siddhas, kings of kinnaras, birds and all beings at all places and at all times.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देवासुरनरेन्द्रेषु यक्षरक्षोगणेषु च।।5.51.40।। विद्याधरेषु सर्वेषु गन्धर्वेषूरगेषु च। सिद्धेषु किन्नरेन्द्रेषु पतत्रिषु च सर्वतः।।5.51.41।। सर्वभूतेषु सर्वत्र सर्वकालेषु नास्ति सः। यो रामं प्रतियुध्येत विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमम्।।5.51.42।।
output: "He is equal to Visnu in valour. There is none who can dare face his rage, be it among gods, asuras, yakshas, rakshasas, vidyadharas, gandharvas uragas, siddhas, kings of kinnaras, birds and all beings at all places and at all times.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वलोकेश्वरस्यैवं कृत्वा विप्रियमुत्तमम्। रामस्य राजसिंहस्य दुर्लभं तव जीवितम्।।5.51.43।।
output: सर्वलोकेश्वरस्य of the lord of all worlds, राजसिंहस्य of a lion among kings, रामस्य Rama's, एवम् in this, उत्तमम् great, विप्रियम् offence, कृत्वा having done, तव your, जीवितम् life, दुर्लभम् is difficult to sustain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
देवाश्च दैत्याश्च निशाचरेन्द्र गन्धर्वविद्याधरनागयक्षाः। रामस्य लोकत्रयनायकस्य स्थातुं न शक्तास्समरेषु सर्वे।।5.51.44।।
output: "O king of demons, even devas, daityas, gandharvas, vidyadharas, nagas, and yakshas are incompetent to face Rama the lord of the three worlds in wars.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूश्चतुराननो वा रुद्रस्त्रिणेत्रस्त्रिपुरान्तको वा। इन्द्रो महेन्द्रस्सुरनायको वा त्रातुं न शक्ता युधि रामवध्यम्।।5.51.45।।
output: "Even the selfborn, fourfaced Brahma, the threeeyed Siva who destroyed Tripura, Mahendra, the king of suras do not have the power to save one whom Rama decides to kill".

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 51:
स सौष्ठवोपेतमदीनवादिनः कपेर्निशम्याप्रतिमोऽप्रियं वचः। दशाननः कोपविवृत्तलोचनः समादिशत्तस्य वधं महाकपेः।।5.51.46।।
output: The tenheaded Ravana who was of matchless strength, hearing the unpleasant words of advice and warning expressed skilfully with dignity by the great Hanuman, enraged Ravana, his eyes rolling in anger ordered the execution of Hanuman. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वानरस्य महात्मनः। आज्ञापयद्वधं तस्य रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः।।5.52.1।।
output: Vibhishana advises Ravana against slaying of an emissary -- elaborates on the code of conduct of a king

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
वधे तस्य समाज्ञप्ते रावणेन दुरात्मना। निवेदितवतो दौत्यं नानुमेने विभीषणः।।5.52.2।।
output: Vibhishana did not approve of the killing of Hanuman, who had declared that he was an envoy (of Sri Rama) when the wicked Ravana ordered his murder.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
तं रक्षोधिपतिं क्रुद्धं तच्च कार्यमुपस्थितम्। विदित्वा चिन्तयामास कार्यं कार्यविधौ स्थितः।।5.52.3।।
output: Vibhishana who stood by the right course of action, having realised that the lord of demons was angry pondered over his duty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निश्चितार्थस्ततस्साम्ना पूज्यं शत्रुजिदग्रजम्। उवाच हितमत्यर्थं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः।।5.52.4।।
output: ततः then, निश्चितार्थः decided about action, शत्रुजित् winner of enemies, वाक्यविशारदः skilled in speech, पूज्यम् reverential, अग्रजम् to his elder brother, अत्यर्थम् profound, हितम् wholesome, वाक्यम् words, साम्ना by soothing words, उवाच addressed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
क्षमस्व रोषं त्यज राक्षसेन्द्र प्रसीद मद्वाक्यमिदं शृणुष्व। वधं न कुर्वन्ति परावरज्ञा दूतस्य सन्तो वसुधाधिपेन्द्राः।।5.52.5।।
output: "O king of ogres give up your wrath, forgive and calm down. Please listen to my appeal. You know the basic values of life. Virtuous rulers of the earth do not order killing of an envoy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राजधर्मविरुद्धं च लोकवृत्तेश्च गर्हितम्। तव चासदृशं वीर कपेरस्य प्रमापणम्।।5.52.6।।
output: वीर warrior, अस्य his, कपेः monkey's, प्रमापणम् killing, राजधर्मविरुद्धं च contrary to righteousness of kings, लोकवृत्तेश्च to fair diplomacy, गर्हितम् depreciable, तव च and your, असदृशम् unbecoming act.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च राजधर्मविशारदः। परावरज्ञो भूतानां त्वमेव परमार्थवित्।।5.52.7।।
output: त्वमेव you alone, धर्मज्ञश्च knower of dharma, कृतज्ञश्च you have a sense of gratitude, राजधर्मविशारदः knower of king's dharma, भूतानाम् among beings, परावरज्ञः knower of right and wrong practices, परमार्थवित् knower of supreme truth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गृह्यन्ते यदि रोषेण त्वादृशोऽपि विचक्षणः। तत श्शास्त्रविपश्चित्त्वं श्रम एव हि केवलम्।।5.52.8।।
output: त्वादृशः persons like you, विचक्षण: a wise one, रोषेण with unjust anger, गृह्यन्ते overpowered, ततः then, शास्त्रविपश्चित्त्वम् learning scriptures, केवलम् a mere, श्रम एव हि only fruitless labour.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मात्प्रसीद शत्रुघ्न राक्षसेन्द्र दुरासद। युक्तायुक्तं विनिश्चित्य दूतदण्डो विधीयताम्।।5.52.9।।
output: शत्रघ्न O destoyer of foes, दुरासद O unassailable, राक्षसेन्द्र king of demon, तस्मात् therefore, प्रसीद calm down, युक्तायुक्तम् that which is proper and improper, विनिश्चित्य  after careful deliberation, दूतदण्डः punishment for the emissary, विधीयताम् may be impose.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। रोषेण महताविष्टो वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.52.10।।
output: Ravana, the lord of demons heard Vibhishana's words and overcome with anger replied:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न पापानां वधे पापं विद्यते शत्रुसूदन। तस्मादेनं वधिष्यामि वानरं पापचारिणम्।।5.52.11।।
output: शत्रुसूदन O slayer of foes, पापानाम् of sinners, वधे in killing, पापम् sin, न विद्यते not incurred, तस्मात् so, पापचारिणम् this sinner, एनम् him, वानरम् vanara, वधिष्यामि will slay.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अधर्ममूलं बहुदोषयुक्तमनार्यजुष्टं वचनं निशम्य। उवाच वाक्यं परमार्थतत्त्वं विभीषणो बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठः।।5.52.12।।
output: On hearing his brother's harsh words spoken in tremendous anger, which were not acceptable to noble souls, wise Vibhishana again spoke these words of supreme truth:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
प्रसीद लङ्केश्वर राक्षसेन्द्र धर्मार्थयुक्तं वचनं शृणुष्व। दूतानवध्यान् समयेषु राजन् सर्वेषु सर्वत्र वदन्ति सन्तः।।5.52.13।।
output: "O lord of Lanka O king of demons be pleased to listen to my words which are the essence of dharma and artha. The elders have declared that the emissaries should not be killed by any means.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
असंशयं शत्रुरयं प्रवृद्धः कृतं ह्यनेनाप्रियमप्रमेयम्। न दूतवध्यां प्रवदन्ति सन्तो दूतस्य दृष्टा बहवो हि दण्डाः।।5.52.14।।
output: This enemy has done a lot of harm, no doubt. Indeed he has done terrible and unpleasant deeds. (Yet) the wise have recommended many alternate punishments, while prohibiting their killing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वैरूप्यमङ्गेषु कशाभिघातो मौण्ड्यं तथा लक्षणसन्निपातः। एतान् हि दूते प्रवदन्ति दण्डान् वधस्तु दूतस्य न नः श्रुतोऽस्ति।।5.52.15।।
output: अङ्गेषु in limbs, वैरूप्यम् deforming, कशाभिघातः flogging, मौण्ड्यम् shaving the head, तथा similarly, लक्षणसन्निपातः disfigurement, एतान् such of those, दूते for an emissary, दण्डान् punishments, प्रवदन्ति elders have prescribed, दूतस्य for emissary, वधस्तु killing of, श्रुतः heard, नास्ति never.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
कथं च धर्मार्थविनीतबुद्धिः परावरप्रत्ययनिश्चितार्थः। भवद्विधः कोपवशे हि तिष्ठेत् कोपं नियच्छन्ति हि सत्त्ववन्तः।।5.52.16।।
output: "You are wellversed  in  dharma and artha. Learned men first decide what is right or wrong (before imposing punishment). How are you swayed by unjust anger? Indeed courageous persons (like you) should control anger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न धर्मवादे न च लोकवृत्ते न शास्त्रबुद्धिग्रहणेषु चापि। विद्येत कश्चित्तव वीर तुल्य स्त्वंह्युत्तमस्सर्वसुरासुराणाम्।।5.52.17।।
output: वीर O hero, धर्मवादे in the discussion on dharma, तव your, तुल्यः equal, कश्चित् any one, न विद्येत does not exist, लोकवृत्ते in the practice worldly affairs, न not, शास्त्रबुद्धिग्रहणेषु चापि in grasping the subtle truths in sastras, न no, त्वम् you, सर्वसुरासुराणाम् among all suras and asuras, उत्तमः हि indeed superior.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
शूरेण वीरेण निशाचरेन्द्र सुरासुराणामपि दुर्जयेन। त्वया प्रगल्भाः सुरदैत्यसङ्घा जिताश्च युद्धेष्वसकृन्नरेन्द्राः।।5.52.18।।
output: "You are the king of demons. Hosts of gods and daityas efficient in wars are conquered by you again and again since you are a brave warrior invincible to gods and demons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
न चाप्यस्य कपेर्घाते कञ्चित्पश्याम्यहं गुणम्। तेष्वयं पात्यतां दण्डो यैरयं प्रेषितः कपिः।।5.52.19।।
output: "I do not see any use in killing this monkey. Pronounce  punishment on those who have sent this vanara.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
साधुर्वा यदि वाऽसाधुः परैरेष समर्पितः। ब्रुवन् परार्थं परवान्न दूतो वधमर्हति।।5.52.20।।
output: "Whether he is soft or harsh, he has been sent by others. He is speaking on other's behalf and is dependent on them. An emissary does not deserve to be killed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अपि चास्मिन् हते राजन्नान्यं पश्यामि खेचरम्। इह यः पुनरागच्छेत्परं पारं महोदधेः।।5.52.21।।
output: "O king If he is killed, I do not see any one who can cross this great ocean and come by air to reach this place.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
तस्मान्नास्य वधे यत्नः कार्य: परपुरञ्जय। भवान् सेन्द्रेषु देवेषु यत्नमास्थातुमर्हति।।5.52.22।।
output: "You who can conquer citadels of enemies should not direct your efforts to kill an envoy.You are fit to make efforts against enemies like gods including Indra.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्मिन्विनष्टे न हि वीरमन्यं पश्यामि यस्तौ वरराजपुत्रौ। युद्धाय युद्धप्रियदुर्विनीतावुद्योजयेद्धीर्घपथावरुद्धौ।।5.52.23।।
output: युद्धप्रिय O lover of war, अस्मिन् if he, विनष्टे is slain, दुर्विनीतौ those two illmannered, दीर्घपथावरुद्धौ those two who are obstructed, तौ नरराजपुत्रौ those princes, यः who ever, युद्धाय for war, उद्योजयेत् can incite, अन्यम्  another, दूतम् emissary, न पश्यामि हि I donot see indeed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 52:
पराक्रमोत्साहमनस्विनां च सुरासुराणामपि दुर्जयेन। त्वया मनोनन्दन नैतानां युद्धायतिर्नाशयतुं न युक्ता।।5.52.24।।
output: "O delighter of demons even the gods and demons who are endowed with valour and energy cannot win you. You are invincible. It is not proper for you to lose chances of a good war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हिताश्च शूराश्च समाहिताश्च कुलेषु जाताश्च महागुणेषु। मनस्विनश्शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठाः कोट्यग्रतस्ते सुभृताश्च योधाः।।5.52.25।।
output: ते to you, हिताश्च wellwishers, शूराश्च courageous, समाहिताश्च wellestablished, महागुणेषु with good qualities, कुलेषु in such races, जाताः born, मनस्विनः intellectuals, शस्त्रभृताम् among wielders of weapons, वरिष्ठाः foremost, सुभृताश्च wellpaid warriors, योधाः warriors, कोट्यग्रतः  in your presence.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदेकदेशेन बलस्य तावत्केचित्तवाऽऽदेशकृतोऽभियान्तु तौ राजपुत्रौ विनिगृह्य मूढौ परेषु ते भावयितुं प्रभावम्।।5.52.26।।
output: By your order let some strong soldiers from one contingency go and capture the two sons of the king, to exhibit your power over the enemy.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवो महात्मनः। देशकालहितं वाक्यं भ्रातुरुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.53.1।।
output: Ravana orders the ogres to put Hanuman's tail on fire and take him round Lanka with his burning tail

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्यगुक्तं हि भवता दूतवध्या विगर्हिता। अवश्यं तु वधादन्यः क्रियतामस्य निग्रहः।।5.53.2।।
output: भवता by you, सम्यक् very well, उक्तं हि indeed spoken, दूतवध्या killing of emissary, विगर्हिता is censured, वधात् other than killing, अन्यः other, निग्रहः punishment, अस्य his, अवश्यम् surely, क्रियताम् may be done.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कपीनां किल लाङ्गूलमिष्टं भवति भूषणम्। तदस्य दीप्यतां शीघ्रं तेन दग्धेन गच्छतु।।5.53.3।।
output: कपीनाम् for the monkeys, लाङ्गूलम् tail, इष्टम् is dear, भूषणम् is an ornament, भवति किल indeed is, अस्य his, तत् that, शीघ्रम् at once, दीप्यताम् may be set fire to, दग्धेन with the burning, तेन by that, गच्छतु  let go.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 53:
ततः पश्यन्त्विमं दीनमङ्गवैरूप्यकर्शितम्। समित्रज्ञातयस्सर्वे बान्धवाः ससुहृज्जनाः।।5.53.4।। आज्ञापयद्राक्षसेन्द्रः पुरं सर्वं सचत्वरम्। लाङ्गूलेन प्रदीप्तेन रक्षोभिः परिणीयताम्।।5.53.5।।
output: "Then all his friends, relatives and his kinsmen will see his disfigured and handicapped form. The demon king having ordered thus, the monkey was taken by the ogres round the junctions of the roads all over the city with his tail on fire.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततः पश्यन्त्विमं दीनमङ्गवैरूप्यकर्शितम्। समित्रज्ञातयस्सर्वे बान्धवाः ससुहृज्जनाः।।5.53.4।। आज्ञापयद्राक्षसेन्द्रः पुरं सर्वं सचत्वरम्। लाङ्गूलेन प्रदीप्तेन रक्षोभिः परिणीयताम्।।5.53.5।।
output: "Then all his friends, relatives and his kinsmen will see his disfigured and handicapped form. The demon king having ordered thus, the monkey was taken by the ogres round the junctions of the roads all over the city with his tail on fire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 53:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसाः कोपकर्शिताः। वेष्टयन्ति स्म लाङ्गूलं जीर्णैः कार्पासकैः पटैः।।5.53.6।।
output: "Obeying the orders of the king, the brutally angry demons wrapped his tail with tatters of cotton.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 53:
संवेष्ट्यमाने लाङ्गूले व्यवर्धत महाकपिः। शुष्कमिन्धनमासाद्य वनेष्विव हुताशनः।।5.53.7।।
output: While the tail was being swathed, the great vanara grew in size like wild fire fed with dry firewood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तैलेन परिषिच्याथ तेऽग्निं तत्राभ्यपातयन्। लाङ्गूलेन प्रदीप्तेन राक्षसांस्तानपातयत्।।5.53.8।। रोषामर्षपरीतात्मा बालसूर्यसमाननः।
output: अथ and then, ते those, तैलेन with oil, परिषिच्य having soaked, तत्र there, अग्निम् in fire, अभ्यपातयन् threw fire at his tail, बालसूर्यसमाननः his face looking like the rising Sun, रोषामर्षपरीतात्मा overtaken with anger and indignation, प्रदीप्तेन burning, लाङ्गूलेन by the tail, तान् राक्षसान् those demons, अपातयत् struck.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लाङ्गूलं सम्प्रदीप्तं तु द्रष्टुं तस्य हनूमतः।।5.53.9।। सहस्त्रीबालवृद्धाश्च जग्मुः प्रीता निशाचराः।
output: तस्य हनूमतः of that Hanuman, सम्प्रदीप्तम् burning, लाङ्गूलम् tail, द्रष्टुम् to see, निशाचराः the demons, प्रीताः joyfully, सहस्त्रीबालवृद्धाश्च including children, women and the old, जग्मुः went out to see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 53:
स भूयः सङ्गतैः क्रूरैर्राक्षसैर्हरिसत्तमः।।5.53.10।। निबद्धः कृतवान्वीरस्तत्कालसदृशीं मतिम्।
output: When the cruel demons collected together and bound him once again the heroic Hanuman thought what was appropriate to the moment.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कामं खलु न मे शक्ता निबद्धस्यापि राक्षसाः।।5.53.11।। छित्त्वा पाशान् समुत्पत्य हन्यामहमिमान्पुनः।
output: 'Even though these ogres are not capable, they have bound me. Indeed I will leap (into  the air) once again and sever my bonds and kill them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदि भर्तुर्हितार्थाय चरन्तं भर्तृशासनात्।।5.53.12।। बध्नन्त्येते दुरात्मनो न तु मे निष्कृतिः कृता।
output: 'These  evilminded demons bind me, ordered by their lord. When I am moving here for the welfare of  my master, I will not let them escape৷৷

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वेषामेव पर्याप्तो राक्षसानामहं युधि।।5.53.13।। किंतु रामस्य प्रीत्यर्थं विषहिष्येऽहमीदृशम्। लङ्का चारयितव्या वै पुनरेव भवेदिति।।5.53.14।।
output: युधि in battle, अहम् I, सर्वेषामेव for all of them, राक्षसानाम् for the ogres, पर्याप्तः enough, किन्तु but, रामस्य Rama's, प्रीत्यर्थम् for his pleasure, अहम् I, ईदृशम् such, लङ्का Lanka, पुनरेव once again, चारयितव्या going about, भवेत् will be, इति in this way, विषहिष्ये I will tolerate.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वेषामेव पर्याप्तो राक्षसानामहं युधि।।5.53.13।। किंतु रामस्य प्रीत्यर्थं विषहिष्येऽहमीदृशम्। लङ्का चारयितव्या वै पुनरेव भवेदिति।।5.53.14।।
output: 'I am strong enough to destroy all the demons in a battle. I am enduring this humiliation in order to make Rama happy. In this way I will get a chance to see Lanka once again.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रात्रौ न हि सुदृष्टा मे दुर्गकर्मविधानतः। अवश्यमेव द्रष्टव्या मया लङ्का निशाक्षये।।5.53.15।।
output: 'Indeed I saw Lanka at night for which I could not acquire proper knowledge about the fortification of the city. Surely it should be seen by me now after the night has passed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कामं बद्धस्य मे भूयः पुच्छस्योद्दीपनेन च। पीडां कुर्वन्तु रक्षांसि न मेऽस्ति मनसश्श्रमः।।5.53.16।।
output: भूयः again, बद्धस्य bound, मे for me, पुच्छस्य tail, उद्दीपनेन च by burning the same, रक्षांसि demons, कामम् surely, पीडाम् torment, कुर्वन्तु they may as they wish, मे me, मनसः mind, श्रमः exhausted, नास्ति not experienced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 53:
ततस्ते संवृताकारं सत्त्ववन्तं महाकपिम्। परिगृह्य ययुर्हृष्टा राक्षसाः कपिकुञ्जरम्।।5.53.17।।
output: Then the ogres set forth joyfully capturing the very powerful elephant among the monkeys, the great vanara who had contracted his body.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शङ्खभेरीनिनादैस्तं घोषयन्तः स्वकर्मभिः। राक्षसाः क्रूरकर्माणश्चारयन्ति स्म तां पुरीम्।।5.53.18।।
output: क्रूरकर्मणः cruel in action, राक्षसाः ogres, तम् him, शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च by sounding conches and beating drums, स्वकर्मभिः with their actions, घोषयन्तः while announcing, तां पुरीम् that city, चारयन्ति स्म paraded him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्वीयमानो रक्षोभिर्ययौ सुखमरिन्दमः। हनुमांश्चारयामास राक्षसानां महापुरीम्।।5.53.19।।
output: Hanuman, the subduer of enemies ranged forth happily while he was followed by the demons in the great city.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथापश्यद्विमानानि विचित्राणि महाकपिः। संवृतान् भूमिभागांश्च सुविभक्तांश्च चत्वरान्।।5.53.20।।
output: The great vanara saw wonderful, towering mansions, secure, mammoth buildings all over and welllaid out squares on the streets.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वीथीश्च गृहसम्बाधाः कपिश्शृङ्गाटकानि च। तथा रथ्योपरथ्याश्च तथैव गृहकान्तरान्।।5.53.21।। गृहांश्च मेघसङ्काशान् ददर्श पवनात्मजः।
output: पवनात्मजः son of the Windgod, कपिः monkey, गृहसम्बाधाः with houses, वीथीः streets, शृङ्गाटकानि च beautiful tall mansions, तथा similarly, रथ्योपरथ्याश्च highways and byways, तथैव च and similarly, गृहकान्तरान् interior paths, मेघसङ्काशान् appearing like clouds, गृहांश्च houses, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 53:
चत्वरेषु चतुष्केषु राजमार्गे तथैव च।।5.53.22।। घोषयन्ति कपिं सर्वे चारीक इति राक्षसाः।
output: All the demons went forth through cross roads, altars built on four pillars and royal roads announcing that he (Hanuman) was a spy.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्त्रीबालवृद्धाः निर्जग्मुस्तत्र तत्र कुतूहलात्।।5.53.23।। तं प्रदीपितलाङ्गूलं हनुमन्तं दिदृक्षवः।
output: With eagerness to have a glance at Hanuman's blazing tail, women, children and the aged here and there came out of eagerness to see him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दीप्यमाने ततस्तत्र लाङ्गूलाग्रे हनूमतः।।5.53.24।। राक्षस्यस्ता विरूपाक्ष्य श्शंसुर्देव्यास्तदप्रियम्।
output: When the tip of Hanuman's tail was set on fire, the uglyeyed shedemon. Carried the unpleasant news to divine Sita.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्त्वया कृतसंवाद स्सीते ताम्रमुखः कपिः।।5.53.25।। लाङ्गूलेन प्रदीप्तेन स एष परिणीयते।
output: सीते O Sita, यः he who, ताम्रमुखः red face, कपिः monkey, त्वया by you, कृतसंवादः who conversed with you, स एषः that person, प्रदीप्तेन set on fire, लाङ्गूलेन with tail, परिणीयते taken round.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रुत्वा तद्वचनं क्रूरमात्मापहरणोपमम्।।5.53.26।। वैदेही शोकसन्तप्ता हुताशनमुपागमत्।
output: वैदेही Vaidehi, आत्मापहरणोपमम् equally distressing as her abduction, क्रूरम् cruel, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा after hearing, शोकसन्तप्ता burning with grief, हुताशनम् firegod, उपागमत् invoked.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मङ्गलाभिमुखी तस्य सा तदाऽसीन्महाकपेः।।5.53.27।। उपतस्थे विशालाक्षी प्रयता हव्यवाहनम्।
output: Wishing the great monkey well, the largeeyed Sita invoked the Firegod in her heart.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 53:
यद्यस्ति पतिशुश्रूषा यद्यस्ति चरितं तपः। यदि चास्त्येकपत्नीत्वं शीतो भव हनूमतः।।5.53.28।।
output: "O Firegod if I have served my husband, if I have practised austerities, and if I am loyal to my husband, be cool to Hanuman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदि किञ्चिदनुक्रोशस्तस्य मय्यस्ति धीमतः।।5.53.29।। यदि वा भाग्यशेषो मे शीतो भव हनूमतः।
output: "If wise Rama has some compassion for me, if there is any residue of good luck for me, to Hanuman be cool O Firegod.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदि मां वृत्तसम्पन्नां तत्समागमलालसाम्।।5.53.30।। स विजानाति धर्मात्मा शीतो भव हनूमतः।
output: "O Firegod if Rama is righteous, if I am pure in mind, and if I am longing to unite with him, be cool to Hanuman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदि मां तारयेदार्यस्सुग्रीवः सत्यसङ्गरः।।5.53.31।। अस्माद्धुःखाम्बुसंरोधाच्छीतो भव हनूमतः।
output: "If Sugriva is true to his promise to fight (for me), if he should be able to rescue me from this ocean of agony let Hanuman be cool (not consumed by fire.)"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 53:
ततस्तीक्ष्णार्चिरव्यग्रः प्रदक्षिणशिखोऽनलः।।5.53.32।। जज्वाल मृगशाबाक्ष्या श्शंसन्निव शिवं कपेः।
output: Then the tips of the intense flame appeared steadily moving to the fawneyed Sita indicating the firegod's auspiciousness and safety to Hanuman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हनुमज्जनकश्चापि पुच्छानलयुतोऽनिलः।।5.53.33।। ववौ स्वास्थ्यकरो देव्याः प्रालेयानिलशीतलः।
output: "The Windgod accompanying Hanuman's firelit tail also blew cool like the wind from snow, to calm the mind of the divine lady.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दह्यमाने च लाङ्गूले चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.53.34।। प्रदीप्तोऽग्निरयं कस्मान्न मां दहति सर्वतः।
output: When the tail was burning, the vanara wondered how the fire ablaze on every side was not burning him:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दृश्यते च महाज्वालः करोति न च मे रुजम्।।5.53.35।। शिशिरस्येव सङ्घातो लाङ्गूलाग्रे प्रतिष्ठितः।
output: महाज्वालः huge flame, दृश्यते seeing, मे my, रुजम् न करोति च is not hurting me, लाङ्गूलाग्रे at the end of my tail, शिशिरस्य like the coolness, सङ्घातः like mass of ice, प्रतिष्ठितः इव is placed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथवा तदिदं व्यक्तं यद्दृष्टं प्लवता मया।।5.53.36।। रामप्रभावादाश्चर्यं पर्वत स्सरितां पतौ।
output: अथवा or else, यत् such an incident, प्लवता while I leaped, मया  by me, रामप्रभावात् by the power of Rama, पर्वत: a mountain, सरितां पतौ foating in the ocean, आश्चर्यम् wonderful, दृष्टम् saw, तत इदम् that this, व्यक्तम् now It is clear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदि तावत्समुद्रस्य मैनाकस्य च धीमतः।।5.53.37।। रामार्थं सम्भ्रमस्तादृक्किमग्निर्न करिष्यति।
output: समुद्रस्य for the ocean, धीमतः of the wise, मैनाकस्य for Mainaka, रामार्थम् for the cause of Rama, तादृक् such, सम्भ्रमः यदि if there was anxiety, अग्निः fire, किम् what, न करिष्यति not do?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सीतायाश्चानृशंस्येन तेजसा राघवस्य च।।5.53.38।। पितुश्च मम सख्येन न मां दहति पावकः।
output: 'Because of Sita's steadfast loyalty, Rama's power and my father's friendship with the Firegod, the fire is not burning me.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भूयस्स चिन्तयामास मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः।।5.53.39।। उत्पपाताथ वेगेन ननाद च महाकपिः।
output: कपिकुञ्जरः an elephantmonkey, सः महाकपिः the great monkey, भूयः once more, चिन्तयामास thought, अथ then, वेगेन with speed, उत्पपात sprang up, ननाद च roarshouted aloud.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुरद्वारं ततश्श्रीमान् शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम्।।5.53.40।। विभक्तरक्षस्सम्बाधमाससादानिलात्मजः।
output: ततः then, श्रीमान् the illustrious, अनिलात्मजः the son of the Windgod (Hanuman), शैलशृङ्गमिव like the peak of a mountain, उन्नतम् lofty, विभक्तरक्षस्सम्बाधम्  turned away the demons, पुरद्वारम् entrance of the city, आससाद reached.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स भूत्वा शैलसङ्काशः क्षणेन पुनरात्मवान्।।5.53.41।। ह्रस्वतां परमां प्राप्तो बन्धनान्यवशातयत्।
output: आत्मवान् assumed original form, सः that, शैलसङ्काशः appearing like a mountain, भूत्वा becoming, क्षणेन in a moment, ह्रस्वताम् very small, प्राप्तः became, बन्धनानि all bondage, अवशातयत् casting off.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विमुक्तश्चाभवछ्रचीमान् पुनः पर्वतसन्निभः।।5.53.42।। वीक्षमाणश्च ददृशे परिघं तोरणाश्रितम्।
output: Illustrious Hanuman was relieved of the bond and once again grew to a mountain size. Looking around he saw an iron club near the archway.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तं गृह्य महाबाहुः कालायसपरिष्कृतम्।।5.53.43।। रक्षिणस्तान् पुनस्सर्वान्सूदयामास मारुतिः।
output: महाबाहुः strongarmed, सः मारुतिः that Maruti, कालयासपरिष्कृतम् made of black Iron, तम् the club, पुनः again, गृह्य seizing, सर्वान् all, तान् रक्षिणः all the guards, सूदयामास killed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तान्निहत्त्वा रणचण्डविक्रम स्समीक्षमाणः पुनरेव लङ्काम्। प्रदीप्तलाङ्गूलकृतार्चिमाली प्रकाशतादित्य इवार्चिमाली।।5.53.44।।
output: रणचण्डविक्रमः of fearsome valour in war, सः he, तान् those, निहत्त्वा having killed, पुनरेव once again, लङ्काम् at Lanka, समीक्षमाणः while gazing, प्रदीप्तलाङ्गूलकृतार्चिमाली garlanded by the flames of his tail, अर्चिमाली garlanded by rays, आदित्य इव just like Sun, प्रकाशत shining.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
वीक्षमाणस्ततो लङ्कां कपिः कृतमनोरथः।।5.54.1।। वर्धमानसमुत्साहः कार्यशेषमचिन्तयत्।
output: With his objectives achieved, the monkey gazed at Lanka with growing zeal and pondered over the remaining work.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
किन्नु खल्ववशिष्टं मे कर्तव्यमिह साम्प्रतम्।।5.54.2।। यदेषां रक्षसां भूयः सन्तापजननं भवेत्।
output: 'Is there anything still left which can further torment the demons here?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
वनं तावत्प्रमथितं प्रकृष्टा राक्षसा हताः।।5.54.3। बलैकदेशः क्षपितश्शेषं दुर्गविनाशनम्।
output: 'All the trees of the garden are broken, powerful demons have been killed, and a contingent of the army is destroyed. Only the destruction of the citadel is left.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
दुर्गे विनाशिते कर्म भवेत्सुखपरिश्रमम्। अल्पयत्नेन कार्येऽस्मिन् मम स्यात्सफलश्श्रमः।।5.54.4।।
output: 'If the citadel is destroyed it would be a happy conclusion with a little effort. I can successfully complete my task.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
यो ह्ययं मम लाङ्गूले दीप्यते हव्यवाहनः। अस्य सन्तर्पणं न्याय्यं कर्तुमेभिर्गृहोत्तमैः।।5.54.5।।
output: 'It would be proper to satiate this fire at the end of my tail  by offering it to these excellent mansions (I shall set fire to these houses).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततः प्रदीप्तलाङ्गूलस्सविद्युदिव तोयदः। भवनाग्रेषु लङ्काया विचचार महाकपिः।।5.54.6।।
output: ततः then, प्रदीप्तलाङ्गूलः with his burning tail, महाकपिः great monkey, सविद्युत् along with lightning, तोयदः इव rain cloudslike, लङ्कायाः of Lanka, भवनाग्रेषु on tops of the mansions, विचचार wandered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
गृहाद्गृहं राक्षसानामुद्यानानि च वानरः। वीक्षमाणो ह्यसन्त्रस्तः प्रासादांश्च चचार सः।।5.54.7।।
output: The vanara moved from one house to the other, looking at the gardens and houses of the demons without fear.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
अवप्लुत्य महावेगः प्रहस्तस्य निवेशनम्। अग्निं तत्र स निक्षिप्य श्वसनेन समो बली।।5.54.8।। ततोऽन्यत्पुप्लुवे वेश्म महापार्श्वस्य वीर्यवान्। मुमोच हनुमानग्निं कालानलशिखोपमम्।।5.54.9।।
output: Powerful and brave Hanuman who was equal to the Windgod in speed jumped down on the house of Prahasta and set fire to it. From there he jumped on to Mahaparsva's house and set it ablaze. Hanuman appeared like the fireflame at the time of dissolution.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
अवप्लुत्य महावेगः प्रहस्तस्य निवेशनम्। अग्निं तत्र स निक्षिप्य श्वसनेन समो बली।।5.54.8।। ततोऽन्यत्पुप्लुवे वेश्म महापार्श्वस्य वीर्यवान्। मुमोच हनुमानग्निं कालानलशिखोपमम्।।5.54.9।।
output: Powerful and brave Hanuman who was equal to the Windgod in speed jumped down on the house of Prahasta and set fire to it. From there he jumped on to Mahaparsva's house and set it ablaze. Hanuman appeared like the fireflame at the time of dissolution.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य च तदा पुप्लुवे स महाकपिः। शुकस्य च महातेजास्सारणस्य च धीमतः।।5.54.10।।
output: The great, brilliant vanara bounded on to Vajradamstra's, of Suka's and wise Sarana's.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
तथा चेन्द्रजितो वेश्म ददाह हरियूथपः। जम्बुमाले स्सुमालेश्च ददाह भवनं ततः।।5.54.11।।
output: Thus Hanuman, the chief of the vanaras set fire to Indrajit's residence and then to Jambumali's and Sumali's building.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रश्मिकेतोश्च भवनं सूर्यशत्रोस्तथैव च। ह्रस्वकर्णस्य दंष्ट्रस्य रोमशस्य च रक्षसः।।5.54.12।। युद्धोन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वजग्रीवस्य रक्षसः। विद्युज्जिह्वस्य घोरस्य तथा हस्तिमुखस्य च।।5.54.13।। करालस्य पिशाचस्य शोणिताक्षस्य चैव हि। कुम्भकर्णस्य भवनं मकराक्षस्य चैव हि।।5.54.14।। यज्ञशत्रोश्च भवनं ब्रह्मशत्रोस्तथैव च। नरान्तकस्य कुम्भस्य निकुम्भस्य दुरात्मनः।।5.54.15।। वर्जयित्वा महातेजा विभीषणगृहं प्रति। क्रममाणः क्रमेणैव ददाह हरिपुङ्गवः।।5.54.16।।
output: महातेजाः brilliant, हरिपुङ्गवः monkey leader, क्रमेणैव gradually, क्रममाणः passing over, विभीषणगृहं प्रति towards Vibhishana's house, वर्जयित्वा sparing, रश्मिकेतो: च of Rasmiketu and, भवनम् mansion, तथैव च in the same way, सूर्यशत्रोः Suryasatru's, ह्रस्वकर्णस्य Hasvakarna's, दंष्ट्रस्य Damshtra's, रक्षसः demon, रोमशस्य Romasa's, युद्धोन्मत्तस्य Yudhonmatta's, मत्तस्य Matta's, रक्षसः of ogre, ध्वजग्रीवस्य Dhwajagriva's, घोरस्य of the fearsome, विद्युज्जिह्वस्य Vidyujjihva's, तथा so also, हस्तिमुखस्य च and Hastimukha's, करालस्य Karala's, पिशाचस्य Pisacha's, शोणिताक्षस्य च इव हि Sonitaksha's, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, भवनम् mansion, मकराक्षस्य चैव हि Makaraksha's, यज्ञशत्रोश्च भवनम् Yagnasatru's building, तथैव च in the same way, ब्रह्मशत्रोः Brahmasatru's, नरान्तकस्य Narantaka's, कुम्भस्य Kumbha's, दुरात्मनः of the wicked minded, निकुम्भस्य Vikumbha's.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रश्मिकेतोश्च भवनं सूर्यशत्रोस्तथैव च। ह्रस्वकर्णस्य दंष्ट्रस्य रोमशस्य च रक्षसः।।5.54.12।। युद्धोन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वजग्रीवस्य रक्षसः। विद्युज्जिह्वस्य घोरस्य तथा हस्तिमुखस्य च।।5.54.13।। करालस्य पिशाचस्य शोणिताक्षस्य चैव हि। कुम्भकर्णस्य भवनं मकराक्षस्य चैव हि।।5.54.14।। यज्ञशत्रोश्च भवनं ब्रह्मशत्रोस्तथैव च। नरान्तकस्य कुम्भस्य निकुम्भस्य दुरात्मनः।।5.54.15।। वर्जयित्वा महातेजा विभीषणगृहं प्रति। क्रममाणः क्रमेणैव ददाह हरिपुङ्गवः।।5.54.16।।
output: The brilliant monkey leader bypassed Vibhishanas's house and avoiding it that way set fire to the mansions of other ogres, Rasmiketu, Suryasatru, Hrasvakarna, Vajradamshtra, Romasa, Yuddhonmatta, Matta, Dhwajagriva, Vidyujjihva, Hastimukha, Karala, Pisacha, Sonitaksha, Kumbhakarna, Makaraksha, Yagnasatru, Brahmasatru, Naranthaka, Kumbha, and wicked Nikumbha.

रश्मिकेतोश्च भवनं सूर्यशत्रोस्तथैव च। ह्रस्वकर्णस्य दंष्ट्रस्य रोमशस्य च रक्षसः।।5.54.12।। युद्धोन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वजग्रीवस्य रक्षसः। विद्युज्जिह्वस्य घोरस्य तथा हस्तिमुखस्य च।।5.54.13।। करालस्य पिशाचस्य शोणिताक्षस्य चैव हि। कुम्भकर्णस्य भवनं मकराक्षस्य चैव हि।।5.54.14।। यज्ञशत्रोश्च भवनं ब्रह्मशत्रोस्तथैव च। नरान्तकस्य कुम्भस्य निकुम्भस्य दुरात्मनः।।5.54.15।। वर्जयित्वा महातेजा विभीषणगृहं प्रति। क्रममाणः क्रमेणैव ददाह हरिपुङ्गवः।।5.54.16।।

रश्मिकेतोश्च भवनं सूर्यशत्रोस्तथैव च। ह्रस्वकर्णस्य दंष्ट्रस्य रोमशस्य च रक्षसः।।5.54.12।। युद्धोन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वजग्रीवस्य रक्षसः। विद्युज्जिह्वस्य घोरस्य तथा हस्तिमुखस्य च।।5.54.13।। करालस्य पिशाचस्य शोणिताक्षस्य चैव हि। कुम्भकर्णस्य भवनं मकराक्षस्य चैव हि।।5.54.14।। यज्ञशत्रोश्च भवनं ब्रह्मशत्रोस्तथैव च। नरान्तकस्य कुम्भस्य निकुम्भस्य दुरात्मनः।।5.54.15।। वर्जयित्वा महातेजा विभीषणगृहं प्रति। क्रममाणः क्रमेणैव ददाह हरिपुङ्गवः।।5.54.16।।

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 54:
रश्मिकेतोश्च भवनं सूर्यशत्रोस्तथैव च। ह्रस्वकर्णस्य दंष्ट्रस्य रोमशस्य च रक्षसः।।5.54.12।। युद्धोन्मत्तस्य मत्तस्य ध्वजग्रीवस्य रक्षसः। विद्युज्जिह्वस्य घोरस्य तथा हस्तिमुखस्य च।।5.54.13।। करालस्य पिशाचस्य शोणिताक्षस्य चैव हि। कुम्भकर्णस्य भवनं मकराक्षस्य चैव हि।।5.54.14।। यज्ञशत्रोश्च भवनं ब्रह्मशत्रोस्तथैव च। नरान्तकस्य कुम्भस्य निकुम्भस्य दुरात्मनः।।5.54.15।। वर्जयित्वा महातेजा विभीषणगृहं प्रति। क्रममाणः क्रमेणैव ददाह हरिपुङ्गवः।।5.54.16।।
