output: दुरात्मनः evilminded one, तस्य your, रावणस्य Ravana's, एतत् all these, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सीता Sita, परमक्रुद्धा very angry, उत्तमम् good, वचनम् these words, उवाच spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसाधम रामस्य भार्याममिततेजसः। इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथस्य स्नुषां दशरथस्य च।।5.58.70।। अवाच्यं वदतो जिह्वा कथं न पतिता तव।
output: राक्षसाधम lowly rakshasa, अमिततेजसः highly valourous one, रामस्य Rama's, भार्याम् wife, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथस्य of the king of Ikshvaku race, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, स्नुषां च daughterinlaw, अवाच्यम् unspeakable, वदतः words, तव your, जिह्वा tongue, कथम् how, न पतिता not fallen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किञ्चिद्वीर्यं तवानार्य यो मां भर्तुरसन्निधौ।।5.58.71।। अपहृत्याऽऽगतः पाप ते नादृष्टो महात्मना।
output: नार्य ignoble, पाप sinner, यः such you, भर्तुः husband, असन्निधौ not near, माम् me, अपहृत्य abducted, महात्मना great, तेन by his, अदृष्टः without being seen, आगतः came, तव your, वीर्यम् courage, किञ्चित् not have little.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न त्वं रामस्य सदृशो दास्येऽप्यस्य न युज्यसे।।5.58.72।। यज्ञीय स्सत्यवादी च रणश्लाघी च राघवः।
output: 'You are not equal to Rama and not even fit to be his servant. He does yagnas and always abides in truth. He is valiant in war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जानक्या परुषं वाक्यमेवमुक्तो दशाननः।।5.58.73।। जज्वाल सहसा कोपाच्चितास्थ इव पावकः।
output: जानक्या by Janaki, एवम् in that way, परुषम् harsh, उक्तः spoken, दशाननः tenheaded one, सहसा suddenly, चितास्थः in the funeral pyre, पावकः इव like fire, कोपात् in anger, जज्वाल like flame.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विवृत्य नयने क्रूरे मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्।।5.58.74।। मैथिलीं हन्तुमारब्ध: स्त्रीभिर्हाहाकृतं तदा।
output: क्रूरे wicked, नयने eyes, विवृत्य opened, दक्षिणम् right hand, मुष्टिम् fist, उद्यम्य raised, मैथिलीम् Mythili, हन्तुम् to kill, आरब्धः started, तदा then, स्त्रीभिः even the women there, हाहाकृतम् raised their voice saying, alas

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्त्रीणां मध्यात्समुत्पत्य तस्य भार्या दुरात्मनः।।5.58.75।। वरा मन्दोदरी नाम तया स प्रतिषेधितः।
output: दुरात्मनः evilminded, तस्य his, भार्या wife, मन्दोदरी नाम named Mandodari, वरा noble one, स्त्रीणाम् among women, मध्यात् from the midst, समुत्पत्य came, तया forward, सः he, प्रतिषेधितः objected.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उक्तश्च मधुरां वाणीं तया स मदनार्दितः।।5.58.76।। सीतया तव किं कार्यं महेन्द्रसमविक्रमः।
output: "She spoke sweetly to Ravana, who was tormented by the god of love saying, 'For what purpose do you desire Sita? You are equal to Mahendra in might'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
देवगन्धर्वकन्याभिर्यक्षकन्याभिरेव च।।5.58.77।। सार्धं प्रभो रमस्वेह सीतया किं करिष्यसि।
output: प्रभो O Lord, देवगन्धर्वकन्याभिः even gods and  daughters of gandharvas, यक्षकन्याभिरेवच even young yaksha ladies, सार्धम् all, इह here, रमस्व enjoy, सीतया with Sita, किं करिष्यसि why do you need.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्ताभिस्समेताभिर्नारीभिस्स महाबलः।।5.58.78।। प्रसाद्य सहसा नीतो भवनं स्वं निशाचरः।
output: "Then all the women got together and stopped the mighty nightranger, Ravana and quickly took him back to his mansion.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
याते तस्मिन् दशग्रीवे राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः।।5.58.79।। सीतां निर्भर्त्सयामासुर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैस्सुदारुणैः।
output: तस्मिन् दशग्रीवे when that tenheaded one, याते went, विकृताननाः those uglyfaced ones, राक्षस्यः demons, क्रूरैः cruel, सुदारुणैः frightful, वाक्यैः words, सीताम् to Sita, निर्भर्त्सयामासुः threatened.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तृणवद्भाषितं तासां गणयामास जानकी।।5.58.80।। गर्जितं च तदा तासां सीतां प्राप्य निरर्थकम्।
output: "Janaki did not care for their words of threat, as though they were a blade of grass and of no use to her.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वृथागर्जितनिश्चेष्टा राक्षस्यः पिशिताशनाः।।5.58.81।। रावणाय शशंसुस्ताः सीताध्यवसितं महत्।
output: "Since the threatenings of the shedemons were of no use the ogresses who live on flesh and blood reported to Ravana about great Sita's formidable determination.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तास्सहितास्सर्वा निहताशा निरुद्यमाः।।5.58.82।। परिक्षिप्य समन्तात्तां निद्रावशमुपागताः।
output: "Then all of them gave up hope of their efforts and scattered around her, succumbed to sleep.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तासु चैव प्रसुप्तासु सीता भर्तृहिते रता।।5.58.83।। विलप्य करुणं दीना प्रशुशोच सुदुःखिता।
output: तासु them, प्रसुप्तासु after sleeping, भर्तृहिते wellwisher of the husband, रता one who remained, सीता Sita, दीना miserable, करुणम् pathetically, विलप्य crying, सुदुःखिता very sad, प्रशुशोच lamented.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तासां मध्यात्समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.58.84।। आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीता विनशिष्यति। जनकस्यात्मजा साध्वी स्नुषा दशरथस्य च।।5.58.85।।
output: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तासां मध्यात्समुत्थाय त्रिजटा वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.58.84।। आत्मानं खादत क्षिप्रं न सीता विनशिष्यति। जनकस्यात्मजा साध्वी स्नुषा दशरथस्य च।।5.58.85।।
output: "From the midst of all of them got up Trijata, saying, 'You eat me if you like. Know that Janaka's daughter is a chaste woman and is the daughterinlaw of Dasaratha. She cannot be destroyed'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वप्नो ह्यद्य मया दृष्टो दारुणो रोमहर्षणः। रक्षसां च विनाशाय भर्तुरस्या जयाय च।।5.58.86।।
output: 'Today I saw in my dream, a dreadful and horripilating scene of destruction of demons and even victory of Sita's husband.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
अलमस्मात्परित्रातुं राघवाद्राक्षसीगणम्। अभियाचाम वैदेहीमेतद्धि मम रोचते।।5.58.87।।
output: 'To protect the demon clan from destruction by Rama, it is enough if we beg her (pardon). Indeed, I think that way.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्या ह्येवंविधस्स्वप्नो दुःखितायाः प्रदृश्यते। सा दुःखैर्विविधैर्मुक्ता सुखमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्।।5.58.88।। प्रणिपातप्रसन्ना हि मैथिली जनकात्मजा।
output: यस्याः whoever, दुःखितायाः is in sorrow, एवं विधः in this way, स्वप्नः dream, प्रदृश्यते sees, सा that, विविधैः many, दुःखै grief, विमुक्ता will be relieved, अनुत्तमम् immense, सुखम् happiness, आप्नोति will result, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, मैथिली Maithili, प्रणिपातप्रसन्ना हि will bless us if we pray her.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्सा ह्रीमती बाला भर्तुर्विजयहर्षिता।।5.58.89।। अवोचद्यदि तत्तथ्यं भवेयं शरणं हि वः।
output: ततः then, ह्रीमती bashful, बाला young, सा that Sita, भर्तुः husband, विजयहर्षिता feeling happy that he will succeed, अवोचत् hearing the words, तत् that, तथ्यं यदि comes true, वः thee, शरणम् protect, भवेयम् I will.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तां चाहं तादृशीं दृष्ट्वा सीताया दारुणां दशाम्। चिन्तयामास विक्रान्तो न च मे निर्वृतं मनः।।5.58.90।।
output: "Seeing Sita's deplorable state, her illluck and her dread, I began  to worry and had no peace of mind.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
सम्भाषणार्थं च मया जानक्याश्चिन्तितो विधिः।।5.58.91।। इक्ष्वाकूणां हि वंशस्तु ततो मम पुरस्कृतः।
output: "I thought of a strategy to enter into conversation with Janaki that is to praise the Ikshvaku race.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
श्रुत्वा तु गदितां वाचं राजर्षिगणपूजिताम्।।5.58.92।। प्रत्यभाषत मां देवी बाष्पैः पिहितलोचना।
output: "The divine lady heard my enumeration, sanctifying the royal seers. She replied me, with  her eyes blinded by tears:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
कस्त्वं केन कथं चेह प्राप्तो वानरपुङ्गवः।।5.58.93।। का च रामेण ते प्रीतिस्तन्मे शंसितुमर्हसि।
output: "O foremost of vanaras who are you? Why and how have you come here? How did you make friendship with Rama? Tell me all that in detail.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ह्यहमप्यब्रुवं वचः।।5.58.94।। देवि रामस्य भर्तुस्ते सहायो भीमविक्रमः। सुग्रीवो नाम विक्रान्तो वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः।।5.58.95।।
output: "Hearing her I also said, 'O queen Sugriva, the warrior of fierce valour and king of monkeys developed friendship with your husband'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ह्यहमप्यब्रुवं वचः।।5.58.94।। देवि रामस्य भर्तुस्ते सहायो भीमविक्रमः। सुग्रीवो नाम विक्रान्तो वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः।।5.58.95।।
output: "Hearing her I also said, 'O queen Sugriva, the warrior of fierce valour and king of monkeys developed friendship with your husband'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य मां विद्धि भृत्यं त्वं हनुमन्तमिहागतम्। भर्त्राहं प्रेषितस्तुभ्यं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।।5.58.96।।
output: इह here, आगतम् I came, माम् me, तस्य his, भृत्यम् servant, त्वम् you, विद्धि to find, अहम् I, भर्त्रा by your husband, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा tireless in action, रामेण by Rama, तुभ्यम् for your sake, प्रेषितः sent me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदं च पुरुषव्याघ्रः श्रीमान् दाशरथिः स्वयम्। अङ्गुलीयमभिज्ञानमदात्तुभ्यं यशस्विनि।।5.58.97।।
output: यशस्विनि O glorious lady, पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men, श्रीमान् illustrious, दाशरथिः Dasaratha's son, स्वयम् himself, इदम् this, अङ्गुलीयम् this ring, तुभ्यम् to you, अभिज्ञानम् to recognise, अदात् sent.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदिच्छामि त्वयाऽऽज्ञप्तं देवि किं करवाण्यहम्। रामलक्ष्मणयोः पार्श्वं नयामि त्वां किमुत्तरम्।।5.58.98।।
output: 'O venerable lady I seek your order. What should I do? Should I take you to  Rama and Lakshmana? What do you say?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा विदित्वा च सीता जनकनन्दिनी। आहरावणमुत्साद्य राघवो मां नयत्विति।।5.58.99।।
output: जनकनन्दिनी delight of Janaka, सीता Sita, एतत् all this, श्रुत्वा having heard, विदित्त्वा च thought over, राघवः Rama, रावणम् Ravana, उत्साद्य slaying, माम् me, नयतु should take, इति this, आह she said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं महमार्यामनिन्दिताम्। राघवस्य मनोह्लादमभिज्ञानमयाचिषम्।।5.58.100।।
output: "Then bowing down I saluted the noble and blameless queen Sita to give a signet, which would be very pleasing to Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथ मामब्रवीत्सीता गृह्यतामयमुत्तमः। मणिर्येन महाबाहू रामस्त्वां बहुमन्यते।।5.58.101।।
output: "Sita then said to me, 'Take this best of gems and present it to the longarmed Rama as a token'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
इत्युक्त्वा तु वरारोहा मणिप्रवरमद्भुतम्। प्रायच्छत्परमोद्विग्ना वाचा मां सन्दिदेशह।।5.58.102।।
output: "Having said so, the noble lady delivered a wonderful jewel with supreme message to me in a sorrowful mood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तस्यै प्रणम्याहं राजपुत्र्यै समाहितः। प्रदक्षिणं परिक्राममिहाभ्युद्गतमानसः।।5.58.103।।
output: "Reminded by her again (that Rama should turn up soon to take her), I offered reverential salutations by circumambulating her.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
उक्तोऽहं पुनरेवेदं निश्चित्य मनसा तया। हनुमन्मम वृत्तान्तं वक्तुमर्हसि राघवे।।5.58.104।।
output: अहम् I, तया to her, मनसा in mind, निश्चित्य determined, पुनरेव again, उक्तः said, हनुमान् Hanuman, राघवे to Rama, मम my, वृत्तान्तम् all about my story, वक्तुम् you tell, अर्हसि I wish.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथा श्रुत्वैव न चिरात्तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। सुग्रीवसहितौ वीरावुपेयातां तथा कुरु।।5.58.105।।
output: 'O heroic Hanuman narrate in such a way that by hearing you both Rama and Lakshmana will come here soon, accompanied by Sugriva.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
यद्यन्यथा भवेदेतद्द्वौ मासौ जीवितं मम। न मां द्रक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थो म्रिये साहमनाथवत्।।5.58.106।।
output: 'Otherwise with none to protect me, I will live only  for two months.I will die like an orphan and he will not see me'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तच्छ्रुत्वा करुणं वाक्यं क्रोधो मामभ्यवर्तत। उत्तरं च मया दृष्टं कार्यशेषमनन्तरम्।।5.58.107।।
output: "When I heard her pathetic appeal, I was overtaken by anger. I perceived the task left over for me to do.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोऽवर्धत मे कायस्तदा पर्वतसन्निभः। युद्धकाङ्क्षी वनं तच्च विनाशयितुमारभे।।5.58.108।।
output: ततः that, तदा then, मे I, कायः body, पर्वतसन्निभः like a mountain, अवर्धत increased, युद्धकाङ्क्षी intent on fighting, तत् that, वनम् garden, विनाशयितुम् to destroy, आरभे started.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तद्भग्नं वनषण्डं तु भ्रान्तत्रस्तमृगद्विजम्। प्रतिबुद्धा निरीक्षन्ते राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः।।5.58.109।।
output: "Those uglyfaced ogresses woke up and saw the devastated garden and terrified beasts and birds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
मां च दृष्ट्वा वने तस्मिन् समागम्य ततस्ततः। ता स्समभ्यागताः क्षिप्रं रावणायाचचक्षिरे।।5.58.110।।
output: ततस्ततः here and there, समागम्य collecting together, तस्मिन् वने in that garden, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा saw, ताः them, क्षिप्रम् at once, समभ्यागताः understood, रावणाय to Ravana, आचचक्षिरे thus reported.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
राजस्वनमिदं दुर्गं तव भग्नं दुरात्मना। वानरेण ह्यविज्ञाय तव वीर्यं महाबल।।5.58.111।।
output: 'O powerful king an evilminded vanara has destroyed the inaccessible pleasure garden not knowing your valour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
दुर्बुद्धेस्तस्य राजेन्द्र तव विप्रियकारिणः। वधमाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं यथासौ विलयं व्रजेत्।।5.58.112।।
output: 'O king may orders be issued to kill this wickedminded vanara wandering aimlessly. He has done contrary to your interest.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रेण विसृष्टा भृशदुर्जयाः। राक्षसाः किङ्करा नाम रावणस्य मनोनुगाः।।5.58.113।।
output: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of demons, भृशदुर्जयाः who are invincible, रावणस्य Ravana's, मनोनुगाः those who know his mind, किङ्करा नाम called kinkara, राक्षसाः demon, विसृष्टाः sent.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषामशीतिसाहस्रं शूलमुद्गरपाणिनाम्। मया तस्मिन्वनोद्देशे परिघेण निषूदितम्।।5.58.114।।
output: तस्मिन् those, वनोद्धेशे near the garden, शूलमुद्गरपाणिनाम् tridents and maces, तेषाम् with them, अशीतिसाहस्रम् battalion of eighty thousand (demons), मया by me, परिघेण by iron bar, निषूदितम् killed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषां तु हतशेषा ये ते गत्वा लघुविक्रमाः। निहतं च महत्सैन्यं रावणायाचचक्षिरे।।5.58.115।।
output: "Those who were left behind, the less powerful ones went and reported to Ravana that the great army has been killed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना चैत्यप्रासादमाक्रमम्। तत्रस्थान्राक्षसान् हत्वा शतं स्तम्भेन वै पुनः।।5.58.116।। ललामभूतो लङ्कायास्स वै विध्वंसितो मया।
output: "Then a thought struck my mind. I took hold of a pillar of the tall, decorated mansion of Lanka and killed with it all the hundred demons stationed there.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
ततः प्रहस्तस्य सुतं जम्बुमालिनमादिशत्।।5.58.117।। राक्षसैर्बहुभिस्सार्धं घोररूपैर्भयानकैः।
output: ततः then, घोररूपैः of terrific appearance, भयानकैः frightening, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः ogres, सार्धम् together with, प्रहस्तस्य Prahasta's, सुतम् son, जम्बुमालिनम् Jambumali, आदिशत् ordered

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं महाबलसम्पन्नं राक्षसं रणकोविदम्।।5.58.118।। परिघेणातिघोरेण सूदयामि सहानुगम्।
output: "With a dreadful iron bar I slayed Jambumali, who was endowed with mighty strength, and was an expert in war and other terrific ogres who accompanied him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्छ्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु मन्त्रिपुत्त्रान्महाबलान्।।5.58.119।। पदातिबलसम्पन्नान् प्रेषयामास रावणः।
output: राक्षसेन्द्रः demon king, रावणः Ravana, महाबलान् mighty army, पदातिबलसम्पन्नान् strong footsoldiers, मन्त्रिपुत्रान् sons of ministers, प्रेषयामास sent.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परिघेणैव तान् सर्वान्नयामि यमसादनम्।।5.58.120।। मन्त्रिपुत्त्रान्हतान्च्छृत्वा समरेऽलघुविक्रमान्। पञ्च सेनाग्रगाच्छ्रूरान्प्रेषयामास रावणः।।5.58.121।।
output: "I sent all of them to the abode of Yama with just an iron bar. Having heard about the death of the less powerful ones, Ravana  sent five heroic army generals.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
परिघेणैव तान् सर्वान्नयामि यमसादनम्।।5.58.120।। मन्त्रिपुत्त्रान्हतान्च्छृत्वा समरेऽलघुविक्रमान्। पञ्च सेनाग्रगाच्छ्रूरान्प्रेषयामास रावणः।।5.58.121।।
output: "I sent all of them to the abode of Yama with just an iron bar. Having heard about the death of the less powerful ones, Ravana  sent five heroic army generals.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तानहं सहसैन्यान्वै सर्वानेवाभ्यसूदयम्। ततः पुनर्दशग्रीवः पुत्रमक्षं महाबलम्।।5.58.122।। बहुभी राक्षसैस्सार्धं प्रेषयामास रावणः।
output: अहम् I, सहसैन्यान् along with the army, तान् सर्वान् all of them, अभ्यसूदयम् having been killed, ततः then, दशग्रीवः tenheaded, रावणः Ravana, महाबलम् mighty, पुत्रम् son, अक्षम् Aksha, बहुभिः and many, राक्षसैः demons, सार्धम् together with, प्रेषयामास sent out.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तं तु मन्दोदरीपुत्त्रं कुमारं रणपण्डितम्।।5.58.123।। सहसा खं समुत्क्रान्तं पादयोश्च गृहीतवान्। चर्मासिनं शतगुणं भ्रामयित्वा व्यपेषयम्।।5.58.124।।
output: "When Mandodari's son, an expert in war had risen up to the sky I caught his feet and whirled him round a hundred times and smashed him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तं तु मन्दोदरीपुत्त्रं कुमारं रणपण्डितम्।।5.58.123।। सहसा खं समुत्क्रान्तं पादयोश्च गृहीतवान्। चर्मासिनं शतगुणं भ्रामयित्वा व्यपेषयम्।।5.58.124।।
output: रणपण्डितम् expert in war, मन्दोदरीपुत्त्रम् Mandodari's son, खम् to the sky, उत्क्रान्तम् risen up, चर्मासिनम् feet, तं कुमारम् of that young man, सहसा at once, पादयोः both feet, गृहीतवान् caught hold of, शतगुणम् hundred times, भ्रामयित्वा whirled him round, व्यवेषयम् smashed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तमक्षमागतं भग्नं निशम्य स दशाननः। तत इन्द्रजितं नाम द्वितीयं रावणस्सुतम्।।5.58.125।। व्यादिदेश सुसंकृद्धो बलिनम् युद्धदुर्मदम्।
output: "When Aksha was done to death, the tenfaced Ravana was enraged and gave instruction to the second son, called Indrajit who was thirsting for war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तच्चाप्यहं बलं सर्वं तं च राक्षसपुङ्गवम्।।5.58.126।। नष्टौजसं रणे कृत्वा परं हर्षमुपागमम्।
output: "When the army and even the Generals were done to death in combat I was very happy.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महतापि महाबाहुः प्रत्ययेन महाबलः।।5.58.127।। प्रेषितो रावणेनैव सह वीरैर्मदोत्कटैः।
output: "Thinking that Indrajit will surely kill me, the strongarmed mighty Ravana again sent intoxicated demon warriors.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽविषह्यं हि मां बुद्ध्वा स्वं बलं चावमर्दितम्।।5.58.128।। ब्राह्मणास्त्रेण स तु मां प्राबध्नाच्छातिवेगितः।
output: "Realising that I cannot be slain and that his (Indrajit's) power is reduced, he released Brahma's weapon on me with high speed and captured me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रज्जुभिश्चाभिबध्नन्ति ततो मां तत्र राक्षसाः।।5.58.129।। रावणस्य समीपं च गृहीत्वा मामुपानयन्।
output: "Then the demons bound me with ropes and brought me to Ravana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दृष्ट्वा सम्भाषितश्चाहं रावणेन दुरात्मना।।5.58.130।। पृष्टश्च लङ्कागमनं राक्षसानां च तं वधम्।
output: अहम् I, दुरात्मना wickedminded, रावणेन by Ravana, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, सम्बाषितश्च conversed, लङ्कागमनम् about my coming to Lanka, राक्षसानाम् ogres, तम् them, वधम् killing, पृष्टश्च enquired.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तत्सर्वं च मया तत्र सीतार्थमिति जल्पितम्।।5.58.131।। अस्याहं दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम्।।5.58.132।।
output: 'I have done all this for the sake of Sita, O demon king I came to your mansion desiring to see Sita. I am the legitimate son of Windgod. My name is Hanuman.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तत्सर्वं च मया तत्र सीतार्थमिति जल्पितम्।।5.58.131।। अस्याहं दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी प्राप्तस्त्वद्भवनं विभो। मारुतस्यौरसः पुत्रो वानरो हनुमानहम्।।5.58.132।।
output: 'I have done all this for the sake of Sita, O demon king I came to your mansion desiring to see Sita. I am the legitimate son of Windgod. My name is Hanuman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामदूतं च मां विद्धि सुग्रीवसचिवं कपिम्। सोऽहं दूत्येन रामस्य त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः।।5.58.133।।
output: 'I am a vanara, a messenger of Rama and minister of Sugriva.You may know that I have come here to convey the message of Rama to you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुग्रीवश्च महातेजास्सत्वां कुशलमब्रवीत्। धर्मार्थकामसहितं हितं पथ्यमुवाच च।।5.58.134।।
output: महातेजाः highly powerful, सः सुग्रीवश्च Sugriva, त्वाम् to you, कुशलम् welfare, अब्रवीत् enquires, धर्मार्थकामसहितम् in accordance with dharma, wealth and wellbeing, पथ्यम् that which provides, हितम् beneficial advice, उवाच sent.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वसतो ऋश्यमूके मे पर्वते विपुलद्रुमे। राघवो रणविक्रान्तो मित्त्रत्वं समुपागतः।।5.58.135।।
output: विपुलद्रुमे filled with plenty of trees, ऋश्यमूके Rshyamuka, वसतः dwelling, मे I, रणविक्रान्तः skilled in war, राघवः Rama, मित्त्रत्वम् friendship, उपागतः was made.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेन मे कथितं राज्ञा भार्या मे रक्षसा हृता। तत्र साहाय्यमस्माकं कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्वया।।5.58.136।।
output: राज्ञा the king, तेन by him, मे to me, कथितम् revealed, मे भार्या my wife, रक्षसा by the demon, हृता abducted, तत्र there, त्वया by your, सर्वात्मना by all ways, अस्माकम् by you, साहाय्यम् help, कार्यम् do.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मया च कथितं तस्मै वालिनश्च वधं प्रति। तत्र साहाय्यहेतोर्मे समयं कर्तुमर्हसि।।5.58.137।।
output: 'Sugriva told the story of Vali in turn and asked for his help and to make agreement to kill Vali.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वालिना हृतराज्येन सुग्रीवेण महाप्रभुः। चक्रेऽग्निसाक्षिकं सख्यं राघवस्सह लक्ष्मणः।।5.58.138।।
output: महाप्रभुः that great lord, सह लक्ष्मणः accompanied by Lakshmana, राघवः Rama, वालिना Vali, हृतराज्येन kingdom usurped, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, अग्निसाक्षिकम् in the presence of fire as witness, सख्यम् ally, चक्रे made.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेन वालिनमुत्पाट्य शरेणैकेन संयुगे। वानराणां महाराजः कृतस्स प्लवतां प्रभुः।।5.58.139।।
output: 'In the combat Rama killed Vali with a single arrow and made Sugriva the king of vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तस्य साहाय्यमस्माभिः कार्यं सर्वात्मना त्विह। तेन प्रस्थापितस्तुभ्यं समीपमिह धर्मतः।।5.58.140।।
output: 'We too have to help him in this task. So a message is sent to you on righteous grounds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षिप्रमानीयतां सीता दीयतां राघवाय च। यावन्न हरयो वीरा विधमन्ति बलं तव।।5.58.141।।
output: वीराः heroic, हरयः vanaras, तव your, बलम् army, यावत् entire, न विधमन्ति before exterminating your army, सीता Sita, क्षिप्रम् at once, आनीयताम् get, राघवाय to Rama, दीयतां च you may give.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
वानराणां प्रभावो हि न केन विदितः पुरा। देवतानां सङ्काशं च ये गच्छन्ति निमन्त्रिताः।।5.58.142।।
output: 'Who knows not the power of Vanaras in the past? Even gods had sought their help.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति वानरराजस्त्वामाहेत्यभिहितो मया। मामैक्षत ततः क्रुद्धश्चक्षुषा प्रदहन्निव।।5.58.143।।
output: इति this, वानरराजः king of vanaras, त्वाम् to you, आह to tell, इति this, मया my, अभिहितः wishing your welfare, ततः that, क्रुद्धः angrily, चक्षुषा eyes, प्रदहन्निव as if to burn, माम् at me, ऐक्षत looked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तेन वध्योऽहमाज्ञप्तो रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा। मत्प्रभावमविज्ञाय रावणेन दुरात्मना।।5.58.144।।
output: "The evilminded demon, Ravana, who perpetrates dreadful acts ordered my slaughter, not knowing my power.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
ततो विभीषणो नाम तस्य भ्राता महामतिः। तेन राक्षसराजोऽसौ याचितो मम कारणात्।।5.58.145।।
output: "Vibhisana, a very pious brother of the demon king, interceded on my behalf.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नैवं राक्षसशार्दूल त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः। राजशास्त्रव्यपेतो हि मार्गः संसेव्यते त्वया।।5.58.146।।
output: "Vibhishana, a tiger among demons, asked Ravana to give up his decision as it was a forbidden course according to the science of royal polity.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दूतवध्या न दृष्टा हि राजशास्त्रेषु राक्षस। दूतेन वेदितव्यं च यथार्थं हितवादिना।।5.58.147।।
output: राक्षस demon, राजशास्त्रेषु by the royal code, दूतवध्या killing of emissary, न दृष्टा हि not seen indeed, हितवादिना wellwisher, दूतेन messenger, यथार्थम् truth, वेदितव्यम् has to convey.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
सुमहत्यपराधेऽपि दूतस्यातुलविक्रमः। विरूपकरणं दृष्टं न वधोऽस्तीति शास्त्रतः।।5.58.148।।
output: 'O Ravana of immeasurable courage even if the emissary has done any kind of harm he may be mutilated but not murdered. Nowhere do the sastras allow killing (of an ambassador).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
विभीषणेनैवमुक्तो रावणस्सन्दिदेश तान्। राक्षसानेतदेवास्य लाङ्गूलं दह्यतामिति।।5.58.149।।
output: 'On hearing Vibhishana, Ravana instructed the demons to burn my tail.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा मम पुच्छं समन्ततः। वेष्टितं शणवल्कैश्च जीर्णैः कार्पासजैः पटैः।।5.58.150।।
output: "Having heard the king's words, all the demons collected and held my tail, wrapped it with saris of fibres and tattered rags of cotton.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसाः सिद्धसन्नाहास्ततस्ते चण्डविक्रमाः। तदाऽदह्यन्त मे पुच्छं निघ्नन्त: काष्ठमुष्टिभिः।।5.58.151।। बद्धस्य बहुभिः पाशैर्यन्त्रितस्य च राक्षसैः।
output: "Many ferociously courageous demons got ready. They bound me and hit me with firesticks and fists. They fastened my tail with ropes and set in on fire.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्ते राक्षसाश्शूरा बद्धं मामग्निसंवृतम्।।5.58.152।। अघोषयन्राजमार्गे नगरद्वारमागताः।
output: "The brave demons took me round the city through the royal streets and announced loudly to let every one know that I am bound and that my tail has been set on fire.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोऽहं सुमहद्रूपं संक्षिप्य पुनरात्मनः।।5.58.153।। विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिस्थः स्थितः पुनः। आयसं परिघं गृह्य तानि रक्षांस्यसूदयम्।।5.58.154।।
output: ततः then, अहम् I, आत्मनः my own, सुमहत् very huge, रूपम् form, पुनः again, संक्षिप्य assumed small form, तं बन्धम् that bondage, विमोचयित्वा got rid off, पुनः again, प्रकृतिस्थः into my natural huge form, स्थितः stayed, आयसम् near by, परिघम् iron beam, गृह्य took up, तानि रक्षांसि that rakshasas, असूदयम् killed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽहं सुमहद्रूपं संक्षिप्य पुनरात्मनः।।5.58.153।। विमोचयित्वा तं बन्धं प्रकृतिस्थः स्थितः पुनः। आयसं परिघं गृह्य तानि रक्षांस्यसूदयम्।।5.58.154।।
output: "I reduced my form and rid of the bondage. Then again I assumed my original huge form and took up an iron bar lying near and killed all the demons (present).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तन्नगरद्वारं वेगेनाप्लुतवानहम्। पुच्छेन च प्रदीप्तेन तां पुरीं साट्टगोपुराम्।।5.58.155।। दहाम्यहमसंभ्रान्तो युगान्ताग्निरिव प्रजाः।
output: "Then I leaped to the entrance gate of the city without being perplexed. With my burning tail I set fire to the boundaries and towering mansions which looked like the world at the end of dissolution.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
दहता च मया लङ्कां दग्धा सीता न संशयः।।5.58.157।। रामस्य हि महत्कार्यं मयेदं वितथीकृतम्।
output: "Lanka has been burnt by me and Sita might have also been burnt. There is no doubt. The great purpose of Rama has been spoilt by me'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तामहमुपागतः।।5.58.158।। अथाहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम्। जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम्।।5.58.159।।
output: इति thus, शोकसमाविष्टः overtaken by sorrow, अहम् I, चिन्ताम् worry, उपागतः became, अथ and then, अहम् I, जानकी Janaki, न च दग्धा not been burn, इति this, विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम् wonderful utterances, चारणानाम् from charanas, शुभाक्षराम् propitious, वाचम् words, अश्रौषम् heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इति शोकसमाविष्टश्चिन्तामहमुपागतः।।5.58.158।। अथाहं वाचमश्रौषं चारणानां शुभाक्षराम्। जानकी न च दग्धेति विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम्।।5.58.159।।
output: इति thus, शोकसमाविष्टः overtaken by sorrow, अहम् I, चिन्ताम् worry, उपागतः became, अथ and then, अहम् I, जानकी Janaki, न च दग्धा not been burn, इति this, विस्मयोदन्तभाषिणाम् wonderful utterances, चारणानाम् from charanas, शुभाक्षराम् propitious, वाचम् words, अश्रौषम् heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना श्रुत्वा तामद्भुतां गिरम्। अदग्धा जानकीत्येवं निमित्तैश्चोपलक्षिता।।5.58.160।।
output: अद्भुताम् amazing, तां गिरम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, ततः then, जानकी Janaki, अदग्धा not been burnt, इत्येवम् this way, मे my, बुद्धिः knew, उत्पन्ना arose, निमित्तैश्च on account of her, उपलक्षिता I understood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दीप्यमाने तु लाङ्गूले न मां दहति पावकः। हृदयं च प्रहृष्टं मे वातास्सुरभिगन्धिनः।।5.58.161।।
output: लाङ्गूले tail, दीप्यमाने was burning, पावकः by fire, माम् but I, न दहति was not burnt, मे my, हृदयं च from my heart, प्रहृष्टम् joy, वाताः wind, सुरभिगन्धिनः very sweet fragrance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
तैर्निमित्तैश्च दृष्टाथै: कारणैश्च महागुणैः। ऋषिवाक्यैश्च सिद्धार्थैरभवं हृष्टमानसः।।5.58.162।।
output: "For these two auspicious signs and the highly propitious words uttered by the sages I felt glad at heart.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुनर्दृष्ट्वा च वैदेहीं विसृष्टश्च तया पुनः। ततः पर्वतमासाद्य तत्रारिष्टमहं पुनः।।5.58.163।। प्रतिप्लवनमारेभे युष्मद्धर्शनकांक्षया।
output: वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, पुनः again, दृष्ट्वा च and to see, तया like that, पुनः again, विसृष्टः seeking permission, ततः then, अरिष्टपर्वतम् mountain Arishta, पुनः again, आसाद्य ascended, अहम् I, युष्मद्धर्शनकांक्षया to see you all, प्रतिप्लवनम् leapt again, आरेभे started.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 58:
ततः पवनचन्द्रार्कसिद्धगन्धर्वसेवितम्।।5.58.164।। पन्थानमहमाक्रम्य भवतो दृष्टवानिह।
output: "Passing along the path of the Windgod, the Moon, the Sun, the siddhas and the gandharvas  I came to see you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवस्य प्रभावेण भवतां चैव तेजसा।।5.58.165।। सुग्रीवस्य च कार्यार्थं मया सर्वमनुष्ठितम्।
output: राघवस्य Rama's, प्रभावेण by the power, भवताम् your, तेजसा चैव grace, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, कार्यार्थं च on his account, मया for me, सर्वम् all, अनुष्ठितम् was favourable.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतत्सर्वं मया तत्र यथावदुपपादितम्।।5.58.166।। अत्र यन्न कृतं शेषं तत्सर्वं क्रियतामिति।
output: एतत् all that, सर्वम् entire, तत्र there, मया by me, यथावत् as it is, उपपादितम् presented, अत्र there, यत् whatever, न कृतम् not done, शेषम् remaining task, तत् that, सर्वम् everything, क्रियताम् will do.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतदाख्याय तत्सर्वं हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। भूयस्समुपचक्राम वचनं वक्तुमुत्तरम्।।5.59.1।।
output: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, सर्वम् entire, तत् एतत् all that, आख्याय having narrated, भूयः whatever happened, उत्तरं वचनम् the good words, वक्तुम् told, समुपचक्राम again started telling.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
सफलो राघवोद्योग स्सुग्रीवस्य च सम्भ्रमः। शीलमासाद्य सीताया मम च प्रवणं मनः।।5.59.2।।
output: "It is due to Rama's exertions, Sugriva's endeavour and Sita's conduct that I have been successful. My devotion to Sita has further deepened.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तपसा निर्दहेल्लोकान्क्रुद्धो वा निर्दहेदपि। सर्वधातिप्रवृद्धोऽसौ रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ॥ 5.59.3 ॥
output: "The demon king is rich in asceticism. He can burn the whole world with the power of his penance. In spite of Sita's anger he was not burnt(Hanuman gives the reason for Ravana's survival).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्य तां स्पृशतो गात्रं तपसा न विनाशितम्। न तदग्निशिखा कुर्यात्संस्पृष्टा पाणिना सती।।5.59.4।। जनकस्यात्मजा कुर्याद्यत्क्रोधकलुषीकृता।
output: "Sita can burn Ravana with the mere touch of her body but because of the power of his penance, he was not burnt even though he touched her hand. If enraged, Janaki can burn the whole world (by virtue of her chastity) in a way that even the flame of fire can not do. (But she desired that her husband should kill him.)

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
अहमेकोऽपि पर्याप्तस्सराक्षसगणां पुरीम्। तां लङ्कां तरसा हन्तुं रावणं च महाबलम्।।5.59.7।।
output: अहम् I, एकोऽपि alone, सराक्षसगणाम् all the demon troops, तां लङ्कां पुरीम् and that city of Lanka, महाबलम् the great army, रावणं च and Ravana, तरसा quickly, हन्तुम् can kill, पर्याप्तः is enough.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किं पुन स्सहितो वीरैर्बलवद्भिः कृतात्मभिः। कृतास्त्रै: प्लवगैश्शूरैर्भवद्भिविजयैषिभिः।।5.59.8।।
output: "When strong, wise and accomplished persons are there with me desiring victory  why speak again?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
अहं तु रावणं युद्धे ससैन्यं सपुरस्सरम्। सहपुत्त्रं वधिष्यामि सहोदरयुतं युधि।।5.59.9।।
output: "I can also kill all the army,  his followers, sons and brothers of Ravana in war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ब्राह्ममैन्द्रं च रौद्रं च वायव्यं वारणं तथा। यदि शक्रजितोऽस्त्राणि दुर्निरीक्षाणि संयुगे।।5.59.10।। तान्यहं वधिष्यामि हनिष्यामि च राक्षसान्।
output: ब्राह्मम् Brahma's, ऐन्द्रं च even Indra's, रौद्रं च Rudra's, वायव्यम् or Windgod's, तथा similarly, वारुणम् Varuna's, शक्रजितः Indrajit, अस्त्राणि missiles, दुर्निरीक्षाणि though difficult to see, यदि such, तानि of them, संयुगे in war, वधिष्यामि will kill, राक्षसान् demon, हनिष्यामि च and destroy them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवतामभ्यनुज्ञातो विक्रमो मे रुणद्धि तम्।।5.59.11।। मयातुला विसृष्टा हि शैलवृष्टिर्निरन्तरा। देवानपि रणे हन्यात्किं पुनस्तान्निशाचरान्।।5.59.12।।
output: Now if I am permitted, I shall repulse them and destroy them with my valour. A  ceaseless shower of rocks sent forth by me in war is enough to destroy even gods what to say about the nightrangers?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवतामभ्यनुज्ञातो विक्रमो मे रुणद्धि तम्।।5.59.11।। मयातुला विसृष्टा हि शैलवृष्टिर्निरन्तरा। देवानपि रणे हन्यात्किं पुनस्तान्निशाचरान्।।5.59.12।।
output: Now if I am permitted, I shall repulse them and destroy them with my valour. A  ceaseless shower of rocks sent forth by me in war is enough to destroy even gods what to say about the nightrangers?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सागरोऽप्यतियाद्वेलां मन्दरः प्रचलेदपि। न जाम्बवन्तं समरे कम्पयेदरिवाहिनी।।5.59.13।।
output: सागरः ocean, वेलाम् shore, अतियादपि exceeds also, मन्दरः mountain Mandara, प्रचलेदपि may shake up, समरे in war, अरिवाहिनी flow of enemies, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, न कम्पयेत् not move.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वराक्षससङ्घानां राक्षसा ये च पूर्वकाः। अलमेको विनाशाय वीरो वालिसुतः कपिः।।5.59.14।।
output: वीरः hero, वालिसुतः son of Vali, कपिः vanara, एकः alone, सर्वराक्षससङ्घानाम् all the demon hordes, पूर्वकाः led, ये by him, विनाशाय to destroy, अलम् enough.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
पनसस्योरुवेगेन नीलस्य च महात्मनः। मन्दरोऽप्यवशीर्येत किंपुनर्युधि राक्षसाः।।5.59.15।
output: "Even the mountain Mandara would be shattered by great Panasa or Nila by the speed of their thighs. What to say in a battle against ogres?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सदेवासुरयक्षेषु गन्धर्वोरगपक्षिषु। मैन्दस्य प्रतियोद्धारं शंसत द्विविदस्य वा।।5.59.16।।
output: "Who among gods, yakshas, gandharvas, nagas and birds can contend Mainda or Dvivida in battle?Tell me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अश्विपुत्रौ महाभागावेतौ प्लवगसत्तमौ। एतयोः प्रतियोद्दारं न पश्यामि रणाजिरे।।5.59.17।।
output: "The (two) sons of Aswini are outstanding and foremost fighters and proud of waging war. Who can oppose them? I do not see any one.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पितामहवरोत्सेकात्परमं दर्पमास्थितौ। अमृतप्राशिनावेतौ सर्ववानरसत्तमौ।।5.59.18।।
output: पितामहवरोत्सेकात् by virtue of the boons received from Brahma, परमम् very, दर्पम् proud, आस्थितौ filled with, एतौ both of them that way, वानरसत्तमौ foremost of vanaras, अमृतप्राशिनौ have consumed nectar of immortality.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अश्विनोर्माननार्थं हि सर्वलोकपितामहः। सर्वावध्यत्वमतुलमनयोर्दत्तवान्पुरा।।5.59.19।।
output: "Earlier Brahma, the grandsire of all worlds has given the Aswini sons immeasurable invulnerability to honour them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
वरोत्सेकेन मत्तौ च प्रमथ्य महतीं चमूम्। सुराणाममृतं वीरौ पीतवन्तौ प्लवङ्गमौ।।5.59.20।।
output: "The heroic monkeys, proud of their boons became intoxicated it and slaughtered vast army and drank the nectar of immortality.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
एतावेव हि सङ्कृद्धौ सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्। लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तौ सर्वे तिष्ठन्तु वानराः।।5.59.21।।
output: "If these two become angry they have the power to destroy Lanka, the cavalry, chariots and also the elephants even if the vanaras stay away.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मयैव निहता लङ्का दग्धा भस्मीकृता पुनः। राजमार्गेषु सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया।।5.59.22।।
output: "I have burnt Lanka and have made my name popular even on the highways.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः।।5.59.23।। अहं कोसलराजस्य दासः पवनसम्भवः। हनुमानिति सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया।।5.59.24।।
output: अतिबलः mighty, रामः Rama, जयति will triumph, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, राघवेण by Rama, अभिपालितः protected, राजा king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, जयति will triumph, पवनसम्भवः son of the Windgod, अहम् I, कोसलराजस्य king of Kosala kingdom, दासः servant, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति this, मया by me, नाम name, विश्रावितम् announced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः।।5.59.23।। अहं कोसलराजस्य दासः पवनसम्भवः। हनुमानिति सर्वत्र नाम विश्रावितं मया।।5.59.24।।
output: "Mighty Rama and Lakshmana and King Sugriva protected by Rama are renowned for their valour. I am Hanuman, son of the Windgod, a servant of Rama. This I announced.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
अशोकवनिकामध्ये रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। अध स्ताच्छिंशुपावृक्षे साध्वी करुणमास्थिता।।5.59.25।। राक्षसीभिः परिवृता शोकसंतापकर्शिता। मेघलेखापरिवृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा।।5.59.26।।। अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही रावणं बलदर्पितम्।
output: "In the wicked, Ravana's Ashoka garden under the Simsupa tree the noble lady Sita surrounded by ogresses, is sitting, tormented by tears. Her brightness is like the Moon's, veiled by flakes of clouds. She does not care for Ravana's glory. She is brooding over Rama only.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अशोकवनिकामध्ये रावणस्य दुरात्मनः। अध स्ताच्छिंशुपावृक्षे साध्वी करुणमास्थिता।।5.59.25।। राक्षसीभिः परिवृता शोकसंतापकर्शिता। मेघलेखापरिवृता चन्द्रलेखेव निष्प्रभा।।5.59.26।।। अचिन्तयन्ती वैदेही रावणं बलदर्पितम्।
output: दुरात्मनः wicked, रावणस्य Ravana's, अशोकवनिकामध्ये in the midst of Ashoka garden, शिंशुपावृक्षे Simsupa tree, अधस्तात् under, साध्वी noble lady, राक्षसीभिः by ogresses, परिवृता surrounded, शोकसन्तापकर्शिता tormented by tears, मेघलेखापरिवृता veiled by clouds, चन्द्रलेखेव like the Moonrays, निष्प्रभा without  brightness, बलदर्पितम्  glory, रावणम् Ravana, अचिन्तयन्ती not even thinking, वैदेही Vaidehi, करुणम् piteous, आस्थिता remained.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
पतिव्रता च सुश्रोणी अवष्टब्धा च जानकी।।5.59.27।। अनुरक्ता हि वैदेही रामं सर्वात्मना शुभा। अनन्यचित्ता रामे च पौलोमीव पुरन्दरे।।5.59.28।।
output: "Chaste Sita of beautiful hips, an auspicious lady though bound is wholly devoted to Rama alone like Sachi, the wife of Indra who was bound by Nahusha.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पतिव्रता च सुश्रोणी अवष्टब्धा च जानकी।।5.59.27।। अनुरक्ता हि वैदेही रामं सर्वात्मना शुभा। अनन्यचित्ता रामे च पौलोमीव पुरन्दरे।।5.59.28।।
output: पतिव्रता chaste woman, सुश्रोणी who has beautiful hips, जानकी Janaki, अवष्टब्धा though bound, शुभा auspicious, वैदेही Vaidehi, सर्वात्मना all her self, रामम् Rama only, अनुरक्ता devoted, पुरन्दरे Indra, पौलोमीव like Sachi the wife of Indra, रामे only on Rama, अनन्यचित्ता always thinking.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदेकवासस्संवीता रजोध्वस्ता तथैव च। शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गी सीता भर्तृहिते रता।।5.59.29।।
output: तदेकवासस्संवीता wearing only one cloth, तथैव च with that only, रजोध्वस्ता filled with dust, शोकसन्तापदीनाङ्गी very sorrowful and piteous, सीता Sita, भर्तृहिते wishing the welfare of her husband, रता remained.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने।।5.59.30।। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा। अधश्शय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे।।5.59.31।। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया।
output: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने।।5.59.30।। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा। अधश्शय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे।।5.59.31।। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया।
output: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता।।5.59.32।। ततः संभाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता।।5.59.33।।
output: मृगशाबाक्षी fawneyed woman, कथञ्चित् little, विश्वासम् confidence, उपपादिता pacified, ततः then, संभाषिता चैव after conversing only, सर्वम् everything, अर्थं च with difficulty, दर्शिता presented, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च alliance of Rama and Sugriva, श्रुत्वा after hearing, प्रीतिम् happy, उपागता became.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता।।5.59.32।। ततः संभाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता।।5.59.33।।
output: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नियतस्समुदाचारो भक्तिर्भर्तरि चोत्तमा। यन्न हन्ति दशग्रीवं सा महात्मा कृतागसम्।।5.59.34।।
output: "Ravana is a great soul because, even though he has done harm to her, he is not killed. This is because Sita being a chaste woman of good conduct and deep devotion towards her husband (she refrained from killing Ravana as she wanted her husband to do that.)

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निमित्तमात्रं रामस्तु वधे तस्य भविष्यति। सा प्रकृत्यैव तन्वङ्गी तद्वियोगाच्च कर्शिता।।5.59.35।। प्रतिपत्पाठशीलस्य विद्येव तनुमतां गता।
output: "To Rama, killing Ravana is easy (since Ravana's power of penance has already declined by his abduction of Sita). Separated from her husband she is naturally emaciated. She has become slender just like a student on the new Moon day (on the first day of study).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 59:
एवमास्ते महाभागा सीता शोकपरायणा।।5.59.36।। यदत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत्सर्वमुपपाद्यताम्।
output: "Noble Sita is absorbed in grief. Let us do all that has to be done now." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वालिसूनुरभाषत। अयुक्तं तु विना देवीं दृष्टवद्भिश्च वानराः।।5.60.1।। समीपं गन्तुमस्माभी राघवस्य महात्मनः।
output: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, वालिसूनुः Vali's son, अभाषत said this, वानराः O vanaras, दृष्टवद्भिः even after seeing, अस्माभिः her, देवीं विना without Sita, महात्मनः great soul, राघवस्य to Rama, समीपम् near, गन्तुम् going, अयुक्तं तु not appropriate.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 60:
दृष्टा देवी न चानीता इति तत्र निवेदनम्।।5.60.2।। अयुक्तमिव पश्यामि भवद्भिः ख्यातविक्रमैः।
output: "O vanaras, you are known for your valour. I think, to tell Rama that we have seen Sita but not brought her is not proper".

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न हि नः प्लवने कश्चिन्नापि कश्चित्पराक्रमे।।5.60.3।। तुल्य स्सामरदैत्येषु लोकेषु हरिसत्तमाः।
output: "O noble vanaras Indeed either among gods or among demons there is none who can match the vanaras in leaping and exhibiting valour.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेष्वेवं हतवीरेषु राक्षसेषु हनूमता।।5.60.4।। किमन्यदत्र कर्तव्यं गृहीत्वा याम जानकीम्।
output: तेषु hence, राक्षसेषु  among demons, हनूमता Hanuman, एवम् in that way, हतवीरेषु dead heroes, अत्र there, किम् what, अन्यत् other, कर्तव्यम् action, जानकीम् Janaki, गृहीत्वा get, याम here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 60:
तमेवं कृतसङ्कल्पं जाम्बवान् हरिसत्तमः।।5.60.5।। उवाच परमप्रीतो वाक्यमर्थवदर्थवित्।
output: "Jambavan, the noble vanara, skilled in the execution of tasks thus commanded in a determined manner:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 60:
न तावदेषा मतिरक्षमा नो यथा भवान् पश्यति राजपुत्र। यथा तु रामस्य मतिर्निविष्टा तथा भवान् पश्यतु कार्यसिद्धिम्।।5.60.6।।
output: "O prince what you think is  acceptable to us also. Even though we are capable of achieving, knowing what is in Rama's mind, we should act only according to his command to accomplish the task. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramyana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः। अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनुमांश्च महाकपिः।।5.61.1।।
output: Monkey leaders enter Madhuvan on the outskirts of Kishkinda and destroy it in their drunkenness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपरस्पराः। महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः।।5.61.2।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः। छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः।।5.61.3।। सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम्। हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः।।5.61.4।। राघवे चार्थनिर्ववृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः। समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः सर्वेसिद्धिभिरुन्नता।।5.61.5।। प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्स्विनः।।5.61.6।।
output: ततः then, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशाः resembling Meru mountain, मत्ताः in rut, गजाः इव like elephants, आकाशम् sky, छादयन्तः इव as though covering the sky, महाकायाः of huge body, महाबलाः mighty, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among leaping monkeys, सर्वे all, महेन्द्राद्रिम् from the summit of Mahendra mountain, परित्यज्य left, प्रीतिमन्तः very happily, वायुपुत्रपुरस्सराः led by the son of the Windgod, भूतैः all creatures, सभाज्यमानम् praised by, आत्मवन्तम् selfconfident, महाबलम् mighty, महावेगम् swift, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दृष्टिभिः seeing, वहन्तः इव like seeing without blinking, राघवे Rama's, अर्थनिर्ववृततिम् remaining in state of offering, परमम् supreme, यशः fame, कर्तुम् to do, समाधाय concentrating, समृद्धार्थाः better than others, कर्मसिद्धिभिः  accomplished ones, उन्नताः eager, पुप्लुवुः jumping vanaras, सर्वे all, प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः pleasantly talking among themselves, सर्वे all, युद्धाभिनन्दिनः anxious to wage a war, मनस्स्विनः determined, सर्वे all, रामप्रतीकारे to please, निश्चितार्थाः determined.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Sundara Kanda, Sarga 61:
प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपरस्पराः। महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः।।5.61.2।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः। छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः।।5.61.3।। सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम्। हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः।।5.61.4।। राघवे चार्थनिर्ववृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः। समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः सर्वेसिद्धिभिरुन्नता।।5.61.5।। प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्स्विनः।।5.61.6।।
output: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.
