output: रामस्य: Rama's, दयिता: dear, स्वयम् his own, पत्नी: wife, नदीयतेयदि: if not given, चलङ्कापुरी: and this Lanka, विनश्येत् हि: will be destroyed, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाश्च: Rakshasas also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रसादयेत्वांबन्धुत्वात्कुरुष्यवचनंमम । हितंतथ्यमहंब्रूमिदीयतामस्यमैथिली ।।6.9.20।।
output: "I am requesting you because you are my relation (brother). Do as I said, as I am telling you for your welfare. Give away Sita."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुराशरत्सूर्यमरीचिसन्निभान्नवाग्रपुङ्खान् सुदृढान्नृपात्मजः । सृजत्यमोघान्विशिखान्वधायतेप्रदीयतांदशरधायमैथिली ।।6.9.21।।
output: "You may restore Rama's Mythili, before the emperor Dasaratha's son sends forth solid unfailing arrows shining like autumnal Sun provided with fresh heads and shafts for killing you."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वजस्वकोपंसुखधर्मनाशनंभजस्वधर्मंरतिकीर्तिवर्धनम् । प्रसीदजीवेमसपुत्रबान्धवाःप्रदीयतांदाशरथायमैथिली ।।6.9.22।।
output: सुखधर्मनाशनम् happiness will destroy virtues, कोपम् anger, आशु: that, त्यज: give up, रतिकीर्तिवर्धनम् pleasures that enhance fame, धर्मम् righteousness, भजस्व: seek, प्रसीद: pacified, सपुत्रबान्धवाः with sons and relatives, जीवेम: live, मैथिली: Mythili, दाशरथाय: Dasaratha's son Rama's, प्रदीयताम् restore.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विभीषणवच्शुत्वारावणोराक्षसेश्वराः । विसर्जयित्वातान्सर्वान्प्रविवेशस्वकंगृहम् ।।6.9.23।।
output: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, तान् those, सर्वान् everything, विसर्जयित्वा: sending away स्वकम् he too, गृहम् home, प्रविवेश: entered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःप्रत्युषसिप्राप्तेप्राप्तधर्मार्थनिश्चयः । राक्षसाधिपतेर्वेश्मभीमकर्माविभीषणः ।।6.10.1।।
output: ततः thereafter, प्राप्तधर्मार्थनिश्चयः determined to relate about righteous and material gains, भीमकर्मा: of fierce task, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युषसि: when morning Sun, प्राप्ते: rose, राक्षसाधिपतेः Lord of Rakshasas, वेश्म: residence.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
शैलाग्रचयसङ्काशंशैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । सुविभक्तमहाकक्षंमहाजनपरिग्रहम् ।।6.10.2।।
output: Like a lofty mountain top, and like a summit of a mountain, Ravana's palace was a supreme one, divided into many spacious sections and surrounded by many people.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मतिमद्भिर्महामात्रैरनुरक्तैरधिष्ठितम् । राक्षसैराप्तपर्याप्तैस्सर्वतःपरिरक्षितम् ।।6.10.3।।
output: मतिमद्भि: wise ones, अनुरक्तै: devoted to their Lord, महामात्रैः great ministers, अधिष्ठितम् commanded by, आप्तपर्याप्तै: competent and trustworthy, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, सर्वतः everywhere, परिरक्षितम् well protected.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
मत्तमातङ्गनिश्श्वासैर्व्याकुलीकृतमारुतम् । शङ्खघोषमहाघोषंतूर्यनादानुनादितम् ।।6.10.4।।
output: It was filled with elephants in rut breathing heavily, which was like a tempestuous wind around, that echoed by the blowing of conchs of the early morning and filled with the sounds of drums and trumpets.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
प्रमदाजनसम्बाधंप्रजल्पितमहापथम् । तप्तकाञ्चननिर्यूहंभूषणोत्तमभूषितम् ।।6.10.5।।
output: (It was) The royal path was filled with women, with prattling sounds of gossiping. It had shining golden passages and decorated with the best of ornaments.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
गन्धर्वाणामिवाऽवासमालयंमरुतामिव । रत्नसञ्चयसम्बाधंभवनंभोगिनामिव ।।6.10.6।।
output: (It was) like the abode of Gandharvas (the celestial musicians), like an abode of wind god, abounding in collection of precious gems, like the mansion of Nagas indulging  in enjoyment.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
तंमहाभ्रमिवाऽदित्यस्तेजोविस्तृतरश्मिमान् । अग्रजस्यालयंवीरःप्रविवेशमहाद्युतिः ।।6.10.7।।
output: Heroic (Vibheeshana) of exceptional splendour, whose brilliance spread widely like the radiance of the highly lustrous Sun entered his brother's abode.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुण्यान्पुण्याहघोषांश्चवेदविद्भिरुदाहृतान् । शुश्रावसुमहातेजाभ्रातुर्विजयसंश्रितान् ।।6.10.8।।
output: Highly effulgent (Vibheeshana) heard sounds of recitation of sacred mantras from Vedas uttered by learned ones desiring a propitious day for his brother.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पूजितान् दधिपात्रैश्चसर्पिर्भिस्सुमनोक्षतैः । मन्त्रवेदविदोविप्रान्ददर्शसमहाबलः ।।6.10.9।।
output: Mighty Vibheeshana saw there, brahmins learned in vedas and mantras, who worshipped with yellow rice, curd, clarified butter and flowers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सपूज्यमानोरक्षोभिद्दीप्यमानस्स्वतेजसा । आसनस्थंमहाबाहुर्ववन्देधनदानुजम् ।।6.10.10।।
output: Vibheeshana, of broad shoulders, who is revered by Rakshasas was shining in his own splendour. He greeted with folded palms, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) seated on his chair.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सराजदृष्टिसम्पन्नमासनंहेमभूषितम् । जगामसमुदाचारंप्रयुज्याचारकोविदः ।।6.10.11।।
output: आचारकोविदः learned in traditions, सः that Vibheeshana, समुदाचारम् wellversed in the code of conduct, प्रयुज्यराजदृष्टिसम्पन्नम् blessed by the glance of the king, हेमभूषितम् decorated with gold, आसनम् seat, जगाम: reached.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
सरावणंमहात्मानंविजनेमन्त्रिसन्निधौ । उवाचहितमत्यर्थंवचनंहेतुनिश्चितम् ।।6.10.12।।
output: When none other than ministers were present, Vibheeshana spoke these meaningful words to the distinguished Ravana, decidedly wishing for welfare.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रसाद्यभ्रातरंजेष्ठंसान्त्वेनोपस्थितक्रमः । देशकालार्थसंवादिदृष्टलोकपरावरः ।।6.10.13।।
output: Vibheeshana who knew the good and bad of the world and knew to advice in consonance with place and time said to his elder brother in an appeasing manner, propitiating him observing the customary tradition.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदाप्रभृतिवैदेहीसम्प्रास्तेमांपुरींतव । तदाप्रभृतिदृश्यन्तेनिमित्तान्यशुभानिनः ।।6.10.14।।
output: इमांपुरीं: this city, वैदेही: Vaidehi, यदाप्रभृतिइह: since she has come here, सम्प्राप्ता: observed, तदाप्रभृति: such signs are observed, नः by us, अशुभानि: inauspicious, निमित्तानि: happenings, दृश्यन्ते: are seen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
सस्फुलिङ्गस्सधूमार्चिस्सधूमकलुषोदयः । मन्त्रसङ्घहुतोऽप्यग्निर्नसम्यगभिवर्थते ।।6.10.15।।
output: "Even from the fire of fire sacrifices, fire particles polluted with smoke are rising and the fire is not burning with brilliance."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्निष्ठेष्वग्निशलासुतथाब्रह्मस्थालीषुच । सरीसृपाणिदृश्यन्तेहन्येषुचपिपीलिकाः ।।6.10.16।।
output: अग्निष्ठेषु: in cooking fire, अग्निशालासु: in places of fire sacrifice, तथा: so also, ब्रह्मस्थलीषुच: at places where offerings are made into fire, सरीसृपाणि: serpents, दृश्यन्ते: are seen, हव्येषु: in the Havis, पिपीलिकाः ants are seen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
गवांसयांसिस्कन्नानिविमदावीरकुञ्जराः । दीनमश्वाःप्रहेषन्तेनचग्रासाभिनन्दिनः ।।6.10.17।।
output: "The udder of cows is dried up, the proud elephants have lost their ichor, the horses are pathetic and neighing. They are not even interested in fodder."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
खरोष्ट्राश्वतराराजभनभिन्नरोमास्स्रवन्तिच । नस्वभावेऽवतिष्ठन्तिविधानैरपिचिन्तिताः ।।6.10.18।।
output: "O King the donkeys and camels have shed their body hair and are crying. Even though they are treated for it in different ways they are not getting to be in normal natural form."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
वायसाःसङ्घशःक्रूराव्याहरन्तिसमन्ततः । समवेताश्चदृश्यन्तेविमानाग्रेषुसङ्घशः ।।6.10.19।।
output: Wild crows are seen in flocks all over the top of aerial chariot sounding harsh gathered in groups.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गृध्राश्चपरिलीयन्तेपुरीमुपरिपिण्डिताः । उपपन्नाश्चस्नध्येद्वेव्याहऱ्नत्यशिवंशिवाः ।।6.10.20।।
output: गृध्राश्च: even eagles, पुरीमुपरि: over the houses of the capital, पिण्डिताः collected, परिलीयन्ते: repeatedly standing, शिवाः auspicious, द्वेसन्ध्ये: in both morning and evening twilight time, उपपन्नाः coming together, अशिवम् inauspicious, व्याहरन्ति: sounding.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्रव्यादानांमृगाणांचपुरीद्वारेषुसङ्घशः । श्रूयन्तेविपुलाघोषास्सविस्फूर्जितनिस्स्वनाः ।।6.10.21।।
output: पुरिद्वारेषु: at the entrance of capital, सङ्घशः collected, क्रव्यादानाम् carnivorous, मृगाणाम् animals, सविस्फूर्जिन्तिस्स्वनाः like thunderous sounds, विपुलाः loud, घोषाः noise, श्रूयन्ते: heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदेवंप्रस्तुतेकार्येप्रायश्चित्तमिदंक्षमम् । रोचतेयदिवैदेहीराघवायप्रदीयताम् ।।6.10.22।।
output: यदि: such being, तत् that, एवम् in that way, प्रस्तुते: commenced, कार्ये: task (of burning Lanka), इदम् this is, क्षमम् appropriate, प्रायश्चित्तम् atonement, रोचते: I have thought, वैदेही: Vaidehi, राघवाय: to Rama, प्रदीयताम् restore.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इदंचयदिवामोहाल्लोभाद्वाव्याहृतंमया । तत्रापिचमहाराज नदोषंकर्तुमर्हसि ।।6.10.23।।
output: "O great king You may know that I am not telling like this out of my delusion or greed. You ought not to find fault with me."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयंहिदोषस्सर्वस्यजनस्यास्योपलक्ष्यते । रक्षसांराक्षसीनांचपुरस्यान्तःपुरस्यच ।।6.10.24।।
output: All of us, the Rakshasas and Rakshasa women of the capital, even those in the harem, and all the common people are aware of this offence.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 10:
श्रावणेचास्यमन्त्रस्यनिवृत्तास्सर्वमन्त्रिणः । अवश्यंचमयावाच्यंयद्दृष्टमपिवाश्रुतम् ।।6.10.25।। सम्विधाययथान्यायंतद्भवान् कर्तुमर्हति ।
output: All your ministers have abstained from telling you out of fear of you. I must necessarily tell you (as brother) this which is seen and heard. You may determine that which is justifiable by determining the propriety. It is proper for me to submit to you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इतिस्ममन्त्रिणांमध्येभ्राताभ्रातरमूचिवान् । रावणंराक्षसांश्रेष्ठंपथ्यमेतद्विभीषणः ।।6.11.26।।
output: भ्राता: brother, विभीषण: Vibheeshana, स्ममन्त्रिणाम् in the presence of his ministers, भ्रातरम् brother, राक्षसां: among Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठम् eminent, रावणम् to Ravana, इति: thus, पथ्यम् beneficial, एतत् all this, ऊचिवान् tendered advice.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हितंमहार्थंमृदुहेतुसंहितंव्यतीतकालायतिसम्प्रतिक्षमम् । निशम्यतद्वाक्यमुपस्थितज्वरःप्रसङ्गवानुत्तरमेतदब्रवीत् ।।6.10.27।।
output: प्रसङ्गवान् words of counsel, हितम् welfare, महार्थम् very meaningful, मृदु: gentle, हेतुसंहितम् that which was full of benefit, व्यतीतकालायतिसम्प्रतिक्षमम् that which is beneficial for the past, present and future also, तत् such, वाक्यम् statement, निशम्य: foregoing, उपस्थितज्वरः seized with anger, एतत् this manner, उत्तरम् replied, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भयंनपश्यामिकुतश्चिदप्यहंनराघवःप्राप्स्यतिजातुमैथिलीम् । सुरैस्सहेन्द्रैरपिसङ्गरेकथंममाग्रतस्स्थास्यतिलक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।।6.10.28।।
output: अहम् I am, कुतश्चिदपि: of anyone, भयम् fear, नपश्यामि: do not perceive, राघवः Rama, जातु: at any time, मैथिलीम् Mythili, नप्राप्स्यति: will not get, सहेन्द्रेः with Indra, सुरैरपि: with Suras, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, सङ्गरे: in battle, मम: with me, अग्रज: elder brother, कथम् how can, स्थास्यति: withstand.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्येवमुक्त्वासुरसैन्यनाशनोमहाबलस्संयतिचण्डविक्रमः । दशाननोभ्रातरमाप्तवादिनंविसर्जयामासतदाविभीषणम् ।।6.10.29।।
output: Then mighty tenheaded Ravana of formidable valour, a destroyer of Devatas' army in war, sent away Vibheeshana who had spoken words of good advice in that manner. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेवामलीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेदशमस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the tenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सबभूवकृशोराजामैथिलीकाममोहितः । असन्मानाच्चसुहृदांपापंपापेनकर्मणा ।।6.11.1।।
output: Ravana enters the royal assembly followed by Vibheeshana, Prahastha and others and holds consultations with his ministers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
अतीतसमयेकालेतस्मिन्वैयुधिरावणः । अमात्यैश्चसुहृद्भिश्चप्राप्तकालममन्यत ।।6.11.2।।
output: Because of the lapse of time, Ravana considered it imminent to consult with his ministers and friends about war.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सहेमजालविततंमणिविद्रुमभूषितम् । उपगम्यविनीताश्वमारुरोहमहारथम् ।।6.11.3।।
output: Ravana, having reached, ascended the magnificent chariot that was overlaid with golden latticework, decked with gems and corals, and yoked to trained horses.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमास्थायरथश्रेष्ठंमहामेघसमस्वनम् । प्रययौरक्षसांश्रेष्ठोदशग्रीवस्सभांप्रति ।।6.11.4।।
output: रक्षसाम् of Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठः eminent, दशग्रीवः tenheaded Ravana, महामेघसमस्वनम् making sound like the roaring noise of a huge cloud, तम् him, रथश्रेष्ठम् best chariot, आस्थाय: climbed up, सभांप्रति: to assembly, प्रययौ: went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
असिचर्मधरायोधास्सर्वायुधधरास्ततः । राक्षसाराक्षसेन्द्रस्यपुरस्तात्सम्प्रतस्थिरे ।।6.11.5।।
output: Then soldiers wielding swords and different kinds of weapons stood in front of the Lord of Rakshasas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नानाविकृतवेषाश्चनानाभूषणभूषिताः । पार्श्वतस्पृष्ठतश्चैनंपरिवार्यययुस्तत:।। 6.11.6।।
output: नानाविकृतवेषाश्च: adorned in different kinds of uncouth attire, नानाभरणभूषिताः wearing different kinds of ornaments, तत: thereafter, एनम् by his, पार्श्वतः sides, पष्ठतश्चैव: and also back, परिवार्य: surrounding, ययुः went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
रथैश्चातिरथाश्शीघ्रंमत्तैश्चवरवारणैः । अनूत्पेतुर्दशग्रीवमाक्रीडद्भिश्चवाजिभिः ।।6.11.7।।
output: (Some Rakshasa) Charioteers riding on chariots, some on proud elephants and some on horses sporting away followed the tenheaded Ravana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गदापरिघहस्ताश्चशक्तितोमरपाणयः । परश्वथधराश्चान्येतथाऽन्येशूलपाणयः ।।6.11.8।।
output: Some holding maces and iron bars, some holding strong iron clubs in hand, and some others holding battle axes, tridents and other weapons went.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणांसञ्जज्ञेनिस्स्वनोमहान् । तुमुलश्शङ्खशब्दश्चसभांगच्छतिरावणे ।।6.11.9।।
output: ततः then, रावणे: as Ravana, सभाम् to the assembly, गच्छति: as he entered, तूर्यसहस्राणाम् thousands of band instruments, महान् high, निस्स्वनः sounded, तुमुलः tumultuous noise, शङ्खशब्दश्च: sounds of conchs, सञ्जज्ञे: broke forth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सनेमिघोषेणमहान्सहसाऽभिनिनादयन् । राजमार्गंश्रियाजुष्टंप्रतिपेदेमहारथः ।।6.11.10।।
output: महान् great, सः he, महारथः great chariot, नेमिघोषेण: rattling sound of chariot, अभिनिनादयन् echoed in all directions, श्रिया: bright, जुष्टम् pleasing, राजमार्गम् royal path, सहसा: all at once, प्रतिपेदे: entered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विमलंचातपत्राणांप्रगृहीतमशोभत । पाण्डुरंराक्षसेन्द्रस्यपूर्णस्ताराधिपोयथा ।।6.11.11।।
output: The pure white canopy of Ravana held by the Rakshasas spread like lines shone like the Lord of stars (the full moon).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
हेममञ्जरिगर्भेचशुद्धस्फटिकविग्रहे । चामरव्यजनेतस्यरेजतुस्सव्यदक्षिणे ।।6.11.12।।
output: A pair of fans with pure crystal like handles with a golden bouquet in the middle glowed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
तेकृताञ्जलयस्सर्वेरथस्थंपृथिवीस्थिताः । राक्षसाराक्षसश्रेष्ठंशिरोभिस्तंववन्दिरे ।।6.11.13।।
output: Standing on the ground, all the Rakshasas bowing their heads down and with folded palms offered their salutations to the foremost of the Rakshasas seated in the chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
राक्षसैस्त्सूयमानस्सञ्जयाशीर्भिररिन्दमः । आससादमहातेजास्सभांविरचितांतदा ।।6.11.14।।
output: Then as the conqueror of foes, an exceptionally splendid one, Ravana was praised by the Rakshasas saying, "Victory to you, Prosperity to you", Ravana entered the wellbuilt royal court.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुवर्णरजतास्तीर्णांविशुद्धस्फटिकान्तराम् । विराजमानोवपुषारुक्मपट्टोत्तरच्छदाम् ।।6.11.15।। तांपिशाचशतै: षङ्भिरभिगुप्तांसदाप्रभाम् । प्रविवेशमहातेजास्सुकृतांविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.11.16।।
output: Exceptionally splendid one, (Ravana) embodied with glowing body entered the royal court constructed by Vishwakarma, with pillars of gold and silver. Inside of the court was pure like crystal and carpeted with shining golden silk. It was very beautiful and ever shining and guarded by six hundred devils.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुवर्णरजतास्तीर्णांविशुद्धस्फटिकान्तराम् । विराजमानोवपुषारुक्मपट्टोत्तरच्छदाम् ।।6.11.15।। तांपिशाचशतै: षङ्भिरभिगुप्तांसदाप्रभाम् । प्रविवेशमहातेजास्सुकृतांविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.11.16।।
output: Exceptionally splendid one, (Ravana) embodied with glowing body entered the royal court constructed by Vishwakarma, with pillars of gold and silver. Inside of the court was pure like crystal and carpeted with shining golden silk. It was very beautiful and ever shining and guarded by six hundred devils.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यांसवैडूर्यमयंप्रियकाजिनसम्वृतम् । महत्सोपाश्रयंभेजेरावणःपरमासनम् ।।6.11.17।।
output: Ravana sat on a huge excellent seat encrusted with Vydurya gems and covered with deer skin and which had a pillow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत: शशासेश्वरवद्दूतान्लघुपराक्रमान् । समानयतमेक्षिप्रमिहैतान्राक्षसानिति ।। कृत्यमस्तिमहज्जानेकर्तव्यमितिशत्रुभिः ।।6.11.18।।
output: Then that Lord like Ravana said "We have to do a great task against the enemies now. It has to be performed." He commanded quick footed messengers to get the Rakshasas to him at once.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
राक्षसास्तद्वचश्श्रुत्वालङ्कायांपरिचक्रमुः ।।6.11.19।। अनुगेहमवस्थायविहारशयनेषुच । उद्यानेषुचरक्षांसिचोदयन्तोह्यभीतवत् ।।6.11.20।।
output: Those Rakshasas having heard the words spoken by Ravana went to places of recreation, bedrooms and gardens and went round without fear into every house directing the Rakshasas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसास्तद्वचश्श्रुत्वालङ्कायांपरिचक्रमुः ।।6.11.19।। अनुगेहमवस्थायविहारशयनेषुच । उद्यानेषुचरक्षांसिचोदयन्तोह्यभीतवत् ।।6.11.20।।
output: Those Rakshasas having heard the words spoken by Ravana went to places of recreation, bedrooms and gardens and went round without fear into every house directing the Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
तेरथान् रुचिरानेकेदृप्तानेकेपृथग्घयान् । नागानेकेऽधिरुरुहुर्जग्मुश्चैकेपदातयः ।।6.11.21।।
output: Of those (Rakshasas) some went on exquisite chariots, some on proud sturdy horses some ascended elephants and some by foot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
सापुरीपरमाकीर्णारथकुञ्जरवाजिभिः । सम्पतद्भिर्विरुरुचेगरुत्मद्भिरिवाम्बरम् ।।6.11.22।।
output: With chariots, elephants and horses advancing in groups the prosperous capital was shining resembling the flocks of birds in the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेवाहनाव्यवस्थाप्ययानानिविविधानिच । सभांपद्भिःप्रविविशुस्सिंहागिरिगुहामिव ।।6.11.23।।
output: ते: those, वाहनानि: vehicles, विविधानि: of several kinds, यानानिच: at the entrance and, अवस्थाप्य: parking, सिंहाः lions, गिरिगुहामिव: like a cave of a mountain, सभाम् royal court, पद्भिः on foot, प्रविविशुः entered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राज्ञःपादौगृहीत्वातुराज्ञातेप्रतिपूजिताः । पीठेष्वन्येबृसीष्वन्येभूमौकेचिदुपाविशन् ।।6.11.24।।
output: They held the feet of the king and on offering salutations to the king took their seat. While some took golden seats, some sat on a kusa grass mat, and some took a se at on the floor.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेसमेत्यसभायांवैराक्षसाराजशासनात् । यथार्हमुपतस्थुस्तेरावणंराक्षसाधिपम् ।।6.11.25।।
output: Those Rakshasas (who arrived) at the royal court settled down in appropriate seats on the king's command. The leaders of Rakshasas s at close by Ravana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मन्त्रिणश्चयथामुख्यानिश्चयार्थेषुपण्डिताः । अमात्याश्चगुणोपेतास्सर्वज्ञाबुद्धिदर्शनाः ।।6.11.26।। समीयुस्तत्रशतशशूराश्चबहवस्तदा । सभायांहेमवर्णायांसर्वार्थस्यसुखायवै ।।6.11.27।।
output: निश्चयार्थे: in deciding matters, पण्डिताः learned, मन्त्रिणश्च: and also ministers, गुणोपेताः virtuous, सर्वज्ञाः knowledgeable, बुद्धिदर्शनाः who can visualise things with their intellect, अमात्याश्च: army men, तथा: likewise, शतशः in hundreds, बहवः many, शूराः heroes, तत्र: there, हेमवर्णायाम् shining with golden colour, सभायाम् in the royal assembly, सर्वार्थस्य: to deliberate on all matters, सुखायवै: for a happy conclusion, यथामुख्याः important people, समीयुः collected.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मन्त्रिणश्चयथामुख्यानिश्चयार्थेषुपण्डिताः । अमात्याश्चगुणोपेतास्सर्वज्ञाबुद्धिदर्शनाः ।।6.11.26।। समीयुस्तत्रशतशशूराश्चबहवस्तदा । सभायांहेमवर्णायांसर्वार्थस्यसुखायवै ।।6.11.27।।
output: Those who were learned in decision making, ministers, virtuous and knowledgeable ones, those who can visualise things with their intellect, army men, like wise many heroes and important people collected at the royal assembly shining in golden colour to deliberate on matters for a happy conclusion.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोमहात्माविपुलंसुयुग्यंरथम्वरंहेमविचित्रिताङ्गम् । शुभंसमास्थायययौयशस्वीविभीषणस्संसदमग्रजस्य ।।6.11.28।।
output: ततः thereafter, महात्मा: great, यशस्वी: illustrious, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, विपुलम् broad, सुयुग्यं: yoked with good horses, हेमविचित्रिताङ्गम् decked with gold, शुभम् auspicious, वरम् choicest, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय: having ascended, अग्रजस्य: of the elder brother, संसदम् assembly, ययौ: went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सपूर्वजायावरजश्शशंसनामाथपश्चाश्चरणौववन्दे । शुकःप्रहस्तश्चतथैवतेभ्योददौयथार्हंपृथगासनानि ।।6.11.29।।
output: There after Vibheeshana the younger brother, repeated his name (by way of courtesy ). A fter that he offered salutations to his elder brother's feet. B oth Sukha and Prahastha likewise followed Vibheeshana and took their seats offered according to their position.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
सुवर्णनानामणिभूषणानांसुवाससांसंसदिराक्षसानाम् । तेषांपरार्घ्यागुरुचन्दनानांस्रजाश्चगन्धाःप्रववुस्समन्तात् ।।6.11.30।।
output: In that royal court decorated with different kinds of golden and gem colours, the Rakshasas attired in beautiful clothes with their body smeared with fragrance of incense and sandal paste and wearing floral garland s whose fragrance had spread all over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 11:
नचुक्रुशुर्नानृतमाहकश्चित्सभापदोनापिजजल्पुरुच्चैः । संसिद्धार्थास्सर्वएवोग्रवीर्याभर्तुस्सर्वेददृशुश्चाननंते ।।6.11.31।।
output: Those who assembled at the royal court neither made a little noise, nor uttered untruth, nor spoke. All of them were fully accomplished, very heroic and looked at their Lord's face.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सरावणश्शस्त्रभृतांमनस्विनांमहाबलानांसमितौमनस्वी । तस्यांसभायांप्रभयाचकाशेमध्येवसूनामिववज्रहस्तेः ।।6.11.32।।
output: तस्याम् in that सभायाम्: assembly, मनस्वी: heroic, सरावणः that Ravana, शस्त्रभृताम् those who held arms, मनस्विनां: heroes, महाबलानाम् of great prowess, समितौ: in battle, वसूनाम् among Vasus (gods ), मध्ये: in the midst, वज्रहस्तः Indra who holds a diamond bolt, इव: like, प्रभया: with glow, चकाशे: shone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सतांपरिषदंकृत्स्नांसमीक्ष्यसमितिञ्जयः । प्रचोदयामासतदाप्रहस्तंवाहिनीपतिम् ।।6.12.1।।
output: तदा: then, समितिञ्जयः one who is victorious in wars, सः he, कृत्स्नाम् vast, तांपरिषदम् that assembly, दृष्टवा: on seeing, तदा: then, वाहिनीपतिम् chief of the army, प्रहस्तम् to Prahastha, प्रचोदयामास: ordered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सेनापतेयथातेस्युःकृतविद्याश्चतुर्विधाः । योधानगररक्षायांतथाव्यादेष्टुमर्हसि ।।6.12.2।।
output: सेनापते: O chief of the army चतुर्विधाः warriors of four divisions of army, कृतविद्याः those who are well versed in the knowledge of all kinds of wars, ते: you, योधाः war, नगररक्षायाम् to safeguarding the city, यथा: likewise, स्युः you entrust, तथा: so also, व्यादेष्टुम् you order to be more alert, अर्हसि: you ought.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
सप्रहस्तःप्रणीतात्माचिकीर्षन् राजशासनम् । विनिक्षिपद्बलंसर्वंबहिरन्तश्चमन्दिरे ।।6.12.3।।
output: Celebrated Prahastha desiring to carry out the king's order assigned the army inside and outside the city.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोविनिक्षिप्यबलंसर्वनगरगुप्तये । प्रहस्तःप्रमुखेराज्ञोनिषसादजगादच ।।6.12.4।।
output: There after Prahastha, having assigned the army for guarding the city, sat down in front of the king, and appealed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
विहितंबहिरन्तश्चबलंबलवतस्तव । कुरुष्याविमनाःक्षिप्रंयदभिप्रेतमस्तुते ।।6.12.5।।
output: "You are a powerful one. Your army has been posted outside as well as inside. You may tell me at once without any distraction what you intend to do."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
प्रहस्तस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाराजाराज्यहितैषिणः । सुखेप्सुस्सुहृदांमध्येव्याजहारसरावणः ।।6.12.6।।
output: Ravana who was keen on doing good to the kingdom desiring happiness and having heard Prahastha's word, said this in the midst of his dear ones.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रियाप्रियेसुखंदुःखंलाभालाभेहिताहिते । धर्मकामार्थकृच्छ्रेषुयूयमर्हथवेदितुम् ।।6.12.7।।
output: यूयम् you all, धर्मकामार्थकृच्छ्रेषु: among dharma (righteous code of conduct), artha (material wealth) and kama (desire), प्रियाप्रिये: that which is desirable and undesirable, सुखम् happiness, दुःखम् sorrow, लाभालाभे: gain and loss, हिताहिते: good and bad, वेदितुम् to know, अर्हथ: you are capable.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वकृत्यानियुष्माभिस्समारब्धानिसर्वथा । मन्त्रकर्मनियुक्तानिनजातुविफलानिमे ।।6.12.8।।
output: सर्वथा: always, युष्माभिः all of you, समारब्धानि: started, मन्त्रकर्मनियुक्तानि: that which has been well thought out and decided, मे: by me, सर्वकृत्यानि: actions carried out, जातु: that I know, नविफलानि: never futile.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ससोमग्रहनक्षत्रैर्मरुद्भिरिववासवः । भवद्भिरहमत्यर्थंवृतश्रियमवाप्नुयाम् ।।6.12.9।।
output: ससोमग्रहनक्षत्रैः ruling over the moon, sun and stars, मरुद्भि: even gods, वासवःइव: just as Indra भवद्भिः with you also, वृतः accompanied, अहम् I, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, श्रियम् at once, अवाप्नुयाम् attain fortune.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहंतुखलुसर्वान्वस्समर्थयितुमुद्यतः । कुम्भकर्णस्यतुस्वप्नान्नेममर्थमचोदयम् ।।6.12.10।।
output: "Indeed, rightly I told all of you earlier. Since Kumbhakarna was sleeping I had not informed him about this matter."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
अयंहिसुप्तःषण्मासान्कुम्भकर्णोमहाबलः । सर्वशस्त्रभृतांमुख्यस्सइदानींसमुत्थितः ।।6.12.11।।
output: "Kumbhakarna, the foremost among the wielders of weapons, is very strong. He was sleeping these six months and has arrived now."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इयंचदण्डकारण्याद्रामस्यमहिषीमया । रक्षोभिश्चरितोद्देशादानीताजनकात्मजा ।।6.12.12।।
output: रामस्य: Rama's, मया: by me, महिषी: consort, इयम् this, जनकात्मजा: Sita, रक्षोभिः Rakshasas, चरितोद्देशात् wandering place, दण्डकारण्यात् from Dandakaranya, आनीता: brought.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सामेवशय्यामारोढुमिच्छत्यलसगामिनी । त्रिषुलोकेषुचान्यामेनसीतासदृशीमता ।।6.12.13।।
output: अलसगामिनी: one whose pace of walk is modest, सा: she, मे: my, शय्याम् bed, आरोढुम् to lay her feet (to love), नइच्छति: not like, त्रिषु: in the three, लोकेषु: in the world, अन्या: others, सीतासदृशी: one who has the looks like Sita, मे: to me, नमता: not think.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तनुमध्यापृथुश्रोणीशरदिन्दुनिभानना । हेमबिम्बनिभासौम्यामायेवमयनिर्मिता ।।6.12.14।।
output: तनुमध्या: one of slender waist, पृथुश्रोणी: plump hips, शरदिन्दुनिभानना: of autumnal full moon like face, हेमबिम्बनिभा: like golden image, सौम्या: gentle lady, मयनिर्मिता: constructed by Maya (Rakshasa), मायेव: like a magical one.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुलोहिततलौश्लक्ष् णौचरणौसुप्रतिष्ठितौ । दृष्ट्वाताम्रनखौतस्यादीप्यतेमेशरीरजः ।।6.12.15।।
output: "Beholding her smooth red soles and evenly shaped pinkish nails of feet, love is kindled in me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हुताग्निरर्चिस्सङ्काशामेनांसौरीमिवप्रभाम् । उन्नसंविमलंवल्गुविपुलांचारुलोचनम् ।।6.12.16।। पश्यंस्तदवशस्तस्याःकामस्यवशमेयिवान् ।
output: हुताग्निरर्चिः like the sacrificial fire, सङ्काशाम् like the radiance, सौरीम् of Sun, प्रभामिव: like the glow, एनाम् her, उन्नसम् prominent nose, विपुलम् large, वल्गु: attractive, चारुलोचनम् beautiful eyes, तस्याः of her, तत् those, पश्यन् seeing, अवशः surely, कामस्य: by love, वशम् overtaken, एयिवान् slave to her.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
क्रोधहर्षसमानेनदुर्वर्णकरणेनच ।।6.12.17।। शोकसन्तापनित्येनकामेनकलुषीकृतः ।
output: "I have been disturbed by passion, which is equal in anger or happiness and makes one pale in grief or agony."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सातुसंवत्सरंकालंमामयाचतभामिनी ।।6.12.18।। प्रतीक्षमाणाभर्तारंराममायतलोचना । तन्मयाचारुनेत्रायःप्रतिज्ञातंवचश्शुभम् ।।6.12.19।। श्रान्तोऽहंसततंकामाद्यातोहयइवाध्वनि ।
output: भर्तारम् husband, रामम् Rama, प्रतीक्षमाणा: expecting to come, आयतलोचना: broadeyed Sita, सा: that, भामिनी: beautiful woman, माम् me, संवत्सरंकालम् one year time, आयाचत: had requested, मया: by me, चारुनेत्रायाः lady with beautiful eyes, शुभम् auspicious, तत् that, वचः word, प्रतिज्ञातम् promised in turn, सततम् ever, अध्वनि: feel exhausted, यातः one that has marched, हयःइव: like the horse, अहम् I, कामात् on account of passion, श्रान्त: tired.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
सातुसंवत्सरंकालंमामयाचतभामिनी ।।6.12.18।। प्रतीक्षमाणाभर्तारंराममायतलोचना । तन्मयाचारुनेत्रायःप्रतिज्ञातंवचश्शुभम् ।।6.12.19।। श्रान्तोऽहंसततंकामाद्यातोहयइवाध्वनि ।
output: "Broadeyed Sita requested me one year time expecting her husband Rama to come (this is a false statement made by Ravana here) and I promised in turn to Sita of beautiful eyes. Just like an exhausted horse that marched I am tired on account of my passion."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कथंसागरमक्षोभ्यंतरिष्यन्तिवनौकसः ।।6.12.20।। बहुसत्त्वसमाकीर्णंतौवादशरथात्मजौ ।
output: "How will the Vanaras and even both the sons of Dasaratha be able to cross the unassailable ocean inhabited by huge crocodiles?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथवाकपिनैकेनकृतंनःकदनंमहत् ।।6.12.21।। दुर् ज्ञेयाःकार्यगतयोब्रूतयस्ययथामति ।
output: "Even so, a huge destruction was done to us, by a single monkey. The consequences of their acts are unpredictable. Tell me what is there in your mind, according to your own understanding."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मानुष्यान्नोभयंनास्तितथापितुविमृश्यताम् ।।6.12.22।। तदादेवासुरेयुद्धेयुष्माभिस्सहितोऽजयम् । तेमेभवन्तश्चतथासुग्रीवप्रमुखान्हरीन् ।।6.12.23।। परेपारेसमुद्रस्यपुरस्कृत्यनृपात्मजौ । सीतायाःपदवींप्राप्यसम्प्राप्तौवरुणालयाम् ।।6.12.24।।
output: मानुषात् of human beings, नः to me, भयम् fear, नास्ति: not there, तथापि: in the same way, विमृश्यताम् let it be deliberated, तदा: then, देवासुरेयुद्धे: in the battle of Devas and asuras, युष्माभिः you also, सहितः along with, अजयम् victory, मे: to me, ते: by you, भवन्तश्च: as it is all of you, तथा: be like that, नृपात्मजौ: sons of King (Rama and Lakshmana), सीतायाः Sita's, पदवीम् a way out, प्राप्या: gain, सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् Sugriva and other leaders, हरीन् Vanaras, पुरस्कृत्य: placed in front, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, परे: shore, पारे: collected, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, the ocean, सम्प्राप्तौ: arrived.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
मानुष्यान्नोभयंनास्तितथापितुविमृश्यताम् ।।6.12.22।। तदादेवासुरेयुद्धेयुष्माभिस्सहितोऽजयम् । तेमेभवन्तश्चतथासुग्रीवप्रमुखान्हरीन् ।।6.12.23।। परेपारेसमुद्रस्यपुरस्कृत्यनृपात्मजौ । सीतायाःपदवींप्राप्यसम्प्राप्तौवरुणालयाम् ।।6.12.24।।
output: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
मानुष्यान्नोभयंनास्तितथापितुविमृश्यताम् ।।6.12.22।। तदादेवासुरेयुद्धेयुष्माभिस्सहितोऽजयम् । तेमेभवन्तश्चतथासुग्रीवप्रमुखान्हरीन् ।।6.12.23।। परेपारेसमुद्रस्यपुरस्कृत्यनृपात्मजौ । सीतायाःपदवींप्राप्यसम्प्राप्तौवरुणालयाम् ।।6.12.24।।
output: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अदेयाचयथासीतावध्यौदशरथात्मजौ । भवद्भिर्मन्त्र्यतांमन्त्रस्सुनीतंचाभिधीयताम् ।।6.12.25।।
output: यथा: that way, सीता: Sita, आदेया: without giving, दशरथात्मजौ: Dasaratha's sons,वध्यौच: to kill, भवद्भिः you may also, मन्त्रः suggestion, मन्त्र्यताम् thinking over, सुनीतम् good scheme, अभिधीयतांच: and suggest me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नहिशक्तिंप्रपश्यामिजगत्यन्यस्यकस्यचित् । सागरंवानरैस्तीर्वानिश्चयेनजयोमम ।।6.12.26।।
output: "No one can cross the ocean with Vanaras (help). As such I do not find anyone has the capacity. I am certain of victory."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यकामपरीतस्यनिशम्यपरिदेवितम् । कुम्भकर्णःप्रचुक्रोधवचनंचेदमब्रवीत् ।।6.12.27।।
output: On hearing the lamentation of Ravana seized with passion, enraged Kumbhakarna uttered these words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
यदातुरामस्यसलक्ष्मणस्यप्रसह्यसीताखलुसाइहाऽहृता । सकृत्समीक्ष्यैवसुनिश्चितंतदाभजेतचित्तंयमुनेवयामुनम् ।।6.12.28।।
output: "If you had at that time, that is before bringing Sita by force, which was accompanied by Rama and Lakshmana, discussed, and thought of, then you would be sure in your mind like the Yamuna River filling the Yamuna (mountain )."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वमेतन्महाराजकृतमप्रतिमंतव । विधीयेतसहास्माभिरादावेवास्यकर्मणः ।।6.12.29।।
output: "Great king If you had discussed with us about all this action earlier, it would have been very good."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न्यायेनराजकार्याणियःकरोतिदशानन: । नससन्तप्यतेपश्चान्निश्चितार्थमतिर्नृपः ।।6.12.30।।
output: दशानन: Ravana, यः whosoever, नृपः is the king, न्यायेन: justifiably, निश्चितार्थमतिः having sense of determination, राजकार्याणि: princely duties, करोति: does, सः he, पश्चात् later, नसन्तप्यते: will not regret.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
अनुपायेनकर्माणिविपरीतानियानिच । क्रियमाणानिदुष्यन्तिहवींष्यप्रयतेष्विव ।।6.12.31।।
output: "Tasks carried out without proper plan and contrary to the right principles are spoilt like inauspicious oblations offered into sacrificial fire."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यःपश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणिकर्माण्यभिचिकीर्षति । पूर्वंचापरकार्याणिनसवेदनयानयौ ।।6.12.32।।
output: "He who seeks to perform earlier what has to be done later and does later what have to be done earlier is not a knower of right and wrong."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चपलस्यतुकृत्येषुप्रसमीक्ष्याधिकंबलम् । क्षिप्रमन्येप्रपद्यन्तेक्रौञ्चस्यखमिवद्विजाः ।।6.12.33।।
output: A hasty one who acts without thinking of the superior strength (of enemy) gets out at once like the swan penetrates into the crevice of Krauncha (mountain).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वयेदंमहादारब्धंकार्यमप्रतिचिन्तितम् । दिष्ट्यात्वांनावधीद्रामोविषमिश्रमिवामिषम् ।।6.12.34।।
output: "Without prior thought this great act has been done by you. Rama has not killed you, fortunately like poison mixed flesh would kill."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
तस्मात्त्वयासमारब्धंकर्मह्यप्रतिमंपरैः । अहंसमीकरिष्यामिहत्वाशत्रूंस्तवानघ ।।6.12.35।।
output: "O Sinless Ravana Therefore, that which you have done is not possible for none other than me. I will kill your enemy and accomplish your goal for you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
अहमुत्सादयिष्यामिशत्रूंस्तवनिशाचर । यदिशक्रविवस्वन्तौयदिपावकमारुतौ ।।6.12.36।। तावहंयोधयिष्यामिकुबेरवरुणावपि ।
output: "O Rakshasa I will ruin the enemy. I will fight with both of them (Rama and Lakshmana) even if they are Indra and sun, fire god and wind god or Kubera and Varuna."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गिरिमात्रशरीरस्यमहापरिघयोधिनः । नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्यबिभीयाद्वैपुरन्दरः ।।6.12.37।।
output: "If I go with a mountain like body and sharp teeth, holding a huge iron bar roaring like a lion, even Indra will run away out of fear."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुनर्मांसद्वितीयेनशरेणनिहनिष्यति । ततोऽहंतस्यपास्यामिरुधिरंकाममाश्वस ।।6.12.38।।
output: सः he, द्वितीयेन: second, शरेण: arrow, माम् on me, पुनः again, निहनिष्यति: by the time he releases ततः immediately, तस्य: his, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यामि: will drink, कामम् stay quiet, आश्वस: confidently.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वधेनवैदाशरथेस्सुखावहंजयंतवाहर्तुमहंयतिष्ये । हत्वाचरामंसहलक्ष्मणेनखादामिसर्वान्हरियूथमुख्यान् ।।6.12.39।।
output: "By killing Rama, I will try to make you happy and victorious. On killing Rama and Lakshmana like that I will consume the Vanara leaders."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 12:
रमस्वकामम् पिबचाग्य्रवारुणींकुरष्वकार्याणिहितानिविज्वरः । मयातुरामेगमितेयमक्षयंचिरायसीतावशगाभविष्यति ।।6.12.40।।
output: "You be free from fear, sporting and drinking the best of wines and doing actions that you like. Rama will be sent to the abode of the god of death. On reaching their Sita will be under your control for long." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्वादशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of twelfth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणंक्रुद्धमाज्ञायमहापार्श्वोमहाबलः । मुहूर्तमनुसञ्चिन्त्यप्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.13.1।।
output: रावणम् Ravana, कृद्धम् became angry, आज्ञाय: having realized, महाबलः one of extraordinary strength, महापार्श्वः Mahaparsva, मुहूर्तम् for a short time, अनुसञ्चिन्त्य: thinking of pleasing, प्राञ्जलिः greeting with folded palms, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 13:
यःखल्वपिवनंप्राप्यमृगव्यालनिषेवितम् । नपिबेन्मधुसम्प्राप्यसनरोबालिशोभवेत् ।।6.13.2।।
output: "Having reached a forest inhabited by wild animals and snakes for honey, whoever does not drink the honey obtained is surely a childish one."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 13:
ईश्वरस्येश्वरःकोऽस्तितवशत्रुनिबर्हण: । रमस्वसहवैदेह्याशत्रूनाक्रम्यमूर्धसु ।।6.13.3।।
output: "O Destroyer of foes Who is there to question Lord since you are Lord? Setting your foot on the head of enemy you may sport with Sita."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बलात्कुक्कुटवृत्तेनप्रवर्तस्वमहाबल: । आक्रम्याक्रम्यसीतांवैतांभुङ् क्ष्वचरमस्वच ।।6.13.4।।
output: "(O Ravana) of great strength Take hold of Sita forcibly like the cock, enjoy and revel with her."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 13:
लब्धकामस्यतेपश्चादागमिष्यतियद्भयम् । प्राप्तमप्राप्तकालंवासर्वंप्रतिसहिष्यति ।।6.13.5।।
output: "When you have fulfilled your desire, why fear? Let it happen. Let that which is yet to come, happen. You will be able to face."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुम्भकर्णस्सहास्माभिरिन्द्रजिच्चमहाबलः । प्रतिषेधयितुंशक्तौसवज्रमपिवज्रिणम् ।।6.13.6।।
output: अस्माभिस्सह: along with us, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलः one of extraordinary strength, इन्द्रजित् च: even Indrajith, सवज्रम् wielder of thunder bolt, Indra, वज्रिणम् thunderbolt, अपि: also, प्रतिषेधयितुम् to ward off, शक्तौ: have the power.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपप्रदानंसान्त्वंवाभेदंवाकुशलैःकृतम् । समतिक्रम्यदण्डेनसिद्धिमर्थेषुरोचये ।।6.13.7।।
output: कुशलैः wise people, कृतम् done, उपप्रदानम् charity, सान्त्वंवा: Sama (conciliation) or, भेदंवा: or by bedha (dissension), समतिक्रम्य: leaving these, अर्थेषु: means, दण्डेन: by d and a (force ), सिद्धिम् success, रोचये: attained.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इहप्राप्तान्वयंसर्वान् शत्रूंस्तवमहाबल: । वशेशस्त्रप्रतापेनकरिष्यामोनसंशयः ।।6.13.8।।
output: महाबल: powerful one, वयम् we, इह: here, प्राप्तान् on arriving, तम: him, सर्वान् all, शत्रून् enemies, शस्त्रप्रतापेन: by the strength of arms, वशे: bring under your control, करिष्यामः will do, संशयः doubt, न: not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तस्तदाराजामहापार्श्वेनरावणः । तस्यसम्पूजयन्वाक्यमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.13.9।।
output: तदा: then, महापार्श्वेन: by Mahaparsva, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, राजा: king, रावणः Ravana, तस्य: his, वाक्यम् statement, सम्पूजयन् feeling happy, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महापार्श्वनिबोधत्वंरहस्यंकिञ्चिदात्मन: । चिरवृत्तंतदाख्यास्येयदवाप्तंपुरामया ।।6.13.10।।
output: महापार्श्व: O Mahaparsva, आत्मनः I myself, किञ्चित् certain, रहस्यम् secret, निबोध: listen to, पुरा: earlier, मया: by me, यत् that which, अवाप्तम् happened, चिरवृत्तम् long time ago, तत् that, आख्यास्ये: will tell.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पितामहस्यभवनंगच्छन्तींपुञ्जिकस्थलाम् । चञ्चूर्यमाणामद्राक्षमाकाशेऽग्निशिखामिव ।।6.13.11।।
output: "While I was going in the sky to the abode of Grandfather Brahma, I saw a celebrated one called Punjikasthala flying concealing herself, glowing like the flame of the fire."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
साप्रसह्यमयाभुक्ताकृताविवसनाततः । स्वयम्भूभवनंप्राप्तालोलितानलिनीयथा ।।6.13.12।।
output: "Then her clothes were stripped off by me forcibly and enjoyed her. Then like a violently shaken lotus stem, she went to the abode of Brahma."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्चतस्यतदामन्येज्ञातमासीन्महात्मनः । अथसङ्कुपितोदेवोमामिदंवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.13.13।।
output: "Then the high souled Brahma happened to know about that incident, I believe. Enraged Brahma made this statement to me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अद्यप्रभृतियामन्याबलान्नारींगमिष्यसि । तदातेशतधामूर्धाफलिष्यतिनसंशयः ।।6.13.14।।
output: अद्यप्रभृति: from today onwards, अन्याम् other, नारीम् women, गमिष्यसि: reach, तदा: then, ते: your, मूर्दा: head, शतधाफलिष्यति: will break into hundred pieces, संशय: doubt, न: no.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्यहंतस्यशापस्यभीतःप्रसभमेवताम् । नारोहयेबलात्सीतांवैदेहींशयनेशुभे ।।6.13.15।।
output: "Thus, frightened on account of his curse, I do not perforce to get her to my lustrous bed."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सागरस्येनमेवेगोमारुतस्येवमेगतिः । नैतद्दाशरथिर्वेदह्यासादयतितेनमाम् ।।6.13.16।।
output: मे: my, वेगः speed, सागरस्येव: like that of ocean, मे: to me, गतिः movement, मारुतस्येन: like that of wind, एतत् all this, दाशरथिः Rama, son of Dasaratha, नवेद: not know, तेन: therefore, माम् me, आसादयतिहि: coming to attack.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 13:
कोहिसिंहमिवासीनंसुप्तंगिरिगुहाशये । क्रुद्धंमृत्युमिवाऽसीनंसम्भोधयितुमिच्छति ।।6.13.17।।
output: "He is waking me up like waking up a lion sleeping in the mountain cave. Like waking up death from sleep, he is desiring to instigate me. What sort of a person is he?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नमत्तोनिशितान्बाणान्द्विजिह्वान्पन्नगानिव । रामःपश्यतिसङ्ग्रामेतेनमामभिगच्छति ।।6.13.18।।
output: रामः Rama, मत्तः from me, निशितान् sharp, द्विजिह्वान् of forked flame like fire, पन्नगानिव: like snakes, बाणान् arrows, सङ्ग्रामे: in combat, नपश्यति: not seen, तेन: so, माम् at me, अभिगच्छति: coming towards.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षिप्रंवज्रसमैर्बाणैश्शतथाकार्मुकच्युतैः । राममादीपयिष्यामिउल्काभिरिवकुञ्जरम् ।।6.13.19।।
output: शतथा: in hundreds, कार्मुकच्युतैः released from my bow, वज्रसमैः like thunderbolt, बाणैः arrows, रामम् at Rama, उल्काभिः meteors, कुञ्जरम् इव: like the elephants, क्षिप्रम् at once, आदीपयिष्यामि: I will blaze up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्चास्यबलमादास्येबलेनमहतावृतः । उदितस्सविताकालेनक्षत्राणामिवप्रभाम् ।।6.13.20।।
output: महता: huge, बलेन: army, वृतः surrounded by, काले: early, morning उदितः rising, सविता: Sun, नक्षत्राणामिव: like the stars, प्रभाम् with radiance, अस्य: his, तत् that, बलम् army, आदास्ये: split up.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 13:
नवासनेनापिसहस्रचक्षुषायुधाऽस्मिशक्योवरुणेनवापुनः । मयात्वियंबाहुबलेननिर्जितापुरापुरीवैश्रवणेनपालिता ।।6.13.21।।
output: "Even for the thousand eyed Indra or Lord Varuna it is not possible to withstand me in combat. In the past I have won this city ruled by Kubera with huge strength." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रयोदशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the thirteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निशाचरेन्द्रस्यनिशम्यवाक्यंसकुम्भकर्णस्यचगर्जितानि । विभीषणोराक्षसराजमुख्यमुवाचवाक्यंहितमर्थयुक्तम् ।।6.14.1।।
output: Vibheeshana advises Ravana to give away Sita to Sri Rama before the Rakshasas are pierced by Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न्तरभोगराशिश्चिन्ताविषस्सुस्मिततीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रः । पञ्चाङ्गुलीपञ्चशिरोऽतिकायस्सीतामहाहिस्तवकेनराजन् ।।6.14.2।।
output: राजन् O king, बाह्वन्तरभोगराशिः who has the hood at her bosom, चिन्ताविषः poison of grief, सुस्मिततीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रः has sharp fangs behind her gentle smile, पञ्चाङ्गुलीपञ्चशिरोऽतिकायः has her five fingers of the palm like five heads of snake, सीतामहाहिः snake called Sita, केन: why, तववृतः you desired.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यावन्नलङ्कांसमभिद्रवन्तिवलीमुखाःपर्वतकूटमात्राः । दष्ट्रायुधाश्चैवनखायुधाश्चप्रदीयतांदाशरथायमैथिली ।।6.14.3।।
output: पर्वतकूटमात्राः of mountain like form, दंष्ट्रायुधाः who have teeth as weapons, नखायुधाश्च: and claws as weapons, वलीमुखाः monkeys, यावत् all of them, लङ्काम् to Lanka, नसमभिद्रवन्ति: before reaching, दाशरथाय: to Rama, मैथिली: Mythili, प्रदीयताम् give away.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यावन्नगृह्णन्तिशिरांसिबाणारामेरिताराक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् । वज्रोपमावायुसमानवेगाःप्रदीयतांदाशरथायमैथिली ।।6.14.4।।
output: "Give away Mythili to Rama before he releases arrows like that of thunder bolt with the speed of wind and take away the heads of the leader."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नकुम्भकर्णेन्द्रजितौचराजंस्तथामहापार्श्वमहोदरौवा । निकुम्भकुम्भौचतथाऽतिकायःस्थातुंनशक्तायुधिराघवस्य ।।6.14.5।।
output: "O King It will not be possible for either Kumbhakarna or Indrajith so also for Mahaparsva not even Mahodara, so also for Nikumbha or Kumbha and Athikaya to face Rama in combat."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 14:
जीवंस्तुरामस्यनमोक्ष्यसेत्वंगुप्तस्सवित्राप्यथवामरुद्भि: । नवासवस्याङ्कगतोनमृत्योर्नभोनपाताळमनुप्रविष्टः ।।6.14.6।।
output: "Rama's arrows will not leave you with life even if you are guarded by Sun or wind god, not even if you sit on the lap of Indra or death god or even if you enter the sky or under water."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निशम्यवाक्यंतुविभीषणस्यततःप्रहस्तोवचनंबभाषे । ननोभयंविद्मनदैवतेभ्योनदानवेभ्योऽप्यथवाकुतश्चित् ।।6.14.7।।
output: After hearing the words said by Vibheeshana, Prahastha spoke these words, we do not know the fear of gods or Rakshasas or anyone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 14:
नयक्षगन्धर्वमहोरगेभ्योभयंनसंख्येपतगोरगेभ्यः । कथंनुरामाद्भविताभयंनोनरेन्द्रपुत्रात्समरेकदाचित् ।।6.14.8।।
output: "We are not afraid of Yakshas, Gandharvas, or even Nagas. We have no fear of birds or reptiles. What fear can we have of the king's son, Rama?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 14:
प्रहस्तवाक्यंत्वहितंनिशम्यविभीषणोराजहितानुकाङ्क्षी । ततोमहार्थंवचनंबभाषेधर्मार्थकामेषुनिविष्टबुद्धि:।। 6.14.9।।
output: Then Vibheeshana, wishing the welfare of the king, intent upon Dharma, artha and kama, thinking rightly and deeply, spoke these words on hearing Prahastha's words that were not good.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 14:
प्रहस्त: राजाचमहोदरश्चत्वंकुम्भकर्णश्चयथाऽर्थजातम् । ब्रवीतरामंप्रतितन्नशक्यंयथागतिस्स्वर्गमधर्मबुद्धेः ।।6.14.10।।
output: "That which you intend to accomplish against Rama is not possible either for you or the king and even for Kumbhakarna and Mahodara, just as heaven is not obtained by the unrighteous people," said Vibheeshana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वधस्तुरामस्यमयात्वयाचप्रहस्तसर्वैरपिराक्षसैर्वा । कथंभवेदर्थविशारदस्यमहार्णवंतर्तुमिवाप्लवस्य ।।6.14.11।।
output: हस्त: Prahastha, मया: by me, त्वयाच: and by you, सर्वैः all, राक्षसैर्वा: by Rakshasas also, अर्थविशारदस्य: one who is knowledgeable of everything, रामस्य: Rama's, वधः killing, अप्लवस्य: not swimming, महार्णवम् great ocean, तर्तुम् इव: like crossing, कथम् how, भवेत् will it be possible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धर्मप्रधानस्यमहारथस्यइक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवस्यराज्ञः । पुरोस्यदेवाश्चतथाविधस्यकृत्येषुशक्तस्यभवन्तिमूढा ।।6.14.12।।
output: धर्मप्रधानस्य: one to whom righteousness alone is foremost, महारथस्य: a great charioteer, इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवस्य: glorious son of Ikshvaku dynasty, कृत्येषु: in action, शक्तस्य: very capable, तथाविधस्य: in such acts राज्ञः by the king, अस्य: its, पुरः earlier, देवाश्च: even gods, मूढा: bewildered, भवन्ति: by you at present.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तीक्ष्णानतायत्तवकङ्कपत्रादुरासदाराघवविप्रमुक्ताः । भित्वाशरीरंप्रविशन्तिबाणाःप्रहस्ततेनैवविकत्थसेत्वम् ।।6.14.13।।
output: "Prahastha Sharp arrows of Rama fixed with feathers of Kanka birds are dangerous arrows. They will tear your body and penetrate. What are you boasting yourself?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 14:
भित्त्वानतावत्प्रविशन्तिकायंप्राणान्तिकास्तेऽशनितुल्यवेगाः । शिताश्शराराघवविप्रमुक्ताःप्रहस्ततेनैवविकत्थसेत्वम् ।।6.14.14।।
output: "Prahastha Before the lifethreatening sharp arrows which have the speed of a meteor released by Rama penetrate and tear your body, why are you boasting yourself?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नरावणोनातिबलस्त्रिशीर्षोनकुम्भकर्णोऽस्यसुतोनिकुम्भः । नचेन्द्रजिद्दाशरधिंप्रसोढुंत्वंवारणेशक्रसमंसमर्थ:।। 6.14.15।।
output: शक्रसमम् equal to Indra, दाशरथिम् son of Dasaratha, रणे: in war, सोढुम् to oppose, रावणः Ravana, नसमर्थः not capable, अतिबलः exceptionally strong, त्रिशीर्षः Trisirsha, न: not, कुम्भकर्णस्य: Kumbhakarna's, सुतः son, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, न: not, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, न: not possible, त्वंवा: how can you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देवान्तकोवापिनरान्तकोवातथातिकायोऽतिरथोमहात्मा । आकम्पनश्चाद्रिसमानसारःस्थातुंनशक्तायुधिराघवस्य ।।6.14.16।।
output: "Either by Devanthaka or Naranthaka, in the same way the great soul Athiratha or Akampana, who is of mountainlike size, will not be able to stand against Raghava in war."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 14:
अयंचराजाव्यसनाभिभूतोमित्रैरमित्रप्रतिमैर्भवद्भि: । अन्वास्यतेराक्षसनाशनार्थेतीक्ष्णःप्रकृत्याह्यसीक्षयकारी ।।6.14.17।।
output: "This king who is by nature violent and acts without thinking about being an addict to seven vices, is destroying Rakshasas. You are also attending to him calling yourself as friends but like enemies."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 14:
अनन्तभोगेनसहस्रमूर्थ्नानागेनभीमेनमहाबलेव । बलात्परिक्षिप्तमिमंभवन्तोराजानमुत्क्षिप्यविमोचयन्तु ।।6.14.18।।
output: "This king is entwined by a fearsome and extremely strong thousand hooded snake endowed with extraordinary energy at present. Lift him up and relieve him."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 14:
यावद्धिकेशग्रहणातसुहृद्भि: समेत्यसर्वैःपरिपूर्णकामैः । निगृह्यराजापरिरक्षितव्योभूतैर्यथाभीमबलैर्गृहीतः ।।6.14.19।।
output: "The king will have to be protected by all friends joined together whose wishes have been gratified even by catching him by his hair forcibly just as a man surrounded by a devil of terrific strength is pulled out by his hair."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुवारिणाराघवसागरेणप्रच्छाद्यमानस्तरसाभवद्भि: । युक्तस्त्वयंतारयितुंसमेत्यकाकुत्स्थपातालमुखेपतन्सः ।।6.14.20।।
output: सुवारिणा: into the pit, राघवसागरेण: ocean called Raghava, तरसा: to be destroyed, प्रच्छाद्यमानः engulfed, काकुत्स्थ: Kakutstha's, पातालमुखे: the underworld, पतन् fall into, अयम् us, भवद्भि: at present, समेत्य: joined together, तारयितुम् will have to make him free, युक्तः proper for you.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदंपुरस्यास्यसराक्षसस्यराज्ञश्चपथ्यंससुहृज्जनस्य । सम्यग्घिवाक्यंस्वमतंब्रवीमिनरेन्द्रपुत्रायददामपत्नीम् ।।6.14.21।।
output: सराक्षसस्य: for the Rakshasas, अस्य: there, पुरस्य: capital, ससुहृज्जनस्य: for all of you the dear ones, राज्ञश्च: for the king, पथ्यम्: embodying, स्वमतम् my opinion, इदंवाक्यम् these words, सम्यक् good, ब्रवीमिहि: told, नरेन्द्रपुत्राय: king's son, पत्नीम् wife, ददाम: will give.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
परस्यवीर्यंस्वबलंचबुध्वास्थानंक्षयंचैवतथैववृद्धिम् । तथास्वपक्षेप्यनुमृश्यबुध्वावदेत् क्षमंस्वामिहितंसमन्त्री ।।6.14.22।।
output: परस्य: foes', वीर्यम् valour, स्वबलंच: one's own strength, बुध्वा: ascertaining, तथा: so also, स्वपक्षे: one's own side, स्थानम् status, क्षयंचैव: reduction also, तथैव: one's own, वृद्धिम् growth, बुध्या: knowing, अनुमृश्य: considering, क्षमम् conducive, स्वामिहितम् to the king's welfare, वदेत् tells, सः he, मन्त्री: minister.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यमतेर्वचस्तन्निशम्ययत्नेनविभीषणस्य । ततोमहात्मावचनंबभाषेतत्रेन्द्रजिन्नैरृतयूथमुख्यः ।।6.15.1।।
output: बृहस्ततेः like Brhaspathi, तुल्यमतेः highly intelligent, विभीषणस्य: Vibheeshana's, तत् those, वचः words, यत्नेन: with restraint, निशम्य: beholding, ततः there, महात्मा: great soul, नैरृतयोथमुख्यः the leader of Rakshasa army, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, तत्र: there, वचनम् words, बभाषे: spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किंनामतेतातकनिष्ठवाक्यमनर्थकंचेवेसुबसुभीतवच्च । अस्मिन्कुलेयोऽपिभवेन्नजातस्सोऽपीदृशंनैववदेन्नकुर्यात् ।।6.15.2।।
output: कनिष्ठतात: father's younger brother (uncle), किंनाम: What a statement, ते: by you, वाक्यम् words, अनर्थकम् meaningless, सुभीतवच्च: frightened, यः such, अस्मिनकुले: in this race, जातः born, न: not, भवेत् What you said, सोपि: unbecoming, ईदृशम् such words, नैववदेत् will not speak, नकुर्यात् not do.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 15:
सत्त्वेनवीर्येणपराक्रमेणशौर्येणधैर्येणचतेजसाच । एकःकुलेऽस्मिन्पुरुषोविमुक्तोविभीषणस्तातकनिष्ठएषः ।।6.15.3।।
output: "In this race, alone younger father Vibheeshana is devoid of strength, valour, prowess, heroism, courage and boldness."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किंनामतौमानुषराजपुत्रावस्माकमेकेनहिराक्षसेन । सुप्राकृतेनापिरणेनिहन्तुमेतौशक्यौकुतोभीषयसेस्मभीरो ।।6.15.4।।
output: "Those two sons of the king of men could be killed in war by an ordinary Rakshasa among us single handed. O timid one Why are you scaring us?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 15:
त्रिलोकनाथोननुदेवराजश्शक्रोमयाभूमितलेनिविष्टः । भयार्पिताश्चापिदिशःप्रपन्नास्सर्वेतथादेवगणास्समग्राः ।।6.15.5।।
output: "I have cast down on the ground, Indra, the Lord of gods and of three worlds. At one time all the gods in groups fled in all directions scared of me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऐरावतोविस्वरमुन्नदन् सनिपातितोभूमितलेमयातु । विकृष्यदन्तौतुमयाप्रसह्यवित्रासितादेवगणास्समग्राः ।।6.15.6।।
output: विस्वरम् making noise, उन्नदन् coming towards, सः that, ऐरावतः Airavata elephant, मया: by me, भूमितलेनिपातितः pushed down, प्रसह्य: violently, दन्तौ: tusks, विकृष्य: pulled down, मया: by me, समग्राः entire, देवगणाः group of gods, वित्रासिताः chased them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽहंसुराणामपिदर्पहन्तादैत्योत्तमानामपिशोकदाता । कथंनरेन्द्रात्मजयोर्नशक्तोमनुष्ययोःप्राकृतयोस्सुवीर्यः ।।6.15.7।।
output: सुराणामपि even Devendra, दर्पहन्ता crushed down the arrogance, दैत्योत्तमानामपि even the leaders of Rakshasas, शोकदाता: will cause grief, सुवीर्यः such a valorous one, सःअहम् that I am, प्राकृतयोः ordinary people, मनुष्ययोः human beings, नरेन्द्रात्मजयोः sons of kings, कथम् how, नशक्तः not possible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथेन्द्रकल्पस्यदुरासदस्यमहौजसस्तद्वचनंनिशम्य । ततोमहार्थवचनंबभाषेविभीषणश्शस्त्रभृतांवरिष्ठः ।।6.15.8।।
output: अथ: and then, इन्द्रकल्पस्य: one who is equal to Indra, दुरासदस्य: dangerous one, महौजसः foremost of the warriors, तत् वचनम् those words, निशम्य: observing, शस्त्रभृताम् among the wielders of weapons, वरिष्ठः great, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ततः that, महार्थम् highly beneficial advice, वचनम् बभाषे: these words spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 15:
नतातमन्त्रेतवनिश्चयोऽस्तिबालस्त्वमद्याप्यविपक्वबुद्धि: । तस्मात्त्वयाप्यात्मविनाशनायवचोऽर्धहीनंबहुविप्रलप्तम् ।।6.15.9।।
output: "O dear  You have no capacity for decision making. You are young and not mature. Therefore, you are talking incoherently without any sense which is selfdestructive."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुत्रप्रवादेवतुरावणस्यत्वमिन्द्रजिन्मित्रमुखोऽसिशत्रुः । यस्येदृशंराघवतोविनाशंनिशम्यमोहादनुमन्यसेत्वम् ।।6.15.10।।
output: "Indrajith Though you are calling yourself as the son of Ravana and pretending to be a friend, you are his foe. Even after hearing about the kind of destruction (of Ravana, his kingdom etc.) from Rama, out of delusion you are accepting (with Ravana)."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वमेववध्यश्चसुदुर्मतिश्चसचापिवध्योयइहाऽनयत्त्वाम् । बालंदृढंसाहसिकंचयोऽद्यप्रावेशयन्मन्त्रकृतांसमीपम् ।।6.15.11।।
output: त्वमेव: you yourself, वध्यश्च: deserved to be killed, बालम् young, दृढम् determined, सुसाहसिकं: one who loves to make bold attempt, त्वम् you, यः whoever, इह: here, आनयत् brought you, मन्त्रकृताम् polluting your thought, समीपम् here, अद्य: now, प्रावेशयत् made to enter, सुदुर्मतिः evil minded, सः he च: and.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मूढोऽप्रगल्भोऽविनयोपपन्नस्तीक्षणस्वभावोऽल्पमतिर्दुरात्मा । मूर्खस्त्वमत्यर्थसुदुर्मतिश्चत्वमिन्द्रजिद्बालतयाब्रवीषि ।।6.15.12।।
output: इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, त्वम् your, मूढः foolish one, अप्रगल्भः one who boasts himself, अविनयोपपन्नः lack obedience, तीक्षणस्वभावः wicked nature, अल्पमतिः of poor intellect, दुरात्मा: cruel, मूर्खः ignorant, अत्यर्थसुदुर्मतिश्च: extremely evil minded, त्वम् you are, बालतया: like a child, ब्रवीषि: spoken.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कोब्रह्मदण्डप्रतिमप्रकाशानर्चिष्मतःकालनिकाशरूपान् । सहेतबाणान्यमदण्डकल्पान्समक्षमुक्तान्युधिराघवेण ।।6.15.13।।
output: "Who can bear the arrows released by Rama in combat, which resembles the shaft of Brahma in splendour and flames of fire resembling death and equal to the shaft of the Lord of death?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धनानिरत्नानिसुभूषणानिवासांसिदिव्यानिमणींश्च । चित्रान् सीतांचरामायनिवेद्यदेवींवसेमराजन् निहवीतशोकाः ।।6.15.14।।
output: "O King We will offer celebrated Sita to Rama along with wealth, gems, good ornaments, wonderful and beautiful clothes and precious gems and remain here devoid of sorrow." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चदशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the fifteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic of the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 16:
सुनिविष्टंहितंवाक्यमुक्तवन्तंविभीषणम् । अब्रवीत्परुषंवाक्यंरावणःकालचोदितः ।।6.16.1।।
output: While Vibheeshana advised in Ravana's favour with all good intention, Ravana who was under the influence of death spoke harsh words.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वसेत्सहसपत्नेनक्रुद्धेऽनाशीविषेणवा । नतुमित्रप्रवादेनसंवसेच्छत्रुसेविना ।।6.16.2।।
output: सपत्नेनसह: with known enemy, वसेत् can live with, कृद्धेन: angry, अशीविषेणच: even with venomous serpent, मित्रप्रवादेन: professing to be a friend, शत्रुणासहतु: devoted to enemy, नसंवसेत् cannot stay together.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जानामिशीलंज्ञातीनांसर्वलोकेषुराक्षस: । हृष्यन्तिव्यसनेष्वेतेज्ञातीनाज्ञातयस्सदा ।।6.16.3।।
output: राक्षस: O Rakshasa, सर्वलोकेषु: in all the worlds, ज्ञातीनाम् of close relatives, शीलम् behaviour, जानामि: is known to me, एते these, ज्ञातयः relatives, सदा: always, ज्ञातीनाम् of relatives, व्यसनेषु: when in difficulty, हृष्यन्ति: are happy.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रथानंसाधनंवैद्यंधर्मशीलंचराक्षस: । ज्ञातयोह्यवमन्यन्तेशूरंपरिभवन्तिच ।।6.16.4।।
output: "O Rakshasa Relatives will insult and disapprove their chief even if he is an accomplished one, a virtuous one or a heroic one and does his duty (as a ruler)."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नित्यमन्योन्यसम्हृष्टाव्यसनेष्वाततायिनः । प्रच्छन्नहृदयाघोराज्ञातयस्तुभयावहाः ।।6.16.5।।
output: व्यसनेषु: in misfortunes, नित्यम् forever, अन्योन्यसम्हृष्टाः rejoice pretending to be friendly, आततायिनः a desperado, प्रच्छन्नहृदयाः a covertly person, घोरा: terrible, ज्ञातियः relatives, भयावहाः create fear.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 16:
श्रूयन्तेहस्तिभिर्गीताश्श्लोकाःपद्मवनेक्वचित् । पाशहस्तान्नरान्द्रुष्टवाशृणुतान्गदतोमम ।।6.16.6।।
output: "In the past elephants in the lotus park, uttered some verses on seeing men holding snares in hand. I will relate those that I heard. You may listen."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नाग्निर्नान्यानिशस्त्राणिननःपाशाभयावहाः । घोरास्स्वार्थप्रयुक्तास्तुज्ञातयोनोभयावहाः ।।6.16.7।।
output: "We have no fear of fire or weapons or noose of death. Selfish relatives are causing fear in us."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपायमेतेवक्ष्यन्तिग्रहणेनात्रसंशयः । कृत्स्नाद्भयाद् ज्ञातिभयंसुकष्टंविदितंचन ।।6.16.8।।
output: एते: they, ग्रहणे: to catch, उपायम् means, वक्ष्यन्ति: teach, कृत्स्ना: great, भयात् fear, ज्ञातिभयम् fear of paternal relatives, नः for us, सुकष्टम् very difficult, विदितम् is known.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 16:
विद्यतेगोषुसम्पन्नंविद्यतेब्राह्मणेदमः । विद्यतेस्त्रीषुचापल्यंविद्यतेज्ञातितोभयम् ।।6.16.9।।
output: "In the cows' wealth is present, in the brahmins forbearance is seen, in the women capriciousness exists but in close relatives fear is present."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोनेष्टमिदंसौम्ययदहंलोकसत्कृतः । ऐश्वर्यमभिजातश्चज्ञातीनांमूर्ध्न्यवस्थितः ।।6.16.10।।
output: "Gentle (Vibheeshana) one Since you belong to the same kinsfolk (as I) you do not like me, who is born of noble descent, attained the position of chief (of clan), is worshipped by the world, and attained sovereignty."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथापुष्करपत्रेषुपतितास्तोयबिन्दवः । नश्लेषमभिगच्छन्तितथाऽनार्येषुसङ्गतम् ।।6.16.11।।
output: "Just as drops of water that fall on lotus leaves do not adhere to each other, like wise however long you spend with an unworthy (relative) one, good friendship does not take place."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथामधुकरस्तर्षाद्रसंविन्दन्नविद्यते । तथात्वमपितत्रैवतथानार्येषुसौहृदम् ।।6.16.12।।
output: यथा: that way, रसम् juice, विन्दन् gaining, मधुकरः honeybees, तर्षात् satisfying, नविद्यते: does not know, त्वमपि: you also, तथा: likewise, तत्रैवअनार्येषु: in the same way with unworthy ones, सौहृदम् making friendship, तथा: that way.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 16:
यथापूर्वंगजस्स्नात्वागृह्यहस्तेनवैरजः । दूषयत्यात्मनोदेहंतथानार्येषुसङ्गतम् ।।6.16.13।।
output: "Just as an elephant takes dust with its trunk and abuses (and spreads on) its own body after taking a bath so also is the association with unworthy ones."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथाशरदिमेघानांसिञ्चतामपिगर्जताम् । नभवत्यम्बुसंक्लेदस्तथाऽनार्येषुसौहृदम् ।।6.16.14।।
output: शरदि: in autumn, गर्जतामपि: even the thundering, सिञ्चताम् water poured down, मेघानाम् from the clouds, अम्बुसंक्लेदः dampness created by water, यथा: in the same way, नभवति: not happen, अनार्येषु: unworthy, सौहृदम् affection.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथामधुकरस्तर्षात्काशपुष्पंपिबन्नपि । रसमत्रनविन्देततथानार्वेषुसौहृदम् ।।6.16.15।।
output: मधुकरः honey bees, तर्षात् on satisfying, काशपुष्पम् from the flower, पिबन्नपि: even after drinking, अत्र: stay here, रसम् the nectar, यथा: in the same way, नविन्देत: after getting, अनार्येषु: unworthy one, सौहृदम् friendships, तथा: likewise.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्यस्त्वेवंविधंब्रूयाद्वाक्यमेतन्निशाचर: । अस्मिन्मुहूर्तेनभवेत्त्वांतुधिक्कुलपांसन ।।6.16.16।।
output: "O Night ranger (Vibheeshana) If any other one had spoken such words, I would not let him live this moment and also destroy. Fie upon you."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्युक्तःपरुषंवाक्यंन्यायवादीविभीषणः । उत्पपातगदापाणिश्चतुर्भिस्सहराक्षसैः ।।6.6.17।।
output: Vibheeshana who was just in his argument rose up, wielding mace in hand accompanied by the four Rakshasas, when Ravana had spoken such harsh words to him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अब्रवीच्चतदावाक्यंजातक्रोधोविभीषणः । अन्तरिक्षगत्शीमान्भ्रातरंराक्षसाधिपम् ।।6.16.18।।
output: जातक्रोधः enraged, श्रीमान् prosperous, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अन्तरिक्षगतः going into the sky, तदा: then, भ्रातरम् brother, राक्षसाधिपम् Lord of Rakshasas, अब्रवीच्च spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सत्वंभ्राताऽसिमेराजन्ब्रूहिमांयद्यदिच्छसि । ज्येष्टोमान्यःपितृसमोनचधर्मपथेस्थितः ।।6.16.19।। इदंतुपरुषंवाक्यंनक्षमाम्यग्रजस्यते ।
output: राजन् O King, सःत्वम् that you, मे: my, भ्राता: brother, असि: being so, यद्यत् that which, इच्छसि: wish, माम् to me, ब्रूहि: to tell, ज्येष्ठः elder, पितृसमः equal to the father, धर्मपथे: righteous path, नचस्थितः not followed, मान्यः honour, आग्रजस्य: to elder brother, ते: to you, इदम् thus, वाक्यं: words तु: to you नक्षमामि: not pardonable.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 16:
सुनीतंहितकामेनवाक्यमुक्तंदशानन: । नगृह्णन्त्यकृतात्मानःकालस्यवशमागताः ।।6.16.20।।
output: "O Tenheaded king Fallen under the sway of death, you are foolish. You do not understand the well prepared good words spoken by me wishing your welfare."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुलभाःपुरुषराजन् सततंप्रियवादिनः । अप्रियस्यचपथ्यस्यवक्ताश्रोताचदुर्लभः ।।6.16.21।।
output: "O King Those who speak pleasingly are always easier to find than those who speak unpleasant but good words. Listeners of unpleasant words (though good) are difficult (to find)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बद्धंकालस्यपाशेनसर्वभूतापहारिणा । ननश्यन्तमुपेक्षेत्वांप्रदीप्तंशरणंयथा ।।6.16.22।।
output: "Bound by the noose of death which is the cause of destruction of all beings you are going to be killed just as the burning house if you ignore my advice."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 16:
दीप्तपावकसङ्काशैश्शितैःकाञ्चनभूषणैः । नत्वामिच्छाम्यहंद्रष्टुंरामेणनिहतंशरैः ।।6.16.23।।
output: "While the sharp golden arrows of Rama burning like fire strike you, I do not wish to see."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 16:
शूराश्चबलवन्तश्चकृतास्त्राश्चरणाजिरे । कालाभिपन्नास्सीदन्तियथावालुकसेतव ।।6.16.24।।
output: "Even the heroic archers and mighty men wielding weapons will fall in war seized by death like the dams of sands."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 16:
तन्मर्षयतुयच्चोक्तंगुरुत्वाद्धितमिच्छता ।।6.16.25।। अत्मानंसर्वथारक्षपुरींचेमांसराक्षसाम् । स्वस्तितेऽस्तुगमिष्यामिसुखीभवमयाविना ।।6.16.26।।
output: "Since you are an elderly one, I desired to tender good advice and spoke these words. I may be excused. You protect all these Rakshasas, this capital city and yourself after I depart. Let you be auspicious and be happy."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तन्मर्षयतुयच्चोक्तंगुरुत्वाद्धितमिच्छता ।।6.16.25।। अत्मानंसर्वथारक्षपुरींचेमांसराक्षसाम् । स्वस्तितेऽस्तुगमिष्यामिसुखीभवमयाविना ।।6.16.26।।
output: "Since you are an elderly one, I desired to tender good advice and spoke these words. I may be excused. You protect all these Rakshasas, this capital city and yourself after I depart. Let you be auspicious and be happy."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निवार्यमाणस्यमयाहितैषिणानरोचतेतेवचनंनिशाचर: । परीतकालाहिगतायुषोनराहितंनगृह्णन्तिसुहृद्भिरीरितम् ।।6.16.27।।
output: "O King My words (of advice), given in your interest to prevent you, are not palatable to you. Good advice tendered by friends at the time of death will not be received by those beings whose life is over." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषोडशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the sixteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
इत्युक्त्वापरुषंवाक्यंरावणंरावणानुजः । आजगाममुहूर्तेनयत्ररामस्सलक्ष्मणः ।।6.17.1।।
output: Vibheeshana, having addressed Ravana in harsh language, reached Rama and Lakshmana in a short while.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंमेरुशिखराकारंदीप्तामिवशतह्रदाम् । गगनस्थंमहीस्थास्तेददृशुसर्ववानराः ।।6.17.2।।
output: All the Vanaras on the ground saw Vibheeshana who was like Mount Meru in form and shining like a brilliant lightning.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
येचाप्यनुचरास्तस्य चत्वारो भीमविक्रमा: । तेsपि सर्वायुधोपेता भूषणैश्चापि भूषिता ।।6.17.3।।
output: His four companions of terrific prowess were also there with him. They were wearing all weapons and were adorned with excellent ornaments.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स च मेघाचलप्रख्यो वज्रायुधसमप्रभः । वरायुधधरो वीरो दिव्याभरणभूषितः ।।6.17.4।।
output: Vibheeshana looked like a mass of cloud, like someone who can cause thunderbolt, possessing excellent weapons and wonderful jewels.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमात्मपञ्चमंदृष्टवासुग्रीवोवाहिनीपति: । वानरैस्सहदुर्धर्षचिन्तयामासबुद्धिमान् ।।6.17.5।।
output: Wise Sugriva the Lord of the Vanara army, a formidable one along with Vanaras, started thinking on seeing Vibheeshana (the fifth one) besides four others.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चिन्तयित्वामुहूर्तंतुवानरांस्तानुवाचह । हनुमत्प्रमुखान्सर्वानिदंवचनमुत्तमम् ।।6.17.6।।
output: Reflecting for a while he addressed Hanuman and the other Vanara leaders in this way.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषसर्वायुधोपेतश्चतुर्भिस्सहराक्षसैः । राक्षसोऽभ्येतिपश्यध्वमस्मान्हन्तुंनसंशयः ।।6.17.7।।
output: सर्वायुधोपेतः armed with all kinds of weapons, एषःराक्षसः this Rakshasa, चतुर्भिराक्षसैःसह: along with four Rakshasas, अभ्येति: coming near, पश्यध्वम् you may see, अस्मान् us, हन्तुम् to attack, संशयः doubt, नः no.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीवस्यवचश्रुत्वासर्वेतेवानरोत्तमाः । सालानुद्यम्यशैलांश्चइदंवचनमब्रुवन् ।।6.17.8।।
output: Having heard Sugriva's words, all the Vanara leaders taking up Sala trees and boulders uttered these words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
शीघ्रंव्यादिशनोराजन्वधायैषांदुरात्मनाम् । निपतन्तुहताश्चैतेधरण्यामल्पतेजसः ।।6.17.9।।
output: "O King Order us to kill these evil minded ones at once. Being mortals and of short life, on striking, all of them will fall down dead on the ground."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषासम्भाषमाणानामन्योन्यंसविभीषणः । उत्तरंतीरमासाद्यखस्थएवव्यतिष्ठत ।।6.17.10।।
output: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, उत्तरम् northern, तीरम् shore, आसाद्य: having reached तेषाम् there, अन्योन्यम् one to the other, सम्भाषमाणानाम् started conversing, खस्थःएव: in the sky, व्यतिष्ठत: stayed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
उवाचमहाप्राज्ञस्स्वरेणमहतामहान् । सुग्रीवंतांश्चसम्प्रेक्ष्यसर्वान्वानरयूथपान् ।।6.17.11।।
output: Great and very wise Vibheeshana, gazing at Sugriva and the Vanaras, addressed them in a loud tone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणोनामदुर्वृत्तोराक्षसोराक्षसेश्वरः । तस्याहमनुजोभ्राताविभीषणइतिश्रुतः ।।6.17.12।।
output: "I am called Vibheeshana, the younger brother of Ravana, the king of Rakshasas and of evil conduct."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेनसीताजनस्थानाद्धृताहत्वाजटायुषम् । रुद्दाचविवशादीनाराक्षसीभिस्सुरक्षिता ।।6.17.13।।
output: तेन: by him, जटायुषम् Jatayu, हत्वा: killing, सीता: Sita, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, हृता: having been carried away, रुद्दा: detained, विवशा: poor, दीना: pitiable, राक्षसीभिः by Rakshasas, सुरक्षिता: protected.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमहंहेतुभिर्वाक्यैर्विविधैश्चन्यदर्शयम् । साधुनिर्यात्यतांसीतारामायेतिपुनःपुनः ।।6.17.14।।
output: "I argued with him again and again in several ways to explain him and admonished him saying 'restore Sita to Rama'."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सचनप्रतिजग्राहरावणःकालचोदितः । उच्यमानंहितंवाक्यंविपरीतइवौषधम् ।।6.17.15।।
output: "Impelled by death Ravana would not take good words of advice tendered to him just as one who is impelled by death does not take medicine."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽहंपरुषितस्तेनदासवच्चावमानितः । त्यक्त्वापुत्रांश्चदारांश्चराघवंशरणंगतः ।।6.17.16।।
output: "Leaving my sons and wife, I have come for protection of Raghava having been put to shame by him (Ravana), spoken to harshly and treated like a slave."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वलोकशरण्यायराघवायमहात्मने । निवेदयतमांक्षिप्रंविभीषणमुपस्थितम् ।।6.17.17।।
output: At once you may inform Raghava who is a protector of the whole world that I, Vibheeshana, are waiting here.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
एतत्तुवचनंश्रुत्वासुग्रीवोलघुविक्रमः । लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतोरामंसम्रब्धमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.17.18।।
output: Highly valiant Sugriva having heard all this (from Vibheeshana) eagerly spoke these words to Rama in the presence of Lakshmana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणस्यानुजोभ्राताविभीषणइतिश्रुतः । चतुर्भिस्सहरक्षोभिर्भवन्तंशरणंगतः ।।6.17.19।।
output: विभीषणःइति: thus Vibheeshana, श्रुतः heard, रावणस्य: Ravana's, अनुजःभ्रातः younger brother, चतुर्भिः all the four, रक्षोभिःसह: along with Rakshasas, भवन्तम्: to you शरणम् protection, गतः sought.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मन्त्रेव्यूहेनयेचारेयुक्तोभवितुमर्हसि । वानराणांचभद्रंतेपरेषांचपरन्तप ।।6.17.20।।
output: "O Scorcher of enemies For Vanara's safety and considering to be spies also you should be alert in your deliberations, with a plan and policy in moving together and deciding what is to be done. Let you be safe."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्तर्धानगताह्येतेराक्षसाःकामरूपिणः । शूराश्चनिकृतिज्ञाश्चतेषांजातुनविश्वसेत् ।।6.17.21।।
output: "Know that these Rakshasas are heroic, crafty and cannot be trusted. They can change their form at will and can move about without being seen."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
प्रणिधीराक्षसेन्द्रस्यरावणस्यभवेदयम् । अनुप्रविश्यसोऽस्मासुभेदंकुर्यान्नसंशयः ।।6.17.22।।
output: "This Rakshasa may be a spy who has found entry into our camp to create differences (among us). No doubt about it."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
अथवास्वयमेवैषछिद्रमासाद्यबुद्धिमान् । अनुप्रविश्यविश्वस्तेकदाचित्प्रहरेदपि ।।6.17.23।।
output: "Or else if he is a wise one and knows our weak points, might have found a way and reached us. He may strike us if he is trusted."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मित्राटवीबलंचैवमौलभृत्यबलंतथा । सर्वमेतद्बलंग्राह्यंवर्जयित्वाद्विषद्बलम् ।।6.17.24।।
output: Army of friends or army from a jungle, so also an army brought up by a king for generations, army obtained on payment and all kinds of army except for enemies can be accepted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रकृत्याराक्षसेन्द्रस्यभ्राताऽमित्रस्यतेप्रभो: । आगतश्चरिपोस्साक्षात्कथमस्मिन्हिविश्वसेत् ।।6.17.25।।
output: "O king, by nature they are Rakshasas, and he is brother of the enemy. Evidently, he has arrived by himself. How to trust him?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
रावणेनप्रणिहितंतमवेहिविभीषणम् । तस्याहंनिग्रहंमन्येक्षमंक्षमवतांवर ।।6.17.26।।
output: "O Rama of most forbearing nature Vibheeshana is sent by Ravana. You may consider that he is fit to be arrested, I think."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसोजिह्मयाबुद्ध्यासंदिष्टोऽयमुपागतः । प्रहर्तुंमाययाच्छन्नोविश्वस्तेत्वयिराघव ।।6.17.27।।
output: राघव: Raghava, अयम्: this, राक्षसः Rakshasa, जिह्मया: with a crooked, बुदद्या: you may know, संदिष्ट: being send, मायया: by deceit, छन्नः under the cover, विश्वस्ते: creating confidence, त्वयि: to you, प्रहर्तुम् to strike you, इह: here, आगतः came.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
प्रविष्टश्शत्रुसैन्यंहिप्राप्तश्शत्रुरतर्कितः । निहन्यादन्तरंलब्ध्वाउलूकवायसानिव ।।6.17.28।।
output: "One who entered the enemy's camp and had access to come inside kills the enemies. It is like an owl killing many crows having entered the hole."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वध्यतामेषतीव्रेणदण्डेनसचिवैस्सह । रावणस्यनृशंसस्यभ्राताह्येषविभीषणः ।।6.17.29।।
output: एषः that way, सचिवैः with ministers, तीव्रेण: severe, दण्डेन: by punishment, वध्यताम् will kill, एषःविभीषणः this Vibheeshana, नृशंसस्य: cruel, रावणस्यभ्राताहि: is Ravana's brother.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वातुतंरामंसम्रब्धोवाहिनीपतिः । वाक्यज्ञोवाक्यकुशलंततोमौनमुपागमत् ।।6.17.30।।
output: वाहिनीपतिः the chief of the army, वाक्यज्ञः one who knows to speak, सम्रब्ध: well, वाक्यकुशलम् one who was adept in expression, तंरामम् him, to Rama, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा: after having spoken, ततः then, मौनम् silent, उपागमत् remained.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
सुग्रीवस्यतुतद्वाक्यंश्रुत्वारामोमहायशाः । समीपस्थानुवाचेदंहनुमत्प्रमुखान्हरीन् ।।6.17.31।।
output: Rama of great fame having heard the words of Sugriva, addressed the Vanara army including the great Hanuman who stood close by.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
यदुक्तंकपिराजेनरावणावरजंप्रति । वाक्यंहेतुमदत्यर्थंचभवद्भिरपितच्छ्रुतम् ।।6.17.32।।
output: "The highly reasonable words of advice given by the king of Vanaras about Ravana's brother was heard even by you."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुहृदामर्थकृच्छेषुयुक्तंबुद्धिमतासदा । समर्थेनोपनिर्देष्टुंशाश्वतींभूतिमिच्छता ।।6.17.33।।
