output: शाश्वतीम् everlasting, भूतिम् welfare, इच्छता: desirable, समर्थेन: capable, बुद्धिमता: wise one, सदा: ever, सुहृदाम् to near and dear ones, अर्थकृच्छ्रेषु: in difficult situation on complex matter, निर्देष्टुम्: to express, युक्तम् is proper.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
इत्येवंपरिपृष्टास्तेस्वंस्वंमतमतन्द्रिताः । सोपचारंतदाराममूचुर्हितचिकीर्षवः ।।6.17.34।।
output: The Vanaras having heard the words spoken by Rama in that way, tendered beneficial advice and their own opinion respectfully, to be vigilant.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अज्ञातंनास्तितेकिंचित्त्रिषुलोकेषुराघव: । आत्मानंसूचयन्राम: पृच्छस्यस्मान् सुहृत्तया ।।6.17.35।।
output: राघव: Raghava, त्रिषु: in the three, लोकेषु: worlds, ते: to you, अज्ञातम् that which, किंचित् nothing, नास्ति: is not there, आत्मानम् you yourself, सूचयन् to give our opinion, पृच्छसि: ask, अस्मान: to us, सुह्रत्तया: out of friendship.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वंहिसत्यव्रतश्शूरोधार्मिकोदृढविक्रमः । परीक्ष्यकारीस्मृतिमान्निसृष्टात्मासुहृत्सुच ।।6.17.36।।
output: त्वम् you, सत्यव्रतः one who follows vows truthfully, शूरः heroic, धार्मिकः one who is righteous, दृढविक्रमः firm in resolve, परीक्ष्यकारी: one who is capable of good judgment, स्मृतिमान् one who has good memory of laws of the past, सुहृत्सु: to your friends, निसृष्टात्माच: and committed in heart.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
तस्मादेकैकशस्तावद्ब्रुवन्तुसचिवास्तव । हेतुतोमतिसम्पन्नास्समर्थाश्चपुन: पुनः ।।6.17.37।।
output: "On account of that reason, since your ministers are richly endowed with intelligence let them speak out again and again, one after the other in that way."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्युक्तेराघवायाऽथमतिमानङ्गदोऽग्रतः । विभीषणपरीक्षार्थमुवाचवचनंहरिः ।।6.17.38।।
output: इति: so, उक्ते: having said, अथ: then, हरिः Vanara, मतिमान् intelligent, अङ्गदः Angada, राघवाय: to Rama, अग्रतः immediately, विभीषणपरीक्षार्थम् for the sake of judging Vibheeshana, वचनम् these words, उवाच: spoken.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
शत्रोस्सकाशात्सम्प्राप्तस्सर्वथाशङ् क्यएवहि । विश्वासयोग्यस्सहसानकर्तव्योविभीषणः ।।6.17.39।।
output: "Since he has come from the enemy's camp suddenly, surely Vibheeshana is to be suspected in every way. He is not worthy to be trusted."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
छादयित्वाऽत्मभावंहिचरन्तिशठबुद्धयः । प्रहरन्तिचरन्ध्रेषुसोऽनर्थस्सुमहान्भवेत् ।।6.17.40।।
output: शठबुद्धयः one with perfidious mind, आत्मभावम् one's own feeling, छादयित्वा: concealing, चरन्तिहि: keep moving about, रन्ध्रेषु: a weak point, प्रहरन्तिच and attack, सः he, महान् great, अनर्थः inestimable mistake, भवेत् will be.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्थानर्थौविनिश्चित्यव्यवसायंभजेतह । गुणतस्सङ्ग्रहंकुर्याद्दोषतस्तुविसर्जयेत् ।।6.17.41।।
output: अर्थानर्थौ: advantages and disadvantages, विनिश्चित्य: ascertaining, व्यवसायम् course of action, भजेत: follows, गुणतः by virtue, सङ्ग्रहम् take hold of, कुर्यात् act, दोषतस्तु: if faulty, विसर्जयेत् should give up.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
यदिदोषोमहांस्तस्मिंस्त्यज्वतामविशङ्कितम् । गुणान्वापिबहून् ज्ञात्वासङ्ग्रहःक्रियतांनृप ।।6.17.42।।
output: "If there are great bad qualities (in Vibheeshana) no doubt he has to be rejected. If there are many virtues let us take him knowing them also."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
शरभस्त्वथनिश्चित्यसार्थंवचनमब्रवीत् । क्षिप्रमस्मिन्नरव्याघ्र  चारःप्रतिविधीयताम् ।।6.17.43।।
output: "Sarabha has also decided and spoken these meaningful words of advice." O Tiger among men Let a spy be assigned to cover him at once."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रणिधायहिचारेणयथावत्सूक्ष्मबुद्धिना । परीक्ष्यचततःकार्योयथान्यायंपरिग्रहः ।।6.17.44।।
output: "By employing a spy with subtle intellect to examine Vibheeshana, we can act in an appropriate manner to accept him (Vibheeshana)."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
जाम्बवांस्त्वथसम्प्रेक्ष्यशास्त्रबुध्याविचक्षणः । वाक्यंविज्ञापयामासगुणवद्दोषवर्जितम् ।।6.17.45।।
output: Then, enlightened Jambavan who was endowed with sense of discrimination, considering all facts made his submission which was free from flaws.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बद्धवैराच्चपापाच्चराक्षेसेन्द्राद्विभीषणः । अदेशकालेसम्प्राप्तस्सर्वथाशङ् क्यतामयम् ।।6.17.46।।
output: "Vibheeshana who has conceived bitter hatred towards the sinful Rakshasa king Ravana came without regard for place and time is always to be viewed with suspicion."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
ततोमैन्दस्तुसम्प्रेक्ष्यनयापनयकोविदः । वाक्यंवचनसम्पन्नोबभाषेहेतुमत्तरम् ।।6.17.47।।
output: "Mainda, who was prudent in making policy and rich in expression, considering all facts expressed this statement that was fully logical."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वजनंनामतस्यैषरावणस्यविभीषणः । पृच्छयतांमधुरेणायंशनैर्नरपतीश्वर ।।6.17.48।।
output: नरपतीश्वर: O king of the mortals, एषः this is, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, तस्य: his, रावणस्य: Ravana's, वचनं: words नाम: indeed, आयम् for long, मधुरेण: gently, शनैः slowly, पृच्छयताम् be interrogated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भावमस्यतुविज्ञायतत्त्वतस्त्वंकरिष्यसि । यदिदुष्टोनदुष्टोवाबुद्धिपूर्वंनरर्षभ ।।6.17.49।।
output: नरर्षभ: O best of kings, अस्य: his, भावम् intention, तत्त्वतः truly, विज्ञाय: after ascertaining, दुष्टोयदि: if he is wicked, नदुष्टोवा: or not wicked also, बुद्धिपूर्वम् wisely, त्वम् you, करिष्यसि: act accordingly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
अथसंस्कारसम्पन्नोहनुमान् सचिवोत्तमः । उवाचवचनंश्लक्ष्णमर्थवन्मधुरंलघु ।।6.17.50।।
output: On the other hand, Hanuman who was endowed with rich culture spoke these soft, sweet, and meaningful words briefly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
नभवन्तंमतिश्रेष्ठंसमर्थंवदतांवरम् । अतिशाययितुंशक्तोबृहस्पतिरपिब्रुवन् ।।6.17.51।।
output: "Even for Brihaspati who is proclaimed to be highly intelligent, it is not possible to surpass you as you are the foremost in capability and eloquence."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
नवादान्नपिसङ्घर्षान्नाधिक्यान्नचकामतः । वक्ष्यामिवचनंराजन्यथार्थंरामगौरवात् ।।6.17.52।।
output: "O King Rama I am telling this to you truly not for the sake of argument, not for the sake of creating friction, or with a sense of superiority, or desire but out of respect."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्थानर्थनिमित्तंहियदुक्तंसचिवैस्तव । तत्रदोषंप्रपश्यामिक्रियानह्युपपद्यते ।।6.17.53।।
output: तव: your, सचिवैः counsellors, अर्थानर्थनिमित्तम् after judging good or bad qualities, यत् by what, उक्तम् has been said, तत्र: there, दोषम् fault, प्रपश्यामि: I see, क्रिया: action, नउपपद्यतेहि: not arise.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋतेनियोगात्सामर्थ्यमवबोद्धुंनशक्यते । सहसाविनियोगोहिदोषवान्प्रतिभातिमे ।।6.17.54।।
output: "When entrusted with duty one's capability will be known. It is not possible to appoint him for duty inconsiderately without understanding (his capacity) as it will be faulty."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चारप्रणिहितंयुक्तंयदुक्तंसचिवैस्तव । अर्थस्यासम्भवात्तत्रकारणंनोपयुज्यते ।।6.17.55।।
output: "Your counsellors (Sarabha) have said that it is proper to know from the spies to ascertain about him. It has no meaning as it is not possible to do so (as he is near you). It does not serve the purpose."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
अदेशकालेसम्प्राप्तइत्ययंयद्विभीषणः । विवक्षातत्रमेऽस्तीयंतांनिबोधयथामति ।।6.17.56।।
output: "This Vibheeshana has come here without regard for place and time. I desire to speak what I feel in this regard."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 17:
सएषदेश: कालश्चभवतीतियथातथा । पुरुषात्पुरुषंप्राप्यतथादोषगुणावपि ।।6.17.57।।
output: "It seems proper for him (Vibheeshana) to come here, considering place and time and so also considering that you are superior to him (Ravana) even if there are demerits in him and merits in you."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्म्यंरावणेदृष्टवाविक्रमंचतथात्वयि । युक्तमागमनंह्यत्रसदृशंतस्यबुद्धितः ।।6.17.58।।
output: "He has thought over and seen wickedness in Ravana, likewise valiance in you has made you come here. He seems to be right and suitable."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अज्ञातरूपैःपुरुषैस्सराजन्पृच्छ् यतामिति । यदुक्तमत्रमेप्रेक्षाकाचिदस्तिसमीक्षिता ।।6.17.59।।
output: राजन् O king अज्ञातरूपैः people of unknown identity, पुरुषैः by men, सः he (Mainda), पृच्छ् यताम् said to enquire इति: this, यत् that way, उक्तम् said, अत्र: here, समीक्षिता: having reviewed, मे: to me, काचित् a little, प्रेक्षा: view, अस्ति: be it.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पृच्छयमानोविशङ्केतसहसाबुद्धिमान्वचः । तत्रमित्रंप्रदुष्येतमिथ्यापृष्टंसुखागतम् ।।6.17.60।।
output: सहसा: at once, पृच्छयमानः if enquired, बुद्धिमान् wise one, वचः words, विशङ्केत: will become suspicious, तत्र: there, सुखागतम् come with relief, मित्रम् friend, मिथ्यापृष्टम् प्रदुष्येत: will appear as wicked one.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अशक्यस्सहसाराजन्भावोबोद्धुंपरस्यवै । अन्तस्स्वभावैर्गीतैस्तैर्नैपुण्यंपश्यतांभृशम् ।।6.17.61।।
output: राजन् O king अन्तस्स्वभावै: his intention, र्गीतै: tone of words स्तै: his, पश्यताम् to find out, भृशम् excessive, नैपुण्यं: dexterity, परस्य: other's, भावः feelings, सहसा: at once, बोद्धुम् to know, अशक्यम् not possible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नत्वस्यब्रुवतोजातुलक्ष्यतेदुष्टभावता । प्रसन्नंवदनंचापितस्मान्मेनास्तिसंशयः ।।6.17.62।।
output: ब्रुवतः he is speaking, अस्य: his, दुष्टभावता: malevolence, जातु: known, नलक्ष्यते: does not seem, वदनंचापि: even his countenance, प्रसन्नम् pleasing, तस्मात् therefore, मे: to me, संशयः suspicion, नास्ति: is not there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अशङ्कितमतिस्स्वस्थोनशठःपरिसर्पति । नचास्यदुष्टावाक्चापितस्मान्नास्तीहसंशयः ।।6.17.63।।
output: "One who is with deceitful feeling will not come without an expression of suspicion. He has come on his own and even his talk and looks are not suspicious to me."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आकारश्चाद्यमानोऽपिनशक्योविनिगूहितम् । बलाद्धिविवृणोत्येवभावमन्तर्गतंनृणाम् ।।6.17.64।।
output: "Even if one intends to hide in his external form, it is not feasible to keep it concealed. The inner feeling of a man gets revealed even if cleverly hidden."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 18:
अथरामःप्रसन्नात्माशृत्वावायुसुतस्यह । प्रत्यभाषतदुर्धषश्रुतवानात्मनिस्थितम् ।।6.18.1।।
output: Having heard Hanuman (son of wind god) formidable Rama was highly pleased at heart and started to tell his opinion.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ममापितुविवक्षाऽस्तिकाचित्प्रतिविभीषणम् । श्रोतुमिच्छामितत्सर्वंभवद्भिश्श्रेयसिस्थितैः ।।6.18.2।।
output: "Even I desire to speak a few words about Vibheeshana. I wish you, who are my well wishers and devoted to me, also hear me."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मित्रभावेनसम्प्राप्तंनत्यजेयंकथञ्चन । दोषोयद्यपितस्यस्यात्सतामेतदगर्हितम् ।।6.18.3।।
output: Although he (Vibheeshana) has defects, as he has come here with a friendly feeling, I cannot reject him. Good people are not reprehensible.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीस्त्वथतद्वाक्यमाभाष्यचविमृश्यच । ततश्शुभतरंवाक्यमुवाचहरिपुङ्गवः ।।6.18.4।।
output: Then Sugriva, the leader of Vanaras reflecting on what was spoken by Rama said these words favouring Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुदुष्टोवाप्यदुष्टोवाकिमेषरजनीचरः । ईदृशंव्यसनंप्राप्तंभ्रातरंयःपरित्यजेत् ।।6.18.5।। कोनामसभवेत्तस्ययमेषनपरित्यजेत् ।
output: "Let this Rakshasa (night ranger) be a wicked one or not a wicked one, what have we to worry about such a person? He has come here abandoned by his brother and who will not send away such a person? Who will not do so?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराधिपतेर्वाक्यंश्रुत्वासर्वानुदीक्ष्यच ।।6.18.6।। ईषदुत्स्मयमानस्तुलक्ष्मणंपुण्यलक्षणम् । इतिहोवाचकाकुत्स्थोवाक्यंसत्यपराक्रमः ।।6.18.7।।
output: सत्यपराक्रमः one of truthful valour, काकुत्स्थ: of Kakuthsa dynasty, वानराधिपतेः of king of Vanaras, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, सर्वान् all, उदीक्ष्यतु: looking at, ईषत् slightly, उत्स्मयमानः throwing up a smile, पुण्यलक्षणम् meritorious characteristics, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, इति: these, वाक्यम् words, उवाचह: spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराधिपतेर्वाक्यंश्रुत्वासर्वानुदीक्ष्यच ।।6.18.6।। ईषदुत्स्मयमानस्तुलक्ष्मणंपुण्यलक्षणम् । इतिहोवाचकाकुत्स्थोवाक्यंसत्यपराक्रमः ।।6.18.7।।
output: सत्यपराक्रमः one of truthful valour, काकुत्स्थ: of Kakuthsa dynasty, वानराधिपतेः of king of Vanaras, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, सर्वान् all, उदीक्ष्यतु: looking at, ईषत् slightly, उत्स्मयमानः throwing up a smile, पुण्यलक्षणम् meritorious characteristics, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, इति: these, वाक्यम् words, उवाचह: spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनधीत्यचशास्त्राणिवृद्धाननुपसेव्यच । नशक्यमीदृशंवक्तुंयदुवाचहरीश्वरः ।।6.18.8।।
output: "That which has been spoken by the Lord of monkeys in this way is not possible for one who has not studied sastras or served the elders."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्तिसूक्ष्मतरंकिंचिद्यदत्रप्रतिभातिमे । प्रत्यक्षंलौकिकंचापिविद्यतेसर्वराजसु ।।6.18.9।।
output: यत् that in this matter, सर्वराजसु: for all kings, प्रत्यक्षम् openly, विद्यते: known, लौकिकंचापि: even from worldly view, सूक्ष्मतरम् in subtle manner, किंचित् a little, अस्ति: is, अत्र: that, मे: to me, प्रतिभाति: strikes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 18:
अमित्रास्तत्कुलीनाश्चप्रातिदेश्याश्चकीर्तिताः । व्यसनेषुप्रहर्तारस्तस्मादयमिहागतः ।।6.18.10।।
output: "When in difficulty kings of the same clan of adjoining countries keep attacking the renowned and so they are declared as enemies. It is on account of this cause he (Vibheeshana) has come here."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अपापास्तत्कुलीनाश्चमानयन्तिस्वकान्हितान् । एषप्रायोनरेन्द्राणांशङ्कनीयस्तुशोभनः ।।6.18.11।।
output: अपापाः sinless one, तत्कुलीनाः of the same clan, स्वकान् of their own, हितान् friendly ones, मानयन्ति: respect, प्रायः by and large, नरेन्द्राणाम् of the kings, शोभनः virtuous ones, एषः in this way, शङ्कनीयः do not believe.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्तुदोषस्त्वयाप्रोक्तोह्यादानेऽरिबलस्यच । तत्रतेकीर्तयिष्यामियथाशास्त्रमिदंशृणु ।।6.18.12।।
output: "I will tell you what the scriptures have said about the demerit in accepting an enemy's strength that you have spoken. You may listen."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नवयंतत्कुलीनाश्चराज्यकाङ् क्षीचराक्षसः । पण्डिताहिभविष्यन्तितस्माद्ग्राह्योविभीषणः ।।6.18.13।।
output: वयम् we, तत्कुलीनाःच: their clan, न: not, राक्षसः Rakshasas, राज्यकाङ् क्षीच: and desire for their (Rakshasa) kingdom, पण्डिताः learned, भविष्यन्ति: desires, तस्मात् on account of this cause, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ग्राह्यः can be accepted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अव्यग्राश्चप्रहृष्टाश्चनभविष्यन्तिसङ्गता । प्रणादश्चमहानेषततोऽस्यभयमागतम् ।।6.18.14।। इतिभेदंगमिष्यन्तितस्माग्राह्योविभीषणः ।
output: "Kinsmen will not be satisfied with one another and are not free from anxiety. That way they will not be together. Vibheeshana who has come out of fear in this way crying loudly for help and is worthy to accept."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नसर्वेभ्रातरस्तातभवन्तिभरतोपमाः । मद्विथावापितुःपुत्रास्सुहृदोनाभवद्विथाः ।।6.18.15।।
output: तात: dear, सर्वे: all, भ्रातरः brothers, भरतोपमाः like Bharata, नभवन्ति: will not be, पितुः father, मद्विथाः like me, पुत्राः are sons, भवद्विधाः like you, सुहृदोवा: or friends.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तस्तुरामेणसुग्रीवस्सहलक्ष्मणः । उत्थायेदंमहाप्राज्ञःप्रणतोवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.18.16।।
output: रामेण: by Rama, एवम् in this way, उक्तः having spoken, महाप्राज्ञः very wise, सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, उत्थाय: got up, प्रणतः saluting, इदम् this, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणेनप्रणिहितंतमवेहिविभीषणम् । तस्याहंनिग्रहंमन्येक्षमंक्षमवतांवर ।।6.18.17।।
output: क्षमवतांवर: exceptional in excusing, तम् him, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, रावणेन: by Ravana, प्रणिहितम् has been sent, अवेहि: Realize, तस्य: his, निग्रहम् captivate, क्षमम् befitting, मन्ये: I think.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसोजिह्मयाबुध्यासन्दिष्टोऽयमिहागतः । प्रहर्तुंत्वयिविश्वस्तेप्रच्छन्नोमयिवानघ ।।6.18.18।। लक्ष्मणेवामहाबाहो सवध्यस्सचिवैस्सहा । रावणस्यनृशंसस्यभ्राताह्येषविभीषणः ।। एवमुक्त्वारघुश्रेष्ठंसुग्रीवोवाहिनीपतिः । वाक्यज्ञोवाक्यकुशलंततोमौनमुपागमत् ।।6.18.19।।
output: अनघ: sinless, महाबाहो: mightyarmed, आयंराक्षसः this Rakshasa, विश्वस्ते: I believe, त्वयि: you, प्रच्छन्नो: covertly, मयि: or me, लक्ष्मणेवा: at Lakshman too, प्रहर्तुम् strike, सन्दिष्टः is been sent, जिह्मया: greedily, बुद्ध्या: on knowing, इह: here, आगतः has come, सः he, सचिवैस्सह: along with his counsellors, बध्यः kill, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, नृशंसस्य: the cruel one, रावणस्यभ्राताहि: Ravana's brother, वाक्यज्ञः adept in expression, वाहिनीपतिः chief of the army, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वाक्यकुशलम् good at speech, रघुश्रेष्ठम् best of Raghu race, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा: having said, ततः then, मौनम् silent, उपागमत् remained.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 18:
राक्षसोजिह्मयाबुध्यासन्दिष्टोऽयमिहागतः । प्रहर्तुंत्वयिविश्वस्तेप्रच्छन्नोमयिवानघ ।।6.18.18।। लक्ष्मणेवामहाबाहो सवध्यस्सचिवैस्सहा । रावणस्यनृशंसस्यभ्राताह्येषविभीषणः ।। एवमुक्त्वारघुश्रेष्ठंसुग्रीवोवाहिनीपतिः । वाक्यज्ञोवाक्यकुशलंततोमौनमुपागमत् ।।6.18.19।।
output: "O sinless mightyarmed Rama I believe that this Rakshasa has been sent to come here covertly to strike at you or me or Lakshmana. On knowing that you are here the cruel Ravana's brother has come greedily along with his counsellors to kill you." Sugriva the chief of the army, who was good at speech and adept in expression, having said to Rama, the best among the Raghu race, remained silent thereafter.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 18:
सुग्रीवस्यतुतद्वाक्यंरामश्रुत्वाविमृश्यच । ततश्शुभतरंवाक्यमुवाचहरिपुङ्गवम् ।।6.18.20।।
output: Having heard the words of the leader of Vanaras that were nobler, Rama spoke these auspicious words.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुदुष्टोवाप्यदुष्टोवाकिमेषरजनीचरः । सूक्ष्ममप्यहितंकर्तुंममाशक्तःकथञ्चन ।।6.18.21।।
output: एषः this, रजनीचरः night ranger, सुदुष्टोवा: wicked or, अदुष्टोवा: or not wicked, मम: to me, कथञ्चन: What to say, सूक्ष्मम् subtlest, अहितमपि: that which is harmful, कर्तुम् to do, आशक्तः capable.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पिशाचानदानवान् यक्ष I नपृथिव्यांचैवराक्षसान् । अङ्गुल्यग्रेणतान् हन्यामिच्छन् हरिगणेश्वर ।।6.18.22।।
output: "O leader of the Vanara troop If I so desire, I can kill with the tip of my big finger the devils, Danavas, Yakshas and the Rakshasas on this earth."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्रूयतेहिकपोतेनशत्रुश्शरणमागतः । अर्चितश्चयथान्यायंस्वैश्चमांसैर्निमन्त्रितः ।।6.18.23।।
output: "You have heard of the (story of a) dove that offered his own flesh to an enemy who came to seek protection according to tradition (of hospitality)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सहितंप्रतिजग्राहभार्याहर्तारमागतः । कपोतोवानरश्रेष्ठ: किंपुनर्मद्विधोजनः ।।6.18.24।।
output: "O Supreme Vanara When the fowler who had carried away the mate came near the dove it received him and in turn protected him. What more can a man like me do?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋषेःकण्वस्यपुत्रेणकण्डुनापरमर्षिणा । शृणुगाथांपुरागीतांधर्मिष्ठासत्यवादिना ।।6.18.25।।
output: पुरा: in the past, कण्वस्यऋषेः sage Kanva's, पुत्रेण: by the son, सत्यवादिना: truthful one, परमर्षिणा: great sage, कण्डुना: Kandu by name, धर्मिष्ठा: inculcating righteousness, गाथा: used to sing, गीता: verses, शृणु: you may listen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटंदीनंयाचन्तंशरणागतम् । नहन्यदानृशंस्यार्थमपिशत्रुंपरन्तप ।।6.18.26।।
output: "O scorcher of enemies To one who greets reverentially with folded hands and begs for protection, we should not be cruel, and he is not to be killed."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आर्तोवायदिवादृप्तःपरेषांशरणांगतः । अरिःप्राणान्परित्यज्यरक्षितव्यःकृतात्मना ।।6.18.27।।
output: An enemy who comes for protection against another enemy should be protected, even giving up one's own life whoever he may be, even if he is afflicted or arrogant.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 18:
सचेद्भयाद्वामोहाद्वाकामाद्वापिनरक्षति । स्वयाशक्त्यायथासत्त्वंतत्पापंलोकगर्हितम् ।।6.18.28।।
output: "If one does not protect, or give refuge, according to his capacity out of fear, desire (to gain) or delusion, the sin acquired by him will be censured by the world."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनष्टःपश्यतस्तस्यारक्षिणश्शरणागतः । आदायसुकृतंतस्यसर्वंगच्छेदरक्षित:।। 6.18.29।।
output: शरणागतः one who seeks protection, अरक्षितः fails to protect, तस्य: his, रक्षिणः refugee, पश्यतः in the eyes of, विनष्टः ruined, तस्य: his, सर्वम् all, सुकृतम् merit, आदाय: takes, गच्छेत् away.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवंदोषोमहानत्रप्रपन्नानामरक्षणे । अस्वर्ग्यंचायशस्यंचबलवीर्यविनाशनम् ।।6.18.30।।
output: प्रपन्नानाम् resorts to, अत्रअरक्षणे: that way fails to protect, एवम् in that way, महान् great, दोषः sin, अस्वर्ग्यम् out of heaven, अयशस्यंच: and infamy, बलवीर्यविनाशनम् strength and virility gets lost.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
करिष्यामियथार्थंतुकण्डोर्वचनमुत्तमम् । धर्मिष्ठंचयशस्यंचस्वर्ग्यंस्यात्तुफलोदये ।।6.18.31।।
output: "Excellent and meaningful words have been said by sage Kandu (about one who protects a refugee), that is by doing one's righteous duty. He will be not only famous but reach heaven as a result of his action."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 18:
सकृदेवप्रपन्नायतवास्मीतिचयाचते । अभयंसर्वभूतेभ्योददाम्येतद्व्रतंमम ।।6.18.32।।
output: "I will provide protection from all living beings for the one who seeks protection from me and begs in this way. This is my vow."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनयैनंहरिश्रेष्ठ: दत्तमस्याभयंमया । विभीषणोवासुग्रीव: यदिवारावणस्स्वयम् ।।6.18.33।।
output: हरिश्रेष्ठ: best of Vanaras, सुग्रीव: Sugriva, विभीषणोवा: either Vibheeshana, यदिवा: or any one, स्वयम् by himself, रावणः Ravana, अस्य: his, मया: from me, अभयम् security, दत्तम् will offer, एनम् thus, आनय: one who is unprotected.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 18:
रामस्यतुवच्शुत्वासुग्रीवःप्लवगेश्वरः । प्रत्यभाषतकाकुत्स्थंसौहार्देनप्रचोदितः ।।6.18.34।।
output: Having heard the inciting words spoken by Rama so lovingly, the king of Vanaras replied.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किमत्रचित्रंधर्मज्ञ: लोकनाथ: सुखावहा: । यत्त्वमार्यंप्रभाषेथास्सत्त्ववान् सत्पथेस्थितः ।।6.18.35।।
output: धर्मज्ञ: knower of righteous duty, लोकनाथसुखावहा: protector of the world, सत्त्ववान् virtuous one, सत्पथे: upright, स्थितः who stands, त्वम् by you, आर्यम् noble, प्रभाषेथाः that which was spoken, इतियत् thus which, अत्र: here, चित्रम् wonderful, किम् What.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ममचाप्यन्तरात्मायंशुद्धंवेत्तिविभीषणम् । अनुमानाच्चभावाच्चसर्वतस्सुपरीक्षितः ।।6.18.36।।
output: मम: my, अयम् this, अन्तरात्माच: inner self, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana's, शुद्धम् pure, वेत्ति: known, अनुमानात् च: and with doubt, भावात् feeling, सर्वतः in all respects, सुपरीक्षितः been tested.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 18:
तस्मात् क्षिप्रंसहास्माभिस्तुल्योभवतराघव: । विभीषणोमहाप्राज्ञस्सखित्वंचाभ्युपैतुनः ।।6.18.37।।
output: "Rama therefore, let this highly sagacious Vibheeshana be with you like a friend in equal terms and enjoy."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तुसुग्रीववचोनिशम्यतद्दरीश्वरेणाभिहितंनरेश्वरः । विभीषणेनाशुजगामसङ्गमंपतत्त्रिराजेनयथापुरन्दरः ।।6.18.38।।
output: ततः then, नरेश्वरः king, तत् there, सुग्रीववचः Sugriva's words, निशम्य: perceiving, पुरन्दरः: like Indra, पतत्त्रिराजेनयथा like with the king of birds, विभीषणेन: with Vibheeshana, अशु: as said, हरीश्वरेण: by Sugriva, अभिहितम् very fitting, सङ्गमम् meeting, जगाम: went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राघवेणाभयेदत्तेसन्नतोरावणानुजः । विभीषणोमहाप्राज्ञोभूमिंसमवलोकयन् ।।6.19.1।।
output: Descending from the sky Vibheeshana seeks refuge with Sri Rama. On enquiry Vibheeshana tells everything about Ravana to Sri Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
खात्पपातावनींहृष्टोभक्तेरनुचरैस्सह । सतरामस्यपरमात्मानिपपातविभीषणः ।।6.19.2।।
output: धर्मात्मा: righteous self, सः that, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, हृष्टः happily, खात् from the sky, भक्तेः devotees, सहा: accompanied by, अवनिम् on to the land, पपातात: descended, रामस्य: towards Rama, निपपात: fell on the feet.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पादयोश्शरणान्वेषीचतुर्भिस्सहराक्षसैः । अब्रवीच्चतदावाक्यंरामंप्रतिविभीषणः ।।6.19.3।। धर्मयुक्तंचयुक्तंचसाम्प्रतंसम्प्रहर्षणम् ।
output: अथ: thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चतुर्भिः and the four, राक्षसैःसह: along with Rakshasas, पादयोः by foot, शरणान्वेषी: who seeks shelter, निपपात: prostrated falling down, रामंप्रति: in front of Rama, धर्मयुक्तम् duly expressing his duty, युक्तंच: and appropriate, साम्प्रतम् placing confidence in, सम्प्रहर्षणम् showing extreme joy, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीच्च: spoken.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
अनुजोरावणस्याहंतेनचाप्यवमानितः । भवन्तंसर्वभूतानांशरण्यंशरणागतः ।।6.19.4।।
output: "I am Ravana's younger brother. Having been put to shame I came to seek protection from you who are the protector of all beings " (Vibheeshana said to Rama)."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
परित्यक्तामयालङ्कमित्राणिचधनानिच । भवद्गतंहिमेराज्यंजीवितंचसुखानिच ।।6.19.5।।
output: मया: my, लङ्का: Lanka, परित्यक्ता: leaving, मित्राणिच: and friends, धनानिच: even wealth, मे: my, राज्यम् kingdom, भवद्गतंहि: at your disposal, जीवितम् life, सुखानिच: for happiness.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
तथ्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वारामोवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.19.6।। वचसासान्त्वयित्वैनंलोचनाभ्यांपिबन्निव । आख्याहिममतत्त्वेनराक्षसानांबलाबलम् ।।6.19.7।।
output: "On hearing those words (of Vibheeshana) that were soothing to him as if he drank (Vibheeshana's love) with his both eyes, Rama asked Vibheeshana to truly relate the strength as well as weakness of the Rakshasas."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथ्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वारामोवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.19.6।। वचसासान्त्वयित्वैनंलोचनाभ्यांपिबन्निव । आख्याहिममतत्त्वेनराक्षसानांबलाबलम् ।।6.19.7।।
output: "On hearing those words (of Vibheeshana) that were soothing to him as if he drank (Vibheeshana's love) with his both eyes, Rama asked Vibheeshana to truly relate the strength as well as weakness of the Rakshasas."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
एवमुक्तंतदारक्षोरामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । रावणस्यबलंसर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।।6.19.8।।
output: Then the Rakshasa (Vibheeshana) having heard that Rama of unwearied action would save him proceeded to speak out about the strength of Ravana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवध्यस्सर्वभूतानांगन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । राजपुत्रदशग्रीवोवरदानात्स्वयंभुवः ।।6.19.9।।
output: "Oh Prince, by virtue of a boon granted by Brahma, the selfborn to the tenheaded Ravana, he cannot be killed by Gandharvas, Rakshasas and by all beings."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणानन्तरोभ्राताममज्येष्ठश्चवीर्यवान् । कुम्भकर्णोमहातेजाश्शक्रप्रतिबलोयुधि ।।6.19.10।।
output: "My elder brother, the one who is younger to Ravana is a highly valiant one endowed with great prowess. He is Kumbhakarna and equal to Indra in war."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामसेनापतिस्तस्यप्रहास्तोयदिवाश्रुतः । कैलासेयेनसङ्ग्रामेमणिभद्रःपराजितः ।।6.19.11।।
output: "Rama You might have heard of Prahastha who the commander in chief of his (Ravana's) army is by whom Manibhadra (Kubera's Commander of Army) was defeated in a comb at in Kailas (the abode of Siva)."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बद्धगोधाङ्गुळित्रश्चअवध्यकवचोयुधि । धनुरादाययस्तिष्टन्नदृश्योभवतीन्द्रजित् ।।6.19.12।।
output: यः he who, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, बुद्धगोधाङ्गुळित्रश्च: possessed with skin of Iguana on his hands, अवध्यकवचः shield which cannot be pierced, धनुः bow, आदाय: wielding, युधि: in combat, तिष्ठन् remains, अदृश्यः unseen, भवति: will be.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सङ्ग्रामसमयव्यूहेतर्पयित्वाहुताशनम् । अन्तर्धानगतश्शत्रूनिन्द्रजिद् हन्तिराघव:।। 6.19.13।।
output: "Raghava Indrajith strikes when caught by a network of foes in war by becoming invisible because of satisfying fire god."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
महोदरमहापार्श्वौराक्षसश्चाप्यकम्पनः । अनीकस्थास्तुतस्यैतेलोकपालसमायुधि ।।6.19.14।।
output: "Mahodara, Mahaparsva, Akampana are Rakshasas who are like the guards of the world. They are the commanders of his (Ravana's) army."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
दशकोटिसहस्राणिरक्षसांकामरूपिणाम् । मांसशोणितभक्ष्याणांलङ्कापुरनिवासिनाम् ।।6.19.15।।
output: "Thousands of Rakshasas inhabit the city of Lanka living on flesh and blood and changing their form at will."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतैस्तुसहितोराजालोकपालानयोधयत् । सहदेवैस्तुतेभग्नारावणेनमहात्मना ।।6.19.16।।
output: "The unassailable rulers of the world and even celestial beings have been shattered by Ravana accompanied by the Rakshasas."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विभीषणवच: श्रुत्वारामोदृढपराक्रमः । अन्वीक्ष्यमनसासर्वमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.19.17।।
output: रामः Rama, दृढपराक्रमः one of mighty prowess, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा: hearing, सर्वम् everything, मनसा: in mind, अन्वीक्ष्य: examining, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यानिकर्मापदानानिरावणस्यविभीषण: । अख्यातानिचतत्त्वेनह्यवगच्छामितान्यहम् ।।6.19.18।।
output: विभीषण: Vibheeshana, रावणस्य: Ravana's, यानि: those, कर्मापदानानि: actions followed, अख्यातानि: that which has been spoken, तानि: those, तत्त्वेन: in essence, अहम् अवगच्छामि: is known to me, हि: also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहंहत्वादशग्रीवंसप्रहस्तंसबान्धवम् । राजानंत्वांकरिष्यामिसत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमिते ।।6.19.19।।
output: "By Killing the tenheaded Ravana along with Prahastha and relatives I will make you the king. I am telling you, this is true."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
रसातलंवाप्रविशेत्पाताळंवापिरावणः । पितामहासकाशंवानमेजीवन्विमोक्ष्यते ।।6.19.20।।
output: "Even if Ravana enters the hell or underground or the abode of Brahma the creator, I will not let him be alive."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
अहत्वारावणंसङ् ख्येसपुत्रजनबान्धवम् । अयोध्यांनप्रवेक्ष्यामित्रिभिस्तैर्भ्रातृभिश्शपे ।।6.19.21।।
output: "I vow upon my three brothers that I will not enter Ayodhya without putting an end to Ravana along with his people, sons and relatives."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रुत्वातुवचनंतस्यरामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । शिरसावन्द्यधर्मात्मावक्तुमेवोपचक्रमे ।।6.19.22।।
output: धर्मात्मा: righteous man, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः untiring in action, तस्यरामस्य: at Rama's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा: after having heard, शिरसा: with head, अवन्द्य: bent down, वक्तुमेव: to speak, उपचक्रमे: started.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
राक्षसानांवधेसाह्यंलङ्कायाश्चप्रधर्षणे । करिष्यामियथाप्राणंप्रवेक्ष्यामिचवाहिनीम् ।।6.19.23।।
output: "I will render assistance with all my strength for storming Lanka, for killing the Rakshasas and for the army to enter."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इतिब्रुवाणांरामस्तुपरिष्वज्यविभीषणम् । अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणंप्रीतस्समुद्राज्जलमानय ।।6.19.24।।
output: When Vibheeshana had spoken in that manner, Rama was pleased and embraced him. He called for Lakshmana to get water from the ocean (for consecration).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
तेनचेमंमहाप्राज्ञमभिषिञ्चविभीषणम् । राजानंरक्षसांक्षिप्रंप्रसन्नेमयिमानद ।।6.19.25।।
output: "I am pleased with this highly intelligent Vibheeshana, a respectable one. I will coronate him at once as king of Rakshasas."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तस्तुसौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम् । मध्येवानरमुख्यानांराजानंरामशासनात् ।।6.19.26।।
output: एवम् in that way, उक्ताः having spoken, सौमित्रि: Saumithri, वानमुख्यानाम् chiefs of army of Vanaras, मध्ये: midst, रामशासनात् by the command of Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, राजानम् as king, अभ्यषिञ्चत् coronated.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
तंप्रसादंतुरामस्यदृष्टवासद्यःप्लवङ्गमाः । प्रचुक्रुशुर्महात्मानंसाधुसाध्वितिचाब्रुवन् ।।6.19.27।।
output: At that instant the Vanaras jumped, moving about exhibiting their joy on witnessing great Rama's grace saying "Good, good."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथाब्रवीद् हनूमांश्चसुग्रीवश्चविभीषणम् । कथंसागरमक्षोभ्यंतरामवरुणालयम् ।।6.19.28।। सैन्यैःपरिवृतास्सर्वेवानराणांमहौजसाम् ।
output: हनूमांश्च: Hanuman also, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, अब्रवीत् said, सुग्रीवश्च: to Sugriva, सर्वे: entire lot of, महौजसाम् highly energetic, वानराणाम् with Vanaras, सैन्यैः army, परिवृताः surrounded, अक्षोभ्यम् imperturbable, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna (ocean), सागरम् ocean, कथम् how, तराम: to cross.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपायंनाधिगच्छामोयथानदनदीपतिम् । तरामतरसासर्वेससैन्यावरुणालयम् ।।6.19.29।।
output: नदनदीपतिम् Lord of rivers and streams, god of water, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, ससैन्याः with the army, सर्वे: entire, तरसा: to cross, यथा: this way, तराम: to cross, उपायैः strategy, अभिगच्चाम: shall we approach.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
एवमुक्तस्तुधर्मज्ञःप्रत्युवाचविभीषणः । समुद्रंराघवोराजाशरणंगन्तुमर्हति ।।6.19.30।।
output: (Hanuman) having asked so, righteous Vibheeshana said, "O king Raghava We ought to go and seek refuge from the god of the ocean."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
खानितस्सगरेणायमप्रमेयोमहोदधिः । कर्तुमर्हतिरामस्यज्ञाते: कार्यंमहामतिः ।।6.19.31।।
output: "This immeasurable great ocean was excavated by Sagara (A King of the Ikshvaku dynasty). The great ocean needs to do the task of Rama who is of the same race."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवंविभीषणेनोक्तोराक्षसेनविपश्चिता । अजगामाथसुग्रीवोयत्ररामस्सलक्ष्मणः ।।6.19.32।।
output: Vibheeshana having spoken in that manner, Sugriva accompanied by Lakshmana reached near Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्चाख्यातुमारेभेविभीषणवचश्शुभम् । सुग्रीवोविपुलग्रीवोस्सागरस्योपवेशनम् ।।6.19.33।।
output: ततः thereafter, विपुलग्रीवः broadnecked, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words of advice, सागरस्य: about Sagara, उपवेशनम् sitting down, आख्यातुम् to make him know आरेभे: started.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रकृत्याधर्मशीलस्यराघवस्याप्यरोचत ।।6.19.34।। सलक्ष्मणंमहातेजास्सुग्रीवंचहरीश्वरम् । सत्क्रियार्थंक्रियादक्षंस्मितपूर्वमुवाचह ।।6.29.35।।
output: प्रकृत्या: by nature, धर्मशीलस्य: one who is of righteous character, अस्यरामस्यापि: to Rama also, रोचित: pleasing, महातेजाः brilliant, सः he, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, क्रियादक्षम् skilful at action, हरीश्वरम् king of Vanaras, सुग्रीवंच: and Sugriva also, सत्क्रियार्थम् about the task to be undertaken, स्मितपूर्वम् smilingly, उवाच: said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
प्रकृत्याधर्मशीलस्यराघवस्याप्यरोचत ।।6.19.34।। सलक्ष्मणंमहातेजास्सुग्रीवंचहरीश्वरम् । सत्क्रियार्थंक्रियादक्षंस्मितपूर्वमुवाचह ।।6.29.35।।
output: To Rama who was by nature righteous the advice (of Vibheeshana) was pleasing. To the brilliant Lakshmana of skilful action, to Sugriva the king of monkeys, Rama said smilingly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विभीषणस्यमन्त्रोऽयंममलक्ष्मण रोचते । सुग्रीवःपण्डितोनित्यंभवान्मन्त्रविचक्षणः ।।6.19.36।। उभाभ्यांसम्प्रधार्यार्थंरोचतेयत्तदुच्यताम् ।
output: "Lakshmana This advice of Vibheeshana is pleasing to me. Sugriva is learned, and you are always capable of good advice. That which appeals to both of you, and which is meaningful may be informed to me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तौततोवीरावुभौसुग्रीवलक्ष्मणौ । समुदाचारसंयुक्तमिदंवचनमूचतुः ।।6.19.37।।
output: ततः then, एवम् that way, उक्तौ: having been said, वीरौ: heroic, सुग्रीवलक्ष्मणौ: to Sugriva and Lakshmana, उभौ: both, समुदाचारसंयुक्तम् mixed with respectful tradition, इदम् these, वचनम् words, ऊचतुः gave reply.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
किमर्थनौनरव्याघ्र: नरोचिष्यतिराघव: । विभीषणेनयच्चोक्तमस्मिन् कालेसुखावहम् ।।6.19.38।।
output: नरव्याघ्र: tiger among kings, राघव: Raghava, अस्मिन् this, काले: time, सुखावहम् good, यत् that which, विभीषणेन: by Vibheeshana, उक्तम् has been spoken, नौ: us, किमर्थम् why will, नरोचिष्यति: it not be pleasing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अबध्वासागरेसेतुंघोरेऽस्मिन्वरुणालये । लङ्कानासादितुंशक्यासेन्द्रैरपिसुरासुरैः ।।6.19.39।।
output: घोरे: terrific, वरुणालये: ocean, अस्मिन् सागरे: over this ocean, सेतुम् bridge, अबध्वा: building, लङ्का: Lanka city, सेन्द्रैरपि: even for Indra, सुरासुरैरपि: for Suras and Asuras also, आसादितुम् to cross over, नशक्या: not possible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 19:
विभीषणस्यशूरस्ययथार्थंक्रियतांवचः ।।6.19.40।। अलंकालात्ययंकृत्वासागरोऽयंनियुज्यताम् । यथासैन्येनगच्छामपुरींरावणपालिताम् ।।6.19.41।।
output: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विभीषणस्यशूरस्ययथार्थंक्रियतांवचः ।।6.19.40।। अलंकालात्ययंकृत्वासागरोऽयंनियुज्यताम् । यथासैन्येनगच्छामपुरींरावणपालिताम् ।।6.19.41।।
output: "Valiant Vibheeshana's words are true. Let us proceed and let us not waste time. Let us request Sagara to help the army to be able to proceed to Lanka ruled by Ravana (Sugriva and Lakshmana said to Rama)."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तःकुशास्तीर्नोतीरेनदनदीपतेः । संविवेशतदारामोवेद्यामिवहुताशनः ।।6.19.42।।
output: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having said, रामः Rama, तदा: then, नदनदीपतेः ocean, कुशास्तीर्णे: on the Kusa grass mat, तीरे: shore, हुताशन: fire God, वेद्यामिव: like in the sacrificial altar, संविवेश: sat.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
ततोनिविष्टांध्वजिनींसुग्रीवेणाभिपालिताम् । ददर्शराक्षसोऽभ्येत्यशार्दूलोनामवीर्यवान् ।।6.20.1।।
output: Then the heroic Rakshasa called Shardula entered into the area encamped by the army under Sugriva's command and saw the sign flag of the army.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
चारोराक्षसराजस्यरावणस्यदुरात्मनः । तांदृष्ट्वासर्वतोव्यग्रंप्रतिगम्यसराक्षसः ।।6.20.2।। प्रविश्यलङ्कांवेगेनरावणंवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
output: The evil minded raskshasa who was a spy of Ravana went back to Lanka speedily unruffled after having observed all over the camp and spoke these words to Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
एषवानरऋक्षौघोलङ्कांसमभिवर्तते । अगाधश्चाप्रमेयश्चद्वितीयइवसागरः ।।6.20.3।।
output: As if it is a second ocean deep and immeasurable, the ocean of Vanaras and Bears are heading towards Lanka (reported the spy).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुत्रौदशरथस्येमौभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ ।।6.20.4।। उत्तमौरूपसम्पन्नौसीतायाःपदमागतौ । एतौसागरमासाद्यसन्निविष्टौमहाद्युती ।।6.20.5।।
output: "Great sons of Dasaratha, Rama and Lakshmana, endowed with beautiful form and exceptional fortitude have come and set their foot on the seashore and settled to come to Sita."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुत्रौदशरथस्येमौभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ ।।6.20.4।। उत्तमौरूपसम्पन्नौसीतायाःपदमागतौ । एतौसागरमासाद्यसन्निविष्टौमहाद्युती ।।6.20.5।।
output: दशरथस्य: Dasaratha's, पुत्रौ: sons, उत्तमौ: great, रूपसम्पन्नौ: endowed with beautiful form, महाद्युती: exceptional fortitude, भ्रातरौ: brothers, इमौ: these, रामलक्ष्मणौ: Rama and Lakshmana, सीतायाः Sita's, पदम् to set foot, आगतौ: have come, सागरम् sea, आसाद्य: reached, सन्निविष्टौ: settled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
बलंचामाकाशमावृत्यसर्वतोदशयोजनम् । तत्त्वभूतंमहाराज क्षिप्रंवेदितुमर्हसि ।।6.20.6।।
output: "Mighty king Ravana the army also is spread all over ten yojanas. I have seen going round the sky. You ought to know the real situation at once."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तवदूतामहाराजक्षिप्रमर्हन्त्यवेक्षितुम् । उपप्रदानंसान्त्वंवाभेदोवात्रप्रयुज्यताम् ।।6.20.7।।
output: महाराज: O king, तव: your, दूताः spies, क्षिप्रम् at once, अवेक्षितुम् seeing, अर्हन्ति: having a claim, उपप्रदानम् entrusting, सान्त्वंवा: by conciliation, भेदोवा: by creating difference, अत्रप्रयुज्यताम् to be deployed there.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
शार्दूलस्यवचश्श्रुत्वारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । उवाचसहसाव्यग्रस्सम्प्रधार्यार्थमात्मनः ।।6.20.8।। शुकंनामतदारक्षोवाक्यमर्थविदांवरम् ।
output: Ravana the tiger among Rakshasas, after having heard Shardula's words decided within himself and said to Suka who is good at work praising him very much as usual.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीवंब्रूहिगत्वाशुराजानंवचनान्मम । यथासन्देशमक्लीबंश्लक्ष्णयापरयागिरा ।।6.20.9।।
output: "Departing quickly, speak to the king Sugriva boldly without getting disturbed but in a gentle way and communicate this message."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वंवैमहाराजकुलप्रसूतोमहाबलश्चर् क्षरजस्सुतश्च । नकश्चिदार्थस्तवनास्त्यनर्थस्तथाहिमेभ्रातृसमोहरीश ।।6.20.10।।
output: महाराज: O king, हरीश: Vanara, त्वम् your, कुलप्रसूतःवै: eminent kings, महाबलश्च: mighty strong, ऋक्षरजस्सुतश्च: and Rksharaja's son, तव: your, अर्थः meaning, कश्चन: a little, नास्ति: not, अनर्थः harm, न: not, तथापि: so also, मे: I am, भ्रातृसमः like your brother.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहंयद्यहरंभार्यांराजपुत्रस्यधीमतः । किंतत्रतवसुग्रीव: किष्किन्धांप्रतिगम्यताम् ।।6.20.11।।
output: सुग्रीव: Sugriva, धीमतः wise one, राजपुत्रस्य: prince's, भार्याम् consort, अहम् I, अहरंयदि: even if I have brought away also, तत्र: there, तव: your, किम् what, किष्किन्धांप्रति: return to Kishkinda, गम्यताम् to reach.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
नहीयंहरिभिर्लङ्काशक्याप्राप्तुंकथञ्चन । देवैरपिसगन्धर्वैःकिंपुनर्नरवानरैः ।।6.20.12।।
output: "It is not possible for Vanaras to get here even for Gandharvas or Devas also. What to say of humans and Vanaras? (You may tell this to Sugriva)."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
सतथाराक्षसेन्द्रेणसन्दिष्टोरजनीचरः । शुकोविहङ्गमोभूत्वातूर्णमाप्लुत्यचाम्बरम् ।।6.20.13।।
output: Thus, commanded by the ruler of Rakshasas, Suka immediately transformed into a bird form and rose apace into the sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सगत्वादूरमध्वानमुपर्युपरिसागरम् । संस्थितोह्यम्बरेवाक्यंसुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.20.14।।
output: Suka having gone a long way in the sky to a distant place, stationed there spoke these words to Sugriva.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वमुक्तंयथादिष्टंरावणेनदुरात्मना । तंप्रापयन्तंवचनंतूर्णमाप्लुत्यवानराः ।।6.20.15।। प्रापद्यन्तदिवंक्षिप्रंलोप्तुंहन्तुंचमुष्टिभि: ।
output: दुरात्मना: evil minded one, रावणेन: by Ravana, यथा: thus, आदिष्टम् commanded, सर्वम् everything, उक्तम् spoke, तम् his, वचनम् words, प्रापयन्तम् while communicating, वानराः Vanara, अप्लुत्य: rose up तदा:: then, क्षिप्रम् at once, लोप्तुम् injuring, मुष्टिभिः with fists, हन्तुंच: to kill, प्रापद्यन्त: started.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतैःप्लवङ्गैःप्रसभंनिगृहीतोनिशाचरः । गगनाद्भूतलेचाशुपरिगृह्यनिपातितः ।।6.20.16।।
output: At once the Vanaras violently seized the night ranger Suka and held him and threw him down to the ground from the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
वानरैःपीड्यमानस्तुशुकोवचनमब्रवीत् । नदूतान्घ्नन्तिकाकुत्स्थ वार्यन्तांसाधुवानराः ।।6.20.17।।
output: Being attacked by Vanaras, Suka told these words. "Oh Kakuthsa Rama messengers should not be killed. It will be good to prevent the Vanaras."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्तुहित्वामतंभर्तुस्स्वमतंसम्प्रभाषते । अनुक्तवादीदूतस्सन् सदूतोवधमर्हति ।।6.20.18।।
output: यः he who, भर्तुः king's, मतम् opinion, हित्वा: putting aside, स्वमतम् his own opinion, सम्प्रभाषते: expresses, धूतस्सन् envoy's, अनुक्तवादी: speaks that which has not been said by the king, सः such he, दूतः messenger, वधम् killing, अर्हति: ought to.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुकस्यवचनंश्रुत्वारामस्तुपरिदेवितम् । उवाचमावधिष्टेतिघ्नतश्शाखामृगर्षभान् ।।6.20.19।।
output: After hearing the appeal of Suka and seeing the monkeys shouting, Rama spoke indicating not to kill him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सचपत्रलघुर्भूत्वाहरिभिर्दर्शितेभये । अन्तरिक्षेस्थितोभूत्वापुनर्वचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.20.20।।
output: Suka, felt secure in the air and finding monkeys also settled, once again spoke these words.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुग्रीव:स त्त्वसम्पन्न: महाबलपराक्रम: । किंमयाखलुवक्तव्योरावणोलोकरावणः ।।6.20.21।।
output: सत्त्वसम्पन्न rich in spirit, महाबलपराक्रम mighty prowess and strength, सुग्रीव Sugriva, लोकरावणः one who makes the world cry, रावणः Ravana, मया by me, किम् what, वक्तव्य should I convey.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सएवमुक्तःप्लवगाधिपस्तदाप्लवङ्गमानामृषभोमहाबलः । उवाचवाक्यंरजनीचरस्यचारंशुकंतूर्णमदीनसत्त्वः ।।6.20.22।।
output: तदा: then, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, महाबलः strong, प्लवगाधिपः leader of monkeys, सः he, अदीनसत्त्वः one who is not depressed in spirit, रजनीचरस्य: to the Rakshasa's, चारम् spy, तूर्णम् quickly, शुकम् to Suka, वाक्यम् words, उवाच: spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
नमेऽसिमित्रंनतथानुकम्प्योनचोपकर्तापिनमेप्रियोऽसि । अरिश्चरामस्यसहानुबन्धस्ततोऽसिवालीववधार्हवध्यः ।।6.20.23।।
output: "O Rakshasa, you are the one who deserves death (Convey to Ravana this as my word). You are an enemy to my friend, like wise you are not worthy of sympathy, not my well wisher and also not dear to me. You are Rama's enemy, so like your relative Vali you are to be killed."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निह्नन्म्यहंत्वांससुतंसबन्धुंसज्ञातिवर्गरजनीचरेश । लङ्काञ्चसर्वांमहताबलेनक्षिप्रंकरिष्यामिसमेत्यभस्म ।।6.20.24।।
output: रजनीचरेश: one who wanders at night (Rakshasa), ससुतम् your sons, सबन्धुं: your relatives, सज्ञातिवर्गम् your kinsfolk, त्वाम् you, अहम् I, निहम्नि: will kill, महता: mighty, बलेन: prowess, समेत्यसर्वाम् altogether, लङ्काम् even Lanka, क्षिप्रम् at once, भस्म: burn to ashes, करिष्यामि: I will turn into.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
नमोक्षयसेरावण: राघवस्यसुरैस्सहेन्द्रैदपिमूढगुप्तः । अन्तर्हितस्सूर्यपथंगतोऽवा ।तथैवपातालमनुप्रविष्टः ।।6.20.25।। गिरीशपादम्बुजसङ्गतोवाहतोऽसिरामेणसहानुजस्त्वम् ।।6.20.26।।
output: "O Foolish Ravana Even if you go to a secret place, or rendered invisible by your interposition, or go into the orbit of the Sun, or go underground to Patala or go to the feet of Lord Siva for protection, you cannot escape from Rama. You along with your brother will be slain."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नमोक्षयसेरावण: राघवस्यसुरैस्सहेन्द्रैदपिमूढगुप्तः । अन्तर्हितस्सूर्यपथंगतोऽवा ।तथैवपातालमनुप्रविष्टः ।।6.20.25।। गिरीशपादम्बुजसङ्गतोवाहतोऽसिरामेणसहानुजस्त्वम् ।।6.20.26।।
output: "O Foolish Ravana Even if you go to a secret place, or rendered invisible by your interposition, or go into the orbit of the Sun, or go underground to Patala or go to the feet of Lord Siva for protection, you cannot escape from Rama. You along with your brother will be slain."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यतेत्रिषुलोकेषुनपिशाचंनराक्षसम् । त्रातारमनुपश्यामिनगन्धर्वंनचासुरम् ।।6.20.27।।
output: "I do not see anyone who can save you in these three worlds, not Rakshasas, not devils or even Gandharvas."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवधीर्यजरावृद्दंगृध्रराजंजटायुषम् । किंनुतेरामसान्निध्येसकाशेलक्ष्मणस्यवा ।।6.20.28।। हृतासीताविशालाक्षीयांत्वंगृह्यनबुध्यसे ।
output: "When the aged and old vulture Jatayu restrained you, why did you disregard and seize broadeyed Sita? Why did you not take her away in the presence of Rama or even Lakshmana?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महाबलंमहात्मानंदुर्धर्षममरैरपि । नबुध्यसेरघुश्रेष्ठंयस्तेप्राणान्हरिष्यति ।।6.20.29।।
output: "You do not understand that the foremost of Raghu's, a benevolent one, is difficult to overcome even for Indra. He will take away your life with his extraordinary might."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽब्रवीद्वालिसुतस्त्वङ्गदोहरिसत्तमः । नायंदूतोमहाराजचारिकःप्रतिभातिमे ।।6.20.30।।
output: "Then Angada, the noble one among Vanaras, the son of Vali, said," O King, to me it appears that he is not a messenger but a spy."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तुलितंहिबलंसर्वमनेनात्रैवतिष्ठता । गृह्यतांमागमल्लङ्कामेतद्दिममरोचते ।।6.20.31।।
output: "While standing here surely he has assessed the entire strength of the army. I hope he is taken as a captive and not returned to Lanka."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोराज्ञासमादिष्टास्समुत्पत्यवलीमुखाः । जगृहुश्चबबन्धुश्चविलपन्तमनाथवत् ।।6.20.32।।
output: तः then, राज्ञा: by the king, समादिष्टाः having been commanded, वलीमुखाः the bird Suka, समुत्पत्य: getting up, अनाथवत् like a forlorn one, विलपन्तम् wailing, जगृहुश्च: caught him, बबन्धुश्च: and bound.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शुकस्तुवानरैश्चण्डैस्तत्रतैस्सम्प्रपीडितः । व्याचुक्रोशमहात्मानंरामंदशरथात्मजम् ।।6.20.33।।
output: तत्र: thereafter, चण्डैः severely, तैःवानरैः by the Vanaras, सम्प्रपीडितः tormented, शुकस्तु: at Suka, महात्मानम् benevolent, दशरथात्मजम् Dasaratha's son, रामम् Rama, व्याचुक्रोश: went towards.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
लुप्येतेमेबलात्पक्षौभिद्येतेमेतथाऽक्षिणी ।।6.20.34।। यांचरात्रिंमरिष्यामिजायेरात्रिंचयामहम् । एतस्मिन्नन्तरेकालेयन्मयाह्यशुभंकृतम् ।।6.20.35।। सर्वंत्वमुपपद्येधाजह्यांचेद्यदिजीवितम् ।
output: "If my wings are cut off and my eyes are injured, on account of that inauspicious act you will take on all sins of my life from the night I was born till the night I am dead leaving my original form, even will happen (Suka tells Rama)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लुप्येतेमेबलात्पक्षौभिद्येतेमेतथाऽक्षिणी ।।6.20.34।। यांचरात्रिंमरिष्यामिजायेरात्रिंचयामहम् । एतस्मिन्नन्तरेकालेयन्मयाह्यशुभंकृतम् ।।6.20.35।। सर्वंत्वमुपपद्येधाजह्यांचेद्यदिजीवितम् ।
output: "If my wings are cut off and my eyes are injured, on account of that inauspicious act you will take on all sins of my life from the night I was born till the night I am dead leaving my original form, even will happen (Suka tells Rama)."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 20:
नाघातयत्तदारामश्श्रुत्वातत्परिदेवनम् । वानरानब्रवीद्रामोमुच्यतांदूतआगतः ।।6.20.36।।
output: "Having heard the lamentation, Rama said to the Vanaras" Do not kill him. Set him free as he had come as an envoy." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twentieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सागरवेलायांदर्भानास्तीर्यराघवः । अञ्जलिंप्राङ्मुखःकृत्वाप्रतिशिश्येमहोदधेः ।।6.21.1।। बाहुंभुजगभोगाभमुपधायारिसूदनः ।
output: When the ocean did not give way, Rama gets angry and resorts to stirring up the ocean with his arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वरकाञ्चनकेयूरमुक्ताप्रवरभूषणैः ।।6.21.2।। भुजैःपरमनारीणामभिमृष्टमनेकदा ।।6.21.3।।
output: वरकाञ्चनकेयूरमुक्ताप्रवरभूषणैः armlet adorned with best of gold, pearls and coral ornaments, परमनारीणाम् by supreme women, भुजैः shoulders, अनेकाथा many times, अभिमृष्टम् besmeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वरकाञ्चनकेयूरमुक्ताप्रवरभूषणैः ।।6.21.2।। भुजैःपरमनारीणामभिमृष्टमनेकदा ।।6.21.3।।
output: वरकाञ्चनकेयूरमुक्ताप्रवरभूषणैः armlet adorned with best of gold, pearls and coral ornaments, परमनारीणाम् by supreme women, भुजैः shoulders, अनेकाथा many times, अभिमृष्टम् besmeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चन्दनागुरुभिश्चैवपुरस्तादधिवासितम् । बालसूर्यप्रकाशैश्चन्दनैरुपशोभितम् ।।6.21.4।।
output: पुरस्तात् earlier, चन्दनागुरुभिश्चैव with sandal paste and Agaru, अधिवासितम् emitting, बालसूर्यप्रकाशैः the brilliance of rising Sun, चन्धनैः sandal, उपशोभितम् very charming.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शयनेचोत्तमाङ्गेनसीतायाश्शोभितंपुरा । तक्षकस्येवसम्भोगगङ्गाजलनिषेचितम् ।।6.21.5।।
output: पुरा earlier, शयने while he slept, सीतायाः Sita's, उत्तमाङ्गेन the best of women, शोभितम् graced, गङ्गाजलनिषेवितम् given bath with waters of Ganga, तक्षकस्य Takshaka's, सम्भोगमिव as if united in delight.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 21:
संयुगेयुगसङ्काशंशत्रूणांशोकवर्धनम् । सुहृदानन्दनंदीर्घंसागरान्तव्यपाश्रयम् ।।6.21.6।।
output: The shoulders were long like the union of Yugas, which brought grief to the enemies in war and delight to the friends, and like the earth bound by the ocean on all sides.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
असत्याचपुनस्सव्यंज्याघातविगतत्वचम् । दक्षिणोदक्षिणंबाहुंमहापरिघसन्निभम् ।।6.21.7।। गोसहस्रप्रदारंमुपधायमहत्भुजम् । अद्यमेमरणंवादतरणंसागरस्यवा ।।6.21.8।। तिरामोमतिंकृत्वामहाबाहुर्महोदधिम् । अधिशिश्येचविधिवत्प्रयतोनियतोमुनिः ।।6.21.9।।
output: The mighty armed Rama's arms were hardened like that of iron bars by the large number of arrows received by the left arm and strained by giving thousands of cows as gifts by the right arm. Rama was determined now to cross over the great ocean or meet the sea with death and lay down subdued and restrained like a sage.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
असत्याचपुनस्सव्यंज्याघातविगतत्वचम् । दक्षिणोदक्षिणंबाहुंमहापरिघसन्निभम् ।।6.21.7।। गोसहस्रप्रदारंमुपधायमहत्भुजम् । अद्यमेमरणंवादतरणंसागरस्यवा ।।6.21.8।। तिरामोमतिंकृत्वामहाबाहुर्महोदधिम् । अधिशिश्येचविधिवत्प्रयतोनियतोमुनिः ।।6.21.9।।
output: महाबाहुः mighty armed, दक्षिणः to left, रामः Rama, अस्यता released, ज्याघातविगतत्वचम् hardened by the large number of arrows released, सव्यम् by it, बाहुम् by the arm, महापरिघसन्निभम् like the iron bar, गोसहस्रप्रदातारम् thousands of cows given as gift, महत् large, दक्षिणम् to the left, भुजम् arm, उपधाय by strokes, अद्य now, मे my, सागरस्य of the ocean तरणंवा or the crossing over, मरणंवा or death, इति thus, धृतिम् determined, कृत्वा having resolved, अत्र and then, विधिवत् accordingly, प्रयतो self restrained, मुनिः sage, नियतः one who is subdued, महादधिम् great ocean, अधिशिश्ये lay down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
असत्याचपुनस्सव्यंज्याघातविगतत्वचम् । दक्षिणोदक्षिणंबाहुंमहापरिघसन्निभम् ।।6.21.7।। गोसहस्रप्रदारंमुपधायमहत्भुजम् । अद्यमेमरणंवादतरणंसागरस्यवा ।।6.21.8।। तिरामोमतिंकृत्वामहाबाहुर्महोदधिम् । अधिशिश्येचविधिवत्प्रयतोनियतोमुनिः ।।6.21.9।।
output: The mighty armed Rama's arms were hardened like that of iron bars by the large number of arrows received by the left arm and strained by giving thousands of cows as gifts by the right arm. Rama was determined now to cross over the great ocean or meet the sea with death and lay down subdued and restrained like a sage.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 21:
तस्यरामस्यसुप्तस्यकुशास्तीर्णेमहीतले । नियमादप्रमत्तस्यनिशास्तिस्रोऽतिचक्रमुः ।।6.21.10।।
output: As Rama kept himself alert with a vow and lay on the kusa grass m at spread on the ground, three nights rolled fast.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सत्रिरात्रोषितस्तत्रनयज्ञोधर्मवत्सलः । उपासततदारामस्सागरंसरितांपतिम् ।।6.21.11।।
output: Rama, a lover of dharma, who had political foresight, spent three nights waiting upon the ocean, the Lord of rivers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 21:
नचदर्शयतेरूपंमन्दोरामस्यसागरः । प्रयतेनापिरामेणयथार्हमभिपूजितः ।।6.21.12।।
output: Though Rama remained selfrestrained and respected the ocean well according to propriety, the ocean was dull and did not show its real form.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समुद्रस्यततःक्रुद्धोरामोरक्तान्तलोचनः । समीपस्थमुवाचेदंलक्ष्मणंशुभलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.21.13।।
output: Enraged at the ocean, Rama's eyes turned red. He went near Lakshmana who was endowed with auspicious marks and thus addressed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवलेपस्समुद्रस्यनदर्शयतियत्स्वयम् । प्रशमश्चक्षमाचैवआर्जवंप्रियवादिता ।।6.21.14।। असामर्थ्यंफल्नात्येतेनिर्गुणेषुसतांगुणाः ।
output: यः who is it, स्वयम् by himself, नदर्शयति does not show up, समुद्रस्य ocean's, अवलेपः pride, प्रशमश्चैव calmness also, क्षमाचैव with forbearance, आर्जवम् straight forwardness, प्रियवादिता politeness of speech, एते all these, सताम् virtues, गुणाः qualities, निर्गुणेषु without attributes, असामर्थ्यफलाःहि construed indeed as incapability.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आत्मप्रशंसिनंदृष्टंधृष्टंविपरिथावकम् । सर्वत्रोत्सृष्टदण्डंचलोकस्सत्कुरुतेनरम् ।।6.21.15।।
output: लोकः the world, आत्मप्रशंसिनम् praising one's own self, दुष्टम् wicked ones, धृष्टम् impudent, विपरिथावकम् an unchaste one, सर्वत्र all over उत्सृष्टदण्डंचनरम् one who goes about with a rod of punishment, सत्कुरुते treat with respect.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 21:
नसाम्नाशक्यतेकीर्तिर्नसाम्नाशक्यतेयशः । प्राप्तुंलक्ष्मण लोकेऽस्मिन् ञ्जयोवारणमूर्धनि ।।6.21.16।।
output: "O Lakshmana Neither fame nor popularity can win a battle front in this world."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्यमद्बाणनिर्भग्नैर्मकरैर्मकरानिलयम् । निरुद्धतोयंसौमित्रेप्लवभदिःपश्यसर्वतः ।।6.21.17।।
output: "Saumithri Witness the crocodiles shattered by my ruthless arrows jumping and floating in the ocean with water splashed on all sides."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महाभोगानिमत्स्यानांकरिणांचकराह । भोगिनांपश्यनागानांमयाछिन्नानिलक्ष्मण ।।6.21.18।।
output: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, मया by me, छिन्नानि cut into pieces, भोगिनाम् serpents, नागानां serpents coiled, मत्स्यानाम् fishes, महाभोगानि huge snakes, करिणाम् sea elephants, काराह large, इह now here, पश्य see.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सशङ्खशुक्तिजालंसमीनमकरंतथा । अद्ययुद्धेनमहतासमुद्रंपरिशोषये ।।6.21.19।।
output: सशङ्खशुक्तिकाजालम् water with its shells, conchs, तथा so also, समीनमकरम् with fishes and crocodiles, समुद्रम् ocean, अद्य now, महता, great युद्धेन combat, परिशोषये will make it dry.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षमयाहिसमायुक्तंमामयंमकरालयः । असमर्थंविजानातिधिक् क्षमामीदृशेजने ।।6.21.20।।
output: क्षमया tolerance, समायुक्तम् remaining, माम् me, आयम् this, मकरालयः abode of fish, असमर्थम् incapable, विजानाति do not know, ईदृशे endowed with such qualities, जने people, क्षमाम् forbearance, धिक् show.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नदर्शयतिसाम्नामेसागरोरूपमात्मनः ।।6.21.21।। चापमानयसौमित्रेशरांश्चाशीविषोपमान् । सागरंशोषयिष्यामिपद् भ्यांयान्तुप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.21.22।।
output: सागरः ocean's, साम्ना to me, मे I, आत्मानम् its own form, नदर्शयिती not shown, सौमित्रे O Saumithri, चापम् bow, आशीविषोषमान् resembling venomous snake, शरांश्च arrows, आनय get, समुद्रम् ocean, शोषयिष्यामि will make it dry, प्लवङ्गमाः all the Vanaras, पद् ब्याम् by foot, यान्तु go.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नदर्शयतिसाम्नामेसागरोरूपमात्मनः ।।6.21.21।। चापमानयसौमित्रेशरांश्चाशीविषोपमान् । सागरंशोषयिष्यामिपद् भ्यांयान्तुप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.21.22।।
output: "The ocean has not shown his own form to me. O Lakshmana Get the bow and venomous snake like arrows, I will dry up the ocean and the Vanaras can walk by foot and go."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्याक्षोभ्यमपिक्रुद्धःक्षोभयिष्यामिसागरम् । वेलासुकृतमर्यादंसहस्रोर्मिसमाकुलम् ।।6.21.23।। निर्मर्यादंकरिष्यामिसायायिकैर्वरुणालयम् । महार्णवंक्षोभयिष्येमहादानवसङ्कुलम् ।।6.21.24।।
output: "(The ocean) Having made me angry, now I will torment the ocean even though it is imperturbable and has its limits. I will torment the ocean with its thousands of waves and mighty demons by my arrows and make the ocean cross its boundary."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्याक्षोभ्यमपिक्रुद्धःक्षोभयिष्यामिसागरम् । वेलासुकृतमर्यादंसहस्रोर्मिसमाकुलम् ।।6.21.23।। निर्मर्यादंकरिष्यामिसायायिकैर्वरुणालयम् । महार्णवंक्षोभयिष्येमहादानवसङ्कुलम् ।।6.21.24।।
output: "(The ocean) Having made me angry, now I will torment the ocean even though it is imperturbable and has its limits. I will torment the ocean with its thousands of waves and mighty demons by my arrows and make the ocean cross its boundary."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वाधनुष्पाणिःक्रोधविस्फारितेक्षणः । बभूवरामोदुर्धर्षोयुगान्तानगिरिवज्वलन् ।।6.21.25।।
output: एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, धनुष्पाणिः bows etc. क्रोधविस्फारितेक्षणः with flaming red eyes, रामः Rama, ज्वलन् burning, युगान्तानगिरिव like the flame at the end of the universe, दुर्धर्षः unassailable, बभूव seemed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 21:
सम्पीड्यचधनुर्घोरंकम्पयित्वाशरैर्जगत् । मुमोचविशिखानुग्रान्वज्रानिवशतक्रतुः ।।6.21.26।।
output: Bending the terrific bow, he released frightful arrows like Indra (who released thunderbolts) who performed a hundred sacrifices.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेज्वलन्तोमहावेगास्तेजसासायकोत्तमाः । प्रविशन्तिसमुद्रस्यसलिलंत्रस्तपन्नगम् ।।6.21.27।।
output: Glowing in brilliance like flame, the arrows of the best among the arrows pierced like snakes into the water of the ocean.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 21:
तोयवेगस्समुद्रस्यसनक्रमकरोमहान् । सम्बभूवमहाघोरस्समारुतरवस्तदा ।।6.21.28।।
output: Then the ocean seemed terrible with the fish and crocodiles rushing out with the speed of water and powerful wind.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महोर्मिकुलाविततश्शङ्खजालसमावृतः । सधूमःपरिवृत्तोर्मिस्सहसासीन्महोदधिः ।।6.21.29।।
output: सहसा all of a sudden, महोदधिः great ocean, महोर्मिजालचलितः with the movement of the water, शङ्खजालसमावृतः filled with conchs and shells, सधूमः terrific smoke, परिवृत्तोर्मिः whirling round and rising up, आसीत् played around.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्यथिताःपन्नगाश्चासदनीप्तास्यादीप्तलोचनाः । दानवाश्चमहावीर्याःपाताळतलवासिनः ।।6.21.30।।
output: Those snakes with blazing hoods and glowing eyes residing in the underworld and the demons became oppressed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऊर्मयस्सिन्धुराजस्यसनक्रमकरास्तथा । विन्द्यमन्दरसङ्काशास्समुत्पेतुस्सहस्रशः ।।6.21.31।।
output: तथा so also, सिन्दुराजस्य king of rivers, सनक्रमकराः which were like, विन्द्यमन्दरसङ्काशाः Vindhya and Mandara mountain peaks, ऊर्मयः waves, सहस्रशः in thousands, समुत्पेतुः rose up.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आघूर्णिततरङ्गौघस्सम्भ्रान्तोरगराक्षसः । उद्वर्तितमहाग्राहस्संवृत्तस्सलिलाशयः ।।6.21.32।।
output: The waves rose up tossing and whirling about. The agitated Nagas and Rakshasas were thrown up by a highly disturbed ocean that produced a great sound.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तुतंराघवमुग्रवेगंप्रकर्षमाणंधनुरप्रमेयम् । सौमित्रिरुत्पत्यसमुच्छवसन्तंमामेतिचोक्त्वादनुराललम्बे ।।6.21.33।।
output: ततः then, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, उत्पत्य got up, उग्रवेगम् at high speed, अप्रमेयम् immeasurably great, धनुः bow, प्रकर्षमाणम् was stretching exceedingly, विनिश्श्वनन्तम् breathing hard in anger, राघवम् at Rama, मामाइति that is enough that is enough, उक्त्वा saying, धनुः bow, आललम्बे seized.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
अथोवाचरघुश्रेष्टस्सागरंदारुणंवचः । अद्यत्वांशोषयिष्यामिसपाताळंमहार्णव: ।।6.22.1।।
output: Thereafter, Rama uttered, "I shall make you dry up to the underworld", to the ocean that made his terrific presence.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
शरनिर्दग्धतोयस्यपरिशुष्कस्यसागर: । मयाशोषितसत्त्वस्यपांसुरुत्पद्यतेमहान् ।।6.22.2।।
output: "O Ocean When your water is dried up to the core by my arrows, huge sand will appear."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मत्कार्मुकविसृष्टेवशरवर्षेणसागर । पारंतेऽद्यगमिष्यन्तिपदभिरेवप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.22.3।।
output: सागर O Ocean, मत्कार्मुकविसृष्टेन all the creatures inhabiting you, शरवर्षेण by the rain of arrows, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, पदभिरेव to the other side of the shore, परंअद्य now to the other, गमिष्यन्ति will go.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विचिन्वन्नाभिजानासिपौरुषंनापिविक्रमम् । दानवालयसन्तापंमत्तोनाधिगमिष्यसि ।।6.22.4।।
output: "You, who are the abode of demons are not aware of my valour and prowess. You are not aware of the sorrow that you will face from me."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेणसंयोज्यब्रह्मदण्डनिभम् शरम् । संयोज्यधनुषिश्रेष्ठविचकर्षमहाबलः ।।6.22.5।।
output: Rama proceeded to stretch the mighty bow that resembled the rod of punishment of Brahma energized by Brahma and released that best of bows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तस्मिन्विविकृष्टेसहसाराघवेणशरासने । रोदसीसम्पफालेवपर्वताश्चचकम्पिरे ।।6.22.6।।
output: When Rama released the arrows from the bow, at once the sky to the earth including mountains trembled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमश्चलोकमाव्रतेदिशश्चवचकाशिरे । प्रतिचुक्षुभिरेचाशुसरांसिसरितस्तथा ।।6.22.7।।
output: Then darkness engulfed the world, the directions were not noticeable and further the rivers were agitated.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तिर्यक्चसहानेक्षत्रैस्सङ्गतौचन्द्रभास्करौ । भास्करांशुभिरादीप्तंतमसाचसमावृतम् ।।6.22.8।। चकाशेतदाकाशमुल्काशतविदीपितम् । अन्तरिक्षाच्चनिर्घातानिर्जग्मुरतुलस्वनाः ।।6.22.9।।
output: The Sun and moon moved obliquely (from south to North) along with the stars. On account of the darkness that covered even the sun was not shining. The sky lighted by the meteors shone and unparalleled thunder shot forth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तिर्यक्चसहानेक्षत्रैस्सङ्गतौचन्द्रभास्करौ । भास्करांशुभिरादीप्तंतमसाचसमावृतम् ।।6.22.8।। चकाशेतदाकाशमुल्काशतविदीपितम् । अन्तरिक्षाच्चनिर्घातानिर्जग्मुरतुलस्वनाः ।।6.22.9।।
output: चन्द्रभास्करौ the Sun and moon, नक्षत्रेःसह with stars, तिर्यक् obliquely, सङ्गतौ moved, भास्करांशुभिः even the Sun light, आदीप्तम् not shining, तमसाच on account of darkness, समावृतम् engulfed all over, तत् then, आकाशम् sky, उल्काशत by the meteors, विदीपितम् again lighted, प्रचकाशे shone, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, अतुलस्वनाः unparalleled, निर्घाताः thunder, निर्जग्मुः shot forth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
वपुस्फुरुश्चघनादिव्यादिविमारुतपङ् ख्कयः । बभञ्जचतदावृक्षान्जलदानुद्वहन्नपिः ।।6.22.10।।
output: Then terrific wind blew breaking forth the clouds, which is an abode of cold water, taking them away in upward direction breaking trees.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अरुजंश्चैनशैलाग्राशनिखराणिबभञ्जनः । दिविस्पृशोमहमेघास्सङ्गतास्समहास्वनाः ।।6.22.11।। मुमुचुर्वैद्युताननगींस्तेमहाशनयस्तदा ।
output: Huge clouds collected were moving at extraordinary speed in the sky breaking mountain peaks. Those clouds in the sky sent forth fire of lightning making a loud sound.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
यानिभूतानिदृश्यानिचुक्रुशुश्चाशनेसमम् ।।6.22.12।। अदृश्यानिचभूतानिमुमुचुर्भैरवस्वनम् । शिशियरेचाभिभूतानिसन्त्रस्ताम्यद्विजन्तिच ।।6.22.13।। सम्प्रविव्यथिरेचापिवचपस्पन्दिरेभयात् ।
output: The creatures like humans etc. That could be seen and those that could not be seen like devils and ghosts remained still out of fear. Few other creatures came out of their place even though it was cold. Some were thrown off from their habitation in fear although they were together.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
यानिभूतानिदृश्यानिचुक्रुशुश्चाशनेसमम् ।।6.22.12।। अदृश्यानिचभूतानिमुमुचुर्भैरवस्वनम् । शिशियरेचाभिभूतानिसन्त्रस्ताम्यद्विजन्तिच ।।6.22.13।। सम्प्रविव्यथिरेचापिवचपस्पन्दिरेभयात् ।
output: The creatures like humans etc. That could be seen and those that could not be seen like devils and ghosts remained still out of fear. Few other creatures came out of their place even though it was cold. Some were thrown off from their habitation in fear although they were together.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सहाभूतैस्सतोयोर्मिस्सनागस्सहराक्षसः ।।6.22.14।। सहसाऽभूत्ततोवेगाबदीमवेगोमहोदधिः । योजनंव्यतिचक्रामवेलामन्यत्रसम्ल्पवात् ।।6.22.15।।
output: ततः thereafter, सतोयोर्मिः those waves of water, सहाभूतै with its creatures, सनागः with serpents, सहराक्षसः with the demons, महोदधि great ocean, सहसा at once, भीमवेगः at terrific speed, अभूत् unprecedented, वेगात् speed, सम्ल्पवात् thrown out, अन्यत्रवेलाम् by the other tides, योजनम् one yojana, व्यतिचक्राम was thrown.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
सहाभूतैस्सतोयोर्मिस्सनागस्सहराक्षसः ।।6.22.14।। सहसाऽभूत्ततोवेगाबदीमवेगोमहोदधिः । योजनंव्यतिचक्रामवेलामन्यत्रसम्ल्पवात् ।।6.22.15।।
output: There after those waves of water with its creatures, serpents and demons were at once thrown off at terrific speed that was unprecedented. They were thrown beyond a yojana by the high tides.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंतदासमतिक्रान्तंनातिचक्रामराघवः । समुद्धतममित्रघ्नोरामोनदनदीपतिम् ।।6.22.16।।
output: राघवः Rama, अमित्रघ्नः destroyer of foes, रामः Rama, तदा then, समतिक्रान्तम् transgressing, समुद्धतम् overweening, तम् them, नदनदीपतिम् Lord of rivers, नातिचक्राम not go far.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोमथ्यात्समुद्रस्यसागरस्स्वयमुत्थितः । उदयन् हिमहाशैलान्मेरोरिवदिवाकरः ।।6.22.17।।
output: ततः then, महामेरोः over the mighty Meru, उदयं rising, दिवाकरःइव like the Sun, सागरः Lord of ocean, समुद्रस्य ocean's, मध्यात् middle, स्वयम् himself, उत्थितः risen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
पन्नगैस्सहदीप्तास्यैस्समुद्रःप्रत्यदृश्यत । स्निग्धवैढूर्यसङ्काशोजाम्बूनदविभूषणः ।।6.22.18।।
output: Then the Lord of the Ocean shining like the Vaidurya stone decked in pure gold as if blazing appeared along with serpents.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरःपद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः । सर्वपुष्पमयींदिव्यांशिरसाधारयन् स्रजम् ।।6.22.19।। जातरूपमयैश्चैवतपनीयविभूषितैः । आत्मजानांचरत्नानांभूषितोभूषणोत्तमैः ।।6.22.20।। धातुभिर्मण्डितश्शैलोविविधैर्हिमवानिव । एकावलीमध्यगतंतरलंपाटलप्रभम् ।।6.22.21।। विपुलेनोरसा बिभ्रत्कौस्तुभस्य सहोदरम् । अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघःकालिकानिलसङ्गुलः ।।6.22.22।। गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधाननाभिरापगाभिस्समावृतः । देवतानांसरूपाभिर्नानारूपाभिरीश्वरः ।।6.22.23।। सागरस्समुपक्रम्यपूर्वमाम्नत्यरवीर्यवान् । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यंराघवंशरपाणिनम् ।।6.22.24।।
output: रत्क्तमाल्याम्बरधरः clad in red coloured robes, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः whose eyes were like lotus petals, शिरसा on the head, सर्वपुष्पमयीम् wearing different kinds of flowers, दिव्याम् wonderful, प्रजम् wreath, धारयन् wearing, जातरूपमयैश्चैव of polished gold, तपनीयविभूषणैः decked in shining ornaments, आत्मजानाम् from his own territory, रत्नानाम् precious gems, भूषणोत्तमैः best of ornaments, भूषितः decked, मण्डितः with different kinds of minerals, हिमनान् शैलःइव resembled the Himalaya mountain, एकावलीमध्यगतम् in the midst of pearl necklace on his bosom, पाण्डरप्रभम् shedding white lustre, कौस्तुभस्यसहोदरम् resembling Kausthuba (a precious jewel with emerald gem worn by Lord Vishnu), तरलम् hanging necklace, विपुलेन broad, उपसा near, बिभ्रत् moving, अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः with several tides rising up, कालिकानिलसङ्कुलः with multitude of tides touching the of clouds, देवतानाम् goddesses, सरूपाभि forms also, नानारूपाभिः of diverse forms, गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधानाभिः Ganga and Sindhu, such important rivers, आपगाभिः coming near, समावृतः surrounded by, ईश्वरः Lord, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सागरः Sagara, समुपक्रम्य all coming near, पूर्वम् first, आम्नत्यर greeting, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, शरपाणिनम् one who held the arrow, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरःपद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः । सर्वपुष्पमयींदिव्यांशिरसाधारयन् स्रजम् ।।6.22.19।। जातरूपमयैश्चैवतपनीयविभूषितैः । आत्मजानांचरत्नानांभूषितोभूषणोत्तमैः ।।6.22.20।। धातुभिर्मण्डितश्शैलोविविधैर्हिमवानिव । एकावलीमध्यगतंतरलंपाटलप्रभम् ।।6.22.21।। विपुलेनोरसा बिभ्रत्कौस्तुभस्य सहोदरम् । अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघःकालिकानिलसङ्गुलः ।।6.22.22।। गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधाननाभिरापगाभिस्समावृतः । देवतानांसरूपाभिर्नानारूपाभिरीश्वरः ।।6.22.23।। सागरस्समुपक्रम्यपूर्वमाम्नत्यरवीर्यवान् । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यंराघवंशरपाणिनम् ।।6.22.24।।
output: Clad in red coloured robes, endowed with lotus petal like eyes having a wonderful wreath of diverse flowers on head, decked in shining ornaments of polished gold encrusted with precious gems from his own territory, he resembled the Himalayan Mountain with minerals. He had a hanging pearl necklace in the centre of his bosom shedding white lustre that resembled the Kausthuba of Lord Vishnu. With several tides moving near, and multitude of tides reaching the clouds threatening, surrounded by Goddesses of several forms and deities of important rivers like Ganga and Sindhu, the valiant Lord of the ocean greeted with folded palms and spoke these words to Rama who was wielding an arrow in his hand.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रक्तमाल्याम्बरधरःपद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः । सर्वपुष्पमयींदिव्यांशिरसाधारयन् स्रजम् ।।6.22.19।। जातरूपमयैश्चैवतपनीयविभूषितैः । आत्मजानांचरत्नानांभूषितोभूषणोत्तमैः ।।6.22.20।। धातुभिर्मण्डितश्शैलोविविधैर्हिमवानिव । एकावलीमध्यगतंतरलंपाटलप्रभम् ।।6.22.21।। विपुलेनोरसा बिभ्रत्कौस्तुभस्य सहोदरम् । अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघःकालिकानिलसङ्गुलः ।।6.22.22।। गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधाननाभिरापगाभिस्समावृतः । देवतानांसरूपाभिर्नानारूपाभिरीश्वरः ।।6.22.23।। सागरस्समुपक्रम्यपूर्वमाम्नत्यरवीर्यवान् । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यंराघवंशरपाणिनम् ।।6.22.24।।
output: रत्क्तमाल्याम्बरधरः clad in red coloured robes, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः whose eyes were like lotus petals, शिरसा on the head, सर्वपुष्पमयीम् wearing different kinds of flowers, दिव्याम् wonderful, प्रजम् wreath, धारयन् wearing, जातरूपमयैश्चैव of polished gold, तपनीयविभूषणैः decked in shining ornaments, आत्मजानाम् from his own territory, रत्नानाम् precious gems, भूषणोत्तमैः best of ornaments, भूषितः decked, मण्डितः with different kinds of minerals, हिमनान् शैलःइव resembled the Himalaya mountain, एकावलीमध्यगतम् in the midst of pearl necklace on his bosom, पाण्डरप्रभम् shedding white lustre, कौस्तुभस्यसहोदरम् resembling Kausthuba (a precious jewel with emerald gem worn by Lord Vishnu), तरलम् hanging necklace, विपुलेन broad, उपसा near, बिभ्रत् moving, अघूर्णिततरङ्गौघः with several tides rising up, कालिकानिलसङ्कुलः with multitude of tides touching the of clouds, देवतानाम् goddesses, सरूपाभि forms also, नानारूपाभिः of diverse forms, गङ्गासिन्दुप्रधानाभिः Ganga and Sindhu, such important rivers, आपगाभिः coming near, समावृतः surrounded by, ईश्वरः Lord, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सागरः Sagara, समुपक्रम्य all coming near, पूर्वम् first, आम्नत्यर greeting, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, शरपाणिनम् one who held the arrow, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
