instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
पृथिवीवायुराकाशमापोज्योतिश्चराघव: । स्वभावेसौम्य तिष्ठन्तिशाश्वतंमार्गमाश्रिताः ।।6.22.25।।
output: "Noble Rama Earth, wind, space, water, and fire, the five elements remain in their path strictly following their nature."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्स्वभावोममाप्येषयदगाधोऽहमप्लवः । विकारस्तुभवेद्गाधएतत्तेप्रवदाम्यहम् ।।6.22.26।।
output: "I am fathomless and as such not capable of being swum across as it is my nature too. My fording will be a deviation. I proclaim to you (how you can cross)."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
नकामान्नचलोभाद्वानभयातत्सापार्थिवात्मज: । ग्राहनकाकुलजलंस्तम्बयेयंकथञ्जन ।।6.22.27।।
output: "O Lord of the land Out of desire or covetousness or even out of fear I will not be able to solidify the water infested with poisonous animals."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विधास्येराम: येनापिविषहिष्येह्यहंतथा । नग्राहाप्रहरिष्यन्तियावत्सेनातरिष्यति ।।6.22.28।। हरीणांतरणेरामकरिष्यामियथास्थलम् ।
output: राम O Rama, अहम् I, येनापि by means of which, तथा so also, विधास्ये in such a mode, हरीणाम् by the Vanaras, तरणे to cross over, स्थलम् base, यत्रा passage, करिष्यामि I will do, तथा and similarly, विषहिष्ये the poisonous creatures, सेना army, यावत् total, तरष्यति crosses over, ग्राहाः seizing, नप्रहरिष्यन्ति will not be of aggressive nature.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तमब्रवीत्तदारामःउद्यतोहिनदीपते । अमोघोऽयंमहाबाणःकस्मिन् देशेनिपात्यताम् ।।6.22.29।।
output: Then Rama said, "O abode of Varuna, listen to me. In which location should I allow this unfailing mighty arrow to descend?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्यवचनंश्रुत्वातंचदृष्टवामहाशरम् । महोदधिर्महातेजाराघवंवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.22.30।।
output: On hearing the question of Rama, the mighty ocean seeing the brilliant arrow spoke these words to him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्तरेणावकाशोऽस्तिकश्चित्पुण्यतमोमम । द्रुमकुल्यइतिख्यातोलोकेयथाभवान् ।।6.22.31।।
output: "To my north there is a holy place called Drumakulya, famous like you, and you have scope to act there (to descend the arrow)."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उग्रदर्शनकर्माणोबहवस्तत्रदस्यवः । आभीरप्रमुखाःपापाःपिबन्तिसलिलंमम ।।6.22.32।।
output: तत्र there, उग्रदर्शनकर्माणः marauders of terrific action, पापाः sinful, आभीरप्रमुखाः chief of Abhiras, बहवः many, दस्यवः enemies of gods, मम my, सलिलम् waters, पिबन्ति drinking.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तैस्तुसंस्पर्शनंपापैर्नसहेपापकर्मभिः । अमोघःक्रियतांराम: तत्रतेषुशरोत्तमः ।।6.22.33।।
output: "Rama I cannot tolerate the touch of ones who are sinful in action. Therefore your (of descending this arrow down) mighty unfailing arrow can be released on them."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वासागरस्यराघवः । मुमोचतंशरंदीप्तंवीरस्सागरदर्शनात् ।।6.22.34।।
output: On hearing the words of the request of Sagara and on account of seeing him, Rama let off the supreme arrow glowing (on the marauders).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तेनतन्मरुकान्तारंपृथिव्याखलुविश्रुतम् । निपातितश्शरोयत्रवज्राशनिसमप्रभः ।।6.22.35।।
output: By the letting down of the dart that resembled the glow of Indra that part of the land was indeed popularly known as Marakantara (Marwar and Bikaner region of Rajasthan).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ननादचतदातत्रवसुधाशल्यपीडिता । तस्माद्ब्राणमुखात्तोयमुत्पपातरसातलात् ।।6.22.36।।
output: तदा then, तत्र there, शल्यपीडिता crevice by the dart, वसुधा earth, ननाद popularly known, तस्मात् therefore, बाणमुखात् by the piercing of the dart, रसातलात् from the underworld, तोयम् water, उत्पपात came out.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सबभूवतदाकूपोव्रणइत्येभिविश्रुतः । सततंचोत्थितंतोयंसमुद्रस्येनदृश्यते ।।6.22.37।।
output: That well (hole created by the dart) came to be known as Vrana. The water springing out of it forever is like sea water.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
अवधारणशब्दश्चदारुणस्समपद्यत । तस्मात्तद्बाणनिपातेनत्वपःकुक्षिष्वशोषयत् ।।6.22.38।।
output: A crack caused in the ground by letting off the dart produced terrific sound and by that, the water in the cavities of the ground dried up.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
विख्यातंत्रिषुलोकेषुमधुकान्तारमेवतत् ।।6.22.39।। मोक्षयित्वाततःकुक्षिंरामोदशरथात्मजः । वरंतस्मैददौविद्वान्मरवेऽमरविक्रमः ।।6.22.40।।
output: Marukantaram is famous in the three worlds. Dasaratha's Rama, who is learned and has the valour of gods made the cavities dry and gave a boon.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विख्यातंत्रिषुलोकेषुमधुकान्तारमेवतत् ।।6.22.39।। मोक्षयित्वाततःकुक्षिंरामोदशरथात्मजः । वरंतस्मैददौविद्वान्मरवेऽमरविक्रमः ।।6.22.40।।
output: Marukantaram is famous in the three worlds. Dasaratha's Rama, who is learned and has the valour of gods made the cavities dry and gave a boon.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पशव्यश्चाल्परोगश्चफलमूलरसायुतः । बहुस्नेहोबहुक्षीरस्सुगधनिर्विविधौषधः ।।6.22.41।। एवमेतैर्गुणैरुक्तोबहुभिस्संयुतोमरुः । रामस्यवरदानाच्चशिवःपन्थाबभूवह ।।6.22.42।।
output: मरुः Maru, रामस्य Rama's, वरदानात् by virtue of the boon, पशव्यश्च tender grass for cows, अल्परोगश्च with less diseases, फलमूलरसायुतः with fruits and roots and honey, बहुस्नेहः very ideal, बहुक्षीरः plenty of milk, सुगधनिः fragrant, विविधौषधिः diverse kinds of medicinal herbs, एवम् in that way, युक्तः suitable, एतैः all these, गुणैः qualities, संयुतः endowed with, शिवः auspicious, पन्थाः holy, बभूव became.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पशव्यश्चाल्परोगश्चफलमूलरसायुतः । बहुस्नेहोबहुक्षीरस्सुगधनिर्विविधौषधः ।।6.22.41।। एवमेतैर्गुणैरुक्तोबहुभिस्संयुतोमरुः । रामस्यवरदानाच्चशिवःपन्थाबभूवह ।।6.22.42।।
output: मरुः Maru, रामस्य Rama's, वरदानात् by virtue of the boon, पशव्यश्च tender grass for cows, अल्परोगश्च with less diseases, फलमूलरसायुतः with fruits and roots and honey, बहुस्नेहः very ideal, बहुक्षीरः plenty of milk, सुगधनिः fragrant, विविधौषधिः diverse kinds of medicinal herbs, एवम् in that way, युक्तः suitable, एतैः all these, गुणैः qualities, संयुतः endowed with, शिवः auspicious, पन्थाः holy, बभूव became.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तस्मिन् दग्धेतदाकुक्षौसमुद्रस्सरितांपतिः । राघवंसर्वशास्त्रज्ञमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.22.43।।
output: Thereafter when that land of Drumakulyam was burnt (by Rama's arrow) the Lord of rivers looked at Rama who was learned in all sastras spoke these words.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अयंसौम्य: नलोनामतनयोविश्वकर्मणः । पित्रादत्तवरशीमान्प्रतिमोविश्वकर्मणाः ।।6.22.44।।
output: सौम्य noble one, श्रीमान् prosperous one, नलोनाम named Nala, अयम् this, विश्वकर्मणः by Vishwakarma's, तनयः son, पित्रा father, दत्तवरः obtained boons, विश्वकर्मणः in architecture, प्रतिमः equal to father.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एषसेतुंमहोत्साहःकरोतुमयिवानरः । तमहंधारयिष्यामियथाह्येषपितातथा ।।6.22.45।।
output: "This monkey is full of zeal. He will build a bridge over me, and I will bear it. In that way he is like his father."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
एवमुक्त्वोदधिर्नष्टस्समुत्थायनलस्तदा । अब्रवीद्वानरश्रेष्ठोवाक्यंरामंमहाबलः ।।6.22.46।।
output: Having spoken in that way, the Sea God disappeared. Nala, the foremost of vanaras, got up there after and spoke these words to mighty Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहंसेतुंकरिष्यामिविस्तीर्णेवरुणालये । पितुस्सामर्थ्यमास्थायतत्त्वमहामहोदधिः ।।6.22.47।।
output: अहम् I, पितुः father, सामर्थ्यम् skill, आस्थाय adopting, विस्तीर्णे broad, वरुणालये on the abode of Varuna, सेतुम् bridge, करिष्यामि will build महोदधिः ocean god, तत्त्वम् truth, आह has spoken.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
अयंहिसागरोभीमस्सेतुकर्मदिदृक्ष्याः । ददौदण्डभयाद्गाधंराघवायमहोदधिः ।।6.22.48।।
output: This fearsome ocean of mighty Sagara (dug by Sagara) then allowed a passage for Rama, out of fear of punishment and also to witness the building of a bridge.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मममातुर्वरोदत्तोमन्दरेविश्वकर्मणा । औरसस्तस्यपुत्रोऽहंसदृशोविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.22.49।। नचाप्यहमनुक्तोवःप्रब्रूयामात्मनोगुणान् । समर्थश्चाप्यहंसेतुंकर्तुंवैवरुणालये ।।6.22.50।। स्मारितोऽस्म्यहमेतेनतत्त्वमहामहोदधिः । काममद्वैवबध्नन्तुसेतुंवानरपुङ्गवाः ।।6.22.51।।
output: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मममातुर्वरोदत्तोमन्दरेविश्वकर्मणा । औरसस्तस्यपुत्रोऽहंसदृशोविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.22.49।। नचाप्यहमनुक्तोवःप्रब्रूयामात्मनोगुणान् । समर्थश्चाप्यहंसेतुंकर्तुंवैवरुणालये ।।6.22.50।। स्मारितोऽस्म्यहमेतेनतत्त्वमहामहोदधिः । काममद्वैवबध्नन्तुसेतुंवानरपुङ्गवाः ।।6.22.51।।
output: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मममातुर्वरोदत्तोमन्दरेविश्वकर्मणा । औरसस्तस्यपुत्रोऽहंसदृशोविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.22.49।। नचाप्यहमनुक्तोवःप्रब्रूयामात्मनोगुणान् । समर्थश्चाप्यहंसेतुंकर्तुंवैवरुणालये ।।6.22.50।। स्मारितोऽस्म्यहमेतेनतत्त्वमहामहोदधिः । काममद्वैवबध्नन्तुसेतुंवानरपुङ्गवाः ।।6.22.51।।
output: "On the Mandara mountain Vishwakarma gave a boon to my mother. I am that Vishwakarma's own son, and I am like him at work by that cause. I have put in my memory all about the ocean. I am aware of the truth of the ocean. I could not speak of my qualities unless questioned. I can build a bridge over the abode of Varuna.Right away let the Vanara leaders get the material required for building the bridge (said Nala)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोविसृष्टारामेणसर्वतोहरियूथपाः । अभिपेतुर्महारण्यंहृष्टाश्शतसहस्रशः ।।6.22.52।।
output: Then directed by Rama the Vanara troop leaders in hundreds and thousands sprang up gladly all over the huge forest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तेनगान्नगसङ्काशाश्शाखामृगगणर्षभाः । बभञ्जुःवानरास्तत्रप्रचकर्षुश्चसागरम् ।।6.22.53।।
output: Mountain like bodied Vanara bulls there upon started collecting roots of trees from the foot of mountain and moved them into the sea.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेसालैश्चाश्वकर्णैश्चधवैशैश्चवानराः । कुटजैरर्जुनैस्तालैस्तिलकैस्न्तिशैरपि ।।6.22.54।। बिल्वकैस्सप्तपर्णैश्चकर्णिकारैश्चसुपुष्पितैः । चूतैश्चाशोकवृक्षैश्चसागरंसमपूरयन् ।।6.22.55।।
output: वानराः Vanaras, सालैश्च sala trees, अश्वकर्णैश्च as vakarna trees, धवैः dhava trees, वंशैश्च bamboo, कुटजैः kutaja, अर्जुनैः arjuna, तालैः palmira, तिलकैः tilaka, न्तिशैरपि trisaira, बिल्वकैः bilva, सप्तपर्णैश्च and saptaparni, पुष्पितैःकर्णिकारैः karnikara blossoms, चूतैश्च mango, अशोकवृक्षैश्च and ashoka trees, सागरम् into ocean, पर्यपूरयन् brought and dumped.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेसालैश्चाश्वकर्णैश्चधवैशैश्चवानराः । कुटजैरर्जुनैस्तालैस्तिलकैस्न्तिशैरपि ।।6.22.54।। बिल्वकैस्सप्तपर्णैश्चकर्णिकारैश्चसुपुष्पितैः । चूतैश्चाशोकवृक्षैश्चसागरंसमपूरयन् ।।6.22.55।।
output: वानराः Vanaras, सालैश्च sala trees, अश्वकर्णैश्च as vakarna trees, धवैः dhava trees, वंशैश्च bamboo, कुटजैः kutaja, अर्जुनैः arjuna, तालैः palmira, तिलकैः tilaka, न्तिशैरपि trisaira, बिल्वकैः bilva, सप्तपर्णैश्च and saptaparni, पुष्पितैःकर्णिकारैः karnikara blossoms, चूतैश्च mango, अशोकवृक्षैश्च and ashoka trees, सागरम् into ocean, पर्यपूरयन् brought and dumped.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समूलांश्चविमूलांश्चपादपान् हरिसत्तमाः । इन्द्रकेतूनिवोद्यम्यप्रजह्रूर्वानरास्तरून् ।।6.22.56।।
output: Lifting some trees with roots and some without roots like the staff of Indra's flag, Vanaras hurled down the trees into the sea.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
ताळानदाडिमगुल्मांश्चनारिकेळन्विभीतकान् । वकुलान्कदिरान्निम्बान्समाजह्रुस्समन्ततः ।।6.22.57।।
output: They brought palmira, dadima, coconut, karira, bakula and nimba trees and dropped all of them into the ocean.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हस्तिमतान्महाकायाःपाषाणांश्चमहाबलाः । पर्वतांश्चसमुत्पाट्ययन्स्सरैःपरिवहन्तिच ।।6.22.58।।
output: महाकायाः of huge body, महाबालाः strong, हस्तिमात्रान् like elephants, पाषाणान् stones, पर्वतांश्च mountains, समुत्पाट्य collecting and lifting up, यन्स्रैः by machines, परिवहन्तिच transported.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
प्रक्षिप्यमाणैरचलैस्सहसाजलमुद्दृतम् । समुत्ससर्पआकाशमवासर्पत्ततस्ततः ।।6.22.59।।
output: At once the water threw up (by dropping the mountains) rose, touching the sky and spreading.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समुद्रंक्षोभयामासुर्वानराश्चस्समन्ततः । सूत्राण्यन्येप्रगृह्णान्तिव्यायतंशतयोजनम् ।।6.22.60।।
output: On account of throwing into the sea it got stirred up Others held the rope over a hundred yojanas in breadth (to make it even).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
नलश्चक्रेमहासेतुंमध्येनदनदीपतेः । सतदाक्रियतेसेतुर्वानरैर्घोरकर्मभिः ।।6.22.61।।
output: Nala started the task of building the huge bridge in the centre of the ocean with Vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
दण्डानन्येप्रगृह्णन्तिविचिन्वन्तितथापरे ।।6.22.62।। वानरैश्शतशस्तत्ररामस्याज्ञापुरस्सराः । मेघाभैःपर्वताग्रैश्चतृणैःकाष्ठैर्बबन्धिरे ।।6.22.63।।
output: Others held sticks and some held logs of wood and reeds following the command of Rama, hundreds of Vanaras who looked like clouds and mountain tops built the bridge.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
दण्डानन्येप्रगृह्णन्तिविचिन्वन्तितथापरे ।।6.22.62।। वानरैश्शतशस्तत्ररामस्याज्ञापुरस्सराः । मेघाभैःपर्वताग्रैश्चतृणैःकाष्ठैर्बबन्धिरे ।।6.22.63।।
output: Others held sticks and some held logs of wood and reeds following the command of Rama, hundreds of Vanaras who looked like clouds and mountain tops built the bridge.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुष्पिताग्रैश्चतरुभिस्सेतुंबध्नन्तिवानराः । पाषाणांश्चगिरिप्रख्यागनिरीणांशिखराणिच ।।6.22.64।। दृश्यन्तेपरिधावन्तोगृह्यदानवसन्निभाः ।
output: The Vanaras who were like Danavas, huge mountains in size were seen seizing boulders from the mountain, the trees with blossoms, and creepers for binding the bridge and running.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
शिलानांक्षिप्यमाणानांशैलानांनिपात्यताम् । बभूवतुमुलश्शब्दस्तदातस्मिन्महोदधौ ।।6.22.65।।
output: By hurling off the mountains in that lofty ocean and throwing stones, a tumultuous sound arose.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कृतानिप्रथमेनाह्नायोजनानिचतुर्दश । प्रहृष्टैर्गजसङ्काश्चैस्त्वरमाणैःप्लवङ्गमैः ।।6.22.66।।
output: Elephants like monkeys rejoiced over building speedily fourteen yojanas the distance of the bridge on the first day.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्वितीयेनतथैचाह्नायोजनानितुविंशतिः । कृतानिप्लवगैस्तूर्णंभीमकायैर्महाबलैः ।।6.22.67।।
output: तथैन in the same order, भीमकायैः of fierce body, महाबलैः extremely strong, प्लवगैः Vanaras, तूर्णम् soon, द्वितीयेन on the second, अह्ना one day, विंशतिः twenty, योजनानि yojanas, कृतानि built.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
अह्नातृतयेनतथायोजनानिकृतानिच । त्वरमाणैर्महाकायैरेकविंशतिरेवच ।।6.22.68।।
output: Endowed with huge body that way the Vanaras built extremely fast, twenty one yojanas on the third day.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चतुर्थेनतथाचाह्नाद्वाविंशतिरथासिवा । योजनानिमहावेगैःकृतानित्वरितस्तुतैः ।।6.22.69।।
output: ततः there upon, महावेगैः of great speed, त्वरितैः at once, अथापि so also, वा and, चतुर्धेन on the fourth, अह्ना a day, द्वाविंशतिः twenty two, योजनानि yojanas, कृतानि did.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
पञ्चमेनतथाचाह्नाप्लवगैःक्षिप्रकारिभिः । योजनानित्रयोविंशत्सुवेलमधिकृत्यवै ।।6.22.70।।
output: Similarly, on the fifth day the Vanaras endowed with great impetus built twenty three yojanas and crossed Mount Suvela.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
सवानरवरश्रशीमान्विश्वकर्मात्माजोबली । बबन्धसागरेसेतुंयथाचाप्यतथापिता ।।6.22.71।।
output: Nala the son of Vishwakarma, the foremost of the Vanaras and strong like his father built the bridge in the sea.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
सनलेनकृतस्सेतुस्सागरेमकरालये । शुशुभेसुभगश्रशीमान् स्वातीपथइवाम्बरे ।।6.22.72।।
output: The bridge was built on the sea, an abode of crocodiles, was auspicious, glorious, and looked like the street in space (milky path).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोदेवस्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्दाश्चपरमर्षयः । आगम्यगगनेतस्थुर्द्रष्टुकामास्तदद्बुतम् ।।6.22.73।।
output: The Gandharvas, gods and even siddhas felt happy and reached their stationed in the sky to see the wonderful bridge.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दशयोजनविस्तीर्णंशतयोजनमायतम् । ददृशुर्देवगन्धर्वानलसेतुंसुदुष्करम् ।।6.22.74।।
output: Gods and Gandharvas witnessed the bridge built by Nala that was ten yojanas in width and hundred yojanas in length.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
आप्लवन्तःप्लवन्तश्चगर्जन्तश्चप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.22.75।। तदच्नित्यमसह्यंचह्यद्भुतंरोमहर्षणम् । ददृशुस्सर्वभूतानिसागरेसेतुबन्धनम् ।।622.76।।
output: The monkeys were jumping about here and there roaring (in joy). All creatures witnessed the bridge that was inconceivable, marvellous, thrilling, and impossible to build constructed in the sea.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आप्लवन्तःप्लवन्तश्चगर्जन्तश्चप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.22.75।। तदच्नित्यमसह्यंचह्यद्भुतंरोमहर्षणम् । ददृशुस्सर्वभूतानिसागरेसेतुबन्धनम् ।।622.76।।
output: प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, आप्लवन्तः here and there jumping, प्लवन्तश्च jumping about, गर्जन्तश्च roaring, सर्वभूतानि all creatures, आच्नित्यम् that which cannot be conceived in mind, असह्यंच impossible, अद्भुतम् marvellous, रोमहर्षणम् which is thrilling, सागरे in the sea, तत् that, सेतुबन्दनम् bridge constructed, ददृशुः witnessed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तानिकोटिसहस्राणिवानराणांमहौजसाम् । बध्नन्तस्सागरेसेतुंजुग्मुःपारंमहोदधेः ।।6.22.77।।
output: The glorious Vanaras in thousands of crores reached the other side of the sea from the bridge constructed in the great sea.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
विशालस्सुकृतश्रशीमान् सुभूमिस्सुसमाहितः । अशोभतमहान् सेतुस्सीमन्तइवसागरे ।।6.22.78।।
output: That huge bridge was well built, magnificent, evenly built, and extensive and looked charming like the partition in a woman's hair.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
ततःपारेसमुद्रस्यगदापाणिर्विभीषणः । परेषामभिघातार्थमतिष्ठत्सचिवैस्सहा ।।6.22.79।।
output: There upon Vibheeshana holding the mace stood on the other side of the ocean along with his friends to slay the enemies.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीवस्तुततःप्राहरामंसत्यपराक्रमम् । हनूमन्तंत्वमारोहअङ्गदंचापिलक्ष्मणः ।।6.22.80।। अयंहिविपुलोवीरसागरोमकरालयः । वैहायपौयुवामेतौवानरौतारयिष्यतः ।।6.22.81।।
output: Sugriva addressed Rama of truthful valour and said, "You mount on heroic Hanuman, let Lakshmana climb on Angada. These Vanaras will hold you up in the sky and assist you to cross the ocean."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुग्रीवस्तुततःप्राहरामंसत्यपराक्रमम् । हनूमन्तंत्वमारोहअङ्गदंचापिलक्ष्मणः ।।6.22.80।। अयंहिविपुलोवीरसागरोमकरालयः । वैहायपौयुवामेतौवानरौतारयिष्यतः ।।6.22.81।।
output: ततः then, सुग्रीवस्तु Sugriva also, सत्यपराक्रमम् one of truthful valour, रामम् Rama, प्राह mount, वीर heroic, मकरालयः home of crocodiles, अयम् this, आरोह climbing, अथ and so, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, त्वम् you, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman's, हि will do, अङ्गदम् Angada, एतौ like that, वानरौ Vanaras, वैहायसौ to the sky, युवाम् hold up both, तारयिष्यतः will assist to cross.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्रतस्तस्यसैन्यस्यश्रीमान्रामस्सलक्ष्मणः । जगामधन्वीधर्मात्मासुग्रीवेणसमन्वितः ।।6.22.82।।
output: सलक्ष्मणः accompanied by Lakshmana, श्रीमान् glorious, धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, समन्वितः joining together, धन्वी wielder of bow, तस्यसैन्यस्य his army, अग्रतः in front, जगाम proceeded.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न्येमध्येनगच्छन्तिपार्श्वतोऽन्येप्लवङ्गमाः । सलिलंप्रपतन्तन्येमार्गमन्येनलेभिरे ।।6.22.83।। केचिद्वैहायसगतास्सुपर्णाइवपुप्लुवुः ।
output: While some monkeys walked in the middle some went in the side, some others were falling down in water (for the want of space to walk) some others went like birds in the path of the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
घोषेणमहतातस्यसिन्धोर्घोषंसमुच्छ्रितम् । भीमन्तर्दधेभीमातरन्तीहरिवाहिनी ।।6.22.84।।
output: तरन्ती by the advancement, भीमा frightening, हरिवाहिनी army troops of monkeys, महता massive, घोषेण by the loud noise, समुच्छ्रितम् risen, भीमम् terrific, तस्य its सिन्धोः of the ocean, घोषम् sound, अन्तर्धधे drowned.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानराणांहिसातीर्णावाहिनीनलसेतुना । तीरेनिविविशेराज्ञाबहुमूलफलोदके ।।6.22.85।।
output: The Vanara army having crossed the bridge of Nala by the king's order settled on the other shore that was filled with several roots and fruits.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
तदद्बुतंराघवकर्मदुष्करंसमीक्ष्यदेवास्सहसिद्धचारणैः । उपेत्यरामसहसामहार्षिभिस्समभ्यषिञ्चन् सुशुभैर्जलैःपृथक् ।।6.2 2.86।।
output: At once the gods, siddhas, charanas and sages came towards Rama looking at his wonderful and most difficult action and sprinkled auspicious water on him individually. (As a mark of worship and blessing).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 22:
जयस्वशत्रून्नरदे व:मेदिनींससागरांपालयशाश्वतीस्समाः । इतीवरामंनरदेवसत्कृ तंशुभैर्वचोभिर्विविधैरपूजयन् ।।6.22.87।।
output: "O Rama the Lord of human beings Let you win over enemies and rule the land for ever." Thus, hailing Rama who is worshipped by humans as well as gods, was worshipped with auspicious words (by the aforesaid gods, siddhas and charanas). ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्वाविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 23:
निमित्तानिनिमित्ताज्ञोदृष्टवालक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । सौमित्रिंसम्परिष्वज्यइदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.23.1।।
output: Perceiving the portents, Rama spoke these words embracing Saumithri who was aware of the portents.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 23:
निमित्तानिपरिगृह्योदकंशीतंवनानिफलवन्तिच । बलौघंसंविभज्येमंव्यूह्यतिष्ठेमलक्ष्मण ।।6.23.2।।
output: "Lakshmana Arrange a place in this forest where there is cool water and fruits for the battalions of the army, we shall remain (alert)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लोकक्षयकरंभीमंभयंपश्याम्युपस्थितम् । निबर्हणंप्रवीराणामृक्षवानररक्षसाम् ।।6.23.3।।
output: "Dreadful warriors, Bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas will be slain, and I foresee that which bodes destruction of people."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 23:
वाताश्चकलुषावान्तिकम्पतेचवसुन्धराः । पर्वताग्राणिवेपन्तेपतन्तिचमहीरुहाः ।।6.23.4।।
output: "The wind is blowing mixed with dust, even the earth is cracking, mountain tops are shaking, and huge trees are breaking and falling down."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मेघाःक्रव्यादसङ्काशाःपरुषाःपरुषस्वनाः । क्रूराःक्रूरंप्रवर्षन्तिमिश्रंशोणितबिन्दुभिः ।।6.23.5।।
output: "Clouds resembling raw flesh in colour, are making harsh frightening sounds, and rain mixed with drops of blood."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 23:
रक्तचन्दनसङ्काशासन्ध्यापरमदारुणा । ज्वलतःप्रपतत्येतदादित्यादग्निमण्डलम् ।।6.23.6।।
output: "The twilight in red sandal colour is very frightening. The Sun is blazing, raining masses of fire in variegated colours."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दीनादीनस्वराःक्रूरास्सर्वतोमृगपक्षिणः । प्रत्यादित्यंविनर्धन्तिजनयन्तोमहाद्भयम् ।।6.23.7।।
output: "The wild animals all over have a piteous look and wailing in low tone standing opposite the Sun is indicating fear."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रजन्यामप्रकाशस्तुसन्तापयतिचन्द्रमाः । कृष्णरक्तांशुपर्यन्तोलोकक्षयइवोदितः ।।6.23.8।।
output: लोकक्षये at the time of dissolution of the universe, उदितइव like the Sun, कृष्णरक्तांशपर्यन्तः with black rays around and red rays behind, चन्द्रमाः moon, रजन्याम् in the night, अप्रकाशः devoid of glow, सन्तापयति causing sorrow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 23:
ह्रस्वोरूक्षोऽप्रशस्तश्चपरिवेषस्सुलोहितः । आदित्येविमलेनीलंलक्ष्मलक्ष्मणदृश्यते ।।6.23.9।।
output: "Lakshmana the white Sun is appearing in copper colour around with black colour in the centre which had not been seen before. It is small and dreary."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रजसामहताचापिनक्षत्राणिहतानिच । युगान्तमिवलोकानांपश्यशंसन्तीवलक्ष्मण ।।6.23.10।।
output: "Lakshmana the stars devoid of brightness are indicating as though it is the time of dissolution of the universe?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
काकाश्श्येनास्तथानीचागृध्राःपरिपतन्तिच । शिवाश्चाप्यशिवान्नादान्नदन्तिसुमहाभयान् ।।6.23.11।।
output: काकाः crows, श्येनाः hawks, ततागृध्राः likewise eagles, नीचाः small, परिपतन्ति falling down, शिवाश्चापि also jackals, महाभयान् great fear, अशिवान् creating, नादान् howls, नदन्ति making.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शैलैश्शूलैश्चखढगैश्चविसृष्टैःकपिराक्षसैः । भविष्यत्यावृताभूमिर्मांसशोणितकर्दमा ।।6.23.12।।
output: "The earth will turn into a mass of flesh and blood and will be covered by the mountains and tridents hurled by Vanaras and Rakshasas."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षिप्रमद्यैवदुर्दर्षांपुरींरावणपालिताम् । अभियामजनेनैवसर्वतोहरिभिर्ववृताः ।।6.23.13।।
output: सर्वैः all, हरिभिः Vanaras, आवृताः turning direction, अद्यैव now itself, क्षिप्रम् immediately, जवेनैव swiftly, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, पुरीम् city, अभियाम will go.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्येवमुक्त्वाधर्मात्माधनवीसङ्ग्रामहर्षणः । प्रतस्थेपुरतोरामोलङ्कामभिमुखोविभुः ।।6.23.14।।
output: रामः Rama, सङ्ग्रामधर्षणः one who subdues his enemies in war, विभुः a celebrated one, रामः Rama, इत्येवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, धनवी wielding a bow, पुरतः in front, लङ्काम् to Lanka, अभिमुखः towards, प्रतस्थे proceeded.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 23:
सविभीषणसुग्रीवास्ततस्तेवानरर्षभाः । प्रतस्थिरेविनर्दन्तोनिश्चिताद्विषतांवधे ।।6.23.15।।
output: Then Vibheeshana, Sugriva and all bulls among Vanaras determined in the matter of slaying (the enemies) went roaring.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 23:
राघवस्यप्रियार्थंतुसुतरांवीर्यशालिनाम् । हरीणांकर्मचेष्टाभिस्तुतोषरघुपुङ्गवः ।।6.23.16।।
output: To make Rama happy, the excessively heroic Vanaras made monkey actions. Seeing that Rama felt happy. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रयोविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty third sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
सावीरसमितीराज्ञाविरराजव्यवस्थिता । शशिनाशुभनक्षत्रापौर्णमासीवशारदी ।।6.24.1।।
output: The army of Vanaras settled that way by Rama's command shone like the autumnal full moon with auspicious stars.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रचचालचवेगेनत्रस्ताचैववसुन्धरा । पीड्यमानाबलौघेनतेनसागरवर्चसा ।।6.24.2।।
output: सागरवर्चसा like the ocean, तेन by that, बलौघेन the army, पीड्यमाना tormented by, वसुन्धरा the earth, वेगेन swift movement, त्रस्ता frightened, प्रचचाल started shaking.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शुश्रुवुराक्रुष्टंलङ्कायांकाननौकसः । भेरीमृदङ्गसङ्घुष्टंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.24.3।।
output: ततः there upon, काननौकसः army having settled, लङ्कायां from Lanka, आक्रुष्टम् terrific, तुमुलम् tumultuous, रेमहर्षणम् that which causes horripilation, भेरीमृदङ्गसङ्घुष्टम् drums and percussion instruments, शुश्रुवुः came to hear.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
बभूवुस्तेनघोषेणसंहृष्टाहरियूथपाः । अमृष्यमाणास्तंघोषंविनेदुर्घोषवत्तरम् ।।6.24.4।।
output: The leaders of Vanara troops felt very happy at the noise from (Lanka) which they were unable to tolerate and roared louder (than that in joy).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
राक्षसास्तुप्लवङ्गानांशुश्रुवुश्चाऽपिगर्जितम् । नर्दतामिवदृप्तानांमेघानामम्बरेस्वनम् ।।6.24.5।।
output: Even the Rakshasas heard the roaring of Vanaras in their pride that was bellowing like that of clouds in the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दृष्टवादाशरथिर्लङ्कांचित्रध्वजपताकिनीम् । जगाममनसासीतंदूयमानेनचेतसा ।।6.24.6।।
output: दाशरधिः Rama the son of Dasaratha, चित्रध्वजपताकिनीम् adored with colourful flags and posts, लङ्काम् of Lanka, दृष्टवा seeing, दूयमानेन afflicted by sorrow, चेतसा thinking, सीताम् of Sita, मनसा in his mind, जगाम went about.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अत्रसामृगशाबाक्षीरावणेनोपरुध्यते । अभिभूताग्रहेणेवलोहिताङ्गेनरोहिणी ।।6.24.7।।
output: मृगशाबाक्षी doveeyed, सा she, लोहिताङ्गेन red colour bodied planet (Mars), ग्रहेणव caught by, अभिभूता conquered, रोहिणीव like Rohini, रावणेन by Ravana, अत्र there, उपरुध्यते obstructed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दीर्घमुष्णंचनिश्वस्यसमुद्वीक्ष्यचलक्ष्मणम् । उवाचवचनंवीरस्तत्कालहितमात्मनः ।।6.24.8।।
output: Heroic Rama heaving hot and long breath looking at Lakshmana spoke these words that were good for him at that time.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
आलिखन्तीमिवाकाशमुत्थितांपश्यलक्ष्मण । मनसेवकृतांलङ्कांनगाग्रेविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.24.9।।
output: "Lakshmana, you may see the city of Lanka elevated on top of the mountain as though clasping the sky, like the one created in the mind of Vishwakarma."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
विमानैर्बहुभिर्लङ्कासङ्कीर्णाभुविराजते । विष्णोःपदमिवाकाशंछादितंपाण्डुभिर्घनैः ।।6.24.10।।
output: "This Lanka appears splendid with a mass of skyscrapers like white clouds covering the path of Vishnu in the sky."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुष्पितैश्शोभितालङ्कावनैश्चत्ररथोपमैः । नानापतगसङ्घुष्टै: फलपुष्पोपगैश्शुभैः ।।6.24.11।।
output: "Lanka is filled with flocks of birds of several kinds singing sweetly, the gardens with charming flowers and fruits are delighting like auspicious gardens of Chaitrara, the garden of Kubera, the god of wealth."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पश्यमत्तविहाङ्गानिप्रलीनभ्रमराणिच । कोकिलाकुलषण्डानिदोधवीतिशिवोऽनिलः ।।6.24.12।।
output: शिवः pleasant, अनिलः breeze, मत्तविहङ्गानि inhabited by proud birds प्रलीनभ्रमराणीच drunken honeybees, कोकिलाकुलषण्डानि crowded with cuckoos and other birds, दोधवीति shaking violently, पश्य you may see (said Rama to Lakshmana).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
इतिदाशरथीरामोलक्ष्मणंसमभाषत । बलंचतद्वैविभजन् शास्त्रदृष्टेनकर्मणा ।।6.24.13।।
output: Dasaratha's son Rama thus talked to Lakshmana in that manner and asked to divide the task of the army in accordance with what is said in sastras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शशासकपिसेनायांबलमादायवीर्यवान् । अङ्गदस्सहनीलेनतिष्ठेदुरसिदुर्जयः ।।6.24.14।।
output: शशास terror for the enemies, वीर्यवान् valiant one, दुर्जयः one who is difficult to win over, अङ्गदः Angada, बलात् with his army, ताम् those, कपिसेनायाम् army of Vanaras, आदाय taking, नीलेनसह along with Nila, उरसि heart (central place), तिष्ठेत् remain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्यावानरौघसमावृतः । आश्रित्यदक्षिणंपार्श्वमृषभोवानरर्षभ:।। 6.24.15।।
output: Let Rshaba the bull among Vanaras approach the south side of the army accompanied by his troop of Vanara contingent and remain there.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गन्धहस्तीवदुर्धर्षस्तरस्वीगन्धमादनः । तिष्ठेद्वानरवाहिन्यास्सव्यंपार्श्वंसमाश्रित:।। 6.24.16।।
output: गन्धहस्तीव like a proud elephant, दुर्धर्षः difficult to conquer, तरस्वी strong one, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, वानरवाहिन्याः Vanara battalion, सव्यंपार्श्वम् right side, समाश्रितः assemble, तिष्ठेत् remain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मूर्ध्निस्थास्याम्यहंयुक्तोलक्ष्मणेनसमन्वितः । जाम्बवांश्चसुषेणश्चवेगदर्शीचवानरः ।।6.24.17।। ऋक्षमुख्यामहात्मानःकुक्षिंरक्षन्तुतेत्रयः ।
output: अहम् myself, लक्ष्मणेन along with Lakshmana, समन्वितः alert, युक्त: appropriate, मूर्ध्नि at the head, स्थास्यामि will remain, जाम्बवांश्च Jambavan and also, सुषेणश्च Sushena, वानरः Vanaras, वेगदर्शीच quick at sighting, महात्मानः great ones, ते those, त्रयः three, ऋक्षमुख्याः chiefs of Bears, कुक्षिम् the belly part, रक्षन्तु remain protecting.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जघनंकपिसेनायाःकपिराजोऽभिरक्षतु । पश्चार्धमिवलोकस्यप्रचेतास्तेजसावृतः ।।6.24.18।।
output: तेजसा brilliant, आवृतः covered, प्रचेताः Pracheta, लोकस्य world's, पश्चार्धमिव as if ruling the west, कपिराजः king of Vanaras, कपिसेनायाः Vanara army's, जघम् hips and loins, अभिरक्षु let him protect.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
सुविभक्तमहाव्यूहामहावानररक्षिता । अनीकिनीसाविबभौयथाद्यौस्साभ्रसम्प्लवा ।।6.24.19।।
output: The Vanara army force organized that way to protect the Vanaras, shone like the mass of clouds in heaven.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
प्रगृह्यगिरिशृङ्गाणिमहातश्चमहीरुहन् । लङ्कांविमर्दयिषवोरणे ।।6.24.20।।
output: Vanaras resolved to go taking peaks of mountains and huge trees to smash Lanka in war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शिखरैर्विकिरामैनांलङ्कांमुष्टभिरेववा । इतिस्मदधिरेसर्वेमनांसिहरिपुङ्गवाः ।।6.24.21।।
output: एनाम् thus, लङ्काम् that Lanka, शिखरैः with peaks, मुष्टिभिरेववा or with bare fists, विकिराम crush it to powder, इतिसर्वे thus all, हरिपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, मनांसि determined in their mind, दधिरे hold, स्म indeed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
ततोरामोमहातेजास्सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् । सुविभक्तानिसैन्यानिशुकएषविमुच्यताम् ।।6.24.22।।
output: Having heard Sugriva, there after splendid Rama spoke thus. "The army is divided (placed in position). Suka may be relieved."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामस्यतुवचश्श्रुत्वावानरेन्द्रोमहाबलः । मोचयामासतंदूतंशुकंरामस्यशासनात् ।।6.24.23।।
output: महाबल mighty, वानरेन्द्रः king of Vanaras, रामस्य Rama's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्य Rama's, शासनात् by the instruction, तंदूतम् that envoy, शुकम् happy, मोचयामास was relieved.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मोचितोरामवाक्येनवानरैश्चनिपीडितः । शुकःपरमसन्त्रस्तोरक्षोधिपमुपागमत् ।।6.24.24।।
output: वानरैः by Vanaras, निपीडितः tormented, रामवाक्येन by Rama's word, मोचितः relieved, शुकः Suka, परमसन्त्रप्त highly terrified, रक्षोधिपम् to the king of Rakshasas, उपागमत् returned.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
रावणःप्रहसन्नेवशुकंवाक्यमुवाचह ।।6.24.25।। किमिमौतेसितौपक्षौलूनपक्षश्चदृश्यसे । कच्चिन्नानेकचित्तानांतेषांत्वंवशमागतः ।।6.24.26।।
output: Laughing at Suka, Ravana spoke these words. "Why are your wings fastened? Your wings have been clipped, it appears!. I suppose you have not fallen under the clutches of the fickle minded Vanaras!"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणःप्रहसन्नेवशुकंवाक्यमुवाचह ।।6.24.25।। किमिमौतेसितौपक्षौलूनपक्षश्चदृश्यसे । कच्चिन्नानेकचित्तानांतेषांत्वंवशमागतः ।।6.24.26।।
output: Laughing at Suka, Ravana spoke these words. "Why are your wings fastened? Your wings have been clipped, it appears!. I suppose you have not fallen under the clutches of the fickle minded Vanaras!"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्सभयसंविग्नस्तदाराज्ञाभिचोदितः । वचनंप्रत्युवाचेदंराक्षसाधिपमुत्तमम् ।।6.24.27।। सागरस्योत्तरेतीरेऽब्रवंतेवचनंतथा । यथासन्धेशमक्लिष्टंसान्त्वयन् श्लक्ष्णयागिरा ।।6.24.28।।
output: ततः then, भयसंविग्नः caught by fear, सः he, तदा then, राज्ञा by king, चोदितः directed, राक्षसाधिपम् Ravana, उत्तमम् excellent, इदम these, वचनम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied, सागरस्य ocean's, उत्तरेतीरे northern bank श्लक्ष्णया gently, गिरा speech, सान्त्वयन् trembling, यथासन्देशम् as conveyed by you, अक्लिष्टम् , ते you, वचनम् words, तथा like that, अब्रवम् told.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सभयसंविग्नस्तदाराज्ञाभिचोदितः । वचनंप्रत्युवाचेदंराक्षसाधिपमुत्तमम् ।।6.24.27।। सागरस्योत्तरेतीरेऽब्रवंतेवचनंतथा । यथासन्धेशमक्लिष्टंसान्त्वयन् श्लक्ष्णयागिरा ।।6.24.28।।
output: Then Suka who was caught by fear, having been asked by the king, trembling away thus replied to the Rakshasa king. "I went to the northern shore of the ocean and delivered gently the speech just as it was conveyed by you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
क्रुद्धैस्सैरहमुत्प्लुतदृष्टमात्रःप्लवङ्गमैः । गृहीतोऽस्म्यपिचारब्दोहन्तुंलोप्तुंचमुष्टिभि ।।6.24.29।।
output: As soon as they saw me, the enraged Vanaras rising up (into the sky) took hold of me and started injuring me and slaying me.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नैवसम्भाषितुंशक्यास्सम्प्रश्नोऽत्रनलभ्यते । प्रकृत्याकोपनास्तीक्ष्णानानराराक्षसाधिप ।।6.24.30।।
output: राक्षसाधिप king of Rakshasas, ते to you, सम्भाषितुम् to negotiate, नशक्याः was not possible, अत्र there, सम्प्रश्नः to question, नलम्यते had no opportunity, वानराः Vanaras, प्रकृत्या by nature, कोपनाः are violent, तीक्ष्णाः highly furious.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
सचहन्ताविराधस्यकबन्धस्यखरस्यच । सुग्रीवसहितोरामस्सीताया: पदमागतः ।।6.24.31।।
output: "The life of Viradha, Kabhanda and Khara has been taken away by Rama. Accompanied by Sugriva they have set their foot into Lanka for Sita's sake."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
सकृत्वासागरेसेतुंतीर्त्वाचलवणोदधिम् । एषरक्षांसिनिर्दूयधन्वीतिष्ठतिराघवः ।।6.24.32।।
output: "Mighty Raghava having crossed the salt sea and reached the shore of Rakshasas, organized them (Vanaras) and stood wielding a bow."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋक्षवानरसङ्घानामनीकानिसहस्रशः । गिरिमेघनिकाशानांछादयन्तिवसुन्धराम् ।।6.24.33।।
output: गिरिमेघनिकाशानाम् resembling mountains and clouds, ऋक्षवानरसङ्घानाम् army of Bears and Vanaras, सहस्रशः in thousands, अनीकानि an army force, वसुन्धराम् on the land, छादयन्ति settled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसानांबलौघस्यवानरेन्द्रबलस्यच । नैतयोर्विद्यतेसन्धिर्देवदानवयोरिव ।।6.24.34।।
output: Alliance is not possible between Rakshasas and army of Bears and Vanaras, just as alliance is not possible between gods and demons.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पुराप्राकारमायान्तिक्षिप्रमेकतरंकुरु । सीतांवास्मैप्रयच्छाशुसुयुद्धंवापिप्रदीयताम् ।।6.24.35।।
output: "They will reach the boundary wall. At once you may do one of the two that I suggest you do. I implore you either to give away Sita or give good battle."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुकस्यवचनंश्रुत्वारावणोवाक्यमब्रवीत् । रोषसंरक्तनयनोनिर्दहन्निनचक्षुषा ।।6.24.36।।
output: Angry, redeyed Ravana, having heard Suka's words spoke as though he would burn him with his glance.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदिमांप्रतियुध्येरन् देवगन्धर्वदानवाः । नैवसीतांप्रदास्यामिसर्वलोकभयादपि ।।6.24.37।।
output: देवगन्धर्वदानवाः gods, Gandharvas and demons, माम् with me, प्रतियुध्येरन्नपि even if come to wage war, सर्वलोकभयादपि even if all worlds threaten me, सीताम् Sita, नावप्रदास्यामि I shall not give away.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
कदासमभिधावन्तिराघवंमामकाश्शराः । वसन्तेपुष्पितंमत्ताभ्रमराइवपादपम् ।।6.24.38।।
output: "Just as drunken bees reach the trees with blossoms in spring when will my arrows attack Rama?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कदातूणीयशैर्दीप्तैर्गणश: कार्मुकच्युतैः । शरैरादीपयाम्येनमुल्काभिरिवकुञ्जरम् ।।6.24.39।।
output: दीप्तै: glowing, तूणीयशै: from the famed quiver, कार्मुकच्युतैः fit to pierce, गणश: thousands of, शरैः darts, येन by which, कुञ्जरम् elephant, उल्काभिरिव like the burning sticks, कदाआदीपयामि when will I able to goad.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्चास्यबलमादास्येबलेनमहतावृतः । ज्योतिषामिवसर्वेषांप्रभामुद्यन्दिवाकरः ।।6.24.40।।
output: "Just as the rising Sun light obscures the radiance of all (other stars) when will I obscure him surrounded by his army?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सागरस्येवमेवेगोमारुतस्येवमेगति: । नहिदाशरथिर्वेदतेनमांयोद्धुमिच्छति ।।6.24.41।।
output: मे I, वेगः speed, सागरस्येव like the ocean, मे I, गति: swiftness, मारुतस्येव like the WindGod, दाशरथिः Dasaratha's son, नहिवेद not know, तेव that is why, माम् with me, योध्दुम् to wage war, इच्छति desiring.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 24:
नमेतूणीशयान्बाणान् सविषानिवपन्नगान् । रामःपश्यतिसङ्ग्रामेतेनमांयोध्दुमिच्छति ।।6.24.42।।
output: "Rama has not seen the poisonous arrows in my quiver in battle. Therefore, he is desiring comb at with me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नजानातिपुरावीर्यममयुद्धेसराघवः । ममचापमयींवीणांशरकोणैःप्रवादिताम् ।।6.24.43।। ज्याशब्दतुमुलांघोरामार्तभीतमहास्वनाम् । नाराचतलसन्नादांतांममाहितवाहिनीम् ।।6.24.44।। अवगाह्यमहारङ्गंवादयिष्याम्यहंरणे ।
output: सःराघवः that Rama, पुरा in the past, युद्धे in war, मम my, वीर्यम् valour, नजानाति not known, अहम् I, रणे in war, ताम् them, मम my, आहितवाहिनीम् entering the enemy's army, महारङ्गम् formidable Veena, अवगाह्य holding, शरकोणैः by the sharp heads of arrows, प्रवादिताम् makes sounds of challenge, ज्याशब्दतुमुलाम् that tumultuous noise, घोराम् terrific, आर्तभीतमहास्वनाम् high sound caused by the destitute and frightened ones, नाराचतलंसन्नादाम् its sound like that of iron arrows, चापमयीम् with that bow in hand, मम of mine, वीणाम् Veena, वादयिष्यामि will play.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नजानातिपुरावीर्यममयुद्धेसराघवः । ममचापमयींवीणांशरकोणैःप्रवादिताम् ।।6.24.43।। ज्याशब्दतुमुलांघोरामार्तभीतमहास्वनाम् । नाराचतलसन्नादांतांममाहितवाहिनीम् ।।6.24.44।। अवगाह्यमहारङ्गंवादयिष्याम्यहंरणे ।
output: सःराघवः that Rama, पुरा in the past, युद्धे in war, मम my, वीर्यम् valour, नजानाति not known, अहम् I, रणे in war, ताम् them, मम my, आहितवाहिनीम् entering the enemy's army, महारङ्गम् formidable Veena, अवगाह्य holding, शरकोणैः by the sharp heads of arrows, प्रवादिताम् makes sounds of challenge, ज्याशब्दतुमुलाम् that tumultuous noise, घोराम् terrific, आर्तभीतमहास्वनाम् high sound caused by the destitute and frightened ones, नाराचतलंसन्नादाम् its sound like that of iron arrows, चापमयीम् with that bow in hand, मम of mine, वीणाम् Veena, वादयिष्यामि will play.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नवासवेनापिसहस्रचक्षुषायथास्मिशक्योवरुणेनवास्वयम् । यमेनवाधर्षयितुंशराग्निनामहाहवेवैश्रवणेनवापुन: ।। 6.24.45।।
output: "It is not possible (to win over) for the thousand eyed Indra, or even Varuna, the god presiding over water, or even for Yama, the god of death and again even for Kubera the god of wealth to face the fire of my arrows (said Ravana to Suka)." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकावेयुध्दकाण्डेचतुर्विंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic, the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सबलेसागरंतीर्णेरामेदशरथात्मजे । अमात्यौरावणश्रीमानब्रवीच्छुकसारणौ ।।6.25.1।।
output: सबले along with army, दशरथात्मजे Dasaratha's son, रामे Rama, सागरम् ocean, तीर्णे crossing the shore, श्रीमान् exuberant, रावणः Ravana, अमात्यौ with ministers, शुकसारणौ to Suka and Saarana, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समग्रंसागरंतीर्णंदुस्तरंवानरंबलम् । अभूतपूर्वंरामेणसागरेसेतुबन्धनम् ।।6.25.2।।
output: समग्रं all of them together, वानरम् Vanaras, बलम् army, दुस्तरम् arduous, सागरम् ocean, तीर्णम् crossed, रामेण by Rama, सागरे in the ocean अभूतपूर्वम् that which is not known before, सेतुबन्धनम् construction.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
सागरेसेतुबन्दंतुनश्रद्दध्यांकथञ्चन । अवश्यंचापिसङ् ख्येयंतन्मयावानरंबलम् ।।6.25.3।।
output: "It is not believable even to me that they constructed a bridge in the sea. Surely I wish to know the size of their army."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भवन्तौवानरंसैन्यंप्रविश्यानुपलक्षितौ । परिमाणंचवीर्यंचयेचमुख्याःप्लवङ्घमाः ।।6.25.4।। मन्त्रिणोयेचरामस्यसुग्रीवस्यचसम्मता: । येपूर्वमभिवर्तन्तेयेचशूराःप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.25.5।। सचसेतुर्यथाबद्धस्सागरेसलिलार्णवे । निवेशंचयधातेषांवानराणांमहात्मनाम् ।।6.25.6।। रामस्यव्यवसायंचवीर्यंप्रहरणानिच । लक्ष्मणस्यचवीर्यंतत्त्वतोज्ञातुमर्हथः ।।6.25.7।।
output: भवन्तौ you both, अनुपलक्षितौ without their notice, वानरम् Vanara's, सैन्यम् army, प्रविश्य entering, परिमाणंच size of it, वीर्यंच heroes, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः of the monkeys, मुख्याः chief, रामस्य Rama's, सुग्रीवस्यच and Sugriva's, ये of those, मन्त्रिणः ministers, सङ्गताः groups, ये of those, पूर्वम् earlier, अभिवर्तन्ते those who are in forefront, ये of those, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, शूराः warriors, सलिलार्णने in the abode of waters, सागरे in the sea, सः that, सेतुः bridge, यधा centre, बद्धः built, महात्मनाम् great, तेषां of those वानराणाम् of the Vanaras, निवेशम् location, यथा in the same way, रामस्यव्यवसायंच Rama's efforts, वीर्यम् valour, प्रहरणानिच weapons also, वीरस्य of the heroes, लक्षयणस्यच and of Lakshmana's, तत्त्वतः truly, ज्ञातुम् wish to know, अर्हथः I ought.

Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
भवन्तौवानरंसैन्यंप्रविश्यानुपलक्षितौ । परिमाणंचवीर्यंचयेचमुख्याःप्लवङ्घमाः ।।6.25.4।। मन्त्रिणोयेचरामस्यसुग्रीवस्यचसम्मता: । येपूर्वमभिवर्तन्तेयेचशूराःप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.25.5।। सचसेतुर्यथाबद्धस्सागरेसलिलार्णवे । निवेशंचयधातेषांवानराणांमहात्मनाम् ।।6.25.6।। रामस्यव्यवसायंचवीर्यंप्रहरणानिच । लक्ष्मणस्यचवीर्यंतत्त्वतोज्ञातुमर्हथः ।।6.25.7।।
output: "Both of you enter Vanara's army without their knowledge and know about the size of the army, of Rama and Sugriva's ministers, of army chiefs who are in the forefront, of the warriors, how they have built bridge in the middle of the sea, about the location of Vanaras and in the same way the efforts and valour of heroes Rama and Lakshmana, I ought to know truly."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कश्चसेनापतिस्तेषांवानराणांमहौजसाम् । तच्चज्ञात्वायथातत्त्वंशीघ्रमगन्तुमर्हथः ।।6.25.8।।
output: Among those energetic Vanaras, who is the chief of the army? Knowing all these matters, it is fit for you to return quickly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
इतिप्रतिसमादिष्टौराक्षसौशुकसारणौ । हरिरूपधरौवीरौप्रविष्टौवानरंबलम् ।।6.25.9।।
output: Having accepted the order, both the Rakshasa heroes, Suka and Saarana took the form of Vanaras and entered the Vanara army.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
ततस्तद्वानरंसैन्यमचिन्त्यंरोमहर्षणम् । सङ् ख्यातुंनाध्यगच्छेतांतदातौशुकसारणौ ।।6.25.10।।
output: There upon both Suka and Saarana did not know the numbers (of the army) at that time as they could not count the numbers from there as it could not be conceived. It caused the raising of their hair.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
संस्थितंपर्वताग्रेषुनिर्दरेषुगुहासुच । समुद्रस्यचतीरेषुवनेषूपवनेषुच ।।6.25.11।। तरमाणंचतीर्णंचतर्तुकामंचसर्वशः । निविष्टंनिविश्चैवभीमनादंमहाबलम् ।।6.25.12।। तद्बलार्णवमक्षोभ्यंददृशातेनिशाचरौ ।
output: पर्वताग्रेषु on mountain summits, निर्दरेषु in caverns, गुहासुच in caves, समुद्रस्य ocean's, तीरेषु shores, वनेषु in forests, उपवनेषुच and adjoining gardens, स्थितम् settled, तरमाणम् crossing, तीर्णंच shores, तर्तुकामंच some in the process of crossing, सर्वशः all over, निविष्टम् settled, निविश्चे staying, भीमनादम् terrific noise, महाबलम् great force, अक्षोभ्यम् that which is never ending, तद्बलार्णवम् that ocean of army, निशाचरौ the Rakshasas, ददृशाते witnessed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
संस्थितंपर्वताग्रेषुनिर्दरेषुगुहासुच । समुद्रस्यचतीरेषुवनेषूपवनेषुच ।।6.25.11।। तरमाणंचतीर्णंचतर्तुकामंचसर्वशः । निविष्टंनिविश्चैवभीमनादंमहाबलम् ।।6.25.12।। तद्बलार्णवमक्षोभ्यंददृशातेनिशाचरौ ।
output: The ocean of army settled on the mountain summits, in caverns and caves, on the shores of the ocean, in the forests and adjoining gardens some who crossed the sea some in the process of crossing settled all over was witnessed by the Rakshasas. It was never ending and making terrific noise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
तौददर्शमहातेजाःप्रतिच्छन्नौचविभीषणः । आचचक्षेऽथरामायगृहीत्वाशुकसारणौ ।।6.25.13।।
output: Brilliant Vibheeshana saw both Suka and Saarana hidden in the army. He took hold of them and brought to the notice of Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यैमौराक्षसेन्द्रस्यमन्त्रिणौशुकसारणौ । लङ्कायस्समनुप्राप्तौचारौपरपुरञ्जय:।। 6.25.14।।
output: "O conqueror of enemy's citadels! these are spies from Lanka, Suka and Saarana who have come to find us out."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तौदृष्टवाव्यथितौरामंनिराशौजीवितेतथा । कृताञ्जलिपुटौभीतौवचनंचेदमूचतुः ।।6.25.15।।
output: तौ those two, रामम् at Rama, दृष्टवा to look, व्यथितौ worried, तथा so also, जीविते of life, निराशौ lost hope, भीतौ caught up with fear, कृताञ्जलिपुटौ lifted up their palms greeting, इदम् these, वचनम् words, ऊचतुः expressed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
आवामिहागतौसौम्य रावणप्रहितावुभौ । परिज्ञातुंबलंसर्वंतवेदंरघुनन्दन:।। 6.25.16।।
output: "O noble one! We have come to you assigned by Ravana. O delight of Raghu race, thus we arrived here to know about the entire strength of your army."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
तयोस्तद्वचनंश्रुत्वारामोदशरथात्मजः । अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्वाक्यंसर्वभूतहितेरतः ।।6.25.17।।
output: "On hearing (the spies) Dasaratha's son Rama who remains devoted to the wellbeing of all beings spoke these words smiling at both of them."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
यदिदृष्टंबलंसर्वंवयंवासुपरिक्षिताः । यथोक्तंवाकृतंकार्यछन्दतःप्रतिगम्यताम् ।।6.25.18।।
output: After observing our entire army carefully, acting appropriately (according to Ravana's words) and accomplishing your task you may freely return (said Rama to the spies).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथकिञ्चिददृष्टंवाभूयस्तद्द्रष्टुमर्हथः । विभीषणोवाकात्स्नर्येनभूयस्सन्दर्शयिष्यति ।।6.25.19।।
output: अथा and now, किञ्चित् even a bit, अदृष्टंवा not seen, तत् that, भूयः you may do, द्रष्टुम् see, अर्हथः ought to see, ना or else, विभीषणः Vibheeshana कात्स्नर्येन in totality, भूयः you may, सन्दर्शयिष्यति will show you.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नचेदंग्रहणंप्राप्यभेत्तव्यंजीवितंप्रति । न्यस्तशस्त्रौगृहतौवानदूतौवधमर्हतः ।।6.25.20।।
output: As you have been caught by us like this you need not have apprehension of your life. Those who do not possess wield or those who are envoys ought not to be slayed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
प्रच्छमानौविमुञ्चैतौचारौरात्रिंचरावुभौ । शत्रुपक्षस्यसततंविभीषण: विकर्षिणौ ।।6.25.21।।
output: "Vibheeshana! Even though they are spies seeking to divide the enemy army as both the night rangers have been requesting, you may set them free."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रविश्यनगरींलङ्कांभवद् भ्यांधनदानुजः । वक्तव्योरक्षसांराजायथोक्तंवचनंमम ।।6.25.22।।
output: "Upon entering the city of Lanka, you may tell my words to the king of Rakshasas, the younger brother of Kubera just as it was told by me."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
यद्बलंचसमाश्रित्यसीतांमेहृतवानपि । तद्दर्शययथाकामंससैन्यस्सहबान्धवः ।।6.25.23।।
output: "Let him display the strength on which he has abducted my Sita along with his army and relations at his will."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्वःकाल्येनगरींलङ्कांसप्राकारांसतोरणाम् । रक्षसंचबलंपश्यशरैर्विध्वंसितंमया ।।6.25.24।।
output: श्वः tomorrow, काल्ये at day dawn, मया of me, शरैः arrows, विध्वंसितम् will crush, रक्षसम् Rakshasas, बलम् strength, सप्राकाराम् in the same manner, सतोरणाम् the arches of the entrance, लङ्कांनगरीम् of Lanka city, पश्य you may see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
क्रोधंभीममहंमोक्ष्येससैन्येत्वयिरावण: । श्वःकाल्येवज्रवान्वज्रंदानवेष्विववासवः ।।6.25.25।।
output: "Tomorrow at the dawn of the day I will release my dreadful anger on Ravana and even on Rakshasas just as the thunderbolt of Indra was released on Rakshasas."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इतिप्रतिसमादिष्टौराक्षसौशुकसारणौ ।।6.25.26।। जयेतिप्रतिनन्द्यैतौराघवंधर्मवत्सलम् । आगम्यनगरींलङ्कामब्रूतांराक्षसाधिपम् ।।6.25.27।।
output: Having heard the reply of Rama, both the Rakshasas Suka and Saarana praising Rama saying, "Victory to you!" reached Lanka and said to the king of Rakshasas as follows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इतिप्रतिसमादिष्टौराक्षसौशुकसारणौ ।।6.25.26।। जयेतिप्रतिनन्द्यैतौराघवंधर्मवत्सलम् । आगम्यनगरींलङ्कामब्रूतांराक्षसाधिपम् ।।6.25.27।।
output: इति thus, प्रतिसमाधिष्टौ heard the words of reply, राक्षसौ both the Rakshasas, शुकसारणौ Suka and Saarana, धर्मवत्सलम् lover of dharma, एनम् in that manner, राघवम् Raghava, जयइतिप्रतिनन्द्य praising saying ' victory to you', लङ्कांनगरीम् to Lanka, आगम्य having reached, राक्षसाधिपम् king of Rakshasas, अब्रूताम् said like this.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विभीषणगृहीतौतुवधार्तौराक्षसेश्वर: । दृष्टवाधर्मात्मनामुक्तौरामेणामिततेजसा ।।6.25.28।।
output: "O king of Rakshasas! Vibheeshana held us captive for slaying us. But righteous self, Rama, the highly effulgent one released us on seeing."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एकस्थानगतायत्रचत्वारःपुरुषर्षभाः । लोकपालसमाश्शूराःकृतास्त्रादृढविक्रमा ।।6.25.29।। रामोदाशरथि्शीमान् लक्ष्मणश्चविभीषणः । सुग्रीवश्चमहातेजामहेन्द्रसमविक्रमः ।।6.25.30।। एतेशक्ताःपुरीलङ्कांसप्राकारांसतोरणाम् । उत्पाट्यसङ्क्रमयितुंसर्वेतिष्ठन्तुवानराः ।।6.25.31।।
output: "Exuberant Rama and Lakshmana, highly brilliant Vibheeshana, and Sugriva who resembles Indra in his valour, are like rulers of the world and are heroic, wielders of weapons and bulls among men. If all four of them come together there in that manner, they will unearth the arch ways and even the city of Lanka. They are capable even if the Vanaras are kept away."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यादृश्यंतस्यरामस्यरूपंप्रहरणानिच । वधिष्यतिपुरींलङ्कामेकस्तिष्ठन्तुतेत्रयः ।।6.25.32।।
output: रामस्य Rama's, तत् that, रूपम् form, यादृशम् to see, प्रहरणानिचएकः weapons, he alone, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka city, वधिष्यति will slay, तेत्रयः those three, तिष्ठन्तु even keep away.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 25:
रामलक्ष्मणगुप्तासासुग्रीवेणचवाहिनी । बभूवदुर्दर्षतरासर्वैरपिसुरासुरैः ।।6.25.33।।
output: "Even if Rama and Lakshmana are protected, and even Sugriva also, the entire army seems formidable like suras and asuras."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
तद्वचःपथ्यमक्लीबंसारणेनाभिभाषितम् । निशम्यरावणोराजाप्रत्यभाषतसारणम् ।।6.26.1।।
output: Perceiving the truthful and beneficial words spoken by Saarana, without hesitation, King Ravana replied.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदिमामभियुञ्जीरन्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः । नैवसीतांप्रदास्यामिसर्वलोकभयादपि ।।6.26.2।।
output: देवगन्धर्वदानवाः Devas, Gandharvas, Danavas, माम् me, अभियुञ्जीरन्: all put together attack me in war, सर्वलोकभयादपि: not even for the fear of the whole world, नैवप्रदास्यामि: will not surrender, सीताम् Sita.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वंतुसौम्यपरित्रस्तोहरिभिर्निर्जितोभृशम् । प्रतिप्रदानमद्यैवसीतायास्साधुमन्यसे ।।6.26.3।।
output: सौम्य: noble, हरिभिः by Vanaras, भृशम् very much, र्निर्जितः vanquished, परित्रस्तः are frightened, त्वंतु: you are, अद्यैव: in this way, सीतायाः Sita, प्रतिप्रदानम् to surrender back, साधु: is good, मन्यसे: thinking.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
कोहिनामसपत्नोमांसमरेजेतुमर्हति । इत्युक्त्वापरुषंवाक्यंरावणोराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.26.4।। आरुरोहततश्रशीमान् प्रासादंहिमपाण्डुरम् । बहुतालसमुत्सेधंरावणोऽथदिदृक्ष्या ।।6.26.5।।
output: "What adversary can win me in war? You ought to know this", said Ravana. Then Ravana, the king of Rakshasas having spoken that way went up to the snow white palace which was of the height of many Palmira trees wishing to see (the Vanaras).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कोहिनामसपत्नोमांसमरेजेतुमर्हति । इत्युक्त्वापरुषंवाक्यंरावणोराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.26.4।। आरुरोहततश्रशीमान् प्रासादंहिमपाण्डुरम् । बहुतालसमुत्सेधंरावणोऽथदिदृक्ष्या ।।6.26.5।।

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ताभ्यांचराभ्यांसहितोरावणःक्रोधमूर्छितः । पश्यमानस्समुद्रंचपर्वतांश्चवनानिच ।।6.26.6।। ददर्शपृथिवीदेशंसुसम्पूर्णंप्लवङ्गमैः ।
output: Deluded with anger Ravana along with both the spies observed the sea, the mountains and the woods crowded with monkeys in that region of the earth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदपारमसंख्ख्येयंवानराणांमहद्बलं । अलोक्यरावणोराजापरिपप्रच्छसारणम् ।।6.26.7।।
output: राजा: king, रावणः Ravana, वानराणाम् Vanaras, आपारम् innumerable, असंख्ख्येयं: impossible to count, तत् that, महद्बलम् great army force, अलोक्यसारणम् looking at Saarana, परिपप्रच्छ: enquired further.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषांवानरमुख्यानांकेशूराःकेमहाबलाः । केपूर्वमभिवर्तन्तेमहोत्साहास्समन्ततः ।।6.26.8।।
output: एषाम् among them, वानराः Vanaras, मुख्या: foremost, के: who is, शूराः valiant, के: who, महाबलाः strong in prowess, महोत्साहाः most energetic, के: who, समन्ततः equals, पूर्वम् earlier, अभिवर्तन्ते: you may tell in order.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
केषांशृणोतिसुग्रीवःकेवायूथपयूथपाः । सारणाचक्ष्वतत्त्वेनकेप्रधानाःप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.26.9।।
output: "Whose advice does Sugriva listen to? Who is the chief of the army of Vanaras? Saarana, I wish to know truly."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सारणोराक्षसेन्द्रस्यवचनंपरिपृच्छतः । आचचक्षेऽथमुख्यज्ञोमुख्यांस्तांस्तुवनौकसः ।।6.26.10।।
output: अथ: thus, मुख्यज्ञः who know the important ones, सारणः Saarana, परिपृच्छतः being asked, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य: by the king of Rakshasas, मुख्यांस्तांस्तु: important there, वनौकसः of the wanderers in woods, वचनम् these words, आचचक्षे: speak out.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषयोऽभिमुखोलङ्कांनर्दंस्तिष्ठतिवानरः । यूथपानांसहस्राणांशतेनपरिवारितः ।।6.26.11।। यस्यघोषेणमहतासप्राकारासतोरणा । लङ्काप्रवेपतेसर्वासशैलवनकानना ।।6.26.12।। सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्रस्यसुग्रीवस्यमहात्मनः । बलाग्रेतिष्ठतेवीरोनीलोनामैषयूथपः ।।6.26.13।।
output: यस्य: whose, महता: great, घोषेण: by his roar, सप्राकारा: the boundary, सतोरणा: that main arch way, सशैलवनकानना: with its mountains and woods, सर्वा: entire, लङ्कां: Lanka, प्रवेपते: trembling, यूथपानाम् commanders of troops, सहस्राणां: thousands of them, शतेन: hundred, परिवारितः surrounded, यः he who, एषः this, वानरः Vanaras, लङ्काम् अभिमुखः facing Lanka, नर्दन् voice, तिष्ठति: stands there, एषः this, नीलोनाम: called Nila, वीरः warrior, यूथपः troop, सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्रस्य: Lord of all troops of Vanaras, महात्मनः great one, सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, बलाग्रे: in forefront, तिष्ठते: stands.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एषयोऽभिमुखोलङ्कांनर्दंस्तिष्ठतिवानरः । यूथपानांसहस्राणांशतेनपरिवारितः ।।6.26.11।। यस्यघोषेणमहतासप्राकारासतोरणा । लङ्काप्रवेपतेसर्वासशैलवनकानना ।।6.26.12।। सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्रस्यसुग्रीवस्यमहात्मनः । बलाग्रेतिष्ठतेवीरोनीलोनामैषयूथपः ।।6.26.13।।
output: "Who, surrounded by thousands of troops is roaring aloud facing Lanka, with whose roar entire Lanka with its boundary walls, archways, mountains and woods are trembling, that one who stands in the forefront of Sugriva the Lord of all Vanara troops is known as the great Nila."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
एषयोऽभिमुखोलङ्कांनर्दंस्तिष्ठतिवानरः । यूथपानांसहस्राणांशतेनपरिवारितः ।।6.26.11।। यस्यघोषेणमहतासप्राकारासतोरणा । लङ्काप्रवेपतेसर्वासशैलवनकानना ।।6.26.12।। सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्रस्यसुग्रीवस्यमहात्मनः । बलाग्रेतिष्ठतेवीरोनीलोनामैषयूथपः ।।6.26.13।।
output: "Who, surrounded by thousands of troops is roaring aloud facing Lanka, with whose roar entire Lanka with its boundary walls, archways, mountains and woods are trembling, that one who stands in the forefront of Sugriva the Lord of all Vanara troops is known as the great Nila."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
बाहूप्रगृह्ययःपद् भ्यांमहींगच्छतिवीर्यवान् । लङ्कामभिमुखःक्रोधादभीक्ष्णंचविजृम्भते ।।6.26.14।। गिरिशृङ्गप्रतीकाशःपद्मकिञ्जल्कसन्निभः । स्पोटयत्यभिसंरब्धोलाङ्गूलंचपुनःपुनः ।।6.26.15।। यस्यलाङ्गूलशब्देनस्वनन्तिप्रदिशोदश । एषवानरराजेनसुग्रीवेणाभिषेचितः ।।6.26.16।। यौवराज्येऽङ्गदोनामत्वामाह्वयतिसंयुगे ।।6.26.17।।
output: "The valiant one who has lifted his arms up and stands on the earth enraged facing Lanka, a highly excited one who is tall and expanded like a mountain peak in form and colour of lotus filament who is hitting his tail again and again on the earth and making noise with his tail, which is resounding in ten directions is Vanara leader by name Angada who has been crowned by Sugriva. This crowned prince is challenging to have war with you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
वालिनस्सदृशःपुत्रस्सुग्रीवस्यसदाप्रियः । राघवार्थेपराक्रान्तश्शक्रार्थेवरुणोयथा ।।6.26.18।।
output: "He is the son of Vali and is similar to him and is ever beloved of Sugriva. Jus t like Varuna fights for the cause of Indra, he is ready to show his valour for the cause of Rama."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
एतस्यसामतिस्सर्वायद्दृष्टाजनकात्मजा । हनूमतावेगवताराघवस्यहितैषिणा ।।6.26.19।।
output: "He is a well wisher of Raghava, called Hanuman. He had come to see Janaka's daughter, and his intellect is the cause for all that."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बहूनिवानरेन्द्राणामेषयूथानिवीर्यवान् । परिगृह्याभियातित्वांस्वेनानीकेनमर्दितुम् ।।6.26.20।।
output: वीर्यवान् a valiant one, एषः this, वानरेन्द्राणाम् Vanara king's, बहूनि: many, यूथानि: troops, परिगृह्य: taking, त्वाम् you, स्वेन: himself, अनीकेन: several (battalions) मर्दितुम्: in order to crush, अभियाति: marching.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
अनुवालिसुतस्यापिबलेनमहताऽवृतः । वीरस्तिष्ठतिसङ्ग्रामेसेतुहेतुरयंनलः ।।6.26.21।।
output: "Behind this Vali's son is Nala surrounded by a huge army force. He is heroic in war. He is the cause of construction of the bridge."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
येतुविष्टभ्यगात्राणिक्ष्वेलयन्तिनदन्तिच । उत्थायचविजृम्भन्तेक्रोधेनहरिपुङ्गवाः ।।6.26.22।। एतेदुष्प्रसहाघोराश्चण्डाश्चण्डपराक्रमाः । अष्टौशतसहस्राणिदशकोटिशतानिच ।।6.26.23।। यएनमनुगच्छन्तिवीराश्चन्दनवासिनः । एषैवाशंसतेलङ्कांस्वेनानीकेनमर्दितुम् ।।6.26.24।।
output: ये: those who are (following him), हरिपुङ्ग: Vanara leader, गात्राणि: their limbs, विष्टभ्य: staying firmly, क्ष्वेलयन्ति: tossing their limbs, नदन्तिच: and roaring, क्रोधेन: in anger, उत्थाय: getting up, विजृम्भन्ते: stretching, चन्दनवासिनः in the sandalwood forest, अष्टोशतसहास्राणि: one thousand and eight, दशकोटिशतानिच: ten hundred crores, ये: of, वीराः warriors, एनम् these, अनुगच्छन्ति: are following, एते: with them, दुष्प्रसहाः unassailable, चण्डाः cruel, घोराः dreadful, चण्डपराक्रमाः of terrible prowess, एषैव: alone, स्वेन: he, अनीकेन: army, लङ्काम् Lanka, मर्दितुम् crush, आशंसते: wishing to do.

output: "Ten hundred crores one lakh and eight of these warriors who are unassailable, cruel, dreadful and terrible prowess are following the Vanara leader. Nala the leader alone is wishing to crush the army and Lanka."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्वेतोरजतसङ्काशश्चपलोभीमविक्रमः । बुद्धिमान्वानरश्शूरस्त्रिषुलोकेषुविश्रुतः ।।6.26.25।। तूर्णंसुग्रीवमागम्यपुनर्गच्छतिसत्वरः । विभजन्वानरींसेनामनीकानिप्रहर्षयन् ।।6.26.26।।
output: "One who resembles silver in colour is Swetha. He is an intelligent one with terrific prowess, and a warrior is well known in the three worlds. Swetha is quickly coming towards Sugriva, dividing the Vanara army forces and again proceeding swiftly."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्वेतोरजतसङ्काशश्चपलोभीमविक्रमः । बुद्धिमान्वानरश्शूरस्त्रिषुलोकेषुविश्रुतः ।।6.26.25।। तूर्णंसुग्रीवमागम्यपुनर्गच्छतिसत्वरः । विभजन्वानरींसेनामनीकानिप्रहर्षयन् ।।6.26.26।।
output: रजतसङ्काशं: resembles silver in colour, चपलः agile, भीमविक्रयः of terrific prowess, बुद्धिमान् intelligent one, वीरः warrior, त्रिषुलोकेषु: in the three worlds, विश्रुतः well known, श्वेतःसवानरः Vanara by name Swetha, तूर्णम् quickly, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, आगम्य: coming towards, वानरीम् to the Vanaras, सेनाम् army, विभजन् dividing, अनीकानि: the forces, प्रहर्षयन् delightfully, सत्वरः swiftly, पुनः again, गच्छति: proceeding.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
यःपुरागोमतीतीरेरम्यंपर्येतिपर्वतम् । नाम्नासङ्कोचनोनामनानानगयुतोगिरिः ।।6.26.27।। तत्रराज्यंप्रशास्त्येषकुमुदोनामयूथपः । योऽसौशतसहस्राणिसहस्रंपरिकर्षति ।।6.26.28।। यस्यवालाबहुव्यामादीर्घलाङ्गूलमाश्रिता । ताम्रापीतास्सीताश्श्वेताःप्रकीर्णाघोरदर्शना ।।6.26.29।। अदीनोरोषणश्चण्डस्सङ्ग्राममभिकाङ् क्षति । एषोऽप्याशंसतेलङ्कांस्वेनानीकेनमर्दितुम् ।।6.26.30।।
output: "He who was residing on the banks of Gomathi earlier, which was delightful with a range of mountain peaks extending far, was ruling this kingdom from the mountain Sankochana. He is Kumuda by name. He drags his troops delightfully the ones with hairy long tails, some of coppery red colour, some yellow and some with white tails. Such a Vanara called Kumuda is dragging hundred thousand Vanaras, some fastened and some scattered. He is one who has no pity and is frightening to look at. Single handed he is aspiring to crush Lanka with its army in war."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्त्वेषसिंहसङ्काशःकपिलोदीर्घलोचनः । निभृतःप्रेक्षतेलङ्कांदिधक्षन्निवचक्षुषा ।।6.26.31।। विन्ध्यंकृष्णगिरिंसह्यंपर्वतंचसुदर्शनम् । राजन्सततमध्यास्तेरम्भोनामयूथपः ।।6.26.32।। शतंशतसहास्राणांत्रिंशच्चहरिपुङ्गवाः । यमेतेवानराश्शूराश्चण्डाश्चण्डपराक्रमाः ।।6.26.33।। परिवार्यानुगच्छन्तिलङ्कांमर्दितुमोजसा ।
output: "O king! He who is like a lion, of tawny colour with long hair, who is steady, who is looking at Lanka as though he is going to burn with his eyes, he who is followed by thirty hundred thousand Vanara warriors of dreadful form and terrific valour are marching to crush Lanka, is called Rambha the leader of the troop. He was always ruling over Vindhya, Krishnagiri and Sudarsanam mountains."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्तुकर्णौविवृणुतेजृम्बतेचपुनःपुनः । नचसंविजतेमृत्योर्नचयुद्धाद्विधावति ।।6.26.34।। प्रकम्पतेचरोषेणतिर्यक्चपुनरीक्षते । पश्यन् लाङ्गूलमपिचक्ष्वेळतेचमहाबलः ।।6.26.35।। महाजवोवीतभयोरम्यंसाल्वेयपर्वतम् । राजन्सततमध्यास्तेशरभोनामयूथपः ।।6.26.36।।
output: राजन्: O king!, कर्णौ: ears, विवृणुते: making stiff, पुनःपुनः again and again, जृम्भतेच: is yawning, मृत्योः even death, नतुसंविजते: will not be afraid of, युद्धात् from war, नचप्रधावति: not go back, रोषेण: reacts in anger, प्रकम्पतेच: violently, पुनः again, तिर्यक् obliquely, ईक्षते: seeing, लाह्गूलम् tail, पस्यन: looking at, क्ष्वेळते: leaps, महाबलः very strong, एषः this, शरभोनाम: called Sarabha, यूतपः troop leader, महाजवो: very fast, वीतभयः devoid of fear, सततम् ever, रम्यम् in delight, साल्वेयंपर्वतम् Salveya mountain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्तुकर्णौविवृणुतेजृम्बतेचपुनःपुनः । नचसंविजतेमृत्योर्नचयुद्धाद्विधावति ।।6.26.34।। प्रकम्पतेचरोषेणतिर्यक्चपुनरीक्षते । पश्यन् लाङ्गूलमपिचक्ष्वेळतेचमहाबलः ।।6.26.35।। महाजवोवीतभयोरम्यंसाल्वेयपर्वतम् । राजन्सततमध्यास्तेशरभोनामयूथपः ।।6.26.36।।
output: "Oh! king of Rakshasas! He who has made his ears stiff, yawning again and again, who is not afraid of death, who will not go back from war, who is looking obliquely and seeing his tail reacting in anger violently and roaring like a lion is a very strong leader called Sarabha. He is a very fast one, a leader of troops, ever in delight. He lives in Salveya mountain."

Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

output: राजन्: O king!, कर्णौ: ears, विवृणुते: making stiff, पुनःपुनः again and again, जृम्भतेच: is yawning, मृत्योः even death, नतुसंविजते: will not be afraid of, युद्धात् from war, नचप्रधावति: not go back, रोषेण: reacts in anger, प्रकम्पतेच: violently, पुनः again, तिर्यक् obliquely, ईक्षते: seeing, लाह्गूलम् tail, पस्यन: looking at, क्ष्वेळते: leaps, महाबलः very strong, एषः this, शरभोनाम: called Sarabha, यूतपः troop leader, महाजवो: very fast, वीतभयः devoid of fear, सततम् ever, रम्यम् in delight, साल्वेयंपर्वतम् Salveya mountain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
एतस्यबलिनस्सर्वेविहारानामयूथपाः । राजन् शतसहस्राणिचत्वारिंशस्तथैवच ।।6.26.37।।
output: "O King! Under him are forty lakhs of strong warriors known as Viharas."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
यस्तुमेघइवाकाशंमहानावृत्यतिष्ठति । मध्येवानरवीराणांसूराणामिववासवः ।।6.26.38।। भेरीणामिवसन्नादोयस्यैषश्रूयतेमहान् । घोषश्शाखामृगेन्द्राणांसङ्ग्राममभिकाङ्क्षिताम् ।।6.26.39।। एषपर्वतमध्यास्तेपारियात्रमनुत्तमम् । युद्धेदुष्प्रसहोनित्यंपनसोनामयूथपः ।।6.26.40।।
output: "He who is huge like a cloud covering the sky, roaring like a lion making noise like the beating of the drums, who is eager to wage war, who stands amid Vanaras like Indra in the midst of suras, who is ever difficult to resist in war is known as Panasa is a great warrior. He resides in the Paariyatra mountains."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एनंशतसहस्राणांशतार्धंपर्युपासते । यूथपायूथपश्रेष्ठंयेषांयूथानिभागशः ।।6.26.41।।
output: "Fifty lakhs of best warriors are under him. They are in separate units."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
यस्तुभीमांप्रवल्गन्तींचमूंतिष्ठतिशोभयन् । स्थितांतीरेसमुद्रस्यद्वितीयइवसागरः ।।6.26.42।। एषदर्दरसङ्काशोविनतोनामयूथपः । पिबंश्चरतिपर्णासांनदीनामुत्तमांनदीम् ।।6.26.43।। षष्टिश्शतसहस्राणिबलमस्यप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.26.44।।
output: "He who is stationed there on the shore like a second sea fluttering the division of army and terrifying is known as Vinata. He is a leader who goes about drinking the waters of the Parnasa, the best among the rivers. He has a sixty hundred thousand army force of Vanaras under him."

instruction:

output: यः he who, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, तीरे: shore, द्वितीयः second, सागरःइव: like the ocean, स्थिताम् stationed, भीमाम् terrifying, प्रवल्गन्तीम् fluttering, चमूम् division of army, शोभयन् charm, तिष्ठतिएषः in that way stationed, दुर्दरसङ्काशः resembling Dardura mountain, विनतोनाम: known as Vinata, यूथपः leader, यः he who, नदीनाम् among the rivers, उत्तमाम् best, पर्णासां: Parnasa, नदीम् river, पिबन् drinking, चरति: goes about, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि: hundred thousand, प्लवङ्गमाः Vanaras, अस्यबलम् his army force.

instruction:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वामाह्वयतियुद्धायक्रोधनोनामयूधपः । विक्रान्ताबलवन्तश्चयथायूथानिभागशः ।।6.26.45।।
output: "The valiant and powerful troop leaders are a part of units of the army under Vanara called Krodhana. He is challenging you for combat."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 26:
यस्तुगैरिकवर्णाभंवपुःपुष्यतिवानरः । अवमत्यसदासर्वान्वानरान्बलदर्पितान् ।।6.26.46।। गवयोनामतेजस्वीत्वांक्रोधादभिवर्तते ।
output: "He who is of an orange colour body of hand some form, who nourishes it ever and who is proud of his strength, a glorious one known as Gava ya is coming towards you angrily with disregard for Vanaras."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एनंशतसहस्राणिसप्ततिःपर्युपासते । एषैवाशंसतेलङ्कांस्वेनानीकेनमर्दितुम् ।।6.26.47।।
output: "He has seventy lakhs under his command. Single handed with army force is aspiring to crush Lanka."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतेदुष्प्रसहाघोराबलिनःकामरूपिणः । यूथपायूथपश्रेष्ठामेषांयूथानिभागशः ।।6.26.48।।
output: बलिनः strong, कामरूपिणः those who can change form at will, ते: these, घोराः fierce, यूथपाः troops, यूथपश्रेष्ठाः best of the monkeys, दुष्प्रसहाः difficult to resist, येषाम् them, यूथानि: army force, भागशः units.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
तांस्तुतेऽहंप्रवक्ष्यामिप्रेक्षमाणस्ययूथपान् । राघवार्थेपराक्रान्तायेनरक्षन्तिजीवितम् ।।6.27.1।।
output: "I will describe the Vanara force, who are not caring for their lives for the cause of Raghava. You may see."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्निग्धायस्यबहुव्यामावालालाङ्गूलमाश्रिताः । ताम्राःपीतास्सिताश्श्वेताःप्रकीर्णाघोरकर्मणः ।।6.27.2।। प्रगृहीताःप्रकाशन्तेसूर्यस्येवमरीचयः । पृथिव्यांचानुकृष्यन्तेहरोनामैषयूथपः ।।6.27.3।।
output: "One who is of terrific action, whose long tail with plenty of hair of different colours like red, white, yellow with shining ends shining like the scattered rays of the rising sun is holding and dragging on the ground is a leader known as Hara."

instruction:

output: घोरकर्मणः one of terrific action, यस्य: his, लाङ्गूलम् tall, आश्रिताः holding, बहुव्यामाः measuring many fathoms, स्निग्धा: glossy, ताम्राः red, पीताः yellow, सिताः white, श्वेताः white, प्रकीर्णाः scattered forth, वालाः hairy, सूर्यस्य: Sun 's, प्रगृहीताः holding, मरीचयःइव: like rays of light, प्रकाशन्ते: shining, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, अनुकृष्यन्तेचएषः and dragging this, हरोनामयूथपः known as leader Hara.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
यंपृष्ठतोऽनुगच्छन्तिशतशोऽथसहस्रशः । द्रुमानुद्यम्यसहसालङ्कारोहणतत्पराः ।।6.27.4।। यूथपाहरिराजस्यकिङ्करास्समुपस्थिताः ।
output: "Standing in attention near Sugriva are hundreds and thousands of warriors holding huge trees aspiring to climb Lanka and controlling the Vanaras at the back prominently and following."

instruction:

output: राजन् O king!, नीलान् dark, महामेघानिव: like a huge cloud, तिष्ठतिः standing, असिताञ्जनसङ्काशान् who are of black colour like collyrium, युद्धे: in war, सत्यपराक्रमान् of unfailing valour, असङ् ख्येयान् innumerable ones, उदधेः water, परंपारमिव: like the other bank of sea shore, अनिर्देश्यान् who cannot be defined, यान्तु: whom, पश्यसि: you may see, येकेचित् them perhaps, पर्वतेषु: from mountains, विषमेषु: difficult locations, नदीषुच: in the rivers, एते: those, सुदारुणाः highly ferocious, ऋक्षाः Bears, त्वाम् to you, अभिवर्तन्ते: are advancing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नीलानिवमहामेघांस्तिष्ठतोयांस्तुपश्यसि ।।6.27.5।। असिताञ्जनसङ्काशान् युद्धेसत्यपराक्रमान् । असङ् ख्येयाननिर्देश्यान्परंपारमिवोदधेः ।।6.27.6।। पर्वतेषुचयेकेचिद्विषमेषुनदीषुच । एतेत्वामभिवर्तन्तेराजन्नृक्षास्सुदारुणाः ।।6.27.7।।
output: "O King! Standing like dark clouds, black in colour like collyrium, who are of unfailing valour in war, innumerable in numbers, like the small particles of sand on the other bank of ocean, who cannot be counted are moving towards you. They are from mountains, riverbanks, and difficult locations. Those highly ferocious Bears are advancing towards you."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एषांमध्येस्थितोराजन्भीमाक्षोभीमदर्शनः । पर्जन्यइवजीमूतैस्समन्तात्परिवारितः ।।6.27.8।। ऋक्षवन्तंगिरिश्रेष्ठमध्यास्तेनर्मदांपिबन् । सर्वऋक्षाणामधिपतिर्धूम्रोनामैषयूथपः ।।6.27.9।।
output: "O king! In the midst of these (Vanaras) stands one with frightening eyes and fearful looks, just like Parjanya (RainGod) is surrounded by clouds, is the Lord of all these Bears called Dhumra. He dwells at the great Rkshavana mountain drinking Narmada's (river) water."

instruction:

instruction:
