यवीयानस्यतुभ्रातापश्यैनंपर्वतोपमम् । भ्रात्रासमानोरूपेणविशिष्टस्तुपराक्रमैः ।।6.27.10।। सएषजाम्बवान्नाममहायूथपयूथपः । प्रक्रान्तोगुरुवर्तीचसम्प्रहारेष्वमर्षण ।।6.27.11।।
output: पर्वतोपमम् as if like a mountain, एनम् this, पश्य: see, अस्य: his (Dh umr a's), यवीयान् younger, भ्राता: brother, रूपेण: in body form, भ्रात्रा: brother, समानः though similar, पराक्रमे: in valour, विशिष्टः great, सएषः as such, महायूथपयूथपःएत: superior among leaders, जाम्बवान्नाम: Jambavan by name, प्रक्रान्त: of valourous deed, गुरुवर्तीच: devoted in serving elders, सम्प्रहारेषु: in killing, आमर्षणः intolerant.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
यवीयानस्यतुभ्रातापश्यैनंपर्वतोपमम् । भ्रात्रासमानोरूपेणविशिष्टस्तुपराक्रमैः ।।6.27.10।। सएषजाम्बवान्नाममहायूथपयूथपः । प्रक्रान्तोगुरुवर्तीचसम्प्रहारेष्वमर्षण ।।6.27.11।।
output: "See this one like a mountain, he is the brother of Dhumra. Even though he is similar to his brother in body form and his valour is great. As such he is superior among leaders. He is called Jambavan, one of valourous deeds, devoted to elders and intolerant in killing."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
एतेनसाह्यंसुमहत्कृतंशक्रस्यधीमता । देवासुरेजाम्बवतालब्धाश्चबहवोवराः ।।6.27.12।।
output: "His assistance was given to Indra in the war between Devas and demons and in turn he obtained many boons."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
आरुह्यपर्वताग्रेभ्योमहाभ्रविपुला: शिलाः । मुञ्चन्तिविपुलाकारानमृत्योरुद्विजन्तिच ।।6.27.13।। राक्षसानांचसदृशाःपिशाचानांचरोमशाः । एतस्यसैन्याबहवोविचरन्त्यग्नितेजसः ।।6.27.14।।
output: Appearing with hairybody glowing like fire like the Rakshasas and demons, many of them in huge form are climbing mountain peaks without caring for death and go about throwing rocks.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आरुह्यपर्वताग्रेभ्योमहाभ्रविपुला: शिलाः । मुञ्चन्तिविपुलाकारानमृत्योरुद्विजन्तिच ।।6.27.13।। राक्षसानांचसदृशाःपिशाचानांचरोमशाः । एतस्यसैन्याबहवोविचरन्त्यग्नितेजसः ।।6.27.14।।
output: Appearing with hairybody glowing like fire like the Rakshasas and demons, many of them in huge form are climbing mountain peaks without caring for death and go about throwing rocks.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यंत्वेनमभिसम्रब्धंप्लवमानमिवस्थितम् । प्रेक्षन्तेवानरास्सर्वेस्थितायूथपयूथपम् ।।6.27.15।। एषराजन् सहस्राक्षंपर्युपास्तेहरीश्वरः । बलेनबलसम्पन्नोदम्भोनामैषयूथपः ।।6.27.16।।
output: राजन् O king!, सर्वे: all, वानरा: Vanaras, अभिसम्रब्धम् highly agitated, प्लवमानमिव: jumping like monkeys, स्थितम् stationed, यूथपयूथपम् leader of leaders, स्थितम् staying, त्वे: they, यम् fearsome, एनम् in that way, प्रेक्षन्ते: looking at him, बलसंयुक्तः mighty powerful, एषः this, हरीश्वरः Lord of monkeys, बलेन: by strong army, सहस्राक्षम् thousand eyed, पर्युपास्ते: sitting round, एषः this, दम्बोनामयूथपः known as leader, Dhamba.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
यंत्वेनमभिसम्रब्धंप्लवमानमिवस्थितम् । प्रेक्षन्तेवानरास्सर्वेस्थितायूथपयूथपम् ।।6.27.15।। एषराजन् सहस्राक्षंपर्युपास्तेहरीश्वरः । बलेनबलसम्पन्नोदम्भोनामैषयूथपः ।।6.27.16।।
output: "O king! This Lord of monkeys, whom whether he is jumping like monkeys or standing is the leader of the leaders, whom the monkeys are looking at standing is called Dhamba, a mighty powerful, fearsome leader and Lord of monkeys. He is surrounded by a strong army like the thousand eyed Indra."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
यःस्थितंयोजनेशैलंगच्छन्पार्श्वेनसेवते । ऊर्ध्वंतथैवकायेनगतःप्राप्नोतियोजनम् ।।6.27.17।। यस्मान्नपरमंरूपंचतुष्पादेषुविद्यते । श्रुतस्संन्नादनोनामवानराणांपितामहाः ।।6.27.18।। येनयुद्धंपुरादत्तंरणेशक्रस्यधीमता । पराजयश्चनप्राप्तस्सोऽयंयूथपयूथपः ।।6.27.19।।
output: "He who stands at one yojana touches a mountain with his flanks, so also gets up and reaches a yojana height with his body, is Sannadana. He is the grandfather of Vanaras. There is no one who has a bigger body size than him among the four legged ones. He had fought war with Indra and is well known for not losing in the battle."

instruction:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्यविक्रममाणस्यशक्रस्येवपराक्रमः । एषगन्धर्वकन्यायामुत्पन्नःकृष्णवर्त्मनः ।।6.27.20।। तदादेवासुरेयुद्धेसाह्यार्थंत्रिदिवौकसाम्
output: "His valour is equal to that of Indra. He is born to Gandharva, a maiden of the god of fire. He was created for the sake of assisting gods in the war between gods and demons."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
यस्यवैश्रवणोराजाजम्बूमुपनिषेवते ।।6.27.21।। योराजापर्वतेन्द्राणांबहुकिन्नरसेविनाम् । विहारसुखदोनित्यंभ्रातुस्तेराक्षसाधिप ।।6.27.22।। तत्रैषवसतिश्रीमान्बलवान्वानरर्षभः । युद्धेष्वकत्थनोनित्यंक्रोधनोनामयूथपः ।।6.27.23।।
output: "O King of Rakshasas! This Vanara who is exceptional among Vanaras, a commander of troops by name Krathana, who is not boastful in wars, lives on Kailas, the king of mountains which is frequented by many Kinnaras, on which your brother king Kubera son of Vysravana stays under Jambu tree and strolls for his pleasure."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वृतःकोटिसहस्रेणहरीणांसमुपस्थितः । एषैवाशंसतेलङ्कांस्वेनानीकेनमर्दितुम् ।।6.27.24।।
output: हरीणाम् with Vanaras, कोटिसहस्रेण: thousand crores, वृतः surrounded, स्थितः stays, स्वेन: his own, आनीकेन: army force, लङ्काम् Lanka, मर्दितुम् to crush, आशंसते: intends to.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
योगङ्गामनुपर्येतित्रासयन्गजयूथपान् । हस्तिनांवानराणांचपूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् ।।6.27.25।। एषयूथपतिर्नेतागच्छन् गिरिगुहाशयः । गजान्योधयतेवन्यान्गिरींश्चैवमहीरुहान् ।।6.27.26।।
output: य: He who, गङ्गाम् Ganga, अनुपर्येति: roam around, त्रासयन: frightening, गजयूथपान्: herds of elephants, हस्तिनाम् of elephants, वानराणांच: and Vanaras, पूर्ववैरम् earlier enmity, अनुस्मरन् remembering, एषः this, यूथपतिर्नेता: leader of commanders, गच्छन् going about,, गिरिगुहाशयः mountain caves, गजान् elephants, योधयते: waging war, वन्यान् wild, गिरींश्चैव: and mountains, महीरुहान् trees.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हरीणांवाहिनीमुख्योनदींहैमवतीमनु । उशीरबीजमाश्रित्यपर्वतंमन्दरोपमम् ।।6.27.27।। रमतेवानरश्रेष्ठोदिविशक्रइवस्वयम् ।
output: "The chief of the army of monkeys and the excellent one among Vanaras revels on the mountain Usirabeejam like the mountain Mandara on the bank of river Hymavathi just as Indra in heaven."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एनंशतसहस्राणांसहस्रमनुवर्तते । वीर्यविक्रमदृप्तानांनर्दतांबलशालिनाम् ।।6.27.28।।
output: वीर्यविक्रमदृप्तानाम् who are proud of their valour and prowess, नर्दताम् roaring like lions, बलशालिनाम् mighty strong ones, शतसहस्राणाम् hundred thousand, सहस्रम् thousand, एनम् like that, अनुवर्तते: follow him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
सएषनेताचैतेषांवानराणांमहात्मनाम् । सएषदुर्धरोराजन्प्रमाथीनामयूथपः ।।6.27.29।।
output: "He alone is the leader of the great Vanaras, O king. He is called Pramathi, a commander and a difficult one to resist."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वातेनेवोद्धतंमेघंयमेनमनुपश्यसि । अनीकमभिसंरब्धंवानराणांतरस्विनाम् ।।6.27.30।। उद्दूतमरुणाभासंपवनेनसमन्ततः । विवर्तमानंबहुधायत्रैतद्बहुळंरजः ।।6.27.31।।
output: वातेन: by the wind, उद्धतम् risen up, मेघमिव: like a cloud, यम् which, एनम् that way, अनुश्यसि: you see, यत्र: there, पवनेन: by the wind, समन्ततः all over, उद्धूत्तम् lifted up, अरुणाभासम् reddish brown dust, बहुशः abundantly, विवर्तमानम् whirling round, बहुळम् several, रजः dust particles, तरस्विनाम् swiftly, वानराणाम् Vanaras, अभिसंरब्धम् furious, अनीकम्: the army.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
वातेनेवोद्धतंमेघंयमेनमनुपश्यसि । अनीकमभिसंरब्धंवानराणांतरस्विनाम् ।।6.27.30।। उद्दूतमरुणाभासंपवनेनसमन्ततः । विवर्तमानंबहुधायत्रैतद्बहुळंरजः ।।6.27.31।।
output: "You see him (Pramathi) who resembles a cloud risen up by the wind you may also see the reddish brown dust particles lifted up by excessive whirling of the wind all over and also the furious Vanara army moving swiftly."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
एतेऽसितमुखाघोरागोलाङ्गूलामहाबलाः । शतंशतहस्राणिदृष्ट्वावैसेतुबन्धनम् ।।6.27.32।। गोलाङ्गूलंमहावेगंगवाक्षंनामयूधपम् । परिवार्याभिवर्तन्तेलङ्कांमर्दितुमोजसा ।।6.27.33।।
output: "These hundred and hundred thousand black monkeys with a tail like that of a cow called Golangulas, endowed with black coloured face, fearsome and with extraordinary strength, watching the bridge constructed, surround Gavaksha the leader, who himself is a Golangula and of great speed. They intend to demolish Lanka with their vigour."

instruction:

output: "These hundred and hundred thousand black monkeys with a tail like that of a cow called Golangulas, endowed with black coloured face, fearsome and with extraordinary strength, watching the bridge constructed, surround Gavaksha the leader, who himself is a Golangula and of great speed. They intend to demolish Lanka with their vigour."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
भ्रमराचरितायत्रसर्वकालफलद्रुमाः ।।6.27.34।। यंसूर्यस्तुल्यपर्णाभमनुपर्येतिपर्वतम् । यस्यभासासदाभान्तितद्वर्णामृगपक्षिणः ।।6.27.35।। यस्यप्रस्थंमहात्मानोनत्यजन्तिमहर्षयः । सर्वकालफलावृक्षास्सदाफलसमन्विताः ।।6.27.36।। मधूनिचमहार्हाणियस्मिन्पर्वतसत्तमे । तत्रैवरमतेराजन्रम्येकाञ्चनपर्वते ।।6.27.37।। मुख्योवानरमुख्यानांकेसरीनामयूथपः ।
output: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भ्रमराचरितायत्रसर्वकालफलद्रुमाः ।।6.27.34।। यंसूर्यस्तुल्यपर्णाभमनुपर्येतिपर्वतम् । यस्यभासासदाभान्तितद्वर्णामृगपक्षिणः ।।6.27.35।। यस्यप्रस्थंमहात्मानोनत्यजन्तिमहर्षयः । सर्वकालफलावृक्षास्सदाफलसमन्विताः ।।6.27.36।। मधूनिचमहार्हाणियस्मिन्पर्वतसत्तमे । तत्रैवरमतेराजन्रम्येकाञ्चनपर्वते ।।6.27.37।। मुख्योवानरमुख्यानांकेसरीनामयूथपः ।
output: "O king! Where the trees give fruit in all seasons which is inhabited by honeybees, whose leaves shine similar to that of Sunshine, where birds animals and all ever shining in golden colour of the Sun, where sages and great souls reside without leaving where trees always yield tasty fruits and have valuable honey in such a delightful golden mountain Vanara leader named Kesari, the chief of all chief Vanaras revels."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
षष्टिर्गिरिसहस्राणांरम्याःकाञ्चनपर्वता ।।6.27.38।। तेषांमध्येगिरिवरस्त्वमिवानघरक्षसाम् । तत्रैतेकपिलाश्श्वेतास्ताम्रास्यामधुपिङ्गलाः ।।6.27.39।। निवसन्त्युत्तमगिरौतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रानखायुधाः । सिंहाइवचतुर्दंष्ट्राव्याघ्राइवदुरासदाः ।।6.27.40।। सर्वेवैश्वानरसमाज्वलिताशीविषोपमाः । सुदीर्घाञ्चितलाङ्गूलामत्तमातङ्गसन्निभाः ।।6.27.41।। महापर्वतसङ्काशामहाजीमूतनिस्स्वनाः । वृत्तपिङ्गलरक्ताक्षाभीमाभीमगतिस्वराः ।।6.27.42।। मर्दयन्तीवतेसर्वेतस्थुर्लङकासमीक्ष्यते ।
output: "O sinless king! there are sixty thousand golden mountains. In the midst of them is this golden mountain just as you are in the midst of the Rakshasas. On the last mountain the Vanaras with brown coloured face, white face, coppery red face and yellow face like honey with sharp teeth like lions, who have nails as weapons, four toothed ones like lions, fearsome ones like tiger, dangerous to approach, all of them like serpents with flaming venomous tongues, with long uplifted tails, like huge elephants in rut in mountain size, roaring like lions, thundering clouds, with round brownish red eyed ones, fearful while walking and causing appalling uproar all of them dwell on the last mountain. They are watching to demolish your Lanka as they look at it."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
विक्रान्तोबलवान् शूरःपौरुषेस्वेव्यवस्थितः । रामप्रियार्थंप्राणानांदयांनकुरुतेहरिः ।।6.27.45।।
output: "He is indomitable, strong and heroic. He will not give up his virility. For the pleasure of Rama, he will not feel pity for his life (he will give up his life)."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
गजोगवाक्षोगवयोनलोनीलश्चवानरः । एकैकएवयोधानांकोटीभिर्दशभिर्वृतः ।।6.27.46।।
output: "Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Nila each of these Vanara leaders have ten crores of army under them."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 27:
तथाऽऽन्येवानरश्रेष्ठाविन्ध्यपर्वतवासिनः । नशक्यन्तेबहुत्वात्तुसङ् ख्यातुंलघुविक्रमाः ।।6.27.47।।
output: "So also, those best of Vanaras of many kinds residing in Vindhya mountain of great valour in large numbers is impossible to count."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वेमहाराजमहाप्रभावास्सर्वेमहाशैलनिकाशकायाः । सर्वेसमर्थापृथिवींक्षणेनकर्तुंप्रविध्वस्तविकीर्णशैलाम् ।।6.27.48।।
output: महाराज: O great king!, सर्वे: all, महाप्रभावाः very splendid, सर्वे: all, महाशैलनिकाशकायाः have mountain like body, सर्वे: all, क्षणेन: in a second, पृथिवीम् the whole earth, प्रविध्वस्तविकीर्णशैलाम् to crush the mountains into powder, कर्तुम् to do, समर्थाः capable.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
साराणस्यवचश्श्रुत्वारावणंराक्षसाधिपम् । बलमादिश्यतत्सर्वंशुकोवाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।।6.28.1।।
output: अथ then, शुक: Suka, सारणस्य Saarana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, तत् then, सर्वम् everything, बलम् strength, आदिश्य having described, राक्षसाधिपम् to Rakshasa king, रावणम् Ravana, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 28:
स्थितान्पश्यसियानेतान्मत्तानिवमहाद्विपान् । न्यग्रोधानिवगाङ्गेयान् सालान् हैमवतानिव ।।6.28.2।। एतेदुष्प्रसहाराजन्बलिनःकामरूपिणः । दैत्यदानवसङ्काशायुद्धेदेवपराक्रमाः ।।6.28.3।।
output: "O King! like a banyan tree on the island, like Sala trees on the Himalayan Mountain these people are stationed. You may see them marching. They are strong to encounter, can change form at their free will. They look like gods and Danavas in war and have the valour of gods."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एषांकोटिसहस्राणिनवपञ्चचसप्तच । तथाशङ्खुसहस्राणितथाबृन्दशतानिच ।।6.28.4।।
output: "These Vanaras are nine, five and seven thousand crores in number. They are in many thousands of Sankhas and Vrindas."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतेसुग्रीवसचिवाःकिष्किन्धानिलयास्सदा । हरयोदेवगन्धर्वैरुत्पन्नाःकामरूपिणः ।।6.28.5।।
output: देवगन्धर्वैः celestial gods and Gandharvas, उत्पन्नाः born to, कामरूपिणः they are free to change their form at will, सुग्रीवसचिवाः Sugriva's allies, एते these, सदा always, किष्किन्दानिलयाः reside in Kishkinda.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यौतौपश्यसितिष्ठन्तौकुमारौदेवरूपिणौ । मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौताभ्यांनास्तिसमोयुधि ।।6.28.6।।
output: तिष्ठन्तौ standing there, देवरूपिणौ in god's form, कुमारौ young ones, यौ both, पश्यसि do you see them, तौ they both, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविधश्चोभौ Dwivida, युधि in war, ताभ्याम् both of them, समः similar, नास्ति none.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ब्राह्मणासममज्ञातावमृतप्राशिनापुभौ । आशंसेतेयुथालङ्कामेतौमर्दितुमोजसा ।।6.28.7।।
output: ब्राह्मणा Brahma, समनुज्ञातौ by the permission of, अमृतप्राशिनौ have drunk the nectar of immortality, एतौ they, उभौ both, मोजसः with their prowess, लङ्गाम् Lanka, मर्धितुम् to destroy, आशंसेतेयुथा leaders aspiring.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यंतुपश्यसितिष्टन्तंप्रभिन्नमिवकुञ्जरम् । योबलात् क्षोभयेत् क्रुद्धस्समुद्रमपिवानरः ।।6.28.8।। एषोऽभिगन्तालङ्कायावैदेह्यास्तवचप्रभो: । एनंपश्यपुरादृष्टंवानरंपुनरागतम् ।।6.28.9।।
output: "O Lord! You may see the one standing there like an elephant who can churn up the sea when he is angry. He has come to Lanka earlier, seen Sita and gone back. You may see that he has come again."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यंतुपश्यसितिष्टन्तंप्रभिन्नमिवकुञ्जरम् । योबलात् क्षोभयेत् क्रुद्धस्समुद्रमपिवानरः ।।6.28.8।। एषोऽभिगन्तालङ्कायावैदेह्यास्तवचप्रभो: । एनंपश्यपुरादृष्टंवानरंपुनरागतम् ।।6.28.9।।
output: प्रभो O Lord!, प्रभिन्नम् deformed, कुञ्जरम् इव like elephants, तिष्ठन्तम standing, यम् there, पश्यसि you may see, क्रुद्धःवानरः when angry this Vanara, यः who, समुद्रमपि even the sea, क्षोभयेत् will churn up, एषः this, लङ्कायाः Lanka's, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi, तन spread, अबिगन्ता seen and gone, परा earlier, दृष्टम् seen, पुनः and again, आगतम् come, एनम् him, पश्य you may see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 28:
ज्येष्ठःकेसरिणःपुत्त्रोवातात्मजइतिश्रुतः । हनूमानितिविख्यातोलङ्घितोयेनसागरः ।।6.28.10।।
output: "He is the eldest son born of Kesari and the son of WindGod and is popularly known as Hanuman. He leapt over the sea and came."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 28:
कामरूपीहरिश्रेष्टोबलरूपसमन्वितः । अनिवार्यगतिश्चैवयथासततगःप्रभुः ।।6.28.11।।
output: "He is a jewel among Vanaras. He can change his form at his will. He is endowed with physical strength and charm. Being existent everywhere like windgod his cause cannot be prevented like that of wind god."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 28:
उद्यन्तभास्करंदृष्टवाबालःकिलपिपासितः । त्रियोजनसहस्रंतुअध्वानमवतीर्यहि ।।6.28.12।। आदित्यमाहरिष्यामिनमेक्षुत्प्रतियास्यति । इतिसञ्चिन्त्यमनसापुरैषबलदर्पितः ।।6.28.13।।
output: When he was a child, on seeing the rising Sun, he travelled three thousand yojanas and said, "I will eat up the Sun otherwise I will not be appeased', being proud of his strength."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उद्यन्तभास्करंदृष्टवाबालःकिलपिपासितः । त्रियोजनसहस्रंतुअध्वानमवतीर्यहि ।।6.28.12।। आदित्यमाहरिष्यामिनमेक्षुत्प्रतियास्यति । इतिसञ्चिन्त्यमनसापुरैषबलदर्पितः ।।6.28.13।।
output: When he was a child, on seeing the rising Sun, he travelled three thousand yojanas and said, "I will eat up the Sun otherwise I will not be appeased', being proud of his strength."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनाधृष्यतमंदेवमपिदेवर्षिदानवैः । अनासाघैवपतितोभास्करोदयनेगिरौ ।।6.28.14।।
output: देवर्षिदानवैरपि even for gods, sages and Danavas, अनाधृष्यतमम् unassailable, देवम् Sun god god, अनासाद्येव not possible, भास्करोदयने near the eastern part, गिरौ on the mountain, पतिता fell down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पतितस्यकपेरस्यहनुरेकाशिलातले । किञ्चिद्भिन्नादृढहनोर्हनूमानेषतेनवै ।।6.28.15।।
output: शिलातले over the mountain, पतितस्य fallen down, अस्य this, कपे monkey, एका one, हनुः jaw, किञ्चित् a bit, भिन्नातेन slightly broken, दृढहनुः solid jaw, एषः this, हनुमान् Hanuman.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 28:
सत्यमागमयोगेनममैषविदितोहरिः । नास्यशक्यंबलंरूपंप्रभावोवाऽपिभाषितम् ।।6.28.16।।
output: "I came to know about him through one of my contacts. His strength, his appearance and glory are indescribable."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषआशंसतेलङ्कामेकोमर्दितुमोजसा । येवजाज्वल्यतेऽपौवैधूमकेतुस्तवाद्यवै ।।6.28.17।। लङ्कायांनिहितश्चापिकथंविस्मरसेकपिम् ।
output: एषः this, एकः single handed, ओजसा prowess, लङ्काम् Lanka, मर्दितुम् demolish, आशंसतेतन is intending to do, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, येन by him, निहितः entrusted, असौ this, धूमकेतुः Dhoomakethu, अद्यवै now, जाज्वल्यते fired the tail, कपिम् monkey, कथम् how, विस्मरसे forget.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यश्चैषोऽनन्तरश्शूरश्श्यामःपद्मनिभेक्षणः । इक्ष्वाकूणामतिरथोलोकेविख्यातपौरुष ।।6.28.18।। यस्मिन्नचलतेधर्मोयोधर्मंनातिवर्तते । योब्राह्ममस्त्रंवेदांश्चवेदवेदविदांवरः ।।6.28.19।। योभिन्द्याद्गगनंबाणैःपर्वतांश्चापिदारयेत् । यस्यमृत्योरिवक्रोधश्शक्रस्येवपराक्रमः ।।6.28.20।। यस्यभार्याजनस्थानात्सीताचापिहृतात्वया । सएषरामस्त्वांयोद्धुंराजन्समभिवर्तते ।।6.28.21।।
output: राजन् O king!, श्यामः dark complexioned, पद्मनिभेक्षणः lotus like eyes, यः he, एषः this, अनन्तरः not distant from him, यस्मिन् his, धर्मः righteousness, वेदविदान् use of vedas, वरः presided over, यः he by whom, ब्राह्मण् Brahma अस्त्रम् weapon, वेदांश्च and vedas also, वेद knows, यः he whose, बाणैः arrows, गगनम् sky, भिन्द्यात् pierce through, पर्वतांश्चापि even the mountains, दारयेत् consort, यस्य his, क्रोधः anger, मृत्योरिव like death, पराक्रमः valour, शक्रस्येव like that of Indra, यस्य his, भार्या wife, सीता Sita, त्वया your, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, हृता borne away, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of Ikshvaku race, विख्यातपौरुषः, सः he, रामः Rama, योद्धुम् war, त्वाम् with you, अभिवर्तते is advancing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 28:
यश्चैषोऽनन्तरश्शूरश्श्यामःपद्मनिभेक्षणः । इक्ष्वाकूणामतिरथोलोकेविख्यातपौरुष ।।6.28.18।। यस्मिन्नचलतेधर्मोयोधर्मंनातिवर्तते । योब्राह्ममस्त्रंवेदांश्चवेदवेदविदांवरः ।।6.28.19।। योभिन्द्याद्गगनंबाणैःपर्वतांश्चापिदारयेत् । यस्यमृत्योरिवक्रोधश्शक्रस्येवपराक्रमः ।।6.28.20।। यस्यभार्याजनस्थानात्सीताचापिहृतात्वया । सएषरामस्त्वांयोद्धुंराजन्समभिवर्तते ।।6.28.21।।
output: "O king! the king who is not distant from him, a dark complexioned, one with lotus eyes who never transgresses his righteousness, who is a great charioteer of Ikshvaku race who knows use of Vedas, who is choicest, who knows the weapons presided over by Brahma whose arrows can pierce through the sky and even mountains whose anger is like anger of death, whose valour is like that of Indra whose consort has been borne away from Janasthana is Rama. He is advancing towards you to wage war with you."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्यैषदक्षिणेपार्श्वेशुद्धजाम्बूनदप्रभः । विशालवक्षास्ताम्राक्षोनीलकुञ्जितमूर्धजः ।।6.28.22।। एषोऽस्यलक्ष्मणोनामभ्राताप्राणसमःप्रियः । नयेयुद्धेचकुशलस्सर्वशस्त्रभृतंवरः ।।6.28.23।।
output: यस्य his, दक्षिणेपार्श्वे right side, एषः this, शुद्धजाम्बूनदप्रभः whose body radiates like gold, विशालवक्षाः one with broad chest, ताम्राक्षः red eyes, नीलकुञ्चितमार्धजः dark curly haired, एषः this is, लक्ष्मणोनाम known as Lakshmana, भ्राता brother, प्राणसमहाप्रियः as dear as life, नये in moral science, युद्धेच and warfare, कुशलः skilled, सर्वशस्त्रभृताम् foremost among all wielders of weapons, वरः the best.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्यैषदक्षिणेपार्श्वेशुद्धजाम्बूनदप्रभः । विशालवक्षास्ताम्राक्षोनीलकुञ्जितमूर्धजः ।।6.28.22।। एषोऽस्यलक्ष्मणोनामभ्राताप्राणसमःप्रियः । नयेयुद्धेचकुशलस्सर्वशस्त्रभृतंवरः ।।6.28.23।।
output: "To his right is his brother known as Lakshmana whose body radiates like gold, he has broad chest, red eyes, dark curly hair. He is as dear as his life to Rama. He is skilled in moral science and warfare. He is the foremost and the best among wielders of weapons."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अमर्षीदुर्जयोजेताविक्रान्तोबुद्धिमान् बली । रामस्यदक्षिणोबाहुर्नित्यंप्राणोबहिश्चरः ।।6.28.24।।
output: "He is one who does not forgive (Rama's enemies), difficult to win, indomitable, victorious, strong and wise one. He is the right hand of Rama and external breath of his life."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नह्येषराघवस्यार्थेजीवितंपरिरक्षति । एषैवाशंसतेयुद्धेनिहन्तुंसर्वराक्षसान् ।।6.28.25।।
output: "For the cause of Rama, he will spare his life. He too is intent upon destroying all Rakshasas."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्तुसव्यमसौपक्षंरामस्याश्रित्यतिष्ठति । रक्षोगणपरिक्षिप्तोराजाह्येषविभीषणः ।।6.28.26।।
output: असौ the one, यःतु who is near, रामस्य Rama's, सव्यम् left, पक्षम् side, आश्रित्य sought refuge, तिष्ठति stands, रक्षोगणपरिक्षिप्तः surrounded by Rakshasas and protected, एषः he is, राजा king, विभीषण Vibheeshana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रीमताराजराजेनलङ्कायामभिषेचितः । त्वामेवप्रतिसंरब्दोयुद्धायैषोऽभिवर्तते ।।6.28.27।।

instruction:

यंतुपस्यसितिष्ठन्तंमध्येगिरिमिवाचलम् । सर्वशाखामृगेन्द्राणांभर्तारममितौजसम् ।।6.28.28।। तेजयशसाबुद् ध्याज्ञानेनाभिजनेनच । यःकपीनतिबभ्राजहिमवानिवपर्वतान् ।।6.28.29।। किष्किन्धांयस्समध्यास्तेगुहांसगहनद्रुमाम् । दुर्गांपर्वतदुर्गस्तांप्रधानैस्सहयूथपैः ।।6.28.30।। यस्यैषाकाञ्चनीमालाशोभितेशतपुष्करा । कान्तादेवमनुष्याणांयस्यांलक्ष्मीप्रतिष्ठिता ।।6.28.31।। एतांचमालांतारांचकपिराज्यंचशाश्वतम् । सुग्रीवोवालिनंहत्वारामेणप्रतिपादितः ।।6.28.32।।
output: "The one whom you see standing in the midst is the king of all chiefs of the Vanara army, a highly glorious one, steady like a mountain. like Himalayas that outshines all mountains, he surpasses all in fame, in intellect, in wisdom and in lineage. See the golden chain on him shining away with hundred lotuses in which stands Lakshmi installed which is difficult even for gods and human beings to covet. In the same way as the golden chain, even his beloved Tara and kingdom of the monkeys was permanently bestowed upon him by Rama after slaying Vali."

output: मनीषिणः the wise men, शतसहस्राणाम् hundred thousand, शतम् hundred, कोटिम् crore, आहुः multiplied by, कोटिसहस्राणाम् thousand crores, शतम् hundred, शङ्कुः Sankhu, इति thus, अभिधीयते is said to be.

Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

output: शङ्कुसहस्राणाम् Thousand Sankhus, शतम् hundred, महाशङ्कुःइति is MahaSankhu. स्मृतः be aware, महाशङ्कुसहस्राणाम् hundred thousand MahaSankhu, शतम् hundred, बृन्दम् Vrinda, इह thus, उच्यते said to be बृन्दपसहस्राणाम् thousand Vrindas, शतम् hundred, महाबृन्दम् इति is said to be MahaVrinda, स्मृतम् you may know, पद्मम् Padmam, इह here, उच्यते is said to be पद्मसहस्राणाम् thousand Padmas, शतम् hundred, महापद्ममिति as Maha Padma, स्मृतम् you may know, महापद्मसहस्राणाम् thousand Mahapadmas, शतम् hundred, खर्वम् Kharvam, इह is, महाखर्मम् Mahakharvam, इवोच्यते is spoken as, महाखर्मसहस्राणाम् thousand MahaKharvam, समुद्रम् Samudram, अभिधीयते as well, शतम् hundred, समुद्रसाहस्रम् thousand Samudras, ओघऋइति Ogha, अभितीयते as well as, ओघसहस्राणाम् thousand Oghas, शतम् hundred, महौघःइति as Mahaogha, विश्रुतः is popularly known as.

output: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.

शतंशङ्कुसहस्राणांमहाशङ्कु: इतिस्मृतः ।।6.28.34।। महाशङ्कुसहस्राणांशतंबृन्दमिहोच्यते । शतंबृन्दसहस्राणांमहावृन्दमितिस्मृतम् ।।6.28.35।। महाबृन्दसहस्राणांशतंपद्ममिहोच्यते । शतंपद्मसहस्राणांमहापद्ममितिस्मृतिम् ।।6.28.36।। महापद्मसहस्राणांशतंखर्वमिहोच्यते । शतंखर्वसहस्राणांमहाखर्वमिवोच्यते ।।6.28.37।। महाखर्वसहस्राणांसमुद्रमभिधीयते । तंसमुद्रसाहस्रमोघइत्यभिधीयते ।।6.28.38।। शतमोघसहस्राणांमहौघइतिविश्रुतः ।
output: A lakh of Sanku is known as Maha Sanku. A lakh of Maha Shanka is spoken as Vrinda. A lakh of Vrindas is spoken as Maha Brinda. A lakh of Maha Vrindas is known as Padma. One lakh Padmas is known as Maha Padma and a lakh of Maha Padmas is known as Kharva. A lakh of Kharvas is known as Maha Kharva and a lakh of Maha Kharvas is known as a Samudra. A lakh of Samudras is known as an Ogha. A lakh of Oghas is popularly known as Maha Ogha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 28:
एवंकोटिसहस्रेणशङ्कूनांचशतेनच ।।6.28.39।। महाशङ्कुसहस्रेणतथाबृन्दशतेनच । महाबृन्दसहस्रेणतथापद्मशतेनच ।।6.28.40।। हापद्मसहस्रेणतथाखर्वशतेनच । समुद्रेणचतेनैवमहौघेनतथैवच ।।6.28.41।। एषकोटिमहौघेनसमुद्रसदृशेनच । विभीषणेनसचिवैःराक्षसैःपरिवारितः ।।6.28.42।। सुग्रीवोवानरेन्द्रस्त्वांयुद्धार्थममवर्तते । महाबलवृतोनित्यंमहाबलपराक्रमः ।।6.28.43।।
output: "In this manner (surrounded by) thousand crore Sankhas, a hundred thousand MahaSankhas, so also by a hundred Vrindas and thousand MahaVrindas, so also by a hundred Padmas and a thousand Mahapadmas, similarly by a hundred Kharvas nay by a Samudra, and similarly by a hundred Oghas and a hundred crore MahaOghas of monkey warriors, accompanied by gallant Vibheeshana and his ministers Sugriva the king of monkeys is ever surrounded by the great army of highly valiant and strong warriors is marching to wage war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 28:
इमांमहाराजसमीक्ष्यवाहिनीमुपस्थितांप्रज्वलितग्रहोपमाम् । ततःप्रयत्नःपरमोविधीयतांयथाजयस्स्यान्नपरैःपराजयः ।।6.28.44।।
output: "O Great King! Observing the ocean of army close by their appearing cruel like a blazing planet, make supreme efforts to be victorious and not to be defeated in the hands of the enemy." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टाविंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the twenty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुकेनतुसमाख्यातान्दृष्ट्वासहरियूथपान् । समीपस्थंचरामस्यभ्रातरंस्वंविभीषणम् ।।6.29.1।। लक्ष्मणंचमहावीर्यंभुजंरामस्यदक्षिणं । सर्ववानरराजंचसुग्रीवंभीमविक्रमम् ।।6.29.2।। अङ्गदंचापिबलिनंवज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम् । हनूमन्तंचविक्रान्तंजाम्बवन्तंचदुर्जयम् ।।6.29.3।। सुषेणंकुमुदंनीलंनलंचप्लवगर्षभम् । गजंगवाक्षंशरभंमैन्दंचद्विविदंतथा ।।6.29.4।। किञ्चिदाविग्नहृदयोजातक्रोधश्चरावणः । भर्त्सयामासतौवीरौकथान्तेशुकसारणौ ।।6.29.5।।
output: Ravana rebukes the spies, Suka and Saarana from the Rakshasa army for praising Vanara army and sends Saardula, another spy who also reports about the strength of Vanara army.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 29:
शुकेनतुसमाख्यातान्दृष्ट्वासहरियूथपान् । समीपस्थंचरामस्यभ्रातरंस्वंविभीषणम् ।।6.29.1।। लक्ष्मणंचमहावीर्यंभुजंरामस्यदक्षिणं । सर्ववानरराजंचसुग्रीवंभीमविक्रमम् ।।6.29.2।। अङ्गदंचापिबलिनंवज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम् । हनूमन्तंचविक्रान्तंजाम्बवन्तंचदुर्जयम् ।।6.29.3।। सुषेणंकुमुदंनीलंनलंचप्लवगर्षभम् । गजंगवाक्षंशरभंमैन्दंचद्विविदंतथा ।।6.29.4।। किञ्चिदाविग्नहृदयोजातक्रोधश्चरावणः । भर्त्सयामासतौवीरौकथान्तेशुकसारणौ ।।6.29.5।।
output: There after Ravana having heard the words spoken by Suka about the army of Vanara heroes, seeing Lakshmana of extraordinary valour, the right shoulder of Rama standing close by Rama his own brother Vibheeshana close by  the king of Vanaras, Sugriva of fierce valour and Angada the son of Vali (the son of Indra who wields thunderbolt)  and valiant Hanuman Jambavan who is difficult to conquer Sushena, Nila, Kumuda, bull among the leaping animals Nala likewise Gaja, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Mainda and Dwivida got a little broken hearted and mixed with fury started to rebuke both the heroes Suka and Saarana.

output: सःरावण that Ravana, शुकेन by Suka, समाख्यातान् spoken that way, हरियूथपान् about the army of monkeys, रामस्य Rama's, दक्षिणंभुजम् right shoulder, महावीर्यम् extraordinary valour, लक्ष्मणंच at Lakshmana, रामस्य Rama's, समीपस्थम् close by, भ्रातरम् the brother, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, सर्ववानरराजम् King of all Vanaras, भीमविक्रमम् one of fierce valour, सुग्रीवंच Sugriva, बलिनम् the strong, वज्रहस्तात्मजात्मजम् the son of Vali (son of Indra who wields a thunderbolt ), अङ्गदंचापि and also Angada, विक्रान्तम् the valiant, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दुर्जयम् difficult to conquer, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, सुषेणम् Sushena, कुमुदम् Kumuda, नीलम् Nila, प्लवगर्षभम् bull among leaping ones, नलंच that Nala, गजम् Gaja, गवाक्षम् at Gavaksha, शरभम् Sarabha, मैन्दम् Mainda, तथा likewise, द्विविदम् Dwiv i da, दृष्टवा seeing, किञ्चित् a little, आविग्नहृदय broken hearted, जातक्रोधश्च with fury, कथांते aforesaid, वीरौ heroes, तौ both, शुकसारणौ Suka and Saarana, भर्त्सयामास started to rebuke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अधोमुखौतौप्रणतावब्रवीच्छुकसारणौ । रोषगद्गदयावाचासंरब्धंपरुषंवचः ।।6.29.6।।
output: अधोमुखौ with heads bent down, प्रणतौ in supplication, तौ both, शुकसाणौ Suka and Saarana, रोषगद्गदया throat choked with anger, वाचा spoke, संरब्द indignantly, तथा so also, परूषम् harshly, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नतावत्सदृशंनामसचिवैरुपजीविभिः । विप्रियंनृपतेर्वक्तुंनिग्रहेप्रग्रहेप्रभोः ।।6.29.7।।
output: उपजीविभि those who are dependant, सचिवै ministers, विग्रहे to keep in check, प्रग्रहे holding forth, प्रभो to a capable, नृपते ruler, निप्रियम् that which is unpleasant, वक्तुम् to speak, सदृशम् in this way, नतावत् नाम् not proper.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 29:
रिपूणांप्रतिकूलानांयुद्धार्थमभिवर्तताम् । उभाभ्यांसदृशंनामवक्तुमप्रस्तवेस्तवम् ।।6.29.8।।
output: "Is it appropriate for both of you to praise the enemy this way before war?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आचार्यागुरवोवृद्धावृथावांपर्युपासिताः । सारंयद्राजशास्त्राणामनुजीव्यंनगृह्यते ।।6.29.9।।
output: "You have not grasped that which is the essence of political wisdom in the sastras in spite of waiting upon elders, teachers and parents which was in vain."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गृहीतोवानविज्ञातोभारोऽज्ञानस्यवाह्यते । ईदृशै: सचिवैर्युक्तोमूर्खैर्दिष्ट्यधराम्यहम् ।।6.29.10।।
output: "Even if you have grasped you have not understood the meaning or out of intensity of your ignorance. Or else I am bearing foolish ones like you who are not fit to be ministers. Out of good luck I am ruling this sovereignty."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किंनुमृत्योर्भयंनास्तिवक्तुंमांपरुषंवचः । यस्यमेशासतोजिह्वाप्रयच्छतिशुभाशुभम् ।।6.29.11।।
output: "Did you not have fear of death when you spoke such harsh words to me, who can by mere order make good or evil to you?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अप्येवदहनंस्पृष्टवावनेतिष्ठन्तिपादपाः । राजदोषपरामृष्टास्तिष्ठन्तेनापराधिनः ।।6.29.12।।
output: "Trees may remain unscathed even on touching forest fire, but those who are punishable do not remain unpunished on account of the king and are treated harshly."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हन्यामहंत्विमौपापौशत्रुपक्षप्रशंसकौ । यदिपूर्वोपकारैस्तुनक्रोधोमृदुतांव्रजेत् ।।6.29.13।।
output: अहम् I, हन्याम् would have slayed, त्वम्इमौपापौ these two sinners, शत्रुपक्षप्रशंसकौ who praise the enemy side, यदि if, मे my, क्रोध anger, न not, मृदुताम् व्रजेत् softened, पूर्वोपकारै due to earlier service.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अपध्वंसतगच्छध्वंसन्निकर्षाद्इतोमम । नहिवांहन्तुमिच्छामिस्मराम्युपकृतानिवाम् ।।6.29.14।। हतावेवकृतघ्नौतौमयिस्नेहपराङ्मुखौ ।
output: अपध्वंसत disappear from here, गच्छध्वम् going from here, मम my, इत this सन्निकर्षात् from neighbourhood,, वाम् you, उपकृतानि services affected by you, स्मरामि remember, हन्तुम् to kill, नइच्छामि do not wish, मयि to me, स्नेहपराङ्मुखौ devoid of love, कृतघ्नौ ungrateful, तौ both, हतावेव stand killed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 29:
एवमुक्तौतुसव्रीळौतावुभौशुकसारणौ । रावणंजयशब्देनप्रतिनन्द्याभिनिस्सृतौ ।।6.29.15।।
output: Ravana, having spoken that way, both Suka and Saarana felt shy and withdrew from speaking words of praise of Ravana saying, 'Let you be victorious'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अब्रवीत्सदशग्रीव: समीपस्थंमहोदरम् । उपस्तापयमेशीघ्रंचारान्नीतिविशारदान् ।।6.29.16।।
output: अब्रवीत् said, स he, दशग्रीव tenheaded one (Ravana), समीपस्थम् who was standing nearby, महोदरम् Mahodara, उपस्थापय bring, मे to me, नीतिविशारद expert in policy, शीघ्रम् swiftly चारान् spies.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महोदरस्तथोक्तस्तुशीघ्रमाज्ञापयच्चरान् ।।6.29.17।। ततश्चारास्संत्वरिताःप्राप्ताःपार्थिवशासनात् । उपस्थिताःप्राञ्जलयोवर्धयित्वाजयशिषाः ।।6.29.18।।
output: तथा so, उक्त having said, महोदर Mahodara, शीघ्रम् swiftly, चरान् spies, आज्ञापयत् ordered, तत then, संत्वरिता quickly, पार्थिवशानात् as per the order of the King,, प्राप्ता approached, चारा spies, प्राञ्जलय greeted with folded hand s, जयशिषा saying 'be victorious', वर्धयित्वा promoting, उपस्थिता stood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महोदरस्तथोक्तस्तुशीघ्रमाज्ञापयच्चरान् ।।6.29.17।। ततश्चारास्संत्वरिताःप्राप्ताःपार्थिवशासनात् । उपस्थिताःप्राञ्जलयोवर्धयित्वाजयशिषाः ।।6.29.18।।
output: तथा so, उक्त having said, महोदर Mahodara, शीघ्रम् swiftly, चरान् spies, आज्ञापयत् ordered, तत then, संत्वरिता quickly, पार्थिवशानात् as per the order of the King,, प्राप्ता approached, चारा spies, प्राञ्जलय greeted with folded hand s, जयशिषा saying 'be victorious', वर्धयित्वा promoting, उपस्थिता stood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तानब्रवीत्ततोवाक्यंरावणोराक्षसाधिपः । चारान्प्रत्यायितान् शूरान्भक्तान्विगतसाध्वसान् ।।6.29.19।।
output: तत there upon, रक्षसाधिप Lord of Rakshasas, रावण Ravana, प्रात्ययितान् those who are dependable, शूरान् warriors, भक्तान् devotees, विगतसाध्वसान् who are devoid of fear of enemies, तान् चरान् those spies, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इतोगच्छतरामस्यव्यवसायंपरीक्षथ । मन्त्रिष्वभ्यन्तरायेऽस्यप्रीत्यातेनसमागताः ।।6.29.20।।
output: "From here you go and reach there you may observe perceptions of Rama and of others close to him, his ministers and those who have reached there in affection to him."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 29:
कथंस्वपितिजागर्तिकिमन्यच्चकरिष्यति । विज्ञायनिपुणंसर्वमागन्तव्यमशेषतः ।।6.29.21।।
output: "You may see how he goes to sleep, how he wakes up etc., what he does, everything. You may come after knowing everything."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चारेणविदितश्शत्रुःपण्डितैर्वसुधाधिपैः । युद्धेस्वल्पेनयत्नेनसमासाद्यनिरस्यते ।।6.29.22।।
output: "Wise kings of the land, having known about enemies from the spies destroy enemies in war with little effort."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चारास्तुतेतथेत्युक्त्वाप्रहृष्टाराक्षसेश्वरम् । शार्दूलमग्रतःकृत्वाततश्चक्रुःप्रदक्षिणम् ।।6.29.23।।
output: The spies then gladly uttered the words 'be it so', went round the king in reverence and departed with Saardula leading in front.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तेतंमहात्मानंचाराराक्षससत्तमम् । कृत्वाप्रदक्षिणंजग्मुर्यत्ररामस्सलक्ष्मणः ।।6.29.24।।
output: तत then, चारा the spies, महात्मानम् great self, तम् him, राक्षससत्तमम् foremost of Rakshasas, प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, कृत्वा having done, सलक्ष्मणःराम that Lakshmana and Rama, यत्र there, जग्मु went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 29:
तेसुवेलस्यशैलस्यसमीपेरामलक्ष्मणौ । प्रच्छन्नाददृशुर्गत्वाससुग्रीवविभीषणौ ।।6.29.25।।
output: Reaching the Suvela mountain in disguise, they saw Rama and Lakshmana along with Sugriva and Vibheeshana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 29:
प्रेक्षमाणाश्चमूंतांतुबभूवुर्भयविक्लबाः । तेतुधर्मात्मनादृष्टाराक्षसेन्द्रेणराक्षसा ।।6.29.26।।
output: Those Rakshasas were bewildered with fear on looking at the army. Righteous Vibheeshana recognized them on seeing them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विभीषणेनतत्रस्थानिगृहीतायदृच्छया । शार्दूलोग्राहितस्त्वेकःपापोऽयमितिराक्षसः ।।6.29.27।।
output: यदृच्छया by chance, तत्रस्था , विभीषणेन by Vibheeshana, निगृहीता seized, आयम् them, राक्षस the Rakshasas, पापा evil one, इतिएक thus alone, शार्दूलःतु you Saardula, ग्राहित caught hold.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मोचितस्सोऽपिरामेणवध्यमानःप्लवङ्गमैः । अनृशंस्येनरामेणमोचिताराक्षसाःपरे ।।6.29.28।।
output: प्लवङ्गमै monkeys, वध्यमान to kill, सोऽपि he too, रामेण by Rama, मोचित relieved, परे other, राक्षसा Rakshasas, अनृशंस्येन compassionate, रामेण by Rama, मोचिता got released.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 29:
वानरैरर्दितास्तेतुविक्रान्तैर्लघुविक्रमैः । पुनर्लङ्कामनुप्राप्ताश्वसन्तोनष्टचेतसः ।।6.29.29।।
output: Harassed by the valorous and swift Vanaras, those Rakshasas lost their senses and returned to Lanka gasping and panting.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
ततस्तमक्षोभ्यबलंलङ्काधिपतयेचराः । सुवेलेराघवंशैलेनिविष्टंप्रत्यवेदयन् ।।6.30.1।।
output: Thereafter, the spies reported to the king of Lanka that Raghava had camped with an unshakable army at the Suvela mountain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चाराणांरावणश्श्रुत्वाप्राप्तंरामंमहाबलम् । जातोद्वेगोऽभवत्किञ्चिच्छार्दूलंवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.30.2।।
output: रावण Ravana, महाबलम् great army, रामम् Rama, प्राप्तम् has camped, चाराणाम् from Spies, श्रुत्वा having heard, किञ्चित् a little, जातोद्वेग felt panicky, अभवत् became, शार्दूलम् to Saardula, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अयथावच्चतेवर्णोदीनश्चासिनिशाचर । नासिकच्चिदमित्राणांक्रुद्धानांवशमागतः ।।6.30.3।।
output: निशाचर forest ranger, ते your, वर्ण colour (face colour), आयथावत् च as it should be, दीनश्च piteous, अपि and also, क्रुद्धानाम् angry, अमित्राणाम् enemies, वशम् side, नआगतःकच्चित् not come to you and done anything.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इतितेनानुशिष्टस्तुवाचंमन्दमुदीरयत् । तदाराक्षसशार्दूलंशार्दूलोभयविह्वलः ।।6.30.4।।
output: इति and then, तेन by him, अनुशिष्ट questioned, भयविह्वल overwhelmed by fear, शार्दूल to Saardula, तदा then, राक्षसशार्दूलम् tiger among Rakshasas, मन्दम् faint tone, वाचम् these words, उदीरयत् revealed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
नतेचारयितुंशक्याराजन्वानरपुङ्गवाः । विक्रान्ताबलवन्तश्चराघवेणचरक्षिताः ।।6.30.5।।
output: "O King! the Vanara heroes are valiant and highly powerful. They are also protected by Rama. It is not possible to spy on them."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
नापिसम्भाषितुंशक्यास्सम्प्रश्नोऽत्रनलभ्यते । सर्वतोरक्ष्यतेपन्थावानरैःपर्वतोपमै ।।6.30.6।।
output: "It is not possible to converse with them or to question and or to examine, since they are guarded all over by mountains like Vanaras."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रविष्टमात्रेज्ञातोऽहंबलेतस्मिन्नचारिते । बलाद्गृहीतोरक्षोभिर्बहुधाऽस्मिविचालितः ।।6.30.7।।
output: तस्मिन् their, बले army, प्रविष्टमात्रे as soon as I entered into, अचारिते was observed, अहम् I, ज्ञात was detected, रक्षोभि even the guards, बलात् forcibly, गृहीत seized, बहुधा many, विचालित rolled on ground, अस्मि me.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
जानुभिर्मुष्टिभिर्दन्तेस्तलैश्चाभिहतोभृशम् । परिणीतोऽस्मिहरिभिर्बलवद्भिरमर्षणैः ।।6.30.8।।
output: "The monkeys had beaten me with fists, bitten my palms with teeth, beaten me intensely and paraded me in the army indignantly."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
परिणीयचसर्वत्रनीतोऽहंरामसंसदम् । रुधिरादिग्धसर्वाङ्गोविह्वलश्चलितेन्द्रियः ।।6.30.9।।
output: "With all my limbs wet with bleeding, control over senses lost, after parading, I was led to the assembly of Rama."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
हरिभिर्वध्यमानश्चयाचमानःकृताञ्जलिः । राघवेणपरित्रातोजीवामीतियदृच्छया ।।6.30.10।।
output: "While smitten by the monkeys, offering salutation with folded hands, and pleading for protection from Raghava, luckily, I am alive."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
एषशैलैश्शिलाभिश्चपूरयित्वामहार्णवम् । द्वारमाश्रित्यलङ्कायारामस्तिष्ठतिसायुधः ।।6.30.11।।
output: "Having filled the great ocean with rocks and stones in that way, taking position at the entrance of Lanka Rama stands equipped with arms."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गरुडव्यूहमास्थायसर्वतोहरिभिर्वृतः । मांविसृज्यमहातेजालङ्कामेवाभिवर्तते ।।6.30.12।।
output: महातेजा O glorious one, माम् me, विसृज्य freeing, हरिभि even monkeys, गरुडव्यूहम् in the form of Garuda, आस्थाय forming, पर्वत mountain, वृत surrounded, लङ्कामेव into Lanka, अभिवर्तते is advancing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
पुराप्राकारमायातिक्षिप्रमेकतरंकुरु । सीतांवास्मैप्रयच्छाशुयुद्धंवाप्रदीयताम् ।।6.30.13।।
output: "Before Rama reaches the boundary, the wall, do one thing quickly. Either give away Sita or set out to give a good war."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
मनसातंतदाप्रेक्ष्यतच्छ्रुत्वाराक्षसाधिपः । शार्दूलंसुमहद्वाक्यमथोवाचसरावणः ।।6.30.14।।
output: "Having heard what has been said by Saardula, Rakshasa king reviewed in his mind and made a good statement before Saardula."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
यदिमांप्रतियुध्येरन्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः । नैवसीतांप्रदास्यामिसर्वलोकभयादपि ।।6.30.15।।
output: "Even if Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas come to wage war with me and even if I have threats from all worlds, I will not give away Sita."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वामहातेजारावणःपुनरब्रवीत् । चरिताभवतासेनाकेऽत्रशूराःप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.30.16।।
output: Glorious Ravana having spoken like that, again said (to Saardula), "You moved about in the army (camp) there. Tell me who among the monkeys are warriors?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कीदृशा: किंप्रभा: सौम्यवानरायेदुरासदाः । कस्यपुत्राश्चपौत्राश्चतत्त्वमाख्याहिराक्षस:।। 6.30.17।।
output: "Gentle Saardula! Of those who are difficult to encounter, what is their description? Who are the powerful ones among them? Whose sons and grandsons, are they? You may speak."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
तथात्रप्रतिपत्स्यामिज्ञात्वातेषांबलाबलम् । अवश्यंबलसङ् ख्यानंकर्तव्यंयुद्धमिच्छताम् ।।6.30.18।।
output: "Likewise knowing their strengths and weaknesses from you I wish to know what to do. It is essential to know their numbers and strength before the war."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथैवमुक्तश्शार्दूलोरावणेनोत्तमश्चरः । इदंवचनमारेभेवक्तुंरावणसन्निधौ ।।6.30.19।।
output: "When Ravana had spoken that way, good spy Saardula proceeded to tell these words in the presence of Ravana."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथर्क्षरजसःपुत्रोयुधिराजासुदुर्जयः । गद्गदस्याथपुत्त्रोऽत्रजाम्बवानितिविश्रुतः ।।6.30.20।।
output: "Certainly, king Sugriva, the son of Rksharaja's, is difficult to be conquered in battle. Here is the son of Gadgada, famously called as Jambavan."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गद्गदस्यैवपुत्त्रोऽन्योगुरुपुत्र: शतक्रतोः । कदनंयस्यपुत्रेणकृतमेकेनरक्षसाम् ।।6.30.21।।
output: Another son of Gadgada is Dhumra. One who killed many Rakshasas is Hanuman, the son of Kesari, who is the son of Brhaspati.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
सुषेणश्चापिधर्मात्मापुत्रोधर्मस्यवीर्यवान् । सौम्यस्सोमात्मजश्चात्रराजन् दधिमुखःकपिः ।।6.30.22।।
output: "O king! Here is a heroic and righteous Sushena, the son of the Lord of death (Yamadharma). Here is Dadhimukha son of noble moon."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुमुखोदुर्मुखश्चात्रवेगदर्शीचवानरः । मृत्युर्वानररूपेणनूनंसृष्टस्स्वयम्भुवा ।।6.30.23।।
output: "Vanaras Sumukha, Durmukha and Vegadarsi are surely created by Brahma in the Vanara form of DeathGod."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
पुत्त्रोहुतवहस्याथनीलस्सेनापतिस्स्वयम् । अनिलस्यचपुत्त्रोऽत्रहनूमानितिविश्रुतः ।।6.30.24।।
output: "The firegod's son indeed is the army chief known as Nila, and here is windgod's son widely known as Hanuman."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नप्ताशक्रस्यदुर्धर्षोबलवानङ्गदोयुवा । मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौबलिनावश्विसम्भवौ ।।6.30.25।। पुत्त्रावैवस्वतस्यात्रपञ्चकालान्तकोपमाः । गजोगवाक्षोगवयश्शरभोगन्धमादनः ।।6.30.26।। दशवानरकोट्यश्चशूराणांयुद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् । श्रीमतांदेवपुत्त्राणांशेषंनाख्यातुमुत्सहे ।।6.30.27।।
output: शक्रस्य Indra's, नप्ता grandson, दुर्धर्ष indomitable, बलवान् powerful, युवा young, अङ्गद Angada, आश्विसम्भवौ twins born of Ashwini, बलिना strong, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च and Dwivida, उभौ both, अथ now, वैनस्वतस्य Vynaswathasya's (Yama, the Lord of death ), पुत्त्रा sons, कालान्तकोपमा resemble god of death (spirit of time), गज: Gaja, गवाक्ष: Gavaksha, गवय: Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पञ्च five, शूराणाम् heroes, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् desiring to wage war, दश ten, वानरकोट्यश्च crores of Vanaras, श्रीमताम् prosperous, देवपुत्राणाम् sons of gods, शेषम् remaining ones, आख्यातुम् to speak, नउत्सहे not possible.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नप्ताशक्रस्यदुर्धर्षोबलवानङ्गदोयुवा । मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौबलिनावश्विसम्भवौ ।।6.30.25।। पुत्त्रावैवस्वतस्यात्रपञ्चकालान्तकोपमाः । गजोगवाक्षोगवयश्शरभोगन्धमादनः ।।6.30.26।। दशवानरकोट्यश्चशूराणांयुद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् । श्रीमतांदेवपुत्त्राणांशेषंनाख्यातुमुत्सहे ।।6.30.27।।
output: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
नप्ताशक्रस्यदुर्धर्षोबलवानङ्गदोयुवा । मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौबलिनावश्विसम्भवौ ।।6.30.25।। पुत्त्रावैवस्वतस्यात्रपञ्चकालान्तकोपमाः । गजोगवाक्षोगवयश्शरभोगन्धमादनः ।।6.30.26।। दशवानरकोट्यश्चशूराणांयुद्धकाङ्क्षिणाम् । श्रीमतांदेवपुत्त्राणांशेषंनाख्यातुमुत्सहे ।।6.30.27।।
output: "The indomitable and powerful young Angada is the grandson of Indra, the strong Mainda and Dwivida are both the twin sons of Ashwini Devas, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha and Gandhamadana are the five sons of Yama, the god of death. There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पुत्त्रोदशरथस्यैषसिंहसंहनोयुवा । दूषणोनिहतोयेनखरश्चत्रिशिरास्तथा ।।6.30.28।।
output: सिंहसंहनन built like lion in form, एष that, युवा young one, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्त्र son, त्रिशिरा Trisira.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नास्तिरामस्यसदृशोविक्रमेभुविकश्चन । विराधोनिहतोयेनकबन्धश्चान्तकोपमः ।।6.30.29।।
output: "Viradha and even Kabhanda who was like the Lord of death were killed by Rama. Perhaps there is none equal to Rama in valour in this world."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
वक्तुंनशक्तोरामस्यनरःकश्चिद्गुणान् क्षितौ । जनस्थानगतायेनयावन्तोराक्षसाहताः ।।6.30.30।।
output: "It is not even possible to recount the virtues of Rama who killed all the Rakshasas approaching Janasthana."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
लक्ष्मणश्चात्रधर्मात्मामातङ्गानामिवर्षभः । यस्यबाणपथंप्राप्यनजीवेदपिवासवः ।।6.30.31।।
output: "Here is righteous Lakshmana, who is like a bull (foremost) resembling a proud elephant. Even Indra will not be alive with in the range of his arrows when he strikes."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
श्वेतोज्योतिर्मुखश्चात्रभास्करस्यात्मसम्भवौ । वरुणस्यचपुत्त्रोऽन्योःहेमकूटःप्लवङ्गमः ।।6.30.32।। विश्वकर्मसुतोवीरोनलःप्लवगसत्तमः । विक्रान्तोबलवानत्रवसुपुत्रस्सदुर्धरः ।।6.30.33।।
output: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्वेतोज्योतिर्मुखश्चात्रभास्करस्यात्मसम्भवौ । वरुणस्यचपुत्त्रोऽन्योःहेमकूटःप्लवङ्गमः ।।6.30.32।। विश्वकर्मसुतोवीरोनलःप्लवगसत्तमः । विक्रान्तोबलवानत्रवसुपुत्रस्सदुर्धरः ।।6.30.33।।
output: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 30:
राक्षसानांवरिष्ठश्चतवभ्रातावीभीषणः । प्रतिगृह्यपुरींलङ्कांराघवस्यहितेरतः ।।6.30.34।।
output: "Here is your brother Vibheeshana the jewel among Rakshasas, who remains as a wellwisher of Rama and has received the city of Lanka (to whom Rama has offered Lanka)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इतिसर्वंसमाख्यातंतवेदंवानरंबलम् । सुवेलेऽधिष्ठितंशैलेशेषकार्येभवान्गतिः ।।6.30.35।।
output: "I have described to you everything about the Vanara strength stationed on Suvela mountain. You may decide the rest of the task to be done." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirtieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तमक्षोभ्यबलंलङ्काधिपतयेचराः । सुवेलेराघवंशैलेनिविष्टंप्रत्यवेदयन् ।।6.31.1।।
output: Rama's army takes position. Ravana seeks advice from his ministers and goes to Sita to threaten her to state that her husband has been killed and places counterfeit head of Rama by Sita's side.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चाराणांरावणश्श्रुत्वाप्राप्तंरामंमहाबलम् । जातोद्वेगोऽभवत्किञ्चित्सचिवानिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.31.2।।
output: Having heard from the spies that Rama has come with mighty force, Ravana got perturbed and said to the ministers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मन्त्रिणश्शीघ्रमायान्तुसर्वेवैसुसमाहिताः । अयंनोमन्त्रकालोहिसम्प्रप्ताइतिराक्षसाः ।।6.31.3।।
output: नः for us, अयम् this is, मन्त्रकालः time to think, सम्प्राप्तः has come इति thus, मन्त्रिणः with ministers, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, सर्वे all, सुसमाहिताः all of them assembled, शीघ्रम् immediately, अयान्तु let them be called.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वामन्त्रिणोऽभ्यागमन् द्रुतम् । ततस्समन्त्रयामासराक्षसैस्सचिवैस्सह ।।6.31.4।।
output: तस्य his, तत् that, शासनम् order, श्रुत्वा having hard, मन्त्रिणः ministers, द्रुवम् instantly, अभ्यागमन् reached, ततः then, सः he, राक्षसैः to Rakshasa, सचिवैः ministers सह along with, मन्त्रयामास started to think.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
मन्त्रयित्वासदुर्धर्षःक्षमंयत्समनन्तरम् । विसर्जयित्वासचिवान्प्रविवेशस्वमालयम् ।।6.31.5।।
output: Thereafter, thinking about what is appropriate to do, unassailable Ravana dispensed his ministers and entered his own residence.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
ततोराक्षसमाहूयविद्युज्जिह्वंमहाबलम् । मायाविदंमहामायःप्राविशद्यत्रमैथिली ।।6.31.6।।
output: Then Ravana of extraordinary skills sent for Vidyujihvam, a learned one in conjuring tricks and went from there to Mythili.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विद्युज्जिह्वंचमायाज्ञमब्रवीद्राक्षसाधिपः । मोहयिष्यावहेसीतांमाययाजनकात्मजाम् ।।6.31.7।।
output: Rakshasa king Ravana said to Vidyujihvam who knew conjuring tricks, "We will cheat Sita, daughter of Janaka by a trick."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
शिरोमायामयंगृह्यराघवस्यनिशाचर: । त्वंमांसमुतिष्ठस्वमहच्चसशरंधनुः ।।6.31.8।।
output: "O Night ranger! You make an illusory head of Raghava and come and stand at me holding an arrow with great bow."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तस्तथेत्याहविद्युज्जिह्वोनिशाचरः । दर्शयामासतांमायांसुप्रयुक्तांसरावणे ।।6.31.9।। तस्यतुष्टोऽभवद्राजाप्रददौचविभूषणम् ।
output: When the Rakshasa king had spoken that way to Vidyujihvam, he said, "Be it so." Pleased with the dexterous production of Vidyujihvam, Ravana presented to him a beautiful ornament.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
अशोकवनिकायांतुसीतादर्शनलालसः । वैरृतानामधिपतिस्संविवेशमहाबलः ।।6.31.10।।
output: Eager to have a look at Sita, the mighty king of Rakshasas entered Asoka grove.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
ततोदीनामदैन्यार्हांददर्शधनदानुजः ।।6.31.11।। अधोमुखींशोकपरामुपविष्टांमहीतले । भर्तारमेवध्यायन्तीमशोकवविकांगताम् ।।6.31.12।।
output: Thereafter, the younger brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw sad Sita, who did not deserve that piteous condition, who had been reduced to sorrowful state, seated on the ground in Asoka grove, with her head bent down filled with sorrow contemplating on her husband alone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोदीनामदैन्यार्हांददर्शधनदानुजः ।।6.31.11।। अधोमुखींशोकपरामुपविष्टांमहीतले । भर्तारमेवध्यायन्तीमशोकवविकांगताम् ।।6.31.12।।
output: ततः there upon, धनदानुजः brother of Kubera, दीनाम् sad, अदैन्यार्हाम् who did not deserve that piteous condition, अथोमुखीम् bending down her head, शोकपराम् filled with sorrow, अशोकवनिकाम् in the Asoka grove, गताम् reduced to that state, महीतले on the ground, उपविष्टाम् seated, भर्तारमेव only about her husband, ध्यायन्तीम् contemplating, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
उपास्यमानांघोराभीराक्षसीभिरितस्ततः । उपसृत्यततस्सीतांप्रहर्षंनामकीर्तयन् ।।6.31.13।। इदंचवचनंधृष्टमुवाचजनकात्मजाम् ।
output: While she was guarded by dreadful Rakshasa women surrounding her closely, Ravana went near her happily and saw her. He addressed Sita praising her.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सान्त्व्यमानामयाभद्रेयमुपाश्रित्यवल्गसे । खरहन्तासतेभर्ताराघवस्समरेहतः ।।6.31.14।।
output: "O Auspicious one! However, much I have requested you, you did not care for me seeking your husband. Raghava, who killed Khara, has been killed in war."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
छिन्नंतेसर्वतोमूलंदर्पस्तेनिहतोमया । व्यसनेनात्मनस्सीते ममभार्याभविष्यसि ।।6.31.15।।
output: "O Sita! All your roots have been crushed by me. Give up your vanity. By your own accord, you become my wife."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विसृजेमांमतिंमूढे: किंमृतेनकरिष्यसि । भवस्वभद्रे: भार्याणांसर्वेसामीश्वरीमम ।।6.31.16।।
output: "O Foolish one! Give up these thoughts from your mind. What will you do with your deceased husband? O auspicious one! You are the queen of all my wives."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अल्पपुण्ये: निवृत्तार्थे: मूढे: पण्डितमानिनि: । शृणुभर्तृवधंसीते: घोरंवृत्रवधंयथा ।।6.31.17।।
output: "O woman of less merit! You are one who has given up all worldly actions. Stupid one! You pretend as if you know everything. O Sita! Hear about your husband 's death like that of Vrthasura."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
समायातस्समुद्रान्तंमांहन्तुंकिलराघवः । वानरेन्द्रप्रणीतेनबलेनमहतावृतः ।।6.31.18।।
output: "Raghava led by the huge army force of the Vanara king has arrived on the seashore."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्निविष्टस्समुद्रस्यपीड्यतीरमथोत्तरम् । बलेनमहतारामोव्रजत्यस्तंदिवाकरे ।।6.31.19।।
output: And when the Sun moved towards the west, Rama encamped on the northern shore of the sea with a huge army to strike.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथाध्वनिपरिश्रान्तमर्धरात्रेस्थितंबलम् । सुखसुप्तंसमासाद्यचारित्रंप्रथमंचरैः ।।6.31.20।।
output: अथ and then, अध्वनि having walked all the way, परिश्रान्तम् taking rest, अर्धरात्रे midnight, सुखसुप्तम् slept well, स्थितम् stayed, बलम् army, प्रथमम् prime, समासाद्य sending, चरैः spies, चारित्रं all about them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्प्रहस्तप्रणीतेनबलेनमहतामम । बलमस्यहतंरात्रौयत्ररामस्सलक्ष्मणः ।।6.31.21।।
output: "There in that camp Lakshmana and Rama are killed by my powerful army led by Prahastha at night."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
पट्टसान्परिघांश्चक्रान्दण्डान्महायशान् । बाणजालानिशूलानिभास्वरान्कूटमुद्गरान् ।।6.31.22।। यष्टीश्चतोमरान् शक्तीश्चक्राणिमुसलानिच । उद्यम्योद्यम्यरक्षोभिर्वानरेषुनिपातितां ।।6.31.23।।
output: Again, and again lifting spears, iron bars, javelins, huge staffs, sparkling maces, shining iron mallets and clubs, lances and strong Musalas, the Rakshasas hurled at Vanaras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पट्टसान्परिघांश्चक्रान्दण्डान्महायशान् । बाणजालानिशूलानिभास्वरान्कूटमुद्गरान् ।।6.31.22।। यष्टीश्चतोमरान् शक्तीश्चक्राणिमुसलानिच । उद्यम्योद्यम्यरक्षोभिर्वानरेषुनिपातितां ।।6.31.23।।
output: Again, and again lifting spears, iron bars, javelins, huge staffs, sparkling maces, shining iron mallets and clubs, lances and strong Musalas, the Rakshasas hurled at Vanaras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथसुप्तस्यरामस्यप्रहस्तेनप्रमाथिना । असक्तंकृतहस्तेनशिरश्छिन्नंमहासिना ।।6.31.24।।
output: अथ thereafter, प्रमाथिना one who is capable of striking, कृतहस्तेन skilled, प्रहस्तेन by Prahastha, महासिना big sword, सुप्तस्य sleeping, रमस्य Rama's, शिरः head, असक्तं without any feeling of attachment, छिन्नम् severed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विभीषणस्समुत्पत्यनिगृहीतोयदृच्छया । दिशःप्रव्राजितस्सर्वैस्सर्लक्ष्मणःप्लवगैस्सहा ।।6.31.25।।
output: यदृच्छया by chance, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, समुत्पत्य when rose up, निगृहीतः caught hold, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्लवगैःसह along with Vanaras, दिशम् directions, प्रव्राजितः fled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
सुग्रीवोग्रीनयासीतेभग्नयाप्लवगाधिपः । निरस्तहनुकश्शेतेहनुमान्राक्षसैर्हतः ।।6.31.26।।
output: "O Sita! Vanara Lord Sugriva with his neck broken, Hanuman with chin broken were killed by Rakshasas and are lying down fallen on the ground."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जाम्बवानथजानुभ्यामुत्पतन्निहतोयुधि । पट्टसैर्बहुभिश्छिन्नोनिकृत्तःपादपोयथा ।।6.31.27।।
output: अथ and, जानुभ्याम् on the knees, उत्पतन् while rising up, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, युधि in combat, निहातः fallen down, बहुभिः many, पट्टसै: iron bars, छिन्नः struck, पादपोयथा like a tree, छिन्नः broken down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौनिहतौवानरर्षभौ ।।6.31.28।। निश्श्वसन्तौरुदन्तौचरुधिरेणसमुक्षितौ । असिनाव्यायतौछिन्नौमध्येह्यरिनिषूदनौ ।।6.31.29।।
output: व्यायतौ of huge body, अरिनिषूदनौ slayers of enemies, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च and Dwivida, उभौ both, वानरर्षभौ bulls among Vanaras, निश्शसन्तौ breathing hard, रुदन्तौ roaring, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षितौ bathing, असिना sword, मध्ये in the midst, छिन्नौ cut.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौनिहतौवानरर्षभौ ।।6.31.28।। निश्श्वसन्तौरुदन्तौचरुधिरेणसमुक्षितौ । असिनाव्यायतौछिन्नौमध्येह्यरिनिषूदनौ ।।6.31.29।।
output: व्यायतौ of huge body, अरिनिषूदनौ slayers of enemies, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च and Dwivida, उभौ both, वानरर्षभौ bulls among Vanaras, निश्शसन्तौ breathing hard, रुदन्तौ roaring, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षितौ bathing, असिना sword, मध्ये in the midst, छिन्नौ cut.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनुतिष्ठतिमेदिन्यांपनसःपनसोयथा ।।6.31.30।। नाराचैर्बहुभिश्चिन्नश्शेतेदर्यांदरीमुखः । कुमुदस्तुमहातेजानिष्कूजन्सायकै: कृतः ।।6.31.31।।
output: पनसोयथा like jackfruit, पनसः Panasa, मेदिन्याम् on the earth, अनुतिष्ठति lying on the ground, दरीमुखः Darimukha, बहुभिः many, नाराचैः arrows, छिन्नः shattered, दर्याम् on the ground, शेते lying down, निष्कूजन् torn off, महातेजाः brilliant, कुमुदस्तु Kumuda too, सायकैः silently, कृतः lying.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
अनुतिष्ठतिमेदिन्यांपनसःपनसोयथा ।।6.31.30।। नाराचैर्बहुभिश्चिन्नश्शेतेदर्यांदरीमुखः । कुमुदस्तुमहातेजानिष्कूजन्सायकै: कृतः ।।6.31.31।।
output: "Panasa is lying down on earth like jackfruit. Darimukha is lying down shattered by many arrows. Brilliant Kumuda too is torn off and silently lying down."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गदोबहुभिश्छिन्नश्शरैरासाद्यराक्षसैः । पतितोरुधिरोद्गारीक्षितौनिपतिताङ्गदः ।।6.31.32।।
output: "By the many arrows of Rakshasas reaching towards Angada, he lies down chopped up and destroyed, with his armlets dropped down throwing up blood."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
हरयोमथितानागैरथजातैस्तथापरे । शयितामृदिताश्चाश्वैर्यायुवेगैरिवाम्बुदाः ।।6.31.33।।
output: "There, some of the sleeping Vanaras were crushed by elephants, so also, just as by the speed of wind the clouds are crushed the Vanaras are crushed to death."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रहृताश्चपरेत्रस्ताहस्यमानाजघन्यतः । अभिद्रुतास्तुरक्षोभिस्सिंहैरिवमहाद्विपाः ।।6.31.34।।
output: परे some, जघन्यतः followed behind, हन्यमानाः destroying, सिंहैः lions, महाद्विपा: इव like huge elephants, रक्षोभिः like Rakshasas, अभिद्रुताः severely afflicted, त्रस्ताः frightened, प्रहृताः struck.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
सागरेपतिताःकेचित्केचिग्दगनमाश्रिताः । ऋक्षावृक्षानुपारूढावानरींवृत्तिमाश्रिताः ।।6.31.35।।
output: "While a few Vanaras dived into the sea, some took refuge in the sky. Resorting to their natural way the Bears climbed the trees."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सागरस्यचतीरेषुशैलेषुचवनेषुच । पिङ्गलास्तेविरूपाक्षैर्बहुभिर्बहवोहताः ।।6.31.36।।
output: "Many fierceeyed Rakshasas killed several Vanaras on the shore of the ocean, in the mountains and woods."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
एवंतवहतोभर्ताससैन्योममसेनया । क्षतजार्द्रंरजोध्वस्तमिदंचस्याहृतंशिरः ।।6.31.37।।
output: "In that way the army of your husband has been killed by Rakshasa army and his decayed head drenched in blood covered with dust has been brought."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःपरमदुर्धर्षोरावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । सीतायामुपशन्त्यांराक्षसीमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.31.38।।
output: ततः then, परमदुर्धर्षः highly unassailable, राक्षसेश्वर king of Rakshasas, रावण Ravana, सीतायाम् while Sita, उशृण्वत्याम् to the hearing of, राक्षसीम् Rakshasas, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसंक्रूरकर्माणंविद्युज्जिह्वंत्वमानय । येनतद्राघवशिरस्सङ्ग्रामात्स्वयमाहृतम् ।।6.31.39।।
output: "Bring that Rakshasa, Vidyujihvam of cruel deeds who brought Rama's head from the battlefield."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
विद्युज्जिह्वस्ततोगृह्यशिरस्तत्सशरासनम् । प्रणामंशिरसाकृत्वारावणस्याग्रतस्थितः ।।6.31.40।।
output: Then holding the head along with the bow, Vidyujihvam bowed his head down in salutation and stood in front of Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 31:
तमब्रवीत्ततोराजारावणोराक्षसंस्थितम् । विद्युज्जिह्वंमहाजिह्वंसमीपपरिवर्तिनम् ।।6.31.41।।
output: Then the king, Ravana spoke to Vidyujihvam, the Rakshasa with extended tongue, who stood close by.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्रतःकुरुसीतायाश्शीघ्रंदाशरधेशशिरः । अवस्थांपश्चिमांभर्तुःकृपणासाधुपश्यतु ।।6.31.42।।
output: दाशरथेः Dasaratha's son's, शिरः head, शीघ्रम् at once, सीतायाः Sita's, अग्रतः before, कुरु place it, कृपणा piteous woman, भर्तुः to husband, पश्चिमाम् at the end, अवस्थाम् ultimate state, साधु attained, पश्यतु let her see.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्तंतुतद्रक्षशशिरस्तत्प्रियदर्शनम् । उपनिक्षिप्यसीतायाःक्षिप्रमन्तरधीयत ।।6.31.43।।
output: Having spoken immediately placed the head of Rama that was pleasing to see, by the side of Sita and went away.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणश्चापिचिक्षेपभस्वरंकार्मुकंमहत् । त्रिषुलोकेषुविख्यातंसीतामिदमुवाचह ।।6.31.44।।
output: Thus addressed Ravana casting down the bright great bow that is famous in the three worlds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदंतुतवरामस्यकार्मुकंज्यासमायुतम् । इहप्रहस्तेनानीतंहत्वातंनिशिमानुषम् ।।6.31.45।।
output: इदम् this, तवरामस्य your Rama's, ज्यासमावृतम duly strung, तत् that, कार्मुकम् bow, निशि in the night, तम् him, मानुषम् he human being, हत्वा after killing, इह here, प्रहस्तेन by Prahastha, अनीतम् has brought.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
सासीतातच्छिरोदृष्टवातच्चकार्मुकमुत्तमम् । सुग्रीवप्रतिसंपर्गमाख्यातंचहनूमता ।।6.32.1।। नयनेमुखवर्णंचभर्तुस्तत्सदृशंमुखम् । केशान् केशान्तदेशंचतंचचूडामणिंशुभम् ।।6.32.2।। एतैस्सर्वेरभिज्ञानैरभिज्ञायसुदुःखिता । निजगर्हेचकैकेयींक्रोशन्तीकुररीयथा ।।6.32.3।।
output: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita recognized the auspicious Chudamani. Identifying all those marks to be like Rama's she felt very sad and cried like a deer and abused Kaikeyi.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
सासीतातच्छिरोदृष्टवातच्चकार्मुकमुत्तमम् । सुग्रीवप्रतिसंपर्गमाख्यातंचहनूमता ।।6.32.1।। नयनेमुखवर्णंचभर्तुस्तत्सदृशंमुखम् । केशान् केशान्तदेशंचतंचचूडामणिंशुभम् ।।6.32.2।। एतैस्सर्वेरभिज्ञानैरभिज्ञायसुदुःखिता । निजगर्हेचकैकेयींक्रोशन्तीकुररीयथा ।।6.32.3।।
output: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita recognized the auspicious Chudamani. Identifying all those marks to be like Rama's she felt very sad and cried like a deer and abused Kaikeyi.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सासीतातच्छिरोदृष्टवातच्चकार्मुकमुत्तमम् । सुग्रीवप्रतिसंपर्गमाख्यातंचहनूमता ।।6.32.1।। नयनेमुखवर्णंचभर्तुस्तत्सदृशंमुखम् । केशान् केशान्तदेशंचतंचचूडामणिंशुभम् ।।6.32.2।। एतैस्सर्वेरभिज्ञानैरभिज्ञायसुदुःखिता । निजगर्हेचकैकेयींक्रोशन्तीकुररीयथा ।।6.32.3।।
output: Sita wails at the sight of Rama's head presented by Ravana to her. Ravana abruptly leaves Ashoka grove.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सकामाभवकैकेयीहतोऽयंकुलनन्दनः । कुलमुत्सादितंसर्वंत्वयाकलहशीलया ।।6.32.4।।
output: कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, सकामा desire fulfilled, भव of yours, कुलनन्दनः delight of the race, आयम् this, हतः killed, कलहशीलया one who is given to creating quarrel, त्वया by you, सर्वम् all, कुलम् race, उत्सादितम् have ruined.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
आर्येणकिंतेकैकेयी कृतंरामेणविप्रियम् । यन्मयाचीरवसनस्त्वयाप्रस्थापितोवनम् ।।6.32.5।।
output: "Kaikeyi, you have given bark robes to prince Rama and sent him to the forest with me. What harm has he done for you? Thinking of this again and again Sita cried."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वातुवैदेहीवेपमानातपस्विनी । जगामजगतींबालाछिन्नातुकदळीयथा ।।6.32.6।।
output: That miserable young, Vaidehi, having said so, fell on the ground trembling like a cut off banana plant.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सामुहूर्तात्समाश्वास्यप्रतिलभ्यचचेतनाम् । तच्छिरस्समुपाघ्रायविललासायतेक्षणा ।।6.32.7।।
output: आयुतेक्षणा broadeyed one, सा she, अथ and then, मुहूर्तात् for a while, समाश्वास्य regaining, चेतनाम् consciousness, परिलभ्य remaining behind, तत् that, शिरः head, समुपाघ्राय sitting close by, विललास lamented.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हाहताऽस्मिमहाबाहो वीरव्रतमनुव्रत । इमांतेपश्चिमावस्थांगताऽस्मिविधवाकृता ।।6.32.8।।
output: "O mightyarmed one! Alas you are killed while following heroic vow. I live to see you in the last state of your life, widowed. I am done."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रथमंमरणंनार्याभर्तुर्वैगुण्यमुच्यते । सुवृत्त: स्साधुवृत्तायास्सम्वृत्तस्त्वंममाग्रतः ।।6.32.9।।
output: "O Rama, you are faithful to your vows, a noble one! It is said that because of a woman's faults, the husband will die. It is not even so as you died in front of a virtuous woman of good conduct."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दुःखाद्दुःखंप्रपन्नायामग्नायाश्शोकसागरे । योहिमामुद्यतनिस्त्रातुंसोऽपित्वंविनिपातितः ।।6.32.10।।
output: दुःखात् in grief, दुःखम् grief, प्रपन्नायाः reaching at, शोकसागरे ocean of sorrow, मग्नायाः filled, यः who, त्वम् you, त्रातु, to save उद्यतः have come, सोऽपि you are also, विनिपातितः are killed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
साश्वश्रूर्ममकौसल्यात्वयापुत्रेणराघव: । वत्सेनेवयथाधेनुर्विवत्सावत्सलाकृता ।।6.32.11।।
output: "O Raghava! Even my motherinlaw Kausalya is separated from her dear son just as cow is separated from calf."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आद्दिष्टंदीर्घमायुस्तेयैरचिन्त्यपराक्रम । अनृतंवचनंतेषामल्पायुरपिराघव ।।6.32.12।।
output: "O Raghava of incomprehensible valour! the words predicted by astrologers that your life is long is falsified. Your life has been short."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथवानश्यतिप्रज्ञाप्राज्ञस्यापिसतस्तव । पचत्येनंयथाकालोभूतानांप्रभवोऽह्ययम् ।।6.32.13।।
output: अथवा or else, प्राज्ञास्यापिसतः even the learned ones, तन diffused, प्रज्ञा wisdom, नश्यति lost, यथा likewise, भूतानाम् living beings, प्रभवः effect, आयम् this, कालः time, एवम् in that way, पचति caused.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
अदृष्टंमृत्युमापन्नःकस्मात्त्वंनयशास्त्रवित् । व्यसनानामुपायज्ञःकुशलोह्यसिवर्जने ।।6.32.14।।
output: "You are the knower of all sastras, and capable of warding off all calamities. How did death have a chance to meet you and overtake?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथात्वंसम्परिष्वज्यरौद्रयाऽतिनृशंसया । काळरात्य्राममाच्छिद्यहृतःकमललोचन:।। 6.32.15।।
output: "O lotuseyed Rama! After you have lost contact with me, the most horrible cruel night has killed you cutting you off from me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपशेषेमहाबाहो: मांविहायतपस्विनीम् । प्रियामिवसमालशिष्यपृथिवींपुरुषर्षभ ।।6.32.16।।
output: महाबाहो mightyarmed one, पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, तपस्विनीम् noble one, माम् me, विहाय sky, पृथिवीम् the earth, प्रियामिव like beloved, समालशिष्य embraced, उपशेषे more over sleeping.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अर्चितंसततंयत्तद्गन्धमाल्यैर्मयातव । इदंतेमप्रतियंवीरधनुःकाञ्चानभूषणम् ।।6.32.17।।
output: "O Hero! This bow that was decorated with gold was always worshipped with sandal and flowers diligently by you and me with utmost devotion."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
पित्रादशरथेनत्वंश्वशुरेणममानघ: । सर्वैश्चपितृभिस्सार्थंनूनंस्वर्गेसमागतः ।।6.32.18।।
output: "O Sinless one! Surely you have reached heaven where your father, my fatherinlaw Dasaratha and your grandfathers have reached."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिविनक्षत्रभूतस्त्वंमहात्कर्मकृतप्रियम् । पुण्यंराजर्षिवंशंत्वमात्मनस्समुपेक्षसे ।।6.32.19।।
output: "In heaven, you will be seeing luminaries of the sky who are dear, who have done great deeds and earned merit and the royal sages of your own race."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किंमांनप्रेक्षसेराजन् किंमांनप्रतिभाषसे । बालांबाल्येनसम्प्राप्तांभार्यांमांसहचारिणीम् ।।6.32.20।।
output: "O King! I have come to you while I was young. I am your companion and wife also. Why are you not seeing me? Why are you not talking to me?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
संश्रुतंगृह्णतापाणिंचरिष्यामीतियत्त्वया । स्मरतन्ममकाकुत्स्थनयमामपिदुःखिताम् ।।6.32.21।।
output: "O Kakutstha! while you held my hand (at the time of marriage) you promised that you will be with me and likewise promised to take me, a (wretched one) with you to the other world. Remembering that I am sad."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कस्मान्मामपहायत्वंगतोगतिमतांवर । अस्माल्लोकादमुंलोकंत्यक्त्वामामपिदुःखिताम् ।।6.32.22।।
output: गतिमताम् jewel among those who have good status, वर O jewel, त्वम् you, माम् me, अपहाय abandoning, कस्मात् why have you, गतः gone, दुखिःताम् I am pained, मामपि I am, त्यक्त्वा deserting, अस्मात् from this, लोकात् world, अमुम् heaven, लोकम् world.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
कल्याणैरुचितंयत्तत्परिष्वक्तंमयैवतु । क्रव्यादैस्तच्छरीरंतेमानंविपरिकृष्यते ।।6.32.23।।
output: "This body which used to be decorated by me with auspicious items, with great respect is dragged by cruel animals."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैरिष्टवानाप्तदक्षिणैः । अग्निहोत्रेणसंस्कारंकेनत्वंनतुलप्स्यसे ।।6.32.24।।
output: आप्तदक्षिणैः all offerings into fire, अग्निष्टोमादिभिः offerings in sacrificial fire, यज्ञैः sacrifices, इष्टवान् which you deserve, त्वम् you, अग्निङोत्रेण by sacrificial performances of fire, संस्कारम् sanctification, केन why, नतुलप्स्यसे you are not getting.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रव्रज्यामुपपन्नानांत्रयाणामेकमागतम् । परिप्रक्ष्यतिकौसल्यालक्ष्मणंशोकलालसा ।।6.32.25।।
output: शोकलालसा immersed in grief, कौसल्या Kausalya, प्रव्रज्याम् of the exiled ones, उपपन्नानाम् attended by, त्रयाणाम् of the three, आगतम् returning, एकम् alone, लक्ष्मणम् only Lakshmana, परिप्रेक्ष्यति will see returned.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतस्याःपरिपृच्छन्त्यावधंमित्रबलस्यते । तवचाख्यास्यतेनूनंनिशायांराक्षसैर्वधम् ।।6.32.26।।
output: "When she questions, he may tell that you and your army were killed by the army of friends at night."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
सात्वांसुप्तंहतंश्रुत्वामांचरक्षोगृहंगताम् । हृदयेनविदीर्णेननभविष्यतिराघव ।।6.32.27।।
output: "Raghava! Hearing that you were killed while asleep and I was taken to the home of Rakshasas, Kausalya will not be able to survive with a broken heart."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
ममहेतोरनार्यायाह्यनर्हःपार्थिवात्म: । रामस्सागरमुततीर्यसत्त्ववान् गोष्पदेहतः ।।6.32.28।।
output: "On account of an undeserving one, Rama, the son of the emperor, a valiant one who does not deserve to be killed, after having crossed the ocean is killed by a footprint of a cow(easily)."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहंदाशरथेनोढामोहात्स्वकुलपांसनी । आर्यपुत्रस्यरामस्यभार्यामृत्युरजायत ।।6.32.29।।
output: स्वकुलपांसनी as an obloquy of his race, अहम् I am, दाशरथेन by the son of Dasaratha, मोहत् in ignorance, ऊढा married, आर्यपुत्रस्य son of noble one, रामस्य with Rama, भार्या wife, मृत्युः death, अजायत turned out to be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
नूनमन्यांमयाजातिंवारितंदानमुत्तमम् । याहमद्येहशोचामिभार्यासर्वतिथेरपि ।।6.32.30।।
output: "Undoubtedly I may have obstructed a supreme offering (such as offering a girl in marriage) in some other (previous) life. So now I am pained even though I am the wife of one who is kind to all."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
साधुपातयमांक्षिप्रंरामस्योपरिरावण । समानयपतिंपन्त्याकुरुकल्याणमुत्तमम् ।।6.32.31।।
output: "O Ravana! You may quickly join me with my husband as it will be highly auspicious for the wife to join the husband."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
शिरसामेशिरश्चास्यकायंकायेनयोजय । रावणानुगमिष्यामिगतिंभर्तुर्महात्मनः ।।6.32.32।।
output: "O Ravana! Join my head with his and my body with his body. I will follow him in the same way."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इतिसदुःखसन्तप्ताविललापायतेक्षणा । भर्तुश्शिरोधनुस्तत्रसमीक्ष्यचपुनःपुनः ।।6.32.33।।
output: Burning in sorrow, the broad eyed Sita gazing at the head of her husband and the bow again and again lamented.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवंलालप्यमानायांसीतायांतत्रराक्षसः । अभिचक्रामभर्तारमनीकस्थःकृताञ्जलिः ।।6.32.34।।
output: सीतायां while Sita, एवम् in that way, लालप्यमानायाम् wailing as said before, तत्र there, अनीकस्थः guarding, राक्षसः Rakshasa, कृताञ्जालिः offered salutation, भर्तारम् to the king, अभिचक्राम approached.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
विजयस्वार्यपुत्रेतिसोऽभिवाद्यप्रसाद्यच । न्यवेदयदनुप्राप्तंप्रहस्तंवाहिनीपतिम् ।।6.32.35।।
output: The Rakshasa (guard) greeted the king saying, "Let you be victorious!" and announced reverentially, "Prahastha, the army chief has arrived."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अमात्यैस्सहितस्सर्वैःप्रहस्तस्समुपस्थितः । तेनदर्शनकामेनवयंप्रस्थापिताःप्रभो ।।6.32.36।।
output: प्रभो O Lord, सर्वेः all, अमात्यैः ministers, सहितः accompanied by, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, त्वाम् to you, उपस्थितः waiting, दर्शनकामेन desiring to see you, तेन so, वयम् me, प्रस्थासितः sent.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नूनमस्तिमहाराज राजभावात्क्षमान्वितं । किञ्चिदात्ययिकंकार्यंतेषांत्वंदर्शनंकुरु ।।6.32.37।।
output: "O great king, endowed with forgiveness and royalty! there is a little urgent work. Undoubtedly, they are waiting to see you please."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
एतच्छ्रुत्वादशग्रीवोराक्षसप्रतिवेदितम् । अशोकन्विकांत्यक्त्वामन्त्रिणांदर्शनंययौ ।।6.32.38।।
output: On hearing the submission of the rakshasa, the tenheaded king left the Asoka grove to see the ministers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 32:
सतुसर्वंसमर्थ्यैवमन्त्रिभिःकृत्यमात्मनः । सभांप्रविश्यविदधेविदित्वारामविक्रमम् ।।6.32.39।।
