instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 39:
निविष्टातत्रशिखरेलङ्कारावणपालिता ।।6.39.20।। शतयोजनविस्तीर्णात्रिंशद्योजनमायता ।
output: Lanka ruled by Ravana was a hundred yojanas in breadth and thirty yojanas in length was seen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सापुरीगोपुरैरुच्चैःपाण्डुराम्बुदसन्निभैः । काञ्चनेनचशालेनराजतेनचशोभते ।।6.39.21।।
output: The city of Lanka looked charming with tall towers resembling white cluster of clouds fortified with gold and silver.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रासादैश्चविमानैश्चलङ्कापरमभूषिता । घनैरिवाऽतपापायेमध्यमंवैष्णवंपदम् ।।6.39.22।।
output: प्रासादैश्च even the buildings, विमानैश्च resembled air planes, परमभूषिता decorated beautifully, लङ्का Lanka, आतपापापये exposed to the sun, घनैः rainy clouds, मध्यमम् in the centre, वैष्णवंपदम् इव resembling the abode of Vishnu.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 39:
यस्यांस्तम्भसहस्रेणप्रासादस्समलङ्कृतः । कैलासशिखराकारोदृश्यतेखमिवोललिखन् ।।6.39.23।। चैत्यस्सराक्षसेन्द्रस्यबभूवपुरभूषणम् । शतेनरक्षसांनित्यंयस्समग्रेणरक्ष्यते ।।6.39.24।।
output: In that city, which was always protected fully by a hundred Rakshasas, there was a palace with thousand pillars, which looked like peak of mount Kailas, and was as though it was scraping the sky and it as like an ornament of Lanka, the city of Rakshasa's Lord.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्यांस्तम्भसहस्रेणप्रासादस्समलङ्कृतः । कैलासशिखराकारोदृश्यतेखमिवोललिखन् ।।6.39.23।। चैत्यस्सराक्षसेन्द्रस्यबभूवपुरभूषणम् । शतेनरक्षसांनित्यंयस्समग्रेणरक्ष्यते ।।6.39.24।।
output: यस्याम् in that city, यः that which is, नित्यम् always, रक्षसाम् protected, समग्रेण fully, शतेन hundred, रक्ष्यते graced, स्तम्बसहस्रेण thousand pillars, समलङ्कङ्कृतः ornament, कैलासशिखराकारः peak of mount Kailasa, प्रासादः palace, खम् sky, उललिखन्निव as if scraping, दृश्यते appeared, सः that, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa Lord's, पुरभूषणम् ornament of city, बभूव looked.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मनोज्ञांकाननवतींपर्वतैरुपशोभिताम् । नानाधातुविचित्रैश्चउद्यानैरुपशोभिताम् ।।6.39.25।। नानाविहङ्गासङ्घुष्टांनानामृगनिषेविताम् । नानाकुसुमसञ्छन्नांनानाराक्षससेविताम् ।।6.39.26।। तांसमृद्धांसमृद्धार्धांलक्ष्मीनान्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । रावणस्यपुरींरामोददर्शसहवानरैः ।।6.39.27।।
output: लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's brother, रामः Rama, मनोज्ञाम् delightfully, काननवतीम् different kinds of forests, नानाधातुविचित्रैः different kinds of minerals, पर्वतैः mountains, उपशोभिताम् very charming, उद्यानैः gardens, उपशोभिताम् very delightful, नानाविहङ्गसङ्घुष्टाम् variety of birds singing happily, नानामृगनिषेविताम् frequented by different kinds of deer, नानाकुसुमसञ्छन्नाम् endowed with different varieties of flowers, नानाराक्षससेविताम् attended by many Rakshasas, समृद्धाम् blooming, समृद्धार्थाम् prosperous, ताम् that city, पुरीम् city, वानरैःसह along with Vanaras, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 39:
तांमहागृहसम्बाधांदृष्टवालक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । नगरीममरप्रख्योविस्मयंप्राप्यवीर्यवान् ।।6.39.28।।
output: Valiant brother of Lakshmana wondered seeing the city filled with great palaces, distinct like Lord Indra's city.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांरत्नपूर्णांबहुसंविधानांप्रासादमालाभिरलङ्कृतांच । पुरींमहायन्त्रकवाटमुख्यांददर्शरामोमहताबलेन ।।6.39.29।।
output: Accompanied by huge Vanara army, Rama saw in the city of Lanka rows of buildingspalaces, adorned with gems, gates fitted with huge machines for war and large army of Ravana. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 40:
ततोरामस्सुवेलाग्रंयोजनद्वयमण्डलम् । अरुरोहससुग्रीवोहरियूधपसम्वृतः ।।6.40.1।।
output: Rama accompanied by Vanara troop and Sugriva, ascended the peak of Suvela mountain spread over yojanas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्थित्वामुहूर्तंतत्रैवदिशोदशविलोकयन् । त्रिकूटशिखरेरम्येनिर्मितांविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.40.2।। ददर्शलङ्कांसुन्यस्तांरम्यकाननशोभिताम् ।
output: Remaining there for a short while, Rama observed the view of Lanka in all directions. He saw Lanka built on the charming peak of Trikuta strongly by Vishwakarma, endowed with delightful groves.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यांगोपुरशृङ्गस्थंराक्षसेन्द्रंदुरासदम् ।।6.40.3।। श्वेतचामरपर्यन्तंविजयच्छत्रशोभितम् । रक्तचन्दनसंलिप्तंरत्नाभरणभूषितम् ।।6.40.4।। नीलजीमूतसङ्काशंहेमसञ्छादिताम्बरम् । ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरुत्कृष्टकिणवक्षसम् ।।6.40.5।। शशलोहितरागेणसंवीतंरक्तवाससा । सन्ध्यातपेनसंवीतंमेघराशिमिवाम्बरे ।।6.40.6।।
output: From there Rama saw on the peak of the tower the Rakshasa king, who is difficult to approach. He was fanned by white whisks on both sides, graced with triumphal parasol, decorated his body with red sandal paste, adorned in redcoloured ornaments, resembling dark clouds, attired in red like the hare's blood, embroidered with golden thread, with scars on his chest caused by indentations made by the tusks of Airavata the elephant of Indra, looked like a mass of cloud covered by sunshine at dusk.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 40:
पश्यतांवानरेन्द्राणांराघवस्यापिपश्यतः । दर्शनाद्राक्षसेन्द्रस्यसुग्रीवस्सहसोत्थितः ।।6.40.7।।
output: Looking at the sight of Raghava seeing Rakshasa king, Sugriva the king of Vanaras got up instantly rashly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रोधवेगेनसंयुक्तस्सत्त्वेनचबलेनच । अचलाग्रादथोत्थायपुप्लुवेगोपुरस्थले ।।6.40.8।।
output: Provoked by anger, courageous and strong Sugriva rose up impelled by impetuosity and flew to the peak of the tower.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

output: सः he, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, स्थित्वा stood, सम्प्रेक्ष्य looking at, निर्भयेन fearlessly, अन्तरात्मना internally, तत् that, रक्षः ogre, तृणीकृत्यः treating like a straw, परुषम् harsh, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 40:
लोकनाथस्यरामस्यसखादासोऽस्मिराक्षस । नमयामोक्ष्यसेऽद्यत्वंपार्थिवेन्द्रस्यतेजसा ।।6.40.10।।
output: "O Rakshasa! I am a friend and servant of the king of kings, ruler of the world. By his power I will not leave you!", Sugriva said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 40:
इत्युक्त्वासहसोत्पत्यपुप्लुवेतस्यचोपरि । आकृष्यमुकुटंचित्रंपातयित्वाऽपतद्भुवि ।।6.40.11।।
output: Having spoken thus, Sugriva got up speedily and flew to the top of the tower (here Ravana was located) held the diadem and pushed it on the ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समीक्ष्यतूर्णमायान्तमबभाषेनिशाचरः । सुग्रीवस्त्वपरोक्षम् मेहीनग्रीवोभविष्यसि ।।6.40.12।।
output: निशाचरः night ranger, तूर्णम् quickly, आयान्तम् coming towards, तम् him, समीक्ष्य observing, बभाषे announced, त्वम् you, मे my, परोक्षम् without being seen by me, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हीनग्रीवः without neck, भविष्यसि will make.

instruction:

इत्युक्त्वोत्थायतंक्षिप्रंबाहुभ्यामाक्षिपत्तले । कन्तुवत्तंसमुत्थायबाहुभ्यामाक्षिपद्धरि ।।6.40.13।।
output: इति like that, उक्त्वा said, उत्थाय getting up, बाहुभ्याम् hand s, तम् his, क्षिप्रम् instantly, तले head, आक्षिपत् dashed, सः he, हरिः Vanara, कन्तुवत् like a ball, समुत्थाय getting up, बाहुभ्याम् with both hand s, आक्षिपत् pushed down

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परस्परंस्वेदविदग्धगात्रौपरस्परंशोणितदिग्धदेहौ । परस्परंलशिष्टनिरुद्धचेष्टौपरस्परंशाल्मलिकिंशुकौयधा ।।6.40.14।। मुष्टिप्रहारैश्चतलप्रहारैररत्निघातैश्चकराग्रघातैः । तौचक्रतुर्युद्धमसह्यरूपंमहाबलौराक्षसवानरेन्द्रौ ।।6.40.15।।
output: Sugriva and Ravana, their bodies sweating all over, bodies coloured red with blood looking like red silk cotton trees, their bodies clinging together interlocked with each other stood motionless. They were fighting with their fists, palms and blows of forearms, hurting each other with nails and carrying out unbearable forms of war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 40:
कृत्वानियुद्धंभृशमुग्रवेगौकालंचिर, गोपुरवेदिमध्ये । उत्क्षिप्यचोत्क्षिप्यविनम्यदेहौपादक्रमाद्गोपुरवेदिलग्नौ ।।6.40.16।।
output: Violently fighting like that aggressively for long, throwing each other down repeatedly, bending and moving their feet in a direction, stood on the fl at area of the peak in the middle portion.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 40:
अन्योन्यमाविध्यवेदिलग्नौतौपेततुस्सालनिखातमध्ये । उत्पेततुर्भूतलमस्पृशन्तौस्थित्वामुहूर्तंत्वभिनिश्श्वसन्तौ ।।6.40.17।।
output: Squeezing their bodies of each other they dropped down between the boundary of the peak and the moat. They were gasping heavily for a moment and clung their body to each other jumping.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आलिङ् ग्यचालिङ् ग्यचबाहुयोक्स्रैस्संयोजयामासतुराहवेतौ । सम्रम्भशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौसंचेरतुस्सम्प्रतियुद्धमार्गैः ।।6.40.18।।
output: तौ they, बाहुयोक्स्रै pressing their bosoms, आलिङ् ग्यच clung to each other, आलिङ् ग्यच and fastened to each other in embrace, आहवे in combat, संयोजयामासतुः having received similar training, सम्रम्भशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौ endowed with might, सम्प्रति at this time, युद्धमार्गैः war methods, सुचेरतुः went on.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शार्दूरसिंहाविवजातदर्पौगजेन्द्रपोताविवसम्प्रयुक्तौ । संहत्यचापीड्यचतावुरोभ्यांनिपेततुर्वैयुगपद्धरण्याम् ।।6.40.19।।
output: तौ both, जातदर्पौ affected by pride, शार्दूलसिंहानिव l who resembled tiger and lion, सम्प्रयुक्तौ connecting to each other, गजेन्द्रपोताविव like Lordly elephants, तावुरोभ्याम् through their shoulders, चापीड्य hitting, संवेद्यच and hurting each other, युगपत् simultaneously at once, धरायाम् holding one another, पेततुःवै fell on the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उद्यम्यचान्योन्यमधिक्षिपन्तौसञ्चक्रमातेबहुयुद्धमार्गे: । व्यायामशिक्षाबलसम्प्रयुक्तौक्लमंनतौजग्मतुराशुवीरौ ।।6.40.20।।
output: Both of them were holding one another, snubbing each other gradually following many kinds of combat. As both the heroes were well trained in wrestling and fighting, they did not feel tiresome.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 40:
बाहूत्तमैर्वारणवारणाभैर्निवारयन्तौवरवारणाभौ । चिरेणकालेनतुसम्प्रयुक्तौसञ्चेरतुर्मण्डलमार्गमाशु ।।6.40.21।।
output: Both Ravana and Sugriva endowed with mighty arms, were resisting each other, and keeping away one another engaging in comb at for a long time. They kept on moving, going around each other swiftly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तौपरस्परमासाद्ययत्तावन्योन्यसूदने । मार्जाराविवभक्ष्यार्थेऽवितस्थातेमुहुर्मुहुः ।।6.40.22।।
output: अन्योन्यसूदने intending to destroy each other, यत्तौ approaching each other, तौ both, परस्परम् one another, आसाद्य to kill, भक्ष्यार्थे for the sake of food, मार्जाराविव like cats, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अवितस्थाते falsely.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मण्डलानिविचित्राणिस्थानानिविविधानिच । मूत्रकाणिचित्राणिगतप्रत्यागतानिच ।।6.40.23।। तिरच्शीनगतान्येवतथावक्रगतानिच । परिमोक्षंप्रहाराणांवर्जनंपरिधावनम् ।।6.40.24।। अभिद्रवणमाप्लावमावस्थानंसविग्रहम् । परावृत्तमपावृत्तमपद्रुतमवप्लुतम् ।।6.40.25।। उपन्यस्तपमन्यस्तंयुद्धमार्गविशारदौ । तौसञ्चेचेरतुरन्योन्यंवानरेन्द्रश्चरावणः ।।6.40.26।।
output: युद्धमार्गविशारदौ learned in war craft, तौ both, वानरेन्द्रश्च Vanara king's, रावणः Ravana, विचित्राणि wonderful, मण्डलानि circles, विविधानि many, स्थानानि postures, चित्राणि wonderful, गोमूत्रकाणि ox's urine, गतप्रत्यागतानिच forward and backward movements, तिरच्शीनगतान्येव horizontal and oblique movement, तथा similarly, वक्रगतानिच roundabout and evasive movements, प्रहाराणाम् hitting, परिमोक्षम् delivering, वर्जनम् abandoning, परिधावनम् striking, अभिद्रवणम् assaulting, आप्लावम् jumping, सविग्रहम् motionless, अवस्थानम् standing steadily, परावृत्तम् , अपावृत्तम् going away circling round, अपद्रुतम् going backwards, अवप्लुतम् jumping behind, उपन्यस्तम् holding the hand, अपन्यस्तम् folding the hand, सञ्चेरतुः exhibiting.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 40:
मण्डलानिविचित्राणिस्थानानिविविधानिच । मूत्रकाणिचित्राणिगतप्रत्यागतानिच ।।6.40.23।। तिरच्शीनगतान्येवतथावक्रगतानिच । परिमोक्षंप्रहाराणांवर्जनंपरिधावनम् ।।6.40.24।। अभिद्रवणमाप्लावमावस्थानंसविग्रहम् । परावृत्तमपावृत्तमपद्रुतमवप्लुतम् ।।6.40.25।। उपन्यस्तपमन्यस्तंयुद्धमार्गविशारदौ । तौसञ्चेचेरतुरन्योन्यंवानरेन्द्रश्चरावणः ।।6.40.26।।
output: Both Vanara king and Ravana being learned in war craft, went around in circles like ox's urine, stood in different wonderful postures, moved forward and backward horizontally and obliquely to evade movements, hitting, and delivering each other, standing steadily motionless, striking, jumping, assaulting each other coming forward and going away, going backwards jumping from behind, holding hands and folding to resist exhibiting their skill in combat.

output: Both Vanara king and Ravana being learned in war craft, went around in circles like ox's urine, stood in different wonderful postures, moved forward and backward horizontally and obliquely to evade movements, hitting, and delivering each other, standing steadily motionless, striking, jumping, assaulting each other coming forward and going away, going backwards jumping from behind, holding hands and folding to resist exhibiting their skill in combat.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरेरक्षोमायाबलमथात्मनः । आरब्धुमुपसंपेदेज्ञात्वातंवानराधिपः ।।6.40.27।। उत्पपाततदाकाशंजितकाशीजितक्लमः । रावणःस्थितएवात्रहरिराजेववञ्चितः ।।6.40.28।।
output: In the meantime, Ravana thought of exhibiting his superiority by jugglery and jumped to the sky. Knowing that Sugriva, the untiring Vanara king assumed the air of victor and rose up to the sky. Baffled Ravana stood thinking Sugriva would come there.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथहरिवरनाथःप्राप्यसङ्ग्रामकीर्तिंनिशिचरपतिमाजौयोजयित्वाश्रमेण । गगनमतिविशालंलङ्घयित्वार्कसूनुर्हरिगणमध्येरामपार्श्वंजगाम ।।6.40.29।।
output: अथ and then, हरिनरनाथः Lord of Vanara chiefs, अर्कसूनुः son of Sun god, प्राप्यसङ्ग्रामकीर्तिः who had won fame in winning battles, आजौ victorious, निशिचरपतिम् Lord of night rangers, श्रमेण exhausting, योजयित्वा travelling, अतिविशालम् extensive, गगनम् sky, लङ्घयित्वा flying, हरिगणबलमध्ये in the midst of Vanara army, रामपार्श्वम् side of Rama, जगाम reached.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इतिससवितृसूनुस्तत्रतत्कर्मकृत्वापवनगतिरनीकंप्राविशत्ससम्प्रहृष्टः । रघुवरनृपसूनोद्वर्धयन्युद्धहर्षंतरुमृगगणमुख्यैःपूज्यमानोहरीन्द्रः ।।6.40.30।।
output: Sugriva the son of the Sun god, having completed the feat, rejoiced by increasing the joy of foremost of Raghus. Then he who is adored by the monkey chiefs entered the army of Vanaras. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fortieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथतस्मिन्निमित्तानिदृष्टवालक्ष्मणपूर्वजः । सुग्रीवंसम्परिष्वज्यतथावचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.41.1।।
output: Sri Rama warns Sugriva against such action being a king and commands Vanara army generals to besiege all the four gates of Lanka. Angada is sent to Ravana to communicate Rama's message that unless Ravana returns Sita back to Rama, he will be killed and Vibheeshana will be made the king of Lanka.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
असन्त्ऱ्यमयासार्थंतदिदंसाहसंकृतम् । एवंसाहसुक्तानिनकुर्वन्तिजनेश्वराः ।।6.41.2।।
output: "You have done this courageous feat without consulting me. Rulers do not do such actions."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
संशयेस्थाप्यमांचेदंबलंचसविभीषणम् । कष्टंकृतमिदंवीर साहसंसाहसप्रिय ।।6.41.3।।
output: "O hero, who is fond of daring actions! To me, to the army and Vibheeshana you created a great doubt by this bold action of yours."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
इदानींमाकृथावीर एवंविधमचिन्तितम् । त्वयिकिञ्चित्समापन्नेकिंकार्यंसीतयामम ।।6.41.4।। भरतेनमहाबाहो लक्ष्मणेनयवीयसा । शत्रुघ्नेनचशत्रुघ्नस्वशरीरेणवापुन:।। 6.41.5।।
output: "O broad shouldered hero, tamer of foes! Do not do this kind of action. Even if you were harmed a bit, O destroyer of foes, of what use is it to me or even to Sita, Bharata, Satrughna or to Lakshmana or even to my body?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदानींमाकृथावीर एवंविधमचिन्तितम् । त्वयिकिञ्चित्समापन्नेकिंकार्यंसीतयामम ।।6.41.4।। भरतेनमहाबाहो लक्ष्मणेनयवीयसा । शत्रुघ्नेनचशत्रुघ्नस्वशरीरेणवापुन:।। 6.41.5।।
output: अरिन्दम tamer of foes, वीर hero, इदानीम् here after, एवंविधम् this kind of, माकृथाः not do, महाबाहो broad shouldered, शत्रुघ्न destroyer of foes, त्वयि your, किञ्चित् even a little, समापन्ने harm, मम my, सीतया Sita, भरतेन also Bharata, यवीयसा, लक्ष्मणेन even Lakshmana, शत्रुघ्नेन and Satrughna also, स्वशरीरेणवा my own body पुनः again, किंकार्यम् What is the use?

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वयिचानागतेपूर्वमितिमेनिश्चितामतिः । जानतश्चापितेवीर्यंमहेन्द्रवरुणोसम ।।6.41.6।। हत्वाऽहंरावणंयुद्धेसपुत्रबलवाहनम् । अभिषिच्यचलङ्कायांविभीषणमथापिच ।।6.41.7।। भरतेराज्यमावेश्यत्यक्ष्येदेहंमहाबल ।
output: "Mighty Sugriva! You resemble Indra and Varuna in might. Your valour is known to me. I have decided in my mind to kill the sons of Ravana and his relatives in battle, coronate Vibheeshana in Lanka, and hand over the kingdom to Bharata and give up my body."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वयिचानागतेपूर्वमितिमेनिश्चितामतिः । जानतश्चापितेवीर्यंमहेन्द्रवरुणोसम ।।6.41.6।। हत्वाऽहंरावणंयुद्धेसपुत्रबलवाहनम् । अभिषिच्यचलङ्कायांविभीषणमथापिच ।।6.41.7।। भरतेराज्यमावेश्यत्यक्ष्येदेहंमहाबल ।
output: "Mighty Sugriva! You resemble Indra and Varuna in might. Your valour is known to me. I have decided in my mind to kill the sons of Ravana and his relatives in battle, coronate Vibheeshana in Lanka, and hand over the kingdom to Bharata and give up my body."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
तमेवंवादिनंरामंसुग्रीवःप्रत्यभाषत ।।6.41.8।। तवभार्यापहर्तारंदृष्टवाराघव रावणम् । मर्षयामिकथंवीरजानपौरुषमात्मनः ।।6.41.9।।
output: To Rama who was speaking in that manner, Sugriva replied, "Heroic Rama! Seeing that Ravana, who has borne away your consort, and knowing my own strength, how can I tolerate?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमेवंवादिनंरामंसुग्रीवःप्रत्यभाषत ।।6.41.8।। तवभार्यापहर्तारंदृष्टवाराघव रावणम् । मर्षयामिकथंवीरजानपौरुषमात्मनः ।।6.41.9।।
output: एवंवादिनम् told in that manner, तम् by, रामम् Rama, सुग्रीवः to Sugriva, प्रत्यभाषत replied, वीर hero, राघव Raghava, तव your, भार्यापहर्तारम् borne away your consort, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, आत्मनः I myself, बलम् strength, जानन् knowing, कथम् how can, मर्षयामि tolerate.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्येवंवादिनंवीरमभिनन्द्यचराघवः । लक्ष्मणंलक्षीसम्पन्नमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.41.10।।
output: राघवः Raghava, इत्येवंवादिनम् thus spoken, वीरम् hero, अभिनन्द्य applauding, लक्ष्मिसम्पन्नम् endowed with prosperity, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
परिगृह्योदकंशीतंवनानिफलवन्तिच । बलौघंसंविभज्येमंव्यूह्यतिष्ठेमलक्ष्मण ।।6.41.11।।
output: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, शीतम् cool, उदकम् water, फलवन्ति good fruits, वनानिच woods, परिगृह्य occupying, इमम् this, बलौघम् army, संविभज्य divide, व्यूह्य plan, तिष्ठाम be ready.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
लोकक्षयकरंभीमंभयंपश्याम्युपस्थितम् । निबर्हणंप्रवीराणामृक्षवानररक्षसाम् ।।6.41.12।।
output: "I foresee the terrific destruction of eminent heroes among Bears, monkeys and Rakshasas. I see the danger approaching."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वाताश्चहिपरुषांवान्तिकम्पतेचवसुन्धरा । पर्वताग्राणिवेपन्तेपतन्तिधरणीधराः ।।6.41.13।।
output: वाताः winds, परुषम् severely, वान्ति blowing, वसुन्धराच in the earth, कम्पते quacking, पर्वताग्राणि mountain peaks, वेपन्ते shaking, धरणीधराः those elephants bearing the earth, पतन्ति falling.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मेघाःक्रवादसङ्काशाःपरुषाःपरुषस्वनाः । क्रूराःक्रूरंप्रवर्षन्तिमिश्रंशोणितबिन्दुभिः ।।6.41.14।।
output: "The fierce clouds resembling wild birds are making terrible harsh sounds and rain mixed with drops of blood is showering."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
रक्तचन्दनसङ्काशासन्ध्यापरमदारुणा । ज्वलच्चनिपतत्येतदादित्यादग्निमण्डलम् ।।6.41.15।।
output: "The twilight appears like red sander trees, the burning fire falling from the sun is like a mass of fire and frightening."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आदित्यमभिवाश्यन्तिजनयन्तोमहद्भयम् । दीनादीनस्वराःघोरानप्रशस्तामृगद्विजाः ।।6.41.16।।
output: दीनाः desperate, दीनस्वराः crying pitifully, घोराः dreadful, नप्रशस्ताः inauspicious, मृगद्विजाः ominous beasts, महत् great, भयम् fear, जनयन्तः creating, आदित्यम् from Sun, अभिवाश्यन्ति facing the Sun.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रजन्यामप्रकाशश्चसन्तापयतिचन्द्रमाः । कृष्णरक्तांशुपर्यन्तोयथालोकस्यसंक्ष्ये ।।6.41.17।।
output: लोकस्य of the universe, संक्ष्येयथा like the dissolution, कृष्णरक्तांशुपर्यन्तः surrounded with black and red halo, अप्रकाशः not radiant, चन्द्रमाः the moon, रजन्याम् in the night, सन्तापयति tormented.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
ह्रस्वोरूक्षोऽप्रशस्तश्चपरिवेषस्सुलोहितः । आदित्यमण्डलेनीलंलक्ष्मलक्ष्मण दृश्यते ।।6.41.18।।
output: "Lakshmana! Short dark spot observed in the Sun 's orbit is inauspicious. moon is surrounded by copper colour and dreary."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दृश्यन्तेनयथावच्छनक्षत्राण्यभिवर्तते । युगान्तमिवलोकस्यपश्यलक्ष्मण शंसति ।।6.41.19।।
output: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, नक्षत्राणि even stars, यथावत् so also, नदृश्यन्ते not visible, लोकस्य in the universe, युगान्तम् end of the universe, शंसतीव spots on the moon, अभिवर्तते dirty, पश्य seen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
काकाश्येनास्तथागृध्रानीचैःपरिपतन्तिच । शिवाश्चाप्यशिवावाचःप्रवदन्तिमहास्वनाः ।।6.41.20।।
output: "The crows, hawks and also vultures are joining lowly animals like jackals and making loud noises which is inauspicious and not good."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
क्षिप्रमद्यदुराधर्षांलङ्कांरावणपालिताम् । अभियामजवेनैवसर्वतोहरिभिर्वृताः ।।6.41.21।।
output: हरिभिः Vanaras, वृताः accompanied by, अद्य now, क्षिप्रम् immediately, दुराधर्षम् difficult to attack, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, लङ्काम् Lanka, सर्वतः all, जवेनैव with good speed, अभियाम march forward.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
शैलैःशूलैश्चखडगैश्चविमुक्स्सैःकपिराक्षसैः । भविष्यत्यावृताभूमिर्मांसशोणितकर्दमा ।।6.41.22।।
output: "The land will remain covered by rocks, tridents, swords hurled by the Vanaras and Rakshasas and with flesh and blood."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
इत्येवंतुवदवनीर्वोलक्ष्मणंलक्ष्मणाग्रजः । तस्मादवातरच्छीघ्रंपर्वताग्रान्महाबलः ।।6.41.23।।
output: Mighty hero Rama, (the elder brother of Lakshmana) said to Lakshmana in this manner (as described earlier) and descended from the peak of the mountain without delay.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवतीर्यचधर्मात्मातस्माच्छैलात्सराघवः । परैःपरमदुर्धर्षंददर्शबलमात्मनः ।।6.41.24।।
output: धर्मात्माच righteous, सःराघवः that Raghava, तस्मात् शैलात् from the mountain, अवतीर्य climbing down, परैः foes, परमदुर्धर्षम् very difficult to assail, आत्मनः in the mind, बलम् army strength, ददर्श reviewed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्नह्यतुससुग्रीवःकपिराजबलंमहत् । कालज्ञोराघवःकालेसंयुगायाभ्यचोदयत् ।।6.41.25।।
output: Raghava, who is knowledgeable of when to do what, motivated the army of Vanaras and Sugriva and ordered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
ततःकालेमहाबाहुर्बलेनमहतावृतः । प्रस्थितःपुरतोधवनीलङ्कामभिमुखःपुरीम् ।।6.41.26।।
output: Surrounded by a large army in front, the broad shouldered Rama proceeded towards Lanka.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंविभीषणसुग्रीवौहनूमाञ्जाम्बवान्नळ । ऋक्षराजस्तथानीलोलक्ष्मणश्चान्वयुस्तदा ।।6.41.27।।
output: Then Vibheeshana, Sugriva, Hanuman, Jambavan, Nala, Neela in the same way Lakshmana followed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःपशचात्सुमहतीपृतनर् क्षवनौकसाम् । प्रच्छाद्यमहतींभूमिमनुयातिस्मराघवम् ।।6.41.28।।
output: Then the bears, monkeys, covering all over the land went behind Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
शैलशृङ्गाणिशतशःप्रवृद्धांश्चमहीरुहान् । जगृहुःकुञ्जरप्रख्यावानराःपरवारणाः ।।6.41.29।।
output: The monkeys who were of the size of elephants capable of warding off the enemy, bore huge grown up trees in their hands and went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
तौत्वदीर्घेणकालेनभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ । रावणस्यपुरींलङ्कामसेदतुररिन्दमौ ।।6.41.30।।
output: In a short while the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana, tamers of foes reached the city of Lanka.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पताकामालिनींरम्यामुद्यानवनशोभिताम् । चित्रवप्रासुदुष्प्रापमुच्चैःप्राकारतोरणाम् ।।6.41.31।। तांसुरैरपिदुर्धर्षांरामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः । यथानिदेशंसम्पीड्यन्यविशन्तवनौकसः ।।6.41.32।।
output: Commanded by Rama's words the Vanaras remaining in their positions as ordained, entered the wonderful Lanka, which was decorated with flags, embellished with gardens. The defensive walls and arches of the boundary of Lanka were difficult to access even for Devatas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पताकामालिनींरम्यामुद्यानवनशोभिताम् । चित्रवप्रासुदुष्प्रापमुच्चैःप्राकारतोरणाम् ।।6.41.31।। तांसुरैरपिदुर्धर्षांरामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः । यथानिदेशंसम्पीड्यन्यविशन्तवनौकसः ।।6.41.32।।
output: Commanded by Rama's words the Vanaras remaining in their positions as ordained, entered the wonderful Lanka, which was decorated with flags, embellished with gardens. The defensive walls and arches of the boundary of Lanka were difficult to access even for Devatas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लङ्कायास्तूत्तरंद्वारंशैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । रामःसहानुजोधन्वीजुगोपचरुरोधच ।।6.41.33।।
output: Accompanied by his brother Lakshmana, Rama, armed with bow, blocked the northern gate of Lanka which was like a lofty mountain peak and protected.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
लङ्कामुपनिविष्टस्तुरामोदशरथात्मजः । लक्ष्मणानुचरोवीरःपुरींरावणपालिताम् ।।6.41.34।। उत्तरद्वारमासाद्ययत्रतिष्ठतिरावणः । नान्योरामाद्धितद् द्वारंसमर्थःपरिरक्षितुम् ।।6.41.35।। सायुथैराक्षसैर्भीमैरभिगुप्तंसमन्ततः । लघूनांत्रासजननंपाताळमिवदानवैः ।।6.41.36।।
output: (Dasaratha's son) Rama who had Lakshmana as follower reached the northern gate protected by Ravana. Just as the ocean is guarded by Varuna, it was guarded by terrific Rakshasas, who were secretly hiding all over like the Rakshasas in the subterranean region with small amounts of numerous armours for protection. It was not possible for anyone other than Rama to enter.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लङ्कामुपनिविष्टस्तुरामोदशरथात्मजः । लक्ष्मणानुचरोवीरःपुरींरावणपालिताम् ।।6.41.34।। उत्तरद्वारमासाद्ययत्रतिष्ठतिरावणः । नान्योरामाद्धितद् द्वारंसमर्थःपरिरक्षितुम् ।।6.41.35।। सायुथैराक्षसैर्भीमैरभिगुप्तंसमन्ततः । लघूनांत्रासजननंपाताळमिवदानवैः ।।6.41.36।।
output: दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, लक्ष्मणानुचरः follower Lakshmana, वीरः heroic, रामः Rama, रावणः Ravana, यत्र there, तिष्ठति settled, उत्तरद्वारम् at northern gate, आसाद्य having reached, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, तम् that, वरुणेन by Varuna, सागरम् इव like an ocean, भीमम् frightening, सायुधैः guarded by,भीमैः terrific, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, समन्ततः all over, अभिगुप्तम् secretly hidden, दानवैः Rakshasas, पाताळमिव like subterranean, लघूनाम् small pieces, त्रासजननम् numerous, तत् द्वारम् that gateway, परिरक्षितुम् highly protected, रामात् by Rama, अन्यः other than, नसमर्थःहि not possible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लङ्कामुपनिविष्टस्तुरामोदशरथात्मजः । लक्ष्मणानुचरोवीरःपुरींरावणपालिताम् ।।6.41.34।। उत्तरद्वारमासाद्ययत्रतिष्ठतिरावणः । नान्योरामाद्धितद् द्वारंसमर्थःपरिरक्षितुम् ।।6.41.35।। सायुथैराक्षसैर्भीमैरभिगुप्तंसमन्ततः । लघूनांत्रासजननंपाताळमिवदानवैः ।।6.41.36।।
output: दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, लक्ष्मणानुचरः follower Lakshmana, वीरः heroic, रामः Rama, रावणः Ravana, यत्र there, तिष्ठति settled, उत्तरद्वारम् at northern gate, आसाद्य having reached, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, तम् that, वरुणेन by Varuna, सागरम् इव like an ocean, भीमम् frightening, सायुधैः guarded by,भीमैः terrific, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, समन्ततः all over, अभिगुप्तम् secretly hidden, दानवैः Rakshasas, पाताळमिव like subterranean, लघूनाम् small pieces, त्रासजननम् numerous, तत् द्वारम् that gateway, परिरक्षितुम् highly protected, रामात् by Rama, अन्यः other than, नसमर्थःहि not possible.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विन्यस्तानिचयोधानांबहूनिविविधानिच । ददर्शाऽयुधजालानितत्रैवकवचानिच ।।6.41.37।।
output: Rama Saw there, numerous weapons of every kind so also shields for the combatants of war.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पूर्वंतुद्वारमासाद्यनीलोहरिचमूपतिः । अतिष्ठत्सहमैन्देनद्विविदेनचवीर्यवान् ।।6.41.38।।
output: Neela the commanderinchief of the army of monkeys, a valiant one, also Dwivida, and Mainda reached the east gate and remained there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गदोदक्षिणद्वारंजग्राहसुमहाबलः । ऋषभेणगवाक्षेणगजेनगवयेनच ।।6.41.39।।
output: Angada endowed with great prowess along with Rshaba, Gavaksha, Gaja, and Gavaya reached the south gate.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हनुमान् पश्चिमद्वारंररक्षबलवान्कपिः । प्रमाथिप्रषुभ्यांचवीरैरन्यैश्चसङ्गतः ।।6.41.40।।
output: बलवान् mighty, कपिः monkey, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रमाथिप्रषुभ्यांच Pramati and Praghasa, अन्यैः and others, वीरैश्च heroes, सङ्गतः united with, पश्चिमद्वारम् west gate, ररक्ष protected.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
मध्यमेचस्वयंगुल्मेसुग्रीवस्समतिष्ठत । सहसर्वैर्हरिश्रेष्ठैस्सुपर्णश्वसनोपमैः ।।6.41.41।।
output: Sugriva chief of all army and best of the monkey army who was equal to Garuda of beautiful wings, endowed with wind speed remained in the middle (of north and west) post.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराणांतुषटित्रंशत्कोट्यःप्रख्यातयूथपाः । निपीड्योपनिविष्टाश्चसुग्रीवोयत्रवानरः ।।6.41.42।।
output: प्रख्यातयूथपाः renowned generals, वानराणाम् of the Vanaras, षटित्रंशत्कोट्यः thirty six crores, वानरः Vanara, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, यत्र there, निपीड्य stood, उपनिविष्टाः camped.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
शासनेनतुरामस्यलक्ष्मणस्सविभीषणः । द्वारेद्वारेहरीणांतुकोटिंकोटिंन्यवेशयेत् ।।6.41.43।।
output: By the command of Rama, Vibheeshana accompanied by Lakshmana posted crores and crores of Vanaras there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पश्चिमेनतुरामस्यसुषेणःसहजाम्बवान् ।।6.41.44।। आदूरान्मध्यमेगुल्मेतस्थौबहुबलानुगः ।
output: Sushena along with Jambavan and a large army of Vanaras were posted in the centre not far from Rama at the west by Rama's order.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेतुवानरशार्धूलाःशार्दूलाइवदंष्ट्रिणः ।।6.41.45।। गृहीत्वाद्रुमशैलाग्रान्हृष्टायुद्धायतस्थिरे ।
output: शार्दूलाःइव resembling tiger, दंष्ट्रिणः endowed with sharp teeth, ते they, वानरशार्दूलाः tigers among Vanaras, हृष्टाः joyfully, द्रुमशैलाग्रान् trees and peaks of mountains, गृहीत्वा holding, युद्धाय to combat, तस्थिरे waited.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
सर्वेविकृतलाङ्गूलास्सर्वेदंष्ट्रानखायुधा:।। 6.41.46।। सर्वेविकृतचित्राङ्गास्सर्वेचविकृताननाः ।
output: All had their tails lifted unusually, had their nails and teeth sharp as weapons, some had unnatural face, and all of them had distorted eyes (as in fury).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
दशनागबलाःकेचित्केचिद्धशगुणोत्तराः ।।6.41.47।। केचिन्नागसहस्रस्यबभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः ।
output: A few of them were having the strength of ten elephants, some had ten times more than others, and a few were endowed with great strength equal to thousand elephants.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सन्तिचौघबलाःकेचित्केचिच्छतगुणोत्तराः ।।6.41.48।। अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्येतत्रासन्हरियूथपाः
output: Few monkeys had strength of an ogha, some had a hundred times more, and the monkey commanders possessed immeasurable strength.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्भुतश्चविचित्रश्चतेषामासीत्समागमः ।।6.41.49।। तत्रवानरसैन्यानांशलभानामिवोद्यमः ।
output: There it seemed as if a flight of locusts had gathered, with monkey army gathered there. It was amazing and astonishing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
प्रतिपूर्णमिवाकाशंसञ्छन्नेवचमेदिनी ।।6.41.50।। लङ्कापुमनिविष्टैश्चसम्पतद्भिश्चवानरैः ।
output: Vanaras settled in such a way all around Lanka completely covering the land with those already at Lanka.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
शतंशतसहस्राणांपृथगृक्षवनौकसाम् ।।6.41.51।। लङ्काद्वाराङयुपाजग्मुरन्येयोद्धुंसमन्ततः ।
output: A hundred thousand bars and monkeys and several others already gathered at the gates of Lanka to fight proceeded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आवृतस्सगिरिस्सर्वैस्सैस्समन्तात् प्लवङ्गमैः ।।6.41.52।। अयुतानांसहस्रंचपुरींतामभ्यवर्तत ।
output: सःगिरिः that mountain, समन्तात् all over, तैः those, प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, आवृतः surrounded, अयुतानाम् boundary, सहस्रम् all over, ताम् them, पुरीम् city, अभ्यवर्तत to collect information.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
वानरैर्बलवद्भिश्चबभूवद्रुमपाणिभिः ।।6.41.53।। सम्वृतासर्वतोलङ्कादुष्प्रवेशाऽपिवायुना ।
output: Mighty Vanaras holding uprooted trees occupied everywhere and it seemed difficult for even wind to enter Lanka.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसाविस्मयंजग्मुःसहसाऽभिनिपीडिताः ।।6.41.54।। वानरैर्मेघसङ्काशैश्शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः ।
output: Caught by Vanaras like clouds and equalled Indra in valour gave way to wonder for the Rakshasas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महान् शब्दोऽभवत्तत्रबलौघस्याभिवर्ततः ।।6.41.55।। सागरस्येवभिन्नस्ययथास्यात्सलिलस्वनः ।
output: Thereafter with the divisions of the Vanara army moving like the ocean on the mountain peak, appeared like the roaring sound of water in the ocean moving out of boundary.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
तेनशब्देनमहतासप्राकारासतोरणा ।।6.41.56।। लङ्काप्रचलितासर्वासशैलवनकानना ।
output: By the great sound the boundary, the archways and the mountains and forests shook violently.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामलक्ष्मणगुप्तासासुग्रीवेणचवाहिनी ।।6.41.57।। बभूवदुर्धर्षतरासर्वैरपिसुरासुरैः ।
output: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता protected by Rama and Lakshmana, सुग्रीवेणच and Sugriva, सा that, हरिवाहिनी monkey army, सर्वैः all, सुरासुरैरपि Rakshasas and Devatas, दुर्धर्षतरा highly difficult, बभूव became.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राघवःसन्निवेश्यैवंस्वसैन्यंरक्षसांवधे ।।6.41.58।। सम्मन्त्ऱ्यमन्त्रिभिस्सार्थंनिश्चित्यचपुनःपुनः । आनन्तर्यमभिप्रेप्सुःक्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् ।।6.41.59।। विभीषणस्यानुमतेराजधर्ममनुस्मरन् । अङ्गदंवालितनयंसमाहूयेदमब्रवीत् ।।6.41.60।।
output: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
राघवःसन्निवेश्यैवंस्वसैन्यंरक्षसांवधे ।।6.41.58।। सम्मन्त्ऱ्यमन्त्रिभिस्सार्थंनिश्चित्यचपुनःपुनः । आनन्तर्यमभिप्रेप्सुःक्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् ।।6.41.59।। विभीषणस्यानुमतेराजधर्ममनुस्मरन् । अङ्गदंवालितनयंसमाहूयेदमब्रवीत् ।।6.41.60।।
output: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवःसन्निवेश्यैवंस्वसैन्यंरक्षसांवधे ।।6.41.58।। सम्मन्त्ऱ्यमन्त्रिभिस्सार्थंनिश्चित्यचपुनःपुनः । आनन्तर्यमभिप्रेप्सुःक्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् ।।6.41.59।। विभीषणस्यानुमतेराजधर्ममनुस्मरन् । अङ्गदंवालितनयंसमाहूयेदमब्रवीत् ।।6.41.60।।
output: क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् deliberating the action repeatedly, राघवः Raghava, स्वम् himself, सैन्यम् army, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वधे to kill, एवम् in the same way, संनिवेश्य gathering together, मन्त्रिभिः even ministers सार्थम् all of them, पुनःपुनः again and again, सम्मन्त्ऱ्य discussing, निश्चित्य decision taken, अनन्तर्यम् later, अभिप्रेप्सुः recalling राजधर्मम् king's duty, अनुस्मरन् calling, विभीषणस्य with Vibhishana, अनुमते per mission, वालितनयम् Vali's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, समाहूय summoning, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
गत्वासौम्य दशग्रीवंब्रूहिमद्वचनात्कपे । लङ्घयित्वापुरींलङ्कांभयंत्यक्त्वागतव्यधः ।।6.41.61।। भ्रष्टश्रीक गतैश्वर्य मुमूर्षो नष्टचेतनः ।
output: "O noble Hanuman crossing over Lanka without fear, giving up the difficulties experienced earlier we reached. Admonish the tenheaded king who has lost senses, his past fortune and sovereignty."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋषीणांदेवतानांचगन्धर्वाप्सरसांतथा ।।6.41.62।। नागानामथयक्षाणांराज्ञांचरजनीचर । यच्चपापंकृतंमोहादवलिप्तेनराक्षस ।।6.41.63।। नूनंतेविगतोदर्पःस्वयम्भुवरदानजः । तस्यपापस्यसम्प्राप्ताव्युष्टिरद्यदुरसदा ।।6.41.64।।
output: रजनीचर night ranger, ऋषीणाम् for the sages, देवतानाम् Devatas, तथा so also, गन्धर्वाप्सरसाम् Gandharvas and celestial beauties, नागानाम् Nagas, अथ and, यक्षाणाम् Yakshas, राज्ञांच and kings, मोहात् because of delusion, अवलिप्तेन conceited, यत् that, पापम् sin, कृतम् done, तस्य by him, पापस्य sin's, दुरासदा dangerous to approach, व्युष्टिः boon, अद्य obtained, सम्प्राप्ता begotten, नूनम् surely, ते those, स्वयम्भुवरदानजः granted by self born creator, दर्पः pride, विगतः has gone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋषीणांदेवतानांचगन्धर्वाप्सरसांतथा ।।6.41.62।। नागानामथयक्षाणांराज्ञांचरजनीचर । यच्चपापंकृतंमोहादवलिप्तेनराक्षस ।।6.41.63।। नूनंतेविगतोदर्पःस्वयम्भुवरदानजः । तस्यपापस्यसम्प्राप्ताव्युष्टिरद्यदुरसदा ।।6.41.64।।
output: "O night ranger! the time has come for punishment for the sins committed by you to the sages, Devatas, so also to Gandharvas, celestial beauties, Nagas, Yakshas and the kings because of your delusion in conceit. Surely your pride about the boons begotten from the selfborn creator will be gone, said Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋषीणांदेवतानांचगन्धर्वाप्सरसांतथा ।।6.41.62।। नागानामथयक्षाणांराज्ञांचरजनीचर । यच्चपापंकृतंमोहादवलिप्तेनराक्षस ।।6.41.63।। नूनंतेविगतोदर्पःस्वयम्भुवरदानजः । तस्यपापस्यसम्प्राप्ताव्युष्टिरद्यदुरसदा ।।6.41.64।।
output: "O night ranger! the time has come for punishment for the sins committed by you to the sages, Devatas, so also to Gandharvas, celestial beauties, Nagas, Yakshas and the kings because of your delusion in conceit. Surely your pride about the boons begotten from the selfborn creator will be gone, said Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यदण्डधरस्तेऽहंदाराहरकर्शितः । दण्डंधारयमाणस्तुलङ्काद्वारेव्यवस्थितः ।।6.41.65।।
output: "You, who have abducted my wife, I will punish you with a rod of punishment. I am your chastiser, O king of Lanka I have taken position."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पदवींदेवतानांचमहर्षीणांचराक्षस । राजर्षीणांचसर्वेषांगमिष्यसिमयाहतः ।।6.41.66।।
output: "O Rakshasa! Even Devatas, sages and even royal sages have also lost their lives, killed by me."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बलेनयेनवैसीतांमाययाराक्षसाधम । यामतिक्रामयित्वात्वंहृतवांस्तद्विदर्शय ।।6.41.67।।
output: "O lowly Rakshasa! By deceiving me you took away Sita. Display that strength now."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
अराक्षसमिमंलोकंकर्तास्मिनिशितैःशरैः । नचेच्छरणमभ्येषितामादायतुमैथिलीम् ।।6.41.68।।
output: "If you do not seek my protection I will devoid this world of Rakshasas with my sharp arrows."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
धर्मात्माराक्षसश्रेष्ठःसम्प्राप्तोऽयंविभीषणः । लङ्कैश्वर्यंधृवंश्रीमानयंप्राप्नोत्यकण्डकम् ।।6.41.69।।
output: "This Vibheeshana, the best of Rakshasas will be glorious and fortunate undoubtedly having got the kingdom of Lanka."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
नहिराज्यमधर्मेणभोक्तुंक्षणमपित्वया । शक्यंमूर्खसहायेनपापेनाविदितात्मना ।।6.41.70।।
output: "One who is not aware of himself, an unrighteous sinner ruling with foolish mates cannot enjoy the kingdom even for a moment."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
युध्यस्ववाधृतिंकृत्वाशौर्यमालम्ब्यराक्षस । मच्छरैस्त्वंरणेशान्तस्ततःशान्तोभविष्यसि ।।6.41.71।।
output: "O Rakshasa! You are resorting to fortitude and valour and embracing gallantry in war. By my arrows you will obtain peace (in death)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यद्वाविशसिलोकांस्त्रीन्पक्षीभूतोमनोजवः । ममचक्षुष्पथंप्राप्यनजीवन्प्रतियास्यसि ।।6.41.72।।
output: "O Ravana! You have no control over your mind, and if you come in the range of my eyesight and enter the three worlds also you will not go alive again."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्रवीमित्वांहितंवाक्यंक्रियतामौर्ध्वदैहिकम् । सुदृष्टाक्रियतांलङ्काजीवितंतेमयिस्थितम् ।।6.41.73।।
output: Having addressed it in well meaning words, Rama said 'I will do you obsequies as no one will be left in Lanka to do your last rites'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
इत्युक्तःसतुतारेयोरामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । जगामाकाशामाविश्यमूर्तिमानिवहव्यवाट् ।।6.41.74।।
output: Rama having spoken that way, Tara's son, Angada, who was like fire god, who was unwearied in action flew to the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽतिपत्यमुहूर्तेनश्रीमान्रावणमन्दिरम् । ददर्शासीनमव्यग्रंरावणंसचिवैःसह ।।6.41.75।।
output: श्रीमान् prosperous, सः that he, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, रावणमन्दिरम् Ravana's palace, अतिपत्य having landed, सचिवैःसह with his ministers, आसीनम् seated, रावणम् Ravana, अव्यग्रम् tiger, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तस्य I विदूरेणनिपत्यसहरिपुङ्गवः । दीप्ताग्निसदृशस्तस्थावङ्गदःकनकाङ्गदः ।।6.41.76।।
output: ततः thereafter, सहरिपुङ्गवः that leader of monkeys, दीप्ताग्निसदृशः blazing like fire, कनकाङ्गदः adorned with golden armlets, अङ्गदः Angada, तस्य his, अविदूरेण at a short distance, निपत्य landed, तस्थौ stood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्रामवचनंसर्वमन्यूनाधिकमुत्तमम् । सामात्यंश्रावयामासनिवेद्यात्मानमात्मना ।।6.41.77।।
output: "I made known the words of Rama completely without adding or deleting. You may listen."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
दूतोऽहंकोशलेन्द्रस्यरामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । वालिपुत्रोऽङ्गदोनामयदितेश्रोत्रमागतः ।।6.41.78।।
output: "I am the son of Vali,by name Angada,an envoy of Rama ,the king of Kosala of unwearied action. You may know that I have landed"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
अहत्वांराघवोरामःकौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः । निष्पत्यप्रतियुध्यस्वनृशंस पुरुषोभव ।।6.41.79।।
output: "Raghava, the enhancer of the happiness of Kausalya speaks to you. Ruthless Rakshasa! Sallying forth, get ready for combat."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हन्तास्मित्वांसहामात्यंसपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवम् । निरुद्विग्नास्त्रयोलोकाभविष्यन्तिहतेत्वयि ।।6.41.80।।
output: "You and your son's relatives and followers being killed (by me) the three worlds will be rid of fear of you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
देवदानवयक्षाणांगन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । शत्रुमद्योद्धरिष्यामित्वामृषीणांचकण्टकम् ।।6.41.81।।
output: "You are an enemy of the gods, Danavas and Yakshas, Gandharvas and Nagas and being a thorn in the neck of sages, I will uproot you from here."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
विभीषणस्यचैश्वर्यंभविष्यतिहतेत्वयि । नचेत्सत्कृत्यवैदेहींप्रणिपत्यप्रदास्यसि ।।6.41.82।।
output: "Unless you return back Vaidehi respectfully, bowing down to me you will be killed and Vibheeshana will get the fortune."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्येवंपरुषंवाक्यंब्रुवाणेहरिपुङ्गवे । अमर्षवशमापन्नोनिशाचरगणेश्वरः ।।6.41.83।।
output: The leader of the monkeys having spoken in that manner, Ravana the ruler of night rangers was overtaken by fury.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्सरोषताम्राक्षश्शशापसचिवांन्नोस्तदा । गृह्यतामेषदुर्मेधावध्यतामितिचासकृत् ।।6.41.84।।
output: ततः thereafter, रोषम् shaken by fury, आपन्नः overtaken, सः he, तदा then, एष in this way, सचिवान् ministers, असकृत् repeatedly, शशास commanded, दुर्मेधाः evil minded, गृह्यताम् seize him, वध्यताम् kill him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणस्यवच्शुत्वादीप्ताग्निसमतेजसा । जगृहुस्तंततोघोराश्चत्वारोरजनीचराः ।।6.41.85।।
output: Thereafter, having heard the words of Ravana, the four Rakshasas seized Angada blazing in brilliance like fire.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ग्राहयामासतारेयस्स्वयमात्मनमात्मवान् । बलंदर्शयितुंवीरोयातुधानगणेतदा ।।6.41.86।।
output: तदा then, आत्मवान् himself, वीरः heroic, तारेयः son of Tara, यातुधानगणे in the presence of Rakshasa army, बलम् strength, दर्शयितुम् to exhibit, स्वयम् on his own, आत्मानम् by his, ग्राहयामास allowed to be caught.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतान्बाहुद्वयासक्तानादायपतगानिव । प्रासादंशैलसङ्कामुत्पपाताङ्गदस्तदा ।।6.41.87।।
output: Then Angada holding the Rakshasas by his arms came down like birds on the roof of the palace which stood like a mountain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेन्तरिक्षाद्विनिर्धूतास्तस्यवेगेनराक्षसाः । भूमौनिपतिताःसर्वेराक्षसेन्द्रस्यपश्यतः ।।6.41.88।।
output: तेन by that, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, तस्य its, निर्धूता crushed, वेगेन speed, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa king's, तस्य from (the mountain), तत्र there, सर्वे all, भूमौ on the ground, निपतिताः fell.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
ततःप्रासादशिखरंशैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । ददर्शराक्षसेन्द्रस्यवालिपुत्रःप्रतापवान् ।।6.41.89।।
output: Then as the courageous Vali's son landed on the high peak of the palace which resembled a mountain peak, Ravana stood looking.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
तत्पफालपदाक्रान्तंदशग्रीवस्यपश्यतः । पुराहिमवतश्शृङ्गंवज्रिणेवविदारितम् ।।6.41.90।।
output: As Ravana was looking, Angada trampling his feet gave way to the palace just as Himalayan peak broke to hit Indra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
भङ् क्त्वाप्रासादशिखरंनामविश्राव्यचात्मनः । विनद्यसुमहानादमुत्पपातविहायसम् ।।6.41.91।।
output: Hitting on the peak of the palace, Angada declaring his own name emitting loud sound rose up to the sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्यथयन्राक्षसान्सर्वान्हर्षयंश्चापिवानरान् । सवानराणांमध्येतुरामपार्श्वमुपागतः ।।6.41.92।।
output: Angada caused pain to the Rakshasas and delighted the monkeys and returned to the midst of Vanaras near Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
रावणस्तुपरंचक्रेक्रोधंप्रासादधर्षणात् । विनाशंचात्मनःपश्यन्निश्श्वासपरमोऽभवत् ।।6.41.93।।
output: Ravana exhibiting extreme anger at the shattering of his palace and seeing his destruction started sighing heavily.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्तुबहुभिर्हृष्टर्निनदद्भिःप्लवङ्गमैः । वृतोरिपुवधाकाङ्क्षीयुद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत ।।6.41.94।।
output: Delighted by the roaring sound of many monkeys Rama awaited surrounded by groups of monkeys desirous of starting war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
सुषेणस्तुमहावीर्योगिरिकूटोपमोहरिः । बहुभिःसम्वृतस्तत्रवानरैःकामरूपिभिः ।।6.41.95।।
output: Sushena of great prowess, who resembled a mountain in form stood there surrounded by many Vanaras who could change their form at their will.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सचतुर्द्वाराणिसर्वाणिसुग्रीववचनात्कपिः । पर्यक्रामतदुर्धर्षोनक्षत्राणीवचन्द्रमाः ।।6.41.96।।
output: दुर्धर्षः one who is difficult to encounter, कपिः monkey, सुग्रीववचनात् by the command of Sugriva, चतुर्द्वाराणि the four gates, सर्वाणि all, चन्द्रमाः moon, नक्षत्राणीव stars, पर्यक्रामत moves around.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 41:
तेषामक्षौहिणिशतंसमवेक्ष्यवनौकसाम् । लङ्कामुपनिविष्टानांसागरंचानिवर्तताम् ।।6.41.97।। राक्षसाविस्मयंजग्मुस्त्रासंजग्मुस्तथापरे । अपरेसमरोध्धर्षाद्धर्षमेवप्रपेदिरे ।।6.41.98।।
output: Seeing the large army of a hundred Akshauhinis of monkeys staying near Lanka spreading beyond the sea waiting for war the Rakshasas were wonder struck, some feared, some were alarmed to witness the jubilant Vanaras who exhibited joy alone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषामक्षौहिणिशतंसमवेक्ष्यवनौकसाम् । लङ्कामुपनिविष्टानांसागरंचानिवर्तताम् ।।6.41.97।। राक्षसाविस्मयंजग्मुस्त्रासंजग्मुस्तथापरे । अपरेसमरोध्धर्षाद्धर्षमेवप्रपेदिरे ।।6.41.98।।
output: Seeing the large army of a hundred Akshauhinis of monkeys staying near Lanka spreading beyond the sea waiting for war the Rakshasas were wonder struck, some feared, some were alarmed to witness the jubilant Vanaras who exhibited joy alone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृत्स्नंहिकपिभिर्व्याप्तंप्राकारपरिखान्तरम् । ददृशूराक्षसादीनाःप्राकारंनानरीकृतम् ।।6.41.99।। हाहाकारंप्रकुर्वन्तिराक्षसाभयमोहिताः ।
output: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, दीनाः desperate, कपिभिः even monkeys, व्याप्तम् spread over, कृत्स्नम् dark, प्राकारपरिखान्तरम् entire area from the boundary and moat, नानरीकृतम् filled with monkeys, प्राकारम् boundary, ददृशुः saw, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, भयम् fear, आगताः reached, हाहाकारम् making noise, प्रकुर्वन्ति converted to defensive walls.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
ततस्तेराक्षसास्तत्रगत्वारावणमन्दिरम् । न्यवेदयन्पुरींरुद्धांरामेणसहवानरैः ।।6.42.1।।
output: Then the Rakshasas proceeding to Ravana's abode informed that Rama along with the vanaras have occupied the whole of Lanka.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रुद्धांतुनगरींश्रुत्वाजातक्रोधोनिशाचरः । विधानंद्विगुणंश्रुत्वाप्रासादंसोऽध्यरोहत ।।6.42.2।।
output: रुद्धां occupied, तु also, नगरीं city, श्रुत्वा hearing, जातक्रोधो very furious, निशाचरः night ranger, विधानं knowing, द्विगुणं twice, श्रुत्वा hearing, प्रासादं top of the mansion, अध्यरोहत planning for the protection of Lanka.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
सददर्शावृतांलङ्कांसशैलवनकाननाम् । असङ्ख्येयैर्हरिगणैःसर्वतोयुद्धकाङ्क्षिभिः ।।6.42.3।।
output: He observed a countless number of Vanara troops spread all over Lanka, mountains, and forests.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सदृष्ट्वावानरैःसर्वांवसुधांकवलीकृताम् । कथंक्षपयितव्याःस्युरितिचिन्तापरोऽभवत् ।।6.42.4।।
output: Seeing the Vanaras occupying the entire earth, Ravana thought of destroying and started thinking.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सचिन्तयित्वासुचिरंधैर्यमालम्ब्यरावणः । राघवंहरियूथांश्चददर्शायतलोचनः ।।6.42.5।।
output: स: he, रावणः Ravana, सुचिरं for long, चिन्तयित्वा thinking over, धैर्यमालम्ब्य picking up courage, अयतलोचनः with thoughtful eyes, राघवं Raghava, हरियूथांश्च at the Vanaras, ददर्शा saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
राघवःसहसैन्येनमुदितोनामपुप्लुवे । लङ्कांददर्शगुप्तांवैसर्वतोराक्षसैर्वृताम् ।।6.42.6।।
output: Raghava accompanied by the army happily went near and witnessed Lanka filled with Rakshasas all over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
दृष्ट्वादाशरथिर्लङ्कांचित्रध्वजपताकिनीम् । जगामसहसासीतांदूयमानेनचेतसा ।।6.42.7।।
output: The son of Dasaratha saw Lanka decorated with flags and posts and thinking of Sita he became very worried.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अत्रसामृगशावाक्षीमत्कृतेजनकात्मजा । पीड्यतेशोकसन्तप्ताकृशास्थण्डिलशायिनी ।।6.42.8।।
output: अत्र here, सा she, मृगशावाक्षी dove eyed, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, पीड्यते tormented, मत्कृते because of me, शोकसन्तप्ता immersed in sorrow, कृशा emaciated, स्थण्डिलशायिनी without food struggling.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पीड्यमानांसधर्मात्मावैदेहीमनुचिन्तयन् । क्षिप्रमाज्ञापयामासवानरान्द्विषतांवधे ।।6.42.9।।
output: धर्मात्मा righteous, स: he (Rama), पीड्यमानां pained, वैदेहीम Vaidehi, अचिन्तयन् thinking of very much, क्षिप्रमाज्ञापयामास immediately ordered, वानरान् Vanaras, द्विषतां enemies, वधे to kill.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तेतुवचनेरामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । संघर्षमाणाःप्लवगाःसिम्हनादैरनादयन् ।।6.42.10।।
output: क्लिष्टकर्मणा one who does not cause sorrow, एवमुक्ते having ordered that way तु, वचने his words, प्लवगाः monkeys, संघर्षमाणाः getting ready for war, सिम्हनादैरनादयन् roared like a lion

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
शिखरैर्विकिरामैनांलङ्कांमुष्टिभिरेववा । इतिस्मदधिरेसर्वेमनांसिहरियूथपाः ।।6.42.11।।
output: The monkey troops thought of crushing Lanka with their fists and mountain peaks.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
उद्यम्यगिरिशृङ्गाणिशिखराणिमहान्तिच । तरूंश्चोत्पाट्यविविधांस्तिष्ठन्तिहरियूथपाः ।।6.42.12।।
output: Holding the mountain peaks, huge trees of many kinds, the Vanara leaders stood ready to fight.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रेक्षतोराक्षसेन्द्रस्यतान्यनीकानिभागशः । राघवप्रियकामार्थंलङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा ।।6.42.13।।
output: To make Rama happy, all the Vanara army divided into groups and started ascending the boundary (of Lanka) walls the king of Rakshasas was witnessing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेताम्रवक्त्राहेमाभारामार्थेत्यक्तजीविताः । लङ्कामेवाभ्यवर्तन्तसालतालशिलायुधाः ।।6.42.14।।
output: Vanaras of copper colour faces and golden coloured ones, dedicating their lives for the sake of Rama holding Sala trees and rocks went towards Lanka.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेद्रुमैःपर्वताग्रैश्चमुष्टिभिश्चप्लवङ्गमाः । प्राकाराग्राण्यरण्यानिममन्थुस्तोरणानिच ।।6.42.15।।
output: ते they (Vanaras ), द्रुमैः trees, पर्वताग्रैश्च peaks of mountains, मुष्टिभिश्च even with fists, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, प्राकाराग्रा top of boundary, अरण्यानि forests, ममन्थुस्तोरणानिच gateways of the city

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
पारिखाःपूरयन्तिस्मप्रसन्नसलिलायुताः । पांसुभिःपर्वताग्रैश्चतृणैःकाष्ठैश्चवानराः ।।6.42.16 ।।
output: The Vanaras started filling the moats with soil, pure water, logs of wood, grass, and mountain peaks.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
ततःसहस्रयूथाश्चकोटीयूथाश्चवानराः । कोटीशतयुताश्चान्येलङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा ।।6.42.17।।
output: Then the Vanaras in thousands and crores ascended Lanka.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
काञ्चनानिप्रमृद्नन्तस्तोरणानिप्लवङ्गमाः । कैलासशिखराभानिगोपुराणिप्रमथ्यच ।।6.42.18।।
output: काञ्चनानि golden, प्रमृद्नन्तस्तोरणानि breaking the gateways, कैलासशिखराभानि like the peaks of Kailasa mountain, गोपुराणि towers, प्रमथ्यच crushing, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
आप्लवन्तःप्लवन्तश्चगर्जन्तश्चप्लवङ्गमाः । लङ्कांतामभिधावन्तिमहावारणसंनिभाः ।।6.42.19।।
output: Jumping here and there like huge elephants, the Vanaras roaring like lions went into Lanka.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जयत्यतिबलोरामोलक्ष्मणश्चमहाबलः । राजाजयतिसुग्रीवोराघवेणाभिपालितः ।।6.42.20।।
output: "Victorious is Sri Rama, who is exceedingly strong and Lakshmana who is endowed with supreme strength. Victorious is Sugriva the king of Vanaras who is protected by Raghava on all sides."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्येवंघोषयन्तश्चगर्जन्तश्चप्लवङ्गमाः । अभ्यधावन्तलङ्कायाःप्राकारंकामरूपिणः ।।6.42.21।।
output: Shouting in that manner, the monkeys who could change their form at their will started roaring and rushed towards the defensive walls.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
वीरबाहुःसुबाहुश्चनलश्चवनगोचरः । निपीड्योपनिविष्टास्तेप्राकारंहरियूथपाः । एतस्मिन्नन्तरेचक्रुःस्कन्धावारनिवेशनम् ।।6.42.22 ।।
output: Veerabahu, Subahu, Nala and the foremost of the Vanara leaders storming the boundary walls in the meantime went inside and stationed at the northeast gate.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
पूर्वद्वारंतुकुमुदःकोटीभिर्दशभिर्वृतः । आवृत्यबलवांस्तस्थौहरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः ।।6.42.23।।
output: Kumuda, surrounded by ten crores of mighty monkeys, who appeared like conquerors, stationed at the east gate.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
साहाय्यार्थंतुतस्यैवनिविष्टःप्रघसोहरिः । पनसश्चमहाबाहुर्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।।6.42.24।।
output: प्रघसो Praghasa, हरिः monkey, महाबाहु broad shouldered, पनसश्च Panasa also, वानर Vanaras, साहाय्यार्थं for assisting, तस्यैव himself, निविष्टः encamped, बहुभि many, आर्वृतः surrounded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दक्षिणंद्वारमागम्यवीरःशतबलिःकपिः । आवृत्यबलवांस्तस्थौविंशत्याकोटिभिर्वृतः ।।6.42.25।।
output: वीरः valiant, शतबलिः Satabali, कपिः monkey, विंशत्या twenty, कोटिभि crores, आवृत्य surrounded by, बलवांस्तस्थौ stood besieging, दक्षिणं south, द्वारमागम्य reached the gate.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
सुषेणःपश्चिमद्वारंगतस्तारापिताहरिः । आवृत्यबलवांस्तस्थौषष्टिकोटिभिरावृतः ।।6.42.26।।
output: Sushena, father of Tara, (Vali's wife) the mighty, stood with sixty crores of monkeys at the western gate.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
उत्तरंद्वारमासाद्यरामःसौमित्रिणासह । आवृत्यबलवांस्तस्थौसुग्रीवश्चहरीश्वरः ।।6.42.27।।
output: Reaching the north gate, Sri Rama along with Saumithri, blockading the gate stood Sugriva the Lord of monkeys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गोलाङ्गूलोमहाकायोगवाक्षोभीमदर्शनः । वृतःकोट्यामहावीर्यस्तस्थौरामस्यपार्श्वतः ।।6.42.28।।
output: Gavaksha of gigantic body and fierce appearance, along with one crore of Golangula species of monkeys endowed with extraordinary virility stood by the side of Sri Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋक्षाणांभीमवेगानांधूम्रःशत्रुनिबर्हणः । वृतःकोट्यामहावीर्यस्तस्थौरामस्यपार्श्वतः ।।6.42.29।।
output: Accompanied by a crore of Bears of redoubtable fury, Dhumra (brother of Jambavan), an exterminator of foes endowed with extraordinary valour stood by Rama's side.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सन्नद्धस्तुमहावीर्योगदापाणिर्विभीषणः । वृतोयस्तैस्तुसचिवैस्तस्थौतत्रमहाबलः ।।6.42.30।।
output: वृतो accompanied by, सन्नद्धस्तु defensive clamour, महावीर्यो of extraordinary virility, गदापाणि wielding mace, विर्भीषणः Vibheeshana, यस्तैस्तु stood, सचिवैस्तस्थौ with ministers stood, तत्र there, महाबलः mighty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गजोगवाक्षोगवयःशरभोगन्धमादनः । समन्तात्परिधावन्तोररक्षुर्हरिवाहिनीम् ।।6.42.31।।
output: गजो Gaja, गवाक्षो Gavaksha, गवयः Gava, शरभ Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandamadhana, मन्तात्परिधावन्तो all over wandering, ररक्षु protecting, हर्रिवाहिनीम् monkey troops.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःकोपपरीतात्मारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । निर्याणंसर्वसैन्यानांद्रुतमाज्ञापयत्तदा ।।6.42.32।।
output: ततः thereafter, राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावण Ravana, सर्वसैन्यानां all his forces, निर्याणं to depart, कोपपरीतात्मा overcome by fury, द्रुत to advance, आज्ञापयत्तदा ordered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
एतच्छ्रुत्वाततोवाक्यंरावणस्यमुखोद्गतम् । सहसाभीमनिर्घोषमुद्घुष्टंरजनीचरैः ।।6.42.33।।
output: Hearing the command issued from Ravana's mouth, immediately a terrific roar was raised by the night rangers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःप्रचोदिताभेर्यश्चन्द्रपाण्डरपुष्कराः । हेमकोणाहताभीमाराक्षसानांसमन्ततः ।।6.42.34।।
output: Then shone the white discs like the moon beaten by the Rakshasas with gold sticks making terrific sound.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनेदुश्चमहाघोषाःशङ्खाःशतसहस्रशः । राक्षसानांसुघोराणांमुखमारुतपूरिताः ।।6.42.35।।
output: राक्षसानां Rakshasas, सुघोराणां terrific sounds, शतसहस्रशः hundred thousand, महाघोषाः loud noise, शङ्खाः with conchs, विनेदुश्च sonorous, मुखमारुत with wind from their mouth, पूरिताः blown.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेबभुःशुभनीलाङ्गाःसशङ्खारजनीचराः । विद्युन्मण्डलसन्नद्धाःसबलाकाइवाम्बुदाः ।।6.42.36।।
output: The night rangers with their brilliant dark limbs, with conchs, were like dark clouds provided with armour with flashes of lightning and accompanied by herons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
निष्पतन्तिततःसैन्याहृष्टारावणचोदिताः । समयेपूर्यमाणस्यवेगाइवमहोदधेः ।।6.42.37।।
output: Urged by Ravana, the army then joyfully rushed forth swiftly like a great ocean at the time of universal destruction.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
ततोवानरसैन्येनमुक्तोनादःसमन्ततः । मलयःपूरितोयेनससानुप्रस्थकन्दरः ।।6.42.38।।
output: Thereafter the Vanara army emitted a sound that filled all sides of Malaya Mountain, its major and minor caves.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
शङ्खदुन्दुभिसंघुष्टःसिम्हनादस्तरस्विनाम् । पृथिवींचान्तरिक्षंचसागरंचैवनादयन् ।।6.42.39।।
output: By the blast of conchs and roll of drums, and roar of lions of Vanara and Rakshasa forces it resounded all over the earth, sky and up to the ocean.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गजानांबृंहितैःसार्धंहयानांहेषितैरपि । रथानांनेमिघोषैश्चरक्षसाम्वदनस्वनः ।।6.42.40 ।।
output: गजानां of elephants, बृंहितैः trumpeting, सार्धंहयानां neighing of horses, हेषितैरपि clatter of wheels, रथानां of chariots, नेमिघोषैश्च shout of, रक्षसाम्, Rakshasas, वदनस्वनः resounded in the air.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरेघोरःसङ्ग्रामःसमवर्तत । रक्षसांवानराणांचयथादेवासुरेपुरा ।।6.42.41।।
output: In the meantime, dreadful conflict arose all over between Rakshasas and Vanaras, which was like the conflict between Devas and asuras earlier.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेगदाभिःप्रदीप्ताभिःशक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः । निजघ्नुर्वानरान्घोराःकथयन्तःस्वविक्रमान् ।।6.42.42।।
output: ते the Rakshasas, स्वविक्रमान् vaunting their own prowess, गदाभिः with maces, प्रदीप्ताभिः flaming शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः with javelins, tridents and pikes, निजघ्नु fiercely struck, नरान्घोराः at Vanaras, कथयन्तः attacked.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राजाजयतिसुग्रीवइतिशब्दोमहानभूत् । राजन्जयजयेत्युक्त्वास्वस्वनामकथान्ततः ।।6.42.43।।
output: राजा king, जयति victory, सुग्रीव Sugriva, इति thus, शब्दो sound, महानभूत् be triumphant, राजन् king, जय victorious, जयेत्युक्त्वा saying victory to you, स्वस्वनामकथान्ततः arose war cry from the Vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 42:
तथावृक्षैर्महाकायाःपर्वताग्रैश्चवानराः । निजघ्नुस्तानिरक्षांसिनखैर्दन्तैश्चवेगिताः ।।6.42.44।।
output: Vanaras in the same manner attacked the Rakshasas, with trees and mountains, swiftly and with their nails and teeth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसास्त्वपरेभीमाःप्राकारस्थामहीगतान् । भिन्दिपालैश्चखड्गैश्चशूलैश्चैवव्यदारयन् ।।6.42.45।।
output: राक्षसास्त्वपरे redoubtable Rakshasas, प्राकारस्था standing on the walls, भीमाः dreadful, भिन्दिपालैश्च Bhindipalas (javelin like weapons), खड्गैश्च and swords, शूलैश्चैव with tridents, व्यदारयन् pierced.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराश्चापिसङ्क्रुद्धाःप्राकारस्थान्महीगताः । राक्षसान्पातयामासुःसमाप्लुत्यप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.42.46।।
output: प्राकारस्थान्महीगताः stationed on the boundary walls, वानराश्चापि Vanaras also, राक्षसान्पातयामासुः dragged down the Rakshasas, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, समाप्लुत्य jumping up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ससम्प्रहारस्तुमुलोमांसशोणितकर्दमः । रक्षसांवानराणांचसम्बभूवाद्भुतोपमाः।।6.42.47।।
output: स that, सम्प्रहार conflict, रक्षसां of Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, तमुलो intense, मांस flesh, शोणित blood, कर्दमः like mire, सम्बभूवा that happened, अद्भुतोपमाः was amazing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
युध्यतांतुततस्तेषांवानराणांमहात्मनाम् । रक्षसांसम्बभूवाथबलकोपस्सुदारुणः ।।6.43.1।।
output: Thereafter the gigantic army of Vanaras were fighting with exceedingly terrific Rakshasas and the anguished Rakshasas could not tolerate the sight.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेहयैःकाञ्चनापीडैर्ध्वश्चाग्निशिखोपमैः । रथैश्चादित्यसङ्काशैःकवचैश्चमनोरमैः ।।6.43.2।। निर्ययूराक्षसव्याघ्रानादयन्तोदिशोदश । राक्षसाभीमकर्माणोरावणस्यजयैषिणः ।।6.43.3।।
output: रावणस्य for Ravana, जयैषिणः desiring victory, राक्षसव्याघ्राः tiger among Rakshasas, भीमकर्माणः of terrible deeds, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, काञ्चनापीडैः provided with golden trappings, हयैः horses, अग्निशिखोपमैः like flames of fire, ऊर्ध्वैः posts, आदित्यसङ्काशैः shining like sun's rays, रथैः chariots, मनोरमैः delightful, कवचैश्च shields, दश ten, दिशः directions, नादयन्तः resounding, निर्ययुः sallied forth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेहयैःकाञ्चनापीडैर्ध्वश्चाग्निशिखोपमैः । रथैश्चादित्यसङ्काशैःकवचैश्चमनोरमैः ।।6.43.2।। निर्ययूराक्षसव्याघ्रानादयन्तोदिशोदश । राक्षसाभीमकर्माणोरावणस्यजयैषिणः ।।6.43.3।।
output: Wishing victory for Ravana, the tiger among ogres, the Rakshasas of terrific deeds sallied forth accompanied by horses with golden trappings and seizing posts, which were like flames of fire shining like the sun's rays on the chariots and delightful shields, roaring resounding in all the ten directions.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराणामपिचमूर्बृहतीजयमिच्छताम् । अभ्यधावततांसेनांरक्षसांकामरूपिणम् ।।6.43.4।।
output: जयम् triumph, इच्छताम् wishing, वानराणाम् Vanaras, बृहती powerful, चमूःअपि army too, घोरकर्मणाम् of terrible deeds, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, तांसेनाम् those army, अभ्यधावत went ahead.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरेतेषामन्योन्यमभिधावताम् । रक्षसांवानराणांचद्वन्द्वयुद्धमवर्तत ।।6.43.5।।
output: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे at that time, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिधावताम् facing one over the other, तेषाम् those, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् duel fight, आवर्तत began.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गदेन्द्रजित्सार्धंवालिपुत्रेणराक्षसः । आयुध्यतमहातेजास्त्ऱ्यम्बकेणयथाऽन्तकः ।।6.43.6।।
output: Indrajith, an exceedingly brilliant Rakshasa, contended with Angada, son of Vali just like Lord Siva with and haka, the Lord of death.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
प्रजङ्घेनचसम्पातिर्नित्यंदुर्मर्षणोरणे । जम्बुमालिनमारब्धोहनुमानपिवानरः ।।6.43.7।।
output: Sampathi , who is invariably difficult to encounter in war fought with Prajangha, and Hanuman started with Jambumali.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
संगतस्तुमहाक्रोधोराक्षसोरावणानुजः । समरेतीक्ष्णवेगेनमित्रघ्नेनविभीषणः ।।6.43.8।।
output: Highly furious Rakshasa, Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana fought with Rakshasa, Mitraghna.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
तपनेनगजस्सार्धंराक्षसेनमहाबलः । निकुम्भेनमहातेजानीलोऽपिसमयुध्यत ।।6.43.9।।
output: Gaja of great strength fought with Rakshasa Tapa, and highly energetic Neela fought with Nikumbha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानरेन्द्रस्तुसुग्रीवःप्रघसेनसमागतः । सङ्गतःसमरेश्रीमान्विरूपाक्षेणलक्ष्मणः ।।6.43.10।।
output: Sugriva the Lord of Vanaras fought with Praghana and prosperous Lakshmana fought with Virupaksha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
अग्निकेतुश्चसुदुर्धर्षोरश्मिकेतुश्चराक्षसः । सुप्तघ्नोयज्ञकोपश्चरामेणसहसङ्गताः ।।6.43.11।।
output: Agnikethu, a Rakshasa who is difficult to win over, Rasmikethu, Suptaghna and Yajnakepu waged war with Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
वज्रमुष्टिस्तुमैन्देनद्विविदेनाशनिप्रभः । राक्षसाभ्यांसुघोराभ्यांकपिमुख्यौसमागतौ ।।6.43.12।।
output: Vajramushti with Mainda and Asaniprabhu with Dwivida, the chief of monkeys, fought with the two Rakshasas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वीरःप्रतपनोघोरोराक्षसोरणदुर्धरः । समरेतीक्ष्णवेगेननळेनसमयुध्यत ।।6.43.13।।
output: Heroic and dreadful Pratapana, who is indomitable in the battle, fought with Nala endowed with high speed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धर्मस्यपुत्रोबलवान्सुषेणइतिविश्रुतः । सविद्युन्मालिनासार्धमयुध्यतमहाकपिः ।।6.43.14।। वानराश्चापरेभीमाराक्षसैरपरैस्सह । द्वन्द्वंसमीयुस्सहसायुद्धायबहुभिस्सह ।।6.43.15।।
output: धर्मस्यपुत्रो righteous son, बलवान्सुषेण of mighty Sushena, इति so also, विश्रुतः well known, सविद्युन्मालिना with Vidyunmali, सार्धमयुध्यत fought with, महाकपिः great monkey, घोराः fierce, अपरे other, वानराश्च Vanaras also, बहुभिःसह along with many, युद्धायच fought in war, अपरैः, राक्षसैःसह Rakshasas also, द्वन्द्वंसमीयुः duel fight.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धर्मस्यपुत्रोबलवान्सुषेणइतिविश्रुतः । सविद्युन्मालिनासार्धमयुध्यतमहाकपिः ।।6.43.14।। वानराश्चापरेभीमाराक्षसैरपरैस्सह । द्वन्द्वंसमीयुस्सहसायुद्धायबहुभिस्सह ।।6.43.15।।
output: Mighty Sushena, the righteous son fought with well known Vidyunmali. And fierce monkeys and Rakshasas fought in dual war with each other.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्रासीत्सुमहद्युद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् । रक्षसांवानराणांचवीराणांजयमिच्छताम् ।।6.43.16।।
output: तत्र there, जयम् victory, इच्छताम् longing, वीराणाम् heroes, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, रोमहर्षणम् fierce which made hair stand on end, तुमुलम् confused, सुमहत् great, युद्धम् war, आसीत् happened.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हरिराक्षसदेहेभ्यःप्रभूताःकेशशाद्वलाः । शरीरसङ्घाटावहाःप्रसुस्रुश्शोणितापगाः ।।6.43.17।।
output: In that war, the streams of blood that flowed from the bodies of Vanaras and Rakshasas were strewn like weeds in the form of hair, bearing logs of wood in the form of dead bodies.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अजघानेन्द्रजित्क्रुद्धोवज्रेणेवशतक्रतुः । अङ्गदंगदयावीरंशत्रुसैन्यविदारणम् ।।6.43.18।।
output: क्रुद्धः enraged, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, शतक्रतुः who has done a hundred sacrifices, वज्रेणेव Indra thunderbolt, गदया mace, शत्रुसैन्यविदारणम् destroyer of hostile forces, वीरम् heroic, अङ्गदम् Angada, आजघान struck.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गंरथंसाश्वंससारथिम् । जघानसमरेश्रीमानङ्गदोवेगवान्कपिः ।।6.43.19।।
output: कपिः monkey, अङ्गदः Angada, वेगवान् swiftly, समरे in fight, तस्य his, काञ्चनचित्राङ्गम् bright with gold, साश्वम् horses, ससारथिम् with charioteer, रथम् chariot, जघान destroyed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
सम्पातिस्तुत्रिभिर्भाणैःप्रजङ्घेनसमाहतः । निजघानश्वकर्णेनप्रजङ्घंरणमूर्धनि ।।6.43.20।।
output: While Prajangha injured Sampathi with three arrows, in turn Sampathi killed him with Aswakarna tree in the midst of war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
जम्बुमालीरथस्थस्तुरथशक्त्यामहाबलः । बिबेदसमरेक्रुद्धोहनूमन्तंस्तनान्तरे ।।6.43.21।।
output: Jambumali of extraordinary might mounting on the chariot in the battle pierced Hanuman in his chest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
तस्यतंरथमास्थायहनूमान् मारुतात्मजः । प्रममाथतलेनाशुसहतेनैवरक्षसा ।।6.43.22।।
output: Hanuman the son of wind god, getting on to the chariot quickly destroyed that Rakshasa Jambumali with his palm.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नदन् प्रतपनोघोरोनलंसोप्यन्वधावत । नलःप्रतपनस्याशुपातयामासचक्षुषी ।।6.43.23।।
output: Dreadful Pratapan roared and jumped over Nala. Nala in turn gouged out the eyes of Pratapan.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भिन्नगात्रश्शरैस्तीक्ष्णैःक्षिप्रहस्तेनरक्षसा । ग्रसन्तमिवसैन्यानिप्रघसंवानराधिपः ।।6.43.24।। सुग्रीवस्सप्तपर्णेननिर्भिभेदजघानच ।
output: क्षिप्रहस्तेन as if consuming monkey troops, रक्षसा Rakshasa, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, भिन्नगात्रः opening his throat, वानराधिपः Vanara leader, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सैन्यानि army, ग्रसन्तमिव as if swallowing, प्रघसम् Praghasan, सप्तपर्णेन Sapataparni, जघानच hit speedily, निर्भिभेद and killed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अग्निकेतुश्चदुर्धर्षोरश्मिकेतुश्चराक्षसः ।।6.43.25।। सुप्तघ्नोयज्ञकोपश्चरामंनिर्भिभिदुश्शरैः ।
output: दुर्धर्षः difficult to attack, अग्निकेतुश्च even Agnikethu, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रश्मिकेतुश्च and Rasmi kethu, मित्रघ्नः Mitraghna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yajakopa, रामम् Rama, शरैः with arrows, निर्भिभिदुः mangled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषांचतुर्णांरामस्तुशिरांसिनिशितैश्शरैः । क्रुद्धश्चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेदघोरैरग्निशिखोपमैः ।।6.43.26।।
output: Raged Rama with his sharp arrows which were like flames of fire destroyed all the four Rakshasas by cutting their heads.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वज्रमुष्टिस्तुमैन्देनमुष्टिनानिहतोरणे । पपातसरथस्साश्वःपुराट्टइवभूतले ।।6.43.27।।
output: Even Vajramushti fell on the ground struck with the fist by Mainda and the chariot and charioteer fell like the fort.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निकुम्बस्तुरणेनीलंनीलाञ्जनचयप्रभम् । निर्बिभेदशरैस्तीक्ष्णैःकरैर्मेघमिवांशुमान् ।।6.43.28।।
output: निकुम्भस्तु Nikumbha also, रणे in battlefield, नीलाञ्जनचयप्रभम् like a mass of dark collyrium, नीलम् Nila, अंशुमान् Sun, करैः dark, मेघमिव cloud like, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, निर्भिभेद shattered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
पुनश्शरशतेनाथक्षिप्रहस्तोनिशाचरः । बिभेदसमरेनीलंनिकुम्भःप्रजहासच ।।6.43.29।।
output: Nikumbha, the night ranger who was endowed with speed in shooting arrows again shot with a thousand arrows and laughed heartily.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यैवरथचक्रेणनीलोविष्णुरिवाहवे । शिरश्चिच्छेदसमरेनिकुम्भस्यचसारथेः ।।6.43.30।।
output: Like Lord Vishnu, Nila took the wheels of the chariot of Nikumbha and shattered the charioteer into pieces.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शोद्विविदोऽप्यशनिप्रभम् । जघानगिरिशृङ्गेणमिषतांसर्वरक्षसाम् ।।6.43.31।।
output: Dwivida whose body was like a thunderbolt to feel, moved about on the mountain peak as Rakshasas were watching.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्विदिधंवानरेन्द्रंतुनगयोधिनमाहवे । शरैरशनिसङ्काशैस्सविव्याधाशनिप्रभः ।।6.43.32।।
output: सःअशनिप्रभः that Asaniprabha, आहवे fighting with, नगयोधिनम् with trees, वानरेन्द्रम् Vanara Lord, तु you, द्विविधम् Dwivida, आशनिसङ्काशैः resembling lightening, शरैः arrows, विव्याध wounded

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सशरैरभिविद्धाङ्गोद्विविदःक्रोधमूर्छितः । सालेनसरथंसाश्वंनिजघानाशनिप्रभम् ।।6.43.33।।
output: शरैः arrows, अभिविद्धाङ्गः whose limbs have been injured, सःद्विविदः that Dwivida, क्रोधमूर्छितः enraged, सालेन Sala tree, सरथम् charioteer, साश्वम् horses, अशनिप्रभम् Asaniprabha, निजघान killed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
विद्युन्मालीरथस्थस्तुशरैःकाञ्चनभूषणैः । सुषेणंताडयामासननादचमुहुर्मुहुः ।।6.43.34।।
output: Vidyunmali mounting the chariot started releasing arrows covered with gold at Sushena and roared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंरथस्थमथोदृष्टवासुषेणोवानरोत्तमः । गिरिशृङ्गेणमहतारथमाशुन्यपातयत् ।।6.43.35।।
output: अथो Nay!, वानरोत्तमः leader of Vanaras, सुषेणः Sushena, रथस्थम् chariot, तम् him, दृष्टवा top, महता great, गिरिशृङ्गेण peak of the mountain, आशु there, रथम् chariot, न्यपातयत् crushed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लाघवेनतुसंयुक्तोविद्युन्मालीनिशाचरः । अपक्रम्यरथात्तूर्णंगदापाणिःक्षितौस्थितः ।।6.43.36।।
output: Vidyunmali seeing Sushena, the monkey leader got a huge rock, and hit him on his chest with the mace.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःक्रोधसमाविष्टःसुषेणोहरिपुङ्गवः । शिलांसुमहतींगृह्यनिशाचरमभिद्रवत् ।।6.43.37।।
output: ततः thereafter, क्रोधसमाविष्टः overtaken by anger, हरिपुङ्गवः monkey leader, सुषेणः Sushena, महतीम् huge, शिलाम् rock, गृह्य seizing, निशाचरम् Rakshasa, अभिद्रवत् dropped.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमापतन्तंगदयाविद्युन्मालीनिशाचरः । वक्षस्यभिजघानाशुसुषेणंहरिपुङ्गवः ।।6.43.38।।
output: Then Vidyunmali, seeing the leader of monkeys getting the huge rock, hit him on the chest with the mace.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गदाप्रहारंतंघोरमच्नित्यप्लवगोत्तमः । तांशिलांपातयामासतस्योरसिमहामृधे ।।6.43.39।।
output: महामृधे great monkey, प्लवगोत्तमः leader of monkeys, घोरम् dreadful, तंगदाप्रहारम् that mace, अच्नित्य not caring, शिलाम् rock, ताम् him, तस्य his, उरसि chest, पातयामास dropped.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शिलाप्रहारभिहतोविद्युन्मालीनिशाचरः । निष्पिष्टहृदयोभूमौगतासुर्निपपातह ।।6.43.40।।
output: शिलाप्रहाराभिहतः hit by the huge rock, निशाचरः night ranger, विद्युन्माली Vidyunmali, निप्पिष्टहृदयः ceased of life, गतासुः gone, भूमौ on the ground, निपपातह dropped.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवंतैर्वानरैश्शूरैश्शूरास्तेरजनीचराः । द्वन्द्वेविमृदितास्तत्रदैत्याइवदिवौकसैः ।।6.43.41।।
output: शूराः warriors, तेरजनीचराः those Rakshasas, शूरैः with warriors, तैःवानरैः those Vanaras, एवम् in that manner, तत्र there, द्वन्द्वे duel fight, दिवौकसैः wonderful, दैत्याइव like Devatas, विमृदिताः delighted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भग्नैखडगैर्गदाभिश्चशक्तितोमरपट्टसै: । अपविद्धैश्चाभिन्नैश्चरथैस्साङ्ग्रामिकैर्हयैः ।।6.43.42।। निहतैःकुञ्जरैर्मत्स्सैस्तथावानरराक्षसैः । चक्राक्षयुगदण्डैश्चभग्नैर्धरणिसंश्रितैः ।।6.43.43।। बभूवायोधनंघोरंगोमायुगणसेवितम् ।
output: गोमायुगणसेवितम् frequented by groups of jackals, अयोधनम् battlefield, भग्नैः broken, खडगैः swords, गदाभिश्च and maces, शक्तितोमरपट्टिशै: spears javelins maces. अपविद्धैः broken, रथैश्चापि chariots also, तथा similarly, साङ्ग्रामिकैः fit for war, हयैः horses, निहतैः dead, मत्स्सैः by elephants, कुञ्जरैः horses, तथा similarly, वानरराक्षसैः Vanaras and Rakshasas, भग्नैः broken, धरणिसंश्रितैः on the ground, चक्राक्षयुगदण्डैश्च wheels and axles of chariots, घोरम् dreadful, बभूव seemed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भग्नैखडगैर्गदाभिश्चशक्तितोमरपट्टसै: । अपविद्धैश्चाभिन्नैश्चरथैस्साङ्ग्रामिकैर्हयैः ।।6.43.42।। निहतैःकुञ्जरैर्मत्स्सैस्तथावानरराक्षसैः । चक्राक्षयुगदण्डैश्चभग्नैर्धरणिसंश्रितैः ।।6.43.43।। बभूवायोधनंघोरंगोमायुगणसेवितम् ।
output: The battlefield was dreadful and, frequented by jackals with spears, javelins, maces, and swords, strewn all over, similarly with broken chariots, horses, elephants, and monkeys fit for war. Broken wheels and axles of chariots were found all over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 43:
कबन्धानिसमुत्पेतुर्दिक्षुवानररक्षसाम् ।।6.43.44।। विमर्देतुमुलेतस्मिन्देवासुररणोपमे ।
output: It was like the war between Devatas and demons, with the trunks of the bodies of Vanaras and Rakshasas rubbing together lying scattered in all directions.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विदार्यमाणाहरिपुङ्गवैस्तदानिशाचराश्शोणितदिग्धगात्राः । पुनःसुयुद्धंतरसासमास्थितादिवाकरस्यास्तमयाभिकाङ्क्षिणः ।।6.43.45।।
output: Then the Rakshasas killed by Vanara leaders, their bodies full of blood were looking for sunset and again picking up strength began to battle. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रिचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty third sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
युध्यतामेनतेषांतुतदावानरराक्षसाम् । रविरस्तंगतोरात्रिःप्रवृत्ताप्राणहारिणी ।।6.44.1।।
