श्रुत्वैतद्वानरेन्द्रस्यसुषेणोवाक्यमब्रवीत् । दैवासुरंमहद्युद्धमनुभूतंसुदारुणम् ।।6.50.26।।
output: वानरेन्द्रस्य Vanara Lord, एतत् वाक्यम् these words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुषेणः Sushena, अब्रवीत् spoke, दैवासुरम् Devatas and Asuras, सुदारुणम् fierce, महत् great, युद्धम् in war, अनुभूतम् experienced.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदास्मदानवाशरसम्स्पर्शकोविदाः । निजघ्नुश्शस्त्रविदुषश्चादयन्तोमुहुर्मुहुः ।।6.50.27।।
output: तदा then, शरसम्स्पर्शकोविदाः adept in using arms, दानवाः Rakshasa, शस्त्रविदुषः learned in using arms, देवान् Devatas, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, छादयन्तः concealing by tricks, निजघ्नुः went about agitated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तानार्तान्नष्टसंज्ञांश्चगतासूंश्चबृहस्पतिः । विद्याभिर्मन्त्रयुक्ताभिरोषधीभिश्चिकित्सति ।।6.50.28।।
output: बृहस्पतिः Brhaspati the sage, आर्तान् restored the affected, नष्टसंज्ञान् wounded and life less, गतासूंश्च lost consciousness, तान् them, मन्त्रयुक्ताभिः by means of mantras, विद्याभिः recitation of prayers, रोषधीभिः herbs, चिकित्सति treatment.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्यौषधान्यानयितुंक्षीरोदंयान्तुसागरम् । जवेनवानराःशीघ्रंसम्पातिपनसादयः ।।6.50.29।।
output: "Let Sampati and Panasa go quickly to the milky ocean in a swift phase to get those medicines."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हरयस्तुविजानन्तिपार्वतीस्तामहौषधीः । सञ्जीवकरणींदिव्यांविशल्यांदेवनिर्मिताम् ।।6.50.30।।
output: हरयः monkeys, पार्वतीः mountains, ताःमहौषधीः that supreme medicine, दिव्याम् wonderful, सञ्जीवकरणीम् Sanjeevakarani, देवनिर्मिताम् for the cause of Devatas विशल्याम् Visalyakarani, विजा s नन्ति known to Brahma.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चन्द्रश्चनामद्रोणश्चक्षीरोदेसागरोत्तमे । अमृतंयत्रमथितंतत्रतेपरमौषधी ।।6.50.31।।
output: यत्र there, अमृतम् nectar of immortality, मथितम् was churned, सागरोत्तमे foremost of oceans, क्षीरोदे milky ocean, चन्द्रश्च Chandra's, द्रोणश्च Drona's, ते they, परमौषधी supreme medicine, तत्र present.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
तौतत्रविहितेदेवैःपर्वतौमहोदधौ । अयंवायुसुतोराजन् हनूमांस्तत्रगच्छतु ।।6.50.32।।
output: "Both the mountains are well known. Deities have kept the herbal medicine there. Let the son of wind god, Hanuman proceed."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरेवायुर्मेगांश्चापिसविद्युतः । पर्यस्यसागरेतोयंकम्पयननिवमेदिनीम् ।।6.50.33।।
output: In the mean while winds blew, clouds also rose up, water in the ocean was scattered about by the wind and lightning appeared in the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महतापक्षवातेनसर्ववदीपमहाद्रुमाः । निपेतुर्भग्नविटपाःसलिलेलवणाम्भसि ।।6.50.34।।
output: सर्ववदीपमहाद्रुमाः all the trees of the island, महता huge, पक्षवातेन by the flutter of the wings wind, भग्नविटपाः broken, लवणाम्भसि salt water of the ocean, सलिले water, निपेतुः entered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
अभवन् पन्नगास्त्रस्ताभोगिनस्तत्रवासिनः । शीघ्रंसर्वाणियादांसिजग्मुश्चलवणार्णवम् ।।6.50.35।।
output: All the serpents and sea monsters inhabiting there terrified at Garuda went quickly into the salty waters of the ocean.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोमुहूर्तार्गरुडंवैनतेयंमहाबलम् । वानराददृशुःसर्वेज्वलन्तमिवपावकम् ।।6.50.36।।
output: Then all the Vanaras perceived Garuda endowed with mighty prowess, the son of Vinatha blazing like fire.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्यनागास्तेसम्प्रदुद्रुवुः । यैस्तौसत्पुरुषौबद्धौशरभूतैर्महाबलौ ।।6.50.37।।
output: Seeing the noble Rama and Lakshmana bound by the serpents in the form of arrows (released by Indrajith), the serpents fled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सुपर्णःकाकुत्स्थौस्पृष्टवाप्रत्यभिनदनितः । विममर्शचपाणिभ्यांमुखेचन्द्रसमप्रभे ।।6.50.38।।
output: Thereafter Garuda paying his respects to the noble Rama and Lakshmana, touching their feet, wiped their face which shone like the moon.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वैनतेयेनसम्स्पृष्टास्तयोःसम्रुरुहुर्व्रणाः । सुवर्णेचतनूस्निग्धेतयोराशुबभूवतुः ।।6.50.39।।
output: Caressed by Garuda, both their bodies were cleared of wounds instantly shone like gold and turned bright.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेजोवीर्यंबलंचौजउत्साहश्चमहागुणाः । प्रदर्शनंचबुद्धिश्चस्मृतिश्चद्विगुणंतयोः ।।6.50.40।।
output: Their brilliance, prowess, daring courage, intelligence, memory, and great qualities got manifested many folds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
तावुत्थाप्यमहातेजागरुडोवासवोपमौ । उभौतौसस्वजेहृष्टोरामश्चैनमुवाचह ।।6.50.41।।
output: Raising up both the princes who were extraordinarily brilliant and equalled Indra, Garuda embraced Rama joyfully and thus spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भवत्प्रसादाद् व्यसनंरावणिप्रभवंमहत् । आवामिहव्यतिक्रान्तौपूर्ववद् बलिनौकृतौ ।।6.50.42।।
output: "By your kindness, we have overcome this calamity caused by Ravana's son and regained our strength as before."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
यथातातंदशरथंयथाऽजंचपितामहम् । तथाभवन्तमासाद्यहृदयंमेप्रसीदति ।।6.50.43।।
output: "For me to meet you is like meeting my father Dasaratha and grandfather, Aja. My heart rejoices."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
कोभवान्रूपसम्पन्नोदिव्यस्रगनुलेपनः । वसानोविरजेवस्त्रदिव्याभरणभूषितः ।।6.50.44।।
output: "Who are you, richly endowed with charming appearance, smeared with unguents adored in dust free garments, wearing beautiful ornaments?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
तमुवाचमहातेजावैनतेयोमहाबलः । पतत्त्रिराजःप्रीतात्माहर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः ।।6.50.45।।
output: To Rama whose eyes were filled with joyful tears, Vinatha, the king of birds, full of brightness and strength said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहंसखातेकाकुत्स्थ प्रियःप्राणोबहिश्चरः । गरुत्मानिहसम्प्राप्तोयुवयोःसाह्यकारणात् ।।6.50.46।।
output: "O Kakuthsa! I am Garuthman, your dear friend and your outer breath. I reached here to help you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
असुरावामहावीर्यावानरावामहाबलाः । सुराश्चापिसगन्ध्वर्वाःपुरस्कृत्यशतक्रतुम् ।।6.50.47।। नेमंमोक्षयितुंशक्ताश्शरबन्धंसुदारुणम् । मायाबलादिन्द्रजितानिर्मितंक्रूरकर्मणा ।।6.50.48।।
output: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
असुरावामहावीर्यावानरावामहाबलाः । सुराश्चापिसगन्ध्वर्वाःपुरस्कृत्यशतक्रतुम् ।।6.50.47।। नेमंमोक्षयितुंशक्ताश्शरबन्धंसुदारुणम् । मायाबलादिन्द्रजितानिर्मितंक्रूरकर्मणा ।।6.50.48।।
output: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
एतेनागाःकाद्रवेयास्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राविषोल्बणाः । रक्षोमायाप्रभावेणशराभूत्वास्त्वदाश्रिताः ।।6.50.49।।
output: "These arrows are serpents born of Kadra Devata. They have sharp fangs and are highly poisonous. By the tricks of Rakshasa, it has turned into arrows and reached you."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सभाग्यश्चासिधर्मज्ञ राम सत्यपराक्रम । लक्ष्मणेनसहभ्रात्रासमरेरिपुघातिना ।।6.50.50।।
output: धर्मज्ञ righteous, सत्यपराक्रम whose strength is truth, राम Rama, समरे in war, शत्रुघातिना destroyer of foes, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेनसह accompanied by Lakshmana, सभाग्यः lucky, असि you are.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमंश्रुत्वातुवृत्तान्तंत्वरमाणोऽहमागतः । सहसायुवयोःस्नेहात्सखित्वमनुपालयन् ।।6.50.51।।
output: "Having heard the information about both of you bound by serpents, out of my friendship and affection and in obedience to you I hastened and reached here."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
मोक्षितौचमहाघोरादस्मात्सायकबन्धनात् । अप्रमादश्चकर्तव्योयुवाभ्यांनित्यमेवच ।।6.50.52।।
output: "Considering it as my duty to relieve you both from the frightful bondage of snakes I reached. Do not be inattentive and guileless."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रकृत्याराक्षसाःसर्वेसङ्ग्रामेकूटयोधिनः । शूराणांशुद्धभावानांभवतामरार्जवंबलम् ।।6.50.53।।
output: प्रकृत्या by nature, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, सङ्ग्रामे in war, कूटयोधिनः use tricks in war, शूराणाम् noble people, शुद्धभावानाम् of good nature, भवताम् for you, आर्जवम् guilelessness, बलम् strength.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तन्नविश्वसनीयंवोराक्षसानांरणाजिरे । एतेनैवोपमानेननित्यंजिह्माहिराक्षसाः ।।6.50.54।।
output: तत् being so, रणाजिरे in war, वः them, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, नविश्वसनीयम् not to be trusted, एतेन because, उपमानेनैव by this experience, राक्षसाः of Rakshasa, नित्यम् ever, जिह्माःहि crooked.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वातदारामंसुपर्णस्सुमहाबलः । परिष्वज्यचसुहृत्स्निग्धमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे ।।6.50.55।।
output: महाबलः mighty strong, सःसुपर्णः that Suparna, तदा then, रामम् to Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सुहृत्स्निग्धम् most affectionately, परिष्वज्यच embracing, अप्रष्टुम् took leave, उपचक्रमे and proceeded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सखे राघव धर्मज्ञ रिपूणामपिवत्सल । अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामिगमिष्यामियथामतम् ।।6.50.56।।
output: धर्मज्ञ right, रिपूणामपि even to an enemy, वत्सल dear, सखे friend, राम Rama, अभ्यनुज्ञातुम् take leave of you, इच्छामि wish, यथामतम् truly, गमिष्यामि let me go.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नचकौतूहलंकार्यंसखित्वंप्रतिराघव । कृतकर्मारणेवीर सखित्वंप्रतिवेत्स्यसि ।।6.50.57।।
output: वीर heroic, राघव Raghava, सखित्वम् friendship, कौतूहलम् curiosity, नकार्यम् that question, रणे in war, कृतकर्मा having won, सखित्वम् friendship, प्रतिवेत्स्यसि recognize.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बालवृद्धावशेषांतुकृत्वालङ्कांशरोर्मिभिः । रावणंचरिपुंहत्वासीतांत्वंसमुलप्स्यते ।।6.50.58।।
output: "Lanka will be left with youngsters and the aged with your arrows. The enemy Ravana killed, you will recover Sita."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
इत्येवमुक्त्वावचनंसुपर्णश्शीघ्रविक्रमः । रामंचविरुजंकृत्वामध्येतेषांवनौकसाम् ।।6.5.59।। प्रदक्षिणंततःकृत्वापरिष्वज्यचवीर्यवान् । जगामाकाशमाविश्यसुपर्णःपवनोयथा ।।6.50.60।।
output: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
इत्येवमुक्त्वावचनंसुपर्णश्शीघ्रविक्रमः । रामंचविरुजंकृत्वामध्येतेषांवनौकसाम् ।।6.5.59।। प्रदक्षिणंततःकृत्वापरिष्वज्यचवीर्यवान् । जगामाकाशमाविश्यसुपर्णःपवनोयथा ।।6.50.60।।
output: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
विरुजौराघवौदृष्टवाततोवानरयूथपाः । सिंहनादांस्तदानेदुर्लङ्गूलंन्दुधुवुस्तदा ।।6.50.61।।
output: Thereafter the Vanara troops, seeing the Raghavas freed from anguish, roared like a lion, and lashed their tails.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोभेरीस्समाजघ्नुर्मृदङ्गांश्चाप्यनादयन् । दध्मुश्शङ्खान्सम्प्रहृष्टाःक्षेवलन्त्यपियथापुरम् ।।6.50.62।।
output: ततः and then, भेरीः drums, समाजघ्नुः played, मृदङ्गांश्चापि even mridangams, अवादयन् played, शङ्खान् conches, दध्मुः blew, यथापुरम् as before, क्षेवलन्त्यपि leap and jump.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 50:
आस्फोट्याःस्पोट्यविक्रान्ताःवानराःनगयोधिनः । द्रुमानुत्पट्यविविधांस्तस्थुश्शतसहस्रशः ।।6.50.63।।
output: The Vanaras who can fight with trees, uprooted several trees expressing their capacity distinctly and breaking them, and cracking their fingers. Making loud noise in hundreds and thousands stood there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विसृजन्तोमहानादांस्त्रासयन्तोनिशाचरान् । लङ्काद्वाराण्युपाजग्मुर्युद्धकामाःप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.50.64।।
output: Making a lot of noise, the Vanaras reached the gates of Lanka frightening night rangers and desiring to wage war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषांसुखीमस्तुमुलोनिनादोबभूवशाखामृगयूथपानाम् । क्षयेनिदाघस्ययथाघनानांनादस्सुभीमोनदतांनिशीथे ।।6.50.65।।
output: निदाघस्य thundering, क्षये universal destruction, निशीधे midnight, नदताम् sound, घनानाम् heavy clouds, सुभीमः terrific, नादःयथा like sound, तेषाम् from there, शाखामृगयूथपानाम् troops of Vanaras who fight with trees, सुभीमः frightening, तुमुलः loud, नादः sound, बभूव arose.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषांसुतुमुलंशब्दंवानराणांतरस्विनाम् । नर्दतांराक्षसैस्सार्धंतदाशुश्रावरावणः ।।6.51.1।।
output: तदा then, तरस्विनाम् courageous, नर्दताम् increasing, तेषांवानराणाम् by those Vanaras, सुतुमुलम् tumultuous noise, शब्दम् sound, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसैःसार्धम् all Rakshasas, शुश्राव heard.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषंश्रुत्वासनिनदंभृशम् । सचिवानांततस्तेषांमध्येवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.51.2।।
output: Thereafter, hearing the loud and deep sounds of roaring and seeing his (Ravana's) ministers in the midst, he spoke as follows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथाऽसौसम्प्रहृष्टानांवानराणांसमुत्थितः । बहूनांसुमहान्नादोमेघनामिवगर्जिताम् ।।6.51.3।। व्यक्तंसुमहतीप्रीतिरेतेषांनात्रसंशयः । तथाहिविपुलैर्नादैश्चुक्षुभेवरुणालयः ।।6.51.4।।
output: सम्प्रहृष्टानाम् very happy, बहूनाम् many of them, वानराणाम् Vanaras, समुत्थित collected:, सुमहान् very great, असौ such, नादः sound, गर्जताम् roaring, मेघानामिव like thunder of rumbling clouds, यथा just as, श्रूयते, सुव्यक्तम् , एतेषाम् by that, प्रीतिः happiness, सुमहती huge, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न no, तथाहि for that reason, विपुलैः wide, नादैः noise, वरुणालयः ocean, चुक्षुभे agitated.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथाऽसौसम्प्रहृष्टानांवानराणांसमुत्थितः । बहूनांसुमहान्नादोमेघनामिवगर्जिताम् ।।6.51.3।। व्यक्तंसुमहतीप्रीतिरेतेषांनात्रसंशयः । तथाहिविपुलैर्नादैश्चुक्षुभेवरुणालयः ।।6.51.4।।
output: "Many Vanaras have collected together and roared making loud noises just as thunder rumbling clouds. By that there is no doubt that they are very happy. For that reason, even the wide ocean is agitated."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तौतुबद्धौशरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ । अयंचसुमहान्नादशङ्कांजनयतीवमे ।।6.51.5।।
output: "The two brothers Rama and Lakshmana are bound by sharp arrows. By the loud noise that I hear I doubt in my mind!"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतत्तुवचनंचोक्त्वामन्त्रिणोराक्षसेश्वरः । उवाचनैरृतांस्तत्रसमीपपरिवर्तिनः ।।6.51.6।।
output: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, मन्त्रिणः to ministers, एतत्तु such, वचनम् words, तु you, उक्त्वा having spoken, तत्र there, समीपपरिवर्तिनः waiting near, नैरृतान् to Rakshasas, उवाच said.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ज्ञायतांतूर्णमेतेषांसर्वेषांचवनचारिणाम् । शोककालेसमुत्पन्नहर्षकारणमुत्थितम् ।।6.51.7।।
output: "For what reason are the Vanaras (rangers of woods) rejoicing that way in the time of grief? It may be found out speedily."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथोक्तास्तेनसम्भ्रान्ताःप्राकारमधिरुह्यच । ददृशुःपालितांसेनांसुग्रीवेणमहात्मना ।।6.51.8।। तौचमुक्तौसुघोरेणशरबन्धेनराघवौ । समुत्थितौमहाभागौविषेदुःप्रेक्ष्यराक्षसाः ।।6.51.9।।
output: Ravana having said so, the bewildered Rakshasas scaling the boundary wall beheld the army protected by great Sugriva and the prosperous Raghavas relieved from arrows and happy, he became worried.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथोक्तास्तेनसम्भ्रान्ताःप्राकारमधिरुह्यच । ददृशुःपालितांसेनांसुग्रीवेणमहात्मना ।।6.51.8।। तौचमुक्तौसुघोरेणशरबन्धेनराघवौ । समुत्थितौमहाभागौविषेदुःप्रेक्ष्यराक्षसाः ।।6.51.9।।
output: Ravana having said so, the bewildered Rakshasas scaling the boundary wall beheld the army protected by great Sugriva and the prosperous Raghavas relieved from arrows and happy, he became worried.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
सन्त्रस्तहृदयाःसर्वेप्राकारात् वरुह्यते । विषण्णवदनाघोराराक्षसेन्द्रमुपस्थिता ।।6.51.10।।
output: All the dreadful Rakshasas getting down the boundary wall with pale faces, sad countenance reached the Lord of Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
तदप्रियंदीनमुखारावणस्यनिशाचराः । कृत्स्नंनिवेदयामासुर्यथावद्वाक्यकोविदाः ।।6.51.11।।
output: Rakshasas who were well versed in talking, desperately conveyed the unpleasantness as it is to Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
यौताविन्द्रजितायुद्धेभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ । निबद्धौशरबन्धेननिष्प्रकम्पभुजौकृतौ ।।6.51.12।। विमुक्तौशरबन्धेनदृश्येतेतौरणाजिरे । पाशानिवगजौछित्वागजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ ।।6.51.13।।
output: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
यौताविन्द्रजितायुद्धेभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ । निबद्धौशरबन्धेननिष्प्रकम्पभुजौकृतौ ।।6.51.12।। विमुक्तौशरबन्धेनदृश्येतेतौरणाजिरे । पाशानिवगजौछित्वागजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ ।।6.51.13।।
output: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्छ्रुत्वावचनंतेषांराक्षसेन्द्रोमहाबलः । चिन्तारोषसमाक्रान्तोविषण्णवदनोऽभवत् ।।6.51.14।।
output: The Rakshasa king endowed with mighty prowess became pale in face, worried and enraged on hearing the words of Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
घोरैर्दत्तवरैर्भद्धौशरैराशीविषोपमैः । अमोघैस्सूर्यसङ्काशैःप्रमथ्येन्द्रजितायुधि ।।6.51.15।। तदस्त्रबन्धमासाद्ययदिमुक्तौरिपूमम । संशयस्थमिदंसर्वमनुपश्याम्यहंबलम् ।।6.51.16।।
output: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
घोरैर्दत्तवरैर्भद्धौशरैराशीविषोपमैः । अमोघैस्सूर्यसङ्काशैःप्रमथ्येन्द्रजितायुधि ।।6.51.15।। तदस्त्रबन्धमासाद्ययदिमुक्तौरिपूमम । संशयस्थमिदंसर्वमनुपश्याम्यहंबलम् ।।6.51.16।।
output: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निष्फलाःखलुसम्वृत्ताश्शराःवासुकितेजसः । अदत्तंयैस्तुसङ्ग्रामेरिपूणांजीवितंमम ।।6.51.17।।
output: तैः they, सङ्ग्रामे in battlefield, मम me, रिपूणाम् enemies, जीवितम् life, अदत्तम् taken away, वासुकितेजसः of equal brilliance as Vasuki, शराः arrows, निष्फलाः wasted, सम्वृत्ताःखलु become in fructuous now.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वातुसङ्क्रुद्धोनिश्श्वसन्नुरगोयथा । अब्रवीद्रक्षसांमध्येधूम्राक्षंनामराक्षसम् ।।6.51.18।।
output: Having said so, hissing Ravana called Dhumraksha to the midst.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
बलेनमहतायुक्तोराक्षसैर्भीमविक्रमः । त्वंवधायाभिनिर्याहिरामस्यसहवानरैः ।।6.51.19।।
output: "Dhumraksha of fierce prowess, you along with a huge Rakshasa army go just now to destroy Rama along with able Vanaras."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्तस्तुधूम्राक्षोराक्षसेन्द्रेणधीमता । कृत्वाप्रणामंसम्हृष्टोनिर्जगामनृपालयत् ।।6.51.20।।
output: धीमता Intelligent, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the Lord of Rakshasas, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः ordered by, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, प्रणाम् prayers, कृत्वा having offered, नृपालयत् from the king, सम्हृष्ट: joyful, निर्जगाम went from there.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अभिनिष्क्रम्यतदद्वारंबलाध्यक्षमुवाचह । त्वरयस्वबलंतूर्णंकिंचिरेणयुयुत्सतः ।।6.51.21।।
output: तद् thereafter, द्वारम् from the gateway, अभिनिष्क्रम्य went from there, बलाध्यक्षम् commander inchief of the army, उवाचह said so, तूर्णम् Instantly, बलम् army, युयुत्सतः get ready, त्वरयस्व speedily, चिरेण delay, किम् why.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धूम्राक्षवचनंश्रुत्वाबलाध्यक्षोबलानुगः । बलमुद्योजयामासरावणस्याज्ञयाद्रुतम् ।।6.51.22।।
output: बलानुगः large army contingent, बलाध्यक्षः CommanderinChief of army, धूम्राक्षवचनम् Dhumraksha's words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, रावणस्य Ravana's, आज्ञया by the order, द्रुतम् quickly, बलम् army, उद्योजयामास got ready.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेबद्धघण्टाबलिनोघोररूपानिशाचराः । विगर्जमानास्सम्हृष्टाधूम्राक्षंपर्यवारयन् ।।6.51.23।।
output: बद्धघण्टाः bound with girdles of bells, बलिनः mighty, घोररूपाः of fierce, तेनिशाचराः the Rakshasa, विगर्जमाना roaring, सम्हृष्टाः joyfully, धूम्राक्षम् with Dhumraksha, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विविधायुधहस्ताश्चशूलमुद्गरपाणयः । गदाभिःपट्टसैर्दण्डैरायसैर्मुसलैर्भृशम् ।।6.51.24।। परिघैर्भिण्डिवालैश्चभल्लैप्रासै: परश्वथै: । निर्ययूराक्षसादिभ्योनर्धन्तोजलदायथा ।।6.51.25।।
output: The dreadful Rakshasas set out roaring like rain clouds armed with different kinds of weapons, like tridents, darts, maces, spears, iron bars, rods, even clubs, spears and slings, arrows in thousands.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
विविधायुधहस्ताश्चशूलमुद्गरपाणयः । गदाभिःपट्टसैर्दण्डैरायसैर्मुसलैर्भृशम् ।।6.51.24।। परिघैर्भिण्डिवालैश्चभल्लैप्रासै: परश्वथै: । निर्ययूराक्षसादिभ्योनर्धन्तोजलदायथा ।।6.51.25।।
output: The dreadful Rakshasas set out roaring like rain clouds armed with different kinds of weapons, like tridents, darts, maces, spears, iron bars, rods, even clubs, spears and slings, arrows in thousands.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
रथैःकवचिनस्त्वन्येध्वजैश्चसमलङ्कृतैः । सुवर्णजालविहितैःखरैश्चविविधाननैः ।।6.51.26।। हयैःपरमशीघ्रैश्चगजैश्चैवमदोत्कटैः । निर्ययुर्नैरृतव्याघ्राव्याघ्राइवदुरासदाः ।।6.51.27।।
output: And others collected together holding shields, fearless like tigers, frightful in appearance, mounted on fast horses, chariots yoked to donkeys of different kinds covered with gold mesh, on maddened elephants Set out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
रथैःकवचिनस्त्वन्येध्वजैश्चसमलङ्कृतैः । सुवर्णजालविहितैःखरैश्चविविधाननैः ।।6.51.26।। हयैःपरमशीघ्रैश्चगजैश्चैवमदोत्कटैः । निर्ययुर्नैरृतव्याघ्राव्याघ्राइवदुरासदाः ।।6.51.27।।
output: And others collected together holding shields, fearless like tigers, frightful in appearance, mounted on fast horses, chariots yoked to donkeys of different kinds covered with gold mesh, on maddened elephants Set out.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वृकसिंहमुखैर्युक्तंखरैःकनकभूषणै: । आरुरोहरथंदिव्यंधूम्राक्षःखरनिस्स्वनः ।।6.51.28।।
output: खरनिःस्वनः of frightful tone, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, वृकसिंहमुखैः having faces like lion and bear, कनकभूषणै: adorned with gold, खरैः donkeys, युक्तम् yoked, दिव्यम् awesome, रथम् chariots, आरुरोह mounted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सनिर्यातोमहावीर्योधूम्राक्षोराक्षसैर्वृतः । प्रहसन्पश्चिमद्वारंहनुमान्यत्रयूथपः ।।6.51.29।।
output: महावीर्यः heroic, सःधूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, प्रहसन् laughing, यत्र there, हनूमान् Hanuman, यूधपः taken position, पश्चिमद्वारं west gate, निर्यातः set forth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
रथप्रवरमास्थायखरयुक्तंखरस्वनम् । प्रयान्तंतुमहाघोरंराक्षसंभीमदर्शनम् ।।6.51.30।। अन्तरिक्षगताःघोराशकुनाःप्रत्यषेधयन् ।
output: While the Rakshasa was mounted on the chariot and going braying like a donkey, a fearful bird going in the sky stood before his chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
रथशीर्षेमहान्भीमोगृध्रश्चनिपपातह ।।6.51.31।। ध्वजाग्रेग्रथिताश्चैवनिपेतुःकुणपाशनाः ।
output: A foul smelling frightening vulture (that feeds on the dead body) descended on top of the chariot and fell down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुधिरार्द्रोमहान् श्वेतःकबन्धःपतितोभुवि ।।6.51.32।। विस्वरंचोत्सृजन्नादंधूम्राक्षस्यसमीपतः । ववर्षरुधिरंदेवस्सञ्चचालचमेदिनी ।।6.51.33।।
output: A trunk of a white bird drenched in blood sounding discordant fell near by Dhumraksha. It appeared like a rain god shedding blood on the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुधिरार्द्रोमहान् श्वेतःकबन्धःपतितोभुवि ।।6.51.32।। विस्वरंचोत्सृजन्नादंधूम्राक्षस्यसमीपतः । ववर्षरुधिरंदेवस्सञ्चचालचमेदिनी ।।6.51.33।।
output: A trunk of a white bird drenched in blood sounding discordant fell near by Dhumraksha. It appeared like a rain god shedding blood on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 51:
प्रतिलोमंवनौवायुर्निर्घातसमनिस्वनः । तिमिरौघवृतास्तत्रदिशश्चनचकाशिरे ।।6.51.34।।
output: Thunder like roar was heard. Wind blew adversely. Darkness pervaded, and directions could not be seen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सतूत्पातांस्तदादृष्टवाराक्षसानांभयावहान् । प्रादुर्भूतान्सुघोरांश्चधूम्राक्षोव्यथितोऽभवत् ।।6.51.35।। मुमुहूराक्षसाःसर्वेधूम्राक्षस्यपुरस्सराः ।
output: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, भयावहान् feared, तदा then, प्रादुद्भूतान् manifesting deities, घोरान् dreadful, उत्पातान् generated, दृष्टवा seeing, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, व्यथितः worried, अभवत् became, धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, पुरःसराः in front, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, मुमुहुः lost consciousness.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःसुभीमोबहुभिर्निशाचरैर्वृतोऽभिनिष्क्रम्यरणोत्सुकोबली । ददर्शतांराघवबाहुपालितांमहौघकल्पांबहुवानरींचमूम् ।।6.51.36।।
output: Thereafter many strong and powerful Rakshasas surrounding Dhumraksha, who was enthusiastic about war, beheld many Vanaras protected by Raghava like at universal dissolution. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty first sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
धूम्राक्षंप्रेक्ष्यनिर्यान्तंराक्षसंभीमविक्रमम् । विनेदुर्वानरास्सर्वेप्रहृष्टायुद्धकाङ् क्षिणः ।।6.52.1।।
output: Seeing Dhumraksha of terrible prowess returning, the vanaras made loud noises out of joy and desire to wage war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषांसुतुमुलंयुद्धंसञ्जज्ञेकपिरक्षसाम् । अन्योन्यंपादपैर्घोरंनिघ्नतांशूलमुद्गरैः ।।6.52.2।।
output: घोरैः terrible, पादपैः trees, शूलमुद्गरैः tridents and clubs, अन्योन्यम् one another, निघ्नताम् , तेषाम् in that way, कपिरक्षसाम् between the Vanaras and Rakshasas, सुतुमुलम् tumultuous, युद्धम् war, संजज्ञे happened.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसैर्वानराघोराविनिकृत्तस्समन्ततः । वानरैराक्षसाश्चापिद्रुमैर्भूमिसमीकृताः ।।6.52.3।।
output: समन्ततः all over, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, घोराः fierce, वानराः Vanara, विनिकृत्ताः mowed down, राक्षसश्चापि even Rakshasas, वानरैः Vanara, द्रुमैः with trees, भूमिसमीकृताः pulled down to the ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसास्त्वभिसङ्क्रुद्धावानरान्निशितैश्शरैः । विव्यथुर्घोरसङ्काशैःकङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः ।।6.52.4।।
output: राक्षसास्तु Rakshasas on their part, अभिसङ्क्रुद्धाः highly enraged, निशितैः sharp, घोरसङ्काशैः dreadful, कङ्कपत्रैः itching feathers, अजिह्मगैः fixed, शरैः arrows, वानरान् at Vanaras, विव्यथु attacked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
तेगदाभिश्चभीमाभिःपट्टसै: कूटमुद्गरैः । घोरैश्चपरिघैश्चित्रैस्त्रिशूलैश्चापिसंश्रितैः ।।6.52.5।। विदार्यमाणारक्षोभिर्वानरास्तेमहाबलाः । अमर्षाज्जनितोद्धर्षाश्चक्रुःकर्माण्यभीतवत् ।।6.52.6।।
output: The Vanaras although strong were wielding maces, spikes, tridents, terrific iron bars and multitude of weapons of many kinds to crush the Rakshasas. They were endowed with prowess, knowledgeable of weapons and doing their duty without fear and with great enthusiasm.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेगदाभिश्चभीमाभिःपट्टसै: कूटमुद्गरैः । घोरैश्चपरिघैश्चित्रैस्त्रिशूलैश्चापिसंश्रितैः ।।6.52.5।। विदार्यमाणारक्षोभिर्वानरास्तेमहाबलाः । अमर्षाज्जनितोद्धर्षाश्चक्रुःकर्माण्यभीतवत् ।।6.52.6।।
output: The Vanaras although strong were wielding maces, spikes, tridents, terrific iron bars and multitude of weapons of many kinds to crush the Rakshasas. They were endowed with prowess, knowledgeable of weapons and doing their duty without fear and with great enthusiasm.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
शरनिर्भिन्नगात्रास्तेशूलनिर्भिन्नदेहिनः । जगृहुस्तेद्रुमांस्तत्रशिलाश्चहरियूथपाः ।।6.52.7।।
output: Vanaras 's bodies split in their necks by the terrible tridents, took up trees and rocks to fight.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेभीमवेगाहरयोनर्दमानास्ततस्ततः । ममन्थूराक्षसान्वीरान्नामानिचबभाषिरे ।।6.52.8।।
output: The monkeys endowed with terrific speed, proceeding from there roaring, proclaiming their names crushed the Rakshasa heroes.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्भभूवाद्भुतंघोरंयुद्धंवानररक्षसाम् । शिलाभिर्विविधाभिश्चबहुभिश्चैवपादपैः ।।6.52.9।।
output: Wonderful fight took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas who held trees and rocks of several kinds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसामथिताःकेचिद्वानरैर्जितकाशिभिः । ववमूरुधिरंकेचिन्मुखैरुधिरभोजनाः ।।6.52.10।।
output: जितकाशिभिः who conquered fear, वानरैः Vanaras, केचित् indeed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, मथिताः crushed into lumps, केचित् indeed, रुधिरभोजनाः blood thrown out, मुखैः from mouth, रुधिरम् blood, ववमूः vomited.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
पार्श्वेषुदारिताःकेचित्केचिद्राशीकृताद्रुमैः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताःकेचित्केचिद्धन्तैर्विदारिताः ।।6.52.11।।
output: Some tore by the sides of the body, some crushed by the trees, some powdered by the rocks, and some were torn into pieces with teeth.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
ध्वजैर्विमथितैर्भग्नैःखङ्गैश्चविनिपातितैः । रथैर्विध्वंसितैश्चापिपतितैःरजनीचरैः ।।6.52.12।।
output: Indeed, the night rangers were killed, their flags were broken. They were crushed, their swords were destroyed with chariots fallen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गजेन्द्रैःपर्वताकारैःपर्वताग्रैर्वनौकसाम् । मथितैर्वाजिभिःकीर्णंसारोहैर्वसुधातलम् ।।6.52.13।।
output: By the Vanaras hurling from the mountains, the crushed elephants were like mountains and the horses with riders crushed covered the ground all over.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानरैर्भीमविक्रान्स्सैराप्लुत्याऽप्लुत्यवेगितैः । राक्षसाःकरजैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मुखेषुविनिर्तिताः ।।6.52.14।।
output: The Vanaras with their terrific valour jumping up wounded the Rakshasas in their face with their sharp nails.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विषण्णवदनाभूयोविप्रकीर्णशिरोरुहाः । मूढाश्शोणितगन्धेननिपेतुर्धरणीतले ।।6.52.15।।
output: भूयः some others, विषण्णवदनाः pale faces, विप्रकीर्णशिरोरुहाः dishevelled hair, शोणितगन्धेन due to the smell of blood, मूढाः lost senses, धरणीतले on the ground, निपेतुः dropped.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्येतुपरमसङ्कृक्रुद्धाराक्षसाभीमनिश्वना: । तलैरेवाभिधावन्तिवज्रस्पर्शसमैर्हरीन् ।।6.52.16।।
output: भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, अन्ये others, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, परमसङ्कृक्रुद्धाः extremely enraged, वज्रस्पर्शसमैः of hard touch like diamond, तलैरेव with palms, हरीन् monkeys, अभिधावन्ति assailed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानरैरापतन्तस्तेवेगितावेगवत्तरैः । मुष्टिभिश्चरणैर्दन्स्सैःपादपैश्चावपोथिता ।।6.52.17।।
output: Endowed with speed, the Vanaras also fell on the Rakshasas at greater speed, knocking them down with fists, feet, teeth and even trees.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सैन्यंतुविद्रुतंदृष्टवाधूम्राक्षोराक्षसर्षभः । रोषेणकदनंचक्रेवानराणांयुयुत्सताम् ।।6.52.18।।
output: राक्षसर्षभ bull among Rakshasas, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, विद्रुतम् distressed, सैन्यम् army, दृष्टवा seeing, रोषेण angrily, युयुत्सताम् eager to fight, वानराणाम् Vanaras, कदनम् havoc, चक्रे running away.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्तासैःप्रमथिताःकेचिद्वानराश्शोणितस्रवाः । मुद्गरैराहताःकेचित्पातिताधरणीतले ।।6.52.19।।
output: केचित् a few, वानराः Vanaras, प्रासैः by barbed darts, प्रमथिताः mutilated, शोणितस्रवाः, केचित् , मुद्गरैः, आहताः, धरणीतले on the ground, पातिताः dropped.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
परिघैर्मथिताःकेचिद्भिण्डिवालैर्विदारिताः । पट्टसैराहता: केचिद्विह्वलन्तोगतासवः ।।6.52.20।।
output: Some were pound by iron bars, some were torn up, some split and some pierced and cut ceased in life.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
केचिद्विनिहताश्शूलैरुधिरार्द्रावनौकसः । केचिद्विद्रावितानष्टाःसङ्क्रुद्धैराक्षसैर्युधि ।।6.52.21।।
output: In the battlefield some Vanaras, attacked by Rakshasas, were floating on the ground in blood, dead.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
विभिन्नहृदयाःकेचिदेकपार्श्वेनदारिताः । विदारितास्त्रिशूलैश्चकेचिदान्स्रैर्विनिःसृताः ।।6.52.22।।
output: Some with their hearts open and broken, beaten on side laid detached of their inner parts.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्सुभीमंमहायुद्धंहरिराक्षससङ्कुलम् । प्रबभौशब्दबहुलंशिलापादपसङ्कुलम् ।।6.52.23।।
output: सुभीमम् very frightful, हरिराक्षससङ्कुलम् monkeys and Rakshasa groups, शिलापादमसङ्कुलम् with rocks and trees, शब्दबहुलम् loud noise, महत् great, तत् युद्धम् that battle, प्रबभौ abounded.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
धनुर्ज्यातन्त्रिमधुरंहिक्कातालसमन्वितम् । मन्धस्न्तितसङ्गीतंतद्युद्धगान्धर्वमाबभौ ।।6.52.24।।
output: It seemed like music in the form of twang of bow strings, neighing of horses like the sound of wooden cymbals, vocal music in the form of trumpeting of elephants, that battle seemed like symphony.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धूम्राक्षस्तुधनुष्पाणिर्वानरान्रणमूर्धनि । हसन्विद्रावयामासदिशस्तुशरवृष्टिभिः ।।6.52.25।।
output: Dhumraksha with his bow in hand, showering arrows, laughing in battlefront dispersed the Vanaras in directions.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धूम्राक्षेणार्दितंसैन्यंव्यथितंप्रेक्ष्यमारुतिः । अभ्यवर्ततसङ्क्रुद्धःप्रगृह्यविपुलांशिलाम् ।।6.52.26।।
output: Beholding the perturbed army, Hanuman seized a huge rock and turned towards Dhumraksha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रोधाद् द्विद्द्विगुणताम्राक्षःपितृस्तुल्यपराक्रमः । शिलांतांपातयामासधूम्राक्षस्यरथंप्रति ।।6.52.27।।
output: Endowed with mighty valour equal to his father, an angry Hanuman hurled the rock at the chariot of Dhumraksha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आपततनींशिलांदृष्टवागदामुद्यम्यसम्भ्रमात् । रथादाप्लुत्यवेगेनवसुधायांव्यतिष्ठत ।।6.52.28।।
output: Beholding the rock descending upon him, Dhumraksha rushed instantly on the ground from the chariot and stood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
साप्रमथ्यरथंतस्यनिपपातशिलाभुवि । सचक्रकूबरसाश्वंसध्वजंसशरासनम् ।।6.52.29।।
output: That rock fell on the chariot and got crushed along with its wheel and axle and with arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सभङ् क्त्वातुरथंतस्यहनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । रक्षसांकदनंचक्रेसस्कन्धविटपैर्द्रुमैः ।।6.52.30।।
output: मारुतात्मजः son of WindGod, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, तस्य his, रथम् chariot, भङ् क्त्वा trunks, सस्कन्धविटपैः stems of trees, द्रुमैः Dhumraksha, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, कदनम् destruction, चक्रे started.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विभिन्नशिरसोभूत्वाराक्षसाश्शोणितोक्षिता: । द्रुमैःप्रमथिताश्चान्येनिपेतुर्धरणीतले ।।6.52.31।।
output: Some Rakshasas hit by trees with their heads broken, shedding blood fell on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
विद्राव्यराक्षसंसैन्यंहनुमान्मारुतात्मजः । गिरिशशिखरमादायधूम्राक्षमभिदुद्रुवे ।।6.52.32।।
output: Hanuman the son of WindGod, after chasing the army of Rakshasas reaching the top of the mountain, jumped on Dhumraksha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमापतन्तंधूम्राक्षोगदामुद्यम्यवीर्यवान् । विनर्दमानःसहसाहनूमन्तमभिद्रवत् ।।6.52.33।।
output: Lifting his mace on seeing Hanuman, heroic and brave Dhumraksha darted on Hanuman, roaring like a lion.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 52:
तस्यक्रुद्धस्यरोषेणगदांतांबहुकण्टकाम् । पातयामासधूम्राक्षोमस्तकेऽथहनूमतः ।।6.52.34।।
output: And then lifting his mace fixed with many nails, Dhumraksha enraged lighted on Hanuman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ताडितःसतयातत्रगदयाभीमरूपया । सकपिर्मारुतबलस्तंप्रहारमचिन्तयन् ।।6.52.35।। धूम्राक्षस्यशिरोमध्येगिरिशृङ्गमपातयत् ।
output: That fierce mace fell on Hanuman's head. Hanuman who was equal to wind god without caring for the hit dropped the peak of the mountain on the centre of Dhumraksha's head.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सविस्फारितसर्वाङ्गोगिरिशृङ्गेणताडितः । पपातसहसाभूमौविकीर्णइवपर्वतः ।।6.52.36।।
output: गिरिशृङ्गेण by the peak of the mountain, ताडितः falling, सः he, विस्फारितसर्वाङ्गः all limbs broken to pieces, सहसा along with, विकीर्णः crushed, पर्वतःइव like a mountain, भूमौ on the ground, पपात fell.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धूम्राक्षंनिहतंदृष्टवाहतशेषानिशाचराः ।।6.52.37।। त्रस्ताःप्रविविशुर्लङ्कांवध्यमानाःप्लवङ्गमैः ।
output: Those Rakshasas who survived the onslaught, seeing Dhumraksha killed, reentered Lanka out of fear of being killed by Vanaras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतुपवनसुतोनिहत्यशत्रून्क्षतजवहरिस्सरितश्चसन्निकीर्य । रिपुवधजनितश्रमोमहात्मामुदमगमत्कपिभिःसुपूज्यमानः ।।6.52.38।।
output: The son of wind god, the great soul, having killed the enemy in the battlefield and making the river of blood to flow, was exhausted by killing enemies. The monkeys started worshipping him in joy. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्विपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धूम्राक्षंनिहतंश्रुत्वारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । क्रोधेनमहताऽविष्टोनिश्श्वसन्नुरगोयथा ।।6.53.1।। दीर्घमुष्णंविनिश्श्वस्यक्रोधेनकलुषीकृतः । अब्रवीद्राक्षसंक्रूरंवज्रदंष्ट्रंमहाबलम् ।।6.53.2।।
output: Ravana sends Vajradamshtra to fight. Fierce fight takes place between Vanaras and Vajradamshtra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धूम्राक्षंनिहतंश्रुत्वारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । क्रोधेनमहताऽविष्टोनिश्श्वसन्नुरगोयथा ।।6.53.1।। दीर्घमुष्णंविनिश्श्वस्यक्रोधेनकलुषीकृतः । अब्रवीद्राक्षसंक्रूरंवज्रदंष्ट्रंमहाबलम् ।।6.53.2।।
output: Ravana sends Vajradamshtra to fight. Fierce fight takes place between Vanaras and Vajradamshtra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
गच्छत्वंवीर निर्याहिराक्षसैःपरिवारितः । जहिदाशरथिंरामंसुग्रीवंवानरैःसह ।।6.53.3।।
output: "O Hero, proceed, accompanied by Rakshasa companions and kill Dasaratha's Rama and Sugriva along with Vanaras."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तथेत्युक्त्वाद्रुततरंमायावीराक्षसेश्वरम् । निर्जगामबलैस्सार्दंबहुभिःपरिवारितः ।।6.53.4।। नागैरश्वैःखरैरुष्ट्रैःसंयुक्तस्सुसमाहितः । पताकाध्वजचित्रैश्चरथैश्चसमलङ्कृतः ।।6.53.5।।
output: The king of Rakshasas, being a deceit, having spoken in that way, many generals of the army went accompanied by elephants, horses, camels, and donkeys with chariots decorated with banners and pennons, and diadems collected together.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
तथेत्युक्त्वाद्रुततरंमायावीराक्षसेश्वरम् । निर्जगामबलैस्सार्दंबहुभिःपरिवारितः ।।6.53.4।। नागैरश्वैःखरैरुष्ट्रैःसंयुक्तस्सुसमाहितः । पताकाध्वजचित्रैश्चरथैश्चसमलङ्कृतः ।।6.53.5।।
output: The king of Rakshasas, being a deceit, having spoken in that way, many generals of the army went accompanied by elephants, horses, camels, and donkeys with chariots decorated with banners and pennons, and diadems collected together.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोविचित्रकेयूरमुकुटैश्चविभूषितः । तनुत्राणिचसमावृत्यसधनुर्निर्ययौद्रुतम् ।।6.53.6।।
output: ततः thereafter, विचित्रकेयूरमुकुटेन adorned with wonderful crown studded with keyura gems विभूषितः decorated, तनुत्राणिच co at covering the body, समावृत्य wearing, सधनुः with a bow, द्रुतम् alert, निर्वयौ went forward.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
पताकालङ्कृतंदीप्तंतप्तकाञ्चनभूषितम् । रथंप्रदक्षिणंकृत्वासमारोहच्चमूपतिः ।।6.53.7।।
output: The general went ascending the chariot shining with well polished shining gold, decked with flags after going around clockwise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
यष्टिभिस्तोमरैचशित्रैश्शूलैश्चमुसलैरपि । भिण्डिपालैश्चपाशैश्चशक्तिभिःपट्टसैरपि ।।6.53.8।। खडगैश्चक्रैर्गदाभिश्चनिशितैश्चपरश्वधैः । पदातयश्चनिर्यान्तिविविधाःशस्त्रपाणयः ।।6.53.9।।
output: Armed with swords, many foot soldiers carrying poles, strange clubs, tridents, iron bars, slings and roped to throw spears and spears with sharp edges, swords, battle axes, javelins, and maces, departed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यष्टिभिस्तोमरैचशित्रैश्शूलैश्चमुसलैरपि । भिण्डिपालैश्चपाशैश्चशक्तिभिःपट्टसैरपि ।।6.53.8।। खडगैश्चक्रैर्गदाभिश्चनिशितैश्चपरश्वधैः । पदातयश्चनिर्यान्तिविविधाःशस्त्रपाणयः ।।6.53.9।।
output: शस्त्रपाणयः armed with swords, विविधाः many, पदातयश्च foot soldiers, यष्टभिः poles, चित्रैः strange, तोमरैः iron clubs, शूलैश्च tridents, मुसलैरपि iron bars, भिदनिपालैश्च slings used to throw, पाशैश्च ropes, शक्तिभिः spears, पट्टसैरपि spears with sharp edge, खडगैः swords, चक्रैः javelins, गदाभिश्च maces, निशितैः sharp, परश्वधैः battle axes, निर्यान्ति departed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विचित्रवाससस्सर्वेदीप्ताराक्षसपुङ्गवाः । गजामदोत्कटाश्शूराश्चलन्तइवपर्वताः ।।6.53.10।।
output: विचित्रवाससः decorated with lovely raiment, सर्वे all, दीप्ताः glowing, राक्षसपुङ्गवाः Rakshasa leaders, शूराः heroes, चलन्तः moved, पर्वताःइव like mountains, मदोत्कटाः intoxicated with ichor, गजाः elephants.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेयुद्धकुशलैरूढास्तोमराङ्कुशपाणिभिः । अन्येलक्षणसंयुक्ताश्शूरारूढामहाबलाः ।।6.53.11।।
output: Carrying tridents, clubs, and goads eager for war the Rakshasas mounted on mahouts and horses of noble characteristics, warriors with extraordinary might departed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तद्राक्षसबलंसर्वंविप्रस्थितमशोभत । प्रावृटकालेयथामेघानर्दमानास्सविद्युतः ।।6.53.12।। निस्सृतादक्षिणद्वारादङ्गदोयत्रयूथपः ।
output: विप्रस्थितम् determined with purpose, तत् then, सर्वम् entire, राक्षसबलम् Rakshasa army, प्रावृट् काले rainy season, नर्दमानाः roaring, सविद्युतः in the vicinity, मेघाःयथा like cloud, यथा like that, अशोभत splendid, यत्र there, अङ्गदः Angada, यूथपः army, दक्षिणद्वारात् from southern gate, निःसृता crossing over.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषांनिष्क्रममाणानामशुभंसमजायत ।।6.53.13।। आकाशाद्विघनात्तीव्रादुल्काश्चाभ्यन्यपतंस्तदा । वमन्त्यःपावकज्वालाशशिवाघोरंववाशिरे ।।6.53.14।।
output: As they were leaving evil portents appeared. Dreadful jackals, dazzling fire from the sky and meteors falling appeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषांनिष्क्रममाणानामशुभंसमजायत ।।6.53.13।। आकाशाद्विघनात्तीव्रादुल्काश्चाभ्यन्यपतंस्तदा । वमन्त्यःपावकज्वालाशशिवाघोरंववाशिरे ।।6.53.14।।
output: तेषाम् in that way, निष्क्रममाणानाम् as they were leaving, अशुभम् evil, अजायत portents, विघनात् appeared, तीव्रात् intense, आकाशात् from the sky, तदा then, उल्काश्च meteors, अभ्यपतन् falling, घोराः dreadful, शिवाः jackals, पावकज्वालाः dazzling fire, वमन्तःववाशिरे giving out from the sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्याहरन्तमृगाघोरारक्षसांनिधनंतदा । समापतन्तोयोधास्तुप्रास्खलन् स्तत्रदारुणम् ।।6.53.15।।
output: Then the fierce animals indicated the death of Rakshasas, who were going deluded with war and fell down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतानौत्पातिकान् दृष्टवावज्रदंष्ट्रोमहाबलः । धैर्यमालम्भ्यतेजस्वीनिर्जगामरणोत्सुकः ।।6.53.16।।
output: Mighty Vajradamshtra who was energetic, picking up courage seeing the portents that came up, sallied forth eager for war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
तांस्तुनिष्क्रमतोदृष्टवावानराजितकाशिनः । प्रणेदुस्सुमहानादान्पूरयांश्चदिशोदश ।।6.53.17।।
output: Vanaras who assumed victory, seeing the Rakshasas coming out stretching filled all the ten directions with loud noise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
ततःप्रवृत्तंतुमुलंहरीणांराक्षसैस्सह । घोराणांभीमरूपाणामन्योन्यवथकाङ् क्षिणाम् ।।6.53.18।।
output: Then dreadful encounters of fierce form took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas each one trying to kill another.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
निष्पतन्तोमहोत्साहोभिन्नदेहशिरोधराः । रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गान्यपतन्थरणीतले ।।6.53.19।।
output: Proceeding Further, very eager to fight they fell on the ground with their bodies broken, heads severed, and all limbs bathed in blood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
केचिदन्योन्यमासाद्यशूराःपरिघपाणयः । चिक्षिपुर्विविधंशस्त्रंसमरेष्न्विवर्तिनः ।।6.53.20।।
output: Heroes in war whose hand s were like iron clubs, who never turned back in war, indeed flung weapons of many kinds on one another.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्रुमाणांचशिलानांचशस्त्राणांचापिनिस्स्वनः ।।6.53.21।। श्रूयतेसुमहांस्तत्रघोरोहृदयभेदसः ।
output: तत्र there, द्रुमाणांशिलानांच trees and rocks, शस्त्राणांच weapons also, घोरः fierce, हृदयभेदसः pierced hearts, सुमहान् loud, निःस्वनः in the battlefield, श्रूयते heard.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रथनेमिस्वनस्तत्रधनुषश्चापिनिस्वसत् ।।6.53.22।। शङ्खभेरीमृदङ्गानांबभूवतुमुलःस्वनः ।
output: Then came out tumultuous sounds of clutter of chariots, bows, conches, kettle drums and tom toms.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
केचिदस्त्राणिसन्सृज्यबाहुयुद्धमकुर्वत । तलैश्चचरणैश्चापिमुष्टिभिश्चद्रुमैरपि ।।6.53.23।। जानुभिश्चहताःकेचिद्भिन्नदेहाश्चराक्षसाः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताःकेचिद्वानरैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः ।।6.53.24।।
output: Indeed, abandoning the weapons, the Vanaras fought with their palms, fists, feet, trees, and knees and smashed the Rakshasas crushing their bodies like rocks.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
केचिदस्त्राणिसन्सृज्यबाहुयुद्धमकुर्वत । तलैश्चचरणैश्चापिमुष्टिभिश्चद्रुमैरपि ।।6.53.23।। जानुभिश्चहताःकेचिद्भिन्नदेहाश्चराक्षसाः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताःकेचिद्वानरैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः ।।6.53.24।।
output: केचित् indeed, अस्त्राणि weapons, सन्सृज्य abandoning, युद्धम् battle, अकुर्वत not did, तलैश्च palms, चरणैश्चापि feet, मुष्टिभिश्च fists, द्रुमैरपि trees, जानुभिश्च knees, युद्धदुर्मदैः, वानरैः Vanaras, हताः smashed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, भिन्नदेहाः broken bodies, केचित् indeed, शिलाभिः rocks, चूर्णिताः crushed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वज्रदंष्ट्रोभृशंबाणै: रणेवित्रासयन्हरीन् । चचारलोकसंहारेपाशहस्तइवान्तकः ।।6.53.25।।
output: वज्रदंष्ट्रैः Vajradamshtra, रणे in battle, बाणैः with arrows, हरीन् at Vanaras, भृशम् striking, वित्रासयन् destruction, लोकसंहारे destruction of the world, पाशहस्तः with noose in hand, अन्तकःइव like god of death, चचार went about.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
बलवन्तोऽस्त्रविदुषोनानाप्रहरणारणे । जघ्नुर्वानरसैन्यानिराक्षसाःक्रोधमूर्छिताः ।।6.53.26।।
output: Mighty Vajradamshtra, who was endowed with the skill of using every kind of weapon, deluded with anger, went after the Vanara army.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
निघ्नतोराक्षसान्दृष्टवासर्वान्वालिसुतोरणे । क्रोधेनवदिगुणाविष्टःसंवर्तकइवानलः ।।6.53.27।।
output: Seeing the Vanaras being destroyed, Vali's son, Angada with redoubled anger, like fire at the time of universal destruction, started to exterminate Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
तान् राक्षसगणान्सर्वान्वृक्षमुद्यम्यवीर्यवान् । अङ्गदःक्रोधताम्राक्षःसिंहःक्षुद्रमृगानिव ।।6.53.28।। कारकदनंघोरंशक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः ।।6.53.29।।
output: Heroic Angada, equal to Indra in prowess, enraged, eyes turned red in anger, seizing a tree made a fierce fight with Rakshasa army like a lion with small animals.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान् राक्षसगणान्सर्वान्वृक्षमुद्यम्यवीर्यवान् । अङ्गदःक्रोधताम्राक्षःसिंहःक्षुद्रमृगानिव ।।6.53.28।। कारकदनंघोरंशक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः ।।6.53.29।।
output: Heroic Angada, equal to Indra in prowess, enraged, eyes turned red in anger, seizing a tree made a fierce fight with Rakshasa army like a lion with small animals.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
अङ्गदाभिहतास्तत्रराक्षसाभीमविक्रमाः । विभिन्नशिरसःपेतुर्विकृताइवपादपाः ।।6.53.30।।
output: There, struck by Angada of fearful valour, the Rakshasas fell like trees smashed and heads broken.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रथैरश्वैर्ध्वजैश्चित्रैश्शरैर्हरिरक्षसाम् । रुधिरेणसञ्छन्नाभूमिर्भयकरातदा ।।6.53.31।।
output: तदा then, रथैः chariots, चित्रैः wonderful, ध्वजैः flags, अश्वैः horses, हरिरक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, शरीरैः bodies, रुधिरेण in blood, सञ्छन्ना bathed, भूमिः ground, भयकरा fearful to look.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 53:
हारकेयूरवस्स्रैश्चशत्रैश्चसमलङ्कृता । भूमिर्भातिरणेतत्रशारदीवयथानिशा ।।6.53.32।।
output: The battlefield with strewn armlets, necklaces and clothes, weapons looked like autumnal night decorated all over.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बलस्यचविघातेनअङ्गदस्यजयेनच । राक्षसःक्रोधमाविष्टोवज्रदंष्ट्रोमहाबलः ।।6.54.1।।
output: Angada fights with Vajradamshtra and kills him in a duel.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
विष्पार्यचधनुर्घोरंशक्राशनिसमस्वनम् । वानराणामनीकानिप्राकिरच्छरवृष्टिभिः ।।6.54.2।।
output: Stretching his terrific bow which had the splendour of Indra's bow he (Vajradamshtra) showered shafts at the army troops of Vanaras and assailed them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
राक्षसाश्चापिमुख्यास्तेरथेषुसमवस्थिताः । नानाप्रहरणाश्शूराःप्रायुध्यन्तस्तदारणे ।।6.54.3।।
output: Seated firmly on the chariots the chiefs and heroes of Rakshasas also fought steadily with different weapons in the combat.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानराणांचशूरायेतेसर्वेप्लवगर्षभाः । आयुध्यन्तशिलाहस्तास्समवेतास्समन्ततः ।।6.54.4।।
output: The best of Vanara warriors also gathered together with rocks in hand contended.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्रायुधसहस्राणितस्मिन्नायोधनेभृशम् । राक्षसाःकपिमुख्येषुपातयांचक्रिरेतदा ।।6.54.5।।
output: Then in that battle the Rakshasas went on hurling thousands of missiles at the chiefs of Vanaras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानराश्चापिरक्षस्सुगिरवृक्षान्महाशिलाः । प्रवीराःपातयामासुर्मत्तमातङ्गसन्निभाः ।।6.54.6।।
output: Heroic Vanaras who resembled elephants in rut showered mountains and trees and huge rocks at Rakshasas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शूराणांयुद्यमानानांसमरेष्न्विवर्तिनाम् । तद्राक्षसगणानांचसुयुद्धंसमवर्तत ।।6.54.7।।
output: Between the heroes fighting the battle, who never returned, Great War continued between Rakshasas troops and Vanaras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रभिन्नशिरसःकेचिछचिन्नैःपादैश्चबाहुभिः । शस्स्रैरर्दितदेहाभ्यरुधिरेणसमुक्षिताः ।।6.54.8।। हरयोराक्षसाश्चैवशेरतेगांसमाश्रिताः । कङ्कगृध्रवळैराढ्याश्चगोमायुगलसङ्कुलाः ।।6.54.9।।
output: केचित् some, हरयः monkeys, राक्षसाश्चैव Rakshasas also, प्रभिन्नशिरसः heads severed, छिन्नैः broken, पादैः feet, बाहुभिः many, शस्त्रै weapons:, आर्दितदेहाः bodies mangled, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षिताः bathed in blood, कङ्कगृध्रावळैराढ्याश्च arms and feet looped over neck, गोमायुगलसङ्कुलाः as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows, गाम् devolving, समाश्रिताः surrounded by, शेरते lay strewn.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
प्रभिन्नशिरसःकेचिछचिन्नैःपादैश्चबाहुभिः । शस्स्रैरर्दितदेहाभ्यरुधिरेणसमुक्षिताः ।।6.54.8।। हरयोराक्षसाश्चैवशेरतेगांसमाश्रिताः । कङ्कगृध्रवळैराढ्याश्चगोमायुगलसङ्कुलाः ।।6.54.9।।
output: There lay strewn some monkeys and Rakshasas also with severed heads, broken feet, with many weapons mangled with bodies, bathed in blood, arms and feet looped to necks devolving as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows surrounded.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कबन्धानिसमुत्पेतुर्भीमाणांभीषणानिवै । भुजपाणिशिरश्छिन्नकायाश्चभूतले ।।6.54.10।। वानराराक्षसाश्चापिनिपेतुस्तत्रवैरणे ।
output: Then in the battlefield, the timid vanaras and even rakshasas with their arms and heads cut off, bodies wounded allover dropped down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोवानरसैन्येनहन्यमानंनिशाचरम् ।।6.54.11।। प्राभज्यतबलंसर्वंवज्रदंष्ट्रस्यपश्यतः ।
output: ततः thereafter, निशाचरम् night rangers, सर्वंबलम् all army, वानरसैन्येन Vanara troops, हन्यमानम् killed, वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य Vajradamshtra's, पश्यतः stood looking, प्राभज्यत ran helterskelter.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
राक्षसान्भयवित्रस्तान्हन्यमानान् प्लवङ्गमैः ।।6.54.12।। दृष्टवासरोषताम्राक्षोवज्रदंष्ट्रःप्रतापवान् । प्रविवेशधनुष्पाणिस्त्रासयन्हरिवाहिनीम् ।।6.54.13।।
output: Struck by monkeys the Rakshasas were in fear. Seeing the Rakshasas Vajraddamshtra's eyes turned red in anger with bow in hand penetrating the Vanara troops terrifying them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसान्भयवित्रस्तान्हन्यमानान् प्लवङ्गमैः ।।6.54.12।। दृष्टवासरोषताम्राक्षोवज्रदंष्ट्रःप्रतापवान् । प्रविवेशधनुष्पाणिस्त्रासयन्हरिवाहिनीम् ।।6.54.13।।
output: प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, हन्यमानान् struck by, भयवित्रस्तान् stricken with fear, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रतापवान् valiant, सः he, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, रोषताम्राक्षः eyes turned red in anger, धनुष्पाणिः bow in hand, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara troops, त्रासयन् terrifying, प्रविवेश penetrated.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शरैर्विदारयामासकङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः । बिभेदवानरांस्तत्रसप्ताष्टौनवपञ्चच ।।6.54.14।। विव्याधपरमक्रुद्धोवज्रदंष्ट्रःप्रतापवान् ।
output: Valiant Vajradamshtra became very furious and pierced with arrows of plumes of buzzard which never missed target in seven, eight, nine and five Vanaras at a time.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
त्रस्ताःसर्वेहरिगणाःशरैःसङ्कृत्तकन्दरा:।। 6.54.15।। अङ्गदंसम्प्रधावन्तिप्रजापतिमिवप्रजाः ।
output: Struck with fear the Vanaras sought the protection of Angada just as people seek protection of Brahma, the creator of beings.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
ततोहरिगणान् भग्नान् दृष्टवावालिसुतस्तदा ।।6.54.16।। क्रोधेनवज्रदंष्ट्रंतमुदीक्षन्तमुदैक्षत ।
output: Then the son of Vali gazing at the broken monkeys looking at Vajradamshtra in anger, faced himself.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वज्रदंष्ट्रोऽङ्गदश्चोभौसङ्गतौहरिराक्षसौ ।।6.54.17।। चेरतुःपरमक्रुद्धौहरिमत्तगजाविव ।
output: वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, अङ्गदश्च Angada's, उभौ both, हरिराक्षसौ monkeys and Rakshasas, सङ्गतौ strode, हरिमत्तगजामिव like lion and elephant in rut, परमक्रुद्धौ enraged, चेरतुः fought.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शतसहस्रेणहरिपुत्रंमहाबलः ।।6.54.18।। जघानमर्मदेशेषुमातङ्गमिवतोमरैः ।
output: ततः then, महाबलः endowed with great strength, हरिपुत्रम् monkey 's son, शतसहस्रेण hundred thousand, मातङ्गमिवतोमरैः like an elephants is pierced with clubs, मर्मदेशेषु private parts, जघान pierced.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गोवालिसूनुर्महाबलः ।।6.54.19।। चिक्षेपवज्रदंष्ट्रायवृक्षंभीमपराक्रमः ।
output: Angada who was endowed with great strength all his limbs bathed in blood and terrific valour took hold of a huge tree and shattered Vajradamshtra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्टापतन्तंतंवृक्षमसम्भ्रान्तश्चराक्षसः ।।6.54.20।। चिच्छेदबहुधासोऽपिमथितःप्रादतद्भुवि ।
output: That Rakshasa (Vajradamshtra) seeing the tree coming towards him was not bewildered. He shattered it into pieces, and it fell on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
तंदृष्टवावज्रदंष्ट्रस्यविक्रमंप्लवगर्षभ ।।6.54.21।। प्रगृह्यविपुलंशैलंचिक्षेपचननादच ।
output: The bull among monkeys, Angada seeing the valour of Vajradamshtra seizing a huge hillock hurled at the Rakshasa making loud sounds and breaking.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समापतन्तंदृष्टवासरथादाप्लुत्यवीर्यवान् ।।6.54.22।। गदापाणिरसम्भ्रान्तःपृथिव्यांसमतिष्ठत ।
output: The valiant Rakshasa who was not perplexed with mace in hand leaping down the chariot looking (at the hillock hurled) sat on the ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
साङ्गदेनगदाक्षिप्तागत्वातुरणमूर्धनि ।।6.54.23।। सचक्रकूबरंसाश्वंप्रममाथरथंतदा ।
output: स he, आङ्गदेव by Angada, क्षिप्ता discharged, शिला hillock, गत्वा went, रणमूर्धनि forefront of the battle, तदा then, सचक्रकूबरम् the wheels and pole, साश्वम् totally, रथम् chariot, प्रममाथ shattered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽन्यच्छिखरंगृह्यविपुलंद्रुमभूषितम् ।।6.54.24।। वज्रदंष्ट्रस्यशिरसिपातयामाससाऽङ्गदः ।
output: Then Angada seized a huge hillock adorned with trees hurled at Vajradamshtra.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
अभवच्छोणितोद्गारीवज्रदंष्ट्रस्समूर्छितः ।।6.54.25।। मुहूर्तमभवन्मूढोगदामालिङ् ग्यनिश्श्वसन् ।
output: Vajradamshtra vomiting blood became unconscious and clasping his mace breathing heavily he remained senseless for a while.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
संलब्दसंज्ञोगदयावालिपुत्रमवस्थितम् ।।6.54.26।। जघानपरमक्रुद्धोवक्षोदेशेनिशाचरः ।
output: संलब्दसंज्ञः regaining senses, निशाचरः night ranger, परमक्रुद्धः extremely angry, अवस्थितम् stood firmly, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, वक्षोदेशे direction of the chest, गदया with mace, जघान attacked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
गदांत्यक्त्वाततस्तत्रमुष्टियुद्धमवर्तत ।।6.54.27।। अन्योन्यंजघ्नतुस्तत्रतावुभौहरिराक्षसौ ।
output: Then leaving off the mace, a dual fight started there between one another, the monkeys, and Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
रुधिरोद्गारिणौतौतुप्रहारैर्जनितश्रमौ ।।6.54.28।। बभूवतुस्सुविक्रान्तावङ्गारकबुधाविव ।
output: Exhausted by strain both very valiant fought like planets Angaraka and Budha and spit out blood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःपरमतेजस्वीअङ्गदःप्लवगर्षभः ।।6.54.29।। उत्पाट्यवृक्षंस्थितवान् बहुपुष्पफलाञ्चितम् ।
output: Then highly energetic, bull among Vanaras, Angada, uprooting a tree full of many flowers and fruits stood there.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
जग्राहचार्षभंचर्मखडगंचविपुलंशुभम् ।।6.54.30।। किङ्किणाजालसञ्छन्नंचर्मणाचपरिष्कृतम् ।
output: (The Rakshasa seized) a huge bright sword, a shield decorated with tiny bells and sword encased in hide sheath.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चित्रांश्चरुचिरान्मार्गांश्चेरतुःकपिराक्षसौ ।।6.54.31।। जघ्नतुश्चतदान्योन्यंनिर्दयंजयकाङ् क्षिणौ ।
output: तदा then, जयकाङ् क्षिणौ desiring victory, कपिराक्षसौ monkey and Rakshasa, निर्दयम् passionately, चित्रान् wonderful, मार्गान् ways, चेरतुः struck, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नतुश्च harshly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
व्रणैस्सास्त्रैरशोभेतांपुष्पिताविवकिंशुकौ ।।6.54.32।। युध्यमानौपरिश्रान्तौजानुभ्यामवनींगतौ ।
output: सास्त्रै: streaming, व्रणैः wounds, पुष्पितौ blossomed, किंशुकाविव Kimsuka like, शोभेताम् charming, युध्यमानौ in the battlefield, परिश्रान्तौ exhausted, जानुभ्याम् knees, अवनीम् on the ground, गतौ sat.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निमेषान्तरमात्रेणअङ्गदःकपिकुञ्जरः ।।6.54.33।। उदतिष्ठतदीप्ताक्षोदण्डाहतइवोरगः ।
output: कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among the monkeys, अङ्गदः Angada, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण time of twinkling of the eyes दीप्ताक्षः eyes glowing, दण्डाहतः struck by staff, उरगःइव serpent like, उदतिष्ठत rose up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निर्मलेनसुधौतेनखड्डेनास्यमहच्छिरः ।।6.54.34।। जघानवज्रदंष्ट्रस्यवालिसूमर्महाबलः ।
output: महाबलः mighty, वालिसूनुः Val['s son, सुधौतेन sharpened well, निर्मलेन stainless, खडगेन sword, अस्यवज्रदंष्ट्रस्य that Vajradamshtra's, महत् great, शिरः head, जघान lopped off.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुधिरोक्षितगात्रस्यबभूवपतितंद्विधा ।।6.54.35।। सरोषपरिवृत्ताक्षंशुभंखडगहतंशिरः ।
output: His (Vajradamshtra's) limbs bathed in blood, cut off by sword, eyeballs rolling cleft into two dropped down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वज्रदंष्ट्रंहतंदृष्टवाराक्षसाभयमोहिताः ।।6.54.36।। त्रस्ताह्यभ्यद्रवन् लङ्कांवध्यमानाःप्लवङ्गमैः । विषण्णवदना: दीनाह्रियाकिञ्चिदवाङ्मुखाः ।।6.54.37।।
output: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, भयमोहिताः deluded in fear, प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, वध्यमानाः struck by monkeys, विषण्णवदनाः panic stricken, ह्रिया in shame, किञ्चित् heads bent, अवाङ्मुखाः faces, woebegone, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभ्यद्रवन् fled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वज्रदंष्ट्रंहतंदृष्टवाराक्षसाभयमोहिताः ।।6.54.36।। त्रस्ताह्यभ्यद्रवन् लङ्कांवध्यमानाःप्लवङ्गमैः । विषण्णवदना: दीनाह्रियाकिञ्चिदवाङ्मुखाः ।।6.54.37।।
output: Deluded with fear, the Rakshasas seeing Vajradamshtra killed by monkeys, panic stricken, heads bent in shame, faces woebegone fled to Lanka.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 54:
निहत्यतंवज्रधरप्रतापःसवालिसूनुःकपिसैन्यमध्ये । जगामहर्षंमहितोमहाबलःसहस्रनेत्रस्त्रिदशैरिवावृतः ।।6.54.38।।
output: Mighty son of Vali, having killed Vajradamshtra, honoured in the midst of great Vanara army was joyful surrounded like the thousand eyed Indra, the Lord of gods. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचतुःपञ्चाशस्सर्गः This is the end of the fifty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 55:
वज्रदंष्ट्रंहतंश्रुत्वावालिपुत्रेणरावणः । बलाध्यक्षमुवाचेदंकृताञ्जलिमुपस्थितम् ।।6.55.1।।
output: On hearing about Vajradamshtra being killed by Vali's son, Ravana spoke to the chief of the army who stood with folded hands.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शीघ्रंनिर्यान्तुदुर्धर्षाराक्षसाभीमविक्रमाः । अकम्पनंपुरस्कृत्यसर्वशस्त्रप्रकोविदम् ।।6.55.2।।
output: "Send for Akampana quickly, who is of terrific valour, difficult to encounter and skilled in all sastras."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषशास्ताचगोप्ताचनेताचयुधिसत्तमः । भूतिकामश्चमेनित्यंनित्यंचसमरप्रियः ।।6.55.3।।
output: युधि in war, शास्ता tamer of foes, गोप्ताच protector of his people, नेताच, एषः in that way, सत्तमः capable, नित्यम् always, मे my, भूतिकामश्च desirous of welfare, नित्यम् ever, समरप्रियः lover of war.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषजेष्यतिकाकत्स्थौसुग्रीवंचमहाबलम् । वानरांश्चापरान् घोरान् हनिष्यतिपरन्तपः ।।6.55.4।।
output: एष in that way, जेष्यति scorcher, काकत्स्थौ Rama and Lakshmana, सुग्रीवंच and Sugriva, महाबलः of mighty prowess, वानरांश्चा Vanaras, परान् घोरान् very dreadful, हनिष्यति will put an end, परन्तपः scorcher of enemies.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परिगृह्यसःताम् I ज्ञाम् रावणस्यमहाबल । बलम् सम्प्रेरयामासःतदालघुपराक्रमः।। 6.55.5।।
output: Then accepting Ravana's order, accordingly, taking hold of the army dispatched them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 55:
ततोनानाप्रहरणाभीमाक्षाभीमदर्शनाः । निष्पेतूराक्षसामुख्याबलाध्यक्षप्रचोदिताः ।।6.55.6।।
output: Thereafter taking different weapons, Rakshasas of fearful eyes and terrific appearance rushed forward ordered by CommanderinChief of the army.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रथमास्थायविपुलंतप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् । मेघाभोमेघवर्णश्चमेघस्वनमहास्वनः ।।6.55.7।। राक्षसैःसम्वृतोघोरैस्तदानिर्यात्यकम्पनः ।
output: Mounted on a huge chariot, Akampana, decked in pure gold jewels, like cloud in form and complexion, whose loud voice resembled thunder, surrounded by Rakshasas went forward.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नहिकम्पयितुंशक्यःसुरैरपिमहामृधे ।।6.55.8।। अकम्पनस्ततस्तेषामादित्यइवतेजसा ।
output: अकम्पनः Akampana, महामृधे in great war, सुरैरपि even for Suras, कम्पयितुम् could not be shaken, नशक्यःहि not possible, ततः then, तेषाम् in that manner, तेजसा brilliant, आदित्यःइव like Sun.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यनिर्धावमानस्यसम्रब्धस्ययुयुत्सया ।।6.55.9।। अकस्माद्दैन्यमागच्छद्धयानांरथवाहिनाम् ।
output: तस्य his, युयुत्सया excited, सम्रब्दस्य to wage war, निर्धानमानस्य experienced depression, अकस्मात् suddenly, रथवाहिनाम् dr awing the chariots, हयानाम् horses, दैन्यम् feeling of desperation, अगच्छत् developed

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्यस्फुरन्नयनंचास्यसव्यंयुद्धाभिनदनिनः ।।6.55.10।। विवर्णोमुखवर्णश्चगद्गदश्चाभवत्स्वनः ।
output: Himself being a lover of war, became pale with his countenance changed, voice choked, and his eyes lost its lustre.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभवत्सुदिनेकालेदुर्दिनंरूक्षमारुतम् ।।6.55.11।। ऊचुःखगमृगाःसर्वेवाचःक्रूराभयावहाः ।
output: At a time on a good day of fine weather, it became cloudy, birds and beasts were making frightening cries all over.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ससिंहापचित्कन्धःशार्दूलसमविक्रमः ।।6.55.12।। तानुत्पातानचिन्स्सैवनिर्जगामरणाजिरम् ।
output: सिंहापचितस्कन्धः whose shoulders were like that of a lion, शार्दूलसमविक्रमः equalled tiger in valour, सः he, तान् them, उत्पातान् developed, अविचिन्स्सैव not minding evil portents, रणाजिरम् to battle, निर्जगाम went.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथानिर्गच्छतस्तस्यरक्षसस्सहराक्षसैः ।।6.55.13।। बभूवसुमहान्नादःक्षोभयन्निवसागरम् ।
output: तस्यरक्षसः that Rakshasa, राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, तथा like that, निर्गच्छदः going, सागरम् ocean, क्षोभयन्निव agitated,, सुमहान् नादः huge noise, बभूव rose.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 55:
तेनशब्देनवित्रस्तावानराणांमहाचमूः ।।6.55.14।। द्रुमशैलप्रहाराणांयोद्धुंसमुपतिष्ठतं ।
output: Huge troops of Vanaras holding trees and hillocks stood prepared for waging and by that the noise that arose expanded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषांयुद्धंमहारौद्रंसञ्जज्ञेकपिरक्षसाम् ।।6.55.15।। रामरावणयोरर्धेसमभित्यक्तजीविनाम् ।
output: रामरावणयोः Rama and Ravana, समभित्यक्तजीविनाम् dedicated their lives तेषाम् that way, कपिराक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, महारौद्रम् enraged, युद्धम् battle, सञ्जज्ञे took place.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वेह्यतिबलाःशूराःसर्वेपर्वतसन्निभाः ।।6.55.16।। हरयोराक्षसाश्चैवपरस्परजिघांसवः ।
output: परस्परजिघासवः intending to kill one another, सर्वे all, हरयः Vanaras, राक्षसाश्चैव even Rakshasas, अतिबलाः of extraordinary might, शूराः warriors, सर्वे all, पर्वतसन्निभाः resembled hills.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषांविवर्धतांशब्दःसंयुगेऽतितरस्विनाम् ।।6.55.17।। शुश्रुवेसुमहान् कोपादन्योन्यमभिगर्जताम् ।
output: A tremendous sound thundered in that war when they fought with exceeding impetuosity with one another and yelled at each other.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रजश्चारुणवर्णाभंसुभीममभवद् भृशम् ।।6.55.18।। उद्धतंहरिरक्षोभिःसंरुरोधदिशोदश ।
output: भृशम् instantly, अरुणवर्णाभम् red coloured, सुभीमम् terrific, रजश्च dust, अभवत् arose, हरिरक्षोभिः Vanaras and Rakshasas, उद्धतम् raised, दश ten, दिशः directions, संरुरोध enveloped.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्योन्यंरजसातेनकौशेयोद्धूतपाण्डुना ।।6.55.19।। सम्वृतानिचभूतानिददृशुर्नरणाजिरे ।
output: The combatants could not see one another in the battlefield, and it seemed as though white silk piece was shaken by the wind by the appearance of the surrounding dust.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नध्वजोनपताकावाचर्मवातुरगोऽपिवा ।।6.55.20।। आयुधंस्यन्दनोवापिददृशेतेनरेणुना ।
output: तेन by that, रेणुना form, ध्वजः posts, नददृशे not visible, पताकावा fags also, न, चर्मवा not shield, तुरगोऽपिवा not horses, आयुधम् not weapons, स्यन्दनोवापि even chariots could not be seen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 55:
शब्दश्चसुमहांस्तेषांनर्दतामभिधावताम् ।।6.55.21।। श्रूयतेतुमुलोयुद्धेनरूपाणिचकाशिरे ।
output: As they were rushing over one another, terrific noise was heard, and no form was discernible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 55:
हरीनेवसुसंरुष्टाहरयोजघ्नुराहवे ।।6.55.22।। राक्षसाराक्षसांश्चापिनिजघ्नुस्तिमिरेतदा ।
output: Then in that darkness and in anger Vanaras went attacking Vanaras and Rakshasas also attacked Rakshasas (not knowing).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेपरांश्चविनिघ्नन्तःस्वांश्चवानरराक्षसाः ।।6.55.23।। रुधिरार्द्रांतदाचक्रुर्महींपङ्कानुलेपनाम् ।
output: परांश्च enemies, स्वांश्च own people, निघ्नन्तः terminating, ते they, वानरराक्षसाः Vanaras and Rakshasas, तदा then, महीम् great, रुधिरार्द्राम् blood flow, पङ्कानुलेपनाम् covered it with mud, चक्रुः did.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तुरुधिरौघेणसिक्तंह्यपगतंरजः ।।6.55.24।। शरीरशवसङ्कीर्णाबभूवचवसुन्धरा ।
output: Then moistened with blood, the dust settled on the ground was seen covered with bodies and limbs.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
द्रुमशक्तिगदाप्रासैश्शिलापरिघतोमरैः ।।6.55.25।। हरयोराक्षसाश्चैवस्तूर्णंजघ्नुरन्योन्यमोजसा ।
output: Then Rakshasas and Vanaras fought one another vigorously with trees, javelins, maces, darts, rocks, and peaks.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
बाहुभिःपरिघाकारैर्युध्यन्तःपर्वतोपमाः ।।6.55.26।। हरयोभीमकर्माणोराक्षसान्झघ्नुराहवे ।
output: भीमकर्माणः terrific deeds, पर्वतोपमाः hills like, हरयः Vanaras, परिघाकारैः resembling iron bars, बाहुभिः many, युध्यन्तः in battle, आहवे attacked, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, जघ्नुः went on.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राक्षसास्त्वभिसङ्क्रुद्धाःप्रासतोमरपाणयः ।।6.55.27।। कपीन्निजघ्निरेतत्रशस्त्रःपरमदारुणैः ।
output: There, the highly furious Rakshasas also exterminated the Vanaras with their weapons and darts.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अकम्पनस्सुसङ्क्रुद्धोराक्षसानांचमूपतिः ।।6.55.28।। सम्हर्षयतितान्सर्वान्राक्षसाभनिमविक्रमान् ।
output: Highly enraged Akampana of fierce valour cheered all the Rakshasa troops.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हरयस्त्वपिरक्षांसिमहाद्रुममहाश्मभिः ।।6.55.29।। विदारयन्त्यभिक्रम्यशस्त्राण्याच्छिद्यवीर्यतः ।
output: हरयस्तुअपि even Vanaras, वीर्यतः valiant, शस्त्राणि weapons, आच्छिद्य mangled, अभिक्रम्य countering, महाद्रुममहाश्मभिः huge trees and rocks, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, विदारयन्ति destroyed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरेवीराहरयःकुमुदोनलः ।।6.55.30।। मैन्दश्चपरमक्रुद्धाश्चक्रुर्वेगमनुत्तमम् ।
output: एतस्मिन् in the meantime अन्तरे in the midst, कुमुदः Kumuda, नलः Nala, मैन्धश्च Mainda, वीराः heroic, हरयः Vanaras, परमक्रुद्धाः very furious, अनुत्तमम् supreme, वेगम् speed, चक्रुः went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 55:
तेतुवृक्षैर्महावीराराक्षसानांचमूमुखे ।।6.55.31।। कदनंसुमहच्चक्रुर्लीलयाहरिपुङ्गवाः । ममन्थूराक्षसान् सर्वेवानरागणशोभृशम् ।।6.55.32।।
output: Great heroes of the Vanara leaders, chiefs of army sportively waged a great battle and crushed Rakshasas repeatedly. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty fifth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
तद्दृष्टवासुमहत्कर्मकृतंवानरतस्तमैः । क्रोधमाहारयामासयुधितीव्रमकम्पनः ।।6.56.1।।
output: Observing the great action and accomplishment of the foremost Vanaras in the battle, Akampana exhibited violent anger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्रोधमूर्चितरूपस्तुधून्वन्परमकार्मुकम् । दृष्टवातुकर्मशत्रूणांसारथिंवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.56.2।।
output: शत्रूणाम् by enemies, कर्म deeds, दृष्टवा looking, क्रोधमूर्चितरूपः exhibited violent anger, परमकार्मुकम् highly furious, धून्वन् bow, सारथिम् charioteer, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्त्त्वैतावत्त्वरितंरथंप्रापयसारथे । यत्रैतेबहवोघ्नन्तिसुबहून्राक्षसान्रणे ।।6.56.3।।
output: सारथे O Charioteer, यत्र there, बहव: many, एते those, रणे in battle, सुबहून् many, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, घ्नन्ति destroyed, त्वरितः quickly, तत्त्रैव to that place, रथम् chariot, प्रापय drive.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतेऽत्रबलवन्तोहिभीमकोपाश्चवानराः । द्रुमशैलप्रहरणास्तिष्ठन्तिप्रमुखेमम ।।6.56.4।।
output: बलवन्तः mighty, भीमकोपाश्च terribly angry, एते those, वानराः Vanara, द्रुमशैलप्रहरणाः using trees and hillocks as weapons, अत्र there, मम my, प्रमुखे chiefs, तिष्ठन्तिहि stand.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतान्निहन्तुमिच्छामिसमरश्लाघिनोह्यहम् । एतैःप्रमथितंसर्वंदृश्यतेराक्षसांबलम् ।।6.56.5।।
output: अहम् I, समरश्लाघिनः boast of their warfare, एतान् them, निहन्तुम् will finish, इच्छामि desire to, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, एतैः in the same way, प्रमथिम् end, दृश्यते wish to see.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःप्रजवनाश्वेनरथेनरथिनांवरः । हरीनभ्यहनत्क्रोधाच्छरजालैकम्पनः ।।6.56.6।।
output: Then Akampana seated in the chariot drawn by fast moving horses, assailed the Vanaras with a network of arrows.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नस्थातुंवानराश्शेकुःकिंपुनर्योद्धुमाहवे । अकम्पनशरैर्भग्नास्सर्वएवविदुद्रुवुः ।।6.56.7।।
output: The Vanaras could not counter or stand nor fight in battle. What to say more? Shattered by Akampana's arrows, they all took to their heels.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्मृत्युवशमापन्नानकम्पनवंशगतान् । समीक्ष्यहनुमान्ज्ञातीनुपतस्थेमहाबलः ।।6.56.8।।
output: Having observed that Vanaras are fallen under the sway of Akampana and under the sway of death, mighty Hanuman approached Akampana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंमहाप्लवगंदृष्टवासर्वेतेप्लवगयूथपा: । समेत्यसमरेवीरास्सहिताःपर्यवारयन् ।।6.56.9।।
output: वीराः hero, ते you, सर्वे all, प्लवगयूतपा: troops of Vanaras, महाप्लवगम् great monkey, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, समेत्य together, सहिताः along with, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अवस्थितंहनूमन्तंतेदृष्टवाहरियूथपा: । बभूवुर्बलवन्तोहिबलवन्तंसमाश्रिताः ।।6.56.10।।
output: ते to you, हरियूथपा: monkey leaders, अवस्थितम् firmly established, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दृष्टवा seeing, बलवन्तम् strong, समाश्रिताः taken shelter, बभूवुः became.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
अकम्पनस्तुशैलाभंहनूमन्तमवस्थितम् । महेन्द्रइवदाराभिश्शरैरभिववर्षह ।।6.56.11।।
output: On Akampana, who was well established like a mountain, mighty Hanuman showered torrents of arrows like Indra showered rain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अचिन्तयित्वाबाणौघान् शरीरेपतितान्शितान् । अकम्पनवधार्थायमनोदध्रेमहाबलः ।।6.56.12।।
output: महाबलः mighty, शितान् pierced, शरीरे in the body, पतितान् fallen, बाणौघान् volley of arrows, अचिन्तयित्वा un mindful, अकम्पनवधार्थाय for destroying Akampana, मनः mind, दध्रे thought.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
सप्रहस्यमहातेजाहनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । अभिदुद्रावतद्रक्षःकम्पयन्निवमेदिनीम् ।।6.56.13।।
output: Hanuman, the highly energetic son of Maruthi laughing, sprung up causing the earth to shake and rushed to that Rakshasa.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्याभिनर्दमानस्यदीप्यमानस्यतेजसा । बभूवरूपंदुर्धर्षंदीप्तस्येवविभावसोः ।।6.56.14।।
output: As he roared, his brilliance was blazing, his form was burning and became formidable for others to be at him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आत्मानंमप्रहरणंज्ञात्वाक्रोधसमन्वितः । शैलमुत्पाटयामासवेगेनहरिपुङ्गवः ।।6.56.15।।
output: हरिपुङ्गवः Vanara leader, आत्मानम् himself, अप्रहरणम् without any weapon, ज्ञात्वा knowing, क्रोधसमन्वितः full of anger, वेगेन quickly, शैलम् mountain, उत्पाटयामास took up.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
गृहीत्वातंमहाशैलंपाणिनैकेनमारुतिः । सविनद्यमहानादंभ्रामयामासवीर्यवान् ।।6.56.16।।
output: He, the heroic Maruthi, with one hand alone taking a huge mountain whirled round making loud noises.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तमभिदुद्रावराक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् । पुराहिनमुचिंसङ् ख्येवज्रेणेवपुरन्दरः ।।6.56.17।।
output: Then he went to Akampana and tormented him just as Indra did with his thunderbolt to Namuchi.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
अकम्पनस्तुतद्दृष्टवागिरिशृङ्गंसमुद्यतम् । दूरादेवमहाबाणैरर्धचन्द्रैर्व्यदारयत् ।।6.56.18।।
output: Seeing the peak of the mountain uplifted, Akampana also discharged halfmoon shaped great arrows from a distance.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्पर्वताग्रमाकाशेरक्षोबाणविदारितम् । विकीर्णंपतितंदृष्टवाहनुमान्क्रोधमूर्छितः ।।6.56.19।।
output: Hanuman seeing the peak of the mountain broken into pieces by Rakshasa's arrows and fallen was deluded with anger.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
सोऽश्वकर्णंसमासाद्यरोषदर्पान्वितोहरिः । तूर्णमुत्पाटयामासमहागिरिमिवोच्छ्रितम् ।।6.56.20।।
output: He (Hanuman) filled with pride and anger quickly uprooted an Aswakarana tree as huge as a mountain and held it.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंगृहीत्वामहास्कन्धंसोऽश्वकर्णंमहाद्युतिः । प्रहस्यपरयाप्रीत्याभ्रामयामासभूतले ।।6.56.21।।
output: He (Hanuman) endowed with great splendour, seizing a huge trunk of Aswakarana tree with great delight, whirled it round on the ground laughing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
प्रधावन्नूरुवेगेनप्रभञ्जंस्तरसाद्रुमान् । हनूमान्परमक्रुद्धश्चरणैर्दारयत्क्षितम् ।।6.56.22।।
output: Highly enraged Hanuman was running at high speed that his feet were seen breaking the trees and cleaving the earth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गजांश्चसगजारोहान्सरथान्रथिनस्तथा । जघानहनुमान् भीमान् राक्षसांश्चपदातिगान् ।।6.56.23।।
output: Hanuman struck the mahouts, elephants, similarly the chariots and riders of chariots as well as the terrific Rakshasas who fought standing on feet.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमन्तकमिवक्रुद्धंसद्रुमंप्राणहारिणम् । हनूमन्तमभिप्रेक्ष्यराक्षसाविप्रदुद्रुवुः ।।6.56.24।।
output: क्रुद्धम् angry, अन्तकमिव like spirit of death, सद्रुमम् those trees, प्राणहारिणम् took life, तंहनूमन्तम् that Hanuman, अभिप्रेक्ष्य seeing, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विप्रदुद्रुवुः took to heels.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
तमापतन्तंसङ्कृद्धंराक्षसानांभयावहम् । ददर्शाकम्पनोवीरश्चुक्षोधचननादच ।।6.56.25।।
output: The heroic Akampana saw Hanuman coming towards him very angry. Fearing Hanuman, the Rakshasas ran roaring in fear.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
सचतुर्दशभिर्बाणैश्शितैर्देहविदारणैः । निर्बिभेदहनूमन्तंमहावीर्यमकम्पनः ।।6.56.26।।
output: With fourteen pointed powerful arrows, Akampana tormented and split the body of Hanuman.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सतदाप्रतिविद्धस्तुबह्वीभिश्शरवृष्टभिः । हनूमान्ददृशेवीरःप्ररूढइवसानुमान् ।।6.56.27।।
