output: शरवृष्टिभिः rain of arrows, बह्वीभिः many times, तदा then, प्रतिविद्दस्तु interrupted, वीरः valiant one, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, प्ररूढः stood still, सानुमानिव like a mountain with trees, ददृशे seemed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विरराजमहाकायोमहावीर्योमहामना: । पुष्पिताशोकसङ्काशोविधूमइवपावकः ।।6.56.28।।
output: महावीर्यः exceedingly valiant, महाकायः gigantic, महामना: courageous, पुष्पिताशोकसङ्काशः like fully blossomed Ashoka trees, विधूमः smokeless, पावकःइव like fire, विरराज shone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽन्यंवृक्षमुत्पाट्यकृत्वावेगमनुत्तमम् । शिरस्यभिजघानाशुराक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् ।।6.56.29।।
output: Then Hanuman performed another supreme deed by uprooting a tree and striking on the head of Akampana, the chief of Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
सवृक्षेणहतस्तेनसक्रोधेनमहात्मना । राक्षसोवानरेन्द्रेणपपातचममारच ।।6.56.30।।
output: Reacting in anger the great Vanara chief struck the Rakshasa with a tree, by which the Rakshasa fell down dead.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंदृष्टवानिहतंभूमौराक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् । व्यथिताराक्षसास्सर्वेक्षितिकम्पइवद्रुमाः ।।6.56.31।।
output: Seeing Akampana lying dead on the ground, the Rakshasas were shaken like the trees in the earthquake and were distressed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्यक्तप्रहरणास्सर्वेराक्षसास्तेपराजिताः । लङ्कामभिययुस्त्रस्तावानरास्तैभिद्रुताः ।।6.56.32।।
output: Abandoning weapons, all Rakshasas having been defeated, chased by the Vanaras, frightened, ran away into Lanka.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेमुक्तकेशाःसम्भ्रान्ताभग्नमानाःपराजिताः । स्रवच्छ्रमजलैरङ्गैश्श्वसन्तोविप्रदुद्रुवुः ।।6.56.33।।
output: सम्भ्रान्ता perplexed, भग्नमाना broken hearted, पराजिताः defeated, मुक्तकेशाः hair loosened, ते they, स्रवच्छ्रमजलैः sweating in limbs, अङ्गैः limbs, श्वसन्तः sighing heavily, विप्रदुद्रुवुः ran very fast.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
अन्योन्यंप्रममन्थुस्तेविविशुर्नगरंभयात् । पृष्ठतस्तेतुसम्मूढाःप्रेक्षमाणामुहुर्मुहुः ।।6.56.34।।
output: Again, and again looking back in fear, covertly, bewildered, crushing one another, they went into the Lanka city.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषुलङ्कांप्रविष्टेषुराक्षसेषुमहाबलाः । समेत्यहरयस्सर्वेहनूमन्तमपूजयन् ।।6.56.35।।
output: Those Rakshasas, endowed with prowess, on entering Lanka got together and paid respects to Hanuman.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽपिप्रहृष्टस्तान् सर्वान् हरीन् सम्प्रत्यपूजयत् । हनुमान्सत्त्वसम्पन्नोयथार्हमनुकूलतः ।।6.56.36।।
output: सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with goodness, सः he, हनुमानपि Hanuman also, अनुकूलतः others for their part, यथार्हम् accordingly, तान् them, सर्वान् all, हरीन् monkeys, सम्प्रत्यपूजयत् greatly honoured.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विनेदुश्चयथाप्राणंहरयोजितकाशिनः । चकर्षुश्चपुनस्तत्रसप्राणानपिराक्षसान् ।।6.56.37।।
output: जितकाशिनः atmosphere of triumph, हरयः monkeys, यथाप्राणम् their life, विनेदुः sportively, तत्र there, सप्राणानपि willing to give up their life, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, पुनः again, चकर्षुश्च shouted.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
सवीरशोभामभजन्महाकपिःसमेत्यरक्षांसिनिहत्यमारुतिः । महासुरंभीमममित्रनाशनःयथैवविष्णुर्बलिनंचमूमुखे ।।6.56.38।।
output: Great Vanara, Maruti shone like a triumphant hero and saviour in front of the army, just as Lord Vishnu, the Lord of Devatas shone after killing the foes (demons).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 56:
अपूजयन्देवगणास्तदाकपिंस्वयंचरामोऽतिबलश्चलक्ष्मणः । तथैवसुग्रीवमुखाःप्लवङ्गमाविभीषणश्चैवमहाबलस्तथा ।।6.56.39।।
output: Thereafter Rama with the army of Devatas, Atibala and Lakshmana, in the same way Sugriva, the army chief, so also, Vibheeshana of exceeding might praised Hanuman. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अकम्पनवधंश्रुत्वाक्रुद्धोवैराक्षसेश्वरः । किञ्चिददीनमुखश्चापिसचिवांस्तानुदैक्षत ।।6.57.1।।
output: Ravana sends Prahastha the CommanderinChief of the army to the battlefield

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सतुध्यात्वामुहूर्तंतुमन्त्रिभिस्संविचार्यच । ततस्तुरावणःपूर्वदिवसेराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.57.2।। पुरींपरिययौलङ्कांसर्वगुल्मानवेक्षितुम् ।
output: राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, सःरावणः Ravana, मुहूर्तम् for a while, ध्यात्वा reflected, मन्त्रिभिः ministers too, संविचार्यच deliberated, ततः then, पूर्वदिवसे forenoon, सर्वगुल्मान् all posts, अवेक्षितुम् inspect, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka city, ययौ proceeded.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांराक्षसगणैर्गुप्तांगुल्मैर्बहुभिरावृताम् ।।6.57.3।। ददर्शनगरींलङ्कांपताकाध्वजमालिनीम् ।
output: Ravana saw Lanka guarded by the Rakshasa army, surrounded by many posts, with flags, posts, and pennants.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुद्धांतुनगरींदृष्टवारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः ।।6.57.4।। उवाचात्महितंकालेप्रहस्तंयुद्धकोविदम् ।
output: Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the city besieged, spoke to Prahastha who was skilled in warfare for his welfare.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
पुरस्योपनिविष्टस्यसहसापीडितस्यवा ।।6.57.5।। नान्यंयुद्धात्प्रपश्यामिमोक्षंयुद्धविशारद ।
output: "I am not able to see anyone (other than you) knowledgeable in warfare to deliver the city oppressed suddenly and can liberate from war."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहंवाकुम्भकर्णोवात्वंवासेनापतिर्मम ।।6.57.6।। इन्द्रजिद्वानिकुम्भोवावहेयुर्भारमीदृशम् ।
output: अहंवा myself, कुम्भकर्णोवा or Kumbhakarna, मम my, सेनापतिः CommanderinChief, त्वंवा or you, इन्द्रजिद्वा Indrajith, निकुम्भोवा or Nikumbha, ईदृशम् such, भारम् burden, वहेयुः undertake.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
सत्वंबलमतश्शीघ्रमादायपरिगृह्यच ।।6.57.7।। विजयायाभिनिर्याहियत्रसर्वेवनौकसः ।
output: "Therefore, quickly get ready with the army and take charge for conquering the vanaras collected there."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निर्याणायादेवतेनूनंचपलाहरिवाहिनी ।।6.57.8।। नर्दतांराक्षसेन्द्राणांश्रुत्वानादंद्रविष्यति ।
output: निर्याणायादेव as soon as you go, ते they, नूनम् surely, चलिता unsettled, हरिवाहिनी Vanara army, नर्दताम् uproar, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् Rakshasas, नादम् sound, श्रुत्वा hearing, द्रविष्यति will run.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
चपलाह्यविनीताश्चचलचित्ताश्चवानराः ।।6.57.9।। नसहिष्यन्तितेनादंसिंहनादमिवद्विपाः ।
output: "Vanaras, who are fickle minded, undisciplined and volatile, will not endure the roar of lions of glowing Rakshasas."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विद्रुतेचबलेतस्मिन् रामःसौमित्रिणासह ।।6.57.10।। अवशस्तेनिरालम्बःप्रहस्तवशमेष्यति ।
output: "Prahastha! Knowing your strength, the helpless Vanaras will surely run away and along with Saumithri. Rama will fall into your power."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आपत्संशयिताश्रेयोनात्रनिस्संशयीकृता ।।6.57.11।। प्रतिलोमानुलोमंवायद्वानोमन्यसेहितम् ।
output: अत्र then, संशयिता uncertain, आपत् if it comes, श्रेयः good, निस्सशयीकृता undesirable, न not, तु you, यत् that, वा or, प्रतिलोमानुलोमंवा whether acceptable or not acceptable, हितम् good, मन्यसे I think.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तुप्रहस्तोवाहिनीपतिः ।।6.57.12।। राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाचेदमसुरेन्द्रमिवोशना ।
output: रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, वाहिनीपतिः CommanderinChief, उशना preceptor of Rakshasas, असुरेन्द्रमिव this way to the king of Rakshasas, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa Lord, इदम् thus, उवाच spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राजन्मन्त्रितपूर्वंनःकुशलैस्सहमन्त्रिभिः ।।6.57.13।। विवादश्चापिनोवृत्तस्समवेक्ष्यपरस्परम् ।
output: "O king! This was deliberated with capable ministers earlier, is it not It was reviewed with one another, and controversy arose."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
प्रदानेनतुसीतायाःश्रेयोव्यवसितंमया ।।6.57.14।। अप्रदानेपुनर्युद्धंदृष्टमेत्तथैवनः ।
output: "If Sita is given away it is beneficial and if not given war is foreseen is known to us."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽहंदानैश्चमानैश्चसततंपूजितस्त्वया ।।6.57.15।। सान्त्वैश्चविविधैःकालेकिंनकुर्यांहितंतव ।
output: "You have always given me gifts, many honours and praises earlier and worshipped me. When time comes why will I not do"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नहिमेजीवितंरक्ष्यंपुत्रदारधनानिच ।।6.57.16।। त्वंपश्यमांजुहूषन्तंत्वदर्थेजीवितंयुधि ।
output: "I do not need to protect my life, sons, wives and wealth also. I am willing to give up my life also in war for you. You will see."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
एवमुक्त्वातुभर्तारंरावणंवाहिनीपतिः ।।6.57.17।। उवाचेदंबलाध्यक्षान्प्रहस्तःपुरतःस्थितान् ।
output: Prahastha, having submitted to his king Ravana in that way, the CommanderinChief of the army commanded the army that stood before him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मेशीघ्रंराक्षसानांमहाद्बलम् ।।6.57.18।। मद्भाणाब्दावेगेनहतानांशनिचरणाजिरे । अद्यहृष्यन्तुमांसादाःपक्षिणःकाननौकसां ।।6.57.19।।
output: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, महाबलम् great army, मे me, समानयत together, काननौकसाम् carnivorous, पक्षिणः birds, मद्बाणाच by my arrows, वेगेन speedily, रणाजिरे to the battlefield, हतानाम् killed, मांसादाः flesh, अद्य they, तृप्यन्तु will be satisfied.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मेशीघ्रंराक्षसानांमहाद्बलम् ।।6.57.18।। मद्भाणाब्दावेगेनहतानांशनिचरणाजिरे । अद्यहृष्यन्तुमांसादाःपक्षिणःकाननौकसां ।।6.57.19।।
output: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
इत्युक्तास्तेप्रहस्तेनबलाध्यक्षा: कृतत्वरा: । बलमुद्योजयामासुस्तस्मिन्राक्षसमन्दिरे ।।6.57.20।।
output: As soon as the commander in chief ordered in that way, the Rakshasa troops mobilized in the abode of Rakshasas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
साबभूवमुहूर्तेननिग्मर्नानाविधायुधैः । लङ्काराक्षसवीरैस्तैर्गजैरिवसमाकुला ।।6.57.21।।
output: In a short while the whole of Lanka was filled with elephant size Rakshasa warriors gathered with different kinds of weapons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
हुताशनंतर्पयतांब्राह्मणांश्चनमस्यताम् । आज्यगन्धप्रतिवहःसुरभिर्मारुतोववौ ।।6.57.22।।
output: A fragrant breeze blew past there with Rakshasas propitiating fire god, with offerings and by the worshipping of brahmins the air was pleasant filled with the fragrance of ghee and flowers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
स्रजश्चविविधाकाराजगृहुस्त्वभिमन्त्रिताः । सङ्ग्रामसज्जाःसम्हृष्टाधरायन्राक्षसास्तदा ।।6.57.23।।
output: Then the Rakshasas rejoiced, wishing victory, consecrated military material with chanting and wore flower garland s.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
सधनुष्काःकवचिनोवेगादाप्लुत्यराक्षसाः । रावणंप्रेक्ष्यराजानंप्रहस्तंपर्यवारयन् ।।6.57.24।।
output: Wearing bows and shields, looking at and greeting the king Ravana, they swiftly surrounded Prahastha.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथामन्त्ऱ्यतुराजानंभेरीमाहत्यभैरवाम् । आरुरोहरथंयुक्तःप्रहस्तस्सज्जकल्पितम् ।।6.57.25।। हयैर्महाजवैर्युक्तंसम्यक्सूतसुसंयतम् । महाजलदनिर्घोषंसाक्षाच्चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् ।।6.57.26।। उरगध्वजदुर्धर्षंसुवरूथंस्ववस्करम् । सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तंप्रहसन्तमिवश्रिया ।।6.57.27।।
output: अथ and then, युक्तः taking leave, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, राजानम् King, आमन्त्य causing, भैरवाम् terrific, भेरीम् drums, आहत्य blowing, सज्जकल्पितम् equipped for fight, महाजवैः of good speed, हयैः horses, युक्तम् driven by, सम्यक् capable, सूतसुसंयुतम् with charioteer, महाजलदनिर्घोषम् sounding like thundering cloud, साक्षात् just as, चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् shining like sun and moon, उरगध्वज with serpent sign on, दुर्धर्षम् difficult to overpower, सुवरूथम् provided with a wooden fence, स्ववस्करम् as defence against collision, सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तम् covered with net of gold, श्रिया splendour, प्रहसन्तमिव as if laughing, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथामन्त्ऱ्यतुराजानंभेरीमाहत्यभैरवाम् । आरुरोहरथंयुक्तःप्रहस्तस्सज्जकल्पितम् ।।6.57.25।। हयैर्महाजवैर्युक्तंसम्यक्सूतसुसंयतम् । महाजलदनिर्घोषंसाक्षाच्चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् ।।6.57.26।। उरगध्वजदुर्धर्षंसुवरूथंस्ववस्करम् । सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तंप्रहसन्तमिवश्रिया ।।6.57.27।।
output: अथ and then, युक्तः taking leave, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, राजानम् King, आमन्त्य causing, भैरवाम् terrific, भेरीम् drums, आहत्य blowing, सज्जकल्पितम् equipped for fight, महाजवैः of good speed, हयैः horses, युक्तम् driven by, सम्यक् capable, सूतसुसंयुतम् with charioteer, महाजलदनिर्घोषम् sounding like thundering cloud, साक्षात् just as, चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् shining like sun and moon, उरगध्वज with serpent sign on, दुर्धर्षम् difficult to overpower, सुवरूथम् provided with a wooden fence, स्ववस्करम् as defence against collision, सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तम् covered with net of gold, श्रिया splendour, प्रहसन्तमिव as if laughing, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथामन्त्ऱ्यतुराजानंभेरीमाहत्यभैरवाम् । आरुरोहरथंयुक्तःप्रहस्तस्सज्जकल्पितम् ।।6.57.25।। हयैर्महाजवैर्युक्तंसम्यक्सूतसुसंयतम् । महाजलदनिर्घोषंसाक्षाच्चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् ।।6.57.26।। उरगध्वजदुर्धर्षंसुवरूथंस्ववस्करम् । सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तंप्रहसन्तमिवश्रिया ।।6.57.27।।
output: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
ततस्तंरथमास्थायरावणार्पितशासनः । लङ्कायानिर्ययौतूर्णंबलेनमहतावृतः ।।6.57.28।।
output: Then, by the order of Ravana, Prahastha set out immediately and departed from Lanka taking a se at in the chariot, surrounded by the great army.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
ततोदुन्धुभिनिर्घोषःपर्जन्यनिनदोपमः । वादित्राणांचनिनदःपूरयन्निवमेदिनीम् ।।6.57.29।। शुश्रुवेशङ्खशब्दश्चप्रयातेवाहिनीपतौ ।
output: As the CommanderinChief was going there arose sounds of kettle drums, blasts of fanfares, and noise of blasts of conchs filling the earth was heard.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
निनदन्तस्स्वरान्घोरान्राक्षसाजग्मुरग्रतः ।।6.57.30।। भीमरूपामहाकायाःप्रहस्तस्यपुरस्सराः ।
output: Rakshasas of fierce appearance, of huge body size, making dreadful sounds went marching ahead of Prahastha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नरान्तकःकुम्भहनुर्महानादस्समुन्नतः ।।6.57.31।। प्रहस्तसचिवाह्येतेनिर्ययुःपरिवार्यतम् ।
output: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnatha, the adjutants of Prahastha went with him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
व्यूढेनेवसुघोरेणपूर्वद्वारात्सनिर्ययौ ।।6.57.32।। गजयूथनिकाशेनबलेनमहतावृतः ।
output: सः he, व्यूढेनेव formed into battle array, सुघोरेण formidable, गजयूथनिकाशेन resembled a herd of elephants, महता huge, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded, पूर्वद्वारात् from the eastern gate, निर्ययौ emerged.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
सागरप्रतिमौघेनवृतस्तेनबलेनसः ।।6.57.33।। प्रहस्तोनिर्ययौक्रुद्धःकालान्तकयमोपमः ।
output: Prahastha emerged in rage surrounded by his forces which was like an ocean that resembled Kala (time spirit), Anthaka (death) and Yama (God of death).

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
तस्यनिर्याणघोषेणराक्षसानांचनर्दताम् ।।6.57.34।। लङ्कायांसर्वभूतानिविनेदुर्विकृतैस्स्वरैः ।
output: By the sounds of roaring that emerged at the departure of the Rakshasas all beings of Lanka shrieked in unnatural ways.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
व्यभ्रमाकाशमाविश्यमांसशोणितभोजनाः ।।6.57.35।। मण्डलान्यपसव्यानिखगाश्चक्रूरथंप्रति ।
output: The birds living on flesh and blood reached the sky and circled anticlockwise around the chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
सम्नत्यःपावकज्वालाःशिवाघोराववाशिरे ।।6.57.36।। अन्तरिक्षात्पपातोल्कावायुश्चपरुषंवनौ ।
output: A meteor fell from the sky, the wind blew violently. Jackals howled vomiting tongues of fire.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धाग्रहाश्चनचकाशिरे ।।6.57.37।। मेघाश्चखरनिर्घोषारथस्योपरिरक्षसः । ववृषंरुधिरंचास्यसिषिचुश्चपुरस्सरान् ।।6.57.38।।
output: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धाग्रहाश्चनचकाशिरे ।।6.57.37।। मेघाश्चखरनिर्घोषारथस्योपरिरक्षसः । ववृषंरुधिरंचास्यसिषिचुश्चपुरस्सरान् ।।6.57.38।।
output: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 57:
केतुर्मूर्धनिगृध्रोऽस्यनिलीनोदक्षिणामुखः । तुदन्नुभयतःपार्श्वंसमग्रामहरत्प्रभाम् ।।6.57.39।।
output: Seeing a vulture sitting on the banner (of Prahastha) facing south scratching both sides, Prahastha became pale as if the entire prosperity had been snatched away.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सारथेर्भहुशश्चास्यसङ्ग्राममवगाहतः । प्रतोदोन्यपतद्धस्तात्सूतस्यहयसादिनः ।।6.57.40।।
output: A charioteer and knower of controlling the horses, the whip slipped many times from his hand.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निर्याणश्रीश्चयाऽस्यासीद्भास्वरावसुदुर्लभाः । साननाशमुहूर्तेनसमेचस्खलिताहयाः ।।6.57.41।।
output: The splendour of Prahastha which is difficult to destroy, disappeared at that moment and the horses stumbled on even ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रहस्तंत्वभिनिर्यान्तंप्रख्यातबलपौरुषम् । युधिनानाप्रहरणाकपिसेनाऽभ्यवर्तत ।।6.57.42।।
output: Seeing Prahastha, who is well known for his valour coming towards, for war with various weapons, the monkey army stood facing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथघोषस्सुतुमुलोहरीणांसमजायत । वृक्षानारुजतांचैवगुर्वीरागृह्णतांशिलाः ।।6.57.43।।
output: And when the monkeys took hold of heavy rocks and trees for fighting exceedingly tumultuous clamor arose.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नदतांराक्षसानांचवानराणांचगर्जताम् । उभेप्रमुदितेसैन्येरक्षोगणवनौकसाम् ।।6.57.44।। वेगितानांसमर्थानामन्योन्यवधकाङ् क्षिणाम् । परस्परंचाह्वयतांनिनाद्शूयतेमहान् ।।6.57.45।।
output: नदताम् yelling noise, राक्षसानांच of Rakshasas, गर्जताम् roaring, वानराणांच noise of Vanaras, उभे both, सैन्ये army, प्रमुदिते highly rejoiced, वेगितानाम् seized with speed, समर्थानाम् powerful, अन्योन्यवधकाङ् क्षिणाम् who sought the destruction of one another, परस्परम् one another, आह्वयताम् challenging, रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् armies of Rakshasas and Vanaras, महान् huge, निनादः roar, श्रूयते was heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नदतांराक्षसानांचवानराणांचगर्जताम् । उभेप्रमुदितेसैन्येरक्षोगणवनौकसाम् ।।6.57.44।। वेगितानांसमर्थानामन्योन्यवधकाङ् क्षिणाम् । परस्परंचाह्वयतांनिनाद्शूयतेमहान् ।।6.57.45।।
output: नदताम् yelling noise, राक्षसानांच of Rakshasas, गर्जताम् roaring, वानराणांच noise of Vanaras, उभे both, सैन्ये army, प्रमुदिते highly rejoiced, वेगितानाम् seized with speed, समर्थानाम् powerful, अन्योन्यवधकाङ् क्षिणाम् who sought the destruction of one another, परस्परम् one another, आह्वयताम् challenging, रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् armies of Rakshasas and Vanaras, महान् huge, निनादः roar, श्रूयते was heard.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःप्रहस्तःकपिराजवाहिनीमभिप्रतस्थेविजयायदुर्मतिः । विवृद्धवेगंश्चविवेशतांचमूंयथामुमूर्षुश्शलभोविभावसुम् ।।6.57.46।।
output: ततः thereafter, दुर्मतिः perverted, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, कपिराजवाहिनीम् army of monkey king, विजयाय to conquer, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, विवृद्धवेगःच grown immensely, मुमूर्षुः being on the point of death, शलभः moth, विभावसंयथा enters into flame, तांचमूम् that, विवेश entered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
ततःप्रहस्तंनिर्यान्तंदृष्टवाभीमपराक्रमम् । उवाचसस्मितंरामोविभीषणमरिन्दमः ।।6.58.1।।
output: Then Rama seeing Prahastha, the tamer of enemies of terrific valour coming towards him, said to Vibheeshana, having a gentle smile.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
कएषस्सुमहाकायोबलेनमहतावृतः । आचक्ष्वमेमहाबाहो वीर्यवन्तंनिशाचरम् ।।6.58.2।।
output: "Oh, Broad shouldered Vibheeshana! Who is this Rakshasa of gigantic form coming surrounded by a great army He seems to be a valiant one. Tell me."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
राघवस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाप्रत्युवाचविभीषणः ।।6.58.3।। एषसेनापतिस्तस्यप्रहस्तोनामराक्षसः । लङ्कायांराक्षसेन्द्रस्यत्रिभागबलसम्वृतः ।।6.58.4।। वीर्यवानस्त्रविच्छूरःसुप्रख्याश्चपराक्रमे ।
output: On hearing Raghava's words Vibheeshana replied." He is a Rakshasa, by name Prahastha, commander in chief of the army of Rakshasa king. He is widely known for his prowess, conversant with weapons and courageous. He is heroic and a third of the army of Ravana is under his command."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राघवस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाप्रत्युवाचविभीषणः ।।6.58.3।। एषसेनापतिस्तस्यप्रहस्तोनामराक्षसः । लङ्कायांराक्षसेन्द्रस्यत्रिभागबलसम्वृतः ।।6.58.4।। वीर्यवानस्त्रविच्छूरःसुप्रख्याश्चपराक्रमे ।
output: On hearing Raghava's words Vibheeshana replied." He is a Rakshasa, by name Prahastha, commander in chief of the army of Rakshasa king. He is widely known for his prowess, conversant with weapons and courageous. He is heroic and a third of the army of Ravana is under his command."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःप्रहस्तंनिर्यान्तंभीमंभीमपराक्रमम् ।।6.58.5।। गर्जन्तंसुमहाकायंराक्षसैरभिसम्वृतम् । ददर्शमहतीसेनावानराणांबलीयसाम् ।।6.58.6।। अभिसञ्जातरोषाणांप्रहस्तमभिगर्जताम् ।
output: ततः then, बलीयसाम् huge army, अभिसञ्जातरोषाणाम् of redoubtable prowess, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, अभिगर्जताम् roaring, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महती powerful, सेना army, निर्यान्तम् coming towards, भीमम् fierce, भीमपराक्रमम् of terrific prowess, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, अभिसम्वृतम् surrounded, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
ततःप्रहस्तंनिर्यान्तंभीमंभीमपराक्रमम् ।।6.58.5।। गर्जन्तंसुमहाकायंराक्षसैरभिसम्वृतम् । ददर्शमहतीसेनावानराणांबलीयसाम् ।।6.58.6।। अभिसञ्जातरोषाणांप्रहस्तमभिगर्जताम् ।
output: The huge army of powerful Vanaras saw Prahastha of terrific prowess, fierce, surrounded by Rakshasas coming towards them roaring.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
खडगशक्त्यृष्णिबाणाश्चशूलानिमुसलानिच ।।6.58.7।। गदाश्चपरिघाःप्रासाविविधाश्चपरिश्वधाः । नूंषिचविचित्राणिराक्षसानांजयैषिणाम् ।।6.58.8।। प्रगृहीतान्यशोभन्तवानरानभिधावताम् ।
output: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
खडगशक्त्यृष्णिबाणाश्चशूलानिमुसलानिच ।।6.58.7।। गदाश्चपरिघाःप्रासाविविधाश्चपरिश्वधाः । नूंषिचविचित्राणिराक्षसानांजयैषिणाम् ।।6.58.8।। प्रगृहीतान्यशोभन्तवानरानभिधावताम् ।
output: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जगृहुःपादपांश्चापिपुष्पितान्वानरर्षभाः ।।6.58.9।। शिलाश्चविपुलादीर्घायोद्धुकामाःप्लवङ्गमाः ।
output: योद्धुकामाः burning to fight, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, पुष्पितान् in bloom, पादपांश्चापि trees, वानरर्षभाः monkeys for their part, विपुलाः huge, दीर्घाः long, शिलाःच rocks also, जगृहुः went.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषामन्योन्यमासाद्यसङ्ग्रामःसुमहानभूत् ।।6.58.10।। बहूनामश्मवृष्टिंचशरवर्षंचवर्षताम् ।
output: अन्योन्यम् one another, आसाद्य approaching, आश्मवृष्टिम् rain of rocks, शरवर्षंच and rain of arrows, वर्षताम् showered, बहूनाम् many, तेषाम् by that, सुमहान् many, सङ्ग्रामः in war, अभूत् happened.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बहवोराक्षसायुद्धेबहून्वानरयूधपान् ।।6.58.11।। वानराराक्षसांश्चापिनिजघ्नुर्बहवोबहून् ।
output: In the course of war many Rakshasas killed many Vanara leaders and many Vanaras killed many Rakshasas also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शूलैःप्रमथिताःकेचित्केचिच्चपरमायुधैः ।।6.58.12।। परिघैराहताःकेचित्केचिच्छिन्नाःपरश्वधैः ।
output: Indeed, some were killed by Rakshasas with pikes, some by javelins, a few with iron bars, and a few were hacked with axes.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निरुच्छवासाःकृता: केचित्पतिताधरणीतले ।।6.58.13।। विभिन्नहृदयाःकेचिदिषुसन्धानसन्दिताः ।
output: केचित् few, कृता: cut, निरुच्छवासाः deprived of life, धरणीतले on the ground, पतिताः fell, केचित् some, इषुसंधानसन्दिताः struck by arrows, विभिन्नहृदयाः hearts broken to pieces.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
केचिव्दिधाकृताःखडगैःस्फुरन्तःपतिताभुवि ।।6.58.14।। वानराराक्षसैश्शूलैपार्श्वतश्चावदारिताः ।
output: Few Vanaras cut into two by Rakshasas fell down and few Vanaras fell on the ground sides of the body cleft ceased life.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानरैश्चापिसङ्क्रुद्धैराक्षसौघाःसमन्ततः ।।6.58.15।। पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्चसम्पिष्टावसुधातले ।
output: Then the highly enraged Vanaras completely crushed Rakshasas in groups by crushing them on the earth's surface with trees and mountain peaks.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वज्रस्पर्शतलैर्हस्स्सैर्मुष्टिभिश्चहताभृशम् ।।6.58.16।। वेमुश्शोणितमास्येभ्योविशीर्णदशनेक्षणाः ।
output: Hit by fists and hands that had the impact of thunderbolt, teeth and eyes smashed and fallen out, the Rakshasas vomited blood from their mouth excessively.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
आर्तस्वनंचस्वनतांसिंहनादंचनर्दताम् ।।6.58.17।। बभूवतुमुलश्शब्दोहरीणांरक्षसांयुधि ।
output: Tumultuous noise like the roar of lions arose in the battlefield with Vanaras and Rakshasas cries of pain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराराक्षसाःक्रुद्धावीरमार्गमनुव्रताः ।।6.58.18।। विवृत्तनयनाःक्रूराश्चक्रुःकर्माण्यभीतवत् ।
output: क्रुद्धाः angry, वीरमार्गम् path of heroes, अनुव्रताः following, क्रूराः cruel, विवृत्तनयनाः reeling of eyes, वानराः Vanaras, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, अभीतवत् without fear, कर्माणि deeds, चक्रुः carried out.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नरान्तकःकुम्भहनुर्महानादस्समुन्नतः ।।6.58.19।। एतेप्रहस्तसचिवास्सर्वेजघ्नुर्वनौकसः ।
output: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnata, all these associates of Prahastha made short work of the monkeys.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषामापततांशीघ्रंनिघ्नतांचापिवानरान् ।।6.58.20।। द्विविदोगिरिशृङ्गेणजघानैकंनरान्तकम् ।
output: शीघ्रम् at great speed, आपतताम् rushing, वानरान् Vanaras, निघ्नतांचापि also killing, तेषाम् in that way, एकम् one, नरान्तकम् Naranthaka, द्विविदः Dwivida, गिरिशृङ्गेण with peak of a mountain, जघान struck.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दुर्मुखःपुनरुत्थायकपिस्सविपुलद्रुमम् ।।6.58.21।। राक्षसंक्षिप्रहस्तस्तुसमुन्नतमपोथयत् ।
output: Dhurmukha monkey uprooting a huge tree holding it in hand killed the Rakshasa Samunnata.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
जाम्बवांस्तुसुसङ्क्रुद्धःप्रगृह्यमहतींशिलाम् ।।6.58.22।। पातयामासतेजस्वीमहानादस्यवक्षसि ।
output: Energetic Jambavantha, enraged, took a huge rock, and hurled at the chest of Mahanada who fell down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथकुम्भहनुस्तत्रतारेणासाद्यवीर्यवान् ।।6.58.23।। वृक्षेणाभिहतोमूर्ध्निप्राणान्सन्त्याजयद्रणे ।
output: And thereafter, valiant Tara closed with Kumbhahanu and attacked him with a tree on the head and he lost his life.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अमृष्यमाणस्तत्कर्मप्रहस्तोरथमाश्रितः ।।6.58.24।। चकारकदनंघोरंधनुष्पाणिर्वनौकसाम् ।
output: Then intolerant of the exploit, Prahastha got on to the chariot with bow in hand and caused dreadful havoc among the monkeys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आवर्तइवसञ्जज्ञेसेनयोरुभयोस्तदा ।।6.58.25।। क्षुभितस्याप्रमेयस्यसागरस्येवनिस्स्वनः ।
output: Then the sound of both armies was like an agitated, boundless ocean, whirling round and frightening.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महताहिशरौघेणप्रहस्तोयुद्धकोविदः ।।6.58.26।। अर्दयामाससङ्क्रुद्धोवानरान् परमाहवे ।
output: परमाहवे major conflict, युद्धकोविदः expert in war, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, सङ्क्रुद्धः highly furious, महता, शरौघेण stream of arrows, वानरान् at Vanaras, अर्धयामास tormented

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराणांशरीरैश्चराक्षसानांचमेदिनी ।।6.58.27।। बभून्विचिताघोराःपतितैरिवपर्वतै ।
output: वानराणाम् of Vanaras, राक्षसानांच and Rakshasas, घोरैः dreadful, शरीरैः bodies, अतिचिता strewn, मेदिनी the earth, पर्वतैः mountains, पतितैःइव like fallen, बभूव seemed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सामहीरुधिरौघेणप्रच्छन्नासम्प्रकाशते ।।6.58.28।। सञ्छन्नामाधवेमासिपलाशैरिवपुष्पितैः ।
output: That battlefield drenched with blood shone bright as though veiled with blossoms of Palasa in the month of Magha.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हतवीरौघवस्रांतुभग्नायुधमहाद्रुमाम् ।।6.58.29।। शोणितौघमहातोयांयमसागरगामिनीम् । यकृत् प्लीहमहापङ्कान्वििकीर्णान्त्रशैवलाम् ।।6.58.30।। भिन्नकायशिरोमीनामङ्गावयवशाद्वलाम् । गृध्रहंसगणाकीर्णांकङ्कसारससेविताम् ।।6.58.31।। मेदःफेनसमाकीर्णामार्तस्न्तितस्वनाम् । तांकापुरषुदुस्तारांयुद्धभूमिमयींनदीम् ।।6.58.32।। नदीमिवघनापायेहंससारससेविताम् । राक्षसाःकपिमुख्याश्चतेरुस्तांदुस्तरांनदीम् ।।6.58.33।। यथापद्मरजोध्वस्तांनळिनींगजयूथपाः ।

output: Further Nila saw Prahastha seated and trembling and discharging a volley of arrows with vehemence exterminating monkeys.

instruction:

उद्धूतइववायुःखेमहदभ्रबलंबलात् ।।6.58.35।। समीक्ष्याभिद्रुतंयुद्धेप्रहस्तोवाहिनीपतिः । रथेनादित्यवर्णेननीलमेवाभिदुद्रुवे ।।6.58.36।।
output: Prahastha, the commander of the army darted, just as the violent wind blows away mass of clouds, observing Nila coming towards him, in his chariot which was bright as the sun.

instruction:

output: Prahastha, the commander of the army darted, just as the violent wind blows away mass of clouds, observing Nila coming towards him, in his chariot which was bright as the sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
सधनुर्धन्विनांश्रेष्ठोविकृष्यपरमाहवे ।।6.58.37।। नीलायव्यसृजद्बाणान्प्रहस्तोवाहिनीपतिः ।
output: Prahastha, the CommanderinChief of the army, supreme among wielders of bow, stretched his best bow and drew it and began to discharge arrows at Neela.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेप्राप्यविशिखानीलंविनिर्भिद्यसमाहिताः ।।6.58.38।। महींजग्मुर्महावेगारुषिताइवपन्नगाः ।
output: The arrows discharged by Prahastha, penetrated piercing into Nila's body at great speed like infuriated serpents and went straight into the earth.

instruction:

output: महाकपिः great Vanara, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सः he, नीलः Nila, निशितैः sharp, ज्वलनोपमैः glowing like tongues of fire, शरैः arrows, अभिहतः having been hit, वृक्षम् tree, उत्पाट्य uprooting, परमदुर्धर्षम् most difficult to encounter, आपतन्तम् rushing towards, तंप्रहस्तम् that Prahastha, ताडयामास struck.

instruction:

output: Great Vanara, a valiant one, Nila having been hit with arrows sharp as tongues of fire, struck Prahastha, who is most difficult to encounter and rushing towards him by uprooting a tree.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सतेनाभिहतःक्रुद्धोनदन्राक्षसपुङ्गवः । ववर्षशरवर्षाणिप्लवङ्गानांचमूपतौ ।।6.58.41।।
output: तेन by that, अभिहतः having been struck, सःराक्षसपुङ्गवः that Rakshasa leader, क्रुद्धः became furious, नदन् roaring, प्लवङ्गानाम् monkeys, चमूपतौ bull among Rakshasas, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, ववर्ष showered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यबाणगणान्घारान्राक्षसस्यमहाबलः । अपारयन्वारयितुंप्रत्यगृह्णान्निमीलितः ।।6.58.42।।
output: महाबलः mighty, तस्य his, राक्षसस्य Rakshasa's, बाणगणान् volley of arrows, वारयितुम् to check, अपारयन् not able to, निमीलितः with closed eyes, प्रत्यगृह्णात् received them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
यथैवगोवृषोवर्षंशारदंशीघ्रमागतम् । एवमेवप्रहस्तस्यशरवर्षंदुरासदम् ।।6.58.43।। निमीलिताक्षस्सहसानीलस्सेहेदुरासदान् ।
output: Just as a mighty bull faces sudden downpour of autumnal rain, in the same way Nila precisely tolerated the rain of arrows of Prahastha, which are difficult to face, with eyes closed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
रोषितश्शरवर्षेणसालेनमहतामहान् । प्रजघानहयाननीलःप्रहस्तस्यमहाबलः ।।6.58.44।।
output: Neela endowed with great prowess, became angry (by the rain of arrows showered on him) and hurled a huge Sala tree at Prahastha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततन्सचापमुद्गृह्यप्रहस्तस्यमहाबलः । बभञ्जतरसानीलोननादचपुनःपुनः ।।6.58.45।।
output: Thereupon, Neela firmly holding the bow of mighty Prahastha broke it again and again and roared

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विधनुस्तुकृतस्तेनप्रहस्तोवाहिनीपतिः । प्रगृह्यमुसलंघोरंस्यन्दनादवपुप्लुवे ।।6.58.46।।
output: Deprived of bow and chariot, Prahastha, the CommanderinChief seizing a terrific mallet jumped down from the chariot.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तावुभौवाहिनीमुख्यौजातवैरौतरस्विनौ । स्थितौक्षतजगदिग्धाङ्गौप्रभिन्नाविवकुञ्जरौ ।।6.58.47।।
output: जातवैरौ deadly enemies, तरस्विनौ strong, तौ they, उभौ both, वाहिनीमुख्यौ CommanderinChief of army, क्षतजगदिग्दाङ्गौ their limbs wetted with blood, प्रभिन्नौ disfigured, कुञ्जरौइव like elephants, स्थितौ stood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उल्लिखन्तौसुतीक्ष्णाभिर्दंष्ट्राभिरितरेतरम् । सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौसिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ ।।6.58.48।। विक्रान्तविजयौवीरौसमरेष्न्विवर्तिनौ । काङ्क्षमाणौयशःप्राप्तुंवृत्रवासवयोस्सह ।।6.58.49।।
output: सुतीक्ष्णाभिः exceedingly sharp, दंष्ट्राभिः teeth, इतरेतरम् each other, उल्लिखन्तौ tearing up, सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौ like lion and tiger, सिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ behaving like lion and tiger, विक्रान्तविजयौ who won many wars, समरेषु in wars, अनिवर्तिनौ never turned back, वीरौ heroes, वृत्रवासवयोः demon Vrta and Indra, यशः fame, सह to conquer, प्राप्तुम् to attain, काङ्क्षमाणाविव desiring to win.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
उल्लिखन्तौसुतीक्ष्णाभिर्दंष्ट्राभिरितरेतरम् । सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौसिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ ।।6.58.48।। विक्रान्तविजयौवीरौसमरेष्न्विवर्तिनौ । काङ्क्षमाणौयशःप्राप्तुंवृत्रवासवयोस्सह ।।6.58.49।।
output: Tearing up each other with exceedingly sharp teeth they were behaving like a lion and tiger. They had won many wars and never turned back in war. They were heroes like Vrta and Indra desiring to conquer and attain fame.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आजघानतदानीलंललाटेमुसलेनसः । प्रहस्तःपरमायत्तस्ततस्सुस्रावशोणितम् ।।6.58.50।।
output: तदा then, सःप्रहस्तः Prahastha, परमायत्तः speedily, मुसलेन with mallet, नीलम् Neela, ललाटे forehead, आजघान struck, ततः then, शोणितम् blood, सुस्राव flowed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःशोणितदिग्धाङ्गःप्रगृह्यसुमहातरुम् । प्रहस्तस्योरसिक्रुद्धोविससर्जमहाकपिः ।।6.58.51।।
output: Then drenched with blood, Neela was enraged and took hold of a huge tree and hurled at the chest of Prahastha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
तमचिन्त्यप्रहारंसप्रगृह्यमुसलंमहत् । अभिदुद्रावबलिनंबलाननीलंप्लवङ्गमम् ।।6.58.52।।
output: He (Prahastha), not caring for the wound, taking a huge mallet went towards that courageous monkey (Neela).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमुग्रवेगंसंरब्धमापतन्तंमहाकपिः । ततस्सम्प्रेक्ष्यजग्राहमहावेगोमहाशिलाम् ।।6.58.53।।
output: Then, seeing Prahastha waging and coming towards him, the great monkey, Neela, endowed with high speed threw a huge rock.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्ययुद्धाभिकामस्यमृथेमुसलयोधिन । प्रहस्तस्यशिलांनीलोमूर्ध्नितूर्णमपातयत् ।।6.58.54।।
output: Fighting with the mallet, Neela quickly dropped the rock on that Prahastha's forehead

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 58:
सातेनकपिमुख्येनविमुक्तामहतीशिला । बिभेदबहुधाघोराप्रहस्तस्यशिरस्तदा ।।6.58.55।।
output: Hurled by Neela, the foremost of monkeys, the huge rock broke the head of Prahastha into pieces.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सगतासुर्गतश्रीकोगतसत्त्वोगतेन्द्रियः । पपातसहसाभूमौछिन्नमूलइवद्रुमः ।।6.58.56।।
output: गतासुः life gone, गतश्रीकः splendour gone, गतसत्त्वः strength gone, गतेन्द्रियः senses gone, सः he, छिन्नमूलः tree at the bottom, द्रुमःइव like tree, सहसा instantly, भूमौ on ground, पपात fell.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विभिन्नशिरसस्तस्यबहुसुस्रावशोणितम् । शरीरादपिसुस्रावगिरेःप्रस्रवणंयथा ।।6.58.57।।
output: तस्य his, विभिन्नशिरसः shattered head, बहु much, शोणितम् blood, सुस्राव flowed, शरीरादपि all over the body, गिरेः mountain, प्रस्रवणंयथा like a spring from, सुस्राव flowed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हतेप्रहस्तेनीलेनतदकम्प्यंमहाबलम् । राक्षसानामहृष्टानांलङ्कामभिजगामह ।।6.58.58।।
output: नीलेन by Neela, प्रहस्ते Prahastha, हते having been killed, अहृष्टानाम् cheerless, राक्षसानाम् of Rakshasas, अकम्प्यम् unshakeable, तत् बलम् that troops, लङ्काम् from Lanka, अभिजगामह could not stay there.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नशेकुस्समवस्थातुंनिहतेवाहिनीपतौ । सेतुबन्धंसमासाद्यविशीर्णंसलिलंयथा ।।6.58.59।।
output: वाहिनीपतौ CommanderinChief, निहते killed, विशीर्णम् breached, सेतुबन्दम् dam, समासाद्य reaching, सलिलंयथा like the water, समवस्थातुम् stationary, नशेकुः not remain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हतेतस्मिंश्चमूमुख्येराक्षसास्तेनिरुद्यमाः । रक्षःपतिगृहंगत्वाध्यानमूकत्वमास्थिताः ।।6.58.60।। प्राप्ताश्शोकार्णवंतीव्रंनिस्सज्ञौइवतेऽभवन् ।
output: CommanderinChief killed, those Rakshasas reduced to speechlessness went to the abode of their Lord and remained without consciousness.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तस्मिन्हतेराक्षससैन्यपालेप्लवङ्गमानामृषभेणयुद्धे । भीमयुधंसागरतुल्यवेगंविदुद्रुवेराक्षसराजसैन्यम् ।।6.59.1।।
output: Commander in chief of the Rakshasa army killed by Neela, the bull of Vanaras, the army Rakshasas with dreadful weapons which were like the fury of an ocean, ran.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गत्वाऽथरक्षोधिपतेश्शशंसुस्सेनापतिंपावकसूनुशस्तम् । तच्छापितेषांवचनंनिशम्यरक्षोधिपःक्रोधवशंजगाम ।।6.59.2।।
output: Having gone to the king of Rakshasas, the survivors said, "Prahastha is killed by the son of fire god." Thereafter, the king of Rakshasas fell prey to anger.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सङ् ख्येप्रहस्तंनिहतंनिशम्यशोकार्दितःक्रोधपरीतचेताः । उवाचतान्राक्षसयूथमुख्यानिन्द्रोयथानिर्जरयोथमुख्यान् ।।6.59.3।।
output: Even as Rakshasas revealed about Prahastha's death, tormented by grief and anger Ravana spoke to Rakshasa troops just as Indra spoke to celestial troops.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नावज्ञारिपवेकार्यायैरिन्द्रबलसूदनः । सूदितस्सैन्यपालोमेसानुयात्रस्सकुञ्जरः ।।6.59.4।।
output: इन्द्रबलसादनः one who is capable of destroying Indra's army, सानुयात्रः followers, सकुञ्जरः elephants, मेसैन्यपालः my commander in chief, यैः he who, सूदितः capable of killing, रिपवे with regard to enemy, अवज्ञा low opinion, नकार्या not to think.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
सोऽहंरिपुविनाशायविजयायाविचारयन् । स्वयमेवगमिष्यामिरणशीर्षंतदद्भुतम् ।।6.59.5।।
output: "I shall go myself without thinking to that wonderful battle scene and put an end to the enemy and succeed."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
अद्यतद्वानरानीकंरामंचसहलक्ष्मणम् । निर्दहिष्यामिबाणौघैर्वनंदीप्स्सैरिवानगिभिः ।।6.59.6।।
output: "Now I will go and burn up that army of Vanaras along with Lakshmana and Rama with the stream of my arrows just as forest fire without the use of fire."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सएवमुक्त्वाज्वलनप्रकाशंरथंतुरङ्गोत्तमराजयुक्तम् । प्रकाशमानंवपुषाज्वलन्तंसमारुरोहामरराजशत्रुः ।।6.59.7।।
output: Ravana, the enemy of the king of Devatas, having spoken like that ascended a chariot yoked to the best of horses, shining by virtue of its form (golden) and luminous like fire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादैरास्फोटितक्षेळ्वितसिंहनादैः । पुण्यैस्स्तवैश्चाप्यभिपूज्यमानस्तदाययौराक्षसराजमुख्य:।। 6.59.8।।
output: As the foremost king of the Rakshasas went forth, a blast of sounds of conchs, beat of drums and clapping of arms and the roaring sounds followed by the chanting of auspicious verses sung by the Rakshasas eulogizing and honouring the king highly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
सशैलजीमून्तिकाशरूपैर्मांसादनैःपावकदीप्तनेत्रैः । बभौवृतोराक्षसराजमुख्योभूतैर्वृतोरुद्रइवासुरेशः ।।6.59.9।।
output: The Rakshasa king surrounded by Rakshasas who resembled mountains and clouds in form seemed like Rudra surrounded by asuras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोनगर्यास्सहसामहौजानिष्क्रम्यतद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम् । महार्णवाभ्रस्तनितंददर्शसमुद्यतंपादपशैलहस्तम् ।।6.59.10।।
output: Thereafter, Ravana possessed with great splendour stopped at the city and saw the army of Vanaras collected together looking like an ocean of clouds wielding trees and rocks.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्राक्षसानीकमतिप्रचण्डमालोक्यरामोभुजगेन्द्रबाहुः । विभीषणंशस्त्रभृतांवरिष्ठमुवाचसेवानुगतःपृथुश्रीः ।।6.59.11।।
output: Rama, whose arms were like the king of serpents, shining with splendour, followed by army, seeing the army of Rakshasas exceedingly furious, spoke to Vibheeshana the foremost of the wielder of weapons.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
नानापताकध्वजशस्त्रजुष्टंप्रासासिशूलायुथवज्रजुष्टम् । कस्येदमक्षोभ्यमभीरुजुष्टंमहेन्द्रोपमनागजुष्टम् ।।6.59.12।।
output: "Under whose command is this unshakeable army with several kinds of flags, posts and weapons armed with missiles, tridents, swords spikes and darts, with elephants the size of Mahendra mountain"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तुरामस्यनिशम्यवाक्यंविभीषणंश्शक्रसमानवीर्यः । शशंसरामस्यबलप्रवेगंमहात्मनांराक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् ।।6.59.13।।
output: ततः thereupon, शक्रसमानवीर्यः hero equal to Indra, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, रामस्य Rama's, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य on hearing, महात्मनाम् great soul, राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् among the Rakshasa leaders, बलप्रवेगम् endowed with great strength, रामस्य to Rama, शशंस revealed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
योऽसौगजस्कन्धगतोमहात्मानवोदितार्कोपमताम्रवक्त्रः । प्रकम्पयन्नागशिरोऽभ्युपैतिह्यकम्पनंत्वेनमवेहिराजन् ।।6.59.14।।
output: "O King! the one seated on the elephant, by whose weight the elephant head is shaking, whose coppery face is like the rising sun, a gigantic one is Akampana."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
योऽसौरथस्थोमृगराजकेतुर्दून्वस्थिन्दनुश्शक्रधनुःप्रकाशम् । करीवभात्युग्रविवृत्तदंष्ट्रस्सइन्द्रजिन्नामवरप्रधानः ।।6.59.15।।
output: रथस्थः from the chariot, मृगराजकेतुः distinguished by the sign of lion, शक्रधनुःप्रकाशम् splendid as the bow of Indra, धनुः bow, धुन्वन् making sound, यःअसौ he who, उग्रविवृत्तदंष्ट्रः with terrific teeth projected forward, करीव elephant, भाति looks like, सः he, वरप्रधानः eminent by the boons bestowed, इन्द्रजित् नाम Indrajith by name.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यश्चैषव्निध्यास्तमहेन्द्रकल्पोधन्वीरथस्थोऽतिरथोतिवीरः । विष्पारयन् चापमतुल्यमानंनाम्नातिकायोऽतिविवृद्धकायः ।।6.59.16।।
output: "He who resembles Vindhya Mountain in the west (where the sun sets) and the Mahendra mountain (in size) seated on the chariot, is a great chariotwarrior, a hero unequalled in size, wielding a bow whose body is grown out of size, who is coming in sight is by name Atikaya."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
योऽसौनवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षुरारुह्यघण्टानिनदप्रणादम् । गजंखरंगर्जतिवैमहात्मामहोदरोनामसएषःवीरः ।।6.59.17।।
output: "He whose eyes are coppery red in anger, who rides on elephant resembles the beating of bells, roars in harsh tone are a great courageous one by the name Mahodara."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
योऽसौहयंकाञ्चनचित्रभाण्डमारुह्यसन्ध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम् । प्रासंसमुद्यम्यमरीचिनद्धंपिशाचएषोऽशनितुल्यवेगः ।।6.59.18।।
output: "He who is mounted on horses decorated with gold shining, like a mountain crowned with cloud, radiant as the Sun holding the shining yokes coming at high speed is by name Pisacha."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यश्चैषशूलंनिशितंप्रगृह्यविद्युत्प्रभंकिङ्करवज्रवेगम् । वृषेन्द्रमास्थायगिरिप्रकाशमायातियोऽसौत्रिशिरायशस्वी ।।6.59.19।।
output: "He who comes firmly shining like lightning, surpassing thunderbolt in speed, seizing a trident, riding a Lordly bull shining like a mountain is the famous Trisira."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
असौचजीमूतनिकाशरूपःकुम्भःपृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः । समाहितःपन्नगराजकेतुर्विष्पारयन्यातिधनुर्विधून्वन् ।।6.59.20।।
output: "There comes Kumbha whose form is like a cloud in form, whose chest is fleshy and broad. He is fully prepared, coming with a sign of the king of serpents (Vasuki) stretching his bow."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यश्चैषजाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टंदीप्तंसधूमंपरिघंप्रगृह्य । आयातिरक्षोबलकेतुभूतःसोऽसौनिकुम्भोऽद्भुतघोरकर्मा ।।6.59.21।।
output: "There comes Nikumbha, studded with gold and diamonds, shining and smoky, who is the chief of Rakshasa army seizing an iron club, is capable of wonderful and terrific deeds."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यश्चैषचापासिशरौघजुष्टंपताकिनंपावकदीप्तरूपम् । रथंसमास्थायविभात्युदग्रोनरान्तकोऽसौनगशृङ्गयोधी ।।6.59.22।।
output: चापासिशरौघजुष्टम् with multitude of swords and arrows, पताकिनम् with flags, पावकदीप्तरूपम् blazing like fire, रथम् chariot, समास्थाय mounted on, यःएषः he that way, विभाति glorious, उदग्रः on top, असौ he is, नगशृङ्गयोधी fights with mountain peaks, नरान्तकः Naranthaka.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यश्चैषनानाविधघोररूपैर्व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्त्रै: । भूतैर्वृतोभातिविवृत्तनेत्स्रैसोऽसौसुराणामपिदर्पहन्ता ।।6.59.23।। त्रैतदिन्दुप्रतिमंविभातिछत्रंसितंसूक्ष्मशलाकमग्य्रम् । अत्रैषरक्षोधिपतिर्महात्माभूतैर्वृतोरुद्रइवावभाति ।।6.59.24।।
output: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यश्चैषनानाविधघोररूपैर्व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्त्रै: । भूतैर्वृतोभातिविवृत्तनेत्स्रैसोऽसौसुराणामपिदर्पहन्ता ।।6.59.23।। त्रैतदिन्दुप्रतिमंविभातिछत्रंसितंसूक्ष्मशलाकमग्य्रम् । अत्रैषरक्षोधिपतिर्महात्माभूतैर्वृतोरुद्रइवावभाति ।।6.59.24।।
output: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
असौकिरीटीचलकुण्डलास्योनगेन्द्रविन्ध्योपमभीमकायः । महेन्द्रवैवस्वतदर्पहन्तारक्षोधिपस्सूर्यइवावभाति ।।6.59.25।।
output: "There is the king of Rakshasas shining like Sun, whose countenance shines with hanging earrings, of terrible form like the Himalayas and Vindhya, who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
प्रत्युवाचततोरामोविभीषणमरिन्दम् । अहोदीप्तमहातेजारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः ।।6.59.26।।
output: Then Rama the scourge of enemies replied Vibheeshana, "Oh! Ravana! King of Rakshasas is endowed with luminous glory."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आदित्यइवदुष्प्रेक्ष्योरश्मिभिर्भातिरावणः । सुव्यक्तंलक्ष्यतेह्यस्यरूपंतेजःसमावृतम् ।।6.59.27।।
output: "Ravana blazing like the sun is difficult to gaze even. His shine is spread all over and not perceptible to discern."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
देवदानववीराणांवपुर्नैवंविधंभवेत् । यादृशंराक्षसेन्द्रस्यवपुरेतत्प्रकाशते ।।6.59.28।।
output: Among the Devas and Danavas such brilliance is not there. He shines so brightly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वेपर्वतसङ्काशास्सर्वेपर्वतयोधिनः । सर्वेदीप्तायुधधरायोधाश्चास्यमहोजस:।। 6.59.29।।
output: "The great warriors of Ravana fighting in war are like mountains and all fought with mountains and glowing weapons."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भातिरक्षोराजोऽसौप्रदीप्त्तैर्भीमविक्रमैः । भूतैःपरिवृतस्तीक्ष्णैर्देहवद्भिरिवान्तकः ।।6.59.30।।
output: प्रदीप्त्तै: shining brilliance, भीमविक्रमैः of terrible valour, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, देहवद्भिः furious forms, परिवृत surrounded by, भूतैः beings, असौ oh, रक्षोराजः Rakshasa king, अन्तकःइव like god of death, भाति shining.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
दिष्ट्याऽयमद्यपापात्माममदृष्टिपथंगतः । अद्यक्रोधंविमोक्ष्यामिसीताहरणसम्भवम् ।।6.59.31।।
output: "By his good luck, this sinful one has come under my sight. I will give vent to my wrath born of Sita's abduction."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
एवमुक्त्वाततोरामोधनुरादायवीर्यवान् । लक्ष्मणानुचरस्तस्थौसमुद्धृत्यशरोत्तमम् ।।6.59.32।।
output: Indomitable Rama having spoken in that manner, followed by Lakshmana got ready and took out an excellent bow and stood.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःसरक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मारक्षांसितान्याहमहाबलानि । द्वारेषुचर्यागृहगोपुरेषुसुनिर्वृतास्तिष्ठतनिर्विशङ्काः ।।6.59.33।।
output: ततः thereupon, महात्मा great soul, सः he, रक्षोधिपतिः Rakshasa king, महाबलानि strong army, तानि them, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, आह you, द्वारेषु at gates, चर्यागृहगोपुरेणु buildings on the four main streets, सुनिर्वृताः fully complacent, निर्विशङ्काः free from apprehension, तिष्ठत stationed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हाऽगतंमांसहितंभवद्भिर्वनौकसश्छिद्रमिदंविदित्वा । शून्यापुरींदुष्प्रसहांप्रमथ्यप्रधर्षयेयुस्सहसासमेताः ।।6.59.34।।
output: भवद्भिः me also, सहितम् with you, माम् me, इह here, आगतम् coming to know my coming, इदम् this, छिद्रम् weak side, विदित्वा knowing, वनौकसः forest dwellers, समेताः together, दुष्प्रसहाम् enter, शून्याम् vacant, पुरीम् City, प्रमथ्य Devastate, सहसा united, प्रधर्षयेयुः storm.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विसर्जयित्वासचिवांस्ततस्तान्गतेषुरक्षस्सुयथानियोगम् । व्यचारयद्वानरसागरौघंमहाझषःपूर्णमिवार्णवौघम् ।।6.59.35।।
output: तान् them, सचिवान् counsellors, विसर्जयित्वा sent away, ततः there upon, रक्षःसु Rakshasa, यथानियोगम् as instructed, गतेषु having departed, वानरसागरौघम् ocean of Vanaras, महाझषः gigantic fish, पूर्णम् totally, अर्णवौघम् इव like the war in the ocean, व्यदारयत् pierced through.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमापतन्तंसहसासमीक्ष्यदीप्तेषुचापंयुधिराक्षसेन्द्रम् । महत्समुत्पाट्यमहीधराग्रंदुद्रावरक्षोधिपतिंहरीशः ।।6.59.36।।
output: Watching Ravana advancing suddenly on the battlefield with great speed, Sugriva took a huge mountain top and went towards Rakshasa king.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्छैलशृङ्गंबहुवृक्षसानुंप्रगृह्यचिक्षेपनिशाचराय । तमापतन्तंसहसासमीक्ष्यचिच्छेदबाणैस्तपनीयपुङ्खैः ।।6.59.37।।
output: Seizing mountain tops whose slopes were filled with trees Sugriva hurled at the night rangers. Watching this Ravana quickly broke them with his arrows fixed with golden shafts.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मिन् प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षेशृङ्गेविकीर्णेपतितेपृथिव्याम् । महाहिकल्पंशरमन्तकाभंसमादधेराक्षसलोकनाथः ।।6.59.38।।
output: तस्मिन् in that, प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे slope covered with excellent trees, शृङ्गे peak, विदीर्णे broken, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, पतिते fallen, राक्षसलोकनाथः king of Rakshasa world, महाहिकल्पम् arranging for destruction, अन्तकाभम् like the spirit of death, शरम् arrow, समादधे got ready.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सतंगृहीत्वाऽनिलतुल्यवेगंसविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् । बाणंमहेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगंचिक्षेपसुग्रीववधायरुष्टः ।।6.59.39।।
output: रुष्टः angry, सः he, अनिलतुल्यवेगम् like the wind in speed, सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् shone like sparks of fire, महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगम् vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, तंबाणम् that arrow, गृहीत्वा seizing, सुग्रीववधाय for the destruction of Sugriva, चिक्षेप released.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
ससायकोरावणबाहुमुक्तःशक्राशनिप्रख्यवपुश्शिताग्रः । सुग्रीवमासाद्यबिभेदवेगाद्गुहेरिताक्रौञ्चमिवोग्रशक्तिः ।।6.59.40।।
output: That arrow released from Ravana's arm, which was hard and sharp as the thunderbolt of Indra, pierced Sugriva just as the sharp thorn edged spear of Guha penetrated Krauncha mountain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ससायकार्तोविपरीतचेताःकूजन्पृथिव्यांनिपपातवीरः । तंप्रेक्ष्यभूमौपतितंविसंज्ञंनेदुःप्रहृष्टायुधियातुधानाः ।।6.59.41।।
output: सःवीरः that hero, सायकार्तः hurt by arrow, विपरीतचेताः lost sense, कूजन् groaning, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, निपपात fell, युधि in battle, विसंज्ञम् sent forth, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, तम् they, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, यातुधानाः an evil spirit, प्रहृष्टाः joyfully, नेदुः shouted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोगवाक्षोगवयस्सुदंष्ट्रस्त्वथर्षभोज्योतिमुखोनलश्च । शैलान् समुत्पाट्यविवृद्धकायाःप्रदुद्रुवुस्तंप्रतिराक्षसेन्द्रम् ।।6.59.42।।
output: Thereafter Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sudamshtra, Rshaba, Jyothimukha and Nala increasing their body size rushed towards the king of Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तेषांप्रहारान् सचकारमोघान् रक्षोधिपोबाणशतैःशिताग्रैः । तान्वानरेन्द्रानपिबाणजालैर्बिभेदजाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः ।।6.59.43।।
output: The Rakshasa Lord made the mountain peaks useless by the hundreds of arrows released by him. The streams of arrows with golden shafts could resist the Rakshasas and strike the Vanara king.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तेवानरेन्द्रास्त्रिदशारिबाणैर्भिन्नानिपेतुर्भुविभीमकायाः । ततस्तुतद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रंप्रच्छादयामाससबाणजालैः ।।6.59.44।।
output: The Vanara leaders of fierce form torn by the streams of sharp arrows discharged in the three directions fell covering the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेवध्यमानाःपतिताःप्रवीरानानद्यमानाभयशल्यविद्धाः । शाखामृगारावणसायकार्ताजग्मुश्शरण्यंशरणंस्मरामम् ।।6.59.45।।
output: Those monkeys struck and fallen by the piercing of arrows shrieking went to seek refuge from Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोमहात्मासधनुर्धनुष्मानादायरामस्सहसाजगाम । तंलक्ष्मणःप्राञ्जलिरभ्युपेत्यउवाचवाक्यंपरमार्थयुक्तम् ।।6.59.46।।
output: ततः that, महात्मा great soul, धनुष्मान् holding bow, सःरामः that Rama, धनुः bow, आदाय taking, सहसा immediately, जगाम went, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तम् him, अभ्युपेत्य addressed, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, परमार्थयुक्तम् consonant with truth, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoken.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
काममार्यस्सुपर्याप्तोवधायास्यदुरात्मनः । विधमिष्याम्यहंचैतमनुजानीहिमांविभो ।।6.59.47।।
output: "I will exterminate the evil minded Ravana. Oh! noble brother, may I be permitted to complete the task"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तमब्रवीन्महातेजारामस्सत्यपराक्रमः । गच्छयत्नपरश्चापिभवलक्ष्मण संयुगे ।।6.59.48।।
output: Sri Rama, who was highly energetic and truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, told Lakshmana, "You go and be careful in the battle."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
रावणोहिमहावीर्योरणेऽद्भुतपराक्रमः । त्रैलोक्येनापिसङ्क्रुद्धोदुष्प्रसह्योनसंशयः ।।6.59.49।।
output: "Ravana is a great hero in the battlefield. His valour in war is wonderful. He is angry but none can withstand him in the three worlds."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तस्यच्छिद्राणिमार्गस्वस्वच्छिद्राणिचलक्ष्य । चक्षुषाधनुषायत्ना प्रक्षात्मानंसमाहितः ।।6.59.50।।
output: "Remaining alert, apply your arrows in the direction of his arrows. Looking at his arrows carefully, making an effort to protect yourself, set your bow."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवस्यवचश्श्रुत्वासपरिष्वज्याभिपूज्यच । अभिवाद्यतत् रामंययौसौमित्रिराहवम् ।।6.59.51।।
output: सौमित्रिः son of Sumitra, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सपरिष्वज्य embracing, अभिपूज्य offering prayers, तं that, रामम् Rama, अभिवाद्यच paying respects, अहवम् for encounter, ययौ sallied forth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सरावणंवारणहस्तबाहुंददर्शभीमोद्यतदीप्तचापम् । प्रच्छादयन्तंशरवृष्टिजालैस्तान्वानराभनिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् ।।6.59.52।।
output: He saw Ravana, endowed with round shoulders like elephant trunks, with fierce bow glowing and the broken bodies of Vanaras spread all over. Ravana was showering nets of arrows and instigating vanaras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमालोक्यमहातेजाहनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । निवार्यशरजालानिप्रदुद्रावसरावणम् ।।6.59.53।।
output: The son of the wind god, Hanuman, a brilliant one seeing Ravana, obstructed the stream of arrows and darted towards him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रथंतस्यसमासाद्यबाहुमुद्यम्यदक्षिणम् । त्रासयन्रावणंधीमान्हनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.59.54।।
output: Courageous Hanuman seeing the chariot of Ravana lifting his right arm menacing him spoke these words.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देवदानवगन्धर्वायक्षाश्चसहराक्षैसैः । अवश्यंतुत्वयाभग्नावानरेभ्यस्तुतेभयम् ।।6.59.55।।
output: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषमेदक्षिणोबाहुःपञ्चशाखःसमुद्यतः । विधमिष्यतितेदेहाद्भूतात्मानंचिरोषितम् ।।6.59.56।।
output: मे I, पञ्चशाखः five branches, एषः that way, समुद्यतः together, दक्षिणःबाहुः right arm, ते to you, देहात् body, चिरोषितम् for long, भूतात्मानम् subtle body, विधमिष्यति will expel.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
श्रुत्वाहनुमतोवाक्यंरावणोभीमविक्रमः । संरक्तनयनःक्रोधादिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.59.57।।
output: Ravana of truly fierce valour, hearing Hanuman's words, his eyes became blood red and spoke to Hanuman this way.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षिप्रंप्रहरनिःशङ्कंस्थिरांकीर्तिमवाप्नुहि । ततस्त्वांज्ञातविक्रान्तंनाशयिष्यामिवानर ।।6.59.58।।
output: वानर Vanara, निःशङ्कम् without any hesitation, क्षिप्रम् at once, प्रहर go about, स्थिराम् permanent, कीर्तिम् fame, अवाप्नुहि will attain, ततः thereafter, ज्ञातविक्रान्तम् knowing your prowess, त्वाम् you, नाशयिष्यामि shall destroy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
रावणस्यवचश्श्रुत्वावायुसूनुर्वचोऽब्रवीत् । प्रहृतंहिमयापूर्वमक्षंतवसुतंतव ।।6.59.59।।
output: Having heard Ravana's words, Hanuman said, "Think of your son Akshaya killed by me earlier."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
एवमुक्तोमहातेजारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । आजघानानिलसुतंतलेनोरसिवीर्यवान् ।।6.59.60।।
output: Having spoken that way by Hanuman, the Lord of Rakshasas slapped his hand on Hanuman's chest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतलाभिहतस्तेनचचालचमुहुर्मुहुः । स्थित्वामुहूर्तंतेजस्वीस्थैर्यंकृत्वामहामतिः ।।6.59.61।। आजघानाभिसङ्कृद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम् ।
output: Smacked by him (Ravana), Hanuman, a brilliant and intelligent one stood firm for a while and picking up courage, highly enraged struck the enemy of gods with his palm.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
ततस्ततेनाभिहतोवानरेणमहात्मना ।।6.59.62।। दशग्रीवःसमाधूतोयथाभूमिचलेऽचलः ।
output: Thereupon, struck by the great soul, Vanara, the ten headed Ravana was shaken like the earthquake on the mountain together.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
सङ्ग्रामेतंतथादृष्टवारावणंतलताडितम् ।।6.59.63।। ऋषयोवानराःसिद्धानेदुर्देवास्सहासुरैः ।
output: Ravana hit by hand in that way in a hard manner, the siddhas, demons as well and even Devatas raised their voice.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
अथाऽश्वास्यमहातेजारावणोवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.59.64।। साधुवानर वीर्येणश्लाघनीयोऽसिमेरिपुः ।
output: And thereafter, thus spoke extremely energetic Ravana recovering from breath, "Well done vanara. You are courageous and praiseworthy, my enemy!"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तुमारुतिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.59.65।। धिगस्तुममवीर्येणयस्त्वंजीवसिरावण ।
output: Ravana having spoken in that way, Maruti said "Oh Ravana! What a shame on my valour, you survived."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सकृत्तुप्रहरेदानींदुर्भुद्धे किंविकत्थसे ।।6.59.66।। ततस्त्वांमामिकामुष्टिर्नयिष्यतियमक्षयम् ।
output: "O evil minded one, why do you brag You do this once more I will strike you once again with my fist and send you to the abode of Yama."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तोमारतिवाक्येनकोधस्तस्यतदाऽज्वलत् ।।6.59.67।। संरक्तनयनोयत्नान्मुष्टिमुद्यम्यदक्षिणम् । पातयामासवेगेनवानरोरसिवीर्यवान् ।।6.59.68।।
output: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तोमारतिवाक्येनकोधस्तस्यतदाऽज्वलत् ।।6.59.67।। संरक्तनयनोयत्नान्मुष्टिमुद्यम्यदक्षिणम् । पातयामासवेगेनवानरोरसिवीर्यवान् ।।6.59.68।।
output: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
हनूमान् वक्षसिव्यूढेसञ्चचालहतःपुनः । विह्वलंतुतदादृष्टवाहनूमन्तंमहाबलम् ।।6.59.69।। रथेनातिरथशशीघ्रंनीलंप्रतिसमभ्यगात् ।
output: Hit on his chest, Hanuman got hurt again and reeled. Seeing Hanuman's power, overcome with fear, the best charioteer Ravana drove quickly towards Neela.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
राक्षसानामधिपतिर्धशग्रीवःप्रतापवान् ।।6.59.70।। पन्नगप्रतिमैर्भीमैःपरमर्माभिभेदिभिः । शरैरादीपयामासनीलंहरिचमूपतिम् ।।6.59.71।।
output: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसानामधिपतिर्धशग्रीवःप्रतापवान् ।।6.59.70।। पन्नगप्रतिमैर्भीमैःपरमर्माभिभेदिभिः । शरैरादीपयामासनीलंहरिचमूपतिम् ।।6.59.71।।
output: राक्षसानाम् for Rakshasas, अधिपतिः Lord, प्रतापवान् indomitable, दशग्रीवः ten headed, पन्नगप्रतिमैः resembling serpents, भीमैः dreadful, परमर्माभिभेदनैः which can pierce through vital parts, शरैः arrows, हरिचमूपतिम् leader of monkeys, नीलम् Nila, आदीपयामास began to strike.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
सशरौघसमायस्तोनीलःकपिचमूपतिः । करेणेकैनेशैलाग्रंरक्षोधिपतयेऽसृजत् ।।6.59.72।।
output: Pressured by the streams of arrows, the monkey leader, Neela single handed took up a peak of a mountain and hurled at the Lord of Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
हनूमानपितेजस्वीसमाश्वस्तोमहामनाः । विप्रेक्षमाणोयुद्धेप्सुस्सरोषमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.59.73।। नीलेनसहसंयुक्तंरावणंराक्षसेश्वरम् । अन्येनयुद्यमानस्यनयुक्तमभिधावनम् ।।6.59.74।।
output: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हनूमानपितेजस्वीसमाश्वस्तोमहामनाः । विप्रेक्षमाणोयुद्धेप्सुस्सरोषमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.59.73।। नीलेनसहसंयुक्तंरावणंराक्षसेश्वरम् । अन्येनयुद्यमानस्यनयुक्तमभिधावनम् ।।6.59.74।।
output: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
रावणोऽपिमहातेजास्तंच्छृङ्गंसप्तभिःशरैः । आजघानसुतीक्ष्णाग्रैस्तद्विकीर्णंपपातह ।।6.59.75।।
output: Ravana, endowed with extraordinary energy attacked that peak hurled by Neela with seven sharp arrows and it fell broken into pieces.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तद्विकीर्णंगिरेश्शृङ्गंदृष्टवाहरिचमूपतिः । कालानगिरिवजज्वालकोपेनपरवीरहा ।।6.59.76।।
output: परवीरहा killer of stupendous foes, चमूपतिः leader, विकीर्णम् broken, तत् that, गिरेःशृङ्गम् mountain peak, दृष्टवा seeing, कोपेन in anger, कालानगिरिव like fire at the universal destruction, जज्वाल shone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽश्वकर्णान्धान् शालांश्चूताश्चापिसुपुष्पितान् । अन्यांश्चविविधान् वृक्षान्नीलश्चिक्षेपसंयुगे ।।6.59.77।।
output: सःनीलः that Neela, संयुगे in battle, अश्वकर्णान्धान् Aswakarana, शालान् Sala, सुपुष्पितान् in bloom, चूतानपि and Mango trees, अन्यान् and other, विविधान् several, वृक्षान् trees, चिक्षेप hurled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सतान्वृक्षान् समासाद्यप्रतिचिच्छेदरावणः । अभ्यवर्षत्सुघोरेणशरवर्षेणपावकिम् ।।6.59.78।।
output: सःरावणः that Ravana, तान् those, वृक्षान् trees, प्रतिसमासाद्य broke in return, चिच्छेद broke, घोरेण formidable, शरवर्षेण rain of arrows, पावकिम् on son of fire god (Neela), अभ्यवर्षच्छ rained.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अभिवृष्टश्शरौघेणमेघेनेवमहाबलः । ह्रस्वंकृत्वाततोरूपंध्वजाग्रेनिपपातह ।।6.59.79।।
output: शरौघेण hail of shafts, मेघेनेव by cloud, अभिवृष्टः when rained, महाबलः mighty strong, ततः that, रूपम् form, ह्रस्वम् small size, कृत्वा reducing, ध्वजाग्रे top of bow, निपपातह landed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पावकात्मजमालोक्यध्वजाग्रेसमवस्थितम् । जज्वालरावणःक्रोधात्ततोनीलोननादच ।।6.59.80।।
output: ध्वजाग्रे on top of the post of bow, समवस्थितम् standing, पावकात्मजम् son of fire god, आलोक्य seeing, रावणः Ravana, क्रोधात् in anger, जज्वाल burning, ततः then, नीलः Neela, ननादच roared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ध्वजाग्रेधनुषश्चाग्रेकिरीटाग्रेचतंहरिम् । लक्ष्मणोऽथहनूमांश्चदृष्टवारामश्चविस्मिताः ।।6.59.81।।
output: ध्वजाग्रे on top of bow, धनुषः unable to release the arrow from the bow, अग्रे top, किरीटाग्रेच on top of the crown, तंहरिम् that monkey, दृष्टवा seeing, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ and then, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, रामश्च Rama, विस्मिताः amazed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणोऽपिमहातेजाःकपिलाघवविस्मितः । अस्त्रमाहारयामासदीप्तमाग्नेयमद्भुतम् ।।6.59.82।।
output: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy was also wonder struck at Neela's agility. Then he took up the shining shaft presided over by fire god.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तेचुक्रुशुर्हृष्टालब्दलक्षाःप्लवङ्गमाः । नीललाघवसम्भ्रान्तंदृष्टवारावणमाहवे ।।6.59.83।।
output: Thereafter, seeing Neela's feat in the war, Ravana was agitated and the Vanaras were cheerful for having achieved their wish and shouted in joy.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानराणांचनादेवसंरब्दोरावणस्तदा । सम्भ्रमाविष्टहृदयोनकिञ्चित्प्रत्यपद्यत ।।6.59.84।।
output: तदा then, वानराणाम् Vanaras, नादेन clamour, संरब्धः provoked, रावणः Ravana, सम्फ्रमाविष्टहृदयः heart filled with anger, किञ्चित् a little, नप्रत्यपद्यत not know what to do in turn.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आग्नेयेनाधसंयुक्तंगृहीत्वारावणश्शरम् । ध्वजशीर्षस्थितंसीलमुदैक्षतनिशाचरः ।।6.59.85।।
output: And then the night ranger Ravana taking up, fitting the arrow charged with fire, looked at Neela resting on top of the bow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजारावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । कपेलाघवयुक्तोऽसिमाययापरयाऽनया ।।6.59.86।।
output: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy said, "Oh monkey, you are unfair, very tricky and further deceptive."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जीवितंखलुरक्षस्वयदिशक्तोऽपिवानर । तानितान्यात्मरूपाणिसृजसित्वमनेकशः ।।6.59.87।।
output: वानर monkey, त्वम् your, अनेकशः many, तानितानि different, आत्मरूपाणि forms of you, सृजसि create, शक्तः have the ability, अपि also यदि which, जीवितम् life, रक्षस्वखलु save your life.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तथापित्वांमयामुक्तस्सायोकोऽस्त्रप्रयोजितः । जीवितंपरिरक्षन्तंजीविताद्भ्रंशयिष्यति ।।6.59.88।।
output: "The arrow released by me now is charged with a missile and will destroy your life. You have been protecting (changing your forms) your life."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवमुक्त्वामहाबाहूरावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । सन्धायबाणमस्त्रणचमूपतिमताडयत् ।।6.59.89।।
output: महाबाहुः broad shouldered, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, एवम् like that, उक्त्वा spoken, बाणम् arrow, अस्त्रण chanting the mantras, सन्धाय fixing the arrow, चमूपतिम् commander in chief, अताडयत् struck.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽस्त्रयुक्तेनबाणेननीलोवक्षसिताडितः । निर्धह्यमानस्सहसानिपपातमहीतले ।।6.59.90।।
output: Struck by the arrow propelled by the missile (of Ravana) on the chest, Neela fell on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
पितृमहात्म्यसंयोगात्मनश्चापितेजसा । जानुभ्यानुपतद्भूमौनतुप्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत ।।6.59.91।।
output: By virtue of his father's greatness and his own power, his life did not cease but he fell on the ground.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
विसंज्ञंवानरंदृष्टवादशग्रीवोरणोत्सुकः । रथेनाम्बुदनादेनसौमित्रिमभिदुद्रुवे ।।6.59.92।।
output: Finding the vanara unconscious the ten headed Ravana who was eager to fight went towards Saumithri in the chariot making sounds that resembled the sound of rattling of clouds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
आसाद्यरणमध्येतंवारयित्वास्थितोज्वलन् । धनुर्विष्फारयामासकम्पयन्निवमेदिनीम् ।।6.59.93।।
output: In the midst of the battlefield stood Ravana, intercepting with his glowing bow making loud sounds as though shaking the earth.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमाहसौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वोविष्फारयन्तंधनुरप्रमेयम् । अभ्येहिमामद्यनिशाचरेन्द्रनवानरांस्त्वप्रतियोद्धुमर्हः ।।6.59.94।।
output: Saumithri who was not depressed in spirit (by Ravana's attack) addressing Ravana who was stretching his bow said "Oh! Lord of night rangers, Be aware. You ought not to fight with vanaras."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतस्यवाक्यंप्रतिपूर्णघोषंज्याशब्दमुग्रंचनिशम्यराजा । आसाद्यसौमित्रिमवस्थितंतंकोपान्वितोवाचमुवाचरक्षः ।।6.59.95।।
output: Hearing the challenging statement of the king of Rakshasas and hearing the vibrating sound, Saumithri standing close by spoke these wrathful words.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिष्ट्यासिमेराघव दृष्टिमार्गंप्राप्तोऽन्तगामीविपरीतबुद्धिः । अस्मिन् क्षणेयास्यसिमृत्युदेशंसम्पाद्यमानोममबाणजालैः ।।6.59.96।।
output: "Oh Raghava! You have come under the path of my sight. You are going to meet your end. You who are perverted in mind, struck by a stream of my arrows will reach the abode of death this very moment."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमाहसौमित्रिरविस्मयानोगर्जन्तमुद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् । राजन्नगर्जन्तिमहाप्रभावाविकत्थसेपापकृतांवरिष्ठ ।।6.59.97।।
output: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, अविस्मयानः not surprised, उद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् projected teeth, गर्जन्तम् screaming, तम् you, आह great, पापकृताम् sinful action, वरिष्ठ displaying, राजन् king, विकत्थसे bluster, महाप्रभावाः of great valour, नगर्जन्ति not shout like that.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जानामिवीर्यंतवराक्षसेन्द्रबलंप्रतापंचपराक्रमंच । अवस्थितोऽहंशरचापपाणिरागच्छकिंमोघविकत्थनेन ।।6.59.98।।
output: "Your valour, heroism, strength and prowess are known to me. I stand firmly with bow and arrow come on. What is the use of bragging"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सएवमुक्तःकुपितस्ससर्जरक्षोथिपस्सप्तशरान् सुपुङ्खान् । तान्लक्ष्मणःकाञ्चनचित्रिपुङ्खैश्चिच्छेदबाणैर्निशिताग्रधारैः ।।6.59.99।।
output: Lakshmana, having spoken in that manner, the Lord of Rakshasas released seven arrows with beautiful plumes. Lakshmana tore them into pieces with sharp pointed and sharpheaded arrows with gold shafts.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तान् प्रेक्षमाणस्सहसानिकृत्तानिकृत्तभोगानिवपन्नगेन्द्रान् । लङ्केश्वरःक्रोधवशंजगामससर्जचान्यान्निशितान्पृषत्कान् ।।6.59.100।।
output: सहसा with force, निकृत्तान् broken down, निकृत्तभोगान् whose coils have been broken, पन्नगेन्द्रानिव like serpent Lords, तान् them, प्रेक्षमाणः seeing, लङ्केश्वरः Lord of Lanka, क्रोधवशम् overtaken by wrath, जगाम fallen down, अन्यान् other, निशितान् sharp, पृषत्कान् let go.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सबाणवर्षंतुववर्षतीव्रंरामानुजःकार्मुकसम्प्रयुक्तम् । क्षुरार्धचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैःशरांश्चचिच्छेदनचुक्षुभेच ।।6.59.101।।
output: The brother of Rama stretched his bow into a circle and showered rain of piercing arrows. He tore the arrows of his enemy with his arrows Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan without nay, perturbance.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सबाणजालान्यथतानितानिमोघानिपश्यंस्त्रिदशारिराजः । विसिस्मियेलक्ष्मणलाघवेनपुनश्चबाणान्निशितान्मुमोच ।।6.59.102।।
output: Ravana, the enemy of gods seeing all his streams of arrows ineffective, was astonished at Lakshmana's skill, and let go sharp arrows again and again.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सलक्ष्मणश्चापिशरान् शिताग्रान्महेन्द्रतुल्योऽशनितुल्यवेगान् । सन्धायचापेज्वलनप्रकाशान् ससर्जरक्षोधिपतेर्वधाय ।।6.59.103।।
output: Lakshmana also, who is comparable to Mahendra, fitting his bow and arrows that shone like fire released sharp and pointed arrows to put an end to Rakshasa king.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सतान् प्रचिच्छेदहिराक्षसेन्द्रःछित्वाचतन्लक्ष्मणमाजघान । शरेणकालाग्निसमप्रभेणस्वयम्भुदत्तेनललाटदेशे ।।6.59.104।।
output: सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, छित्वा broken, तान् those, चतान् arrows, प्रचिच्छेदहि covered, कालाग्निसमप्रभेण bright as the fire at universal destruction, स्वयम्भुदत्तेन given by Brahma, शरेण by arrow, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana's, ललाटदेशे forehead, आजघान struck.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
सलक्ष्मणोरावणसायकार्तश्चचालचापंशिधिलंप्रगृह्य । पुनश्चसंज्ञांप्रतिलभ्यकृच्छ्राच्चिच्छेदचापंत्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रो ।।6.59.105।।
output: Lakshmana hurt by Ravana's dart, shaken up, seizing the bow feebly with great difficulty regaining consciousness tore the bow of the enemy of Indra into pieces in return.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
निकृत्तचापंत्रिभिराजघानबाणैस्तदादाशरथिश्शिताग्रैः । ससायकार्तोविचचालराजाकृच्छ्राच्छसंज्ञांपुनराससाद ।।6.59.106।।
output: Then Lakshmana son of Dasaratha, struck the bow of the king into pieces with three sharp and pointed arrows. The king swooned and recovered with great difficulty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सकृत्तचापःशरताडितश्चमेदार्द्रगात्रोरुधिरावसिक्तः । जग्राहशक्तिंस्वयमुग्रशक्तिस्स्वयम्भुदत्तांयुधिदेवशत्रुः ।।6.59.107।।
output: कृत्तचापः bow being cut, शरताडितश्च hurt by the arrows, मेदार्द्रगात्रः limbs splattered with fat, रुधिरावसिक्तः bathed in blood, स्वयम् his own, उग्रशक्तिः formidable energy, सः he, देवशत्रुः enemy of god, युधि in the battlefield, स्वयम्भुदत्ताम् gifted by the self born, शक्तिम् javelin जग्राह seized.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतांसधूमानलसन्निकाशांवित्रासनींसंयतिवानराणाम् । चिक्षेपशक्तिंतरसाज्वलन्तींसौमित्रयेराक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः ।।6.59.108।।
output: The Lord of the world of Rakshasas instantly flung javelin, emitting fire without smoke, on Saumithri, which created fear among Vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तामापतन्तींभरतानुजोऽस्त्रैर्जघानबाणैश्चहुताग्निकल्पैः । तथापिसातस्यविवेशशक्तिर्भुजान्तरंदाशरथेर्विशालम् ।।6.59.109।।
output: Lakshmana, the brother of Bharata struck the fierce weapon coming towards him like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, even then it struck him on his broad chest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सशक्तिमान् शक्तिसमाहतःसन् प्रजज्वालमुहुःरघुप्रवीरः । तंविह्वलन्तंसहसाभ्युपेत्यजग्राहराजातरसाभुजाभ्याम् ।।6.59.110।।
output: Lakshmana the eminent hero of Raghu's was badly hurt by the javelin and was burning in pain. King Ravana caught him who was losing consciousness, violently and held him by his shoulders.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
हिमवान् मन्दरोमेरुस्तैलोक्यंवासहामरैः । शक्यंभुजाभ्यामुद्धर्तुंनसङ् ख्येभरतानुजः ।।6.59.111।।
output: It may be possible to lift Himalayas, Mandara, Meru mountains or even the Devatas of the three worlds but not possible to lift Lakshmana by shoulders.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
शक्त्याब्राह्म्याहिसौमित्रिस्ताडितास्तुस्तनान्तरे । विष्णोरचिन्यन्त्यंस्वंभागमात्मानंप्रत्यनुस्मरत् ।।6.59.112।।
output: Even though Saumithri was wounded in the chest and the power of Brahma entered (into his chest) he recalled himself as an inconceivable form of Vishnu.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोदानवदर्पघ्नंसौमित्रिंदेवकण्टकः । तंपीडयित्वाबाहुभ्यांनप्रभुर्लङ्घनेऽभवत् ।।6.59.113।।
output: ततः thereafter, देवकण्टकः enemy of Devatas, तम् him, दानवदर्पघ्नम् pride of Rakshasas, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, पीडयित्वा capable of crushing, लङ्घने to lift, प्रभुः king, नाभवत् not do.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथवायुसुतःक्रुद्धोरावणंसमभिद्रवत् । आजघानोरसिक्रुद्धोवज्रकल्पेनमुष्टिना ।।6.59.114।।
output: अथ and then, क्रुद्धः angry, वायुसुतः son of wind god, रावणम् Ravana, समभिद्रवत् came towards, क्रुद्धः angry, वज्रकल्पेन by thunderbolt, मुष्टिना fist, उरसि on the chest, आजघान struck.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तेनमुष्टिप्रहारेणरावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौचचालचपपातच ।।6.59.115।।
output: By the blow of Hanuman's fist, Ravana the Lord of Rakshasas was shaken and fell on the ground on his knees.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
अस्यैश्चनेत्रैश्श्रवणैःपपातरुधिरंबहु । विघूर्णमानोनिश्चेष्टोरथोपस्थउपाविशत् ।।6.59.116।।
output: Much blood flowed from his(Ravana's) mouth, ears, and eyes. Rolling in the hind part of the chariot he became still and sank.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विसंज्ञोमूर्च्छ्रितश्चासीन्नचस्थानंसमालभत् । विसंज्ञंरावणंदृष्टवासमरेभीमविक्रमम् ।।6.59.117।। ऋषयोवानराश्चैवनेदुर्देवास्सवासवाः ।
output: Ravana of fierce valour having lost senses and waking up from unconscious state, perturbed, did not know where he was. Seeing this the sages, even Vanaras, the demons as well as Devatas shouted in joy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
हनूमानपितेजस्वीलक्ष्मणंरावणार्धितम् ।।6.59.118।। आनयद्राघवाभ्याशंबाहुभ्यांपरिगृह्यतम् ।
output: Brilliant Hanuman holding Lakshmana wounded by Ravana in both shoulders brought him to Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
वायुसूनोःसुहृत्त्वेनभक्त्यापरमयाचसः ।।6.59.119।। शत्रूणामप्रकम्प्योऽपिलघुत्वमगमत्कपेः ।
