output: Lakshmana though unshakeable for enemies, became light for the son of wind god by his friendship and high devotion.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तंसमुत्सृज्यसाशक्तिःसौमित्रिंयुधिदुर्जयम् ।।6.59.120।। रावणस्यरथेतस्मिन् स्थानंपुनरुपागता ।
output: That power returned back to Ravana's chariot to its position, leaving Lakshmana, who was difficult to vanquish.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
आश्वस्तश्चनिशल्यश्चलक्ष्मणश्शत्रुसूदनः ।।6.59.121।। विष्णोर्भागममीमांस्यमात्मानंप्रत्यनुस्मरन् ।
output: Lakshmana who could destroy foes, recovering from unconsciousness, relieved of wounds again remembered himself to be part of Vishnu of immeasurable power.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
रावणोऽपिमहातेजाःप्राप्यसंज्ञांमहाहवे ।।6.59.122।। आददेनिशितान् बाणान् जग्राहचमहद्धमः ।
output: Ravana of mighty prowess waking up from consciousness took over his sharp arrows and the great bow also.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निपातितमहावीरांद्रवन्तींवानरींचमूम् ।।6.59.123।। राघवस्तुरणेदृष्टवारावणंसमभिद्रवत् ।
output: Raghava also assailed Ravana seeing the fallen Vanara heroes struck in the combat.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
अथैवमुपसङ्गम्यहनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.59.124।। ममपृष्ठंसमारुह्यराक्षसंशास्तुमर्हसि । विष्णुर्यथागरुत्मन्तंबलवन्तंसमाहितः ।।6.59.125।।
output: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
अथैवमुपसङ्गम्यहनूमान्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.59.124।। ममपृष्ठंसमारुह्यराक्षसंशास्तुमर्हसि । विष्णुर्यथागरुत्मन्तंबलवन्तंसमाहितः ।।6.59.125।।
output: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तच्छ्रुत्वाराघवोवाक्यंवायुपुत्रेणभाषितम् । आरुरोहमहाशूरंबलवन्तंमहाकपिम् ।।6.59.126।। रथस्थंरावणंसङ् ख्येददर्शमनुजाधिपः ।
output: राघवः Raghava, वायुपुत्रेण to the son of wind god, भाषितम् spoken, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, आरुरोहमहाशूरं climbed on the hero, महाकपिम् great monkey, बलवन्तम् strong, आरुरोह on climbing, मनुजाधिपः Lord of humans, सङ् ख्ये in war, रथस्थम् on the chariot, रावणम् Ravana, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तमालोक्यमहातेजाःप्रदुद्रावसराघवः ।।6.59.127।। वैरोचनिवक्रुद्धोविष्णुरभ्युद्यतायुधः ।
output: Beholding Ravana, highly energetic Rama wielding his bow went furiously towards him just as Lord Vishnu went with his discuss against Virochana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
ज्याशब्दमकरोत्तीव्रंवज्रनिष्पेषनिस्वनम् ।।6.59.128।। गिरागम्भीरयारामोराक्षसेन्द्रमुवाचह ।
output: Rama created a sound like a clap of thunder ringing intensely, a majestic one and spoke in a deep voice to the king.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तिष्ठतिष्ठममत्वंहिकृत्वाविप्रियमीदृशम् ।।6.59.129।। क्वनुराक्षसशार्दूल गतोमोक्षमवाप्स्यसि ।
output: राक्षसशार्दूल tiger among Rakshasas, तिष्ठतिष्ठ forbear, त्वम् you, मम to me, ईदृशम् such, विप्रियम् delivered, कृत्वा having done, क्वनु where, गत्वा going, मोक्षम् deliverance, अवाप्स्यसि after the offence.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदीन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान्वास्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशंकरान्वा । गमिष्यसित्वंदशवादिशोवातथापिमेनाद्यगतोविमोक्ष्यसे ।।6.59.130।।
output: "If you go to Indra or Yama or Sun God or the selfborn Brahma or fire God or Shankara or the ten directions like that, and if you run in front of me you cannot escape."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यश्चैवशक्त्याभिहतस्त्वयाऽद्यइच्छन्विषादंसहसाभ्युपेत्य । सएषरक्षोगणराजमृत्युःसपुत्रपौत्रस्यतवाद्ययुद्धे ।।6.59.131।।
output: रक्षोगणराज king of Rakshasa troop, अद्य in front, यःएषः he who like that, त्वया by you, शक्त्या support, अभिहतः struck now, विषादम् sorrow, इच्छन् , सःएव he himself, सहसा now, अभ्युपेत्य come, अद्य in front, युद्धे to combat, सपुत्रपौत्रस्य sons and grandsons, तव your, मृत्युः death.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतेनचात्यद्भुतदर्शनानिशरैर्जवस्थानकृतालयानि । चतुर्धशान्यात्तवरायुधानिरक्षःसहस्राणिनिषूदितानि ।।6.59.132।।
output: "By me, who is your adversary, fourteen thousand Rakshasas of fierce forms, who had taken abode at Janasthana and used choicest weapons were exterminated."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
राघवस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाराक्षसेन्द्रोमहाबलः । वायुपुत्रंमहावेगंवहन्तंराघवंरणे ।।6.59.133।। रोषेणमहताविष्टःपूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् । आजघानशरैर्दीप्स्सैःकालानलशिखोपमैः ।।6.59.134।।
output: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
राघवस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाराक्षसेन्द्रोमहाबलः । वायुपुत्रंमहावेगंवहन्तंराघवंरणे ।।6.59.133।। रोषेणमहताविष्टःपूर्ववैरमनुस्मरन् । आजघानशरैर्दीप्स्सैःकालानलशिखोपमैः ।।6.59.134।।
output: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसेनाहवेतस्यताडितस्यापिसायकैः । स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्यभूयस्तेजोऽभ्यवर्धत ।।6.59.135।।
output: राक्षसेन by the Rakshasa, आहवे discharged, सायकैः arrows, ताडितस्यापि when hurt him also, स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य by nature endowed with energy, तस्य his, तेजः energy, भूयः exceedingly, अभ्यवर्धत went on increasing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोरामोमहातेजारावणेनकृतव्रणम् । दृष्टवाप्लवगशार्दूलंक्रोधस्यवशमेयिवान् ।।6.59.136।।
output: Seeing the wounds caused by Ravana to Hanuman, the tiger among monkeys, possibly Rama was seized with anger.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्याभिसङ्क्रम्यरथंसचक्रंसाश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम् । ससारथिंसाशनिशूलखडगंरामःप्रचिच्छेदशरैस्सुपुङ्खैः ।।6.59.137।।
output: रामः Rama, अभिसङ्क्रम्य advancing forward, तस्य his, सचक्रम् the wheel of chariot, साश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम् horses, standard, canopy, ससारथिम् the charioteer, साशनिशूलखडगम् tridents and weapons, रथम् chariot, शरैः darts, पुङ्खैः swords, प्रचिच्छेद tore into pieces.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
अथेन्द्रशत्रुंतरसाजघानबाणेनवज्राशनिसन्निभेन । भुजान्तरेव्यूढसुजातरूपेवज्रेणमेरुंभगवानिवेन्द्रः ।।6.59.138।।
output: Then with a shining thunderbolt like arrows Rama struck with the weapon of Indra into the fine chest in between the shoulders just as Indra would strike the Meru Mountain with his thunderbolt.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
योवज्रपातशनिसन्निपातान्नचक्षुभेनापिचचालराजा । सरामबाणाभिहतोभृशार्तश्चचालचापंचमुमोचवीरः ।।6.59.139।।
output: यः he, राजा king, वज्रपाताशनिसन्निपातात् one who is not disturbed hit by thunderbolt or by lightning, नचुक्षुभे not disturbed, नापिचचाल arrow, सः he, वीरः hero, रामबाणाभिहतः struck by Rama's arrow, भृशार्तः reeled, चचाल agonized, चापंच bow also, मुमोच let go.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तंविह्वलन्तंप्रसमीक्ष्यरामस्समाददेदीप्तमथार्थचन्द्रम् । तेनार्कवर्णंसहसाकिरीटंचिच्छेदरक्षोधिपतेर्महात्मा ।।6.59.140।।
output: Seeing Ravana swooning, great soul Rama took up a crescent shaped arrow and hastily broke his crown into pieces which were shining bright red like the Sun.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
तंनिर्विषाशीविषसन्निकाशंशान्तार्चिषंसूर्यमिवाप्रकाशम् । गतश्रियंकृत्तकिरीटकूटमुवाचरामोयुधिराक्षसेन्द्रम् ।।6.59.141।।
output: Rama said to the king of Rakshasas, who was like a serpent rid of poison without (head) crown, without splendour like the Sun without brightness, his glory lost with the crown broken in the combat.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
कृतंत्वयाकर्ममहत्सुभीमंहतप्रवीरश्चकृतस्त्वयाऽहम् । तस्मात्परिश्रान्तइतिव्यवस्यन्नत्वांशरैर्मृत्युवशंनयामि ।।6.59.142।।
output: A great task of killing mighty heroes has been accomplished by you. Therefore, you are exhausted. I declare that I will not send you to death.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गच्छानुजानामिरणार्धितस्त्वंप्रविश्यरात्रिंचरराजलङ्काम् । आश्वस्यनिर्याहिरथीचधन्वीतदाबलंप्रेक्ष्यसिमेरथस्थः ।।6.59.143।।
output: रात्रिंचरराज king of night rangers, जानामि I know, त्वम् you, रणार्धितः are agonized after war, गच्छ go, लङ्काम् to Lanka, प्रविश्य reenter, अश्वस्य resting, रथी chariot, धन्वीच and bow, निर्याहि depart, तदा then, रथस्थः mounted on chariot, मे my, बलम् strength, प्रेक्ष्यसि witness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सएवमुक्तोहतदर्पहर्षोनिकृत्तचापश्चहताश्वसूतः । शरार्दितःकृत्तमहाकिरीटोविवेशलङ्कांसहसास्मराजा ।।6.59.144।।
output: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, सः by him, हतदर्पहर्षः vanity and joy crushed, निकृत्तचापः bow broken into pieces, हताश्वसूतः horses and charioteer killed, शरार्धितः wounded by arrows, कृत्तमहाकिरीटः crown broken, सःराजा that king, सहसा hastily, लङ्काम् Lanka, विवेश entered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 59:
प्रविष्टेरजनीचरेन्द्रेमहाबलेदाववदेवशत्रौ । हरीन् विशल्यान् सहलक्ष्मणेनचकाररामःपरमाहवाग्रे ।।6.59.145।।
output: After the king of prowlers, the enemy of Danavas and Devas entered Lanka, Rama and Lakshmana also drew out the arrows from monkeys in the forefront of the battlefield and went.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मिन्प्रभन्नेत्रिदशेन्द्रशतौसुरासुराभूतगणादिशश्च । ससागरास्सर्षिमहोरगाश्चतथैवभूम्यम्बुचराश्चप्रहृष्टाः ।।6.59.146।।
output: त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ enemy of Indra, तस्मिन् his, प्रभन्ने having been routed, सुरासुराः suras and Asuras, भूतगणाः guardians, दिशश्च of four quarters, हसागराः including sea, सर्षिमहोरगाःच including the sages and serpents, तथैव so also, भूम्यम्बुचराः creatures of land and water, प्रहृष्टाः joyful.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सप्रविश्यपुरींलङ्कांरामबाणभयार्धितः । भग्नदर्पस्तदाराजाबभूवव्यथितेन्द्रियः ।।6.60.1।।
output: Then the king of Lanka after entering the city of Lanka, felt humiliated by Rama's arrow, vanity crushed and had lost control over his senses.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मातङ्गइवसिंहेनगरुडेनेवपन्नगः । अभिभूतोऽभवद्राजाराघवेणमहात्मना ।।6.60.2।।
output: Overcome by humiliation from the high souled Rama, Ravana remained like an elephant rejected by a lion and a serpent rejected by Garuda.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्रह्मदण्डप्रतीकानांविद्युत्सदृशवर्चसाम् । स्मरन्राघवबाणानांविव्यथेराक्षसेश्वरः ।।6.60.3।।
output: The Lord of Rakshasas remained disquieted recalling the arrows of Rama which emitted light like lightning, resembling Brahmadanda.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नकाञ्चनमयंदिव्यमाश्रित्यपरमासनम् । विप्रेक्षमाणोरक्षांसिरावणोवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.60.4।।
output: Ravana seated on the wonderful golden magnificent throne gazing at Rakshasas spoke these words.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वंतत्खलुमेमोघंयत्तप्तंपरमंतपः । यत्समानोमहेन्द्रेणमानुषेणास्मिर्जितः ।।6.60.5।।
output: " All the penance which I have done, and the asceticism practised by me equal to Mahendra has become purposeless and defeated."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इदंतद्ब्रह्मणोघोरंवाक्यंमामभ्युपस्थितम् । मानुषेभ्योविजानीहिभयंत्वमितितत्तथा ।।6.60.6।।
output: त्वम् you, मानुषेभ्यः from humans, भयम् fear, विजानीहि coming to be true, इति thus, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, इदम् these, घोरम् dreadful, वाक्यम् words, माम् to me, उपस्थितम् warning given, तत् that, तथा like that.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः । अवध्यत्वंमयाप्राप्तंमानुषेभ्योनयाचितम् ।।6.60.7।।
output: "I sought protection from Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Rakshasas and serpents but not asked for protection from humans."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विदितंमानुषंमन्येरामंदशरथात्मजम् । इक्ष्वाकुकुलजातेनअनरण्येनयत्पुरा ।।6.60.8।। उत्पत्स्यतेहिमद्वंशेपुरुषोराक्षसाधनु । यस्त्वांसपुत्रंसामात्यंसबलंसाश्वसारथिम् ।।6.60.9।। निहनिष्यतिसङ्ग्रामेत्वांकुलाधम दुर्मते ।
output: राक्षसाधम lowest Rakshasa, कुलाधम vilest of the clan, दुर्मते evil minded, यः he who, सपुत्रम् your sons, सामात्यम् altogether, सबलम् all army, साश्वसारथिम् your horses and charioteers, त्वाम् you, सङ्ग्रामे in war, निहनिष्यति will perish, पुरुषः man, मद्वंशे in my race, उत्पत्स्यतेहि will be born, पुरा in the past, इक्ष्वाकुकलजातेन in the race of Ikshvaku, अनरण्येनयत् like that by Anaranya, विदितम् made known, दशरथात्मजम् Dasaratha's son, रामम् Rama, मानुषम् human, मन्ये I think.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विदितंमानुषंमन्येरामंदशरथात्मजम् । इक्ष्वाकुकुलजातेनअनरण्येनयत्पुरा ।।6.60.8।। उत्पत्स्यतेहिमद्वंशेपुरुषोराक्षसाधनु । यस्त्वांसपुत्रंसामात्यंसबलंसाश्वसारथिम् ।।6.60.9।। निहनिष्यतिसङ्ग्रामेत्वांकुलाधम दुर्मते ।
output: "I think that Dasaratha's son Rama, a human being is about whom king Anaranya born in Ikshvaku race, who cursed me earlier saying, 'In my race will be born a man who will kill you in war, with your sons, your horses, charioteers, all army, O evil minded lowest of Rakshasas, and the vilest of Rakshasas."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शप्तोऽहंवेदवत्याचयदासाधर्षितापुरा ।।6.60.10।। सेयंसीतामहाभागाजाताजनकनन्दिनी ।
output: यदा that way, पुरा in the past, सा she, धर्षिता violated, वेदवत्या by Vedavathi, अहम् I am, शप्तः cursed, सा she, इयम् thus, महाभागा highly blessed, जनकनन्दिनी loved by Janaka, सीता Sita, जाता born.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
उमानन्दीश्वरश्चापिरम्भावरुणकन्यका ।।6.60.11।। यथोक्तास्तन्मयाप्राप्तंनमिथ्याऋषिभाषितम्
output: "Uma, Nandeeswara, Rambha and daughter of Varuna have cursed me like that and the prediction of those endowed with vision has been attained by me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतदेवाभ्युपागम्ययत्नंकर्तुमहार्हथ ।।6.60.12।। राक्षसाश्चापितिष्ठन्तुचर्यागोपुरमूर्थसु ।
output: एतत् एव all this, अभ्युपागम्य knowing, इह here, यत्नम् make effort, कर्तुम् will do, अर्हथ ought to, राक्षसाश्चापि even Rakshasas, चर्यागोपुरमूर्धसु strive to succeed positioned at the top of gates, तिष्ठन्तु positioned.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सचाप्रतिमगाम्भीर्योदेवदानवदर्पहा ।।6.60.13।। ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतस्तुकुम्भकर्णोविबोध्यताम् ।
output: "Let Kumbhakarna of unparalleled profundity, capable of crushing Devas and Danavas, who is in slumber owing to the curse of Brahma be awakened."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सपराजितमात्मानंप्रहस्तंचनिषूदितम् ।।6.60.14।। ज्ञात्वारक्षोबलंभीममादिदेशमहाबलः ।
output: महाबलः endowed with mighty prowess, सः he, पराजितम् defeated, आत्मानम् himself, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, निषूदितम् killed, भीमम् terrific, बलम् strength, आदिदेश be instructed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
द्वारेषुयत्नःक्रियतांप्राकारश्चाधिरुह्यताम् ।।6.60.15।। निद्रावशसमाविष्टःकुम्भकर्णोविबोद्यताम् ।
output: "Let the Rakshasas climb up the defensive walls and attempt to guard. Also let Kumbhakarna be aroused from sleep."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सुखंस्वपितिनिश्चिन्तःकालोपहतचेतनः ।।6.60.16।। नवषट् सप्तचाष्टौचमासान् स्वपितिराक्षसः ।
output: राक्षसः Rakshasa, कालोपहतचेतनः lost consciousness for long, निश्चिन्तः slumbering at ease, नव nine, सप्त seven, षट् six, अष्टौ eight च and, मासान् months, सुखम् happily, स्वपिति sleeping.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मन्त्रयित्वाप्रसुप्तोऽयमितस्तुनवमेऽहनि ।।6.60.17।। तंतुबोधयतक्षिप्रंकुम्भकर्णंमहाबलम् ।
output: मन्त्रयित्वा deliberating like this, अयम् I am, इतः here, नवमे nine, अहनि day and night, प्रसुप्तः sleeping, महाबलम् great strength, तंकुम्बकुर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, क्षिप्रम् quickly, बोधयत may be informed

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सतुसङ् ख्येमहाबाहुःककुदस्सर्वरक्षसाम् ।।6.60.18।। वानरान् राजपुत्रौचक्षिप्रमेवहनिष्यति
output: "Endowed with broad shoulders, he is the foremost of Rakshasas. He will crush many Vanaras immediately and the two princes (Rama and Lakshmana)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एषःकेतुःपरंसङ् ख्येमुख्योवैसर्वरक्षसाम् ।।6.60.19।। कुम्भकर्णःसदाशेतेमूढोग्राम्यसुखेरतः ।
output: "He, (Kumbhakarna) is the foremost chief among all Rakshasas enumerated. In that way he is distinguished. But he is insensate, remains addicted always to indecent delight in the form of sleep."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
रामेणहिनिरस्तस्यसङ्ग्रामेऽस्मिन् सुदारुणे ।।6.60.20।। भविष्यतिनमेशोकःकुम्भकर्णेविबोधिते ।
output: " After Kumbhakarna is fully aroused, my sorrow impelled in this terrible comb at with Rama will not be there."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किंकरिष्याम्यहंतेनशक्रतुल्यबलेनहि ।।6.60.21।। ईदृशेव्यसनेघोरेयोनसाह्यायकल्पते ।
output: "What can I do if he does not assist me in such a dreadful comb at because of his weakness, even though he is equal to Indra in strength"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
तेतुतद्वचनंश्रुत्वाराक्षसेन्द्रस्यराक्षसाः ।।6.60.22।। जग्मुःपरमसम्भ्रान्ताःकुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम् ।
output: On listening to the Rakshasa king's words, the Rakshasas went to the abode of Kumbhakarna highly puzzled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तांप्रविश्यमहाद्वारंसर्वतोयोजनायताम् ।।6.60.23।। कुम्भकर्णगुहांरम्यांसर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् । कुम्भकर्णस्यनिःश्वासादवधूतामहाबलाः ।।6.60.24।। प्रतिष्ठमानाःकृच्छ्रेणयत्नात्प्रविविशुर्गुहाम् ।
output: महाद्वाराम् huge gates, सर्वतः all over, योजनायुताम् one yojana on all sides, सर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् with all fragrant flowers food etc, रम्याम् beautiful, कुम्भकर्णगुहाम् residence of Kumbhakarna, प्रविश्य entered, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, निःश्वासात् by the breath, अवधूताः attendants, महाबलाः of mighty strength, कृच्छ्रेण pushed out, प्रतिष्ठमानाः pushed their way, यत्नात् attempt, गुहाम् residence, प्रविविशुः entered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांप्रविश्यमहाद्वारंसर्वतोयोजनायताम् ।।6.60.23।। कुम्भकर्णगुहांरम्यांसर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् । कुम्भकर्णस्यनिःश्वासादवधूतामहाबलाः ।।6.60.24।। प्रतिष्ठमानाःकृच्छ्रेणयत्नात्प्रविविशुर्गुहाम् ।
output: The Rakshasas entered the beautiful residence of Kumbhakarna which was one yojana on all sides with huge gates, taking fragrant garlands and foods (to wake up Kumbhakarna) from where they were pushed out by the breath of Kumbhakarna. The Rakshasas endowed with mighty strength pushed their way into the residence of Kumbhakarna and entered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
तांप्रविश्यगुहांरम्यांशुभांकाञ्चनकुट्टिमाम् ।।6.60.25।। ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रंशयानंभीमविदर्शनम् ।
output: The tigers among Rakshasas entered the residence paved with gold and precious stones, a delightful one and saw sleeping Kumbhakarna of great prowess.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेतुतंविकृतंसुप्तंविकीर्णमिवपर्वतम् ।।6.60.26।। कुम्भकर्णंमहानिद्रंसहिताःप्रत्यबोधयन् ।
output: ते those, सहिताः collected together, विकृतम् of unnatural form, सुप्तम् sleeping on bed, विकीर्णम् scattered, पर्वतम् इव mountain like, महानिद्रम् in dead sleep, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, प्रत्यबोधयन् to awaken.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुंश्वसन्तमिवपन्नगम् । भ्रामयन्तम् न्विश्श्वसैःशयानम् भीमविदर्शमम् ।।6.60.27।। भीमनासापुटंतंतुपातालोविपुलाननम् । शयनेन्यस्तसर्वाङ्गंमेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् ।।6.60.28।। काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गंकिरीटिनमरिन्दमम् । ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रंकुम्भकर्णमरिन्दमम् ।।6.60.29।।
output: ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुम् body covered with bristling hair, पन्नगमिव like a serpent, श्वसन्तम् breathing, न्वििश्श्वसैः hissing heavily, भ्रामयन्तम् turning back, शयानम् sleeping, भीमविदर्शमम् of terrible, नीमनासापुटम् horrible nostrils, पातालविपुलाननम् face as vast as underworld, वयने, न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गम् all limbs stretched out, मेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् emitting smell of fat and blood, काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गम् arms adorned with gold bracelets, किरीटिनम् wearing a crown, अरिन्दमम् tamer of foes, नैरृतव्याघ्रम् tiger of southwest, अरिमर्धनम् destroyer of enemies, तंकुम्भकर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, ददृशुः saw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुंश्वसन्तमिवपन्नगम् । भ्रामयन्तम् न्विश्श्वसैःशयानम् भीमविदर्शमम् ।।6.60.27।। भीमनासापुटंतंतुपातालोविपुलाननम् । शयनेन्यस्तसर्वाङ्गंमेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् ।।6.60.28।। काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गंकिरीटिनमरिन्दमम् । ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रंकुम्भकर्णमरिन्दमम् ।।6.60.29।।
output: The Rakshasas saw Kumbhakarna, destroyer of enemies, the tiger of the southwest, tamer of foes, with his body fully covered with bristling hair, breathing heavily like a serpent with horrible nostrils, turning back with facemouth as vast as underworld all limbs stretched out, emitting smell of fat and blood, arms adorned with gold bracelets, wearing a crown, and sleeping.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुंश्वसन्तमिवपन्नगम् । भ्रामयन्तम् न्विश्श्वसैःशयानम् भीमविदर्शमम् ।।6.60.27।। भीमनासापुटंतंतुपातालोविपुलाननम् । शयनेन्यस्तसर्वाङ्गंमेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् ।।6.60.28।। काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गंकिरीटिनमरिन्दमम् । ददृशुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रंकुम्भकर्णमरिन्दमम् ।।6.60.29।।
output: The Rakshasas saw Kumbhakarna, destroyer of enemies, the tiger of the southwest, tamer of foes, with his body fully covered with bristling hair, breathing heavily like a serpent with horrible nostrils, turning back with facemouth as vast as underworld all limbs stretched out, emitting smell of fat and blood, arms adorned with gold bracelets, wearing a crown, and sleeping.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्चक्रुर्महात्मानंकुम्भकर्णाग्रतस्तदाचाग्रतः ।।6.60.30।। मांसानांमेरुसङ्काशंराशिंपरमतर्पणम् ।
output: ततः thereafter, महात्मानः great soul, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, अग्रतः before, मांसानाम् meat, मेरुसङ्काशम् of the size of Meru mountain, परमतर्पणम् for pleasing immensely, राशिम् heap, चक्रुः placed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मृगाणांमहिषाणांचवराहाणांचसञ्चयान् ।।6.60.31।। चक्रुर्नैरृतशार्दूलाराशिमन्नस्यचाद्भुतम् ।
output: नैरृतशार्दूलाः tiger of southwest, मृगाणाम् antelopes, महिषाणांच buffaloes also, वराहाणांच swine also, सञ्चयान् in heaps, अन्नस्य food, अद्भुतम् marvellous, राशिंच a mass, चक्रुः placed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
ततश्शोणितकुम्भांश्चमद्यानिविविधानिच ।।6.60.32।। पुरस्तात्कुम्भकर्णस्यचक्रुस्त्रिदशशत्रवः ।
output: Then the Rakshasas placed thirty three kinds of meat, pails of blood, and a variety of wines in front of Kumbhakarna.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लिलिपुश्चपरार्ध्येनचन्दनेनपरन्तपम् ।।6.60.33।। दिव्यैराश्वासयामामासुर्माल्यैर्गन्धैस्सुगन्धिभिः ।
output: परार्ध्येन highly fragrant, चन्दनेन sandal paste, परन्तपम् super, लिलिपुः to take in, दिव्यैः wonderful, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant, माल्यैः garland s, गन्दैःच and perfumes, आश्वासयामासुः daubed him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धूपंसुगन्धांश्चससृजुस्तुष्टवुश्चपरन्ततम् ।।6.60.34।। जलदाइवचानेदुर्यातुधानास्ततस्ततः ।
output: They also burnt incense, sandal to send forth fragrance to gratify Kumbhakarna and thundered like clouds here and there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शङ्खांनापूरयामासुश्शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान् ।।6.60.35।। तुमुलंयुगपच्छापिविनेदुश्चाप्यमर्षिताः ।
output: They blew moon size conches shining brightly. Intolerant Rakshasas raised loud noise simultaneously.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नेदुरास्फोटयामासुश्चिक्षिपुस्तेनिशाचराः ।।6.60.36।। कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थंचक्रुस्तेविपुलंस्वनम् ।
output: Those night rangers drawing the limbs of Kumbhakarna pushed his arms, clapping loudly to awaken him making a sound.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादमास्फोटितक्षेवळितसिंहनादम् । दिशोद्रवन्तस्त्रिदिवंकीरन्तःश्रुत्वाविहंगाःसहसानिपेतुः ।।6.60.37।।
output: On hearing the conchs, and of the clapping of arms, and thundering like a lion, the birds playing in the sky got scattered and fell.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदाभृशंतैर्निनदैर्महात्मानकुम्बकर्णोबुबुधेप्रसुप्तः । ततोमुसुण्ठीर्मुसलानिसर्वेरक्षोगणास्तेजगृहुर्गदाश्च ।।6.60.38।।
output: प्रसुप्तः sleeping, महात्मा great soul, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, भृशम् angry, तैः they, निनदैः roared, यदा that way, नबुबुधे not awakened, ततः then सर्वे all, रक्षोगणाः Rakshasas, तम् him, मुसुण्ठीः mallets, मुसलानि bars, गदाश्च and maces, जगृहुः hit.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंशैलशृङ्गैर्मुसलैर्गदाभिर्वृक्षैस्तरैर्मुद्गरमुष्टिभिश्च । सुखप्रसुप्तंभुविकुम्भकर्णंरक्षांस्युदग्राणितदानिजघ्नुः ।।6.60.39।।
output: Then the excited Rakshasas could not wake up Kumbhakarna happily sleeping on the ground in spite of hitting with rocks and trees and their fists.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यनिःश्वासवातेनकुम्भकर्णस्यरक्षसः । राक्षसाबलवन्तोऽपिस्थातुनाशक्नुवन्पुरः ।।6.60.40।।
output: रक्षसः Rakshasa, तस्यकुम्भकर्णस्य that Kumbhakarna's, निःश्वासवातेन by the breathing out, बलवन्तःअपि with such force, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, पुरः earlier, स्दातुम् to stand, नशक्नुवन् not possible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
ततःपरिहितागाढंराक्षसाभीमविक्रमाः । मृदङ्गपणवान् भेरीश्शङ्खकुम्भगणांस्तथा ।।6.60.41।।
output: The Rakshasas of terrible valour resorted to abandoned drums and tom toms that way and pails of clay.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दशराक्षससाहस्रंयुगपत्पर्यवारयन् । नीलाञ्जनचयाकारंतेतुतंप्रत्यबोधयन् ।।6.60.42।। अभिघ्नन्तोनदन्तश्चनैवसंविविदेतुसः ।
output: दशराक्षससाहस्रम् ten thousand Rakshasas, युगपत् all together simultaneously, पर्यवारयन् surrounded, तेतु but he, नीलाञ्जनचयाकारम् like a mass of antimony, तम् him, अभिघ्नन्तः striking, नदन्तःनैव even made loud noise, तम् him, प्रत्यबोधयन् tried to wake, बोधयन् shouted, सः he, संविविदे not responded.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदाचैनंनशेकुस्तेप्रतिबोधयितुंतदा ।।6.60.43।। ततोगुरुतरंयत्नंदारुणंसमुपाक्रमन् ।
output: ते they, यदा that way, एनम् in that way, प्रतिबोधयितुम् called him again and again, नशेकुः not got up, तदा then, ततः thereafter, गुरुतरम् difficult, दारुणम् dreadful, यत्नम् effort, समुपाक्रमन् approaching.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
आश्वानुष्ट्रान् खरन्नागान् जघ्नुर्दण्डकशाङ्कुशैः ।।6.60.44।। भेरीशङ्खमृदङ्गांश्चसर्वप्राणैरवादयन् ।
output: They urged horses, elephants, camels, and donkeys to pounce on him, whipping with staff, whips, and goads.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
निजघ्नुश्चास्यगात्राणिमहाकाष्ठकङ्करैः ।।6.60.45।। मुद्गरैर्मुसलैश्चापिसर्वप्राणसमुद्यतैः ।
output: The city of Lanka including the woods was filled with that noise. They pushed him with mallets with all their strength, but he did not wake up.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेननादेवमहतालङ्कासमभिपूरिता ।।6.60.46।। सपर्वतवनासर्वासोऽपिनैवप्रबुध्यते ।
output: All Lanka and mountains were filled by the great noise made by the Rakshasas. Even then Kumbhakarna did not wake up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्सहस्रंभेरीणांयुगसत्समहन्यत ।।6.60.47।। मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणानामासक्तानांसमन्ततः ।
output: ततः then, मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणानाम् polished gold sticks, समन्ततः everywhere,आसक्तानाम् continuously, भेरीणाम् drums, सहस्रम् thousand, समहन्यत collected.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
एवमप्यन्तिद्रिस्तुयदानैवप्रबुध्यत ।।6.60.48।। शापस्यवशमापन्नस्ततःक्रुद्धानिशाचराः ।
output: Wrapped in sleep like that because of the spell of the curse, he had not wakened. The Rakshasas got enraged.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महाक्रोधसमाविष्टास्सर्वेभीमपराक्रमाः ।।6.60.49।। तद्रक्षोबोधयिष्यन्तश्चक्रुरन्येपराक्रमम् ।
output: All the Rakshasas endowed with mighty prowess became enraged and others started to arouse with all their strength.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
अन्येभेरीस्समाजघ्नुरन्येचक्रुर्महास्वनम् ।।6.60.50।। केशानन्येप्रलुलुपुःकर्णावन्येदशन्तिच ।
output: While some were beating the drums, some shouted at the pitch of their voice, some started pulling his hair and some bit his ears.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
उदकुम्बशतान्यन्येसमसिञ्चन्तकर्णयोः ।।6.60.51।। नकुम्भकर्णःपस्पन्देमहानिद्रावशंगतः ।
output: Some poured hundreds of pails of water into ears, distressed that he did not wake up under the spell of deep sleep.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
अन्येचबलिनस्तस्यकूटमुद्गरपाणयः ।।6.60.52।। मूर्ध्निवक्षसिगात्रेषुपातन् कूटमुद्गरान् ।
output: Some had their nails fixed with mallets, letting their mallets fall on the forehead, on the chest and throw at of Kumbhakarna.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
रज्जुबन्धनबद्धाभिश्शतघ्नीभिश्चसर्वशः ।।6.60.53।। वध्यमानोमहाकायोनप्राबुध्यतराक्षसः ।
output: Some struck with sataghni (mace) all over his huge body fastened with cords.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
वारणानांसहस्रंचशरीरेऽस्यप्रधावितम् ।।6.60.54।। कुम्बकर्णस्तदाबुद् ध्वास्पर्शंपरमबुध्यत ।
output: A thousand elephants were made to walk over his body. Then Kumbhakarna felt the touch but did not understand.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सपात्यमानैर्गिरिशृङ्गवृक्षैरचिन्तयंस्तान्विपुलान् प्रहारान् । निद्राक्ष्यात् क्षुद्भयपीडितश्चविजृम्भमाणस्सहसोत्पपाप ।।6.60.55।।
output: Tormented by hunger and hit by mountain peaks and huge trees he sprang up suddenly descended and awakened.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सनागभोगाचलशृङ्गकल्पौविक्षिप्यबाहूगिरशृङ्गसारौ । निवृत्यवक्त्रंवडवामुखाभंनिशाचरोऽसौविकृतंजजृम्भे ।।6.60.56।।
output: Kumbhakarna, devoid of any beauty threw out his limbs which were like the coils of cobra and as hard as mountain tops, his mouth was unnatural like a submarine fire as he yawned.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
तस्यजाजृम्भमाणस्यवक्त्रंपातालसन्निभम् । ददृशेमेरुशृङ्गाग्रेदिवाकरइवोदितः ।।6.60.57।।
output: As he yawned his mouth resembling the underworld, it was like the Sun rose over the top of Mount Meru.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सजृम्भमाणोऽतिबलःप्रद्धोनिशाचरः । निःश्वासश्चास्यसञ्जज्ञेपर्वतादिवमारुतः ।।6.60.58।।
output: As the mighty night ranger awakened and yawned continuously his breath was like wind blowing from the mountain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रूपमुत्तिष्ठतस्तस्यकुम्भकर्णस्यतद्बभौ । तपान्तेसबलाकस्यमेघस्येवविवर्षतः ।।6.60.59।।
output: As Kumbhakarna woke up he appeared like the time spirit at the time of dissolution of the universe like a rainy cloud at twilight as if seeking to consume all beings.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
तस्यदीप्ताग्निसदृशेविद्युत्सदृशवर्चसी । ददृशातेमहानेत्रेदीप्ताविवमहाग्रहौ ।।6.60.60।।
output: His huge eyes were like blazing fire dazzling like lightning glowing like two huge planets.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
ततस्त्वदर्शयन् सर्वान्भक्ष्यांश्चविविधान् बहून् । वराहान्महिषांश्चैवबभक्षसमहाबलः ।।6.60.61।।
output: Thereafter having seen several kinds of food items of hogs, buffaloes he ate them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
आददुन्भुक्षितोमांसंशोणितंतृषितःपिबन् । मेदःकुम्भांश्चमद्यांश्चपपौशक्ररिपुस्तदा ।।6.60.62।।
output: After eating the meat and feeling thirsty, the enemy of Indra drank blood, pails of fat and wine.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तृप्तइतिज्ञात्वासमुत्पेतुर्निशाचराः । शिरोभिश्चप्रणम्यैनंसर्वतःपर्यवारयन् ।।6.60.63।।
output: ततः there upon, निशाचराः night ranger, तृप्तःइति satisfied in that way, ज्ञात्वा realizing, समुत्पेतुः got up, एनम् all of them, शिरोभिः heads bent down, प्रणम्य greeting, सर्वतः all, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
निद्राविशदनेत्रस्तुकलुषीकृतलोचनः । चारयन् सर्वतोदृष्टिंतान् ददर्शनिशाचरान् ।।6.60.64।।
output: With sleepy eyes casting his glance at the night rangers looked at all of them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
ससर्वान् सान्त्वयामासनैरृतान् नैरृतर्षभः । बोधनाद्विस्मितश्चापिराक्षसानिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.60.65।।
output: He, the bull among the south west region, astonished at his awakening, soothed, and spoke to all the Rakshasas in this way.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
किमर्थमहमादृत्यभवद्भिःप्रतिबोधितः । कच्छित्सुकुशलंराज्ञोभयंवानेषनकिम् ।।6.60.66।।
output: "What have you done to wake me Hope King is fine and has no fear of danger"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
अथवाध्रुवमन्येभ्योभयंपरमुपस्थितम् । यदर्थमेवत्वरितैर्भवद्भिःप्रतिबोधितः ।।6.60.67।।
output: "Is there any fear of some enemies Is it because of that you have woken me up Let me know."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अद्यराक्षसराजस्यभयमुत्पाटयाम्यहम् । दारयिष्येमहेन्द्रंवाशातयिष्येतथानलम् ।।6.60.68।।
output: अद्य devour, अहम् I will, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, भयम् fear, उत्पाटयामि eradicate, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra, दारयिष्ये destroy, तथा like that, अनलम् fire, शातयिष्ये alleviate

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
नह्यल्पकारणेसुप्तंबोधयिष्यतिमांगुरुः । तदाख्यातार्थतत्त्वेनमत्प्रबोधनकारणम् ।।6.60.69।।
output: "For a small reason he will not awaken me. Tell me the reason truly for waking me."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
एवंब्रुवाणंसम्रब्धंकुम्भकर्णमरिन्दमम् । यूपाक्षःसचिवोराज्ञःकृताञ्जलिरभाषत ।।6.60.70।।
output: Kumbhakarna, tamer of enemies having spoken in that way in anger, Yupaksha, a minister joined palms and replied to him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ननोदेवकृतंकिञ्चिद्भयमस्तिकदाचन । मानुषान्नोभयंराजंस्तुमुलंसम्प्रबाधते ।।6.60.71।।
output: राजन् king, नः no, कदाचन danger, देवकृतम् Devas did, भयम् fear, किंचित् a small, नास्ति destruction, मानुषात् by human, तुमुलम् is pressing, भयम् danger, सम्प्रबाधते causing pain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नदैत्यदानवेभ्योवाभयमस्तिहितादृशम् । यादृशंमानुषंराजन् भयमस्मानुपस्थितम् ।।6.60.72।।
output: राजन् king, मानुषम् human, यादृशम् this kind, भयम् danger, अस्मान् for us, उपस्थितम् has arisen, तादृशम् the kind of, भयम् fear, दैत्यदानवेभ्योवा either from Daityas or Danavas, नास्तिहि not there.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वानरैःपर्वताकारैर्लङ्केयंपरिवारिता । सीताहरणसन्तप्ताद्रामान्नस्तुमुलंभयम् ।।6.60.73।।
output: इयंलङ्का this Lanka, पर्वताकारैः mountain like form, वानरैः Vanaras, परिवारिता accompanied by, सीताहरणसन्तप्तात् by abduction of Sita, रामात् from Rama, नः not, तुमुलम् little, भयम् fear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एकेनवानरेणेयंपूर्वंदग्धामहापुरी । कुमारोनिहतश्चाक्षस्सानुयात्रःसकुञ्जरः ।।6.60.74।।
output: एकेन alone, वानरेण by Vanara, पूर्वम् earlier, इयम् this, महापुरी great city, दग्धा burnt, सानुयात्रः followers, सकुञ्जरः his elephants, कुमारः son अक्षःच Aksha, निहतः killed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वयंरक्षोधिपश्चापिपौलस्त्योदेवकण्टकः । मृतेतिसंयुगेमुक्तोरामेणादित्यतेजसा ।।6.60.75।।
output: "Rakshasa king, scion of sage Paulastya, an enemy of Devatas, was let off from death by Rama who has the splendour of Sun."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
यन्नदेवैःकृतोराजानापिदैत्यैर्नदानवैः । कृतःसइहरामेणविमुक्तःप्राणसंशयात् ।।6.60.76।।
output: "The king could escape from the verge of death and such an act was never done by Daityas or Danavas earlier in the encounter."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सयूपाक्ष्वचश्श्रुत्वाभ्रातुर्युधिपराभवम् । कुम्भकर्णोविवृत्ताक्षोयूपाक्षमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.60.77।।
output: On hearing the words of Yupaksha, regarding the insult of his brother Kumbhakarna said this rolling his eyes.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वमद्यैवयूपाक्षहरिसैन्यंसलक्ष्मणम् । राघवंचरणेजित्वाततोद्रक्ष्यामिरावणम् ।।6.60.78।।
output: यूपाक्ष Yupaksha, अद्यैव now itself, सर्वम् all, हरिसैन्यम् Vanara army, सलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, राघवंच and Raghava, रणे in war, जित्वा conquering, ततः then, रावणम् Ravana, द्रक्ष्यामि will see.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
राक्षसांस्तर्पयिष्यामिहरीणांमांसशोणितैः । रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापिस्वयंपास्यामिशोणितम् ।।6.60.79।।
output: "I will satisfy the Rakshasas with the flesh and blood of Rama and Lakshmana. You will see."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्तस्यवाक्यंब्रुवतोनिशम्यसगर्वितंरोषविवृद्धदोषम् । महोदरोनैरृतयोधमुख्यःकृताञ्जलिर्वाक्यमिदंबभाषे ।।6.60.80।।
output: ब्रुवतः replied, तस्य his, गर्वितम् proudly, रोषविवृद्धदोषम् words full of arrogance, तत् वाक्यम् his words, निशम्य submitted, नैरृतयोधमुख्यः chief of army of Rakshasas, सः he, महोदरः Mahodara, कृताञ्जलिः offering salutations, इदंवाक्यम् these words, बभाषे spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणस्यवचःश्रुत्वागुणदोषौविमृश्यच । पश्चादपिमहाबाहो शत्रून्युधिविजेष्यसि ।।6.60.81।।
output: "O Mighty Armed One! You hear from Ravana the advantages and disadvantages and thereafter assess the enemy to conquer."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
महोदरवचश्श्रुत्वाराक्षसैःपरिवारितः । कुम्भकर्णोमहातेजास्सम्प्रतस्थेमहाबलः ।।6.60.82।।
output: Kumbhakarna of extraordinary energy, mighty strong, on hearing Mahodara went in surrounded by Rakshasas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सुप्तमुत्थाप्यभीमाक्षंभीमरूपपराक्रमम् । राक्षसास्त्वरिताजुग्मर्दशग्रीन्विवेशनम् ।।6.60.83।।
output: After rousing up Kumbhakarna of frightful eyes and fierce strength from sleep the Rakshasas quickly went to the abode of the ten headed king.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोगत्वादशग्रीवमासीनंपरमासने । ऊचुर्बद्धाञ्जलिपुटास्सर्वएवनिशाचराः ।।6.60.84।।
output: सर्वे all, तेनिशाचराः those night rangers, परमासने excellent seat, आसीनम् seated, दशग्रीवम् tenheaded king, अनिगम्य reaching, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः greeting with folded hands, ऊचुः spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रबुद्धोऽयंकुम्भकर्णभ्रातातेराक्षसेश्वर । कथंतत्रैवनिर्यातुद्रक्ष्यसेतमिहागतम् ।।6.60.85।।
output: राक्षसेश्वर Rakshasa Lord, तेभ्राता your brother, अयंकुम्भकर्णः this Kumbhakarna, प्रबुद्धः greetings, तत्रैव to you, निर्यातुकथम् tell me what to do, इह now, आगतम् have come, तम् to you, द्रक्ष्यसे What order.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टोराक्षसांस्तानुपस्थितान् । द्रष्टुमेनमिहेच्छामियथान्यायंचपूज्यताम् ।।6.60.86।।
output: रावणस्तु Ravana on his part, हृष्टः cheerful, उपस्थितान् seated, तान् him, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, अब्रवीत् said, एवम् in that way, इह now, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि desire, यथान्यायम् as propriety demands, पूज्यताम् to honour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
तथेत्युक्त्वातुतेसर्वेपुनरागम्यराक्षसाः । कुम्भकर्णमिदंवाक्यमूचूरावणचोदिताः ।।6.60.87।।
output: All the Rakshasas taking leave from Ravana said this again approaching Kumbhakarna.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
द्रष्टुंत्वांकांक्षतेराजासर्वराक्षसपुङ्गवः । गमनेक्रियतांबुद्धिर्भ्रातरंसम्प्रहर्षयः ।।6.60.88।।
output: All the Rakshasa leaders said to Kumbhakarna," the king desires to see you. Start. Make up your mind. Be pleased to depart to your brother."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुम्भकर्णस्तुदुर्धर्षोभ्रातुराज्ञायशासनम् । तथेत्युक्त्वामहावीर्यश्शयनादुत्पपातह ।।6.60.89।।
output: दुर्धर्षः formidable, महावीर्यः courageous, कुम्भकर्णस्तु Kumbhakarna also, भ्रातुः brother, शासनम् order, आज्ञाय instruction, तथाइति saying yes, उक्त्वा said, शयनात् from the bed, उत्पपातह rose up.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रक्षाळ्यवदनंहृष्टस्स्नातःपरमभूषितः । पिपासुस्त्वरयामासपानंबलसमीरणम् ।।6.60.90।।
output: Joyful Kumbhakarna, washed his face, had a bath and being thirsty ordered a drink that can increase his strength.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
ततस्तेत्वरितास्तत्रराक्षसारावणाज्ञया । मद्यकुम्भांश्चविविधान् क्षिप्रमेवोपहारयन् ।।6.60.91।।
output: By the order of Ravana hurriedly they got several kinds of wine in pots.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
पीत्वाघटसहस्रेद्वेगमनायोपचक्रमे । ईषत्समुत्कटोमत्तस्तेजोबलसमन्वितः ।।6.60.92।।
output: (Kumbhakarna) Having drunk two thousand pots of wine, slightly excited and inebriated and replenished with strength and energy was ready to depart.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुम्भकर्णोबभौहृष्टःकालान्तकयमोपमः । भ्रातुस्सभवनंगच्छन्रक्षोबलसमन्वितः ।।6.60.93।। कुम्भकर्णःपदन्यासैरकम्पयतमेन्दिीम् ।
output: रक्षोबलसमन्वितः surrounded by Rakshasa army, भ्रातुः brother, भवनम् residence, गच्छन् going, हृष्टः happily, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, कालान्तकयमोपमः like the Lord of death, बभौ looked, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, न्यासैः strides, मेन्दिीम् earth, अकम्पयत shook.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 60:
सराजमार्गंवपुषाप्रकाशयन् सहस्ररश्मिर्धरणीमिवांशुभिः । जगामतत्राञ्जलिमालयावृतश्शतक्रतुर्गेहमिवस्वयम्भुवः ।।6.60.94।।
output: Kumbhakarna went like the thousand rayed Sun illuminating the earth by his splendour brightening the royal path, greeted by a circle of Rakshasas joining palms like Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices went to the abode of selfborn Brahma.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंराजमार्गस्थममित्रघातिनंवनौकसस्तेसहसाबहिस्स्थिताः । दृष्टवाऽप्रमेयंगिरिशृङ्गकल्पंवितत्रसुस्तेहरियूथपालाः ।।6.60.95।।
output: And then the Vanaras and the leaders of the Vanara army who were present looked at the immeasurably tall form of Kumbhakarna walking through the royal path and got alarmed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
केचिच्छरण्यंशरणंस्मरामंव्रजन्तिकेचिद् व्यथिताःपतन्ति । केचिद्धशस्मव्यथिताःपतन्तिकेचिद्भयार्ताभुविशेरतेस्म ।।6.60.96।।
output: Indeed, some took refuge from Rama who could give shelter, some fell down in panic, some went in all directions in panic, and some out of fear lay down on the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमद्रिशृङ्गप्रतिमंकिरीटिनंस्पृशन्तमादित्यमिवाऽत्मतेजसा । वनौकसःप्रेक्ष्यविवृद्धमद्भुतं 3 भयार्धितादुद्रुविरेततस्ततः ।।6.60.97।।
output: Oppressed with fear the Vanaras ran here and there seeing the form of Kumbhakarna that was like the peak of a mountain as if touching the selfluminous Sun, crowned and wonderful, grown in size. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixtieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
ततोरामोमहातेजाधनुरादायवीर्यवान् । किरीटिनंमहाकायंकुम्भकर्णंददर्श ह ।।6.61.1।।
output: On taking up a bow Rama saw Kumbhakarna of extraordinary energy, prodigious, and of large body, adorned with a crown.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
तंदृष्टवाराक्षसश्रेष्ठंपर्वताकारदर्शनम् । क्रममाणमिवाकाशंपुरानारायणंप्रभुम् ।।6.61.2।।
output: That foremost of Rakshasas was like a mountain in appearance, it was like Lord Narayana taking steps to the sky earlier.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतोयाम्बुदसङ्काशंकाञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम् । दृष्टवापुनःप्रदुद्रवावानराणांमहाचमूः ।।6.61.3।।
output: Seeing the Rakshasa who was like a rainy cloud with water, decked with gold ornaments, the commander in chief of Vanaras ran.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विद्रुतांवाहिनींदृष्टवावर्धमानं च राक्षसम् । सविस्मयमिदंरामोविभीषणमुवाच ह ।।6.61.4।।
output: Seeing the army scared away and the army of Rakshasas growing in size, Rama was astonished and thus spoke to Vibheeshana.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कोऽसौपर्वतसङ्काशःकिरीटीहरिलोचनः । लङ्कायांदृश्यतेवीरःसविद्युदिवतोयदः ।।6.61.5।।
output: पर्वतसङ्काशः resembling mountain, किरीटी crowned, हरिलोचनः of tawny eyes, सविद्युत् by lightning, तोयदःइव like rainy cloud, वीरः hero, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, दृश्यते seen, असौ oh, क who is he.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पृथिव्यांकेतुभूतोऽसौमहानेकोऽत्रदृश्यते । यंदृष्टवावानरास्सर्वेविद्रवन्तिततस्ततः ।।6.61.6।।
output: महान् remarkable, असौ he is, एकः lone, अत्र there, पृथिव्याम् earth, केतुभूतः comet, दृश्यते appears, यम् him, दृष्टवा on seeing, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, ततस्ततः hither and thither, विद्रवन्ति fleeing.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आचक्षवसुमहान् कोऽसौरक्षोवायदिवाऽसुरः । न मयैवंविधंभूतंदृष्टपूर्वंकदाचन ।।6.61.7।।
output: सुमहान् gigantic, असौ he is, क who, रक्षःवा that Rakshasa, यदिवा perhaps, असुरः demon, आचक्षव colossus, मया by me, एवंविधम् this kind, धूतम् messenger, कदाचन not seen, न दृष्टपूर्वम् not seen earlier.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
संपृष्टोराजपुत्रेणरामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । विभीषणोमहाप्राज्ञःकाकुत्थ्समिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.61.8।।
output: राजपुत्रेण by the prince, अक्लिष्टकर्मण of unwearied action, रामेण by Rama, संपृष्टः having been asked, महाप्राज्ञः highly intelligent, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, काकुत्थ्सम् to Kakuthsa, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
येनवैवस्वतोयुद्धेवासवश्चपराजितः । सैषविश्रवसःपुत्रःकुम्भकर्णःप्रतापवान् ।।6.61.9।। अस्यप्रमाणसदृशोराक्षसाऽन्यो न विद्यते ।
output: "Vyvasvatha (Lord of death) as well as Vasava (Indra) were defeated by him in war. He is Kumbhakarna, the son of sage Visrava, a stupendous one and there is no other Rakshasa who equals him in size."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतेनदेवायुधिदानवाश्चयक्षाभुजङ्गाःपिशिताशनाश्च । गन्धर्वविद्याधरकिन्नरैश्चसहस्रशोराघवसम्प्रभग्नाः ।।6.61.10।।
output: "O Raghava! In war Devas, Danavas, Yakshas, Nagas, ogres, Gandharvas, Vidydharas, Kinneras in thousands were defeated by him."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शूलपाणिंविरूपाक्षंकुम्भकर्णंमहाबलम् । हन्तुं न शेकुस्त्रिदशाःकालोऽयमितिमोहिताः ।।6.61.11।।
output: "This Kumbhakarna with pike in hand and fierce eyes, is mighty strong. All the Devatas could not kill him, deluded that he is death personified."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रकृत्याह्येषतेजस्वीकुम्भकर्णोमहाबलः । अन्येषांराक्षसेन्द्राणांवरदानकृतंबलम् ।।6.61.12।।
output: एषः in that way, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, प्रकृत्याः by nature, तेजस्वी energetic, महाबलः mighty, अन्येषाम् of others, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् Rakshasa kings, बलम् strength, वरदानकृतम् is on account of boons.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एतेनजातमात्रेणक्षुधार्तेनमहात्मना । भक्षितानिसहस्राणिसत्त्वानांसुबहून्यपि ।।6.61.13।।
output: जातमात्रेण as he was born, क्षुधार्तेन due to hunger, एतेन all, महात्मना great soul, सत्त्वानाम् created beings, सुबहूनिअपि being strong, सहस्राणि thousands, भक्षितानि were consumed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषुसंभक्षयमाणेषुप्रजाभयनिपीडिताः । यान्तिस्मशरणंशक्रंतमप्यर्थंन्यवेदयन् ।।6.61.14।।
output: "In that way when Kumbhakarna was devouring, out of fear all people sought the refuge of Indra and represented."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सकुन्भकर्णंकुपितोमहेन्द्रोजघानवज्रेणशितेनवज्री । सशक्रवज्राभिहतोमहात्माचचालकोपाच्चभृशंननाद ।।6.61.15।।
output: वज्री armed with thunderbolt, सः he, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, कुपितः enraged, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, वज्रेण at Indra, जघान hurt, शक्रवज्राभिहतः with thunderbolt, महात्मा great self, सः he, चचाल reeled, कोपात् in anger, भृशम् intense, ननाद च roared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
तस्यनानद्यमानस्यकुम्भकर्णस्यरक्षसः । श्रुत्वानिनादंवित्रस्ताःभूमिभूयोवितत्रसे ।।6.61.16।।
output: "People were already afraid of Kumbhakarna, and after hearing the lion roar of this Rakshasa they were even more scared."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्रकोपान्महेन्द्रस्यकुम्भकर्णोमहाबलः । विकृष्यैरावताद्धन्तंजघानोरसिवासवम् ।।6.61.17।।
output: तत्र then, महेन्द्रस्य Mahendra's, कोपात् anger, महाबलः mighty, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, ऐरावतात् Airavatham, दन्तम् tusk, विकृष्य tearing, वासवम् from the mouth, उरसि chest, जघान struck.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
कुम्भकर्णप्रहारार्तोविजज्वाल स वासवः । ततोविषेदुस्सहसादेवाब्रह्मर्षिदानवाः ।।6.61.18।। प्रजाभिस्सहशक्रश्चययौस्थानंस्वयम्भुवः ।
output: "Hit by Kumbhakarna Indra felt tormented. The Devatas, Brahmarshis and Danavas became despondent. Accompanied by created beings they complained to Brahma."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
कुम्भकर्णस्यदौरात्म्यंशशंसुस्तेप्रजापतेः ।।6.61.19।। प्रजानांभक्षणंचापिधर्षणं च दिवौकसाम् । आश्रमध्वंसनंचापिपरस्त्रीहरणंभृशम् ।।6.61.20।।
output: "They reported to Brahma about Kumbhakarna's ruthless deeds, devouring created beings, insulting, harsh and also destroying the abodes of sages violently and abducting others' wives."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुम्भकर्णस्यदौरात्म्यंशशंसुस्तेप्रजापतेः ।।6.61.19।। प्रजानांभक्षणंचापिधर्षणं च दिवौकसाम् । आश्रमध्वंसनंचापिपरस्त्रीहरणंभृशम् ।।6.61.20।।
output: ते you, प्रजापतेः Brahma, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, दौरात्म्यम् ruthless deeds, प्रजानाम् created beings, भक्षणंचापि devouring, दिवौकसाम् insulting, धर्षणं च harshness, आश्रमध्वंसनंचापि also destroying the abodes of sages, भृशम् violently, परस्त्रीहरणम् abducted others' wives, शशंसुः reported.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एवंप्रजायदित्वेषभक्षयिष्यतिनित्यशः । अचिरेणैवकालेनशून्योलोकोभविष्यति ।।6.61.21।।
output: एषः if he, एवम् in that way, नित्यशः every day, प्रजाः created beings, भक्षयिष्यतियदि if consumes, अचिरेण soon, कालेनैव in course of time, लोकः world, शून्यः empty, भविष्यति will become.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वासवस्यवचश्श्रुत्वासर्वलोकपितामहः । रक्षांस्यावाहयामासकुम्भकर्णंददर्श ह ।।6.61.22।।
output: Hearing the words of Indra, Brahma conjured the Rakshasas and saw Kumbhakarna with them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुम्भकर्णंसमीक्ष्यैववितत्रासप्रजापतिः । दृष्टवाविश्वास्यचैवैनंस्वयम्भूरिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.61.23।।
output: कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, समीक्ष्यैव beholding, प्रजापतिः Brahma, वितत्रास alarmed, स्वयम्भूः Brahma, दृष्टवा seeing, विश्वास्यचैवैनम् to restore confidence, इदं, this अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ध्रुवंलोकविनाशायपौलस्त्येनासिनिर्मितः । तस्मात्त्वमद्यप्रभृतिमृतकल्पःशयिष्यसे ।।6.61.24।।
output: "Surely you are begotten by Paulastya for the destruction of the universe. Therefore, remain sleeping like a dead one from today, ' said Brahma and cursed him."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतोऽथनिपपाताग्रतःप्रभोः । ततःपरमसम्भ्रान्तोरावणोवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.61.25।।
output: "Thereafter, by the curse of Lord Brahma, Kumbhakarna fell in front. Highly agitated at this Ravana spoke these words to Brahma."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
विवृद्धःकाञ्चनोवृक्षःफलकालेनिकृत्यते । न नप्तारंस्वकंन्यायंशप्तुमेवंप्रजापते ।।6.61.26।।
output: "Oh Brahma! Cutting a golden tree at the stage of fruiting is not fair. It is not proper for you to curse your great grandson in that way."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न मिथ्यावचनश्चत्वंस्वप्स्यत्येष न संशयः । कालस्तुक्रियतामस्यशयनेजागरेतथा ।।6.61.27।।
output: "Your words will not become untrue, no doubt. Sleep, he must but waking time may be fixed."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
रावणस्यवचश्श्रुत्वास्वयम्भूरिदमब्रवीत् । शयिताह्येषषण्मासानेकाहंजागरिष्यति ।।6.61.28।।
output: On hearing Ravana's words, Brahma said" He will sleep for six months and stay awake for a day."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
एकेनाह्नात्वसौवीरश्चरन् भूमिंबुभुक्षितः । व्यात्तास्योभक्षयेल्लोकान् सङ्कृद्धइवपावकः ।।6.61.29।।
output: "This hero will open his mouth wide and move about and alone he will consume the world like the swollen fire."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
सोऽसौव्यसमापन्नःकुम्भकर्णमबोधयत् । त्वत्पराक्रमभीतश्चराजासम्प्रतिरावणः ।।6.61.30।।
output: "Overtaken by worry, the king out of fear of your prowess just awakened sleeping Kumbhakarna."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
स एषनिर्गतोवीरःशिबिराद्भीमविक्रमः । वानरान्भृशसङ्कृद्धोभक्षयन्परिधावति ।।6.61.31।।
output: "This heroic Kumbhakarna has come out of his residence extremely angry and going to and from to consume all Vanaras."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुम्भकर्णंसमीक्ष्यैवहरयोऽद्यप्रविद्रुतुः । कथमेनंरणेक्रुद्धंवारयिष्यन्तिवानराः ।।6.61.32।।
output: अद्य running, हरयः monkeys, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, प्रतीक्ष्यैव on seeing itself, प्रविद्रुतुः, रणे war, क्रुद्धम् angry, एनम् these, वानराः Vanaras, कथम् how, वारयिष्यन्ति check.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उच्यन्तांवानराःसर्वेयन्त्रमेतत्समुच्छ्रितम् । इतिविज्ञायहरयोभविष्यन्तीहनिर्भयाः ।।6.61.33।।
output: एतत् this, समुच्छ्रितम् standing high, यन्त्रम् machine, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, उच्यन्ताम् having told, हरयः Vanaras, इति this, विज्ञाय victory, निर्भयाः not scared, इह here, भविष्यन्ति will be.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
विभीषणवचश्श्रुत्वाहेतुमत्सुमुखेरितम् । उवाचराघवोवाक्यंनीलंसेनापतिंतदा ।।6.61.34।।
output: Hearing the words of Vibheeshana, which was reasonable and, in their favour, Raghava said this to Nila, the commander in chief of the army.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गच्छसैन्यानिसर्वाणिव्यूह्यतिष्ठस्वपावके । द्वाराण्यादायलङ्कायाश्चर्याश्चाप्यथसङ्क्रमान् ।।6.61.35।।
output: पावके Pavaka (the son of fire god), गच्छ go, सर्वाणि all, सैन्यानि army, व्यूह्य organizing, लङ्काया Lanka, द्वाराणि gates, चर्याश्चापि highways, अथ and, सङ्क्रमान् bridges, आदाय getting together, तिष्ठ occupying.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
शैलशृङ्गाणिवृक्षांश्चशिलाश्चाप्युपसंहर । तिष्ठन्तुसायुधास्सर्वेसायुधाश्शैलपाणयः ।।6.61.36।।
output: "Be ready staying on mountain tops, trees, rocks armed with weapons and rocks in hand."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
राघवेणसमादिष्टोनीलोहरिचमूपतिः । शशासवानरानीकंयथावत्कपिकुञ्जरः ।।6.61.37।।
output: As instructed by Raghava, the monkey leader Nila, elephant among the monkeys, ordered the monkey troops as instructed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 61:
ततोगवाक्षश्शरभोहनूमानङ्गदस्तथा । शैलशृङ्गाणिशैलाभागृहीत्वाद्वारमभ्ययुः ।।6.61.38।।
output: Then taking mountains, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Hanuman, Angada who looked like mountains themselves marched to the gate.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामवाक्यमुपश्रुत्य हरयो जितकाशिनः । पादपैरर्दयवनीरावानराःपरवाहिनीम् ।।6.61.39।।
output: The monkeys desiring to be triumphant, took trees and began to strike at the enemies on hearing Rama's control.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोहरीणांतदनीकमुग्रंरराजशैलोद्यतदीप्तहस्तम् । गिरेःसमीपानुगतंयथैवहन्महाम्भोधरजालमुग्रम् ।।6.61.40।।
output: ततः then, शैलोद्यतदीप्तहस्तम् taking trees and rocks in their shining hand s, हरीणाम् the Vanaras, उग्रम् front, तत् that, गिरेः mountain, समीपानुगतम् close to each other, उग्रम् terrible, महत् huge, महाम्भोधरजालंयथैव like mass of clouds hanging, रराज seemed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तुराक्षसशार्दूलोनिद्रामदसमाकुलः । राजमार्गंश्रियाजुष्टंययौविपुलविक्रमः ।।6.62.1।।
output: विपुलविक्रमः of indomitable prowess, सः he, राक्षसशार्दूलः tiger among Rakshasas, निद्रामदसमाकुलः sleepy and inebriated, श्रिया prosperous, जुष्टम् splendid, राजमार्गम् royal path, ययौ marched.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसानांसहस्रैश्चवृतःपरमदुर्जयः । गृहेभ्यःपुष्पवर्षेणकीर्यमाणस्तदाययौ ।।6.62.2।।
output: तदा then, परमदुर्जयः very difficult to win, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, सहस्रैः violently, वृतः surrounded, गृहेभ्यः from the houses, पुष्पवर्षेण rain of flowers, कीर्यमाणः covered, ययौ went.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स हेमजालविततंभानुभास्वरदर्शनम् । ददर्शविपुलंरम्यंराक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् ।।6.62.3।।
output: He saw the vast abode of the king of Rakshasas, with lattice work of gold and looking bright like the morning Sun

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
स तत्तदासूर्यइवाभ्रजालंप्रविश्यरक्षोधिपतेर्निवेशम् । ददर्शदूरेऽग्रजमासनस्थंस्वयम्भुवंशक्रवासनस्थम् ।।6.62.4।।
output: He saw entering the abode of Lord of Rakshasas like the Sun penetrating into a mass of clouds, from a distance his elder brother seated on the throne just like Indra saw the SelfBorn Brahma on the throne.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
भ्रातुस्सभवनंगच्छन्रक्षोगणसमन्विम् । कुम्भकर्णःपदन्यासैरकम्पयतमेदिनीम् ।।6.62.5।।
output: While Kumbhakarna accompanied by troops of Rakshasas, was taking strides to his brother's abode, even the earth was shaken.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽभिगम्यगृहंभ्रातुःकक्ष्यामभिविगाह्य च । ददर्शोद्विगन्नमासीनंविमानेपुष्पकेगुरुम् ।।6.62.6।।
output: Having gone to his brother's residence, stepping into the enclosure, he saw his brother seated in a perturbed state.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथदृष्टवादशग्रीवःकुम्भकर्णमुपस्थितम् । तूर्णमुत्थायसंहृष्टःसन्निकर्षमुपानयत् ।।6.62.7।।
output: The ten headed Ravana seeing Kumbhakarna, was delighted and got up quickly and made him come close to him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथासीनस्यपर्यङ्केकुम्भकर्णोमहाबलः । भ्रातुर्ववन्देचरणौकिंकृत्यमितिचाब्रवीत् ।।6.62.8।।
output: अथ and then, महाबलः endowed with extraordinary might, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, पर्यङ्के getting up, आसीनस्य from his seat, भ्रातुः brother, चरणौ feet, ववन्दे clasped, किम् what, कृत्यम् task to do, इति च now, अब्रवीत् said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
उत्पत्यचैनंमुदितोरावणःपरिषस्वजे । स भ्रात्रासम्परिष्वक्तोयथावच्छाभिनन्दितः ।।6.62.9।। कुम्भकर्णश्शुभंदिव्यंप्रतिपेदेवरासनम् ।
output: Getting up from his seat Ravana embraced and greeted Kumbhakarna. So also, he duly rejoiced and occupied the seat.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
स तदासनमाश्रित्यकुम्भकर्णोमहाबलः ।।6.62.10।। संरक्तनयनःक्रोधाद्रावणंवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
output: Mighty Kumbhakarna, duly took the seat. Enraged Ravana with blood shot eyes spoke these words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
किमर्थमहमादृत्यत्वयाराजन्विबोधितः ।।6.62.11।। शंसकस्माद्भयंतेऽत्रकोऽद्यप्रेतोभविष्यति ।
output: "O King! For what purpose have I been awakened by you? Whom are you fearing? I wish to know who is to be ceased in life?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
भ्रातरंरावणःक्रुद्धंकुम्भकर्णमवस्थितम् ।।6.62.12।। ईषत्तुपरिवृत्ताभ्यांनेत्राभ्यांवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
output: Kumbhakarna, was overcome with anger, and asked his brother Ravana, who was seated and rolling his eyes in anger.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्यतेसुमहान्कालश्शयानस्यमहाबल ।।6.62.13।। सुखितस्त्वं न जानीषेममरामकृतंभयम् ।
output: "Oh! Kumbhakarna of extraordinary prowess! You were asleep for long happily. You do not know that I am afraid of Rama."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषदाशरथीरामःसुग्रीवसहितोबली ।।6.62.14।। समुद्रंसबलस्तीर्त्वामूलंनःपरिकृन्तति ।
output: दाशरथिः Dasarathi, बली strong, एषः he, रामः that Rama, सुग्रीवसहितः accompanied by Sugriva, समुद्रम् ocean, सबलम् with army, नःमूलम् at our roots, परिकृन्तति crossed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हन्तपश्यस्वलङ्कायावनान्युपवनानि च ।।6.62.15।। सेतुनासुखमागम्यवानरैकार्णवीकृतम् ।
output: हन्त alas, पश्यस्व you see, लङ्कायाः Lanka, वनानि groves, पवनानि च gardens, सेतुना bridge happily, आगम्य having come, वानरैकार्णवीम् Vanaras work, कृतम् done.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
येराक्षसामुख्यतमाहतास्तेवानरैर्युधि ।।6.62.16।। वानराणांक्षयंयुद्धे न पश्यामिकदाचन । नचापिवानरायुद्धेजितपूर्वाःकदाचन ।।6.62.17।।
output: "Of the Rakshasas, the chiefs have been killed in war by Vanaras. But I did not see even one Vanara to have been killed in war. Vanaras have not failed to succeed in war."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
येराक्षसामुख्यतमाहतास्तेवानरैर्युधि ।।6.62.16।। वानराणांक्षयंयुद्धे न पश्यामिकदाचन । नचापिवानरायुद्धेजितपूर्वाःकदाचन ।।6.62.17।।
output: मुख्यतमाः of the chief, येराक्षसाः the Rakshasas, ते to you, युधि in war, वानरैः Vanara, हताः killed, युद्धे in combat, वानराणाम् Vanaras, क्षयम् killed, कदाचन but even, न पश्यामि did not see, वानराः Vanaras, युद्धे in war, कदाचन even, जितपूर्वाः not failed to succeed, न चापि not seen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदेतद्भयमुत्पन्नंत्रायस्वेमांमहबल । नाशयत्वमिमानद्यतदर्थंबोधितोभवान् ।।6.62.18।।
output: "Mighty strong I am, but such is the fear that has been created in me from them. You have been awakened, to destroy them. Reported Ravana."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वक्षपितकोशं च स त्वमभ्यवपद्यमाम् । त्रायस्वेमांपुरींलङ्कांबालवृद्धावशेषिताम् ।।6.62.19।।
output: " All resources of mine are exhausted. These children and aged are only left in Lanka city, knowing that you will save the city of Lanka."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
भ्रातुरर्थेमहाबाहो कुरुकर्मसुदुष्करम् । मयैवंनोक्तपूर्वोहिकश्चिद्भ्रातः परन्तप ।।6.62.20।।
output: "O broad shouldered brother! Do this task which is difficult for others. O Scourge of enemies! I have not asked you before for such a task."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
त्वय्यस्तिममस्नेहःपरासम्भावना च मे । दैवासुरेषुयुद्धेषुबहुशोराक्षसर्षभ ।।6.62.21।। त्वयादेवाःप्रतिव्यूह्यनिर्जिताश्चासुरायुधि ।
output: "O Bull among Rakshasas! Being my brother, do this for me. I always have affection for you. Considering that you have encountered war with Devas and Asuras and won both Devas and Asuras, do this help."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदेतत्सर्वमातिष्ठवीर्यंभीमपराक्रम ।।6.62.22।। न हितेसर्वभूतेषुदृश्यतेसदृशोबली ।
output: भीमपराक्रमः of fierce valour, तत् that, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, वीर्यम् heroism, आतिष्ठ get up, सर्वभूतेषु among all beings, ते to you, सदृशः, बली stronger, न दृश्यतेहि not seen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 62:
कुरुष्वमेप्रियहितमेतदुत्तमंयथाप्रियंप्रियरणबान्धवप्रिय । स्वतेजसाविधमसपत्नवाहिनींशरद्घनंपवनइवोद्यतोमहान् ।।6.62.23।।
output: "You are a lover of wars. You are a lover of relations. You are always my dear well wisher. O self glorious one! Do this task of throwing out the torrent army just like wind throws rainy clouds." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यराक्षसराजस्यनिशम्यपरिदेवितम् । कुम्भकर्णोबभाषेदंवचनंप्रजहास च ।।6.63.1।।
output: तस्य his, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, परिदेवितम् lamentation, निशम्य hearing, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, इदंवचनम् these words, बभाषे replied, प्रजहास च laughing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
दृष्टोदोषोहियोऽस्माभिःपुरामन्त्रन्वििर्णये । हितेष्वनभियुक्तेनसोऽयमासादितस्त्वया ।।6.63.2।।
output: "While we were discussing earlier and taking decisions, that disaster foreseen by me has reaped for having not trusted the well wishers."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शीघ्रंखल्वभ्युपेतंत्वांफलंपापस्यकर्मणः । निरयेष्वेवपतनंयथादुष्कृतकर्मणः ।।6.63.3।।
output: दुष्कृतकर्मणः those who do sinful deeds, निरयेषु unobstructed, पतनमेव fall down, यथा so also, पापस्य by the sinful, कर्मणः action, फलम् fruit, त्वाम् you, शीघ्रम् quickly, उपेतंखलु come upon you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
प्रथमंवैमहाराजकृत्यमेतदचिन्तितम् । केवलंवीर्यदर्पेणनानुबन्धोविचिन्तितः ।।6.63.4।।
output: "O king! All this action was not thought of at the beginning, nor the consequences of action weighed in the pride of your prowess."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यःपश्चातूर्वकार्याणिकुर्यादैश्वर्यमास्थितः । पूर्वंचोत्तरकार्याणि न स वेदनयानया ।।6.63.5।।
output: "Confident of prosperity, he who defers action earlier, he does not know what is right and wrong later on."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देशकालविहीनानिकर्माणिविपरीतवत् । क्रियमाणानिदुष्यन्तिहवींष्यप्रयतेष्विव ।।6.63.6।।
output: " Actions performed without regard for time and place will be disastrous like the oblations offered into fire without consecration, gets wasted."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्रयाणांपञ्चधायोगंकर्मणांयःप्रपश्यति । सचिवैस्समयंकृत्वा स सभ्येवर्ततेपथि ।।6.63.7।।
output: He who thinks with ministers and considers the five aspects of threefold duties and moves in the right path performs (Five aspects of action are the method of initiating action, material to be worked upon, time and place of action, provision against mischance and the chances of success). Threefold duties with reference to enemies are Sama, Daana, and Bedha."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथागमं च योराजासमयंविचिकीर्षति । बुध्यतेसचिवान्बध्यासुहृदश्चानुपश्यति ।।6.63.8।।
output: "The king who does his duty in time in accordance with justice and thinking intelligently with his ministers, understands rightly."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धर्ममर्थं च कामं च सर्वान्वारक्षसांपते । भजतेपुरुषःकालेत्रीणिद्वन्द्वानिवापुनः ।।6.63.9।।
output: "O Rakshasa king! A man should pursue his duty or worldly gain or sensual pleasures all the three combined or at least any two in time (the scriptures lay down that duty should be pursued in the morning, wealth in the afternoon and sensual pleasures at night)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्रिषुचैतेषुयच्छ्रेष्ठंश्रुत्वातन्नावबुध्यते । राजावाराजमात्रोवाव्यर्थंतस्यबहुश्रुतम् ।।6.63.10।।
output: " A sovereign king or a king hearing these three does not recognize the best of the three is in vain even though he heard many."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपप्रदानंसान्त्वं च भेदंकाले च विक्रमम् । योगं च रक्षसांश्रेष्ठतावुभौ च नयानयौ ।।6.63.11।। कालेधर्मार्थकामान्यस्सम्मन्त्ऱ्यसचिवैःसह । निषेवेतात्मवान्लोके न स व्यसनमाप्नुयात् ।।6.63.12।।
output: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठ foremost, यः you are, उपप्रदानम् gifting, सान्त्वं च conciliation, भेदं च dissension, उभौ both, तौ together, नयानयौ at the appropriate time, काले right time, धर्मार्थकामान् virtue, wealth and sensual pleasures, सचिवैःसह with ministers, सम्मन्त्ऱ्य discussing, निषेवेत resorts to, आत्मवान् self, सः he, व्यसनम् sorrow, नाप्नुयात् not meet.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपप्रदानंसान्त्वं च भेदंकाले च विक्रमम् । योगं च रक्षसांश्रेष्ठतावुभौ च नयानयौ ।।6.63.11।। कालेधर्मार्थकामान्यस्सम्मन्त्ऱ्यसचिवैःसह । निषेवेतात्मवान्लोके न स व्यसनमाप्नुयात् ।।6.63.12।।
output: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठ foremost, यः you are, उपप्रदानम् gifting, सान्त्वं च conciliation, भेदं च dissension, उभौ both, तौ together, नयानयौ at the appropriate time, काले right time, धर्मार्थकामान् virtue, wealth and sensual pleasures, सचिवैःसह with ministers, सम्मन्त्ऱ्य discussing, निषेवेत resorts to, आत्मवान् self, सः he, व्यसनम् sorrow, नाप्नुयात् not meet.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हितानुबन्धमालोच्यकार्यात्कार्यमिहात्मनः । राजासहार्थतत्त्वज्ञैस्सचिवैर्बुस्सहिजीवति ।।6.63.13।।
output: राजा king, अर्थतत्त्वज्ञैः reality of things, सचिवैःसहि with ministers, आत्मनः himself, हितानुबन्धम् What is beneficial, आलोक्य thinking well, इह here, कार्यम् action, कार्यात् by their action, जीवति living.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अनभिज्ञायशास्त्रार्थान् पुरुषाःपशुबुद्धयः । प्रागल्भ्याद्वक्तुमिच्छन्तिमन्त्रेष्वभ्यन्तरीकृताः ।।6.63.14।।
output: मन्त्रेषु with ministers, अभ्यन्तरीकृताः being included in to express their views, पशुबुद्धयः those who have the intelligence level of animals, पुरुषाः men, शास्त्रार्थान् meaning of shastras, अनभिज्ञाय not knowing, प्रागल्भ्यात् impudence, वक्तुम् expressing, इच्छन्ति desire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
अशास्त्रविदुषांतेषां न कार्यमभिहितंवचः । अर्थशास्त्रानभिज्ञानांविपुलांश्रियमिच्छताम् ।।6.63.15।।
output: "Those who have no knowledge of shastras are ignorant of the science of wealth and desire huge wealth. Their advice ought not to be followed."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
अहितं च हिताकारंधार्ष्ट्याज्जल्पन्तियेनराः । अवेक्ष्यमन्त्रबाह्यास्तेकर्तव्याःकृत्यदूषणा:।। 6.63.16।।
output: "Those who tender advice, which is unwholesome but in wholesome grab, out of their impudence should be kept away from discussion examining early as they mar the purpose."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विनाशयन्तोभर्तारंसहिताश्शत्रुभिर्बुधैः । विपरीतानिकृत्यानिकारयन्तीहमन्त्रिणः ।।6.63.17।।
output: "Some ministers in order to ruin the king, collide with enemies and make the king take wrong actions."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
तान्भर्तामित्रसङ्काशानमित्रान्मन्त्रनिर्णये । व्यवहारेणजानीयात्सचिवानुपसम्हितान् ।।6.63.18।।
output: " A ruler should know those ministers bribed by the enemy, who have become close to the enemy and appear as friends. Those ministers must be known through their behaviour in the deliberations."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
चपलस्येहकृत्यानिसहसानुप्रधावतः । छिद्रमन्येप्रपद्यन्तेक्रौञ्चस्य ख मिवद्विजाः ।।6.63.19।।
output: "Enemies find out the weakness of the king who is unsteady and rush after the actions forcibly without thinking like brahmins just as birds find the holes in Krauncha mountain and elaborate to others."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
योहिशत्रुमवज्ञायनात्मानमभिरक्षति । अवाप्नोतिहिसोऽनर्थान् स्थानाच्चव्यवरोप्यते ।।6.63.20।।
output: यः he who, शत्रुम् enemy, अवज्ञाय knowing fully, आत्मानम् himself, नाभिरक्षति does not protect himself, सः he, अनर्थान् reverses, अवाप्नोतिहि attains, स्थानात् from position, व्यवरोप्यते च is dragged

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
यदुक्तमिहतेपूर्वंक्रियतामनुजेन च । तदेवनोहितंवाक्यंयदिच्छसि च तत्कुरु ।।6.63.21।।
output: "The advice given to you in the past by your brother alone is good. That is good for you. Or you may do what you wish."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्तुश्रुत्वादशग्रीवःकुम्भकर्णस्यभाषितम् । भ्रुकुटिंचैवसञ्चक्रेक्रुद्धश्चैनमभाषत ।।6.63.22।।
output: Kumbhakarna having spoken that way, the ten headed Ravana frowned, shaking his eyebrows in anger and spoke this way.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मान्योगुरुवारिचार्यःकिमांत्वमनुशाससि । किमेवंवाक्छ्रमंकृत्वाकालेयुक्तंविधीयताम् ।।6.63.23।।
output: मान्यः worthy of respect, गुरुः father, आचार्यःइव like teacher, त्वम् you, माम् me, किम् why, अनुशाससे instruct, एवम् in that way, वाक्छ्रमम् cleverness in speaking, कृत्वा doing, किम् why, काले time, युक्तम् is appropriate, विधीयताम् follow.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विभ्रमाच्चित्तमोहाद्वाबलवीर्याश्रयेणवा । नाभिपन्नमिदानींयद्व्यर्थातस्यपुनःकथाः ।।6.63.24।।
output: विभ्रमात् due to delusion, चित्तमोहाद्वा lack of understanding, बलवीर्यश्रयेणवा or due to pride of strength, यत् that, नाभिपन्नम् did something, तस्य that, इदानीम् now to talk of it, पुःकथाः again the same story, व्यर्था is futile

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अस्मिन्कालेतुयद्युक्तंतदिदानींविधीयताम् । गतंतुनानुशोचन्तिगतंतुगतमेवहि ।।6.63.25।।
output: "You may speak of only what is proper to do now. Do not think of the past as it is gone."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ममापनयजंदोषंविक्रमेणसमीकुरु । यदिखल्वस्तिमेस्नेहोविक्रमंवाऽवगच्छसि ।।6.63.26।। यदिवकार्यंमेतत्तेहृदिकार्यतमंमतम् ।
output: "If at all there is any affection in you for me now, you recognize your strengths and think what action is justified in your heart. You may nullify the evil that sprung from my heart."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
स सुहृद्योविपन्नार्थंदीनमभ्यवपद्यते ।।6.63.27।। स बन्धुर्योऽपनीतेषुसाहाय्यायोपकल्पते ।
output: " A friend is one who helps when one's fortune is lost and is desperate. Deviating from morals the one who is prepared to help is a relation."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमथैवंब्रुवाणंतुवचनंधीरदारुणम् ।।6.63.28।। रुष्टोऽयमितिविज्ञायशनैश्श्लक्षणमुवाच ह ।
output: Thereafter knowing that Ravana is agitated and arguing in a grave and harsh manner, Kumbhakarna, spoke slowly in a gentle tone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
अतीवहिसमालक्ष्यभ्रातरंक्षुभितेन्द्रियम् ।।6.63.29।। कुम्भकर्णश्शनैर्वाक्यंबभाषेपरिसान्त्वयन् ।
output: Sensing that Ravana is disturbed very much, Kumbhakarna taking hold of the brother and consoling him slowly said these words.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शृणुराजन्नवहितोममवाक्यमरिन्दम ।।6.63.30।। अलंराक्षसराजेन्द्र सन्तापमुपपद्यते । रोषं च सम्परित्यज्यस्वस्थोभवितुमर्हसि ।।6.63.31।।
output: "Listen to my words, Rakshasa king! You are a scourge of enemies. Put aside this sorrow. Give up the agony also. Be normal. You ought to be your normal self again."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
शृणुराजन्नवहितोममवाक्यमरिन्दम ।।6.63.30।। अलंराक्षसराजेन्द्र सन्तापमुपपद्यते । रोषं च सम्परित्यज्यस्वस्थोभवितुमर्हसि ।।6.63.31।।
output: "Listen to my words, Rakshasa king! You are a scourge of enemies. Put aside this sorrow. Give up the agony also. Be normal. You ought to be your normal self again."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नैतन्मनसिकर्तव्यंमयिजीवतिपार्थिव । तमहंनाशयिष्यामियत्कृतेपरितप्यते ।।6.63.32।।
output: "While I am (my body is) with life you need not entertain despondency. I will exterminate him, by whose account you are agitated."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
अवश्यंतुहितंवाच्यंसर्वावस्थांतवमया । बन्धुभावादभिहितंभ्रातृस्नेहाच्छपार्थिव ।।6.63.33।।
output: "O king! I will give you good advice in all circumstances being a relation. Salutary advice has been given to you out of brotherly affection."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
सदृशंयत्तुकालेऽस्मिन् कर्तुंस्निग्धेनबन्धुना । शत्रूणांकदनंपश्यक्रियमाणंमयारणे ।।6.63.34।।
output: " At this time, you will see a relation doing that which is right out of affection. All enemies will be destroyed."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्यपश्यमहाबाहो मयासमरमूर्धनि । हतेरामेसहभ्रात्राद्रवन्तींहरिवाहिनीम् ।।6.63.35।।
output: "O mighty armed King! You see Rama along with his brother being killed by me and Vanaras fleeing away from the forefront of war."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
अद्यरामस्यतद्दृष्टवामयानीतंरणाच्छिरः । सुखीभवमहाबाहो सीताभवतुदुःखिता ।।6.63.36।।
output: "Be happy today, O Mighty armed brother! I will bring Rama's head from the battlefield. Sita will be sad. You will see."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अद्यरामस्यपश्यन्तुनिधनंसुमहत्प्रियम् । लङ्कायांराक्षसाःसर्वेयेतेनिहतबान्धवाः ।।6.63.37।।
output: लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, ये those, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, निहतबान्धवाः relations killed, तेसर्वे all of them, अद्य now, रामस्य Rama's, सुमहत्प्रियम् very welcome, निधनम् death, पश्यन्तु witness.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
अद्यशोकपरीतानांस्वबन्धुवधकारणात् । शत्रोर्युधिविनाशेनकरोम्यस्रप्रमार्जनम् ।।6.63.38।।
output: Now I will wipe the tears of Rakshasas who lost their kin and are bewailing their loss.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अद्यपर्वतसङ्काशंससूर्यमिवतोयदम् । विकीर्णंपश्यसमरेसुग्रीवंप्लवगोत्तम ।।6.63.39।।
output: अद्य now, समरे in war, प्रकीर्णम् of mountain shape, पर्वतसङ्काशम् resembling mountain, ससूर्यम् illumined by evening Sun, तोयदम् इव like a cloud water, प्लवगोत्तम foremost of the monkeys, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, पश्य see.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कथं च राक्षसैरेभिर्मया च परिरक्षितः । जिघांसुभिर्दाशरथिं वध्यसे त्वमिहानघ ।।6.63.40।।
output: "O Sinless Ravana! As I am going to kill this son of Dasaratha whom Rakshasas are intending to kill, how can Rama kill you now?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
मांनिहत्यकिलत्वांहिनिहनिष्यतिराघवः । नाहमात्मनिसन्तापंगच्छेयंराक्षसाधिप ।।6.63.41।।
output: "Rakshasa king! Raghava will kill you only after killing me. Never give way for distress."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कामंवतिदानीमपिमांव्यादिशत्वंपरन्तप । न परःप्रेषणीयस्तेयुद्धायातुलविक्रम ।।6.63.42।।
output: "Command me to wage war at this moment, O Scorcher of enemies. There is no one better than me to be sought for O hero endowed with extraordinary strength."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहमुत्सादयिष्यामिशत्रूंस्तवमहाबल: । यदिशक्रोयदियमोयदिपावकमारुतौ ।।6.63.43।। तानहंयोधयिष्यामिकुबेरवरुणावपि ।
output: "I shall exterminate your enemies, however mighty they may be. I can contend with Indra or fire god or Yama or wind god, Kubera or even Varuna."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गिरिमात्रशरीरस्यशितशूलधरस्यमे ।।6.63.44।। नर्दतस्तीक्षणदंष्ट्रस्यबिभीयाच्चपुरन्दरः ।
output: गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य body as big as a mountain, शितशूरधरस्य with spike like pointed teeth, तीक्षणदंष्ट्रस्य sharp too the d, नर्दतः roar, मे my, पुरन्दरः Indra, भिभीयात् च will run out of fear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथवात्यक्तशस्त्रस्यमृद्नतस्तरसारिपून् ।।6.63.45।। न मेप्रतिमुखेस्थातुंकश्चित् शक्तोजिजीविषुः ।
output: अथवा or else, त्यक्तशस्त्रस्य giving up weapons, तरसा crush, रिपून् enemy, मृद्नतः with swords and shafts, मे I, जिजीविषुः with arms, कश्चित् indeed, प्रतिमुखे opposite to me, स्थातुम् to stand, न शक्तः not possible.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
नैवशक्त्या न गदयानासिनानिशितैश्शरैः ।।6.63.46।। हस्ताभ्यामेवसम्रब्दोहनिष्याम्यपिवज्रिणम् ।
output: "I shall not fight with javelin or mace or sword or sharp arrows. Enraged, alone I can strike down even Indra."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
यदिमेमुष्टिवेगं स राघवोऽद्यसहिष्यते ।।6.63.47।। ततःपाश्यन्तिबाणौघारुधिरंराघवस्यतु ।
output: "Now if that Raghava can withstand the force of my fists, you will see volleys of Rama's arrows will drink my blood."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चिन्तयाबाध्यसेराजन्किमर्थंमयितिष्ठति ।।6.63.48।। सोऽहंशत्रुविनाशाय तव निर्यातुमुद्यतः ।
output: राजन् king, मयि I am, तिष्ठति here, किमर्थम् for what purpose, चिन्तया worry, बाध्यसे anxiety, सः he, अहम् I, तव your, शत्रुविनाशाय will destroy your enemy, निर्यातुम् decidedly, उद्यतः going now.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मुञ्चरामाद्भयंराज न्हनिष्यामीहसम्युगे ।।6.63.49।। राघवंलक्ष्मणंचैवसुग्रीवं च महाबलम् । हनूमन्तं च रक्षोघ्नंलङ्कायेनप्रदीपिता ।।6.63.50।।
output: राजन् king, भयम् fear, मुञ्च give up, इह here, सम्युगे battlefield, राघवम् Rama, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, महाबलम् mighty, सुग्रीवं च Sugriva also, येन our, लङ्का Lanka, प्रदीपिता who set fire, रक्षोघ्नम् many Rakshasas, हनूमन्तं च Hanuman also, निहनिष्यामि dispose of.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 63:
मुञ्चरामाद्भयंराज न्हनिष्यामीहसम्युगे ।।6.63.49।। राघवंलक्ष्मणंचैवसुग्रीवं च महाबलम् । हनूमन्तं च रक्षोघ्नंलङ्कायेनप्रदीपिता ।।6.63.50।।
output: "O King! Give up the fear, as both Rama and Lakshmana will be made short of work in the battlefield, as also mighty Sugriva and dispose of Hanuman, the destroyer of many Rakshasas and who set fire to Lanka."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
