output: The great monkey hit by the fist (of Trisira) became furious and in anger he got hold of Trisira's head with crown.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तस्यशीर्षाण्यसिनाशितेनकिरीटजुष्टानिसकुण्डलानि । क्रुद्धःप्रचिच्छेदसुतोऽनिलस्यत्वष्टुस्सुतस्येवशिरांसिशक्रः ।।6.70.47।।
output: क्रुद्धः enraged, सः he, अनिलस्यसुतः wind god's son, तस्य his, कीरीटजुष्टानि along with crown, सकुण्डलानि and earrings, शीर्षाणि three heads (of Vishwarupa), शक्रः Indra, त्वष्टुः Twashsta's, सुतस्य son's, शिरांसिइव three heads like that, शितेन sharp, असिना cut off, प्रचिच्छेद severed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तान्यायताक्षाण्यगसन्निभानिप्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि । पेतुशिरांसीन्द्ररिपोःर्धरण्यांज्योतींषिमुक्तानियथार्कमार्गात् ।।6.70.48।।
output: आयताक्षाणि incongruous eyes, अगसन्निभानि resembling mountains, प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि glowing like Vyshvanara's eyes, इन्द्ररिपोः Indra's enemy, तानिशिरांसि those heads, अर्कमार्गात् from the path of the Sun, मुक्तानि like pearls, ज्योतींषियथा like stars, अरण्याम् wilderness, पेतुः fallen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मिन् न्हतेदेवरिपौत्रिशीर्षेहनूमताशक्रपराक्रमेण । नेदुःप्लवंगाःप्रचचालभूमीरक्षांस्यथोदुद्रुविरेसमन्तात् ।।6.70.49।।
output: देवरिपौ enemy of gods, तस्मिन् his, त्रिशीर्षे Trisira's, शक्रपराक्रमेण endowed with the prowess of Indra, हनूमता Hanuman, हते killed, प्लवंगाः monkeys, नेदुः roared, भूमिः earth, प्रचचाल shook, अथो and, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, समन्तात् in all sides, दुद्रुविरे took to their heels.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हतंत्रिशिरसंदृष्टवातथैवचमहोदरं । हतौप्रेक्षयदुराधर्षौदेवान्तकनरान्तकौ ।।6.70.50।। चुकोपपरमामर्षीमत्तोराक्षसपुङ्गवः ।
output: त्रिशिरसं Trisira, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा witnessing, अथापि च earlier, महोदरम् Mahodara, दुराधर्षौ difficult to encounter, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka, हतौ killed, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, परमामर्षी roared in joy, राक्षसपुङ्गवः Rakshasa leaders, मत्तः Matta, चुकोप very angry.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जग्राहार्चिष्मतींघोरांगदांसर्वायसींशुभां ।।6.70.51।। हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तांमांसशोणितफेनिलाम् । विराजमानांवपुषांशत्रुशोणितरंजिताम् ।।6.70.52।। तेजसासंप्रदीप्ताग्रांरक्तमाल्यविभूषिताम् । ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् ।।6.70.53।।
output: शुभाम् good, अर्चिष्मतीम् venerable, सर्वायसीम् all powerful, हेमपरिक्षिप्ताम् plated with gold, मांसशोणितफेनिलाम् smeared with flesh and blood, विराजमानाम् shining with lustre, वपुषाम् by enemy's, शत्रुशोणितरंजिताम् shining in red colour with enemy's blood, तेजसा effulgent, संप्रदीप्ताग्राम् whose head has been glowing, रक्तमाल्यविभूषिताम् decorated with red flower garland s, ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् brought terror to Airavata, Mahapadma and Sarvabhauma (three of the four elephants guarding the quarters), गदाम् mace, जग्राह seized hold of.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जग्राहार्चिष्मतींघोरांगदांसर्वायसींशुभां ।।6.70.51।। हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तांमांसशोणितफेनिलाम् । विराजमानांवपुषांशत्रुशोणितरंजिताम् ।।6.70.52।। तेजसासंप्रदीप्ताग्रांरक्तमाल्यविभूषिताम् । ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् ।।6.70.53।।
output: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 70:
जग्राहार्चिष्मतींघोरांगदांसर्वायसींशुभां ।।6.70.51।। हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तांमांसशोणितफेनिलाम् । विराजमानांवपुषांशत्रुशोणितरंजिताम् ।।6.70.52।। तेजसासंप्रदीप्ताग्रांरक्तमाल्यविभूषिताम् । ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् ।।6.70.53।।
output: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गदामादायसङ्कृद्धोमत्तोराक्षसपुङ्गवः । हरीन् समभिदुद्रावयुगान्तानगिरिवज्वलन् ।।6.70.54।।
output: Matta, the Rakshasa leader became very furious and took hold of the mace glowing like fire, at the time of dissolution of the universe and scattered the monkeys.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथर्षभस्समुत्पत्यवानरोरावणानुजम् । मत्तानीकमुपागम्यतस्थौतस्याग्रतोबली ।।6.70.55।।
output: Rshaba, the bull among Vanaras endowed with prowess, springing up came and stood in front of Mahaparsva.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 70:
तंपुरस्तात् स्थितंदृष्टवावानरंपर्वतोपमम् । आजघानोरसिक्रुद्धोगदयावज्रकल्पया ।।6.70.56।।
output: Again, seeing Rshaba standing in front like a mountain, enraged Mahaparsva hit him on the chest with the mace that was like a thunderbolt.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 70:
स तयाऽभिहतस्तेनगदयावानरर्षभः । भिन्नवक्षास्समाधूतस्सुस्रावरुधिरंबहु ।।6.70.57।।
output: Hit in that way by the mace, Rshaba, bull of Vanaras, with chest broken, blood flowed excessively.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स संज्ञांप्राप्यसुचिरादृषभोवानरर्षभः । क्रुद्धोविस्फुरमाणौष्ठोमहापार्श्वमुदैक्षत ।।6.70.58।।
output: वानरेश्वरा Vanara chief, सःऋषभः that Rshaba, चिरात् after long time संज्ञाम् consciousness, प्राप्य regained, क्रुद्धः angered, विस्फुरमाणौष्ठः lips quivering, महापार्श्वम् to Mahaparsva, उदैक्षत ran.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 70:
स वेगवान् वेगवदभ्युपेत्यतंराक्षसंवानरवीरमुख्यः । सम्वर्त्यमुष्टिंसहसाजघानबाह्वन्तरेशैलनिकाशरूपः ।।6.70.59।।
output: The chief of the Vanaras, whose form was like a mountain, endowed with speed, got up quickly, duly, and forcibly hit the Rakshasa (Mahaparsva) in the space between his arms.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 70:
स कृत्तमूलस्सहसेववृक्षःक्षितौपपातक्षतजोक्षिताङ्गः । तांचास्यघोरांयमदण्डकल्पांगदांप्रगृह्याशुतदाननाद ।।6.70.60।।
output: Like a tree whose roots have been severed, the Rakshasa fell on the ground. Then seizing forcibly, the dreadful mace that resembled the rod of Lord of death he roared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मुहूर्तमासीत्सगतासुकल्पःप्रत्यागतात्मासहसासुरारिः । उत्पत्यसन्ध्याभ्रसमानवर्णस्तंवारिराजात्मजमाजघान ।।6.70.61।।
output: सः he, मुहूर्तम् for a short while, गतासुकल्पः life gone like, आसीत् seated, सहसा suddenly, सन्ध्याभ्रसमानवर्णः of the colour of evening sun, सुरारिः enemy of gods, प्रत्यागतात्मा life having restored, उत्पत्य got up, तम् him, वारिराजात्मजम् son of waters, आजघान struck.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 70:
स मूर्भितोभूमितलेपपातमुहूर्तमुत्पत्यपुनस्ससंज्ञः । तामेवतस्याद्रिवराद्रिकल्पांगदांसमाविध्यजघानसङ्ख्ये ।।6.70.62।।
output: The monkey was unconscious for a while having fallen on the ground. Regaining senses, overcoming, took up the mace which looked like the rock of a foremost mountain and struck him (Mahaparsva) on the battlefield.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 70:
सातस्यरौद्रासमुपेत्यदेहंरौद्रस्यदेवाध्वरविप्रशत्रोः । बिभेदवक्षःक्षतजं च भूरिसुस्रावधात्वम्भइवाद्रिराजः ।।6.70.63।।
output: He (Rshaba) reached the body of the ferocious enemy of gods and brahmins. He split his chest with his mace and the timid Rakshasa shed blood just as Himalaya Mountain discharges water.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 70:
अभिदुद्राववेगेनगदांतस्यमहात्मनः । गृहीत्वातांगदांभीमामाविध्य च पुनःपुनः ।।6.70.64।। मत्तानीकंमहात्मानंजघानरणमूर्धनि ।
output: The great Rakshasa Mahaparsva went towards the mace held by Rshaba, the great soul. Taking hold of the mace, Rshaba struck the Rakshasa again and again and pierced him in the forefront of the battlefield.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स स्वयागदयाभग्नोविदीर्णदशनेक्षणः ।।6.70.65।। निपपातततोमत्तोवज्राहतइवाचलः ।
output: स्वया his own, गदया mace, भग्नः shattered by, सः he, मत्तः Matta विशीर्णदशनेक्षणः whose eyes had been crushed, तदा then, वज्राहतः struck by lightning, अचलःइव like a mountain, निपपात fallen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विदीर्णनयनेभूमौगतसत्त्वेगतायुषि ।।6.70.66।। पतितेराक्षसेतस्मिन् विद्रुतंराक्षसंबलम् ।
output: गतसत्त्वे strength gone, गतायुषि life ceased, विदीर्णनयने eyes crushed, तस्मिन् राक्षसे his Rakshasas, भूमौ ground, पतिते fallen, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, बलम् army, विद्रुतम् ran in fear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वबलंव्यथितंदृष्टवातुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् । भ्रातृ़ंश्चनिहतान् दृष्टवाशक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् ।।6.71.1।। पितृव्यौचापिसनृदृश्यसमरेसन्निघादितौ । युद्धोन्मत्तं च मत्तं च भ्रातरौराक्षसर्षभौ ।।6.71.2।। चुकोप च महातेजाब्रह्मदत्तवरोयुधि । अतिकायोऽद्रिसङ्काशोदेवदानवदर्पहा ।।6.71.3।।
output: महातेजाः highly energetic, ब्रह्मदत्तवरः who had obtained boons from Brahma, अद्रिसङ्काशः mountain like form, युधि in battle, देवदानवदर्पहा who subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, अतिकायः of huge body, तुमुलम् making a tumultuous sound, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, स्वबलम् his own army, व्यथितम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् equal to Indra in valour, भ्रातृ़न् च brothers, निहतान् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, पितृव्वौ uncles, राक्षसर्षभौ bulls among Rakshasas, भ्रातरौ brothers, युद्धोन्मतं च Yuddhomatta, मत्तं च Matta, समरे in conflict, सन्निघादितौ collected together, सन्द्दृश्य seeing, चुकोप च was furious.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
स्वबलंव्यथितंदृष्टवातुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् । भ्रातृ़ंश्चनिहतान् दृष्टवाशक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् ।।6.71.1।। पितृव्यौचापिसनृदृश्यसमरेसन्निघादितौ । युद्धोन्मत्तं च मत्तं च भ्रातरौराक्षसर्षभौ ।।6.71.2।। चुकोप च महातेजाब्रह्मदत्तवरोयुधि । अतिकायोऽद्रिसङ्काशोदेवदानवदर्पहा ।।6.71.3।।
output: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वबलंव्यथितंदृष्टवातुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् । भ्रातृ़ंश्चनिहतान् दृष्टवाशक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् ।।6.71.1।। पितृव्यौचापिसनृदृश्यसमरेसन्निघादितौ । युद्धोन्मत्तं च मत्तं च भ्रातरौराक्षसर्षभौ ।।6.71.2।। चुकोप च महातेजाब्रह्मदत्तवरोयुधि । अतिकायोऽद्रिसङ्काशोदेवदानवदर्पहा ।।6.71.3।।
output: Atikaya, son of Dhanyamalini, arrives on the battlefield. Vanaras and Rama wondered at his form, chariot, and brilliance. Lakshmana has a terrific fight with Atikaya and kills him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
स भास्करसहस्रस्यसङ्घातमिवभास्वरम् । रथमास्थायशक्रारिरभिदुद्राववानरान् ।।6.71.4।।
output: Adorned with a crown, Ravana glowing like a thousand suns collected together mounted the chariot and darted towards Vanaras.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स विस्फार्यमहाचापंकिरीटीमृष्टकुण्डलः । नामविश्रावयामासननाद च महास्वनम् ।।6.71.5।।
output: किरीटी adorned with crown, मृष्टकुण्डलः polished earrings, सः he, महा great, चापम् bow, विस्फार्य twanging,नाम name, विश्रावयामास proclaimed, महास्वनम् sounding aloud, ननाद च roared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तेनसिंहप्रणादेननामविश्रावणेन च । ज्याशब्देन च भीमेनत्रासयामासवानरान् ।।6.71.6।।
output: By that lionroar, and proclamation of his name (by the sound of the twang) frightening the Vanaras he struck terror.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तेदृष्टवादेहमाहात्म्यंकुम्भकर्णोऽयमुथतितः । भयार्तावानरास्सर्वेसंश्रयन्तेपरस्परम् ।।6.71.7।।
output: Those Vanaras seeing the huge body thought, "This is Kumbhakarna, who has got up and come'. Out of fear, they sought the help of one another.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेतस्यरूपमालोक्ययथाविष्टोस्त्रिविक्रमे । भयाद्वानरयूधास्तेविद्रवन्तिततस्ततः ।।6.71.8।।
output: ते they, वानरयूधाः Vanara troops, त्रिविक्रमे Trivikrama form assumed, विष्णोःयथा by Vishnu, तस्य his, रूपम् form, आलोक्य observing, भयात् in panic, ततस्ततः here and there, विद्रवन्ति fled in panic.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेऽतिकायंसमासाद्यवानरामूढचेतसः । शरण्यंशरणंजग्मुर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजमाहवे ।।6.71.9।।
output: तेवानराः those Vanaras, अतिकायम् huge body, समासाद्य reaching, मूढचेतसः deluded, आहवे sought, शरण्यम् refuge, लक्ष्मणाग्रजम् brother of Lakshmana, जग्मुः went.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तोऽतिकायंकाकुत्स्थोरथस्थंपर्वतोपमम् । ददर्शधवनिनंदूराद्गर्जन्तंकालमेघवत् ।।6.71.10।।
output: ततः then, काकुत्थ्सः Kakutstha, रथस्थम् on the chariot, पर्वतोपमम् looking like mountain, धवनिन wielding bow, कालमेघवत् rumbling like cloud at the time of universal destruction, गर्जन्तम् roaring, अतिकायम् huge body, दूरात् from a distance, ददर्श saw.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तंदृष्टवामहात्मानंराघवस्तुविसिस्मिये । वानरान् सान्त्वयित्वा च विभीषणमुवाच ह ।।6.71.11।।
output: सः he, राघवस्तु Raghava, महात्मानं great self, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, विसिस्मिये. amazed, वानरान् Vanaras, सान्त्वयित्वा च reassuring, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, उवाच ह spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कोऽसौपर्वतसङ्काशोधनुष्मान्हरिलोचनः । युक्तेहयसहस्रेणविशालेस्यन्दनेस्थितः ।।6.71.12।।
output: "Who is he, the yelloweyed, resembling a mountain, seated in the broad chariot drawn by a thousand horses?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
य एषनिशितैश्शूलैस्सुतीक्णैःप्रासमुद्गरैः । अर्चिष्मद्भिर्वृतोभातिभूतैरिवमहेश्वरः ।।6.71.13।।
output: "Who is he in the midst, with sharp tridents and shining spears, like Maheswara surrounded by beings?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कालजिह्वाप्रकाशाभिर्यएषोऽतिविराजते । आवृतोरथशक्तीभिर्विद्युद्भिरिवतोयदः ।।6.71.14।।
output: यः he who, एषः in that way, कालजिह्वाप्रकाशाभिः gleaming like the tongues of Kala, रथशक्तीभिः with flashes of javelins, आवृतः encircled, विद्युद्भिः lightning, तोयदःइव like a cloud, अतिविराजते shining very bright.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धनूंषिचास्यसज्जानिहेमपृष्ठानिसर्वशः । शोभयन्तिरथश्रेष्ठंशक्रचापमिवाम्बरम् ।।6.71.15।।
output: सज्जानि all bows, हेमपृष्ठानि with golden backs, धनूंषि च bows, अस्य his, रथश्रेष्ठम् excellent chariot, शक्रचापम् rainbow, अम्बरम् इव in the sky like, सर्वशः all sides, शोभयन्ति beautiful.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क एषरक्षश्शार्दूलोरणभूमिविराजयन् । अभ्येतिरथिनांश्रेष्ठोरथेनादित्यतेजसा ।।6.71.16।। ध्वजशृङ्गप्रतिष्ठेनराहुणाभिविराजते । सूर्यरमशिनिभैर्बाणैर्दिशो दश विराजयन् ।।6.71.17।।
output: "The tiger among the Rakshasas seated in the chariot is the foremost car warrior. He is illuminating the battlefield like the brightness of the Sun, resplendent like Sun 's rays. By his arrows he is illuminating the ten directions. The Rahu emblem on top of the pole of the chariot is very splendid."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क एषरक्षश्शार्दूलोरणभूमिविराजयन् । अभ्येतिरथिनांश्रेष्ठोरथेनादित्यतेजसा ।।6.71.16।। ध्वजशृङ्गप्रतिष्ठेनराहुणाभिविराजते । सूर्यरमशिनिभैर्बाणैर्दिशो दश विराजयन् ।।6.71.17।।
output: कः he, रक्षश्शार्दूलः tiger among Rakshasas, रथिनाम् on the chariot, श्रेष्ठः foremost, एषः in that way, रणभूमिम् battlefield, विराजयन् illuminating, आदित्यतेजसा like the brightness of the Sun, रथेन on chariot, अभ्येति coming, सूर्यरमशिनभैः resplendent like Sun 's rays, बाणैः by arrows, दश ten, दिशः directions, विराजयन् illuminating, ध्वजशृङ्घप्रतिष्ठेन on top of the pole of the chariot, राहुणा by the Rahu, अभिविराजते very splendid.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
त्रिणतंमेघसन्नादंहेमपृष्ठमलङ्कृतम् । शतक्रतुधनुःप्रख्यंधनुश्चास्यविराजते ।।6.71.18।।
output: "His bow with three curves, covered with gold, decorated, is close to a thundering cloud, casting its splendour."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स ध्वजस्सपताकश्चसानुकर्षोमहारथः । चतुस्सादिसमायुक्तोमेघस्तनितानि ।।6.71.19।।
output: सध्वजः the standard, सपताकश्च and the flag, सानुकर्षः axletree, मेघस्तनितानि emitting sound like the rumblings of cloud, महारथः great chariot, चतुस्सादिसमायुक्तः driven by four charioteers.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
विंशतिर्दशचाष्टौ च तूण्योऽस्यरथमास्थिताः । कार्मुकानि च भीमानिज्याश्चकाञ्चनपिङ्गळाः ।।6.71.20।।
output: "This chariot has twenty quivers, ten frightening bows, and eight bow strings of golden colour lay arranged in the chariot."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
द्वौ च खडगौरथगतौपार्श्वस्थौपार्श्वशोभितौ । चतुर्हस्तत्सरुयुतौव्यक्तहस्तदशायतौ ।।6.71.21।।
output: "It has two swords off our cubits and ten cubits long swords provided with hilts hanging on its sides as decoration."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रक्तगण्ठगुणोधीरोमहापर्वतसन्निभः । कालःकालमहावक्त्रोमेघस्थइवभास्करः ।।6.71.22।।
output: "Wearing red garland s round the neck, brave, like a mountain in form, dark with large mouth, like death, like sun veiled by clouds he seems."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाभ्यांभूजाभ्यामेषशोभते । शृङ्गाभ्यामिवतुङ्गाभ्यांहिमवान् पर्वतोत्तमः ।।6.71.23।।
output: "By adorning armlets, his both arms are like high peaks of Himalaya mountain shining away."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कुण्डलाभ्यांतुयस्यैतद्भतध्भातिशुभेक्ष । पुनर्वस्वन्तरगतंपूर्णंभिंबमिवैंदवम् ।।6.71.24।।
output: "He who shines like the full moon between two Punarvasu stars, his auspicious eyes and countenance shines with both earrings."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आचक्ष्वमेमहाबाहोत्वमेनंराक्षसोत्तमम् । यंदृष्टवावानरास्सर्वेभयार्ताविद्रुतादिशः ।।6.71.25।।
output: महाबाहो mighty armed one, यं him, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanara, भयार्ताः fear, दिशः direction, विद्रुताः fled, एनम् such, राक्षसोत्तमम् foremost of the Rakshasas, त्वम् you, मे to me, आचक्ष्व show him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
स पृष्टोराजपुत्रेणरामेणामिततेजसा । आचचक्षेमहातेजारघवायविभीषणः ।।6.71.26।।
output: Interrogated by the highly brilliant prince Raghava, energetic Vibheeshana revealed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दशग्रीवोमहातेजाराजावैश्रवणानुजः । भीमकर्मामहोत्साहोरावणोराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.71.27।।
output: "The tenheaded and highly brilliant king Ravana, who is the brother of Vysravana, is of terrible deeds and highly exploitative."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यासीद्वीर्यवान्पुत्रोरावणप्रतिमोरणे । वृद्धसेवीश्रुतिधरस्सर्वास्त्रविदुषांवरः ।।6.71.28।।
output: तस्य to him, वीर्यवान् valiant, रणे in war, रावणप्रतिमः compeer of Ravana, वृद्धसेवी served elders, श्रुतिधरः learned, सर्वास्त्रविदुषाम् well versed in all sastras, वरः blessed, पुत्रः son, आसीत् born.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अश्वपृष्ठेरथेनागेखडगेधनुषिकर्षणे । भेदेसान्त्वे च दाने च नयेमन्त्रे च सम्मतः ।।6.71.29।।
output: अश्वपृष्ठे best in riding on horseback, नागेरथे on elephant, खडगे in the use of sword, सान्त्वे च and bow also, भेदे sowing dissension, दाने च in making charity, नये in making peace, मन्त्रे च in statecraft, सम्मतः capable.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्यबाहूसमाश्रित्यलङ्कावसतिनिर्भया । तनयंधान्यमालिन्याअतिकायमिमंविदुः ।।6.71.30।।
output: "He is known as Atikaya, son of Dhanyamalini. Lanka remains fearless on his shoulders, you may know."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
एतेनाराधितोब्रह्मोतपसाभावितात्मना । अस्त्राणिचाप्यवाप्तानिरिपवश्चपराजिताः ।।6.71.31।।
output: "By penance on supreme self he propitiated Brahma, who blessed him with mystic missiles by way of boons by which his enemies were subdued."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
सुरासुरैरवध्यत्वंदत्तमस्मैस्वयम्भुवा । एतच्चकवचंदिव्यंरधश्चैषोऽरभास्वरः ।।6.71.32।।
output: "Exemption from death from gods and demons was given to him and all this wonderful shield and chariot as bright as the sun."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतेनशतशोदेवादानवाश्चपराजिताः । रक्षितानि च रक्षांसियक्षाश्चापिनिषूदिताः ।।6.71.33।।
output: "By this (boon) hundreds of Devatas and demons were defeated by him, Yakshas were killed, nay Rakshasas were protected."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वज्रंविष्टम्भितंयेनबाणैरिन्द्रस्यधीमतः । पाशस्सलिलराजस्यरणेप्रतिहतस्तथा ।।6.71.34।। एषोऽतिकायोबलवान्राक्षसानामथर्षभः । रावणस्यतोधीमान्देवदानवदर्पहा ।।6.71.35।।
output: "Here is strong Atikaya, a wise son of Ravana, bull among Rakshasas, who is a subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas, by whom thunderbolt of Indra was obstructed firmly in battle and likewise the noose of Varuna was repelled in war."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वज्रंविष्टम्भितंयेनबाणैरिन्द्रस्यधीमतः । पाशस्सलिलराजस्यरणेप्रतिहतस्तथा ।।6.71.34।। एषोऽतिकायोबलवान्राक्षसानामथर्षभः । रावणस्यतोधीमान्देवदानवदर्पहा ।।6.71.35।।
output: "Here is strong Atikaya, a wise son of Ravana, bull among Rakshasas, who is a subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas, by whom thunderbolt of Indra was obstructed firmly in battle and likewise the noose of Varuna was repelled in war."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तदस्मिन्क्रियतांयत्नःक्षिप्रंपुरुषपुंगव । पुरावानरसैन्यानिक्ष्यंनयतिसायकैः ।।6.71.36।।
output: "Oh, best of men! Quickly make efforts to put an end to him before he puts down Vanara army."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
ततोतिकायोबलवान्प्रविश्यहरिवाहिनीम् । विष्फारयामासधनुर्ननाद च पुनःपुनः ।।6.71.37।।
output: Thereafter, mighty Atikaya entered the monkey army, twanged his bow again and again and made a loud noise.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंभीमवपुषंदृष्टवारथस्थंरथिनांवरम् । अभिपेतुर्महात्मानोयेप्रधानावनौकसः ।।6.71.38।।
output: अथस्थम् seated, रथिनाम् on the chariot, परम् supreme, भीमवपुषम् dreadful enemy, तम् him, दृष्टवा observing, प्रधानाः foremost, महात्मानः great, ये those, वनौकसः Vanaras, अभिपेतुः rushed towards him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुमुदोद्विविदोमैन्दोनीलश्शरभएव च । पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्चयुगपत्समभिद्रवन् ।।6.71.39।।
output: कुमुदः Kumuda, द्विविदः Dwivida, मैन्दः Mainda, नीलः Neela, शरभःएव च even Sarabha, पादपैः with trees, गिरिशृङ्गैःच and mountain peaks, युगपत् assailed समभिद्रवन् all at once.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तेषांवृक्षांश्चशैलांश्चशरैःकाञ्चनभूषणैः । अतिकायोमहातेजाश्चिच्छेदास्त्रविदांवरः ।।6.71.40।।
output: Atikaya, endowed with extraordinary energy, efficient in the use of weapons, shattered the trees and rocks hurled by the Vanaras with his arrows adorned with gold.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांश्चैवसर्वान् स हरीन् शरैस्सर्वायसैर्बली । विव्याथाभिमुखस्सङ्ख्येभीमकायोनिशाचर ।।6.71.41।।
output: The powerful night ranger of terrible form, pierced all monkeys who were facing him in the battlefield with iron arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेऽर्दितांबाणवर्षेणभिन्नगात्राःप्लवङ्गमाः । न शेकुरतिकायस्यप्रतिकर्तुंमहारणे ।।6.71.42।।
output: महारणे great war, अतिकायस्य Atikaya's, बाणवर्णेण by a hail of arrows, अर्दिताः hard pressed, भिन्नगात्राः limbs broken, ते they, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, प्रतिकर्तुम् to resist, न शेकुः not possible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत् त्सैन्यंहरिवीराणांत्रासयामासराक्षसः । मृगयूथमिवक्रुद्धोहरिर्यौवनदर्पितः ।।6.71.43।।
output: यौवनदर्पितः lion with youthful pride, राक्षसः Rakshasa, क्रुद्धः enraged, हरिः monkey, मृगयूथमिव group of deer, हरिवीराणाम् monkey heroes, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, त्रासयामास struck.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सराक्षसेन्द्रोहरिसैन्यमध्येनायुध्यमानंनिजघानकञ्चित् । उपेत्यरामंसधम: कलापी स गर्वितंवाक्यमिदंबभाषे ।।6.71.44।।
output: सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa Lord, हरिसैन्यमध्ये in the midst of monkey army, अयुध्यमानम् wielding weapon, कञ्चित् indeed, निजाघान not strike, सधम: कलापी armed with bow and quiver, सः he, उपेत्य taking, रामम् Rama, गर्वितम् with pride, इदम् this, वाक्यम् words, बभाषे spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रथेस्थितोहंशरचापपाणिर्नप्राकृतंकञ्चनयोधयामि । यस्यास्तिकश्चिद्व्यवसाययुक्तोददातुमेक्षिप्रमिहाद्ययुद्धम् ।।6.71.45।।
output: "I am with a bow and arrow seated in the chariot. Indeed, I am not strong in fighting with common warriors. Whoever is interested to fight now can come speedily to fight with me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्तस्यवाक्यंब्रुवतोनिशम्यचुकोपसौमित्रिरमित्रहन्ता । अमृष्यमाणश्चसमुत्पपातजग्राहचापं च ततस्स्मयित्वा ।।6.71.46।।
output: ब्रुवतः having spoken, तस्य his, वाक्यम् that word, निशम्य hearing, अमित्रहन्ता destroyer of enemies, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, चुकोप in anger, ततः then, स्मयित्वा not enduring, अमृष्यमाणः not able to tolerate, समुत्पपात went towards, चापम् sword, जग्राह took up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्रुद्धस्सौमित्रिरुत्पत्यतूणादाक्षिप्यसायकम् । पुरस्तादतिकायस्यविचकर्षमहद्धनुः ।।6.71.47।।
output: क्रुद्धः furious. सौमित्रिः Saumithri, उत्पत्य springing up, तूणात् from quiver, सायकम् arrow, आक्षिप्य stretching, अतिकायस्य full length, पुरस्तात् before, महत् great, धनुः bow, चकर्ष discharged.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पूरयन् स महींशैलानाकाशंसागरंदिशः । ज्याशब्दोलक्ष्मणस्योग्रस्त्रासयन् रजनीचरान् ।।6.71.48।।
output: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, सः that, ज्याशब्दः sound of twang, शैलान् mountains, महीम् earth, आकाशम् sky, सागरम् ocean, दिशः directions, पूरयन् filled, रजनीचरान् night ranger, त्रासयन् terror, उग्रः terrible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सौमित्रेश्चापनिर्घोषंश्रुत्वाप्रतिभयंतदा । विसिष्मियेमहातेजाराक्षसेन्द्रात्मजोबली ।।6.71.49।।
output: तदा then, बली powerful, महातेजाः extraordinary energetic, राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजः Rakshasa king's son, प्रतिभयम् in turn frightened, सौमित्रेः Saumithri's, चापनिर्घोषम् sound of his bow, श्रुत्वा hearing, विसिष्मिये astonished.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
अथातिकायःकुपितोदृष्टवालक्ष्मणमुत्थितम् । आदायनिशितंबाणमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.71.50।।
output: Seeing Atikaya, furious Lakshmana sprang up and took a sharp shaft and spoke as follows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
बालस्त्वमसिसौमित्रेविक्रमेष्वविचक्षणः । गच्छकिंकालसदृशंमांयोधयतुमिच्छसि ।।6.71.51।।
output: "O Saumithri! You are valiant but young, not able to discriminate. I am equal to the Lord of death. Why do you desire to comb at with me?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न हिमद्बाहुसृष्टानामस्त्राणाहिमवानपि । सोढुमुत्सहतेवेगमन्तरिक्षमथोमही ।।6.71.52।।
output: The shafts discharged from my arm can't be borne, by the Himalayas, even the atmosphere between the sky and earth can't bear the force.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुखप्रसुप्तंकालाग्निंविबोधयितुमिच्छसि । न्यस्यचापंनिवर्तस्वमाप्राणान् जहिमद्गतः ।।6.71.53।।
output: "Why do you want to arouse the fire of dissolution sleeping comfortably? Return, casting away your bow, without confronting. Go away."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथवात्वंप्रतिष्टब्धो न निवर्तितुमिच्छसि । तिष्ठप्राणान् परित्यज्यगमिष्यसियमक्ष्यम् ।।6.71.54।।
output: अथवा or else, त्वम् you, प्रतिष्टब्धः you want to oppose, निवर्तितुम् to return, न इच्छसि not wish, तिष्ठ stay, प्राणान् life, परित्यज्य giving up, यमक्ष्यम् Yama's abode, गमिष्यसि proceed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
पश्यमेनिशितान्बाणानरिदर्पनिषूदनान् । ईश्वरायुधसङ्काशांस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणान् ।।6.71.55।।
output: "See my sharp shafts capable of reducing enemy's pride like Ishwara's trident, ornamented with polished gold."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषतेसर्पसंकाशोबाणःपास्यतिशोणितम् । मृगराजइवक्रुद्धोनागराजस्यशोणितम् ।।6.71.56।। इत्येवमुक्त्वासंक्रुद्धश्शरंधनुषिसंदधे ।
output: सर्पसंकाशः like serpents, एषःबाणाः these arrows, क्रुद्धः angry, मृगराजः lion, नागराजस्य elephant's, शोणितम् blood, ते to you, शोणितम् blood, पास्यति drink, इत्येवम् therefore, उक्त्वा told, संक्रुद्धः furious, शरम् arrow, धनुषि bow, संदधे fixed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
श्रुत्वातिकायस्यवचस्सरोषंसगर्वितंसम्यतिराजपुत्रः । स सञ्चुकोपातिबलोमनस्वीरुवाचवाक्यं च ततोमहार्थम् ।।6.71.57।।
output: राजपुत्रः prince, सम्यति fitted, अतिकायस्य Atikaya, सरोषम् in wrath, सगर्वितम् proud, वचः utterance, श्रुत्वा hearing, सञ्चुकोप enraged, अतिबलः very strong, मनस्वी high minded, महार्थम् great meaning, सः he, ततः those, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न वाक्यमात्रेणभवान् प्रधानो न कत्थनात्सत्पुरुषाभवन्ति । मयिस्थितेधन्विनिबाणपाणौनिदर्शयस्वात्मबलंदुरात्मन् ।।6.71.58।।
output: दुरात्मन् evil minded, भवान् you are, वाक्यमात्रेण by mere statement, प्रधानः chief, न not, कत्थनात् speech, सत्पुरुषाः good people, न भवन्ति not do, धन्विनि bow, बाणपाणौ armed with a bow, स्थिते stand, मयि my, आत्मबलम् your strength, निदर्शयस्य prove.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
कर्मणासूचयात्मानं न विकत्थितुमर्हसि । पौरुषेणतुयोयुक्तस्सतुशूरइतिस्मृतः ।।6.71.59।।
output: "Reveal yourself by action not by indication. You do not deserve it. He who is with prowess is a right hero."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सर्वायुधसमायुक्तोधन्वीत्वंरथमास्थितः । शरैर्वायदिवाप्यस्त्रैर्दर्शयस्वपराक्रमम् ।।6.71.60।।
output: त्वम् you, धन्वी bow, सर्वायुधसमायुक्तः collecting all kinds of weapons, रथम् chariot, आस्थितः seated, शरैःवा with arrows, यदिवापि by that alone, अस्त्रै: weapons, पराक्रमम् capable, दर्शयस्य show.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततश्शिरस्तेनिशितैःपातयिष्याम्यहंशरैः । मारुतःकालसम्पक्वंवृन्तात्ताळफलंयथा ।।6.71.61।।
output: ततः then, अहम् I, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, तेशिरः his head, मारुतः wind, कालसम्पक्वम् in the process of time when ripened, ताळफलम् palm fruit, वृन्तात् यथा drops, पातयिष्यामि will throw.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्यतेमामकाबाणास्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः । पास्यन्तिरुधिरंगात्राद्बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् ।।6.71.62।।
output: "Now, you will drink the blood ejected from your neck by the holes made with my pointed arrows decked with polished gold."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
बालोऽयमितिविज्ञाय न मावज्ञातुमर्हसि । बालोवायदिवावृद्धोमृत्युंजानीहिसंयुगे ।।6.71.63।। बालेनविष्णुनालोकास्त्रयःक्रान्तास्त्रिविक्रमैः ।
output: "You should not underestimate me thinking I am young or old to win. You do not know that I am spirit of death in battle. Did not Vishnu as young Trivikrama win the three worlds going by three strides?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लक्ष्मणस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाहेतुमत्परमार्थवत् ।।6.71.64।। अतिकायःप्रचुक्रोधबाणंचोत्तममाददे ।
output: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, हेतुमत् reasoning, परमार्थवत् full of truth, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, अतिकायः Atikaya, प्रचुक्रोध very furious, उत्तमम् best of, बाणम् arrows, आददे च took.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
ततोविद्याधराभूतादेवादैत्यामहर्षयः ।।6.71.65।। गुह्यकाश्चमहात्मानस्तद्युद्धंद्रष्टुमागमन् ।
output: Then vidhyadharas, demons, devatas, daityas, sages and great guhyakas arrived at the battlefield to witness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तोऽतिकायःकुपितश्चापमारोप्यसायकम् ।।6.71.66।। लक्ष्मणायप्रचिक्षेपसङ्क्षिपन्निवचाम्बरम् ।
output: ततः then, अतिकायः Atikaya, कुपितः enraged, सायकम् arrows, चापम् to bow, आरोप्य fixing, अम्बरम् sky, सङ्क्षिपम् इव as if discharging it in the sky, लक्ष्मणाय at Lakshmana, प्रचिक्षेप directed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमापतन्तंनिशितंशरमाशीविषोपमम् ।।6.71.67।। अर्धचन्द्रेणचिच्छेदलक्ष्मणःपरवीरहा ।
output: Lakshmana, the heroic destroyer of enemies, shattered the venomous serpent like arrow with his sharp half moon shaped arrow.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंनिकृत्तंशरंदृष्टवाकृत्तभोगमिवोरगम् ।।6.71.68।। अतिकायोभृशंक्रुद्धःपञ्चबाणान् समाददे ।
output: अतिकायः Atikaya, कृत्तभोगम् torn asunder, उरगम् इव like serpent, निकृत्तम् offended, तंशरम् that arrow, दृष्टवा seeing, भृशम् , क्रुद्धः angry, पञ्च five, बाणान् arrows, समाददे fitted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्शरान् सम्प्रचिक्षेपलक्ष्मणायनिशाचरः ।।6.71.69।। तानप्राप्तान् शरैस्तीक्ष्णैश्चिच्छेदभरतानुजः ।
output: The night ranger set loose those arrows at Lakshmana, Bharata's brother. Lakshmana shattered them even before it reached him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सतान् छित्त्वाशितैर्बाणैर्लक्ष्मणःपरवीरहा ।।6.71.70।। आददेनिशितंबाणंज्वलन्तमिवतेजसा ।
output: Lakshmana, the heroic destroyer of foes, having split those arrows, seized a shaft which was a bright and sharp flaming arrow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तमादायधनुश्श्रेष्ठेयोजयामासलक्ष्मणः ।।6.71.71।। विचकर्ष च वेगेनविससर्ज च वीर्यवान् ।
output: Valiant Lakshmana, foremost of the wielders of bow stretching his bow till the ear, quickly discharged the arrow.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पूर्णायतविसृषेनशरेणनतपर्वणा ।।6.71.72।। ललाटेराक्षसश्रेष्ठमाजघान स वीर्यवान् ।
output: वीर्यवान heroic, सः he, पूर्णायतविसृषेन fully stretching, नतपर्वणा bending to curvature, शरेण the arrow, राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् foremost of the Rakshasas, ललाटे forehead, आजघान struck.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सललाटेशरोमग्नस्तस्यभीमस्यरक्षसः ।।6.71.73।। ददृशेशोणितेनाक्तःपन्नगेन्द्रइवाचले ।
output: That arrow stuck on the forehead of the terrific Rakshasa looked like a serpent on a mountain.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राक्षसःप्रचकम्पे च लक्ष्मणेषुप्रपीडितः ।।6.71.74।। रुद्रबाणहतंघोरंयथात्रिपुरगोपुरम् ।
output: अथ now, लक्ष्मणेषुप्रपीडितः tormented by Lakshmana's arrow, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रुद्रबाणहतम् as though struck by arrow of Rudra, घोरम् dreadful, त्रिपुरगोपुरंयथा like the gate of Tripura, प्रचकम्पे shaken.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चिन्तयामासचाश्वास्यविमृश्य च महाबलः ।।6.71.75।। साधुबाणनिपातेनश्लाघनीयोऽसिमेरिपुः ।
output: Recovering from the hurt and reflecting, the Rakshasa contemplated the course of action, and said 'By releasing the arrow on me you are an enemy worthy of praise."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
विधायैवंविनम्यास्यंनियम्य च भुजावुभौ ।।6.71.76।। स रथोपस्थमास्थायरथेनप्रचचार ह ।
output: Having spoken that way bending his face setting both shoulders right, he settled at the rear end of the chariot started to move from the chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
कंत्रीन्पञ्चसप्तेतिसायन्राक्षसर्षभः ।।6.71.77।। आददेसन्दधेचापिविचकर्षोत्ससर्ज च ।
output: The bull among the Rakshasas taking, one, three, five and seven arrows, fixing them to the bow stretching released.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेबाणाःकालसङ्काशाराक्षसेन्द्रधुनुश्च्युताः ।।6.71.78।। हेमपुङ्खारविप्रख्याश्चक्रुर्दीप्तमिवाम्बरम् ।
output: The gold feathered arrows released from the rakshasas's bow, were like death arrows which shone in the sky as if the sky was glowing.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तस्तान्राक्षसोत्सृष्टान्शरौघान्राघवानुजः ।।6.71.79।। असम्ब्रान्तःप्रचिच्छेदनिशितैर्बहुभिश्शरैः ।
output: Raghava's brother remained unconfounded and then he shattered the volley of many sharp arrows released by the Rakshasa.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तान् शरान्युधिसम्प्रेक्ष्यनिकृत्तान्रावणात्मजः ।।6.71.80।। चुकोपत्रिदशेन्द्रारिर्जग्राहनिशितंशरम् ।
output: Ravana's son, an enemy of Indra, observing that all arrows have been ineffective, took up another sharp arrow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ससन्धायमहातेजास्तंबाणंसहसोत्सृजत् ।।6.71.81।। तेनस्सौमित्रिमायान्तमाजघानस्तनान्तरे ।
output: Highly energetic Atikaya, fixing another arrow released it between the breasts of Saumithri and pierced.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अतिकायेनसौमित्रिस्ताडितोयुधिवक्षसि ।।6.71.82।। सुस्रावरुधिरंतीव्रंमदंमत्तइवद्विपः ।
output: In the battle, Saumithri was hurt in the chest by Atikaya's arrow and blood flowed like the ichor from elephant in rut.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सचकारतदात्मानंविशल्यंसहसाविभुः ।।6.71.83।। जग्राह च शरंतीक्ष्णमस्त्रेणापिचसन्दधे ।
output: विभुः glorious, सः he, तदा then, आत्मानम् stuck in his body, सहसा forcibly, विशल्यम् noble, चकार seized, तीक्षणम् pointed, शरम् arrow, जग्राह removed, अस्त्रेणपि also with mystic spell, सन्दधे च pulled out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
आग्नेयेनतदाऽस्त्रेणयोजयामाससायकम् ।।6.71.84।। स जज्वालतदाबाणोधनुष्यस्यमहात्मनः ।
output: Then Lakshmana by concentration of his mind fixed on fire god which presided over the arrow, that great selffixed in his bow glowed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
अतिकायोतितेजस्वीसौरमस्त्रंसमादधे ।।6.71.85।। तेनबाणंभुजङ्गाभंहेमपुङ्खमयोजयत् ।
output: Highly energetic Atikaya took a serpentlike arrow with gold feathers and charged it by the concentration of his mind on the power of Sun god.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तदस्त्रंज्वलितंघोरंलक्ष्मणश्शरमाहितम् ।।6.71.86।। अतिकायायचिक्षेपकालदण्डमिवान्तकः ।
output: Lakshmana placed that fierce, glowing missile looking like the staff of God of death on Atikaya.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
आग्नेयेनाभिसंयुक्तंदृष्टवाबाणंनिशाचरः ।।6.71.87।। उत्ससर्जतदाबाणंदीप्तंसूर्यास्त्रयोजितम् ।
output: The night ranger, seeing the missile charged with fire god coming towards him, released the glowing arrow charged with the power of Sun god.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तावुभावम्बरेबाणावन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः ।।6.71.88।। तेजसासंप्रदीप्ताग्रौक्रुद्धाविवभुजंगमौ ।
output: Both the arrows effulgent, flaming with fire, were like angry serpents in the sky striking one another violently.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तावन्योन्यंविनिर्दह्यपेततुर्धरणीतले ।।6.71.89।। निरर्चिषौभस्मकृतौ न भ्राजेतेशरोत्तमौ । तावुभौदीप्यमानौस्म न भ्राजेतेमहीतले ।।6.71.90।।
output: तौ those two, अन्योन्यम् one another, विनिर्दह्य burning themselves, पृथिवीतले on the earth surface, पेततुः fallen, निरर्चिषौ with no life, भस्मकृतौ burnt to ashes, शरोत्तमौ best of arrows, न भ्राजेते not shine, दीप्यमानौ glowing, तौ those, उभौ two, महीतले on the ground, न भ्राजेते not.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तावन्योन्यंविनिर्दह्यपेततुर्धरणीतले ।।6.71.89।। निरर्चिषौभस्मकृतौ न भ्राजेतेशरोत्तमौ । तावुभौदीप्यमानौस्म न भ्राजेतेमहीतले ।।6.71.90।।
output: तौ those two, अन्योन्यम् one another, विनिर्दह्य burning themselves, पृथिवीतले on the earth surface, पेततुः fallen, निरर्चिषौ with no life, भस्मकृतौ burnt to ashes, शरोत्तमौ best of arrows, न भ्राजेते not shine, दीप्यमानौ glowing, तौ those, उभौ two, महीतले on the ground, न भ्राजेते not.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोऽतिकायस्सङ्कृद्धस्त्वस्त्रमैषीकमुत्सृजत् । तत्प्रचिच्छेदसौमित्रिरस्त्रमैन्द्रेणवीर्यवान् ।।6.71.91।।
output: Then Atikaya seized with anger discharged Ishikam presided over by Twashta (the architect of gods). Saumithri then split the arrow with one presided by Indra and split Ishikam.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
ऐषीकंनिहतंदृष्टवारुषितोरावणात्मजः । याम्येनार्स्तेणसङ्कृद्धोयोजयामाससायकम् ।।6.71.92।।
output: Annoyed by his arrow Ishikam being struck, Atikaya, son of Ravana charged Lakshmana's arrow with an arrow presided over by Yama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तदस्त्रंचिक्षेपलक्ष्मणायनिशाचरः । वायव्येनतदस्त्रेणनिजघान स लक्ष्मणः ।।6.71.93।।
output: Then the night ranger shattered the arrow of Lakshmana and in turn released an arrow presided by Vayu.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथैनंशरधाराभिर्धाराभिरिवतोयदः । अभ्यवर्षत्सुसङ्कृद्धोलक्ष्मणोरावणात्मजम् ।।6.71.94।।
output: अथ and then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, एनम् it, रावणात्मजम् Ravana's son, तोयदः water, धाराभिःइव rainy cloud, शरधाराभिः showered arrows, अभ्यवर्षत heavy torrents.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तेऽतिकायंसमासाद्यकवचेवज्रभूषिते । भग्नाग्रशल्यास्सहसापेतुर्बाणामहीतले ।।6.71.95।।
output: On those arrows touching Atikaya's diamond like body, the pointed arrows shattered the coat covering the body and the broken coat of nails had fallen down.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्मोघानभिसम्प्रेक्ष्यलक्ष्मणःपरवीरहा । अभ्यवर्षन्महेषूणांसहस्रेणमहायशाः ।।6.71.96।।
output: Lakshmana of great fame, subduer of enemy looking at the arrows becoming useless mighty hero released thousand arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स वृष्यमाणोबाणौघैरतिकायोमहाबलः । अवध्यकवचस्सङ्ख्येराक्षसोनैवविव्यथे ।।6.71.97।।
output: बाणौघैः covered with arrows, वृष्यमाणः showered down, महाबलः mighty, अवध्यकवचः shield that impenetrable, राक्षसः Rakshasa, अतिकायः Atikaya, सङ्ख्ये in battlefield, विव्यथे not felt tormented.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शरंचाशीविषाकारंलक्ष्मणायव्यपासृजत् । स तेनविद्धस्सौमित्रिर्मर्मदेशेशरेण ह ।।6.71.98।। मुहूर्तमात्रंनिस्संज्ञोह्यभवच्छत्रुतापनः ।
output: Atikaya released an arrow resembling a poisonous serpent at Lakshmana. Pierced in vital part Saumithri, the tormentor of the enemy lost consciousness for a while.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
ततःस्संज्ञामुपालभ्यचतुर्भिस्सायकोत्तमैः ।।6.71.99।। निजघानहयान्सङ्ख्येसारथिं च महाबलः । ध्वजस्योन्मथनंकृत्वाशरवर्षैररिन्दमः ।।6.71.100।।
output: Then mighty subduer of enemies, regaining senses, getting up destroyed the chariot pole with rain of arrows. Taking up four best arrows he struck down the chariot, charioteer, and the horses.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःस्संज्ञामुपालभ्यचतुर्भिस्सायकोत्तमैः ।।6.71.99।। निजघानहयान्सङ्ख्येसारथिं च महाबलः । ध्वजस्योन्मथनंकृत्वाशरवर्षैररिन्दमः ।।6.71.100।।
output: ततः then, महाबलः mighty, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, संज्ञाम् regaining senses, उपालभ्य getting up, शरवर्षैः rain of arrows, ध्वजस्य chariot pole, उन्मथनम् uplifted, कृत्वा destroying, चतुर्भिः four, सायकोत्तमैः best arrows, सङ्ख्ये in the battlefield, सारथिम् charioteer, हयान् horses, निजघान struck down.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
असम्भ्रान्तस्ससौमित्रिस्तान्शरानभिलक्षितान् । मुमोचलक्ष्मणोबाणान्वधार्थंतस्यरक्षसः ।।6.71.101।।
output: Saumithri, son of Sumithra, was not able to inflict injury on that Rakshasa with those arrows, though desiring to kill him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न शशाकरुजंकर्तुंयुधितस्यनरोत्तमः । अथैनमभ्युपागम्यवायुर्वाक्यमुवाच ह ।।6.71.102।।
output: Wind god (Vayu) having come to the best of men, Lakshmana, spoke to him that in battle it is not possible to injure him or kill him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ब्रह्मदत्तवरोह्येषअवध्यकवचावृतः । ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेणभ्निथ्येनमेषवध्योहिनान्यथा ।।6.71.103।। अवध्यएषह्यन्येषामस्त्राणांकवचीबली ।
output: By the boon given by Brahma his body is covered with armour which can't be broken. By Brahma's weapon only you can strike to kill him because of his armour and might. By any other weapon it is not possible to kill him.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तुवायोर्वचनंनिशम्यसौमित्रिरिन्द्रप्रतिमानवीर्यः । समाददेबाणममोघवेगंतद्ब्राह्ममस्त्रंसहसानियोज्य ।।6.71.104।।
output: Then Saumithri who is equal to Indra hearing wind god's words invoked Brahma's weapon into service. While he was charging into his arrows and fixing the arrow went at terrific speed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नियुज्यमानेसौमित्रिणाबाणवरेशिताग्रे । दिशश्चचन्द्रर्कमहाग्रहाश्चनभश्चतत्रासचचालचोर्वी ।।6.71.105।।
output: सौमित्रिणआ Saumithri, शिताग्रे sharp pointed tip, बाणवरे best, तस्मिन् that, वरास्त्रे foremost arrow नियुज्यमाने charged, दिशः च directions, चन्द्रार्कमहाग्रहाश्च moon and Sun and other planets, नभश्च sky, तत्रास feared, ऊर्वीच earth, चचाल shook.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंब्रह्मणोऽस्त्रेणनियुज्यचापेशरंसुपुङ्खंयमदूतकल्पम् । सौमित्रिरिन्द्रारिसुतस्यतस्यससर्जबाणंयुधिवज्रकल्पम् ।।6.71.106।।
output: Golden feathered arrow, which resembled thunderbolt, was released on Atikaya, enemy of Indra for whom it was like a messenger of death. It was charged with Brahma's mystic by Saumithri and released on fixing it.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तंलक्ष्मणोत्सृष्टममोघवेगंसमापतन्तंज्यलनप्रकाशम् । सुपर्णवज्रोत्तमचित्रपुङ्खंतदाऽतिकायस्समरेददर्श ।।6.71.107।।
output: Atikaya saw the arrow of Lakshmana coming at a speed, which possessed the velocity of the wind, fixed with feathers resembling the wings of Garuda in the battle.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंप्रेक्षमाणस्सहसाऽतिकायोजघानबाणैर्निशितैरनेकैः । स सायकस्तस्यसुपर्णवेगस्तदातिकायस्यजगामपार्श्वम् ।।6.71.108।।
output: As Atikaya was looking at the arrow, Lakshmana struck many arrows forcibly with sharp arrows possessing the speed of Garuda. The arrows reached towards Atikaya.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तमागतंप्रेक्ष्यतदातिकायोबाणंप्रदीप्तान्तककालकल्पम् । जघानक्त्यृष्टिगदाकुठारैशूलैर्हुलैश्चाप्यविपन्नचेता ।।6.71.109।।
output: Perceiving the glowing arrow coming, like the spirit of death, Atikaya struck it with unceasing effort with javelins, spears, maces, axes, tridents and even arrows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तान्यायुधान्यद्भुतविग्रहाणिमोघानिकृत्वा स शरोऽग्निदीप्तः । प्रगृह्यतस्यैवकिरीटजुष्टम् ततोऽतिकायस्यशिरोजहार ।।6.71.110।।
output: This great arrow of Lakshmana glowing like fire rendered the weapons in wonderful shapes released by Atikaya unsuccessful and severed the head of Atikaya decked with a crown.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तछचिरस्सशिरस्त्राणंलक्ष्मणेषुप्रपीडितम् । पपातसहसाभूमौशृङ्गंहिमवतोयथा ।।6.71.111।।
output: Struck by Lakshmana's arrow, the crowned head of Atikaya fell on the ground like Himalaya peak.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 71:
तंभूमौनिपतितंदृष्टवाविक्षिप्तभूषणम् बभूवुर्व्यथितास्सर्वेहतशेषानिशाचराः ।।6.71.112।।
output: All the Rakshasas who escaped from killing, felt distressed seeing the king and his ornaments scattered on the ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेविषण्णमुखादीनाःप्रहारजनितश्रमाः । विनेदुरुच्चैर्बहवस्सहसाविस्वरैस्स्वरैः ।।6.71.113।।
output: प्रहारजनितश्रमाः pride hurt sorrowful, विषण्णमुखाः desperate looks, दीनांबहवः very sad, ते they, सहसा , विस्वरैः discordant tones, स्वरैः voice, उच्चैः burst into, विनेदुः roared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तेत्वरितंयातानिरपेक्षानिशाचराः । पुरीमभिमुखाभीताद्रवन्तोनायकेहते ।।6.71.114।।
output: नायके leader, हते killed, ततः then, निशाचराः night rangers, भीताः afraid, निरपेक्षाः listless, पुरीम् city, अभिमुखाः towards, द्रवन्तः ran, तेत्वरितम् quickly, याताः from there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रहर्षयुक्ताबहवस्तुवानराःप्रबुद्दपद्मप्रतिमाननास्तदा । अपूजयन्लक्ष्मणविष्टभागिनंहतेरिपौभीमबलेदुरासदे ।।6.71.115।।
output: Enemy who was difficult to approach and of terrible might being killed, the Vanaras were extremely delighted. Their faces looked like lotuses in bloom. Filled with joy they worshipped Lakshmana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अतिकायंहतंश्रुत्वालक्ष्मणेनमहौजसा । उद्वेगमगमद्राजावचनंचेदमब्रवीत् ।।6.72.1।।
output: Ravana gets concerned about the safety of Lanka after hearing about Atikaya's death and commands Rakshasas to take care.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
धूम्राक्षःपरमामर्षीधन्वीशस्त्रभृतांवरः । अकम्पनःप्रहस्तश्चकुम्भुकर्णस्तथैव च ।।6.72.2।। एतेमहाबलावीराराक्षसायुद्धकाङ्क्षिणः । जेतारःपरसैन्यानांपरैर्नित्यापराजिताः ।।6.72.3।। निहतास्तेमहावीर्यारामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । राक्षसास्सुमहाकायानानाशस्त्रविशारदाः ।।6.72.4।। अन्ये च बहवश्शूरामहात्मानोनिपातिताः ।
output: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा of unwearied action, रामेण to Rama, धुम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, परमामर्षी highly intolerant, धन्वीशस्त्रभृताम् skilled in the use of bow and arms, वरः foremost, अकम्पनः Akampana, प्रहस्तश्च Prahastha, तथैव च in the same way, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलाः of stupendous valour, वीराः heroes, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः desiring to combat, परसैन्यानाम् with enemy army. जेतारः not defeated, परैः hostile, नित्यापराजिताः conquerors of enemies, निहता killed, महावीर्याः great heroes, हताः killed, सुमहाकायाः of huge body, नानाशस्त्रविशारदाः skilled in the use of several weapons, महात्मानः great, अन्ये others, बहवः many, शूराः warriors, विनिपातिताः have been killed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 72:
धूम्राक्षःपरमामर्षीधन्वीशस्त्रभृतांवरः । अकम्पनःप्रहस्तश्चकुम्भुकर्णस्तथैव च ।।6.72.2।। एतेमहाबलावीराराक्षसायुद्धकाङ्क्षिणः । जेतारःपरसैन्यानांपरैर्नित्यापराजिताः ।।6.72.3।। निहतास्तेमहावीर्यारामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । राक्षसास्सुमहाकायानानाशस्त्रविशारदाः ।।6.72.4।। अन्ये च बहवश्शूरामहात्मानोनिपातिताः ।
output: "Dhumraksha, a highly intolerant one, Akampana, the foremost of the Rakshasas and skilled in the use of bow and arms, in the same way Prahastha, Kumbhakarna of stupendous valour and heroes among Rakshasas desiring for combat, who have never been defeated and conquerors of hostile armies, have been killed. Great heroes of huge body, skilled in the use of many weapons and other warriors have been killed by Rama."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धूम्राक्षःपरमामर्षीधन्वीशस्त्रभृतांवरः । अकम्पनःप्रहस्तश्चकुम्भुकर्णस्तथैव च ।।6.72.2।। एतेमहाबलावीराराक्षसायुद्धकाङ्क्षिणः । जेतारःपरसैन्यानांपरैर्नित्यापराजिताः ।।6.72.3।। निहतास्तेमहावीर्यारामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । राक्षसास्सुमहाकायानानाशस्त्रविशारदाः ।।6.72.4।। अन्ये च बहवश्शूरामहात्मानोनिपातिताः ।
output: "Dhumraksha, a highly intolerant one, Akampana, the foremost of the Rakshasas and skilled in the use of bow and arms, in the same way Prahastha, Kumbhakarna of stupendous valour and heroes among Rakshasas desiring for combat, who have never been defeated and conquerors of hostile armies, have been killed. Great heroes of huge body, skilled in the use of many weapons and other warriors have been killed by Rama."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रख्यातबलवीर्येणपुत्रेणेन्द्रजितामम ।।6.72.5।। यौहितौभ्रातरौतदावीरौबद्धौदत्तवरैश्शरैः ।
output: "Both the famous brothers, Rama and Lakshmana were bound with arrows by my heroic son Indrajith who is conferred with boons and whose strength is well known.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यन्नशक्यंसुरैस्सर्वैरसुरैर्वामहाबलैः ।।6.72.6।। मोक्तुंतद्बन्धनंघोरंयक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः । तन्नजानेप्रभावैर्वामाययामोहनेनवा ।।6.72.7।। शरबन्धाद्विमुक्तौतौभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ ।
output: "That formidable bond which could not be undone by Devatas, mighty Demons, Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras got released by both the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana by their powers and conjuring tricks which are not known to me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यन्नशक्यंसुरैस्सर्वैरसुरैर्वामहाबलैः ।।6.72.6।। मोक्तुंतद्बन्धनंघोरंयक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः । तन्नजानेप्रभावैर्वामाययामोहनेनवा ।।6.72.7।। शरबन्धाद्विमुक्तौतौभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ ।
output: यत् that which, सर्वैः all, सुरैः Devatas, महाबलैः mighty, असुरैर्वा demons, यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः Yaksha, Gandharva, and Kinnaras, मोक्तुम् to release, शक्यम् possible, तत् that, बन्धनम् bond, घोरम् formidable, शरबन्धात् bound by arrows, भ्रातरौ brothers, तौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, प्रभावैःवै powers, मायया conjuring, मोहनेनवा by tricks, विमुक्तौ released, तत् which, न जाने not known to me.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
येयोधानिर्गताश्शूराराक्षसाममशासनात् ।।6.72.8।। तेसर्वेनिहतायुद्धेवानरैस्सुमहाबलैः ।
output: " All those heroes who have gone by my order for combat, have been killed in the battle by mighty Vanaras."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तम्नपश्याम्यहंयुद्धेयोऽद्यरामंसलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.72.9।। शासयेत्सबलंवीरंससुग्रीवविभीषणम् ।
output: "I do not see any warrior who will be able to wage with that Lakshmana, or his army, or with Sugriva, Vibheeshana or with Rama to put an end to them."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 72:
अहोसुबलवान् रामोमहदस्त्रबलं च वै ।।6.72.10।। यस्यविक्रममासाद्यराक्षसानिधनंगताः ।
output: "Rama's valour is great the strength of his missiles is great, and his valour is formidable. Rakshasas can't stand his range."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अप्रमत्सैश्चसर्वत्रगुप्सैरक्ष्यापुरीवतियम् ।।6.72.11।। अशोकवनिकायांचयत्रसीताऽभिरक्ष्यते ।
output: "This city and even the Ashoka grove where Sita is kept secretly to be guarded by being vigilant on all sides."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निष्क्रामोवाप्रवेशोवाज्ञातव्यस्सर्वदैवनः ।।6.72.12।। यत्रयत्रभवेद्गुल्मस्तत्रतत्रपुनःपुनः ।
output: यत्रयत्र where ever, गुल्मः troops, भवेत् are posted, तत्रतत्र here and there, पुनःपुनः again and again, सर्वदैव all over, निष्क्रामोवा be it exit, प्रवेशोवा be it entry, सः that, ज्ञातव्यः not to go out.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 72:
सर्वतश्चापितिष्ठध्वंस्स्वै: परिवृताबलैः ।।6.72.13।। द्रष्टव्यं च पदंतेषांवानराणांनिशाचराः ।
output: "Surrounded by the army on all sides, whoever it may be, keep watching the movement of Vanaras."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रदोषेवार्धरात्रेवाप्रत्यूषेवापिसर्वत ।।6.72.14।। नावज्ञातेषुकर्तव्यावानरेषुकदाचन । द्विषतांबलमुद्युक्तमापतकतिंस्थितंसदा ।।6.72.15।।
output: प्रदोषेवा evening or, अर्धरात्रेवा or midnight, प्रत्यूषेवा early morning, सर्वत at all times:, कदाचन indeed, तेषु at these, वानरेषु Vanaras, नावज्ञा no indifference, कर्तव्या not active, द्विषताम् watched, बलम् army, उद्युक्तम् standing, आपतत्advancing, सदा constantly, स्थितम् stands where it was.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 72:
प्रदोषेवार्धरात्रेवाप्रत्यूषेवापिसर्वत ।।6.72.14।। नावज्ञातेषुकर्तव्यावानरेषुकदाचन । द्विषतांबलमुद्युक्तमापतकतिंस्थितंसदा ।।6.72.15।।
output: " At all times, whether it is evening or midnight or early morning, Vanaras movements are to be watched by the army without indifference. Indeed, the army should be active or inactive, standing, advancing constantly and staying wherever they are."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तेराक्षसास्सर्वेश्रुत्वालङ्काधिपस्यतत् । वचनंसर्वमातिष्ठन् यथावत्तुमहाबलाः ।।6.72.16।।
output: ततः then, महाबलाः great army, सर्वे all, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, लङ्काधिपस्य at the king of Lanka, तत् his, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सर्वम् all, आतिष्ठन् got up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तान् सर्वान् हिसन्दिश्यरावणोराक्षसाधिपः । मन्युशल्यंवहन् दीनःप्रविवेशस्वमालयम् ।।6.72.17।।
output: सः he, राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, तान् them, सर्वान् all, सन्दिश्य enjoined, मन्युशल्यम् thorn of wrath, वहन् bearing, दीनः desperate, स्वम् himself, आलयम् abode, प्रविवेश entered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोहतान्राक्षसपुङ्गवांस्तान् देवान्तकादित्रिशिरोतिकायान् । रक्षोगणास्तत्रहतावशिष्टास्तेरावणायत्वरिताश्शशंसुः ।।6.73.1।।
output: Indrajith consoles Ravana, takes up Brahmastra and attacks Rama and Lakshmana and the army of Vanaras and makes them become unconscious by the network of arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोहतांस्तान् सहसानिशम्यराजामुमोहपरिप्लुताक्षः । पुत्रक्षयंभ्रातृवधं च घोरंविचिन्त्यराजाविपुलंप्रदध्यौ ।।6.73.2।।
output: ततः there upon, राजा king, तान् them, हतान् killed, सहसा suddenly, निशम्य getting to know, मुमोहपरिप्लुताक्षः lost senses by the eyes bathed in tears, घोरम् dreadful, पुत्रक्षयम् and son, भ्रातृवधं च about killing of his brother, विचिन्त्य thinking, विपुलम् seriously, प्रदध्यौ held.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तुराजानमुदीक्ष्यदीनंशोकार्णवेसम्परिपुप्लुवानम् । रथर्षभोराक्षसराजसूनुस्तमिन्द्रजिद्वाक्यमिदंबभाषे ।।6.73.3।।
output: ततः then, दीनम् desperate, शोकार्णवे sea of sorrow, सम्परीपुप्लुवानम् immersed in, राजानम् Oh king, उदीक्ष्य submitted, रथर्षभः foremost of chariot riders, राक्षसराजसूनुः Rakshasa king's son, इन्द्रन्द्रजित् Indrajith, तम् him, इदंवाक्यम् these words, बभाषे spoke.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न तात मोहंपरिगन्तुमर्हसियत्रेन्द्रजिजजीवतिराक्षसेन्द्र । नेन्द्रारिबाणाभिहतोहिकश्चित्प्राणान् समर्थस्समरेऽभिपातुम् ।।6.73.4।।
output: राक्षसेन्द्र Rakshasa king,तात् dear, यत्र there, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, जीवति alive, मोहम् delusion, परिगन्तुम् to despair, न अर्हसि not give way, समरे in battle, इन्द्रारिबाणाभिहतः struck with arrows of Indra, कश्चित् indeed, प्राणान् life, अभिपातुम् strike, न समर्थःहि not capable.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पश्याद्यरामंसहलक्ष्मणेनमद्बाणनिर्भिन्नविकीर्णदेहम् । गतायुषंभूमितलेशयानंशितैश्शरैराचितसर्वगात्रम् ।।6.73.5।।
output: अद्य now, मद्बाणनिर्भिन्नविकीर्णदेहम् body torn to pieces along with his army, गतायुषम् life ceased, भूमितले on the ground, शयानम् lying, शितैः pierced, शरैः arrows, आचितसर्वगात्रम् all limbs covered with arrows clung, लक्ष्मणेनसह along with Lakshmana also, रामम् Rama, पश्य you will see.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इमांप्रतिज्ञांशृणुशक्रशत्रोःसुनिश्चितांपौरुषदैवयुक्ताम् । अद्यैवरामंसहलक्ष्मणेनसन्तर्पयिष्यामिशरैरमोघैः ।।6.73.6।।
output: "Listen to this vow of Indra's enemy, which is fully determined and combined with manliness and divinity. I shall put an end to Rama and Lakshmana with my wonderful arrows."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
अद्येन्द्रवैवस्वतविष्णुमित्रसाध्याश्चवैश्वानरचन्द्रसूर्याः । द्रक्ष्यन्तुमेविक्रममप्रमेयंविष्णोरिवोग्रंबलियज्ञवाटे ।।6.73.7।।
output: "Today, Indra, Vishnu, Mitra, Sadhyas, Vysvanara, moon and Sun will witness my immeasurable prowess as they witnessed the terrible prowess of Vishnu at the fire sacrifice of Bali."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स एवमुक्त्वात्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रुरापृच्छयराजानमदीनसत्त्वः । समारुरोहानितुल्यवेगंरथंखरश्रेष्ठसमाधियुक्तम् ।।6.73.8।।
output: त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रुः enemy of Indra, the ruler of gods, अदीनसत्त्वः unshaken in spirit, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, राजानम् to the king, आपृच्छय taking leave, अनिलतुल्यवेगम् swift as wind in speed, खरश्रेष्ठसमाधियुक्तम् drawn by best of donkeys, रथम् chariot, समारुरोह ascended.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमास्थायमहातेजारथंहरिरथोपमम् । जगामसहसातत्रयत्रयुद्धमरिन्दमः ।।6.73.9।।
output: Highly energetic he (Indrajith) was, a tamer of enemies, seated in the chariot that was like Indra's, quickly went to the battlefield from there.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंप्रस्थितंमहात्मानमनुजग्मुर्महाबलाः । सम्हर्षमाणाबहनोधनुष्प्रवरपाणयः ।।6.73.10।। गजस्कन्धगताःकेचित्केचित्प्रवरवाजिभिः । व्याघ्रवृश्चिकमार्जारखरोरोष्ट्रैश्चभुजङ्गमैः ।।6.73.11।। वराहैश्श्वापदैस्सिंहैर्जम्बुकैःपर्वतोपमैः । काकहंसमयूरैश्चराक्षसाभीमविक्रमाः ।।6.73.12।। प्रासमुद्गरनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वथगदाधराः । भुशुण्डिमुद्गरायष्टिशतघ्नीपरिघायुधा ।।6.73.13।।
output: Many Rakshasas of terrific valour, endowed with extraordinary strength, happily, wielding excellent bows, taking barbed missiles, hammers, whetted axes, maces, Bhusandi mallets, Ayasthis, Sataghnis, and Parighas, making noise, went following great Indrajith. Some went on the back of elephants and horses, tigers as large as mountains, scorpions, cats, donkeys, and camels. As well as on serpents, lions, tigers, and jackals.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंप्रस्थितंमहात्मानमनुजग्मुर्महाबलाः । सम्हर्षमाणाबहनोधनुष्प्रवरपाणयः ।।6.73.10।। गजस्कन्धगताःकेचित्केचित्प्रवरवाजिभिः । व्याघ्रवृश्चिकमार्जारखरोरोष्ट्रैश्चभुजङ्गमैः ।।6.73.11।। वराहैश्श्वापदैस्सिंहैर्जम्बुकैःपर्वतोपमैः । काकहंसमयूरैश्चराक्षसाभीमविक्रमाः ।।6.73.12।। प्रासमुद्गरनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वथगदाधराः । भुशुण्डिमुद्गरायष्टिशतघ्नीपरिघायुधा ।।6.73.13।।
output: महाबलाः mighty strong, भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, बहवः many, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, सम्हर्षमाणा very happy, धनुःप्रवरपाणयः wielding excellent bows, प्रासमुद्गरनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वथगदाधराः barbed missiles, hammers whetted axes, maces भुशण्डिमुद्गरा Bhusandi, mallets ष्टिशतघ्नीपरिघायुधाः Ayashtis, Satahgnis and Parighas, प्रस्थितम् making noise, महात्मानम् great Indrajith, तम् they, अनुजग्मुः went, केचित् some, गजस्कन्धगताः back of elephants and horses, केचित् some, प्रवरवाजिभिः horses, पर्वतोपमैः like mountains, व्याघ्रवृश्चिकमार्जारखरोष्ट्रै tigers, scorpions, cats, donkeys and camels, भुजङ्गमैः serpents, सिंहैः lions, जम्बुकैः Jackals.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
तंप्रस्थितंमहात्मानमनुजग्मुर्महाबलाः । सम्हर्षमाणाबहनोधनुष्प्रवरपाणयः ।।6.73.10।। गजस्कन्धगताःकेचित्केचित्प्रवरवाजिभिः । व्याघ्रवृश्चिकमार्जारखरोरोष्ट्रैश्चभुजङ्गमैः ।।6.73.11।। वराहैश्श्वापदैस्सिंहैर्जम्बुकैःपर्वतोपमैः । काकहंसमयूरैश्चराक्षसाभीमविक्रमाः ।।6.73.12।। प्रासमुद्गरनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वथगदाधराः । भुशुण्डिमुद्गरायष्टिशतघ्नीपरिघायुधा ।।6.73.13।।
output: Many Rakshasas of terrific valour, endowed with extraordinary strength, happily, wielding excellent bows, taking barbed missiles, hammers, whetted axes, maces, Bhusandi mallets, Ayasthis, Sataghnis, and Parighas, making noise, went following great Indrajith. Some went on the back of elephants and horses, tigers as large as mountains, scorpions, cats, donkeys, and camels. As well as on serpents, lions, tigers, and jackals.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंप्रस्थितंमहात्मानमनुजग्मुर्महाबलाः । सम्हर्षमाणाबहनोधनुष्प्रवरपाणयः ।।6.73.10।। गजस्कन्धगताःकेचित्केचित्प्रवरवाजिभिः । व्याघ्रवृश्चिकमार्जारखरोरोष्ट्रैश्चभुजङ्गमैः ।।6.73.11।। वराहैश्श्वापदैस्सिंहैर्जम्बुकैःपर्वतोपमैः । काकहंसमयूरैश्चराक्षसाभीमविक्रमाः ।।6.73.12।। प्रासमुद्गरनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वथगदाधराः । भुशुण्डिमुद्गरायष्टिशतघ्नीपरिघायुधा ।।6.73.13।।
output: Many Rakshasas of terrific valour, endowed with extraordinary strength, happily, wielding excellent bows, taking barbed missiles, hammers, whetted axes, maces, Bhusandi mallets, Ayasthis, Sataghnis, and Parighas, making noise, went following great Indrajith. Some went on the back of elephants and horses, tigers as large as mountains, scorpions, cats, donkeys, and camels. As well as on serpents, lions, tigers, and jackals.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
स शङ्खनिनदैःपूर्णैर्भेरीणांचापिनिस्स्वनैः । जगामत्रिदशेन्द्रास्तूयमानोनिशाचरैः ।।6.73.14।।
output: The Rakshasas went on praising the enemy of Indra, Indrajith, making noise, blowing conchs in full blast, beating drums.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
स शङ्खशशिवर्णेनछत्रेणरिपुसूदनः । रराजप्रतिपूर्णेननभश्चन्द्रमसायथा ।।6.73.15।।
output: He, the destroyer of foes went with white parasols like a full moon shine in the sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवीज्यतततोवीरोहैमैर्हेमविभूषितैः । चारुचामरमुख्यैश्चमुख्यस्सर्वधनुष्मताम् ।।6.73.16।।
output: Thereafter the chief hero went decked with golden ornaments, fanned by archers holding whisks with gold handles.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तुदृष्टवाविनिर्यान्तंबलेनमहातावृतम् । राक्षसाधिपतिश्रशीमान् रावणःपुत्रमब्रवीत् ।।6.73.17।।
output: राक्षसाधिपतिः Rakshasa king, श्रीमान् prosperous, सः he, रावणः Ravana, महता huge, बलेन army, वृतम् surrounded by, विनिर्यान्तम् sallying forth, तंपुत्रम् his son, दृष्टवा seeing, अब्रवीत् spoke.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
त्वमप्रतिरथःपुत्रत्वयावैवासवोजितः । किम्पुनर्मानुषंधृष्यंनिहनिष्यसिराघवम् ।।6.73.18।। तथोक्तोराक्षसेन्द्रेणप्रत्यगृह्णान्महाशिषः ।
output: "Son! there is no adversary who can fight with you sitting in a chariot. Indra has been won by you. What to say about mortals like Rama who can be assailed by you."Rakshasa king having spoken that way, Indrajith accepted the blessings and departed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
तस्त्विन्द्रजितालङ्कासूर्यप्रतिमतेजसा ।।6.73.19।। रराजाप्रतिवीर्येणद्यौरिवार्केणभास्वता ।
output: Then Lanka shone like the Sun in the sky with Indrajith who was effulgent like the Sun and matchless in valour shone.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्प्राप्यमहातेजायुद्धभूमिमरिन्दमः ।।6.73.20।। स्थापयामासरक्षांसिरथंप्रतिसमन्ततः ।
output: महातेजाः very energetic, अरिन्दमः tamer of foes, सः he, युद्धभूमिम् battlefield, सम्प्राप्य reaching, रक्षांसि Rakshasa, रथंप्रतिसमन्ततः ranged around the chariot, स्थापयामास looked around the chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
ततस्तुहुतभोक्तारंहुतभुक्सदृशप्रभः ।।6.73.21।। जुहावराक्षसश्रेष्ठोमन्त्रवद्विधिवत्तदा ।
output: Then the foremost of Rakshasas, who was like fire god in brilliance worshipped fire god with chanting of mantras as per tradition.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
सहविर्लाजसंस्कारैर्माल्यगन्धपुरस्कृतैः ।।6.73.22।। जुहुवेपावकंतत्रराक्षनेन्द्रःप्रतापवान् ।
output: The heroic Rakshasa king worshipped according to tradition with flowers and fragrance followed by parched grain and fire god.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शस्त्राणिशरपत्राणिसमिधोऽथविभीतकाः ।।6.73.23।। लोहितानि च वासांसिस्रुवंकार्ष्णायसंतथा ।
output: स्त्राणि reed, शरपत्राणि weapons as leaves, अथ and, विभीतकाः bibitika, समिधः sticks, लोतानि red coloured, वासांसि च cloth, तथा same way, कार्ष्णायसम् ladle made of black iron, स्रुवम् to spread.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
सतत्राग्निंसमास्तीर्यशरपत्रैस्सतोमरैः ।।6.73.24।। छागस्यकृष्णवर्णस्यगळंजग्राहजीवतः ।
output: There he strewed into the fire, lances as leaves, dark coloured live go at clasped by its neck and consigned.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सकृदेवसमिद्धस्यविधूमस्यमहार्चिषः ।।6.73.25।। बभूवुस्तानिलिङ्गानिविजयंयान्यदर्शयन् ।
output: सकृदेव from the fire set ablaze, समिद्धस्य fire sticks, विधूमस्य free from smoke, महार्चिषः burst into flames, यानि those, विजयम् victory, अदर्शयन् indicating, तानि those, लिङ्गानि mark of, बभूवुः appeared.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः ।।6.72.26।। हविस्तत्प्रतिजग्राहपावकस्स्वयमास्थितः ।
output: तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः ornaments of polished gold, पावकः fire, स्वयम् itself, अस्थितः accepted, प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखः turned round towards, तत् that, हविः fire, प्रतिजग्राह in turn.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोऽस्त्रमाहारयामासब्राह्ममिन्द्ररिपुस्तदा ।।6.73.27।। धनुश्चात्मरथंचैवसर्वंतत्राभ्यमन्त्रयत् ।
output: अस्त्ररिपुः enemy of weapons, सः he, ब्राह्मम् Brahma's, इन्द्रम् weapon, आहारयामास invoked, तत्र there, धनुश्च bow, आत्मरथंचैव his own chariot also, सर्वम् all, अभ्यमन्त्रयत् charged with invocation of Brahma.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्मिन्नाहूयमानेस्त्रेहूयमाने च पावके ।।6.73.28।। सार्धंग्रहेन्दुनक्षत्रैर्वितत्रासनभस्थ्सलम् ।
output: तस्मिन् while, अस्त्रे missile, आहूयमाने invoking, पावके fire god, हूयमाने च doing fire sacrifice, सार्धंग्रहेन्दुनक्षत्रै all planets, moon, Sun and Stars, नभस्थ्सलम् in the sky, वितत्रास shook in fear.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स पावकंपावकदीप्ततेजाहुत्वामहेन्द्रप्रतिमप्रभावः । स चापबाणासिरथाश्वसूतःखेऽन्तर्दधेऽत्मानमचिन्त्यरूपः ।।6.73.29।।
output: पावकदीप्ततेजाः flaming like fire god, महेन्द्रप्रतिमप्रभावः endowed with the prowess of Indra, अचिन्त्यरूपः of inconceivable form, सः he, सचापबाणासिरथाश्वसूतः with bow, arrows and chariot, खे into the sky, आत्मानम् himself, अन्तर्दधे disappeared.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोहयरथाकीर्णंपताकाध्वजशोभितम् । निर्ययौराक्षसबलंनर्दमानंययुत्सया ।।6.73.30।।
output: Then, the Rakshasa army filled with horses and chariots, graced with pennants and flags, desiring to fight went roaring aloud.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेशरैर्बहुभिश्चित्रैस्तीक्ष्णवेगैरलङ्कृतैः । तोमरैरङ्कुशैश्चापिवानरान् जघ्नुराहवे ।।6.73.31।।
output: They began to strike Vanaras, with many wonderfully decorated, sharp and swift arrows, lances, and tridents.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
रावणिस्तुततस्सङ्कृद्धस्तान्निरीक्ष्यनिशाचरान् । हृष्टाभवन्तोयुध्यन्तुवानराणांजिघांसया ।।6.73.32।।
output: Thereafter enraged Ravana's son looking at the Rakshasas said, "Be happy and kill the Vanaras in fight."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्तेराक्षसास्सर्वेनर्धन्तोजयकाङ्क्षिणः । अभ्यवर्षंस्ततोघोरान्वानरान् शरवृष्टिभिः ।।6.73.33।।
output: Thereafter the Rakshasas roaring and longing for victory rained arrows in a terrific manner at the Vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
स तुनालीकनाराचैर्गदाभिर्मुसलैरपि । रक्षोभिस्सम्वृतस्सङ्ख्येवानरान् विचकर्त ह ।।6.73.34।।
output: Indrajith, remaining concealed and surrounded by Rakshasas, destroyed the Vanaras with nalikas, steel arrows and maces.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
तेवध्यमानास्समरेवानराःपादपायुधाः । अभ्यवर्षन्तसहसारावणिंशैलपादपैः ।।6.73.35।।
output: Struck in the battle by Indrajith, the Vanaras rained heavily armed with trees and rocks.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
इन्द्रजित्तुतदाक्रुद्धोमहातेजामहाबलः । वानराणांशरीराणिव्यधमद्रावणात्मजः ।।6.73.36।।
output: Mighty and energetic son of Ravana, Indrajith became angry and began to attack the Vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
शरेणैकेन च हरीन्नवपञ्च च सप्त च । बिभेदसमरेक्रुद्धोराक्षसान् संप्रहर्षयन् ।।6.73.37।।
output: Filled with anger, Indrajith alone with nine, five, seven arrows tore the Vanaras into pieces.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स शरैस्सूर्यसङ्काशैश्शातकुम्भविभूषितैः । वानरान् समरेवीरःप्रममाथसुदुर्जयः ।।6.73.38।।
output: Hero Indrajith, who is difficult to conquer in battle, killed the Vanaras with sun like arrows decorated with gold.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेभिन्नगात्रास्समरेवानराश्शरपीडिताः । पेतुर्मथितसङ्कल्पास्सुरैरिवमहासुराः ।।6.73.39।।
output: समरे in battle, शरपीडिताः pierced by arrows, तेवानराः those Vanaras, भिन्नगात्राः necks broken, सुरैः by asuras, महासुराःइव like great suras, मथितसङ्कल्पाः frustrated in mind, पेतुः fallen.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंतपन्तमिवादित्यंघोरैर्बाणगभस्तिभिः । अभ्यधावन्तसङ्कृद्धास्सम्युगेवानरर्षभाः ।।6.73.40।।
output: ते they, वानरर्षभाः bulls among Vanaras, सम्युगे in battle, घोरैः dreadful, बाणगभस्तिभिः arrows like Sun 's rays, तपन्तम् blazing, आदित्यम् इव like the Sun's rays, सङ्कृद्धा highly enraged, अभ्यधावन्त rushed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
ततस्तुवानरास्सर्वेभिन्नदेहाविचेतसः । व्यथिताविद्रवन्तिस्मरुधिरेणसमुक्षिताः ।।6.73.41।।
output: Then Vanaras with their bodies broken, courage and consciousness lost, blood flowed from mutilated bodies.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्यार्थेपराक्रम्यवानरास्त्यक्तजीविताः । नर्दन्तस्तेऽभिवृत्तास्तुसमरेसशिलायुधाः ।।6.73.42।।
output: Vanaras, armed with rocks in the battle, roaring and not turning back, stood for the cause, giving up their life.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेद्रुमैःपर्वताग्रैश्चशिलाभिश्चप्लवङ्गमाः । अभ्यवर्षन्तसमरेरावणिंपर्यवस्थिताः ।।6.73.43।।
output: The Vanaras retreated back to the battle and rained on Ravana's son, trees, mountains and rocks.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तद्रुमाणांशिलानां च वर्षंप्राणहरंमहत् । व्यपोहतमहातेजारावणिस्समितिंजयः ।।6.73.44।।
output: महातेजाः energetic, समितिञ्जयः ever victorious in war, रावणिः Indrajith, द्रुमाणाम् trees, शिलानां च and at rocks, प्राणहरम् that which can take out life, महत् deadly, तंवर्षम् rain, व्यपोहत dispersed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःपावकसङ्काशैश्शरैराशीविषोपमैः । वानराणामनीकानिबिभेदसमरेप्रभुः ।।6.73.45।।
output: Then the Lord of Rakshasas dispersed the complete army of Vanaras with arrows burning like fire and resembling venomous serpents.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अष्टादशशरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्सविदद्वागन्धमादनम् । विव्याथनवभिश्चैवनलंदूरादवस्थितम् ।।6.73.46।।
output: सः he, तिक्ष्णै very sharp, अष्टादशशरैः eighteen, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadana, विद्ध्वा shattered, दूरात् far away, अवस्थितम् standing, नलम् Nala also, नवभिः nine, विव्याथ shattered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सप्तभिस्तुमहावीर्योमैन्दंमर्मविदारणैः । पञ्चभिर्विशिखैश्चैवगजंविव्याथसंयुगे ।।6.73.47।।
output: Indrajith, the eminent hero, hurt Mainda in private parts and even afflicted Gaja with five spades in the battle.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
जाम्बवन्तंतुदशभिर्नीलंत्रिंशद्भिरेव च । सुग्रीवमृषभंचैवसोऽङ्गदंद्विविधंतथा ।।6.73.48।। घोरैर्दत्तवरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्निष्प्राणानकरोत्तदा ।
output: Then he struck Jambavan with ten, Neela with thirty, and Sugriva, Rshaba and Angada. In the same way Dwivida with sharp and terrific arrows that were bestowed upon him as boons and made them lose consciousness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्यानपितदामुख्यान्वानरान् बहुभिश्शरैः ।।6.73.49।। अर्दयामाससङ्कृद्धःकालानगिरिवमूर्छितः ।
output: सङ्कृद्धः highly enraged, मूर्छितः lost senses, कालानगिरिव like fire at the time of destruction, बहुभिः many, शरैः arrows, तदा then, मुख्यान् chief, अन्यान् others, वानरानपि Vanaras also, अर्दयामास tormented.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सशरैस्सूर्यसङ्काशैस्सुमुक्सैशशीघ्रगामिभिः ।।6.73.50।। वानराणामनीकानिनिर्ममन्थमहारणे ।
output: He, with his swift moving arrows, bright like the Sun , stretching to the ear hurt many vanaras in that great war.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
आकुलांवानरींसेनांशरजालेनमोहिताम् ।।6.73.51।। हृष्टस्सपरयाप्रीत्याददर्शक्षतजोक्षिताम् ।
output: Seeing the vast Vanara army deluded by the net of arrows, Indrajith was very happy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
वानरेवमहातेजाराक्षसेन्द्रात्मजोबली ।।6.73.52।। संसृज्यबाणवर्षं च शस्त्रवर्षं च दारुणम् । ममर्दवानरानीकमिन्द्रजित्त्वरितोबली ।।6.73.53।।
output: Highly energetic, mighty, and swift Indrajith raining sharp arrows and weapons quickly Devastated the Vanara army.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
वानरेवमहातेजाराक्षसेन्द्रात्मजोबली ।।6.73.52।। संसृज्यबाणवर्षं च शस्त्रवर्षं च दारुणम् । ममर्दवानरानीकमिन्द्रजित्त्वरितोबली ।।6.73.53।।
output: Highly energetic, mighty, and swift Indrajith raining sharp arrows and weapons quickly Devastated the Vanara army.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्वसैन्यमुत्सृज्यसमेत्यतूर्णंमहारणेवानरवाहिनीषु । अदृश्यमानश्शरजालमुग्रंववर्षनीलाम्बुधरोयथाम्बु ।।6.73.54।।
output: स्वसैन्यम् his own army, उत्सृज्य leaving, तूर्णम् moving swiftly, महारणे great battle, समेत्य staying, अदृश्यमानः concealed, वानरवाहिनीषु from Vanara army, उग्रम् sharp, शरजालम् arrows of net, नीलाम्बुधरः from the blue sky, अम्बुयथा like rainy cloud, ववर्ष rained.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
तेशक्रजिद्बाणविशीर्णदेहामायाहताविस्वरमुन्नदन्तः । रणेनिपेतुर्हरयोऽद्रिकल्पायथेन्द्रवज्राभिहतानगेन्द्राः ।।6.73.55।।
output: In the battle, the Vanaras who were like mountains, became victims of cheating, and were struck by Indrajith's thunderbolt like arrows. Their bodies were broken and shrieking in discordant tones they fell like mountains.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेकेवलंसन्ददृशुशशिताग्रान्बाणान्रणेवानरवाहिनीषु । मायानिगूढंतुसुरेन्द्रशत्रुं न चावृतंराक्षसमभ्यपश्यन् ।।6.73.56।।
output: रणे in war, ते they, वानरवाहिनीषु only Vanara troops, केवलम् alone, सिताग्रान् sharp pointed, बाणान् arrows, सन्ददृशुः saw, आवृतम् covering them, मायाविगूढम् magical power, सुरेन्द्रशत्रुम् enemy of Indra, तंराक्षसम् अपि those Rakshasas also, न अपश्यन् not seen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततस्सरक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मासर्वादिशोबाणगणैशशिताग्रैः । प्रच्छादयामासरविप्रकाशैर्विपादयामास च वानरेन्द्रान् ।।6.73.57।।
output: Thereafter the mighty Lord of Rakshasas despatched volley of sharp tipped arrows bright like the Sun, at Vanara leaders on all sides and eradicated.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स शूलनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वधानिव्याविध्यदीप्तानलसन्निभानि । सविस्फुलिङ्गोज्ज्वलपावकानिववर्षतीव्रंप्लवगेन्द्रसैन्ये ।।6.73.58।।
output: सः he, व्याविध्यदीप्तानिलसन्निभानि glowing like fire sacrifice, सविस्फुलिङ्गोज्ज्वलपावकानि flames with sparks of fire, शूलनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वधानिtridents, swords and axes, तीव्रम् violent, प्लवगेन्द्रसैन्ये Vanara army, ववर्ष rained.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोज्वलनसङ्काशैश्शरैर्वानरयूथपाः । ताडिताश्शक्रजिद्बाणैःप्रफुल्लाइवकिंशुकाः ।।6.73.59।।
output: Struck by Indrajith's arrows, the (bodies of) Vanara troops were glowing like Kimsuka trees (red in colour) bearing flowers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेन्योन्यमभिसर्पन्तोनिनदन्तश्चविस्वरम् । राक्षसेन्द्रास्त्रनिर्भिन्नानिपेतुर्वानरर्षभाः ।।6.73.60।।
output: Hit by the Rakshasa king, the bulls among Vanaras gliding towards one another roared in discordant tones and fell down.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उदीक्षमाणागगनंकेचिन्नेत्रेषुताडिताः । शरैर्विविशुरन्योन्यंपेतुश्चजगतीतले ।।6.73.61।।
output: गगनम् sky, उदीक्षमाणाः looking up, केचित् some, शरैः arrows, नेत्रेषु in the eyes, ताडिताः pierced, अन्योन्यम् one another, विविशुः holding, जगतीतले on the ground, पेतुश्च fell.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हनूमन्तं च सुग्रीवमङ्गदंगन्धमादनम् । जाम्बवन्तंसुषेणं च वेगदर्शिनमेव च ।।6.73.62।। मैन्दं च द्विविदंनीलंगवाक्षंगजगोमुभौ । केसरिंहरिलोमानंविद्युद्धंष्ट्रं च वानरम् ।।6.73.63।। सूर्याननंज्योतिमुखंतथादधिमुखंहरिम् । पावकाक्षनळंचैवकुमुदंचैववानरम् ।।6.73.64।। प्रसैश्शूलैश्शितैर्बाणैरिन्द्रजिन्मन्त्रसम्हितैः । विव्याधहरिशार्दूलान् सर्वांस्तान्राक्षसोत्तमः ।।6.73.65।।
output: Indrajith, the foremost of the Rakshasas, with lances, tridents, sharp arrows charged with mantras pierced at all the tigers among Vanaras --Hanuman, Sugriva, Angada, Gandhamadanam, Jambavantha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Mainda, Dwivida, Neela, Gavaksha, Vidyuuhamshtra, and monkeys Suryanana, Jyothimukha, Dadhimukha, Pavaksha, and also Nala, Kumuda.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
हनूमन्तं च सुग्रीवमङ्गदंगन्धमादनम् । जाम्बवन्तंसुषेणं च वेगदर्शिनमेव च ।।6.73.62।। मैन्दं च द्विविदंनीलंगवाक्षंगजगोमुभौ । केसरिंहरिलोमानंविद्युद्धंष्ट्रं च वानरम् ।।6.73.63।। सूर्याननंज्योतिमुखंतथादधिमुखंहरिम् । पावकाक्षनळंचैवकुमुदंचैववानरम् ।।6.73.64।। प्रसैश्शूलैश्शितैर्बाणैरिन्द्रजिन्मन्त्रसम्हितैः । विव्याधहरिशार्दूलान् सर्वांस्तान्राक्षसोत्तमः ।।6.73.65।।
output: Indrajith, the foremost of the Rakshasas, with lances, tridents, sharp arrows charged with mantras pierced at all the tigers among Vanaras --Hanuman, Sugriva, Angada, Gandhamadanam, Jambavantha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Mainda, Dwivida, Neela, Gavaksha, Vidyuuhamshtra, and monkeys Suryanana, Jyothimukha, Dadhimukha, Pavaksha, and also Nala, Kumuda.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 73:
हनूमन्तं च सुग्रीवमङ्गदंगन्धमादनम् । जाम्बवन्तंसुषेणं च वेगदर्शिनमेव च ।।6.73.62।। मैन्दं च द्विविदंनीलंगवाक्षंगजगोमुभौ । केसरिंहरिलोमानंविद्युद्धंष्ट्रं च वानरम् ।।6.73.63।। सूर्याननंज्योतिमुखंतथादधिमुखंहरिम् । पावकाक्षनळंचैवकुमुदंचैववानरम् ।।6.73.64।। प्रसैश्शूलैश्शितैर्बाणैरिन्द्रजिन्मन्त्रसम्हितैः । विव्याधहरिशार्दूलान् सर्वांस्तान्राक्षसोत्तमः ।।6.73.65।।
output: Indrajith, the foremost of the Rakshasas, with lances, tridents, sharp arrows charged with mantras pierced at all the tigers among Vanaras --Hanuman, Sugriva, Angada, Gandhamadanam, Jambavantha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Mainda, Dwivida, Neela, Gavaksha, Vidyuuhamshtra, and monkeys Suryanana, Jyothimukha, Dadhimukha, Pavaksha, and also Nala, Kumuda.
