instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पताकाध्वजसंसक्तमुत्तमासिपरश्वधम् । भीमाश्वरथमातङ्गंनानापततिसमाकुलम् ।।6.75.55।। दीप्तशूलगदाखडगप्रासतोमरकार्मुकम् । तद्राक्षसबलंघोरभीमंविक्रमपौरुषम् ।।6.75.56।। ददृशेज्वलितप्रासंकिङ्किणीशतनादितम् । हेमजालाचितभुजंव्यावेष्टितपरश्वथम् ।।6.75.57।। व्याघूर्णितमहाशस्त्रंबाणसंसक्तकार्मुकम् । गन्धमाल्यमधूत्सेकसम्मोदितमहानिलम् ।।6.75.58।।
output: Then the Rakshasa army appeared terrific, fixed with flags and poles, equipped with best of axes, horses yoked to formidable chariots and elephants different kinds of foot soldiers, distinguished by wielding shining tridents, maces, swords spears and lances warriors of frightening valour and prowess holding shining barbed missiles hundreds of tiny bells tied to the chariots and elephants making noise  warriors endowed with arms decorated with gold, with axes and weapons to pierce arrows fixed to the bows, with an abundance of fragrance.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
घोरंशूरजनाकीर्णंमहाम्बुदरनिस्स्वनम् । तद्दृष्टवाबलमायातंराक्षसानांसुदारुणं ।।6.75.59।। सञ्चचालप्लवङ्गानांबलमुच्चैर्ननाद च ।
output: Crowded with fierce warriors coming like thundering rainy clouds, the Rakshasas, and the monkey troops coming forward made loud noises with an elevated tone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 75:
जवेनाफ्लुत्य च पुनस्तद्बलंरक्षसांमहत् ।।6.75.60।। अभ्ययात्प्रत्यरिबलंपतङ्गाइवपावकम् ।
output: The great army of Rakshasas rushed towards the hostile army just as moths flew up towards flame.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेषांभुजपरामर्शव्यामृष्टपरिघाशनि ।।6.75.61।। राक्षसानांबलंश्रेष्ठंभूयस्तरमशोभत ।
output: तेषांराक्षसानाम् by the Rakshasas, भुजपरामर्शव्यामृष्टपरिघाशनि Clubs and Asanis brandished by rubbing with the arms, श्रेष्ठम् great, बलम् army, भूयः appeared, परम् very, अशोभत brightly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत्रोन्मत्ताइवोत्पेतुर्हरयोऽथयुयुत्सवः ।।6.75.62।। तरुशैलैरभिघ्नन्तोमुष्टिभिश्चनिशाचरान् ।
output: अथ and now, तत्र there, युयुत्सवः eager, हरयः monkeys, निशाचरान् night rangers, तरुशैलैः with trees and rocks, मुष्टिभिः च and fists, अभिघ्नन्तः striking, उन्मत्ताःइव as if gone mad, उत्पेतुः rose up.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथैवापततांतेषांकपीनामसिभिशशितैः ।।6.75.63।। शिरांसिसहसाजह्रूराक्षसाभीमदर्शना ।
output: तथैव in that manner, दर्शना showed up, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, आपतताम् approaching, तेषांकपीनाम् those monkeys, शिरांसि head, सहसा instantly, शितैः sharp swords, जह्रुः cut off.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दशनैर्हतकर्णाश्चमुष्टिनिष्कीर्णमस्तकाः ।।6.75.64।। शिलाप्रहारभग्नाङ्गाविचेरुस्तत्रराक्षसाः ।
output: तत्र there, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, दशनैः teeth, हतकर्णाः , ears bitten off मुष्टिः with fist, निष्कीर्णमस्तकाः skulls smashed, शिलाप्रहारभग्नाङ्गाः limbs broken with blows of rocks, विचेरुः moved about.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तथैवाप्यपरेतेषांकपीनामभिलक्षिता ।।6.75.65।। प्रवीरानभितोजघ्नुर्घोररूपानिशाचराः ।
output: तथैव in the same way, घोररूपाः of terrific appearance, अपरे more, निशाचराः night rangers, शितैः sharp, असिभिः with swords, तेषाम् those, कपिनाम् Vanaras, प्रवीरान् great heroes, अभितः in front, जघ्नुः struck.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
घ्नन्तमन्यंजघानान्यःपातयन्तमपातयत् ।।6.75.66।। गर्हमाणंजगर्हेऽन्योदशन्तमपरोऽदशत् ।
output: घ्नन्तम् struck, अन्यम् other, अन्यः other, जघान striking, पातयन्तम् throwing down, अपातयत् thrown, गर्हमाणम् reproach contemptuously, अन्यः other, जगर्हः abused, दशन्तम् one who is biting, अपरः other, अदशत् bitten.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देहीत्यन्योददात्यन्योददामीत्यपरःपुनः ।।6.75.67।। किंक्लेशयसितिष्ठेतितत्रान्योन्यंबभाषिरे ।
output: There they conversed this way with one another 'One said hit me and another one offered to hit,', again another intervened and said, 'Why are you crying?' meaning I offer resistance, one said 'Why are you suffering like this?'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विप्रलम्भितवस्त्रं च विमुक्तकवचायुधम् ।।6.75.68।। समुद्यतमहाप्रासंयष्टिशूलासिसङ्कुलम् । प्रावर्ततमहारौद्रंयुद्धंवानररक्षसाम् ।।6.75.69।।
output: Highly enraged Vanaras and Rakshasas fought with them, raiment slipping, shields and weapons dodged, huge lances lifted to fight. They used fists, tridents, spears, and swords.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विप्रलम्भितवस्त्रं च विमुक्तकवचायुधम् ।।6.75.68।। समुद्यतमहाप्रासंयष्टिशूलासिसङ्कुलम् । प्रावर्ततमहारौद्रंयुद्धंवानररक्षसाम् ।।6.75.69।।
output: Highly enraged Vanaras and Rakshasas fought with them, raiment slipping, shields and weapons dodged, huge lances lifted to fight. They used fists, tridents, spears, and swords.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 75:
वानरान्दशसप्तेतिराक्षसाजघ्नुराहवे । राक्षसान्दशसप्तेतिवानराश्चाभ्यपातयन् ।।6.75.70।।
output: In that fight the Rakshasas killed the Vanaras at the rate of ten to seven and the Vanaras struck down Rakshasas at the rate of ten to seven.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रवृत्तेसङ्कुलेतस्मिन् घोरेवीरजनक्ष्ये । अङ्गदःकम्पनंवीरमाससादरणोत्सुकः ।।6.76.1।।
output: Angada kills Kampana and Prajaghna, Dwivida kills Sonithaksha, Mainda kills Yupaksha and Sugriva kills Kumbha in the terrific encounter between Rakshasas and Vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
आहूयसोङ्गदंकोपात्ताडयामासवेगितः । गदयाकम्पनःपूर्वं स चचालभृशाहतः ।।6.76.2।।
output: Kampana struck Angada challenging himin anticipation. He swiftly hurled a mace in anger and hurt him grievously and Angada reeled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स संज्ञांप्राप्यतेजस्वीचिक्षेपशिखरंगिरेः । अर्दितस्तत्प्रहारेणकम्पनःपतितोभुवि ।।6.76.3।।
output: तेजस्वी rejuvenated, सः he, संज्ञाम् regaining consciousness, प्राप्य acquired, गिरेः mountain, शिखरम् peak, चिक्षेप shattered, कम्पनः Kampana, प्रहारेण blow, अर्दितः wounded, भुवि ground, पतितः fell.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
ततस्तुकम्पनंदृष्टवाशोणिताक्षोहतंरणे । रथेनाभ्यपतत् क्षिप्रंतत्राङ्गदमभीतवत् ।।6.76.4।।
output: Then seeing Kampana killed, Sonitaksha, a fearless hero, quickly reached Angada by chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
सोङ्गदंनिशितैर्बाणैस्तदाविव्याधवेगितः । शरीरदारणैस्तीक्ष्णैःकालाग्निसमविग्रहैः ।।6.76.5।। क्षुरक्षुरप्रैर्नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्शिलीमुखैः । कर्णिशल्यविपाठैश्चबहुभिश्चशितैश्शरैः ।।6.76.6।।
output: He (Sonitaksha) swiftly pierced with pointed shafts resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution and struck Angada with arrows known by names, Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, Vatsadanta, Silimukha, Karni, Salya, vipada and many sharp arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सोङ्गदंनिशितैर्बाणैस्तदाविव्याधवेगितः । शरीरदारणैस्तीक्ष्णैःकालाग्निसमविग्रहैः ।।6.76.5।। क्षुरक्षुरप्रैर्नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्शिलीमुखैः । कर्णिशल्यविपाठैश्चबहुभिश्चशितैश्शरैः ।।6.76.6।।
output: सः he, वेगितः swiftly, शरीरदारणैः piercing shafts, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, कालाग्निसमविग्रहैः resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution, निशितैः sharp, बाणैः shafts, अङ्गदम् Angada, विव्याध struck, क्षुरक्षुरप्रनाराचैः known as Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, वत्सदन्सैः Vatsadanta, शिलीमुखैः Silimukha, कर्णिशल्यविपादैःच Karni, Salya, Vipada, निशितैः sharp, बहुभिश्च many, शरैः arrows.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गदःप्रतिविद्धाङ्गोवालिपुत्रःप्रतापवान् । धनुरग्य्रंरथंबाणान्ममर्दतरसाबली ।।6.76.7।।
output: Courageous son of Vali, the mighty Angada encountered with vigour and crumbled the formidable bow (of Sonitaksha), his chariot and arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शोणिताक्षस्ततःक्षिप्रमसिचर्मसमाददे । उत्पपातदिवंक्रुद्धोवेगवानविचारयन् ।।6.76.8।।
output: ततः there upon, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, क्षिप्रम् quickly, असिचर्म sword, समाददे shield, दिवम् to the sky, क्रुद्धः enraged, वेगवान् at high speed, अविचारयन् unhesitatingly, उत्पपात sprang up.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंक्षिप्रतरमाफ्लुत्यपरामृश्याङ्गदोबली । करेणतस्यतंखङ्गंसमाच्छिद्यननाद च ।।6.76.9।।
output: Mighty Angada springing up at a higher speed grasped his (Sonitaksha) hand and irritated him with a sword making loud noise.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
तस्यांसफलकेखडगंनिजघानततोऽङ्गदः । यज्ञोपवीतवच्चैनंचिच्छेदकपिकुञ्जरः ।।6.76.10।।
output: Then Angada pierced his sword on the fl at surface of his shoulder diagonally and cut him with his sword.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंप्रगृह्यमहाखडगंविनद्य च पुनःपुनः । वालिपुत्रोऽभिदुद्रावरणशीर्षेपरानरीन् ।।6.76.11।।
output: Vali's son, seizing that great sword again and again, roaring to finally terminate the remaining Rakshasas, went forward.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आयसींतुगदांप्रगृह्य स वीरःकनकाङ्गदः । शोणिताक्षस्समाविध्यतमेवानुपपात ह ।।6.76.12।।
output: वीरः hero, कनकाङ्गदः adorned with golden armlets, सः he, शोणिताः Sonitha, समाविध्य recovering, आयसीम् iron, गदाम् mace, प्रगृह्य taking hold, तमेव with that, अनुपपात ह rushed behind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रजङ्घसहितोवीरोयूपाक्षस्तुततोबली । रथेनाभिययौक्रुद्दोवालिपुत्रंमहाबलम् ।।6.76.13।।
output: Then mighty Yupaksha, and Prajaghna for his part in fury assailed mighty Angada's chariot.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तयोर्मध्येकपिश्रेष्ठश्शोणिताक्षप्रजङ्घयोः । विशाखयोर्मध्यगतःपूर्णचन्द्रइवाभवत् ।।6.76.14।।
output: Angada, the foremost of Vanaras, coming between both Sonitaksha and Prajaghna shone like a full moon between the Visakha stars.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अङ्गदंपरिरक्षन्तौमैन्दोद्विविदएव च । तस्यतस्थतुरभ्याशेपरस्परदिदृक्ष्या ।।6.76.15।।
output: मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदःएव even Dwivida, अङ्गदम् Angada, परिरक्षन्तौ for protection, परस्परदीदृक्ष्या one another to hold in check, तस्य his, अभ्याशे facing the enemy, तस्थतुः took position.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
भिपेतुर्महाकायाःप्रतियत्तामहाबलाः । राक्षसावानरान् रोषादसिचर्मगदाधराः ।।6.76.16।।
output: Rakshasas wielding swords and mace, endowed with stupendous strength and of huge body agitated and assailed Vanaras.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्रयाणांवानरेन्द्राणांत्रिभीराक्षसपुङ्गवैः । संसक्तानांमहद्युद्धमभवद्रोमहर्षणम् ।।6.76.17।।
output: A momentous war took place between the three Rakshasas (Prajaghna, Yupaksha and Sonitaksha) and Vanara chiefs (Angada, Dwivida and Mainda) that caused horripilation.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेतुवृक्षान् समादायसम्प्रचिपुराहवे । खडगेनप्रतिचिच्छेदतान् प्रजङ्घोमहाबलः ।।6.76.18।।
output: आहवे in the combat, ते they, वृक्षान् trees, समादाय taking, सम्प्रचिक्षिपुः at that time shattered, महाबलः mighty, प्रजङ्घः Prajaghana, खडगेन with sword, तान् them, प्रतिचिच्छेद violently hurled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रथानश्वान् द्रुमैश्शैलैस्तेप्रचिक्षिपुराहवे । शरौघैःप्रतिचिच्छेदतान्यूपाक्षोनिशाचरः ।।6.76.19।।
output: आहवे in that war, रथान् chariots, अश्वान् horses, द्रुमान् trees, शैलान् rocks, प्रतिचिक्षिपुः encountered, निशाचरः night rangers, यूपाक्षः Yupaksha, तान् them, शरौघैः tore them चिच्छेद , shattered.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सृष्टाव्निविदमैन्दाभ्यांद्रुमानुत्पाट्यवीर्यवान् । बभञ्जगदयामध्येशोणिताक्षःप्रतापवान् ।।6.76.20।।
output: Heroic and courageous Sonitaksha tore the trees hurled by Dwivida and Mainda in midway by his mace and crushed them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उद्यम्यविपुलंखडगंपरमर्मनिकृन्तनम् । प्रजङ्घोवालिपुत्रायअभिदुद्राववेगितः ।।6.76.21।।
output: Prajaghna taking up a huge sword went forward swiftly and assailed Angada.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
तमभ्याशगतंदृष्टवावानरेन्द्रोमहाबलः । आजघानाश्वकर्णेनद्रुमेणातिबलस्तदा ।।6.76.22।।
output: Then Vanara leader Angada who was endowed with extraordinary strength, seeing Prajaghna of stupendous power coming forward, hit him with Aswakarna tree.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
बाहुंचास्यसनिस्त्रिंशमाजघान स मुष्टिना । वालिपुत्रस्यघातेन स पपातक्षितावसिः ।।6.76.23।।
output: Angada hit the shoulder of Prajaghna which held the sword, with his fist. By that blow the sword got broken and dropped down

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंदृष्टवापतितंभूमौखङ्गमुलसन्निभम् । मुष्टिंसम्वर्तयामासवज्रकल्पंमहाबलः ।।6.76.24।।
output: भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, मुलसन्निभम् pestle shape, तंखङ्गम् that sword, दृष्टवा seeing, महाबलः mighty, वज्रकल्पम् hard as thunderbolt, मुष्टिम् fist, सम्वर्तयामास clenched.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
स ललाटेमहावीर्यमङ्गदंवानरर्षभम् । आजघानमहातेजास्समुहूर्तंचचाल ह ।।6.76.25।।
output: Sonitaksha of extraordinary energy hit at the forehead of highly valiant Angada. For a while Angada was unable to move.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
स संज्ञांप्राप्यतेजस्वीवालिपुत्रःप्रतापवान् । प्रजङ्घस्यशिरःकायातखङ्गेनपातयत्क्षितौ ।।6.76.26।।
output: Son of Vali, who was full of vigour, on regaining consciousness hit Prajaghna on the head and trunk and made him fall down.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
स यूपाक्षोऽश्रुपूर्णाक्षःपितृव्येनिहतेरणे । अवरुह्यरथात्क्षिप्रंक्षीणेषुखङ्गमाददे ।।6.76.27।।
output: Instantly alighting from the chariot, Yupaksha seeing the uncle exhausted and hurt, eyes filled with tears, he wielded the sword.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
तमापतन्तंसम्प्रेक्ष्ययूपाक्षंद्विविदस्त्वरन् । आजघानोरसिक्रुद्धोजग्राह च बलाद्बली ।।6.76.28।।
output: Observing Yupakasha fallen and rushing quickly, furious Dwivida struck him in the bosom with force and caught him

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गृहीतंभ्रातरंदृष्टवाशोणिताक्षोमहाबलः । आजघानगदाग्रेणवक्षसिद्विविदंततः ।।6.76.29।।
output: ततः then, गदाग्रेण with the mace, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, महाबलम् of great strength, भ्रातरम् brother, गृहीतम् being caught, दृष्टवा seeing, द्विविदम् Dwivida, वक्षसि from the bosom, आजघान struck.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स गदाभिहतस्तेनसञ्चचालमहाबलः । उद्यता च पुनस्तस्यजहारद्विविदोगदाम् ।।6.76.30।।
output: Dwivida, though mighty reeled and could not move when struck by Sonitaksha. He got up and again and snatched the mace from Sonithaksha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
तस्मिन्नन्तरेमैन्दोवीरोवानरयूथपः । यूपाक्षंताडयामासतलेनोरसिवीर्यवान् ।।6.76.31।।
output: In the meantime, valiant Vanara leader Mainda arrived and struck with his palm on the chest of Yupaksha.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
तौशोणिताक्ष्यूपाक्षौप्लवङ्गाभ्यांतरस्विनौ । चक्रतुस्समरेतीव्रमाकर्षोत्पाटनंभृशम् ।।6.76.32।।
output: In that fight, courageous Sonitaksha and Yupaksha contested with the two monkeys pulling one another violently and throwing intensely.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
द्विविदश्शोणिताक्षंतुविददारनखैर्मुखै । निष्पिपेष च वेगेनक्षितावाविध्यवीर्यवान् ।।6.76.33।।
output: वीर्यवान् valiant, द्विविदः Dwivida, नखैः nails, शोणिताक्षम् Sonitaksha, मुखे face, विददार tearing, वेगेन quickening his pace, क्षितौ on the surface of the ground, आविध्य thrown with force, निष्पिपेष च bruising.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
पाक्षमभिसङ्कृद्धो मैन्दो वानरयूथपः । पीडयामासबाहुभ्यांसपपातहतःक्षितौ ।।6.76.34।।
output: Vanara leader, Mainda on his part, angrily pierced Yupaksha many times who fell on the ground dead.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
हतप्रवीराव्यथिताराक्षसेन्द्रचमूस्तदा । जगामाभिमुखीसातुकुम्भकर्णसुतोयतः ।।6.76.35।।
output: Then many heroes died, Rakshasa king's army was distressed and went towards where Kumbhakarna's son was fighting.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
आपततनीं च वेगेनकुम्भस्तांसान्त्वयच्चमूम् । अथोत्कष्टंमहावीर्यैर्लब्धलक्ष्यैःप्लवङ्गमैः ।।6.76.36।। निपातितमहावीरांदृष्टवारक्षश्चमूंततः । कुम्भःप्रचक्रेतेजस्वीरणेकर्मसुदुष्करम् ।।6.76.37।।
output: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
आपततनीं च वेगेनकुम्भस्तांसान्त्वयच्चमूम् । अथोत्कष्टंमहावीर्यैर्लब्धलक्ष्यैःप्लवङ्गमैः ।।6.76.36।। निपातितमहावीरांदृष्टवारक्षश्चमूंततः । कुम्भःप्रचक्रेतेजस्वीरणेकर्मसुदुष्करम् ।।6.76.37।।
output: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स धनुर्धन्विनांश्रेष्ठःप्रगृह्यसुसमाहितः । मुमोचाशीविषप्रख्यान्शरान्देहविदारणान् ।।6.76.38।।
output: He (Kumbha), the foremost wielder of bow, taking up the bow, remaining fully composed released arrows that resembled poisonous serpents capable of tearing the flesh.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यतच्छुशुभेभूयस्सशरंधनुरुत्तमम् । विद्युदैरावतार्चिष्मद्िद्वतीयेन्द्रधनुर्यथा ।।6.76.39।।
output: सशरम् those arrows, उत्तमम् best, तस्य his, तत् that, धनुः bow, विद्युदैरावतार्चिष्मत् shining like the cloud with flashes of lightning, द्वितीयेन्द्रधनुः second bow of Indra यथा like that, भूयः shone, शुशुभे released.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आकर्णाकृष्टमुक्तेनजघानद्विविदंतदा । तेनहाटकपुङ्खेनपत्रतिणापत्त्रवाससा ।।6.76.40।।
output: Then he struck Dwivida with a golden shafted arrow that was loosened to kill by stretching the bow till the ear and released.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
सहसाभिहतस्तेनविप्रमुक्तपदस्स्फुरन् । निपपाताद्रिकूटाभोविह्वलन् प्लवगोत्तमः ।।6.76.41।।
output: Struck all of a sudden, the foremost Vanara (Dwivida) alarmed, fell with legs, outstretched, trembling.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मन्दस्तुभ्रातरंभग्नंदृष्टवातत्रमहाहवे । लभिदुद्राववेगेनप्रगृह्यमहतींशिलाम् ।।6.76.42।।
output: Seeing the brother shattered in the great combat, Mainda on his part seizing a huge rock rushed swiftly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तांशिलांतुप्रचिक्षेपराक्षसायमहाबलः । बिभेदतांशिलांकुम्भःप्रसन्नैःपञ्चभिश्शरैः ।।6.76.43।।
output: महाबलः mighty, ताम् him, शिलाम् rock, राक्षसाय Rakshasa, प्रचिक्षेप hurled to crush, कुम्भः Kumbha, प्रसन्नैः sharp, पञ्चभिः five, शरैः arrows, तांशिलाम् that rock, बिभेद broken.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सन्धायचान्यंसुमुखंशरमाशीविषोपमम् । आजघानमहातेजावक्षसिद्विविदाग्रजम् ।।6.76.44।।
output: महातेजाः haughty, सुमुख arrow म् charming, आशीविषोपमम् resembling venomous serpent, अन्यम् another, शरम् arrow, सन्धाय fixing, द्विविदाग्रजम् Dwivida's brother, वक्षसि on the chest, आजघान struck.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तुतेनप्रहारेणमैन्दोवानरयूथपः । मर्मण्यभिहतस्तेनपपा त भुविमूर्छितः ।।6.76.45।।
output: वानरयूथपः Vanara leader, सःमैन्दः that Mainda, तेन by that, प्रहरेण blow, तेन his, मर्मणि private, अभिहतः hit, मूर्छितः lost consciousness, भुवि ground, पपात fell.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
अङ्गदोमातुलौदृष्टवापथितौतुमहाबलौ । अभिदुद्राववेगेनकुम्भमुद्यतकार्मुकम् ।।6.76.46।।
output: Seeing the two maternal uncles fallen, Angada, who was endowed with great strength, attacked Kumbha, wielding a bow.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमापतन्तंविव्याधकुम्भःपञ्चभिरायसैः । त्रिभिश्चान्यैश्शितैर्बाणैर्मातङ्गमिवतोमरैः ।।6.76.47।।
output: Kumbha seeing Angada advancing towards him, with five steel arrows and three shafts pierced him just as an elephant is pierced with lances.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
सोऽङ्गदंविविधैभिर्बाणैःकुम्भोविव्याथवीर्यवान् । अकुण्ठधारैर्निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैःकनकभूषणैः ।।6.76.48।।
output: Kumbha, a valiant hero pierced Angada continuously with several sharp and pointed arrows decked with gold.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गदःप्रतिविद्धाङ्गोवालिपुत्रो न कम्पते । शिलापादपवर्षाणितस्यमूर्ध्निववर्ष ह ।।6.76.49।।
output: Vali's son was not shaken by the strike, showered rain of rocks and trees on his (Kumbha) forehead.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
स प्रचिच्छेदतान् सर्वान् बिभेद च पुनश्शिलाः । कुम्भकर्णात्मजश्रशीमान् वालिपुत्त्रसमीरितान् ।।6.76.50।।
output: Prosperous Kumbhakarna's son also shattered the rocks hurled on him, breaking them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आपतन्तं च ससम्प्रेक्ष्यकुम्भोवानरयूथपम् । भ्रुवोर्विव्याथबाणाभ्यामुल्काभ्यामिवकुञ्जरम् ।।6.76.51।।
output: कुम्भः Kumbha, आपतन्तम् coming towards, वानरयूथपम् Vanara leaders, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing, उल्काभ्याम् fire sticks, कुञ्जरम् इव like elephant, बाणाभ्याम् with arrows, भ्रुवोः eyebrows, विव्याध pierced.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यसुस्रावरुधिरंपिहितेचास्यलोचने । अङ्गदःपाणिनानेत्रेपिधायरुधिरोक्षिते ।।6.76.52।। सालमासन्नमेकेनपरिजग्राहपाणिवा ।
output: Blood flowed from his injured eyes and his eyes got veiled by blood. Covering his eyes with one hand he took hold of a Sal tree nearby.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सम्पीड्यरसिचास्कन्धम् करेणाभिनिवेश्य च ।।6.76.53।। किञ्चिदभ्यवनम्यैनमुन्ममाथयथागजः ।
output: Compressing the trunk of the tree on the chest with one hand and bending forward a little its branches with another hand, he (Angada) tore Kumbha in that way in the great fight like an elephant.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तमिन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमंवृक्षंमन्दरसन्निभम् ।।6.76.54।। समुत्सृजन्तंवेगेनपश्यतांसर्वरक्षसाम् ।
output: सर्वरक्षसाम् all Rakshasas, पश्यताम् seeing, इन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमम् resembling Indra's banner, मन्दरसन्निभम् like the Mandara mountain, तंवृक्षम् that tree, वेगेन hurriedly, समुत्सृजन्तम् impatiently.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सबिभेदशितैर्बाणैस्सप्तभिःकायभेदनैः ।।6.76.55।। अङ्गदोविव्यधेऽभीक्षणंससादचमुमोह च ।
output: सः he, कायभेदनैः tearing the body, शितैः sharp, सप्तभिः seven, बाणैः arrows, चिच्छेद shattered, सः , अङ्गदः that Angada, अभीक्ष्णम् immediately, विव्यथे pained, ससादच screaming, मुमोह च lost senses.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अङ्गदंव्यथितंदृष्टवासीदन्तमिवसागरम् ।।6.76.56।। दुरासदंहरिश्रेष्ठंरामायन्येन्यवेदयन् ।
output: Seeing the foremost Vanara, Angada who was difficult to encounter fell and like sinking into the ocean of despondency, the foremost Vanaras submitted to Rama.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामस्तुव्यथितंश्रुत्वावालिपुत्त्रंरणाजरे ।।6.76.57।। व्यादिदेशहरिश्रेष्ठान्जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्ततः ।
output: ततः then, रामः Rama, रणाजरे in the battlefield, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, व्यथितम् pained, श्रुत्वा hearing, जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् Jambavan and other leaders, हरिश्रेष्ठान् best of monkeys, व्यादेश ordered.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेतुवानरशार्दूलाश्श्रुत्वारामस्यशासनम् ।।6.76.58।। अभिपेतुस्सुसङ्कृद्धाःकुम्भमुद्यतकार्मुकम् ।
output: ते those, वानरशार्दूलाः Vanara tigers, रामस्य Rama's, शासनम् command, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुसङ्कृद्धाः very angry, उद्यतकार्मुकम् took up his bow, कुम्भम् Kumbha, अभिपेतुः to attack.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोद्रुमशिलाहस्ताःकोपसंरक्तलोचनाः ।।6.76.59।। रिरक्षिषन्तोऽभ्यपतन्नङ्गदंवानरर्षभाः ।
output: Bulls among Vanaras then took trees, and rocks in hand, with their eyes red in anger started for the protection of Angada.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जाम्बवांश्चसुषेणश्चवेगदर्शी च वानरः ।।6.76.60।। कुम्भकर्णात्मजंवीरंक्रुद्धास्समभिदुद्रुवुः ।
output: Jambavan, Sushena, Vegadarsi and other heroic Vanaras, full of anger also rushed to assail Kumbhakarna's son.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
समीक्ष्यापततस्तांस्तुवानरेन्द्रान् महाबलान् ।।6.76.61।। आववारशरौघेणनगेनेवजलाशयम् ।
output: Perceiving that great army of Vanara leaders are advancing, Kumbha obstructed them with a volley of arrows just like a mountain obstructing the path of torrent.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यबाणपथंप्राप्य न शेकुरतिवर्तितुम् ।।6.76.62।। वानरेन्द्रामहात्मानोवेलामिवमहादधिः ।
output: The Vanara leaders could not bear the range of arrows of Kumbhaka, just as a tide can't overstep the shore of an ocean.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांस्तुदृष्टवाहरिगणान् शरवृष्टिभिरर्दितान् ।।6.76.63।। अङ्गदंपृष्ठतःकृत्वाभ्रातृजंप्लवगेश्वरः । भिदुद्राववेगेनसुग्रीवःकुम्भमाहवे ।।6.76.64।। शैलसानुचरंनागंवेगवानिवकेसरी ।
output: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांस्तुदृष्टवाहरिगणान् शरवृष्टिभिरर्दितान् ।।6.76.63।। अङ्गदंपृष्ठतःकृत्वाभ्रातृजंप्लवगेश्वरः । भिदुद्राववेगेनसुग्रीवःकुम्भमाहवे ।।6.76.64।। शैलसानुचरंनागंवेगवानिवकेसरी ।
output: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्पाट्य च महाशैलनश्वकर्णान्दवान्बहून् ।।6.76.65।। अन्यांश्चविविधान्ववृक्षाचिक्षेपचिमहाबलः ।
output: Mighty strong he was, uprooting Aswakarna and many other several kinds of trees he hurled at them (Rakshasas).

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तांछादयन्तीमाकाशंवृक्षवृष्टिंदुरासदाम् ।।6.76.66।। कुम्भकर्णात्मजश्शीघ्रंचिच्छेदनिशितैश्शरैः ।
output: शीघ्रं frenzied, कुम्भकर्णात्मजः Kumbhakarna's son, आकाशम् space, छादयन्तीम् covering, दुरासदाम् difficult to approach, ताम् them, वृक्षवृष्टिम् shower of trees, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, चिच्छेद torn asunder.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अभिलक्षेणतीव्रेणकुम्भेननिशितैश्शरैः ।।6.76.67।। अचितास्तेद्रुमारेजुर्यथाघोराषतघ्नयः ।
output: The sharp arrows aimed at the target by Kumbha covered the trees and they shone like dreadful Sataghnis.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
द्रुमवर्षंतुसञ्छिन्नंदृष्टवाकुम्भोनवीर्यवान् ।।6.76.68।। वानराधिपति: शीमान्महासत्त्वो न विव्यथे ।
output: Valiant hero, the prosperous and noble Sugriva, the chief of Vanaras did not get distressed when tormented with rain of trees.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
निर्भिद्यमानस्सहसासहमानश्चतान् शरान् ।।6.76.69।। कुम्भस्यधनुराक्षिप्यबभञ्जेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम् ।
output: He snatched the bow of Kumbha forcibly which was like Indra's rainbow, pulled it and broke, while tolerating the pain of the arrows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
अवफ्लुत्यततश्शीघ्रंकृत्वाकर्मसुदुष्करम् ।।6.76.70।। अब्रवीत्कुपितःकुम्भंभग्नशृङ्गमिवद्विपम् ।
output: Then Sugriva leapt into the chariot, which was a difficult deed to perform, saw Kumbha who was like an elephant and whose tusks were broken and spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निकुम्भाग्रजवीर्यंतेबाणवेगवदद्भुतम् ।।6.76.71।। सन्नतिश्चप्रभावश्चतववारावणस्यवा ।
output: "Oh, elder brother of Nikumbha! Your valour, speed of your arrows, compliance, and glory is wonderful like that of Ravana's."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रह्लादबलिवृत्रघ्नकुभेरवरुणोपम ।।6.76.72।। एकस्त्वमनुजातोऽसिपितरंबलवृत्ततः ।
output: "You are equal to Prahlada, Bali, Indra, Kubera and Varuna in might. You alone have taken over like your father."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वामेवैकंमहाबाहुंचापहस्तमरिन्दमम् ।।6.76.73।। त्रिदशानातिवर्तन्तेजितेन्द्रियमिवाधयः । विक्रमस्वमहाबुद्धे कर्माणिममपश्यतः ।।6.76.74।।
output: "Oh! mightyarmed, Kumbha! wielding pike in hand, you are a tamer of enemies, you alone are the one that gods are not able to overcome, a pre eminent one who has gained over senses, highly intelligent, exhibiting your prowess and deeds before me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्वामेवैकंमहाबाहुंचापहस्तमरिन्दमम् ।।6.76.73।। त्रिदशानातिवर्तन्तेजितेन्द्रियमिवाधयः । विक्रमस्वमहाबुद्धे कर्माणिममपश्यतः ।।6.76.74।।
output: महाबाहुम् mighty armed, शूलहस्तम् wielding pike in hand, अरिन्दमम् tamer of enemies, त्वाम् you, एकमेव you alone, त्रिदशाः gods, जितेन्द्रियम् one who has overcome senses, आधयः pre eminent, नातिवर्तन्ते not able to overcome, महाबुद्धे highly intelligent, विक्रमस्व prowess, मम me, कर्माणि deeds, तः those, पश्यत: exhibit.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
वरदानापतितृव्यस्तेसहतेदेवदानवान् । कुम्भकर्णस्तुवीर्येणसहते च सुरासुरान् ।।6.76.75।।
output: "Your uncle Ravana is able to withstand the Devas and Danavas by virtue of the boons and Kumbhakarna was able to with stand gods and demons by virtue of his courage."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःकुम्भस्तुसुग्रीवंबाहुभ्यांजगृहेतदा । गजाविवाहितमदौनिश्श्वसन्तौमुहुर्मुहु 76.81।। अन्योन्यगात्रग्रथितौकर्षन्तावितरेतरम् । सधूमांमुखतोज्वालांविसृजन्तौपरिश्रमात् ।।6.76.82।।
output: ततः thereafter, कुम्भः Kumbha, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva's, जगृहे held, तदा then, अहतमदौ intoxicated, गजाविव like elephants, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, निश्श्वसन्तौ breathing heavily, अन्योन्यगात्रग्रथितौ holding one another's limbs, इतरेतरम् one another, कर्षन्तौ rubbing each other, परिश्रमात् in exertion, मुखतः from face, सधूमाम् smoke, ज्वालाम् flames, विस्पजन्तौ let out.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
महाविमर्दंसमरेमयासहतवाद्भुतम् । अद्यभूतानिपश्यन्तुशक्रशम्बरयोरिव ।।6.76.77।।
output: अद्य now, समरे in combat, मयासह with me, तव your, अद्भुतम् wonderful, महाविमर्दम् mighty encounter, शक्रम्बरयोरिव Indra and Sambara like, भूतानि beings, पश्यन्तु witness.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कृतमप्रतिमंकर्मदर्शितंचास्त्रकौशलम् । पातिताहरिवीराश्चत्वयावैभीमविक्रमाः ।।6.76.78।।
output: त्वया your, अप्रतिमम् unequal, कर्म deed, कृतम् done, अस्त्रकौशलं च efficiency in the use of weapons, दर्शितम् exhibited, भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, एते of those, हरिवीराश्च monkey heroes, पातिताः made to fall.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उपालम्भभयाच्चापिनासिवीरमयाहतः । कृतकर्मपरिश्रान्तोविश्रान्तःपश्यमेबलम् ।।6.76.79।।
output: वीर stalwart, कृतकर्मपरिश्रान्तः exhausted by your deeds and resting, मया by me, उपालम्भभयात् fear of reproaching, हतः finished, नअसि are not, विश्रान्तः having rested, मे my, बलम् strength, पश्य witness.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
तेनसुग्रीववाक्येनसावमानेनमानितः । अग्नेराज्याहुतस्येवतेजस्तस्याभ्यवर्धत ।।6.76.80।।
output: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.

instruction:

output: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.

instruction:

output: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तयोःपादाभिघाताच्चनिमग्नाचाभवन्महि । व्याघूर्णिततरङ्गश्चचुक्षुभेवरुणालयः ।।6.76.83।।
output: Then by the trampling of their feet the earth sank down, the abode of Varuna (ocean) was agitated with rolling waves.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
ततःकुम्भंसमुत्क्षिप्यसुग्रीवोलवणाम्भसि । पातयामासवेगेनदर्शयन्नुदधेस्तलम् ।।6.76.84।।
output: Then Sugriva lifted Kumbha and threw him into the ocean quickly, to show him the bottom.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःकुम्भनिपातेनजलराशिस्समुत्थितः । व्निध्यमन्दरसङ्काशोविससर्पसमन्ततः ।।6.76.85।।
output: By Kumbha falling into the ocean, it got swollen to the form of Vindhya and Mandara mountain and water flowed all over.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
ततःकुम्भस्समुत्पत्यसुग्रीवमभिपद्य च । आजघानोरसिक्रुद्धोवज्रवेगेनमुष्टिना ।।6.76.86।।
output: Then Kumbha hit Sugriva in anger with his fist at the speed of a thunderbolt on his chest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:
तस्यचचर्मच पुस्फोटबहुसुस्रावशोणितम् । स च मुष्टिर्महावेगःप्रतिजघ्नेऽस्थिमण्डले ।।6.76.87।।
output: The armour of Sugriva slit open, and blood flowed at high speed and excessively. The first hit of Kumbha hit the skeletal framework of Sugriva in return.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्दावेगेनतत्रासीत्तेजःप्रज्वलितंमहत् । वज्रनिष्पेषसञ्जाताज्वालामेरोर्यथागिरेः ।।6.76.88।।
output: तदा then, तत्र there, वेगेन speedily, महत् great, तेजः flame, मेरोःगिरेः Meru mountain, वज्रनिष्पेषसञ्जाता force of the fist like thunderbolt, ज्वालायथा like flame, प्रज्वलितम् burst forth.

instruction:

output: Then mighty Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras, hit by the fist, clenched his fist adamantly.

instruction:

output: Sugriva, the champion pressed his first which shone like the Sun encircled with rays on the chest of Kumbha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:

output: By the blow of Sugriva, that Kumbha was pained severely and overcome by fear he fell like fire which has lost its glow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 76:

output: Struck by the fist of Sugriva, the Rakshasa fell just as the glowing planet endowed with brightness accidentally fell from the sky.

instruction:

कुम्भस्यपततोरूपंभग्नस्योरसिमुष्टीना । बभौरुद्राभिपन्नस्ययथारूपंगवांपतेः ।।6.76.93।।
output: Struck in the chest by Sugriva's fist, Kumbha fell down and shone like the Sun god over powered by Rudra।।

instruction:

निकुम्भोभ्रातरंदृष्टवासुग्रीवेणनिपातितम् । प्रदहन्निवकोपेनवानरेन्द्रमवैक्षत ।।6.77.1।।
output: Seeing his brother struck down by Sugriva, Nikumbha gazed at him as if to burn him in wrath.

instruction:

output: Then the hero Nikumbha, girded with flowers measuring five digits in breadth, took an auspicious club like the peak of Mahendra mountain.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 77:
हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तंवज्रविद्रुमभूषितम् । यमदण्डोपमंभीमंरक्षसांभयनाशनम् ।।6.77.3।।
output: It was decked with a gold band, encrusted with diamonds and corals, in the form of Yama's rod, a fierce one which dispelled fear.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 77:
तमाविध्यमहातेजाश्शक्रध्वजसमंतदा । निननादविवृत्तास्योनिकुम्भोभीमविक्रमः ।।6.77.4।।
output: The club was highly splendorous and of terrific strength with the banner of Indra and Nikumbha took that club roared opening his mouth wide and pierced it with force.

instruction:

output: By Nikumbha whirling around the club and the conjunction of the seven winds coming in contact with the club in his hand crashed in space and glowed like a smokeless fire burst forth.

instruction:

नगर्याविटपावत्यागन्धर्वभवनोत्तमैः । सतारग्रहनक्षत्रंसचन्द्रंसमहाग्रहम् ।।6.77.8।। निकुम्भपरिघाघूर्णंभ्रमतीवनभस्थ्सलम् ।

output: परिघाभरणप्रभः glowing by the cluband ornaments, कपीनांस for the Vanaras, निकुम्भाग्निः fire of Nikumbha, उत्थितः burst, युगान्ताग्निःइव as though it is fire at the time of dissolution of the universe, दुरासदःformidable, सञ्जज्ञे to reflect

राक्षसावानराश्चापि न शेकुस्स्पन्दितुंभयात् ।।6.77.10।। हनूमांस्तुविवृत्योरस्तस्थौतस्याग्रतोबली ।
output: The Rakshasas and even Vanaras were not able to move out of fear. Only mighty Hanuman stood there showing his chest.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 77:
परिघोपमबाहुस्तुपरिघंभास्करप्रभम् ।।6.77.11।। बलीबलवतस्तस्यपातयामासवक्षसि ।
output: The Rakshasa, whose arms were like iron bars and shining like the Sun brought it down on the breast of mighty Hanuman.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्थिरेतस्योरसिव्यूढेपरिघश्शतधाकृतः ।।6.77.12।। विकीर्यमाणस्सहसाउल्काशतमिवाम्बरे ।
output: As soon as the iron club touched the broad chest (of Hanuman), it split into a hundred splinters, in the sky and crumbled.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तुतेनप्रहारेणविचचालमहाकपिः ।।6.77.13।। परिघेणसमाधूतोयथाभूमिचलेऽचलः ।
output: परिघेण by the iron club, समाधूतः with, सःमहाकपिः that great Vanara, तेन by that, प्रहारेण blow, भूमिचले mountain in earthquake, अचलःयथा not shake, विचचाल steady

तथाभिहतस्तेनहनुमान् प्लवगोत्तमः ।।6.77.14।। मुष्टिंसम्वर्तयामासबलेनातिमहाबलः ।
output: तेन by that, तथा like that, अभिहतः struck, सःhe, प्लवगोत्तमः foremost of monkeys, अतिमहाबलःextraordinary mighty, हनुमान् Hanuman, बलेन by his strength, मुष्टिम् fist, सम्वर्तयामास clenched violently

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तमुद्यम्यमहातेजानिकुम्भोरसिवीर्यवान् ।।6.77.15।। अभिचिक्षेपवेगेनवेगवान् वायुविक्रमः ।
output: Highly energetic champion endowed with speed, close to wind god in valour raising his fist instantly crushed Nikumbha on the chest.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःपुस्फोटचर्मास्यप्रसुस्राव च शोणितम् ।।6.77.16।। मुष्टिनातेनसञ्जज्ञेमेघेविद्युदिवोत्थिता ।
output: तेन, मुष्टिना by the fist, तत: then, अस्य his, चर्मपुस्फोट skin split, शोणितं च even blood, प्रसुस्राव started flowing, मेघे cloud, विद्युत् lightning, उत्थिताइव risen like, सञ्जज्ञे appeared

instruction:

सःतुतेनप्रहारेणनिकुम्भोविचचाल ह ।।6.77.17।। स्वस्थश्चापिनिजग्राहहनूमन्तंमहाबलम् ।
output: By that blow, Nikumbha was not moved. Recovering from that he caught hold of Hanuman of extraordinary strength.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चुक्रुशुस्तदासङ्ख्येभीमंलङ्कानिवासिनः ।।6.77.18।। निकुम्भेनोद्यतंदृष्टवाहनूमन्तंमहाबलम् ।
output: तदा then, सङ्ख्ये in combat, निकुम्भेनNikumbha's, उद्यतम् lifting up, महाबलम् endowed with might, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, दृष्टवा seeing, लङ्कानिवासिनः residents of Lanka, भीमम् terribly, विचुक्रुशुः roared

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदाह्रियमाणोऽपिकुम्भकर्णात्मजेन ह ।।6.77.19।। आजघानानिलसुतोवज्रकल्पेनमुष्टिना ।
output: तेन by that, तदा then, ह्रियमाणःअपि being carried also, अनिलसुतः son of windgod, कुम्भकर्णात्मजेन son of Kumbhakarna, वज्रकल्पेन with his hard adamant, मुष्टिना fist, आजघान hit him.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आत्मानंमोक्षयित्वाथक्षितावभ्यवपद्यत ।।6.77.20।। हनूमानुन्ममाथाशुनिकुम्भंमारुतात्मजः ।
output: मारुतात्मजः son of windgod, हनूमान् Hanuman, आत्मानम् himself, मोक्षयित्वा getting released, अथ now, क्षितौ on ground, अभ्यपद्यत springing up, आशु standing, निकुम्भम् Nikumbha, उन्ममाथ tormented

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निक्षिप्यपरमायत्तोनिकुम्भंनिष्पिपेष ह ।।6.77.21।। उत्पत्यचास्यवेगेनपपातोरसिवीर्यवान् ।
output: Throwing down Nikumbha with great effort, Hanuman endowed with speed sprang up and fell on his chest.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परिगृह्य च बाहुभ्यांपरिवृत्यशिरोधराम् ।।6.77.22।। उत्पाटयामानशिरोभैरवंनदतोमहत् ।
output: Taking hold of the neck with both arms and twisting it round Hanuman broke off the neck of Nikumbha while he was crying terribly.

instruction:

अथनिनदतिसादितेनिकुम्भेपवनसुतेनरणेबभूवयुद्धम् । दशरथसुतराक्षसेन्द्रसून्वोर्भृशतरमागतरोषयोस्सुभीमम् ।।6.77.23।।
output: अथ and then, निनदति crying aloud, निकुम्भेNikumbha, रणे in the battlefield, पवनसुतेन by wind god's son, सादिते destroyed, भृशतम् violent, आगतरोषयोःhighly perturbed, दशरथसुतराक्षसेन्द्रसून्वोःDasharatha's son and Makara raksha (son of Khara), सुभीमम् fierce, युद्धम् war, बभूव happened

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निकुम्भंनिहतंश्रुत्वाकुम्भं च विनिपातितम् । रावणःपरमामर्षीप्रजज्वालानलोयथा ।।6.78.1।।
output: निकुम्भम् Nikumbha, निहतम् killed, कुम्भं च Kumbha and, विनिपातितम् had been killed, श्रुत्वा on hearing, रावणः Ravana, परमामर्षी very furious, अनलोयथा like fire, प्रजज्वाल burning in anger

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 78:
नैरृतःक्रोधशोकाभ्यांद्वाभ्यांतुपरिमूर्छितः । खरपुत्रंविशालाक्षंमकराक्षमचोदयत् ।।6.78.2।।
output: The Rakshasa king was overtaken by both anger and sorrow, bewildered excessively sent for broadeyed Makara, the son of Khara.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गच्छपुत्रऽमयाऽजाज्ञप्तोबलेनाभिसमवनितः । राघवंलक्ष्मणंचैवजहितांश्चवनौकसः ।।6.78.3।।
output: पुत्र son, मया by me, आज्ञप्तःcommand, अभिसमवनितः accompanied by army, गच्छ going, वनौकसः Vanaras, तां them, राघवम् Raghava, लक्ष्मणंचैव and Lakshman also, जहि kill

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाशूरमानीखरात्मजः । बाढमित्यब्रवीद्धृष्टोमकराक्षोनिशाचरम् ।।6.78.4।।
output: शूरमानी proclaiming as hero, खरात्मजःson of Khara, मकराक्षःMaka raksha, वचःwords, श्रुत्वा hearing, हृष्टः rejoiced, निशाचरम् Rakshasa, बाढम् इति good, अब्रवीत् said

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽभिवाद्यदशग्रीवंकृत्वाचापिप्रदक्षिणम् । निर्जगामगृहाच्छुभ्राद्रावणस्याज्ञयाबली ।।6.78.5।।
output: Greeting the tenheaded Rakshasa and going round him according to tradition, the mighty warrior went out from the abode early morning by the command of Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 78:
समीपस्थंबलाध्यक्षंखरपुत्रोऽब्रवीदिदम् । रथश्चानीयतांशीघ्रंसैन्यंत्वानीयतांत्वरात् ।।6.78.6।।
output: Khara's son spoke to the commanderinchief of the army standing nearby 'Let the chariot be brought quickly and the army proceed'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वाबलाध्यक्षोनिशाचरः । स्यन्दनं च बलंचैवसमीपंप्रत्यपादयत् ।6.78.7।।
output: तस्य his, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा hearing, बलाध्यक्षः commanderinchief, निशाचरः Rakshasas, स्यन्दनं च responded, बलंचैव army too, समीपम् near, प्रत्यपादयत् placed near

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रदक्षिणंरथंकृत्वाआरुरोहनिशाचरः । सूतंसञ्चोदयामासशीघ्रंमेरथमावह ।।6.78.8।।
output: After having gone round the chariot he (Makara) ascended and said to the charioteer, 'let the chariot be driven quickly'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथतान्राक्षसान्सर्वान्मकराक्षोऽब्रवीदिदम् । यूयंसर्वेप्रयुध्यध्वंपुरस्तान्ममराक्षसाः ।।6.78.9।।
output: Thereafter, Maka raksha spoke to all Rakshasas, 'All of you be ahead of me and fight violently'.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अहंराक्षसराजेनरावणेनमहात्मना । आज्ञप्तःसमरेहन्तुंतावुभौरामलक्ष्मणौ ।।6.78.10।।
output: अहम् I, राक्षसराजेन by Rakshasa king's, महात्मना great self, रावणेन to Ravana, समरे in battle, तौ those, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, उभौ both, हन्तुम् will kill, आज्ञप्तः by his order

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्यरामंवधिष्यामिलक्ष्मणं च निशाचराः । शाखामृगं च सुग्रीवंवानरांश्चशरोत्तमैः ।।6.78.11।।
output: "Now I shall put an end to Rama and Lakshmana, Sugriva and the Vanaras with the best of arrows."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 78:
अद्यशूलनिपातैश्चवानराणांमहाचमूम् । प्रदहिष्यामिसम्प्राप्तांशुष्केन्धनमिवानलः ।।6.78.12।।
output: "Going there now, I will terminate the great Vanara army with these pikes just as drywood is burnt by fire."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मकराक्षस्यतच्छ्रुत्वावचनंतेनिशाचराः । सर्वेनानायुधोपेताबलवन्तःसमाहिताः ।।6.78.13।।
output: On hearing Maka raksha's words all the mighty Rakshasas came with different kinds of weapons.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेकामरूपिणस्सरेदंष्ट्रिणःपिङ्गलेक्षणा । मातङ्गाइवनर्दन्तोध्वस्तकेशाभयावहाः ।।6.78.14।। परिवार्यमहाकायामहाकायंखरात्मजम् । अभिजघ्नुस्ततोहृष्टाश्चालयन्तोवसुन्धराम् ।।6.78.15।।
output: कामरूपिणः who could change their form at will, क्रूराः cruel, दंष्ट्रिणः protruding teeth, पिङ्गलेक्षणाः yellow eyes, ध्वस्तकेशाःdishevelled hair, भयावहाःfrightful appearance, महाकायाः huge body size, ते they, ततः then, मातङ्गाःइव like elephants, महाकायम् of huge size, खरात्मजम् son of Khara, परिवार्य surrounding, हृष्टाःjoyously, वसुन्धराम् earth, चालयन्तःshaking, अभिजघ्नुःwent forward

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 78:
तेकामरूपिणस्सरेदंष्ट्रिणःपिङ्गलेक्षणा । मातङ्गाइवनर्दन्तोध्वस्तकेशाभयावहाः ।।6.78.14।। परिवार्यमहाकायामहाकायंखरात्मजम् । अभिजघ्नुस्ततोहृष्टाश्चालयन्तोवसुन्धराम् ।।6.78.15।।
output: Those who could change their form at will, cruel, with protruding teeth, yellow eyes, dishevelled hair, of frightful appearance, huge like elephants surrounding the son of Khara went joyously forward shaking the earth.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शङ्खभेरीसहस्राणामाहतानांसमन्ततः । क्ष्येळितास्फोटितानां च तत्रशब्दोमहानभूत् ।।6.78.16।।
output: तत्र there, आहतानाम् beating of drums, शङ्खभेरीसहस्राणाम्blowing of thousands of conches, क्षेवळितास्फोटितानां च clappings of arms, महान् great, शब्धः sound, समन्ततःe very where, अभूत् heard

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 78:
प्रभ्रष्टोऽथकरात्तस्यप्रतोदस्सारथेस्तदा । पपातसहसादैवाद्ध्वजस्तस्यतुरक्षसः ।।6.78.17।।
output: There, the long whip dropped from the charioteer's hand and the Rakshasa's standard had fallen suddenly by divine will.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यतेरथसंयुक्ताहयाविक्रमवर्जिताः । चरणैराकुलैर्गत्वादीनाःसास्रमुखाययुः ।।6.78.18।।
output: तस्य his, रथसंयुक्ताः yoke binding the chariot, ते they, हयाःhorses, विक्रमवर्जिताःgiven up their valour, आकुलैःfaltering, चरणैः feet, गत्वा going, दीनाःdesperate, सास्रमुखाः shedding tears, ययुःwent

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रवातिपवनस्तस्मिन् सपांसुःखरदारुणः । निर्याणेतस्यरौद्रस्यमकराक्षस्यदुर्मतेः ।।6.78.19।।
output: रौद्रस्य angry, दुर्मतेः evil minded, तस्यमकराक्षस्य that Maka raksha, तस्मिन् निर्याणे at his departure, सपांसुः crumbling dust, खरदारुणः dreadful and violent, पवनः wind, प्रवाति blowed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 78:
तानिदृष्टवानिमित्तानिराक्षसावीर्यवत्तमाः । अचिन्त्यनिर्गतास्सर्वेयत्रतौरामलक्ष्मणौ ।।6.78.20।।
output: Seeing those portents incidentally and not taking into account those Rakshasas went where Rama and Lakshmana were.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
निर्गतंमकराक्षंतेदृष्टवावानरपुङ्गवाः । आप्लुत्यसहसासर्वेयोद्धुकामाव्यवस्थिताः ।।6.79.1।।
output: On seeing Maka raksha all the Vanara chiefs returned, jumped, and stood ready enthusiastically to fight.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
ततःप्रवृत्तंसुमहत्तद्युद्धंरोमहर्षणम् । निशाचरैःप्लवङ्गानांदेवानांदानवैरिव ।।6.79.2।।
output: Then ensued a battle between Rakshasas and Vanaras whichcaused horripilation, just like the battle between Devas and Danavas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वृक्षशूलनिपातैश्चशिलापरिघपातनैः । अन्योन्यंमर्दयन्तिस्मतदाकपिनिशाचराः ।।6.79.3।।
output: Then monkeys as well as Rakshasas fought hurling trees and pikes and bringing down rocks and clubs physically hurting each other.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शक्तिखडगगदाकुन्तैस्तोमरैश्चनिशाचराः । पट्टसैर्भिण्ढिपालैश्चबाणपातैःसमन्ततः ।।6.79.4।। पाशमुद्गरदण्डैश्चनिखातैश्चापरेस्तथा । कदनंकपिसिंहानांचक्रुस्तेरजनीचराः ।।6.79.5।।
output: रजनीचराःnight rangers, तेनिशाचराःthose prowlers, शक्तिखडगगदाकुन्तैjavelins, swords, maces, spears, तोमरैश्च lances, पट्टसै: small swords, भिण्डिपालैश्चbhindi Palas (slings for throwing stones), बाणपातैःshafts, पाशमुद्गरदण्डैः च nooses, mallets, and staffs, निखातैःcollection, तथा like that, अन्यैश्च and other weapons, समन्ततः discharging, कपिसिंहानाम् lions among monkeys, कदनम् destruction, चक्रुःcaused

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
शक्तिखडगगदाकुन्तैस्तोमरैश्चनिशाचराः । पट्टसैर्भिण्ढिपालैश्चबाणपातैःसमन्ततः ।।6.79.4।। पाशमुद्गरदण्डैश्चनिखातैश्चापरेस्तथा । कदनंकपिसिंहानांचक्रुस्तेरजनीचराः ।।6.79.5।।
output: Those prowlers, then ight rangers discharging javelins, swords, maces, spears, lances, small swords, bhindi Palas, shafts, nooses, mallets and staff and other weapons on the lions among the monkeys, caused destruction.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बाणौघैरर्दिताश्चापिखरपुत्रेणवानराः । सम्भ्रान्तमनसस्सर्वेदुद्रुवुर्भयपीडिताः ।।6.79.6।।
output: Vanaras perturbed terribly by the volley of arrows of Khara's son were stricken with fear and ran.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्दृष्टवाराक्षसास्सर्वेद्रवमाणान्वलीमुखान् । नेदुस्तेसिम्हवद्दृष्टाराक्षसाजितकाशिनः ।।6.79.7।।
output: The monkeys saw all the arrogant Rakshasas roaring like lions and running as though triumphed.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विद्रवत्सुतदातेषुवानरेषुसमन्ततः । रामस्तान्वारमायासशरवर्षेणराक्षसान् ।।6.79.8।।
output: Thereafter, seeing the Vanaras running all over, Rama stopped the Rakshasas by rain of arrows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
रितान्राक्षसान्दृष्टवामकराक्षोनिशाचरः । क्रोधानलसमाविष्टोवचनंचेदमब्रवीत् ।।6.79.9।।
output: Seeing the intercepted Rakshasas, the night ranger Maka raksha was overtaken by fire of anger spoke these words.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तिष्ठराम मयासार्धंद्वन्द्वयुद्धंददामिते । त्याजयिष्यामितेप्राणान् धनुर्मुक्सैशशितैश्शरैः ।।6.79.10।।
output: "Rama Stop. Duel will take place with me. I will give you sharpened arrows from my bow and relieve you of your life."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यत्तदादण्डकारण्येपितरंहतवान्मम । तदग्रतःस्वकर्मस्थंदृष्टवारोषोऽभिवर्धते ।।6.79.11।।
output: तदा then, दण्डकारण्ये in D and akaranya, मम my, पितरम् father, यत् there, हतवान् was killed, तत् that, स्वकर्मस्थम् for the same cause, अग्रतःin front, दृष्टवा seeing, रोषःanger, अभिवर्धते is increasing

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दह्यन्तेधृशमङ्गानिदुरात्मन्ममराघव । यन्मयासि न दृष्टस्त्वंतस्मिन् कालेमहावने ।।6.79.12।।
output: "O Evil minded Raghava! at that time, I did not see you in D and aka forest. My limbs are burning in anger."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिष्ट्यासिदर्शनंराम ममत्वंप्राप्तवानिह । काङ्क्षितोऽसिक्षुधार्तस्यसिंहस्येवेतरोमृगः ।।6.79.13।।
output: "Rama! To my good fortune it became possible for me to see you here. Just as a hungry lion waits for an animal, I am waiting for you."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अद्यमद्बाणवेगेनप्रेतराडिवषयंगतः । येत्वयानिहताःशूराःसहतैश्चसमेष्यसि ।।6.79.14।।
output: "Now by the speed of my arrow I will send you totherealm of Yama and there you will be along with the demons killed by you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
बहुनात्रकिमुक्तेनशृणुराम वचोमम । पश्यन्तुसकलालोकास्त्वा, मांचैवरणाजिरे ।।6.79.15।।
output: "Rama, why talk so much? Listen to my words. Let people in all worldssee you and me in the battlefield."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
अस्त्रैर्वागदयावापिबाहुभ्यांवामहाहवे । अभ्यस्तंयेनवाराम तेनैवयुधिवर्तताम् ।।6.79.16।।
output: "By weapons, or by mace or else with hand s or any other weapon or with your military practice, you fight, he said to Rama."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
मकराक्ष्वचश्श्रुत्वारामोदशरथात्मजः । अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्वाक्यमुत्तरोत्तरवादिनम् ।।6.79.17।।
output: Laughing at the words of Maka raksha who was speaking again and again Rama said.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
कत्थसेकिंवृथारक्षो बहून्यसदृशानिते । न रणेशक्यतेजेतुंविनायुद्धेनवाग्भलात् ।।6.79.18।।
output: "Rakshasa! Why so much of wasteful talk about What you can't accomplish? Victory is not possible on the battlefield with your force of speech"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 79:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणिरक्षसांत्वत्पिता च यः । त्रिशिरादूषणश्चापिदण्डकेनिहतामया ।।6.79.19।।
output: "In Dandaka, fourteen thousand Rakshasas, your father, Trisira, and also Dooshana were killed by me alone."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वाशितास्तवमांसेनगृध्रगोमायुवायसाः । भविष्यन्त्यद्यवैपाप तीक्ष्णतुण्डनखाङ्कुराः ।।6.79.20।।
output: "O Sinner! Today vultures, jackals and crows with sharp beaks and goads like claws will also be satiated with your flesh."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तुमकराक्षोमहाबलः । बाणौघानमुचत्तस्मैराघवायरणाजिरे ।।6.79.21।।
output: राघवेण by Raghava, एवम् in that manner, उक्तःspoken, महाबलः endowed with extraordinary strength, मकराक्षः Maka raksha, रणाजिरे in the battlefield, राघवाय on Rama, बाणौघम् war of arrows, अमुचत् released

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्शरान् शरवर्षेणरामश्चिच्छेदनैकधा । निपेतुर्भुवितेछिन्नारुक्मपुङ्खास्सहस्रशः ।।6.79.22।।

प्रच्छादयन्तौगगनंशरजालैर्महाबलौ । तमस्त्रःसूर्यसङ्काशैर्नैवपस्पृशतुश्शरैः ।।6.80.24।।
output: महाबलौ mighty, शरजालैःnet of arrows, गगनम् sky, प्रच्छादयन्तौcovering, सूर्यसङ्काशैःresembling sun, अस्त्रःweapons, शरैः arrows, तम् they, न पस्पृशतुःnot touch

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स हिधूमान्धकारं च चक्रेप्रच्चादयन्नभः । दिशश्चान्तर्दधेश्रीमान्नीहारतमसावृताः ।।6.80.25।।
output: सःhe, सभःsky, प्रच्छादयन् obscured, धूमान्धकारम् darkness through smoke, चक्रे did, श्रीमान् glorious, नीहारतमसाdarkness through fog, वृताःsurrounded, दिशश्च directions, अन्तर्दधे invisible

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नैवज्यातलनिर्घोषा न च नेमिखुरस्वनः । शुश्रुवेचरतस्तस्य न च रूपंप्रकाशते ।।6.80.26।।
output: तस्य his, चरतः movement, ज्यातलनिर्घोषःsound produced by the palms, नैवशुश्रुवे nor the sounds, निमुखरसर्वनःच of the wheels or ho of s of horses, न च not heard, रूपं च form also, न प्रकाशते not visible

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
घनान्धकारेतिमिरेशरावर्षमिवाद्भुतम् । स ववर्षमहाबाहुर्नाराचशरवृष्टिभिः ।।6.80.27।।
output: महाबाहुः mighty armed, सःhe, घानन्धकारे like the darkness of clouds, तिमिरे darkness, नाराचशरवृष्टिभिःrain of rocks and hails of steel arrows, अद्भुतम् wonderful, शरवर्षमिव rain of arrows, ववर्ष showered

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स रामंसूर्यसङ्काशैश्शरैर्धत्तवरोर्भृशम् । विव्याधसमरेक्रुद्धःसर्वगात्रेषुरावणिः ।।6.80.28।।
output: In that conflict, the enraged son of Ravana, pierced all over Rama's limbs, with arrows bestowed to him, which were as effulgent as the Sun.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तौहन्यमानौनाराचैर्धाराभिरिवपर्वतौ । हेमपुङ्खान्नरव्याघ्रौतिग्मान्मुमुचतुःशरान् ।।6.80.29।।
output: The tigers among humans, Rama, and Lakshmana, like two mountains hit by steel arrows, released sharp pointedgold shafted steel arrows and tormented (Indrajith).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अन्तरिक्षेसमासाद्यरावणिंकङ्कपत्रिणः । निकृत्यपतगाभूमौसेतुस्तेशोणितोक्षिताः ।।6.80.30।।
output: The arrows fixed with swords like wings, reaching Ravana's son in the sky pierced him and he fell down soaked in blood.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अतिमात्रंशरौघेणपीड्यमानौनरोत्तमौ । तानिषून्पततोभल्लैरनेकैर्विचकर्ततुः ।।6.80.31।।
output: Brightened by the mass of arrows on their body, the best of men, Rama and Lakshmana began to tear the numerous arrows called Bhallas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यतोहिददृशातेतौशरान् निपतितान्शितान् । ततस्तुतौदाशरथीससृजातेऽस्त्रमुत्तमम् ।।6.80.32।।
output: तौ both, यतः that way, निपतितान् falling, शितान् sharp, शरान् arrows, ददृशाते from which direction, ततः then, तौ they both दाशरथी on sons of Dasharatha, उत्तमम् best, अस्त्रम् weapon, ससृजातेdirected

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 80:
रावणिस्तुदिशस्सर्वारथेनातिरथोऽपतत् । विव्याधतौदाशरथीलघ्वस्त्रनिशितैःशरैः ।।6.80.33।।
output: The son of Ravana who was a superior chariot warrior and swift in discharging arrows coursed through all directions and pierced arrows at Rama and Lakshmana from the aerial car.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेनातिविद्धौतौवीरौरुक्मपुङ्खैःसुसम्हतैः । बभूवतुर्धाशरथीपुष्पितामिवकिंशुकौ ।।6.80.34।।
output: सुसम्हतैः wellmade fully stretched, रुक्मपुङ्खैः gold shafted arrows, तेन by that, अतिविद्धौ severely hurt, वीरौ heroes, तौदाशरथी both sons of Dasharatha, पुष्पितौ in blossom, किंशुकौइव like Kimsuka, बभूवतुःappeared

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नास्यवेगगतिंकचशिन्न च रूपंधनुश्शरान् । न चान्यद्विदितंकिञ्चित्सूर्यस्येवाभ्रसम्प्लवे ।।6.80.35।।
output: When the clouds are cast thickly, except the position of the Sun, nothing is visible. So also, with a swift movement of Indrajith, neither his form nor his bow and arrows were visible.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तेनविद्धाश्चहरयोनिहताश्चगतासवः । बभूवुःशतशस्तत्रपतिताधरणीतले ।।6.80.36।।
output: तेन then, विद्धाःstruck, हरयः monkeys, निहताःkilled, गतासवः ceased of life, शतशःhundreds, तत्र there, धरणीतले on ground, पतिताःfallen, बभूवुःseen

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
लक्ष्मणस्तुततस्सुङ्क्रृद्धोभ्रातरंवाक्यमब्रवीत् । ब्राह्ममस्त्रंप्रयोक्ष्यामिवधार्थंसर्वरक्षसाम् ।।6.80.37।।
output: Then Lakshmana also, enraged, spoke to his brother, saying," I will kill all the Rakshasas using the weapon of Brahma."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 80:
तमुवाचततोरामोलक्ष्मणंशुभलक्षणम् । नैकस्यहेतोरक्षांसिपृथिव्यांहन्तुमर्हसि ।।6.80.38।।
output: To Lakshmana, gifted with auspicious signs, Rama said" for the sake of killing one Rakshasa, you are not to kill all the Rakshasas on the earth."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अयुध्यमानंप्रच्छन्नंप्राञ्जलिंशरणागतम् । पलायमानंमत्तंवा न हन्तुंत्वमिहार्हसि ।।6.80.39।।
output: इह here, त्वम् you, अयुध्यमानम् without waging war, प्रच्छन्नम् not fighting, has hidden, प्राञ्जलिम् folded palms, शरणागतम् one who surrenders, पलायमानम् one who runs away, मत्तंवा not alert, हन्तुम् to kill, न अर्हसिought not

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्यैवतुवधेयत्नंकरिष्यावोमहाभुज । आदेक्ष्यावोमहावेगावस्त्रानाशीविषोपमान् ।।6.80.40।।
output: महाभुज mighty armed, अस्यैव I will, वधे kill, यत्नम् effort, करिष्यावःwill make, महावेगान् endowed with high speed, आशीविषोपमान् venomous serpents, अस्त्रान् weapons, आदेक्ष्यावःwill command

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 80:
तमेनंमायिनंक्षुद्रमन्तर्हितरथंबलात् । राक्षसंनिहनिष्यन्तिदृष्टवावानरयूथपाः ।।6.80.41।।
output: " A conjurer, mean, and invisible Indrajith with the chariot, if seen, in any way the Vanara troops will forcibly kill him with their strength."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यद्येषभूमिंविशतेदिवंवारसातलंवापिनभस्स्थलंवा । एवंनिगूढोऽममास्त्रदग्धःपतिष्यतेभूमितलेगतासुः ।।6.80.42।।
output: यद्येषः by himself, भूमिम् into earth, विशतेयदिenters also, दिवंवा heaven or, रसातलंवापि underground, नभस्तलंवा subterranean world, एवम् in that way, निगूढोऽपि remains hidden, ममmy, अस्त्रदग्धःweapon, गतासुः consumed, भूमितले on the ground, पतिष्यतेwill fall

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 81:
विज्ञायतुमनस्तस्यराघवस्यमहात्मनः । स निवृत्याहवात्तस्मात् प्रविवेशपुरींततः ।।6.81.1।।
output: Knowing the highsouled Raghava's mind, Indrajith departed from there and entered the city.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सोऽनुस्मृत्यवधंतेषांराक्षसानांतरस्विनाम् । क्रोधताम्रेक्षणश्शूरोनिर्जगामाहाद्युति: ।।6.81.2।।
output: Recollecting those Rakshasas killed, the heroic, mighty and courageous Indrajith's eyes were red in anger.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स पश्चिमेवद्वारेणनिर्ययौराक्षसैर्वृतः । इन्द्रजित्सुमहावीर्यःपौलस्त्योदेवकण्टकः ।।6.81.3।।
output: Paulastya (one of the nine mind born sons of Brahma, a scion of sage Paulastya), stupendous hero, a tormentor of Devatas, Indrajith, surrounded by Rakshasas came out through the western gate.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इन्द्रजित्तुततोदृष्टवाभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ । रणायाभ्युद्यतौवीरौमायांप्रादुष्करोत्तदा ।।6.81.4।।
output: इन्द्रजित् तुIndrajith also, ततः there, वीरौheroes, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, रणाय for war, अभ्युद्यतौ prepared, दृष्ट्या witnessing, तदा then, मायाम् by conjuring, प्रादुष्करोत्exhibited

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इन्द्रजित्तुरथेस्थाप्यसीतांमायामयींतदा । बलेनमहतावृत्यतस्यावधमरोचयत् ।।6.81.5।।
output: Indrajith, also through a trick, wanted to make illusory Sita and place her in the chariot surrounded by Rakshasas and thought of killing her.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 81:
मोहनार्थंतुसर्वेषांबुद्धिंकृत्वासुदुर्मतिः । हन्तुंसीतांव्यवसितोवानराभिमुखोययौ ।।6.81.6।।
output: Evil minded Indrajith, made up his mind to hoodwink every one who decided to kill Sita and went towards the Vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 81:
तम्दृष्टवात्वभिनिर्यान्तंसर्वेतेकाननौकसः । उत्पेतुरभिसङ्क्रुद्धाश्शिलाहस्तायुयुत्सवः ।।6.81.7।।
output: All the forest animals perceiving Indrajithadvancing became angry and with rocks in hand faced him with enthusiasm.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 81:
हनूमान् पुरतस्तेषांजगामकपिकुञ्जरः । प्रगृह्यसुमहच्छृङ्गंपर्वतस्यदुरासदम् ।।6.81.8।।
output: Hanuman, the elephant among monkeys, taking hold of a huge mountain peak that was difficult to reach marched forward and went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 81:
स ददर्शहतानन्दांसीतामिन्द्रजितोरथे । एकवेणीधरांदीनामुपवासकृशाननाम् ।।6.81.9।। परिक्लिष्टैकवसनाममृजांराघवप्रियाम् । रजोमलाभ्यामालिप्तैस्सर्वगात्रैर्वरस्त्रियम् ।।6.81.10।।
output: Hanuman beheld in the chariot of Indrajith, cheerless Sita with one braid, with no desire to live, emaciated by fasting, wearing a single cloth, body not anointed, covered with dust and dirt all over the body, who was dear to Raghava.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स ददर्शहतानन्दांसीतामिन्द्रजितोरथे । एकवेणीधरांदीनामुपवासकृशाननाम् ।।6.81.9।। परिक्लिष्टैकवसनाममृजांराघवप्रियाम् । रजोमलाभ्यामालिप्तैस्सर्वगात्रैर्वरस्त्रियम् ।।6.81.10।।
output: सः he, इन्द्रजितः Indrajith, रथे chariot, हतानन्दाम् cheerless, एकवेणीधराम् with one braid, दीनाम् piteous, उपवासकृशाननाम् emaciated with fasting, परिक्लिष्टैकवसनाम् wearing only one cloth, अमृजाम् with no desire to live, रजोमलाभ्याम् covered with dust and mud, आलिप्तै: without any anointment, सर्वगात्रैः all over body, वरस्त्रियम् dear, राघवप्रियाम् wife of Raghava, सीताम् Sita, ददर्श saw

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांनिरीक्ष्यमुहूर्तंतुमैथिलीत्यध्यवस्यतु । बभूवाचिरदृष्टाहितेनसाजनकात्मजा ।।6.81.11।।
output: He looked at her for a moment and recognised her as Janaka's daughter since he had seen her not long before.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अब्रवीत्तांतुशोकार्तांनिरानन्दांतपस्विनीम् । दृष्टवारथोस्थितांदृष्ट्वाराक्षसेन्द्रसुतश्रिताम् ।।6.81.12।। कंसमर्थितमस्येतिचिन्तयन्समहाकपिः । सहतैर्वानरश्रेष्ठैरभ्यधावतरावणिम् ।।6.81.13।।
output: सःमहाकपिः that great Vanara, शोकार्ताम् miserable, निरानन्दाम् joyless, तपस्विनीम् ascetic woman, राक्षसेन्द्रसुतश्रिताम् under the sway of the son of the king of Rakshasas, ताम् her, दृष्टवा gazing, अस्य her, किम् why, समर्थितम् seated, इति thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, चिन्तयन् worried, तैः with those, वानरश्रेष्ठैःसह best of Vanaras रावणिम् son of Ravana, अभ्यधावत rushed

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 81:
अब्रवीत्तांतुशोकार्तांनिरानन्दांतपस्विनीम् । दृष्टवारथोस्थितांदृष्ट्वाराक्षसेन्द्रसुतश्रिताम् ।।6.81.12।। कंसमर्थितमस्येतिचिन्तयन्समहाकपिः । सहतैर्वानरश्रेष्ठैरभ्यधावतरावणिम् ।।6.81.13।।
output: Great Vanara, Hanuman, gazing at miserable, joyless, ascetic woman seated in the chariot, worried, why she is in the chariot. He spoke to the best of Vanara leaders and rushed towards the son of Ravana with them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तद्वानरबलंदृष्टवारावणिःक्रोधमूर्छितः । कृत्वाविकोशंनिस्त्रिंशंमूर्ध्निसीतामकर्षयत् ।।6.81.14।।
output: Indrajith saw the Vanara army coming towards him, deluded with anger, unsheathed the sword and touched Sita's forehead.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तांस्त्रियंपश्यतांतेषांताडयामासरावणि: । क्रोशन्तींरामरामेतिमाययायोजितांरथे ।।6.81.15।।
output: As they were looking at Sita on the chariot trickishly constructed, and she was crying saying, 'O Rama, O Rama', he stood and hit her.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
गृहीतमूर्धजांदृष्टवाहनुमान् दैन्यमागतः । शोकजंवारिनेत्राभ्यामुत्सृजन्मारुतात्मजः ।।6.81.16।।
output: Seeing Indrajith holding Sita's head, Maruti's son, was immersed in grief, and shed tears of sorrow from his eyes.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तांदृष्टवाचारुसर्वाङ्गींरामस्यमहिषींप्रियाम् । अब्रवीत्पुरुषंवाक्यंक्रोधाद्रक्षोधिपात्मजम् ।।6.81.17।।
output: चारुसर्वाङ्गीम् one with lovely limbs, रामस्य Rama's, प्रियाम् dear, महिषीम् wife, ताम् her, दृष्टवा looking, क्रोधात् in anger, रक्षोधिपात्मजम् Rakshasa king's son, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत्rebuked

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दुरात्मन्नात्मनाशायकेशपक्षेपरामृशः । ब्रह्मर्षीणांकुलेजातोराक्षसींयोनिमाश्रितः ।।6.81.18।।
output: "O evil minded Indrajith! You are born as Rakshasa in the clan of seers of vedic mantras and sought the womb of Rakshasa woman. It is for your own self destruction you seized her hair.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 81:
धिक्त्वांपापसमाचारंयस्यतेमतिरिदृशी । नृशंसानार्य दुर्वृत्त क्षुद्र पापपराक्रम ।।6.81.19।। अनार्यस्येदृशंकर्मघृणातेनास्तिनिर्घृण ।
output: "You are ignoble, mean, of sinful prowess, not merciful. You have resolved to take such a sinful action which is not worthy of you. You have no compassion to act in this manner."

instruction:

output: राघवश्चापि Raghava too, राक्षसवनौकसाम् Rakshasas and Vanaras, तम् them, विपुलम् विपुलम great, सङ्ग्रामनिर्घोषम् noise of the war, श्रुत्वा hearing, जाम्बवन्तम् to Jambavantha, उवाच ह said

instruction:

सौम्यनूनंहनुमताकृतंकर्मसुदुष्करम् । श्रूयते च यथाभीमस्सुमहावायुधस्वनः ।।6.83.2।।
output: सौम्य gentle, सुमहान् very great, भीमः terrific, आयुधस्वनः sound of weapons, यथा like that, श्रूयते was heard, हनुमता Hanuman, सुदुष्करम् very difficult कर्म action, कृतम् done, नूनम् surely

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तद्गच्छकुरुसाहाय्यंस्वबलेनाभिसम्वृतः । क्षिप्रमक्षपतेतस्यकपिश्रेष्ठस्ययुध्यतः ।।6.83.3।।
output: ऋक्षपतेःking of Bears, तत् therefore, स्वबलेन by your army, अभिसम्वृतः collected together, गच्छ go, युध्यतः to the battlefield, तस्य his, कपिश्रेष्ठस्य best of monkeys, क्षिप्रम् soon, साहाय्यम् to help

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋक्षराक्षस्तथोक्तस्तुस्वेनानीकेनसम्वृतः । आगच्छत्पश्चिमद्वारंहनूमान्यत्रवानरः ।।6.83.4।।
output: Rama having spoken thus, King of Bears surrounded by Vanaras went to Hanuman at the western gate.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
अथायान्तंहनूमन्तंददर्शर्क्षपतिपथि । वानरैःकृतसङ्ग्रामैश्श्वसद्भिरभिसम्वृतम् ।।6.83.5।।
output: Then the Lord of Bears saw Hanuman accompanied by Vanaras who fought in war coming sighing.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृष्टापथिहनूमांश्चतदृक्षबलमुद्यतम् । नीलमेघनिभंभीमंसन्निवार्यन्यवर्तत ।।6.83.6।।
output: Hanuman seeing the terrific army of Bears marching like a dark cloud asked them to return and he also returned with them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स तेनसहसैन्येनसन्निकर्षंमहायशाः । शीघ्रमागम्यरामायदुःखितोवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.83.7।।
output: महायशाः of great fame, सःhe, तेन by that, सैन्येनसह accompanied by army, शीघ्रम् quickly, सन्निकर्षम् submitted, आगम्य came, दुःखितः sorrowfully, रामाय to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत्spoken

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
समरेयुध्यमानानामस्माकंप्रेक्षतांपुरः । जघानरुदतींसीतामिन्द्रजिद्रावणात्मजः ।।6.83.8।।
output: रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, समरे in war, युध्यमानानम् while we were fighting the war, प्रेक्षताम् looking, अस्माकम् in front of us, पुरःearlier, रुदतीम् crying, सीताम् Sita, जघान struck

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उद्भ्रान्तचित्तस्तांदृष्टवाविषण्णोऽहमरिन्दमः । तदहंभवतोवृतंविज्ञापयितुमागतः ।।6.83.9।।
output: "O Tamer of enemies! Seeing her (Sita) bewildered in mind, worried, I have come to inform you accompanied by Vanaras."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वाराघवश्शोकमूर्चितः । निपपाततदाभूमौछिन्नमूलंइवद्रुमः ।।6.83.10।।
output: तदा then, तस्य his, तत् वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, राघवःRaghava, शोकमूर्छितः deluded in sorrow, छिन्नमूलः roots cut, द्रुमःइव like a tree, भूमौ on the ground, निपपात fell

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंभूमौदेवसङ्काशंपतितंदृश्यराघवम् । अभिपेतुस्समुत्पत्यसर्वतःकपिसत्तमाः ।।6.83.11।।
output: Seeing Raghava who is equal to god fallen on the ground, and the best of monkeys lifting him, the Vanaras from all over came jumping.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आसिञ्चन् सलिलैश्चैनंपद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिभिः । प्रदहन्तमानासाद्यंसहसाग्निमिवोद्यतम् ।।6.83.12।।
output: सहसा suddenly, उद्यतम् risen up, प्रदहन्तम् burning, अग्निमिव fire like, अनासाद्यम् reaching there, एनम् that way, पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिभिः with lotuses and lilies fragrance, सलिलैः water, असिञ्चन् sprinkled

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तंलक्ष्मणोऽथबाहुभ्यांपरिष्वज्यसुदुःखितः । उवाचराममस्वस्थंवाक्यंहेत्वर्थसम्युतम् ।।6.83.13।।
output: अथ and then, सुदुःखितः very worried, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अस्वस्थम् not well, तंरामम् him, Rama, बाहुभ्याम् arms, परिष्वज्य holding, हेत्वर्थसंयुतम् meaningful, वाक्यम् words, उवाचspoken

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शुभेवर्त्मनितिष्ठन्तंत्वामार्यविजितेन्द्रियम् । अनर्थेभ्यो न शक्नोतित्रातुंधर्मोनिरर्थकः ।।6.83.14।।
output: "O Noble Rama! If You, who have gained over senses and sticking to a virtuous path are not protected, from this calamity by righteousness, then righteousness is useless."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
भूतानांस्थावाराणां च जङ्गमानां च दर्शनम् । यथास्ति न तथाधर्मस्तेननास्तीतिमेमतिः ।।6.83.15।।
output: " As animate and inanimate beings are seen experiencing joy at present, righteousness is not the cause of joy, I think so."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यथैवस्थावरंव्यक्तंजङ्गमं न तथाविधम् । नायमर्थस्तथायुक्तस्त्वद्विधो न विपद्यते ।।6.83.16।।
output: स्थावरम् inanimate, यथैव in the same way, व्यक्तम् spoken, जङ्गमं च animate also, तथाशिधम् being so, तथा like that, अयम् this, अर्थः meaning, न युक्तः not proper, त्वद्विधः knowing that, न विपद्यते not there

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यद्यधर्मोभवेद्भूतोरावणोनरकंव्रजेत् । भवांश्चधर्मसम्युक्तोनैवंव्यसनमाप्नुयात् ।।6.83.17।।
output: अधर्मः unrighteousness, भूतः beings, भवेद्यदि if it is there, रावणः Ravana, नरकम् hell, व्रजेत् will be, धर्मसम्युक्तः endowed with righteousness, भवान् च you also, एवम् in that way, व्यसनम् agony, नाप्नुयात् not have

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
तस्य च व्यसनाभावाद्व्यसनंचागतेत्वयि । धर्मोभवत्यधर्मश्चपरस्परविरोधिनौ ।।6.83.18।।
output: " As Ravana has no sorrow and you have experienced agony the contraries of each other have changed the roles of righteousness and unrighteousness."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
धर्मेणोपलभेद्धर्ममधर्मंचाप्यधर्मतः । यद्यधर्मेणयुज्येयुर्येष्वधर्मःप्रतिष्ठितः ।।6.83.19।। यदिधर्मेणवियुज्येरन्नधर्मरुचयोजनाः । धर्मेणचरतांधर्मंचैषांधर्मफलंभवेत् ।।6.83.20।।
output: "The righteous attains the benefit through righteous means, and the unrighteous suffer by unrighteous means. If unrighteousness is rooted in the unrighteous and are pleased with unrighteousness they will be deprived of the result of righteousness. It is not otherwise."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
धर्मेणोपलभेद्धर्ममधर्मंचाप्यधर्मतः । यद्यधर्मेणयुज्येयुर्येष्वधर्मःप्रतिष्ठितः ।।6.83.19।। यदिधर्मेणवियुज्येरन्नधर्मरुचयोजनाः । धर्मेणचरतांधर्मंचैषांधर्मफलंभवेत् ।।6.83.20।।
output: "The righteous attains the benefit through righteous means, and the unrighteous suffer by unrighteous means. If unrighteousness is rooted in the unrighteous and are pleased with unrighteousness they will be deprived of the result of righteousness. It is not otherwise."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
यस्मादर्थाविवर्धन्तेयेष्वधर्मःप्रतिष्ठितः । क्लिश्यन्तेधर्मशीलाश्चतस्मादेतौनिरर्थकौ ।।6.83.21।।
output: "Since those rooted in unrighteous develop and are wealthy, and those who follow dharma suffer both these are meaningless."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
वध्यन्तेपापकर्माणोयद्यधर्मेणराघव । वधकर्महतोऽधर्मः स हतःकिंवधिष्यति ।।6.83.22।।
output: "Righteousness and unrighteousness are forms of actions, sinful or not sinful. If sinful action is unrighteous, those who have done sinful actions should suffer. Since sinful action is momentary, and as soon as the action is over unrighteousness is also gone. That being so how can unrighteousness cause pain to anyone?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
अथवाविहितेनायंहन्यतेहन्तिवापरम् । विधिरालिप्यतेतेन न स पापेनकर्मणा ।।6.83.23।।
output: "Or else if a man is destroyed by killing another, destiny which is engendered by the sinful action suffers and not the doer of sinful action."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अदृष्टप्रतिकारेणत्वव्यक्तेनासतासता । कथंशक्यंपरंप्राप्तुंधर्मेणारिविकर्षण ।।6.83.24।।
output: "O Crusher of enemies! How does righteousness get encountered? It is not seen. How to know whether it is real or unreal? Is it possible to know that the best result is attained by righteousness."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
यदिसत्स्यात्सतांमुख्यनासत्स्यत्तवकिञ्चन । त्वयायदीदृशंप्राप्तंतस्मात्सन्नोपपद्यते ।।6.83.25।।
output: "O foremost among the victorious! To you, who are a jewel no evil should accrue. Since such difficulty has been faced by you, the fact that good actions result in good destiny is not true."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
अथवादुर्बलःक्लीबोबलंधर्मोऽनुवर्तते । दुर्बलोहृतमर्यादो न सेव्यइतिमेमतिः ।।6.83.26।।
output: "Or else dharma becomes feeble, ineffective, submits to might, then it is better not to follow such dharma which is feeble, I think."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
बलस्ययदिचेद्धर्मोगुणभूतःपराक्रमे । धर्ममुत्सृज्यवर्तस्वयथाधर्मेतथाबले ।।6.83.27।।
output: "Giving up predominance of virtue, seek courage and submit to might for succeeding in action. Seek might just as you have sought dharma earlier for success."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथचेत्सत्यवचनंधर्म: किलपरन्तप । अनृतस्त्वय्यकरुणःकिं न बद्धस्त्वयापिता ।।6.83.28।।
output: "O scorcher of enemies! If you consider speaking the truth is dharma, why did you not bind your father (who promised to give the kingdom) and was not compassionate (spoke untruth later)."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
यदिधर्मोभवेद्भूतअधर्मोवापरन्तप । न स्महत्वामुनिंवज्रीकुर्यादिज्यांशतक्रतुः ।।6.83.29।।
output: "Indra killed an ascetic (Viswarupa) and did fire sacrifice. If dharma alone is his duty, he could have done hundreds of fire sacrifices and not have killed the ascetic. If adharma is duty he would have killed the ascetic and not done fire sacrifice."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
अधर्मसंश्रितोधर्मोविनाशयतिराघव । सर्वमेतद्यथाकामंकाकुत्स्थकुरुतेनरः ।।6.83.30।।
output: "Kakuthsa Rama! Kings followed dharma and adharma both according to context. Whether following dharma or adharma destruction is happening. Therefore, humans keep doing both as per their desire."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
ममचेदंमतंतातधरोऽयमितिराघव । धर्ममूलंत्वयाछिन्नंराज्यमुत्सृजतातदा ।।6.83.31।।
output: "Dear Raghava! In my opinion also depending on desire and context, following dharma or adharma is proper. You have severed the roots of dharma by giving up the kingdom."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्थेभ्योहिप्रवृद्धेभ्यःसम्वृत्तेभ्यस्ततस्ततः । क्रियाःसर्वाःप्रवर्तन्तेपर्वतेभ्यःइवापगाः ।।6.83.32।।
output: ततस्ततः, by all those means, सम्वृत्तेभ्यःaugmented, प्रवृद्धेभ्यः developed, अर्थेभ्यःprosperity, पर्वतेभ्यः mountains, अपगाःइव rivers flow, सर्वा all, क्रियाः actions, प्रवर्तन्तेहि follow

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अर्थेनहिविमुक्तस्यपुरुषस्याल्पचेतसः । विच्छिद्यन्तेक्रियास्सर्वाग्रीष्मेकुसरितोयथा ।।6.83.33।।
output: "Just like streams dry up in summer, if one who is of meagre intelligence and forsakes wealth, all his actions will be interrupted."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
सोऽयमर्थंपरित्यज्यसुखकामःसुखैधितः । पापमारभतेकर्तुंतदादोषःप्रवर्तते ।।6.83.34।।
output: "If one who has been happy seeks happiness on renouncing wealth then proceeds to perform sinful actions it is a mistake."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यस्यार्थास्तस्यमित्राणियस्यार्थास्यस्यबान्धवाः । यस्यार्थास्सपुमान्लोकेयस्यार्थाः स च पण्डितः ।।6.83.35।।
output: "Friends gather round him in whom riches abide. Relations stand by him who has wealth. He is considered manly in whom wealth abides, and he is learned who has wealth."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यस्यार्थास्स च विक्रान्तोयस्यार्थास्स च बुद्धिमान् । यस्यार्थास्समहाभागोयस्यार्थास्समहागुणः ।।6.83.36।।
output: यस्य whoseअर्थाः wealth, सः च he also, विक्रान्तः gallant, यस्य his, अर्थाः wealth, सः च he is बुद्धिमान् intelligent, यस्य his, अर्थाः wealth, सः he, महाभागः glorious, यस्य his, अर्थाः wealth, ससः superior, महागुणः of great virtues

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अर्थस्यैतेपरित्यागेदोषाःप्रव्याहृतामया । राज्यमुत्सृजतावीरयेनबुद्धिस्त्वयाकृता ।।6.83.37।।
output: वीर heroic, राज्यम् kingdom, उत्सृजता giving up, त्वया by you, येन by that, बुद्धि intellect having done, कृता do, मया by me, अर्थस्य wealth, परित्यागे giving up, एते those, दोषाः evils, प्रव्याहृताःfollow

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
यस्यार्थाःधर्मकामार्थास्तस्यसर्वंप्रदक्षिणम् । अधनेनार्थकामेननार्थश्शक्योविचिन्वता ।।6.83.38।।
output: For one who has wealth all his actions of dharma would give pleasure and favourable. One who has no wealth and is worrying about it can't attain it.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हर्षःकामश्चदर्पश्चधर्मःक्रोधश्शमोदमः । अर्थादेतानिसर्वाणिप्रवर्तन्तेनराधिप ।।6.83.39।।
output: "O Rama! Desire, delight, pride, virtue, anger, forgiveness, fortitude all these are effective through wealth."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 83:
येषांनश्यत्ययंलोकश्चरतांधर्मचारिणाम् । तेऽर्थास्त्वयि न दृश्यन्तेदुर्दिनेषुयथाग्रहाः ।।6.83.40।।
output: "Even if there is wealth if one renunciates wealth and follows dharma in this world they perish like planets on cloudy days."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वयिप्रव्रजितेवीरगुरोश्चवचनेस्थिते । रक्षसापहृताभार्याप्राणैःप्रियतरातव ।।6.83.41।।
output: "O heroic Rama! You have been faithful to the promise to your father and left home following dharma (giving up wealth), and your dear wife who is your life has been abducted by Rakshasa."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदद्यविपुलंवीरदुःखमिन्द्रजिताकृतम् । कर्मणाव्यपनेष्यामितस्मादुत्तिष्ठराघव ।।6.83.42।।

instruction:

output: Vibheeshana was pained to see Rama immersed in grief, depressed in spirit, and asked for What is all this grief for?

output: Lakshmana looking at Sugriva's face and also at the Vanaras, his eyes bathed in tears spoke in a dull tone.

output: Vibheeshana spoke these meaningful words to Rama, who was unconscious, restraining Saumithri from speaking.

instruction:

output: "O mighty armed Rama! with reference to Sita, you do not know Ravana's opinion. He will never kill Sita."

output: Immersed in grief, Raghava could not make out the words spoken by Vibheeshana.

instruction:

output: Then Rama, who can win over enemies, picked up courage, said to Vibheeshana seated near him in front of Vanaras.
