instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मुहूर्ताल्लब्धसंज्ञस्तुमहापार्श्वोमहाबलः ।।6.99.10।। अङ्गदंबहुभिर्बाणैर्भूयस्तंप्रत्यविध्यत ।
output: मुहूर्तात् in a short while, लब्धसंज्ञः gaining consciousness, महाबलः mighty, महापार्श्वः Mahaparsva, बहुभिः many, बाणैः shafts, तम् them, अङ्गदम् on Angada, भूयःagain, प्रत्यविध्यत struck in turn

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 99:
जाम्बवन्तंत्रिभिर्बाणैराजघानस्तनान्तरे ।।6.99.11।। ऋक्षराजंगवाक्षं च जघानबहुभिश्शरैः ।
output: Mahaparsva pierced three shafts into the chest of Jambavantha and attacked Gavaksha with many arrows.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जाम्बवन्तंगवाक्षं च स दृष्टवाशरपीडितौ ।।6.99.12।। जग्राहपरिघंघोरमङ्गदःक्रोधमूर्छितः ।
output: Seeing Gavaksha and Jambavantha afflicted by shafts, deluded with anger, Angada took hold of a dreadful iron bar.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्याङ्गदःप्रकुपितोराक्षसस्यतमायसम् ।।6.99.13।। दूरस्थितस्यपरिघंरविरश्मिसमप्रभम् । द्वावाभ्यांभुजाभ्यांसङ्गृह्यभ्रामयित्वा च वेगवान् ।।6.99.14।। महापार्श्वस्यचिक्षेपवधार्थंवालिनस्सुतः ।
output: Vali's son Angada got enraged, seized an iron bar which shone like the radiant sun's rays and stood at a distance to kill Mahaparsva. Angada whirling the iron bar round and round hurled it around and thrown at Mahaparsva.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 99:
तस्याङ्गदःप्रकुपितोराक्षसस्यतमायसम् ।।6.99.13।। दूरस्थितस्यपरिघंरविरश्मिसमप्रभम् । द्वावाभ्यांभुजाभ्यांसङ्गृह्यभ्रामयित्वा च वेगवान् ।।6.99.14।। महापार्श्वस्यचिक्षेपवधार्थंवालिनस्सुतः ।
output: Vali's son Angada got enraged, seized an iron bar which shone like the radiant sun's rays and stood at a distance to kill Mahaparsva. Angada whirling the iron bar round and round hurled it around and thrown at Mahaparsva.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 99:
स तुक्षिप्तोबलवतापरिघन्तस्यरक्षसः ।।6.99.15।। धनुश्चसशरंहस्ताछचिरस्त्रांचाप्यपातयत् ।
output: That iron bar hurled by Angada hit the forehead of the Rakshasa.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंसमासाद्यवेगेनवालिपुत्रःप्रतापवान् ।।6.99.16।। तलेनाभ्यहनत्क्रुद्धः कर्णमूले सकुण्डले ।
output: Courageous son of Vali, enraged, with all speed, slapped the Rakshasa's ear adorned with shining earrings, with his palm.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तुक्रुद्धोमहावेगोमहापार्श्वोमहाद्युति ।।6.99.17।। करेणैकेनजग्राहसुमहान्तंपरश्वथम् ।
output: Angry Mahaparsva, who was endowed with speed and shining brightly, took hold of an extraordinary battle axe in one hand.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 99:
तंम्तैलधौतंविमलंशैलसारमयंदृढम् ।।6.99.18।। राक्षसःपरमक्रुद्धोवालिपुत्रेन्यपातयत् ।
output: Extremely enraged Rakshasa, hurled at Vali's son that axe that was cleansed with oil, the clean strong axe that was like feet of a mountain.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेनवामांसफलकेभृशंप्रत्यवपादितम् ।।6.99.19।। अङ्गदोमोक्ष्यामाससरोषस्सपरश्वधम् ।
output: Angada, full of fury, escaped Mahaparsva's aim to strike his left shoulder blade in violence.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 99:
सवीरोवज्रसङ्काशमङ्गदोमुष्टिमात्मनः ।।6.99.20।। संवर्तयत्सुसङ्कृद्धःपितृतुल्यपराक्रमः ।
output: Angada, who was equal to his father in his prowess, was highly furious and himself clenched his fist which resembled thunderbolt.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 99:
राक्षसस्यस्तनाभ्याशेमर्मज्ञोहृदयंप्रति ।।6.99.21।। इन्द्राशनिमस्पर्शं स मुष्टिंविन्यपातयत् ।
output: Angada who knew the vital parts, pierced into the middle of the breasts of the Rakshasa into the heart by his fist which was equal to Indra's thunderbolt.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेनतस्यनिपातेनराक्षसस्यमहामृधे ।।6.99.22।। पफालहृदयंचास्य स पपातहतोभुवि ।
output: In that great conflict, struck by the fist, the Rakshasa (Mahaparsva's) heart broke and killed and fell on the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्मिन्निपतितेभूमौतत्सैन्यंसम्प्रचुक्षुभे ।।6.99.23।। अभवच्चमहान्क्रोधस्समरेरावणस्यतु ।
output: Mahaparsva having fallen down in the battle, the army was bewildered, and Ravana was overcome with anger.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानराणांश्चहृष्टानांसिंहनादःसुपुष्कलः ।।6.99.24।। स्पोटयन्निवशब्देनलङ्कांसाट्टालगोपुराम् । महेन्द्रेणेवदेवानांनादस्समभवन्महान् ।।6.99.25।।
output: Highly rejoiced Vanaras roared in high pitch sound. The tall attics and gates of Lanka vibrated with sound. Even the gods, accompanied by Indra, made great sounds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 99:
वानराणांश्चहृष्टानांसिंहनादःसुपुष्कलः ।।6.99.24।। स्पोटयन्निवशब्देनलङ्कांसाट्टालगोपुराम् । महेन्द्रेणेवदेवानांनादस्समभवन्महान् ।।6.99.25।।
output: Highly rejoiced Vanaras roared in high pitch sound. The tall attics and gates of Lanka vibrated with sound. Even the gods, accompanied by Indra, made great sounds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
महोदरमहापार्श्वौहतौदृष्टवातुराक्ष । तस्मिंश्चनिहतेवीरेविरूपाक्षेमहाबले ।।6.100.1।। आविवेशमहान् क्रोधोरावणंतुमहामृधे । सूतं सञ्चोदयामास वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह ।।6.100.2।।
output: On seeing Mahodara and Mahaparsva killed in the great war, Virupaksha of extraordinary might also killed, Ravana was highly infuriated and addressed the charioteer in the following words.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महोदरमहापार्श्वौहतौदृष्टवातुराक्ष । तस्मिंश्चनिहतेवीरेविरूपाक्षेमहाबले ।।6.100.1।। आविवेशमहान् क्रोधोरावणंतुमहामृधे । सूतं सञ्चोदयामास वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह ।।6.100.2।।
output: Rama and Ravana armed with excellent bows and powerful missiles begin to fight.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निहतानाममात्यानांरुद्धस्यनगरस्य च । दुःखमेवापनेष्यामि हत्या तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।।6.100.3।।
output: "On killing both Rama and Lakshmana, I will relieve the sorrow of ministers killed and of Lanka from suffering.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
रामवृक्षंरणेहमनिसीतापुष्पफलप्रदम् । प्रशाखायस्यसुग्रीवोजाम्बवान्कुमुदोनलः ।।6.100.4।। दिविदश्चैवमैन्दश्चअङ्गदोगन्दमादनः । हनुमांश्चसुषेणव्चसर्वे च हरियूथपाः ।।6.100.5।।
output: That tree in the shape of Rama for which Sugriva, Jambavan, Kumuda, Dwivida, Mainda, Angada, Gandhamadana and Hanuman are the principal branches, that tree which will yield flowers and fruit in the shape of Sita will be cut down in the battle.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामवृक्षंरणेहमनिसीतापुष्पफलप्रदम् । प्रशाखायस्यसुग्रीवोजाम्बवान्कुमुदोनलः ।।6.100.4।। दिविदश्चैवमैन्दश्चअङ्गदोगन्दमादनः । हनुमांश्चसुषेणव्चसर्वे च हरियूथपाः ।।6.100.5।।
output: That tree in the shape of Rama for which Sugriva, Jambavan, Kumuda, Dwivida, Mainda, Angada, Gandhamadana and Hanuman are the principal branches, that tree which will yield flowers and fruit in the shape of Sita will be cut down in the battle.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
स दिशोदशघोषेणरथस्यातिरथोमहान् । नादयन् प्रययौतूर्णंराघवंचाभ्यधावत ।।6.100.6।।
output: Ravana, the great charioteer, who could surpass many rushed quickly towards Raghava, by the chariot making great noise reverberating in all directions.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
पूरितातेनशब्देनसनदीगिरिकानना । सञ्चचाल मही सर्वा त्रस्तसिंहमृगद्विजा ।।6.100.7।।
output: By that sound, the rivers, mountains, and forests including the earth, filled with the boars, lions and other beasts were shaken.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
तामसंसुमहाघोरंचकारास्त्रंसुदारुणम् । निर्ददाहकपीन् सर्वांस्तेप्रपेतुःसमन्ततः ।।6.100.8।।
output: He released an exceedingly formidable weapon called Taamasa which consumed all the monkeys all over and had fallen.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
उत्पपातरजोभूमौतैर्भग्नैःसम्प्रधावितैः । न हितत्सहितुंशेकुर्भ्रह्मणानिर्मितंस्वयम् ।।6.100.9।।
output: As the Taamasa missile had been built and bestowed by Brahma, the monkeys were unable to bear and by their running dust had risen.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान्यनीकान्यनेकानि रावणस्य शरोत्तमैः । दृष्टवाभग्नानि शतशो राघवः पर्यवस्थितः ।।6.100.10।।
output: Ravana's shafts had burnt many hundreds of Vanaras in war and seeing that Rama took a firm stand.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोराक्षसशार्दूलोविद्राव्यहरिवाहिनीम् । स ददर्शततोरामंतिष्ठन्तमपराजितम् ।।6.100.11।। लक्ष्मणेनसहभ्रात्राविष्णुनावासवंयथा । अलिखन्तमिवाकाशमवष्टभ्यमहद्धनुः ।।6.100.12।। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षंदीर्घबाहुमरिन्दमम् ।
output: Thereafter, the tiger among Rakshasas having routed the Vanaras from there, saw the lotus petaleyed Rama, endowed with long arms, an unconquered one, the tamer of enemies, standing with his brother Lakshmana like Lord Vishnu with Indra, holding a huge bow that was scraping the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
ततोराक्षसशार्दूलोविद्राव्यहरिवाहिनीम् । स ददर्शततोरामंतिष्ठन्तमपराजितम् ।।6.100.11।। लक्ष्मणेनसहभ्रात्राविष्णुनावासवंयथा । अलिखन्तमिवाकाशमवष्टभ्यमहद्धनुः ।।6.100.12।। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षंदीर्घबाहुमरिन्दमम् ।
output: Thereafter, the tiger among Rakshasas having routed the Vanaras from there, saw the lotus petaleyed Rama, endowed with long arms, an unconquered one, the tamer of enemies, standing with his brother Lakshmana like Lord Vishnu with Indra, holding a huge bow that was scraping the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
ततोरामोमहातेजाःसौमित्रिसहितोबली ।।6.100.13।। वानरांश्चरणेभग्नानापतन्तं च रावणम् । समीक्ष्यराघवोहृष्टोमध्येजग्राहकार्मुकम् ।।6.100.14।।
output: Then the highly brilliant, mighty Raghava along with Saumithri, witnessing the Vanaras routed in war and Ravana coming towards him. joyful Rama took hold of his bow and held in the midst.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 100:
ततोरामोमहातेजाःसौमित्रिसहितोबली ।।6.100.13।। वानरांश्चरणेभग्नानापतन्तं च रावणम् । समीक्ष्यराघवोहृष्टोमध्येजग्राहकार्मुकम् ।।6.100.14।।
output: Then the highly brilliant, mighty Raghava along with Saumithri, witnessing the Vanaras routed in war and Ravana coming towards him. joyful Rama took hold of his bow and held in the midst.

instruction:

मुद्गराःकूटपाशाश्चदीप्ताश्चाशनयस्तथा । निष्पेतुर्विविधास्तीक्ष्णावाताइवयुगक्षये ।।6.101.4।।
output: Several kinds of sharp multitudes of weapons and flaming thunderbolts issued forth like gales at the time of universal destruction.

instruction:

output: Glorious Raghava, who is the best of those proficient in the use of missiles endowed with great splendour, neutralized that missile (of Ravana) with the missile presided over by Gandharvas.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
तस्मिन्प्रतिहतेऽतुराघवेणमहात्मना । रावणःक्रोधाताम्राक्षस्सौरमस्त्रमुदैरयत् ।।6.101.6।।
output: When the missile of Ravana was turned void by the great selfRaghava, Ravana's eyes turned red in anger, and he used a missile presided over by the Sun God.

instruction:

output: Thereafter, brilliant discus of the Sun God, issued forth from wise Ravana's bow at a terrific speed.

instruction:

output: सःराघवः that Raghava, बाणौघैः shafts, तानि them, चक्राणि discuses, रावणस्य of Ravana, आयुधानि च and the weapons, चमूमुखे forefront of army, चिच्छेद shattered

output: Rakshasa king, frustrated on seeing the missiles, pierced Rama in his private parts with shafts.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
स विद्धोदशभिर्बाणैर्महाकार्मुकनिस्सृतैः । रावणेनमहातेजा न प्राकम्पतराघवः ।।6.101.11।।
output: Even though pierced by Ravana with ten arrows, Rama, endowed with high energy, was not shaken.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोविव्याथगात्रेषुसर्वेषुसमितिञ्जयः । राघवस्तुसुसङ्क्रुद्धोरावणंबहुभिश्शरैः ।।6.101.12।।
output: Then, Raghava, who had won many battles, became highly furious, piercing Ravana in all his limbs with many arrows.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरेक्रुद्धोराघवस्यानुजोबली । लक्ष्मणःसायकान्सप्तजग्राहपरवीरहा ।।6.101.13।।
output: In the meantime, enraged Lakshmana, the brother of Rama, a mighty warrior, seized hold of seven shafts.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
तै: स्सायकैर्महावेगैरावणस्यमहाद्युति । ध्वजंमनुष्यशीर्षंतुतस्यचिच्छेदनैकधा ।।6.101.14।।
output: Lakshmana, who was endowed with extraordinary splendour, for his part, with his shafts which had great force, shattered the device of man's head on the flag post of Ravana.

instruction:

output: श्रीमान् celebrated, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, बाणेन by the arrows, नैरृतस्य night ranger's, सारथेः charioteer, ज्वलितकुण्डलम् glittering earrings, शिरः head, जहार struck

instruction:

तस्यबाणैश्चचिच्छेदधनुर्गजकरोपमम् । लक्ष्मणोराक्षसेन्द्रस्यपञ्चभिर्निशितैस्तदा ।।6.101.16।।
output: Then Lakshmana split with five sharpened arrows the bow of Rakshasa king that resembled elephant's trunk.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
नीलमेघनिभांश्चास्यसदश्वान् पर्वतोपमान् । जघानाप्लुत्यगदयारावणस्यविभीषणः ।।6.101.17।।
output: Vibheeshana struck with his formidable mace the horses of Ravana which were like dark clouds and huge like mountains.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
हताश्वात्त्तुस्वोवेगादवप्लुत्यमहारथात् । कोपमाहारत्तीव्रंभ्रातरंप्रतिरावणः ।।6.101.18।।
output: With the horses of his chariot dead, Ravana descended from the huge chariot and exhibited violent rage against his brother.

instruction:

output: ततः then, महाशक्तिः of extraordinary energy, प्रतापवान् powerful leader, राक्षसेन्द्र Rakshasa king, प्रदीप्ताम् flaming, अशनीमिव thunderbolt like, शक्तिम् javelin, विभीषणस्य at Vibheeshana, चिक्षेप hurled

instruction:

output: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अप्राप्तामेव even before it reached, ताम् those, त्रिभिः three, बाणैः shafts, चिच्छेद shattered, अथ and then, महारणए in that huge conflict, वानराणाम् Vanaras, सन्नादःcheered, उदतिष्ठत rose

output: Then, Ravana seized hold of a huge javelin shining with its own splendour, a formidable one even for the god of death.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सावेगिताबलवतारावणेनदुरात्मना । जज्वालसुमहातेजादीप्ताशनिसमप्रभा ।।6.101.23।।
output: That javelin was endowed with speed, resembling thunderbolt in splendour, whirled round by the mighty and evilminded Ravana, shone.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरेवीरोलक्ष्मणस्तंविभीषणम् । प्राणसंशयमापन्नंतूर्णमभ्यवपद्यत ।।6.101.24।।
output: In the meantime, seeing Vibheeshana's life in danger, heroic Lakshmana reached him and stood obstructing (the javelin).

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तंविमोक्षयितुंवीरश्चापमायम्यलक्ष्मणः । रावणंशक्तिहस्तंवैशरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।।6.101.25।।
output: Heroic Lakshmana stretched his bow and showered volley of arrows and covered Ravana who held javelin in hand.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:

output: Covered by the stream of shafts discharged by the great self, Lakshmana, Ravana could not shake his hand and was not inclined in his mind to strike (Vibheeshana).

instruction:

output: सःरावणः that Ravana, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, भ्रातरम् brother, मोक्षितम् rescued, दृष्टवा seeing, लक्ष्मणाभिमुखःfacing Lakshmana, तिष्ठन् stood, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke

मोक्षितस्तेबलश्लाघिन्यस्मादेवंविभीषणः । विमुच्यराक्षसंशक्तिस्त्वयीयंविनिपात्यते ।।6.101.28।।
output: "Lakshmana! You are proud of your might of rescuing Vibheeshana. Now this javelin released from me will strike at you."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एषातेहृदयंभित्त्वाशक्तिर्लोहितलक्षणा । मद्भाहुपरिघोत्सृष्टाप्राणानादाययास्यति ।।6.101.29।।
output: "This javelin released by my bludgeonlike arm will pierce your heart and take away your life."

instruction:

output: Enraged Ravana, having spoken in this manner, hurled the javelin adorned with eight bells making loud noise, designed magically by Maya, a stupendous one capable of destroying any enemy, which was glowing with shine, aiming at Lakshmana, and roared aloud.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
साक्षिप्ताभीमवेगेनवज्राशनिसमस्वना । शक्तिरभ्यपतद्वेगाल्लक्ष्मणंरणमूर्धनि ।।6.101.32।।
output: भीमवेगेन at terrific speed, क्षिप्ता hurled, वज्राशनिसमस्वना equal to thunderbolt, साशक्तिः that javelin, रणमूर्धनि forefront of war, वेगात् speedily, लक्ष्मणम् towards Lakshmana, अभ्यपतत् went

output: Seeing the javelin coming towards Lakshmana, Raghava said 'May Lakshmana be auspicious. May he be well. May your attempt to kill Lakshmana be ineffective and wasted'.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
रावणेनरणेशक्तिःक्रुद्धेनाशीविषोपमाः । मुक्ताशूरस्यभीतस्यलक्ष्मणस्यममज्जसा ।।6.101.34।।
output: Released by Ravana in anger, that javelin, which was like poison of venomous serpent, pierced into the chest of Lakshmana who stood fearless.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

output: उरगराजस्य king of serpents, Vasuki, दीप्यमाना glowing, जिह्वेव like tongue, महाद्युतिःflaming, महावेगा at high speed, सा that javelin, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshman's, महोरपि broad chest, न्यपतत् descended on

output: Thereafter, Lakshmana fell on the ground, pierced by the javelin, deep into the heart from far with great force by Ravana.

instruction:

तदवस्थंसमीपस्थोलक्ष्मणंप्रेक्ष्यराघवः । भ्रातृस्नेहान्महातेजाविषण्णहृदयोऽभवत् ।।6.101.37।।
output: Watching Lakshmana in that situation, most courageous Raghava, out of brotherly affection felt despondent at heart.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
स मुहूर्तमिवध्यात्वाबाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः । बभूवसम्रब्धतरोयुगान्तइवपावकः ।।6.101.38।।
output: He (Raghava) stood confused for a short while as it was, his eyes filled with tears like fire at the end of the universe.

output: रक्षसा Rakshasa, क्षिप्रहस्तेन released from his hand, बाणौघैः by the arrows, अर्दिताःचैव pained, ते they, हरिश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, बलीयसा with great strength, रावणेन by Ravana, प्रहिताम् discharged, ताम् them, शक्तिम् javelin, यत्नतःअपि effort also, अवमर्दितुम् to pull out, न शेकुः not feasible

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तामपिप्रहितांशक्तिंरावणेनबलीयसा ।।6.101.41।। यत्नतस्तेहरिश्रेष्ठा न शेकुरवमर्दितुम् । अर्दिताश्चैवबाणौघैस्तेक्षिप्रहस्तेनरक्षसा ।।6.101.42 ।
output: It was not feasible for the best of Vanaras to pull out the javelin (from Lakshmana's body) discharged with great strength from Ravana's hand, despite great efforts.

instruction:

सौमित्रिंसाविनिर्भिद्यप्रविष्टाधरणीतलम् । तांकराभ्यांपरामृश्यरामःशक्तिंभयावहाम् ।।6.101.43।। बभञ्जसमरेक्रुद्धोबलवान्विचकर्ष च ।
output: It pierced through Lakshmana's body and entered into the earth. Mighty Rama held the terrific javelin with both hands bent it and removed in the course of struggle.

instruction:

तस्यनिष्कर्षतःशक्तिंरावणेनबलीयसा ।।6.101.44।। शराःसर्वेषुगात्रेषुपातितामर्मभेदिनः ।
output: While Rama was pulling out the javelin, mighty and courageous Ravana struck him in his private parts and all over the body with arrows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 101:
अचिन्तयित्वातान्बाणान्समालशिष्य च लक्ष्मणम् ।।6.101.45।। अब्रवीच्चहनूमन्तंसुग्रीवं च महाकपिम् ।
output: Not minding the arrows struck, Rama embraced Lakshmana and spoke to Hanumantha and the great Vanara Sugriva.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्ष्मणंपरिवार्यैवतिष्ठध्वंवानरोत्तमाः ।।6.101.46।। पराक्रमस्यकालोऽयंसम्प्राप्तोमेचिरेप्सितः । पापात्मायंदशग्रीवोवध्यतांपापनिश्चयः ।।6.101.47।। काङ्क्षितस्स्तोककस्येवघर्मान्तेमेघदर्शनम् ।
output: "O foremost of Vanaras! Take care of Lakshmana by surrounding him. Just as clouds appeared before the chataka bird waiting for long, time has come to exhibit my valour which was awaited for long. Now I will destroy the ten headed Ravana of sinful resolve rightfully in a short while from now."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
शक्त्याविनिहतंदृष्टवारावणेनबलीयसा । लक्ष्मणंसमरेशूरंरूधिरौघपरिप्लुतम् ।।6.102.1।। स दत्त्वातुमुलंयुद्धंरावणस्यदुरात्मनः । विसृजन्नेवबाणौघान् सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.102.2।।
output: Seeing Lakshmana struck by exceedingly mighty, evil minded Ravana's javelin and soaked in blood Rama giving intense fight by discharging arrows also spoke as follows to Sushena.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शक्त्याविनिहतंदृष्टवारावणेनबलीयसा । लक्ष्मणंसमरेशूरंरूधिरौघपरिप्लुतम् ।।6.102.1।। स दत्त्वातुमुलंयुद्धंरावणस्यदुरात्मनः । विसृजन्नेवबाणौघान् सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.102.2।।
output: Rama laments over Lakshmana's unconscious state. Hanuman is directed by Sushena to Himalayas and get herbs for treating Lakshmana. Hanuman gets the herbs and on inhalation of the herbs Lakshmana recovers.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषरावणवीर्येणलक्ष्मणःपतितोभुविः । सर्पवच्चेष्टतेवीरोभूमौशोकमुदिरीयन् ।।6.102.3।।
output: रावणवीर्येण prowess of Ravana, भुवि earth, पतितः fallen, एषः like that, वीरः hero, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शोकम् sorrow, उदीरयन् writhing, सर्पवत् like snake, भूमौ on the ground, चेष्टते rolling

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
शोणितार्द्रमिमंवीरंप्राणैःप्रियतरंमम । पश्यतोममकाशक्तिर्योद्धुंपर्याकुलात्मनः ।।6.102.4।।
output: ' As I see Lakshmana, who is more than my life, and loving soaked in blood, my mind is agitated. How can I have the energy to fight?'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
अ यं स समरश्लाघीभ्रातामेशुभलक्षणः । यदिपञ्चत्वमापन्नःप्राणैर्मेकिंसुखेनवा ।।6.102.5।।
output: 'Lakshmana, my brother, is praised for his efficiency in war, is endowed with auspicious marks. If he is met with death, what use is my happiness and life for me?'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लज्जतीवहिवीर्यंभ्रश्यतीवकराद्धनुः । सायकाव्यवसीदन्तिदृष्टिर्भाष्पवशंगता ।।6.102.6।।
output: वीर्यम् heroism, लज्जतीव shy, धनुः bow, करात् from hand, भ्रश्यतीव slip from, सायकाः arrows, व्यवसीदन्ति dropping, दृष्टिः vision, बाष्पवशम् filled with tears, गताहि gone

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
अवसीदन्तिगात्राणिस्वप्नयानेनृणामिव । चिन्तामेवर्ततेतीव्रामुमूर्षापि च जायते ।।6.102.7।।
output: 'Seeing Lakshmana in this state, just as in dream, my limbs are retrieving while walking, being on the point of death intense sorrow is growing and the desire to live is gone.'

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भ्रातरंनिहतंदृष्टवारावणेनदुरात्मना । विष्टनन्तंतुदुःखार्तंमर्मण्यभिहतंभृशम् ।।6.102.8।।
output: दुरात्मना evil minded, रावणेन by Ravana, निहतम् wounded, विष्टनन्तम् filled with grief, दुःखार्तम् sad, भृशम् breathing heavily, मर्मणि vital parts, अभिहतम् struck, भ्रातरम् brother, दृष्टवा seeing

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
राघवोभ्रातरंदृष्टवाप्रियंप्राणंबहिश्चरम् । दुःखेनमहताविष्टोध्यानशोकपरायणः ।।6.102.9।।
output: राघवो Raghava, भ्रातरं brother, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रियं dear, प्राणंबहिश्चरम् life outside, दुःखेन in grief, महताविष्टो overcome by anxiety, ध्यानशोकपरायणःgave himself to great sorrow lost senses

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
परंविषादमापन्नोविललापाकुलेन्द्रियः । भ्रातरंनिहतंदृष्टवालक्ष्मणंरणपांसुषु ।।6.102.10।।
output: Seeing the wounded brother Lakshmana in the battlefield, the very sad Rama lost control over his senses and grieved.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
विजयोऽपिहिमेशूर न प्रियायोपकल्पते । अचक्षुर्विषयश्चन्द्रःकांप्रीतिंजनयिष्यति ।।6.102.11।।
output: 'O Hero! Even victory for me will not give joy. What pleasure will one have if he desires to see the moon when he has lost vision?'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किंमेयुद्धेनकिंप्राणैर्युद्धकार्यं न विद्यते । यत्रायंनिहतश्शेतेरणमूर्धनिलक्ष्मणः ।।6.102.12।।
output: 'What purpose is there to fight in battle or in life with Lakshmana lying in the forefront struck in the battlefield?'

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
यथैवमांवनंयान्तमनुयातिमहाद्युतिः । अहमप्युपयास्यामितथैवैनंयमक्षयम् ।।6.102.13।।
output: 'Lakshmana who is endowed with splendour followed me to the forest. In the same way I will follow him to the god of death.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इष्टबन्धुजनोनित्यंमां स नित्यमनुव्रतः । इमामवस्थांगमितोराक्षसैःकूटयोधिभिः ।।6.102.14।।
output: 'Lakshmana, who loved the kin and was devoted to me, has been led to pass by the Rakshasas.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
देशेदेशेकलत्राणिदेशेदेशे च बान्दवाः । तंतुदेशं न पश्यामियत्रभ्रातासहोदरः ।।6.102.15।।
output: 'Wives can be found everywhere, relatives can be found everywhere but biological sibling brothers are not found in any place.'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इत्येवंविलपन्तंतंशोकविह्वलितेद्रनियम् । विवेष्टमानंकरुणमच्छवसन्तंपुनःपुनः ।।6.102.16।। राममाश्वासयनवीरसुषेनोवाक्यमब्रवीत
output: Grieving in this manner, lost control over senses, and discrimination, Rama was sighing again and again and was pitiable. Sushena, the hero consoling Rama spoke these words.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किनुराज्येनदुर्धर्षलक्ष्मणेनविनामम । कथंवक्ष्याम्यहंत्वम्बांसुमित्रांपुत्रवत्सलाम् ।।6.102.17।।
output: 'Without Lakshmana who is difficult to win, what use is kingdom to me? What can I tell mother Sumithra who is the lover of her son?'

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न मृथोयंमहाबाहो लक्ष्मणोलक्षमिवर्धन: । न चास्यविक्रतंवक्त्रानापिशस्वासं न निष्प्रभं ।।6.102.18।।
output: O Broad shouldered Rama! Enhancer of prosperity, Lakshmana is not dead. His face has not changed, and he has not lost splendour.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
सुप्रभंसुप्रसन्नं च मुखमस्यनिरीक्ष्यताम् ।।6.102.19।। पद्मपत्रतलौहस्तौसुप्रसन्ने च लोचने ।
output: 'His face is radiant and pleasing to see. His palms are like red lotuses and his eyes are so pleasant'.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऐ वं न विद्यतेरूपंगतासूनांविशम्पते ।।6.102.20।। माविषादंमृकृथावीरसप्राणोऽयमरिन्दम ।
output: "O hero! Those who cease to live will not have such appearance and signs. He who is a tamer of foes is alive. I tell you, do not grieve."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आ ख्यासतितुप्रसुप्तस्यस्रस्तगात्रस्यभूतले ।।6.102.21।। सोच्छवासंहृदयंवीरकम्पमानंमुहुर्मुहुः ।
output: तु you, प्रसुप्तस्य fallen thus, स्रस्तगात्रस्य from the limbs, सोच्छवासम् lying alive, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, कम्पमानम् throbbing, हृदयम् heart, आख्याति is known

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
एवमुक्त्वामहाप्राज्ञःसुषेणोराघवंवचः ।।6.102.22।। समीपस्थमुवाचेदंहनूमन्तंमहाकपिम् ।
output: Very wise Sushena, having spoken like that to Raghava, spoke to the great Vanara, Hanuman nearby.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सौम्य शीघ्रमितोगत्वाशैलमौषधिपर्वतम् ।।6.102.23।। पूर्वंतुकथितोयोऽसौवीर जाम्बवताशुभ: । दक्षिणेशिखरेजातामोषधिमानय ।।6.102.24।। सवर्णकरणींनाम्नासावर्ण्यकरणींतथा । सञ्जीवकरणींवीरसन्धानीं च महौषधीम् ।।6.102.25।। सञ्जीवनार्धंवीरस्यलक्ष्मणस्यमहात्मनः ।
output: "O gentle Hanumantha! Going to that mountain of herbs about which Jambavan had earlier spoken to you, get the herbs from the southern peak of that great mountain. To make Lakshmana the great soul alive quickly go and get Savarankarani, Sarvakarani so also Sanjeevakarani and Sandhanakarani and come."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
सौम्य शीघ्रमितोगत्वाशैलमौषधिपर्वतम् ।।6.102.23।। पूर्वंतुकथितोयोऽसौवीर जाम्बवताशुभ: । दक्षिणेशिखरेजातामोषधिमानय ।।6.102.24।। सवर्णकरणींनाम्नासावर्ण्यकरणींतथा । सञ्जीवकरणींवीरसन्धानीं च महौषधीम् ।।6.102.25।। सञ्जीवनार्धंवीरस्यलक्ष्मणस्यमहात्मनः ।
output: "O gentle Hanumantha! Going to that mountain of herbs about which Jambavan had earlier spoken to you, get the herbs from the southern peak of that great mountain. To make Lakshmana the great soul alive quickly go and get Savarankarani, Sarvakarani so also Sanjeevakarani and Sandhanakarani and come."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सौम्य शीघ्रमितोगत्वाशैलमौषधिपर्वतम् ।।6.102.23।। पूर्वंतुकथितोयोऽसौवीर जाम्बवताशुभ: । दक्षिणेशिखरेजातामोषधिमानय ।।6.102.24।। सवर्णकरणींनाम्नासावर्ण्यकरणींतथा । सञ्जीवकरणींवीरसन्धानीं च महौषधीम् ।।6.102.25।। सञ्जीवनार्धंवीरस्यलक्ष्मणस्यमहात्मनः ।
output: सौम्य gentle, वीर heroic, यःअसौ that which, पूर्वम् earlier, जाम्बवता Jambavantha, तव your, कथितः spoken, औषथिपर्वतम् mountain of herbs, शैलम् peak, इतः now, शीघ्रम् quickly, गत्वाreach, दक्षिणेशिखरे southern peak, जाताम् having gone, नाम्ना by name, सवर्णकरणीम् Sarvakarani, महौषधिम् great herb, तथा so also, सावर्ण्यकरणीम् Savarnakarani, सञ्जीवकरणीम् Sanjeevakarani, सन्धानीं च Sandhanakarani, महौषधीम् great herbs, महात्मनः great soul, वीरस्यhero's, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, सञ्जीवनार्धम् to make him alive, इह here, आनय come

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्येवमुक्तोहनुमान्गत्वाचौषथिपर्वतम् ।।6.102.26।। चिन्तामभ्यगमछ्रचीमानजानं स्ता महौषधीः ।
output: इत्येवम् in this manner, उक्तः having said, श्रीमान् glorious, हनुमान् Hanuman, औषधिपर्वतम् mountain of herbs, गत्वा having gone, ताः those, महौषदीः great herbs, अजानन् not able to recognize, चिन्ताम् thought over, अभ्यगतम् after having reached

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यबुद्धि: समुत्पन्नामारुतेरमितौजसः ।।6.102.27।। इदमेवगमिष्यामिगृहीत्वाशिखरंगिरेः ।
output: Highly brilliant Hanuman used his intellect and thought to seize the peak of the mountain on which herbs had sprung.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्मिंस्तुशिखरेजातामोषधिंतांसुखावहाम् ।।6.102.28।। प्रतर्केणावगच्छामिसुषेणोह्यवमब्रवीत् ।
output: सुखावहाम् that which does good, ताम् to him, ओषधिम् herb, अस्मिन् in this, शिखरे peak, जाताम् growing, प्रतर्केण reasoning, अवगच्छामि is known, सुषेणः Sushena, एवम् in that way, अब्रवीत् हि has told

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अगृह्ययदिगच्छामिविशल्यकरणीमहम् ।।6.102.29।। कालात्ययेनदोषःस्याद्वैक्लब्यं च महद्भवेत् ।
output: अहम् I, विशल्यकरणीम् Visalakarani, अगृह्य taking, गच्छामियदि if I go, कालात्ययेन through passage of time, दोषः mistake, स्यात् again, महत् huge, वैक्लब्यं च perplexity, भवेत् will arise

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इतिसञ्चिन्त्यहनूमान्गत्वाक्षिप्रंमहाबलः ।।6.102.30।। आसाद्यपर्वतश्रेष्ठंप्रक्रम्यगिरेश्शिरः । फुल्लनानातरुगणंसमुत्पाट्यमहाबलः ।।6.102.31।। गृहीत्वाहरिशार्दूलोहस्ताभ्यांसमतोलयत् ।
output: महाबलः mighty, हरिशार्दूलः tiger among Vanaras, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking, क्षिप्रम् quickly, गत्वाgoing, पर्वतश्रेष्ठम् foremost of the mountains, आसाद्य reached, गिरेः mountain, शिखरं top, हस्ताभ्याम् with both hands, गृहीत्वाseized, त्रिःthrice, प्रकम्प्य shaking, फुल्लनानातरुगणम् with plants, flowers in bloom, समुत्पाट्य uprooted, महाबलः mighty, समतोलयत् balanced

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 102:
इतिसञ्चिन्त्यहनूमान्गत्वाक्षिप्रंमहाबलः ।।6.102.30।। आसाद्यपर्वतश्रेष्ठंप्रक्रम्यगिरेश्शिरः । फुल्लनानातरुगणंसमुत्पाट्यमहाबलः ।।6.102.31।। गृहीत्वाहरिशार्दूलोहस्ताभ्यांसमतोलयत् ।
output: Hanuman, the mighty among the Vanaras, thinking so quickly reached the foremost of the mountains, seized the mountain with both hands by shaking it thrice, uprooted the plants with flowers in bloom and balanced it with his hands.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सनीलमिवजीमूतंतोयपूर्णंनभस्तलात् ।।6.102.32।। उत्पपातगृहीत्वातुहनूमान् शिखरंगिरेः ।
output: सःहनूमान् that Hanuman, तोयपूर्णम् filled with water, नीलम् bluish, जीमूतम् इव like the wind, गिरेःशिखरम् mountain peak, गृहीत्वा holding, नभस्तलात् from the earth surface, उत्पपात went into air

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
समागम्यमहावेगःसंन्यस्यशिखरंगिरेः ।।6.102.33।। विश्रम्यकिञ्चिद्धनुमान्सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत् ।
output: Hanuman came at high speed with the mountain and letting it down and resting for a while spoke as follows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ओषधीर्नावगच्छामिताअहंहरिपुङ्गव ।।6.102.34।। तदिदंशिखरंकृत्स्नंगिरेस्तस्याहृतंमया ।

output: त्वयि you, पञ्चत्वम् from the five elements, आगते not come out, मे to me, जीवितेन life, सीतया even Sita, विजयेनवा or victory, अर्थः meaning, न हि not there, मे to me, तेन your, कः what, अर्थः use, वद said

instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

output: " A victim of your arrow can not be alive just as an elephant fallen into the clutch of a roaring lion with sharp teeth is not possible to live."

instruction:

output: Rama discharged dreadful shafts at Ravana's army in the forefront. Ravana ascended another chariot and went towards Rama, just as the planet Rahu moved towards the Sun.

instruction:

output: Sri Rama steadily covered Ravana, the ten headed Rakshasa with shining shafts covered with gold glowing like fire in the battle.

instruction:

output: "Proceed quickly in my chariot to the foremost of the Raghus on the earth, where Sri Rama stands and call him to sit in the chariot as per the words of Devas."

instruction:

output: Then the thousand eyed charioteer, holding the whip in hand, from the chariot, offered salutations with folded palms to Sri Rama and spoke these words.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:

output: "To you, Kakuthsa, who are endowed with great prowess, destroyer of enemies, this chariot has been sent by Indra for your victory."

instruction:

इदमैन्द्रंमहच्चापंकवचंचानगिसन्निभम् । शराश्चादित्यसङ्काशाःशक्तिश्चविमलाशिवा ।।6.103.16।।
output: "Here is Indra's mighty bow, armour shining like fire, shafts resembling the Sun and stainless auspicious javelin."

instruction:

output: "O heroic king! With me as charioteer, mounting this chariot, kill the Rakshasa Ravana as Mahendra killed the demons."

instruction:

output: Speaking like that, Matali went round Sri Rama, and went round the chariot clockwise saluting him. Sri Rama then ascended the chariot, illuminating his splendour to the world.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
तद्भभूवाद्भुतंयुद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् । रामस्य च महाबाहोरावणस्य च रक्षसः ।।6.103.19।।
output: Then a wonderful, severe thrilling fight took place between Sri Rama and Ravana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स गान्धर्वेणगान्धर्वंदैवंदैवेनराघवः । अस्त्रंराक्षसराजस्यजघानपरमास्त्रवित् ।।6.103.20।।
output: Raghava who was highly skilled in the use of supreme weapons destroyed that missile presided over by Gandharvas and gods, released by Ravana.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
अस्त्रंतुपरमंघोरंराक्षसंराक्षसाधिपः । ससर्जपरमक्रुद्धःपुनरेवनिशाचरः ।।6.103.21।।
output: The Rakshasa king, the night ranger, became highly furious and once again discharged the most terrific missile presided over by Rakshasas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेरावणधनुर्मुक्ताःशराःकाञ्चनभूषणाः । अभ्यवर्तन्तकाकुत्स्थंसर्पाभूत्वामहाविषाः ।।6.103.22।।
output: The shafts released from Ravana's bow were covered with gold and highly venomous like serpents reached near Kakuthsa.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेदीप्तवदनादीप्तंसमन्तोज्वलनंमुखैः । राममेवाभ्यवर्तन्तव्यादितास्याभयानकाः ।।6.103.23।।
output: Those shafts with wide flaming mouths, vomiting fire, glowing, frightening, and striking went over to Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
तैर्वासुकिसमस्पर्शैर्दीप्तभोगैर्महाविषैः । दिशश्चसन्ततास्सर्वाप्रदिशश्चसमावृताः ।।6.103.24।।
output: Flaming coils like the Vasuki, covering all quarters with poison, enveloped all over.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तान् दृष्टवापन्नगान् रामःसमापततआहवे । अस्त्रंगारुत्मतंघोरंप्रादुश्चक्रेभयावहम् ।।6.103.25।।
output: Seeing the dreadful reptiles approaching, Rama discharged the missile presided over by Garuda.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
तेराघवधनुर्मुक्तारुक्मपुङ्खाःशिखिप्रभाः । सुपर्णाःकाञ्चनाभूत्वाविचेरुःसर्पशत्रवः ।।6.103.26।।
output: By the missile discharged by Raghava those reptiles and snakes turned into golden feathered eagles and by the shine of the feathers, the reptiles flew.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
तेतान्सर्वान् जघ्नुस्सर्परूपान्महाजवान् । सुपर्णरूपारामस्यविशिखाःकामरूपिणः ।।6.103.27।।
output: Those shafts of Rama in the form of eagles which could change their form at will, destroyed the serpent forms and they flew at great speed.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अस्त्रेप्रतिहतेक्रुद्धोरावणोराक्षसाधिपः । अभ्यवर्षत्तदारामंघोराभिःशरवृष्टिभिः ।।6.103.28।।
output: अस्त्र missiles, प्रतिहते knocked back, क्रुद्धः enraged, राक्षसाधिपः king of Rakshasas, तदा then, घोराभिः terrific, शरवृष्टिभिः shower of shafts, रामम् Rama, अभ्यवर्षत् covered

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
ततश्शरसहस्रेणराममक्लिष्टकारिणम् । अर्दयित्वाशरौघेणमातलिम्प्रत्यविध्यत ।।6.103.29।।
output: Thereafter having showered a thousand shafts on Rama, of unwearied action, Ravana pierced Matali with shafts.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चिच्छेदकेतुमुद्धिश्यशरेणैकेनरावणः । पातयित्वारथोपस्थेरथात्केतुं च काञ्चनम् ।।6.103.30।। ऐन्द्रानपिजघानाश्वान्शरजालेनरावणः ।
output: Ravana attacked the flag post of the chariot with one arrow and felled it down. Then he released a network of arrows on Indra's horses and struck them.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
तदृष्ट्वासुमहातत्कर्मरावणस्यदुरात्मना: । विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वाचारणादानवैस्सह ।।6.103.31।। राममार्तंतदादृष्टवासिद्धाश्चपरमर्षयः । व्यथितावानरेन्द्राश्चबभूवुस्सविभीषणाः ।।6.103.32।। रामचन्द्रमसंदृष्टवाग्रस्तंरावणराहुणा ।
output: On seeing Sri Rama afflicted by the action of evilminded Ravana, the Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, Danavas also, Siddhas and foremost rishis were despondent. Seeing the moon like Sri Rama eclipsed by planet Rahu in the form of Ravana, the Vanara leaders and Vibheeshana became worried.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
तदृष्ट्वासुमहातत्कर्मरावणस्यदुरात्मना: । विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वाचारणादानवैस्सह ।।6.103.31।। राममार्तंतदादृष्टवासिद्धाश्चपरमर्षयः । व्यथितावानरेन्द्राश्चबभूवुस्सविभीषणाः ।।6.103.32।। रामचन्द्रमसंदृष्टवाग्रस्तंरावणराहुणा ।
output: On seeing Sri Rama afflicted by the action of evilminded Ravana, the Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, Danavas also, Siddhas and foremost rishis were despondent. Seeing the moon like Sri Rama eclipsed by planet Rahu in the form of Ravana, the Vanara leaders and Vibheeshana became worried.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्राजात्यं च नक्षत्रंरोहिणींकशशिनःप्रियाम् ।।6.103.33।। समाक्रम्यबुधस्तस्थौप्रजानामशुभावहः ।
output: When the planet Budha comes closer to the Rohini planet presided over by the Lord of creation, people predict bad luck.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिःप्रज्वलन्निवसागरः ।।6.103.34।। उत्पपाततदाक्रुद्धस्स्पृशन्निवदिवाकरम् ।
output: सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिः waves covered by mist (Dhumakethu) turning round, प्रज्वलन्निव as though going to touch the radiant sun, सागरः ocean, तदा then, क्रुद्धः enraged, दिवाकरम् sun, स्स्पृशन्निव as though to touch, उत्पपात rose high

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शस्त्रवर्णस्सुपरुषोमन्दरश्मिद्दिवाकरः ।।6.103.35।। अदृश्यतकबन्धाङ्कःसंसक्तोधूमकेतुना ।
output: शस्त्रवर्णः like weapon in colour (grey), सुपरुषः devoid of radiance, मन्दरश्मि: dull in radiance, दिवाकरः sun, कबन्धाङ्कः Kabhandaka, धूमकेतुना Dhumakethu, संसक्तः combined with, अदृश्यत seemed

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 103:
कोसलानां च नक्षत्रंव्यक्तमिन्द्राग्निदैवतम् ।।6.103.36।। आक्रम्याङ्गारकस्तस्थौविशाखामपिचाम्बरे ।
output: In the sky, the planet Mars too stood in constellation with Visakha star presided over by gods Indra and Agni in heaven, which was propitious for the kosala kings.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दशास्योविंशतिभुजःप्रगृहीतशरासनः ।।6.103.37।। अदृशास्यःदशग्रीवःमैनाकःपर्वतःइव
output: दशास्यः ten heads, विंशतिभुजः twenty arms, प्रगृहीतशरासनः seizing hold of bow, दशग्रीवः ten headed, मैनाकःपर्वतः इव like Mynaka mountain, अदृश्यत appeared

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निरस्यमानोरामस्तुदशग्रीवेणरक्षसा ।।6.103.38।। नाशक्नोदभिसन्धातुंसायकान्रणमूर्धनि ।
output: While Ravana with ten heads and arms was ready in the forefront of the battle, Sri Rama had no possibility to fix his arrows.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तस्यक्रुद्धस्यवदनंदृष्टवारामस्यधीमतः ।।6.104.1।। सर्वभूतानिवित्रेसुःप्राकम्पत च मेदिनी ।
output: Dreadful war takes place between Rama and Ravana. Celestial bodies watch the war from the sky.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सिंहशार्दूलान्शैलस्सञ्चचालचलद्द्रुमः । बभूवचापिक्षुभितःसमुद्रःसरिताम्पतिः ।।6.104.2।।
output: सिंहशार्दूलवान् abode of lions and tigers, चलद्द्रुमः trees shook, शैलः mountains, सञ्चचाल, सरिताम्पतिः king of rivers, समुद्रः च and ocean, अपि also, क्षुभितः agitated, बभूव became

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
खराश्चखरनिर्घोषागगनेपरुषाघनाः । औत्पातिकानिनर्दन्तस्समन्तात्परिचक्रमुः ।।6.104.3।।
output: Dreadful and portentous clouds went in circles all over sky looking like donkeys emitting harsh sounds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
रामंदृष्टवासुसङ्क्रुद्धमुत्पातांश्चैवसुदारुणान् । वित्रेसुस्सर्वभूतानिरावणस्याभवद्भयम् ।।6.104.4।।
output: Rama became highly furious, most dreadful sounds were rising up and all beings were frightened. Ravana was also afraid.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
विमानस्थास्तदादेवागन्धर्वाश्चमहोरगाः । ऋषिदावनदैत्याश्चगरुत्मन्तश्चखेचराः ।।6.104.5।। ददृशुस्तेतदायुद्धंलोकसम्वर्तसंस्थितम् । नानाप्रहरणैर्भीमैश्शूरयोस्सम्प्रयुध्यतोः ।।6.104.6।।
output: Then from the aerial chariots, Devas, Gandharvas, great Nagas, sages, devils, giants, birds, and eagles watched the duel war that went on between the heroes clashing with different kinds of frightening weapons like at the dissolution of the world.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विमानस्थास्तदादेवागन्धर्वाश्चमहोरगाः । ऋषिदावनदैत्याश्चगरुत्मन्तश्चखेचराः ।।6.104.5।। ददृशुस्तेतदायुद्धंलोकसम्वर्तसंस्थितम् । नानाप्रहरणैर्भीमैश्शूरयोस्सम्प्रयुध्यतोः ।।6.104.6।।
output: तदा then, भीमैः frightening, नानाप्रहरणैः different kinds of weapons, सम्प्रयुथ्यतोः together clashing, शूरयोः arrows, लोकसम्वर्तसंस्थितम् dissolution of the world, युद्धम् war, तदा then, विमानस्थाः from the aerial chariots, देवाः Devas, गन्धर्वाश्च Gandharvas, महोरगाः great Nagas, ऋषिदावनदैत्याश्च sages, devils and giants खेचराः birds, ते they, गरुत्मन्तश्च eagles, ददृशुः watched.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
ऊचुस्सुरासुरास्सर्वेतदाविग्रहमागताः । प्रेक्षमाणामहर्युद्धंवाक्यंभक्त्याप्रहृष्टवत् ।।6.104.7।।
output: Then watching the great war, all the Suras, Asuras, lost control and overcome with happiness spoke these words with devotion.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
दशग्रीवंजयेत्याहुरसुराःसमवस्थिताः । देवाराममवोचंस्तेत्वंजयेतिपुनःपुनः ।।6.104.8।।
output: Firmly established the Asuras uttered 'Victory to the Ten headed Ravana', and Devas for their part pronounced 'Rama be victorious' again and again.

instruction:

एतस्मिन्नन्तरेक्रोधाद्राघवस्य स रावणः । प्रहर्तुकामोदुष्टात्मास्पृशन् प्रहरणंमहत् ।।6.104.9।। वज्रसारंमहानादंसर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् । शैलशृङ्गनिभैःकूटैश्चित्तदृष्टिभयावहम् ।।6.104.10।। सधूममिवतीक्ष्णाग्रंयुगान्ताग्निचमोपमम् । अतिरौद्रमनासाद्यंकालेनापिदुरासदम् ।।6.104.11।। त्रासनंसर्वभूतानांदारणंभेदनंतथा । प्रदीप्तमिवरोषेणशूलंजग्राहरावणः ।।6.104.12।।
output: In the meantime, the evil self Ravana who is called so, as he makes others cry, in intense anger making loud noise, stroking an unassailable weapon which was like the thunderbolt, capable of killing all enemies, a spike which closely resembled mountain peaks, dreadful even to think, like a mass of smoke, sharp and pointed, blazing like at the dissolution of the universe, very frightening, difficult to hand le, like the god of death, a terror for all beings, frightening, tearing, splitting, glowing like trident seized hold of to attack Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्छूलंपरमक्रुद्धोमध्येजग्राहवीर्यवान् । अनेकैःसमरेश्शूरैराक्षसैःपरिवारितः ।।6.104.13।।
output: In the battlefield surrounded by Rakshasa heroes, enraged valiant Ravana took up the trident holding it in the middle.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
समुद्यम्यमहाकायोननादयुधिभैरवम् । संरक्तनयनोरोषात्स्वसैन्यमभिहर्षयन् ।।6.104.14।।
output: Gigantic Ravana, eyes turned red in anger, raising the trident made formidable noise to make his army extremely joyful in the battlefield.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
पृथिवींचान्तरिक्षं च दिशश्चप्रदिशस्तथा । प्राकम्पयत्तदाशब्दोराक्षसेन्द्रस्यदारुणः ।।6.104.15।।
output: By the horrible sound made by the Rakshasa king, the earth, even the heavens, similarly the quarters and corners trembled.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
अतिनादस्य्यदानेनतेनतस्यदुरात्मनः । सर्वभूतानिवित्रेसुस्सागरश्चप्रचुक्षुभे ।।6.104.16।।
output: By the loud roar of the evilminded Ravana's sound, all living beings feared and even the ocean was set to tremble.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
स गृहीत्वामहावीर्यश्शूलंतद्रावणोमहत् । विनद्यसुमहानादंरामंपरुषमब्रवीत् ।।6.104.17।।
output: Ravana who was endowed with extraordinary valour, taking hold of the trident, addressed Rama harshly in a loud tone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शूलोऽयंवज्रसारस्तेरामरोषान्मयोद्यतः । तवभ्रातृसहायस्यसम्यक् प्राणान् हरिष्यति ।।6.104.18।।
output: "O Rama! This thunderbolt like trident taken up by me now will take away your life along with your brother's."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रक्षसामद्यशूराणांनिहतानांचमूमुखे । त्वांनिहत्यरणश्लाघीकरोमितरसासमम् ।।6.104.19।।
output: "I, who commend warfare, will quickly kill you today in the forefront of the army and join you with Rakshasa heroes who were killed."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तिष्ठेदानींनिहमनित्वामेषशूलेनराघव । एवमुक्त्वा स चिक्षेपतच्छूलंराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.104.20।।
output: "O Raghava! Stay there. Right now, I will kill you with this trident." Having spoken that way, Ravana hurled the trident.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
तद्रावणकरान्मुक्तंविद्युन्मालासमावृतम् । अष्टघण्टंमहानादंवियद्गतमशोभत ।।6.104.21।।
output: The trident discharged from Ravana's hand, made circles of lightning, and covered the atmosphere with its glow and shine along with eight bells making loud sounds.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तच्छूलंराघवोदृष्टवाज्वलन्तंघोरदर्शनम् । ससर्जविशिखान्रामश्चापमायम्यवीर्यवान् ।।6.104.22।।
output: Valiant Raghava, seeing the glowing trident that was horrible to look at, loosed a number of arrows at it.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आपतन्तंशरौघेणवारयामासराघवः । उत्पतन्तंयुगान्तानगिंजलौघैरिववासवः ।।6.104.23।।
output: Raghava intercepted the trident, just as the fire was obstructed by the flow of water, at the time of universal dissolution, and obstructed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
निर्ददाह स तान्बाणान्रामकार्मुकनिःसृतान् । रावणस्यमहान् शूलःपतङ्गानिवपावकः ।।6.104.24।।
output: The arrows released from Rama's bow fell on the great trident of Ravana and burnt like moths falling in fire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
तान्दृष्टवाभस्मसाद्भूतान्शूलसम्स्पर्शचूर्णितान् । सायकानन्तरिक्षस्थान् राघवःक्रोधमाहरत् ।।6.104.25।।
output: Rama was overcome with fury on seeing his arrows being crushed to powder in the sky on touching the trident and reduced to ashes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
स तांमातलिनानीतांशक्तिंवासवसम्मताम् । जग्राहपरमक्रुद्धोराघवोरघुनन्दनः ।।6.104.26।।
output: Raghava, the enhancer of the joy of Raghus, lifted up the javelin brought by Matali, esteemed by Indra.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सातोलिताबलवताशक्तिर्घण्टाकृतस्वना । नभःप्रज्वालयामासयुगान्तोल्केवसप्रभा ।।6.104.27।।
output: When mighty Rama lifted up that javelin, it rendered sonorous sounds of bells and lit up the sky like a meteor at the end of the universal dissolution.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
साक्षिप्ताराक्षसेन्द्रस्यतस्मिन्कूलेपपात ह । भिन्नःशक्त्यामहान् शूलोनिपपातहतद्युतिः ।।6.104.28।।
output: With the hurling of the javelin by Rama at the great trident of Ravana and on (the javelin) touching the trident, it was broken, lost its splendour and fell down.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 104:
निर्भिभेदततोबाणैर्हयानस्यमहाजवान् । रामस्त्रीक्ष्णैर्महावेगैर्भाणवद्भिरजिह्मगैः ।।6.104.29।।
output: Rama then released arrows endowed with great speed, shower of multitude of arrows straight into the horses of Ravana and shattered them.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निर्बिभेदोरपितदारावणंनिशितैश्शरैः । राघवःपरमायत्तोललाटेपत्रतिभिस्त्रिभिः ।।6.104.30।।
output: Raghava pierced into the chest of Ravana sharp arrows and with great effort three sharp arrows on the forehead.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स शरैर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गोगात्रप्रसृतशोणितः । राक्षसेन्द्रस्समूहस्थःफुल्लाशोकइवाबभौ ।।6.104.31।।
output: शरैः arrows, भिन्नसर्वाङ्गः pierced all over the limbs, गात्रप्रसृतशोणितः blood flowing from limbs, सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, समूहस्थः in the gathering, फुल्लाशोकःइव like Ashoka tree, अबभौ appeared

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स तेनतुतदाक्रोधात्काकुत्स्थेनार्दितोरणे । रावणस्समरश्लाघिमहाक्रोधामुपागमत् ।।6.105.1।।
output: Rama accuses Ravana for abducting Sita. Ravana gets confused with the rain of arrows from Rama. Seeing the situation of Ravana his charioteer takes him away from the battlefield.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स दीप्तनयनोरोषाच्चापमायाम्यवीर्यवान् । अभ्यर्दयत्सुसङ्कृद्धोराघवंपरमाहवे ।।6.105.2।। बाणधारसहस्रैस्तैस्सतोयदइवाम्बरात् । राघवंरावणोबाणैस्तटकमिवपूरयन् ।।6.105.3।।
output: Valiant hero, Ravana, with his eyes flaming in anger, raising his bow, rained arrows at Sri Rama. He continued to rain thousands of arrows just as rain filled the tank, his arrows covered Raghava.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स दीप्तनयनोरोषाच्चापमायाम्यवीर्यवान् । अभ्यर्दयत्सुसङ्कृद्धोराघवंपरमाहवे ।।6.105.2।। बाणधारसहस्रैस्तैस्सतोयदइवाम्बरात् । राघवंरावणोबाणैस्तटकमिवपूरयन् ।।6.105.3।।
output: वीर्यवान् valiant one, वीरः hero, सः he, अमर्षात् bearing, दीप्तनयनः flaming eyes, राघवम् Raghava, सुसङ्क्रुद्ध: very angry, रोषात् furiously, चापम् bow, अपयाम्य fixing, अम्बरात् sky, सः he, तोयदःइव like water, तटाकम् इव like tank, बाणधारासहस्रैः thousands of arrows showered, राघवम् Raghava, पूरयन् fill, अभ्यर्दयत् covered

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पूरितःशरजालेनधनुर्मुक्तेनसम्युगे । महागिरिरिवाकम्प्यःकाकुत्स्थो न प्रकम्पते ।।6.105.4।।
output: Sri Rama did not get agitated, and stood like a huge mountain, even though the network of arrows released from the bow of Ravana covered him in the conflict.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स शरैश्शरजालानिवारयन् समरेस्थितः । गभस्तीनिवसूर्यस्यप्रतिजग्राहवीर्यवान् ।।6.105.5।।
output: वीर्यवान् valiant, सः he, समरे in war, स्थितः stood, शरैः arrows, शरजालानि streams of arrows, वारयन् intercepting, सूर्यस्य sun's, गभस्तीनिव like rays, प्रतिजग्राह tolerated

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
ततश्शरसहस्राणिक्षिप्रहस्तोनिशाचरः । निजघानोरसिक्रुद्धोराघवस्यमहात्मनः ।।6.105.6।।
output: Thereafter the quickhanded angry night ranger struck into the chest of Raghava thousands of arrows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स शोणितसमादिग्धस्समरेलक्ष्मणाग्रजः । दृष्टःफुल्लइवारण्येसुमहान् किंशुकद्रुमः ।।6.105.7।।
output: समरे in the conflict, शोणितसमादिग्धः covered with blood all over, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, अरण्ये in the forest, फुल्लः in bloom, सुमहान् huge, किंशुकद्रुमः Kimsuka tree, दृष्टः looked

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शराभिघातसम्रब्दःसोऽभिजग्राहसायकान् । काकुत्स्थ: सुमहातेजायुगान्तादित्यतेजसः ।।6.105.8।।
output: शराभिघातसम्रब्दः angered by the impact of arrows, सुमहातेजाः highly energetic, सःकाकुत्स्थ: that Kakuthsa, युगान्तादित्यतेजसः like the sun blazing at the end of dissolution of the universe, सायकान् shafts, अभिजग्राह took up

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
ततोऽन्योन्यंसुसम्रब्धौतावुभौरामरावणौ । शरान्धकारेसमरेनोपलक्ष्यतांतदा ।।6.105.9।।
output: Then with both Rama and Ravana speedily releasing (hail of) arrows on one another, the battlefield was darkened by arrows, and they were not able to see each other.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःक्रोधसमाविष्टोरामोदशरथात्मजः । उवाचरावणंवीरःप्रहस्यपरुषंवचः ।।6.105.10।।
output: ततः then, दशरथात्मजः Dasharatha's son, वीरः heroic, रामः Rama, क्रोधसमाविष्टः overcome by anger, प्रहस्य laughing, रावणम् at Ravana, परुषम् harsh, वचः words, उवाच spoke

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ममभार्याजनस्थानादज्ञानाद्राक्षसाधम । हृतातेविवशायस्मात्तस्मात्त्वंनासिवीर्यवान् ।।6.105.11।।
output: "Lowly Rakshasa! My wife was abducted by you ignorantly when she was helpless. Therefore, you are not valiant."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मयाविरहितांदीनांवर्तमानांमहावने । वैदेहींप्रसभंहृत्वाशूरोऽहमितिमन्यसे ।।6.105.12।।
output: "Having abducted Vaidehi living in the forest by force, when she was desperate and separated from me, do you think that you are a hero?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
स्त्रीषुशूरविनाथासुपरदाराभिमर्शक । कृत्वाकापुरुषंकर्मशूरोऽहमितिमन्यसे ।।6.105.13।।
output: "Timid fellow! You having laid hands on another woman think you are a hero? You, who have done such an action, think that you are a hero?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भिन्नमर्यादनिर्लज्ज चारित्रेष्वनवस्थित । दर्पान्मृत्युमुपादायशूरोऽहमितिमन्यसे ।।6.105.14।।
output: भिन्नमर्याद transgressed morality, निर्लज्ज shameless, चारित्रे traditional practice, अनवस्थित dissolute, दर्पात् pride, मृत्युम् death, उपादाय seeking, अहम् I, शूरः heroic, इति thus, मन्यसे think

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
शूरेणधनदभ्रात्राबलैःसमुदितेन च । श्लाघनीयंमहत्कर्मयशस्यं च कृतंत्वया ।।6.105.15।।
output: "By laudable great action performed by you (of abducting Sita and your penance) you have attained fame. You are a heroic brother of Kubera, rich in might."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्सेकानाभिपन्नस्यगर्हितस्याहितस्य च । कर्मणःप्राप्नुहीदानांतस्याद्यसुमहत्फलम् ।।6.105.16।।
output: "You will attain the great result of your hurtful action, overpowered by pride and vanity today."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
शूरोऽहमितिचात्मानमवगच्छसिदुर्मते । नैवलज्जास्तितेसीतांचौरवद्वृपकर्षतः ।।6.105.17।।
output: "O Evil minded fellow! You boast yourself as a hero, while you abducted Sita like a thief. Shame did not stand in your way."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदिमत्सन्निधौसीताधर्षितास्यात्त्वयाबलात् । भ्रातरंतुखरंपश्येस्तदामत्सायकैर्हतः ।।6.105.18।।
output: सीता Sita, त्वया by you, मत्सन्निधौ my presence, बलात् forcibly, धर्षिता taken, स्याद्यदि been seen, तदा then, मत्सायकैः by my arrows, हतः killed, भ्रातरम् brother, खरम् Khara, पश्येः seen

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
दिष्ट्यासिममदुष्टात्मश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः । अद्यत्वांसायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नयामियमसादनम् ।।6.105.19।।
output: "O selfish Ravana! Today you have come in my sight by good fortune. I shall send you to the abode of Yama with my arrows."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
अद्यतेमच्छरैश्चिन्नंशिरोज्वलितकुण्डलम् । क्रव्यादाव्यपकर्षन्तुविकीर्णंरणपांसुषु ।।6.105.20।।
output: "Now, let your head severed by my shafts lying in dust in the battlefield with the shining earrings be dragged by the carnivorous animals."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
निपत्योरसिगृध्रास्तेक्षितौक्षिप्तस्यरावण । पिबन्तुरुधिरंतर्षाद्बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् ।।6.105.21।।
output: "Ravana! After your body is caused to destroy and scattered on the ground, let the vultures drink the blood oozing from your chest pierced by the heads of my arrows."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अद्यमद्बाणभिन्नस्यगतासोःपतितस्यते । कर्षन्त्वन्त्राणिपतगागरुत्मन्तइवोरगान् ।।6.105.22।।
output: अद्य now, मद्बाणभिन्नस्य by my arrows splitting, गतासोः ceased of life, पतितस्य fallen, ते your, अन्त्राणि intestines, पतगाः birds, गरुत्मन्तः eagles, उरगानिव like snakes, कर्षन्तु dragging

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
इत्येवं स वदन्वीरोरामश्शत्रुनिबर्हणः । राक्षसेन्द्रंसमीपस्थंशरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।।6.105.23।।
output: Speaking in this way to Ravana who was nearby, Rama the exterminator of enemies rained showers of arrows and covered.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 105:
बभूवद्विगुणंवीर्यंबलंहर्षश्चसंयुगे । रामस्यास्त्रबलंचैवशत्रोर्निधनकाङ्क्षिणः ।।6.105.24।।
output: The strength, valiance, enthusiasm, and the strength of missiles of Rama, who was desirous of the destruction of the enemy, doubled.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रादुर्भभूवुरस्त्राणिसर्वाणिविदितात्मनः । प्रहर्षाच्चमहातेजाश्शीघ्रहस्ततरोऽभवत् ।।6.105.25।।
output: All missiles appeared before Rama because of his richness in selfknowledge. In his excessive energy and joy the prince became more skillful with his hands.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शुभान्येतानिचिह्नानिविज्ञायात्मगतानिसः । भूयएवार्दयद्रामोरावणंराक्षसान्तकृत् ।।6.105.26।।
output: राक्षसान्तकृत् one who can put an end to Rakshasas, सःरामः that Rama, आत्मगतानि his own past, शुभानि auspicious, एतानि all these, चिह्नानि signs, विज्ञाय knowing, रावणम् Ravana, भूयःएव more vehemently, अर्दयत् strike

instruction:

output: "You are the possessor of heat, adorned with a circle of rays. You are killer of all enemies, tawny destroyer of all, omniscient, lover of all devotees and source of all evolutes.

instruction:

output: "You are the Lord of all stars and planets. You are the creator of all, resplendent among the splendid, the twelve faces of twelve months. Hail to you.

instruction:

output: "Namaskar, Namaskar to the giver of victory, joy born of victory, god having green horses. Hail to you Aditya.

output: "Hail to you of terrible form, of valiant one, denoted by the syllable 'AUM'. Namaskar to the awakener of lotuses. Namaskar to the fierce one.

output: "You are the dispeller of darkness, dispeller of cold, dispeller of enemies, your extent is immeasurable. You are the destroyer of the ungrateful, the ruler of lights, the Lord of all and namaskar to you.

output: "Being a creator and destroyer of the world, this Sun god alone radiates, creates thirst by heat and rains to relieve.

instruction:

output: "He alone pervades the created beings and remains awake in sleep. He alone is the fire sacrifice as well as the fruits obtained from fire sacrifice.

output: "He is all vedas, as well as all the sacrifices as also the fruits of all sacrifices. He is the supreme controller of all actions in all worlds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शराधाराविमुञ्चन्तंधारासारमिवाम्बुदम् । तंदृष्टवामेघसङ्काशमापतन्तंरथंरिपोः ।।6.108.7।। गिरेर्वज्राभिमृष्टस्यदीर्यतस्सदृशस्वनम् । विस्पारयन्वैवेगेनबालचन्द्रानतंधनुः ।।6.108.8।। उवाचसारथिंरामंसहस्राक्षस्यमातलिम् ।
output: शरधाराः flow of arrows, विमुञ्चन्तम् released from, धारासारमिवा like the flow of water, अम्बुदमिव like rain water cloud, मेघसङ्काशम् from the clouds, वज्राभिमृष्टस्य struck by thunderbolt, दीर्यतः broken, गिरेः mountain, सदृशस्वनम् like sound of mountain, आपतन्तम् cloud, तम् him, रथम् chariot, दृष्टवा seeing, रामः Rama, बालचन्द्रानतम् crescent shaped like the young moon, धनुः bow, वेगेन with speed, विस्फारयन् stretching, सहस्राक्षस्यसारथिम् Indra's charioteer, मातलिम् Matali, उवाच spoke

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
शराधाराविमुञ्चन्तंधारासारमिवाम्बुदम् । तंदृष्टवामेघसङ्काशमापतन्तंरथंरिपोः ।।6.108.7।। गिरेर्वज्राभिमृष्टस्यदीर्यतस्सदृशस्वनम् । विस्पारयन्वैवेगेनबालचन्द्रानतंधनुः ।।6.108.8।। उवाचसारथिंरामंसहस्राक्षस्यमातलिम् ।
output: The flow of arrows (from Ravana) released from the chariot were seen by Rama like the flow of water from rain clouds. Seeing that, Sri Rama made terrific sounds by stretching his bow to crescent shape, and it was as if a mountain struck by thunderbolt had broken and resounding and seeing Matali, charioteer of Indra, Sri Rama spoke as follows.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
मातलेपश्यसम्रद्धमापतन्तंरथंरिपोः ।।6.108.9।। यथापसव्यंपततावेगेनमहतापुनः । समरेहन्तुमात्मानंतथानेनकृतामतिः ।।6.108.10।।
output: "Matali! the enemy's chariot is darting forward hurriedly. See him coming in the reverse direction with great speed once again. It strikes my mind that he is surely causing his fall."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मातलेपश्यसम्रद्धमापतन्तंरथंरिपोः ।।6.108.9।। यथापसव्यंपततावेगेनमहतापुनः । समरेहन्तुमात्मानंतथानेनकृतामतिः ।।6.108.10।।
output: "Matali! the enemy's chariot is darting forward hurriedly. See him coming in the reverse direction with great speed once again. It strikes my mind that he is surely causing his fall."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
तदप्रमादमातिष्ठन्प्रत्युद्गच्छरथंरिपोः । विध्वंसयितुमिच्छामिवायुर्मेघमिवोत्थितम् ।।6.108.11।।
output: "Being alert, you drive the chariot towards Ravana, just as wind drives the cloud in the sky, as I wish to destroy him."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अविक्लबमसम्भ्रान्तमव्यग्रहृदयेक्षणम् । रमशिसञ्चारनियंप्रचोदयरथंद्रुतम् ।।6.108.12।।
output: अविक्लबम् without confusion, असम्भ्रान्तम् without agitation, अव्यग्रहृदयेक्षणम् with steady heart and vision, रमशिसञ्चारनियतम् movement of reins controlled, रथम् chariot, द्रुतम् determined, प्रचोदय drive swiftly

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कामं न त्वंसमाधेयःपुरन्दररथोचितः । युयुत्सुरहमेकाग्रःस्मारयेत्वां न शिक्ष्ये ।।6.108.13।।
output: "You are a driver of great Indra's chariot. You are not required to be told. Wishing to fight with rapt attention, I will remind you now and then not instruct you", said Rama to Matali."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परितुष्टः स रामस्यतेनवाक्येनमातलिः । प्रचोदयामासरथंसुरसारथिरुत्तमः ।।6.108.14।।
output: Matali, the best charioteer of the Devatas, was highly delighted at Rama's words and started driving.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अपसव्यंततःकुर्वन् रावणस्यमहारथम् । चक्रसम्भूतरसारावणंव्यवदूनयन् ।।6.108.15।।
output: ततः then, रावणस्य Ravana's, रथम् chariot, अपसव्यम् turned, कुर्वन् done, चक्रसम्भूतरजसा dust arising out of rolling wheels, रावणम् Ravana, व्यवधूनयन् shaken

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःक्रुद्धोदशग्रीवस्ताम्रविस्फारितेक्षणः । रथप्रतिमुखंरामंसायकैरवधूनयत् ।।6.108.16।।
output: ततः then, क्रुद्धःfurious, दशग्रीवः ten headed, ताम्रविस्फारितेक्षणः coppery eyes open widely, रामम् Rama, सायकैः arrows, अवधूनयत् struck

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
धर्षणामर्षितोरामोधैर्यंरोषेणलम्भयन् । जग्राहसुमहावेगमैन्द्रंयुधिशरासनम् ।।6.108.17।।
output: Rama who was provoked by the assault and army was perturbed. He took up Indra's bow of extraordinary impulse and of high speed like sunbeams.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शरांश्चसुमहावेगान्सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभान् । तदुपोढुंमहद्युद्धमन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणोः ।।6.108.18।। परस्पराभिमुखयोर्दृप्तयोरिवसिंहयोः ।
output: सुमहावेगान् of very high speed, सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभान् glowing in radiance like the sun's rays, शरान् च arrows, अन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणोः each one desirous killing the other, तत् then, महत् great, युद्धम् war, परस्पराभिमुखयोः who stood facing each other, दृप्तयोः ensued, सिंहयोरिव like lions, उपोढम् come near

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोदेवास्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्चपरमर्षयः ।।6.108.19।। समीयुर्द्वैरथंद्रष्टुंरावणक्षयकाङ्क्षिणः ।
output: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas and sages longing for the end of Ravana came there to witness the duel.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वर्षरुधिरंदेवोरावणस्यरधोपरि ।।6.108.20।। वातामण्डलिनस्त्रीव्राह्यपसव्यंप्रचक्रमुः ।
output: Devas rained blood on Ravana's chariot, wind blew in circles intensely from left to right.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
महत् गृध्रकुलंचास्यभ्रममाणंनभस्तले ।।6.108.21।। येनयेनरथोयातितेनतेनप्रधावति
output: In the sky, a huge flock of eagles hovering on the chariot of Ravana went following the chariot wherever it went.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
सन्ध्ययाचावृतालङ्काजपापुष्पनिकाशया ।।6.108.22।। दृश्यतेसम्प्रदीप्तेवदिवसेऽपिवसुन्धरा ।
output: Lanka seemed glowing in red colour like at dusk, and as though the earth was burning, shrouded with Japa flowers, even though it was daytime.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सनिर्घातामहोल्काश्चसम्प्रपेतुर्महास्वनाः ।।6.108.23।। विषादयंस्तेरक्षांसिरावणस्यतदाहिताः ।
output: सनिर्घाताः meteors, महास्वनाः with great sound, महोल्काश्च huge fire, सम्प्रपेतुः dropped, रावणस्य Ravana's, अहिताः end, ते they, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, विषादयन् were sad

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सनिर्घातामहोल्काश्चसम्प्रपेतुर्महास्वनाः ।।6.108.23।। विषादयंस्तेरक्षांसिरावणस्यतदाहिताः ।
output: Meteors and huge fire dropped there indicating Ravana's end. Seeing them, Rakshasas were sad.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
रावणश्चयतस्तत्रप्रचचालवसुन्धरा ।।6.108.25।। रक्षसां च प्रहरतांगृहीताइवबाहवः ।
output: Wherever Ravana went, the earth shook. Many Rakshasas felt their hands clasped.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताम्राःपीतास्सिताश्वेताःपतितास्सूर्यरश्मयः ।।6.108.26।। दृश्यन्तेरावणस्याग्रेपर्वतस्येवधातवः ।
output: रावणस्य Ravana's, अग्रे front, ताम्राः red, पीताः yellow, सिताश्वेताः white and dark, सूर्यरश्मयः sun rays, पतिताः fallen, पर्वतस्य mountain's, धातवःइव minerals, दृश्यन्ते appeared

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
गृध्रैरनुगताश्चास्यवमन्त्योज्वलनंमुखैः ।।6.108.27।। प्रणेदुर्मुखमीक्षन्त्यःसम्रद्धमशिवंशिवाः ।
output: The vultures followed by shejackals vomited, burning fire from their mouths indicating inauspiciousness and screamed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
प्रतिकूलंववेवायूरणेपांसून् समुकतिरन् ।।6.108.28।। तस्यराक्षसराजस्यकुर्वन्दृष्टिविलोपनम् ।
output: The unfavourable wind that blew in war, clouded the sight of Rakshasa king.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निपेतुरिन्द्राशनयस्सैन्येचाप्यसमन्ततः ।।6.108.29।। दुर्विषह्यस्वनाघोरंविनाजलधरोदयम् ।
output: Without clouds, terrific thunderbolts of Indra (rain) dropped on his (Ravana's) army all over causing unbearable sound.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिशश्चप्रदिशस्सर्वाबभूवुस्तिमिरावृताः ।।6.108.30।। पांसुवर्षेणमहतादुर्दर्शं च नभोऽभवत् ।
output: All directions and intermediate points were enveloped by darkness by the shower of dust and the huge sky was obscure.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कुर्वन्त: कलहंघोरंशारिकास्तद्रथंप्रति ।।6.108.31।। निपेतुश्शतशस्तत्रदारुणादारुणारुताः ।
output: Hundreds of minas making frightening sounds, fighting in terrific manner emitting dreadful cries had fallen on the chariot there.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 108:
जघनेभ्यःस्फुलिङ्गांश्चनेत्रेभ्योऽश्रूणिसन्ततम् ।।6.108.32।। मुमुचुस्तस्यतुरगास्तुल्यमग्नि च वारि च ।
output: His (Ravana's) horses were letting out fire sparks from their hips, tears, water, and fire from their eyes at a time, continuously.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवंप्रकाराबहवस्समुत्पाताभयापहाः ।।6.108.33।। रावणस्यविनाशायदारुणाःसम्प्रजज्ञिरे ।
output: In that manner, many frightful and dreadful objects falling indicated destruction of Ravana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रामस्यापिनिमित्तानिसौम्यानि च शिवानि च ।।6.108.34।। बभूवुर्जयशंसीनिप्रादुर्भूतानिसर्वशः ।
output: On all sides appeared indications of signs of victory for Rama, displaying beings delightful and auspicious.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निमित्तानि च सौम्यानिराघवःस्वजयायवै ।।6.108.35।। दृष्टवापरमसम्हृष्टोहतंमेने च रावणम् ।
output: राघवःRaghava, स्वजयाय his own victory, सौम्यानि good, निमित्तानि indications, दृष्टवा seeing, परमसम्हृष्टः very delighted रावणम् Ravana, हतम् destroyed, मेने by me

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःप्रवृत्तंसुक्रूरंरामरावणयोस्तदा । सुमहदद्वैरथंयुद्धंसर्वलोकभयावहम् ।।6.109.1।।
output: ततः thereupon, तदा then, रामरावणयोः for Rama and Ravana, सुक्रूरम् fierce, सुमहत् great, सर्वलोकभयावहम् fearsome to the whole world, धैरथम् duel, युद्धम् war, प्रवृत्तम् ensued

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोराक्षससैन्यं च हरीणां च महद्बलम् । प्रगृहीतप्रहरणंनिश्चेष्टंसमवर्तत ।।6.109.2।।
output: ततः then, राक्षससैन्यं च Rakshasa army, हरीणाम् Vanaras, महत् huge, बलं च army, प्रगृहीतप्रहरणम् holding their weapons readily, निश्चेचष्टम् motionless, समवर्तत stood

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सम्प्रयुद्धेतुतौदृष्टवाबलवन्नरराक्षसौ । व्याक्षिप्तहदृयास्सर्वेपरंविस्मयमागताः ।।6.109.3।।
output: सम्प्रयुद्धौ engaged in battle, तौ both, बलवन्नरराक्षसौ mighty human and Rakshasa, दृष्टवा to see, सर्वे all, व्याक्षिप्तहृदयैः distracted in heart, परम् supreme, विस्मयम् wonderment, आगताः experienced

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नाप्रहरणैर्व्यग्रैर्भुजैर्विस्मितबुद्धयः । तस्थुःप्रेक्षय च सर्वेतेनाभिजग्मुःपरस्परम् ।।6.109.4।।
output: All the army on both sides lifted their hands up, holding different kinds of implements, and were amazed looking at them and did not attack one another.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रक्षसांरावणंचापिवानराणां च राघवम् । पश्यतांविस्मिताक्षाणांसैन्यंचित्रमिवाबभौ ।।6.109.5।।
output: The army of Rakshasas was looking at Ravana and the Vanaras were looking at Raghava with astonishment as though it was a wonderful picture.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तौतुतत्रनिमित्तानिदृष्टवाराघवरावणौ । कृतबुद्धीस्थिरामर्षौयुयुधातेह्यभीतवत् ।।6.109.6।।
output: Both Ravana and Rama, seeing their portents, firmly resolved in mind with indignation, fought fearlessly.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जेतव्यमितिकाकुत्स्थोमर्तव्यमितिरावणः । धृतौस्ववीर्यसर्वस्वंयुद्धेऽदर्शयतांतदा ।।6.109.7।।
output: जेतव्यम् victory, इति thus, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, मर्तव्यम् death, इति this, रावणः Ravana, धृतौ determined, तदा then, युद्धे in battle, स्ववीर्यसर्वस्वम् their total prowess, अदर्शयताम् exhibited

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततःक्रोधाद्धशग्रीवश्शरान्सन्धायवीर्यवान् । मुमोचध्वजमुद्धिस्यराघवस्यरथेस्थितम् ।।6.109.8।।
output: ततः thereafter, वीर्यवान् valiant, दशग्रीवः ten headed, क्रोधात् in anger, शरान् arrows, न्धाय fixing, राघवस्य on Raghava's, ध्वजे flag post, स्थितम् stood, ध्वजम् flag, उद्धिस्य aiming, मुमोच struck

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 109:
तेशरास्तमनासाद्यपुरन्दररथध्वजम् । रथशक्तिंपरामृश्यनिपेतुर्धरणीतले ।।6.109.9।।
output: Those arrows, without reaching the post on Indra's chariot, touching the chariot fell on ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोरामोऽपिसङ्क्रुद्धश्चपमाकृष्यवीर्यवान् । कृतप्रतिकृतंकर्तुंमनसस्सम्प्रचक्रमे ।।6.109.10।।
output: ततः then, वीर्यवान् valiant one, रामः Rama, अपि very, सङ्क्रुद्धः angry, चापम् bow, आकृष्य stretching, कृतप्रतिकृतम् return back to Ravana, कर्तुम् to do, मनसा in his mind, सम्प्रचक्रमे started to comply

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणध्वजमुद्दिस्यमुमोचनिशितंशरम् । महासर्पमिवासह्यंज्वलन्तंस्वेनतेजसा ।।6.109.11।।
output: Rama, intolerant like a snake, targeting Ravana's post, released a sharp bright glowing arrow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 109:
रामश्चिक्षेपतेजस्वीकेतुमुद्धिश्यसायकम् । जगाम स महींछित्त्वादशग्रीवध्वजंशरः ।।6.109.12।।
output: Glorious Rama aiming at the flag post of Ravana, released an arrow that tore the post and went into the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स निकृत्तोऽपतद्भूमौरावणस्यन्दनध्वजः । ध्वजस्योन्मथनंदृष्टवारावणस्समहाबलः ।।6.109.13।। सम्प्रदीप्तोऽभवत्क्रोधादमर्षात्प्रहसन्निव । स रोषवशमापन्नश्शरवर्षंववर्ष ह ।।6.109.14।।
output: Ravana's flag post fell down, struck by Rama. Mighty Ravana, observing his post being struck, became intolerant, and burning in anger, laughing, rained showers of arrows at Rama out of fury.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रामस्यतुरगान्दीप्तै: शरैर्विव्याथरावणः । तेदिव्याहरयस्तत्रनास्खलन्नापिबभ्रमुः ।।6.109.15।। बभूवुःस्वस्थहृदयाःपद्मनालैरिवाहताः ।
output: रावणः Ravana, दीप्तै: burning, शरैः arrow, रामस्य of Rama, तुरगान् horses, विद्याथ pierced, दिव्याः wonderful, तेतुरगाः those horses, तत्र there, नास्खलन् not staggered, न बभ्रमुः nor reeled, पद्मनारैः lotus stalks, आहताःइव as if not hurt, स्वस्थहृदयाः complacent at heart, बभूवुः remained

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेषामसम्भ्रमंदृष्टवावाजिनांरावणस्तदा ।।6.109.16।। भूयएवसुसङ्क्रुद्धश्शरवर्षंमुमोच ह ।
output: Ravana perceived that the horses were just unperturbed by his arrows, became enraged and showered arrows excessively.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गदाश्चपरिघांश्चैवचक्राणिमुसलानि च ।।6.109.17।। गिरिशृङ्गाणिवृक्षांश्चतथाशूलपरश्वधान् ।
output: गदाश्च maces, परिघांश्च iron bars, चक्राणि discuses, मुसलानि च with clubs, गिरिशृङ्गाणि mountain peaks, वृक्षान् च and trees, तथा so also, शूलपरश्वधान् tridents and axes.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 109:
मायाविहितमेतत्तुशस्त्रवर्षमपातयत् ।।6.109.18।। सहस्रशस्तदाबाणानश्रान्तहृदयोद्यमः ।
output: Unwearied at heart, Ravana let loose rain of arrows created by magic in thousands.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तुमुलंत्रासजननंभीमंभीमप्रतिस्वनम् ।।6.109.19।। तद्वर्षमभवद्युद्धेनैकशस्त्रमयंमहत् ।
output: In that war, noisy, alarming, fearful loud noise of weapons of different kinds, in huge numbers, descended.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 109:
राघवरथंसमन्ताद्वानरेबले ।।6.109.20।। सायकैरन्तरिक्षं च चकारसुनिरन्तरम् ।
output: Obstructed by Raghava's chariot on all sides, the arrows covered the Vanara army and up to the sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 109:
मुमोच ह दशग्रीवोनिःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना ।।6.109.21।। व्यायच्छमानंतंदृष्टवासत्वरमरावणंरणे । प्रहसन्निवकाकुत्स्थसन्दधेनिशितान्शरान् ।।6.109.22।। स मुमो च ततोबाणान्शतशोऽथसहस्रशः ।
output: Seeing the ten headed Ravana releasing arrows with enthusiasm, not thinking of anything in his mind, quickly Kakuthsa laughed at them, fixed pointed arrows, and released hundreds and thousands.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 109:
मुमोच ह दशग्रीवोनिःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना ।।6.109.21।। व्यायच्छमानंतंदृष्टवासत्वरमरावणंरणे । प्रहसन्निवकाकुत्स्थसन्दधेनिशितान्शरान् ।।6.109.22।। स मुमो च ततोबाणान्शतशोऽथसहस्रशः ।
output: Seeing the ten headed Ravana releasing arrows with enthusiasm, not thinking of anything in his mind, quickly Kakuthsa laughed at them, fixed pointed arrows, and released hundreds and thousands.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 109:
तान् दृष्टवारावणश्चक्रेस्वशरैःखंनिरन्तरम् ।।6.109.23।। ततस्थाभ्यांप्रमुक्तेनशरवर्षेणभास्वता । शरबद्धमिवाभातिद्वितीयंभास्वदम्भरम् ।।6.109.24।।
output: Seeing the arrows in the sky released by Rama, even Ravana released arrows up to the sky. With the arrows released by both of them, the space became resplendent and by the network of arrows covering it seemed like another sky.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 109:
तान् दृष्टवारावणश्चक्रेस्वशरैःखंनिरन्तरम् ।।6.109.23।। ततस्थाभ्यांप्रमुक्तेनशरवर्षेणभास्वता । शरबद्धमिवाभातिद्वितीयंभास्वदम्भरम् ।।6.109.24।।
output: Seeing the arrows in the sky released by Rama, even Ravana released arrows up to the sky. With the arrows released by both of them, the space became resplendent and by the network of arrows covering it seemed like another sky.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नानिमित्तोऽभवद्भाणोनानिर्भेत्ता न निष्फलः । अन्योन्यमभिसम्हत्यनिपेतुर्धरणीतले ।।6.109.25।। तथाविसृजतोर्भाणान् रामरावणयोर्मृथे ।
output: The arrows released by both Rama and Ravana were without result. None failed to reach the target. None failed to complete the target. The arrows were colliding with one another and fell on the ground.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रायुध्येतामविच्छिन्नमस्यन्तौसव्यदक्षिणम् ।।6.109.26।। चक्रतुश्चशरैर्घोरैर्निरुच्छवासमिवाम्बरम् ।
output: Discharging from right and left, the two heroes without break vehemently released dreadful arrows that covered the sky and left no breathing space between them.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
रावणस्यहयान्रामोहयान्रामस्यरावणः ।।6.109.27।। जघ्नतुस्तौतदान्योन्यंकृतानुकृतकारिणौ ।
output: रावणस्य Ravana's, हयान् horses, रामः Rama, रामस्य Rama's, हयान् horses, रावणः Ravana, तौ both, तदा then, अन्योन्यम् one another, कृतानुकृतकारिणौ each other blow to blow, जघ्नतुः struck

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवंतुतौसुसङ्क्रुद्धौचक्रतुर्युद्धमुत्तमम् ।।6.109.28।। मुहूर्तमभवद्युद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् ।
output: Both became furious in that way and the best duel took place for a moment that was fierce and horipulating.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
तौतथायुध्यमानौतुसमरेरामरावणौ । ददृशुस्सर्वभूतानिविस्मितेनान्तरात्मना ।।6.110.1।।
output: As Rama and Ravana were thus fighting in war, all beings watched with astonishment in mind.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अर्धयन्तौतुसमरेतयोस्तौस्यन्दनोत्तमौ । परस्परमभिक्रुद्धौपरस्परमभिद्रुतौ ।।6.110.2।।
output: Both of them were moving quickly seeking to gain one another, very furiously persevering.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
परस्परवधेयुक्तौघोररूपौबभूवतुः । मण्डलानि च वीधीश्चगतप्रत्यागतानि च ।।6.110.3।। दर्शयन्तौबहुविधांसूतसामर्थ्यजांगतिम् ।
output: Both striking one another diligently, going in circles moving forward and backward displaying feats, went on.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
अर्धयन्रावणंरामोराघवंचापिरावणः ।।6.110.4।। गतिवेगंसमापन्नौप्रतिवेगप्रवर्तने ।
output: Ravana hurting Rama and vice versa displaying quickness in retaliation and speed of arrows, the fight happened.

instruction:
