output: शरजालानि network of arrows, क्षिपतोः released, तयोः by both, स्यन्दनोत्तमौ excellent warriors, सासारौ in the battlefield, जलदौइव like water streams, संयुगमहीम् like two clouds, चेरतुः both chariots

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दर्शयित्वातदातौतुगतिंबहुविधांरणे ।।6.110.6।। परस्परस्याभिमुखौपुनरेव च तस्थतुः ।
output: Then those two, having seen many movements, once again stood facing each other in the battlefield.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
धुरंधुरेणरथयोर्वक्त्रंवक्त्रेणवाजिनाम् ।।6.110.7।। पताकाश्चपताकाभिस्समीयुस्स्थितयोस्तदा ।
output: The two chariots stood facing each other on the battlefield once more, the axle of one chariot facing the axle of another chariot, the flag of one with another flag, the standard with another standard, the face of one horse with the face of another horse stood and it seemed as though they were together.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
रावणस्यततोरामोधनुर्मुस्तैश्शितैश्शरैः ।।6.110.8।। चतुर्भिश्चतुरोदीप्तान्हयान्प्रत्यपसर्पयत् ।
output: Thereupon, Rama, stretching the bow, released four sharp glowing arrows at Ravana's four horses and drove them back.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सक्रोधवशमापन्नोहयानामपसर्पणे ।।6.110.9।। मुमोचनिशितान्बाणान्राघवायदशाननः ।
output: Fallen prey to anger for retreating the horses, the ten headed Ravana released pointed arrows on Raghava.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
सोतिविद्धोबलवतादशग्रीवेणराघवः ।।6.110.10।। जगाम न विकारं च न चापिव्यथितोऽभवत् ।
output: Raghava, though wounded by the mighty Ravana's arrows, did notexperience suffering or agitation, nor disquiet.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चिक्षेप च पुनर्भाणान्वज्रपातसमस्वनान् ।।6.110.11।। सारथिंवज्रहस्तस्यसमुद्दिश्यदशाननः ।
output: The ten headed Ravana with his thunderbolt like hands hurled arrows and struck the charioteer of Rama, making sounds like thunder.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
मातलेस्तुमहावेगाश्शरीरेपतिताश्शराः ।।6.110.12।। न सूक्ष्ममपिसम्मोहंव्यथांवाप्रददुर्युधि ।
output: Even though the arrows fell on Matali's body at great speed, he did not feel perturbed or experience even slight suffering.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तयाधर्षणयाक्रुद्धोमातलेर्नतथात्मनः ।।6.110.13।। चकारशरजालेनराघवोविमुखंरिपुम् ।
output: राघवः Raghava, मातलेः Matali, तयाधर्षणया like that torment, क्रुद्धः furious, आत्मनः himself, तथा in that way, न not, शरजालेन by the network of arrows, रिपुम् enemy, विमुखम् diverted, चकार made

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
विंशतिंत्रिंशतिंषष्टिंशतशोऽथसहस्रशः ।।6.110.14।। मुमोचराघवोवीरस्सायकान्स्यन्दनेरिपोः ।
output: वीर hero, राघवःRaghava, रिपोः enemy, स्यन्दने chest, विंशतिम् twenty, त्रिंशतिम् thirty, षष्टिम् sixty, अथ and then, शतशः hundreds, सहस्रशः thousands, सायकान् shafts, मुमोच loosed at him

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
रावणोऽपिततःक्रुद्धोरथस्थराक्षसेश्वरः ।।6.110.15।। गदामुसलवर्षेणरामंप्रत्यर्दयद्रणे ।
output: Enraged Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, also in return, retaliated with maces and mallets.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
तत्प्रवृतंपुनर्युद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.110.16।। गदानांमुसलानां च परिघाणांचनिस्स्वनैः । शराणांपुङ्खवातैश्चक्षुभितास्सप्तसागराः ।।6.110.17।।
output: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत्प्रवृतंपुनर्युद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.110.16।। गदानांमुसलानां च परिघाणांचनिस्स्वनैः । शराणांपुङ्खवातैश्चक्षुभितास्सप्तसागराः ।।6.110.17।।
output: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
क्षुब्दानांसागराणां च पातालतलवासिनः । व्यथितादानवाःसर्वेपन्नगाश्चसहस्रशः ।।6.110.18।।
output: क्षुब्दानाम् sounds, सागराणाम् in the seas, पातालतलवासिनः inhabiting the subterranean region, सर्वे all, दानवाःDanavas, सहस्रशःthousands, पन्नगाश्च snakes, व्यथिताः distressed

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
चकम्पेमेदिनीकृत्स्नासशैलवनकानना । भास्करोनिष्प्रभश्चासीन्नवनौचापिमारुतः ।।6.110.19।।
output: सशैलवनकानना with mountains, gardens, forests, कृत्स्ना dark, मेदिनी earth, चकम्पे shook, भास्करश्च even the sun, निष्प्रभः lost radiance, आसीत् not move, मारुतश्चापि even the wind, न ववौ not blow

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोदेवास्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्चपरमर्षयः । चिन्तामापेदिरेसर्वेसकिन्नरमहोरगाः ।।6.110.20।।
output: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas, great sages, Kinneras and huge serpents all of them became anxious.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 110:
स्वस्तिगोब्राह्मणेभ्योऽस्तुलोकास्तिष्ठन्तुशाश्वताः । जयतांराघयसङ्ख्येरावणंराक्षसेश्वरम् ।।6.110.21।। एवंजपन्तोऽपश्यंस्तेदेवास्सर्षिगणास्तदा । रामरावणयोर्युद्धंसुघोरंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.110.22।।
output: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वस्तिगोब्राह्मणेभ्योऽस्तुलोकास्तिष्ठन्तुशाश्वताः । जयतांराघयसङ्ख्येरावणंराक्षसेश्वरम् ।।6.110.21।। एवंजपन्तोऽपश्यंस्तेदेवास्सर्षिगणास्तदा । रामरावणयोर्युद्धंसुघोरंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.110.22।।
output: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.

instruction:

Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इयंहिपूर्वैस्सन्दिष्टागतिःक्षत्रियसम्मता । क्षत्रियोनिहतंसङ्ख्ये न शोच्यइतिनिश्चयः ।।6.112.19।।
output: "This course has been practised in the past by ancient kings for those killed in war. Warrior killed in war is not to be mourned', is true."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 112:
तदेवंनिश्चयंदृष्टवातत्त्वमास्थायविज्वरः । यदिहानन्तरंकार्यंकल्प्यंतदनुचिन्तय ।।6.112.20।।
output: In principle, in that way, decide the action, freed from grief, considering what action is required."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
मुक्तवाक्यंविक्रान्तंराजपुत्रंविभीषणः । उवाचशोकसन्तप्तोभ्रातुर्हितमनन्तरम् ।।6.112.21।।
output: Having spoken that way by the valiant prince to Vibheeshana, who was immersed in grief, spoke to Rama for the good of his brother.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
योऽयंविमर्देष्वविभग्नपूर्वःसुरैस्समस्थेरपिवासवेन । भवन्तमासाद्यरणेविभग्नोवेलामिवासाद्ययथासमुद्रः ।।6.112.22।।
output: "He who has not been defeated in battle by even gods or Indra combined together in a trial of strength has been routed by you like the flow of the ocean divides on reaching the shore."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अनेनदत्तानिवनीपकेषुभुक्ताश्चभोगानिभृताश्चभृत्याः । धनानिमित्रेषुसमर्पितानिवैराण्यमित्रेषुनिपातितानि ।।6.112.23।।
output: "He bestowed gifts to mendicants, nurtured dependents, filled his friends with wealth, and held grudges against enemies and destroyed them."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
एषोहिताग्निश्च:महातपाश्चवेदान्तगःकर्मसुचाग्य्रशूरः । एतस्ययत्प्रेतगतस्यकृत्यंतत्कर्तुमिच्छामितवप्रसादात् ।।6.112.24।।
output: एषः he, हिताग्नि: maintained sacred fire, महातपाश्च practised austerities, वेदान्तगः mastered vedas, कर्मसु च even in doing rituals, अग्रशूरः foremost, प्रेतगतस्य departed soul, एतस्य to him, कृत्यम् to do the rituals, तव your, प्रसादात् permission, कर्तुम् will do, इच्छामि I desire

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रावणंनिहतंदृष्टवाराघवेणमहात्मना । अन्तःपुराद्विनिष्पेतूराक्षस्यश्शोककर्शिताः ।।6.113.1।।
output: Lamentation of Ravana's consorts on seeing his dead body.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
वार्यमाणास्सुबहुशोवेष्टन्त्यःक्षितिपांसुषु । विमुक्तकेश्यश्शोकार्तागावोवत्सहतायथा ।।6.113.2।।
output: सुबहुशो: numerous Rakshasa women, वार्यमाणाः obstructed, क्षितिपांसुषु rolling in dust, वेष्ट्नत्यः encompassing, विमुक्तकेश्यः dishevelled, वत्सहताः young ones lost, गावःयथा like cows, शोकार्ताः crying

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्तरेणविनिष्क्रम्यद्वारेणसहराक्षसैः । प्रविश्यायोधनंघोरंविचिन्वन्त्वोहतंपतिम् ।।6.113.3।। आर्यपुत्रेतिवादिन्योहानाथेति च सर्वशः । परिपेतुःकबन्धाङ्कांमहींशोणितकर्दमाम् ।।6.113.4।।
output: The Rakshasa women along with Rakshasas came out of the north gate and entered the battlefield screaming 'O son', 'O husband' and crying, seeing the trunks soaked in blood and mud on the ground and went about all over.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
उत्तरेणविनिष्क्रम्यद्वारेणसहराक्षसैः । प्रविश्यायोधनंघोरंविचिन्वन्त्वोहतंपतिम् ।।6.113.3।। आर्यपुत्रेतिवादिन्योहानाथेति च सर्वशः । परिपेतुःकबन्धाङ्कांमहींशोणितकर्दमाम् ।।6.113.4।।
output: राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, उत्तरेणद्वारेण northern gate, विनिष्क्रम्य coming out, हतम् killed, पतिम् husbands, विचिन्वन्त्वः crying, घोरम् dreadful, अयोधनम् battlefield, प्रविश्य entered, आर्यपुत्रेति O son, हानाथेति ha husband, वादिन्यः speaking, कबन्धाङ्काम् trunks, शोणितकर्दमाम् soaked in blood and mud, महीम् on ground, सर्वशः all over, परिपेतुःwent about

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताबाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्ष्योभर्तृशोकपराजिताः । करेण्वइवनर्द्नत्योविनेदुर्हतयूथपाः ।।6.113.5।।
output: बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्ष्यः eyes filled with tears, भर्तृशोकपरिजाताः on account of grief for their husbands, ताः they, हतयूथपाः leader lost, करेण्वःइव like female elephant, नर्द्नत्यः bellowing, विनेदुः roared

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
ददृशुस्तामहाकायंमहावीर्यंमहाद्युतिम् । रावणंनिहतम्भूमौनीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् ।।6.113.6।।
output: They looked at the gigantic body of Ravana of extraordinary valour, full of splendor, killed and lying like a heap of dark mountain on the ground.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ताःपतिंसहसादृष्टवाशयानंरणपांसुषु । निपेतुस्तस्यगात्रेषुछिन्नावनलताइव ।।6.113.7।।
output: ताः they, रणपांसुषु in the battlefield, शयानम् lying, पतिम् husband, सहसा precipitately, दृष्टवा seeing, छिन्नाः broken, वनलताइव like creepers in a garden, तस्य his, गात्रेषु limbs, निपेतुः fallen

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
बहुमानात्परिष्वज्यकाचिदेवंरुरोद ह । चरणौकाचिदालम्ब्यकाचित्कण्ठेऽवलम्ब्य च ।।6.113.8।।
output: Indeed, out of respect some embraced him and roared aloud, some held his feet and wept, some held his neck and started weeping.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
उत्क्षिप्य च भुजौकाचिद्भूमौसुपरिवर्तते । हतस्यवदनंदृष्टवाकाचिन्मोहमुपागमत् ।।6.113.9।।
output: Some lifting their arms threw themselves on ground, some rolled, some beholding the dead Ravana's face became deluded.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
काचिदङ्केशिरःकृत्वारुरोदमुखमीक्षती । स्नापयन्तीमुखंबाष्पैस्तुषारैरिवपङ्कजम् ।।6.113.10।।
output: One held his head on her lap, and one held his face and looking at it shed tears, like nature covers lotus with dew and roared.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
एवमार्ताःपतिंदृष्टवारावणंनिहतंभुवि । चुक्रुशुर्भहुधाशोकाद्भूयस्ताःपर्यदेवयन् ।।6.113.11।।
output: Afflicted on beholding their husband Ravana, killed, and lying on the ground, the Rakshasa women again and again cried exceedingly in many ways overcome with grief.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
येनमित्रासितःशक्रोयेनवित्रासितोयमः । येनवैश्रवणोराजापुष्पकेणवियोजितः ।।6.113.12।। गन्धर्वाणामृषीणां च सुराणां च महात्मनाम् । भयंयेनरणेदत्तंसोऽयंशेतेरणेहतः ।।6.113.13।।
output: "By whom Indra feared, by whom Yama feared, at whom king Visrava feared, by whom Pushpaka was deprived to Kubera in war, by whom Gandharvas and ascetics were afraid of, by whom high souled Suras were afraid of lies in the battlefield asleep."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
येनमित्रासितःशक्रोयेनवित्रासितोयमः । येनवैश्रवणोराजापुष्पकेणवियोजितः ।।6.113.12।। गन्धर्वाणामृषीणां च सुराणां च महात्मनाम् । भयंयेनरणेदत्तंसोऽयंशेतेरणेहतः ।।6.113.13।।
output: "By whom Indra feared, by whom Yama feared, at whom king Visrava feared, by whom Pushpaka was deprived to Kubera in war, by whom Gandharvas and ascetics were afraid of, by whom high souled Suras were afraid of lies in the battlefield asleep."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
असुरेभ्यःसुरेभ्योवापन्नगेभ्योऽपिवातथा । भयंयो न विजानातितस्येदंमानुषाद् भयम् ।।6.113.14।।
output: यः he who, असुरेभ्यः from Asuras, सुरेभ्योवा or Suras, तथा so also, पन्नगेभ्योऽपि Uragas also, भयम् fear, न विजानाति not known, तस्य his, मानुषात् by human, इदम् thus, भयम् experienced fear

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
अवध्योदेवतानांयस्तथादानवराक्षसाम् । हतःसोऽयंरणेशेतेमानुषेणपदातिना ।।6.113.15।।
output: "He, whom Devatas, Danavas and Rakshasas could not kill, lies asleep, killed by a mortal who came by walk."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
यो न शक्यस्सुरैर्हन्तुं न यक्षैर्नासुरैस्तथा । सोऽयंकश्चिदिवासत्त्वोमृत्युंमर्त्येनलम्भितः ।।6.113.16।।
output: "He, who could not be killed by Suras, Asuras or Yakshas, such a hero lies like a weak person devoid of strength, killed by a mortal, is resting."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
एवंवदन्त्योरुरुदुस्तस्यतादुःखिताःस्त्रियः । भूयएव च दुःखार्ताविलेपुश्चपुनःपुनः ।।6.113.17।।
output: Those women grieving in that way roared aloud, lamenting again and again cried, afflicted by sorrow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
अशृण्वतातुसुहृदांसततंहितवादिनाम् । मरणायहृतासीताराक्षसाश्चनिपातिताः ।।6.113.18।। एतास्सममिदानींतेवयमात्मा च पातितः ।
output: "You did not listen to the good advice of your dear and good at heart. You brought Sita and destroyed yourself and all of us at a time."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ब्रुवाणोऽपिहितंवाक्यमिष्टोभ्राताविभीषणः ।।6.113.19।। धृष्टंपरुषितोमोहत्त्वयात्मवथकाङ्क्षिणा ।
output: हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवाणोऽपि even though told, इष्टःभ्राता dear brother, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, धृष्टम् evidently, आत्मवथकाङ्णा sought your own destruction, त्वया by you, मोहात् in delusion, परुषितः harshly

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दिनिर्यातितातेस्वासतीतारामायमैथिली ।।6.113.20।। ननस्स्याद्व्यसनंघोरमिदंमूलहरंमहत् ।
output: "If Sita, princess of Mithila had been returned by you, this great destruction of the very root and calamity with you and for us would not have happened."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
वृत्तकामोभवेद्भ्रातारामोमित्रकुलंभवेत् ।।6.113.21।। वयंचाध्विवाःसर्वाःसकमा न च शत्रवः ।
output: "If your brother's desire had been fulfilled Rama would have turned to be our friend. We would not have been widows. Our enemy's desire would not have been fulfilled."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
त्वयापुनर्नृशंशंसेनसीतांसंरुन्धताबलात् ।।6.113.22।। राक्षसावयमात्मा च त्रयंतुल्यंनिपातितम् ।
output: "With evil intention you kept Sita under detention. These Rakshasas and you and us all the three are together destroyed."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 113:
न कामकारःकामंवातवराक्षसपुङ्गव । दैवंचेष्टयतेसर्वंहतंदैवेनहन्यते ।।6.113.23।।
output: "O Foremost of Rakshasas! You have acted according to your desire alone is not sufficient as divine will make you do everything. He is killed whom destiny kills."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
वानराणांविनाशोऽयंराक्षसानां च तेरणे । तवचैवमहाबाहो दैवयोगादुपागतः ।।6.113.24।।
output: "O mighty armed Ravana! For Vanaras, Rakshasas and you too, this destruction in this war has come by divine grace."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नैवार्थेन न कामेनविक्रमेण न चाज्ञया । शक्यादैवगतिर्लोकेनिवर्तयितुमुद्यता ।।6.113.25।।
output: उद्यता to lift up, दैवगतिः divine course, लोके in the world, अर्थेन by wealth, निवर्तयितुम् to stop, न शक्या not possible, कामेन with will, न not, विक्रमेण by prowess, न not, आज्ञया च king's order, न not

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तासांविलपमानानांतदाराक्षसयोषिताम् । ज्येष्ठापत्नीप्रियाजीनाभर्तारंसमुदैक्षत ।।6.114.1।।
output: Mandodari laments over Ravana's death. Requested by Rama, Vibheeshna performs the funeral rites of Ravana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दशग्रीवंहतंदृष्टवारामेणाचिन्त्यकर्मणा । पतिंमण्डोदरीतत्रकृपणापर्यदेवयत् ।।6.114.2।।
output: Looking at her husband Ravana killed by Rama of inconceivable exploits, Mandodari piteously lamented there.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ननुनाममहाबाहोतववैश्रवणानुज । क्रुद्धस्यप्रमुखेस्थातुंत्रस्यत्यपिपुरन्दरः ।।6.114.3।।
output: महाबाहो mighty armed, वैश्रवणानुज brother of Visrava, क्रुद्धस्य in anger, तव your, प्रमुखे chief, स्थातुम् to stand, पुरन्दरःअपि even Purandara, त्रस्यति fears, ननुनाम well known

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
ऋषयश्चमहान्तोऽपिगन्धर्वाश्चयशस्विनः । ननुनामतवोद्वेगाच्चारणाश्चदिशोगताः ।।6.114.4।।
output: "For fear of you, even great seers, illustrious Gandharvas, Charanas also went in all directions, is well known."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स त्वंमानुषमात्रेणरामेणयुधिनिर्जितः । न व्यपत्रपसेराजन् किमिदंराक्षसेश्वर ।।6.114.5।।
output: "O Lord of Rakshasas! Just by Rama, a mortal, you have been killed in war. Are you not shy of it?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कथंत्रैलोक्यमाक्रम्यश्रियावीर्येणचान्वितम् । अविषह्यंजघानत्वांमानुषोवनगोचरः ।।6.114.6।।
output: त्रैलोक्यम् in the three worlds, आक्रम्य occupying, श्रिया glorious, वीर्येण च by your valour, अन्वितम् irresistible, अविषह्यम् beyond the reach, त्वाम् you, वनगोचरः wanderer in forest, मानुषः human, कथम् how, जघान struck you

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
मानुषाणामविषयेचरतःकामरूपिणः । विनाशस्तवरामेणसम्युगेनोपपद्यते ।।6.114.7।।
output: "You lived in an inaccessible place and are capable of assuming any form at will. It is not believable how you have been destroyed by Rama."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
न चैतत्कर्मरामस्यश्रद्धधामिचमूमुखे । सर्वतस्समुपेतस्यतवतेनाभिमर्षणम् ।।6.114.8।।
output: "You are always well equipped with the army, so such action (killing you) is not possible for Rama."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदैव च जनस्थानेराक्षसैर्भहुनिर्ववृतः । खरस्तवहतोभ्रातातदैवासौ न मानुषः ।।6.114.9।।
output: " At Janasthana your brother Khara, who was surrounded by many Rakshasas, was killed by a mortal in the same manner."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
यदैवनगरींलङ्कांदुष्प्रवेशांसुरैरपि । प्रविष्टोहनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैवव्यथितावयम् ।।6.114.10।।
output: "To Lanka, which is inaccessible to anyone, Hanuman entered by increasing his valour. Knowing this we worried (that Rama may not be mere mortal)."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदैववानरैर्घोरैर्बद्धस्सेतुर्महार्णवे । तदैवहृदयेनाहंशङ्केरामममानुषम् ।।6.114.11।।
output: "When these terrific Vanaras constructed a bridge over the great ocean, I doubted in my mind at that time itself that Rama is not a mortal."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथवारामरूपेणकृतान्तस्स्वयमागतः । मायांतवविनाशायविधायाप्रतितर्किताम् ।।6.114.12।।
output: अथवा or else, स्वयम् by himself, कृतान्तः god of death, तव your, विनाशाय for destruction, अप्रतितर्किताम् inconceivable recourse, मायाम् conceit, विधाय right knowledge, रामरूपेण in the form of Rama, आगतः would have come.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
अथवावासवेनत्वंधर्षितोऽपिमहाबल । वासवस्यतुकाशक्तिस्त्वांद्रष्टुमपिसंयुगे ।।6.114.13।।
output: "Or else O king of extraordinary might! Indra would have come to overthrow you in the form of Rama. Indra has no energy even to look at you in the battlefield."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
व्यक्तमेषमहायोगीपरमात्मासनातनः । अनादिमध्यनिधनोमहतंपरमोमहान् ।।6.114.14।। तमसःपरमोधाताशङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । श्रीवत्सवक्षानित्यश्रीरजय्यश्शाश्वतोध्रुवः ।।6.114.15।। मानुषंरूपमास्थायविष्णुस्सत्यपराक्रमः । सर्वैःपरिवृतोदेवैर्वानरत्वमुपागतैः ।।6.114.16।। सर्वलोकेश्वर्श्रीमान्लोकानांहितकाम्यया । सराक्षसरपरीवारंहतवांस्त्वांमहाद्युतिः ।।6.114.17।।
output: "It is evident that this Rama is a great yogi, eternal, who has no beginning, middle or end. He is supreme, greater than great and stands beyond darkness, a sustainer. He holds conch, discus, and mace in hand. He has symbols of Srivatsa on his chest. He is ever rich, invincible, everlasting, steady supreme soul and of truthful valour. He is prosperous, a mass of brilliance, Lord Vishnu and the Lord of all worlds, a wellwisher of all. He has come in mortal form, in the form of Vanaras also, and by all gods. He vanquished you along with Rakshasas is evident."

instruction:

इन्द्रियाणिपुराजित्वाजितंत्रिभुवनंत्वया । स्मरद्भिरिवतद्वैरमिन्द्रियैरेवनिर्जितः ।।6.114.18।।
output: "In the past by winning your senses you gained the three worlds. Now it seems as though the senses have recollected and taken their grudge. You have lost control over your senses, thereby you are killed by your enemy."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदैवहिजनस्थानेराक्षसैर्भहुभिर्वृतः । खरस्तुनिहतोभ्रातातदारामो न मानुषः ।।6.114.19।। यदैवनगरींलङ्कांदुष्प्रवेशांसुरैरपि । प्रविष्टोहनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैवव्यथितावयम् ।।6.114.20।।
output: जनस्थाने at Janasthana, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, वृतः surrounded by, तवभ्राता your brother, खरः Khara, हतःgot killed, तदैव so also, असौ He is, मानुषः mortal, न not, यदैव so also, हनुमान् Hanuman, सुरैरपि even gods, दुष्प्रवेशाम् difficult to enter, लङ्कांनगरीम् Lanka city, वीर्यात्, प्रविष्टः entered, तदैव that time, वयम् I, व्यथिताः got perturbed

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यदैवहिजनस्थानेराक्षसैर्भहुभिर्वृतः । खरस्तुनिहतोभ्रातातदारामो न मानुषः ।।6.114.19।। यदैवनगरींलङ्कांदुष्प्रवेशांसुरैरपि । प्रविष्टोहनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैवव्यथितावयम् ।।6.114.20।।
output: " At Janasthana when your brother Khara was surrounded by many Rakshasas also he got killed by a mortal. So also, when Hanuman entered the city of Lanka, which is difficult to enter even for gods, I got perturbed."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
क्रियतामविरोधश्चराघवेणेतियन्मया । उच्यमानं न गृह्णासितस्येयंव्युष्टिरागता ।।6.114.21।।
output: "You were advised by me not to have any hostile action with Rama. You had not listened to me. This is the result of that action."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
अकस्माच्छाभिकामोऽसिसीतांराक्षसपुङ्गवः । ऐश्वर्यस्यविनाशायदेहस्यस्वजनस्य च ।।6.114.22।।
output: "O Foremost of Rakshasas! To the destruction of your wealth, life and your own people you suddenly developed passion for Sita."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अरुन्धत्याविशिष्टांतांरोहिण्याश्चापिदुर्मते । सीतांधर्षयतामान्यांत्वयाह्यसदृशंकृतम् ।।6.114.23।।
output: "O evil minded king! Sita is to be respected even more than Arundathi or Rohini. Your arrogant action to her is unworthy."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
वसुधायाहिवसुधांश्रियःश्रींभर्तृवत्सलाम् । सीतांसर्वानवद्याङ्गीमरण्येविजनेशुभाम् ।।6.114.24।। आनयित्वातुतांदीनांछद्मनात्मस्वदूषण । अप्राप्यतंचैवकामंमैथिलीसङ्गमेकृतम् ।।6.114.25।। पतिव्रतायास्तपसानूनंदग्धोऽसिमेप्रभो ।
output: "O king! You dishonoured your wives and me. Sita, who is tolerant as the goddess of earth, prosperous, goddess of fortune, who is fond of her husband, charming in all respects, living alone in the forest, an auspicious one, desperate, was brought in disguise by you. Before you cherished your desire to be in union with Mythili, surely you got burnt by her austerity."

output: तनुमध्यमाम् of slender waist, धर्षयन् touched, त्वम् you, तदैव at that time, न दग्धःइति not burnt, यत्, सेन्द्राः Indra, सानाग्नीपुरोगमाः headed by fire god, देवाः gods, ते to you, अभिभ्यते approaching with hostile intentions

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
अवश्यमेवलभतेफलंपापस्यकर्मणः । घोरंपर्यागतेकालेकर्तानास्त्यत्रसंशयः ।।6.114.27।।
output: "When time comes surely one who does sinful action will reap the result. There is no doubt that the doer of a terrible action will be destroyed."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न कुलेन न रूपेण न दाक्षिण्येनमैथिली । मयाधिकावातुल्यावातत्त्वंमोहान्नबुध्यसे ।।6.114.28।।
output: मैथिली Mythili, कुलेन by race, मया compared to me, अधिकावा superior, तुल्यावा न not little, रूपेण form, न not, दाक्षिण्येन in civility, न not, त्वम् you, मोहात् out of infatuation, तत् that, न बुध्यसे not perceived

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
सर्वदासर्वभूतानांनास्तिमुत्युरलक्षणः । तवतावदयंमृत्युर्मैथिलीकृतलक्षणः ।।6.114.29।।
output: "Death does not happen without reason for any being. To you this happened because of getting Mythili."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सीतानिमित्तजोमृत्युस्त्वयादूरादुपाहृतः । मैथिलीसहरामेणविशोकाविहरिष्यति ।।6.114.30।।
output: त्वया by you, सीतानिमित्तजः on account of Sita, मृत्युः death, दूरात् distance, उपाहृतः abducting, मैथिली Mythili, विशोका devoid of sorrow, रामेणसह with Rama, विहरिष्यति will sport

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
अल्पपुण्यात्वहंघोरेपतिताशोकसागरे । कैलासेमन्दरेमेरौतथाचैत्ररथेवने ।।6.114.31।। देवोद्यानेषुसर्वेषुविहृत्यसहितात्वया । विमानेनानुरूपेणयायाम्यतुलयाश्रिया ।।6.114.32।। पश्यन्तिविविधान्देशांस्तांस्तांश्चित्रस्रगम्बरा । भ्रम्शिताकामभोगेभ्यःसास्मिवीरवधात्तव ।।6.114.33।। सैवान्येवास्मिसम्वृत्ताधिग्राज्ञांचञ्चलाःश्रियः ।
output: "O Hero! Whose stock of merit was less, that you have tumbled down into an ocean of grief. I, having sported with you, clad in picturesque robes and the like, by the aerial car Chaitra ratha on mount Kailasa, Mount Meru and Mandara as well as in divine gardens all over, and various lands with matchless splendour, have been deprived of sensual pleasures because of your falling down. What a pity I am surrounded by ordinary women changed into another woman with fleeting fortunes!"

instruction:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हाराजन् सुकुमारंतेसुभ्रुसुत्वक्समुन्नसम् ।।6.114.34।। कान्तिश्रीद्युतिभिस्तुल्यमिन्दुपद्मदिवाकरैः । किरीटकूटोज्ज्वलितंताम्रास्यंदीप्तकुण्डलम् ।।6.114.35।। मदव्याकुललोलाक्षंभूत्वायत्पानभूमिषु । विविधस्रग्धरंचारुवल्गुस्मितकथंशुभम् ।।6.114.36।। तदेवाद्यतवैवंहिवक्त्रं न भ्राजतेप्रभो । रामसायकनिर्भिन्नंरक्तंरुधिरविस्रवैः ।।6.114.37।। वीशीर्णमेदोमस्तिष्कंरूक्षस्यन्दनरेणुभिः ।
output: "Oh King, My Lord! Your shiny eyes with delicate eyebrows, which used to be shiny and delicate your prominent nose brilliant skin resembling moon in pleasantness, lotus in beauty, and Sun in radiance your illuminating crown, your shining crown with gems like the peaks of mountains your coppery lips, glowing earrings, rolling eyes were pleasing earlier in the drinking parlours through inebriety, and your auspicious mouth having been indulged in pleasing talk. Today you are pierced by Rama's arrow and shattered with blood flowing, marrow of brain scattered, soiled by dust, dirtied and without any shine."

instruction:

हापश्चिमामेसम्प्राप्तादशावैधव्यदायिनी ।।6.114.38।। यामयासीन्नसुम्बद्धाकदाचिदपिमन्दया ।

instruction:

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृप्तामर्दनाःशूराःप्रख्यातबलपौरुषाः ।।6.114.40।। अकुतश्चिद्भयानाथाममेत्यासीन्मतिर्दृढा ।
output: "Those who are capable of protecting me are warriors, as they are capable of crushing the enemies and renowned for their pride of their strength. They had no fear from any quarter. I had this conviction in my mind."

instruction:

output: "O Bull among Rakshasas! You are such a famous king. This fear from a human is unknown. How did it come?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलंतुप्रांशुशैलोपमंमहत् ।।6.114.42।। केयूराङ्गदवैडूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम् । कान्तंविहारेष्वधिकंदीप्तांसङ्ग्रामभूमिषु ।।6.114.43।। भात्याभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिवतोयदः । तदेवाद्यशरीरंतेतीक्ष्णैर्नैकशरैश्चितम् ।।6.114.44।। पुनर्दुर्लभसम्पर्शंपरिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते । श्वाविधःशलकैर्यद्वद्भाणैर्लग्नैर्निरन्तरम् ।।6.114.45।। स्वर्पितैर्मर्मसुभृशंसञ्छिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् । क्षितौनिपतितंराजन् श्यामंवैरुधिरच्छवि ।।6.114.46।। वज्रप्रहाराभिहतोविकीर्णइवपर्वतः ।
output: राजन् king, स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलम् like a dark shining sapphire, प्रांशुशैलोपमम् mountain like body, महत् great, केयूराङ्गदवैदूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम् Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, विहारेषु at sporting time, अधिकम् very, कान्तम् bright, सङ्ग्रामभूमिषु on the battlefield, दीप्तम् glowing, यत् those, तेशरीरम् on your body, आभरणभाभिः lustre of jewels, विद्युद्भिः flashes of lightning, तोयदःइव like rainy clouds, भाति shining, पुनः again, दुर्लभसम्पर्शम् difficult to touch, अद्य today, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, नैकशरैः numerous arrows, चितम् fixed, श्वाविधः cut to pieces, शलकैःयद्वत् since darts, लग्नैः stuck to, निरन्तरम् ever, मर्मसु vital parts, स्वर्पितैः inserted, बाणैः arrows, सम्ञ्छिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् concealed to perform ablution, क्षितौ broken, निपतितम् fallen, श्यामम् dark, रुधिरच्छवि soaked in blood, वज्रप्रहाराभिहतः hit by thunderbolt, विकीर्णः crushed, पर्वतःइव like mountain, तदेव in that way, परिष्वक्तुम् to embrace, न शक्यते not possible

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलंतुप्रांशुशैलोपमंमहत् ।।6.114.42।। केयूराङ्गदवैडूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम् । कान्तंविहारेष्वधिकंदीप्तांसङ्ग्रामभूमिषु ।।6.114.43।। भात्याभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिवतोयदः । तदेवाद्यशरीरंतेतीक्ष्णैर्नैकशरैश्चितम् ।।6.114.44।। पुनर्दुर्लभसम्पर्शंपरिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते । श्वाविधःशलकैर्यद्वद्भाणैर्लग्नैर्निरन्तरम् ।।6.114.45।। स्वर्पितैर्मर्मसुभृशंसञ्छिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् । क्षितौनिपतितंराजन् श्यामंवैरुधिरच्छवि ।।6.114.46।। वज्रप्रहाराभिहतोविकीर्णइवपर्वतः ।
output: "O king! Your body which is gigantic like a mountain, dark like a sapphire adorned with Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, which were charming when in the battlefield, and shone brightly on your body with the lustre of your jewels like a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning. It is fixed with numerous arrows cut into pieces by darts and difficult to touch. Since the darts are inserted deep into your vital parts, it is not possible to perform ablution. It is dark, soaked in blood, broken, and crushed like a mountain hit by thunderbolt. Alas, it is not possible to embrace."

Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारंत्रैलोक्योद्वेगदंमहत् ।।6.114.48।। जेतारंलोकपालानांक्षेप्तारांशङ्करस्य च ।
output: त्रैलोक्यवसुभोक्तारम् enjoyer of the treasures of the three worlds, महत् great, त्रैलोक्यद्वेगदम् annoyer of the three worlds, लोकपालानाम् able to win ruler of the three worlds, जेतारम् conqueror of the world, शङ्करस्य Shankara's, क्षेप्तारम् lifted the seat

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दृप्तानांनिग्रहीतारमाविष्कृतपराक्रमम् ।।6.114.49।। लोकक्षोभयितारं च नादैर्भूतविराविणम् ।
output: दृप्तानाम् arrogant, निग्रहीतारम् subduer, आविष्कृतपराक्रमम् who manifested his prowess, लोकक्षोभयितारम् who has tormented the world, नादैः by his insolent words, भूतविराविणम् who made the world cry

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ओजसादृप्तवाक्यानांवक्तारंरिपुसन्निधौ ।।6.114.50।। स्वयूथभृत्यगोप्तारंहन्तारंभीमकर्मणाम् ।
output: "He, who commanded uttering harsh words in the presence of the enemy, who protected his own brand, who killed those indulged in terrible deeds.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
हन्तारंदानवेन्द्राणांयक्षाणां च सहस्रशः ।।6.114.51।। निवातकवचानां च सङ्ग्रहीतारमाहवे ।
output: सहस्रशः thousands, दानवेन्द्राणाम् chiefs of Danavas, यक्षाणां च Yakshas, हन्तारम् killed, आहवे in combat, निवातकवचानाम् Nivatakavachas (a class of Danavas), सङ्ग्रहीतारम् subdued

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नैकयज्ञविलोप्तारंत्रातारंस्वजनस्य च ।।6.114.52।। धर्मव्यवस्थाभेत्तारंमायास्रष्टारमाहवे ।
output: नैकयज्ञविलोप्तारम् obstructed performance of sacrificial rituals, स्वजनस्य च his own, त्रातारम् protected, धर्मव्यवस्थाभेत्तारम् who violated code of conduct, आहवे in combat, मायास्रष्टारम् by conjuring tricks

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
देवासुरनृकन्यानामाहर्तारंततस्ततः ।।6.114.53।। शत्रुस्त्रीशोकदातारं नेतारं स्वजनस्य च ।
output: "Brought by force virgin girls of Devas, suras and human beings from here and there forcibly and caused the enemy women to mourn"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
लङ्काद्वीपस्यगोप्तारंकर्तारंभीमकर्मणाम् ।।6.114.54।। अस्माकंकामभोगानांदातारंरथिनांवरम् ।
output: लङ्काद्वीपस्य in the island of Lanka, गोप्तारम् one who conceals, भीमकर्मणाम् terrible deeds, कर्तारम् did, अस्माकम् for his own, कामभोगानाम् sexual pleasures, दातारम् provided, रथिनाम् among the providers of sensual pleasures, वरम् foremost

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
एवंप्रभावंभर्तारंदृष्टवारामेणपातितम् ।।6.114.55।। स्थिरास्मियादेहमिमंधारयामिहतप्रिया ।
output: "Such a husband of mine endowed with this kind of influence, killed by Rama, is lying here. Beholding the lover gone, I am holding this body and standing here."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
शयनेषुमहार्हेषुशयित्वाराक्षसेश्वर ।।6.114.56।। इहकर्मात्प्रसुप्तोऽसिधरण्यांरेणुगुण्ठितः ।
output: "O Lord of Rakshasas! Having slept on the best of beds, you are now lying here on the hard ground, body covered with dust. Where are you sleeping?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
यदातेतनयश्शस्तोलक्ष्मणेनेन्द्रजिद्युधि ।।6.114.57।। तदात्वभिहतातीव्रमद्यत्वस्मिनिपातिता ।
output: "When my son Indrajith was killed by Lakshmana I was in intense grief. Now you have fallen."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
साहंबन्धुजनैर्हीनाहीनानाथेन च त्वया ।।6.114.58।। विहीनाकामभोगैश्चशोचिष्येशाश्वतीस्समाः ।
output: "Disconnected with relatives, forsaken by you also, deprived of sensual pleasures, I shall grieve permanently."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रपन्नोदीर्घमध्वानंराजन्नद्यसुदुर्गमम् ।।6.114.59।। नयमामपिदुःखार्तां न वर्तिष्येत्वयाविना ।
output: "O king! Today, take me on your journey which is very difficult. Stricken with sorrow I cannot live without you."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
कस्मात्त्वंमांविहायेहकृपणांगन्तुमिच्छसि ।।6.114.60।। दीनांविलपतींमन्दांकिंवामांनाभिभाषसे ।
output: "You are leaving me, a desperate one, stricken, crying. Why are you desiring to go? Why are you not replying to me?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
दृष्टवा न खल्वभिक्रुद्धोमामिहानवकुण्ठिताम् ।।6.114.61।। निर्गतांनगरद्वारात्पद्भ्यामेवागतांप्रभो ।
output: प्रभो Lord, नगरद्वारात् through city gate, निर्गताम् going, पद्भ्यामेव walking, आगताम् come, अनवकुण्ठिताम् them come forth, माम् me, इह here, दृष्टवा seeing, न अभिक्रुद्धःखलु not angry

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
पश्येष्टदारदारांस्तेभ्रष्टलज्जावकुण्ठितान् ।।6.114.62।। बहिर्निष्पतितान्सर्वान्कथंदृष्टवा न कुप्यसि ।
output: इष्टदार one who is a lover of his wives, भ्रष्टलज्जावकुण्ठितान् removing their veils, बहिः out, निष्पतितान् leaving their abode, ते to you, सर्वान् all, दारान् gate, पश्य see, दृष्टवा seeing, कथं न कुप्यसि how is it that you are not angry?

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अयंक्रीडासहायस्तेऽनाथेलालप्यतेजनः ।।6.114.63।। न चैवमाश्वासयसिकिंवा न बहुमन्यसे ।
output: ते to you, क्रीडासहायः in all sporting, अयंजनः these people, नाथ Lord, लालप्यते calling them, एनम् why, न च आश्वासयसि are you not consoling them, न बहुमन्यसेकिंवा not inviting them

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
याःस्त्वयाविधवाराजन्कृतानैकाःकुलस्त्रियः ।।6.114.64।। पतिव्रताधर्मरतागुरुशुश्रूषणेरताः । ताभिश्शोकाभितप्ताभिश्शप्तःपरवशंगतः ।।6.114.65।। त्वयाविप्रकृताभिर्यत्तदाशप्तंतदागतम् ।
output: राजन् king, नैकाः noble lineage, पतिव्रताः chaste women, धर्मरताः righteous, गुरुशुश्रूषणे in the service of elders, रताः remained, याः those, कुलस्त्रियः noble women, त्वया by you, विधवाः widowed, शोकाभितप्ताभिः tormented in sorrow, ताभिः they also, शप्तं curse, परवशंगतः under the sway of the enemy, तदा then, त्वया by you, विप्रकृताभिः having done wrong action, यत् because of that, शप्तम् curse, तत् that, आगतम् has come on you

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
याःस्त्वयाविधवाराजन्कृतानैकाःकुलस्त्रियः ।।6.114.64।। पतिव्रताधर्मरतागुरुशुश्रूषणेरताः । ताभिश्शोकाभितप्ताभिश्शप्तःपरवशंगतः ।।6.114.65।। त्वयाविप्रकृताभिर्यत्तदाशप्तंतदागतम् ।
output: "King! Chaste women of noble lineage being righteous, serving the elders have been widowed by you. Because of their curse, you have fallen under the sway of your enemy and because of that, this has come to you."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रवादस्सत्यएवायंत्वांप्रतिप्रायशोनृप ।।6.114.66।। प्रतिव्रतानांनाकस्मात्सपत्नत्यश्रूणिभूतले ।
output: नृप king, पतिव्रतानाम् noble women, अश्रूणि tears, अकस्मात् fallen, भूतले on earth, न पतन्ति not drop, अयम् this, प्रवादः calamity, त्वांप्रति to you in turn, प्रायशः resulted, सत्यएव it is true

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
कथं च नामतेराजन् लोकानाक्रम्यतेजसा ।।6.114.67।। नारीचौर्यमिदंक्षुद्रंकृतंशौण्डीर्यमानिना ।
output: "King! You have invaded the world by your brilliance and were proud of your heroism. How did you do this mean act of abducting a woman?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
अपनीयाश्रमाद्रामंयन्मृगच्छद्मनात्वया ।।6.114.68।। आनीतारामपनतीसातत्तेकातर्यलक्षणम् ।
output: "By your cowardly action of creating an illusory deer, you have brought Rama's consort from the hermitage."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
कातर्यं न च तेयुद्धेकदाचित्संस्मराम्यहम् ।।6.114.69।। तत्तुभाग्यविपर्यासान्नूनंतेपक्वलक्षणम् ।
output: "Indeed, I do not remember you being cowardly in war. The timidness that appeared in you is a sign of the adverseness of fate, for your destruction."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अतीतानागतार्थज्ञोवर्तमानविचक्षणः ।।6.114.70।। मैथिलीमाहृतांदृष्टवाध्यात्वानिःश्वस्यचायतम् । सत्यवाक्यमहाबाहो देवरोमेयदब्रवीत् ।।6.114.71।। अयंराक्षसमुख्यानांविनाशःपर्युपस्थितः । कामक्रोधसमुत्थेनव्यसनेनप्रसङ्गिना ।।6.114.72।।
output: महाबाहो mighty armed, अतीतानागतार्थज्ञः knower of matters relating to future, वर्तमानविचक्षणः future and present, सत्यवान् truthful one, सः he, मे my, देवरः husband's brother, अहृताम् getting, मैथिलीम् Mythili, दृष्टवा seeing, ध्यात्वा thought of, अयतम् for some time, निःश्वस्य sighing, यत् that which, अब्रवीत् spoke, अयम् this, राक्षसमुख्यानाम् for all Rakshasa chiefs, विनाशःdestruction, कामक्रोधमुत्थेन by the desire for sensual pleasure and anger, overtaken by death, प्रसङ्गिना as you told, व्यसनेन by that deep desire, पर्युपस्थितःhas resulted in this calamity

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अतीतानागतार्थज्ञोवर्तमानविचक्षणः ।।6.114.70।। मैथिलीमाहृतांदृष्टवाध्यात्वानिःश्वस्यचायतम् । सत्यवाक्यमहाबाहो देवरोमेयदब्रवीत् ।।6.114.71।। अयंराक्षसमुख्यानांविनाशःपर्युपस्थितः । कामक्रोधसमुत्थेनव्यसनेनप्रसङ्गिना ।।6.114.72।।
output: महाबाहो mighty armed, अतीतानागतार्थज्ञः knower of matters relating to future, वर्तमानविचक्षणः future and present, सत्यवान् truthful one, सः he, मे my, देवरः husband's brother, अहृताम् getting, मैथिलीम् Mythili, दृष्टवा seeing, ध्यात्वा thought of, अयतम् for some time, निःश्वस्य sighing, यत् that which, अब्रवीत् spoke, अयम् this, राक्षसमुख्यानाम् for all Rakshasa chiefs, विनाशःdestruction, कामक्रोधमुत्थेन by the desire for sensual pleasure and anger, overtaken by death, प्रसङ्गिना as you told, व्यसनेन by that deep desire, पर्युपस्थितःhas resulted in this calamity

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
अतीतानागतार्थज्ञोवर्तमानविचक्षणः ।।6.114.70।। मैथिलीमाहृतांदृष्टवाध्यात्वानिःश्वस्यचायतम् । सत्यवाक्यमहाबाहो देवरोमेयदब्रवीत् ।।6.114.71।। अयंराक्षसमुख्यानांविनाशःपर्युपस्थितः । कामक्रोधसमुत्थेनव्यसनेनप्रसङ्गिना ।।6.114.72।।
output: "Mighty armed King! Your brother, who is a knower of matters relating to future, present and past, a truthful one, after your getting Mythili, thought for a while and sighing spoke this. 'The destruction of Rakshasa chiefs is now sure to happen', has come true.' The desire for sensual pleasures and anger has resulted in your death and resulting in this calamity."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
निर्वृत्तस्त्वत्कृतेऽनर्थःसोऽयंमूलहरोमहान् । त्वयाकृतमिदंसर्वमनाधंराक्षसंकुलम् ।।6.114.73।।
output: "By this major disaster of yours, the very root has been destroyed. With the extermination of the Rakshasas, the entire Rakshasa clan is orphaned now by your action."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
हित्वंशोचितव्योमेप्रख्यातबलपौरुषः । स्त्रीस्वभावात्तुमेबुद्धिःकारुण्येपरिवर्तते ।।6.114.74।।
output: "You are famous for your strength and courage. I do not need to wail for you. Being a woman, by nature I am compassionate, and my mind is moving towards sorrow."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुकृतंदुष्कृतं च त्वंगृहीत्वास्वांगतिंगतः । आत्मानमनुशोचामित्वद्विनाशेनदुःखिताम् ।।6.114.75।।
output: "You have taken away the good and evil deeds done by your death. I'm thinking of myself and wailing."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
सुहृदांहितकामानां न श्रुतंवचनंत्वया । भ्रात्रूणांचैवकार्त्न्सनहितमुक्तंदशानन ।।6.114.76।।
output: "O Ten headed king! You did not heed the good words of advice given by your friends. You did not totally heed the good words spoken by your brothers."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हेत्वर्थयुक्तंविधिवच्छ्रेयस्करमदारुणम् । विभीषणेनाभिहितं न कृतंहेतुमत्त्वया ।।6.114.77।।
output: "You have not listened to the meaningful, agreeable and reasonable advice given according to tradition by Vibheeshana."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 114:
मारीचकुम्भकर्णाभ्यांवाक्यंममपितुस्तथा । न श्रुतंवीर्यमत्तेनतस्येदंफलमीदृशम् ।।6.114.78।।
output: "You did not take the advice of both Maricha and Kumbhakarna. You have also not taken the advice of my father because of the pride of your valour. This kind of result is the consequence of that."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
नीलजीमूतसङ्काश पीताम्बरशुभाङ्गद । स्वगात्राणिविनिक्षिप्यकिंशेषेरुधिराप्लुतः ।।6.114.79।।
output: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशः resembling dark cloud in colour, पीताम्बरशुभाङ्गद clad in yellow silk, स्वगात्राणि your own limbs, विनिक्षिप्य thrown down broken, रुधिराप्लुतः covered with blood, किम् why, शेषे lying

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रसुप्तइवशोकार्तांकिंमां न प्रतिभाषसे । महावीर्यस्यदक्षस्यसम्युगेष्वपलायिनः ।।6.114.80।। यातुधानस्यदौहित्रींकिंमां न प्रतिभाषसे ।
output: प्रसुप्तःइव sleeping like this, शोकार्ताम् stricken with grief, माम् me, किम् why, न प्रतिभाषसे not replying, महावीर्यस्य being great hero, दक्षस्य Daksha'sसम्युगेषु in the combat, अपलायिनः disown, यातुधानस्य like husband 's brother's wife, दौहित्रीं granddaughter, माम् me, किम् why, न प्रतिभाषसे not you are not answering

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठकिंशेषेनवेपरिभवेकृते ।।6.114.81।। अद्यवैनिर्भयालङ्कांप्रविष्टांसूर्यरश्मयः ।
output: "Get up, Rise up. When you are insulted why are you lying down? Because you are lying down, even the radiance of the Sun has entered Lanka without fear."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
येनसूदयसेशत्रून् समरेसूर्यवर्चसा ।।6.114.82।। वज्रंवज्रधरस्येवसोऽयंतेसततार्चितः । रणेबहुप्रहरणोहेमजापरिष्कृतः ।।6.114.83।। परिघोव्यवकीर्णस्तेबाणैश्चिन्नैःसहस्रधा ।

श्लाघनीयोऽनिलस्यत्वंसुतःपरमधार्मिकः ।।6.116.27।। बलंशौर्यंश्रुतंसत्त्वंविक्रमोदाक्ष्यमुत्तमम् । तेजःक्षमाधृतिस्स्थैर्यंविनीतत्वं न संशयः ।।6.116.28।। एतेचान्ये च बहवोगुणास्त्वय्येवशोभनाः ।
output: "You are a praiseworthy son of wind god. In strength, righteousness, valour, vigour, prowess, skill, you are excellent. You are energetic, endowed with tolerance, forbearance, firmness, brilliance, and humility. You alone have many more qualities, no doubt."

instruction:

output: Now with folded palms offering prayers to Sita, Hanuman stood without perturbation, with all humility and again spoke to Sita.

instruction:

output: "I desire to kill all those Rakshasas who in the past have intimidated you indeed and whoever threatened you."

instruction:

output: "O Devi! You, who were so devoted to your husband, were tormented in Asoka grove earlier. These cruel Rakshasas of hideous conduct, of fierce and distorted forms with terrible eyes addressing you in harsh words by Ravana's order, were heard by me."

instruction:

विकृताविकृताकाराःक्रूराःक्रूरकचेक्षणाः ।।6.116.33।। इच्छामिविविधैराघतैर्हन्तुमेतास्सुदारुणाः । राक्षस्योदारुणकथावरमेतत्प्रयच्छमे ।।6.116.34।।
output: "I wish to kill by all kinds of strokes, these cruel distorted forms of Rakshasas having terrible hair and fierce eyes and not to mention their violence. Permit me."

output: "O Illustrious lady! I would like to kill the terrible forms of ogres who threatened you, in that way, I will be at and strike in many ways and destroy them", said Hanuman to Sita.

instruction:

output: Hanuman having spoken like that, Sita who was fond of the desperate, thus spoke to Hanuman thinking for a while.

output: "By Ravana's order they threatened me so. Now with his death, they will not be threatening me."

instruction:

output: "O Monkey! In olden days a bear had uttered a verse which conforms to righteousness. I shall tell you now."

output: पापनांवा sinners, शुभानांवा or noble, प्लवङ्गम monkey, वधार्हाणाम् those who deserve death, आर्येण by noble souls, कारुण्यम् compassion, कार्यम् action, कश्चित् indeed, नापराध्यतिइति न none commits harm

output: Sita, having spoken that way to Hanuman, he, who was capable of good expression, replied as follows to Rama's consort, who was irreproachable.

output: Hanuman, having spoken that way to Vaidehi, daughter of Janaka, she said" I desire to see my husband."

instruction:

output: On hearing Mythili, wise Hanuman spoke these words to her bringing joy to her.

output: Hanuman reached Raghava with extraordinary speed assuring Sita, who shone like Lakshmi, goddess of prosperity, and had spoken like that.

output: "You ought to see that noble lady Mythili, who was immersed in grief, for whose sake these actions were started and has borne fruit."

instruction:

Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 118:
सीतामुत्पलपत्राक्षींनीलकुञ्चितमूर्थजाम् । अवदद्वैवरारोहंमध्येवानररक्षसाम् ।।6.118.12।।
output: In the midst of Vanaras and Rakshasas, Rama spoke with great discomfort to Sita whose eyes were like lotus petals and hair was dark and curly and whose limbs were beautiful.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 118:
यत्कर्तव्यंमनुष्येणधर्षणांप्रतिमार्जता । तत्कृतंरावणंहत्वामयेदंमानकाङ्क्षिणा ।।6.118.13।।
output: "That which my mind desired as a duty of a human being, to get rid of the insult has been done by killing Ravana."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
निर्जिताजीवलोकस्यतपसाभावितात्मना । अगस्त्येनदुराधर्षामुनिनादक्षिणेवधिक् ।।6.118.14।।
output: "Though the southern quarter is difficult to assail for the world of mortals, Agastya, a realized sage, has won by the power of his austerity. In the same way I have won you."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विदितश्चास्तुभत्रंतेयोऽयंरणपरिश्रमः । सुतीर्णःसुहृदांवीर्यान्नत्वदर्थंमयाकृतः ।।6.118.15।। रक्षतातुमयावृत्तपमवादं च सर्वतः । प्रख्यातस्यात्मवंशस्यव्यङ्ग्यं च परिमार्जता ।।6.118.16।।
output: "Sita! This effort in carrying out with the assistance of valiant friends is not done for your sake. Let it be known to you. I have done this to protect good conduct and my illustrious race from scandal and rid of obloquy from all sides."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 118:
विदितश्चास्तुभत्रंतेयोऽयंरणपरिश्रमः । सुतीर्णःसुहृदांवीर्यान्नत्वदर्थंमयाकृतः ।।6.118.15।। रक्षतातुमयावृत्तपमवादं च सर्वतः । प्रख्यातस्यात्मवंशस्यव्यङ्ग्यं च परिमार्जता ।।6.118.16।।
output: "Sita! This effort in carrying out with the assistance of valiant friends is not done for your sake. Let it be known to you. I have done this to protect good conduct and my illustrious race from scandal and rid of obloquy from all sides."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 118:
प्राप्तचारित्रसन्देहाममप्रतिमुखेस्थिता । दीपोनेत्रातुरस्येवप्रतिकूलासिमेदृढम् ।।6.118.17।।
output: "In the event of doubtful conduct also you are standing firmly like a glowing lamp for me suffering from sore eyes and disagreeable to me."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 118:
तद्गच्छत्वानुजानेऽद्ययथेष्टंजनकात्मजे । एतादशदिशोभद्रेकार्यमस्ति न मेत्वया ।।6.118.18।।
output: "O Janaka's daughter! therefore now you are permitted to go wherever to any quarter. Let you be auspicious. I have no work with you."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कःपुमांस्तुकुलेजातस्स्त्रयंपरगृहाषिताम् । तेजस्वीपुनरादद्यात्सुहृल्लेख्येनचेतसा ।।6.118.19।।
output: कुले good race, जातः born, तेजस्वी eminent, कःपुमान्? which man, परगृहोषिताम् in other's home, स्त्रियम् lived, सुहृल्लेख्येन kind, चेतसा consciously, पुनः again, अदत्यात् accept

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 118:
रावणाङ्कपरिक्लिष्टांदृष्टांदुष्टेनचक्षुषा । कथंत्वापुनरादद्यांकुलंव्यपदिशन् महत् ।।6.118.20।।
output: "You are thrown out of the arms of Ravana. You have been seen by him with lustful eyes, have been seen by all with evil eyes. How can one born in a great race accept you again?"

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तदर्थंनिर्जितामेत्वंयशःप्रत्याहृतंमया । नास्तिमेत्यय्यभिष्वङ्गोयथेष्टंगम्यतामितः ।।6.118.21।।
output: त्वम् your, तदर्थम् the purpose, मे my, निर्जिता to rid of, मया by me, यशः fame, प्रत्याहृतम् won back, मे by me, त्वयि in you, अभिष्वङ्गः no interest, नास्ति not,

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 118:
तदद्यव्याहृतंभद्रेमयैतत् कृतबुधदिना । लक्ष्मणेनाथभरतेकुरुबुधदिंयथासुखम् ।।6.118.22।।
output: " Auspicious one! This utterance has been thought over well today. You may go wherever you find happiness, either to Lakshmana or else to Bharata. Think well and do."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
शत्रुघ्नेवाथसुग्रीवेराक्षसेवाविभीषणे । निवेशयमनस्सीतेयथावासुखमात्मनः ।।6.118.23।।
output: "Sita! You can go to Shatrughna or else Sugriva or even Rakshasa Vibheeshana, wherever you feel like to live."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
न हित्वांरावणोदृष्टवादिव्यरूपांमनोरमाम् । मर्षयेतचिरंसीतेस्वगृहेपर्यवस्थिताम् ।।6.118.24।।
output: सीते Sita, दिव्यरूपाम् wonderful appearance, मनोरमाम् beautiful, स्वगृहे his own house, चिरम् long, पर्यवस्थिताम् resisted, त्वाम् you, दृष्टवा seeing, रावणः Ravana, नमर्षयेतहि not have detained

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
एवमुक्तातुवैदेहिपरुषंरोमहर्षणम् । राघवेणसरोषेणश्रुत्वाप्रव्यथिताऽभवत् ।।6.119.1।।
output: Vaidehi heard the harsh horripilating words spoken by Rama in anger and was very much afflicted.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सातदश्रुतपूर्वंहिजनेमहतिमैथिली । श्रुत्वाभर्तृर्वचोरूक्षंलज्जयावनताभवत् ।।6.119.2।।
output: तदा then, सामैथिली she, Mythili, महति large number, जने people, अश्रुतपूर्वम् filled with tears, घोरम् ruthless, भर्तुः husband 's, वचःwords, श्रुत्वा hearing, लज्जया shy, अवनता bent, अभवत् stayed

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
प्रविशन्तीवगात्राणिस्वानिसाजनकात्मजा । वाक्षरैस्स्सैःसशल्येवभृशमाश्रूण्यवर्तयत् ।।6.119.3।।
output: As if pierced by those arrowlike words, Janaka's daughter shed tears excessively, shrinking into her own limbs.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततोबाष्पपरिक्लिन्नंप्रमार्जन्तीस्वमाननम् । शनैर्गद्गदयावाचाभर्तारमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.119.4।।
output: ततः thereafter, बाष्पपरिक्लिन्नम् flowing tears clean, स्वम् her, आननम् face, प्रमार्जन्ती wiping off, भर्तारम् to husband, गद्गदया in broken tone, वाचा words, शनैः slowly, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
किंमामसदृशंवाक्यमीदृशंश्रोत्रदारुणम् । रूक्षंश्रावयसेवीर प्राकृतःप्राकृतमिव ।।6.119.5।।
output: "Hero! Why are you addressing me in such harsh unkind words in a rude manner, in a harsh tone like a common man?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न तथास्मिमहाबाहो यथामामवगच्छसि । प्रत्ययंगच्छमेस्वेनचारित्रेणैवतेशपे ।।6.119.6।।
output: "O Mighty armed! I am not as you think of me, so also show me a proof of it in my past. I swear on my past."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
पृथकस्त्रीणांप्रचारेणजातिंत्वंपरिशङ्कसे । परित्यजैनांशङ्कांतुयदितेऽहंपरीक्षिता ।।6.119.7।।
output: "You give up judging all womankind by the path followed by vulgar women. You give up these doubts if you have examined."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
यदहंगात्रसम्पर्शंगतास्मिविशवाप्रभो । कामकारो न मेतत्रदैवंतत्रापराध्यति ।।6.119.8।।
output: प्रभो Lord, विवशा helpless, अहम् I am, गात्रसम्पर्शम् touching the limbs, गता in the past, अस्मि by me, इतियत् all this, तत्र there, मे to me, कामकारः acting at will, न not, तत्र there, दैवम् fate, अपराध्यति to be blamed

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
मदधीनंतुयत्तन्मेहृदयंत्वयिवर्तते । पराधीनेषुगात्रेषुकिंकरिष्याम्यनीश्वरी ।।6.119.9।।
output: यत् that which, मदधीनम् mind under my control, तत् that, मे is my, हृदयंतु heart, त्वयि you, वर्तते abides, पराधीनेषु at others' mercy, गात्रेषु limbs, अनीश्वरी not possible, किम् what, करिष्यामि can I do

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
सहसम्वृद्धभावेनसंसर्गेण च मानद । यदितेऽहं न विज्ञाताहतातेनास्मिशाश्वतम् ।।6.119.10।।
output: "Honourable Rama! If I am not understood by you despite our growing up together with love and in spite of our intimate relationship, I am done forever."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
प्रेषितस्तेमहावीरोहनुमानवलोककः । लङ्कास्थाहंत्वयाराजन्किंतदा न विसर्जिता ।।6.119.11।।
output: "King! When the great hero Hanuman was sent by you to find me in Lanka, why did you not leave me then."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रत्यक्षंवानरस्यास्यतद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम् । त्वयासन्त्यक्तयावीरत्यक्तंस्याजजीवितंमया ।।6.119.12।।
output: "O hero! Had you given me up immediately on receiving your message from Vanara I would have given up my life in the presence of Hanuman there itself."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न वृथातेश्रमोऽयंस्यात्संशयेन्यस्यजीवितम् । सुहृज्जनपरिक्लेशो न चायंविपुलस्तव ।।6.119.13।।
output: "O Life! If you had a doubt this exertion to you is wasteful. This fruitless hard work was perhaps not required on your part nor your friends."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वयातुनृपशार्दूलदोषमेवानुवर्तता । लघुनेवमनुष्येणस्त्रीत्वमेवपुरस्कृतम् ।।6.119.14।।
output: "O tiger among kings! You also gave up yourself to anger like a weak man and adopted womanliness"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
न प्रमाणीकृतंपाणिर्भाल्येममनिपीडितः । ममभक्तिश्चशीलं च सर्वंतेपृष्ठतःकृतम् ।।6.119.16।।
output: "When in my young age you held my hand as a mark of acceptance (in our marriage), has it not been considered by you? Has my devotion, character and chastity not been taken into account?"

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
इतिब्रुवन्तीरुदतीबाष्पगद्गगभाषिणी । उवाचलक्ष्मणंसीतादीनंध्यानपरायणम् ।।6.119.17।।
output: Thus speaking, and weeping with tears, with choked throat, Sita was absorbed in her mind and piteous. She spoke to Lakshmana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
चितांमेकुरुसौमित्रेव्यवनस्यास्यभेषजम् । मिध्यापवादोपहतानाहंजीवितुमुत्सहे ।।6.119.18।।
output: "Saumithri! Cure for this sorrow is only pyre. Arrange for pyre as I do not desire to live with false reproaches."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
अप्रीतेनगुणैर्भर्त्रात्यक्तायाजनसंसदि । याक्षमामेगतिर्गन्तुंप्रवेक्ष्येहव्यवाहनम् ।।6.119.19।।
output: "When my husband is not pleased with my virtues, renounces me in the gathering of people, I have only that path for me, that is, entering fire and offering myself as oblation."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
एवमुक्तस्तुवैदेह्यालक्ष्मणःपरवीरहा । अमर्षवशमापन्नोराघवंसमुदैक्षत ।।6.119.20।।
output: Spoken in that manner by Vaidehi, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemies, overcome with indignation looked at Raghava.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
स विज्ञायततश्छन्दंरामस्याकारसूचितम् । चितांचकारसौमित्रिर्मतेरामस्यवीर्यवान् ।।6.119.21।।
output: Understanding Rama's indication from his looks, Saumithri started to prepare the earth for pyre.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
नहिरामंतदाकश्चित्कालान्तकयमोपमम् । अनुनेतुमथोवक्तुंद्रष्टुंवाप्यशकत्सुहृत् ।।6.119.22।।
output: Indeed, no friend or dear could see or speak or make a request or pacify Rama. at that time.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अधोमुखंस्थितंरामंततःकृत्वाप्रदक्षिणम् । उपावर्ततवैदेहीदीप्यमानंहुताशनम् ।।6.119.23।।
output: Thereafter, Vaidehi, walking clockwise near Rama went round him in accordance with tradition and approached the pyre.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
प्रणम्यदैवतेभ्यश्चब्राह्मणेभ्यश्चमैथिली । बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाचेदमुवाचानगिसमीपतः ।।6.119.24।।
output: मैथिली Mythili, दैवतेभ्यश्च even to gods, ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च brahmanas, प्रणम्य greeting with joined palms, अनगिसमीपतः near fire, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा again joining her palms, इदम् this, उवाच च spoke

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथामेहृदयंनित्यंनापसर्पतिराघवात् । तथालोकस्यसाक्षीमांसर्वतःपातुपावकः ।।6.119.25।।
output: "If it is true that my heart has never slid from Raghava at all, may the fire god protect me always and so also the world witness."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथामांशुद्धचरितांदुष्टांजानातिराघवः । तथालोकस्यसाक्षीमांसर्वतःपातुपावकः ।।6.119.26।।
output: "If in Rama's view, I am of impeccable conduct and so also if what he is seeing is not known to be true, let the world witness and fire god protect me."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
कर्मणामनसावाचायथानातिचराम्यहम् । राघवंसर्वधर्मज्ञंतथामांपातुपावकः ।।6.119.27।।
output: 'If I have ever acted or been unfaithful at heart or in speech and did not follow a righteous path with Rama, who is a knower of all virtues, let the fire god protect me."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
आदित्योभगवान्वायुर्धिशश्चन्द्रस्तथैव च । अहश्चापितथासन्ध्येरात्रिश्चपृथिवीतथआ ।।6.119.28।। यथान्येऽपिविजानन्तितथाचारित्रसंयुताम् ।
output: भगवान् O god, आदित्यः Aditya, वायुः wind god, दिशः god of the four quarters, तथैव च by you, चन्द्रः moon, अहश्चापि me, सन्ध्ये twilight, रात्रिश्च night, तथा so also, पृथिवी earth, अन्येऽपि and other gods, चारित्रसम्युताम् woman of character, विजानन्ति accept यथा similarly, तथा let it happen that way

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमुक्त्वातुवैदेहीपरिक्रम्यहुताशनम् । विवेशज्वलनंदीप्तंनिःशङ्केनान्तरात्मना ।।6.119.29।।
output: Having spoken in that way, Vaidehi went round fire fearlessly, absorbed with in herself and entered the flaming and burning fire.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 119:
नश्चसुमहांस्तत्रबालवृद्धसमाकुलः ।।6.119.30।। ददर्शमैथिलींदीप्तांप्रविशन्तींहुताशनम् ।
output: Young and old assembled there, and the gathering of people witnessed Mythili entering the flaming and burning fire.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सातप्तनवहेमाभातप्तकाञ्चनभूषणा ।।6.119.31।। पपातज्वलनंदीप्तंसर्वलोकस्यसन्निधौ ।
output: तप्तनवहेमाभा like polished gold, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणा like shining ornament of gold, सा she, सर्वलोकस्य total world, सन्निधौ presence, दीप्तम् flaming, ज्वलनम् glowing, पपात fell

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ददृशुस्तांविशालाक्षींपतन्तींहव्यवाहनम् ।।6.119.32।। सीतांसर्वाणिरूपाणिरुक्मवेदिनिभांतदा ।
output: विशालाक्षीम् large eyed goddess of fortune, हन्यवाहनम् on her vehicle, पतन्तीम् descending, रुक्मवेदिनिभाम् golden altar, तांसीताम् her, Sita, सर्वाणि all beings, रूपाणि forms, ददृशुः witnessed

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ददृशुस्तांमहाभागांप्रविशन्तींहुताशनम् ।।6.119.33।। सीतांकृत्स्नास्त्रयोलोकाःपुण्यामाज्याहुतीमिव ।
output: हुताशनम् fire, प्रविशन्तीम् entering, महाभागाम् noble, तांसीताम् Sita, कृत्स्नाः dark, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, पुण्याम् blessed, आज्याहुतीमिव like ghee offered to fire, ददृशुः witnessed

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
प्रचुक्रुशुःस्त्रियःसर्वास्तांदृष्टवाहव्यवाहवे ।।6.119.34।। पतन्तींसंस्कृतांमन्रन्स्सैर्वसोर्दारामिवाध्वरे ।
output: All the women who stood there fled, screaming on seeing Sita falling into fire, like the flow of ghee poured continuously into sacrificial fire reciting sacred verses by priests.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ददृशुस्तांत्रयोलोकादेवगन्धर्वदानवाः ।।6.119.35।। शस्तांपतन्तींनिरयेत्रिविवाद्धेवतामिव ।
output: All the Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas of the three worlds who witnessed her falling, extolled her as if goddess was falling from heaven into hell.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोहिदुर्मनाराम्श्रुत्वैवंवदतांगिरः । दध्यौमुहूर्तंधर्मात्माबाष्पव्याकुललोचनः ।।6.120.1।।
output: All gods witness Sita entering fire and seek the presence of Rama. Creator Brahma praises Rama as the glorious Narayana.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततोवैश्रवणोराजायमश्चपितृभिःसह । सहस्राक्षश्चदेवेशोवरुणश्चजलेश्वरः ।।6.120.2।। षडर्धनयन्श्रीमान्महादेवोवृषध्वजः । कर्तासर्वस्यलोकस्यब्रह्माब्रह्मविदांवरः ।।6.120.3।। एतेसर्वेसमागम्यविमानैस्सूर्यसन्निभैः । आगम्यनगरींलङ्कामभिजग्मुश्चराघवम् ।।6.120.4।।
output: Then king Kubera, son of Vysravana, Yama, with Devas, Indra of thousand eyes, Varuna, the god of waters, glorious six eyed MahaDeva, who has bull on his banner, the creator of all the worlds, foremost of creators, Brahma, all of them reached Lanka city and went towards Raghava.

output: ततः then, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Vysravana, पितृभिःसह with father, यमश्च Yama, देवेशः Devas, सहस्राक्षश्च Indra of thousand eyes, जलेश्वरः god of waters, वरुणश्च Varuna, षडर्धनयनःsix eyed, श्रीमान् glorious, वृषध्वजःVrshadwaja, महादेवः MahaDeva, सर्वस्य all, लोकस्य worlds, कर्ता creator, ब्रह्मविदाम् creators, वरःforemost, ब्रह्मा Brahma, एते all those, सर्वे all, समागम्य reached, सूर्यसन्निभैः closely resembling the sun in radiance, विमानैः aerial car, लङ्कांनगरीम् to Lanka city, आगम्य having reached, राघवम् Raghava, अभिजग्मुः went towards

instruction:

ततोवैश्रवणोराजायमश्चपितृभिःसह । सहस्राक्षश्चदेवेशोवरुणश्चजलेश्वरः ।।6.120.2।। षडर्धनयन्श्रीमान्महादेवोवृषध्वजः । कर्तासर्वस्यलोकस्यब्रह्माब्रह्मविदांवरः ।।6.120.3।। एतेसर्वेसमागम्यविमानैस्सूर्यसन्निभैः । आगम्यनगरींलङ्कामभिजग्मुश्चराघवम् ।।6.120.4।।
output: Then king Kubera, son of Vysravana, Yama, with Devas, Indra of thousand eyes, Varuna, the god of waters, glorious six eyed MahaDeva, who has bull on his banner, the creator of all the worlds, foremost of creators, Brahma, all of them reached Lanka city and went towards Raghava.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 120:
ततःसहस्ताभरणान्प्रगृह्यविपुलान्भुजान् । अब्रुवंस्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठाराघवंप्राञ्जलिंस्थितम् ।।6.120.5।।
output: Then foremost of gods adorned with ornaments in hands lifted up their long shoulders and greeted Raghava with joined palms and spoke as follows.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कर्तासर्वस्यलोकस्यश्रेष्ठोज्ञानवतांप्रभुः । उपेक्षसेकथंसीतांपतन्तींहव्यवाहने ।।6.120.6।। कथंदेवगणश्रेष्ठमात्मानंनावबुद्ध्यसे ।
output: सर्वस्य all sides, लोकस्य in the world, कर्ता creator, ज्ञानवताम् knowledgeable, श्रेष्ठः foremost, प्रभुः Lord, हव्यवाहने fire, पतन्तीम् falling, सीताम् Sita, कथम् how, उपेक्षसे looking, देवगणश्रेष्ठम् foremost of the hosts of Devas, आत्मानम् himself, कथम् how, नावबुद्ध्यसे not know?

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 120:
ऋतधामावसुःपूर्वंवसूनां च प्रजापतिः ।।6.120.7।। त्रयाणामपिलोकानामादिकर्तास्वयंप्रभुः ।
output: " Among the Vasus, you are the Rtadhama and the creator of the three worlds and the first creator and selfconstituted ruler."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
रुद्राणामष्टमोरुद्रस्साध्यानामपिपञ्चमः ।।6.120.8।। अश्विनौचापिकर्णौतेसूर्यचन्द्रामसौदृशौ ।
output: "You are the eighth among the Rudras, fifth among the Sadhyas, two Aswins are your ears, and the sun and moon are your eyes."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्तेचादौ च लोकानांदृश्यसे च परन्तप ।।6.120.9।। उपेक्षसे च वैदेहींमानुषःप्राकृतोयथा ।
output: परन्तप tormentor of enemies, लोकानाम् in the world, आदौ at the beginning, अन्ते च and at the end, दृश्यसे seen, प्राकृतः common, मानुषोयथा like the man, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, उपेक्षसे च looking as if you are ignorant

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
इत्युक्तोलोकपालैस्तैस्स्वामीलोकस्यराघवः ।।6.120.10।। अब्रवीत्त्रिदशश्रेष्ठान्रामधर्मभृतांवरः ।
output: लोकपालैः ruler of the world, इति this, उक्तः having said, लोकस्य world, स्वामी Lord, राघवः Raghava, धर्मभृताम् upholder of Dharma, वरः foremost, रामः Rama, त्रिदशश्रेष्ठान् supreme god, अब्रवीत् spoke

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
आत्मानंमानुषंमन्येरामंदशरथात्मजम् ।।6.120.11।। सोऽहंयस्ययतश्चाहंभगववंस्तद्भ्रवीतुमे ।
output: "I am Dasharatha's son, a human and thinking to be Rama. Tell me O divine creator, from where and whence I am here."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 120:
इतिब्रुवाणंकाकुत्स्थंब्रह्माब्रह्मविदांवरः ।।6.120.12।। अब्रवीच्छ्रुणुमेवाक्यंसत्यंसत्यपराक्रम ।
output: To Kakuthsa who spoke that way, creator Brahma replied, "O Lord of truthful prowess, listen to my true submission."

instruction:

भवान्नारायणोदेवःश्रीमांश्चक्रायुधःप्रभुः ।।6.120.13।। एकशृङ्गोवराहस्त्वंभूतभव्यसपत्नजित् ।
output: भवान् yourself, देवः divine, श्रीमान् glorious, चक्रायुधः wielder of discus, प्रभुः Lord, नाराणयः Narayana, त्वम् you, एकशृङ्गः single tusk, वराहः boar, भूतभव्यसपत्नजित् knower of past and future

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अक्षरंब्रह्मसत्यं च मध्येचान्ते च राघव ।।6.120.14।। लोकानांत्वंपरोधर्मोविष्वक्सेनश्चतुर्भुजः ।
output: "You are the imperishable Brahma in the midst or end, abiding in truth. You are dharma, all pervading four shouldered Vishnu in the world."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शार्ङ्गधन्वाहृषीकेशःपुरुषःपुरुषोत्तमः ।।6.120.15।। अजितःखङ्गदृग्विष्णुःकृष्णश्चैवमहाबलः ।
output: शार्ङ्गधन्वा wielder of Saranga bow, हृषीकेशः subduer of senses, पुरुषः man, पुरुषोत्तमः supreme person, अजितः never faced defeat, खङ्गभृत् wielder of sword, विष्णुः Vishnu, कृष्णश्चैव Krishna also, महाबलः mighty

instruction:

सेनानीर्ग्रामणीश्चत्वंत्वंबुद्धिस्त्वंक्षमादमः ।।6.120.16।। प्रभवश्चाप्ययश्चत्वमुपेन्द्रोमधुसूदनः ।
output: त्वम् you, सेनानीः commander of the army of gods (Karthikeya), ग्रामणीश्च head of village, त्वम् you, बुद्धिः intellect, त्वम् you, क्षमा forbearance, दमः sense control, त्वम् you, प्रभवः origin, अप्ययश्च and end, उपेन्द्रःVamana, मधुसूदनः destroyer of demon Madhu

instruction:

इन्द्रकर्मामहेन्द्रस्त्वंपद्मनाभोरणान्तकृत् ।।6.120.17।। शरण्यंशरणं च त्वामाहुर्दिव्यामहर्षयः ।
output: त्वम् you, इन्द्रकर्मा creator of Indra, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, पद्मनाभः Padmanabha, who has a lotus sprung from his navel, रणान्तकृत् who puts an end to combat, दिव्याः wonderful, महर्षयःgreat sage, त्वाम् you, शरण्यम् refuge, शरणम् of seekers, आहुः spoken of

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सहस्रशृङ्गोवेदात्माशरशीर्षोमहर्षभः ।।6.120.18।। त्वंत्रयाणांहिलोकानामादिकर्तास्वयम्प्रभुः । सिद्धानामपिसाध्यानामाश्रयश्चासिपूर्वजः ।।6.120.19।।
output: "You are the self of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred divisions. You are the beginning of the three worlds and end. You are the selfshining. You are the Siddha among the achievers and their refuge as well as their protector."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सहस्रशृङ्गोवेदात्माशरशीर्षोमहर्षभः ।।6.120.18।। त्वंत्रयाणांहिलोकानामादिकर्तास्वयम्प्रभुः । सिद्धानामपिसाध्यानामाश्रयश्चासिपूर्वजः ।।6.120.19।।
output: "You are the self of Vedas with its thousand branches and hundred divisions. You are the beginning of the three worlds and end. You are the selfshining. You are the Siddha among the achievers and their refuge as well as their protector."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वम्यज्ञस्त्वंवषटकारस्त्वमोङ्कारःपरात्परः ।।6.120.20।। प्रभवंनिधनंवातेनोविदुःकोभवानिति ।
output: "You are the form of sacrifice ritual you are worshipped by Vasat. You are the syllable OM. Only the highest of the higher know you. You are without a beginning or end. Who you are is not known to Vedas also?"

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
दृश्यसेसर्वभूतेषुगोषु च ब्राह्मणेषु च ।।6.120.21।। दिक्षुसर्वासुगगनेपर्वतेषुनदीषु च ।
output: "You are seen in cows and brahmanas. You exist in all quarters, in the sky, mountains and rivers."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सहस्रचरण्श्रीमान् शतशीर्षस्सहस्रदृक् ।।6.120.22।। त्वंधारयसिभूतानिपृथिवीं च सपर्वताम् ।
output: "You are endowed with thousand feet, glorious, with hundred heads and hundred eyes, you sustain all beings, mountains and earth."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अन्तेपृथिव्याःसलिलेदृश्यसेत्वंमहोरगः ।।6.120.23।। त्रीन्लोकान्धारयन् राम देवगन्धर्वदानवान् ।
output: राम Rama, पृथिव्याः on earth, अन्ते end, सलिले in waters, त्वम् you, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, देवगन्धर्वदानवान् Devas, Gandharvas and Danavas, धारयन् sustain, महोरगः great serpent, दृश्यसे seen

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अहंतेहृदयंरामजिह्वादेवीसरस्वती ।।6.120.24।। देवारोमाणिगात्रेषुब्रह्मणानिर्मिताःप्रभो ।
output: "Rama, all gods constitute your heart, Devi Saraswathi is your tongue, the gods created by Brahma are the hair on your limbs."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
निमेषस्तेस्मृतारात्रिरुन्मेषोदिवसस्तथा ।।6.120.25।। संस्कारास्त्वभवन्वेदानैतदस्तित्वयाविना ।
output: ते your, निमेषः closing your eyelids, रात्रिः night, स्मृता death, तथा so also, उन्मेषः open the eyelids, दिवसः day, संस्काराः perfection in action, वेदाः Vedas, त्वयाविना without you, एतत् all this, नास्ति not there

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जगत्सर्वंशरीरंतेस्थैर्यंतेवसुथातलम् ।।6.120.26।। अग्निःकोपःप्रसादस्तेसोम्श्रीवत्सलक्षणः ।
output: "The total world represents your body, your firmness represents the earth, your anger is fire, your grace is nobility, a sign of Srivatsa."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वयालोकास्त्रयःक्रान्ताःपुरास्वैर्विक्रमैस्त्रिभिः ।।6.120.27।। महेन्ध्रश्चकृतोराजाबलिंबद्ध्वासुदारुणम् ।
output: "Before you took the form of Trivikrama, and took three strides, occupied the three worlds and bound the dreadful king Bali you made Mahendra as king of heaven."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 120:
सीतालक्ष्मीर्भवान् विष्णुर्देवःकृष्णःप्रजापतिः ।।6.120.28।। वधार्थंरावणस्येहप्रविष्टोमानुषींतनुम् ।
output: "Sita is goddess Lakshmi while you are Vishnu. You are Krishna. You are the Lord of created beings. In order to put an end to Ravana, you entered the mortal body on earth."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 120:
तदिदंनस्त्वयाकार्यंकृतंधर्मभृतांवर ।।6.120.29।। निहतोरावणोरामप्रहृष्टोदिवमाक्रम ।
output: "Rama you are the supreme and upholder of dharma. The purpose for which you are born has been accomplished. Ravana is killed. You return to your abode happily."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अमोघंदेववीर्यंते न तेमोघाःपराक्रमाः ।।6.120.30।। अमोघंदर्शनंरामअमोघस्तवसंस्तवः ।
output: देव O God, ते your, वीर्यम् valour, अमोघम् wonderful, ते your, पराक्रमाः prowess, मोघाः astonishing, न never goes vain, रामदर्शनम् your sight, अमोघम् unfailing, तव your, संस्तवः praise, अमोघःwill never go in vain

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 120:
अमोघास्तेभविष्यन्तिभक्तिमन्तोनराभुवि ।।6.120.31।। येत्वांदेवंध्रुवंभक्ताःपुराणंपुरुषोत्तमम् । प्राप्नुवन्तिसदाकामनिहलोकेपरत्र च ।।6.120.32।।
output: "Those mortals who are devoted to you, the supreme god, will be very successful. You are eternal, supreme being. Your devotees in this world and other world will always attain the desired results."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 120:
अमोघास्तेभविष्यन्तिभक्तिमन्तोनराभुवि ।।6.120.31।। येत्वांदेवंध्रुवंभक्ताःपुराणंपुरुषोत्तमम् । प्राप्नुवन्तिसदाकामनिहलोकेपरत्र च ।।6.120.32।।
output: "Those mortals who are devoted to you, the supreme god, will be very successful. You are eternal, supreme being. Your devotees in this world and other world will always attain the desired results."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 121:
एतच्छ्रुत्वाशुभंवाक्यंपितामहसमीरितम् । अङ्केनादायवैदेहिमुत्पपातविभावसुः ।।6.121.1।।
output: On hearing creator Brahma's address to Rama, fire god emerged picking auspicious Vaidehi in his arms.

instruction:

output: Then the fire god taking human form emerged from the fire immediately,with Janaka's daughter shaking off the fire sticks.

instruction:

output: Radiating like the rising sun, adorned with polished gold ornaments, wearing red coloured clothes, with beautiful black hair, wearing fresh flowers, being in the same young form as before, blameless Vaidehi was held in the arms of the fire god and presented to Rama.

instruction:

output: Then the fire god who is a witness in the world, spoke to Rama," Here is your wife Vaidehi and she does not know any sin."

instruction:

output: "Sita is of good conduct and auspicious. To you who are endowed with valour, she is faithful by speech, by intention of thought and intellect and even by glance."

output: "Mythili is of untainted mind and a sinless one. Take her back without any reply, I am ordering you."

instruction:

output: Then the supremely righteous Rama, who is good at speaking rejoiced at heart, his eyes filled with tears, thought for a moment.

output: Rama who is endowed with valour and firmness, and an upholder of dharma, a supreme person said to Brahma.

instruction:

output: सीता Sita, अवश्यम् surely, त्रिषुलोकेषु in the three worlds, पापम् sin, न अर्हति not done, शुभा auspicious, इयम् this, रावणान्तःपुरे in the gynaeceum of Ravana, दीर्घकालोषिताहि lived for log time

output: "The people will surely say that mighty Dasharatha's son, Rama being lusty at heart has accepted Janaki without testing."

instruction:

output: "I also know that Mythili is ever coming around me with undivided love and is devoted to me."

instruction:

output: "Naturally she is selfeffulgent and can protect herself. Will Ravana be able to violate broad eyed Janakijust as the great ocean can't cross the bounds."

output: "It could not be possible for the evil minded Rakshasa to access or lay thoughts on Mythili who was glowing like flames of fire."

output: "The dread of Ravana in all the worlds which caused gloom and fear has been fortunately removed by you in the war."

output: "Comforting piteous Bharata, illustrious Kausalya and Kaikeyi too, seeing Lakshmana's mother Sumithra, and attaining sovereignty, make relatives happy. Establishing Ikshvaku race, conducting horse sacrifice and satisfying the Lord attain highest renown by giving wealth in charity to brahmins. You, who are endowed with mighty prowess, deserve to go to heaven", said Lord Maheswara.

output: "O Kakuthsa! Here is your father, teacher in the mortal world, king Dasharatha seated in the aerial car."

output: Raghava along with Lakshmana offered salutations to his father seated on top of the aerial chariot after listening to Lord MahaDeva.

output: Raghava with his younger brother Lakshmana saw his father who was effulgent, blazing and adorned in white clothes.

output: "Rama separated from you, even the suras and sages honouring me in heaven does not give me happiness. It is true and I promise."
