output: द्विजातिमुख्यैः foremost of brahmins, सनैगमैः together, श्रेणीमुख्यैश्च foremost leaders, माल्यमोदकहस्तै: having garlands and Modakas (kind of sweet which is white in colour) in hand, मन्त्रिभिः ministers also, वृतः surrounded, धर्मात्मा righteous, शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च with sounds of conches and drums, वन्दिभिश्च with bards praising, अभिनन्तितः greeting, धर्मकोविदः knowledgeable of responsibilities, उपवासकृशः emaciated by fasting, दीनः desperate, चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः wearing bark clothes and a skin of antelope, भ्रातुः brother, आगमनम् returning, श्रुत्वा hearing, तत्पूर्वम् before that, हर्षम् joy, आगतः experienced, महात्मा great soul, भरतः Bharata, आर्यपादौ sandals of noble Rama, शिरसा on head, गृहीत्वा taking, शुक्लमाल्योपशोभितम् decorated with white garlands, पाण्डुरम् yellow, छत्रम् umbrella, राजार्हे worthy of kings, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, शुक्ले white, वालव्यजने whisks, आदाय taking, सचिवैःसह with friends, तदा then, प्रत्युद्ययौ went to receive

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
द्विजातिमुख्यैर्धर्मात्माश्रेणीमुख्यैस्सनैगमैः ।।6.130.16।। माल्यमोदकहस्तैश्चमन्त्रिभिर्भरतोवृतः । शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्चवन्दिभिश्चाभिवनन्दितः ।।6.130.17।। आर्यपादौगृहीत्वातौशिरसाधर्मकोविदः । पाण्डुरंछत्रमादायशुक्लमाल्योपशोभितम् ।।6.130.18।। शुक्ले च वालव्यजनेराजार्हेहेमभूषिते । उपवासकृशोदीनश्चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः ।।6.130.19।। भ्रातुरागमनंश्रुत्वातत्पूर्वंहर्षमागतः । प्रत्युद्ययौतदारामंमहात्मासचिवैस्सह ।।6.130.20।।
output: Then the foremost of brahmins, leaders with garlands and Modaka sweets in hand, surrounded by ministers went with righteous Bharata, accompanied by bards praising, accompanied by sounds of blowing conches and drums and greeting. Bharata was emaciated due to fastings, was desperate, wearing bark fabric and skin of antelope. The great soul Bharata, knower of righteous responsibilities, greeting, experienced great joy, on hearing about the returning of the brother. Decorated with white garlands, he carried Rama's sandals on his head. His friends accompanied him and took with him a yellow umbrella adorned with gold, worthy of kings and white whisks. Bharata went to receive Sri Rama.

instruction:

अश्वानांखुरशब्दैश्चरथनेमिस्वनेन च । शङ्खदुन्दुभिनादेनसञ्चचालेवमेदिनी ।।6.130.21।।
output: The earth shook by the sounds of hooves of the horses, sounds of conches and drums, and the rattling of the chariot wheels.

instruction:

output: Reviewing the arrangements, Bharata spoke these words to wind god's son, Hanuman.

instruction:

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
अथैवमुक्तेवचनेहनूमानिदमब्रवीत् । अर्थ्यंविज्ञापयन्नेवभरतंसत्यविक्रमम् ।।6.130.24।।
output: And then Bharata having spoken that way, Hanuman understood the meaning of his words and spoke thus.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
सदाफलान्कुसुमितान्वृक्षान् प्राप्यमधुस्रवान् । भरद्वाजप्रसादेनमत्तभ्रमरनादितान् ।।6.130.25।। तस्यचैषवरोदत्तोवासवेनपरन्तप । ससैन्यस्यतवातिथ्यंकृतंसर्वगुणान्वितम् ।।6.130.26।। निस्स्वन्श्रूयतेभीमःप्रहृष्टानांवनौकसाम् । मन्येवानरसेनासानदींतरतिगोमतीम् ।।6.130.27।।
output: "By the grace of Bharadwaja, all the trees have fruits shedding sweet juice, and in bloom, the Vanaras are very delighted. The forest rangers are making terrific sounds. The tormentor of enemies, endowed with all virtues, by virtue of the boon given by Indra extended hospitality to the Vanara army. I think they are crossing the river Gomathi now."

instruction:

output: "See the rain of dust started at Sala Forest. Vanaras are shaking the beautiful Sala grove, I think."

instruction:

output: Pushpaka is seen at a distance, resembling the moon. This wonderful Pushpaka has been created through Brahma's mind.

instruction:

output: "Rama's vehicle is amazing, and he got it by killing Ravana and his relatives. It shines brightly like the rising sun, and it speeds at the thought of mind. Kubera got this aerial car by Brahma's grace."

instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

instruction:

आपितोविमानंतद्भरतस्सत्यविक्रमः ।।6.130.38।। राममासाद्यमुदितःपुनरेवाभ्यवादयत् ।
output: Bharata of unfailing valour duly permitted to ascend Pushpaka by Sri Rama, reached Rama and once again offered salutations to Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
तंसमुत्थाप्यकाकुत्स्थश्चिरस्याक्षिरथंगतम् ।।6.130.39।। अङ्केभरतमारोप्यमुदितःपरिषस्वजे ।
output: Kakuthsa Rama happily lifting up Bharata, who came into his sight after long, on to his thigh embraced him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
ततोलक्ष्मणमासाद्यवैदेहीं च परन्तपः ।।6.130.40।। अथाभ्यवादयप्रतीतोभरतोनामचाब्रवीत् ।
output: Then the tormentor of enemies, Bharata approached Lakshmana and then greeted Vaidehi and announced his name.

instruction:

instruction:

सुषेणं च नलंचैवगवाक्षंगन्धमादनम् ।।6.130.42।। शरभंपनसंचैवपरितःपरिषस्वजे ।
output: He embraced Sushena, Nala, Gavaksha, Gandhamadana, Sarabha, Panasa who were around.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तेकृत्वामानुषंरूपंवानराःकामरूपिणः ।।6.130.43।। कुशलंपर्यपृच्छंस्तेप्रहृष्टाभरतंतदा ।
output: Then he inquired about the welfare of those Vanaras who can take any form at will, who were in human form and was delighted.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रस्सुग्रीवंवानरर्षभम् ।।6.130.44।। परिष्वज्यमहातेजाभरतोधर्मिणांवरः ।
output: And thereafter highly brilliant, foremost among the righteous, prince Bharata embraced Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras and spoke.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
त्वम्स्माकंचतुर्णांवैभ्रातासुग्रीवपञ्चमः ।।6.130.45।। सौहार्दाज्जायतेमित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम् ।
output: "Sugriva, you are the fifth brother to four of us and should have been born like that" said Bharata. One who helps becomes friend and maleficence is a sign of an enemy.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
विभीषणं च भरतःसान्त्ववाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।।6.130.46।। दिष्ट्यात्वयासहायेनकृतंकर्मसुदुष्करम् ।
output: And then Bharata spoke this good word. "Luckily with your help, the very difficult task was done."

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
शत्रुघ्नश्चतदाराममभिवाद्यसलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.130.47।। सीतायाश्चरणौवीरोविनयादभ्यवादयत् ।
output: Then hero Shatrughna and Lakshmana also greeted Rama and then worshipped Sita also.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
रामोमातरमासाद्यविवर्णांशोककर्शिताम् ।।6.130.48।। जग्राहप्रणतःपादौमनोमातुःप्रहर्षयन् ।
output: Rama reached his mother who was pale and emaciated in grief and offered salutations clasping her feet in obedience and was delighted in his mind.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
अभिवाद्यसुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम् ।।6.130.49।। स मात्रूश्चततस्सर्वापुरोहितमुपागमत् ।
output: Then he greeted Sumitra, and illustrious Kaikeyi also and then all the mothers and the priests who had come.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स्वागतंतेमहाबाहोकौसल्यानन्दवर्धना ।।6.130.50।। इतिप्राञ्जलयःसर्वेनागराराममब्रुवन् ।
output: "Welcome to you mighty armed Rama, enhancer of Kausalya's joy" saying so citizens of the city spoke with folded hand s greeting Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
तान्यञ्जलिसहस्राणिप्रगृहीतानिनागरैः ।।6.130.51।। व्याकोचानीवपद्मानिददर्शभरताग्रजः ।
output: The citizens in thousands greeting Rama, elder brother of Bharata lifting up their hand s with folded palms seemed like lotus buds.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
पादुकेतेतुरामस्यगृहीत्वाभरतस्स्वयम् ।।6.130.52।। चरणाभ्यांनरेन्द्रस्ययोजयामासधर्मवित् ।
output: Taking the sandals given to Bharata, the knower of dharma put on the sandals on Rama's feet by himself.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अब्रवीच्चतदारामंभरतः स कृताञ्जलिः ।।6.130.53।। एतत्तेसकलंराज्यंन्यासंनिर्यातितंमया ।
output: सःभरतः he, Bharata, कृताञ्जलिः greeting with folded palms, तदा then, रामम् to Rama, अब्रवीच्च spoke, न्यासम् held in trust, ते to you, सकलम् everything, एतत् this, राज्यम् kingdom, मया by me, निर्यातितम् returned

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
अद्यजन्मकृतार्थंमेसम्वृत्तश्चमनोरथः ।।6.130.54।। यत्त्वांपश्यामिराजानमयोध्यांपुनरागतम् ।
output: Today my life is fulfilled, my wish is completed. I am seeing you returned to Ayodhya again as king of this kingdom.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अवेक्षतांभवान्शोकंकोष्ठागारंगृहंबलम् ।।6.130.55।। भवतस्तेजसासर्वंकृतंदशगुणंमया ।
output: You may review your treasury, granary, palaces, army. Everything has increased tenfold by me by virtue of your brilliance.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
तथाब्रुवाणंभरतंदृष्टवातंभ्रातृवत्सलम् ।।6.130.56।। मुमुचुर्वानराबाष्पंराक्षसश्चविभीषणः ।
output: Seeing Bharata, the lover of his brother, who spoke like that, the Vanaras, Rakshasas, and Vibheeshana shed tears.

instruction:

ततःप्रहर्षाद्भरतमङ्गमारोप्यराघवः ।।6.130.57।। ययौतेनविमानेनससैन्योभरताश्रमम् ।
output: ततः then, राघवः Raghava, प्रहर्षात् rejoiced, भरतम् Bharata, अङ्कम् thigh, आरोप्य lifted up, ससैन्यः that army, भरताश्रमम् from Bharata's hermitage, ययौ flew

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
भरताश्रममासाद्यससैन्योराघवस्तदा ।।6.130.58।। अवतीर्यविमानाग्रादवतस्थेमहीतले ।
output: तदा then, राघवः Raghava, भरताश्रमम् Bharata's hermitage, आसाद्य alighted, ससैन्यः that army, विमानाग्रात् top of Pushpaka, अवतीर्य landed, महीतले on ground, अवतस्थे stood

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अब्रवीत्तुतदारामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।।6.130.59।। वहवैश्रवणंदेवमनुजानामिगम्यताम् ।
output: तदा then, रामः Rama, अनुत्तमम् best, तत् that, विमानम् Pushpaka, अब्रवीत् told, देवम् god, वैश्रवणम् Vysravana, वह there अनुजानामि permit, गम्यताम् to go

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 130:
ततोरामाभ्यनुज्ञातंतद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।।6.130.60।। उत्तरांदिशमुद्दिश्यजगामधनदालयम् ।
output: That aerial car duly permitted by Rama rose up to go to Kubera and set out in the northern direction and flew.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विमानंपुष्पकंदिव्यंसम्गृहीतंतुरक्षसा ।।6.130.61।। अगमद्धनदंवेगाद्रामवाक्यप्रचोदितम् ।
output: That wonderful Pushpaka received from Rakshasa impelled by Rama's order speedily went to Kubera.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधायकैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनः । बभाषेभरतोज्येष्ठंरामंसत्यपराक्रमम् ।।6.131.1।।
output: कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of Kaikeyi's joy, भरतः Bharata, शिरसि head, अञ्जलिम् folded hands, आधाय submitted, सत्यपराक्रमम् unfailing valour, ज्येष्ठम् to elder, रामम् Rama, बभाषे spoke

instruction:

पूजितामामिकामातादत्तंराज्यमिदंमम । तद्ददामिपुनस्तुभ्यंयथात्वमददामम ।।6.131.2।।
output: मामिका mine, माता mother, पूजिता worshipped, इदंराज्यम् this kingdom, मम myself, दत्तम् bestowed, तत् that, त्वम् to you, मम me, यथा as it is, आददाः returning, पुनः again, तुभ्यम् and now, ददामि giving

instruction:

output: बलीयसा strong, एकाकिना alone, वृषभेण young ox, न्यस्ताम् transferred to, धुरम् burden, किशोरवत् like young, गुरुम् heavy, भारम् burden, अहम् I, वोढुम् bull, न उत्सहे not able to bear

वारिवेगेनमहताभिन्नस्सेतुरिवक्षरन् । दुर्बन्धनमिदंमन्येराज्यच्छ्रिदमसम्वृतम् ।।6.131.4।।
output: "If the kingdom containing vulnerable points is not protected on all sides, it can't stand, just as a strong rush of water can be prevented from breach only by constructing a dam.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
गतिंखरइवाश्वस्यहंसस्येव च वायसः । नान्वेतुमुत्सहेराम तवमार्गमरिन्दम ।।6.131.5।।
output: "O Rama! Donkey can't run like horse crow can't run like swan. I am not able to bear the burden of kingdom like you, O tormentor of enemies."

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यथाचारोपितोवृक्षोजातश्चार्न्न्तिवेशने । महांश्चसुदुरारोहोमहास्कन्दःप्रशाखवान् ।।6.131.6।। शीर्येतपुष्पितोभूत्वा न फलानिप्रदर्शयन् । तस्यनानुभवेदर्थंयस्यहेतोस्सरोपितः ।।6.131.7।। एषोपमामहाबाहोत्वमर्थंवेत्तुमर्हसि । यद्यस्मान्मनुजेन्द्रत्वंभर्ताभृत्यान्नशाधिहि ।।6.131.8।।
output: "If for example you have planted a tree in your own house, it becomes huge and difficult to climb in spite of a large trunk, many branches and after flowering does not yield fruits and is withered, the person who planted will not enjoy the fruit. In that way O mighty armed Rama, you are the ruler of the people, if you would not take care of us, your dependants, I solicit you ought to understand what I mean.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
जगदद्याभिषिक्तंत्वामनुपश्यतुराघव । प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यंमध्याह्नेदीप्ततेजसम् ।।6.131.9।।
output: "Raghava, let you be consecrated in the afternoon and the world will see you dazzling in brilliance like the sun today."

instruction:

तूर्यसङ्घान्तिर्घोषैःकाञ्चीनूपुरनिःस्वनैः । मधुरैर्गीतशब्दैश्चप्रतिबुध्यस्वशेष्व च ।।6.131.10।।
output: तूर्यसङ्घान्तिर्घोषैः sounds of musical instruments, काञ्चीनूपुरनिःस्वनैः tinkling of ornaments strung with tiny bells, मधुरैः sweet, गीतशब्दैश्च sounds of singing, प्रतिबुध्यस्व worn around waist and anklets, शेष्व च and sweet

instruction:

यावदावर्ततेचक्रंयावती च वसुन्धरा । तावत्त्वमिहलोकस्यस्वामित्वमनुवर्तय ।।6.131.11।।
output: As long as the stellar sphere goes round, and as long as the earth revolves around that long you enjoy the rulership of the world."

instruction:

भरतस्यवच्श्रुत्वारामःपरपुरञ्जयः । तथेतिप्रतिजग्राहनिषसादासनेशुभे ।।6.131.12।।
output: Hearing Bharata's words, the conqueror of enemies, Rama said 'Be it so'. Then Bharata took the auspicious seat.

instruction:

ततश्शत्रुघ्नवचनान्निपुणाःश्मश्रुवर्धनाः । सुखहस्ताःसुशीघ्राश्चराघवंपर्यवारयन् ।।6.131.13।।
output: Then at the command of Shatrughna's words, experts with hand work (barbers) who had soft skills quickly surrounded Raghava.

instruction:

पूर्वंतुभरतेस्नातेलक्ष्मणे च महाबले । सुग्रीवेवानरेन्द्रे च राक्षसेन्द्रेविभीषणे ।।6.131.14।। विशोधितजटस्स्नातश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः । महार्हवसनोपेतस्तस्थौतत्रश्रियाज्वलन् ।।6.131.15।।
output: Bharata had his bath first, and mighty Lakshmana, Sugriva the monkey king, and Vibheeshana the Rakshasa king followed him. Sri Rama removed the matted hair, had bath, adorned with colourful garlands, and daubed with sandal paste and clothed in exquisite robes stood glowing and shining.

instruction:

पूर्वंतुभरतेस्नातेलक्ष्मणे च महाबले । सुग्रीवेवानरेन्द्रे च राक्षसेन्द्रेविभीषणे ।।6.131.14।। विशोधितजटस्स्नातश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः । महार्हवसनोपेतस्तस्थौतत्रश्रियाज्वलन् ।।6.131.15।।

instruction:

प्रतिकर्म च रामस्यकारयामासवीर्यवान । लक्ष्मणस्य च लक्ष्मीवानिक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनः ।।6.131.16।।
output: Then valiant and prosperous, Shatrughna, who is an enhancer of the glory of Ikshvaku race decorated Sri Rama and Lakshmana (duly with ornaments).

instruction:

प्रतिकर्मचसीतायास्सर्वादशरथस्त्रियः । आत्मनैवतदाचक्रुर्मनस्विन्योमनोहरम् ।।6.131.17।।
output: तदा then, सर्वाः all, मनस्विन्यः nobleminded, दशरथस्त्रियः Dasharatha's wives, सीतायाः for Sita, मनोहरम् beautiful, प्रतिकर्म decoration, आत्मनैव themselves, चक्रुः did

instruction:

ततोवानरपत्नीनांसर्वासामेवशोभनम् । चकारयत्नात्कौसल्याप्रहृष्टापुत्रवत्सला ।।6.131.18।।
output: The very delighted Kausalya, lover of her sons started making effort to decorate the wives of all Vanaras in a splendid manner.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
तत: श्शत्रुघ्नवचनात्सुमन्त्रोनामसारथिः । योजयित्वाभिचक्रामरथंसर्वाङ्गशोभनम् ।।6.131.19।।
output: Then Sumantra the charioteer, commanded by Shatrughna came there with all parts of the chariot decorated and yoked.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
अर्कमण्डलसङ्काशंदिव्यंदृष्टवारथंस्थितम् । आरुरोहमहाबाहूरामःपरपुरंञ्जयः ।।6.131.20।।
output: Seeing the wonderful chariot like the radiance of the planet sun, mighty armed Rama the conqueror of hostile enemies ascended.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सुग्रीवोहनुमांश्चैवमहेन्द्रसदृशद्युती । स्नातौदिव्यनिभैर्वस्त्रैर्जग्मतुश्शुभकुण्डलौ ।।6.131.21।।
output: Sugriva and Hanuman having bathed wore sparkling earrings, clothed in heavenly robes vied with Mahendra in splendour, started.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वाभरणजुष्टाश्चयुयुस्तश्शुभकुण्डलाः । सुग्रीवपत्नयःसीता च द्रष्टुंनगरमुत्सुकाः ।।6.131.22।।
output: Sugriva's wife and Sita decked with all kinds of ornaments and earrings, enthused to see the city, started.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
अयोध्यायांतुसचिवाराज्ञोदशरथस्य च । पुरोहितंपुरस्कृत्यमन्त्रयामासुरर्थवत् ।।6.131.23।।
output: At Ayodhya also, king Dasharatha's ministers, priests started to Vasishta and thought of the required arrangements.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
अशोकोविजयश्चैवसिद्धार्थश्चसमाहिताः । मन्त्रयन्रामवृध्यर्थंबुध्यर्थंनगरस्य च ।।6.131.24।।
output: Ashoka, Vijaya, Siddhartha, collected together and started consulting with each other for the growth of Rama and the City.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
सर्वमेवाभिषेकार्थंजयार्हस्यमहात्मनः । कर्तुमर्हथरामस्ययद्यन्मङ्गलपूर्वकम् ।।6.131.25।।
output: For the success of the great soul Rama's consecration, whatever was auspicious, all that ought to be done as he deserves.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
इतितेमन्त्रिणस्सर्वेसन्दिश्य च पुरोहितम् । नगरान्निर्ययुस्तूर्णंरामदर्शनबुद्धयः ।।6.131.26।।
output: All those ministers, priests thus communicating with each other, speedily set forth to have a glance at Sri Rama.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
हरियुक्तंसहस्राक्षोरथमिन्द्रइवानघः । प्रययौरथमास्थायरामोनगरमुत्तमम् ।।6.131.27।।
output: Like the thousand eyed Indra seated in the excellent chariot yoked to green horses, the sinless Rama departed to the city.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
जग्राहभरतोरमशीन्शत्रुघ्नश्चत्रमाददे । लक्ष्मणोव्यजनंतस्यमूर्ध्निसम्पर्यवीजयत् ।।6.131.28।। श्वेतं च वालव्यजनंजगृहेपरितस्स्थितः । अपरंचन्द्रसङ्काशंराक्षसेन्द्रोविभीषणः ।।6.131.29।।
output: Bharata held the reins, Shatrughna took hold of the parasol, Lakshmana standing in front held the fan, and the Rakshasa king Vibheeshana held a white whisk which was like a moon for driving the air.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
जग्राहभरतोरमशीन्शत्रुघ्नश्चत्रमाददे । लक्ष्मणोव्यजनंतस्यमूर्ध्निसम्पर्यवीजयत् ।।6.131.28।। श्वेतं च वालव्यजनंजगृहेपरितस्स्थितः । अपरंचन्द्रसङ्काशंराक्षसेन्द्रोविभीषणः ।।6.131.29।।
output: Bharata held the reins, Shatrughna took hold of the parasol, Lakshmana standing in front held the fan, and the Rakshasa king Vibheeshana held a white whisk which was like a moon for driving the air.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ऋषिसङ्घैस्तदाकाशेदेवैश्चसमरुद्गणैः । स्तूयमास्यरामस्यशुश्रुवमधुरध्वनिः ।।6.131.30।।
output: Then the host of sages, Rudras and gods from the heaven started praising Rama with sweet sounding chanting.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ततःशत्रुञ्जयंनामकुञ्जरंपर्वतोपमम् । आरुरोहमहातेजास्सुग्रीवःप्लवगर्षभः ।।6.131.31।।
output: Then resplendent Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras, ascended the mountain like elephant by the name Satrumjaya.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
नवनागसहस्राणिययुरास्थायवानराः । मानुषंविग्रहंकृत्वासर्वाभरणभूषिताः ।।6.131.32।।
output: Assuming human semblance, the Vanaras adorned with ornaments ascended nine thousand elephants and departed.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
शङ्खशब्दप्रणादैश्चदुन्दुभीनां च निस्स्वनैः । प्रययौपुरुषव्याघ्रस्तांपुरींहर्म्यमालिनीम् ।।6.131.33।।
output: Sri Rama the tiger among men went accompanied by sounds of blasts of conches and shouts and roll of drums along the rows of mansions in the city.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
ददृशुस्तेसमायान्तंराघवंसपुरस्सरम् । विराजमानंवपुषारथेनातिरथंतदा ।।6.131.34।।
output: Then they saw all those who had gone to Ayodhya coming in advance in accordance with tradition, to receive Rama, the great car warrior, who was shining brightly advancing by the chariot.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
तेवर्थयित्वाकाकुत्स्थंरामेणप्रतिनन्दिताः । अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानंभ्रातृभिःपरिवारितम् ।।6.131.35।।
output: They were blessing Sri Rama in turn and Rama responded to them very happily. Surrounded by brothers and all followed Rama the great soul.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अमात्यैर्ब्राह्मणैश्चैवतथाप्रकृतिभिर्ववृतः । श्रियाविरुरुचेरामोनक्षत्ररिवचन्द्रमाः ।।6.131.36।।
output: अमात्यैः ministers, ब्राह्मणैश्चैव brahmins, तथा so also, प्रकृतिभिः common people, वृतः surrounded, रामः Rama, नक्षत्रैः star, चन्द्रमाःइव like moon, श्रिया glorious, विरुरुचे shone brightly.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
स पुरोगामिभिस्तूर्यैस्तालस्वस्तिकपाणिभिः । प्रव्याहरद्भिर्मुदितैर्मङ्गलानिवृतोययौ ।।6.131.37।।
output: He went forward surrounded by bands, trumpets, wooden cymbals and swastikas and very happily singing auspicious festive songs.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
अक्षतंजातरूपं च गावःकन्यास्सहद्विजाः । नरामोदकहस्ताश्चरामस्यपुरतोययुः ।।6.131.38।।
output: Taking yellow rice (rice smeared with turmeric) appearing like gold, cows, virgin women, brahmins with Modakas in hand went before Rama.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
सख्यं च रामस्सुग्रीवेप्रभावंचानिलात्मजे । वानराणां च तत्कर्मह्याचचक्षेऽऽथमन्त्रिणाम् ।।6.131.39।।
output: Rama narrated about his friendship with Sugriva and the distinct performance of Hanuman and Vanaras to the ministers.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
श्रुत्वा च विस्मयंजग्मुरयोध्यापुरवासिनः । वानराणां च ततकर्मराक्षसानां च तद्बलम् ।।6.131.40।।
output: Hearing about the action of Vanaras and the strength of Rakshasas, the citizens of Ayodhya were astonished.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
विभीषणस्यसम्योगमाचचक्षेऽथमन्त्रिणाम् । द्युतिमानेतदाख्यायरामोवानरसम्युतः ।।6.131.41।। हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णमयोध्यांप्रविवेशसः ।
output: Sri Rama narrated about Vibheeshana's friendship to the ministers. Splendorous Rama then entered Ayodhya filled with very happy people accompanied by Vanaras.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
ततोह्यभ्युच्छ्रयन्पौराःपताकाश्चगृहेगृहे ।।6.131.42।। ऐक्ष्वाकुध्युषितंरम्यमाससादपितुर्गृहम् ।
output: The citizens of Ayodhya held the flags up in every house. Thereupon Rama reached the beautiful home of his father, the abode of the Ikshvaku dynasty.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रोभरतंधर्मिणांवरम् ।।6.131.43।। अर्धोपहितयावाचामधुरंरघुनन्दनः । पितुर्भवनमासाद्यप्रविश्य च महात्मनः ।।6.131.44।। कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीमभिवाद्य च ।
output: अथ and then, राजपुत्रः prince, रघुनन्दनः the joy of Raghus, महात्मनः great soul, पितुः father, भवनम् mansion, आसाद्य reached, कौसल्यां च and Kausalya's, सुमित्रां च and Sumitra's, कैकेयीं च and Kaikeyi's, अभिवाद्य च greeted them, धर्मिणाम् virtuous, परम् supreme, भरतम् Bharata, अर्थोपहितया meaningful, वाचा words, मधुरम् sweet tone, अब्रवीत् spoke

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रोभरतंधर्मिणांवरम् ।।6.131.43।। अर्धोपहितयावाचामधुरंरघुनन्दनः । पितुर्भवनमासाद्यप्रविश्य च महात्मनः ।।6.131.44।। कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीमभिवाद्य च ।
output: And thereafter prince Rama, the joy of Raghus, the great soul reached father's mansion and then to Kausalya's and to Sumitra, to Kaikeyi and greeted them. He then spoke meaningful words to virtuous Bharata in a sweet tone.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
यच्छमद्भवनंश्रेष्ठंसाशोकवनिकंमहत् ।।6.131.45।। मुक्तावैदूर्यसङ्कीर्णंसुग्रीवायनिवेदय ।
output: Let the splendid, excellent mansion attached to Ashoka grove, encrusted with cat's eye gems and pearls be placed at the disposal of Sugriva.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वाभरतस्सत्यविक्रमः ।।6.131.46।। हस्तेगृहीत्वासुग्रीवंप्रविवेशतमालयम् ।
output: ततः then, सत्यविक्रमःupright, भरतःBharata, तस्य his, तत् वचनम् that words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, हस्ते hand, गृहीत्वा taking, तम् to him आलयम् that temple like abode, प्रविवेश entered

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
तत: स्स्सैलप्रदीपांश्चपर्यङ्कास्तरणानि च ।।6.131.47।। गृहीत्वाविविशुःक्षिप्रंशत्रुघ्नेप्रचोदिताः ।
output: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नेन by Shatrughna, प्रचोदिताः commanded, तैलप्रदीप्तांश्च glowing oil lamps, पर्यङ्कास्तरणानि च coverlets for the couches, गृहीत्वा taking, क्षिप्रम् quickly, विविशुःentered

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उवाच च महातेजास्सुग्रीवंराघवानुजः ।।6.131.48।। अभिषेकायरामस्यदूतानाज्ञापयप्रभो ।
output: Highly brilliant Sugriva said to Bharata, "Let envoys be sent for the consecration of Rama."

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
सौवर्णान्वानरेन्द्राणांचतुर्णांचतुरोघटान् ।।6.131.49।। ददौक्षिप्रंससुग्रीवस्सर्वरत्नविभूषितान् ।
output: स: he, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, क्षिप्रम् instantly, चतुर्णाम् four, वानरेन्द्राणाम् Vanara leaders, सौवर्णान् golden, सर्वरत्नविभूषितान् well decorated, चतुरः four, घटान् pots, ददौ gave

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
यथाप्रत्यूषसमयेचतुर्णांसागराम्बसाम् ।।6.131.50।। पूर्णघटैःप्रतीक्षध्वंतथाकुरुतवानराः ।
output: Sugriva gave four pots to the four of the Vanaras to get them filled with the water of the four oceans and get them by early morning and said to await for him.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
एवमुक्तामहात्मानोवानरावारणोपमाः ।।6.131.51।। उत्पेतुर्गगनंशीघ्रंगरुडाइवशीघ्रगाः ।
output: Having spoken like that by Sugriva, the Vanaras of mountainlike forms fled like Garuda into the sky quickly.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
जाम्बवांश्चहनूमांश्चवेगदर्शी च वानरः ।।6.131.52।। ऋषभश्चैवकलशान्जलपूर्णानथानयन् । नदीशतानांपञ्चानांजलंकुम्भैरुपाहरन् ।।6.131.53।। पूर्वात्समुद्रात्कलशंजलपूर्णमथानयत् । सुषेणस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ।।6.131.54।।
output: Jambavan, Hanuman, Vegadarsa and Rshaba brought pots of water from the seas. Another five hundred monkeys brought five hundred pots from five hundred rivers of the country. Jambavan richly endowed with courage brought in a pot encrusted with all kinds of gems. Sushena brought water from the eastern sea.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
जाम्बवांश्चहनूमांश्चवेगदर्शी च वानरः ।।6.131.52।। ऋषभश्चैवकलशान्जलपूर्णानथानयन् । नदीशतानांपञ्चानांजलंकुम्भैरुपाहरन् ।।6.131.53।। पूर्वात्समुद्रात्कलशंजलपूर्णमथानयत् । सुषेणस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ।।6.131.54।।
output: Jambavan, Hanuman, Vegadarsa and Rshaba brought pots of water from the seas. Another five hundred monkeys brought five hundred pots from five hundred rivers of the country. Jambavan richly endowed with courage brought in a pot encrusted with all kinds of gems. Sushena brought water from the eastern sea.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
जाम्बवांश्चहनूमांश्चवेगदर्शी च वानरः ।।6.131.52।। ऋषभश्चैवकलशान्जलपूर्णानथानयन् । नदीशतानांपञ्चानांजलंकुम्भैरुपाहरन् ।।6.131.53।। पूर्वात्समुद्रात्कलशंजलपूर्णमथानयत् । सुषेणस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ।।6.131.54।।
output: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavantha, हनूमांश्च Hanuman, वेगदर्शी Vegadarsa, वानरः Vanara, ऋषभश्चैव Rshaba, कलशा pots, न्जलपूर्णा filled with sea water, नथानयन् different rivers, नदीशतानां a hundred rivers, पञ्चानां five, जलंwater, कुम्भैरुपाहरन् brought in pots, अथ and then, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with courage, सुषेणः Sushena, पूर्वात् eastern समुद्रात् ocean, सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, जलपूर्णम् pot filled with water, कलशम् pot, आनयत् brought

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ऋषभोदक्षिणात्तूर्णंसमुद्राज्जलमानयत् । रक्तचन्दनशाखाभिस्सम्वृतंकाञ्चनंघटम् ।।6.131.55।।
output: ऋषभः Rshaba, दक्षिणात् समुद्रात् from southern sea, रक्तचन्दनशाखाभिः covered with red sandal paste, संवृतम् covered, काञ्चनम् golden, घटम् pot, जलम् water, तूर्णम् quickly, आनयत् brought

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
गवयःपश्चिमात्तोयमाजहारमहार्णवात् । रत्नकुम्भेनमहताशीतंमारुतविक्रमः ।।6.131.56।।
output: मारुतविक्रमःexpert like wind god, गवयः Gavaya, महता great, रत्नकुम्भेन pot encrusted with gems, पश्चिमात् west sea, महार्णवात् great abode of varuna, शीतम् cold, तोयम् water, आजहार brought

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
उत्तराच्चजलंशीघ्रंगरुडानिलविक्रमः । आजहार स धर्मात्मानलःसर्वगुणान्वितः ।।6.131.57।।
output: Nala who vied with Garuda in speed, a righteous one, endowed with all virtues quickly brought water from the north.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
ततस्तैर्वानरश्रेष्ठैरानीतंप्रेक्ष्यतज्जलम् । अभिषेकायरामस्यशत्रुघ्नस्सचिवैस्सह ।।6.131.58।। पुरोहितायश्रेष्ठायसुहृद्भ्यश्चन्यवेदयत् ।
output: ततः then, सचिवैःसह along with ministers, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकाय for the consecration, तैः they, वानरश्रेष्ठैः foremost of Vanaras, आनीतम् brought by, तत् that, जलम् water, श्रेष्ठाय supreme, पुरोहिताय priest, सुहृद्भ्यः च friends, न्यवेदयत् placed

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
ततस्सप्रयतोवृद्धोवसिष्ठोब्राह्मणैःसह ।।6.131.59।। रामंरत्नमयेपीठेससीतंसन्नयवेशयत् ।
output: Then accompanied by brahmins, sage Vasishta, active though aged, asked Sita and Sri Rama to occupy the plank made with full of precious stones.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
वसिष्ठोवामदेवश्चजाबालिरथकाश्यपः ।।6.131.60।। कात्यायनोसुयज्ञश्चगौतमोविजयस्तथा । अभ्यषिञ्चन्नरव्याघ्रंप्रसन्नेनसुगन्धिना ।।6.131.61।। सलिलेनसहस्राक्षंवसवोवासवंयथा ।
output: Eight sages, Vasishta, Vama Deva, Jabali, Kasyapa, Katyayana, Suyajna, Gautama and Vijaya consecrated Sri Rama, the tiger among men, with pure fragrant waters as the Vasus consecrated the thousand eyed Indra.

instruction:

output: While Rama was ruling for thousands of years, people were blessed with thousands of sons and lived free from trouble and sorrow.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
प्रीयतेसततंरामस्सहिविष्णुस्सनातनः । आदिदेवोमहाबाहुर्हरिन्नारायणःप्रभुः ।।6.131.120।। साक्षाद्रामोरघुश्रेष्ठश्शेषोलक्ष्मणउच्यते ।
output: Rama is said to be ever pleased with him who listens or reads the Ramayana daily. Foremost of Raghus, the mighty armed Rama is eternal Lord Vishnu himself. He is Hari, the ruler Narayana and Lakshmana is Sesha.

instruction:
Summarize the key idea behind this verse:
एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तमाख्यानंभद्रमस्तुवः ।।6.131.121।। प्रव्याहरतविस्रब्धंबलंविष्णोःप्रवर्थताम् ।
output: This way Ramayana is the ancient narration. Read it daily with trust and devotion. You be auspicious and let the strength of Vishnu grow in you.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
देवाश्चसर्वेतुष्यन्तिग्रहणाच्छ्रवणात्तथा ।।6.131.122।। रामायणस्यश्रवणेतुष्यन्तिपितस्सदा ।
output: By grasping and listening to Ramayana, all gods will be delighted, ancestors will be pleased.

instruction:
Explain this verse from Yuddha Kanda, Sarga 131:
भक्त्यारामस्ययेचेमांसंसितामृषिणाकृताम् ।।6.131.123।। येलिखन्ती ह च नरास्तेषांवासस्त्रिविष्टपे ।
output: Residence in heaven is assured for those who transcribe this Ramayana with devotion and full of meaning, composed by the great sage.

instruction:
Translate this Sanskrit verse to English:
कुटुम्बवृद्धिंधनधान्यवृद्धिंस्त्रियश्चमुख्यास्सुखमुत्तमं च । श्रुत्वाशुभंकाव्यमिदंमहार्थंप्राप्नोतिसर्वांभुविचार्थसिद्धम् ।।6.131.124।।
output: महार्थम् great meaning, शुभम् auspicious, काव्यम् epic, श्रुत्वा listening, कुटुम्बवृद्धिम् growth of the family, धनधान्यवृद्धिम् augmentation of wealth, grains, मुख्याः mainly, स्त्रियश्च women also, उत्तमम् excellent, सुखं च comfort, भुवि on earth, सर्वाम् all, अर्थसिद्धिं च accomplishment of one's objects, प्राप्नोति will result.
